//0112A.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

const char S[] = "Bulbasaur";

char s[100005];

int cnt[256], hh[256], ans = 10247445;

int main() {
	scanf("%s", s );
	for (int i = strlen(s) - 1; i > -1; i--) cnt[s[i]]++;
	for (int i = strlen(S) - 1; i > -1; i--) hh[S[i]]++;
	for (int i = 'z'; i >= 'A'; i--) {
		if (hh[i]) ans = min(ans, cnt[i] / hh[i]);
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

//0112B.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
int n, ans = 1;
int cnt[MAXN];
bool notprime[MAXN];

void init() {
	for (int i = 2; i <= 100000; i++) {
		if (!notprime[i]) {
			int ret = 0;
			for (int j = i; j <= 100000; j += i) {
				ret += cnt[j];
				notprime[j] = 1;
			}
			ans = max(ans, ret);
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", &x), cnt[x]++;
	init();
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

//0112D.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MOD 1000000007

int n;
char s[80];

int check(int l, int r) {
	int ret = (s[l]=='1');
	while (l++ != r) {
		ret = ret << 1 | (s[l] == '1');
	}
	return ret;
}
vector<int> dp[80];
int ans = 0, top[80], map[80][80];

int get(int x) {
	int k = 1;
	while (k <= x)  k <<= 1;
	return k - 1;
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	scanf("%s", s + 1);
	memset(map, -1, sizeof(map));
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
		for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
			map[i][j] = check(i, j) - 1;
			if (map[i][j] >= 20) {
				map[i][j] = -1;
				break;
			}
		}
	dp[0].resize(262144);
	dp[0][0] = 1;
	top[0] = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		dp[i].resize(262144);
		dp[i][0] = 1;
		top[i] = 0;
		for (int j = i; j; j--) {
			if (map[j][i] == -1) continue;
			int v = 1<<map[j][i];
			int q = j - 1;;
			top[i] = max(top[i], get(top[q]|v));
			if (dp[i].size() <= top[i]) dp[i].resize(top[i] + 1);
			for (int k = top[q]; k > -1; k--) if ((dp[i][k | v] += dp[q][k]) >= MOD) dp[i][k | v] -= MOD;
		}
		while (top[i] && !dp[i][top[i]]) top[i]--;
		for (int k = 1; k <= top[i]; k = ((k + 1) << 1) - 1) {
			if ((ans += dp[i][k]) >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

//0113C.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef unsigned long long LL;

#define P 2147483647
#define X 20000816
#define MOD 1000000007

int n, m;
LL a[1000005], f[1000005], ans = 1;

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
	for (int i = 1, g; i <= n; i++) {
		scanf("%d", &g);
		for (int j = 1, x; j <= g; j++) {
			scanf("%d", &x);
			a[x] = (a[x] * P + i) ^ X;
		}
	}
	sort(a + 1, a + m + 1);
	f[0] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
	for (int i = 1, j; i <= m; i = j) {
		j = i + 1;
		while (j <= m && a[j] == a[i]) j++;
		ans = (ans * f[j - i]) % MOD;
	}
	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}

//0117A.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

#define MOD 1000000007
#define Modadd(x, y) if ((x += y) >= MOD) x -= MOD

int n;
char s[105];
int Dp[105][2505];
bool vis[105][2505];

int dp(int x, int y) {
	if (y < 0) return 0;
	if (!y) return 1;
	if (!x && y) return 0;
	if (vis[x][y]) return Dp[x][y];
	vis[x][y] = 1;
	for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) Modadd(Dp[x][y], dp(x - 1, y - i));
	return Dp[x][y];
}

void work() {
	scanf("%s", s + 1);
	n = (int) strlen(s + 1);
	int sum = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum += s[i] - 'a';
	printf("%d\n", (dp(n, sum) + MOD - 1) % MOD);
}

int main() {
	int T;
	scanf("%d", &T);
	while (T--) work();
	return 0;
}

//0117B.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL n, N, m, MOD, ans = 1;
int f[100005];

int getf(int x) {
	if (f[x] < 0) return x;
	else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
	int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
	if (fu != fv) {
		if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
		f[fu] += f[fv];
		f[fv] = fu;
	}
}

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
	LL ret = 1;
	while (p) {
		if (p & 1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
		p >>= 1;
		x = (x * x) % MOD;
	}
	return ret;
}

int main() {
	cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = -1;
	for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) cin>>u>>v, merge(u, v);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (f[i] < 0) N++, ans = (ans * (-f[i])) % MOD;
	if (N == 1) cout << 1 % MOD << endl;
	else cout << (ans * power(n, N - 2)) % MOD << endl;
	return 0;
}

int getf(int x) {
	if (f[x] < 0) return x;
	else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
	int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
	if (fu != fv) {
		if (f[fu] < f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
		f[fu] += f[fv];
		f[fv] = fu;
	}
}

vector <int> a;

int main() {
	cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = -1;
	for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) cin>>u>>v, merge(u, v);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (f[i] < 0) a.push_back(-f[i]);
	int tot = a[0];
	for (int i = 1; i < a.size(); i++) ans = ((ans * a[i]) % MOD * tot) % MOD, tot += a[i];

}

//0117C.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int n, ans = 0;
vector <int> a[100005];

int main() {
	cin >> n;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		int k, x;
		cin >> k;
		while (k--) {
			cin >> x;
			a[i].push_back(x);
		}
		sort(a[i].begin(), a[i].end());
	}
	a[0] = a[n];
	a[n + 1] = a[1];
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		for (int j = 1; j < a[i].size(); j++) {
			if (upper_bound(a[i - 1].begin(), a[i - 1].end(), a[i][j]) - lower_bound(a[i - 1].begin(), a[i - 1].end(), a[i][j - 1]) != upper_bound(a[i + 1].begin(), a[i + 1].end(), a[i][j]) - lower_bound(a[i + 1].begin(), a[i + 1].end(), a[i][j - 1])) ans++;
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

//0117D.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

struct Rg {
	int l, r, v;
	Rg() {}
	Rg(int a, int b, int c) : l(a), r(b), v(c) {}
	bool operator < (Rg a) const {
		return v < a.v;
	}
	Rg operator + (Rg a) const {
		return Rg(l, a.r, v + a.v);
	}
	Rg operator - () const {
		return Rg(l, r, -v);
	}
};

struct Node {
	int l, r;
	bool lazy;
	Rg v, hd[2], ta[2], md[2];
} t[262144];

struct Ret {
	Rg v, hd, ta, md;
	Ret() {}
	Ret(Node x) : v(x.v), hd(x.hd[0]), ta(x.ta[0]), md(x.md[0]) {}
	Ret operator + (Ret a) const {
		Ret ret;
		ret.v = v + a.v;
		ret.hd = max(hd, v + a.hd);
		ret.ta = max(a.ta, ta + a.v);
		ret.md = max(max(max(md, a.md), ta + a.hd), max(ret.hd, ret.ta));
		return ret;
	}
};

int tcnt = 0;

#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r

void rev(int x) {
	Node to = t[x];
	to.v = -to.v;
	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
		to.hd[i] = -t[x].hd[i^1];
		to.ta[i] = -t[x].ta[i^1];
		to.md[i] = -t[x].md[i^1];
	}
	to.lazy ^= 1;
	t[x] = to;
}

void pushup(int x) {
	t[x].v = t[lch].v + t[rch].v;
	t[x].hd[0] = max(t[lch].hd[0], t[lch].v + t[rch].hd[0]);
	t[x].hd[1] = min(t[lch].hd[1], t[lch].v + t[rch].hd[1]);
	t[x].ta[0] = max(t[rch].ta[0], t[lch].ta[0] + t[rch].v);
	t[x].ta[1] = min(t[rch].ta[1], t[lch].ta[1] + t[rch].v);
	t[x].md[0] = max(max(max(max(t[lch].md[0], t[rch].md[0]), t[lch].ta[0] + t[rch].hd[0]), t[x].hd[0]), t[x].ta[0]);
	t[x].md[1] = min(min(min(min(t[lch].md[1], t[rch].md[1]), t[lch].ta[1] + t[rch].hd[1]), t[x].hd[1]), t[x].ta[1]);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
	if (t[x].lazy) {
		rev(lch);
		rev(rch);
		t[x].lazy = 0;
	}
}

int n, m;

int build(int l, int r) {
	int x = ++tcnt;
	if (l != r) {
		int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
		lch = build(l, mid);
		rch = build(mid + 1, r);
		pushup(x);
	} else {
		int v;
		scanf("%d", &v);
		t[x].v = Rg(l, l, v);
		for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) t[x].hd[i] = t[x].ta[i] = t[x].md[i] = t[x].v;
	}
	return x;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
	if (l == r) {
		t[x].v = Rg(l, l, v);
		for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) t[x].hd[i] = t[x].ta[i] = t[x].md[i] = t[x].v;
		return;
	}
	pushdown(x);
	int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
	if (p <= mid) update(lch, l, mid, p, v);
	else update(rch, mid + 1, r, p, v);
	pushup(x);
}

void Rev(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
	if (l == ql && r == qr) {
		rev(x);
		return;
	}
	pushdown(x);
	int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
	if (ql <= mid) Rev(lch, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
	if (qr > mid) Rev(rch, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
	pushup(x);
}

Ret query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
	if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x]);
	pushdown(x);
	int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
	if (qr <= mid) return query(lch, l, mid, ql, qr);
	else if (ql > mid) return query(rch, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
	else return query(lch, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(rch, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

Rg sta[50];
int top = 0;

void Query(int l, int r, int k) {
	int ans = 0;
	Ret tmp;
	while (k-- && (tmp = query(1, 1, n, l, r)).md.v > 0) {
		sta[++top] = tmp.md;
		ans += sta[top].v;
		Rev(1, 1, n, sta[top].l, sta[top].r);
	}
	while (top) {
		Rev(1, 1, n, sta[top].l, sta[top].r);
		top--;
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	build(1, n);
	scanf("%d", &m);
	for (int i = 1, op, l, r, k; i <= m; i++) {
		scanf("%d", &op);
		if (!op) {
			scanf("%d%d", &l, &k);
			update(1, 1, n, l, k);
		} else {
			scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &r, &k);
			Query(l, r, k);
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

//0118B.cpp
/* Never Say doubleie. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

double dp[1048576];
bool vis[1048576];
struct S {
	int x, dep;
	double ps;
	S () {}
	S (int a, int b, double c) : x(a), dep(b), ps(c) {}
};

queue <S> q;

int n, k;
double p[25], ans[25];

int main() {
	cin >> n >> k;
	int rln = n;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		cin >> p[i];
		if (p[i] < 1e-15) rln--;
	}
	k = min(k, rln);
	dp[0] = 1;
	q.push(S(0, 0, 1.0));
	while (!q.empty()) {
		S st = q.front();
		q.pop();
		if (st.dep >= k) continue;
		int x = st.x;
		double pp = st.ps;
		if (pp < 1e-10) continue;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (!(x & (1 << i))) {
				dp[x | (1 << i)] += dp[x] * (p[i] / pp);
				if (!vis[x | (1 << i)]) {
					vis[x | (1 << i)] = 1;
					q.push(S(x | (1 << i), st.dep + 1, pp - p[i]));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for (int i = (1 << n) - 1; i > -1; i--) {
		if (__builtin_popcount(i) == k) {
			for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
				if (i & (1 << j)) ans[j] += dp[i];
			}
		}
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) printf("%.15lf ", ans[i]);
	return 0;
}

//0118C.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

inline int max(int a, int b, int c, int d) {
	return max(max(a, b), max(c, d));
}

inline int min(int a, int b, int c) {
	return min(min(a, b), c);
}

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
	a = 0;
	while (ch != -1 && (ch < '0' || ch > '9')) ch = getchar();
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - 48;
		ch = getchar();
	}
}
inline void read(bool &a) {
	while (ch != -1 && (ch < '0' || ch > '9')) ch = getchar();
	a = (ch == '1');
	ch = getchar();
}
int tmp[15], *top = tmp;
inline void writeln(int a) {
	if (a) {
		while (a) {
			int d = a / 10;
			*(top++) = a - d * 10 + '0';
			a = d;
		}
		while (top != tmp) putchar(*(--top));
	} else putchar('0');
	putchar('\n');
}

int n, m;
bool a[1005][1005];
int dp[1005][1005], f[1005][1005][10][10];

void init() {
	read(n);
	read(m);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
		for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
			read(a[i][j]);
			f[i][j][0][0] = dp[i][j] = (a[i][j]) ? min(dp[i - 1][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]) + 1 : 0;
		}
	for (int k = 1; k < 10; k++) {
		int K = 1 << (k - 1), K_ = n - (1 << k) + 1;
		for (int i = 1; i <= K_; i++)
			for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
				f[i][j][k][0] = max(f[i][j][k - 1][0], f[i + K][j][k - 1][0]);
		K_ = m - (1 << k) + 1;
		for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
			for (int j = 1; j <= K_; j++)
				f[i][j][0][k] = max(f[i][j][0][k - 1], f[i][j + K][0][k - 1]);
	}
	for (int q = 1; q < 10; q++) {
		int Q = 1 << (q - 1), Q_ = n - (1 << q) + 1;
		for (int w = 1; w < 10; w++) {
			int W = 1 << (w - 1), W_ = m - (1 << w) + 1;
			for (int i = 1; i <= Q_; i++) {
				for (int j = 1; j <= W_; j++) {
					f[i][j][q][w] = max(f[i][j][q - 1][w - 1], f[i + Q][j][q - 1][w - 1], f[i][j + W][q - 1][w - 1], f[i + Q][j + W][q - 1][w - 1]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

int LOG_2(int x) {
	int ret = 0;
	while (x > 1) x >>= 1, ret++;
	return ret;
}

int check(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
	int xx = LOG_2(x2 - x1 + 1), yy = LOG_2(y2 - y1 + 1);
	int xt = x2 - (1 << xx) + 1, yt = y2 - (1 << yy) + 1;
	return max(f[x1][y1][xx][yy], f[x1][yt][xx][yy], f[xt][y1][xx][yy], f[xt][yt][xx][yy]);
}

void work() {
	int Q;
	read(Q);
	for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
		int x1, y1, x2, y2;
		read(x1);
		read(y1);
		read(x2);
		read(y2);
		int l = 0, r = min(y2 - y1, x2 - x1) + 1;
		while (l < r) {
			int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
			if (check(x1 + mid - 1, y1 + mid - 1, x2, y2) >= mid) l = mid;
			else r = mid - 1;
		}
		writeln(l);
	}
}

int main() {
	init();
	work();
	return 0;
}

//0118D.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

bool swaped = 0;

int query(int x1, int x2, int y1, int y2) {
	if (swaped) swap(x1, y1), swap(x2, y2);
	printf("? %d %d %d %d\n", x1, y1, x2, y2);
	fflush(stdout);
	int ret;
	scanf("%d", &ret);
	return ret;
}

int n;

pair<int, int> check() {
	int l = 0, r = n - 1;
	while (l < r) {
		int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
		if (query(1, n, 1, mid)) r = mid - 1;
		else l = mid;
	}
	return make_pair(l + 1 < n ? query(1, n, l + 2, n) : 0, l + 1);
}

struct Rect {
	int x1, x2, y1, y2;
	Rect() {}
	Rect(int a, int b, int c, int d) : x1(a), x2(b), y1(c), y2(d) {}
} A, B;

Rect work(int L, int R) {
	Rect ret;
	int l = L, r = R;
	while (l < r) {
		int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
		if (query(1, n, mid, R)) l = mid;
		else r = mid - 1;
	}
	ret.y1 = l;
	L = l;
	r = R;
	while (l < r) {
		int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
		if (query(1, n, L, mid)) r = mid;
		else l = mid + 1;
	}
	ret.y2 = l;
	R = l;
	l = 1, r = n;
	while (l < r) {
		int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
		if (query(mid, n, L, R)) l = mid;
		else r = mid - 1;
	}
	ret.x1 = l;
	int X = l;
	r = n;
	while (l < r) {
		int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
		if (query(X, mid, L, R)) r = mid;
		else l = mid + 1;
	}
	ret.x2 = l;
	return ret;
}

void printans() {
	if (swaped) swap(A.x1, A.y1), swap(B.x1, B.y1), swap(A.x2, A.y2), swap(B.x2, B.y2);
	printf("! %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n", A.x1, A.y1, A.x2, A.y2, B.x1, B.y1, B.x2, B.y2);
	fflush(stdout);
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	pair<int, int> ret = check();
	if (ret.first != 1) swaped = 1, ret = check();
	A = work(1, ret.second);
	B = work(ret.second + 1, n);
	printans();
	return 0;
}

//0119A.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 200005
#define U LL(-1e9 - 5)
#define D LL(MAXN * 1e9)
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
	int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN];

struct Node {
	int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 45];
int root = 0, tcnt = 0;
int n, a[MAXN], ans[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, fa[MAXN];
LL dep[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to = v;
	e[ecnt].next = head[u];
	e[ecnt].w = w;
	head[u] = ecnt;
}

void update(int &x, LL l, LL r, LL p) {
	if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
	t[x].v++;
	if (l != r) {
		LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
		if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
		else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
	}
}

int query(int x, LL l, LL r, LL ql, LL qr) {
	if (!x) return 0;
	if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
	LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
	int ret = 0;
	if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
	if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
	return ret;
}

void dfs(int x) {
	ans[x] -= query(root, U, D, U, dep[x]);
	for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, dfs(e[now].to);
	ans[x] += query(root, U, D, U, dep[x]);
	update(root, U, D, dep[x] - a[x]);
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d", &n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i);
	for (int i = 2, w; i <= n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d", fa + i, &w);
		add(fa[i], i, w);
	}
	dfs(1);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", ans[i]);
	return 0;
}

//0121A.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 200005
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
int n;
LD ans = 0;
LL sum[MAXN];

void check(char a[], char b[], char cmp) {
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		if (a[i] == cmp) ans += sum[i - 1] * (n - i + 1) * LD(6.0) / (LL(n) * LL(n + 1) * LL(2 * n + 1));
		sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (b[i] == cmp ? i : 0);
	}
}

char a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

void work(char cmp) {
	check(a, b, cmp);
	check(b, a, cmp);
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d%s%s", &n, a + 1, b + 1);
	for (char x = 'A'; x <= 'Z'; x++) work(x);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (a[i] == b[i]) ans += i * LL(n - i + 1) * LD(6.0) / (LL(n) * LL(n + 1) * LL(2 * n + 1));
	printf("%.9lf\n", (double)ans);
	return 0;
}

//0930C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 5005
#define MAXM 5005

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int dis[MAXN][MAXN],pre[MAXN][MAXN];

int n,m,T,ecnt=0;
int head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[u]=ecnt;
}
// ya 16384
queue<int> q;
inline void work() {
	dis[1][1]=1;
	q.push((1<<14) + 1);
	while (!q.empty()) {
		int x=q.front()>>14,y=q.front()&16383,st=(x<<14)+y,dd=dis[x][y];
		q.pop();
		if (dd>=T) continue;
		for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			int d=dis[e[now].to][y+1];
			if ((!d || d>dd+e[now].w)) {
				dis[e[now].to][y+1]=dd+e[now].w;
				pre[e[now].to][y+1]=st;
				q.push((e[now].to<<14)+y+1);
			}
		}
	}
}

int sta[MAXN],top=0;

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&T);
	for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
		add(u,v,w);
	}
	T++;
	work();
	int ans=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (dis[n][i] && dis[n][i]<=T) ans=i;
	}
	int x=n,y=ans;
	while (x!=1) {
		sta[++top]=x;
		int to=pre[x][y];
		x=to>>14,y=to&16383;
	}
	printf("%d\n1",ans);
	while (top) {
		printf(" %d",sta[top--]);
	}
	return 0;
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

long long C[25][25];

void init() {
	for (int i=0; i<=20; i++) {
		C[i][0]=1;
		for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
			C[i][j]=C[i-1][j]+C[i-1][j-1];
		}
	}
}

long long g[25][25][25];

int n=5,m=3,k;

int main() {
	init();
	for (k=0; k<=n*m; k++) {
		memset(g,0,sizeof(g));
		for (int i=0; i<=n; i++)
			for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
				long long s=0;
				for (int a=0; a<=i; a++)
					for (int b=0; b<=j; b++) {
						if (a!=i || b!=j) {
							s+=g[a][b][k]*C[i][a]*C[j][b];
						}
					}
				g[i][j][k]=(C[i*j][k]-s);
			}
		printf("ans %d : %lld\n",k,g[n][m][k]);
	}
	return 0;
}

//1014B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105
#define VAL 1000
bool notprime[VAL+5];
int prime[200],pcnt=0,cnt[200];

void init() {
	for (int i=2; i<=VAL; i++) {
		if (!notprime[i]) {
			prime[++pcnt]=i;
			for (int j=i*i; j<=VAL; j+=i) notprime[j]=1;
		}
	}
}

int gcd(int a,int b) {
	if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
	else return a;
}

int insert(int x) {
	for (int i=1; i<=pcnt && x>1; i++) {
		while (x%prime[i]==0) {
			x/=prime[i];
			cnt[i]++;
		}
	}
	return x;
}

int n,gpre,gnow;
int a[MAXN],need[MAXN],more[MAXN];

int WTF() {
	int ret=1;
	for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
		for (int j=n; j<=cnt[i]; j+=n) {
			ret*=prime[i];
		}
	}
	return ret;
}

struct data {
	int x,y,g;
	bool operator < (data qq) const {
		return g<qq.g;
	}
	data() {}
	data(int q,int w,int e):x(q),y(w),g(e) {}
};

priority_queue <data> q;

int work() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			int g=gcd(more[i],need[j]);
			if (g>1) {
				q.push(data(i,j,g));
			}
		}
	}
	int ret=0;
	while (!q.empty()) {
		data wtf=q.top();
		q.pop();
		if (gcd(more[wtf.x],need[wtf.y])!=wtf.g) continue;
		ret++;
		more[wtf.x]/=wtf.g;
		need[wtf.y]/=wtf.g;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			int g=gcd(more[wtf.x],need[i]);
			if (g>1) q.push(data(wtf.x,i,g));
		}
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			int g=gcd(more[i],need[wtf.y]);
			if (g>1) q.push(data(i,wtf.y,g));
		}
	}
	return ret;
}

int main() {
	init();
	scanf("%d",&n);
	gpre=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
		gpre=gcd(a[i],gpre);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		a[i]/=gpre;
		a[i]/=insert(a[i]);
	}
	gnow=WTF();
	printf("%d ",gpre*gnow);
	if (gnow==1) {
		printf("0\n");
		return 0;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		int g=gcd(gnow,a[i]);
		if (g!=gnow) {
			need[i]=gnow/g;
		} else {
			need[i]=1;
		}
		more[i]=a[i]/g;
	}
	printf("%d\n",work());
	return 0;
}

//1014C.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 300005
#define MAXC 10005
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}

struct node {
	int v,l,r;
} t[5000000];

int n,m,c,rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
	int now=++tcnt;
	t[now].l=t[x].l;
	t[now].r=t[x].r;
	t[now].v=t[x].v+1;
	if (l==r) return now;
	int mid=(l+r)>>1;
	if (p<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
	else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
	return now;
}

int k;

int query(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int p) {
	if (l==r) {
		int val=t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
		if (val>=k) return l;
		else return -1;
	}
	int val=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v,mid=(l+r)>>1;
	if (val>=p)
		return query(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,p);
	else
		return query(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,p-val);
}

int main() {
	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
	read(n);
	read(c);
	rt[0]=0;
	t[0].l=t[0].r=t[0].v=0;
	for (int i=1,val; i<=n; i++) {
		read(val);
		rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,c,val);
	}
	cerr<<tcnt<<endl;
	read(m);
	for (int i=1,l,r,ret; i<=m; i++) {
		read(l);
		read(r);
		k=(r-l+1)/2+1;
		ret=query(rt[l-1],rt[r],1,c,k);
		if (ret==-1) puts("no");
		else printf("yes %d\n",ret);
	}
	return 0;
}

//1014D.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

struct data {
	int x,v;
	bool operator < (data a) const {
		return v<a.v;
	}
	data() {}
	data(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
};

priority_queue <data> q;

int n,a[MAXN][MAXN],len[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN*MAXN],cnt=0;
int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",len+i);
		for (int j=1; j<=len[i]; j++) {
			scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
		}
		q.push(data(i,a[i][len[i]]));
	}
	while (!q.empty()) {
		data now=q.top();
		q.pop();
		ans[++cnt]=now.v;
		len[now.x]--;
		if (len[now.x]) q.push(data(now.x,a[now.x][len[now.x]]));
	}
	for (int i=cnt; i>1; i--) {
		printf("%d ",ans[i]);
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans[1]);
	return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 10005

int n,k,a[MAXN];

bool check(double ans) {
	double more=0,need=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (a[i]>=ans) more+=a[i]-ans;
		else need+=ans-a[i];
	}
	return (more*(100-k)/100.0-need>=-0);
}

int main() {
	freopen("energy.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("energy.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
	}
	double l=0,r=1001,mid;
	for (int t=64; t>0; t--) {
		mid=(l+r)/2.0;
		if (check(mid)) l=mid;
		else r=mid;
	}
	printf("%.9lf\n",l);
	return 0;
}

//1015B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205
#define MAXM 1005

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,ecnt,head[MAXN],ss[MAXM],scnt=0;

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
	memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
	ecnt=1;
}

struct statu {
	int x,v;
	statu() {}
	statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
};

queue <statu> q;
int dis[MAXN][MAXM];
bool inq[MAXN][MAXM];

void spfa(int st) {
	memset(dis,0,sizeof(dis));
	for (int i=1; i<=scnt; i++) {
		dis[st][i]=i;
		q.push(statu(st,i));
	}
	while (!q.empty()) {
		int x=q.front().x,maxv=q.front().v,minv=dis[x][maxv];
		q.pop();
		inq[x][maxv]=0;
		for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			int tomaxv=maxv,tominv=minv;
			if (e[now].w>maxv) tomaxv=e[now].w;
			else if (e[now].w<minv) tominv=e[now].w;
			if (dis[e[now].to][tomaxv]<tominv) {
				dis[e[now].to][tomaxv]=tominv;
				if (!inq[e[now].to][tomaxv]) {
					inq[e[now].to][tomaxv]=1;
					q.push(statu(e[now].to,tomaxv));
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

int find(int x) {
	int l=1,r=scnt,mid;
	while (l<r) {
		mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
		if (ss[mid]<=x) l=mid;
		else r=mid-1;
	}
	return l;
}

void work() {
	for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
		add(u,v,w);
		ss[i]=w;
	}
	sort(ss+1,ss+m+1);
	scnt=int(unique(ss+1,ss+m+1)-ss-1);
	ss[0]=-123456789;
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		int tag=find(e[i<<1].w);
		e[i<<1].w=e[(i<<1)^1].w=tag;
	}
	int Q;
	scanf("%d",&Q);
	for (int i=1,s,t; i<=Q; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",&s,&t);
		spfa(s);
		int ans=123456789;
		for (int j=1; j<=scnt; j++) {
			ans=min(ans,ss[j]-ss[dis[t][j]]);
		}
		if (ans<123456789) {
			printf("%d\n",ans);
		} else {
			printf("-1\n");
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	freopen("road.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("road.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF && n && m) {
		init();
		work();
		n=m=0;
	}
	return 0;
}

//1015C.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072

int n,d,a[MAXN],ret[MAXN];
int t[s<<1];

void init() {
	memset(t,0,sizeof(t));
	memset(ret,0,sizeof(ret));
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",a+i),a[i]+=2;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
	int ans=0;
	for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
		if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,t[l^1]);
		if (r&1) ans=max(ans,t[r^1]);
	}
	return ans;
}

void update(int x,int v) {
	x+=s;
	if (t[x]<v) {
		t[x]=v;
		for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=max(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)^1]);
	}
}

void work() {
	int ans=0;
	for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
		r=ret[i]+1;
		ans=max(ans,r);
		update(a[i],r);
		if (i+d<n) ret[i+d+1]=query(1,a[i+d+1]-1);
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
	freopen("seq.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("seq.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&d)!=EOF && n) {
		init();
		work();
		n=0;
	}
	return 0;
}

//1015D.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}

inline bool readop() {
	while (ch!='Q' && ch!='C') ch=getchar();
	return ch=='C';
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072

int n,m;

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int ecnt,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct chain_node {
	int top,dep,fa,maxs,son,size,tid;
} a[MAXN];

int rev[MAXN],dfn=0;

void finds(int x) {
	a[x].size=1;
	a[x].maxs=a[x].son=0;
	for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
		int v=e[now].to;
		if (v!=a[x].fa) {
			a[v].fa=x;
			a[v].dep=a[x].dep+1;
			finds(v);
			a[x].size+=a[v].size;
			if (a[v].size>a[x].maxs) {
				a[x].maxs=a[v].size;
				a[x].son=v;
			}
		}
	}
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
	a[x].tid=++dfn;
	rev[dfn]=x;
	a[x].top=anc;
	if (a[x].son) {
		link(a[x].son,anc);
		for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			if (e[now].to!=a[x].son && e[now].to!=a[x].fa) {
				link(e[now].to,e[now].to);
			}
		}
	}
}

int col[MAXN];
// Segment Tree
struct node {
	int head,tail,lch,rch,tot;
} t[s<<1];
struct line {
	int head,tail,tot;
	line() {}
	line(int z,int x,int c):head(z),tail(x),tot(c) {}
};

line merge(line x,line y) {
	line ret=line(x.head,y.tail,x.tot+y.tot);
	if (x.tail==y.head) ret.tot--;
	return ret;
}

void t_merge(int now) {
	t[now].head=t[t[now].lch].head;
	t[now].tail=t[t[now].rch].tail;
	t[now].tot=t[t[now].lch].tot+t[t[now].rch].tot;
	if (t[t[now].lch].tail==t[t[now].rch].head) t[now].tot--;
}

int tcnt=0,root;
int build(int l,int r) {
	int now=++tcnt;
	if (l==r) {
		t[now].lch=t[now].rch=0;
		t[now].head=t[now].tail=col[rev[l]];
		t[now].tot=1;
		return now;
	}
	int mid=(l+r)>>1;
	t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
	t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
	t_merge(now);
	return now;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
	t[t[x].lch].head=t[t[x].lch].tail=t[x].head;
	t[t[x].rch].head=t[t[x].rch].tail=t[x].tail;
	t[t[x].lch].tot=t[t[x].rch].tot=1;
}

line query(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
	if (l!=r && t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
		pushdown(x);
	}
	if (l==ql && r==qr) {
		return line(t[x].head,t[x].tail,t[x].tot);
	}

	int mid=(l+r)>>1;
	if (ql<=mid && qr>mid) {
		line lx=query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,mid),ly=query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,mid+1,qr);
		return merge(lx,ly);
	} else {
		if (ql<=mid) {
			return query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,qr);
		} else {
			return query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,ql,qr);
		}
	}
}

void modify(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,int v) {
	if (l==ql && r==qr) {
		t[x].head=t[x].tail=v;
		t[x].tot=1;
		return;
	}
	if (t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
		pushdown(x);
	}
	int mid=(l+r)>>1;
	if (ql<=mid) {
		modify(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid),v);
	}
	if (qr>mid) {
		modify(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
	}
	t_merge(x);
}

void change(int u,int v,int c) {
	while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
		if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
		modify(1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
		u=a[a[u].top].fa;
	}
	if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
	modify(1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
	while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
		if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
		u=a[a[u].top].fa;
	}
	if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
	return u;
}
line getLine(int x,int LCA) {
	bool flag=1;
	line ret;
	while (a[x].top!=a[LCA].top) {
		if (flag) {
			//		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
			ret=query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid);
			//		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
			flag=0;
		} else {
			//		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
			ret=merge(query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
			//		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
		}
		x=a[a[x].top].fa;
	}
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n",LCA,x);
	if (flag) return query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid);
	else return merge(query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
}

int ask(int u,int v) {
	int LCA=getLCA(u,v);
//	printf("%d\n",LCA);
	line lx=getLine(u,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",lx.head,lx.tail,lx.tot);
	line ly=getLine(v,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",ly.head,ly.tail,ly.tot);
	swap(ly.head,ly.tail);
	lx=merge(lx,ly);
	return lx.tot;
}

void init() {
	read(n);
	read(m);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		read(col[i]);
	}
	for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
		read(u);
		read(v);
		add(u,v);
	}
	a[1].fa=0;
	a[1].dep=1;
	finds(1);
	link(1,1);
	root=build(1,n);
}

void work() {
	for (int i=1,u,v,c; i<=m; i++) {
		if (readop()) {
			read(u);
			read(v);
			read(c);
			change(u,v,c);
		} else {
			read(u);
			read(v);
			printf("%d\n",ask(u,v));
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	freopen("paint.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("paint.out","w",stdout);
	init();
	work();
	return 0;
}

	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
	}
	int tot=2*n+1;
	if (n<=5000) {
		dis[1][1]=a[n];
		for (int i=2; i<=tot; i++) {
			dis[1][i]=dis[1][i-1]+a[n];
		}
		for (int t=2,now=0,prev=1; t<=tot; t++,now^=1,prev^=1) {
			dis[now][1]=dis[prev][1]+a[n];
			for (int i=2; i<=tot; i++) {
				dis[now][i]=min(dis[now][i-1],dis[prev][i])+a[max(abs(i-n-1),abs(t-n-1))];
			}
		}
		printf("%lld\n",dis[1][tot]);
	} else {
		int x=1,y=1;
		long long ans=a[n];
		while (x<tot || y<tot) {
			if (x==tot) {
				++y;
			} else if (y==tot) {
				++x;
			} else {
				if (a[max(abs(x-n),abs(y-n-1))]<a[max(abs(x-n-1),abs(y-n))]) ++x;
				else ++y;
			}
			ans+=a[max(abs(x-n-1),abs(y-n-1))];
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//1017A.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef unsigned long long ull;

ull gcd(ull a,ull b) {
	if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
	else return a;
}

ull lcm(ull x,ull y) {
	return x/gcd(x,y)*y;
}

ull n,a[3],ans=0;

int main() {
	cin>>n;
	cin>>a[0]>>a[1]>>a[2];
	for (int i=1,cnt; i<8; i++) {
		ull x=1;
		cnt=0;
		for (int k=0; k<3; k++) {
			if ((i>>k)&1) {
				x=lcm(x,a[k]);
				cnt++;
			}
		}
		if (cnt&1) {
			ans+=n/x;
		} else {
			ans-=n/x;
		}
	}
	cout<<n-ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//1017B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 2500000

struct edge {
	int next,to;
	char kind;
} te[MAXL];

int th[MAXL],tcnt=0;
bool isword[MAXL];

int n;
char temp[50005];

void add(int u,int v,char kind) {
	te[tcnt].to=v;
	te[tcnt].next=th[u];
	te[tcnt].kind=kind;
	th[u]=tcnt;
}

void insert() {
	int x=0,len=(int)strlen(temp);
	for (int p=0; p<len; p++) {
		char to=temp[p];
		int go=-1;
		for (int now=th[x]; now; now=te[now].next) {
			if (te[now].kind==to) {
				go=now;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (go==-1) {
			add(x,++tcnt,to);
			go=tcnt;
		}
		x=te[go].to;
	}
	isword[x]=1;
}

struct newe {
	int next,to;
} e[MAXL];

int head[MAXL],ecnt=0;

void add_e(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
	if (isword[x]) {
		add_e(fa,x);
		fa=x;
	}
	for (int now=th[x]; now; now=te[now].next) {
		dfs(te[now].to,fa);
	}
}

#define MOD 9191

int work(int x) {
	int ans=1;
	for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
		ans=(ans*work(e[now].to))%MOD;
	}
	return (ans+1)%MOD;
}

int main() {
	freopen("hack2.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("hack2.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%s",temp);
		insert();
	}
	dfs(0,0);
	printf("%d\n",(work(0)+9190)%MOD);
	return 0;
}

//1017C.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

struct data {
	int x,maxl;
	bool operator < (data a) const {
		return maxl>a.maxl;
	}
} a[MAXN];

int n,head[MAXN],d[MAXN],ecnt=0;

bool visit[MAXN];

long long ans=0;

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
		e[++ecnt].to=v;
		e[ecnt].next=head[u];
		e[ecnt].w=w;
		head[u]=ecnt;
		e[++ecnt].to=u;
		e[ecnt].next=head[v];
		e[ecnt].w=w;
		head[v]=ecnt;
		d[u]++,d[v]++;
		ans+=w;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		int maxl=0;
		for (int now=head[i]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			maxl=max(maxl,e[now].w);
		}
		a[i].x=i,a[i].maxl=maxl;
	}
	sort(a+1,a+n+1);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		int tot=0;
		for (int now=head[a[i].x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			if (visit[e[now].to]) tot++;
		}
		ans+=((long long)n-1-d[a[i].x]-(i-1)+tot)*(a[i].maxl+1LL);
		visit[a[i].x]=1;
	}
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

inline void read(long long &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}

int n,a[MAXN];
long long sum[MAXN],s;

inline bool check(int x) {
	for (int i=0,j=x; j<=n; i++,j++) {
		if (sum[j]-sum[i]>=s) return 1;
	}
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	read(s);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
	sum[0]=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) sum[i]=sum[i-1]+a[i];
	int l=1,r=n,mid;
	while (l<r) {
		mid=(l+r)>>1;
		if (check(mid)) r=mid;
		else l=mid+1;
	}
	printf("%d\n",l);
	return 0;
}

#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MOD 1000000007
long long n,m;

long long quickpower(long long x) {
	long long ret=1,temp=2;
	while (x) {
		if (x&1) ret=(ret*temp)%MOD;
		temp=(temp*temp)%MOD;
		x>>=1;
	}
	return ret;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("chessboard.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("chessboard.out","w",stdout);
	cin>>n>>m;
	n-=2,m-=2;
	cout<<((quickpower(n)+quickpower(m)+MOD-1)*24)%MOD<<endl;
	return 0;
}

		for (int b=0; b<10; b++)
			for (int c=0; c<10; c++) {
				if ((a+b)%10!=c && (a*a+c*c)%10!=b && a!=b && b!=c && a!=c)
					list[a][b][c]=1;
			}
}

void work_2() {
	for (int i=1; i<10; i++) {
		dp[1][i==7][0][i]=1;
		for (int j=0; j<10; j++) {

		}
	}

							dp[num][sev+int(k==7)][j][k]+=dp[num-1][sev][i][j];
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

//1018C.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
	int next,to;
	double w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,x[MAXN],y[MAXN],p[MAXN],head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

int from[MAXN],fa[MAXN][12],dep[MAXN];
double dis[MAXN],tot=0,maxe[MAXN][12];

int sqr(int a) {
	return a*a;
}

// prim
bool visit[MAXN];

void prim() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) dis[i]=1e9;
	int now=1;
	while (now) {
		visit[now]=1;
		int to=0;
		double d=1e9;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			if (!visit[i]) {
				double xd=sqrt(sqr(x[now]-x[i])+sqr(y[now]-y[i]));
				if (dis[i]>xd) {
					dis[i]=xd;
					from[i]=now;
				} else xd=dis[i];
				if (xd<d) {
					d=xd;
					to=i;
				}
			}
		}
		if (to) {
			add(from[to],to,d);
			tot+=d;
		}
		now=to;
	}
}

void dfs(int x) {
	for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
		int v=e[now].to;
		if (v!=fa[x][0]) {
			fa[v][0]=x;
			dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
			maxe[v][0]=e[now].w;
			dfs(v);
		}
	}
}

void init() {
	for (int k=1; k<=10; k++) {
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			fa[i][k]=fa[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
			maxe[i][k]=max(maxe[i][k-1],maxe[fa[i][k-1]][k-1]);
		}
	}
}

double query(int u,int v) {
	int wtf=p[u]+p[v];
	if (fa[v][0]==u) swap(u,v);
	if (fa[u][0]==v) return wtf/(tot-maxe[u][0]);
	double emax=0;
	if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
	int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
	for (int k=10; k>-1; k--) {
		if ((x>>k)&1) {
			emax=max(emax,maxe[u][k]);
			u=fa[u][k];
		}
	}
	if (u==v) return wtf/(tot-emax);
	for (int k=10; k>-1; k--) {
		if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
			emax=max(emax,maxe[u][k]);
			emax=max(emax,maxe[v][k]);
			u=fa[u][k];
			v=fa[v][k];
		}
	}
	emax=max(emax,maxe[u][0]);
	emax=max(emax,maxe[v][0]);
	return wtf/(tot-emax);
}

int main() {
	freopen("loser.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("loser.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d%d",x+i,y+i,p+i);
	}
	prim();
	fa[1][0]=dep[1]=1;
	maxe[1][0]=0;
	dfs(1);
	init();
	double ans=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
			ans=max(ans,query(i,j));
		}
	}
	printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

	scanf("%d",&n);
	long long temp=1;
	for (int i=2; i<n; i++) {
		temp*=i;
	}
	ans+=temp;
	temp=(n-1)*(n-2)/2;
	int top=n-1-2,choose=n-2;

//1021B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct statu {
	int MIN,MAX;
	statu() {}
	statu(int a,int b):MIN(a),MAX(b) {}
} ret[MAXN];

int n,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0,root;
void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

int ans=0;

void dfs(int x) {
	siz[x]=1;
	ret[x]=statu(x,x);
	for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
		dfs(e[now].to);
		siz[x]+=siz[e[now].to];
		if (ret[x].MIN>ret[e[now].to].MIN) ret[x].MIN=ret[e[now].to].MIN;
		if (ret[x].MAX<ret[e[now].to].MAX) ret[x].MAX=ret[e[now].to].MAX;
	}
	if (siz[x]==ret[x].MAX-ret[x].MIN+1) ans++;
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
		add(u,v);
		fa[v]=u;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (!fa[i]) {
			root=i;
			break;
		}
	}
	dfs(root);
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

//1021C.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

char s[MAXN];

bool visit[MAXN];
int a[MAXN];
long long ans=0;
int n;

void dfs(int now) {
	if (now>n) {
		ans++;
		return;
	}
	if (s[now]=='I') {
		for (int i=a[now-1]+1; i<=n; i++) {
			if (!visit[i]) {
				visit[i]=1;
				a[now]=i;
				dfs(now+1);
				visit[i]=0;
			}
		}
	} else if (s[now]=='D') {
		for (int i=a[now-1]-1; i; i--) {
			if (!visit[i]) {
				visit[i]=1;
				a[now]=i;
				dfs(now+1);
				visit[i]=0;
			}
		}
	} else {
		for (int i=n; i; i--) {
			if (!visit[i]) {
				visit[i]=1;
				a[now]=i;
				dfs(now+1);
				visit[i]=0;
			}
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%s",s+2);
	n=(int)strlen(s+2)+1;
	dfs(1);
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

#define MAXL 1005
#define MOD 1000000007

char X[MAXL],Y[MAXL];
int xlen,ylen,L;
int dp[MAXL][MAXL];
long long cnt[MAXL][MAXL];
int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%s%s",X+1,Y+1);
	xlen=(int)strlen(X+1);
	ylen=(int)strlen(Y+1);
	X[0]=0,Y[0]=1;
	for (int i=0; i<=xlen; i++) cnt[i][0]=1;
	for (int i=0; i<=ylen; i++) cnt[0][i]=1;
	for (int i=1; i<=xlen; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=ylen; j++) {
			dp[i][j]=max(max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1]),dp[i-1][j-1]+(X[i]==Y[j]));
			if (X[i]==Y[j]) {
				cnt[i][j]=cnt[i-1][j-1];
				if (dp[i][j]==dp[i-1][j]) cnt[i][j]+=cnt[i-1][j];
				if (dp[i][j]==dp[i][j-1]) cnt[i][j]+=cnt[i][j-1];
			} else {
				if (dp[i][j]==dp[i-1][j]) cnt[i][j]+=cnt[i-1][j];
				if (dp[i][j]==dp[i][j-1]) cnt[i][j]+=cnt[i][j-1];
				if (dp[i-1][j]==dp[i][j-1] && dp[i][j]==dp[i-1][j-1]) {
					cnt[i][j]=cnt[i][j]+MOD-cnt[i-1][j-1];
				}
			}
			if (cnt[i][j]>=MOD) cnt[i][j]%=MOD;
		}
	}
	cout<<cnt[xlen][ylen]<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//1021Dstd.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <stack>
#include <bitset>
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define eps 1e-8
#define FI first
#define SE second
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
const int N = 1005;
const int Mod = 1e9 + 7;
char A[N], B[N];
int dp[N][N], f[N][N];
int pre[N][26], pos[30];

inline void add(int &x, int v) {
	x += v;
	if(x >= Mod) x -= Mod;
}

int main() {
	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%s%s", A + 1, B + 1);
	int n = strlen(A + 1);
	int m = strlen(B + 1);
	for(int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
		for(int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
			dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j]);
			if(A[i] == B[j]) dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1);
		}
	}
	memset(pos, -1, sizeof(pos));
	for(int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
		pos[B[i] - 'a'] = i;
		for(int j = 0; j < 26; ++j) pre[i][j] = pos[j];
	}
	for(int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) f[i][0] = 1;
	for(int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) f[0][i] = 1;
	for(int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
		for(int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
			f[i][j] = 0;
			if(dp[i][j] == dp[i - 1][j]) add(f[i][j], f[i - 1][j]);
			int p = pre[j][A[i] - 'a'];
			if(p != -1 && dp[i - 1][p - 1] + 1 == dp[i][j]) add(f[i][j], f[i - 1][p - 1]);
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", f[n][m]);
	return 0;
}

//1028A.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 128

const int dx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[4]= {0,0,1,-1};

int n,ans=0x1f1f1f1f;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];
int dis[MAXN][MAXN];

int q[16384];
bool inq[MAXN][MAXN];

bool check(int MIN) {
	memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
	dis[1][1]=map[1][1];
	int head=0,tail=1;
	q[0]=(1<<10)|1;
	while (head<tail) {
		int x=q[head&16383]>>10,y=q[head&16383]&1023;
		head++;
		inq[x][y]=0;
		for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
			int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d],tov=max(dis[x][y],map[tox][toy]);
			if (tox>0 && tox<=n && toy>0 && toy<=n && map[tox][toy]>=MIN && tov<dis[tox][toy]) {
				dis[tox][toy]=tov;
				if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
					inq[tox][toy]=1;
					q[tail&16383]=(tox<<10)|toy;
					++tail;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if (dis[n][n]<0x1f1f1f1f) ans=min(dis[n][n]-MIN,ans);
	else return 1;
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
		}
	for (int m=0; m<=map[1][1]; m++) {
		if (check(m)) break;
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

//1028B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

int ans;
int q[MAXN],fa[MAXN],siz[MAXN],maxs[MAXN];

void bfs() {
	int h=1,t=2;
	q[1]=1;
	fa[1]=0;
	while (h<t) {
		int x=q[h++];
		for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
				fa[e[now].to]=x;
				q[t++]=e[now].to;
			}
		}
	}
	ans=n;
	for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
		int x=q[i],f=fa[x];
		siz[x]++;
		siz[f]+=siz[x];
		maxs[f]=max(maxs[f],siz[x]);
		ans=min(ans,max(n-siz[x],maxs[x]));
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
		add(u,v);
		add(v,u);
	}
	bfs();
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	if (m==0) {
		LL u,v;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%lld%lld",&u,&v);
			ans+=max(u,v);
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	} else if (n<=5) {
		for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			scanf("%lld%lld",&a[i].x,&a[i].y);
		}
		for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
			scanf("%d%d%lld%lld%lld",&c[i].u,&c[i].v,&c[i].yy,&c[i].xx,&c[i].zz);
			c[i].u--,c[i].v--;
		}
		int top=(1<<n);
		for (int st=0; st<top; st++) {
			long long temp=0;
			for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
				if ((st>>i)&1) temp+=a[i].x;
				else temp+=a[i].y;
			}
			for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
				int x=c[i].u,y=c[i].v;
				if (((st>>x)&1) == ((st>>y)&1)) {
					if ((st>>x)&1) temp+=c[i].xx;
					else temp+=c[i].yy;
				} else temp-=c[i].zz;
			}
			ans=max(ans,temp);
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	} else {
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%lld%lld",&a[i].x,&a[i].y);
		}
		for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
			scanf("%d%d%lld%lld%lld",&c[i].u,&c[i].v,&c[i].yy,&c[i].xx,&c[i].zz);
			// val u v st
			d[++dcnt]=data(a[c[i].u].x+a[c[i].v].x+c[i].xx,c[i].u,c[i].v,3);
			d[++dcnt]=data(a[c[i].u].x+a[c[i].v].y-c[i].zz,c[i].u,c[i].v,2);
			d[++dcnt]=data(a[c[i].u].y+a[c[i].v].x-c[i].zz,c[i].u,c[i].v,1);
			d[++dcnt]=data(a[c[i].u].y+a[c[i].v].y+c[i].yy,c[i].u,c[i].v,0);
		}
		sort(d+1,d+dcnt+1);
		memset(col,-1,sizeof(col));
		for (int i=1; i<=dcnt; i++) {
			int x=d[i].u,y=d[i].v,sx=d[i].st>>1,sy=d[i].st&1;
			if ((col[x]==-1 || col[x]==sx) && (col[y]==-1 || col[y]==sy)) {
				if (col[x]!=sx) col[x]=sx;
				if (col[y]!=sy) col[y]=sy;
			}
		}
		ans=0;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			if (col[i]==0) {
				ans+=a[i].y;
			} else if (col[i]==1) {
				ans+=a[i].x;
			} else {
				ans+=max(a[i].x,a[i].y);
			}
		}
		for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
			int x=c[i].u,y=c[i].v;
			if (col[x]==col[y]) {
				if (col[x]==1) ans+=c[i].xx;
				else ans+=c[i].yy;
			} else ans-=c[i].zz;
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

struct num {
	int v[320],len;
	int &operator [](int x) {
		return v[x];
	}
	num() {
		memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
		len=1;
	}
	num(int x) {
		memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
		v[1]=x;
		len=1;
	}
	num operator = (int x) {
		v[1]=x;
		len=1;
		return *this;
	}
	num operator + (num a) const {
		num c(0);
		int l=max(len,a.len);
		for (int i=1; i<=l; i++) {
			c[i]+=v[i]+a[i];
			if (c[i]>9) c[i]-=10,c[i+1]=1;
		}
		if (c[l+1]) l++;
		c.len=l;
		return c;
	}
	void print() {
		for (int i=len; i>0; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
		putchar('\n');
	}
} dp[1024][128];

int n,k;
int quickpower(int a,int x) {
	int ans=1;
	a%=1000;
	while (x) {
		if (x&1) ans=(ans*a)%1000;
		a=(a*a)%1000;
		x>>=1;
	}
	return ans;
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
	k=quickpower(k,k);
	dp[1][1]=1;
	for (int i=2; i<=k; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+dp[i-1][j];
		}
	}
	dp[k][n].print();
	return 0;
}

//1104D_.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 505

int n,m,A,B;
int a[MAXN][MAXN],sum[MAXN][MAXN];

inline int query(int x1,int x2,int y1,int y2) {
	return (sum[x2][y2]-sum[x1][y2]-sum[x2][y1]+sum[x1][y1]);
}
bool can(int l,int r,int x) {
	int cnt=0,now=0,tot=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		tot+=query(l,r,now,i);
		if (tot>=x) {
			tot=0;
			now=i;
			cnt++;
		}
	}
	return cnt>=B;
}

bool check(int x) {
	int cnt=0,now=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (can(now,i,x)) {
			now=i;
			cnt++;
		}
	}
	return cnt>=A;
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&A,&B);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
		}
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			sum[i][j]=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1]+a[i][j];
		}
	}
	int l=0,r=sum[n][m]/(A*B),mid;
	while (l<r) {
		mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
		if (check(mid)) l=mid;
		else r=mid-1;
	}
	printf("%d\n",l);
	return 0;
}

//123123.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;

inline void read(char *a) {
	*a = 0;
	while (!_c || _c == '\n' || _c == '\r') _c = getchar();
	while (_c != EOF && _c != '\n' && _c != '\r') *(a++) = char(_c), _c = getchar();
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1000319
const LL P1 = 201, P2 = 301, MOD1 = 1200000319, MOD2 = 2147483647;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

struct Hash {
	LL a, b;
	void append(Hash pre, int v) {
		a = (pre.a * P1 + v) % MOD1;
		b = (pre.b * P2 + v) % MOD2;
	}
	bool operator == (Hash x) const {
		return a == x.a && b == x.b;
	}
	bool operator < (Hash x) const {
		return a < x.a || (a == x.a && b < x.b);
	}
} A[MAXN], revA[MAXN], B[MAXN], revB[MAXN];

Hash comb(Hash a, Hash b, int lenb) {
	a.a = (a.a * X1[lenb] + b.a) % MOD1;
	a.b = (a.b * X2[lenb] + b.b) % MOD2;
	return a;
}

Hash Ha(Hash st, Hash ed, int len) {
	ed.a = (ed.a - st.a * X1[len]) % MOD1;
	if (ed.a < 0) ed.a += MOD1;
	ed.b = (ed.b - st.b * X2[len]) % MOD2;
	if (ed.b < 0) ed.b += MOD2;
	return ed;
}

int n;
char a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

void init() {
	read(a + 1);
	read(b + 1);
	n = (int)strlen(a + 1);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) A[i].append(A[i - 1], a[i]);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) B[i].append(B[i - 1], b[i]);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) revA[i].append(revA[i - 1], a[n + 1 - i]);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) revB[i].append(revB[i - 1], b[n + 1 - i]);
	X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

map <Hash, int> vis;

int ansx = -1, ansy = -1;

int main() {
	freopen("trans.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("trans.out", "w", stdout);
	init();
	for (int i = n - 1, j = 1; i; i--, j++) {
		Hash tmp = comb(A[i], revA[j], j);
		vis[tmp] = i;
		if (revB[i] == A[i]) {
			tmp = comb(A[i], B[j], j);
			if (vis.find(tmp) != vis.end()) {
				ansx = i - 1, ansy = vis[tmp];
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	printf("%d %d\n", ansx, ansy);
	return 0;
}

//1231312.cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;
int l,r,ans,mid,INF,K,Case,tot;
int prime[41005],mu[41005],i,j;
bool check[41005];

void init() {
	mu[1]=1;
	for (i=2; i<41000; i++) {
		if (!check[i]) mu[i]=-1, prime[++tot]=i;
		for (j=1; j<=tot; j++) {
			if (i*prime[j]>41000) break;
			check[i*prime[j]]=1;
			if (i%prime[j]==0) {
				mu[i*prime[j]]=0;
				break;
			} else mu[i*prime[j]] = -mu[i];
		}
		if (i<100) printf("mu[%d] = %d\n",i,mu[i]);
	}
}

bool Judge() {
	int ret=0;
	for (int i=1; i*i<=mid; i++)
		ret+=(mid/i/i)*mu[i];
	return (ret>=K);
}

int main() {
	//freopen("2440.in","r",stdin);
	//freopen("2440.out","w",stdout);
	init();
	INF=41000;
	INF=INF*INF;
	scanf("%d",&Case);
	while (Case--) {
		scanf("%d",&K);
		l=1;
		r=INF;
		while (l<=r) {
			mid=((long long)l+r)>>1;
			if (Judge()) ans=mid, r=mid-1;
			else l=mid+1;
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//1238.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

int ch;
bool getLine(char *s) {
	while (ch < ' ') {
		if (~ch) ch = getchar();
		else return 0;
	}
	while (ch >= ' ') {
		*(s++) = ch;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	*s = 0;
	return 1;
}

char s[23333];
bool vis[55]['Z' + 1], tmp[55]['Z' + 1];
int line = 1;
set <int> S;

void chk(int i, int ed, int dep) {
	for ( ; i < ed; i++) {
		if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') {
			if (!vis[dep][s[i]]) S.insert(s[i]);
		}
	}
	for (set<int>::iterator it = S.begin(); it != S.end(); it++) {
		printf("Line %d: variable %c might not have been initialized\n", line, *it);
	}
	S.clear();
}

bool fill() {
	while (getLine(s)) {
		line++;
		int len = (int)strlen(s);
		if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') return 0;
		else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') return 1;
		printf("Line %d: unreachable code\n", line);
		if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') if (fill()) fill();
	}
	return 0;
}

bool solve(int dep) {
	memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
	bool el = 0, re1 = 0;
	while (getLine(s)) {
		line++;
		int len = (int)strlen(s);
		if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') {
			if (el) {
				for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
					if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
						vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0;
		} else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') {
			memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
			memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
			el = 1;
		} else if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') {
			chk(2, len - 5, dep);
			if (solve(dep + 1)) {
				for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
				if (fill()) {
					memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
					memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
					el = 1, re1 = 1;
				} else {
					if (el) {
						for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
							if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
								vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
							}
						}
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}
		} else if (s[2] == '=') {
			chk(2, len, dep);
			vis[dep][s[0]] = 1;
		} else if (s[0] == 'R' && s[1] == 'E') {
			chk(6, len, dep);
			for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
			if (fill()) {
				memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
				memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
				el = 1, re1 = 1;
			} else {
				if (el) {
					if (re1) {
						return 1;
					}
					for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
						if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
							vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
						}
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	getLine(s);
	for (int i = (int)strlen(s) - 1; i > 5; i--)
		if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') vis[0][s[i]] = 1;
	solve(1);
	return 0;
}

//123.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}
#define MOD 100000000
typedef long long LL;
LL temp[12];
struct num {
	int v[12],len;
	num():len(0) {
		memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
	}
	num operator = (int x) {
		v[0]=x;
		return *this;
	}
	int &operator [](int x) {
		return v[x];
	}
	num operator + (num a) {
		len=max(len,a.len);
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
			v[i]+=a[i];
			if (v[i]>=MOD) v[i]-=MOD,v[i+1]++;
		}
		if (v[len+1]) len++;
		return *this;
	}
	num operator - (num a) {
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
			v[i]-=a[i];
			if (v[i]<0) v[i]+=MOD,v[i+1]--;
		}
		while (!v[len] && len) len--;
		return *this;
	}
	num operator * (num a) {
		memset(temp,0,sizeof(temp));
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++)
			for (int j=0; j<=a.len; j++)
				temp[i+j]+=LL(v[i])*LL(a[j]);
		int l=len+a.len;
		num c;
		for (int i=0; i<=l; i++) {
			c[i]=int(temp[i]%MOD);
			temp[i+1]+=temp[i]/MOD;
			if (i==l && temp[i+1]) l++;
		}
		c.len=l;
		return c;
	}
	num operator += (num a) {
		return *this+a;
	}
	num operator -= (int a) {
		num x;
		x=a;
		return *this-x;
	}
	num operator -= (num a) {
		return *this-a;
	}
	void print() {
		printf("%d",v[len]);
		for (int i=len-1; i>-1; i--) {
			printf("%08d",v[i]);
		}
		putchar('\n');
	}
} dp[1024][1024],pd[1024][1024],ans;

int n;
int a[1024];
void Dp() {
	dp[0][0]=1;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j];
		for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) dp[i][j^a[i]]+=dp[i-1][j];
	}
	for (int i=n+1; i>-1; i--) dp[i][0]-=1;
}
void Pd() {
	pd[n+1][1023]=1;
	for (int i=n; i; i--) {
		for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) pd[i][j]=pd[i+1][j];
		for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) pd[i][j&a[i]]+=pd[i+1][j];
	}
	for (int i=n+1; i>-1; i--) pd[i][1023]-=1;
}

int main() {
	freopen("sequence.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("sequence.out","w",stdout);
	read(n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		read(a[i]);
	}
	Dp();
	Pd();
	ans=0;
	for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
		for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) {
			ans+=(dp[i][j]-dp[i-1][j])*pd[i+1][j];
		}
	}
	ans.print();
	return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
	_a = 0;
	bool _f = 0;
	while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
	while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
	if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

int n, a[100], req, ff;

bool check() {
	int now = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		now = now | (now << a[i]);
	}
	return ff == now;
}

bool dfs(int q, int x) {
	if (q < x) return 0;
	if (x == 1) return a[x] = q, check();
	for (int i = 1; i < q; i++) {
		a[x] = i;
		if (dfs(q - i, x - 1)) return 1;
	}
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	for (n = 1; n <= 15; n++) {
		req = n * (n + 1) / 2;
		ff = (1 << (req + 1)) - 1;
		if (dfs(req, n)) {
			printf("%d\n", n);
			for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", a[i]);
			putchar('\n');
		} else printf("%d : -1\n", n);
	}
	return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
	_a = 0;
	bool _f = 0;
	while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
	while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
	if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 300005

int n, q;
int f[MAXN], w[MAXN], nxt[MAXN];

int main() {
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(w[i]);
	for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) read(f[i]);
	read(q);
	for (int i = 1; i <= q; i++) {
		int s, t;
		read(s);
		read(t);
		int x = t, st = 0, k = 0;
		LL tot = 0;
		while (x != s) {
			nxt[f[x]] = x;
			x = f[x];
		}
		while (x != t) {
			x = nxt[x];
			st++;
			tot++;
			if (x == t) break;
			if (k < w[x]) {
				tot += st * LL(w[x] - k);
				k = w[x];
			}
		}
		printf("%lld\n", tot);
	}
	return 0;
}

//23333.cpp
#include <iostream>

}

	return a > b ? a : b;
}
inline double min(double a, double b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline double max(double a, double b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}

#define Lim 15
const double eps = 1e-4;

struct point {
	int x,y;
	double v;
	point () {}
	point (int a, int b, double c) {
		x = a, y = b, v = c;
	}
	bool operator < (point a) const {
		return v>a.v;
	}
} tmp[23][233];

double Src[Lim + 1];

int G[Lim + 1][Lim + 1],cnt[3];
double t1[Lim + 1][Lim + 1], t2[Lim + 1][Lim + 1], (*att)[Lim + 1] = t1, (*dfn)[Lim + 1] = t2;

string myData;

char tt[Lim * Lim];

void printBoard() {
	myData += "+ 010203040506070809101112131415\n";
	for (int i = 1; i <= Lim; i++) {
		sprintf(tt, "%02d",i);
		myData += tt;
		for (int j = 1; j <= Lim; j++) {
			myData += ' ';
			switch (G[i][j]) {
			case 0:
				myData += ' ';
				break;
			case 1:
				myData += '#';
				break;
			case 2:
				myData += 'O';
				break;
			}
		}
		myData += '\n';
	}
}

inline void check(int a,int b) {
	memset(att,0,sizeof(double) * (Lim + 1) * (Lim + 1));
	memset(dfn,0,sizeof(double) * (Lim + 1) * (Lim + 1));
	for (int i=1; i<=Lim; i++) {
		cnt[1] = cnt[2] = 0;
		for (int k = 0; k <= 3; k++) cnt[G[i][1 + k]]++;
		for (int j=1; j<=Lim-4; j++) {
			cnt[G[i][j+4]]++;
			if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i][j+k] += Src[cnt[a]];
			if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i][j+k] += Src[cnt[b]];
			cnt[G[i][j]]--;
		}
	}
	for (int j=1; j<=Lim; j++) {
		cnt[1] = cnt[2] = 0;
		for (int k = 0; k <= 3; k++) cnt[G[1 + k][j]]++;
		for (int i=1; i<=Lim-4; i++) {
			cnt[G[i+4][j]]++;
			if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i+k][j] += Src[cnt[a]];
			if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i+k][j] += Src[cnt[b]];
			cnt[G[i][j]]--;
		}
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=Lim-4; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=Lim-4; j++) {
			cnt[1]=cnt[2]=0;
			for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) cnt[G[i+k][j+k]]++;
			if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i+k][j+k] += Src[cnt[a]];
			if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i+k][j+k] += Src[cnt[b]];
		}
	}
	for (int i=5; i<=Lim; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=Lim-4; j++) {
			cnt[1]=cnt[2]=0;
			for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) {
				cnt[G[i-k][j+k]]++;
			}
			if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i-k][j+k] += Src[cnt[a]];
			if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i-k][j+k] += Src[cnt[b]];
		}
	}
}

inline void upd(int x, int y, int a, int b, int f) {
	for (int i = max(1, x - 4); i <= x && i + 4 <= Lim; i++) {
		cnt[1] = cnt[2]=0;
		for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) cnt[G[i+k][y]]++;
		if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i+k][y] += f * Src[cnt[a]];
		if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i+k][y] += f * Src[cnt[b]];
	}
	for (int j = max(1, y - 4); j <= y && j + 4 <= Lim; j++) {
		cnt[1] = cnt[2]=0;
		for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) cnt[G[x][j + k]]++;
		if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[x][j + k] += f * Src[cnt[a]];
		if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[x][j + k] += f * Src[cnt[b]];
	}
	for (int d = min(4, min(x - 1, y - 1)), i = x - d, j = y - d; i <= Lim-4 && j <= Lim-4 && i <= x; i++, j++) {
		cnt[1]=cnt[2]=0;
		for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) cnt[G[i+k][j+k]]++;
		if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i+k][j+k] += f * Src[cnt[a]];
		if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i+k][j+k] += f * Src[cnt[b]];
	}
	for (int d = min(4, min(Lim - x, y - 1)), i = x + d, j = y - d; i >= 4 && j <= Lim-4 && j <= y; i--, j++) {
		cnt[1]=cnt[2]=0;
		for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) cnt[G[i-k][j+k]]++;
		if (cnt[b]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) att[i-k][j+k] += f * Src[cnt[a]];
		if (cnt[a]==0) for (int k=0; k<=4; k++) dfn[i-k][j+k] += f * Src[cnt[b]];
	}
}

inline void update(int x, int y, int a, int b, int c) {
	upd(x, y, a, b, -1);
	G[x][y] = c;
	upd(x, y, a, b, 1);
	swap(att, dfn);
}

const int X = 9;

double dfs(int a, int b, int dep, double alpha, double beta) {
//	printBoard();
	if (!dep) {
		double ma = 0, mb = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i <= 15; i++)
			for (int j = 1; j <= 15; j++) {
				ma = max(ma, att[i][j]);
				mb = max(mb, dfn[i][j]);
			}
		return ma - mb;
	}
	int tot = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= 15; i++)
		for (int j = 1; j <= 15; j++) {
			if (att[i][j] > 9e9) return 1e30;
			else if (dfn[i][j] > 9e9) return -1e30;
			if (!G[i][j]) {
				tmp[dep][++tot].x = i;
				tmp[dep][tot].y = j;
				tmp[dep][tot].v = att[i][j] + dfn[i][j];
			}
		}
	int y = min(tot, max(dep, X - 2) - 1);
	nth_element(tmp[dep] + 1, tmp[dep] + y, tmp[dep] + tot + 1);
	sort(tmp[dep] + 1, tmp[dep] + y + 1);
	for (int i = 1; i <= y; i++) {
		update(tmp[dep][i].x, tmp[dep][i].y, a, b, a);
		double val = -dfs(b, a, dep - 1, -beta - eps, -alpha - eps);
		update(tmp[dep][i].x, tmp[dep][i].y, b, a, 0);
		if (val >= beta) return val;
		alpha = max(alpha, val);
	}
	return alpha;
}

int now, ene;

point work() {
	int stp = min(X, cnt[1] * 4);
	check(now, ene);
	int tot = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= 15; i++)
		for (int j = 1; j <= 15; j++) {
			if (!G[i][j]) tmp[Lim][++tot] = point(i, j, att[i][j] + dfn[i][j]);
		}
	//printBoard();

	sort(tmp[Lim] + 1, tmp[Lim] + tot + 1);
	double ma = -1e233;
	int x = tmp[Lim][1].x, y = tmp[Lim][1].y;
	for (int i = 1; i <= min(15, tot); i++) {
		check(now, ene);
		update(tmp[Lim][i].x, tmp[Lim][i].y, now, ene, now);
		double pos = -dfs(ene, now, stp, -1e233, -ma - eps);
		//	myData += to_string(pos) + " -> " + to_string(tmp[Lim][i].x) +  " " + to_string(tmp[Lim][i].y) + "\n";
		update(tmp[Lim][i].x, tmp[Lim][i].y, ene, now, 0);
		if (pos - eps > ma) {
			ma = pos;
			x = tmp[Lim][i].x, y = tmp[Lim][i].y;
		}
	}
	return point(x, y, 0);
}

//2333.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

const int SZ = 1000010;

bool vis[SZ];
int pri[SZ],phi[SZ];
LL sum[SZ];

void shai(int n) {
	phi[1] = 1;
	for(int i = 2,tot = 0; i <= n; i ++) {
		if(!vis[i]) pri[++ tot] = i,phi[i] = i - 1;
		for(int j = 1,m; j <= tot && (m = i * pri[j]) <= n; j ++) {
			vis[m] = 1;
			if(i % pri[j] == 0) {
				phi[m] = pri[j] * phi[i];
				break;
			} else phi[m] = phi[pri[j]] * phi[i];
		}
	}
	for(int i = 1; i <= n; i ++)
		sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + phi[i];
}

LL ask(int n,int m) {
	if(n > m) swap(n,m);
	LL ans = 0;
	for(int i = 1,r; i <= n; i = r + 1) {
		r = min(n / (n / i),m / (m / i));
		ans += (sum[r] - sum[i - 1]) * (n / i) * (m / i);
		printf("%d %lld\n",r,ans);
	}
	return (ans << 1) - (LL)n * m;
}

int main() {
	int n,m;
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	shai(min(n,m));
	printf("%lld\n",ask(n,m));
	return 0;
}

//24p.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#define eps 0.001
using namespace std;
double a[4],rnk[4];
bool book[4];
double make(int oprt,double a,double b) {
	switch (oprt) {
	case 0:
		return a+b;
	case 1:
		return a-b;
	case 2:
		return a*b;
	case 3:
		return b==0?(-1e9):(a/b);
	}
}
int findresult() {
	double temp=0;
	for (int i=0; i<=3; i++)
		for (int j=0; j<=3; j++)
			for (int k=0; k<=3; k++) {
//				printf("%d %d %d\n",i,j,k);
				temp=make(k,make(j,make(i,rnk[0],rnk[1]),rnk[2]),rnk[3]);
				if (temp+eps>24 && temp-eps<24) return 1;
				temp=make(j,make(i,rnk[0],rnk[1]),make(k,rnk[2],rnk[3]));
				if (temp+eps>24 && temp-eps<24) return 1;
				temp=make(k,make(i,rnk[0],make(j,rnk[1],rnk[2])),rnk[3]);
				if (temp+eps>24 && temp-eps<24) return 1;
				temp=make(i,rnk[0],make(k,make(j,rnk[1],rnk[2]),rnk[3]));
				if (temp+eps>24 && temp-eps<24) return 1;
				temp=make(i,rnk[0],make(j,rnk[1],make(k,rnk[2],rnk[3])));
				if (temp+eps>24 && temp-eps<24) return 1;
			}
	return 0;
}
int dfs(int x) {
	if (x==4)
		return findresult();
	for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
		if (book[i]==0) {
			book[i]=1;
			rnk[x]=a[i];
			int re=dfs(x+1);
			if (re) return 1;
			book[i]=0;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	int n;
	scanf("%d",&n);
	while (n--) {
		memset(book,0,sizeof(book));
		scanf("%lf%lf%lf%lf",a,a+1,a+2,a+3);
		if (dfs(0))
			puts("Yes");
		else
			puts("No");
	}
	return 0;
}

//2732ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define inf 1e100
#define eps 1e-15
#define mid (l+r)/2
const int N=200010;
struct S {
	double x,y0,y1;
} a[N];
struct Point {
	double x,y;
} p[N];
struct Line {
	Point p,v;
	double ang;
	inline void prepare(double k,double b,double kind) {
		p=(Point) {
			0.,b
		};
		double dis=sqrt(1.+k*k);
		v.x=kind/dis;
		v.y=kind/dis*k;
		ang=atan2(v.y,v.x);
	}
	bool operator < (const Line &x)const {
		return ang<x.ang;
	}
} l[N],q[N];
Point operator + (Point x,Point y) {
	return (Point) {
		x.x+y.x,x.y+y.y
	};
}
Point operator - (Point x,Point y) {
	return (Point) {
		x.x-y.x,x.y-y.y
	};
}
Point operator * (Point x,double y) {
	return (Point) {
		x.x*y,x.y*y
	};
}
inline double Cross(Point x,Point y) {
	return x.x*y.y-x.y*y.x;
}
inline bool onleft(Line x,Point y) {
	return Cross(x.v,y-x.p)>0.;
}
inline Point get_point(Line x,Line y) {
	Point u=x.p-y.p;
	double t=Cross(y.v,u)/Cross(x.v,y.v);
	return x.p+x.v*t;
}
inline bool check(int x) {
	int h,t,tot=0,i;
	l[++tot].p=(Point) {0.,0.},l[tot].v=(Point) {1.,0.},l[tot].ang=atan2(0.,1.);
	l[++tot].p=(Point) {0.,0.},l[tot].v=(Point) {0.,1.},l[tot].ang=atan2(1.,0.);
	l[++tot].p=(Point) {0.,inf},l[tot].v=(Point) {-1.,0.},l[tot].ang=atan2(0.,-1.);
	l[++tot].p=(Point) {-inf,0.},l[tot].v=(Point) {0.,-1.},l[tot].ang=atan2(-1.,0.);
	for(i=1; i<=x; ++i) {
		l[++tot].prepare(-a[i].x,a[i].y0*1.0/a[i].x,1.);
		l[++tot].prepare(-a[i].x,a[i].y1*1.0/a[i].x,-1.);
	}
	sort(l+1,l+tot+1);
	q[h=t=1]=l[1];
	for(i=2; i<=tot; ++i) {
		while(h<t&&!onleft(l[i],p[t-1])) --t;
		while(h<t&&!onleft(l[i],p[h])) ++h;
		q[++t]=l[i];
		if(fabs(Cross(q[t].v,q[t-1].v))<eps) {
			--t;
			if(onleft(q[t],l[i].p)) q[t]=l[i];
		}
		if(h<t) p[t-1]=get_point(q[t-1],q[t]);
	}
	while(h<t&&!onleft(q[h],p[t-1])) --t;
	return t-h>1;
}
int main() {
	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
	int i,j,n;
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for(i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
		scanf("%lf%lf%lf",&a[i].x,&a[i].y0,&a[i].y1);
		a[i].y0-=eps;
		a[i].y1+=eps;
	}
	int l=0,r=n,ans=0;
	while(l<r) {
		if(check(mid)) ans=max(ans,mid),l=mid+1;
		else r=mid;
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
}

#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

LL t;
int n;

vector <int> tmp;

LL val = 0;

LL a[1001];
map<LL, vector<int> > b;

void dfs(int dep) {
	if ((b.size() & 1048575) == 0)cerr << b.size() << endl;
	if (dep > 5) return;
	if (b.find(val) == b.end() || b[val].size() > tmp.size())
		b[val] = tmp;
	else return;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		tmp.push_back(i);
		val += a[i];
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val -= a[i];
		tmp.pop_back();

		tmp.push_back(-i);
		val -= a[i];
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val += a[i];
		tmp.pop_back();
	}
}

int main() {
	cin >> t >> n;

	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		cin >> a[i];
	}

	dfs(0);

	int ans = 0x3f3f3f3f;
	map<LL, vector<int> >::iterator x, y;

	for (map<LL, vector<int> >::iterator i = b.begin(), j; i != b.end(); i++) {
		LL z = t - i->fir;
		j = b.find(z);
		if (j != b.end()) {
			int tot = (int)i->sec.size() + j->sec.size();
			if (tot < ans) {
				ans = tot;
				x = i, y = j;
			}
		}
	}

	printf("%d haha \n", ans);
	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n", x->sec[i]);

	x = y;

	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n", x->sec[i]);

	return 0;
}

//3224_2333.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
struct data {
	int x,p;
	bool operator < (data a) const {
		return x<a.x;
	}
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=1,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[s<<1];

inline void insert(int x) {
	for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
	for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]--;
}

inline int rank(int x) {
	int l=1,r=x-1,ans=1;
	for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
		if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
		if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
	}
	cerr << "rank : " << ans << endl;
	return ans;
}

inline int get_rank(int k) {
	int x=1;
	while (x<s) {
		if (t[(x<<1)]>=k) x=x<<1;
		else {
			k-=t[(x<<1)];
			x=(x<<1)^1;
		}
	}
	cerr << "get : " << rev[x - s] << endl;
	return rev[x-s];
}

inline int pre(int x) {
	return get_rank(rank(x)-1);
}

inline int nxt(int x) {
	return get_rank(rank(x));
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",opt+i,num+i);
		if (opt[i]==6) num[i]++;
		if (opt[i]!=4) {
			tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
			tem[cnt].p=i;
		}
	}
	sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
	num[tem[1].p]=1;
	rev[1]=tem[1].x;
	for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
		if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
			num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
			rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
		} else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		switch (opt[i]) {
		case 1:
			insert(num[i]);
			break;
		case 2:
			del(num[i]);
			break;
		case 3:
			printf("%d\n",rank(num[i]));
			break;
		case 4:
			printf("%d\n",get_rank(num[i]));
			break;
		case 5:
			printf("%d\n",pre(num[i]));
			break;
		case 6:
			printf("%d\n",nxt(num[i]));
			break;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

			 int cube[1000];
int mem[10000005],now=1;

int solve(int x) {
	if (mem[x]!=-1)
		return mem[x];
	while (cube[now]<=x)
		now++;
	return mem[x]=solve(x-cube[now-1])+1;
}

int main() {
	memset(mem,-1,sizeof(mem));
	mem[0]=0;
	for (int i=1; i<1000; i++)
		cube[i]=i*i*i;
	int now=-1;
	for (int i=1; i<=10000005; i++) {
		if (solve(i)>now) {
			now=mem[i];
			printf("%d %d\n",i,mem[i]);
		}
	}
	printf("Ended.\n");
	return 0;
}

//368B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 100005
#define s 131072
#define INF 2242545357980376863ll

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,k,ecnt,head[MAXN],st[MAXN];
long long t[s<<1],dis[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline int query() {
	int now=1;
	while (now<s) {
		if (t[now<<1]<t[(now<<1)+1])
			now<<=1;
		else
			now=(now<<1)|1;
	}
	return now-s;
}

inline void update(int pos, long long val) {
	t[pos+=s]=val;
	for (; pos; t[pos>>=1]=val) val=min(t[pos],t[pos^1]);
}

inline void dijkstra() {
	memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
	memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
	for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
		update(st[i],0);
	}
	int x=query();
	while (t[s+x]<INF) {
		dis[x]=t[s+x];
		visit[x]=1;
		update(x,INF);
		int v;
		long long w;
		for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			v=e[now].to,w=e[now].w+dis[x];
			if (!visit[v] && w<t[s+v]) {
				update(v,w);
			}
		}
		x=query();
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
	for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
		add(u,v,w);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
		scanf("%d",st+i);
	}
	dijkstra();
	long long ans=INF;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (dis[i]) ans=min(ans,dis[i]);
	}
	if (ans^INF) cout<<ans<<endl;
	else cout<<-1<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//369B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

int n;
int x,y;
long long map[505][505],sum[505],nowsum;

int main() {
	cin>>n;
	if (n==1) {
		puts("1");
		return 0;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		sum[i]=0;
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			cin>>map[i][j];
			sum[i]+=map[i][j];
			if (map[i][j]==0) {
				x=i,y=j;
			}
		}
	}
	if (x==1) {
		map[x][y]=sum[2]-sum[x];
		sum[x]=sum[2];
	} else {
		map[x][y]=sum[1]-sum[x];
		sum[x]=sum[1];
	}
	nowsum=sum[1];
	if (map[x][y]<=0) {
		puts("-1");
		return 0;
	}
	// row
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (sum[i]!=nowsum) {
			puts("-1");
			return 0;
		}
	}
	//line
	for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
		sum[j]=0;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			sum[j]+=map[i][j];
		}
		if (sum[j]!=nowsum) {
			puts("-1");
			return 0;
		}
	}
	long long cnt=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		cnt+=map[i][i];
	}
	if (cnt!=nowsum) {
		puts("-1");
		return 0;
	}
	cnt=0;
	for (int i=1,j=n; i<=n; i++,j--) {
		cnt+=map[i][j];
	}
	if (cnt!=nowsum) {
		puts("-1");
		return 0;
	}
	cout<<map[x][y]<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//369E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MOD 1000003

long long n,k,x;

inline long long quickpower(long long a,long long x) {
	long long ans=1;
	while (x) {
		if (x&1) ans=(ans*a)%MOD;
		a=(a*a)%MOD;
		x>>=1;
	}
	return ans;
}

int main() {
	cin>>n>>k;
	if (n<=61 && k>(1ll<<n)) {
		puts("1 1");
		return 0;
	}
	x=quickpower(2ll,n);
	if (k==2) {
		cout<<1<<" "<<x<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	long long fenzi,fenmu=quickpower(x,k);
	if (k>x) {
		fenzi=0;
	} else {
		long long temp=x;
		fenzi=1;
		for (int i=1; i<=k; i++,temp--) {
			fenzi=(fenzi*temp)%MOD;
		}
	}
	long long cnttwo=n;
	for (long long i=2; i<=k-1; i<<=1) {
		cnttwo+=(k-1)/i;
	}
	long long two=quickpower(2ll,cnttwo),niyuan=quickpower(two,MOD-2);
	fenzi=(((fenmu-fenzi+MOD)%MOD)*niyuan)%MOD;
	fenmu=(fenmu*niyuan)%MOD;
	cout<<fenzi<<" "<<fenmu<<endl;
	return 0;
}
