//3D.cpp
#include<stdio.h>
#include<math.h>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
int x[1000 + 5];
int y[1000 + 5];
int z[1000 + 5];
int n;
double big;
struct Edge {
	double delz;
	double sq;
	int from, to;
	double res;
} e[500000 + 5];
double res[500000+5];
int ecnt = 0;
int fa[1000 + 5];
int findfa(int a) {
	if(fa[a]==a)return a;
	else return findfa(fa[a]);
}
double max(double a,double b) {
	if(a>b)return a;
	else return b;
}
bool cmp(Edge a,Edge b) {
	return a.res<b.res;
}
bool check(double a) {
	for(int i=1; i<=ecnt; i++)
		e[i].res=e[i].delz-a*e[i].sq;
	sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1,cmp);
	double ss=0;
	for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if(findfa(e[i].from)!=findfa(e[i].to)) {
			fa[findfa(e[i].to)]=findfa(e[i].from);
			ss+=e[i].res;
		}
	}
	//printf("a=%lf ss=%lf\n",a,ss);
	if(ss<=0)return true;
	else return false;
}
int main() {
	freopen("3D.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("3D.out","w",stdout);
	while(~scanf("%d",&n)) {
		ecnt=0;
		big=0;
		double sum=0;
		for(int i=1; i <= n; i++)
			scanf("%d%d%d",&x[i],&y[i],&z[i]);
		for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
			for(int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
				int a=(x[i] - x[j])*(x[i] - x[j]);
				int b=(y[i] - y[j])*(y[i] - y[j]);
				big=max(big,(double)abs(z[i] - z[j])/sqrt(double(a + b)));
				e[++ecnt].delz = (double)abs(z[i] - z[j]);
				e[ecnt].sq = sqrt(double(a + b));
				e[ecnt].from=i;
				e[ecnt].to=j;
			}
		double l=0,r=big,mid;
		while(r-l>0.001) {
			for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
				fa[i]=i;
			//printf("l=%lf r=%lf\n",l,r);
			mid = (l+r)/2;
			if(check(mid))r=mid;
			else l=mid;
		}
		printf("%.3lf\n",r);
	}
	fclose(stdin);
	fclose(stdout);
	return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
	bool f = 0;
	while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
		if (_c == '-') f = 1;
		_c=getchar();
	}
	_a = 0;
	while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
		_a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
		_c = getchar();
	}
	if (f) _a = -_a;
}
void op(int &o) {
	while (_c != 'K' && _c != 'N') _c = getchar();
	o = _c == 'K';
	_c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
int n, zero = MAXN, delta = 0;
int len[MAXN * 2];

void update(int x) {
	int p = int(lower_bound(len + zero, len + zero + n + 1, x - delta) - len - zero - 1);
	len[p + zero + 1] = min(len[p + zero + 1], x - delta);
}
void row() {
	zero--;
	delta++;
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1, o, x; i <= n; i++) {
		op(o);
		if (o) read(x), update(x);
		else row();
	}
	printf("%d\n", int(lower_bound(len + zero, len + zero + n + 2, INF) - len - zero - 1));
	return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

LL t;
int n;

pair<LL, pii> a[100010];

vector <pii> tmp;

LL val = 0;

map<LL, vector<pii> > b;

pii rev(pii aa) {
	return mp(-aa.fir, -aa.sec);
}

void dfs(int dep) {
	if ((b.size() & 1048575) == 0)cerr << b.size() << endl;
	if (b.size() > 10000000) return;
	if (dep > 3) return;
	if (b.find(val) == b.end() || b[val].size() > tmp.size())
		b[val] = tmp;
	else return;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		tmp.push_back(a[i].sec);
		val += a[i].fir;
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val -= a[i].fir;
		tmp.pop_back();

		tmp.push_back(rev(a[i].sec));
		val -= a[i].fir;
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val += a[i].fir;
		tmp.pop_back();
	}
}

int main() {
	cin >> t >> n;
	cout << t << endl;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		int x, y;
		LL bb;
		cin >> x >> y;
		cin >> bb;
		a[i] = mp(bb, mp(x, y));
	}

	dfs(0);

	int ans = 0x3f3f3f3f;
	map<LL, vector<pii> >::iterator x, y;

	for (map<LL, vector<pii> >::iterator i = b.begin(), j; i != b.end(); i++) {
		LL z = t - i->fir;
		j = b.find(z);
		if (j != b.end()) {
			int tot = (int)i->sec.size() + j->sec.size();
			if (tot < ans) {
				ans = tot;
				x = i, y = j;
			}
		}
	}

	printf("%d\n", ans * 2);
	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n%d\n", x->sec[i].fir, x->sec[i].sec);

	x = y;

	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n%d\n", x->sec[i].fir, x->sec[i].sec);

	return 0;
}

//63BAC.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const int Max = 15;
char G[Max+2][Max+2];
bool vis[15][15][9850];
int  R,C,targetx,targety,n;
// n is snake-body num
int  dir[4][2] = {-1,0,1,0,0,-1,0,1};
int  caculate[8] = {1,3,9,27,81,243,729,2187};
typedef struct status {
	int x[9];
	int y[9];
	int step;
};

status ori;
status thisq[1000000];

int getturn(int x,int y,int x0,int y0) {
	if (x - x0 == 1) return 0;
	if (x - x0 == -1) return 1;
	if (y - y0 == 1) return 2;
	if (y - y0 == -1) return 3;
	printf("Error at get turn!\n");
}

int getcode(status& x) {
	int buffer[12];
	int code = 0;
	for(int i = 1; i<n; ++i)
		code += getturn(x.x[i],x.y[i],x.x[i-1],x.y[i-1]) * caculate[i-1];
	return code;
}

bool judge(status& x) {
	int tx = x.x[0];
	int ty = x.y[0];
	for(int i = 1; i<n; ++i)
		if(x.x[i] == tx && x.y[i] == ty)
			return false;
	return true;
}

bool dfs1(int x,int y) {
	int front = 0,rear = 0;
	int q[8000][2];
	bool evis[15][15];
	memset(evis,false,sizeof(evis));
	evis[x][y] = true;
	q[rear][0] = x;
	q[rear++][1] = y;
	while(front < rear) {
		int tx = q[front][0];
		int ty = q[front++][1];
		if (tx == targetx && ty == targety) return true;
		for(int i = 0; i<4; ++i) {
			int newx = tx + dir[i][0];
			int newy = ty + dir[i][1];
			if (!evis[newx][newy] && G[newx][newy] != '#' && newx < R && newx >=0 && newy < C && newy >=0) {
				q[rear][0] = newx;
				q[rear++][1] = newy;
				evis[newx][newy] = true;
			}
		}
	}

	return false;
}

int dfs() {
	int front = 0,rear = 0;
	ori.step = 0;
	thisq[rear++] = ori;
	vis[ori.x[0]][ori.y[0]][getcode(ori)] = true;
	while(front < rear) {
		int tx = thisq[front].x[0];
		int ty = thisq[front].y[0];
		int step = thisq[front].step;
		if (tx == targetx && ty == targety)  {
			return step;
		}
		for(int i = 0 ; i < 4; ++i) {
			int newx = tx + dir[i][0];
			int newy = ty + dir[i][1];
			int newstep = step+1;
			if (newx >= R || newx < 0 || newy >=C || newy < 0 || G[newx][newy] == '#')
				continue;
			status newst;
			newst.x[0] = newx;
			newst.y[0] = newy;
			newst.step = step + 1;
			for(int j=1; j<n; ++j) {
				newst.x[j] = thisq[front].x[j-1];
				newst.y[j] = thisq[front].y[j-1];
			}
			if (!vis[newst.x[0]][newst.y[0]][getcode(newst)] && judge(newst)) {
				thisq[rear++] = newst;
				vis[newst.x[0]][newst.y[0]][getcode(newst)] = true;
			}
		}

		front++;
	}

	return -1;
}

bool input() {
	while(scanf("%d%d%*c",&R,&C)==2) {
		n = 0;
		memset(vis,false,sizeof(vis));
		for(int i = 0; i<R; ++i)
			gets(&G[i][0]);
		for(int i = 0; i<R; ++i)
			for(int j = 0; j<C; ++j)
				if(G[i][j] == '@') {
					targetx = i;
					targety = j;
				} else if(G[i][j] <= '9' && G[i][j] >= '1') {
					ori.x[G[i][j] - '1'] = i;
					ori.y[G[i][j] - '1'] = j;
					n ++ ;
				}
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

int main(int argc,char * argv[]) {
	int T = 1;
	while(input() == true) {
		if(!dfs1(ori.x[0],ori.y[0])) {
			cout << "Case #"<< T++ <<": -1" <<endl;
			continue;
		}
		int ans = dfs();
		cout << "Case #"<< T++ <<": "<< ans <<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

//63B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
bool visit[16][16][262144];
struct Snake {
	int x[10],y[10];
	int depth;
} snake,now;
char read[20];
int map[20][20],temp[20][20],n,m,k;
int fx[4]= {0,0,1,-1},fy[4]= {1,-1,0,0};
inline void init() {
	memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
	memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
	k=-1;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%s",read+1);
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (read[j]=='#')
				map[i][j]=0;
			else
				map[i][j]=-1;
			if (read[j]>'0' && read[j]<='9') {
				int now=read[j]-'0';
				snake.x[now]=i;
				snake.y[now]=j;
				if (now>k)
					k=now;
			}
			if (read[j]=='@')
				map[i][j]=-2;
		}
	}
	return;
}
inline int getStatu() {
	int temp=0;
	for (int j=k; j>1; j--) {
		int xx=snake.x[j]-snake.x[j-1],yy=snake.y[j]-snake.y[j-1],now;
		for (now=0; now<4; now++) {
			if (fx[now]==xx && fy[now]==yy)
				break;
		}
		temp=temp*4+now;
	}
	return temp;
}
inline bool Judge(int x,int y) {
	for (int i=1; i<k; i++) {
		if (x==now.x[i] && y==now.y[i])
			return 0;
	}
	return 1;
}
inline int bfs() {
	queue<Snake> q;
	visit[snake.x[1]][snake.y[1]][getStatu()]=1;
	snake.depth=0;
	q.push(snake);
	while (!q.empty()) {
		now=q.front();
		q.pop();
		int x=now.x[1],y=now.y[1],depth=now.depth;
		for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
			int tox=x+fx[i],toy=y+fy[i];
			if (map[tox][toy] && Judge(tox,toy)) {
				snake.x[1]=tox,snake.y[1]=toy;
				for (int i=2; i<=k; i++) {
					snake.x[i]=now.x[i-1];
					snake.y[i]=now.y[i-1];
				}
				int statu=getStatu();
				if (!visit[snake.x[1]][snake.y[1]][statu]) {
					if (map[tox][toy]==-2) {
						return depth+1;
					}
					visit[snake.x[1]][snake.y[1]][statu]=1;
					snake.depth=depth+1;
					q.push(snake);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return -1;
}
int main() {
	int CASE=1;
	while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
		init();
		printf("Case #%d: %d\n",CASE++,bfs());
	}
	return 0;
}

//63C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int n,sum,top,ans,a[100];
bool visit[100];
int cnt;
inline bool cmp(int a,int b) {
	return a>b;
}
bool dfs(int depth,int nowlen,int now,int len) {
	if (depth==cnt)
		return 1;
	for (int i=now+1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (visit[i])
			continue;
		if (nowlen+a[i]==len) {
			visit[i]=1;
			if (dfs(depth+1,0,0,len))
				return 1;
			visit[i]=0;
			return 0;
		} else if (nowlen+a[i]<len) {
			visit[i]=1;
			if (dfs(depth,nowlen+a[i],i,len))
				return 1;
			visit[i]=0;
			if (nowlen==0)
				return 0;
			while (a[i]==a[i+1])
				i++;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d",&n)!=EOF) {
		if (n==0)
			return 0;
		sum=0;
		top=0;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%d",a+i);
			sum+=a[i];
			top=max(top,a[i]);
		}
		sort(a+1,a+n+1,cmp);
		ans=sum;
		for (int i=top; i<sum; i++) {
			if (sum%i==0) {
				//printf("try : %d\n",i);
				memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
				cnt=sum/i;
				if (dfs(1,0,0,i)) {
					ans=i;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
}

//63D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct statu {
	long long x,y,z;
	statu() {}
	statu(long long _x,long long _y,long long _z):x(_x),y(_y),z(_z) {}
	bool operator < (statu a) const {
		if (x!=a.x)
			return x<a.x;
		if (y!=a.y)
			return y<a.y;
		return z<a.z;
	}
	bool operator == (statu a) const {
		return x==a.x && y==a.y && z==a.z;
	}
} s[6000000];
int n,b1,b2,b3,mid,cnt=0;
int a[30][5];

bool find(statu x) {
	int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
	while (l<r) {
		mid=(l+r)>>1;
		if (s[mid]<x)
			l=mid+1;
		else
			r=mid;
	}
	if (s[l]==x)
		return 1;
	return 0;
}
void dfs(long long x,long long y,long long z,int depth) {
	if (depth>mid) {
		s[++cnt]=statu(x,y,z);
		return;
	}
	dfs(x+a[depth][1],y,z,depth+1);
	dfs(x,y+a[depth][2],z,depth+1);
	dfs(x,y,z+a[depth][3],depth+1);
	return;
}

bool check(long long x,long long y,long long z,int depth) {
	if (depth==mid) {
		if (find(statu(x,y,z)))
			return 1;
		return 0;
	}
	if (check(x-a[depth][1],y,z,depth-1)) return 1;
	if (check(x,y-a[depth][2],z,depth-1)) return 1;
	if (check(x,y,z-a[depth][3],depth-1)) return 1;
	return 0;
}
int main() {
	scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&b1,&b2,&b3);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		scanf("%d%d%d",a[i]+1,a[i]+2,a[i]+3);
	mid=n>>1;
	dfs(b1,b2,b3,1);
	sort(s+1,s+cnt+1);
	if (check(0,0,0,n))
		puts("YES");
	else
		puts("NO");
	return 0;
}

//63E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

struct statu {
	int p,val;
	bool s;
	statu() {}
	statu(int _p,int _val,bool _s):p(_p),val(_val),s(_s) {}
};
char visit[6][1000000][2];
int s,t;
int ten[6]= {1,10,100,1000,10000,100000};
inline int L(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int left=val/100000;
	return val + (pval-left)*100000 + (left-pval)*ten[p];
}
inline int R(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int right=val%10;
	return val + (pval-right) + (right-pval)*ten[p];
}
int main() {
	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d%d",&s,&t)!=EOF) {
		if (s==t) {
			puts("0");
			continue;
		}
		memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
		queue<statu> q;
		visit[5][s][0]=1;
		q.push(statu(5,s,0));
		for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
			visit[i][t][1]=1;
			q.push(statu(i,t,1));
		}
		int ans;
		while (!q.empty()) {
			statu now=q.front();
			q.pop();
			int p=now.p,val=now.val,st=now.s;
			int depth=visit[p][val][st],temp,pval=(val/ten[p])%10;
			//opt 1
			temp=L(p,val,pval);
			if (visit[p][temp][st^1]) {
				ans=depth+visit[p][temp][st^1]-1;
				break;
			}
			if (!visit[p][temp][st]) {
				visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
			}
			//opt 2
			temp=R(p,val,pval);
			if (visit[p][temp][st^1]) {
				ans=depth+visit[p][temp][st^1]-1;
				break;
			}
			if (!visit[p][temp][st]) {
				visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
			}
			//opt 3
			if (pval!=9) {
				temp=val+ten[p];
				if (visit[p][temp][st^1]) {
					ans=depth+visit[p][temp][st^1]-1;
					break;
				}
				if (!visit[p][temp][st]) {
					visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 4
			if (pval!=0) {
				temp=val-ten[p];
				if (visit[p][temp][st^1]) {
					ans=depth+visit[p][temp][st^1]-1;
					break;
				}
				if (!visit[p][temp][st]) {
					visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 5
			if (st^1 && p!=0) {
				if (!visit[p-1][val][st]) {
					visit[p-1][val][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p-1,val,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 6
			if (st && p!=5) {
				if (!visit[p+1][val][st]) {
					visit[p+1][val][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p+1,val,st));
				}
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//63Elister.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
bool visit[3000000];
struct statu {
	int p,a[6],depth;
	int cansix;
	bool point[6];
};
int a[6]= {0,1,2,3,4,5};

int getstatu(statu x) {
	int temp=0;
	for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
		temp=temp*6+x.a[i];
	}
	temp=temp*6+x.p;
	return temp;
}
bool check(statu x) {
	for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
		if (x.a[i]!=i)
			return 0;
	}
	return 1;
}
int bfs(statu x) {
	queue<statu> q;
	q.push(x);
	visit[getstatu(x)]=1;
	while (!q.empty()) {
		statu now=q.front(),temp;
		q.pop();
		int p=now.p,depth=now.depth;
		if (check(now))
			return now.cansix;
		temp=now;
		temp.depth++;
		//L
		swap(temp.a[0],temp.a[p]);
		if (!visit[getstatu(temp)]) {
			visit[getstatu(temp)]=1;
			q.push(temp);
		}
		swap(temp.a[0],temp.a[p]);
		//R
		swap(temp.a[p],temp.a[5]);
		if (!visit[getstatu(temp)]) {
			visit[getstatu(temp)]=1;
			int t=temp.cansix;
			temp.cansix=1;
			q.push(temp);
			temp.cansix=t;
		}
		swap(temp.a[p],temp.a[5]);
		//shl
		if (p!=0) {
			temp.p--;
			if (!visit[getstatu(temp)])
				q.push(temp);
			temp.p++;
		}
		//shr
		if (p!=5) {
			temp.p++;
			if (!visit[getstatu(temp)]) {
				q.push(temp);
			}
			temp.p--;
		}
	}
	return -1;
}

int main() {
	printf("bool cansix[720]={0");
	next_permutation(a,a+6);
	for (int i=2; i<=720; i++,next_permutation(a,a+6)) {
		statu now;
		for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
			now.a[i]=a[i];
		}
		now.depth=0;
		now.p=0;
		now.cansix=0;
		memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
		int ans=bfs(now);
		printf(",%d",ans);
	}
	printf("};");
	return 0;
}

int S[6],T[6],a[6];
int main() {
	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	int s,t,ans;
	while (scanf("%d%d",&s,&t)!=EOF) {
		ans=100000009;
		for (int i=5; i>=0; i--) {
			S[i]=s%10;
			s/=10;
		}
		for (int i=5; i>=0; i--) {
			T[i]=t%10;
			t/=10;
		}
		for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
			a[i]=i;
		}
		for (int i=0; i<720; i++,next_permutation(a,a+6)) {
			int temp=list[i],most=mostr[i],fuckcnt=0;
			for (int j=0; j<=5; j++) {
				int aa=abs(T[a[j]]-S[j]);
				temp+=aa;
				if (aa>0 && j>most && !(j==5 && cansix[i])) {
					fuckcnt=j;
				}
			}
			if (fuckcnt>0) {
				temp+=fuckcnt-most;
			}
			if (ans>temp) {
				ans=temp;
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//63Ervio.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

struct statu {
	int p,val,depth;
	statu() {}
	statu(int _p,int _val,int _depth):p(_p),val(_val),depth(_depth) {}
};
bool visit[6][1000000];
int s,t;
int ten[6]= {1,10,100,1000,10000,100000};
inline int L(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int left=val/100000;
	return val + (pval-left)*100000 + (left-pval)*ten[p];
}
inline int R(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int right=val%10;
	return val + (pval-right) + (right-pval)*ten[p];
}
int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d%d",&s,&t)!=EOF) {
		if (s==t) {
			puts("0");
			continue;
		}
		memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
		queue<statu> q;
		visit[5][s]=1;
		q.push(statu(5,s,0));
		int ans;
		while (!q.empty()) {
			statu now=q.front();
			q.pop();
			int p=now.p,val=now.val,depth=now.depth,temp,pval=(val/ten[p])%10;
			if (val==t) {
				ans=depth;
				break;
			}
			//opt 1
			temp=L(p,val,pval);
			if (!visit[p][temp]) {
				visit[p][temp]=1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,depth+1));
			}
			//opt 2
			temp=R(p,val,pval);
			if (!visit[p][temp]) {
				visit[p][temp]=1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,depth+1));
			}
			//opt 3
			if (pval!=9) {
				temp=val+ten[p];
				if (!visit[p][temp]) {
					visit[p][temp]=1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,depth+1));
				}
			}
			//opt 4
			if (pval!=0) {
				temp=val-ten[p];
				if (!visit[p][temp]) {
					visit[p][temp]=1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,depth+1));
				}
			}
			//opt 5
			if (p!=0) {
				if (!visit[p-1][val]) {
					visit[p-1][val]=1;
					q.push(statu(p-1,val,depth+1));
				}
			}
			//opt 6
			if (p!=5) {
				if (!visit[p+1][val]) {
					visit[p+1][val]=1;
					q.push(statu(p+1,val,depth+1));
				}
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//63Evio.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

struct statu {
	int p,val;
	bool s;
	statu() {}
	statu(int _p,int _val,bool _s):p(_p),val(_val),s(_s) {}
};
char visit[6][1000000][2];
int s,t;
int ten[6]= {1,10,100,1000,10000,100000};
inline int L(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int left=val/100000;
	return val + (pval-left)*100000 + (left-pval)*ten[p];
}
inline int R(int p,int val,int pval) {
	int right=val%10;
	return val + (pval-right) + (right-pval)*ten[p];
}
int main() {
	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
	while (scanf("%d%d",&s,&t)!=EOF) {
		if (s==t) {
			puts("0");
			continue;
		}
		memset(visit,-1,sizeof(visit));
		queue<statu> q;
		visit[5][s][0]=0;
		q.push(statu(5,s,0));
		for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
			visit[i][t][1]=0;
			q.push(statu(i,t,1));
		}
		int ans=-1;
		while (!q.empty()) {
			statu now=q.front();
			q.pop();
			int p=now.p,val=now.val,st=now.s;
			int depth=visit[p][val][st],temp,pval=(val/ten[p])%10;
			if (visit[p][val][st^1]>0) {
				ans=depth+visit[p][val][st^1];
				break;
			}
			//opt 1
			temp=L(p,val,pval);
			if (visit[p][temp][st]<0) {
//				printf("%d %d %d %d\n",p,temp,st,depth+1);
				visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
			}
			//opt 2
			temp=R(p,val,pval);
			if (visit[p][temp][st]<0) {
//				printf("%d %d %d %d\n",p,temp,st,depth+1);
				visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
				q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
			}
			//opt 3
			if (pval!=9) {
				temp=val+ten[p];
				if (visit[p][temp][st]<0) {
//				printf("%d %d %d %d\n",p,temp,st,depth+1);
					visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 4
			if (pval!=0) {
				temp=val-ten[p];
				if (visit[p][temp][st]<0) {
//				printf("%d %d %d %d\n",p,temp,st,depth+1);
					visit[p][temp][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p,temp,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 5
			if (p!=0) {
				if (visit[p-1][val][st]<0) {
					visit[p-1][val][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p-1,val,st));
				}
			}
			//opt 6
			if (p!=5) {
				if (visit[p+1][val][st]<0) {
					visit[p+1][val][st]=depth+1;
					q.push(statu(p+1,val,st));
				}
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//6.cpp

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

LL t;
int n;

pair<LL, pii> a[100010];

vector <pii> tmp;

LL val = 0;

map<LL, vector<pii> > b;

pii rev(pii aa) {
	return mp(-aa.fir, -aa.sec);
}

void dfs(int dep) {
	if ((b.size() & 1048575) == 0)cerr << b.size() << endl;
	if (b.size() > 10000000) return;
	if (dep > 4) return;
	if (b.find(val) == b.end() || b[val].size() > tmp.size())
		b[val] = tmp;
	else return;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		tmp.push_back(a[i].sec);
		val += a[i].fir;
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val -= a[i].fir;
		tmp.pop_back();

		tmp.push_back(rev(a[i].sec));
		val -= a[i].fir;
		dfs(dep + 1);
		val += a[i].fir;
		tmp.pop_back();
	}
}

int main() {
	cin >> t >> n;
	cout << t << endl;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		int x, y;
		LL bb;
		cin >> x >> y;
		cin >> bb;
		a[i] = mp(bb, mp(x, y));
	}

	dfs(0);

	int ans = 0x3f3f3f3f;
	map<LL, vector<pii> >::iterator x, y;

	for (map<LL, vector<pii> >::iterator i = b.begin(), j; i != b.end(); i++) {
		LL z = t - i->fir;
		j = b.find(z);
		if (j != b.end()) {
			int tot = (int)i->sec.size() + j->sec.size();
			if (tot < ans) {
				ans = tot;
				x = i, y = j;
			}
		}
	}

	printf("%d\n", ans * 2);
	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n%d\n", x->sec[i].fir, x->sec[i].sec);

	x = y;

	for (int i = 0; i < x->sec.size(); i++) printf("%d\n%d\n", x->sec[i].fir, x->sec[i].sec);

	return 0;
}

//724B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct point {
	int x,y;
	point() {}
	point(int _x,int _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
};

int n,m;
int dx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[4]= {0,0,1,-1},pr[105][105];
bool map[105][105],visit[105][105];
char r[105];

inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
	return x && x<=n && y && y<=m;
}

inline void work() {
	queue<point> q;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%s",r+1);
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (r[j]=='T')
				map[i][j]=1;
			else {
				q.push(point(i,j));
				visit[i][j]=1;
				pr[i][j]=map[i][j]=0;
			}
		}
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (!visit[i][1]) {
			q.push(point(i,1));
			visit[i][1]=1;
			pr[i][1]=1;
		}
		if (!visit[i][m]) {
			q.push(point(i,m));
			visit[i][m]=1;
			pr[i][m]=1;
		}
	}
	for (int i=2; i<m; i++) {
		if (!visit[1][i]) {
			q.push(point(1,i));
			visit[1][i]=1;
			pr[1][i]=1;
		}
		if (!visit[n][i]) {
			q.push(point(n,i));
			visit[n][i]=1;
			pr[n][i]=1;

		}
	}
	while (!q.empty()) {
		int nowx=q.front().x,nowy=q.front().y;
		q.pop();
		for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
			int x=nowx+dx[i],y=nowy+dy[i];
			if (inrange(x,y) && !visit[x][y]) {
				visit[x][y]=1;
				pr[x][y]=pr[nowx][nowy]+1;
				q.push(point(x,y));
			}
		}
	}
}

inline void print() {
	bool flag=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			if (pr[j][i]>9) {
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (flag) break;
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++,printf("\n"))
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (flag)
				putchar('.');
			if (pr[i][j]==0)
				printf("..");
			else {
				if (pr[i][j]<10)
					printf(".%d",pr[i][j]);
				else
					printf("%d",pr[i][j]);
			}
		}
}

int main() {
	while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
		memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
		work();
		print();
	}
	return 0;
}

//724C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[100005];

int n,m,s,t,ecnt=0,head[105];
long long dp[11][105];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

int main() {
	while (scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&s,&t)!=EOF) {
		memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
		memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
		dp[0][s]=1;
		ecnt=0;
		for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
			scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
			add(u,v);
			add(v,u);
		}
		for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
			for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
				for (int now=head[j]; now; now=e[now].next) {
					int v=e[now].to;
					dp[i][j]+=dp[i-1][v];
				}
			}
		}
		long long ans=0;
		for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			ans+=dp[t][i];
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//724E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

bool block[30][3];
long long dp[30][125];
int n,k;
int main() {
	while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&k)!=EOF) {
		memset(block,0,sizeof(block));
		for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
			double x,y;
			scanf("%lf%lf",&x,&y);
			block[int(x)+1][int(y)]=1;
		}
		memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
		dp[0][0]=1;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			for (int j=0; j<125; j++) {
				if (!dp[i-1][j])
					continue;
				int x[3]= {j%5,(j/5)%5,j/25};
				for (int k=0; k<125; k++) {
					int y[3]= {k%5,(k/5)%5,k/25};
					bool flag=1;
					for (int r=0; r<3; r++) {
						if (block[i][r] && y[r]!=0) {
							flag=0;
							break;
						}
						if (x[r]==1 && y[r]!=2) {
							flag=0;
							break;
						}
						if (y[r]==2 && x[r]!=1) {
							flag=0;
							break;
						}
						if (y[r]==3 && (r==2 || y[r+1]!=4)) {
							flag=0;
							break;
						}
						if (y[r]==4 && (r==0 || y[r-1]!=3)) {
							flag=0;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag) {
						dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][j];
					}
				}
			}
		}
		long long ans=0;
		for (int i=0; i<125; i++) {
			int x[3]= {i%5,(i/5)%5,i/25};
			bool flag=1;
			for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
				if (x[j]==1)
					flag=0;
			}
			if (flag) ans+=dp[n][i];
		}
		printf("%lld\n",ans);
	}

	return 0;
}

//724G.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,now;
bool map[12][12],temp[12][12];
char r[12],s[200],ans[12][12];

inline bool check() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			if (map[i][j]) {
				if (ans[i][j]) {
					if (ans[i][j]!=s[now++])
						return 1;
				} else ans[i][j]=s[now++];
			}
		}
	return 0;
}

inline void turn() {
	for (int i=1,nowj=1; i<=n; i++,nowj++)
		for (int j=1,nowi=n; j<=n; j++,nowi--) {
			temp[i][j]=map[nowi][nowj];
		}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			map[i][j]=temp[i][j];
		}
}

inline bool work() {
	if (check()) return 0;
	turn();
	if (check()) return 0;
	turn();
	if (check()) return 0;
	turn();
	if (check()) return 0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			if (!ans[i][j])
				return 0;
		}
	return 1;
}

inline void print() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			putchar(ans[i][j]);
		}
	puts("");
}

int main() {
	while (scanf("%d",&n)!=EOF) {
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%s",r+1);
			for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
				if (r[j]=='X')
					map[i][j]=0;
				else {
					map[i][j]=1;
				}
			}
		}
		scanf("%s",s+1);
		memset(ans,0,sizeof(ans));
		now=1;
		if (work())	print();
		else puts("invalid grille");
	}
	return 0;
}

//724H.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int a[100005],n,k;

inline int check(int len) {
	int cnt=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		int now=a[i];
		cnt++;
		while (i<n && a[i+1]-now<len)
			i++;
	}
	return cnt;
}

int main() {
	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	while (t--) {
		scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%d",a+i);
		}
		int l=1,r=a[n],mid;
		while (l<r) {
			mid=(l+r)>>1;
			if (check(mid)<=k)
				r=mid;
			else
				l=mid+1;
		}
		printf("%d\n",l);
	}
	return 0;
}

//724I.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n;
int a[105],v[105],dp[105];

int main() {
	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	while (t--) {
		int ans=0;
		scanf("%d",&n);
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%d",a+i);
			int temp=a[i];
			v[i]=0;
			while (temp>0 && (temp&1)^1) {
				temp>>=1;
				v[i]++;
			}
		}
		a[0]=0;
		dp[0]=0;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			dp[i]=0;
			for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
				if (a[j]<a[i])
					dp[i]=max(dp[i],dp[j]+v[i]);
			}
			ans=max(ans,dp[i]);
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

//725A.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long gcd(long long a,long long b) {
	if (b)
		return gcd(b,a%b);
	return a;
}

char r[25];
int len,num[100];
long long ten[17],nine[17];

inline void init() {
	ten[0]=nine[0]=1;
	nine[1]=9;
	for (int i=1; i<17; i++)
		ten[i]=ten[i-1]*10;
	for (int i=2; i<17; i++)
		nine[i]=nine[i-1]*10+9;
}

int main() {
	init();
	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	for (int ca=1; ca<=t; ca++) {
		scanf("%s",r+1);
		len=strlen(r+1);
		int cnt=0,p=-1,lp=-1,rp=-1;
		for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
			if (r[i]>='0' && r[i]<='9')
				num[++cnt]=r[i]-'0';
			else if (r[i]=='.') {
				p=cnt;
			} else if (r[i]=='(') {
				lp=cnt;
			} else if (r[i]==')')
				rp=cnt;
		}
		if (p==-1) {
			printf("Case #%d: ",ca);
			for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
				printf("%d",num[i]);
			}
			printf("/1\n");
			continue;
		}
		long long nl=0,nm=1,loop=0,lm=1;
		if (lp==-1 || lp==rp) {
			for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
				nl=nl*10+num[i];
			}
			nm=ten[cnt-p];
			long long g=gcd(nl,nm);
			nl/=g;
			nm/=g;
			printf("Case #%d: %lld/%lld\n",ca,nl,nm);
		} else {
			for (int i=1; i<=lp; i++) {
				nl=nl*10+num[i];
			}
			nm=ten[lp-p];
			for (int i=lp+1; i<=cnt; i++) {
				loop=loop*10+num[i];
			}
			nl=nl*nine[rp-lp]+loop;
			lm=nine[rp-lp]*nm;
			long long g=gcd(nl,lm);
			nl/=g;
			lm/=g;
			printf("Case #%d: %lld/%lld\n",ca,nl,lm);
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

//725B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 1005
using namespace std;

int n,m;
char r[MAXN];
bool map[MAXN][MAXN];
int dp[8][MAXN][MAXN];

inline void init() {
	memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
	memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
}

inline void work() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (map[i-1][j]) {
				dp[1][i][j]=dp[0][i-1][j]+1;
				dp[2][i][j]=dp[3][i-1][j]+1;
			}
		}
		for (int j=2; j<=m; j++) {
			if (map[i][j-1]) {
				dp[0][i][j]=dp[1][i][j-1]+1;
			}
		}
		for (int j=m-1; j>0; j--) {
			if (map[i][j+1]) {
				dp[3][i][j]=dp[2][i][j+1]+1;
			}
		}
	}
	for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (map[i+1][j]) {
				dp[4][i][j]=dp[5][i+1][j]+1;
				dp[7][i][j]=dp[6][i+1][j]+1;
			}
		}
		for (int j=2; j<=m; j++) {
			if (map[i][j-1]) {
				dp[5][i][j]=dp[4][i][j-1]+1;
			}
		}
		for (int j=m-1; j>0; j--) {
			if (map[i][j+1]) {
				dp[6][i][j]=dp[7][i][j+1]+1;
			}
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	while (t--) {
		scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
		init();
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%s",r+1);
			for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
				map[i][j]=(r[j]=='1');
			}
		}
		work();
		int ans=0;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
			for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
				if (map[i][j]) {
					ans=max(ans,dp[0][i][j]+dp[2][i][j]+dp[4][i][j]+dp[6][i][j]);
				}
			}
		printf("%d\n",ans+1);
	}
	return 0;
}

//725C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long n,k;
int vis[105],q[105],cnt;
int main() {
	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	while (t--) {
		scanf("%lld%lld",&n,&k);
		memset(vis,0,sizeof(vis));
		int now=n%100;
		vis[now]=1;
		q[cnt=1]=now;
		now=(now<<1)%100;
		while (!vis[now]) {
			vis[now]=++cnt;
			q[cnt]=now;
			now=(now<<1)%100;
		}
		int lpst=vis[now]-1,len=cnt-vis[now]+1;
		if (k<=lpst) {
			for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
				n+=q[i];
			}
		} else {
			for (int i=1; i<=lpst; i++) {
				n+=q[i];
			}
			k-=lpst;
			long long sum=0;
			for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
				sum+=q[lpst+i];
			}
			long long times=k/len;
			n+=times*sum;
			times=k%len;
			for (int i=1; i<=times; i++) {
				n+=q[lpst+i];
			}
		}
		printf("%lld\n",n);
	}

	return 0;
}

//725D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 105
using namespace std;

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[100005];

int n,ecnt,head[MAXN],block,f[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
int ch=0;
inline int readln(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
		if (ch==-1)
			return EOF;
		ch=getchar();
	}
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
	if (ch=='\n')
		return 0;
	else
		return 1;
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void init() {
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		f[i]=i;
	}
}

int getf(int x) {
	if (f[x]==x)
		return x;
	return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline bool merge(int a,int b) {
	int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
	if (fa==fb) return 0;
	f[fa]=fb;
	return 1;
}

int main() {
	while (readln(n)!=EOF && n) {
		memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
		ecnt=0;
		int u,v,ans=0;
		readln(u);
		while (u) {
			while (readln(v))
				add(u,v);
			add(v,u);
			add(u,v);
			add(v,u);
			readln(u);
		}
		for (block=1; block<=n; block++) {
			init();
			int cnt=0;
			for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
				if (i==block) continue;
				for (int now=head[i]; now; now=e[now].next) {
					if (e[now].to!=block) {
						if (merge(e[now].to,i))
							cnt++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (cnt<n-2)
				ans++;
		}
		printf("%d\n",ans);
	}
	return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

//725G.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXE 20005
#define MAXN 1005
#define s 1024
#define INF 1061109567
using namespace std;

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXE<<1];

int n,m,ta,ecnt;
int head[MAXN],t[s<<1],dis[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void init() {
	memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
	memset(t,63,sizeof(t));
	memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
	memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
	ecnt=0;
}

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
	x+=s;
	t[x]=d;
	for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)^1]);
}

inline int query() {
	int now=1;
	while (now<s) {
		if (t[now<<1]<t[(now<<1)^1])
			now=now<<1;
		else
			now=(now<<1)^1;
	}
	return now-s;
}

inline void dijkstra() {
	while (t[1]<INF) {
		int x=query();
		visit[x]=1;
		dis[x]=t[x+s];
		update(x,INF);
		for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
			v=e[now].to;
			if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[v+s])
				update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	while (scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&ta)==3) {
		init();
		for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
			scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
			add(u,v,w);
		}
		int tot;
		scanf("%d",&tot);
		for (int i=1,x; i<=tot; i++) {
			scanf("%d",&x);
			update(x,0);
		}
		dijkstra();
		if (dis[ta]==INF)
			printf("-1\n");
		else
			printf("%d\n",dis[ta]);
	}
	return 0;
}

	int t;
	scanf("%d",&t);
	while (t--) {
		long long n,ans=0;
		scanf("%lld",&n);
		for (long long i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			long long now=n/i,to=n/now;
			ans+=((to-i+1)%MOD)*(now%MOD);
			ans%=MOD;
			i=to;
		}

	}

}

//729A.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n;
int a[100005];
int m;
long long ans=0,s[100005],cnt[100005];
int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
	}
	sort(a+1,a+n+1);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (a[i]!=a[i-1])
			s[++m]=a[i],cnt[m]=1;
		else
			cnt[m]++;
	}
	for (long long now=2; now<= s[m]<<1; now<<=1) {
		int i=1,j=1;
		while (j<m && s[i]+s[j]<now)
			j++;
		while (i<=j) {
			while (i<=j && s[i]+s[j]>now)
				j--;
			if (i>j)
				break;
			if (s[i]+s[j]==now) {
				if (i==j) {
					ans+=(cnt[i]*(cnt[i]-1))>>1;
				} else {
					ans+=cnt[i]*cnt[j];
				}
			}
			i++;
		}
	}
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//729C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

int n,m,ans=0;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN];

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		scanf("%d",b+i);
	}
	int tower=1;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		int dis=abs(a[i]-b[tower]);
		while (tower<m && dis>=abs(a[i]-b[tower+1])) {
			dis=abs(a[i]-b[++tower]);
		}
		ans=max(ans,dis);
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

//729D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long d,k,a,b,t;
long long ans=0;
int main() {
	cin>>d>>k>>a>>b>>t;
	if (d<=k) {
		cout<<d*a<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	d-=k;
	ans+=k*a;
	if (k*a+t>=b*k) {
		ans+=d*b;
		cout<<ans<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	ans+=(d/k)*(k*a+t)+min((d%k)*a+t,b*(d%k));
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	cin.tie(0);
	cout.tie(0);
	cin>>n>>m;
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
		cin>>go[i][0];
	}
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
		cin>>w[i];
		dis[i][0]=ma[i][0]=w[i];
	}
	for (int k=1; 1ll<<k <= m; k++) {
		int k_=k-1;
		for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			go[i][k]=go[go[i][k_]][k_];
			dis[i][k]=dis[i][k_]+dis[go[i][k_]][k_];
			ma[i][k]=min(ma[i][k_],ma[go[i][k_]][k_]);
		}
	}
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
		int x=i;
		long long d=0,minw=123456789;
		for (int k=33; k>-1; k--) {
			if ((m>>k)&1) {
				d+=dis[x][k];
				minw=min(minw,ma[x][k]);
				x=go[x][k];
			}
		}
		cout<<d<<" "<<minw<<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

//825B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 45500
long long a, b, c, d;
//  00 01 10 11
long long x,y,z;
long long zero=-1,one=-1;
int sta[MAXN<<1],top=0;
int main() {
	cin>>a>>b>>c>>d;
	x=a<<1;
	y=d<<1;
	z=b+c;
	for (int i=1,temp; i<=45000; i++) {
		temp=((i-1)*i);
		if (temp==x) {
			zero=i;
		}
		if (temp==y) {
			one=i;
		}
	}
	if (zero==-1 || one==-1) {
		puts("Impossible");
		return 0;
	}
	if (z==0) {
		if (x && y) {
			puts("Impossible");
			return 0;
		}
		if (!x && !y) {
			puts("0");
			return 0;
		}
		if (x) {
			for (int j=1; j<=zero; j++) putchar('0');
			putchar('\n');
			return 0;
		}
		for (int j=1; j<=one; j++) putchar('1');
		putchar('\n');
		return 0;
	}
	if (z!=zero*one) {
		puts("Impossible");
		return 0;
	}
	long long nowone=one,nowzero=zero;
	while (c>0) {
		while (c>=nowone) {
			sta[++top]='0';
			c-=nowone;
			nowzero--;
		}
		while (nowone>c) {
			sta[++top]='1';
			nowone--;
		}
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=nowzero; i++) {
		putchar('0');
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=nowone; i++) {
		putchar('1');
	}
	while (top) {
		putchar(sta[top--]);
	}

	putchar('\n');
	return 0;
}

//825C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 400005

struct edge {
	int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,nn,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
int subs[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],top[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
	subs[x]=1;
	maxs[x]=0;
	top[x]=0;
	for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
		v=e[now].to;
		if (v!=fa) {
			dfs(v,x);
			subs[x]+=subs[v];
			maxs[x]=max(maxs[x],subs[v]-top[v]);
			top[x]=max(top[x],top[v]);
			if (subs[v]<=nn) top[x]=max(top[x],subs[v]);
		}
	}
	if (subs[x]<=nn) top[x]=subs[x];
	if ((n-subs[x])<=nn) {
		if (maxs[x]<=nn)
			ans[i]=1;
		else
			ans[i]=-1;
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
		add(u,v);
	}
	nn=n>>1;
	dfs(1,0);
	getans(1,0);
	return 0;
}

// 877.cpp
// Created on 2016-07-08 20:56

#include <stdio.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
using namespace std;
const int mx=1024;
int tpn,n,a[mx],f[mx][mx],b[mx],ans,ma[mx];

struct segtree {
	int t[mx<<1];
	inline int getmax(int l,int r);
	inline void update(int num,int po);
} s[mx];
inline int segtree::getmax(int l,int r) {
	int out=0;
	l=l+mx-1;
	r=r+mx+1;
	while(r!=l+1) {
		if((l&1)^1) out=max(out,t[l+1]);
		if(r&1) out=max(out,t[r-1]);
		l>>=1;
		r>>=1;
	}
	return out;
}
inline void segtree::update(int num,int po) {
	po+=mx;
	t[po]=num;
	po>>=1;
	while(po) {
		t[po]=max(t[po<<1],t[(po<<1)+1]);
		po>>=1;
	}
}

inline void update(int ar[mx],int po) {
	for(int i=0; i<=n; i++) s[i].update(ar[i],po+1);
}
inline void getmax(int d) {
	for(int i=0; i<=n; i++) b[i]=s[i].getmax(1,d+1)+1;
}

int main() {
	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%d",&tpn);
	for(int i=1; i<=tpn; i++) scanf("%d",a+i);

	for(int i=1; i<=tpn; i++) ma[i]=a[i];
	sort(ma+1,ma+1+tpn);
	n=unique(ma+1,ma+1+tpn)-ma-1;

	for(int i=1; i<=tpn; i++) {
		int d=lower_bound(ma+1,ma+n,a[i])-ma;
		memset(b,0,sizeof(b));
		getmax(d);
		for(int x=0; x<=n; x++) {
			f[d][x]=b[x];
			f[x][d]=b[x];
			ans=max(ans,b[x]);
		}
		update(b,d);
		for(int x=0; x<=n; x++) s[d].update(f[d][x],x+1);
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

//92F.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXP 32000
#define MAXN 105
#define INF 12345678

struct edge {
	int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

bool notprime[MAXP+5];
int n,m,s,t,ans=0,pcnt,p[3500],a[MAXN],temp[MAXN],x[MAXN],y[MAXN];

int ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

int tag[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

void init() {
	for (int i=2; i<=MAXP; i++) {
		if (!notprime[i]) {
			p[++pcnt]=i;
			for (int j=i*i; j<=MAXP; j+=i) {
				notprime[j]=1;
			}
		}
	}
}

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].to=v;
	e[ecnt].next=head[u];
	e[ecnt].w=w;
	head[u]=ecnt;
	e[++ecnt].to=u;
	e[ecnt].next=head[v];
	e[ecnt].w=0;
	head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline bool bfs() {
	memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
	queue<int> q;
	tag[0]=1;
	bool flag=0;
	q.push(0);
	while (!q.empty()) {
		int x=q.front();
		q.pop();
		if (x==t) flag=1;
		for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
			v=e[now].to;
			if (!tag[v] && e[now].w) {
				tag[v]=tag[x]+1;
				q.push(v);
			}
		}
	}
	return flag;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
	visit[x]=1;
	if (x==t) return flow;
	for (int now=head[x],v,re; now; now=e[now].next) {
		v=e[now].to;
		if (!visit[v] && e[now].w) {
			if (re=dfs(v,min(flow,e[now].w))) {
				e[now].w-=re;
				e[now^1].w+=re;
				return re;
			}
		}
	}
	visit[x]=0;
	return 0;
}

void work() {
	ecnt=1;
	memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i+=2) {
		add(s,i,temp[i]);
	}
	for (int i=2; i<=n; i+=2) {
		add(i,t,temp[i]);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		add(x[i],y[i],INF);
	}
	int re;
	while (bfs()) {
		while (re=dfs(0,INF)) {
			ans+=re;
			memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
		}
		memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
	}
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	s=0,t=n+1;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%d",a+i);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d",x+i,y+i);
		if (y[i]&1) swap(x[i],y[i]);
	}
	init();
	for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
		bool flag=0;
		for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
			temp[j]=0;
			while (!(a[j]%p[i])) {
				a[j]/=p[i];
				temp[j]++;
			}
			if (temp[j]) flag=1;
		}
		if (flag) {
			work();
		}
	}
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		if (a[i]>1) {
			for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
				if (i==j) continue;
				temp[j]=0;
				while (!(a[j]%a[i])) {
					a[j]/=a[i];
					temp[j]++;
				}
			}
			temp[i]=1;
			a[i]=1;
			work();
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();

#define MAXN 1000319

	read(n);
	read(K);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		int ai;
		scanf("%d", &ai);
		printf("%d\n", i);
		fflush(stdout);
		pre[i] = last[ai];
		last[ai] = i;
	}
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		int bi;
		read(bi);
		sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + bi;
	}
	dp[0] = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		if (pre[i]) dp[i] = max(dp[pre[i] - 1] + sum[i] - sum[pre[i] - 1], dp[pre[i]] + sum[i] - sum[pre[i]]);
		dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - 1]);
	}
	printf("%lld\n", dp[n]);
	return 0;

		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch=getchar();
	}
	a = 0;
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 100005

int n, m, g, tot;
int dp[MAXN][2];

inline int Modadd(int a, int b) {
	a += b;
	if (a >= MOD) return a - MOD;
	else return a;
}

void work() {
	int now = 0;
	dp[0][g] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++, now ^= 1) {
		int mm = min(i, m);
		for (int j = mm; j > 0; j--) dp[j][now^0] = Modadd(dp[j][now^0], dp[j - 1][now^0]), dp[j][now^1] = Modadd(dp[j][now^1], dp[j - 1][now^0]);
	}
	printf("%d\n", (dp[m][now^1] + dp[m - 1][now]) % MOD);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("A.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("A.out", "w", stdout);
	read(n);
	read(m);
	read(g);
	tot = n + m - 1;
	work();
	return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();

const int N = 20005;
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

int n;
int val[2][2][N], cnt[N];
LL tot = 0;

LL dfs(int dep, LL alpha, LL beta) {
	if (!dep) return tot;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		if (cnt[i] < 2) {
			cnt[i]++;
			tot += val[dep & 1][cnt[i] - 1][i];
			LL ret = -dfs(dep - 1, -beta, -alpha);
			tot -= val[dep & 1][cnt[i] - 1][i];
			cnt[i]--;

			if (ret >= beta) return beta;
			if (ret > alpha) {
				alpha = ret;
			}
		}
	}
	return alpha;
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		read(val[0][0][i]);
		read(val[1][0][i]);
		read(val[0][1][i]);
		read(val[1][1][i]);
		val[1][0][i] *= -1;
		val[1][1][i] *= -1;
	}
	printf("%lld\n", dfs(2 * n, -INF, INF));
	return 0;
}

//ab.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}
#define MOD 1000000000
typedef long long LL;
LL temp[1000];
struct num {
	int v[1000],len;
	num():len(0) {}
	num operator = (int x) {
		memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
		v[0]=x;
		return *this;
	}
	int &operator [](int x) {
		return v[x];
	}
	num operator + (num a) {
		len=max(len,a.len);
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
			v[i]+=a[i];
			if (v[i]>=MOD) v[i]-=MOD,v[i+1]++;
		}
		if (v[len+1]) len++;
		return *this;
	}
	num operator - (num a) {
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
			v[i]-=a[i];
			while (v[i]<0) v[i]+=MOD,v[i+1]--;
		}
		while (!v[len] && len>0) len--;
		return *this;
	}
	num operator * (num a) {
		memset(temp,0,sizeof(temp));
		for (int i=0; i<=len; i++)
			for (int j=0; j<=a.len; j++)
				temp[i+j]+=LL(v[i])*LL(a[j]);
		int l=len+a.len;
		num c;
		for (int i=0; i<=l; i++) {
			c[i]=int(temp[i]%MOD);
			temp[i+1]+=temp[i]/MOD;
			if (i==l && temp[i+1]) l++;
		}
		c.len=l;
		return c;
	}
	num operator += (num a) {
		return *this+a;
	}
	num operator -= (int a) {
		num x;
		x=a;
		return *this-x;
	}
	num operator -= (num a) {
		return *this-a;
	}
	void print() {
		printf("%d",v[len]);
		for (int i=len-1; i>-1; i--) {
			printf("%08d",v[i]);
		}
		putchar('\n');
	}
}

int main() {

	return 0;
}

//AC4567.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<ctime>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iomanip>
#include<vector>
#include<stack>
#include<queue>
#include<map>
#include<set>
#include<bitset>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100010
#define MAXM 510010
#define ll long long
#define INF 1000000000
#define MOD 1000000007
#define eps 1e-8
int son[MAXM][26];
char s[MAXM];
bool v[MAXM];
int tms[MAXM];
int tim;
int rt,tot;
int n;
ll ans;
vector<int>mp[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];
bool cmp(int x,int y) {
	return siz[x]<siz[y];
}
void ins() {
	int l=strlen(s+1);
	int p=rt;
	int i;
	for(i=l; i; i--) {
		if(!son[p][s[i]-'a']) {
			son[p][s[i]-'a']=++tot;
		}
		p=son[p][s[i]-'a'];
	}
	v[p]=1;
}
void dfs(int x) {
	int i;
	if(v[x]) {
		mp[tms[x]].push_back(++tim);
		tms[x]=tim;
	}
	for(i=0; i<26; i++) {
		if(son[x][i]) {
			tms[son[x][i]]=tms[x];
			dfs(son[x][i]);
		}
	}
}
void dp(int x) {
	int i,y;
	siz[x]=1;
	for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
		y=mp[x][i];
		dp(y);
		siz[x]+=siz[y];
	}
}
void cal(int x) {
	int i;
	tms[x]=++tim;
	sort(mp[x].begin(),mp[x].end(),cmp);
	for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
		ans+=tim+1-tms[x];
		cal(mp[x][i]);
	}
}
int main() {
	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	int i;
	rt=tot=1;
	scanf("%d",&n);
	for(i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		scanf("%s",s+1);
		ins();
	}
	tms[rt]=tim=1;
	dfs(rt);
	dp(1);
	tim=0;
	cal(1);
	printf("%lld\n",ans);
	return 0;
}

	a += b;
	if (a >= MOD) return a - MOD;
	else return a;

	int now = 1, pre = 0;
	dp[0][0][g] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++, now ^= 1, pre ^= 1) {

/* Never Say Die */
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define NAME CoinsQuery
#define METHOD query

#define MOD 1000000007

class NAME {

	LL dp[10319], cnt[103][10319];
public:
	vector <LL> METHOD(vector<int> w, vector <int> v, vector<int> query) {
		memset(dp, -1, sizeof dp);
		memset(cnt, 0, sizeof cnt);
		dp[0] = 0, cnt[0] = 1;
		int n = (int)w.size();
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			for (int j = w[i]; j <= 10000; j++) {
				if (dp[j - w[i]] != -1 && dp[j] < dp[j - w[i]] + v[i]) dp[j] = dp[j - w[i]] + v[i];
			}
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			for (int j = w[i]; j <= 10000; j++) {
				if (dp[j - w[i]] != -1 && dp[j] < dp[j - w[i]] + v[i]) dp[j] = dp[j - w[i]] + v[i];
			}
		}
		vector <LL> ret;
		for (int i = 0; i < query.size(); i++) {
			if (query[i] > 10000 || dp[query[i]] == -1) {
				ret.push_back(-1);
				ret.push_back(-1);
			} else {
				ret.push_back(dp[query[i]]);
				ret.push_back(cnt[query[i]]);
			}
		}
		return ret;
	}

} test_case;

int main() {

	vector <int> a = {2,3,5}, b = {20, 30, 50}, c = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6};
	vector <LL> ret = test_case.METHOD(a, b, c);
	for (int i = 0; i < ret.size(); i++) {
		printf("%lld ", ret[i]);
	}
	return 0;
}

//AlexGo.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#define PRID "alexgo10"
int d[2100004];
int n,q;
inline void nextInt(int& a) {
	bool f=0;
	a = 0;
	char ch = getchar();
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch=='-')
			f=1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f)
		a=-a;
}

int main() {
//	freopen(PRID ".in","r",stdin);
//	freopen(PRID ".out","w",stdout);
	nextInt(n);
	int last=0,now;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		nextInt(now);
		d[i]=now-last;
		last=now;
	}
	nextInt(q);
	for (int i=1,l,r,x; i<=q; i++) {
		nextInt(l);
		nextInt(r);
		nextInt(x);
		d[l]+=x;
		d[r+1]-=x;
	}
	int MIN=100000009,MAX=-100000009;
	now=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		now+=d[i];
		if (MIN>now)
			MIN=now;
		if (MAX<now)
			MAX=now;
	}
	printf("%d %d",MAX,MIN);
	return 0;
}

//AlexGoWithSegTree.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

inline void read(int& a) {
	int ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>'9' || ch<'0')
		ch=getchar();
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
	return;
}
int t[4194305],lazy[4194305],L[4194305],R[4194305],s,m,n;
inline void getSize(int& s) {
	for (s=1; s<n; s<<=1);
	return;
}
inline void init() {
	read(n);
	read(m);
	getSize(s);
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
		read(t[s+i]);
		L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i+1;
	}
	for (int i=n; i<s; i++)
		L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i+1;
	for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
		t[i]=min(t[i<<1],t[(i<<1)+1]);
		L[i]=L[i<<1];
		R[i]=R[(i<<1)+1];
	}
	return;
}
inline void pushdown(int x) {
	if (lazy[x]==0)
		return;
	if (L[x]==R[x])
		return;
	t[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
	lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
	t[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x];
	lazy[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x];
	lazy[x]=0;
	return;
}
void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
	pushdown(x);
	if (l>r)
		return;
	if (l>R[x])
		return;
	if (r<L[x])
		return;
	if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
		t[x]+=d;
		lazy[x]+=d;
		return;
	}
	int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
	if (l<=mid) {
		update(x<<1,l,min(mid,r),d);
	}
	if (r>mid) {
		update((x<<1)+1,max(mid+1,l),r,d);
	}
	t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)+1]);
	return;
}
inline void work() {
	for (int i=1,d,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
		read(d);
		read(l);
		read(r);
		update(1,l,r,-d);
		if (t[1]<0) {
			printf("-1\n%d\n",i);
			return;
		}
	}
	puts("0");
	return;
}
int main() {
	init();
	work();
	return 0;
}

	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();

const int N = 20005;
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

int n;
int val[2][2][N], cnt[N];

LL dfs(int dep) {
	if (!dep) return 0;
	LL ret = -INF;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		if (cnt[i] < 2) {
			cnt[i]++;
			ret = max(ret, val[dep & 1][cnt[i] - 1][i] - dfs(dep - 1));
			cnt[i]--;
		}
	}
	return ret;
}

	read(n);

		read(val[0][1][i]);
		read(val[1][1][i]);
	}
	printf("%lld\n", dfs(2 * n));
	return 0;
}

//angrybirds.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
const double eps=1e-8;
struct point {
	double x,y;
} a[25];
int T;
int n,m;
struct edge {
	int next,w;
} e[1000];

int head[25],ecnt,dp[262146];

int check(point _a,point _b) {
	double x1=_a.x,x2=_b.x,m1=x1*x1,m2=x2*x2,y1=_a.y,y2=_b.y;
	double B=(y1*(m2/m1)-y2)/(x1*(m2/m1)-x2);
	double A=(y2-B*x2)/m2;
	if (A>=-eps) return 0;
	int ret=0;
	for (int i=n-1; i>=0; i--) {
		ret<<=1;
		if (abs(a[i].x*a[i].x*A+a[i].x*B-a[i].y)<eps) ret|=1;
	}
	return ret;
}

inline void add(int x,int w) {
	e[++ecnt].w=w;
	e[ecnt].next=head[x];
	head[x]=ecnt;
}
void work() {
	int top=(1<<n)-1;
	ecnt=0;
	memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
		for (int j=i+1; j<n; j++) {
			int ret=check(a[i],a[j]);
			if (ret) {
				add(i,ret);
				add(j,ret);
			}
		}
	for (int i=1; i<=top; i++) dp[i]=0x3f3f3f3f;
	for (int i=0; i<top; i++) {
		int p=0;
		for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
			if (!((i>>j)&1)) {
				p=j;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (dp[i|(1<<p)]>dp[i]+1) dp[i|(1<<p)]=dp[i]+1;
		for (int now=head[p]; now; now=e[now].next) {
			if (dp[i|e[now].w]>dp[i]+1) dp[i|e[now].w]=dp[i]+1;
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n",dp[top]);
}

int main() {
	scanf("%d",&T);
	while (T--) {
		scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
		for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			scanf("%lf%lf",&a[i].x,&a[i].y);
		}
		work();
	}
	return 0;
}

	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();

const int N = 20005;
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

int n;
int val[2][2][N], cnt[N];
LL tot = 0;

typedef pair <LL, string> hh;

hh dfs(int dep, LL alpha, LL beta) {
	if (!dep) return mp(tot, "");
	string des = "";
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		if (cnt[i] < 2) {
			cnt[i]++;
			tot += val[dep & 1][cnt[i] - 1][i];
			hh ret = dfs(dep - 1, -beta, -alpha);
			tot -= val[dep & 1][cnt[i] - 1][i];
			cnt[i]--;

			ret.fir = -ret.fir;
			if (ret.fir >= beta) return mp(beta, "");
			if (ret.fir > alpha) {
				alpha = ret.fir;
				des = char(i + '0') + ret.sec;
			}
		}
	}
	return mp(alpha, des);
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		read(val[0][0][i]);
		read(val[1][0][i]);
		read(val[0][1][i]);
		read(val[1][1][i]);
		val[1][0][i] *= -1;
		val[1][1][i] *= -1;
	}
	hh ans = dfs(2 * n, -INF, INF);
	cout << ans.fir << " " << ans.sec << endl;
	return 0;
}

//Asubmit.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 3500000
#define MAXP 255000
using namespace std;

bool notprime[MAXN+5]= {1,1};
int k,p[MAXP]= {0},pcnt=0;

void init() {
	for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
		if (!notprime[i]) {
			p[++pcnt]=i;
			if (i>1880) continue;
			for (int j=i*i; j<=MAXN; j+=i) {
				notprime[j]=1;
			}
		}
	}
}

int check(int x) {
	int ans=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
		if (p[i]>x) break;
		ans+=x/p[i];
	}
	return ans;
}

int main() {
	init();
	scanf("%d",&k);
	int l=1,r=MAXN,mid,val;
	while (l<r) {
		mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
		val=check(mid);
		if (val<k)
			l=mid;
		else if (val>k)
			r=mid-1;
		else {
			l=mid;
			break;
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n",l);
	return 0;
}

//automata.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct NoDataNode {
	int l, r;
} tt[66 * MAXN];
int tb[int(6 * MAXN)];
int Cnt, tCnt;
int n;

struct Persistent_Array {
	inline int update(int pre, int p, int v) {
		int ret = Cnt + 1, x, l = 1, r = n;
		while (l < r) {
			x = ++Cnt;
			if (pre) tt[x] = tt[pre];
			int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
			if (p <= mid) pre = tt[x].l, tt[x].l = Cnt + 1, r = mid;
			else pre = tt[x].r, tt[x].r = Cnt + 1, l = mid + 1;
		}
		x = ++tCnt;
		tb[x] = v;
		tt[Cnt].l > Cnt ? (tt[Cnt].l = x) : (tt[Cnt].r = x);
		return ret;
	}
	inline int at(int p, int x) {
		int l = 1, r = n, mid;
		while (l < r && x) {
			mid = (l + r) >> 1;
			if (p <= mid) x = tt[x].l, r = mid;
			else x = tt[x].r, l = mid + 1;
		}
		return x ? tb[x] : 0;
	}
	inline int set(int R, int x, int v) {
		return update(R, x, v);
	}
} T;

map<int, int> t[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN];
int rt[MAXN];
int p[MAXN], c[MAXN];
int q[MAXN];

void build() {
	for (int i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) t[p[i]][c[i]] = i;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) t[0][i] = 1, rt[0] = T.set(rt[0], i, 1);
	int he = 0, ta = 1;
	q[he] = 1;
	while (he < ta) {
		int x = q[he++];
		rt[x] = rt[fa[x]];
		for (map <int, int>::iterator it = t[x].begin(); it != t[x].end(); it++) {
			int i = it->fir, to = it->sec;
			rt[x] = T.set(rt[x], i, to);
			fa[to] = T.at(i, rt[fa[x]]);
			q[ta++] = to;
		}
	}
}

int main() {
	freopen("automata.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("automata.out", "w", stdout);
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i + 1]), p[i + 1]++;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(c[i + 1]);
	build();
	for (int i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) printf("%d%c", fa[i] - 1, i == n + 1? '\n' : ' ');
	return 0;
}

void cheat() {

	int pos=int(((k-1)/(double(n)*double(n-1)/2))*12250000+1);
	for (int i=1; i<=12250000; i++) {
		int r=getRand()%(n+1),l=getRand()%(n+1);
		if (l>r) swap(l,r);
		if (l==r) {
			i--;
			continue;
		}
		fuck[++cnt]=(sum[r]-sum[l])/double(r-l);
	}
	nth_element(fuck+1,fuck+pos,fuck+cnt+1);
	printf("%.4lf\n",fuck[pos]);
}
int main() {
	freopen("ave.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ave.out","w",stdout);
	read(n);
	read(k);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
	if (n<=3500) {
		violent();
	} else if (k==1) {
		spj();
	} else if (k==LL(n)*LL(n-1)/2ll) {
		spj_2();
	} else {
		cheat();
	}
	return 0;
}

//A_vio.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

const int dx[] = {-1, 1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, -1, 1};

int n, K, ans = 0;
signed char a[MAXN];

map <int, map<int, bool> > vis;

int main() {
	read(n);
	read(K);
	while (ch < 'A') ch = getchar();
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = ch == 'N' ? 0 : (ch == 'S' ? 1 : (ch == 'W' ? 2 : 3)), ch = getchar();

	int x = 0, y = 0;
	vis[x][y] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
		for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
			x += dx[a[j]], y += dy[a[j]];
			if (!vis[x][y]) {
				vis[x][y] = 1;
				bool q = vis[x - 1][y], w = vis[x][y - 1], e = vis[x + 1][y], r = vis[x][y + 1];
				if (q && w && vis[x - 1][y - 1]) ans++;
				if (q && r && vis[x - 1][y + 1]) ans++;
				if (e && w && vis[x + 1][y - 1]) ans++;
				if (e && r && vis[x + 1][y + 1]) ans++;
			}
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

inline void read(ull &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}

int temp[21],*e;
inline void output(ull a) {
	if (a) {
		while (a) {
			++e;
			*e='0'+a%10;
			a=a/10;
		}
		while (e!=temp) {
			putchar(*e);
			--e;
		}
	} else putchar('0');
	putchar('\n');
}

int n;
ull a[20005],*st,*ed;

int main() {
	freopen("avr.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("avr.out","w",stdout);
	e=temp;
	read(n);
	st=a,ed=a+n;
	ull *i,*j,ret;
	for (i=st; i!=ed; ++i) {
		read(*i);
	}
	for (int len=1; len<n; len++) {
		ret=0;
		for (i=st,j=st+len; j!=ed; ++i,++j) {
			ret+=(*i&*j)+((*i^*j)>>1);
		}
		output(ret);
	}
	return 0;
}

//awdp.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

long long dp[12][10],cnt[12];
void init() {
	for (int i=0; i<10; i++)
		dp[1][i]=1;
	cnt[1]=9;
	for (int len=2; len<=10; len++) {
		for (int now=0; now<10; now++) {
			for (int last=0; last<10; last++) {
				if (abs(now-last)>1) {
					dp[len][now]+=dp[len-1][last];
				}
			}
			if (now)
				cnt[len]+=dp[len][now];
		}
		cnt[len]+=cnt[len-1];
	}
	return;
}
long long calc(int x) {
	long long ans=0;
	char temp[15];
	sprintf(temp,"%d",x);
	int len=strlen(temp),last=-1;
	ans=cnt[len-1];
	for (int i=0,nowlen=len; i<len; i++,nowlen--) {
		int now=temp[i]-'0';
		for (int j=(i?0:1); j<now; j++) {
			if (abs(j-last)>1) {
				ans+=dp[nowlen][j];
			}
		}
		if (abs(last-now)<2)
			break;
		last=now;
	}
	return ans;
}
long long solve(int l,int r) {
	return calc(r+1)-calc(l);
}
int main() {
	int l,r;
	init();
	scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
	printf("%lld",solve(l,r));
	return 0;
}

//back.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int p[1005];
bool dp[1005];
int n,m;

int main () {
	int ans,ans2;
	while (1) {
		scanf("%d",&n);
		if (n==0)
			break;
		for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
			scanf("%d",p+i);
		}
		scanf("%d",&m);
		if (m<5) {
			printf("%d\n",m);
			continue;
		}
		m-=5;
		memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
		dp[0]=1;
		ans=0;
		sort(p+1,p+n+1);
		for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
			for (int v=m; v>=p[i]; v--) {
				if (dp[v-p[i]]) {
					dp[v]=1;
					ans=max(ans,v);
				}
			}
		}
		printf("%d\n",m+5-ans-p[n]);
	}
	return 0;
}

//baikal.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

struct Point {
	D x, y;
	Point () {}
	Point (D a, D b) {
		x = a, y = b;
	}
	friend Point operator + (const Point a, const Point b) {
		return Point(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y);
	}
	friend Point operator - (const Point a, const Point b) {
		return Point(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
	}
	friend D operator * (const Point a, const Point b) {
		return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
	}
	friend bool operator < (const Point &a, const Point &b) {
		return a * b > 0;
	}
} a[MAXN], base;

int n;
int sta[MAXN];

int main() {
	freopen("baikal.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("baikal.out", "w", stdout);
	read(n);
	D x, y = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		read(x);
		y += x;
		a[i].x = y / 2;
		a[i].y = y / x;
		if (i == 1 || (a[i].x < base.x || (a[i].x == base.x && a[i].y < base.y))) base = a[i];
	}
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i] - base;
	sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);

	int top = 0;

	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		while (top > 1 && (a[sta[top]] - a[sta[top - 1]]) * (a[i] - a[sta[top]]) < 0) top--;
		sta[++top] = i;
	}
	LD ans = 0;
	sta[0] = sta[top];
	for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) {
		ans += a[sta[i - 1]] * a[sta[i]];
	}
	if (ans < 0) ans = -ans;
	printf("%.5lf\n", (double)ans + 1e-10);
	return 0;
}

//balloon.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200319
#define eps 1e-10

int n, d;
int x[MAXN], y[MAXN];
int ans = 0;

int main() {
	freopen("balloon.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("balloon.out", "w", stdout);
	scanf("%d%d", &n, &d);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d%d", x + i, y + i);
	if (n > 10000) {
		printf("%lld\n", (long long)n * (n - 1ll) / 2);
		return 0;
	}
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
			int dx = x[i] - x[j], dy = y[i] - y[j];
			double A = -dy, B = dx, C = -(A * x[i] + B * y[i]);
			if (d > eps + abs(C) / sqrt(A * A + B * B)) ans++;
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}

/*******************************************************************************

#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <stack>
#include <ctime>
#include <vector>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

#define end() return 0

typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned int uint;
typedef unsigned long long ull;

const int maxn = 1000 + 5;

int T;
int M, N;
char str[maxn][maxn];
int length[maxn][maxn][5];

void input() {
	memset(str, '\0', sizeof(str));
	scanf("%d%d", &M, &N);
	for(int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
		scanf("%s", str[i]);
	}
}

bool check(int x, int y) {
	return (x >= 0 && x < M && y >= 0 && y < N);
}

void initAns() {

	memset(length, 0, sizeof(length));
	int sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1, sx2, sy2, sx3, sy3;

	for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) {

		sx0 = 0;
		sy0 = i;
		while(check(sx0, sy0)) {
			if(sx0 == 0) {
				if(str[sx0][sy0] == '1') length[sx0][sy0][0] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx0][sy0] == '1') length[sx0][sy0][0] = length[sx0 - 1][sy0 - 1][0] + 1;
			sx0++;
			sy0++;
		}

		sx1 = 0;
		sy1 = i;
		while(check(sx1, sy1)) {
			if(sx1 == 0) {
				if(str[sx1][sy1] == '1') length[sx1][sy1][1] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx1][sy1] == '1') length[sx1][sy1][1] = length[sx1 - 1][sy1 + 1][1] + 1;
			sx1++;
			sy1--;
		}

		sx2 = M - 1;
		sy2 = i;
		while(check(sx2, sy2)) {
			if(sx2 == M - 1) {
				if(str[sx2][sy2] == '1') length[sx2][sy2][2] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx2][sy2] == '1') length[sx2][sy2][2] = length[sx2 + 1][sy2 + 1][2] + 1;
			sx2--;
			sy2--;
		}

		sx3 = M - 1;
		sy3 = i;
		while(check(sx3, sy3)) {
			if(sx3 == M - 1) {
				if(str[sx3][sy3] == '1') length[sx3][sy3][3] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx3][sy3] == '1') length[sx3][sy3][3] = length[sx3 + 1][sy3 - 1][3] + 1;
			sx3--;
			sy3++;
		}
	}

	for(int i = 0; i < M; i++) {

		sx0 = i;
		sy0 = 0;
		while(check(sx0, sy0)) {
			if(sy0 == 0) {
				if(str[sx0][sy0] == '1') length[sx0][sy0][0] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx0][sy0] == '1') length[sx0][sy0][0] = length[sx0 - 1][sy0 - 1][0] + 1;
			sx0++;
			sy0++;
		}

		sx1 = i;
		sy1 = N - 1;
		while(check(sx1, sy1)) {
			if(sy1 == N - 1) {
				if(str[sx1][sy1] == '1') length[sx1][sy1][1] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx1][sy1] == '1') length[sx1][sy1][1] = length[sx1 - 1][sy1 + 1][1] + 1;
			sx1++;
			sy1--;
		}

		sx2 = i;
		sy2 = N - 1;
		while(check(sx2, sy2)) {
			if(sx2 == N - 1) {
				if(str[sx2][sy2] == '1') length[sx2][sy2][2] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx2][sy2] == '1') length[sx2][sy2][2] = length[sx2 + 1][sy2 + 1][2] + 1;
			sx2--;
			sy2--;
		}

		sx3 = i;
		sy3 = 0;
		while(check(sx3, sy3)) {
			if(sy3 == 0) {
				if(str[sx3][sy3] == '1') length[sx3][sy3][3] = 1;
			} else if(str[sx3][sy3] == '1') length[sx3][sy3][3] = length[sx3 + 1][sy3 - 1][3] + 1;
			sx3--;
			sy3++;
		}
	}
}

void solve() {
	initAns();
	int ans = 0;
	for(int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
		for(int j = 0; j < N; j++) {

			if(str[i][j] == '0') continue;
			int sum = 1;

			if(i - 1 >= 0) {
				if(length[i - 1][j][1] < length[i][j][1]) {
					sum += 2 * length[i - 1][j][1];
				} else {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j][1] - 1;
				}

			}

			if(i + 1 < M) {
				if(length[i + 1][j][3] < length[i][j][3]) {
					sum += 2 * length[i + 1][j][3];
				} else {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j][3] - 1;
				}
			}

			if(j - 1 >= 0) {
				if(length[i][j - 1][0] < length[i][j][0]) {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j - 1][0];
				} else {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j][0] - 1;
				}
			}

			if(j + 1 < N) {
				if(length[i][j + 1][2] < length[i][j][2]) {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j + 1][2];
				} else {
					sum += 2 * length[i][j][2] - 1;
				}
			}

			ans = max(ans, sum);
		}
	}
	printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	scanf("%d", &T);
	while(T--) {
		input();
		solve();
	}
	end();
}

	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();

struct Node {
	int a[50];
};

Node operator + (Node a, Node b) {
	Node c;
	for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
		c.a[i] = a.a[i] + b.a[i];
	}
	return c;
}

Node operator - (Node a, Node b) {
	Node c;
	for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
		c.a[i] = a.a[i] - b.a[i];
	}
	return c;
}

int n;
Node a[50][50];

int main() {
	read(n);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[1][i].a[i] = 1;
	int stp = 0;
	for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
		for (int j = 1; i + j <= n + 1; j++) {
			a[i][j] = stp & 1 ? a[i - 1][j] - a[i - 1][j + 1] : a[i - 1][j] + a[i - 1][j + 1];
			stp++;
		}
	}

	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
		printf("%d ", a[n][1].a[i]);
	}

	return 0;

//B.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define NAME PowerEquation
#define METHOD count

#define MOD 1000000007

int gcd(int a, int b) {
	return b ? gcd(b, a % b) : a;
}

bool vis[1000005];

class NAME {
	LL f[100];

public:
	int METHOD(int n) {
		LL N = n, ans = N * N % MOD;
		f[0] = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i <= 32; i++) {
			for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
				for (int k = 1; k <= i; k++) {
					(f[i] += N / (max(j, k) / gcd(j, k))) %= MOD;
				}
		}
		LL j = (LL)sqrt(N), tot = 0;
		for (LL i = 2; i <= j; i++) {
			if (!vis[i]) {
				int cnt = 0;
				for (LL k = i; k <= N; k *= i, cnt++) {
					if (k <= j) vis[k] = 1;
					else tot++;
				}
				(ans += f[cnt]) %= MOD;
			}
		}
		(ans += (N - j - tot) * N) %= MOD;
		return (int)ans;
	}

} test_case;

int main() {

	int x;
	while (cin >> x)
		cout << test_case.METHOD(x) << endl;

	return 0;
}

//bipartite.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <cstring>
#define rep(i,n) for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
#define fora(i,a,b) for(int i=a;i<b;i++)

using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 15;

const int MOD = int(1e9+7);

int mypow(int a,int e) {
	if(e==0) return 1;
	return e%2==0?mypow(1LL*a*a%MOD,e>>1):1LL*a*mypow(a,e-1)%MOD;
}
int inv(int a) {
	return mypow(a,MOD-2);
}

int x[MAX_N][MAX_N],y[MAX_N][MAX_N],u[MAX_N][MAX_N];

typedef pair<int,int> PII;

void addIt(int&x,int c) {
	x+=c;
	if(x>=MOD) x -= MOD;
}

int main() {
	int n,m;
	cin>>n>>m;
	memset(x,-1,sizeof x);

	rep(i,m) {
		int tp;
		cin>>tp;
		if(tp==0) {
			int a,b;
			cin>>a>>b;
			--a,--b;
			x[a][b]=-2;
		} else {
			int a,b,c,d;
			cin>>a>>b>>c>>d;
			--a,--b,--c,--d;
			if(a==c||b==d) {
				x[a][b] = x[c][d] = -2;
			} else {
				if(a>c) swap(a,c),swap(b,d);
				x[c][d] = -2;

				x[a][b]=c;
				y[a][b]=d;
				u[a][b]=tp==1?1:-1;
			}
		}
	}

	int p[MAX_N];
	rep(i,n) p[i] = i;
	int ans = 0;
	do {
		int tmp = 1;
		rep(i,n) {
			if(x[i][p[i]]==-1) goto next;
			if(x[i][p[i]]!=-2) {
				int ni = x[i][p[i]];
				int nj = y[i][p[i]];
				int v = u[i][p[i]];
				if(p[ni]==nj) {
					if(v==-1)
						goto next;
					else
						tmp = tmp * 2 % MOD;
				}
			}
		}
		addIt(ans,tmp);
next: {
		}
	} while(next_permutation(p,p+n));

	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}
//birthday.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int m,n;
int w[1005],a[1005],b[1005],s[1005];
int dp[2][2005],ans=0;
int main() {
	scanf("%d%d",&m,&n);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		scanf("%d%d%d%d",w+i,a+i,b+i,s+i);
	memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
	int now=1,prev=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			dp[now][j]=dp[prev][j];
		}
		for (int k=1,W=0,V=b[i]; k<=s[i]; k++) {
			W+=w[i];
			V+=a[i];
			for (int j=m; j>=W; j--) {
				dp[now][j]=max(dp[now][j],dp[prev][j-W]+V);
			}
		}
		now=prev;
		prev=1^prev;
	}
	printf("%d",dp[prev][m]);
	return 0;
}

//biu.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009

using namespace std;

bool map[20][20];
int n,m,ans;
bool tr[20];
int temp[20][20];
int total=0;
inline void click(int x,int y) {
	temp[x][y]^=1;
	temp[x+1][y]^=1;
	temp[x-1][y]^=1;
	temp[x][y+1]^=1;
	temp[x][y-1]^=1;
	return;
}
inline void check() {
	int re=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++)
			temp[i][j]=map[i][j];
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
		if (tr[i]) {
			click(1,i);
			re++;
		}
	for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			if (!temp[i][j]) {
				click(i+1,j);
				re++;
			}
		}
	for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
		if (!temp[n][i])
			return;
	ans=min(ans,re);
	return;
}
void dfs(int x) {
	if (total>200000)
		return;
	if (x>m) {
		check();
		return;
	}
	tr[x]=map[1][x];
	dfs(x+1);
	tr[x]^=1;
	dfs(x+1);
	total+=2;
	return;
}
int main() {
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			char r=getchar();
			while (r!='.' && r!='X') {
				r=getchar();
			}
			if (r=='.')
				map[i][j]=1;
		}
	ans=INF;
	dfs(1);
	printf("%d",ans);
	return 0;
}

//boringClass.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
	_a = 0;
	bool _f = 0;
	while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
	while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
	if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50319

int T[MAXN];

int n, Rt, dp[MAXN], pre[MAXN], a[MAXN], b[MAXN], atem[MAXN], btem[MAXN], atot, btot;

int sta[MAXN], top;

#define cmp(x, y) ((dp[x] > dp[y] || (dp[x] == dp[y] && x < y)) ? x : y)
#define find(x, tem, tot) int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1, x) - tem)
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
#define rint register int
int v, w, id;
int tcnt;
struct node {
	int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 85];

void update(rint *x) {
	rint l = 1, r = btot, mid;
	while (l < r) {
		if (!*x) *x = ++tcnt, t[*x].l = t[*x].r = t[*x].v = 0;
		t[*x].v = cmp(t[*x].v, id);
		mid = (l + r) >> 1;
		if (w <= mid) r = mid, x = &t[*x].l;
		else l = mid + 1, x = &t[*x].r;
	}
	if (!*x) *x = ++tcnt, t[*x].l = t[*x].r = t[*x].v = 0;
	t[*x].v = cmp(t[*x].v, id);
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
	if (!x) return 0;
	if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
	int mid = (l + r) >> 1, reta = 0, retb = 0;
	if (ql <= mid) reta = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
	if (qr > mid) retb = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
	return cmp(reta, retb);
}

inline int Query() {
	rint x = v, ret = 0, r;
	for ( ; x; x ^= lowbit(x)) {
		if (T[x]) {
			r = query(T[x], 1, btot, w, btot);
			ret = cmp(ret, r);
		}
	}
	return ret;
}

inline void Update() {
	rint x = v;
	for ( ; x <= atot; x += lowbit(x)) update(T + x);
}

int main() {
	rint i, j, ans;
	while (scanf("%d", &n) != EOF) {
		Rt = tcnt = atot = btot = 0;
		for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), atem[++atot] = a[i];
		for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), btem[++btot] = b[i];
		sort(atem + 1, atem + atot + 1);
		sort(btem + 1, btem + btot + 1);
		atot = int(unique(atem + 1, atem + atot + 1) - atem - 1);
		btot = int(unique(btem + 1, btem + btot + 1) - btem - 1);
		ans = 0;
		for (i = n; i; i--) {
			a[i] = find(a[i], atem, atot);
			b[i] = find(b[i], btem, btot);
			v = a[i], w = b[i], id = i;
			j = Query();
			dp[i] = dp[j] + 1;
			pre[i] = j;
			Update();
			ans = cmp(i, ans);
		}
		printf("%d\n", dp[ans]);
		top = 0;
		while (ans != 0) sta[top++] = ans, ans = pre[ans];
		for (i = 0; i < top; i++) printf("%d%c", sta[i], i == top - 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
		memset(T + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * atot);
	}
	return 0;
}
