//bracket.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
	return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
	return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
	bool f = 0;
	a = 0;
	while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
		if (ch == '-') f = 1;
		ch = getchar();
	}
	while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
		a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
		ch = getchar();
	}
	if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

const int lim = int(CLOCKS_PER_SEC * 3.8);

int n, K, cnt, ans = INF, tot = 0;
int a[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];
int f[5003][5003];

void dfs(int x) {
	if (x > n) {
		for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
			f[i][i + 1] = int(s[i] != '(') + int(s[i + 1] != ')');
		}
		for (int l = 3; l < n; l += 2) {
			for (int i = 1, j = i + l; j <= n; i++, j++) {
				f[i][j] = f[i + 1][j - 1] + int(s[i] != '(') + int(s[j] != ')');
				for (int k = i + 1; k < j; k += 2) f[i][j] = min(f[i][j], f[i][k] + f[k + 1][j]);
			}
		}
		if (f[1][n] > K) ans = min(ans, tot);
		return;
	}
	dfs(x + 1);
	if (!(++cnt & 524287) && clock() > lim) {
		printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? 0 : ans);
		exit(0);
	}
	s[x] ^= 1;
	tot += a[x];
	dfs(x + 1);
	s[x] ^= 1;
	tot -= a[x];
}

int main() {
	read(n);
	read(K);
	if (n > 5000) {
		puts("0");
		return 0;
	}
	scanf("%s", s + 1);
	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
	dfs(1);
	printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? 0 : ans);
	return 0;
}

//breaker.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define s 65536
#define ui int

ui t[s<<1],full[s<<1],sum[s<<1];
int n,L[s<<1],R[s<<1],lazy[s<<1]= {0,-1};
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
	while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
	a=0;
	while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
		a=a*10+ch-'0';
		ch=getchar();
	}
}
void fill(int x,int l,int r) {
	if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
		t[x]=full[x];
		lazy[x]=1;
		return;
	}
	if (lazy[x]) {
		if (lazy[x]==1) return;
		else {
			t[x<<1]=t[(x<<1)|1]=0;
			lazy[x<<1]=lazy[(x<<1)|1]=-1;
			lazy[x]=0;
		}
	}
	int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
	if (l<=mid) fill(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
	if (r>mid) fill((x<<1)|1,max(mid+1,l),r);
	t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)|1];
}

void clear(int x,int l,int r) {
	if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
		t[x]=0;
		lazy[x]=-1;
		return;
	}
	if (lazy[x]) {
		if (lazy[x]==-1) return;
		else {
			t[x<<1]=full[x<<1];
			t[(x<<1)|1]=full[(x<<1)|1];
			lazy[x<<1]=lazy[(x<<1)|1]=1;
			lazy[x]=0;
		}
	}
	int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
	if (l<=mid) clear(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
	if (r>mid) clear((x<<1)|1,max(mid+1,l),r);
	t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)|1];
}

ui query(int x,int l,int r) {
	if (lazy[x]) {
		if (lazy[x]==1) {
			return sum[r]-sum[l-1];
		} else return 0;
	}
	if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
		return t[x];
	}
	int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
	ui ret=0;
	if (l<=mid) ret=query(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
	if (r>mid) ret=ret+query((x<<1)|1,max(mid+1,l),r);
	return ret;
}
int temp[11],*e;
inline void output(ui a) {
	if (a) {
		while (a) {
			++e;
			*e='0'+a%10;
			a=a/10;
		}
		while (e!=temp) {
			putchar(*e);
			--e;
		}
	} else putchar('0');
	putchar('\n');
}

inline void init() {
	sum[0]=0;
	for (int i=s,j=1; j<=s; ++i,++j) {
		L[i]=R[i]=j;
		full[i]=j;
		sum[j]=sum[j-1]+j;
	}
	for (int i=s-1; i; --i) {
		full[i]=full[i<<1]+full[(i<<1)|1];
		L[i]=L[i<<1];
		R[i]=R[(i<<1)|1];
	}
	e=temp;
}
int main() {
	freopen("check.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
	init();
	read(n);
	int op,l,r;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
		read(op);
		read(l);
		read(r);
		if (op) {
			if (op==1) fill(1,l,r);
			else clear(1,l,r);
		} else {
			output(query(1,l,r));
		}
	}
	cerr<<"Out: "<<(double)clock()/CLOCKS_PER_SEC<<endl;
	return 0;
}

//brick.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int n,m,ans=-(0x3f3f3f3f);
int map[105][105],sum[105][105];
int maf[105],mab[105],mif[105],mib[105];

inline void init() {
	scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
	sum[0][0]=0;
	for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
		sum[i][0]=0;
		for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
			scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
			sum[i][j]=map[i][j]+sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
		}
	}
}

inline void work() {
	memset(maf,200,sizeof(maf));
	memset(mab,200,sizeof(mab));
	memset(mif,31,sizeof(mif));
	memset(mib,31,sizeof(mib));
#define a(k) (sum[k][j]-sum[k][i]-sum[k-1][j]+sum[k-1][i])
	int now;
	for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
		for (int j=i+1; j<=m; j++) {
			//front max
			now=0;
			for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
				if (now<0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				maf[k]=max(maf[k],now);
			}
			// front min
			now=0;
			for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
				if (now>0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				mif[k]=min(mif[k],now);
			}
			// back max
			now=0;
			for (int k=n; k>0; k--) {
				if (now<0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				mab[k]=max(mab[k],now);
			}
			// back min
			now=0;
			for (int k=n; k>0; k--) {
				if (now>0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				mib[k]=min(mib[k],now);
			}
		}
#undef a
	for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
		maf[i]=max(maf[i],maf[i-1]);
		mif[i]=min(mif[i],mif[i-1]);
	}
	for (int i=n-1; i>0; i--) {
		mab[i]=max(mab[i],mab[i+1]);
		mib[i]=min(mib[i],mib[i+1]);
	}
	for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
		ans=max(ans,maf[i]*mab[i+1]);
		ans=max(ans,mif[i]*mib[i+1]);
	}

	memset(maf,200,sizeof(maf));
	memset(mab,200,sizeof(mab));
	memset(mif,31,sizeof(mif));
	memset(mib,31,sizeof(mib));

#define a(k) (sum[j][k]-sum[i][k]-sum[j][k-1]+sum[i][k-1])
	for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
		for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
			//front max
			now=0;
			for (int k=1; k<=m; k++) {
				if (now<0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				maf[k]=max(maf[k],now);
			}
			// front min
			now=0;
			for (int k=1; k<=m; k++) {
				if (now>0) now=a(k);
				else now+=a(k);
				mif[k]=min(mif[k],now);
            }
            // back max
            now=0;
            for (int k=m; k>0; k--) {
                if (now<0) now=a(k);
                else now+=a(k);
                mab[k]=max(mab[k],now);
            }
            // back min
            now=0;
            for (int k=m; k>0; k--) {
                if (now>0) now=a(k);
                else now+=a(k);
                mib[k]=min(mib[k],now);
            }
        }
#undef a
    for (int i=2; i<=m; i++) {
        maf[i]=max(maf[i],maf[i-1]);
        mif[i]=min(mif[i],mif[i-1]);
    }
    for (int i=m-1; i>0; i--) {
        mab[i]=max(mab[i],mab[i+1]);
        mib[i]=min(mib[i],mib[i+1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        ans=max(ans,maf[i]*mab[i+1]);
        ans=max(ans,mif[i]*mib[i+1]);
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("brick.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("brick.out","w",stdout);
    init();
    work();
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//bruteforce.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const int col=5,row=3;

int top=(1<<(col*row))-1;

int tot[20],ans[20];
int x[10],y[10];

void check(int a) {
    int cnt=0;
    for (int i=0; i<15; i++) {
        if ((a>>i)&1) {
            cnt++;
            x[i%col]=a;
            y[i/col]=a;
        }
    }
    tot[cnt]++;
    for (int i=0; i<col; i++) if (x[i]!=a) return;
    for (int j=0; j<row; j++) if (y[j]!=a) return;
    ans[cnt]++;
}

int main() {
    memset(x,-1,sizeof(x));
    memset(y,-1,sizeof(y));
    for (int i=0; i<=top; i++) {
        check(i);
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=col*row; i++) {
        printf("ans %d : %d\n",i,ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1001.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 10485765

int ch=0;

inline int readInt(void) {
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch=getchar();
    int r=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        r = r * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return r;
}

/* Main */
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[8000005];
int n,m,ecnt=0,src,sink,nm;
int dis[2*MAXN*MAXN],head[2*MAXN*MAXN],t[s<<1];

bool visit[2*MAXN*MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
//	printf("%d->%d %d\n",u,v,w);
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build2() {
    src=0,sink=1;
    int cnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            tag[i][j][0]=++cnt;
            tag[i][j][1]=++cnt;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[1][i][0],sink,row[1][i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][m-1][0],sink,col[i][m]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][1][1],src,col[i][1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[n-1][i][1],src,row[n][i]);
    }
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i-1][j][1],tag[i][j][0],row[i][j]);
        }
    for (int j=2; j<m; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            add(tag[i][j-1][0],tag[i][j][1],col[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i][j][0],tag[i][j][1],slp[i][j]);
        }
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    t[x+=s]=d;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)|1]);
}

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<t[(x<<1)|1])
            x<<=1;
        else
            x=(x<<1)|1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void dijkstra() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
    update(src,0);
    int x=src;
    while (t[x+s]<INF) {
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        update(x,INF);
        visit[x]=1;
        if (x==sink) return;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[s+v]) {
                update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
}

int main() {
    n=readInt();
    m=readInt();
    if(n==1 || m==1) {
        if(n>m) swap(n, m);
        int ans=INF;
        for(int i=1, a; i<m; i++) {
            a=readInt();
            if(ans>a) ans=a;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans==INF?0:ans);
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            row[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            col[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            slp[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    build2();
    dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n",dis[sink]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1002.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 105
#define MAXN 105

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i+1]+=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i]%=10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} fib[MAXN],dp[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    fib[1]=num(1);
    fib[2]=num(3);
    dp[1]=num(1);
    dp[2]=num(5);
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        fib[i]=fib[i-1]+fib[i-2];
        dp[i]=fib[i]*fib[i];
        if ((i&1)^1) dp[i]=dp[i]-4;
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1003.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105
#define MAXM 25

int n,m,K,E,D;
int minc[MAXN][MAXN],G[MAXM][MAXM],dis[MAXM];
bool fuck[MAXN][MAXM],ban[MAXM];
int ans[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
bool inq[MAXN];
int work(int ti) {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (fuck[ti][i]) ban[i]=1;
    }
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
            if (!ban[i] && dis[i]>G[x][i]+dis[x]) {
                dis[i]=G[x][i]+dis[x];
                if (!inq[i]) {
                    inq[i]=1;
                    q.push(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[m];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&K,&E);
    memset(G,63,sizeof(G));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) G[i][i]=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=E; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        if (G[u][v]>w) G[u][v]=G[v][u]=w;
    }
    scanf("%d",&D);
    for (int i=1,P,a,b; i<=D; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&P,&a,&b);
        for (int j=a; j<=b; j++) {
            fuck[j][P]=1;
        }
    }
    ans[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        memset(ban,0,sizeof(ban));
        for (int j=i; j<=n; j++) {
            minc[i][j]=work(j);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans[i]=0x3f3f3f3f;
        for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
            if (minc[j+1][i]<0x3f3f3f3f) ans[i]=min(ans[i],ans[j]+minc[j+1][i]*(i-j)+K);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans[n]-K);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1005.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 5005

long long ans=1;

int n;
int pcnt=0,prime[205],cnt[205];
bool notprime[1005];

void init() {
    for (int i=2; i<=1000; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=1000; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
}

void add(int x,int v) {
    if (x>2 || v==0) return;
    int now=1;
    while (x!=1) {
        while (x%prime[now]!=0) now++;
        while (x%prime[now]==0) {
            cnt[now]+=v;
            x/=prime[now];
        }
    }
}

void addfac(int x,int v) {
    for (int i=2; i<=x; i++) add(i,v);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==1) {
        int d;
        scanf("%d",&d);
        if (d) puts("0");
        else puts("1");
        return 0;
    }
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1,d; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&d);
        if (d==0) {
            puts("0");
            return 0;
        }
        tot+=d-1;
        addfac(d-1,-1);
    }
    if (tot!=n-2) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    addfac(n-2,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        while (cnt[i]--) ans=ans*prime[i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1006.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 2000005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct node {
    int next,x;
} p[MAXM+MAXN];
int pcnt=0,level[MAXN],seq[MAXN],label[MAXN];
int visit[MAXN];
inline void Push(int lev,int x) {
    p[++pcnt].x=x;
    p[pcnt].next=level[lev];
    level[lev]=pcnt;
}
inline void Pop(int lev) {
    level[lev]=p[level[lev]].next;
}

void MCS() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        label[i]=0;
        Push(0,i);
    }
    int top=0;
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        while (1) {
            while (level[top] && visit[p[level[top]].x]) Pop(top);
            if (level[top]) break;
            else top--;
        }
        int x=p[level[top]].x;
        Pop(top);
        seq[i]=x;
        visit[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                label[e[now].to]++;
                if (label[e[now].to]>top) top=label[e[now].to];
                Push(label[e[now].to],e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    MCS();
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    memset(level,0,sizeof(level));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        int x=seq[i];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            visit[level[e[now].to]]=x;
        }
        int col;
        for (col=1;; col++) if (visit[col]!=x) break;
        level[x]=col;
        ans=max(col,ans);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1007.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 50005
#define eps 1e-9

struct line {
    int k,b,lab;
    line() {}
    line(int x,int y,int z):k(x),b(y),lab(z) {}
    bool operator < (line a) const {
        if (k!=a.k) return k<a.k;
        return b>a.b;
    }
} l[MAXN],sta[MAXN];

int n;
double x[MAXN];
bool ans[MAXN];
double crossx(line l1,line l2) {
    return (l2.b-l1.b)*1.0/(l1.k-l2.k);
}

inline void work() {
    int top=1;
    sta[1]=l[1],x[1]=-1e15;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (l[i].k==sta[top].k) continue;
        while (x[top]+eps>crossx(l[i],sta[top])) top--;
        sta[++top]=l[i];
        x[top]=crossx(sta[top],sta[top-1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=top; i++) ans[sta[i].lab]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (ans[i]) printf("%d ",i);
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==1) {
        printf("1\n");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        l[i]=line(u,v,i);
    }
    sort(l+1,l+n+1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1009.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXM 25
// 0~9 0~M-1
int n,m,MOD;
char s[MAXM],ss[MAXM];
int now[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM],trans[MAXM][MAXM],ans[MAXM];

inline bool cmp(int a,int b,int c) {
    for (int i=a,j=c; i<=b; i++,j++) {
        if (s[i]!=ss[j]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

inline int getl(int len) {
    for (int ret=len; ret; ret--) {
        if (cmp(1,ret,len-ret+1)) return ret;
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void exp(int a[MAXM][MAXM],int b[MAXM][MAXM]) {
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++)
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
}

inline void quickpower(int x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            exp(now,trans);
        }
        exp(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%s",&n,&m,&MOD,s+1);
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        ss[i]=s[i];
        now[i][i]=1;
        for (int j=0; j<10; j++) {
            ss[i+1]=j+'0';
            int to=getl(i+1);
            if (to<m) trans[i][to]++;
        }
    }
    quickpower(n);
    ans[0]=1;
    int ret=0;
    for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
        for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
            ret=(ret+ans[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1010.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 50005

int n, L;

LL c[MAXN], s[MAXN], h[MAXN], f[MAXN];

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return (f[j] + power(s[j] + L) - f[k] - power(s[k] + L)) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * s[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], x) <= slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = x;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(L);
    ++L;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(c[i]), s[i] = s[i - 1] + c[i] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + power(s[i] - s[j] - L);
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1011.cpp
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 100005
int n;
double a,m[MAXN],sum[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lf",&n,&a);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int r=int(a*i+1e-8);
        double ans=0;
        scanf("%lf",m+i);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+m[i];
        if (i<=1000) {
            for (int j=1; j<=r; j++) {
                ans+=m[i]*m[j]/(i-j);
            }
        } else {
            ans=sum[r]*m[i]/(i-r*0.5);
        }
        printf("%.6lf\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1012.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

/* Configuration */
#define s 262144

int m,d,n=0,last=0;
int t[s<<1];

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='A' && ch!='Q') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='A';
}

inline void update(int p,int x) {
    for (t[p+=s]=x,p>>=1; p; t[p]=max(t[p<<1],t[(p<<1)^1]),p>>=1);
}

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=-1;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,t[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=max(ans,t[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

            read(x);
            update(++n,(x+last)%d);
        } else {
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n",last=query(n-x+1,n));
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1013.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const double eps = 1e-8;
struct Equation {
    double v[15];
    double &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
} a[15];

int n;
double base[15];

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = n + 1;
        double v = 0;
        for (int j = now; j <= n; j++) if (abs(a[j][i]) > v) v = abs(a[j][i]), to = j;
        if (v < eps) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    while (now <= n) {
        if (abs(a[now][0]) > eps) return 0;
        else now++;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", base + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        double x;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            scanf("%lf", &x);
            a[i][j] = 2 * (x - base[j]);
            a[i][0] += x * x - base[j] * base[j];
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        printf("%.3lf ", a[i][0]);
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n", a[n][0]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1014.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
const int C = /*2*/1;
const LL P[C] = {811/*, 911*/}, MOD[C] = {2123456767/*, 2147483647*/};
LL X[C][MAXN];
struct Ha {
    LL v[C];
    Ha (LL val = 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) v[i] = val % P[i];
    }
    Ha append(LL y) {
        Ha ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) ret.v[i] = (v[i] * P[i] + y) % MOD[i];
        return ret;
    }
    Ha merge(Ha &x, LL len) {
        Ha ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) ret.v[i] = (v[i] * X[i][len] + x.v[i]) % MOD[i];
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator == (Ha a) const {
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) if (v[i] != a.v[i]) return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("{%lld", v[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < C; i++) printf(", %lld", v[i]);
        printf("}\n");
    }
};

void init() {
    for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) X[j][0] = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X[j][i] = X[j][i - 1] * P[j] % MOD[j];
}

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2];
    int siz;
    LL val;
    Ha ha;
    Node () : siz(0), val(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        ha = ((c[0]->ha).append(val)).merge(c[1]->ha, c[1]->siz);
    }
} mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

Node *newNode(LL v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->ha = Ha(v);
    return ptr++;
}

char s[MAXN];
int n, m;

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(s[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        int ls = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < ls) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > ls) k -= ls + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) { // [L, R)
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R;
}

void modify(int p, char c) {
    Node *x = get(p, p + 1);
    x->c[0]->val = c;
    x->c[0]->upd(), x->upd(), root->upd();
}

void insert(int x) {
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    n += len;
    Node *r = get(x + 1, x + 1);
    r->setc(build(1, len), 0), r->upd(), root->upd();
}

bool check(int l1, int r1, int l2, int r2) {
    Ha v1 = get(l1, r1)->c[0]->ha, v2 = get(l2, r2)->c[0]->ha;
    return v1 == v2;
}

void work(int x, int y) {
    int l = 0, r = n - max(x, y) + 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(x, x + mid, y, y + mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%s%d", s + 1, &m);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        switch(s[0]) {
        case 'Q':
            scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
            work(x, y);
            break;
        case 'R':
            scanf("%d%s", &x, s + 1);
            modify(x, s[1]);
            break;
        case 'I':
            scanf("%d%s", &x, s + 1);
            insert(x);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1015.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2000005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,k,ecnt=0,tot=0,f[MAXN],head[MAXN],a[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void init() {
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        tot--;
        if (fu<fv) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    read(k);
    for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        visit[a[i]]=1;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) {
            tot++;
            for (int now=head[i]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                    merge(i,e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ans[k]=tot;
    for (int i=k-1,x; i>-1; i--) {
        tot++;
        x=a[i];
        visit[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                merge(x,e[now].to);
            }
        }
        ans[i]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1016.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 105
#define MAXM 1005
#define MOD 31011
struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

int ans = 1;
int n, m;
struct Equa {
    int v[MAXN];
    int &operator [] (int i) {
        return v[i];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int f[MAXN], vis[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], rec[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        f[fu] += f[fv], f[fv] = fu;
    }
}

int work(int st, int ed) {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = st; i <= ed; i++) {
        int u = getf(e[i].u), v = getf(e[i].v);
        if (u == v) continue;
        u = vis[u] ? vis[u] : (rec[++cnt] = u, vis[u] = cnt);
        v = vis[v] ? vis[v] : (rec[++cnt] = v, vis[v] = cnt);
        a[u][v]--, a[v][u]--, a[u][u]++, a[v][v]++;
    }
    for (int i = st; i <= ed; i++) merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    tmp[getf(rec[1])] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= cnt; i++) if (!tmp[getf(rec[i])]) tmp[getf(rec[i])] = 1, a[1][i]--, a[i][1]--, a[1][1]++, a[i][i]++;
    int ret = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < cnt; j++) {
            while (a[j][i]) {
                int t = a[i][i] / a[j][i];
                if (t) for (int k = i; k <= cnt; k++) a[i][k] = (a[i][k] - a[j][k] * t) % MOD;
                swap(a[i], a[j]), ret = -ret;
            }
        }
        ret = ret * a[i][i] % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof(f));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v), read(e[i].w), merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) if (getf(i) != getf(1)) return printf("0\n"), 0;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof(f));
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= m; i = j) {
        j = i + 1;
        while (j <= m && e[j].w == e[i].w) j++;
        ans = ans * work(i, j - 1) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1017ac.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int a[55], need[55], c[55], b[55], s[55][55], g[55][55], v[55];
int f[55][2010][110], d[55][2010];
int n, m, i, j, k, ans;
char ch;

void dp(int x) {
    int i, j, k, l;
    if (!need[x]) {
        b[x] = min(b[x], m / c[x]);
        for (i = b[x]; i >= 0; i--)
            for (j = 0; j <= i; j++)
                f[x][i * c[x]][j] = a[x] * (i - j);
        return;
    }
    b[x] = 1 << 30;
    for (i = 1; i <= need[x]; i++) {
        dp(j = s[x][i]);
        b[x] = min(b[x], b[j] / g[x][i]);
        c[x] += c[j] * g[x][i];
    }
    b[x] = min(b[x], m / c[x]);
    memset(d, -0x3f3f3f3f, sizeof(d));
    d[0][0] = 0;
    for (l = b[x]; l >= 0; l--) {
        for (i = 1; i <= need[x]; i++)
            for (j = 0; j <= m; j++)
                for (k = 0; k <= j; k++)
                    d[i][j] = max(d[i][j], d[i - 1][j - k] + f[s[x][i]][k][g[x][i] * l]);
        for (j = 0; j <= m; j++)
            for (k = 0; k <= l; k++)
                f[x][j][k] = max(f[x][j][k], d[need[x]][j] + a[x] * (l - k));
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    memset(v, 0, sizeof(v));
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%c%c", &a[i], &ch, &ch);
        if (ch == 'A') {
            scanf("%d", &need[i]);
            for (j = 1; j <= need[i]; j++) {
                scanf("%d%d", &s[i][j], &g[i][j]);
                v[s[i][j]] = 1;
            }
        }
        if (ch == 'B') scanf("%d%d", &c[i], &b[i]);
    }
    memset(f, -0x3f3f3f3f, sizeof(f));
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        if (!v[i]) {
            dp(i);
            for (j = 0; j <= m; j++)
                for (k = 0; k <= b[i]; k++)
                    ans = max(ans, f[i][j][k]);
        }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        ch = getchar();
    }

    }

void dp(int x) {
    if (!ty[x]) {
        lim[x] = min(lim[x], m / cost[x]);
        for (int i = lim[x]; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int j = i; ~j; j--)
                f[x][i * cost[x]][j] = a[x] * (i - j);
        return;
    }
    lim[x] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= C[x]; i++) {
        dp(t[x][i]);
        lim[x] = min(lim[x], lim[t[x][i]] / c[x][i]);
        cost[x] += cost[t[x][i]] * c[x][i];
    }
    lim[x] = min(lim[x], m / cost[x]);
    memset(g, -INF, sizeof g);
    g[0] = 0;
    for (int li = lim[x]; ~li; li--) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= C[x]; i++)
            for (int j = m; ~j; j--)
                for (int k = j; ~k; k--)
                    g[j] = max(g[j], g[j - k] + f[t[x][i]][k][c[x][i] * li]);
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k <= li; k++)
                f[x][j][k] = max(f[x][j][k], g[j] + a[x] * (li - k));
    }
}

            read(C[i]);
            for (int j = 1; j <= C[i]; j++) read(t[i][j]), read(c[i][j]), in[t[i][j]] = 1;
        } else {
            read(cost[i]);
            read(lim[i]);
        }
    }
    memset(f, -INF, sizeof f);
    memset(ans, -INF, sizeof ans);
    ans[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!in[i]) {
            dp(i);
            for (int j = m; ~j; j--) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= j; k++) {
                    ans[j] = max(ans[j], ans[k] + f[i][j - k][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans[i] = max(ans[i - 1], ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans[m]);
}

//BZOJ1018.cpp

struct ri {

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].l=l,t[now].r=r;
    if (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].hasq=t[t[now].lch].hasq|t[t[now].rch].hasq;
    } else {
        if (rr[l].op==3) t[now].hasq=1;
    }
    return now;
}

inline int gettag(int x,int y) {
    if (y-x==1) return x;
    else return x+262144;
}

int A,B;
void add_query(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        info[++icnt].c1=A;
        info[icnt].c2=B;
        info[icnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=icnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) add_query(t[x].lch,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid) add_query(t[x].rch,max(mid+1,l),r);
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return getf(f[x]);
}

int merge(int head,int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    if (f1!=f2) {
        sta[++statop]=recover(f1,f[f1],head);
        head=statop;
        sta[++statop]=recover(f2,f[f2],head);
        head=statop;
        if (f[f1]<f[f2]) {
            f[f1]+=f[f2];
            f[f2]=f1;
        } else {
            f[f2]+=f[f1];
            f[f1]=f2;
        }
    }
    return head;
}

bool is_same(int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    return f1==f2;
}

int change(int x) {
    int head=0;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=info[now].next) {
        head=merge(head,info[now].c1,info[now].c2);
    }
    return head;
}

void rec(int head) {
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].tag]=sta[now].val;
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    int head=change(x);
    if (t[x].l==t[x].r) {
        if (is_same(rr[t[x].l].c1,rr[t[x].l].c2)) putchar('Y'),putchar('\n');
        else putchar('N'),putchar('\n');
    } else {
        if (t[t[x].lch].hasq) dfs(t[x].lch);
        if (t[t[x].rch].hasq) dfs(t[x].rch);
    }
    rec(head);
}

int main() {
    init_buf();
    read(c);
    m=1;
    while (readop(rr[m].op)) {
        int r1,c1,r2,c2;
        read(r1);
        read(c1);
        read(r2);
        read(c2);
        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
        m++;
    }
    m--;
    if (m==0) return 0;
    if (m==1) {
        if (rr[1].op==3) puts("N");
        return 0;
    }
    root=build(1,m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int tag=gettag(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (!visit[tag]) visit[tag]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2) {
            if (visit[tag]) {
                A=rr[i].c1;
                B=rr[i].c2;
                add_query(root,visit[tag],i);
                visit[tag]=0;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]) {
            A=i;
            B=i+1;
            add_query(root,visit[i],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+131072]) {
            A=i+131072;
            B=i+131073;
            add_query(root,visit[i+131072],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+262144]) {
            A=i;
            B=i+131072;
            add_query(root,visit[i+262144],m);
        }
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(root);
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1024.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;

double dfs(double x,double y,int n) {
    double re=INF;
    if (n==1) {
        if (x<y)
            swap(x,y);
        return x/y;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<= (n>>1); i++) {
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x*i/n,y,i),dfs(x*(n-i)/n,y,n-i)));
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x,y*i/n,i),dfs(x,y*(n-i)/n,n-i)));
    }
    return re;
}

int main() {
    double x,y;
    int n;
    scanf("%lf%lf%d",&x,&y,&n);
    printf("%.6f",dfs(x,y,n));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1025.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

bool notprime[MAXN];
int n,pcnt,prime[MAXN];
long long dp[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void init() {
    pcnt=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=n; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=n; j++) dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j];
        for (int j=prime[i]; j<=n; j*=prime[i]) {
            for (int k=j; k<=n; k++) {
                dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][k-j];
            }
        }
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        ans+=dp[pcnt][i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1027.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 505
#define eps 1e-9
struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double a,double b):x(a),y(b) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) const {
        return x*a.y-a.x*y;
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) const {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN],b[MAXN];

double fun;
int m,n;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];

inline bool spj() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (b[i].x!=b[i-1].x || b[i].y!=b[i-1].y) return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (b[1].x==a[i].x && b[1].y==a[i].y) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int check(point st,point ed) {
    int cnt1=0,cnt2=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        double x=(ed-st)*(b[i]-st);
        if (!(x+eps>0 && x-eps<0)) {
            if (x>0) {
                cnt1++;
            } else {
                cnt2++;
            }
        }
    }
    int ret=0;
    if (!cnt1) ret=1;
    if (!cnt2) ret+=2;
    return ret;
}

inline bool allin(point x,point y) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (((b[i]-x)^(y-b[i]))+eps<0) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

inline bool build() {
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=m; j++) {
            int ret=check(a[i],a[j]);
            if (ret==3) {
                if (allin(a[i],a[j])) return 1;
                else continue;
            }
            if (ret&1) map[i][j]=1;
            if (ret&2) map[j][i]=1;
        }
    return 0;
}

inline void work() {
    for (int k=1; k<=m; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (map[i][j]>map[i][k]+map[k][j]) map[i][j]=map[i][k]+map[k][j];
            }
    int ans=m+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (map[i][i]<ans) ans=map[i][i];
    }
    if (ans>m) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&m,&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",&a[i].x,&a[i].y,&fun);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",&b[i].x,&b[i].y,&fun);
    }
    if (spj()) puts("1");
    else if (build()) puts("2");
    else work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1029.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 150005

struct data {
    int t,r;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} b[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    priority_queue<int> q;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&b[i].t,&b[i].r);
    }
    sort(b+1,b+n+1);
    int total=0,ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (b[i].r-total>=b[i].t) {
            total+=b[i].t;
            q.push(b[i].t);
            ans++;
        } else {
            if (b[i].t<q.top()) {
                total-=q.top()-b[i].t;
                q.pop();
                q.push(b[i].t);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1030ac.cpp

#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#define mod 10007
using namespace std;
int n,m,sz=1,ans1,ans2=1;
int a[6001][27],point[6001],q[6001],f[101][6001];
char s[101];
bool danger[6001];
void ins() {
    int now=1,c;
    for(int i=0; i<strlen(s); i++) {
        c=s[i]-'A'+1;
        if(a[now][c])now=a[now][c];
        else now=a[now][c]=++sz;
    }
    danger[now]=1;
}
void acmach() {
    int t=0,w=1,now;
    q[0]=1;
    point[1]=0;
    while(t<w) {
        now=q[t++];
        for(int i=1; i<=26; i++) {
            if(!a[now][i])continue;
            int k=point[now];
            while(!a[k][i])k=point[k];
            point[a[now][i]]=a[k][i];
            if(danger[a[k][i]])
                danger[a[now][i]]=1;
            q[w++]=a[now][i];
        }
    }
}
void dp(int x) {
    for(int i=1; i<=sz; i++) {
        if(danger[i]||!f[x-1][i])continue;
        for(int j=1; j<=26; j++) {
            int k=i;
            while(!a[k][j])k=point[k];
            f[x][a[k][j]]=(f[x][a[k][j]]+f[x-1][i])%mod;
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for(int i=1; i<=26; i++)a[0][i]=1;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s);
        ins();
    }
    acmach();
    f[0][1]=1;
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++)dp(i);
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        ans2=(ans2*26)%mod;
    for(int i=1; i<=sz; i++)
        if(!danger[i])ans1=(ans1+f[m][i])%mod;
    printf("%d",(ans2-ans1+mod)%mod);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1030.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 6666
#define MOD 10007

int t[MAXN][26], fail[MAXN], tag[MAXN], tcnt = 1;
char s[105];

void insert() {
    int x = 1, n;
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'A';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    tag[x] = 1;
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) to = t[j][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                tag[to] |= tag[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
}

int n, m, ans = 0;
int f[105][MAXN], g[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) insert();
    build();
    f[0][1] = 1;
    g[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) g[i] = (g[i - 1] * 26) % MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= tcnt; j++) {
            if (f[i][j] && !tag[j]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
                    (f[i + 1][t[j][k]] += f[i][j]) %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int j = 1; j <= tcnt; j++) if (tag[j] && f[i + 1][j]) {
                (ans += f[i + 1][j] * g[m - i]) %= MOD;
            }
    }
    printf("%d", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1031.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200005

int n;

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN];

void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    int m = 128;
    Sort(x, sa, y, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i + n] = s[i];
    n *= 2;
    getsa();
    int nn = n / 2;
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= n && j <= nn; i++) {
        if (sa[i] <= nn) putchar(s[sa[i] + nn - 1]), j++;
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1036.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 30005
#define s 32768
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,dfn=0,ecnt=0,q,a[MAXN],head[MAXN];
int subs[MAXN],maxsize[MAXN],dep[MAXN],fa[MAXN],son[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN];
int ts[65536],tm[65536];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void findsize(int x) {
    subs[x]=1;
    maxsize[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            visit[v]=1;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            findsize(v);
            subs[x]+=subs[v];
            if (subs[v]>maxsize[x]) {
                maxsize[x]=subs[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void linkedge(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        visit[son[x]]=0;
        linkedge(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (visit[v]) {
                visit[v]=0;
                linkedge(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline int qmax(int l,int r) {
    int ans=-s;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,tm[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=max(ans,tm[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int qsum(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=ts[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=ts[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int getmax(int u,int v) {
    int ans=-s;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]])
            swap(u,v);
        ans=max(ans,qmax(tid[top[u]],tid[u]));
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v])
        swap(u,v);
    return max(ans,qmax(tid[u],tid[v]));
}

inline int getsum(int u,int v) {
    int ans=0;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]])
            swap(u,v);
        ans+=qsum(tid[top[u]],tid[u]);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v])
        swap(u,v);
    return ans+qsum(tid[u],tid[v]);
}

inline void change(int x,int v) {
    x+=s;
    tm[x]=ts[x]=v;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) {
        tm[x]=max(tm[x<<1],tm[(x<<1)^1]);
        ts[x]=ts[x<<1]+ts[(x<<1)^1];
    }
}

inline void init() {
    //tree chain partition
    dep[0]=fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    visit[1]=1;
    findsize(1);
    visit[1]=0;
    linkedge(1,1);
    //seg tree
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        tm[s+tid[i]]=ts[s+tid[i]]=a[i];
    }
    tm[s]=-s;
    for (int i=s+n+1,ta=s<<1; i<ta; i++)
        tm[i]=-s;
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        ts[i]=ts[i<<1]+ts[(i<<1)^1];
        tm[i]=max(tm[i<<1],tm[(i<<1)^1]);
    }
}

char op[10];

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%s%d%d",op,&u,&v);
        if (op[1]=='H')
            change(tid[u],v);
        else if (op[1]=='M')
            printf("%d\n",getmax(u,v));
        else
            printf("%d\n",getsum(u,v));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1038.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1319
typedef long double D;
const D eps = 1e-12;
const D INF = 1e18;
inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < eps ? -1 : 0);
}
inline D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (const Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (const Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (const D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (const D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (const Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    //void print() {printf("(%.2lf, %.2lf)", x, y);}
};

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border() {}
    Border(Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
    //void print() {p1.print(), p2.print(), putchar('\n');}
};

Point Is(Point a1, Point a2, Point b1, Point b2) {
    D x1 = (b2 - b1) * (a1 - b1), x2 = (a2 - b1) * (b2 - b1);
    return (a1 * x2 + a2 * x1) / (x1 + x2);
}

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return (a.p2 - a.p1) * (b.p2 - a.p1) > eps;
}

bool fail(Border &a, Border &b, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(a.p1, a.p2, b.p1, b.p2);
    return ((x - i.p1) * (i.p2 - i.p1)) > -eps;
}

Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
Point p[MAXN];
int n, cnt;

D ans = INF;
void update1(Point u, Point v) {
    if (u.x > v.x) swap(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (p[i].x < u.x - eps) continue;
        if (p[i].x > v.x + eps) break;
        Point is = Is(Point(p[i].x, 0), Point(p[i].x, 1), u, v);
        ans = min(ans, is.y - p[i].y);
    }
}

void update2(Point t) {
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (p[i].x - eps > t.x) break;
        if (p[i + 1].x + eps > t.x) {
            Point is = Is(Point(t.x, 0), Point(t.x, 1), p[i], p[i + 1]);
            ans = min(ans, t.y - is.y);
            break;
        }
    }
}

void hpi() {
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && fail(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && fail(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && fail(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && fail(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    Point last = Is(q[ta - 1].p1, q[ta - 1].p2, q[he].p1, q[he].p2), now;
    update2(last);
    for (int i = he + 1; i < ta; i++) {
        now = Is(q[i - 1].p1, q[i - 1].p2, q[i].p1, q[i].p2);
        update1(last, now);
        update2(now);
        last = now;
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n", double(ans + eps));
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i].x);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i].y);
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(p[1].x, 1), Point(p[1].x, 0));
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(p[n].x, 0), Point(p[n].x, 1));
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(1, INF), Point(0, INF));
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) a[++cnt] = Border(p[i - 1], p[i]);
    hpi();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1040.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1000005

typedef long long LL;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

struct dp {
    LL first,second;
    dp() {}
    dp(LL a,LL b):first(a),second(b) {}
} ret[MAXN];

int n,ecnt=1,a[MAXN],head[MAXN],h[MAXN],f[MAXN],visit[MAXN],r[MAXN],r1,r2;
LL ans=0;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void find(int x) {
    int now=x;
    while (!visit[now]) {
        visit[now]=x;
        now=h[now];
    }
    if (visit[now]==x) {
        r[getf(now)]=now;
    }
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    ret[x]=dp(0,(LL)a[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa && e[now].to) {
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
            ret[x].first+=max(ret[e[now].to].first,ret[e[now].to].second);
            ret[x].second+=ret[e[now].to].first;
        }
    }
    return;
}

inline LL work(int x) {
    r1=r[x],r2=h[r1];
    int rec=0;
    for (int now=head[r1]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to==r2) {
            e[now].to=0,e[now^1].to=0;
            rec=now;
            break;
        }
    }
    dfs(r1,0);
    LL ans1=ret[r1].first;
    dfs(r2,0);
    LL ans2=ret[r2].first;
    e[rec].to=r2;
    e[rec^1].to=r1;
    return max(ans1,ans2);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        read(h[i]);
        merge(i,h[i]);
        add(i,h[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) {
            find(i);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (i==getf(i)) {
            ans+=work(i);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1041AC.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<algorithm>
#define LL long long
using namespace std;
LL r,ans;
LL gcd(LL a,LL b) {
    return !b?a:gcd(b,a%b);
}
bool pd(LL a,double b) {
    if (floor(b)==b) {
        LL tmpb=(LL)(floor(b));
        if (gcd(tmpb*tmpb,a*a)==1&&tmpb*tmpb!=a*a)  return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%lld",&r);
    for (LL d=1; d<=(LL)(sqrt(2*r)); d++) {
        if (2*r%d==0) {
            for (LL a=1; a<=(LL)(sqrt((2*r)/(2*d))); a++) {
                double b=sqrt(2*r/d-a*a);
                if (pd(a,b))    ans++;
            }
            if (d!=2*r/d) {
                for (LL a=1; a<=(LL)(sqrt(d/2)); a++) {
                    double b=sqrt(d-a*a);
                    if (pd(a,b))    ans++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld",ans*4+4);
}

//BZOJ1041.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL r,rr,sqrt_rr,tot;

LL gcd(LL a,LL b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

inline bool check(LL a,LL b) {
    if (gcd(a,b)==1 && a!=b) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld",&r);
    rr=2*r;
    sqrt_rr=LL(sqrt(rr));
    for (LL d=1; d<=sqrt_rr; d++) {
        if (rr%d==0) {
            LL lim=LL(sqrt(rr/(2*d)));
            for (LL a=1; a<=lim; a++) {
                LL b=(LL)sqrt(rr/d-a*a);
                if (a*a+b*b==rr/d && check(a,b)) tot++;
            }
            if (d*d!=rr) {
                lim=LL(sqrt(d/2));
                for (LL a=1; a<=lim; a++) {
                    LL b=LL(sqrt(d-a*a));
                    if (a*a+b*b==d && check(a,b)) tot++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    tot++;
    printf("%lld\n",tot*4);
    return 0;
}

    dp[0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<4; i++)
        for (int v=c[i]; v<=100001; v++) {
            dp[v]+=dp[v-c[i]];
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {

        for (int k=0,cnt; k<16; k++) {
            cnt=0;
            long long st=0;
            for (int j=0; j<4; j++) {
                if ((k>>j)&1) {
                    cnt++;
                    st+=(long long)c[j]*(d[j]+1);
                }
            }

                ans+=dp[s-st]*(cnt&1?-1:1);
        }

inline bool check(int x) {
    int now=0,cnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (stick[i]+now>x) {
            cnt++;
            now=stick[i];
        } else
            now+=stick[i];
    }
    if (now)
        cnt++;
    if (cnt<=m)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}

    m++;
    int l=0,r=0,mid;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",stick+i);
        l=max(stick[i],l);
        r+=stick[i];
    }
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            r=mid;
        else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);

}

//BZOJ1045.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 100005

int T;
int n;
int r[MAXN];
int q[MAXN<<1],ans[MAXN],cnt=0;

struct data {
    int x,v;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return x<a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("write.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        cnt=0;
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d",r+i);
            a[i].x=i;
            a[i].v=r[i];
        }
        sort(a+1,a+n+1);
        int head=MAXN,tail=MAXN-1,nowpos=1,stackpos=1;
        while (nowpos<=n) {
            if (head<=tail) {
                if (q[head]<q[tail]) {
                    if (a[nowpos].v==q[head]) {
                        ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (a[nowpos].v==q[tail]) {
                        ans[++cnt]=q[tail--];
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (a[nowpos].x<stackpos) {
                nowpos++;
                continue;
            }
            for (; stackpos<=a[nowpos].x; stackpos++) {
                q[--head]=r[stackpos];
            }
            ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
        }
        while (head<=tail) {
            if (q[head]<q[tail]) {
                ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
            } else {
                ans[++cnt]=q[tail--];
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            printf("%d ",ans[i]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1048.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

const double INF = pow(2, 31);

double dp[11][11][11][11][11], avr;
int a, b, n;
int v[11][11], sum[11][11];

double power(double x) {
    return x * x;
}

int get(int i, int j, int k, int l) {
    i--, k--;
    return sum[j][l] - sum[i][l] - sum[j][k] + sum[i][k];
}

double work(int d, int x1, int x2, int y1, int y2) {
    double &ans = dp[d][x1][x2][y1][y2];
    if (ans != INF) return ans;
    if (d == 1) return ans = power(get(x1, x2, y1, y2) - avr);
    ans = INF + 1;
    for (int i = x1 + 1; i <= x2; i++) {
        for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
            ans = min(ans, work(k, x1, i - 1, y1, y2) + work(d - k, i, x2, y1, y2));
        }
    }
    for (int i = y1 + 1; i <= y2; i++) {
        for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
            ans = min(ans, work(k, x1, x2, y1, i - 1) + work(d - k, x1, x2, i, y2));
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(n);
    for (int q = 0; q <= n; q++)
        for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= a; j++)
                for (int k = 1; k <= b; k++)
                    for (int l = 1; l <= b; l++)
                        dp[q][i][j][k][l] = INF;

    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= b; j++) {
            read(v[i][j]);
            sum[i][j] = sum[i - 1][j] + sum[i][j - 1] - sum[i - 1][j - 1] + v[i][j];
        }
    avr = sum[a][b] * 1. / n;
    printf("%.2lf\n", sqrt(work(n, 1, a, 1, b) / n));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1050.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int u,v,w;
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[5005];

int n,m,f[505],s,t;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline void merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa==fb) return;
    if (f[fa]<f[fb]) {
        f[fa]+=f[fb];
        f[fb]=fa;
    } else {
        f[fb]+=f[fa];
        f[fa]=fb;
    }
}

int x,y;
double ans=1e9;

int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    return a;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&e[i].u,&e[i].v,&e[i].w);
    }
    scanf("%d%d",&s,&t);
    sort(e+1,e+m+1);
    for (int now=m; now; now--) {
        if (e[now].w==e[now+1].w) continue;
        int temp=now;
        memset(f,-1,4+(n<<2));
        while (temp) {
            merge(e[temp].u,e[temp].v);
            if (getf(s)==getf(t)) break;
            temp--;
        }
        if (getf(s)!=getf(t)) break;
        double nowans=e[now].w/(double)e[temp].w;
        if (nowans<ans) {
            ans=nowans;
            x=e[now].w,y=e[temp].w;
        }
    }
    if (ans<1e9) {
        int g=gcd(x,y);
        x/=g,y/=g;
        printf("%d",x);
        if (y!=1) printf("/%d",y);
        printf("\n");
    } else puts("IMPOSSIBLE");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1051.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXM 50005
#define MAXN 10005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXM],f[MAXM];

int n,m,scc=0,head[MAXN],belong[MAXN],dfn[MAXN],low[MAXN],siz[MAXN],cnt=0;
int sta[MAXN],top=0;
bool inq[MAXN];
void dfs(int x) {
    dfn[x]=low[x]=++cnt;
    sta[++top]=x;
    inq[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!dfn[v]) dfs(v),low[x]=min(low[x],low[v]);
        else if (inq[v]) low[x]=min(low[x],low[v]);
    }
    if (dfn[x]==low[x]) {
        siz[++scc]=0;
        int now=0;
        while (now!=x) {
            now=sta[top--];
            belong[now]=scc;
            inq[now]=0;
            siz[scc]++;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    dfs(1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1052.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define INF 1000000009
#define MAXN 20005
int n;
int x[MAXN],y[MAXN],lft=INF,bot=INF,rt=-INF,top=-INF;
bool visit[MAXN];
queue<int> q,w;

inline void cut(queue<int> &q,int l,int r,int b,int t) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i] && x[i]>=b && x[i]<=t && y[i]>=l && y[i]<=r) {
            q.push(i);
            visit[i]=1;
        }
    }
}

inline bool ok(int len) {
    int l=INF,r=-INF,b=INF,t=-INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) {
            t=max(t,x[i]);
            b=min(b,x[i]);
            l=min(l,y[i]);
            r=max(r,y[i]);
        }
    }
    if (r-l<=len && t-b<=len) return 1;
    return 0;
}

inline bool judge(int len) {
    int l=INF,r=-INF,b=INF,t=-INF;
    bool flag=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) {
            t=max(t,x[i]);
            b=min(b,x[i]);
            l=min(l,y[i]);
            r=max(r,y[i]);
        }
    }
    if (r-l<=len && t-b<=len) return 1;
    cut(w,l,l+len,t-len,t);
    if (ok(len)) flag=1;
    while (!w.empty()) {
        visit[w.front()]=0;
        w.pop();
    };
    cut(w,r-len,r,t-len,t);
    if (ok(len)) flag=1;
    while (!w.empty()) {
        visit[w.front()]=0;
        w.pop();
    };
    cut(w,l,l+len,b,b+len);
    if (ok(len)) flag=1;
    while (!w.empty()) {
        visit[w.front()]=0;
        w.pop();
    };
    cut(w,r-len,r,b,b+len);
    if (ok(len)) flag=1;
    while (!w.empty()) {
        visit[w.front()]=0;
        w.pop();
    };
    return flag;
}

inline bool make(int l,int r,int b,int t,int len) {
    bool flag=0;
    cut(q,l,r,b,t);
    if (judge(len)) flag=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        visit[q.front()]=0;
        q.pop();
    }
    return flag;
}

inline bool check(int len) {
    if (rt-lft<=len && top-bot<=len) return 1;
    if (make(lft,lft+len,top-len,top,len)) return 1;
    if (make(rt-len,rt,top-len,top,len)) return 1;
    if (make(lft,lft+len,bot,bot+len,len)) return 1;
    if (make(rt-len,rt,bot,bot+len,len)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",x+i,y+i);
        top=max(x[i],top);
        bot=min(x[i],bot);
        lft=min(y[i],lft);
        rt=max(y[i],rt);
    }
    int l=0,r=INF,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        if (check(mid=(l+r)>>1)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1054.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

inline void get(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        ch = getchar();
        while (~ch & '0') ch = getchar();
        a = a << 1 | (ch ^ '0');
    }
}

int st, ed;
int dis[262144];

queue <int> q;

#define p(x, i, j) ((x >> (i << 2 | j)) & 1)

void bfs() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    dis[st] = 0;
    q.push(st);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                if (p(x, i, j)) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int tox = i + dx[d], toy = j + dy[d];
                        if (tox >= 0 && tox < 4 && toy >= 0 && toy < 4 && !p(x, tox, toy)) {
                            int to = x ^ (1 << (i << 2 | j)) ^ (1 << (tox << 2 | toy));
                            if (dis[to] > dis[x] + 1) {
                                dis[to] = dis[x] + 1;
                                q.push(to);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    get(st);
    get(ed);
    bfs();
    printf("%d\n", dis[ed]);
    return 0;
}
