#define MAXM 1005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int T,n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],val[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

bool check(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (val[e[now].to]==-1) {
            val[e[now].to]=val[x]+e[now].w;
        }
        if (val[e[now].to]!=val[x]+e[now].w) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {

    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
        ecnt=0;

            scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
            add(u-1,v,w);
        }
        memset(val,-1,sizeof(val));
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
            if (val[i]==-1) val[i]=0;
            if (check(i)) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) puts("true");
        else puts("false");
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <ctime>

using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 1048580

int n,m,trie[205][26],tcnt=0;
bool dp[MAXN],word[205];
char s[MAXN];

inline void insert() {
    int now=0;
    for (int i=0; s[i]; i++) {
        int x=s[i]-'a';
        if (!trie[now][x]) trie[now][x]=++tcnt;
        now=trie[now][x];
    }
    word[now]=1;
}

inline void work() {
    int len=strlen(s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) s[i]-='a';
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=1;
    int ans;
    for (int i=0,cnt=0; cnt<11 && i<len; i++) {
        if (!dp[i]) {
            cnt++;
            continue;
        }
        ans=i;
        cnt=0;
        for (int j=i+1,now=0; j<=len; j++) {
            if (!trie[now][s[j]]) break;
            now=trie[now][s[j]];
            if (word[now]) dp[j]=1;
        }
    }
    if (dp[len]) ans=len;
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s);
        insert();
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        work();
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

struct task {
    long long num,arr,exe,val;
    task() {}
    task(long long a,long long b,long long c,long long d):num(a),arr(b),exe(c),val(d) {}
    bool operator < (task a) const {
        if (val!=a.val) return val<a.val;
        return arr>a.arr;
    }
};

priority_queue<task> q;

int main() {
    long long a,b,c,d;
    long long t=-1;
    q.push(task(-1,-1,1000000000000000ll,-1));
    while (scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld",&a,&b,&c,&d)!=EOF) {
        task now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        while (b-t>=now.exe) {
            t+=now.exe;
            printf("%lld %lld\n",now.num,t);
            now=q.top();
            q.pop();
        }
        if (b>t) {
            if (now.num!=-1) now.exe-=(b-t);
            t=b;
        }
        q.push(now);
        q.push(task(a,b,c,d));
    }
    while (q.top().num!=-1) {
        task now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        t+=now.exe;
        printf("%lld %lld\n",now.num,t);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1217.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 10005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,ecnt=0,f[MAXN],head[MAXN],label[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[h]=1;
    f[1]=1;
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=f[x]) {
                f[e[now].to]=x;
                q[t++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void mark(int x,int val) {
    if (val<=label[x]) return;
    label[x]=val;
    if (val) {
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            mark(e[now].to,val-1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    bfs();
    memset(label,-1,sizeof(label));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        if (label[q[i]]==-1) {
            mark(f[q[i]],1);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#define LIM 5002

int n,r,sum[LIM][LIM];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&r);
    for (int i=1,x,y,v; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&v);
        sum[x+1][y+1]=v;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<LIM; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<LIM; j++) {
            sum[i][j]+=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=r; i<LIM; i++)
        for (int j=r; j<LIM; j++) {
            ans=max(ans,sum[i][j]-sum[i-r][j]-sum[i][j-r]+sum[i-r][j-r]);
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 6001

    read(n);
    memset(dp, 0x3f, sizeof dp);
    dp[0] = 0;
    int top = 0;
    for (register int i = 1, j, a, b, c; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        if (a | b | c) {
            for (j = top; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (b) dp[j + b] = min(dp[j + b], dp[j]);
                if (c) dp[j + c] = min(dp[j + c], dp[j] + c);
                if (a) dp[j] = dp[j] + a;
                else dp[j] = INF;
            }
            top += max(b, c);
        }
    }
    int ans = INF;
    for (int i = 0; i <= top; i++) ans = min(ans, max(dp[i], i));
    printf("%d\n", ans);

//BZOJ1238.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <algorithm>

int ch;
bool getLine(char *s) {
    while (ch < ' ') {
        if (~ch) ch = getchar();
        else return 0;
    }
    while (ch >= ' ') {
        *(s++) = ch;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    *s = 0;
    return 1;
}

char s[23333];
bool vis[55]['Z' + 1], tmp[55]['Z' + 1];
int line = 1;
set <int> S;

void chk(int i, int ed, int dep) {
    for ( ; i < ed; i++) {
        if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') {
            if (!vis[dep][s[i]]) S.insert(s[i]);
        }
    }
    for (set<int>::iterator it = S.begin(); it != S.end(); it++) {
        printf("Line %d: variable %c might not have been initialized\n", line, *it);
    }
    S.clear();
}

bool fill() {
    while (getLine(s)) {
        line++;
        int len = (int)strlen(s);
        if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') return 0;
        else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') return 1;
        printf("Line %d: unreachable code\n", line);
        if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') if (fill()) fill();
    }
    return 0;
}

bool solve(int dep) {
    memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
    bool el = 0, re1 = 0;
    while (getLine(s)) {
        line++;
        int len = (int)strlen(s);
        if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') {
            if (el) {
                for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                    if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                        vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        } else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') {
            memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
            memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
            el = 1;
        } else if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') {
            chk(2, len - 5, dep);
            if (solve(dep + 1)) {
                for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
                if (fill()) {
                    memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
                    memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
                    el = 1, re1 = 1;
                } else {
                    if (el) {
                        for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                            if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                                vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (s[2] == '=') {
            chk(2, len, dep);
            vis[dep][s[0]] = 1;
        } else if (s[0] == 'R' && s[1] == 'E') {
            chk(6, len, dep);
            for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
            if (fill()) {
                memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
                memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
                el = 1, re1 = 1;
            } else {
                if (el) {
                    if (re1) {
                        return 1;
                    }
                    for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                        if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                            vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    getLine(s);
    for (int i = (int)strlen(s) - 1; i > 5; i--)
        if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') vis[0][s[i]] = 1;
    solve(1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1246.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 5005

int n, m, tot = 0, mid;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], sum[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

bool dfs(int cnt, int dep, int len, int top, int totlen) {
    if (!dep) return 0;
    if (totlen < sum[mid]) return 0;
    if (cnt == mid) return 1;
    if (len < a[1]) return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
    for (int i = top, last = -1; i; i--) {
        if (!vis[i] && a[i] != last && a[i] <= len) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            bool ret = dfs(cnt + 1, dep, len - a[i], i - 1, totlen);
            vis[i] = 0;
            if (ret) return 1;
            else last = a[i];
        }
    }
    return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]), tot += b[i];
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    int l = 0, r = n;
    // greedy
    for (int i = 1, j = 1, now = b[1]; i <= n; i++) {
        while (j <= m && a[i] > now) now = b[++j];
        if (j > m) break;
        now -= a[i];
        l++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (dfs(0, m, b[m], mid, tot)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1263.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
struct num {
    int v[1300],len;
    num operator * (int a) const {
        num ret;
        int next=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]=v[i]*a+next;
            if (ret.v[i]>9999) {
                next=ret.v[i]/10000;
                ret.v[i]%=10000;
            } else next=0;
        }
        if (next) {
            ret.len=len+1;
            ret.v[ret.len]=next;
        } else ret.len=len;
        return ret;
    }
} ans;

int n;

inline void quickpower(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=x; i++) ans=ans*3;
}

inline void prizero(int f) {
    int left=100-f,now=ans.len-1;
    printf("%d",ans.v[ans.len]);
    while (left>=4) {
        printf("%04d",ans.v[now--]);
        left-=4;
    }
    int x=ans.v[now];
    if (left) {
        printf("%d",x/1000);
        if (left>1) {
            printf("%d",(x/100)%10);
            if (left>2) {
                printf("%d",(x/10)%10);
            }
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

inline void pri() {
    if (ans.v[ans.len]) printf("%d",ans.v[ans.len]);
    for (int i=ans.len-1; i; i--) {
        printf("%04d",ans.v[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

int main() {
    memset(ans.v,0,sizeof(ans.v));
    ans.len=ans.v[1]=1;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int left=n%3;
    if (!left) {
        quickpower(n/3);
    } else if (left==1) {
        quickpower((n/3)-1);
        ans=ans*4;
    } else {
        quickpower((n/3));
        ans=ans*2;
    }
    int ans1=(ans.len-1)<<2;
    if (ans.v[ans.len]>0) {
        ans1++;
        if (ans.v[ans.len]>9) {
            ans1++;
            if (ans.v[ans.len]>99) {
                ans1++;
                if (ans.v[ans.len]>999) ans1++;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans1);
    if (n>628) prizero(ans1-((ans.len-1)<<2));
    else pri();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1266.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 505
#define MAXM 125005
#define s 512
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,c;
} e[MAXM<<1];

struct ee {
    int next,to,w;
} f[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,fcnt=1,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN],rdis[MAXN],fh[MAXN],tag[MAXN],t[s<<1];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w,int c) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].c=c;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].c=c;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void fadd(int u,int v,int w) {
    f[++fcnt].to=v;
    f[fcnt].w=w;
    f[fcnt].next=fh[u];
    fh[u]=fcnt;
    f[++fcnt].to=u;
    f[fcnt].w=0;
    f[fcnt].next=fh[v];
    fh[v]=fcnt;
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    t[x+=s]=d;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)|1]);
}

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<t[(x<<1)|1])
            x<<=1;
        else
            x=(x<<1)|1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void dijkstra(int st,int dis[]) {
    memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    update(st,0);
    int x=st;
    while (t[x+s]<INF) {
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        update(x,INF);
        visit[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[s+v]) {
                update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
}

queue<int> q;
inline bool bfs() {
    bool flag=0;
    q.push(1);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[1]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x==n) flag=1;
        for (int now=fh[x],v; now; now=f[now].next) {
            v=f[now].to;
            if (!tag[v] && f[now].w) {
                tag[v]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return flag;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==n) {
        return flow;
    }
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=fh[x],v; now; now=f[now].next) {
        v=f[now].to;
        if (!visit[v] && tag[v]>tag[x] && f[now].w) {
            int ret=0;
            if ((ret=dfs(v,min(flow,f[now].w)))) {
                f[now].w-=ret;
                f[now^1].w+=ret;
                return ret;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline long long dinic() {
    long long ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        int ret=0;
        while ((ret=dfs(1,INF))) {
            ans+=ret;
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w,c; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w,&c);
        add(u,v,w,c);
    }
    dijkstra(1,dis);
    dijkstra(n,rdis);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]+rdis[i]>dis[n]) continue;
        for (int now=head[i],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (rdis[i]-rdis[v]==e[now].w) {
                fadd(i,v,e[now].c);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n%lld\n",dis[n],dinic());
    return 0;
}

        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';

template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

    read(k);

    for (int i=1,t,y; i<=k; i++) {

        for (int j=1; j<=t; j++) {

            a[++acnt]=p(y,i);

        int nowpos=a[j].x;
        while (j<=n && a[j].x==nowpos) {
            if (cnt[a[j].v]==0) need--;
            cnt[a[j++].v]++;
        }

        puts("0");
        return 0;

            while (j<=n && a[j].x==nowpos) {
                if (cnt[a[j].v]==0) need--;
                cnt[a[j++].v]++;

//BZOJ1296.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int n,m,T,sum[55],dp[2505][55],val[2505],pack[2505];
char s[55];
void update() {
    for (int i=T; i>0; i--) {
        for (int j=i-1,ta=max(i-m,0); j>=ta; j--) {
            pack[i]=max(pack[i],pack[j]+val[i-j]);
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&T);
    for (int ca=1; ca<=n; ca++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) sum[i]=sum[i-1]+(s[i]=='1');
        memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
        for (int t=1; t<=m; t++) {
            int ret=0;
            for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
                dp[t][i]=dp[t-1][i];
                for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
                    dp[t][i]=max(dp[t][i],dp[t-1][j]+max(sum[i]-sum[j],i-j-sum[i]+sum[j]));
                }
                ret=max(ret,dp[t][i]);
            }
            val[t]=ret;
        }
        update();
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) ans=max(ans,pack[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1297.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 15
#define MAXM 105
#define MOD 2009
int n;
long long t;
char r[MAXN];
int map[MAXN][MAXN],lab[MAXN][MAXN],cnt=-1;
int now[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM],trans[MAXM][MAXM],ans[MAXM];

inline void exp(int a[MAXM][MAXM],int b[MAXM][MAXM]) {
    for (int i=0; i<=cnt; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<=cnt; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<=cnt; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++)
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
}

inline void quickpower(long long x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            exp(now,trans);
        }
        exp(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld",&n,&t);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",r);
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            map[i][j]=r[j]-'0';
        }
    }
    for (int tt=0; tt<9; tt++) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            lab[tt][i]=++cnt;
            now[cnt][cnt]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int tt=8; tt; tt--) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            trans[lab[tt][i]][lab[tt-1][i]]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (!map[i][j]) continue;
            trans[lab[0][i]][lab[map[i][j]-1][j]]=1;
        }
    }
    quickpower(t);
    ans[0]=1;
    for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++) {
        temp[0][j]=0;
        for (int k=0; k<=cnt; k++) {
            temp[0][j]=(temp[0][j]+ans[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",temp[0][lab[0][n-1]]);
    return 0;
}

int n,b,p=-1;

long long ans=0;

inline void work(int fc[],int bc[]) {
    fc[0]=bc[0]=1;
    int now=0;
    for (int i=p-1; i>0; i--) {
        now+=a[i];
        fc[now]++;
    }
    now=0;
    for (int i=p+1; i<=n; i++) {
        now+=a[i];
        bc[now]++;
    }
    for (int i=-100000; i<=100000; i++) {
        ans+=(long long)fc[i]*bc[-i];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&b);
    for (int i=1,t; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&t);
        if (t>b) a[i]=1;
        else if (t<b) a[i]=-1;
        else p=i;
    }
    work(fcnt+100001,bcnt+100001);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define MAXN 10319
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int m, n;
int fa[MAXN], c[MAXN], dp[MAXN][2];

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x <= n) {
        dp[x][c[x]] = 1;
        dp[x][c[x] ^ 1] = INF;
        return;
    }
    dp[x][0] = dp[x][1] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            dp[x][0] += min(dp[e[now].to][0] - 1, dp[e[now].to][1]);
            dp[x][1] += min(dp[e[now].to][1] - 1, dp[e[now].to][0]);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(c[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(m);
    printf("%d\n", min(dp[m][0], dp[m][1]));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1305.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='Y') a=1;
    else a=0;
    ch=getchar();
}

#define MAXN 210
#define MAXM MAXN*MAXN*2
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM];

bool map[55][55];
const int src=0,sink=1;
int n,k,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt;

void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build(int mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i<<2,mid);
        add(i<<2,(i<<2)|1,k);
        add((i<<2)|2,(i<<2)|3,k);
        add((i<<2)|3,1,mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) {
                add(i<<2,(j<<2)|3,1);
            } else {
                add((i<<2)|1,(j<<2)|2,1);
            }
        }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]!=0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==sink) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

bool dinic(int mid) {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=((n<<2)|3); i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,n*mid);
    }
    return ans==n*mid;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            readop(map[i][j]);
        }
    }
    int l=min(n,k),r=n,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        build(mid);
        if (dinic(mid)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

int n, ans = 0;
int Lst[30], a[30], cnt = 0;

void dfs(int x, int y) {
    if (y > n) {
        y = (++x) + 1;
        if (x >= n && a[x] == 0) {
            ans++;
            return;
        } else if (Lst[a[x]] > n - x) return;
    }
    if (a[x] >= 3) {
        a[x] -= 3;
        if (Lst[a[x]] <= n - y) dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[x] += 3;
    }
    if (cnt && a[x] && a[y]) {
        cnt--;
        a[x] -= 1;
        a[y] -= 1;
        if (Lst[a[x]] <= n - y && Lst[a[y]] <= n - x - 1) dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[x] += 1;
        a[y] += 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    if (a[y] >= 3) {
        a[y] -= 3;
        if (Lst[a[x]] <= n - y) dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[y] += 3;
    }
}

int main() {
    memset(Lst, 0x1f, sizeof Lst);
    Lst[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
        Lst[i + 3] = min(Lst[i + 3], Lst[i] + 1);
        Lst[i + 1] = min(Lst[i + 1], Lst[i] + 1);
    }
    read(n);
    cnt = n * (n - 1) / 2 * 3;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), cnt -= a[i];
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    dfs(1, 2);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1336.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL A=1234,B=101,C=107,M=19260817;
const double eps=1e-12;
int Rand() {
    A=(A*B+C)%M;
    return int(A);
}

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
} p[500005];
double dis(point a,point b) {
    return sqrt((a.x-b.x)*(a.x-b.x)+(a.y-b.y)*(a.y-b.y));
}
point mid(point a,point b) {
    return point((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2);
}

point center(point a,point b,point c) {
    double a1=b.x-a.x,b1=b.y-a.y,c1=(a1*a1+b1*b1)/2;
    double a2=c.x-a.x,b2=c.y-a.y,c2=(a2*a2+b2*b2)/2;
    double d=a1*b2-a2*b1;
    return (point) {
        a.x+(c1*b2-c2*b1)/d,a.y+(a1*c2-a2*c1)/d
    };
}
int n;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
        if (i&2) swap(p[i],p[Rand()%(i-1)+1]);
    }
    point O=p[1];
    double r=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis(O,p[i])>eps+r) {
            O=p[i];
            r=0;
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++)
                if (dis(O,p[j])>eps+r) {
                    O=mid(p[i],p[j]);
                    r=dis(O,p[j]);
                    for (int k=1; k<j; k++) {
                        if (dis(O,p[k])>eps+r) {
                            O=center(p[i],p[j],p[k]);
                            r=dis(O,p[j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n",r);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1367ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<algorithm>
#include<stack>
#include<cmath>
using namespace std;
const int MAXN=1000000+50;
typedef long long ll;
struct node {
    int key,dis,size;
    int lson,rson,father;
    int L,R;

} ltree[MAXN];
int n,z[MAXN];
stack<int> S;

void pushup(int x) {
    int l=ltree[x].lson,r=ltree[x].rson;
    ltree[x].size=1+ltree[l].size+ltree[r].size;
}

void build(int rt,int x) {
    ltree[rt].key=x;
    ltree[rt].dis=(rt==0)?-1:0;
    ltree[rt].size=(rt==0)?0:1;
    //\B2\BB?\CD\FC\C1?\B1Rt=0\B5\C4?\BA\F2size?0
    ltree[rt].lson=ltree[rt].rson=0;
    ltree[rt].father=ltree[rt].L=ltree[rt].R=rt;
}

int merge(int x,int y) {
    if (x==0 || y==0) return (x+y);
    if (ltree[x].key<ltree[y].key) swap(x,y);
    ltree[x].L=min(ltree[x].L,ltree[y].L);
    ltree[x].R=max(ltree[x].R,ltree[y].R);
    ltree[x].rson=merge(ltree[x].rson,y);
    int &l=ltree[x].lson,&r=ltree[x].rson;
    if (ltree[l].dis<ltree[r].dis) swap(l,r);
    if (r==0) ltree[x].dis=0;
    else ltree[x].dis=ltree[r].dis+1;
    pushup(x);
    return x;
}

int del(int rt) {
    int l=ltree[rt].lson,r=ltree[rt].rson;
    ltree[rt].dis=0;
    ltree[rt].size=1;
    ltree[rt].lson=ltree[rt].rson=0;
    int ret=merge(l,r);
    ltree[ret].L=ltree[rt].L;
    ltree[ret].R=ltree[rt].R;
    return ret;
}

void init() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",&z[i]),z[i]-=i;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) build(i,z[i]);
    build(0,0);
}

void solve() {
    S.push(1);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        int now=i;
        while (!S.empty()) {
            int tail=S.top();
            if (ltree[now].key<ltree[tail].key) {
                S.pop();
                int tmp=merge(tail,now);
                now=tmp;
                while (ltree[now].size*2>(ltree[now].R-ltree[now].L+2)) now=del(now);
                //\B2\BB?\CD\FC\BC\C7\C1\CB\D5\E2\C0\EF\CA\C7ltree[now].R-ltree[now].L+2\A3\AC?\BF\AA?��\B3\C9\C1\CB+1
                if (S.empty()) {
                    S.push(now);
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                S.push(now);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    while (!S.empty()) {
        int now=S.top();
        S.pop();
        printf("%d %d %d\n", ltree[now].L, ltree[now].R, ltree[now].key);
        for (int i=ltree[now].L; i<=ltree[now].R; i++) ans+=abs(z[i]-ltree[now].key);
    }
    printf("%lld",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    solve();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 1000005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int key, d, siz;
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->l = ptr->r = null;
    ptr->key = v;
    ptr->d = ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node *merge(Node *x, Node *y) {
    if (x == null) return y;
    if (y == null) return x;
    if (x->key < y->key) swap(x, y);
    x->r = merge(x->r, y);
    if (x->l->d < x->r->d) swap(x->l, x->r);
    x->d = x->r->d + 1;
    x->siz = x->l->siz + x->r->siz + 1;
    return x;
}

int n, a[MAXN];
Node *sta[MAXN];
int tot[MAXN], top = 0;
LL ans = 0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        a[i] -= i;
        Node *x = newNode(a[i]);
        int nowtot = 1;
        while (top && sta[top]->key > x->key) {
            nowtot += tot[top];
            x = merge(x, sta[top--]);
            while (x->siz > nowtot / 2 + 1) {
                x = merge(x->l, x->r);
            }
        }
        tot[++top] = nowtot;
        sta[top] = x;
    }
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
        while (!tot[top]--) top--;
        ans += abs(sta[top]->key - a[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();

#define MAXN 1000319

int n;

int get(char *s) {
    int i = 0, j = 1, k = 0;
    while (i < n && j < n && k < n) {
        if (s[(i + k) % n] == s[(j + k) % n]) k++;
        else {
            s[(i + k) % n] > s[(j + k) % n] ? i += k + 1 : j += k + 1;
            if (i == j) j++;
            k = 0;
        }
    }
    return min(i, j);
}

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (a[(mi + i) % n] != b[(mj + i) % n]) {
            flag = 0;
            break;
        }
    if (flag) {
        puts("Yes");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) putchar(a[(i + mi) % n]);
        puts("");
    } else puts("No");
    return 0;
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void add_2(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int source=0,sink=1;
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(source);
    tag[source]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[sink]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==sink) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow));
            if (ret) {
                usd+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(source,12345678);
    }
    return ans;
}

//BZOJ1443.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <fstream>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105

int n,m,S,T;
char map[MAXN][MAXN];
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[(MAXN*MAXN)<<4];

int ecnt=1,head[MAXN*MAXN],cur[MAXN*MAXN],tag[MAXN*MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]!=0;
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x==T) return 1;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x])
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].flow^=1;
                e[now^1].flow^=1;
                return 1;
            }
    }
    return 0;
}

void dinic() {
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=S; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        while (dfs(S));
    }
}

#define pos(i,j) ((i-1)*m+j)

bool ans[MAXN*MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN*MAXN];

void update(int x,bool st) {
    visit[x]=1;
    if (st) {
        ans[x]=1;
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (!e[now].flow && e[now].to!=S && e[now].to!=T && !visit[e[now].to]) {
            update(e[now].to,st^1);
        }
    }
}

void build(int x) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            if (map[i][j]=='.' && (((i^j)&1)==x)) {
                if (i>1 && map[i-1][j]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i-1,j));
                if (i<n && map[i+1][j]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i+1,j));
                if (j>1 && map[i][j-1]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j-1));
                if (j<m && map[i][j+1]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j+1));
                add(S,pos(i,j));
            }
    x^=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]=='.' && (((i^j)&1)==x)) {
                add(pos(i,j),T);
            }
        }
    }
}

bool flag=0;
void work(int x) {
    build(x);
    dinic();
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (((i^j)&1)!=x && map[i][j]=='.' && head[pos(i,j)] && e[head[pos(i,j)]].flow && !visit[pos(i,j)]) {
                flag=1;
                update(pos(i,j),1);
            }
        }
}

    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    S=0;
    T=n*m+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",map[i]+1);
    }
    work(0);
    work(1);
    if (flag) {
        puts("WIN");
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (ans[pos(i,j)]) {
                    printf("%d %d\n",i,j);
                }
            }
    } else puts("LOSE");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1449.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

#define N 10005
#define NN (N + 1024)
struct edge {
    int next, to,  w;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 3 * 4];

int head[NN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v,  w, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -w, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int S = 0, T = 1, node;

#define TOP 8191
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int q[TOP + 1], pre[NN], dis[NN];
bool inq[NN];
LL ans = 0;

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, (node + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    dis[q[0] = S] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q[(ta++) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

LL solve() {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f = 0, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n, m;
int W[N], L[N], C[N], D[N], d[N];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(W[i]);
        read(L[i]);
        read(C[i]);
        read(D[i]);
    }
    node = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        d[u]++;
        d[v]++;
        int to = ++node;
        add(to, T, 0);
        add(u + 1, to, 0);
        add(v + 1, to, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL now = C[i] * power(W[i]) + D[i] * power(L[i] + d[i]);
        ans += now;
        for (int j = 1; j <= d[i]; j++) {
            LL tmp = C[i] * power(W[i] + j) + D[i] * power(L[i] + d[i] - j);
            add(S, i + 1, int(tmp - now));
            now = tmp;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans + solve());
    return 0;
}

int n, m, Q;

void update(int t[301][301], int x, int y, int v) {
    for (int i = x; i <= n; i += i & -i)
        for (int j = y; j <= m; j += j & -j)
            t[i][j] += v;
}

int query(int t[301][301], int x, int y) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = x; i; i -= i & -i)
        for (int j = y; j; j -= j & -j) {
            ret += t[i][j];
        }
    return ret;
}

int a[301][301];
int t[102][301][301];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
            update(t[a[i][j]], i, j, 1);
        }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y, z, w, c; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(c);
            update(t[a[x][y]], x, y, -1);
            update(t[a[x][y] = c], x, y, 1);
        } else {
            read(w);
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            read(c);
            w--;
            y--;
            printf("%d\n", query(t[c], x, z) - query(t[c], x, y) - query(t[c], w, z) + query(t[c], w, y));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1460.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, p, k;
bool vis[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];

int ds(int x, int fa) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to, x);
    }
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x, 0);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int dep[MAXN], s[MAXN], top;
int ext[1000319], tag = 0;

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    s[++top] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

bool work(int x) {
    ext[0] = ++tag;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            top = 0;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) if (ext[k - s[i]] == tag) return 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) ext[s[i]] = tag;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    if (work(x)) return 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) if (solve(e[now].to)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void init() {
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
        read(k);
        if (k == 0) {
            puts("Yes");
            continue;
        }
        init();
        if (solve(1)) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1468.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 40319

LL ans = 0;

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, k;
int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x, int fa) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to, x);
    }
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x, 0);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs > siz[x] / 2) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int l[MAXN], lcnt = 0, dep[MAXN];

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    l[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa && !vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

LL work(int rt, int base) {
    dep[rt] = base;
    lcnt = 0;
    dd(rt, 0);
    sort(l + 1, l + lcnt + 1);
    LL ret = 0;
    int i = 1, j = lcnt;
    while (i < j) {
        if (l[i] + l[j] <= k) ret += j - i, i++;
        else j--;
    }
    return ret;
}

void solve(int x) {
    int rt = find(x);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    ans += work(rt, 0);
    for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            ans -= work(e[now].to, e[now].w);
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    read(k);
    solve(1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1475.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
#define MAXN 999

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4 * 2];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, node;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (T + 1));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = T; i >= 0; i--) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    T = n * n + 1;
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1, aij; j <= n; j++) {
            read(aij);
            tot += aij;
            if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                add(S, (i - 1) * n + j, aij);
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                    if (x && x <= n && y && y <= n) {
                        add((i - 1) * n + j, (x - 1) * n + y, INF);
                    }
                }
            } else add((i - 1) * n + j, T, aij);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", tot - dinic());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000005

int n, m, ans = 0;
int c[MAXN], he[MAXN], siz[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], fa[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
        fa[c[i]] = c[i];
        nxt[i] = he[c[i]];
        he[c[i]] = i;
        siz[c[i]]++;
    }
    ans = !!n;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) ans += c[i] != c[i - 1];
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 2) printf("%d\n", ans);
        else {
            int x, y, last;
            read(x);
            read(y);
            if (siz[fa[x]] > siz[fa[y]]) swap(fa[x], fa[y]);
            x = fa[x], y = fa[y];
            if (x == y || !siz[x]) continue;
            for (int i = he[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (c[i - 1] == y) ans--;
                if (c[i + 1] == y) ans--;
                last = i;
            }
            for (int i = he[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) c[i] = y;
            siz[y] += siz[x];
            nxt[last] = he[y];
            he[y] = he[x];
            siz[x] = 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1500.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 500005

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void readOp(int &a) {
    while (ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z') ch = getchar();
    switch (ch) {
    case 'I':
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'D':
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'R':
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'G':
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M':
        getchar();
        a = (getchar() == 'K') ? 3 : 6;
    }
    while (ch != ' ') ch = getchar();
}

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, sum, head, tail, mid;
    bool rev, same;
    Node () : siz(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF), rev(0), same(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void setv(int v) {
        siz = 1;
        sum = val = head = tail = mid = v;
    }
    void relax();
    void sameIt(int v) {
        same = 1;
        sum = (val = v) * siz;
        head = tail = mid = v > 0 ? sum : v;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(head, tail);
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
        head = max(c[0]->head, c[0]->sum + val + max(0, c[1]->head));
        tail = max(c[1]->tail, c[1]->sum + val + max(0, c[1]->tail));
        mid = max(max(max(head, tail),max(c[0]->mid, c[1]->mid)), max(0, c[0]->tail) + val + max(c[1]->head, 0));
    }
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = new Node();
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->setv(v);
    return x;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (same) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (c[i] != null) {
                c[i]->same = 1, c[1]->rev = 0;
                c[i]->sum = (c[i]->val = val) * c[i]->siz;
                c[i]->head = c[i]->tail = c[i]->mid = val > 0 ? c[i]->sum : val;
            }
        }
        same = 0, rev = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        c[0]->rev ^= 1, c[1]->rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0]->head, c[0]->tail);
        swap(c[1]->head, c[1]->tail);
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node* build(int tot) {
    if (tot <= 0) return null;
    int mid = tot >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode();
    x->setc(build(mid), 0);
    int v;
    read(v);
    x->setv(v);
    x->setc(build(tot - mid - 1), 1);
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    printf("rot %lld %lld\n", x == null ? -1ll : (long long)x, fa == null ? -1ll : (long long)fa);
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void dfs_prt(Node *x, int depth) {
    x->relax();
    for (int i = 1; i <= depth; i++) putchar('\t');
    printf("%d\n",x->val);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) if (x->c[i] != null) dfs_prt(x->c[i], depth + 1);
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        printf("X = %lld FA = %lld\n", x == null ? -1ll : (long long)x, fa == null ? -1ll : (long long)fa);
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ;) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) { // [l,r)
    printf("Pick %d %d\n", l - 1, r);
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", L, R, null);
    puts("Select Success");
    splay(L);
    puts("1");
    splay(R, L);
    puts("2");
    return R->c[0];
}

int step[MAXN];
Node *sta[MAXN];

void del(Node *rt) {
    rt->fa->setc(null, rt->dir());
    int top = 1;
    sta[top] = rt, step[top] = -1;
    while (top) {
        if (step[top]++ == 2) delete(sta[top--]);
        else if (sta[top]->c[step[top]] != null) sta[top + 1] = sta[top]->c[step[top]], step[++top] = -1;
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    (root = newNode())->setc(newNode(), 1);
    root->c[1]->setc(build(n), 0);
    splay(root->c[1]->c[0]);
    dfs_prt(root, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op, pos, tot, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readOp(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            get(pos, pos);
            root->c[1]->setc(build(tot), 0);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 2 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            del(get(pos, pos + tot));
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 3 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            read(v);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->sameIt(v);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 4 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->revIt();
            root->c[0]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 5 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            printf("%d\n", get(pos, pos + tot)->sum);
            break;
        case 6 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);

//BZOJ1503.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 300000
#define s 131072
#define INF 214748300

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void getop(int &op) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='I') op=0;
    else if (ch=='A') op=1;
    else if (ch=='S') op=2;
    else op=3;
    ch=0;
}

int n,minv;
int op[MAXN],a[MAXN],t[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1],M[s<<1];
int tem[MAXN],ntem=0,cnt=0;

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    read(minv);
    for (int i=1,delta=0; i<=n; i++) {
        getop(op[i]);
        read(a[i]);
        if (op[i]==0) {
            a[i]+=delta;
            tem[++ntem]=a[i];
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            delta-=a[i];
        } else if (op[i]==2) {
            delta+=a[i];
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+ntem+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+ntem+1)-tem);
    tem[0]=-INF,tem[ntem]=INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=ntem; i++) {
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=M[s+i]=tem[i];
    }
    for (int i=ntem+1; i<s; i++) {
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=M[s+i]=INF+i;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)|1];
        M[i]=R[i<<1];
    }
}

void update(int x,int p) {
    if (t[x]==0 && x<s) t[x<<1]=t[(x<<1)|1]=0;
    t[x]++;
    if (x>=s) return;
    if (p<=M[x]) update(x<<1,p);
    else update((x<<1)|1,p);
}

void clear(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x]==0) return;
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]=0;
        return;
    }
    if (l<=M[x]) clear(x<<1,l,min(r,M[x]));
    if (r>M[x]) clear((x<<1)|1,max(l,L[(x<<1)|1]),r);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)|1];
}

int query(int x,int rnk) {
    if (x>=s) return x-s;
    if (t[x<<1]<rnk) return query((x<<1)|1,rnk-t[x<<1]);
    return query(x<<1,rnk);
}

inline void letsgo() {
    int l=0,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        if (tem[(mid=(l+r+1)>>1)]<minv) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    if (l) clear(1,tem[1],tem[l]);
}

inline void work() {
    int delta=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (op[i]==0) {
            if (a[i]>=minv) cnt++,update(1,a[i]);
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            minv-=a[i];
            delta+=a[i];
            letsgo();
        } else if (op[i]==2) {
            minv+=a[i];
            delta-=a[i];
            letsgo();
        } else {
            if (a[i]>t[1]) printf("-1\n");
            else printf("%d\n",delta+tem[query(1,t[1]-a[i]+1)]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",cnt-t[1]);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 2333333

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz;
    char v;
    inline bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    inline void sc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

Node *newNode(char v) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->sc(x, fa->d());
    fa->sc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->sc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (rt == fa) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *kth(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        int ls = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < ls) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > ls) k -= ls + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

Node *Get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = kth(l - 1), *R = kth(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return rt->c[1];
}

int pos = 0;

char tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(tmp[mid]);
    x->sc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->sc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (x->v) putchar(x->v);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

void ins() {
    int n, i = 0;
    read(n);
    ch = getchar();
    while (i < n) {
        if (ch >= 32 && ch <= 126) tmp[i++] = (char)ch;
        ch = getchar();
    }

    Get(pos + 1, pos)->sc(build(0, n - 1), 0);
    rt->c[1]->upd();
    rt->upd();
}

void del() {
    int n;
    read(n);
    Get(pos + 1, pos + n)->sc(null, 0);
    rt->c[1]->upd();
    rt->upd();
}

void mov() {
    int k;
    read(k);
    pos = k;
}

void get() {
    int n;
    read(n);
    dfs(Get(pos + 1, pos + n)->c[0]);
    putchar('\n');
}

void pre() {
    pos--;
}

void nxt() {
    pos++;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode('{');
    rt->sc(newNode('}'), 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", tmp);

        case 'I' :
            ins();
            break;
        case 'M' :
            mov();
            break;
        case 'D' :
            del();
            break;
        case 'G' :
            get();
            break;
        case 'P' :
            pre();
            break;
        case 'N' :
            nxt();
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        ans--;
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    ans=n;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        merge(i,x);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;

#define MAXN 40010

    int u,v;
} re[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<3];

int n,m,ecnt,S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tag[MAXN],cur[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=n+m+1; i>=0; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7ffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(int mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(i+1,T,mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(S,n+i+1,1);
        add(n+i+1,re[i].u+1,1);
        add(n+i+1,re[i].v+1,1);
    }
    return dinic()==m;
}

    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(re[i].u);
        read(re[i].v);
    }
    int l=(m>0),r=m,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {

    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct fuck {
    int v, x;
    fuck () {}
    fuck (int a, int b = 0) : v(a), x(b) {}
    void r(int i) {
        read(v);
        x = i;
    }
    bool operator < (fuck a) const {
        return v < a.v || (v == a.v && x < a.x);
    }
    bool operator == (fuck a) const {
        return v == a.v && x == a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2];
    bool rev;
    fuck v, mi;
    int siz;
    Node () : rev(0), v(INF), mi(INF) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        mi = min(min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi), v);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
} mem[100005], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root;

int n;

Node *newNode(fuck v) {
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->v = ptr->mi = v;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int cnt(Node *x, fuck v) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (1) {
        x->relax();
        if (x->c[0]->mi == v) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->v == v) return ret + x->c[0]->siz;
        else ret += x->c[0]->siz + 1, x = x->c[1];
    }
}

        printf("%d%c", ret + i, i == n ? '\n' : ' ');

    }

                tot+=s[i];

                add(i,T,-s[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int x=0; x<nm; x++) {
        if (tag[x]) {
            for (int now=fh[x]; now; now=f[now].next) {
                if (tag[f[now].to]) {
                    add(f[now].to,x,INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ans=tot-dinic();
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    int next,to;
} e[MAXM<<1];

bool visit[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void tag(int x) {
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) visit[e[now].to]=1;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    if (visit[x]) return;
    visit[x]=1;
    ans--;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) dfs(e[now].to);
}

int main() {

    ans=p;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=c; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        tag(r);
    }
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 50005
#define S 262144
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXM * 2];
LL dis[22][MAXN], t[S * 2];
bool vis[22][MAXN];

void update(int x, LL v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m, K;

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dijkstra() {
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    update(1, 0);
    for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
        int k = (x - 1) / n, p = x - k * n;
        dis[k][p] = t[x + S];
        vis[k][p] = 1;
        update(x, INF);
        if (k <= K) for (int now = head[p]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[k][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + S] > dis[k][p] + e[now].w)
                    update(e[now].to + k * n, dis[k][p] + e[now].w);
                if (!vis[k + 1][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + n + S] > dis[k][p])
                    update(e[now].to + k * n + n, dis[k][p]);
            }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    dijkstra();
    printf("%lld\n", dis[K][n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1593ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cmath>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstring>
#include<cstdlib>
#define LL long long
#define pa pair<int,int>
#define F(i,j,n) for(int i=j;i<=n;i++)
#define D(i,j,n) for(int i=j;i>=n;i--)
#define MAXN 50005
using namespace std;
int n,m,x,y,z;
struct tree_type {
    int l,r,mx,lmx,rmx,sum,tag;
} t[MAXN*4];
int read() {
    int ret=0,flag=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') flag=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        ret=ret*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return ret*flag;
}
void update(int k,int z) {
    t[k].tag=z;
    if (z==1) t[k].mx=t[k].lmx=t[k].rmx=0;
    else t[k].mx=t[k].lmx=t[k].rmx=t[k].sum;
}
void pushdown(int k) {
    if (t[k].tag==-1) return;
    update(k<<1,t[k].tag);
    update(k<<1|1,t[k].tag);
    t[k].tag=-1;
}
void pushup(int k) {
    t[k].lmx=t[k<<1].mx==t[k<<1].sum?t[k<<1].mx+t[k<<1|1].lmx:t[k<<1].lmx;
    t[k].rmx=t[k<<1|1].mx==t[k<<1|1].sum?t[k<<1].rmx+t[k<<1|1].mx:t[k<<1|1].rmx;
    t[k].mx=max(max(t[k<<1].mx,t[k<<1|1].mx),t[k<<1].rmx+t[k<<1|1].lmx);
}
void build(int k,int x,int y) {
    t[k].l=x;
    t[k].r=y;
    t[k].sum=y-x+1;
    t[k].mx=t[k].lmx=t[k].rmx=t[k].sum;
    t[k].tag=-1;
    if (x==y) return;
    int mid=(x+y)>>1;
    build(k<<1,x,mid);
    build(k<<1|1,mid+1,y);
}
void cover(int k,int x,int y,int z) {
    if (t[k].l==x&&t[k].r==y) {
        update(k,z);
        return;
    }
    pushdown(k);
    int mid=(t[k].l+t[k].r)>>1;
    if (mid>=y) cover(k<<1,x,y,z);
    else if (mid+1<=x) cover(k<<1|1,x,y,z);
    else cover(k<<1,x,mid,z),cover(k<<1|1,mid+1,y,z);
    pushup(k);
}
int query(int k,int z) {
    if (t[k].l==t[k].r) return t[k].l;
    pushdown(k);
    if (t[k<<1].mx>=z) return query(k<<1,z);
    else if (t[k<<1].rmx+t[k<<1|1].lmx>=z) return t[k<<1].r-t[k<<1].rmx+1;
    else return query(k<<1|1,z);
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    n=read();
    m=read();
    build(1,1,n);
    F(i,1,m) {
        x=read();
        y=read();
        if (x==1) {
            if (t[1].mx<y) {
                printf("0\n");
                continue;
            }
            int ans=query(1,y);
            cover(1,ans,ans+y-1,1);
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            z=read();
            cover(1,y,y+z-1,0);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1593.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
struct Rg {
    int l, r;
    Rg () :l(0), r(-1) {}
    Rg (int a) : l(a), r(a) {}
    Rg (int a, int b) : l(a), r(b) {}
    bool empty() {
        return l == 0 && r == -1;
    }
    bool geq(int x) {
        return r + 1 >= x + l;
    }
    bool operator < (Rg a) const {
        return (r +  a.l < l + a.r) || (r +  a.l == l + a.r && l > a.l);
    }
    bool operator == (Rg a) const {
        return l == a.l && r == a.r;
    }
    int size() {
        return r - l + 1;
    }
    Rg operator + (Rg a) {
        if (empty()) return a;
        if (a.empty()) return *this;
        return Rg(min(l, a.l), max(r, a.r));
    }
} E(0, -1);

struct Node {
    Rg hd, md, tl, fu;
    int l, r;
    bool f, c;
    void fillIt() {
        c = 0, f = 1;
        hd = md = tl = E;
    }
    void clrIt() {
        c = 1, f = 0;
        hd = md = tl = fu;
    }
} t[131072];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].hd = t[t[x].l].hd == t[t[x].l].fu ? t[t[x].l].fu + t[t[x].r].hd : t[t[x].l].hd;
    t[x].tl = t[t[x].r].tl == t[t[x].r].fu ? t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].fu : t[t[x].r].tl;
    t[x].md = max(max(max(t[x].hd, t[x].tl), max(t[t[x].l].md, t[t[x].r].md)), t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].hd);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].f) t[t[x].l].fillIt(), t[t[x].r].fillIt(), t[x].f = 0;
    else if (t[x].c) t[t[x].l].clrIt(), t[t[x].r].clrIt(), t[x].c = 0;
}

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].hd = t[x].tl = t[x].md = Rg(l);
    t[x].fu = t[x].md;
    return x;
}

void fill(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].fillIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) fill(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) fill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void clr(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].clrIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) clr(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) clr(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int d) {
    if (l == r) return fill(1, 1, n, l, l), l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (t[t[x].l].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, d);
    else if (!t[t[x].l].tl.empty() && t[t[x].l].tl.size() + t[t[x].r].hd.size() >= d) ret = t[t[x].l].tl.l, fill(1, 1, n, t[t[x].l].tl.l, t[t[x].l].tl.l + d - 1);
    else if (t[t[x].r].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, d);
    else assert(0);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, d; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) read(d), printf("%d\n", t[1].md.geq(d) ? query(1, 1, n, d) : 0);
        else read(x), read(d), clr(1, 1, n, x, x + d - 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1597.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50005

struct Rect {
    int x, y;
    bool operator < (Rect a) const {
        if (x != a.x) return x < a.x;
        else return y < a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], sta[MAXN];

int n, m = 0;
LL f[MAXN], xx[MAXN], yy[MAXN];

LD slope(int u, int v) {
    return LD(f[u] - f[v]) / (yy[v] - yy[u]);
}

struct monoStack {
    int l, r;
    int v[MAXN];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    void maintain(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < xx[x]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(x, v[r]) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = x;
    }
} s;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i].x), read(a[i].y);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (m && a[i].y >= sta[m].y) m--;
        sta[++m] = a[i];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        xx[i] = sta[i].x;
        yy[i - 1] = sta[i].y;
    }
    f[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        s.maintain(i);
        int to = s[s.l];
        f[i] = f[to] + xx[i] * yy[to];
        s.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1601.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>
