#define MAXN 305
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
struct edge {
    int u,v,w;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,ecnt=0,f[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 1;
    if (f[fu]<fv) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int w;
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt]=edge(0,i,w);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            int w;
            read(w);
            if (i!=j) e[++ecnt]=edge(i,j,w);
        }
    sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (merge(e[j].u,e[j].v)) j++;
        ans+=e[j].w;
        j++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1602.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,ecnt=0,q,fa[MAXN][15],dep[MAXN],dis[MAXN],head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int k=1; k<=12; k++) {
        fa[x][k]=fa[fa[x][k-1]][k-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) u=fa[u][k];
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&q);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    fa[1][0]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    dep[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        printf("%d\n",dis[u]+dis[v]-2*dis[getLCA(u,v)]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1603.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,head[MAXN],val[MAXN],ecnt=0;
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            val[e[now].to]=val[x]^e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w^1);
        add(v,u,w^1);
    }
    val[1]=1;
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%d\n",val[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1604.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 123456789012345ll
typedef long long LL;
struct data {
    LL x,y;
    int id;
    data() {}
    data(LL b):x(0),y(b),id(0) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];
bool cmp(data q,data w) {
    return q.x<w.x;
}
int n,C,f[MAXN],ans,cnt[MAXN];
multiset<data> Tree;
multiset<data>::iterator it;
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
        ans--;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&C);
    ans=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x,y;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        a[i].x=x+y;
        a[i].y=x-y;
        a[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,cmp);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    Tree.insert(a[1]);
    Tree.insert(data(-INF));
    Tree.insert(data(INF));
    for (int i=2,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (a[i].x-a[j].x>C) {
            it=Tree.find(a[j]);
            Tree.erase(it);
            j++;
        }
        it=Tree.lower_bound(a[i]);
        data x=*it;
        if (x.y-a[i].y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        x=*--it;
        if (a[i].y-x.y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        Tree.insert(a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d ",ans);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cnt[getf(i)]++;
    int MAX=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) MAX=max(cnt[i],MAX);
    printf("%d\n",MAX);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1605AC.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
int n,m,k;
typedef struct node {
    int x,y;
} node;
node cow[1005];
bool grass[1005][1005];
int  get[105][105];
int dp[105][105][35];
char Turn(int x,int y) {
    if(x==-1)
        return 'W';
    if(x==1)
        return 'E';
    if(y==-1)
        return 'S';
    return 'N';
}
int moved[4][2]= {{1,0},{0,1},{0,-1},{-1,0}};
bool check(int x,int y) {
    if(x<0 || x>1000 || y<0 || y>1000)
        return 0;
    return 1;
}
char pre[105][105][35];
char nn[4]= {'E','N','S','W'};
int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    int x,y;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    int fix=k+1;
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++)
        scanf("%d%d",&cow[i].x,&cow[i].y);
    for(int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        grass[x][y]=1;
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=2*k+1; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=2*k+1; j++) {
            if(abs(i-fix)+abs(j-fix)>k)
                continue;
            for(int z=0; z<n; z++) {
                x=cow[z].x+i-fix,y=cow[z].y+j-fix;
                if(!check(x,y))
                    continue;
                if(grass[x][y])
                    get[i][j]++;
            }
        }
    int out=0;
    for(int t=1; t<=k; t++)
        for(int i=1; i<=2*k+1; i++)
            for(int j=1; j<=2*k+1; j++) {
                int tmp=abs(i-fix)+abs(j-fix);
                if(tmp>t)
                    continue;
                if(tmp==t || (t-tmp)%2==0) {
                    dp[i][j][t]=max(max(dp[i-1][j][t-1],dp[i+1][j][t-1]),max(dp[i][j-1][t-1],dp[i][j+1][t-1]))+get[i][j];
                    if(t==k && dp[i][j][t]>=out)
                        out=dp[i][j][t];
                }
            }
    for(int i=1; i<=2*k+1; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=2*k+1; j++)
            if(dp[i][j][k]==out)
                pre[i][j][k]='F';
    cout << out << endl;
    for(int t=k-1; t>=0; t--)
        for(int i=1; i<=2*k+1; i++)
            for(int j=1; j<=2*k+1; j++) {
                int tmp=abs(i-fix)+abs(j-fix);
                if(tmp>t)
                    continue;
                for(int z=3; z>=0; z--)
                    if(dp[i][j][t]+get[i+moved[z][0]][j+moved[z][1]]==dp[i+moved[z][0]][j+moved[z][1]][t+1] && pre[i+moved[z][0]][j+moved[z][1]][t+1]!=0)
                        pre[i][j][t]=nn[z];
            }
    int nowx=fix,nowy=fix;
    for(int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        printf("%c",pre[nowx][nowy][i]);
        switch(pre[nowx][nowy][i]) {
        case 'E':
            nowx++;
            break;
        case 'N':
            nowy++;
            break;
        case 'S':
            nowy--;
            break;
        case 'W':
            nowx--;
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1605.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1005
const int dy[]= {0,1,-1,0},dx[]= {1,0,0,-1};
const char dd[]= {'E','N','S','W'};
struct statu {
    int t,x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b,int c):t(a),x(b),y(c) {}
};
int n,m,k;
int x[1050],y[1050],dp[32][64][64];
LL from[32][64][64];
bool ok[1050][1050],visit[32][64][64];
queue <statu> q;
string seq;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",x+i,y+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&xx,&yy);
        ok[xx+31][yy+31]=1;
    }
    q.push(statu(0,31,31));
    from[0][31][31]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        statu now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        LL st=from[now.t][now.x][now.y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=now.x+dx[d],toy=now.y+dy[d],temp=dp[now.t][now.x][now.y];
            for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
                if (ok[tox+x[i]][toy+y[i]]) temp++;
            }
            if (temp>dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]) {
                dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]=temp;
                from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            } else if (temp==dp[now.t+1][tox][toy] && (from[now.t+1][tox][toy]>((st<<2)|d) || !visit[now.t+1][tox][toy])) from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            if (!visit[now.t+1][tox][toy] && now.t+1<k) {
                q.push(statu(now.t+1,tox,toy));
            }
            visit[now.t+1][tox][toy]=1;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++)
            ans=max(ans,dp[k][i][j]);
    if (ans==0) {
        printf("0\n");
        for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) putchar('E');
        putchar('\n');
        return 0;
    }
    LL sta=0x7fffffffffffffffll;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++) {
            if (dp[k][i][j]==ans) {
                sta=min(sta,from[k][i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    for (int i=k-1; i>-1; i--) {
        putchar(dd[3&(sta>>(i<<1))]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);

    k[0]=k[1]-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (k[i]-k[i-1]>10e-8) ans++;
    }

//BZOJ1611.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {0,1,-1,0,0};
int map[305][305];
int dis[305][305];

int n;
void mark(int x,int y,int c) {
    for (int i=0; i<=4; i++) {
        int tox=x+dx[i],toy=y+dy[i];
        map[tox][toy]=min(map[tox][toy],c);
    }
}
struct statu {
    int x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
};
queue<statu> q;

int main() {
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,x,y,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&c);
        mark(x+1,y+1,c-1);
    }
    if (map[1][1]<0) {
        puts("-1");
        return 0;
    }
    dis[1][1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,1));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().x,y=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        if (map[x][y]==0x1f1f1f1f) {
            printf("%d\n",dis[x][y]);
            return 0;
        }
        for (int d=1; d<=4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && toy && dis[tox][toy]==0x1f1f1f1f && map[tox][toy]>dis[x][y]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }
    puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,ans=0,map[MAXN][MAXN];
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) map[i][i]=1;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        map[u][v]=1;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=n; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (map[i][k])
                for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) if (map[k][j]) map[i][j]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int tot=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]||map[j][i]) tot++;
        }
        if (tot==n) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1613.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1100
int n,fa[MAXN],S,T;
double x[MAXN],y[MAXN],r[MAXN],x_t,y_t,s[MAXN],ans=0;;

bool flag=0;

double dis(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt((x[a]-x[b])*(x[a]-x[b])+(y[a]-y[b])*(y[a]-y[b]));
}

void dfs(int p) {
    ans+=s[p];
    if (p==T) {
        flag=1;
        printf("%d\n",int(ans));
        return;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (abs(dis(p,i)-(r[i]+r[p]))<1e-8 && i!=fa[p]) {
            fa[i]=p;
            s[i]=s[p]*r[p]/r[i];
            dfs(i);
            if (flag) return;
        }
    }
    ans-=s[p];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lf%lf",&n,&x_t,&y_t);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",x+i,y+i,r+i);
        if (x[i]==0 && y[i]==0) S=i;
        else if (x[i]==x_t && y[i]==y_t) T=i;
    }
    s[S]=10000;
    fa[S]=0;
    dfs(S);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1614.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXP 10005
#define MAXN 1005
#define INF 522133279
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXP<<1];

struct statu {
    int x,dep;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _x,int _d):x(_x),dep(_d) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return dep<a.dep;
    }
};

int n,p,k,ecnt;
int head[MAXN],visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline bool check(int val) {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    memset(visit,31,sizeof(visit));
    visit[1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x;
        if (x==n) return 1;
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to,dis=visit[x]+(e[now].w>val);
            if (visit[v]>dis && dis<=k) {
                visit[v]=dis;
                q.push(statu(v,dis));
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&p,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=p; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    int l=0,r=1000001,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            r=mid;
        else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>1000000) l=-1;
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1619.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0,1,-1,1,-1},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1,1,1,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 705
struct point {
    int x,y,v;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
} p[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,m,pcnt=0,ans=0;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN][MAXN];
void dfs(int x,int y) {
    visit[x][y]=1;
    for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (!visit[tox][toy] && map[tox][toy]<=map[x][y]) dfs(tox,toy);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            p[++pcnt].x=i,p[pcnt].y=j,p[pcnt].v=map[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n+1; i++) visit[i][0]=visit[i][m+1]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) visit[0][i]=visit[n+1][i]=1;
    sort(p+1,p+pcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (!visit[p[i].x][p[i].y]) {
            dfs(p[i].x,p[i].y);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1626.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
typedef long long LL;
int n,m,f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}
bool visit[MAXN];
double dis[MAXN],ans=0;
LL power(LL x) {
    return x*x;
}
LL X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
double dist(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt(power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]));
}
void prim() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) dis[i]=1e9;
    int x=1,to;
    double mindis;
    while (1) {
        visit[x]=1;
        to=-1;
        mindis=1e10;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                if (getf(i)==getf(x)) {
                    dis[i]=0;
                } else {
                    dis[i]=min(dis[i],dist(x,i));
                }
                if (dis[i]<mindis) {
                    mindis=dis[i];
                    to=i;
                }
            }
        }
        if (to==-1) break;
        ans+=mindis;
        merge(x,to);
        x=to;
    }
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=n; i++) {
        read(xx);
        read(yy);
        X[i]=xx,Y[i]=yy;
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u,v);
    }
    prim();
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1627.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {1,-1,0,0};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int tx,ty,n,dis[1024][1024];
bool map[1024][1024];
queue <int> q;
int bfs() {
    map[512][512]=1;
    dis[512][512]=0;
    q.push((512<<11)|512);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front()>>11,y=q.front()&2047;
        q.pop();
        if (x==tx && y==ty) return dis[x][y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && tox<1023 && toy && toy<1023 && !map[tox][toy]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                map[tox][toy]=1;
                q.push((tox<<11)|toy);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    read(tx);
    read(ty);
    read(n);
    tx+=512,ty+=512;
    memset(dis,0x3f,sizeof(dis));
    for (int i=1,a,b; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        map[a+512][b+512]=1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",bfs());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1630.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 1000000
int T,A,S,B;
int dp[2][100005],sum[2][100005],N[1005];

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(A);
    read(S);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=A; i++) {
        read(x);
        N[x]++;
    }
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=A; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        int now=i&1,prev=now^1;
        sum[now][0]=1;
        dp[now][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            if (j>N[i]) dp[now][j]=MOD+sum[prev][j]-sum[prev][j-N[i]-1];
            else dp[now][j]=sum[prev][j];
            if (dp[now][j]>=MOD) dp[now][j]-=MOD;
            sum[now][j]=sum[now][j-1]+dp[now][j];
            if (sum[now][j]>=MOD) sum[now][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=S; i<=B; i++) {
        ans+=dp[T&1][i];
        if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;

void spfa() {
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[X]=0;
    q.push(X);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;

                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[q.front()]) q.push(e[now].to);

//BZOJ1632.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,2,-2,1,-1,2,-2},dy[]= {2,2,1,1,-2,-2,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int m,n,map[35][35],add[35][35],dis[35][35],sx,sy,ex,ey;
long long cnt[35][35];
bool inq[35][35];
bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<=m && y>0 && y<=n;
}

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    q.push((sx<<10)|sy);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(add,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[sx][sy]=0;
    add[sx][sy]=0;
    cnt[sx][sy]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int nowx=q.front()>>10,nowy=q.front()&1023;
        q.pop();
        inq[nowx][nowy]=0;
        for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
            int tox=nowx+dx[d],toy=nowy+dy[d];
            if (!inrange(tox,toy) || map[tox][toy]==2) continue;
            int toadd=add[nowx][nowy]+(map[tox][toy]==0);
            if (toadd<add[tox][toy]) {
                add[tox][toy]=toadd;
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                    inq[tox][toy]=1;
                    q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                }
            } else if (toadd==add[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1<dis[tox][toy]) {
                    dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                    cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                } else if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1==dis[tox][toy]) {
                    cnt[tox][toy]+=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            if (map[i][j]==3) {
                sx=i,sy=j;
            } else if (map[i][j]==4) {
                ex=i,ey=j;
            }
        }
    spfa();
    if (add[ex][ey]>n*m) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n%d\n%lld\n",add[ex][ey],dis[ex][ey],cnt[ex][ey]);
    return 0;
}

        for (int k = i; k <= n; k++) {
            if (a[j] == s[k]) j++;
            f[i][k] = min(f[i][k], a[j] == '$' ? k - i + 1 - (j - 1) : 2333);
        }
    }

    read(n);

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 10005
struct qqq {
    int L,R;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        if (L!=a.L) return L<a.L;
        else return R<a.R;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n,fun,h,m,d[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(fun);
    read(h);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].L);
        read(q[i].R);
        if (q[i].L>q[i].R) swap(q[i].L,q[i].R);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    q[0].L=q[0].R=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].L==q[i].R) continue;
        if (q[i].L==q[i-1].L && q[i].R==q[i-1].R) continue;
        d[q[i].L+1]--;
        d[q[i].R]++;
    }
    int now=h;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        now+=d[i];
        printf("%d\n",now);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1636.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
int n,q;
int a[MAXN];
int Minv[MAXN][20],Maxv[MAXN][20];

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int x=r-l+1;
    int tt=log_2(x);
    return max(Maxv[l][tt],Maxv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt])-min(Minv[l][tt],Minv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),Minv[i][0]=a[i],Maxv[i][0]=a[i];
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=n; k++) {
        int tt=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            Minv[i][k]=min(Minv[i][k-1],Minv[i+tt][k-1]);
            Maxv[i][k]=max(Maxv[i][k-1],Maxv[i+tt][k-1]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1637.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 50005
struct cow {
    int id, x;
    bool operator < (cow a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n;
int tmp[MAXN * 2], tmp2[MAXN * 2];

void work(int fir[], int las[]) {
    int ans = 0, sum = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i].id) sum++;
        else sum--;
        if (i < n && fir[sum] > a[i + 1].x) fir[sum] = a[i + 1].x;
        las[sum] = a[i].x;
    }
    for (int i = -n; i <= n; i++) ans = max(ans, las[i] - fir[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].id);
        read(a[i].x);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    memset(tmp, 0x3f, sizeof(tmp));
    work(tmp + MAXN, tmp2 + MAXN);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1638.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
} E[MAXN];
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, in[MAXN];
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], g[MAXN], *dp = f;

queue <int> q;

void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!in[i]) q.push(i), dp[i] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!(--in[e[now].to])) q.push(e[now].to);
            dp[e[now].to] += dp[x];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(E[i].u), read(E[i].v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].u, E[i].v);
    solve();
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    memset(in, 0, sizeof in);
    ecnt = 1, dp = g;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].v, E[i].u);
    solve();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans = max(ans, f[E[i].u] * g[E[i].v]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    int cnt = 1, now = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (now + a[i] > mid) now = 0, cnt++;
        now += a[i];
    }
    return cnt <= m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int l = 0, r = 0;
    for (int i =1 ; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), l = max(l, a[i]), r += a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();

#define N 105
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

char s[N];
int n, sx, sy, tx, ty, G[N][N];
int dis[N][N][4];

struct Node {
    int x, y, d;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int b, int c) : x(a), y(b), d(c) {}
};

deque <Node> q;

void bfs() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) dis[sx][sy][i] = 0, q.push_back(Node(sx, sy, i));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node now = q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            if (dis[now.x][now.y][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d))
                dis[now.x][now.y][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
            int tox = now.x + dx[d], toy = now.y + dy[d];
            if (G[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[tox][toy][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d)) {
                    dis[tox][toy][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
                    if (now.d == d) q.push_front(Node(tox, toy, d));
                    else q.push_back(Node(tox, toy, d));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = INF;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ans = min(ans, dis[tx][ty][i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            G[i][j] = s[j] != 'x';
            if (s[j] == 'A') sx = i, sy = j;
            else if (s[j] == 'B') tx = i, ty = j;
        }
    }
    bfs();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1645.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

struct Node {
    int l, r, tag, v;
} t[MAXN * 99];

int tcnt = 1;

void pushdown(int &x, int tag) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (tag <= t[x].v) return;
    t[x].tag = tag, t[x].v = tag;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (v <= t[x].v) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].tag = v;
        t[x].v = v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(t[x].l, t[x].tag);
    pushdown(t[x].r, t[x].tag);
    //zuy zxhujyujhzuijuiiiiikjjjjjjjhggfv
    int mid = (l +  r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr, v);
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

LL ans = 0;

void dfs(int x, int l, int r, int tag) {
    tag = max(tag, t[x].tag);
    if (l == r) {
        ans += tag;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].l) dfs(t[x].l, l, mid, tag);
    else ans += LL(mid - l + 1) * tag;
    if (t[x].r) dfs(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, tag);
    else ans += LL(r - mid) * tag;
    return;
}

#define MAX 1000000001

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(v);
        update(1, 1, MAX, l, r - 1, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 1, MAX, 0);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

}

int dis[200319];

    read(n);
    read(k);
    dis[n] = 0;

    while (1) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x == k) {
            printf("%d\n", dis[x]);
            return 0;
        }
        if (x < k && dis[2 * x] > dis[x] + 1) dis[2 * x] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(2 * x);
        if (x > 0 && dis[x - 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x - 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x - 1);
        if (x < k && dis[x + 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x + 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x + 1);

//BZOJ1647.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 15
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n, m, ans = INF, tot;
int vis[MAXN][MAXN];
bool G[MAXN][MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXN], b[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void pop(int x, int y) {
    tot++;
    a[x][y] ^= 1;
    x && (a[x - 1][y] ^= 1);
    y && (a[x][y - 1] ^= 1);
    x + 1 != m && (a[x + 1][y] ^= 1);
    y + 1 != n && (a[x][y + 1] ^= 1);
}

void update(int st) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) b[i][j] = vis[i][j] == st;
}

void work(int st) {
    tot = 0;
    memcpy(a, G, sizeof G);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((st >> i) & 1) pop(0, i), vis[0][i] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[i - 1][j]) pop(i, j), vis[i][j] = st;
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[m - 1][j]) return;
    if (tot < ans) ans = tot, update(st);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            G[i][j] = x;
        }
    memset(vis, -1, sizeof vis);
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) work(i);
    if (ans == INF) puts("IMPOSSIBLE");
    else {
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                printf("%d%c", b[i][j], j == n - 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
            }
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 10];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int K, n, m, p[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a, b;

void dfs(int x) {
    b[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!b[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(K);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(p[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    a.set();
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        b.reset();
        dfs(p[i]);
        a &= b;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)a.count());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1650.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 50003;

int n, m, l, a[maxn];

int checkStone(int lt) {
    int s(0), po(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        if (a[i] - po >= lt)
            po = a[i];
        else
            ++ s;
    if (l - po < lt)
        ++ s;
    return s;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &n, &m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        scanf("%d", a + i);
    sort(a, a + n) ;
    int le(0), re(l);
    while (le < re) {
        int md((le + re + 1) >> 1);
        if (checkStone(md) > m)
            re = md - 1;
        else
            le = md;
    }
    printf("%d\n", le);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1653.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 12

int f[N][N];
int a[N], vis[N];
int n;

void solve(int x, int sum) {
    if (x > n) {
        if (sum) return;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d%c", a[i], i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        exit(0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n && i * f[n][x] + n - x <= sum; i++) if (!vis[i]) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            a[x] = i;
            solve(x + 1, sum - i * f[n][x]);
            vis[i] = 0;
        }
}

int main() {
    int sum;
    read(n);
    read(sum);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i][1] = 1;
        for (int j = 2; j <= i; j++) {
            f[i][j] = f[i - 1][j] + f[i - 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    solve(1, sum);
    return 0;

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
#define MAXM 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXM * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, stp = 0, ans = 0;
int dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
bool inq[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    sta[++top] = x;
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to && !dfn[e[now].to]) {
            e[now ^ 1].to = 0;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            e[now ^ 1].to = x;
            low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        } else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        ans += sta[top] != x;
        while (sta[top--] != x);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!dfn[i]) dfs(i);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define TOP 1000000000000000000ll

struct Num {
    int top;
    LL a[233];
    Num () {}
    Num (int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        top = 0;
        a[0] = x;
    }
    LL operator [] (const int x) const {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator += (const Num &b) {
        top = max(top, b.top);
        for (int i = 0; i <= top; i++) {
            a[i] += b[i];
            if (a[i] >= TOP) {
                a[i] -= TOP;
                a[i + 1]++;
                top += i == top;
            }
        }
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lld", a[top]);
        for (int i = top - 1; ~i; i--) printf("%18lld", a[i]);
    }
} dp[1005];

    read(K);
    dp[0] = 1;

        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) dp[j] += dp[j - i];
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;

//BZOJ1659.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 2 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

int L, T, top;
long long base, mo;
int dp[53][53][(1 << 8) + 1], last[53][53][(1 << 8) + 1];
int rr[53];

void trans(int i, int j, int k, int v, int ti, int tj, int tk) {
    if (dp[i][j][k] + v > dp[ti][tj][tk]) {
        dp[ti][tj][tk] = dp[i][j][k];
        last[ti][tj][tk] = j;
    } else if (dp[i][j][k] + v > dp[ti][tj][tk] && j < last[ti][tj][tk]) {
        last[ti][tj][tk] = j;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &L, &T);
    read(base);
    read(mo);
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof dp);
    memset(rr, 0x3f, sizeof rr);
    top = 1 << T;
    int tmp = (1 << (T - 1)) - 1;
    dp[T][0][getBit(T)] = 1;
    for (int i = T; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i - T; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < top; k++) {
                if (dp[i][j][k] != -1) {
                    trans(i, j, k, ~k & 1, i + 1, j, (at(i) << (T + 1)) | (k >> 1));
                    trans(i, j, k, k & 1, i + 1, j + 1, (at(i) << (T + 1)) | ((k >> 1) ^ tmp));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        for (int j = n; j >= 0; j--) {
            ans = max(ans, dp[n + 1][j][i] + __builtin_popcount(i));
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        for (int j = n; j >= 0; j--) {
            if (dp[n + 1][j][i] + __builtin_popcount(i) == ans) {
                updateans(j, i);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

inline void readchar(char &_ch) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    _ch = char(_c);
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 60319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'A' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int k = 0, i, j = 1; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j]  == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, len;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) readchar(s[i]);
    s[n + 1] = 'Z' + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[n + 2 + i] = s[n - i];
    len = 2 * n + 1;
    getsa(s, sa, len, 27);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int t = 1, i = 1, j = n + 2; t <= n; t++) {
        if (rk[i] < rk[j]) putchar(s[i++]);
        else putchar(s[j++]);
        if (t != n && t % 80 == 0) putchar('\n');
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1697.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 10005

int n, a[MAXN], b[MAXN], hh[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int find(int v) {
    int l = 1, r = n;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >>1;
        if (b[mid] >= v) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

long long ans = 0;

void solve(int st) {
    vis[st] = 1;
    long long sum = b[st], Min = b[st], len = 1;
    int x = st;
    while (a[x] != st) {
        x = a[x];
        vis[x] = 1;
        len++;
        sum += b[x], Min = min(Min, (long long)b[x]);
    }
    ans += sum + min((len - 2) * Min, Min + (len + 1) * b[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), b[i] = a[i];
    sort(b + 1, b + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = find(a[i]), hh[a[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!vis[i]) solve(i);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    }

            for (int k=1; k<=ccnt; k++) {
                if (!(can[j]&can[k]) && !(can[k]&st[i])) {
                    dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][j];

                }

//BZOJ1756.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 500319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node (): l(0), r(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
} t[1048576];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].head = max(t[t[x].l].head, t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].head);
    t[x].tail = max(t[t[x].r].tail, t[t[x].r].sum + t[t[x].l].tail);
    t[x].mid = max(max(t[x].head, t[x].tail),max(max(t[t[x].l].mid, t[t[x].r].mid), t[t[x].l].tail + t[t[x].r].head));
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        scanf("%d", &t[x].sum);
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum;
    }
    return x;
}

void modify(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum = v;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    }
}

Node combine(Node L, Node R) {
    Node ret;
    ret.sum = L.sum + R.sum;
    ret.head = max(L.head, L.sum + R.head);
    ret.tail = max(R.tail, R.sum + L.tail);
    ret.mid = max(max(ret.head, ret.tail),max(max(L.mid, R.mid), L.tail + R.head));
    return ret;
}

Node query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr)
        return Node(t[x]);
    Node ret;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = combine(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql),qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (op == 2) {
            modify(1, 1, n, l, r);
        } else {
            if (l > r) swap(l, r);
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r).mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1770.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
typedef long long LL;

struct QAQ {
    LL v;
    int cnt;
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return cnt > a.cnt;
    }
};

void work(LL a[], int &top, QAQ ans[], int tot) {
    top = 1 << tot;
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tot; j++) {
            if ((i>>j)&1) ans[i].v ^= a[j], ans[i].cnt++;
        }
    }
}

#define MAXN 40
int n, m, top[2];
LL a[MAXN];
QAQ ans[2][262144];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = 1ll<<i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        u--, v--;
        a[u] |= 1ll<<v;
        a[v] |= 1ll<<u;
    }
    int mid = n / 2;
    work(a, top[0], ans[0], mid);
    work(a + mid, top[1], ans[1], n - mid);
    LL hh = (1ll<<n) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < top[0]; i++) {
        ans[0][i].v ^= hh;
    }
    sort(ans[0], ans[0] + top[0]);
    sort(ans[1], ans[1] + top[1]);
    int i = top[0] - 1, j = top[1] - 1, ret = n;
    while (i >= 0 && j >= 0) {
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v < ans[1][j].v) j--;
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v > ans[1][j].v) i--;
        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v == ans[1][j].v) {
            ret = min(ret, ans[0][i].cnt + ans[1][j].cnt);
            while (i && ans[0][i - 1].v == ans[0][i].v) i--;
            while (j && ans[1][j - 1].v == ans[1][j].v) j--;
            i--, j--;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1798.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <ctime>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
int n,m,tcnt=0;
LL MOD;
int a[MAXN];
struct node {
    int l,r;
    LL v,mul,add;
} t[262144];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].mul=1;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
    } else {
        scanf("%lld",&t[now].v);
        t[now].v%=MOD;
    }
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int now,int lsiz,int rsiz) {
    if (t[now].mul!=1) {
        t[lch].add=(t[lch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].add=(t[rch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].mul=(t[lch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].mul=(t[rch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[now].mul=1;
    }
    if (t[now].add) {
        t[lch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[rch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v+t[now].add*lsiz)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v+t[now].add*rsiz)%MOD;
        t[now].add=0;
    }
}

void update_mul(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].mul=(t[now].mul*v)%MOD;
        t[now].add=(t[now].add*v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_mul(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_mul(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

void update_add(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].add=(t[now].add+v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v+(r-l+1)*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_add(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_add(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

LL query(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[now].v;
    LL ret=0;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret%MOD;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld",&n,&MOD);
    build(1,n);
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        LL k;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&op,&x,&y);
        if (op==2) {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_add(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(1,1,n,x,y));
        } else {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_mul(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005

    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];

#define lch t[now].l

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) lch=update(lch,l,mid,v);
        else rch=update(rch,mid+1,r,v);

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    lr[x]=++dfn;
    rt[dfn]=update(rt[dfn-1],1,n,h[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) dfs(e[now].to,x);
    }
    rr[x]=dfn;
}

int kth(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) return rec[l];
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=k) return kth(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,k);
    else return kth(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,k-lv);
}

    }

}

struct edge {
    int u,v,dis;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),dis(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return dis<a.dis;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN/2];

int n,k,ecnt,f[MAXN],X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
#define power(x) ((x)*(x))
int dis(int a,int b) {
    return power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]);
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu]>f[fv]) swap(fu,fv);
    f[fu]+=f[fv];
    f[fv]=fu;
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&X[i],&Y[i]);

        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            e[++ecnt]=edge(i,j,dis(i,j));
        }
    sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,tot=n-k; i<=ecnt; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) if (tot--==0) {
                printf("%.2lf\n",sqrt(e[i].dis));
                return 0;
            }
    }
    while (1) puts("t360yh");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1822.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define N 233
#define eps 1e-9
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

double power(double x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct Witch {
    int x, y, r, t;
} w[N];

struct Fairy {
    int x, y;
} f[N];

struct Tree {
    int x, y, r;
} t[N];

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point (int a = 0, int b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    template <class X, class Y> Point (X a, Y b) : x(b.x - a.x), y(b.y - a.y) {}
    int operator ^ (Point b) const {
        return x * b.x + y * b.y;
    }
};

template <class X, class Y> double dis(X &_a, Y &_b) {
    return power(_a.x - _b.x) + power(_a.y - _b.y);
}

bool check(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    return (Point(a, b) ^ Point(a, c)) >= 0 && (Point(b, a) ^ Point(b, c)) >= 0;
}

double getdis(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    double A = b.y - a.y, B = a.x - b.x, C = -(A * a.x + B * a.y);
    return abs(A * c.x + B * c.y + C) / sqrt(A * A + B * B);
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[N * N * 2];

int head[N + N], cur[N + N], tag[N + N], ecnt = 1, S = 0, T = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, ff
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, K, tt = 0;
bool G[N][N], ok[N];

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

bool ak(int mid) {
    memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(i + n + 1, T, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i + 1, w[i].t == 0 ? INF : 1 + mid / w[i].t);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) add(i + 1, j + n + 1, 1);
        }
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memcpy(cur, head, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret == m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(w[i].x), read(w[i].y), read(w[i].r), w[i].r *= w[i].r, read(w[i].t), tt = max(tt, w[i].t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(f[i].x), read(f[i].y);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(t[i].x), read(t[i].y), read(t[i].r);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (dis(w[i], f[j]) - eps < w[i].r) {
                bool flag = 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                    double mindis;
                    if (check(w[i], f[j], t[k])) mindis = getdis(w[i], f[j], t[k]);
                    else mindis = sqrt(min(dis(w[i], t[k]), dis(f[j], t[k])));
                    if (mindis - eps < t[k].r) {
                        flag = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                G[i][j] = flag;
                ok[j] |= flag;
            } else G[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!ok[i]) return puts("-1"), 0;
    int l = 0, r = tt * (n - 1), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ak(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1833.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

struct data {
    long long ans[10];
} ansa,ansb;

long long a,b;
inline long long calc(long long x,int dig) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long front=x,now=0,rear=0,ten=0,ret=0;
    if (dig==0) {
        while (front) {
            rear+=now*ten;
            if (ten) ten*=10;
            else ten=1;
            now=front%10;
            front/=10;
            if (now>dig) {
                ret+=front*ten;
            } else if (now==dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten+rear+1;
            } else if (now<dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    while (front) {
        rear+=now*ten;
        if (ten) ten*=10;
        else ten=1;
        now=front%10;
        front/=10;
        if (now>dig) {
            ret+=(front+1)*ten;
        } else if (now==dig) {
            ret+=front*ten+rear+1;
        } else if (now<dig) {
            ret+=front*ten;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void work(long long x,data &ans) {
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++)
        ans.ans[i]=calc(x,i);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld",&a,&b);
    work(a-1,ansa);
    work(b,ansb);
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {
        printf("%lld%c",ansb.ans[i]-ansa.ans[i],i==9?'\n':' ');
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1834.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 5005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,k,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,nocost=0,tot=0;
    while (tot<k) {
        spfa();
        if (dis[n]) {
            ans+=dis[n];
            tot++;
        } else {
            nocost++;
        }
        for (int x=n; x!=1; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",nocost,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,f,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&f,&w);
        add(u,v,0,f);
        add(u,v,w,k);
    }
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1835ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<vector>
#define N 200010
#define K 110
#define inf 1000000000
using namespace std;
int n,k,st[N],en[N],next[N],point[N],d[N],c[N],s[N],w[N];
long long t[N<<2],p[N<<2],f[N];
vector<int>q[N];
int read() {
    int x(0);
    char ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0'||ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0'&&ch<='9') x=x*10+ch-'0',ch=getchar();
    return x;
}
int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=n,ans;
    if (x<=0) return 0;
    while (l<=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (d[mid]<x) {
            ans=mid;
            l=mid+1;
        } else r=mid-1;
    }
    return ans;
}
void build(int k,int l,int r) {
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (l==r) {
        t[k]=f[l];
        return;
    }
    build(k<<1,l,mid);
    build(k<<1|1,mid+1,r);
    t[k]=min(t[k<<1],t[k<<1|1]);
}
void paint(int k,int l,int r,long long v) {
    t[k]+=v;
    p[k]+=v;
}
void pushdown(int k,int l,int r,long long v) {
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    paint(k<<1,l,mid,v);
    paint(k<<1|1,mid+1,r,v);
    p[k]=0;
}
void add(int k,int l,int r,int ll,int rr,long long v) {
    if (ll>rr) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ll<=l&&r<=rr) {
        paint(k,l,r,v);
        return;
    }
    if (p[k]) pushdown(k,l,r,p[k]);
    if (ll<=mid) add(k<<1,l,mid,ll,rr,v);
    if (mid<rr) add(k<<1|1,mid+1,r,ll,rr,v);
    t[k]=min(t[k<<1],t[k<<1|1]);
}
int query(int k,int l,int r,int ll,int rr) {
    if (ll>rr) return 0;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (l==ll&&r==rr) return t[k];
    if (p[k]) pushdown(k,l,r,p[k]);
    if (rr<=mid) return query(k<<1,l,mid,ll,rr);
    else if (mid<ll) return query(k<<1|1,mid+1,r,ll,rr);
    else return min(query(k<<1,l,mid,ll,mid),query(k<<1|1,mid+1,r,mid+1,rr));
}
void solve() {
    long long temp(0);
    long long ans=inf;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[i]=(long long)(temp+c[i]);
        for (int o=point[i]; o; o=next[o])
            temp+=w[o];
    }
    ans=f[n];
    for (int i=2; i<=k; i++) {
        build(1,1,n);
        memset(p,0,sizeof(p));
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            f[j]=query(1,1,n,1,j-1)+c[j];
            for (int o=point[j]; o; o=next[o])
                add(1,1,n,1,st[o],w[o]);
        }
        ans=min(ans,f[n]);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    n=read();
    k=read();
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) d[i]=read();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) c[i]=read();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) s[i]=read();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) w[i]=read();
    n=n+1;
    k=k+1;
    d[n]=inf;
    w[n]=inf;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int l=d[i]-s[i],r=d[i]+s[i];
        st[i]=find(l);
        en[i]=find(r);
        if (d[en[i]+1]==r) en[i]+=1;
        next[i]=point[en[i]];
        point[en[i]]=i;
    }
    solve();
}

//BZOJ1835.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 22005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, lazy;
} t[MAXN * 3];

vector < pair<int, int> > a[MAXN];
int n, k, tcnt = 0, g[MAXN], C[MAXN], D[MAXN], W[MAXN], S[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

void rebuild(int x, int l, int r) {
    t[x].lazy = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rebuild(t[x].l, l, mid);
        rebuild(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = g[l];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = INF;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr > mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy += v, t[x].v += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    upd(x);
}

void print(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l < r) {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        print(t[x].l, l, mid);
        print(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else printf("at %d : %d\n", l, t[x].v);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(k);
    n++, k++, D[0] = -INF, D[1] = 0, D[n] = INF;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) read(D[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(S[i]);
    for (int i = 1, st, ed; i < n; i++) {
        read(W[i]);
        st = int(upper_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] + S[i]) - D) - 1;
        ed = int(lower_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] - S[i]) - D) - 1;
        //printf("st : %d ed : %d\n", st, ed);
        a[st].push_back(make_pair(ed, W[i]));
    }
    memset(g, INF, sizeof g);
    g[0] = 0;
    build(0, n);
    for (int q = 1; q <= k; q++) {
        rebuild(1, 0, n);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int ret = query(1, 0, n, 0, i - 1);
            //printf("f %d %d :\n", q, i);
            //print(1, 0, n);
            g[i] = min(ret + C[i], g[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < a[i].size(); j++) update(1, 0, n, 0, a[i][j].first, a[i][j].second);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", g[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1852ac.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const int MAXN=2000000;
struct node {
    int l,r,a,b,tag,max;
} T[MAXN];
int tot,n,m,l,r,c;
void addtag(int x,int tag) {
    T[x].tag+=tag;
    T[x].max+=tag;
}
void pb(int x) {
    if(T[x].l) {
        addtag(T[x].l,T[x].tag);
        addtag(T[x].r,T[x].tag);
    }
    T[x].tag=0;
}
void up(int x) {
    T[x].max=max(T[T[x].l].max,T[T[x].r].max);
}
void build(int l,int r) {
    int x=++tot;
    T[x].a=l;
    T[x].b=r;
    T[x].tag=T[x].l=T[x].r=T[x].max=0;
    if(l==r)return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    T[x].l=tot+1;
    build(l,mid);
    T[x].r=tot+1;
    build(mid+1,r);
    up(x);
}
void change(int x,int a,int b,int p) {
    if(T[x].a>=a&&T[x].b<=b) {
        addtag(x,p);
        return;
    }
    if(T[x].tag)pb(x);
    int mid=(T[x].a+T[x].b)>>1;
    if(mid>=a&&T[x].l)change(T[x].l,a,b,p);
    if(mid<b&&T[x].r)change(T[x].r,a,b,p);
    up(x);
}
int query(int x,int a,int b) {
    if(T[x].a>=a&&T[x].b<=b)return T[x].max;
    if(T[x].tag)pb(x);
    int mid=(T[x].a+T[x].b)>>1,res=0;
    if(mid>=a&&T[x].l)res=max(res,query(T[x].l,a,b));
    if(mid<b&&T[x].r)res=max(res,query(T[x].r,a,b));
    return res;
}
struct data {
    int a,b;
} p[100010];
bool cmp(data x,data y) {
    return x.a+x.b>y.a+y.b;
}
int N,disc[200010];
int remark(int x) {
    int l=1,r=2*N;
    while(l<=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if(disc[mid]<x)l=mid+1;
        else if(disc[mid]==x)return mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ1852ac.out", "w", stdout);
    while(~scanf("%d",&N)) {
        for(int i=1; i<=N; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&p[i].a,&p[i].b);
            disc[(i<<1)-1]=p[i].a;
            disc[i<<1]=p[i].b;
        }
        sort(disc+1,disc+(N<<1)+1);
        for(int i=1; i<=N; i++)p[i].a=remark(p[i].a),p[i].b=remark(p[i].b);
        sort(p+1,p+N+1,cmp);
        n=N<<1;
        build(1,n);
        for(int i=1; i<=N; i++) {
            if(p[i].a>p[i].b) {
                int t=query(1,p[i].a,n);
                int t1=query(1,p[i].a,p[i].a);
                change(1,p[i].a,p[i].a,t-t1);
                change(1,p[i].b+1,p[i].a,1);
            } else {
                int t=query(1,p[i].b+1,n);
                int t1=query(1,p[i].a,p[i].a);
                change(1,p[i].a,p[i].a,t-t1+1);
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",query(1,1,n));
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int l, r, v, tag;
    void operator += (const int a) {
        tag += a;
        v += a;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].tag) {
        if (t[x].l) t[t[x].l] += t[x].tag;
        if (t[x].r) t[t[x].r] += t[x].tag;
        t[x].tag = 0;
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void insert(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (t[x].v < v) t[x].v = v;
    if (l == r) return;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (p <= mid) insert(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
    else insert(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	cerr << "update ( " << l << " " << r << " ) " << t[x].v << endl;
        t[x] += 1;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

struct St {
    int a, b;
    St () {}
    St (int x, int y) : a(x), b(y) {}
    bool operator < (const St &q) const {
        return a + b > q.a + q.b;
    }
} a[MAXN];

        if (a[i].a <= a[i].b + 1) {

            //		cerr << "a . query " << a[i].b + 1 << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            //		cerr << "ins " << a[i].a << " " << dp << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);
        } else {
            dp = query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, MAX) + 1;
            //		cerr << "b . query " << a[i].a << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);

    }

//BZOJ1853.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const long long top=10000000000;

long long q[2100];
bool ban[2100];
int head=1,tail=1;
void init() {
    q[tail++]=6;
    q[tail++]=8;
    while (head<tail) {
        long long now=q[head++];
        if (now*10+6<=top) q[tail++]=now*10+6;
        if (now*10+8<=top) q[tail++]=now*10+8;
    }
    for (int i=2; i<tail; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
            if (!ban[j] && q[i]%q[j]==0) {
                ban[i]=1;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

long long work(long long x) {
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<tail; i++) {
        if (!ban[i]) ans+=x/q[i];
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    long long a,b;
    init();
    cin>>a>>b;
    cout<<work(b)-work(a-1)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int n;
int f[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] != x) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
    if (u == v) vis[u] = 1;
    else {
        if (u < v) swap(u, v);
        vis[v] = 1;
        f[v] = u;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(10001, n + 1); i++) f[i] = i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) if (!vis[i]) return printf("%d\n", i - 1), 0;
}

#define MAXN 2000319
#define MOD 20100403

int power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

int fac[MAXN], inv[MAXN];

int C(int n, int m) {
    return int((LL)fac[n] * inv[n - m] % MOD * inv[m] % MOD);
}

int main() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) fac[i] = int(LL(fac[i - 1]) * i % MOD);
    inv[MAXN - 1] = power(fac[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN - 2; i; i--) inv[i] = int(LL(inv[i + 1]) * (i + 1) % MOD);
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (n < m) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n", (C(n + m, m) - C(n + m, m - 1) + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

double dis(double a,double b,double c,double d) {
    return sqrt((a-c)*(a-c)+(b-d)*(b-d));
}

int Ax,Ay,Bx,By,Cx,Cy,Dx,Dy,P,Q,R;
double calc(double m,double n) {
    double x1=(Ax*m+Bx*(100-m))/100,y1=(Ay*m+By*(100-m))/100;
    double x2=(Cx*n+Dx*(100-n))/100,y2=(Cy*n+Dy*(100-n))/100;
    return dis(Ax,Ay,x1,y1)/P+dis(x1,y1,x2,y2)/R+dis(x2,y2,Dx,Dy)/Q;
}

double getans(double k) {
    double ll=0,rr=100,l,r;
    double llans=calc(k,ll),rrans=calc(k,rr),lans,rans;
    while (rr-ll>1e-2) {
        l=(ll*501+rr*499)/1000;
        r=(ll*499+rr*501)/1000;
        lans=calc(k,l);
        rans=calc(k,r);
        if (rans<lans) ll=l,llans=lans;
        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }
    return min(llans,rrans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d",&Ax,&Ay,&Bx,&By,&Cx,&Cy,&Dx,&Dy,&P,&Q,&R);
