        l=(ll*501+rr*499)/1000;
        r=(ll*499+rr*501)/1000;
        lans=getans(l);
        rans=getans(r);
        if (rans<=lans) ll=l,llans=lans;
        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n",min(llans,rrans));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1858.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int l, r, siz;
    int sum, lazy;
    int he[2], ta[2], md[2];
    bool rev;
} t[262144];

int tcnt = 0;

#define lch(q) t[q].l
#define rch(q) t[q].r

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[lch(x)].sum + t[rch(x)].sum;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        t[x].he[i] = t[lch(x)].he[i] == t[lch(x)].siz ? t[lch(x)].siz + t[rch(x)].he[i] : t[lch(x)].he[i];
        t[x].ta[i] = t[rch(x)].ta[i] == t[rch(x)].siz ? t[rch(x)].siz + t[lch(x)].ta[i] : t[rch(x)].ta[i];
        t[x].md[i] = max(max(max(t[lch(x)].md[i], t[rch(x)].md[i]), max(t[x].he[i], t[x].ta[i])), t[lch(x)].ta[i] + t[rch(x)].he[i]);
    }
}

void rev(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) t[x].lazy = -t[x].lazy;
    else t[x].rev ^= 1;
    swap(t[x].he[0], t[x].he[1]);
    swap(t[x].ta[0], t[x].ta[1]);
    swap(t[x].md[0], t[x].md[1]);
    t[x].sum = t[x].siz - t[x].sum;
}

void clr(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = -1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = t[x].siz;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = 0;
}

void fil(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = 1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = 0;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = t[x].siz;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy > 0) fil(lch(x)), fil(rch(x));
        else clr(lch(x)), clr(rch(x));
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (t[x].rev) {
        rev(t[x].l), rev(t[x].r);
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].siz = r - l + 1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        int p;
        read(p);
        t[x].sum = p;
        t[x].he[!p] = t[x].ta[!p] = t[x].md[!p] = 0;
        t[x].he[p] = t[x].ta[p] = t[x].md[p] = 1;
    }
    return x;
}

int n, m;

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, void(*opt)(int)) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        opt(x);
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), opt);
    if (qr > mid) update(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, opt);
    upd(x);
}

int Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += Sum(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Ret {
    int he, ta, md, siz;
    Ret (int x = 0, int y = 0, int z = 0, int w = 0) : he(x), ta(y), md(z), siz(w) {}
};

Ret operator + (Ret x, Ret y) {
    Ret ret;
    ret.he = x.he == x.siz ? x.siz + y.he : x.he;
    ret.ta = y.ta == y.siz ? y.siz + x.ta : y.ta;
    ret.md = max(max(ret.he, ret.ta), max(max(x.md, y.md), x.ta + y.he));
    ret.siz = x.siz + y.siz;
    return ret;
}

Ret Cons(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x].he[1], t[x].ta[1], t[x].md[1], t[x].siz);
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Ret ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + Cons(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + Cons(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(0, n - 1);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        switch (x) {
        case 0:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, clr);
            break;
        case 1:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, fil);
            break;
        case 2:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, rev);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", Sum(1, 0, n - 1, l, r));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", Cons(1, 0, n - 1, l, r).md);
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>

#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 1253
#define MOD 100000000

char temp[MAXL*10];

struct num {
    int a[MAXL+5];
    num() {
        memset(a,0,sizeof(a));
    }
    int &operator [](int i) {
        return a[i];
    }
    void operator /=(int x) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>=1; i--) {
            a[i-1]+=a[i]%x*MOD,a[i]/=x;
        }
    }
    void operator -=(num &b) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]-b[i]+(a[i-1]+MOD)/MOD-1,a[i-1]=(a[i-1]+MOD)%MOD;
        }
    }
    void operator *=(int x) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]*x+a[i-1]/MOD,a[i-1]%=MOD;
        }
    }
    bool operator < (num &b) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>0; i--) {
            if (a[i]!=b[i]) return a[i]<b[i];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    bool iszero() {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) if (a[i]!=0) return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<8; i++) temp[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",temp+8);
        int len=(int)strlen(temp+1),p=1;
        while (len-8*p+1>0) {
            sscanf(temp+len-8*p+1,"%8d",&a[p]);
            p++;
        }
    }
    void print() {
        int p=MAXL;
        while (!a[p] && p>0) p--;
        printf("%d",a[p--]);
        while (p>0) printf("%08d",a[p--]);
        printf("\n");
    }
} a,b;

num gcd(num x,num y) {
    int g=0;
    while (!x.iszero() && !y.iszero()) {
        bool xx=(x[1]&1)^1,yy=(y[1]&1)^1;
        if (xx&&yy) {
            g++;
            x/=2;
            y/=2;
        } else if (xx||yy) {
            if (xx) x/=2;
            else y/=2;
        }
        if (y<x) x-=y;
        else y-=x;
    }
    if (x<y) x=y;
    while (g--) x*=2;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    a.read();
    b.read();
    gcd(a,b).print();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1877.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 405
#define MAXM 20005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[source]=0;
    q.push(source);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pre[sink]!=-1;
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,tot=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        tot++;
        ans+=dis[sink];
        for (int x=sink; x!=source; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",tot,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++) {
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u*2+1,v*2,w,1);
    }
    add(0,3,0,12345678);
    add(n*2,1,0,12345678);
    work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 50005
#define MAXM 200005
#define s 65536
struct ls {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (ls a) const {
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return x<a.x;
    }
} d[MAXN];

struct qqq {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} q[MAXM];

int n,m,cnt=0;
int a[MAXN],last[MAXN],ans[MAXM],t[s<<1];

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=d;
}

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&d[i].v);
        d[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(d+1,d+n+1);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (d[i].v==d[i-1].v) {
            last[d[i].x]=d[i-1].x;
        }
    }
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&q[i].l,&q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int now=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        update(i,1);
        if (last[i]) update(last[i],-1);
        while (now<=m && q[now].r==i) {
            ans[q[now].x]=query(q[now].l,i);
            now++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'A' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'R' :
        getchar();
        getchar();
        _c = getchar();
        a = 2 + (_c == 'O');
        break;
    case 'I' :
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'D' :
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        a = 6;
        break;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x7fffffff
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int mi, siz, val, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : mi(INF), siz(0), val(INF) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        mi += v;
        val += v;
        lazy += v;
    }
    void relax();
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        mi = min(min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi), val);
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

void Node::relax() {
    if (lazy) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->add(lazy);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->add(lazy);
        lazy = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt();
        c[1]->revIt();
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->val = ptr->mi = v;
    ptr->lazy = ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

int a[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax();
    x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R; // R->c[0] = [l, r)
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    a[0] = a[n + 1] = INF;
    rt = build(0, n + 1);
    read(m);
    Node *R, *tmp;
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y, z, mid; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->add(z);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->revIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            z %= (y - x + 1);
            mid = y - z + 1;
            R = get(mid, y + 1);
            tmp = R->c[0];
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            R = get(x, x);
            R->setc(tmp, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 4:
            read(x);
            read(z);
            R = get(x + 1, x + 1);
            R->setc(newNode(z), 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 5:
            read(x);
            R = get(x, x + 1);
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 6:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            printf("%d\n", get(x, y + 1)->c[0]->mi);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 10005
int T;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,ans=0,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to]=x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    if (cnt[x]==0) cnt[fa[x]]++;
    else if (cnt[x]==1) cnt[fa[x]]++,ans--;
    else ans-=2;
    cnt[x]=0;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    ans=n;
    fa[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        init();
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1911.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    a = 0;
    bool F = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') F |= ch == '-', ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (F) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 1000005
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
int n;
LL A, B, C, s[MAXN], f[MAXN], y[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(y[j] - y[k]) / LD(s[j] - s[k]);
}
LL calc(LL x) {
    return A * x * x + B * x + C;
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) > 2 * A * s[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) > slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) {
        read(ai);
        s[i] = s[i - 1] + ai;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + calc(s[i] - s[j]);
        y[i] = f[i] + A * s[i] * s[i] - B * s[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
inline bool nxtBit() {
    ch = getchar();
    while (ch != '0' && ch != '1') ch = getchar();
    return ch == '1';
}

#define MAXN 1024

int n, m;
bool ansed = 0, sf[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a[2048], b[2048];
char tmp[MAXN];

bool check(int cnt) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) a[i] = b[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= cnt && !a[to][i]) to++;
        if (to > cnt) return 0;
        swap(a[to], a[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            if (j != i && a[j][i]) a[j] ^= a[i];
        }
    }
    if (!ansed) {
        ansed = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sf[i] = a[i][0];
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) b[i][j] = nxtBit();
        b[i][0] = nxtBit();
    }
    int l = n, r = m + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    if (l > m) puts("Cannot Determine");
    else {
        printf("%d\n", l);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            printf("%s\n", sf[i] ? "?y7M#" : "Earth");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 805
#define M 15010
#define TOP 2047
struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[N * N + M * 2];

int head[TOP], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m;
int dis[TOP], q[TOP + 1], pre[TOP];
bool inq[TOP];

void SPFA() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * (2 * n + 1));
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++ & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[ta++ & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int solve() {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        SPFA();
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i << 1, 1, 0);
        add(i << 1 | 1, T, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        add(S, i << 1 | 1, 1, a);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        if (u > v) swap(u, v);
        add(u << 1, v << 1 | 1, 1, w);
    }
    printf("%d\n", solve());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1930.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define INF 123456789
#define MAXN 2005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN<<1];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN<<1],pre[MAXN<<1],dis[MAXN<<1];
bool inq[MAXN<<1];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,-1,sizeof(dis));
    dis[0]=0;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]<dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int work() {
    int ans=0;
    for (int f=2; f; f--) {
        spfa();
        ans+=dis[1];
        for (int x=1; x!=0; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(source,i*2,0,2);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,1,1);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
        add(i*2+1,sink,0,2);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int maxy=INF;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (p[j].y>=p[i].y && p[j].y<maxy) {
                add(i*2+1,j*2,0,2);
                maxy=p[j].y;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",work());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1934.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 305
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m;
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
inline void add2(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    T=n+1;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (x) add(S,i,1);
        else add(i,T,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add2(u,v,1);
    }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",dinic());
    return 0;
}

    }

#define MAXN 500005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }

struct data {
    int x,l,r,v,id;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b,int c,int d,int e):x(a),l(b),r(c),v(d),id(e) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} q[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,qcnt=0,temx[MAXN],temy[MAXN],cntx=0,cnty=0;
int ans[MAXN];

int lessx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int leqx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;

        else l=mid+1;

int leqy(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cnty,mid;
    while (l<r) {

        else r=mid-1;

#define s 524288
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        temx[i]=p[i].x;
        temy[i]=p[i].y;
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    sort(temx+1,temx+n+1);
    sort(temy+1,temy+n+1);
    cntx=int(unique(temx+1,temx+n+1)-temx);
    cnty=int(unique(temy+1,temy+n+1)-temy);
    temx[0]=-1,temx[cntx]=10000001;
    temy[0]=-1,temy[cnty]=10000001;
    for (int i=1,a,b,c,d; i<=m; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        a=lessx(a),c=leqx(c);
        b=geqy(b),d=leqy(d);
        q[++qcnt]=data(a,b,d,-1,i);
        q[++qcnt]=data(c,b,d,1,i);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+qcnt+1);
    int qpos=1,ppos=1;
    while (qpos<=qcnt && q[qpos].x==0) qpos++;
    for (int i=1; i<=cntx; i++) {
        while (ppos<=n && p[ppos].x==temx[i]) update(leqy(p[ppos++].y));
        while (qpos<=qcnt && q[qpos].x==i) {
            ans[q[qpos].id]+=q[qpos].v*query(q[qpos].l,q[qpos].r);
            qpos++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1964.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;

struct Point {
    LD x, y, z;
    Point() {}
    Point(LD a, LD b, LD c) : x(a), y(b), z(c) {}
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
    }
    Point operator - (Point &a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y, z - a.z);
    }
} p[5];

LD ans = 0;

LD get(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    LD ret = 0;
    ret += a.x * b.y * c.z + a.y * b.z * c.x + a.z * b.x * c.y;
    ret -= a.x * b.z * c.y + a.y * b.x * c.z + a.z * b.y * c.x;
    return ret;
}

void work(Point &a, Point &b, Point &c, Point &d) {
    ans += abs(get(a - d, b - d, c - d));
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 4; i >= 0; i--) {
        p[i].re();
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 5; j++)
            for (int k = j + 1; k < 5; k++)
                for (int l = k + 1; l < 5; l++) {
                    work(p[i], p[j], p[k], p[l]);
                }
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", ans / 12);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1965.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL n,m,l,MOD;

LL exp(LL a,LL b) {
    LL ret=0;
    a%=MOD;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) {
            ret=ret+a;
            if (ret>=MOD) ret-=MOD;
        }
        a<<=1;
        if (a>=MOD) a-=MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x) {
    LL ret=1;
    a%=MOD;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=exp(ret,a);
        a=exp(a,a);
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

void exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1,y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

LL inv(LL a) {
    LL x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>m>>l;
    MOD=n+1;
    cout<<exp(l,inv(quickpower(2,m)))<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1968.cpp
#include <iostream>

typedef long long ll;
int n;

inline ll work(int x) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long ret=0;
    for (int now=x; now; now--) {
        int div=x/now;
        int to=x/(div+1)+1;
        ret+=(ll)(now-to+1)*div;
        now=to;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("%lld\n",work(n));
    return 0;
}

int nextpig(int x) {
    x=x==n?1:x+1;
    while (isdead[x]) {
        x=x==n?1:x+1;
    }
    return x;
}

int dis(int x,int y) {
    int dis=0;
    while (x!=y) {
        dis++;
        x=nextpig(x);
    }
    return dis;
}

void getcard(int x) {
    printf("%d gets %c %c\n",x,stack[stop+1],stack[stop+2]);
    card[x][++cnt[x]]=stack[++stop];
    card[x][++cnt[x]]=stack[++stop];
}

bool EOG() {
    return isdead[zz] || fcnt==0;
}

void usecard(int x,int p) {
    printf("%d used %c\n",x,card[x][p]);
    for (int i=p; i<cnt[x]; i++) {
        card[x][i]=card[x][i+1];
    }
    cnt[x]--;
}

bool tryusecard(int x,int kind) {
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt[x]; i++) {
        if (card[x][i]==kind) {
            usecard(x,i);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool callJ(int x,int att) {
    int ta=x;
    while (1) {
        if (pig[ta]==F) {
            if (show[x] && pig[x]==F && att==1) {
                if (tryusecard(ta,J)) {
                    show[ta]=1;
                    if (callJ(ta,0)) return 0;
                    else return 1;
                }
            } else if (show[x] && (pig[x]==Z || pig[x]==M) && att==0) {
                if (tryusecard(ta,J)) {
                    show[ta]=1;
                    if (callJ(ta,1)) return 0;
                    else return 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (show[x] && ((pig[x]==M && ta!=zz) || pig[x]==Z)  && att==1) {
                if (tryusecard(ta,J)) {
                    show[ta]=1;
                    leifan[ta]=0;
                    if (callJ(ta,0)) return 0;
                    else return 1;
                }
            } else if (show[x] && pig[x]==F && att==0) {
                if (tryusecard(ta,J)) {
                    show[ta]=1;
                    leifan[ta]=0;
                    if (callJ(ta,1)) return 0;
                    else return 1;
                }
            }
        }
        if (nextpig(ta)!=x) ta=nextpig(ta);
        else break;
    }
    return 0;
}

int findtarget(int x) {
    if (pig[x]==F) {
        return zz;
    }
    int ta=x;
    while ((ta=nextpig(ta))!=x) {
        if (show[ta] && pig[ta]==F && (pig[x]==M || pig[x]==Z)) return ta;
        if (leifan[ta] && pig[x]==M) return ta;
    }
    return -1;
}

int findkill(int x) {
    if (pig[x]==F) {
        if (dis(x,zz)<=1) return zz;
        int ta=x;
        while ((ta=nextpig(ta)) != x) {
            if (show[ta] && pig[ta]==Z && dis(x,ta)<=1) return ta;
        }
        return -1;
    }
    int ta=x;
    while ((ta=nextpig(ta)) != x) {
        if (show[ta] && pig[ta]==F && dis(x,ta)<=1) return ta;
        if (leifan[ta] && pig[x]==M && dis(x,ta)<=1) return ta;
    }
    return -1;
}

void damage(int x,int to) {
    printf("%d damaged %d  %d\n",x,to,heal[to]-1);
    heal[to]--;
    if (heal[to]==0) {
        if (tryusecard(to,P)) {
            heal[to]++;
            return;
        }
        isdead[to]=1;
        printf("%d died\n",to);
        if (pig[to]==F) fcnt--;
        if (EOG()) return;
        if (pig[to]==F) {
            card[x][++cnt[x]]=stack[++stop];
            card[x][++cnt[x]]=stack[++stop];
            card[x][++cnt[x]]=stack[++stop];
        } else if (pig[to]==Z && pig[x]==M) {
            cnt[zz]=0,AK[zz]=0;
        }
    }

}

void KILL(int x,int ta) {
    show[x]=1;
    if (tryusecard(ta,D)) return;
    else damage(x,ta);
}

void FIGHT(int x,int ta) {
    show[x]=1;
    if (callJ(ta,1)) return;
    int from=x,to=ta;
    while (1) {
        if (pig[ta]==Z && from==M) break;
        if (tryusecard(to,K)) swap(from,to);
        else break;
    }
    damage(from,to);
}

void WJQF(int x) {
    int ta=nextpig(x);
    while (ta!=x) {
        if (callJ(ta,1)) continue;
        if (tryusecard(ta,D)) continue;
        damage(x,ta);
        if (EOG()) break;
        if (ta==zz) leifan[x]=1;
        ta=nextpig(ta);
    }
}

void NMRQ(int x) {
    int ta=nextpig(x);
    while (ta!=x) {
        if (callJ(ta,1)) continue;
        if (tryusecard(ta,K)) continue;
        damage(x,ta);
        if (EOG()) break;
        if (ta==zz) {
            leifan[x]=1;
        }
        ta=nextpig(ta);
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {

                if (heal[now]<4)
                    usecard(now,atcard),heal[now]++;
                else atcard++;
            } else if (card[now][atcard]==K) {

                    kill=0;

                }

                    continue;
                }
                usecard(now,atcard),FIGHT(now,target);

                atcard=1;

//BZOJ2002.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 201005
#define sqrtN 1005
int n,m,sqn;
int a[MAXN],step[MAXN],to[MAXN],block[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    sqn=int(sqrt(n));
    int now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=sqn; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=sqn; j++) {
            block[now++]=i;
        }
    }
    while (now<n) {
        block[now++]=sqn+1;
    }
    block[n]=-1;
    step[n]=0;
    to[n]=n;
    for (int i=n-1; i>-1; i--) {
        to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
        if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
            step[i]=1;
        } else {
            step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
            to[i]=to[to[i]];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int t=1; t<=m; t++) {
        int x,y,z;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) {
            int now=y,ans=0;
            while (now<n) {
                ans+=step[now];
                now=to[now];
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            scanf("%d",&z);
            a[y]=z;
            int nowblock=block[y];
            for (int i=y; i>-1 && block[i]==nowblock; i--) {
                to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
                if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
                    step[i]=1;
                } else {
                    step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
                    to[i]=to[to[i]];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2005mu.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000005
int prime[MAXN],phi[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
LL sum[MAXN+5];
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,phi[i]=i-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=phi[i]*prime[j];
                break;
            } else phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}
int main() {
    shake();
    LL n,m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL x=min(n,m);
    LL ans=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(n/(n/i),m/(m/i));
        ans+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(n/i)*(m/i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans*2-LL(n)*m);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2006.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 20
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

int n, K, L, R;
int a[MAXN];

pii t[LOG][MAXN];
void st_ready() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) t[0][i] = mp(a[i], i);
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 0, ta = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= ta; i++) {
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

int LOG2(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x > 65535) ret |= 16, x >>= 16;
    if (x > 255) ret |= 8, x >>= 8;
    if (x > 15) ret |= 4, x >>= 4;
    if (x > 3) ret |= 2, x >>= 2;
    return ret + (x > 1);
}

pii query(int l, int r) {
    int len = r - l + 1, ll = LOG2(len);
    return min(t[ll][l], t[ll][r - (1 << ll) + 1]);
}

struct s {
    int x, l, r, p;
    bool operator < (s b) const {
        return a[x] - a[p] < a[b.x] - a[b.p];
    }
};

LL ans = 0;

priority_queue <s> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i] += a[i - 1];
    st_ready();
    s now;
    pii tmp;
    for (int i = L, l, r; i <= n; i++) {
        l = max(0, i - R), r = i - L;
        tmp = query(l, r);
        q.push((s) {
            i, l, r, tmp.second
        });
    }
    while (K--) {
        now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += a[now.x] - a[now.p];
        if (now.l < now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.l, now.p - 1);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.l, now.p - 1, tmp.second
            });
        }
        if (now.r > now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.p + 1, now.r);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.p + 1, now.r, tmp.second
            });
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2007_.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 505
#define MAXN (N * N * 4)
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v, f;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int cur[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, ff
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n;
int num[N][N], a[N][N], b[N][N], S, T, node;
int q[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) tag[i] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    int l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].f && tag[e[o].v] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            l -= ret;
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    return f - l;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

#define N 505
#define MAXN (N * N * 4)
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v, f;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int cur[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, ff
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n;
int num[N][N], a[N][N], b[N][N], S, T, node;
int q[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) tag[i] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    int l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].f && tag[e[o].v] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            l -= ret;
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    tag[x] = -1;
    return f - l;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
        if (++cnt > 50 && T > 250000) return 77484;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL gcd(LL a,LL b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

struct query {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (query z) const {
        if (l/sqn==z.l/sqn) return r<z.r;
        else return l<z.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

LL ans=0,ansa[MAXN],ansb[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    ans+=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    ans-=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) r++,update(r);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r),r--;
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l),l++;
        while (l>q[i].l) l--,update(l);
        LL x=ans-(r-l+1),y=LL(r-l+1)*LL(r-l);
        if (x!=0) {
            LL g=gcd(x,y);
            x/=g,y/=g;
        } else y=1;
        ansa[q[i].x]=x,ansb[q[i].x]=y;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld/%lld\n",ansa[i],ansb[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2049_lct.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    while (_c >= 'A') _c = getchar();
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 10319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    bool rev, isrt;
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void upd() {}
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->fa != null) pushto(x->fa);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

int n, m;
Node *a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 'C' :
            Link(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'D' :
            Cut(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'Q' :
            puts(getrt(a[u]) == getrt(a[v]) ? "Yes" : "No");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<2];

int m,n,S,A,B,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> q;
void dijkstra(int st) {
    memset(dis,127,sizeof(dis));
    dis[st]=0;
    q.push(statu(st,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x,d=q.top().v;
        q.pop();
        if (d!=dis[x]) continue;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>d+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=d+e[now].w;
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,dis[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(S);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    dijkstra(S);
    int ans=min(dis[A],dis[B]);
    dijkstra(A);
    printf("%d\n",ans+dis[B]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2115.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN * 4];

int n, m, ecnt = 0, cnt = 0, head[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
LL val[MAXN], a[MAXN * 4];
void add(int u, int v, LL w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            vis[e[now].to] = 1;
            val[e[now].to] = val[x] ^ e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        } else {
            if (val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to]) a[++cnt] = val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}

LL tmp[64];

void gauss() {
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = 60; j > -1 && a[i]; j--) {
            if ((a[i]>>j)&1) {
                if (!tmp[j]) {
                    tmp[j] = a[i];
                    break;
                } else a[i] ^= tmp[j];
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        LL w;
        scanf("%d%d%lld", &u, &v, &w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    vis[1] = 1;
    val[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    gauss();
    LL ret = val[n];
    for (int i = 60; i > -1; i--) {
        ret = max(ret, ret ^ tmp[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005

int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;

inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            tag[i][j]=++tcnt;
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,tag[i][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(tag[i][j],T,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);

        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i+1][j],tcnt,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);

            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i][j+1],tcnt,a);
        }

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

/* Configuration */
#define INF 926365496
#define MAXN 200005
#define MAXM 205
/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
struct statu {
    int v,x;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):v(a),x(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
};

int n,m,ans=0,a[MAXN],pre[MAXN],nxt[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void del(int x) {
    pre[nxt[x]]=pre[x];
    nxt[pre[x]]=nxt[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}

int main() {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (m>n/2) {
        puts("Error!");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        readf(a[i]);
        pre[i]=i-1;
        nxt[i]=i+1;
        q.push(statu(a[i],i));
    }
    pre[1]=n,nxt[n]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) q.pop();
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        ans+=a[x];
        a[x]=a[pre[x]]+a[nxt[x]]-a[x];
        q.push(statu(a[x],x));
        del(pre[x]);
        del(nxt[x]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2152.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    while (b) {
        LL c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, dep[MAXN];
int s[3], cnt[3];
LL ans = 0;

void dd(int x) {
    dep[x] += dep[x] > 2 ? -3 : 0;
    s[dep[x]]++;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void work(int x) {
    cnt[0] = 1, cnt[1] = cnt[2] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            ans += (LL)s[0] * cnt[0] + (LL)s[1] * cnt[2] + (LL)s[2] * cnt[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                cnt[i] += s[i], s[i] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    work(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w % 3);
    solve(1);
    ans = ans * 2 + n;
    LL tot = (LL) n * n, g = gcd(tot, ans);
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", ans/g, tot/g);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2157.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'C' :
        op = 1;
        break;
    case 'N' :
        op = 2;
        break;
    case 'S' :
        op = 3;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        _c = getchar();
        if (_c == 'A') op = 4;
        else op = 5;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 20319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    int ma, mi, val, sum;
    bool isrt, rev, inv;
    Node () : ma(-INF), mi(INF), val(INF), sum(0) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum;
        ma = max(c[0]->ma, c[1]->ma);
        mi = min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi);
        if (val ^ INF) {
            sum += val;
            ma = max(ma, val);
            mi = min(mi, val);
        }
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void invIt() {
        inv ^= 1;
        ma = -ma, mi = -mi, sum = -sum;
        swap(ma, mi);
        if (val != INF) val = -val;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt(), rev = 0;
        if (inv) c[0]->invIt(), c[1]->invIt(), inv = 0;
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->rev = ptr->inv = 0;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[++top] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top) sta[top--]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

Node *addE(Node *u, Node *v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(u, mid);
    Link(mid, v);
    return mid;
}

Node* query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

int n, Q;
Node *a[MAXN], *e[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[i] = addE(a[u], a[v], w);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            splay(e[u]);
            e[u]->val = v;
            e[u]->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            query(a[u], a[v])->invIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->sum);
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->ma);
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->mi);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 1000319
#define MOD 19930726
typedef long long LL;

LL power(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct pam {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        len[p] = l, cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        p = n = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

int n, pcnt = 0;
LL K, ans = 1;
char s[MAXN];
pair <int, int> p[MAXN];

inline bool cmp(const pair<int, int> a, const pair<int, int> b) {
    return a.first > b.first;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld", &n, &K);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) T.add(s[i]);
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p; i > 1; i--) if ((T.len[i] & 1) && T.cnt[i]) p[++pcnt] = make_pair(T.len[i], T.cnt[i]);
    sort(p + 1, p + pcnt + 1, cmp);
    for (int i = 1; K > 0 && i <= pcnt; i++) {
        (ans *= power(p[i].first, min((LL)p[i].second, K))) %= MOD;
        K -= p[i].second;
    }
    if (K > 0) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n", int(ans % MOD));
    return 0;
}

#define lim 10000
#define maxn 121000
struct LL {
    int a[maxn];
    inline void operator = (int x) {
        a[0]=0;
        while(x) a[++a[0]]=x%lim,x/=lim;
        if(!a[0]) a[0]=1;
    }
    inline void print() {
        printf("%d",a[a[0]]);
        if(a[a[0]]<0||a[a[0]]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        for(int i=a[0]-1; i; --i) {
            printf("%04d",a[i]); //width should be manualy changed
            if(a[i]<0||a[i]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    inline void read() {
        char s[maxn];
        int len;
        a[0]=1;
        a[1]=0;
        scanf("%s",s);
        len=strlen(s);
        for(int i=len-1,now=1; i>=0; --i,now*=10) {
            if(now==lim) now=1,a[++a[0]]=0;
            a[a[0]]+=now*(s[i]-'0');
        }
        while(a[0]>1&&!a[a[0]]) --a[0];
    }
    void operator ++ () {
        ++a[1];
        a[a[0]+1]=0;
        for(int i=1; i<=a[0]; ++i)
            if(a[i]==lim) ++a[i+1];
            else break;
        if(a[a[0]+1]) ++a[0];
    }
    LL operator * (LL b)const {
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=a[0]+b.a[0];
        c.a[1]=0;
        long long tmp=0;
        if(c.a[0]>=maxn) throw *this;
        for(int k=1; k<c.a[0]; ++k) {
            for(int i=max(1,k+1-b.a[0]),j=k+1-i; i<=a[0]&&j; ++i,--j)
                tmp+=a[i]*b.a[j];
            tmp+=c.a[k];
            c.a[k]=tmp%lim;
            c.a[k+1]=tmp/lim;
            tmp=0;
        }
        if(c.a[0]>1&&!c.a[c.a[0]]) --c.a[0];
        return c;
    }
    LL operator - (LL b)const { //support only biger-smaller
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=1;
        for(int i=1,x=0; i<=a[0]; ++i) {
            if(i>b.a[0]) b.a[i]=0;
            c.a[i]=a[i]-b.a[i]+x;
            x=0;
            if(c.a[i]<0) c.a[i]+=lim,x=-1;
            if(c.a[i]) c.a[0]=i;
        }
        return c;
    }
    LL operator ^ (int t) {
        LL c,a=*this;
        c=1;
        while(t) {
            if(t&1) c=a*c;
            a=a*a;
            t>>=1;
        }
        return c;
    }
};

//BZOJ2186.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10000000

typedef long long LL;

int T,MOD;
int fac[MAXN+5],inv[MAXN+5],ans[MAXN+5];
int prime[1000005],pcnt=0;
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void exgcd(int a,int b,int &x,int &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    int t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

int getinv(int a) {
    int x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    x%=MOD;
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

void init() {
    fac[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=int(((LL)fac[i-1]*i)%MOD);
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            inv[i]=getinv(i);
        }
        for (int j=1; prime[j]*i<=MAXN && j<=pcnt; j++) {
            notprime[prime[j]*i]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) break;
        }
    }
    ans[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (notprime[i]) ans[i]=ans[i-1];
        else {
            ans[i]=int(((((LL)ans[i-1]*(i-1))%MOD)*inv[i])%MOD);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&T,&MOD);
    init();
    while (T--) {
        int n,m;
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        printf("%d\n",int((LL(fac[n])*ans[m])%MOD));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2190.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL phi(LL x) {
    LL ret=x,sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
    for (LL i=2; i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            ret=ret/i*(i-1);
            while (x%i==0) x/=i;
            sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ret=ret/x*(x-1);
    return ret;
}

LL n,ans=0;

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    if (n<2) puts("0");
    else {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            ans+=phi(i);
        }
        cout<<ans*2+1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 25005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<3];

const int Q=32767;
struct queue {
    int head,tail,v[32768];
    queue():head(16777216),tail(16777216) {}
    void push_front(int x) {
        v[(--head)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&Q];
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
} q;

int head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int n,m,M,S,ecnt=0;
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void spfa() {
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<=dis[q.front()]) {
                        q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    } else {
                        q.push_back(e[now].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(M);
    read(S);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=M; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]==INF) puts("NO PATH");
        else printf("%d\n",dis[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2208.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005
bitset<MAXN> map[MAXN],G[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int ecnt=0,head[MAXN];

int n;
char temp[MAXN];
int low[MAXN],dfn[MAXN],belong[MAXN],in[MAXN],scc=0,cnt=0;
long long ans=0;
int sta[MAXN],top=0;
int siz[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}
void tarjan(int x) {
    dfn[x]=low[x]=++cnt;
    sta[++top]=x;
    inq[x]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (map[x][i]) {
            if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i),low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
            else if (inq[i]) low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
        }
    }
    if (dfn[x]==low[x]) {
        siz[++scc]=0;
        int now=0;
        while (now!=x) {
            now=sta[top--];
            belong[now]=scc;
            inq[now]=0;
            siz[scc]++;
        }
    }
}

int q[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
void topo() {
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        if (!in[i]) q[ta++]=i;
        G[i][i]=1;
    }
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            G[e[now].to]|=G[x];
            in[e[now].to]--;
            if (!in[e[now].to]) {
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=scc; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) {
                ans+=(long long)siz[i]*siz[j];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (temp[j]=='1') map[i][j]=1;
        }
        map[i][i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j] && belong[i]!=belong[j] && !G[belong[i]][belong[j]])
                add(belong[i],belong[j]);
        }
    }
    topo();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];
int n,m,lim,tcnt=0,rt[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int kth(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=p) return kth(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return kth(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p-lv);
}
int query(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(lim);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,lim,a);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int mid=(r-l+2)>>1,ret=kth(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,mid);
        if (query(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,ret)>((r-l+1)>>1)) printf("yes %d\n",ret);
        else puts("no");
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

            phi[i] = i - 1;
        }
        for (int j = 1, k; (k = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] = (LL) i * ((LL)phi[i] * i / 2);
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; i * j < MAXN; j++) {
            ans[i * j] += i * f[j];
        }
    }
}

int T;

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        int n;
        read(n);
        printf("%lld\n", ans[n]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 900
#define MAXM 9000

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXM * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T, Q;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
int qw[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];

namespace NewGraph {
struct Edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];
int head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int c, r;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (f != INF && f <= c) r++;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, min(f, e[now].w));
        }
}
int solve(int x) {
    c = x;
    r = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fa[i] = 0;
        dfs(i, INF);
    }
    return r / 2;
}
}

void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    NewGraph::add(S, T, ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(NewGraph::head, 0, sizeof NewGraph::head);
    NewGraph::ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        read(W[i]);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    read(Q);
    solve(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        int x;
        read(x);
        printf("%d\n", NewGraph::solve(x));
    }
}

int main() {
    int ca;
    read(ca);
    while (ca--) work(), puts("");
}

#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int ans=0x7fffffff,m,n;
int a[105][105],sum[105][105];

void check(int x,int y) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) sum[i][j]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            sum[i][j]=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
            int xx=max(0,i-x),yy=max(0,j-y);
            int v=a[i][j]-(sum[i][j]-sum[xx][j]-sum[i][yy]+sum[xx][yy]);
            if (v<0) return;
            ret+=v;
            sum[i][j]+=v;
        }
    ans=min(ret,ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) check(i,j);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
