typedef long long LL;

int ch=0;
inline bool read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch==-1) return 0;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return 1;
}
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x,LL MOD) {
    a%=MOD;
    LL ans=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ans=(ans*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

LL exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (!b) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return a;
    }
    LL g=exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
    return g;
}

void solve2(LL a,LL z,LL p) {
    LL x,y;
    // solve ax - py == Z (mod P)
    LL g=exgcd(a,-p,x,y);
    if (z%g!=0) puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
    else {
        x=(x*(z/g))%p;
        if (x<0) printf("%lld\n",x+p);
        else printf("%lld\n",x);
    }
}

map<LL,LL> Hash;

void solve3(LL y,LL z,LL p) {
    // solve y^x==z -> y ^ (km + i) == z
    y%=p;
    if (z==1) {
        puts("0");
        return;
    }
    if (y==0) {
        if (z==0) puts("1");
        else puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
        return;
    }
    LL m=(LL)sqrt(p)+1;
    Hash.clear();
    Hash[1]=-1;
    for (LL i=1,t=1; i<m; i++) {
        t=(t*y)%p;
        if (!Hash[t]) Hash[t]=i;
    }
    LL temp=quickpower(y,p-m-1,p),ine=1;
    for (LL k=0; k<m; k++) {
        LL x=Hash[(z*ine)%p];
        if (x) {
            if (x==-1) x=0;
            printf("%lld\n",k*m+x);
            return;
        }
        ine=(ine*temp)%p;
    }
    puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
}

int main() {
    int T;
    while (scanf("%d",&T)!=EOF) {
        LL y,z,p;
        int k;
        scanf("%d",&k);
        while (T--) {
            scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&y,&z,&p);
            if (k==1) {
                printf("%lld\n",quickpower(y,z,p));
            } else if (k==2) {
                solve2(y,z,p);
            } else {
                solve3(y,z,p);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 256
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*64];

int m,n,S=0,T=1,ecnt=1;
int L[MAXN],t[MAXN][MAXN],W[MAXN][MAXN],dis[MAXN*2],head[MAXN*2],pre[MAXN*2],pos[MAXN*2];
#define task(i) (i+1)
#define worker(i) (i+n+1)
bool inq[MAXN*2];
void add(int u,int v,int flow,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,C; i<=n; i++) read(C),add(task(i),T,C,0);;
    for (int i=1,A; i<=m; i++) for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(A);
            if (A) add(worker(i),task(j),INF,0);
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(L[i]);
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) read(t[i][j]);
        for (int j=0; j<=L[i]; j++) read(W[i][j]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) {
            add(S,worker(i),t[i][j]-t[i][j-1],W[i][j]);
        }
        add(S,worker(i),INF,W[i][L[i]]);
    }
}
queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    memset(pos,0,sizeof(pos));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pos[T]>0;
}

void work() {
    LL ans=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int Minflow=INF;
        for (int x=1; x; x=pre[x]) {
            Minflow=min(Minflow,e[pos[x]].flow);
        }
        ans+=LL(Minflow)*dis[T];
        for (int x=T; x; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow-=Minflow;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow+=Minflow;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000005

    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    if (a[1]+1>=n) {
        printf("%d\n",a[1]+1-n);
        return 0;
    }
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=dis[a[1]+2]=0;
    visit[1]=1;

    while (head<tail) {
        int x=q[head++];

        visit[x]=1;
        if (a[x]+x>=n) {

        } else {
            ans=min(ans,dis[x]+n-a[x]-x);
            if (!visit[a[x]+x+1]) q[--head]=a[x]+x+1,dis[a[x]+x+1]=dis[x];
        }

        if (x<n && !visit[x+1] && dis[x+1]>dis[x]+1) q[tail++]=x+1,dis[x+1]=dis[x]+1;

//BZOJ2282.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,s,ecnt=0;
int dis[MAXN],fa[MAXN],head[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
int visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

inline int bfs(int st) {
    fa[st]=st;
    dis[st]=0;
    int he=1,ta=2;
    q[1]=st;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                fa[v]=x;
                dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                q[ta++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
    int d=0,t=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]>d) {
            d=dis[i];
            t=i;
        }
    }
    return t;
}

struct statu {
    int val,tag;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):val(a),tag(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return val<a.val;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> fnt,back,on;
int minans=0x7fffffff;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(s);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    int root=bfs(1);
    int x=bfs(root),tag=0;
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        visit[i]=++tag;
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    for (int i=n; i>1; i--) {
        if (!visit[q[i]]) {
            ans[fa[q[i]]]=max(ans[fa[q[i]]],ans[q[i]]+dis[q[i]]-dis[fa[q[i]]]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        back.push(statu(ans[i]-dis[i],visit[i]));
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    int i=x,j=x;
    on.push(statu(ans[x],visit[x]));
    while (j!=root) {
        while (j!=root && dis[i]-dis[fa[j]]<=s) {
            j=fa[j];
            on.push(statu(ans[j],visit[j]));
        }
        //push back
        while (!back.empty() && back.top().tag<=visit[j]) back.pop();
        //push on
        while (!on.empty() && on.top().tag<visit[i]) on.pop();
        int nowans=on.top().val;
        if (!back.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,back.top().val+dis[j]);
        if (!fnt.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,fnt.top().val-dis[i]);
        minans=min(minans,nowans);
        fnt.push(statu(ans[i]+dis[i],visit[i]));
        i=fa[i];
    }
    printf("%d\n",minans);
    return 0;
}

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';

    }

#define MAXN 250005
#define LOG 20
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int n, m;
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], dep[MAXN], rev[MAXN], stp = 0;
int q[MAXN * 2], tot = 0, Log[MAXN * 2], st[LOG][MAXN * 2], fir[MAXN];
int fa[LOG][MAXN], Min[LOG][MAXN];

inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return dep[x] < dep[y] ? x : y;
}

inline void init() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) st[0][i] = q[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = tot - (x << 1) + 1;  i <= j; i++) {
            st[k][i] = cmp(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

inline int LCA(int x, int y) {
    x = fir[x], y = fir[y];
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return cmp(st[Log[y - x + 1]][x], st[Log[y - x + 1]][y - (1 << Log[y - x + 1]) + 1]);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++stp;
    rev[stp] = x;
    q[++tot] = x;
    fir[x] = tot;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) {
        fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
        Min[i][x] = min(Min[i - 1][x], Min[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[0][x]) {
            fa[0][e[now].to] = x;
            Min[0][e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            q[++tot] = x;
        }
    }
    R[x] = stp;
}

LL MinE(int x, int y) {
    int d = dep[x] - dep[y], ret = INF;
    for (int i = 0; d; i++, d >>= 1) {
        if (d & 1) {
            ret = min(ret, Min[i][x]);
            x = fa[i][x];
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int K;
int a[MAXN], sta[MAXN], g[MAXN];
LL f[MAXN];

void solve() {
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= K; i++) read(x), a[i] = L[x];
    sort(a + 1, a + K + 1);
    int top = 0;
    sta[++top] = 1, f[top] = g[top] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        int x = rev[a[i]], lca = LCA(sta[top], x);
        while (dep[sta[top]] > dep[lca]) {
            if (dep[sta[top - 1]] <= dep[lca]) {
                int tmp = (int)min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], MinE(sta[top], lca));
                top--;
                if (lca != sta[top]) {
                    sta[++top] = lca;
                    f[top] = g[top] = 0;
                }
                f[top] += tmp;
                break;
            } else {
                f[top - 1] += min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], MinE(sta[top], sta[top - 1]));
                top--;
            }
        }
        if (sta[top] != x) sta[++top] = x, f[top] = 0;
        g[top] = 1;
    }
    while (top > 1) {
        f[top - 1] += min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], MinE(sta[top], sta[top - 1]));
        top--;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[1]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u, w
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(1);
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) solve();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};
int n,zcnt=0,cnt=0,m,ans=0;
int a[MAXN],next[MAXN],prev[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void del(int x) {
    prev[next[x]]=prev[x];
    next[prev[x]]=next[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}
priority_queue<statu> q;
void work() {
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        q.push(statu(i,abs(a[i])));
    }
    for (int i=zcnt; i>m; i--) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) {
            q.pop();
        }
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        a[x]=a[prev[x]]+a[next[x]]+a[x];
        del(prev[x]);
        del(next[x]);
        q.push(statu(x,abs(a[x])));
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (!visit[i] && a[i]>0) ans+=a[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(a[2]);
    cnt=2;
    prev[2]=1;
    next[2]=3;
    if (a[2]>0) zcnt=1;
    for (int i=2,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (abs(a[cnt])+abs(x)==abs(a[cnt]+x)) {
            a[cnt]+=x;
            continue;
        }
        a[++cnt]=x;
        if (a[cnt]>0) zcnt++;
        prev[cnt]=cnt-1;
        next[cnt]=cnt+1;
    }
    if (a[2]<=0) a[2]=-1000000001;
    prev[1]=0;
    next[1]=2;
    prev[0]=0;
    next[0]=1;
    if (a[cnt]<=0) a[cnt]=-1000000001;
    a[0]=a[1]=a[cnt+1]=a[cnt+2]=-1000000001;
    prev[cnt+1]=cnt;
    prev[cnt+2]=cnt+1;
    next[cnt+1]=cnt+2;
    next[cnt+2]=cnt+2;
    work();
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2289ac.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cmath>
#include<cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef double ld;
const ld _0=1e-6l;
const int N=100010;
int n;
ld x[N],y[N],r[N];
ld L,R;
int read() {
    int x=0,c=getchar(),f=1;
    while(c>57||c<48) {
        if(c=='-')f=-1;
        c=getchar();
    }
    while(c>47&&c<58)x=x*10+c-48,c=getchar();
    return x*f;
}
void get(int id,ld X,ld&a,ld&b) {
    X-=x[id];
    X=sqrt(r[id]*r[id]-X*X);
    a=y[id]-X;
    b=y[id]+X;
}
bool chk(ld X,int a,int b) {
    if(fabs(X-x[a])>r[a]||fabs(X-x[b])>r[b])return 0;
    ld a1,a2,b1,b2;
    get(a,X,a1,a2);
    get(b,X,b1,b2);
    return a2>b1&&a1<b2;
}
void chk(int a,int b) {
    ld xd=x[b]-x[a],yd=y[b]-y[a];
    ld d=sqrt(xd*xd+yd*yd);
    if(d+_0>r[a]+r[b]) {
        puts("NO");
        exit(0);
    }
    ld s=(r[a]+r[b]+d)/2.;
    ld h=2*sqrt(s*(s-r[a])*(s-r[b])*(s-d))/d;
    ld m=x[a]+xd*sqrt(r[a]*r[a]-h*h)/d,c=h*fabs(yd)/d;
    if(d*d+r[a]*r[a]<r[b]*r[b])m=x[a]*2-m;
    ld lx=m-c,rx=m+c;
    if(lx>x[a]-r[a]&&chk(x[a]-r[a]+_0,a,b))lx=x[a]-r[a];
    if(lx>x[b]-r[b]&&chk(x[b]-r[b]+_0,a,b))lx=x[b]-r[b];
    if(rx<x[a]+r[a]&&chk(x[a]+r[a]-_0,a,b))rx=x[a]+r[a];
    if(rx<x[b]+r[b]&&chk(x[b]+r[b]-_0,a,b))rx=x[b]+r[b];
    if(lx>L)L=lx;
    if(rx<R)R=rx;
}
int main() {
    n=read();
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        x[i]=read();
        y[i]=read();
        r[i]=read();
    }
    L=x[0]-r[0],R=x[0]+r[0];
    for(int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        if(L<x[i]-r[i])L=x[i]-r[i];
        if(R>x[i]+r[i])R=x[i]+r[i];
    }
    while(1) {
        if(L+_0>R) {
            puts("NO");
            return 0;
        }
        ld M=(L+R)/2.;
        ld y1,y2,a1,a2;
        get(0,M,y1,y2);
        for(int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            get(i,M,a1,a2);
            if(a1>y1)y1=a1;
            if(a2<y2)y2=a2;
            if(y1+_0>y2) {
                for(int j=0; j<i; j++) {
                    get(j,M,y1,y2);
                    if(y1>=a2-_0||y2<=a1+_0) {
                        chk(i,j);
                        goto re;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        puts("YES");
        return 0;
re:
        ;
    }
}

//BZOJ2289.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define N 100005
#define eps 1e-6
int n;
LD xx[N], yy[N], rr[N], mi = -1e15, ma = 1e15;

struct Point {
    LD x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point rev() {
        return Point(y, -x);
    }
    Point operator * (LD a) {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (LD a) {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
};

#define power(x) ((x) * (x))
#define sign(x) (x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0))
LD dist(int a, int b) {
    return sqrt(power(xx[a] - xx[b]) + power(yy[a] - yy[b]));
}
#define R rr[a]
#define r rr[b]
int intersec(LD mid, int a, int b) {
    LD d = dist(a, b);
    if (!sign(d)) return 0;
    if (R + r >= d) return 2;
    LD x = (power(R) - power(r) + power(d)) / (2 * d), y = sqrt(power(R) - power(x));
    Point st(xx[a], yy[a]), gox(xx[b] - xx[a], yy[b] - yy[a]), goy = gox.rev();
    gox = gox * (x / d);
    goy = goy * (y / d);
    Point A = st + gox + goy, B = st + gox - goy;
    if (sign(A.x - mid) == sign(B.x - mid)) return sign(A.x - mid) ? sign(A.x - mid) : 2;
    return 2;
}
#undef r
#undef R

int check(LD mid) {
    LD b = -1e15, t = 1e15;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LD a = sqrt(power(rr[i]) - power(mid - xx[i]));
        LD bot = yy[i] - a, top = yy[i] + a;
        if (bot > t - eps || top - eps < b) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                LD a_ = sqrt(power(rr[j]) - power(mid - xx[j]));
                LD bot_ = yy[j] - a_, top_ = yy[j] + a_;
                if (bot_ >= top || bot >= top_) return intersec(mid, i, j);
            }
        }
        t = min(top, t);
        b = max(bot, b);
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(xx[i]), read(yy[i]), read(rr[i]);
        mi = max(mi, xx[i] - rr[i]);
        ma = min(ma, xx[i] + rr[i]);
    }
    bool Yes = 0;
    while (ma - mi > eps) {
        LD mid = (ma + mi) / 2;
        int ret = check(mid);
        if (ret == 0) {
            Yes = 1;
            break;
        } else if (ret == -1) ma = mid;
        else if (ret == 1) mi = mid;
        else break;
    }
    puts(Yes ? "YES" : "NO");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2301.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 50005
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n;
int prime[MAXN/5],mu[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
LL sum[MAXN+5];
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=mu[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) mu[i]=-1,prime[++pcnt]=i;
        for (int j=1; i*prime[j]<=MAXN && j<=pcnt; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                mu[i*prime[j]]=0;
                break;
            } else mu[i*prime[j]]=-mu[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+mu[i];
    }
}

LL work(int a,int b) {
    int x=min(a,b);
    LL ret=0;
    for (int i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(a/(a/i),b/(b/i));
        ret+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(a/i)*(b/i);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    shake();
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,a,b,c,d,k; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        read(k);
        a--;
        c--;
        a/=k;
        b/=k;
        c/=k;
        d/=k;
        printf("%lld\n",work(b,d)-work(a,d)-work(b,c)+work(a,c));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2314ac.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#define M 500500
#define MOD 1032992941
using namespace std;
struct abcd {
    int to,next;
} table[M<<1];
int n,fa[M];
long long f[M],g[M],h[M];
long long F[M],G[M],H[M];
//f-\D7?\BA?\D4\F1 g-\B1\BB\D7??\E3?\C5\E4 h-\B7\C5\D6\C3play
int head[M],tot;
void Add(int x,int y) {
    table[++tot].to=y;
    table[tot].next=head[x];
    head[x]=tot;
}
void Tree_DP(int x) {
    int i;
    f[x]=1;
    g[x]=0x3f3f3f3f;
    h[x]=0;
    F[x]=G[x]=H[x]=1;
    for(i=head[x]; i; i=table[i].next) {
        if(table[i].to==fa[x])
            continue;
        fa[table[i].to]=x;
        Tree_DP(table[i].to);

        {
            long long min_sta=min(min(f[table[i].to],g[table[i].to]),h[table[i].to]);
            long long ans=0;
            if(f[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=F[table[i].to];
            if(g[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=G[table[i].to];
            if(h[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=H[table[i].to];
            f[x]+=min_sta;
            F[x]=(ans*F[x])%MOD;
        }

        {
            long long min_sta=min(min(g[x]+f[table[i].to],g[x]+g[table[i].to]),h[x]+f[table[i].to]);
            long long ans=0;
            if(g[x]+f[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=(G[x]*F[table[i].to])%MOD;
            if(g[x]+g[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=(G[x]*G[table[i].to])%MOD;
            if(h[x]+f[table[i].to]==min_sta)
                ans+=(H[x]*F[table[i].to])%MOD;
            g[x]=min_sta;
            G[x]=ans%MOD;
        }

        {
            h[x]+=g[table[i].to];
            H[x]=(H[x]*G[table[i].to])%MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d :  %lld %lld %lld\n",x,f[x],g[x],h[x]);
}
int main() {
    int i,x,y;
    cin>>n;
    for(i=1; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        Add(x,y);
        Add(y,x);
    }
    Tree_DP(1);
    cout<<min(f[1],g[1])<<endl;
    cout<<( (f[1]==g[1]) ? ((F[1]+G[1])%MOD) : (f[1]<g[1]?F[1]:G[1]) )<<endl;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

using namespace std;
#define MAXN 500005
#define MOD 1032992941
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
typedef long long LL;
int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL cnt[MAXN][3],dp[MAXN][3];
// 0 - son 1 - self 2 - fa
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
#define v e[now].to
void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    dp[x][0]=0;
    cnt[x][0]=1;
    dp[x][1]=1;
    cnt[x][1]=1;
    dp[x][2]=0x3f3f3f3f;
    cnt[x][2]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            LL minans=min(min(dp[v][0],dp[v][1]),dp[v][2]),sum=0;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++) if (dp[v][i]==minans) sum+=cnt[v][i];
            dp[x][1]+=minans;
            cnt[x][1]=(cnt[x][1]*sum)%MOD;
            minans=min(min(dp[x][2]+dp[v][1],dp[x][2]+dp[v][2]),dp[x][0]+dp[v][1]);
            sum=0;
            if (dp[x][2]+dp[v][1]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][2]*cnt[v][1])%MOD;
            if (dp[x][2]+dp[v][2]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][2]*cnt[v][2])%MOD;
            if (dp[x][0]+dp[v][1]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][0]*cnt[v][1])%MOD;
            dp[x][2]=minans;
            cnt[x][2]=sum%MOD;
            dp[x][0]+=dp[v][2];
            cnt[x][0]=(cnt[x][0]*cnt[v][2])%MOD;
        }
    }
}
#undef v

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    dfs(1,1);
    printf("%lld\n",min(dp[1][2],dp[1][1]));
    if (dp[1][2]<dp[1][1]) printf("%lld\n",cnt[1][2]%MOD);
    else if (dp[1][2]>dp[1][1]) printf("%lld\n",cnt[1][1]%MOD);
    else printf("%lld\n",(cnt[1][2]+cnt[1][1])%MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2326.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
LL temp[3][3],n,MOD;
void mul(LL a[3][3],LL b[3][3],LL c[3][3]) {
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<3; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            c[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

LL a[3][3],b[3][3];

void work(LL t,LL to) {
    memset(b,0,sizeof(b));
    b[0][0]=t%MOD;
    b[1][0]=1;
    b[2][0]=1;
    b[1][1]=1;
    b[2][1]=1;
    b[2][2]=1;
    LL y=to-t/10+1;
    while (y) {
        if (y&1) mul(a,b,a);
        mul(b,b,b);
        y>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>MOD;
    LL t=10;
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++) a[i][i]=1;
    while (n>=t) {
        work(t,t-1);
        t=t*10;
    }
    work(t,n);
    cout<<a[2][0]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2330.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 100005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
#define MOD 262143
int q[262144],h=0,t=0;

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int cnt[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
bool spfa() {
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[(h++)&MOD];
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if ((cnt[e[now].to]++)>n) return 1;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q[(t++)&MOD]=e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,a,b; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        if (x==1) {
            add(a,b,0);
            add(b,a,0);
        } else if (x==2) {
            if (a==b) {
                puts("-1");
                return 0;
            }
            add(a,b,1);
        } else if (x==3) {
            add(b,a,0);
        } else if (x==4) {
            if (a==b) {
                puts("-1");
                return 0;
            }
            add(b,a,1);
        } else {
            add(a,b,0);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        q[t]=i;
        t++;
        dis[i]=1;
        inq[i]=1;
    }
    if (spfa()) puts("-1");
    else {
        long long ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            ans+=dis[i];
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2342.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
typedef long long LL;

const LL P1 = 19260817, MOD1 = 999999319, P2 = 120180241, MOD2 = 2147483647;
LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash (LL a = 0, LL b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    inline Hash operator + (register char a) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + a) % MOD1, (y * P2 + a) % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator * (register int len) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[len] % MOD1, y * X2[len] % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator - (register Hash a) const {
        return Hash(x < a.x ? x - a.x + MOD1 : x - a.x, y < a.y ? y - a.y + MOD2 : y - a.y);
    }
    inline bool operator == (register Hash a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], rev[MAXN];

inline Hash get(register int l, register int r) {
    return a[r] - a[l] * (r - l);
}

inline Hash revget(register int l, register int r) {
    return rev[l] - rev[r] * (r - l);
}

int n, R[MAXN], ans = 0;
char ss[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(register int u, register int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

#define s 524288

int t[s * 2];

inline void update(register int x) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
}
inline int find(register int x) {
    while (x < s) {
        x <<= 1;
        if (t[x ^ 1]) x ^= 1;
    }
    return x - s;
}
inline int query(register int l, register int r) {
    static int sta[23];
    register int top = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l & 1) sta[top++] = l ^ 1;
        if (r & 1) if (t[r ^ 1]) return find(r ^ 1);
    }
    while (top--) if (t[sta[top]]) return find(sta[top]);
    return -1;
}

vector <int> G[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d\n%s", &n, ss + 1);
    init();
    register int i, l, r, mid, now;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = n; i; i--) rev[i] = rev[i + 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        l = 0, r = (i << 1) > n ? n - i : i;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (get(i - mid, i) == revget(i + 1, i + mid + 1)) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        R[i] = l;
        add(i - l, i);
    }
    for (now = head[0]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
        if (R[i] > 1) ans = max(ans, query(i, i + R[i] / 2) - i);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans * 4);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2351.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    _c = getchar();
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
int getNxt() {
    _c = getchar();
    while (_c != '0' && _c != '1') _c = getchar();
    return _c == '1' ? 920009 : 108161;
}

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define P 19260817
#define MOD 2147483647
#define MAXN 1005
int m, n, a, b;

LL h[MAXN][MAXN];
map <LL, bool> vis;

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(a);
    read(b);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            h[i][j] = (h[i][j - 1]  * P + getNxt()) % MOD;
        }
    }
    LL Pa = 1, Pb = 1, Pab = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) Pa = (Pa * P) % MOD;
    for (int i = 1; i <= b; i++) Pb = (Pb * P) % MOD, Pab = (Pab * Pa) % MOD;
    for (int j = b; j <= n; j++) {
        LL now = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < a; i++) {
            now = (now * Pb + h[i][j] - h[i][j - b] * Pb) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = a; i <= m; i++) {
            now = (now * Pb + (h[i][j] - h[i][j - b] * Pb) % MOD - ((h[i - a][j] - h[i - a][j - b] * Pb) % MOD) * Pab) % MOD;
            now += now < 0 ? MOD : 0;
            vis[now] = 1;
        }
    }
    int q;
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= q; i++) {
        LL now = 0;
        for (int j = a * b; j; j--) now = (now * P + getNxt()) % MOD;
        putchar(vis[now] + '0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
    return 0;
}

#define N 1010

int n;
void mul(int a[], int b[N][N]) {
    static int c[N];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            c[j] += a[i] * b[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = c[i], c[i] = 0;
}

//BZOJ2407.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 40005
#define MAXM 200005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define S 65536
struct Edge {
    int u, v, w, z;
} E[MAXM];
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
};

int t[S * 2], dis[MAXN], p[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
void update(int x, int v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m;

struct Graph {
    edge e[MAXM * 2];
    int head[MAXN], ecnt;
    Graph () {
        ecnt = 1;
    }
    inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    void dijkstra() {
        memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
        memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
        update(1, 0);
        for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
            dis[x] = t[x + S];
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(x, INF);
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + S] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                    update(e[now].to, dis[x] + e[now].w);
                    p[e[now].to] = x == 1 ? (now >> 1) : p[x];
                }
            }
        }
    }
} G1, G2;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].w);
        read(E[i].z);
        if (E[i].v == 1) swap(E[i].u, E[i].v), swap(E[i].w, E[i].z);
        G1.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
        G1.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
    }
    G1.dijkstra();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (E[i].u == 1) {
            if (p[E[i].v] != i) {
                G2.add(1, n + 1, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, E[i].w);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].v, n + 1, E[i].z);
            }
        } else {
            if (p[E[i].u] != p[E[i].v]) {
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, dis[E[i].u] + E[i].w);
                G2.add(1, E[i].u, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
                G2.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
            }
        }
    }
    G2.dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n", dis[n + 1]);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

int ch = 0;
inline bool read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        else if (ch == EOF) return 0;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
    return 1;
}

inline void read(double &a) {
    bool f = 0, p = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        else if (ch == '.') p = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (!p) while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
            ch = getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') p = 1, ch = getchar();
    if (p) {
        double x = 0.1;
        while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a += x * (ch - '0');
            x *= 0.1, ch = getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const double eps = 1e-7;

#define MAXN 205

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m;
double G[MAXN][MAXN];

void buildEquation() {
    for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
        for (int v = 1; v <= n; v++) {
            if (G[u][v] > eps) {
                a[u][v] += G[u][v];
                a[u][u] -= G[u][v];
            }
        }
    }
    a[1][0] = -1.0;
    a[n][0] = 1.0;
}

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    for (int i = now; i <= n; i++) if (abs(a[i][0]) > eps) return 0;
    return 1;
}

void clear() {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    memset(G, 0, sizeof G);
}

int main() {
    while (read(n) && read(m)) {
        clear();
        for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
            double R;
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(R);
            if (u != v) G[u][v] = G[v][u] = G[v][u] + 1.0 / R;
        }
        buildEquation();
        gauss();
        printf("%.2lf\n", abs(a[1][0] - a[n][0]));
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXM 50319
#define MAXN 55

int m, B, H, n, sum = 0, ans = 0x7fffffff, tag;
int a[MAXM], h[MAXN], C[MAXN][MAXM];

pair<int, int> v[MAXM];

void work(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) v[i] = make_pair(C[x][i] - C[0][i], i);
    sort(v + 1, v + m + 1);
    int ss = H + h[x], left = sum;
    for (int i = 1; left && i <= m; i++) {
        int use = min(left, a[v[i].second]);
        ss += v[i].first * use;
        left -= use;
    }
    if (ans > ss) {
        ans = ss;
        tag = x;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(B);
    read(H);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(a[i]), sum += a[i];
    sum -= B;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(C[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) H += a[i] * C[0][i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    printf("%d\n%d\n", tag, ans);
    return 0;
}

double ave=0.0,ans=0.0,tmp=0.0,T=10000.0,minans=1e30;
int n,m,sum[30],belong[30],a[30];
void fire() {
    T=10000.0;
    memset(sum,0,sizeof(sum));
    ans=0.0;
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        int xx=rand()%m;
        sum[xx]+=a[i];
        belong[i]=xx;
    }
    for(int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        ans+=(sum[i]*1.0-ave)*(sum[i]*1.0-ave);
    }
    while(T>0.1) {
        T*=0.9;
        int t=rand()%n,y;
        int x=belong[t];
        if(T>500)
            y=min_element(sum,sum+m)-sum;
        else y=rand()%m;
        if(x==y)continue;
        tmp=ans;
        ans-=(sum[x]*1.0-ave)*(sum[x]*1.0-ave);
        ans-=(sum[y]*1.0-ave)*(sum[y]*1.0-ave);
        sum[x]-=a[t];
        sum[y]+=a[t];
        ans+=(sum[x]*1.0-ave)*(sum[x]*1.0-ave);
        ans+=(sum[y]*1.0-ave)*(sum[y]*1.0-ave);
        if(ans<=tmp)
            belong[t]=y;
        else if(rand()%10000>T) {
            sum[x]+=a[t];
            sum[y]-=a[t];
            ans=tmp;
        } else belong[t]=y;
        minans=min(minans,ans);
    }
}

        ave+=(a[i]*1.0);
    }
    ave/=(double)m;
    rep(i,1,10000)
    fire();
    printf("%.2lf",sqrt(minans/m));
}

#define INF 1e10

D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}

int n, m;
int a[22], sum;
D avr, ans, s[22], dp[22][7];

D get() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i] = s[i - 1] + a[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) dp[0][i] = INF;
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = INF;
        for (int j = m; j; j--) {
            dp[i][j] = INF;
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[k][j - 1] + power(s[i] - s[k] - avr));
        }
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i][j - 1] + power(avr));
    }
    return dp[n][m];
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    srand(19260817);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), sum += a[i];
    avr = sum * 1. / m;
    D temp = 300000, now = ans = get(), nxt;
    while ((temp *= 0.999) > 0.001) {
        int x = rand() % n + 1, y = rand() % n + 1;
        swap(a[x], a[y]);
        ans = min(nxt = get(), ans);
        if (nxt <= now || (exp((now - nxt)) * RAND_MAX > rand())) now = nxt;
        else swap(a[x], a[y]);
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", sqrt(ans / m));
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <string>

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-48;
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

long long ans=0;
int n,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN];
int q[MAXN],siz[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[1]=1;
    while (h^t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                fa[v]=x;
                q[t++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    bfs();
    for (int i=n; i; i--) {
        int x=q[i];
        siz[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                ans+=(long long)e[now].w*(long long)abs(n-(siz[v]<<1));
                siz[x]+=siz[v];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2437.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int n, m, nm, K;
char s[45];
int G[45][45], vis[1633], mat[1633], stp;

vector <int> ans, E[1633];

int nowx, nowy;

#define lab(i, j) ((i - 1) * m + j)

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)E[x].size(); i++) if (vis[E[x][i]] != stp) {
            vis[E[x][i]] = stp;
            if (!mat[E[x][i]] || find(mat[E[x][i]])) return mat[E[x][i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int match() {
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * nm);
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
            if (E[lab(i, j)].size()) {
                stp++;
                ret += find(lab(i, j));
            }
    return ret;
}

int win(int sp) {
    G[nowx][nowy] = sp;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (((i ^ j) & 1)) E[lab(i, j)].clear();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (G[i][j] && ((i ^ j) & 1)) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int tox = i + dx[d], toy = j + dy[d];
                    if (G[tox][toy] && G[tox][toy] != G[i][j]) {
                        E[lab(i, j)].push_back(lab(tox, toy));
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    int ret1 = match();
    G[nowx][nowy] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (((i ^ j) & 1)) E[lab(i, j)].clear();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (G[i][j] && ((i ^ j) & 1)) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int tox = i + dx[d], toy = j + dy[d];
                    if (G[tox][toy] && G[tox][toy] != G[i][j]) {
                        E[lab(i, j)].push_back(lab(tox, toy));
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    int ret2 = match();
    return ret1 != ret2;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    nm = n * m;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            switch (s[j]) {
            case 'X' :
                G[i][j] = 1;
                break;
            case 'O' :
                G[i][j] = 2;
                break;
            case '.' :
                nowx = i, nowy = j;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    scanf("%d", &K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        int tx, ty, ddx, ddy;
        read(tx);
        read(ty);
        read(ddx);
        read(ddy);
        int w1 = win(1);
        swap(G[tx][ty], G[nowx][nowy]);
        nowx = tx, nowy = ty;
        int w2 = win(2);
        if (w1 && w2) ans.push_back(i);
        swap(G[ddx][ddy], G[nowx][nowy]);
        nowx = ddx, nowy = ddy;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ans.size(); i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 300319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXM];
int head[MAXN], ecnt;
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}
int dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN], stp = 0, sta[MAXN], top = 0, bel[MAXN], siz[MAXN], scc;
bool inq[MAXN];
void dfs(int x) {
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    sta[++top] = x;
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!dfn[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to), low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        siz[++scc] = 0;
        int now = 0;
        while (now != x) {
            inq[now = sta[top--]] = 0;
            siz[bel[now] = scc]++;
        }
    }
}

vector <int> in[MAXN], out[MAXN];

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!dfn[i]) dfs(i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (bel[i] != bel[e[now].to]) {
                in[bel[e[now].to]].push_back(bel[i]);
                out[bel[i]].push_back(bel[e[now].to]);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= scc; i++) {
        if (in[i].size()) {
            sort(in[i].begin(), in[i].end());
            in[i].erase(unique(in[i].begin(), in[i].end()), in[i].end());
        }
        if (out[i].size()) {
            sort(out[i].begin(), out[i].end());
            out[i].erase(unique(out[i].begin(), out[i].end()), out[i].end());
        }
    }
    int tot = 0, flag = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= scc; i++) {
        if (!in[i].size()) {
            tot++;
            if (siz[i] == 1) {
                bool ok = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < out[i].size(); j++) {
                    ok &= in[out[i][j]].size() > 1;
                }
                flag |= ok;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", 1 - double(tot - flag) / n);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2440.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1000000
int T,K;
int prime[MAXN>>2],mu[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    mu[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,mu[i]=-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            if (i%prime[j]) {
                notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
                mu[i*prime[j]]=mu[i]*mu[prime[j]];
            } else {
                notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
                mu[i*prime[j]]=0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    LL ans=0;
    for (int i=1,ta=int(sqrt(mid)); i<=ta; i++) {
        ans+=mu[i]*(mid/i/i);
    }
    return ans>=K;
}
int main() {
    shake();
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&K);
        LL l=1,r=K*2+1,mid;
        while (l<r) {
            mid=(l+r)>>1;
            if (check(mid)) r=mid;
            else l=mid+1;
        }
        printf("%d\n",l);
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2453.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 10319

int bl[MAXN];

struct Query {
    int l, r, t;
    bool operator < (Query a) const {
        return bl[l] == bl[a.l] ? (bl[r] == bl[a.r] ? t < a.t : r < a.r) : l < a.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

struct Change {
    int x, pre, nxt, t;
} c[MAXN];

int n, siz, m, qcnt, ccnt;
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], ans[MAXN], cnt[1000319];

int t = 0, l = 1, r = 0, tot = 0;

void add(int x) {
    cnt[x]++;
    if (cnt[x] == 1) tot++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[x]--;
    if (cnt[x] == 0) tot--;
}

void apply(int x, int v) {
    if (l <= x && x <= r) {
        del(a[x]);
        add(v);
    }
    a[x] = v;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    siz = int(pow(n, 2. / 3) + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
        bl[i] = i / siz;
    }
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op == 'Q') q[++qcnt] = (Query) {
            l, r, i
        };
        else c[++ccnt] = (Change) {l, tmp[l], r, i}, tmp[l] = r;
    }
    memset(ans, -1, sizeof ans);
    l = 1, r = 0, t = 0, tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= qcnt; i++) {
        while (c[t].t > q[i].t) {
            apply(c[t].x, c[t].pre);
            t--;
        }
        while (t < ccnt && c[t + 1].t < q[i].t) {
            ++t;
            apply(c[t].x, c[t].nxt);
        }
        while (l < q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        while (l > q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (r > q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (r < q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        ans[q[i].t] = tot;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (ans[i] != -1) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    }

            if (ma[i] < h) h = mi[i];
            else b = 1, h = ma[i];
        } else {
            if (mi[i] > h) h = ma[i];
            else b = 0, ans++, h = mi[i];
        }
    }

//BZOJ2462.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/

#define MOD 100000009
typedef long long LL;
using namespace std;
int n,m,A,B,q;
LL pp=1000000007,pA,pB;
int wtf,ha[MAXN][MAXN],hha[MAXN][MAXN];
char s[MAXN];
bitset<MOD> hhh;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&A,&B);
    pB=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=B; i++) {
        pB<<=1;
        if (pB>P1) pB-=P1;
    }
    pA=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=A; i++) pA=(pA*pp)%MOD;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        ha[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            ha[i][j]=ha[i][j-1]<<1;
            if (s[j]=='1') ha[i][j]|=1;
            if (ha[i][j]>P1) ha[i][j]-=P1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
            hha[i][j]=(ha[i][j]-pB*ha[i][j-B])%P1;
            if (hha[i][j]<0) hha[i][j]+=P1;
        }
    memset(ha,0,sizeof(ha));
    for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            ha[i][j]=(ha[i-1][j]*pp+hha[i][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    memset(hha,0,sizeof(hha));
    for (int i=A; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
            hha[i][j]=(ha[i][j]-ha[i-A][j]*pA)%MOD;
            if (hha[i][j]<0) hha[i][j]+=MOD;
            hhh[hha[i][j]]=true;
        }
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1; i<=q; i++) {
        int val=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            scanf("%s",s+1);
            int tmp=0;
            for (int k=1; k<=B; k++) {
                tmp<<=1;
                if (s[k]=='1') tmp|=1;
                if (tmp>P1) tmp-=P1;
            }
            val=int((val*pp+tmp)%MOD);
        }
        if (hhh[val]) puts("1");
        else puts("0");
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2502.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#define INF 12345678
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 215

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} ee[MAXN<<10],e[MAXN<<11];

int S,T,SS,TT,eecnt=0,ehead[MAXN],ecnt=1,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],in[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_1(int u,int v) {
    ee[++eecnt].to=v;
    ee[eecnt].next=ehead[u];
    ehead[u]=eecnt;
}

int n;
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow-used));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int work() {
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int now=ehead[i]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
            add(i,ee[now].to,INF),in[i]--,in[ee[now].to]++;
        }
    }
    SS=n+1;
    TT=SS+1;
    S=TT+1;
    T=S+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(SS,i,INF);
        add(i,TT,INF);
        if (in[i]>0) add(S,i,in[i]);
        else if (in[i]<0) add(i,T,-in[i]);
    }
    add(TT,SS,INF);
    dinic();
    int ans=e[ecnt].flow;
    head[SS]=e[head[SS]].next;
    head[TT]=e[head[TT]].next;
    for (int now=head[S]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].flow=e[now^1].flow=0;
    }
    for (int now=head[T]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].flow=e[now^1].flow=0;
    }
    add(S,TT,INF);
    add(SS,T,INF);
    return ans-dinic();
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&x);
        for (int j=1,p; j<=x; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&p);
            add_1(i,p);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",work());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2510.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define MAXN 1005

int n, m, K, A[MAXN];
LD tr[MAXN], b[MAXN], c[MAXN];

void mul(LD a[MAXN]) {
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        c[j] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) c[j] += a[k] * b[(j - k + n) % n];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = c[i];
}

void work() {
    tr[0] = 1, b[0] = LD(m - 1) / m, b[n - 1] = LD(1) / m;
    while (K) {
        if (K & 1) mul(tr);
        mul(b);
        K >>= 1;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(A[i]);
    work();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        c[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            c[i] += A[j] * tr[(j - i + n) % n];
        }
        printf("%.3lf\n", (double)c[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2535ac.cpp
#include<stdio.h>
#include<stdlib.h>
int k[2005]= {0},f[2005]= {0},s[2005]= {0},v[10005]= {0},first[2005]= {0},next[10005]= {0},heap[2005]= {0},pos[2005]= {0};
int n,e=0,node;
void tj(int x,int y) {
    v[++e]=y;
    next[e]=first[x];
    first[x]=e;
}
void jh_heap(int a,int b) {
    int t=heap[a];
    heap[a]=heap[b];
    heap[b]=t;
    t=pos[heap[a]];
    pos[heap[a]]=pos[heap[b]];
    pos[heap[b]]=t;
}
void tj_heap(int x) {
    int i;
    heap[++node]=x;
    pos[x]=node;
    for(i=node; i>1; i/=2) {
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
void sc() {
    int i=1;
    jh_heap(1,node);
    node--;
    while(i*2<=node) {
        i*=2;
        if(i+1<=node&&k[heap[i]]<k[heap[i+1]]) i++;
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
int work(int x) {
    int i,j,t;
    node=0;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        f[i]=heap[i]=pos[i]=0;
    for(i=1; i<=e; i++)
        f[v[i]]++;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        if(f[i]==0&&i!=x) tj_heap(i);
    for(i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        if(node==0) return n-i;
        t=heap[1];
        sc();
        if(k[t]<i) return n-i;
        s[i]=t;
        for(j=first[t]; j!=0; j=next[j])
            if(--f[v[j]]==0&&v[j]!=x) tj_heap(v[j]);
    }
    return n;
}

        scanf("%d",&k[i]);

    }*/

struct data {
    int u,v;
} y[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM<<2];

int n,m,r,t,k,S=0,T,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt=1;

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool act[MAXN];

int check() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (act[i]) add(S,i,1);
    }
    int ret=dinic();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (act[i] && !e[head[i]].flow) {
            act[i]=0;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

    }
    int lim=t/r,score=0,penal=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) act[i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) add(i+n,T,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) add(y[i].u,y[i].v,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=lim; i++) {
        int ret=check();
        if (ret) {
            score+=ret;
            penal+=ret*i*r;
        } else break;
    }

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

#define MAXN 300019

struct PT {
    map <int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int last, n, p;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        cnt[p] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        return p++;
    }
    inline void init() {
        p = 0;
        newNode(0);
        newNode(-1);
        last = 0;
        n = 0;
        S[0] = -1;
        fail[0] = 1;
    }
    inline int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    inline int add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
        return len[cur] + 2;
    }
} T;

int n, P1[MAXN], P2[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P1[i] = T.add(s[i]);
    T.init();
    for (int i = n; i; i--) P2[i] = T.add(s[i]);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) ans = max(ans, P1[i] + P2[i + 1]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 50005
struct cow {
    int x,p;
    cow() {}
    cow(int a,int b):x(a),p(b) {}
    bool operator < (cow a) const {
        return p<a.p;
    }
    bool operator > (cow a) const {
        return p>a.p;
    }
};
priority_queue<cow,vector<cow>,greater<cow> > disc,nodisc;
priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int> > price;
int n,k,C[MAXN],P[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
LL m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(P[i]);
        read(C[i]);
        disc.push(cow(i,C[i]));
        nodisc.push(cow(i,P[i]));
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) price.push(0);
    int ans=n;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        while (visit[nodisc.top().x]) nodisc.pop();
        while (visit[disc.top().x]) disc.pop();
        int Pri=nodisc.top().p,tag=0;
        if (!price.empty()) {
            int tt=disc.top().p+price.top();
            if (Pri>tt) Pri=tt,tag=1;
        }
        if (Pri>m) {
            ans=i;
            break;
        }
        m-=Pri;
        if (tag) {
            int x=disc.top().x;
            visit[x]=1;
            disc.pop();
            price.pop();
            price.push(P[x]-C[x]);
        } else {
            int x=nodisc.top().x;
            visit[x]=1;
            nodisc.pop();
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2594.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 1000319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : ma(this), val(0) {}
    inline void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    inline bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        ma = this;
        if (c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
        if (c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
    }
    inline void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    inline void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    inline void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

inline void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

inline Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

inline void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *st[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) st[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) st[top]->relax();
}

inline void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    //return y;
}

inline void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

inline void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

inline void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

inline Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->ma;
}

inline Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];
pair<int, int> E[MAXN + MAXM];

inline void newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(mid, a[u]);
    Link(mid, a[v]);
    E[mid - mem] = make_pair(u, v);
}

inline void delE(Node *mid) {
    int u = E[mid - mem].first, v = E[mid - mem].second;
    Cut(mid, a[u]);
    Cut(mid, a[v]);
}

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    if (getrt(a[u]) == getrt(a[v])) {
        Node *ma = query(a[u], a[v]);
        if (ma->val > w) {
            delE(ma);
            newE(u, v, w);
        }
    } else newE(u, v, w);
}

struct query {
    int op, u, v;
} q[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return u < b.u || (u == b.u && v < b.v);
    }
    bool operator != (edge b) const {
        return u != b.u || v != b.v;
    }
} e[MAXM], K[MAXN];

int n, m, Q, kcnt = 0;

int ans[MAXN], top = 0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
        if (e[i].u > e[i].v) swap(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].op);
        read(q[i].u);
        read(q[i].v);
        if (q[i].u > q[i].v) swap(q[i].u, q[i].v);
        if (q[i].op == 2) {
            K[++kcnt] = (edge) {
                q[i].u, q[i].v, 0
            };
        }
    }
    sort(K + 1, K + kcnt + 1);
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; ; i++) {
        if (i > kcnt) {
            while (j <= m) {
                add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].w);
                j++;
            }
            break;
        }
        while (K[i] != e[j]) {
            add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].w);
            j++;
        }
        K[i].w = e[j].w;
        j++;
    }
    for (int i = Q; i; i--) {
        if (q[i].op == 1) {
            ans[top++] = query(a[q[i].u], a[q[i].v])->val;
        } else {
            add(q[i].u, q[i].v, K[lower_bound(K + 1, K + kcnt + 1, (edge) {
                q[i].u, q[i].v, 0
            }) - K].w);
        }
    }
    while (top) printf("%d\n", ans[--top]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2599.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ans = INF;
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                    maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                    to = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, k, dep[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int ext[1000319], s[MAXN], top;

stack <int> used;

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dis[x] > k) return;
    s[++top] = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

void work(int x) {
    ext[0] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            top = 0;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) if (ext[k - dis[s[i]]] != INF) {
                    ans = min(ans, dep[s[i]] + ext[k - dis[s[i]]]);
                }
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) {
                ext[dis[s[i]]] = min(ext[dis[s[i]]], dep[s[i]]);
                used.push(dis[s[i]]);
            }
        }
    }
    while (!used.empty()) {
        ext[used.top()] = INF;
        used.pop();
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    work(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 2, u, v, w; i <= n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    memset(ext, 0x3f, sizeof ext);
    if (k == 0) puts("0");
    else {
        solve(0);
        if (ans > n) puts("-1");
        else printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2618.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define INF 1e23
#define eps 1e-14
#define MAXN 2333
inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
    }
};

Point Is(Point p1, Point p2, Point q1, Point q2) {
    D a1 = (q2 - q1) * (p1 - q1), a2 = (p2 - q1) * (q2 - q1);
    return (p1 * a2 + p2 * a1) / (a1 + a2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border () {}
    Border (Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lf %lf %lf %lf\n", p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y);
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return sign((b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1)) > 0;
}

bool ok(Border &p, Border &q, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(p.p1, p.p2, q.p1, q.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

int n, cnt;
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
Point p[MAXN];
int pcnt = 0;

void work() {
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he < 3) puts("0.000");
    else {
        D ans = 0;
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int nxt = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[++pcnt] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[nxt].p1, q[nxt].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
            int nxt = i == pcnt ? 1 : i + 1;
            ans += p[i] * p[nxt];
        }
        printf("%.3lf\n", abs(ans) / 2 + eps);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int m;
        Point first, last, now;
        read(m);
        first.re();
        last = first;
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) {
            now.re();
            a[++cnt] = Border(last, now);
            last = now;
        }
        a[++cnt] = Border(last, first);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

    int i,j;
    cin>>k>>n>>m;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            double temp=(double)(i-1)*(j-1)/n/m*(n-i+1)*(m-j+1)/n/m+
                        (double)(n-i)*(j-1)/n/m*(i)*(m-j+1)/n/m+
                        (double)(i-1)*(m-j)/n/m*(n-i+1)*(j)/n/m+
                        (double)(n-i)*(m-j)/n/m*(i)*(j)/n/m+
                        (double)1*(j-1)/n/m*(m-j+1)/m+
                        (double)1*(m-j)/n/m*(j)/m+
                        (double)(i-1)*1/n/m*(n-i+1)/n+
                        (double)(n-i)*1/n/m*(i)/n+
                        (double)1*1/n/m;
            printf("%.3lf\n", 1 - temp);
            ans+=1-pow(1-temp,k);
        }

//BZOJ2631.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c != '+' && _c != '-' && _c != '*' && _c != '/') _c = getchar();
    op = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MOD 51061
typedef long long LL;

struct Mark {
    LL add, mul;
    Mark(LL a, LL m) : add(a), mul(m) {}
    Mark() : add(0), mul(1) {}
    bool operator != (Mark b) const {
        return (add != b.add) || (mul != b.mul);
    }
} I;

Mark operator * (Mark a, Mark b) {
    return Mark((a.add * b.mul + b.add) % MOD, a.mul * b.mul % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *p, *c[2];
    Mark m;
    LL sum, val;
    int size;
    bool rev, isRoot;
    Node () : sum(0), rev(0), isRoot(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int d) {
        c[d] = ch;
        ch->p = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = (val + c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum) % MOD;
        size = c[0]->size + c[1]->size + 1;
    }
    void apply(Mark a) {
        m = m * a;
        sum = (sum * a.mul + a.add * size) % MOD;
        val = (val * a.mul + a.add) % MOD;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setRoot(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setRoot(Node *f) {
    fa = f;
    isRoot = 1;
    p = null;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (m != I) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->apply(m);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->apply(m);
        m = I;
    }
    if (rev) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->revIt();
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->sum = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->m = I;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->isRoot = 1;
    ptr->p = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *t) {
    Node *p = t->p;
    bool d = t->d();
    p->p->setc(t, p->d());
    p->setc(t->c[!d], d);
    t->setc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isRoot) {
        p->isRoot= 0;
        t->isRoot= 1;
        t->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) {
        sta[top++] = x;
        x = x->p;
    }
    if (x->p != null) pushto(x->p);
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; i--) sta[i]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *u, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(u);
    while (u->p != fa) {
        if (u->p->p == fa) rot(u);
        else u->d() == u->p->d() ? (rot(u->p), rot(u)) : (rot(u), rot(u));
    }
    u->upd();
}

Node* expose(Node *u) {
    Node *v;
    for (v = null; u != null; v = u, u = u->fa) {
        splay(u);
        u->c[1]->setRoot(u);
        u->setc(v, 1);
        v->fa = u;
    }
    return v;
}

void makeRoot(Node *u) {
    expose(u);
    splay(u);
    u->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *x, Node *y) {
    makeRoot(x);
    x->fa = y;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->fa = v->p = null;
    v->isRoot = 1;
}

void update(Node *u, Node *v, Mark m) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    v->apply(m);
}

LL query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

int n, Q;
Node*v[MAXN];
vector<int> E[MAXN];

int que[MAXN], fa[MAXN], qh = 0, qt = 0;

void bfs() {
    que[qt++] = 1;
    fa[1] = 0;
    while (qh < qt) {
        int u = que[qh++];
        for (vector<int>::iterator e = E[u].begin(); e != E[u].end(); ++e)
            if (*e != fa[u])
                fa[*e] = u, v[*e]->fa = v[u], que[qt++] = *e;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        E[x].push_back(y);
        E[y].push_back(x);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) v[i] = newNode(1);
    bfs();
    for (int i = 1, op, c, x, y; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        switch (op) {
        case '+':
            read(c);
            markPath(v[x], v[y], Mark(c, 1));
            break;
        case '*':
            read(c);
            markPath(v[x], v[y], Mark(0, c));
            break;
        case '/':
            printf("%lld", queryPath(v[x], v[y]));
            break;
        default :
            delEdge(v[x], v[y]);
            read(x);
            read(y);
            addEdge(v[x], v[y]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
