        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

    for (int i = 3; i < MAXN; i += 2) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i << 1) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }

    int n;
    read(n);
    int i = 1, j = pcnt, ans = 0;
    while (p[j] > n) j--;

        int tmp = p[j--];
        while (i <= j + 1 && tmp <= n) tmp *= p[i++];
        i--;
    }

//BZOJ2645.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 4012
#define MAXK 505
int n, k, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN], sum[MAXN], fa[MAXN], fL[MAXN][MAXK], fR[MAXN][MAXK];

vector <int> G[MAXN];

void dfsL(int u) {
    sum[u] = sum[fa[u]] + a[u];
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fL[v][j] = fL[u][j];
        dfsL(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fL[u][j] = max(fL[u][j], fL[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

void dfsR(int u) {
    for (int i = (int)G[u].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fR[v][j] = fR[u][j];
        dfsR(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fR[u][j] = max(fR[u][j], fR[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]), read(a[i]);
        if (fa[i]) G[fa[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    dfsL(1);
    dfsR(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (G[i].size() == 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) ans = max(ans, fL[i][j] + fR[i][k - j] + sum[i]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2648.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

int Q[2];
Node *newNode(int x = Q[0], int y = Q[1]) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) {
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2653.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define read(a) {a = 0; while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') a = a * 10 + (ch & 15), ch = getchar();}
#define MAXN 20319
#define rint register int
inline int max(rint a, rint b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, he, ta;
} t[MAXN * 33];

struct Range {
    int v, he, ta;
    Range (int a = 0, int b = 0, int c = 0) : v(a), he(b), ta(c) {}
};

int tcnt = 0;

inline Range operator + (Range a, Range b) {
    Range ret;
    ret.v = a.v + b.v;
    ret.he = max(a.he, a.v + b.he);
    ret.ta = max(b.ta, b.v + a.ta);
    return ret;
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].he = max(t[t[x].l].he, t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].he);
    t[x].ta = max(t[t[x].r].ta, t[t[x].r].v + t[t[x].l].ta);
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = -1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    }
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, v);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = 1;
    return x;
}

Range query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Range(t[x].v, t[x].he, t[x].ta);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Range ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

typedef pair<int, int> pii;
int n, Q, x[4], rt[MAXN];
pii p[MAXN];

int main() {
    rint ans = 0, i, j, l, r, v, ch;
    read(n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        read(l);
        p[i] = make_pair(l, i);
    }
    sort(p, p + n);
    rt[n] = build(0, n - 1);
    for (i = n - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        rt[i] = update(rt[i + 1], 0, n - 1, p[i].second);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            read(x[j]);
            x[j] = (x[j] + ans) % n;
        }
        sort(x, x + 4);
        l = 0, r = n - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            j = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            v = query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[1], x[2]).v;
            if (x[0] < x[1]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[0], x[1] - 1).ta);
            if (x[2] < x[3]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[2] + 1, x[3]).he);
            if (v >= 0) l = j;
            else r = j - 1;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans = p[l].first);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2654.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int u, v, w, c;
} e[MAXN];

bool B;
bool operator < (const edge &a, const edge &b) {
    return a.w != b.w ? a.w < b.w : (B ? a.c < b.c : a.c > b.c);
}

int n, m, need;
int f[MAXN], ans;
int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}
bool merge(int x, int y) {
    x = getf(x), y = getf(y);
    if (x == y) return 0;
    if (f[x] > f[y]) swap(x, y);
    f[x] += f[y];
    f[y] = x;
    return 1;
}

inline pii check(int mid) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w += mid;

    int tot1 = 0, tot2 = 0;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 0;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            ans += e[i].w;
            tot1 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    ans -= mid * tot1;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 1;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            tot2 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w -= mid;
    return mp(tot1, tot2);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(need);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
        read(e[i].c);
    }
    int l = -100, r = 100;
    while (l <= r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        pii ret = check(mid);
        if (ret.fir <= need && ret.sec >= need) break;
        else if (ret.fir > need) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2656.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define rint register int

struct Num {
    int a[100], len;
    Num() {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 0;
    }
    Num(int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 1;
        a[1] = x;
    }
    int &operator [] (unsigned id) {
        return a[id];
    }
    Num operator + (Num b) const {
        Num ret;
        rint maxlen = len > b.len ? len : b.len, i;
        for (i = 1; i <= maxlen; i++) {
            ret[i] += a[i] + b[i];
            ret[i + 1] = ret[i] / 10000;
            ret[i] = ret[i] - ret[i + 1] * 10000;
        }
        ret.len = maxlen + (!!ret[maxlen + 1]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool odd() const {
        return a[1] & 1;
    }
    Num div2() const {
        Num ret;
        for (int i = len; i; i--) {
            if (a[i] & 1) ret[i - 1] = 5000;
            ret[i] += a[i] >> 1;
        }
        ret[0] = 0;
        ret.len = len - (!ret[len]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator < (Num b) const {
        if (len == b.len) {
            for (rint i = len; i; i--) {
                if (a[i] != b[i]) return a[i] < b[i];
            }
            return 0;
        } else return len < b.len;
    }
    void print() const {
        if (len) {
            printf("%d", a[len]);
            for (int i = len - 1; i; i--) printf("%04d", a[i]);
        } else putchar('0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} zero, one(1);

map <Num, Num> f;

char s[233];
int n;

Num dp(Num x) {
    if (f.find(x) == f.end()) {
        Num ha = x.div2();
        if (x.odd()) f[x] = dp(ha) + dp(ha + 1);
        else f[x] = dp(ha);
    }
    return f[x];
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] ^= '0';
    reverse(s, s + n);
    s[n] = s[n + 1] = s[n + 2] = 0;
    Num N;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i += 4) {
        N[++N.len] = s[i] + s[i + 1] * 10 + s[i + 2] * 100 + s[i + 3] * 1000;
    }
    dp(N).print();
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    f[zero] = zero;
    f[one] = one;
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <queue>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct edge {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int rt = 1, dep[MAXN];

void dfs(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > dep[rt]) rt = x;
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != fa) dep[e[o].v] = dep[x] + 1, dfs(e[o].v, x);
    }
}

struct Node {
    int u, v, id;
    bool operator < (const Node &a) const {
        if (u ^ a.u) return u < a.u;
        else		 return v < a.v;
    }
} a[MAXN * 2];

int cnt = 0;

void push(int u, int v, int id) {
    if (u > v) swap(u, v);
    a[++cnt] = (Node) {
        u, v, id
    };
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    if (n == 3) return puts("1"), 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
        int x, y, z, d;
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
        d = (x - y + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(x, y, i);
        d = (x - z + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(x, z, i);
        d = (z - y + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(z, y, i);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i += 2) add(a[i].id, a[i + 1].id);
    dfs(1, 0);
    dep[rt] = 0;
    dfs(rt, 0);
    printf("%d\n", dep[rt] + 1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2661.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 2005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[10005];

const int src=0,sink=1;

int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

int a,b;
int ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build() {
    for (int i=a; i<=b; i++) {
        add(src,i<<1,0);
        add((i<<1)^1,sink,0);
    }
    for (int y=a; y<b; y++)
        for (int x=y+1; x<=b; x++) {
            int z2=x*x-y*y,z=int(sqrt(z2));
            if (z2==z*z && gcd(y,z)==1) {
                add(x<<1,(y<<1)^1,x+y);
                add(y<<1,(x<<1)^1,x+y);
            }
        }
}
int dis[MAXN],pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
queue <int> q;

bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,200,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    q.push(src);
    dis[src]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front(),d=dis[x];
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]<d+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=d+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return (pre[sink]!=0);
}

void work() {
    int p=0;
    long long ans=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        p++;
        ans+=dis[sink];
        for (int now=sink; now!=src; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow--;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    cout<<p/2<<" "<<ans/2<<endl;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

bool opt(int &op) {
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') _c=getchar();
    op = _c - '0';
    _c = getchar();
    return op != 3;
}

struct Node {
    int id, x, y, v, ans;
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y) || (x == a.x && y == a.y && id < a.id);
    }
} q[200000 * 4 + 5], tmp[200000 * 4 + 5];

int N, cnt = 0;

#define s 524288

int t[s << 1];

void add(int x, int v) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x] += v;
}

int query(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int l = s - 1, r = x + s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l&1) ret += t[l ^ 1];
        if (r&1) ret += t[r ^ 1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void cdq(int l, int r) {
    nputif (l >= r) return;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lp = l, rp = mid + 1;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (q[i].v)	{
            if (q[i].id <= mid) add(q[i].y, q[i].v);
        } else {
            if (q[i].id > mid) q[i].ans += query(q[i].y);
        }
    }
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (q[i].v && q[i].id <= mid) add(q[i].y, -q[i].v);
        if (q[i].id <= mid) tmp[lp++] = q[i];
        else tmp[rp++] = q[i];
    }
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) q[i] = tmp[i];
    cdq(l, mid);
    cdq(mid + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    read(N);
    int op, x, y, a, b;
    while (opt(op)) {
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(a);
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x, y, a, 0
            };
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(a);
            read(b);
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, a, b, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, a, y - 1, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x - 1, b, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x - 1, y - 1, 0, 0
            };
        }
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + cnt + 1);
    cdq(1, cnt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (!q[i].v) {
            printf("%d\n", q[i].ans - q[i + 1].ans - q[i + 2].ans + q[i + 3].ans);
            i += 3;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define N 10000005
#define MOD 100000009

bool vis[N];
int p[N / 7], pcnt;
LL f[N];

void init() {
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, f[i] = -i + 1;
        for (int j = 1, k; (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) f[k] = f[i] * f[p[j]] % MOD;
            else {
                f[k] = f[i];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) ((f[i] *= i) += f[i - 1]) %= MOD;
}

int n, m;

LL sum(LL x, LL y) {
    x = x * (x + 1) / 2 % MOD, y = y * (y + 1) / 2 % MOD;
    return x * y % MOD;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        (ret += sum(1, n / i) * sum(1, m / i) % MOD * (f[j] - f[i - 1])) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(ret + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;

LL n,sqn,ans=0;

LL phi(LL x) {
    LL sqx=LL(sqrt(x)),ret=x;
    for (int i=2; i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            ret=ret/i*(i-1);
            while (x%i==0) {
                x/=i;
            }
            sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ret=ret/x*(x-1);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    sqn=LL(sqrt(n));
    for (LL i=1; i<=sqn; i++) {
        if (n%i==0) {
            ans+=i*phi(n/i)+(n/i)*phi(i);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2716_kdt.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

Node *newNode(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int Q[2];
#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (x->d[d] >= Q[d]) x->l = x->l ? insert(x->l, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    else x->r = x->r ? insert(x->r, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    x->upd();
    if ((max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 3) >> 1 > x->siz) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    } else return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2732.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define INF 1e30
#define MAXN 200319
typedef double D;
const D eps = 1e-18;

inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}

struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    D operator ^ (Point a) const {
        return x * a.x + y * a.y;
    }
};

Point Is(Point p1, Point p2, Point q1, Point q2) {
    D a1 = (q2 - q1) * (p1 - q1), a2 = (p2 - q1) * (q2 - q1);
    return (p1 * a2 + p2 * a1) / (a1 + a2);
}

Point Iss(Point a1, Point a2, Point b1, Point b2) {
    D x1 = (b2 - b1) * (a1 - b1), x2 = (a2 - b1) * (b2 - b1);
    return (a1 * x2 + a2 * x1) / (x1 + x2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    int id;
    Border () {}
    Border(Point a, Point b, int i = 0) : p1(a), p2(b), id(i) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2((long double)(p2.y - p1.y), (long double)(p2.x - p1.x));
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return sign((b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1)) >= 0;
}
Border a[MAXN * 2];

int n, cnt;

Border q[MAXN * 2];

bool ok(Border &pp, Border &qq, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(pp.p1, pp.p2, qq.p1, qq.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

bool check(int mid) {
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) if (a[i].id <= mid) {
            while (ta - he > 1 && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
            while (ta - he > 1 && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
            q[ta++] = a[i];
        }
    while (ta - he > 1 && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (ta - he > 1 && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    return ta - he >= 3;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("bzoj_27326.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("bzoj_2732.out", "w", stdout);
    Point a(1, 1), b(3, 3), c(4, 4), d(5, 3);
    printf("%lf %lf\n", Is(a, b, c, d).x, Is(a, b, c, d).y);
    printf("%lf %lf\n", Iss(a, b, c, d).x, Iss(a, b, c, d).y);
    read(n);
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(0, 0), Point(0, INF));
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(0, INF), Point(-INF, INF));
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(-INF, INF), Point(-INF, 0));
    a[++cnt] = Border(Point(-INF, 0), Point(0, 0));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        D x, y1, y2;
        read(x);
        read(y1);
        read(y2);
        a[++cnt] = Border(Point(-1, y1 / x + x), Point(1, y1 / x - x), i);
        a[++cnt] = Border(Point(1, y2 / x - x), Point(-1, y2 / x + x), i);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2733.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='B') ch=getchar();
    a=(ch=='Q');
    ch=getchar();
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct node {
    int lch,rch,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];

int n,m,q,tcnt=0,a[MAXN],rev[MAXN],rt[MAXN],f[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[x].lch;
    t[now].rch=t[x].rch;
    t[now].v=t[x].v+1;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].lch=update(t[x].lch,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].rch=update(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
int merge_tree(int x,int y) {
    if (!x) return y;
    if (!y) return x;
    t[x].lch=merge_tree(t[x].lch,t[y].lch);
    t[x].rch=merge_tree(t[x].rch,t[y].rch);
    t[x].v+=t[y].v;
    return x;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            rt[fu]=merge_tree(rt[fu],rt[fv]);
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            rt[fv]=merge_tree(rt[fv],rt[fu]);
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

int kth_element(int x,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (t[t[x].lch].v>=k) {
        return kth_element(t[x].lch,l,mid,k);
    } else {
        return kth_element(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,k-t[t[x].lch].v);
    }
}

int main() {
//  freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//  freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        rev[a[i]]=i;
        rt[i]=update(0,1,n,a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        merge(x,y);
    }
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (op) {
            int fx=getf(x);
            if (-f[fx]<y) puts("-1");
            else printf("%d\n",rev[kth_element(rt[fx],1,n,y)]);
        } else {
            merge(x,y);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
}
ll tot=1;
int bin[20];
int n;
int a[20][20],b[20],f[20][2048];
bool mark[100005];
int cal(int x) {
    memset(b,0,sizeof(b));
    a[1][1]=x;
    for(int i=2; i<=18; i++)
        if(a[i-1][1]*2<=n)
            a[i][1]=a[i-1][1]*2;
        else a[i][1]=n+1;
    for(int i=1; i<=18; i++)
        for(int j=2; j<=11; j++)
            if(a[i][j-1]*3<=n)
                a[i][j]=a[i][j-1]*3;
            else a[i][j]=n+1;
    for(int i=1; i<=18; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=11; j++)
            if(a[i][j]<=n) {
                b[i]+=bin[j-1];
                mark[a[i][j]]=1;
            }
    for(int i=0; i<=18; i++)
        for(int x=0; x<=b[i]; x++)
            f[i][x]=0;
    f[0][0]=1;

        for(int x=0; x<=b[i]; x++) {

                for(int y=0; y<=b[i+1]; y++)
                    if(((x&y)==0)&&((y&(y>>1))==0))
                        f[i+1][y]=(f[i][x]+f[i+1][y])%mod;
        }
    return f[18][0];
}

//BZOJ2734.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 1000000001
#define MAXN 100005
#define top 2048
typedef long long LL;
LL ans=1,dp[18][235];
int n,can[235],num[18][13],ccnt=0;
bool visit[MAXN];

void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<=top; i++) {
        if (!(i&(i>>1))) can[++ccnt]=i;
    }
}

void Modadd(LL &a,LL b) {
    a+=b;
    if (a>=MOD) a-=MOD;
}

void work(int x) {
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    num[1][1]=x;
    dp[0][1]=1;
    int last=1;
    for (int i=1;; i++) {
        int cnt=1;
        visit[num[i][1]]=1;
        for (int j=2;; j++) {
            num[i][j]=num[i][j-1]*3;
            if (num[i][j]>n) break;
            cnt=j;
            visit[num[i][j]]=1;
        }
        int nowtop=1<<cnt,now=1;
        for (int j=1;; j++) {
            if (can[j]>=nowtop) break;
            now=j;
            for (int k=1; k<=last; k++) {
                if (!(can[j]&can[k])) Modadd(dp[i][j],dp[i-1][k]);
            }
        }
        last=now;
        num[i+1][1]=num[i][1]*2;
        if (num[i+1][1]>n) {
            LL ret=0;
            for (int j=1; j<=now; j++) {
                Modadd(ret,dp[i][j]);
            }
            ans=(ans*ret)%MOD;
            return;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) work(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2738.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 505

struct data {
    int x,y,v;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
} d[MAXN*MAXN];

struct query {
    int x1,y1,x2,y2,k;
} q[60005];

int n,Q,dcnt=0,a[MAXN][MAXN],sum[MAXN][MAXN],f[60005],ans[60005];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool isin(int x,int y,int k) {
    return x>q[k].x1 && x<=q[k].x2 && y>q[k].y1 && y<=q[k].y2;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(d[++dcnt].v);
            d[dcnt].x=i,d[dcnt].y=j;
        }
    }
    sort(d+1,d+dcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].x1);
        read(q[i].y1);
        read(q[i].x2);
        read(q[i].y2);
        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].x1--;
        q[i].y1--;
        f[i]=i;
    }
    f[Q+1]=Q+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int st=(i-1)*n;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            a[d[st+j].x][d[st+j].y]=1;
        }
        for (int x=1; x<=n; x++) {
            for (int y=1; y<=n; y++) {
                sum[x][y]=a[x][y]+sum[x-1][y]+sum[x][y-1]-sum[x-1][y-1];
            }
        }
        for (int w=getf(1); w<=Q; w=getf(w+1)) {
            int tot=sum[q[w].x2][q[w].y2]-sum[q[w].x1][q[w].y2]-sum[q[w].x2][q[w].y1]+sum[q[w].x1][q[w].y1];
            if (tot>=q[w].k) {
                int qqq=tot-q[w].k;
                for (int j=n; j; j--) {
                    if (isin(d[st+j].x,d[st+j].y,w)) {
                        if (!(qqq--)) {
                            ans[w]=d[st+j].v;
                        }
                    }
                }
                f[w]=w+1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 20005
#define TOP 30
typedef long long LL;
int n, m, lastans = 0;
struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 64];
int tcnt = 0;

void insert(int x, int v) {
    for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
        int now = ++tcnt;
        t[now] = t[x];
        t[now].v++;
        if ((v>>i)&1) t[now].l = tcnt + 1, x = t[x].l;
        else t[now].r = tcnt + 1, x = t[x].r;
    }
    t[++tcnt].v = 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, sum; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        rt[i] = tcnt + 1;
        insert(rt[i - 1], a);
    }
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        l = (int)min(((LL)x + lastans) % n + 1, ((LL)y + lastans) % n + 1);
        r = (int)max(((LL)x + lastans) % n + 1, ((LL)y + lastans) % n + 1);
        printf("%d\n", query(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
#define s 1048576
int n, m, c;
vector <int> Q[s], id[s];
int a[s], last[s], pre[s], ans[s], t[s * 2];

void update(int x, int v) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x] += v;
}
int query(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l&1) ret += t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret += t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(c);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        Q[r].push_back(l);
        id[r].push_back(i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        pre[i] = last[a[i]];
        if (pre[i]) {
            update(pre[i], 1);
            if (pre[pre[i]]) update(pre[pre[i]], -1);
        }
        last[a[i]] = i;
        for (int j = 0; j < Q[i].size(); j++) {
            ans[id[i][j]] = query(Q[i][j], i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2744.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXA 205
#define MAXB 3019

int A, B, M, ans;
int a[MAXA], b[MAXB], c[2], oktot;
bool G[MAXA][MAXB], H[MAXB][MAXB], ok[MAXB];
vector <int> E[MAXB];

int mat[MAXB], vis[MAXB], tag = 0;

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = (int)E[x].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (ok[E[x][i]] && vis[E[x][i]] != tag) {
            vis[E[x][i]] = tag;
            if (!mat[E[x][i]] || find(mat[E[x][i]])) return mat[x] = E[x][i], 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int work() {
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * B);
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) {
        if (ok[i] && b[i] & 1) {
            tag++;
            ret += find(i);
        }
    }
    return oktot - ret;
}

int main() {
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(M);
    for (int i = 1; i <= A; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) read(b[i]), c[b[i] & 1]++;
    ans = max(int(!!A), max(c[0], c[1]));
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) if (b[i] & 1) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= B; j++) {
                if (~b[j] & 1 && ~__builtin_popcount(b[i] | b[j]) & 1) E[i].push_back(j);
            }
        }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= M; i++) read(u), read(v), G[u][v] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= A; i++) {
        oktot = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= B; j++) ok[j] = G[i][j], oktot += ok[j];
        ans = max(ans, work() + 1);
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= A; j++) {
            if ((a[i] ^ a[j]) & 1) {
                oktot = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= B; k++) ok[k] = G[i][k] & G[j][k], oktot += ok[k];
                ans = max(ans, work() + 2);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    dp[0].reset();
    dp[0][bg]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
        dp[i].reset();
        dp[i]|=dp[i-1]<<c[i];
        dp[i]|=dp[i-1]>>c[i];
        for (int j=ml+1; j<1005; j++) dp[i][j]=0;
    }
    int ans=-1;
    for (int i=0; i<=ml; i++) if (dp[n][i]) ans=i;
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2751.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXK 100005
#define MOD 1000000007
using namespace std;
struct lim {
    int x,y;
    bool operator < (lim a) const {
        if (x!=a.x)
            return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
    bool operator != (lim a) const {
        return !(a.x==x && a.y==y);
    }
} l[MAXK];
long long n,m,k,sum,tot=0,ans=1;

inline long long quickpower(long long x,long long b) {
    long long ans=1;
    x%=MOD;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1)
            ans=(ans*x)%MOD;
        x=(x*x)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l[i].x,&l[i].y);
    }
    sort(l+1,l+k+1);
    sum=((1+n)*n)>>1;
    int i,j;
    for (i=2,j=1; i<=k; i++) {
        if (l[i]!=l[j]) {
            l[++j]=l[i];
        }
    }
    k=j;
    int now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        tot+=l[i].x-now-1;
        now=l[i].x;
        long long last=sum-l[i].y;
        while (i<k && l[i+1].x==now) {
            i++;
            last-=l[i].y;
        }
        ans=(ans*(last%MOD))%MOD;
    }
    tot+=m-now;
    ans=(ans*quickpower(sum,tot))%MOD;
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 45
#define MAXNODE 2005
#define INF 1234567890123456ll
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL flow;
} e[MAXNODE<<4];

int S,T;
int n,m,head[MAXNODE],ecnt,tag[MAXNODE],cur[MAXNODE];
int a[MAXN][MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,LL flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[2048];
bool bfs() {
    int h=0,t=1;
    q[0]=0;
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q[t++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

LL dfs(int x,LL flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    LL used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            LL ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=T; i!=-1; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,INF);
    }
    return ans;
}

#define pos(i,j) ((i-1)*m+j)

bool ok(LL mid) {
    ecnt=1;
    LL should=0;
    S=0,T=n*m+1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if ((i^j)&1) {
                should+=mid-a[i][j];
                add(0,pos(i,j),mid-a[i][j]);
                if (j<m) add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j+1),INF);
                if (j>1) add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j-1),INF);
                if (i<n) add(pos(i,j),pos(i+1,j),INF);
                if (i>1) add(pos(i,j),pos(i-1,j),INF);
            } else {
                add(pos(i,j),T,mid-a[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dinic()==should;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    read(t);
    while (t--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        int MAX=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                read(a[i][j]);
                MAX=max(a[i][j],MAX);
            }
        LL s[2]= {0,0};
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                s[(i^j)&1]+=a[i][j];
            }
        if (n&m&1) {
            LL x=s[0]-s[1];
            if (x>=MAX && ok(x)) printf("%lld\n",(x*n*m-(s[0]+s[1]))/2);
            else puts("-1");
        } else {
            if (s[0]!=s[1]) puts("-1");
            else {
                LL l=MAX,r=INF,mid;
                while (l<r) {
                    mid=(l+r)>>1;
                    if (ok(mid)) r=mid;
                    else l=mid+1;
                }
                printf("%lld\n",l*(n*m)/2-s[0]);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,k,s,t,ecnt=0,head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dis[MAXN][MAXK];
bool inq[MAXN][MAXK];
queue <int> q;
int spfa() {
    memset(dis,127,sizeof(dis));
    q.push(s<<10);
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        dis[s][i]=0;
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front()>>10,d=q.front()&1023;
        q.pop();
        inq[x][d]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to][d]>dis[x][d]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to][d]=dis[x][d]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to][d]) {
                    inq[e[now].to][d]=1;
                    q.push((e[now].to<<10)|d);
                }
            }
            if (d<k && dis[e[now].to][d+1]>dis[x][d]) {
                dis[e[now].to][d+1]=dis[x][d];
                if (!inq[e[now].to][d+1]) {
                    inq[e[now].to][d+1]=1;
                    q.push((e[now].to<<10)|(d+1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans=0x7f7f7f7f;
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        ans=min(ans,dis[t][i]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    read(s);
    read(t);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    printf("%d\n",spfa());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

int n,head[MAXN],sum[MAXN],a[MAXN],s,h,t,ans=0,ecnt=0;

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    int dep=++t;
    sum[dep]=sum[dep-1]+a[x];
    while (sum[dep]-sum[h]>s) h++;
    if (sum[dep]-sum[h]==s) ans++;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            int hh=h;
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
            h=hh;
        }
    }
    --t;
}

    read(s);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    sum[0]=0;
    h=t=0;
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 500005
#define P 19260817

int n, q;
char s[MAXN];
LL h[MAXN], p[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    p[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) h[i] = h[i - 1] * P + s[i], p[i] = p[i - 1] * P;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            for (int j = i; j <= n; j += i) {
                vis[j] = 1;
                num[j][cnt[j]++] = i;
            }
        }
    }
}

#define Ha(l, r) (h[r] - h[l] * p[r - (l)])

void work() {
    int l, r;
    while (q--) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int len = r - (--l), flag = (len > 1);
        while (flag) {
            flag = 0;
            for (int i = cnt[len] - 1; i > -1; i--) {
                int ta = len / num[len][i];
                if (Ha(l, r - ta) == Ha(l + ta, r)) {
                    flag = ta > 1, len = ta;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n", len);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    init();
    read(q);
    work();
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;

    f[0]=0;
    f[1]=1;
    M[0]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=90; i++) {
        f[i]=f[i-1]+f[i-2];

int find(LL x) {
    int l=4,r=90,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (f[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int query(LL x) {
    int k=M[x];
    if (k) return k;
    int q=find(x);
    return M[x]=min(query(x-f[q-1]),query(f[q]-x))+1;
}

//BZOJ2809.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define master 1
using namespace std;
char ch;
inline void read(int& a) {
    a=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
struct Tree {
    int cnt,L,R;
    long long total;
} t[MAXN*22];
int n,m,ecnt=0,dfscnt=0,tcnt=0;
int c[MAXN],l[MAXN],head[MAXN],st[MAXN],ed[MAXN],rt[MAXN];
int fuck[MAXN],fucker;
long long ans=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].cnt=0;
    t[now].total=0;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    t[now].L=build(l,mid);
    t[now].R=build(mid+1,r);
    return now;
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int val) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].L=t[x].L;
    t[now].R=t[x].R;
    t[now].cnt=t[x].cnt+1;
    t[now].total=t[x].total+val;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid)
        t[now].L=update(t[x].L,l,mid,p,val);
    else
        t[now].R=update(t[x].R,mid+1,r,p,val);
    return now;
}

int query(int tl,int tr,int l,int r,long long p) {
    if (l==r) {
        int Num=t[tr].cnt-t[tl].cnt;
        return min(Num,(int)(p/fuck[l]));
    }
    long long nowcost=t[t[tr].L].total-t[t[tl].L].total;
    if (nowcost>p)
        return query(t[tl].L,t[tr].L,l,(l+r)>>1,p);
    else
        return query(t[tl].R,t[tr].R,((l+r)>>1)+1,r,p-nowcost)+t[t[tr].L].cnt-t[t[tl].L].cnt;
}

int dfs(int x) {
    int st=++dfscnt,ed=st;
    rt[dfscnt]=update(rt[dfscnt-1],0,MAXN,(int)(lower_bound(fuck+1,fuck+fucker+1,c[x])-fuck),c[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        ed=dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    long long res=(long long)l[x]*query(rt[st-1],rt[ed],0,MAXN,m);
    if (ans<res)
        ans=res;
    return ed;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(c[0]);
    read(c[1]);
    read(l[1]);
    fuck[1]=c[1];
    for (int i=2,boss; i<=n; i++) {

        fuck[i]=c[i];
        add(boss,i);
    }

    sort(fuck+1,fuck+fucker+1);
    rt[0]=build(0,MAXN);
    dfs(master);
    printf("%lld",ans);
    return 0;
}

    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!mark[i]) {
            p[++pcnt]=i;
            phi[i]=i-1;
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt; j++) {
            if (i*p[j]>n) break;
            mark[i*p[j]]=1;
            if (i%p[j]==0) {
                phi[i*p[j]]=p[j]*phi[i];
                break;
            } else {
                phi[i*p[j]]=(p[j]-1)*phi[i];
            }
        }
    }
}

    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        ans+=(sum[n/p[i]])*2-1;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;

}

//BZOJ2820.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <bitset>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10000002

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt;
int mu[MAXN], f[MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = p[i]; j < MAXN; j += p[i])
            f[j] += mu[j / p[i]];
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] += f[i - 1];
}

int T;

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i)) + 1;
        ans += (long long)(f[j - 1] - f[i - 1]) * (n / i) * (m / i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2821.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define SQN 320
int n, c, m, sqn;
int a[MAXN], st[SQN], ed[SQN], tot = 0;
int sum[SQN][MAXN], f[SQN][SQN], tmp[MAXN];

int lastans = 0;

void init() {
    sqn = (int)sqrt(n) + 1;
    tot = n / sqn + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!st[i / sqn + 1]) st[i / sqn + 1] = i;
        ed[i / sqn + 1] = i;
    }
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        tmp[a[i]]++;
        if (i == ed[j]) memcpy(sum[j++] + 1, tmp + 1, c * 4);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int j = st[i], k = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if (tmp[a[j]]&1) ans++;
            else if (tmp[a[j]] != 0) ans--;
            tmp[a[j]]++;
            if (j == ed[k]) f[i][++k] = ans;
        }
    }
}

int work(int l, int r) {
    int bl = l / sqn + 1, br = r / sqn + 1, ret = f[bl + 1][br], cnt = 0;
    if (bl != br) {
        for (int i = l; i <= ed[bl]; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        for (int i = st[br]; i <= r; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= cnt; i = j) {
            j = i + 1;
            while (j <= cnt && tmp[j] == tmp[i]) j++;
            int tt = sum[br - 1][tmp[i]] - sum[bl][tmp[i]];
            if (tt > 0 && ~tt&1) ret--;
            tt += j - i;
            if (tt > 0 && ~tt&1) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= cnt; i = j) {
            j = i + 1;
            while (j <= cnt && tmp[j] == tmp[i]) j++;
            if ((~j^i)&1) ret++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(c);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    init();
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + lastans) % n + 1;
        r = (r + lastans) % n + 1;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        printf("%d\n", lastans = work(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2822.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 5005

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (num a) const {
        num ret=*this;
        for (int i=1; i<=a.len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]-=a.v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        for (int i=ret.len+1; i<len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        while (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[i]-=temp*10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (int a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i]*a;
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[i]-=temp*10;
            }
        }
        ret.len=len;
        while (ret.v[ret.len+1]) {
            ret.len++;
            if (ret.v[ret.len]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[ret.len]/10;
                ret.v[ret.len+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[ret.len]-=temp*10;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} ans(1);

#define MAXN 505

int n,pcnt=0,p[MAXN],minp[MAXN<<1],cnt[MAXN<<1];
bool notprime[MAXN<<1];

void init() {
    int nn=n<<1;
    for (int i=2; i<=nn; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            p[++pcnt]=i;
            minp[i]=pcnt;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=nn; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
                if (!minp[j]) minp[j]=pcnt;
            }
        }
    }
}

void calc(int x,int v) {
    while (x!=1) {
        cnt[minp[x]]+=v;
        x/=p[minp[x]];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    init();
    for (int i=2*n; i>n+1; i--) calc(i,1);
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) calc(i,-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        while (cnt[i]) ans=ans*p[i],cnt[i]--;
    }
    ans.print();
    return 0;
}

    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

typedef long long LL;
LL A=1234,B=101,C=107,M=19260817;
const double eps=1e-6;
int Rand() {
    A=(A*B+C)%M;
    return int(A);
}

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
} p[500005];
double dis(point a,point b) {
    return sqrt((a.x-b.x)*(a.x-b.x)+(a.y-b.y)*(a.y-b.y));
}
point mid(point a,point b) {
    return point((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2);
}

point center(point a,point b,point c) {
    double a1=b.x-a.x,b1=b.y-a.y,c1=(a1*a1+b1*b1)/2;
    double a2=c.x-a.x,b2=c.y-a.y,c2=(a2*a2+b2*b2)/2;
    double d=a1*b2-a2*b1;
    return (point) {
        a.x+(c1*b2-c2*b1)/d,a.y+(a1*c2-a2*c1)/d
    };
}
int n;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    point O=p[1];
    double r=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis(O,p[i])>eps+r) {
            O=p[i];
            r=0;
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++)
                if (dis(O,p[j])>eps+r) {
                    O=mid(p[i],p[j]);
                    r=dis(O,p[j]);
                    for (int k=1; k<j; k++) {
                        if (dis(O,p[k])>eps+r) {
                            O=center(p[i],p[j],p[k]);
                            r=dis(O,p[j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    printf("%.2lf %.2lf %.2lf\n",O.x,O.y,r);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2875.cpp
#include <iostream>

long long MOD,n,g,x0,a,c;

long long now[2][2],trans[2][2],temp[2][2];

inline long long exp(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ret=0;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) {
            ret=(ret+a)%MOD;
        }
        a=(a+a)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void fuck(long long a[2][2],long long b[2][2]) {
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<2; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+exp(a[i][k],b[k][j]))%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

inline void quickpower(long long x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            fuck(now,trans);
        }
        fuck(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>MOD>>a>>c>>x0>>n>>g;
    trans[0][0]=a;
    trans[0][1]=0;
    trans[1][0]=c;
    trans[1][1]=1;
    now[0][0]=1;
    now[1][1]=1;
    quickpower(n);
    cout<<((exp(x0,now[0][0])+now[1][0])%MOD)%g<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define eps 1e-12

int n;
D E, s[MAXN], K[MAXN], v[MAXN], x[MAXN];

bool check(D lam) {
    D ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        D l = max(0., v[i]), r = 1e9;
        while (r - l > eps) {
            D mid = (l + r) / 2;
            if (2 * lam * K[i] * mid * mid * (mid - v[i]) >= 1) r = mid;
            else l = mid;
        }
        x[i] = l;
        ret += K[i] * s[i] * (x[i] - v[i]) * (x[i] - v[i]);
    }
    return ret >= E;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%lf", &E);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf", s + i, K + i, v + i);
    }
    D l = 0, r = 1e9, mid;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid;
    }
    D ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += s[i] / x[i];
    printf("%.8lf\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2879.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 45
#define MAXM 105
#define MAXP 805
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next, to, w, flow;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * MAXM];

int n, m, ecnt = 1, S = 0, T = 1, sum = 0, node, ans = 0;
int p[MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXM], head[MAXN * MAXP], name[MAXN * MAXP], tot[MAXM];

#define dish(x) (x + 1)

void add(int u, int v, int w, int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].flow = flow;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].flow = 0;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(dish(i), T, 0, p[i]);
    node = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        add(S, ++node, 0, 1);
        name[node] = i;
        tot[i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            add(node, dish(j), a[j][i], 1);
        }
    }
}

int dis[MAXN * MAXP], pre[MAXN * MAXP], pos[MAXN * MAXP];
bool inq[MAXN * MAXP];
queue <int> q;

bool spfa() {
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, node * 4);
    memset(pre + 1, 0, node * 4);
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

void addAns() {
    int c = INF;
    for (int x = T;; x = pre[x]) {
        e[pos[x]].flow--, e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        if (pre[x] == S) {
            c = name[x];
            break;
        }
    }
    ans += dis[T];
    tot[c]++;
    name[++node] = c;
    add(S, node, 0, 1);
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        add(node, dish(j), a[j][c] * tot[c], 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i]), sum += p[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    init();
    while (spfa()) addAns();
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {

    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {

        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 45
#define MAXM 105
#define MAXP 805
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct statu {
    int c, v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int w, int e) : c(w), v(e) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v > a.v;
    }
};

int n, m, ans = 0;
int p[MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXM], level[MAXM], sum = 0;
priority_queue<statu> q[MAXN];

void dij() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        level[i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            q[j].push(statu(i, a[j][i]));
        }
    }
    while (sum--) {
        printf("Left : %d\n", sum);
        int val = INF, tag = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (p[i]) {
                while (!q[i].empty()) {
                    int c = q[i].top().c, v = q[i].top().v;
                    if (a[i][c] * level[c] != v) q[i].pop();
                    else {
                        if (v < val) val = v, tag = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ans += val;
        int c = q[tag].top().c;
        q[tag].pop();
        printf("%d %d", c, tag);
        level[c]++;
        p[tag]--;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            q[i].push(statu(c, a[i][c] * level[c]));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i]), sum += p[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    dij();
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2929.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 205

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
int tag[MAXN],cur[MAXN];
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(1);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[1]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[n]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==n) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(1,INF);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,cnt; i<n; i++) {
        read(cnt);
        for (int j=1,x; j<=cnt; j++) {
            read(x);
            if (i==1 || x==n) add(i,x,1);
            else add(i,x,INF);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",dinic());
    return 0;
}

struct acm {
    int cnt;
    int next[30005][2];
    int fail[30005],danger[30005],q[30005];
    bool vis[30005],ins[30005];
    char ch[30005];
    acm() {
        cnt=1;
        for(int i=0; i<2; i++)next[0][i]=1;
    }
    void insert() {
        scanf("%s",ch);
        int now=1,l=strlen(ch);
        for(int i=0; i<l; i++) {
            if(!next[now][ch[i]-'0'])next[now][ch[i]-'0']=++cnt;
            now=next[now][ch[i]-'0'];
        }
        danger[now]=1;
    }
    void buildfail() {
        int head=0,tail=1;
        q[0]=1;
        fail[0]=1;
        while(head!=tail) {
            int now=q[head];
            head++;
            for(int i=0; i<2; i++) {
                int v=next[now][i];
                if(!v) {
                    next[now][i]=next[fail[now]][i];
                    continue;
                }
                int k=fail[now];
                while(!next[k][i])k=fail[k];
                fail[v]=next[k][i];
                danger[v]|=danger[next[k][i]];
                q[tail++]=v;
            }

        }
    }
    bool dfs(int x) {
        cerr << x << endl;
        ins[x]=1;
        for(int i=0; i<2; i++) {
            int v=next[x][i];
            if(ins[v])return 1;
            if(vis[v]||danger[v])continue;
            vis[v]=1;
            if(dfs(v))return 1;
        }
        ins[x]=0;
        return 0;
    }
} acm;

//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        acm.insert();
    acm.buildfail();
    if(acm.dfs(1))puts("TAK");
    else puts("NIE");
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 30005

bool vis[MAXN];

void insert() {
    scanf("%s" , s + 1);
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    int x = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] ^ '0';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    vis[x] = 1;

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    t[0][0] = t[0][1] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = 1;
    fail[0] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            int to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) t[x][i] = t[fail[x]][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                vis[to] |= vis[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
}

    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int to = t[x][i];
        if (inq[to]) return 1;
        if (vis[to]) continue;
        vis[to] = 1;
        if (dfs(to)) return 1;
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    return 0;
}

inline int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';

    }

int n;

struct sam {
    int cnt,last;
    int fa[4005],a[4005][27],mx[4005],len[4005],ans[4005];
    int v[4005],q[4005];
    sam() {
        last=++cnt;
    }
    void extend(int c) {
        int p=last,np=last=++cnt;
        mx[np]=mx[p]+1;
        while(!a[p][c]&&p)a[p][c]=np,p=fa[p];
        if(!p)fa[np]=1;
        else {
            int q=a[p][c];
            if(mx[p]+1==mx[q])fa[np]=q;
            else {
                int nq=++cnt;
                mx[nq]=mx[p]+1;
                memcpy(a[nq],a[q],sizeof(a[q]));
                fa[nq]=fa[q];
                fa[np]=fa[q]=nq;
                while(a[p][c]==q)a[p][c]=nq,p=fa[p];
            }
        }
    }
    void pre() {
        for(int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)ans[i]=mx[i];
        for(int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)v[mx[i]]++;
        for(int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)v[i]+=v[i-1];
        for(int i=cnt; i; i--)q[v[mx[i]]--]=i;
    }
    void solve() {
        scanf("%s",ch+1);
        memset(len,0,sizeof(len));
        int l=strlen(ch+1),p=1,tmp=0;
        for(int i=1; i<=l; i++) {
            int c=ch[i]-'a';
            while(!a[p][c]&&p)p=fa[p];
            if(p==0)p=1,tmp=0;
            else tmp=min(tmp,mx[p])+1,p=a[p][c];
            len[p]=max(len[p],tmp);
        }
        for(int i=cnt; i; i--)len[fa[q[i]]]=max(len[fa[q[i]]],len[q[i]]);
        for(int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)ans[i]=min(ans[i],len[i]);
    }
} sam;
int main() {
    n=read();
    scanf("%s",ch+1);
    int l=strlen(ch+1);
    for(int i=1; i<=l; i++)sam.extend(ch[i]-'a');
    sam.pre();
    for(int i=1; i<n; i++)sam.solve();
    int ans=0;
    for(int i=1; i<=sam.cnt; i++)
        ans=max(ans,sam.ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 9999
#define K 26
struct SAM {
    int t[MAXN * 2][K], tot, dis[MAXN * 2], fa[MAXN * 2], ans[MAXN * 2];
    int last;
    int qq[MAXN * 2], tmp[MAXN * 2];
    SAM () {
        last = ++tot;
    }
    void add(int x) {
        int p = last, np = ++tot;
        last = np, dis[np] = dis[p] + 1;
        for ( ; p && !t[p][x]; p = fa[p]) t[p][x] = np;
        if (!p) fa[np] = 1;
        else {
            int q = t[p][x];
            if (dis[q] == dis[p] + 1) fa[np] = q;
            else {
                int nq = ++tot;
                dis[nq] = dis[p] + 1;
                memcpy(t[nq], t[q], K * 4);
                fa[nq] = fa[q], fa[np] = fa[q] = nq;
                for ( ; t[p][x] == q; p = fa[p]) t[p][x] = nq;
            }
        }
    }
    void build() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) tmp[dis[i]]++;
        for (int i = tot - 1; ~i; i--) tmp[i] += tmp[i + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) qq[tmp[dis[i]]--] = i;
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) ans[i] = dis[i];
    }
} T;

int n, m, dd[MAXN * 2];
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    m = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) T.add(s[i] - 'a');
    T.build();

    for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        memset(dd + 1, 0, T.tot * 4);
        int x = 1, now = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            int to = s[i] - 'a';
            if (T.t[x][to]) x = T.t[x][to], now++;
            else {
                while (x && !T.t[x][to]) x = T.fa[x];
                if (!x) x = 1, now = 0;
                else now = min(T.dis[x], now) + 1, x = T.t[x][to];
            }
            dd[x] = max(dd[x], now);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) {
            T.ans[T.qq[i]] = min(T.ans[T.qq[i]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
            dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]] = max(dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) ans = max(ans, T.ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2946hash.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define LEN 2005
#define P 83
int n,len[6],maxlen=0;
char s[6][LEN];
LL ha[6][LEN],pp[LEN],ck[6][LEN*5];

bool check(int mid) {
    int tot[6]= {0},pos[6]= {1,1,1,1,1,1};
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=mid; j<=len[i]; j++) {
            ck[i][++tot[i]]=ha[i][j]-ha[i][j-mid]*pp[mid];
        }
        sort(ck[i]+1,ck[i]+tot[i]+1);
    }
    while (pos[1]<=tot[1]) {
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            while (pos[i]<tot[i] && ck[i][pos[i]+1]<=ck[1][pos[1]]) pos[i]++;
            if (ck[i][pos[i]]!=ck[1][pos[1]]) flag=0;
        }
        if (flag) return 1;
        pos[1]++;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s[i]+1);
        len[i]=(int)strlen(s[i]+1);
        ha[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=len[i]; j++) {
            ha[i][j]=ha[i][j-1]*P+s[i][j];
        }
        maxlen=max(maxlen,len[i]);
    }
    pp[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=maxlen; i++) pp[i]=pp[i-1]*P;
    int l=0,r=maxlen,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 10319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int b, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - b + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

        scanf("%d",&k);
