//BZOJ2953.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 30005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, dep[MAXN], fa[15][MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < 15; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[0][x]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            fa[0][e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = 14; ~i; i--) if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) u = fa[i][u], v = fa[i][v];
    return fa[0][u];
}

#define dis(x, y) (dep[x] + dep[y] - 2 * dep[lca(x, y)])

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1);
    read(m);
    int x = 1, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(y);
        ans += dis(x, y);
        x = y;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 19940417
#define inv2 9970209
#define inv6 3323403
LL getsum(LL x) {
    LL ret=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=x/(x/i);
        ret=(ret+(((x/i)*(i+j))%MOD)*(((j-i+1)*inv2)%MOD))%MOD;
    }
    return (x*x-ret+MOD)%MOD;
}
LL powersum(LL x) {
    return (((x*(x+1)%MOD)*(2*x+1))%MOD*inv6)%MOD;
}

LL fuck(LL x,LL y) {
    LL ret=0,fret=0;
    LL mm=min(x,y),xy=(x*y)%MOD;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=mm; i=j+1) {
        j=min(x/(x/i),y/(y/i));
        LL a=x/i,b=y/j,sum=(((i+j)*(j-i+1))%MOD*inv2)%MOD,ab=(a*b)%MOD;
        ret=(ret+xy*(j-i+1)+(MOD+powersum(j)-powersum(i-1))*ab)%MOD;
        fret=(fret+(a*y+b*x)%MOD*sum)%MOD;
    }
    if (ret<fret) return MOD+ret-fret;
    else return ret-fret;
}

LL n,m,ans=0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL sumn=getsum(n),summ=getsum(m);
    ans=(sumn*summ)%MOD;
    ans=(ans-fuck(n,m)+MOD)%MOD;
    printf("%d\n",int(ans));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2957ac.cpp
//It is made by ljh2000
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <ctime>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define RG register
const int MAXN = 100011;
int n,m,ans,pos;
double val;
struct node {
    double maxl;
    int cnt;
} a[MAXN*4];

inline int getint() {
    RG int w=0,q=0;
    RG char c=getchar();
    while((c<'0' || c>'9') && c!='-') c=getchar();
    if(c=='-') q=1,c=getchar();
    while (c>='0' && c<='9') w=w*10+c-'0', c=getchar();
    return q ? -w : w;
}

inline void build(int root,int l,int r) {
    if(l==r) return ;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    int lc=root*2,rc=lc+1;
    build(lc,l,mid);
    build(rc,mid+1,r);
}

inline int calc(int root,int l,int r,double height) {
    if(l==r) return a[root].maxl>height;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    int lc=root*2,rc=lc+1;
    if(a[lc].maxl<=height) return calc(rc,mid+1,r,height);
    return calc(lc,l,mid,height)+a[root].cnt-a[lc].cnt;
}

inline void update(int root,int l,int r) {
    if(l==r) {
        a[root].maxl=val;
        a[root].cnt=1;
        return ;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    int lc=root*2,rc=lc+1;
    if(pos<=mid) update(lc,l,mid);
    else update(rc,mid+1,r);
    a[root].maxl=max(a[lc].maxl,a[rc].maxl);
    a[root].cnt=a[lc].cnt+calc(rc,mid+1,r,a[lc].maxl);
}

inline void work() {
    n=getint();
    m=getint();
    int x,y;
    build(1,1,n);
    while(m--) {
        x=getint();
        y=getint();
        pos=x;
        val=(double)y/x;
        update(1,1,n);
        printf("%d\n",a[1].cnt);
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define N 105
#define NN (N * N / 2 + N)
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
    bool f;
} e[N * N * 5];

int head[NN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v,  w, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -w, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int S = 0, T = 1, node;

#define TOP 8191
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
int q[TOP + 1], dis[NN], pre[NN];
bool inq[NN];

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, (node + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    dis[q[0] = S] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q[(ta++) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

int solve() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f = 0, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;
int a[N][N], p[N][N], d[N];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    node = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            int to = ++node;
            add(to, T, 0);
            if (a[i][j] == 0) add(j + 1, to, 0), d[j]++;
            else if (a[i][j] == 1) add(i + 1, to, 0), d[i]++;
            else add(i + 1, to, 0), p[i][j] = ecnt, add(j + 1, to, 0), d[i]++, d[j]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < d[i]; j++) add(S, i + 1, j);
    }
    printf("%d\n", n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6 - solve());
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (a[i][j] == 2) {
                if (e[p[i][j]].f) a[i][j] = 1;
                else a[i][j] = 0;
                a[j][i] = 1 - a[i][j];
            }
            printf("%d%c", a[i][j], j == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    read(K);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int xmid = n & 1 ? (n + 1) >> 1 : -1, ymid = m & 1 ? (m + 1) >> 1 : -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= (n + 1) >> 1; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= (m + 1) >> 1; j++) {
            D x1 = D(i - 1) / n, x2 = 1. / n, x3 = D(n - i) / n;
            D y1 = D(j - 1) / m, y2 = 1. / m, y3 = D(m - j) / m;
            D a = x1 * y1, b = x1 * y2, c = x1 * y3, d = x2 * y1, f = x2 * y3, g = x3 * y1, h = x3 * y2, e = x3 * y3;
            ans += (1 - pow(a * (a + d + g + b + c)
                            + b * (a + b + c)
                            + c * (a + b + c + f + e)
                            + d * (a + d + g)
                            + f * (c + f + e)
                            + g * (a + d + g + h + e)
                            + h * (g + h + e)
                            + e * (g + h + e + c + f), K)) * (1 + (i != xmid) + (j != ymid) + (i != xmid && j != ymid));
        }
    printf("%.0lf\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2986.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 1000000

int p[MAXN + 5], mu[MAXN + 5], pcnt = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

void shake() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] <= MAXN; j++) {
            if (i % p[j]) vis[i *p[j]] = 1, mu[i * p[j]] = mu[i] * mu[p[j]];
            else {
                vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

LL K;

bool ck(LL mid) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (LL i = 1; i * i <= mid; i++) {
        ret += mu[i] * (mid / i / i);
    }
    return mid - ret >= K;
}

int main() {
    shake();
    read(K);
    LL l = 4, r = LL(3e10);
    while (l < r) {
        LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ck(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3012_dc.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 200319
#define LOG	18

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int q[MAXN], Fa[MAXN], siz[MAXN], he, ta;

int getrt(int u) {
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = u;
    Fa[u] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        siz[x] = 1;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && Fa[x] != e[now].to) {
                Fa[e[now].to] = x;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = ta - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int x = q[i];
        if (siz[x] * 2 >= ta) return x;
        siz[Fa[x]] += siz[x];
    }
    return u;
}

int n, Q, A, a[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN][LOG], fae[MAXN * 2][LOG];
int fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], est[MAXN * 2], eed[MAXN * 2];
LL ftot[MAXN], etot[MAXN];
int depth[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN][LOG];
pair<int, LL> fl[MAXN * LOG], el[MAXN * LOG * 2];
int fcnt = 0, Ecnt = 0;

bool cmp(const pair<int, LL> &u, const pair<int, LL> &v) {
    return a[u.first] < a[v.first];
}

void solve(int u, int dep) {
    u = getrt(u);
    vis[u] = 1;
    depth[u] = dep;
    fa[u][dep] = u;
    fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(u, 0ll);
    fst[u] = fcnt;
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            he = ta = 0;
            q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            Fa[e[now].to] = u;
            dis[e[now].to][dep] = e[now].w;
            est[now] = Ecnt + 1;
            while (he < ta) {
                int x = q[he++];
                fae[x][dep] = now;
                fa[x][dep] = u;
                fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                el[++Ecnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                for (int i = head[x]; i; i = e[i].next) {
                    if (!vis[e[i].to] && e[i].to != Fa[x]) {
                        dis[e[i].to][dep] = dis[x][dep] + e[i].w;
                        Fa[e[i].to] = x;
                        q[ta++] = e[i].to;
                    }
                }
            }
            eed[now] = Ecnt;
            sort(el + est[now], el + eed[now] + 1, cmp);
        }
    }
    fed[u] = fcnt;
    sort(fl + fst[u], fl + fed[u] + 1, cmp);
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to, dep + 1);
    }
}

int find(pair<int, LL> li[], int l, int r, int x) {
    int mid;
    r++;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[li[mid].first] > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

LL get(pair<int, LL> li[], int st, int ed, int L, int R, LL d) {
    int l = find(li, st, ed, L), r = find(li, st, ed, R);
    return li[r].second - li[l].second + d * (r - l);
}

LL work(int x, int L, int R) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = depth[x]; i >= 0; i--) {
        int p = fa[x][i];
        ret += get(fl, fst[p], fed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
        if ((p = fae[x][i]))
            ret -= get(el, est[p], eed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    solve(1, 0);
    for (int i = 2; i <= fcnt; i++) fl[i].second += fl[i - 1].second;
    for (int i = 2; i <= Ecnt; i++) el[i].second += el[i - 1].second;
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, L, R; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(L);
        read(R);
        L = int((L + ans) % A);
        R = int((R + ans) % A);
        if (L > R) swap(L, R);
        L--;
        printf("%lld\n", ans = work(u, L, R));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3038.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v;
    bool w;
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].w = t[t[x].l].w | t[t[x].r].w;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else scanf("%lld", &t[x].v), t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    return x;
}

LL sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

void kill(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!t[x].w) return;
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].v = LL(sqrt(t[x].v));
        t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        kill(t[x].l, l, mid);
        kill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return kill(x, l, r);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    build(1, n);
    scanf("%d", &m);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        if (op) printf("%lld\n", sum(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

        int pp = i;

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXM 10000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fll
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,s,head[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN],t[MAXN<<1];

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        x<<=1;
        if (t[x^1]<t[x]) x^=1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

void update(int x,LL v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) if (t[x]>v) t[x]=v;
        else return;
}
void del(int x) {
    x+=s;
    t[x]=INF;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)^1]);
}

bool visit[MAXN];
inline long long dijkstra() {
    update(1,0);
    int x=1;
    while (x) {
        visit[x]=1;
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        if (x==n) return dis[x];
        del(x);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to+s]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                update(e[now].to,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
    return -1;
}

        b=max(y%n+1,y%n+1);
        e[i].to=b;
        e[i].next=head[a];
        e[i].w=100000000-100*a;
        head[a]=i;
    }

//BZOJ3041.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1};
typedef long long LL;
int n;
int map[8][8],ans;
bool used[6],ansed;
LL now,lim;
#define istrue(x,y,z) (((x>>(y<<3))>>z)&1)
#define mark(x,y,z) (x|=((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z))
#define remove(x,y,z) (x&=(-1llu)^(((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z)))
#define inrange(x,y) (x>-1 && x<n && y>-1 && y<n)
void dfs(int x,int y,int c) {
    mark(now,x,y);
    remove(lim,x,y);
    for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (inrange(tox,toy) && !istrue(now,tox,toy)) {
            if (map[tox][toy]==c) dfs(tox,toy,c);
            else mark(lim,tox,toy);
        }
    }
}

int get_dif() {
    memset(used,0,sizeof(used));
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (!istrue(now,i,j) && !used[map[i][j]]) {
                used[map[i][j]]=1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

bool fill(int c) {
    bool flag=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (istrue(lim,i,j) && map[i][j]==c) {
                flag=1;
                dfs(i,j,c);
            }
        }
    return flag;
}

void idas(int step) {
    int dfc=get_dif();
    if (!dfc) ansed=1;
    if (step+dfc>ans || ansed) return;
    LL nn=now,ll=lim;
    for (int i=0; i<=5; i++) {
        if (fill(i)) idas(step+1);
        now=nn,lim=ll;
    }
}

int main() {
    while (1) {
        scanf("%d",&n);
        if (!n) break;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
            }
        }
        now=0,lim=0;
        dfs(0,0,map[0][0]);
        ansed=0;
        for (ans=0;; ans++) {
            idas(0);
            if (ansed) {
                printf("%d\n",ans);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3083.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN],val[MAXN];
int maxs[MAXN],siz[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;
int lt[MAXN],rt[MAXN];
int t[524288],lazy[524288],lch[524288],rch[524288],tcnt=0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (lazy[x]) {
        t[lch[x]]=t[rch[x]]=lazy[x];
        lazy[x]=0;
    }
}

inline void pushup(int x) {
    t[x]=min(t[lch[x]],t[rch[x]]);
}

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now]=val[l];
        return now;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    lch[now]=build(l,mid);
    rch[now]=build(mid+1,r);
    pushup(now);
    return now;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R,int v) {
    if (l==L && r==R) {
        t[x]=lazy[x]=v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid,v);
    if (r>mid) update(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R,v);
    pushup(x);
}

int query(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R) {
    if (l==L && r==R) return t[x];
    if (lazy[x]) return t[x];
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    int ret=0x7fffffff;
    if (l<=mid) ret=query(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid);
    if (r>mid) ret=min(ret,query(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R));
    return ret;
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            if (siz[v]>=maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=siz[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    lt[x]=dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    val[dfn]=a[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    rt[x]=dfn;
}

void init() {
    fa[1]=1;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    build(1,n);
}

int nowrt=1;

void __update(int u,int v,int w) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        update(1,tid[top[u]],tid[u],1,n,w);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[v]<dep[u]) {
        swap(u,v);
    }
    update(1,tid[u],tid[v],1,n,w);
}

int findtheson(int x,int r) {
    while (top[r]!=top[x]) {
        r=top[r];
        if (fa[r]!=x) r=fa[r];
        else break;
    }
    if (fa[r]==x) return tid[r];
    else return tid[x]+1;
}

int __query(int x) {
    if (nowrt==x) {
        return t[1];
    } else if (tid[nowrt]<lt[tid[x]] || tid[nowrt]>rt[tid[x]]) {
        return query(1,lt[tid[x]],rt[tid[x]],1,n);
    } else {
        int theson=findtheson(x,nowrt);
        int ret=0x7fffffff;
        if (lt[theson]>1) ret=query(1,1,lt[theson]-1,1,n);
        if (rt[theson]<n) ret=min(ret,query(1,rt[theson]+1,n,1,n));
        return ret;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&nowrt);
    for (int i=1,opt,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&opt);
        if (opt==1) {
            scanf("%d",&nowrt);
        } else if (opt==2) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
            __update(u,v,w);
        } else {
            scanf("%d",&u);
            printf("%d\n",__query(u));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        c[p] = x;
        x->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd();
    inline void revIt() {
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    inline void addIt(int v) {
        ;
    }
    inline void relax() {
        if (rev) {

        }
    }

inline void Node::setf(Node *f) {
    fa = null;
    top = f;
    isrt = 1;
}
inline void Node::upd() {
    siz = 1;
    sum = val, E = (LL)val * val;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) if (c[i] != null) {
            E += c[i]->E + (LL)sum * c[i]->sum;
            sum += c[i]->sum;
        }
}
inline void Node::relax() {
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt();
        c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

inline Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->sum = ptr->E = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = ptr->isrt = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) fa->isrt = 0, x->isrt = 1, x->top = fa->top;
}

void pushto(NOde *a) {
    if (a != null) {
        pushto(a->fa);
        x->relax();
    }
}

inline void splay(Node *x) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa()->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = x; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setf(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->rev();
}

#define MAXN 1000005
int n;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

bool check(int x) {
    printf("x = %d\n",x);
    memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
    int need=x,more=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=x; i++) {
        if (a[i]>x) more++;
        else {
            cnt[a[i]]++;
            if (cnt[a[i]]==1) need--;
            else if (cnt[a[i]]>1) more++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",need,more);
    if (need==0 && more==0) return 1;
    for (int i=x+1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (a[i-x]>x) more--;
        else {
            cnt[a[i-x]]--;
            if (cnt[a[i-x]]==1) more--;
            else if (cnt[a[i-x]]==0) need++;
            if (a[i-x]>x) more--;
        }
        cnt[a[i]]++;
        if (a[i]>x) {
            more++;
        } else {
            if (cnt[a[i]]==1) need--;
            else if (cnt[a[i]]>1) more++;
        }

        printf("%d %d\n",need,more);
        if (need==0 && more==0) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);

        int x = a[i];
        for (int j = 30; j > -1 && x; j--) {
            if ((x>>j)&1) {
                if (tmp[j]) x ^= tmp[j];
                else {
                    tmp[j] = x;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!x) ans += a[i];

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3107ac.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int Digit(int x) {
    int re=0;
    while(x)
        ++re,x>>=1;
    return re;
}
int Count(int x) {
    int re=0;
    while(x)
        x^=x&-x,++re;
    return re;
}
int main() {
    //freopen("3107.in","r",stdin);
    //freopen("3107.out","w",stdout);
    int x,y,z,limit,ans;
    cin>>x>>y>>z;
    limit=max( max( Digit(x) , Digit(y) ) , Digit(z) );
    x=Count(x);
    y=Count(y);
    z=Count(z);
    if(x<y) swap(x,y);
    if(z<=y) ans=((1<<x)-1)+((1<<z)-1|((1<<y-z)-1<<x));
    else if(z<=x) ans=((1<<x)-1)+((1<<y)-1<<z-y);
    else if(z<=x+y) ans=((1<<x)-1<<z-x)+((1<<z-x)-1|((1<<x+y-z)-1<<z+z-x-y));
    else ans=-1;
    if(Digit(ans)>limit) ans=-1;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;

    read(m);

#define MAXN 100319

typedef long long LL;

int n, m, nt = 0;
int st[MAXN], tem[MAXN];

#define find(x) int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1, x) - tem)

struct node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN * 233];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy++;
        t[x].v += r - l + 1;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v; // pushup
}

LL query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, rt;
} T[MAXN * 2 + 1];

int Tcnt = 0;

int Build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++Tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        T[x].l = Build(l, mid);
        T[x].r = Build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void Update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int ql, int qr) {
    update(T[x].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) Update(T[x].l, l, mid, p, ql, qr);
        else Update(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, ql, qr);
    }
}

int select(LL k, int ql, int qr) {
    int x = 1, l = 1, r = nt, mid;
    LL rs;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rs = query(T[T[x].r].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
        if (rs < k) r = mid, x = T[x].l, k -= rs;
        else l = mid + 1, x = T[x].r;
    }
    return l;
}

int op[MAXN], a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL c[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op[i]);
        read(a[i]);
        read(b[i]);
        read(c[i]);
        if (op[i] == 1) tem[++nt] = (int)c[i];
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1);
    nt = (int)(unique(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1) - tem - 1);
    Build(1, nt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (op[i] == 1) Update(1, 1, nt, find(c[i]), a[i], b[i]);
        else printf("%d\n", tem[select(c[i], a[i], b[i])]);
    }
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 23333

int n, tot;
int pre[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], st[MAXN], ed[MAXN], node;
int t[MAXN / 2], m[MAXN / 2], p[MAXN / 2]
void newNode(int from, int to, int l, int r) {
    nxt[from] = ++node;
    pre[node] = from;
    pre[to] = node;
    nxt[node] = to;
    st[node] = l, ed[node] = r;
}

bool cmp(int x, int y) {
    return t[x] + p[x] < t[y] + p[y];
}

priority_queue <int, vector <int>, cmp> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    newNode(0, 0, 0, n);
    long long now = 0;

        read(T);
        read(M);
        read(P);
        m[++task] = M, p[++task] = P;
        if (!T && !M && !P) break;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.top();
            if (now + t[x] + p[x] <= T) {
                now += t[x] + p[x];
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3123.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 80319
#define LOG 17

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * LOG * LOG];

int rt[MAXN], tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];
int fa[LOG][MAXN], *Fa = fa[0], dep[MAXN], f[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], tot;

int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int x, int y, int lca, int flca, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[y].l].v - t[t[flca].l].v - t[t[lca].l].v;
    if (k <= ls) return query(t[x].l, t[y].l, t[lca].l, t[flca].l, l, mid, k);
    else return query(t[x].r, t[y].r, t[lca].r, t[flca].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    rt[x] = update(rt[Fa[x]], 1, tot, a[x]);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != Fa[x]) {
            Fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv), swap(u, v);
    f[fu] += f[fv];
    f[fv] = fu;
    Fa[v] = u;
    dep[v] = dep[u] + 1;
    dfs(v);
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG - 1; ~i; i--) if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) {
            u = fa[i][u];
            v = fa[i][v];
        }
    return Fa[u];
}

int n, m, T;
char s[3];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        dep[i] = 1, f[i] = -1, rt[i] = update(0, 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        add(x, y);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, x, y, k; i <= T; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        if (s[0] == 'Q') {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(k);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans, k ^= ans;
            int lca = LCA(x, y);
            printf("%d\n", ans = tmp[query(rt[x], rt[y], rt[lca], rt[Fa[lca]], 1, tot, k)]);
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans;
            add(x, y);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN];
LL dep[MAXN];
int maxd = 1;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (dep[x] > dep[maxd]) maxd = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, fa[e[now].to] = x, dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

LL get(int x, int y) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != y && e[now].to != fa[x]) ret = max(ret, get(e[now].to, -1) + e[now].w);
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, a, b, c; i < n; i++) read(a), read(b), read(c), add(a, b, c);
    int L, R;
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    L = maxd;
    dep[L] = fa[L] = 0;
    dfs(L);
    R = maxd;
    printf("%lld\n", dep[R]);
    int x = R, y = R;
    while (x != L) {
        LL d = get(fa[x], x);
        x = fa[x];
        if (d == dep[y] - dep[x]) R = x;
        if (d == dep[x]) L = x;
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (R != L) ret++, R = fa[R];
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3131ac.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<queue>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 400010, MOD = 1000000007;
int s[15], top, cnt;
long long n, m, f[15][MAXN][2], Hash[MAXN], g[MAXN], ans;
struct Heapnode {
    int x, y;
    long long v;
    Heapnode(int x = 0, int y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {
        v = g[x]*g[y];
    }
    bool operator < (const Heapnode &rhs) const {
        return v < rhs.v;
    }
};
priority_queue<Heapnode> q;

inline long long read() {
    long long x = 0, f = 1;
    char ch = getchar();
    for(; ch<'0' || ch>'9'; ch=getchar()) if(ch == '-') f=-1;
    for(; ch>='0'&&ch<='9'; ch=getchar()) x = x*10 + ch-'0';
    return x * f;
}

void dfs(int cur, int len, long long res) {
    if(len == top) {
        Hash[cnt++] = res;
        return;
    }
    if(!res) return;
    int i;
    for(i = cur; i < 10; i++)
        dfs(i, len+1, res * i);
}

bool cmp(long long a, long long b) {
    return a > b;
}

int main() {
    int i, j, k;
    n = read(), m = read();
    long long u = n;
    while(u) {
        s[++top] = u % 10;
        u /= 10;
    }
    Hash[++cnt] = 0;
    dfs(0, 0, 1);
    sort(Hash+1, Hash+cnt+1);
    cnt = unique(Hash+1, Hash+cnt+1)-Hash-1;
    f[0][2][0] = 1;
    for(i = 0; i < top; i++)
        for(j = 1; j <= cnt; j++)
            for(k = 0; k <= 1; k++)
                if(f[i][j][k])
                    for(int x = i == 0 ? 0 : 1; x < 10; x++) {
                        int r = lower_bound(Hash+1, Hash+cnt+1, Hash[j]*x)-Hash;
                        f[i+1][r][(k+x)>s[i+1]] += f[i][j][k];
                    }
    for(i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        for(j = 1; j < top; j++)
            g[i] += f[j][i][0] + f[j][i][1];
        g[i] += f[top][i][0];
    }
    sort(g+1, g+cnt+1, cmp);
    q.push(Heapnode(2, 2));
    while(!q.empty() && m) {
        Heapnode u = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans = (ans + u.v)%MOD;
        if(!(--m)) break;
        if(u.x != u.y) {
            ans = (ans + u.v)%MOD;
            if(!(--m)) break;
            q.push(Heapnode(u.x+1, u.y));
        }
        if(u.x == 2) q.push(Heapnode(u.x, u.y+1));
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline int max(int a, int b) {

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000000007

LL n;
int K;

int len, a[22];
void getlen(LL x) {
    while (x) {
        a[len++] = int(x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
}

int tot = 0;
LL b[211000];
int tr[11000][10];

void dfs(LL mul, int dep, int x) {
    if (mul > n) return;
    if (dep == len) b[++tot] = mul;
    else {
        while (x < 10) {
            dfs(mul * x, dep + 1, x);
            x++;
        }
    }
}

LL f[14][11000][2];
LL g[11000];

struct Node {
    int fir, sec;
    LL v;
    Node () {}
    Node (int x, int y) {
        fir = x;
        sec = y;
        v = g[fir] * g[sec];
    }
    bool operator < (const Node &r) const {
        return v < r.v;
    }
};

priority_queue <Node> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    getlen(n);
    dfs(1, 0, 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + tot + 1);
    tot = (int)(unique(b + 1, b + tot + 1) - b - 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= 9; j++) {
            LL mul = b[i] * j;
            tr[i][j] = int(lower_bound(b + 1, b + tot + 1, mul) - b);
            if (tr[i][j] > tot) tr[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    f[0][1][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (f[i][j][k]) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= 9; x++) {
                        f[i + 1][tr[j][x]][(k + x) > a[i]] += f[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < len; j++) {
            g[i] += f[j][i][0] + f[j][i][1];
        }
        g[i] += f[len][i][0];
    }

    sort(g + 1, g + tot + 1);
    q.push(Node(tot, tot));
    LL ans = 0;
    while (K--) {
        Node x = q.top();
        q.pop();
        (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
        if (x.fir < x.sec && K) {
            K--;
            (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
            q.push(Node(x.fir, x.sec - 1));
        }
        if (x.sec == tot) q.push(Node(x.fir - 1, x.sec));
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3140.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 15319

struct Point {
    int x, y, z;
} p[MAXN];

int a, b, c, t, swap_tag, pcnt, ans;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int dfn = 0;

int s[MAXN], mat[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

bool find(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (vis[e[now].to] != dfn) {
            vis[e[now].to] = dfn;
            if (!mat[e[now].to] || find(mat[e[now].to])) return mat[e[now].to] = x, 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void check(int st, int cnt) {
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * b);
    ecnt = 0;
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) if (!((st >> p[i].x) & 1) && s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] != st) add(p[i].y, p[i].z), s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i <= b && ans > cnt; i++) ++dfn, cnt += find(i);
    ans = cnt;
}

void work() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    if (a <= b && a <= c) swap_tag = 0;
    else if (b <= a && b <= c) swap_tag = 1;
    else swap_tag = 2;
    pcnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0, x; i < a; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < b; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < c; k++) {
                read(x);
                if (x) p[++pcnt] = (Point) {
                    i, j, k
                };
            }
    if (swap_tag == 1) {
        swap(a, b);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].y);
    } else if (swap_tag == 2) {
        swap(a, c);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].z);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) p[i].y++, p[i].z++;
    t = 1 << a;
    ans = a;
    memset(s, -1, sizeof s);
    for (int i = 0, cnt; i < t; i++) if ((cnt = __builtin_popcount(i)) < ans) check(i, cnt);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

//BZOJ3143.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 505
typedef double LD;
const LD eps = 1e-9;
struct edge {
    int u, v;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

struct Equa {
    LD v[MAXN];
    LD &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m, d[MAXN];

void gauss() {
    n--;
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    n++;
}

LD w[MAXN * MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v);
        a[e[i].u][e[i].v] = a[e[i].v][e[i].u] = -1;
        d[e[i].u]++, d[e[i].v]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < n; ++j)
            if (d[j]) a[i][j] = a[i][j] / d[j];
        a[i][i] = 1, a[i][0] = 0;
    }
    a[1][0] = 1;
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (d[i]) a[i][0] /= d[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        w[i] = a[e[i].u][0] + a[e[i].v][0];
    }
    sort(w + 1, w + m + 1);
    LD ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans += w[i] * (m - i + 1);
    printf("%.3lf\n", (double)ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005

int n;
LL f[MAXN], a[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(2 * f[j] + (LL)j * j + j - 2 * f[k] - (LL)k * k - k) / (j - k);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < 2 * i) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + LL(i - j) * (i - j - 1) / 2 + a[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

#define MAXN 262144
#define MOD 1000000007

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
} A[MAXN], B[MAXN];

int R[MAXN];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++ ) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step = Comp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

struct Pam {
    int nxt[MAXN / 2][2];
    int fail[MAXN / 2], cnt[MAXN / 2], len[MAXN / 2], S[MAXN / 2];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p][0] = nxt[p][1] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        n = p = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        int &now = nxt[cur][c];
        if (!now) {
            fail[p] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
        }
        last = now;
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) {
            cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
        }
    }
} T;

char s[MAXN / 2];
int N, n, tot[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

void work(char x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        A[i] = B[i] = Comp(i < N ? (s[i] == x) : 0, 0);
    }
    FFT(A, n, 1);
    FFT(B, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A[i] * B[i];
    FFT(A, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tot[i] += int(A[i].r + 0.5);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    N = (int) strlen(s);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) T.add(s[i] - 'a');
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p - 1; i > 1; i--) ans = (ans - T.cnt[i]) % MOD;
    for (n = 2; n < N; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 1;
    getR(n);
    work('a');
    work('b');
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = (ans + power(2, (tot[i] + 1) / 2) - 1) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", int((ans + MOD) % MOD));
    return 0;
}

    LL x,y;

        LL tx,ty;

        read(ty);
        x=tx+ty;
        y=tx-ty;
    }

    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        p[i].input();
        xx[i]=p[i].x;
        yy[i]=p[i].y;
    }
    sort(xx+1,xx+n+1);
    sort(yy+1,yy+n+1);

    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) sumy[i]=sumy[i-1]+yy[i];

        LL ret=0;
        int px=int(lower_bound(xx+1,xx+n+1,p[i].x)-xx-1);

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1}, dt[] = {'D', 'U', 'R', 'L'};

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[29 * 29 * 4 * 2];

int head[29 * 29], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m, node = 1;
int G[29][29];
char s[29];

queue <int> q;
bool inq[29 * 29];
int dis[29 * 29], pre[29 * 29];

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * node);
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] <= node;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            add(S, G[i][j] = ++node, 0);
            add(++node, T, 0);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int tx = (i + dx[d] + n) % n, ty = (j + dy[d] + m) % m;
                if (dt[d] == s[j]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 0);
                else add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", MCMF());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319
#define LOG 21

char s[MAXN];

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char hhh[56 * 1024];

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], Log[MAXN];

int st[LOG][MAXN];

#define rmq(l, r) min(st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][l], st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][r - (1 << Log[r - (l) + 1]) + 1])

void getsa(int n) {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], c[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = c[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; c[i + k] == c[j + k]; k++);
    }

    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, q = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (q << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            st[k][i] = min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + q]);
    }
}

int n, p[MAXN], len[MAXN], Len;

int query(int x, int y) {

    int ret = 1, l, r, mid;
    l = 1, r = x + 1;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= y) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    ret += x - l + 1;

    l = x, r = Len;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x + 1, mid) >= y) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    ret += l - x;

    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = p[i - 1] + len[i - 1] + 1;
        s[p[i] - 1] = '$';
        scanf("%s", s + p[i]);
        len[i] = (int)strlen(s + p[i]);
    }
    Len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa(Len);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", query(rk[p[i]], len[i]));
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, 1, -1, -1, 2, 2, -2, -2}, dy[] = {2, -2, 2, -2, 1, -1, 1, -1};

#define MAXN 205
#define NN MAXN * MAXN
struct edge {
    int next, to;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 8 * 4];

int head[NN], cur[NN], ecnt = 1;
const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, G[MAXN][MAXN], node = 1;

char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[NN], tag[NN];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * node);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x] && dfs(e[now].to)) {
            e[now].f = 0;
            e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        for (int now = head[S]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '0') {
                G[i][j] = ++node;
                if ((i ^ j) & 1) add(S, node);
                else add(node, T);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1 + (i & 1); j <= n; j += 2) if (G[i][j]) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
                    int tx = i + dx[d], ty = j + dy[d];
                    if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && G[tx][ty]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty]);
                }
            }
    }
    printf("%d\n", node - 1 - dinic());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000000
#define INF 1000000000
typedef long long LL;
int n,p;
int prime[200000],lowp[MAXN+5],pcnt=0,pl;

void init() {
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!lowp[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            lowp[i]=i;
            if (i==p) pl=pcnt;
            if (i>1000) continue;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=MAXN; j+=i) if (!lowp[j]) lowp[j]=i;
        }
    }
}

void vio() {
    n--;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (i*p>INF) break;
        if (lowp[i]>=p) n--;
        if (!n) {
            printf("%d\n",i*p);
            return;
        }
    }
    puts("0");
}

LL tot=0,kk;

void dfs(int x,LL val,int f) {
    if (val>kk) return;
    if (x==pl) {
        tot+=kk/val*f;
    } else {
        dfs(x+1,val,f);
        dfs(x+1,val*prime[x],-f);
    }
}

bool check(int mid) {
    tot=0;
    kk=mid/p;
    dfs(1,1,1);
    return tot>=n;
}

void work() {
    int l=1,r=INF+1,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>INF) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n",l);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    init();
    if (p>1000) vio();
    else work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3196.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define NODE 1500005
#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, cnt, val;
    Node() : siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[NODE], *Stack[NODE], **Top = Stack, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void init(int top) {
    for (Node *i = mem + top; (i--) != mem; *(Top++) = i);
}

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = *(--Top);
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->val = v, x->siz = x->cnt = 1;
    return x;
}

void release(Node *x) {
    *(Top++) = x;
}

struct Splay {
    Node *root;
    int l, r;
    Splay(): root(null), l(0), r(0) {}
    int size() {
        return root->siz - 2;
    }
    void init() {
        root = newNode(-INF);
        root->setc(newNode(INF), 1);
    }
    void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *fa = x->fa;
        int dir = x->dir();
        fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
        fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
        x->setc(fa, !dir);
        fa->upd();
        if (fa == root) root = x;
    }

    void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
        while (x->fa != fa) {
            if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
            else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }

    Node* select(int k) {
        for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
            int s = x->c[0]->siz;
            if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
            else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
            else return x;
        }
    }

    Node* get(Node* L, Node* R) {
        splay(L);
        splay(R, L);
        return R->c[0];
    }

    Node* leq(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v >= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v >= (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* geq(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v <= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v <= (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* prev(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* succ(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* find(int v) {
        for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
            if (x->val == v) {
                splay(x);
                return x;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = root, *y = null;
            while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
            (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), v > y->val));
            splay(x);
        }
    }
    void del(int v) {
        Node *x = find(v);
        if (!(--x->cnt)) {
            Node *y = x->c[0];
            while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
            splay(y, x);
            y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
            release(x);
        } else x->upd();
    }
} t[262144];

struct QAQ {
    int v, p;
    QAQ() {}
    QAQ(int a, int b): v(a), p(b) {}
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return p < a.p;
    }
} a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];

int n, m;
int num[MAXN], tem[MAXN * 2], lim = 0, tcnt = 0;

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid].p);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void merge(int lpos, int midpos, int rpos) {
    int cnt = 0, i = lpos, j = midpos;
    while (i < midpos && j < rpos) {
        if (a[i].p < a[j].p) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
        else tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    }
    while (i < midpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
    while (j < rpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    i = lpos, j = 0;
    while (j < cnt) a[i++] = tmp[j++];
}

int build(int l, int r, int lpos, int rpos) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1, midpos = int(lower_bound(a + lpos, a + rpos, QAQ(mid + 1, -INF)) - a);
        t[x].l = build(l, mid, lpos, midpos);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, midpos, rpos);
        merge(lpos, midpos, rpos);
    }
    QAQ L = QAQ(0, -INF), R = QAQ(0, INF);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    t[x].root=build(lpos - 1, rpos);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    return x;
}

int getSiz(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].get(t[x].prev(sl), t[x].succ(sr))->siz;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), sl, sr);
    if (qr > mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, sl, sr);
    return ret;
}

int getKth(int x, int l, int r, int k, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ls = getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, l, mid, sl, sr);
    if (k <= ls) return getKth(t[x].l, l, mid, k, sl, sr);
    else return getKth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls, sl, sr);
}

void delVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].del(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) delVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else delVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

void addVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].add(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) addVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else addVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

struct Query {
    int opt, l, r, k;
} Q[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init((n + m) * 15);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].v);
        a[i].p = i;
        tem[++lim] = a[i].v;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(Q[i].opt);
        if (Q[i].opt == 3) {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].k);
        } else {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].r);
            read(Q[i].k);
        }
        if (Q[i].opt != 2) tem[++lim] = Q[i].k;
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1);
    lim = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1) - tem);
    tem[0] = -INF, tem[lim] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].v = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, a[i].v) - tem);
        num[a[i].p] = a[i].v;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    build(0, lim, 1, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, opt, l, r, k, pos; i <= m; i++) {
        opt = Q[i].opt;
        l = Q[i].l;
        r = Q[i].r;
        k = Q[i].k;
        switch (opt) {
        case 1:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, k - 1, l, r) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, k, l, r)]);
            break;
        case 3:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            delVal(1, 0, lim, l, num[l]);
            addVal(1, 0, lim, l, k);
            num[l] = k;
            break;
        case 4:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem) - 1;
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r), l, r)]);
            break;
        case 5:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r) + 1, l, r)]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005

struct query {
    int x,y,id;
    LL ha;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }
} q[MAXN];
int n,m,k,tcnt=0;
int a[MAXN];
LL ha[MAXN],mi;
bool ans[MAXN];
LL hh(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=ha[r]-ha[l-1]*mi;
    return ret;
}
void getHash(LL &ret) {
    ret=0;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=k; i++) {
        read(x);
        ret=ret*19260817+x;
    }
}
map<LL,int> Tree;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    ha[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*19260817+a[i];
    }
    mi=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) mi=mi*19260817;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].y);
        getHash(q[i].ha);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int i=k,j=1;
    while (j<=m && q[j].y<k) j++;
    for (; i<=n; i++) {
        Tree[hh(i-k+1,i)]=i;
        while (j<=m && q[j].y==i) {
            if (Tree[q[j].ha]>=q[j].x+k-1) ans[q[j].id]=1;
            j++;
        }
    }
    for (i=1; i<=m; i++)
        if (ans[i]) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3211.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
int n,m,a[MAXN],tcnt=0;
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[s<<1];
LL sum[s<<1];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    } else {
        t[now].v=a[l]>1;
    }
    return now;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        sum[s+i]=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        sum[i]=sum[i<<1]+sum[(i<<1)|1];
    }
    build(1,n);
}

LL query(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=sum[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=sum[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void dec(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) sum[x]-=d;
}

void work(int now,int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) {
        int to=int(sqrt(sum[l+s]));
        dec(l,int(sum[l+s])-to);
        if (to<=1) t[now].v=0;
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) work(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) work(rch,mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    }
}

void update(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (!t[now].v) return;
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        work(now,l,r);
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) update(lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) update(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x==1) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(l,r));
        } else {
            update(1,1,n,l,r);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 5011

struct edge {
