int head[MAXN * 18], ecnt = 1, cur[MAXN * 18];

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 18];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, tcnt;
int rt[MAXN];
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], W[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], P[MAXN];
int tmp[MAXN * 3], tot = 0;

int nowx;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (pre) add(pre, x, INF);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) add(t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p), x, INF);
        else add(t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p), x, INF);
    } else add(nowx * 2, x, INF);
    return x;
}

void Link(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(x, nowx * 2 + 1, INF);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Link(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) Link(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

int q[MAXN * 18], tag[MAXN * 18];

inline bool bfs() {
    register int he, ta, x, now;
    for (x = 1; x <= tcnt; x++) tag[x] = 0;
    tag[S] = 1;
    q[he = ta = 1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[++ta] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow, ret;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 0; i <= tcnt; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int ans = 0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]), read(b[i]), read(W[i]), read(L[i]), read(R[i]), read(P[i]);
        tmp[++tot] += a[i];
        tmp[++tot] = L[i];
        tmp[++tot] = R[i];
        ans += W[i];
        ans += b[i];
    }
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1) - tmp - 1);
    tcnt = 2 * n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, 2 * i, W[i]);
        add(2 * i, T, b[i]);
        add(2 * i + 1, 2 * i, P[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        L[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, L[i]) - tmp);
        R[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, R[i]) - tmp);
        nowx = i;
        Link(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, L[i], R[i]);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1500000

struct node {
    int data,l,r,fa,rev,size;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):data(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),rev(0),size(0) {}
} a[MAXN];

int n,m,root,tot;

inline void pushup(int x) {
    a[x].size=a[a[x].l].size+a[a[x].r].size+1;
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (a[x].rev) {
        a[x].rev=0;
        swap(a[x].l,a[x].r);
        a[a[x].l].rev^=1;
        a[a[x].r].rev^=1;
    }
}

void build(int &x,int fa,int l,int r) {
    if (l>r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    x=++tot;
    a[x]=node(mid-1,fa);
    build(a[x].l,x,l,mid-1);
    build(a[x].r,x,mid+1,r);
    pushup(x);
}

inline void zig(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].l=a[x].r;
    a[a[x].r].fa=y;
    a[x].r=y;
    if (y==a[z].l) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void zag(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].r=a[x].l;
    a[a[x].l].fa=y;
    a[x].l=y;
    if (a[z].l==y) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void splay(int x,int s) {
    pushdown(x);
    while (a[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=a[x].fa;
        int z=a[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==a[z].l) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==a[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int rank(int x,int k) {
    printf("%d %d %d\n",x,k,a[x].size);
    pushdown(x);
    int s=a[a[x].l].size;
    if (k==s+1) return x;
    if (k<=s) return rank(a[x].l,k);
    return rank(a[x].r,k-s-1);
}

inline void reverse(int l,int r) {
    int x=rank(root,l),y=rank(root,r+2);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    a[a[y].l].rev^=1;
}

void dg(int x) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (a[x].l) dg(a[x].l);
    if (a[x].data>0 && a[x].data<=n) printf("%d ",a[x].data);
    if (a[x].r) dg(a[x].r);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    build(root,0,1,n+2);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
        reverse(l,r);
    }
    dg(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223_Pointers.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val;
    bool rev;
    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->rev ^= 1, c[1]->rev ^= 1;
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, m;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(mid);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1);
    Node *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    x->relax();
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (0 < x->val && n >= x->val) printf("%d ", x->val);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        Node *range = get(l, r);
        range->revIt();
        splay(range);
    }
    dfs(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223_Structure.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
struct Node {
    int c[2], fa, siz, val;
    bool rev;
    inline void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}
} t[MAXN];

int n, m, tcnt = 0, root = 0;

inline void setc(int fa, int ch, int p) {
    t[ch].fa = fa;
    t[fa].c[p] = ch;
}

inline bool dir(int x) {
    return t[t[x].fa].c[1] == x;
}

inline void relax(int x) {
    if (t[x].rev) {
        swap(t[x].c[0], t[x].c[1]);
        t[t[x].c[0]].rev ^= 1, t[t[x].c[1]].rev ^= 1;
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}
inline void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz = t[t[x].c[0]].siz + t[t[x].c[1]].siz + 1;
}

inline int newNode(int v) {
    t[++tcnt].siz = 1;
    t[tcnt].c[0] = t[tcnt].c[1] = t[tcnt].fa = 0;
    t[tcnt].val = v;
    return tcnt;
}

inline int build(int l, int r) {
    if (l>r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int x = newNode(mid);
    setc(x, build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    setc(x, build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    pushup(x);
    return x;
}

inline void rot(int x) {
    int fa = t[x].fa;
    relax(fa), relax(x);
    int d = dir(x);
    setc(t[fa].fa, x, dir(fa));
    setc(fa, t[x].c[!d], d);
    setc(x, fa, !d);
    pushup(fa);
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

inline void splay(int x, int fa = 0) {
    while (t[x].fa != fa) {
        if (t[t[x].fa].fa == fa) rot(x);
        else dir(x) == dir(t[x].fa) ? (rot(t[x].fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    pushup(x);
}

inline int select(int k) {
    for (int x = root; ; ) {
        relax(x);
        int s = t[t[x].c[0]].siz;
        if (k < s) x = t[x].c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = t[x].c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

inline int get(int l, int r) {
    int L = select(l - 1), R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R,L);
    return t[R].c[0];
}

void dfs(int x) {
    relax(x);
    if (t[x].c[0]) dfs(t[x].c[0]);
    if (0 < t[x].val && n >= t[x].val) printf("%d ", t[x].val);
    if (t[x].c[1]) dfs(t[x].c[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        int range = get(l, r);
        t[range].revIt();
        splay(range);
    }
    dfs(root);

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct node {
    int v,l,r,fa,cnt,siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):v(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),cnt(0),siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];
void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;
}
//void pushdown(int x) {} // No need of pushdown
int n,m,root=0,tcnt=0;
void zig(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    if (y==t[z].l) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x,int s) {
    //pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v,0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
            //pushdown(x);
            t[x].siz++;
            if (t[x].v>v) {
                if (!t[x].l) {
                    t[x].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].l;
            } else {
                if (!t[x].r) {
                    t[x].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].r;
            }
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x,0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        //pushdown(x);
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else {
            if (x!=root) splay(x,root);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root,ret=0;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v),x=kth(rr),z=kth(rr+1),y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}
int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x,0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}
int pre(int v) { // lower_bound(v-1);
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}
int nxt(int v) { //upper_bound(v);
    int cnt=count_less(v),x=kth(cnt+1);
    if (t[x].v>v) return t[x].v;
    else return t[kth(cnt+1+t[x].cnt)].v;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n",count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n",t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n",pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n",nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;

int n, m, root=0, tcnt=0;

int newNode(int fa,int v) {
    t[++tcnt]=node(fa,v,1);

/*********** XXX: \B8\FC\C8\DD\D2?\C7\D2\E4\B5?��, \C4\E3\CF\EB?\B8\F6\D3\EF\BE\E4\B5\C4\D2\E2\D2\E5 ********/
void zig(int x) {	   // x is lc(y)
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    (y == t[z].l) ? (t[z].l = x) : (t[z].r = x);
    t[x].fa = z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    t[y].fa=x;
    pushup(y);
}

/*********** XXX: ?\C9\CF ********/
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

// ?\D0\D0233
void splay(int x, int s) {
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(x)) : (zag(x));
            break;
        } else if (y==t[z].l) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(y)) : (zag(x));
            zig(x);
        } else {
            (x==t[y].r) ? (zag(y)) : (zig(x));
            zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x, 0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}

    if (!root) {

        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v, 0);
        t[root].cnt=1;

    } else {

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return splay(x, 0), x;
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root, ret=0;
    while (x) {
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v), x=kth(rr), z=kth(rr+1), y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x, 0);
    splay(y, root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}

void dzydel(int v) {

    if (!(--t[x].cnt)) {
        int y = t[x].l;
        while (t[y].r) y = t[y].r;
        splay(y, x); // now y does not have a right child
        root = y, t[y].fa = 0, t[y].r = t[x].r, t[t[x].r].fa = y;
        pushup(y); // possibly other pushups as well
    } else pushup(x);
}

//BZOJ3224_ka.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;
char ch = 0;
char buf[20 << 20], *Now = buf, *End;
char wb[20 << 20], *ptr = wb;
struct IO {
    IO () {
        End = buf + fread(buf, 1, 20 << 20, stdin);
    }
    ~IO () {
        fwrite(wb, 1, ptr - wb, stdout);
    }
} I_O;

#define getchar() (*Now++)

inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') a = a * 10 + ch - '0', ch = getchar();
}

#define putchar(x) (*ptr++=x)

inline void pr(int x) {
    static char sta[11];
    int top = 0, tmp;
    if (x < 1) {
        if (x) putchar('-'), putchar('1');
        else putchar('0');
    } else {
        while (x) {
            tmp = x / 10;
            sta[++top] = char('0' + x - tmp * 10);
            x = tmp;
        }
        while (top) putchar(sta[top--]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

#define MAXN 300005
struct data {
    int x,p;
    inline bool operator < (const data &a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=2,Log,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[MAXN];

#define insert(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) ++t[x];}
#define del(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) --t[x];}

inline int rk(int x) {
    int ret = 1;
    for (--x; x; x -= x & -x) ret += t[x];
    return ret;
}

inline int get_rk(int k) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int j = 1 << Log, to; j; j >>= 1) {
        to = ret | j;
        if (to <= tot && k > t[to]) k -= t[ret = to];
    }
    return rev[ret + 1];
}

#define pre(x) get_rk(rk(x) - 1)
#define nxt(x) get_rk(rk(x))

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(opt[i]);
        read(num[i]);
        if (opt[i]==5) num[i]++;
        if (opt[i]!=2) {
            tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
            tem[cnt].p=i;
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    num[tem[1].p]=2;
    rev[2]=tem[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
            num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
            rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
        } else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
    }
    rev[tot + 1] = rev[1] = -1;
    for (Log = 0; tot >> Log; Log++);
    Log--;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        switch (opt[i]) {
        case 0:
            insert(num[i]);
            break;
        case 1:
            del(num[i]);
            break;
        case 3:
            pr(rk(num[i])-1);
            break;
        case 2:
            pr(get_rk(num[i]));
            break;
        case 4:
            pr(pre(num[i]));
            break;
        case 5:
            pr(nxt(num[i]));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224_Pointers.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull , *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr->cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *f = null) {
    while (x->fa != f) {
        if (x->fa->fa == f) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[x->val < v]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x -> c[v > x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v > x->val];
        if (v > x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v >= x->val];
        if (v < x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) {
        root = newNode(v);
        root->fa = null;
    } else {
        Node *x = root, *y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(int v) {
    Node *x = find(v);
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x->c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}
/*
// Slower! version
int count_less(int v) {
	Node *x = root; int ret = 0;
	while (x != null) {
		if (v > x->val)  ret += x->c[0]->siz + x->cnt;
		x = x->c[v > x->val];
	}
	return ret;
}
Node* pre(int v) {
	return select(count_less(v) - 1);
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
	return select(count_less(v + 1));
}
*/

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(y);
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

    for (int i=1,op,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&op,&y);
        if (op==1) {
            m[y]++;
            tot++;
        } else if (op==2) {
            if (!m[y]) {
                printf("Delete %d Failed\n",y);
                return 0;
            }
            m[y]--;
            tot--;
        } else if (op==3) {
            if (!m[y]) {
                printf("Rank : %d not exist\n",y);
                return 0;
            }
        } else if (op==4) {
            if (y>tot) {
                printf("Kth %d > %d\n",y,tot);
                return 0;
            }
        }

    }
    while (1);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readOP(int &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    a=ch;
}
inline void readRange(int &s,int &t) {
    bool flag1=0,flag2=0;
    while (ch!='(' && ch!='[') read(ch);
    if (ch=='(') flag1=1;
    read(s);
    read(t);
    while (ch!=')' && ch!=']') read(ch);
    if (ch==')') flag2=1;
    s=(s<<1)|flag1;
    t=(t<<1)-flag2;
}
int m,L=0,R=131072;

    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,s,t; i<=m; i++) {
        readOP(x);
        readRange(s,t);
        if (x=='U') fill(1,L,R,s,t);
        else if (x=='I') {
            if (s>L) clear(1,L,R,L,s-1);
            if (t<R) clear(1,L,R,t+1,R);
        } else if (x=='D') clear(1,L,R,s,t);
        else if (x=='C') {
            if (s>L) clear(1,L,R,L,s-1);
            if (t<R) clear(1,L,R,t+1,R);
            reverse(1,L,R,s,t);
        } else if (x=='S') {
            reverse(1,L,R,s,t);
        }
    }
    printAns();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3236.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,sqn,blo[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN],blosum[MAXN],bloans[MAXN];
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];
int tot[MAXM],ans[MAXM];
struct data {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (data q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int query_sum(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            ret+=cnt[i];
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=blosum[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
    }
    return ret;
}
int query_cnt(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        blo[i]=i/sqn;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        tot[q[i].x]=query_sum(q[i].a,q[i].b);
        ans[q[i].x]=query_cnt(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d %d\n",tot[i],ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 200005
#define MAXK 100005

struct edge {
    int u, v, head;
} e[MAXM];

int n, m, K, head[MAXM];

struct Node {
    int t, next;
} ls[MAXK * 4];
int lcnt = 0;

void add(int x, int i) {
    ls[++lcnt].t = i;
    ls[lcnt].next = e[x].head;
    e[x].head = lcnt;
}

struct segNode {
    int l, r, head;
} t[262144];
int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

struct Query {
    int tag, next;
} q[(MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int qcnt = 0;

void addQuery(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        q[++qcnt].tag = v;
        q[qcnt].next = t[x].head;
        t[x].head = qcnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) addQuery(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) addQuery(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

struct stackNode {
    int pos, val;
} s[(MAXN + MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int top = 0;

int f[MAXN], tot = 0;

void modify(int p, int v) {
    s[++top].pos = p, s[top].val = f[p];
    f[p] = v;
}

int getf(int x) {
    while (f[x] > 0) x = f[x];
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        modify(fu, f[fu] + f[fv]);
        modify(fv, fu);
        tot++;
    }
}

void solve(int x, int l, int r) {
    int tmp = top;
    for (int now = t[x].head; now; now = q[now].next) merge(e[q[now].tag].u, e[q[now].tag].v);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else {
        puts(tot == n - 1 ? "Connected" : "Disconnected");
    }
    while (top > tmp) {
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        tot--;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
    }
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, c, x; i <= K; i++) {
        read(c);
        for (int j = 1; j <= c; j++) {
            read(x);
            add(x, i);
        }
    }
    build(1, K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x = K;
        for (int now = e[i].head; now; now = ls[now].next) {
            int y = ls[now].t;
            if (x > y) addQuery(1, 1, K, y + 1, x, i);
            x = y - 1;
        }
        if (x) addQuery(1, 1, K, 1, x, i);
    }
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    solve(1, 1, K);
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 500319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int n, sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa();
    h[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (h[sta[top]] >= h[i]) top--;
        if (top) L[i] = sta[top] + 1;
        else L[i] = 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (h[sta[top]] > h[i]) top--;
        if (top) R[i] = sta[top] - 1;
        else R[i] = n;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += i * LL(n - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ans -= 2ll * h[i] * (i - L[i] + 1) * (R[i] - i + 1);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define MOD 1000000007

LL power(LL a, LL b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void get(LL &a, LL &b) {
    a = 0, b = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    int stp = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        b = b * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
        if ((++stp & 7) == 0) a %= MOD, b %= MOD - 1;
    }
}

LL n, nn, m, mm, a, b, c, d;

int main() {
    get(n, nn);
    get(m, mm);
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    read(d);

    LL q, w;

    //cerr << a << " " << mm << " " << endl;

    q = power(a, mm + MOD - 2);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, mm - 1)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (m - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;
    a = c * q % MOD;
    b = (c * w + d) % MOD;

    //cerr << q << " " << w << " " << a << " " << b << endl;

    (++n) %= MOD;

    q = power(a, nn + MOD - 1);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, nn)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (n - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;

    LL ans = (q + w - d) * power(c, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3252ac.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K, a[MAXN], head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], rev[MAXN], ecnt;
LL ans = 0, vv[MAXN];
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], dfn = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x, LL tot) {
    L[x] = ++dfn;
    rev[dfn] = x;
    if (!head[x]) {
        vv[L[x]] = tot + a[x];
    } else {
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, tot + a[x]);
        }
    }
    R[x] = dfn;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v, lazy;
} t[524288];

int tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = vv[l];
    return x;
}

int get(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return ans += t[x].v, l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[t[x].l].v == t[x].v) return get(t[x].l, l, mid);
    else return get(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, LL v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += v, t[x].lazy += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ3252ac.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 0);
    build(1, n);
    vis[0] = 1;
    while (t[1].v > 0 && K--) {
        int x = rev[get(1, 1, n)];
        while (!vis[x]) {
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(1, 1, n, L[x], R[x], -a[x]);
            x = fa[x];
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K;
int head[MAXN], a[MAXN], son[MAXN], cnt = 0;
long long dep[MAXN], c[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    dep[x] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        if (dep[x] < dep[e[now].to]) {
            dep[x] = dep[e[now].to];
            son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
    dep[x] += a[x];
}

void Link(int x, bool ed) {
    if (!ed) c[++cnt] = dep[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], 1);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, 0);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ3252.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[i] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = i;
    }
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 0);
    sort(c + 1, c + cnt + 1, greater<long long>());
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(cnt, K); i++) ans += c[i];
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='A' && ch!='Q') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='A';
}

#define MAXN 600005
#define bitwise 24

struct node {
    int lch,rch,v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int n,m,tcnt=0;
int sum[MAXN],rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre,int num,int dep) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[pre].lch;
    t[now].rch=t[pre].rch;
    t[now].v=t[pre].v+1;
    if (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) t[now].rch=update(t[pre].rch,num,dep-1);
        else t[now].lch=update(t[pre].lch,num,dep-1);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int num) {
    int dep=bitwise,ret=0;
    while (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) {
            if (t[t[rx].lch].v-t[t[lx].lch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
            else lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
        } else {
            if (t[t[rx].rch].v-t[t[lx].rch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
            else lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
        }
        dep--;
    }
    dep=bitwise;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    rt[1]=update(0,0,bitwise);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]^a;
        rt[i+1]=update(rt[i],sum[i],bitwise);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r,x; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            n++;
            sum[n]=sum[n-1]^x;
            rt[n+1]=update(rt[n],sum[n],bitwise);
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(x);
            l--,x^=sum[n];
            printf("%d\n",query(rt[l],rt[r],x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include<iostream>

inline int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch>'9'||ch<'0') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
}
int n,m,t[200005],ans[100005];
struct data {
    int a,b,c,s,ans;
} a[100005],p[100005];
inline bool cmp(data a,data b) {
    if(a.a==b.a&&a.b==b.b)return a.c<b.c;
    if(a.a==b.a)return a.b<b.b;
    return a.a<b.a;
}
inline bool operator<(data a,data b) {
    if(a.b==b.b)return a.c<b.c;
    return a.b<b.b;
}
inline int lowbit(int x) {
    return x&(-x);
}
inline void update(int x,int num) {
    for(int i=x; i<=m; i+=lowbit(i))
        t[i]+=num;
}
inline int ask(int x) {
    int tmp=0;
    for(int i=x; i; i-=lowbit(i))
        tmp+=t[i];
    return tmp;
}
void solve(int l,int r) {
    if(l==r)return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    solve(l,mid);
    solve(mid+1,r);
    sort(p+l,p+mid+1);
    sort(p+mid+1,p+r+1);
    int i=l,j=mid+1;
    while(j<=r) {
        while(i<=mid&&p[i].b<=p[j].b) {
            update(p[i].c,p[i].s);
            i++;
        }
        p[j].ans+=ask(p[j].c);
        j++;
    }
    for(int j=l; j<i; j++)update(p[j].c,-p[j].s);
}

    m=read();
    for(int i=1; i<=N; i++)
        a[i].a=read(),a[i].b=read(),a[i].c=read();
    sort(a+1,a+N+1,cmp);
    int cnt=0;
    for(int i=1; i<=N; i++) {
        cnt++;
        if(a[i].a!=a[i+1].a||a[i].b!=a[i+1].b||a[i].c!=a[i+1].c) {
            p[++n]=a[i];
            p[n].s=cnt;
            cnt=0;
        }
    }
    solve(1,n);
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        ans[p[i].ans+p[i].s-1]+=p[i].s;
    for(int i=0; i<N; i++)
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3262.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

int ch=0;

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005

struct flower {
    int x,y,z,siz,ans;
    bool operator < (flower a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        else if (y!=a.y) return y<a.y;
        else return z<a.z;
    }
} a[MAXN],p[MAXN];

bool cmp(flower x,flower y) {
    if (x.z!=y.z) return x.y<y.y;
    else return x.z<y.z;
}

int n,k,tot[MAXN];
#define s 262144
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}
void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]=0;
}
int query(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int l=s,r=x+s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void cdq(int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    cdq(l,mid);
    cdq(mid+1,r);
    sort(p+l,p+mid+1,cmp);
    sort(p+mid+1,p+r+1,cmp);
    int i=l,j=mid+1;
    while (j<=r) {
        while (i<=mid && p[i].y<=p[j].y) {
            update(p[i].z,p[i].siz);
            i++;
        }
        p[j].ans+=query(p[j].z);
        j++;
    }
    for (i=l; i<=mid; i++) del(p[i].z);
}

//BZOJ3270.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 22
const double eps = 1e-9;

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN * MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN * MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

int n, m, S, T, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, cnt[MAXN], tag[MAXN][MAXN], tagcnt = 0;
double p[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
    cnt[u]++, cnt[v]++;
}

void build(int x, int y) {
    for (int nowx = head[x]; nowx; nowx = e[nowx].next) {
        int u = e[nowx].to;
        for (int nowy = head[y]; nowy; nowy = e[nowy].next) {
            int v = e[nowy].to;
            if (u != v) a[tag[x][y]][tag[u][v]] = (1.0 - p[u]) / cnt[u] * (1.0 - p[v]) / cnt[v];
        }
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[e[now].to][y]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[y];
    for (int now = head[y]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != x) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][e[now].to]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[x];
    a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] = -1;
    if (x != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] += p[x] * p[y];
}

void gauss() {
    int tot = tag[n][n], now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= tot && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > tot) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double t = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= tot; j++) a[now][j] /= t;
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            if (j != now && abs(a[j][i]) > eps) {
                t = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= tot; k++) a[j][k] -= t * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &S, &T);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", p + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            tag[i][j] = ++tagcnt;
        }
    a[tag[S][T]][0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            build(i, j);
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%.6lf ", a[tag[i][i]][0]);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 3005
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,S=0,T,a[MAXN],head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt=1;
void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}
int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}
int gcd(int x,int y) {
    if (y) return gcd(y,x%y);
    else return x;
}
#define power(x) (LL(x)*LL(x))

int main() {
    read(n);
    T=n+1;
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        if (a[i]&1) add(S,i,a[i]);
        else add(i,T,a[i]);
        tot+=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if ((a[i]^a[j])&1 && gcd(a[i],a[j])==1) {
                LL x=power(a[i])+power(a[j]);
                LL sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
                if (sqx*sqx==x) {
                    if (a[i]&1)	add(i,j,0x7fffffff);
                    else add(j,i,0x7ffffff);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

        if (c=='-') f=-1;
        c=getchar();
    }

inline bool cmp(int *y,int a,int b,int k) {
    int arank1=y[a];
    int brank1=y[b];
    int arank2=a+k>=len?-1:y[a+k];
    int brank2=b+k>=len?-1:y[b+k];
    return arank1==brank1&&arank2==brank2;
}
inline void make_sa() {
    int *x=t1,*y=t2;
    int m=256;
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) cc[i]=0;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) ++cc[x[i]=s[i]];
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) cc[i]+=cc[i-1];
    for (int i=len-1; ~i; i--) sa[--cc[x[i]]]=i;
    for (int k=1; k<len; k<<=1) {
        int p=0;
        for (int i=len-k; i<len; i++) y[p++]=i;
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++)
            if (sa[i]>=k) y[p++]=sa[i]-k;
        for (int i=0; i<m; i++) cc[i]=0;
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++) ++cc[x[y[i]]];
        for (int i=1; i<m; i++) cc[i]+=cc[i-1];
        for (int i=len-1; ~i; i--) sa[--cc[x[y[i]]]]=y[i];
        swap(x,y);
        x[sa[0]]=0;
        m=1;
        for (int i=1; i<len; i++)
            x[sa[i]]=cmp(y,sa[i-1],sa[i],k)?m-1:m++;
        if (m>=len) break;
    }
}
inline void make_height() {
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) rank[sa[i]]=i;
    height[0]=0;
    int k=0;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
        if (!rank[i]) continue;
        if (k) k--;
        int j=sa[rank[i]-1];
        while (s[i+k]==s[j+k]) k++;
        height[rank[i]]=k;
    }
}
inline void make_st() {
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++)
        f[i][0]=height[i];
    for (int j=1; j<=19; j++)
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++)
            if (i+(1<<j)-1<len)
                f[i][j]=min(f[i][j-1],f[i+(1<<(j-1))][j-1]);
}
inline int rmq(int l,int r) {
    int k=log2(r-l+1);
    return min(f[l][k],f[r-(1<<k)+1][k]);
}
inline bool judge(int x,int y) {
    int L,R;
    if (height[x+1]<y) R=x;
    else {
        int l=x+1,r=len-1;
        while (l<=r) {
            int mid=l+r>>1;
            if (rmq(x+1,mid)>=y) l=mid+1;
            else r=mid-1;
        }
        R=r;
    }
    if (height[x]<y) L=x;
    else {
        int l=0,r=x-1;
        while (l<=r) {
            int mid=l+r>>1;
            if (rmq(mid+1,x)>=y) r=mid-1;
            else l=mid+1;
        }
        L=l;
    }
    return rec[R]>=L;
}

    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=st[i]; j<=en[i]; j++)
            belong[j]=i;
    int t=1,k=0;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++)
        if (belong[sa[i]]) {
            if (!cnt[belong[sa[i]]]) k++;
            cnt[belong[sa[i]]]++;
            if (k>=K) {
                while (k-(cnt[belong[sa[t]]]==1)>=K) {
                    k-=(cnt[belong[sa[t]]]==1);
                    cnt[belong[sa[t++]]]--;
                }
                rec[i]=t;
            }
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        long long ans=0;
        int k=0;
        for (int j=st[i]; j<=en[i]; j++) {
            if (k) k--;
            while (k+1<=en[i]-j+1&&judge(rank[j],k+1)) k++;
            ans+=k;
        }
        printf("%lld ",ans);
    }

}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 400319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa(int n) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] != '$' && s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int t[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1, t[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
    }
}

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    //if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(t[Log[y - x]][x + 1], t[Log[y - x]][y - (1 << Log[y - x]) + 1]);
}

int n, K, len;
int st[MAXN], ed[MAXN], bel[MAXN];
int cnt[MAXN], pre[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = st[i]; j < ed[i]; j++) bel[j] = i;
    int i = 1, j = 0, tot = 0;
    while (bel[sa[j + 1]]) {
        tot += !cnt[bel[sa[++j]]], ++cnt[bel[sa[j]]];
        while (tot >= K) --cnt[bel[sa[i]]], tot -= !cnt[bel[sa[i++]]];
        pre[j] = i - 1;
    }
}

inline bool check(int x, int L) {
    int l_, r_;
    int l = x, r = len;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x, mid) >= L) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    r_ = l;
    l = 1, r = x;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= L) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    l_ = l;
    return pre[r_] >= l_;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st[i] = ed[i - 1] + 1;
        scanf("%s", s + st[i]);
        ed[i] = st[i] + (int)strlen(s + st[i]);
        s[ed[i]] = '$';
    }
    len = ed[n];
    getsa(len);
    getst(len);
    init();
    for (int p = 1; p <= n; p++) {
        int k = 0;
        LL ans = 0;
        for (int i = st[p]; i < ed[p]; i++, ans += k) {
            for (k -= !!k; k < ed[p] - i && check(rk[i], k + 1); k++);
        }
        printf("%lld ", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

            for (int a=1; a<=i; a++)
                for (int b=1; b<=j; b++) {
                    if (a!=i || b!=j) {
                        s=(s+((g[a][b][k]*C[i][a])%MOD)*C[j][b])%MOD;
                    }
                }
            g[i][j][k]=(C[i*j][k]-s)%MOD;
            if (g[i][j][k]<0) g[i][j][k]+=MOD;
        }
}

long long dp[15][35][35];

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&c);
    dp[0][0][0]=1;
    int tot=0;
    for (int t=1,cc; t<=c; t++) {
        scanf("%d",&cc);
        tot+=cc;
        if (cc==0) {
            t--,n--;
            continue;
        }
        if (cc>n*m) {
            puts("0");
            return 0;
        }
        if (!visit[cc]) initg(cc);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (g[i][j][cc]) {
                    for (int a=0; a+i<=n; a++)
                        for (int b=0; b+j<=m; b++) {
                            if (dp[t-1][a][b]) {
                                dp[t][a+i][b+j]=(dp[t][a+i][b+j]+((dp[t-1][a][b]*g[i][j][cc])%MOD)*((C[a+i][i]*C[b+j][j])%MOD))%MOD;
                            }
                        }
                }
            }
    }
    if (n*m<tot) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    if (tot==0) {
        puts("1");
        return 0;
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            ans=(ans+dp[c][i][j]*((C[n][i]*C[m][j])%MOD))%MOD;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3295.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

struct element {
    int num,val,t,ans;
} a[MAXN];

inline bool byNum(element a,element b) {
    return a.num>b.num;
}
inline bool byVal(element a,element b) {
    return a.val<b.val;
}
inline bool reNum(element a,element b) {
    return a.num>b.num;
}
inline bool reVal(element a,element b) {
    return a.val>b.val;
}
inline bool byT(element a,element b) {
    return a.t>b.t;
}
int n,m,s=131072,list[MAXN],t[262144];

inline void update(int x) {
    for (t[x+=s]++,x>>=1; x>0; t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1],x>>=1);
}
inline void clear(int x) {
    for (t[x+=s]=0,x>>=1; x>0; t[x]=0,x>>=1);
}
inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

long long rev=0;
inline void getrev() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        rev+=query(a[i].val,n);
        update(a[i].val);
    }
    memset(t,0,sizeof(t));
    return;
}

void cdq(int l,int r,bool (*cmp)(element,element)) {
    if (l==r)
        return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    cdq(l,mid,cmp);
    cdq(mid+1,r,cmp);
    sort(a+l,a+mid+1,cmp);
    sort(a+mid+1,a+r+1,cmp);
    for (int i=mid+1,j=l; i<=r; i++) {
        while (j<=mid && cmp(a[j],a[i])) {
            update(a[j++].t);
        }
        a[i].ans+=query(1,a[i].t);
    }
    for (int i=l; i<=mid; i++)
        clear(a[i].t);
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i].num=i;
        scanf("%d",&a[i].val);
        list[a[i].val]=i;
        a[i].t=1;
        a[i].ans=0;
    }
    getrev();
    for (int i=m+1,now; i>1; i--) {
        scanf("%d",&now);
        a[list[now]].t=i;
    }
    cdq(1,n,reVal);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,reNum);
    cdq(1,n,byVal);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,byT);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n",rev);
        rev-=a[i].ans;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3332.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

char BUF[1 << 25], *buf = BUF, *end = BUF;

#define getchar() gtc()

inline int getchar() {
    if (buf == end) {
        buf = BUF;
        end = BUF + fread(BUF, 1 << 25, 1, stdin);
    }
    return *buf++;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    register int ch = getchar();
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') {
            getchar();
            a = -1;
            return;
        }
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0') {
        a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0');
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 300319
struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
} e[MAXM], E[MAXM];

struct List {
    int he, ta;
} L[MAXN];

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], G[MAXN][MAXN];

void Sort() {
    static int P[32768];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i < 32768; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[e[i].w]++;
    for (i = 32766; i; i--) P[i] += P[i + 1];
    for (i = m; i; i--) E[P[e[i].w]--] = e[i];
}

inline int getf(register int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    register int top = 0;
    while (f[x] > 0) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

bool work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    register int i, j;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) read(G[i][j]);
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (G[e[i].u][e[i].v] == -1) return 0;
        e[i].w = G[e[i].u][e[i].v];
    }
    Sort();
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i] = -1;
        nxt[i] = 0;
        L[i].he = L[i].ta = i;
    }
    int u, v, w;
    for (int now = 1; now <= m; now++) {
        u = getf(E[now].u), v = getf(E[now].v), w = E[now].w;
        if (u != v) {
            if (f[u] > f[v]) swap(u, v);
            for (i = L[u].he; i; i = nxt[i])
                for (j = L[v].he; j; j = nxt[j]) {
                    if (G[i][j] != w) {
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            nxt[L[u].ta] = L[v].he;
            L[u].ta = L[v].ta;
            f[u] += f[v];
            f[v] = u;
        }
    }
    u = getf(1);
    for (int now = 2; now <= n; now++) {
        v = getf(now);
        if (u != v) {
            if (f[u] > f[v]) swap(u, v);
            for (i = L[u].he; i; i = nxt[i])
                for (j = L[v].he; j; j = nxt[j]) {
                    if (G[i][j] != -1) {
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            nxt[L[u].ta] = L[v].he;
            L[u].ta = L[v].ta;
            f[u] += f[v];
            f[v] = u;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    for (int ca = 1; ca <= T; ca++) {
        printf("Case #%d: ", ca);
        if (work()) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3339.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 200005

int n,sqn,Q;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],ans[MAXN],nowans=0;
struct query {
    int l,r,id;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    cnt[x]++;
    while (cnt[nowans]) nowans++;
}
void del(int x) {
    cnt[x]--;
    if (!cnt[x] && nowans>x) nowans=x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn=int(sqrt(n))+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+Q+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=Q; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        ans[q[i].id]=nowans;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3365.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, k;

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];
int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

LL ans = 0;
int dep[MAXN], l[MAXN], lcnt;

void dd(int x) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    vis[x] = 1;
    l[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

LL work(int x, int base = 0) {
    dep[x] = base;
    lcnt = 0;
    dd(x);
    sort(l + 1, l + lcnt + 1);
    int i = 1, j = lcnt;
    LL ret = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (l[i] + l[j] <= k) ret += j - i++;
        else j--;
    }
    return ret;
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    ans += work(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            ans -= work(e[now].to, e[now].w);
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    read(k);
    solve(1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3437.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005

int n;
LL a[MAXN], s[MAXN], b[MAXN], f[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[j] + b[j] - f[k] - b[k]) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < i) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) < slope(v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), s[i] = s[i - 1] + b[i], b[i] = b[i - 1] + b[i] * i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.front();
        f[i] = f[j] + i * (s[i] - s[j]) - (b[i] - b[j]) + a[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3442.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 105

struct edge {
    int next, to, w, f;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * 16];

int n, m, k, ecnt = 1, head[MAXN * 2];
int C[MAXN], F[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], aff[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w, int f) {
    if (f < 1) return;
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].f = f;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].f = 0;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}
void insert(int x) {
    if (++cnt[x] > aff[x]) return;
    add(0, x + 1, -C[x] * (2 * cnt[x] - 1), 1);
}
int dis[MAXN * 2], pre[MAXN * 2], pos[MAXN * 2];
bool inq[MAXN * 2];
queue <int> q;
int spfa() {
    memset(dis, 0xc0, sizeof(dis));
    dis[0] = 0;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) inq[e[now].to] = 1, q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[1] > (int)0xc0c0c0c0;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0, to;
    while (spfa()) {
        if ((to = pre[pre[1]]) == 0) {
            int f = min(e[pos[1]].f, e[pos[pre[1]]].f);
            for (int i = 1; i; i = pre[i]) e[pos[i]].f -= f, e[pos[i] ^ 1].f += f;
        } else {
            ret += dis[1];
            for (int i = 1; i; i = pre[i]) e[pos[i]].f--, e[pos[i] ^ 1].f++;
            insert(to - 1);
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(F[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (s[j] == '1') {
                flag = 1;
                break;
            }
        if (!flag) {
            i--, n--;
            continue;
        }
        add(0, i + m + 1, 0, k - 1);
        add(i + m + 1, 1, 0, k);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (s[j] == '1') add(j + 1, i + m + 1, F[j], 1), aff[j]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) insert(i);
    printf("%d\n", -MCMF());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 305
#define MOD 12345

const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1};
struct data {
    int x,y,v;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b,int c):x(a),y(b),v(c) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
} d[MAXN*MAXN];

int n,m,cnt=0,K;
int a[MAXN][MAXN];
int f[MAXN][MAXN][205],z[205][205];

void init() {
    z[1][1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=K; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
            z[i][j]=z[i-1][j-1]+z[i-1][j];
            if (z[i][j]>=MOD) z[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&K);
    K++;
    init();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
            d[++cnt]=data(i,j,a[i][j]);
        }
        a[i][0]=a[i][m+1]=1234567890;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) a[0][i]=a[n+1][i]=1234567890;
    sort(d+1,d+cnt+1);
    for (int ii=1; ii<=cnt; ii++) {
        int x=d[ii].x,y=d[ii].y;
        for (int q=1; q<=K; q++) f[x][y][q]=1;
        for (int q=0; q<4; q++) {
            int tox=x+dx[q],toy=y+dy[q];
            if (a[tox][toy]<a[x][y]) {
                for (int i=1; i<=K; i++) {
                    for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
                        f[x][y][i]=(f[x][y][i]+f[tox][toy][j]*z[i][j])%MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=K; i++) {
            printf("F %d %d %d = %d\n",x,y,i,f[x][y][i]);
        }
    }
    for (int ii=1; ii<=K; ii++) {
        int ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                ans+=f[i][j][ii];
                if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
            }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3503_checker.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
            if (a[i][j]) flag = 1;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            int now = a[i][j] ^ a[i - 1][j] ^ a[i][j - 1] ^ a[i + 1][j] ^ a[i][j + 1];
            if (now) return cerr << "wrong answer on " << i << " " << j << endl, 1;
        }
    cerr << n << " " << m << " ";
    if (!flag) return cerr << "Warning : All 0" << endl, 2;

//BZOJ3503.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 45

LL a[MAXN], st[MAXN][MAXN];
bool ans[MAXN][MAXN];

int n, m;

void gauss() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= m && !((a[to] >> i) & 1)) to++;
        if (to > m) continue;
        swap(a[i], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (j != i && ((a[j] >> i) & 1)) a[j] ^= a[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = m; i; i--) {
        if (!((a[i] >> i) & 1)) a[i] |= 1;
        if (a[i] & 1) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) if ((a[j] >> i) & 1) a[j] ^= 1;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) st[1][i] = 1ll << i;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            st[i][j] = st[i - 1][j - 1] ^ st[i - 1][j] ^ st[i - 1][j + 1] ^ st[i - 2][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) a[i] = st[n + 1][i];
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans[1][i] = (a[i] & 1);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            ans[i][j] = ans[i - 1][j - 1] ^ ans[i - 1][j] ^ ans[i - 1][j + 1] ^ ans[i - 2][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            printf("%d%c", ans[i][j] ? 1 : 0, j == m ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 45

void gauss() {
    M = m;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= M && !((a[to] >> i) & 1)) to++;
        if (to > M) {
            a[++M] = (1ll << i) ^ 1;
            swap(a[i], a[M]);
        } else {
            swap(a[i], a[to]);
            for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                if (j != i && ((a[j] >> i) & 1)) a[j] ^= a[i];
            }
        }
    }
}

        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {

        }
