//BZOJ3504.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 55
#define MAXB MAXN*MAXN

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXB<<1];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,a1,a2,an,b1,b2,bn,ecnt,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN];
char temp[MAXN][MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_2(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_N(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=123;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=123;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void build() {
    add(0,a1+2,an);
    add(a2+2,1,an);
    add(0,b1+2,bn);
    add(b2+2,1,bn);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
            if (temp[i][j]=='O') {
                add_2(i+1,j+1);
            } else if (temp[i][j]=='N') {
                add_N(i+1,j+1);
            }
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(0);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow));
            if (ret) {
                usd+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

bool dinic() {
    int ans=0,k=an+bn;
    while (k!=ans && bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=n+1; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,k-ans);
    }
    return ans==k;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&a1,&a2,&an,&b1,&b2,&bn)==7 && n) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp[i]+1);
        }
        init();
        build();
        if (dinic()) {
            swap(b1,b2);
            init();
            build();
            if (dinic()) puts("Yes");
            else puts("No");
        } else puts("No");
        n=0;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3514.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define N 200319
#define M N
#define INF N

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2], *top;
    Node *mi;
    int val;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : mi(this), val(INF) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = this;
        if (mi->val > c[0]->mi->val) mi = c[0]->mi;
        if (mi->val > c[1]->mi->val) mi = c[1]->mi;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} mem[N + M], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *E;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    fa = null;
    top = f;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int val = INF) {
    ptr->val = val;
    ptr->mi = ptr;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->isrt = 1, ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[N + M];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[++top] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top) sta[top--]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

Node *query(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    expose(y);
    splay(y);
    return y;
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0], x->relax();
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

int n, m, K, type, uu[N], vv[N];
Node *a[N];

int newE(int i) {
    Node *mid = newNode(i);
    if (uu[i] == vv[i]) return i;
    int ret = 0;
    if (getrt(a[uu[i]]) == getrt(a[vv[i]])) {
        Node *mi = query(a[uu[i]], a[vv[i]])->mi;
        ret = mi->val;
        Cut(mi, a[uu[mi - E]]);
        Cut(mi, a[vv[mi - E]]);
    }
    Link(a[uu[i]], mid);
    Link(mid, a[vv[i]]);
    return ret;
}

struct Tnode {
    int l, r, v;
} t[N * 23];

int rt[N], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, v);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!rx) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    read(type);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    E = ptr - 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(uu[i]);
        read(vv[i]);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 0, m, newE(i));
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= K; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (type) l ^= ans, r ^= ans;
        ans = n - query(rt[l - 1], rt[r], 0, m, 0, l - 1);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();

#define MAXN 1005

        }
    }

//BZOJ3521.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

int n;
char ss[MAXN];
int sum[MAXN], ma[MAXN], mi[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top;

set <int> s;
set <int>::iterator it;
vector <int> del[MAXN];
vector <int>::iterator vi;
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", ss + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (ss[i] == 'j' ? -1 : 1);
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (top && sum[sta[top]] < sum[i]) ma[sta[top--]] = i;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) ma[sta[top--]] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        while (top && sum[sta[top]] > sum[i]) mi[sta[top--]] = i - 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) mi[sta[top--]] = n;
    int ans = 0;
    if (mi[0] != 0) {
        s.insert(0);
        del[mi[0]].push_back(0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        it = s.lower_bound(ma[i]);
        if (it != s.end()) ans = max(ans, i - *it);
        s.insert(i);
        del[mi[i]].push_back(i);
        for (vi = del[i].begin(); vi != del[i].end(); vi++) {
            s.erase(s.find(*vi));
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3522.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 5005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], flag[MAXN];
LL ans = 0, f[4][MAXN];

void dfs(int x, int fl) {
    if (flag[dep[x]] != fl) {
        flag[dep[x]] = fl;
        for (int i = 3; i; i--) f[i][dep[x]] += f[i - 1][dep[x]] * cnt[dep[x]];
        cnt[dep[x]] = 0;
    }
    cnt[dep[x]]++;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to, fl);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i < n; i++) read(x), read(y), add(x, y);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) f[0][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int k = 0;
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) k++;
        if (k < 3) continue;
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) fa[e[now].to] = i, dep[e[now].to] = 0, dfs(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) if (flag[j]) {
                ans += f[3][j] + f[2][j] * cnt[j];
                f[1][j] = f[2][j] = f[3][j] = cnt[j] = flag[j] = 0;
            }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3524.cpp

#define MAXN 500005
struct node {

} t[MAXN<<5];
int n,m,tcnt=0,rt[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int kth(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=p) return kth(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return kth(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p-lv);
}
int query(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,n,a);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int mid=(r-l+2)>>1,ret=kth(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,n,mid);
        if (query(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,n,ret)>((r-l+1)>>1)) printf("%d\n",ret);
        else puts("0");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3529.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt = 0, mu[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int T;
struct query {
    int n, m, a, id;
    bool operator < (query b) const {
        return a < b.a;
    }
} q[20319];

struct Fu {
    int v, id;
    bool operator < (Fu b) const {
        return v < b.v;
    }
} F[MAXN];

unsigned ans[MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] =-mu[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        F[i].id = i;
        for (int j = i; j < MAXN; j += i)
            F[j].v += i;
    }
    sort(F + 1, F + MAXN);
}

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

unsigned t[MAXN];

unsigned sum(int x) {
    unsigned ret = 0;
    for (int i = x; i; i -= lowbit(i)) ret += t[i];
    return ret;
}

void inc(int x, unsigned v) {
    if (v) for (int i = x; i < MAXN; i += lowbit(i)) t[i] += v;
}

void update(int x, unsigned v) {
    for (int i = 1; i * x < MAXN; i++) inc(i * x, v * mu[i]);
}

unsigned work(int n, int m) {
    unsigned ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        ret += (sum(j) - sum(i - 1)) * (n / i) * (m / i);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) read(q[i].n), read(q[i].m), read(q[i].a), q[i].id = i;
    sort(q + 1, q + T + 1);
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= T; i++) {
        while (j < MAXN && F[j].v <= q[i].a) update(F[j].id, F[j].v), j++;
        ans[q[i].id] = work(q[i].n, q[i].m);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) printf("%u\n", ans[i] & 0x7fffffff);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3531.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch>'9' || ch<'0') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline int readop() {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='C') {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch=='C') return 0;
        else return 1;
    } else {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch=='S') return 2;
        else return 3;
    }
}

const int CW=1,QS=3,QM=4;

struct order {
    int opt,x,y,c,time;
    order() {}
    order(int q,int w,int e,int r,int t):opt(q),x(w),y(e),c(r),time(t) {}
    bool operator < (order a) const {
        if (c!=a.c) return c<a.c;
        else return time<a.time;
    }
} op[MAXN*3];

int ans[MAXN*3];

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,q,ocnt=0;
int col[MAXN],wei[MAXN],head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN],son[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],siz[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            if (siz[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=siz[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
#define s 131072
int tmax[s<<1],tsum[s<<1];

void init() {
    dep[1]=fa[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    memset(ans,-1,sizeof(ans));
}

void update(int x,int v) {
    x+=s;
    tmax[x]=tsum[x]=v;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) {
        tmax[x]=max(tmax[x<<1],tmax[(x<<1)^1]);
        tsum[x]=tsum[x<<1]+tsum[(x<<1)^1];
    }
}

int query_s(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=tsum[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=tsum[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int query_m(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret=max(ret,tmax[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ret=max(ret,tmax[r^1]);
    }
    return ret;
}

int query_sum(int u,int v) {
    int ret=0;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        ret+=query_s(tid[top[u]],tid[u]);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    ret+=query_s(tid[u],tid[v]);
    return ret;
}

int query_max(int u,int v) {
    int ret=0;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        ret=max(ret,query_m(tid[top[u]],tid[u]));
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    ret=max(ret,query_m(tid[u],tid[v]));
    return ret;
}

void work(int st,int ed) {
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (op[i].opt==CW) {
            update(tid[op[i].x],op[i].y);
        } else if (op[i].opt==QS) {
            ans[op[i].time]=query_sum(op[i].x,op[i].y);
        } else {
            ans[op[i].time]=query_max(op[i].x,op[i].y);
        }
    }
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (op[i].opt==CW && op[i].y!=0) {
            update(tid[op[i].x],0);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,w,c; i<=n; i++) {
        read(w);
        read(c);
        col[i]=c;
        wei[i]=w;
        ++ocnt;
        op[ocnt]=order(CW,i,w,c,ocnt);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=q; i++) {
        int opt=readop();
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (opt==0) {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,0,col[x],ocnt);
            col[x]=y;
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,wei[x],y,ocnt);
        } else if (opt==1) {
            wei[x]=y;
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        } else if (opt==2) {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(QS,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        } else {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(QM,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        }
    }
    sort(op+1,op+ocnt+1);
    for (int i=1,j; i<=ocnt; i=j) {
        for (j=i+1; j<=ocnt && op[j].c==op[i].c; j++);
        work(i,j-1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=ocnt; i++) {
        if (ans[i]!=-1) printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 500319

struct Node {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (const Node &a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

struct Query {
    int v, x, k, id;
    bool operator < (const Query &a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} q[MAXM];

struct Tnode {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 20];

int n, m, Q, tcnt;
int a[MAXN], f[MAXN], rt[MAXN], ans[MAXM], tmp[MAXN], tot = 0;

inline int build(int p, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    int ret = tcnt + 1;
    for (t[++tcnt].v = 1; l < r; t[++tcnt].v = 1) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[tcnt].l = tcnt + 1, r = mid;
        else t[tcnt].r = tcnt + 1, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] > 0) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!y) return x;
    if (!x) return y;
    t[x].v += t[y].v;
    t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return x;
}

inline int query(int x, int k, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (t[t[x].l].v >= k) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else k -= t[t[x].l].v, x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt[i] = build(a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
    }
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].v);
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].id = i;
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + Q + 1);

    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    e[m + 1].w = 0x7fffffff;
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; ; i++) {
        for ( ; j <= Q && e[i].w > q[j].x; j++) {
            int fa = getf(q[j].v);
            if (-f[fa] < q[j].k) ans[q[j].id] = -1;
            else {
                ans[q[j].id] = tmp[query(rt[fa], -f[fa] + 1 - q[j].k)];
            }
        }
        if (i > m || j > Q) break;
        int fu = getf(e[i].u), fv = getf(e[i].v);
        if (fu != fv) {
            if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
            f[fu] += f[fv];
            f[fv] = fu;
            rt[fu] = merge(rt[fu], rt[fv]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
char ch = 0;
char buf[20 << 20], *Now = buf, *End = buf;

#define getchar() (Now == End ? (End = buf + fread(buf, 1, 20 << 20, stdin), *(Now = buf)++) : *Now++)

unsigned A = MAXM;

#define Rand() (A ^= A << 13, A ^= A >> 17, A ^= A << 5, A)

inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    inline bool operator < (const edge &a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], tot = 0;
int n, m, Q, tcnt, rf[MAXN], rr[MAXN], W[MAXN], vcnt = 0;

struct NoDataNode {
    int l, r;
};

NoDataNode tt[76 * MAXN];
int tb[int(5.5 * MAXN)];
int Cnt, tCnt;

template <int defnum> struct Persistent_Array {
    int rt;
    Persistent_Array () {
        rt = 0;
    }
    inline int update(int pre, int p, int v) {
        int ret = Cnt + 1, x, l = 1, r = n;
        while (l < r) {
            x = ++Cnt;
            if (pre) tt[x] = tt[pre];
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (p <= mid) pre = tt[x].l, tt[x].l = Cnt + 1, r = mid;
            else pre = tt[x].r, tt[x].r = Cnt + 1, l = mid + 1;
        }
        x = ++tCnt;
        tb[x] = v;
        tt[Cnt].l > Cnt ? (tt[Cnt].l = x) : (tt[Cnt].r = x);
        return ret;
    }
    inline int at(int p, int x) {
        int l = 1, r = n, mid;
        while (l < r && x) {
            mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (p <= mid) x = tt[x].l, r = mid;
            else x = tt[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        }
        return x ? tb[x] : defnum;
    }
    inline int operator [] (int p) {
        return at(p, rt);
    }
    inline void set(int x, int v) {
        rt = update(rt, x, v);
    }
    inline int set(int R, int x, int v) {
        return update(R, x, v);
    }
};

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[int(MAXN * 33.5)];

Persistent_Array<-1> f;
Persistent_Array<0> rt;

inline int build(int p, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    int ret = tcnt + 1;
    for (t[++tcnt].v = 1; l < r; t[++tcnt].v = 1) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[tcnt].l = tcnt + 1, r = mid;
        else t[tcnt].r = tcnt + 1, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct pii {
    int fir, sec;
};

#define pii(x, y) (pii){x, y}

inline pii getf(int x, int ver = vcnt) {
    int r = rf[ver];
    int tm = f.at(x, r);
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (tm > 0) {
        sta[++top] = x;
        x = tm;
        tm = f.at(x, r);
    }
    while (top > 4) r = f.set(r, sta[top -= 3], x);
    rf[ver] = r;
    return pii(x, tm);
}

O3 int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!y) return x;
    if (!x) return y;
    int p = ++tcnt;
    t[p].v = t[x].v + t[y].v;
    t[p].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[p].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return p;
}

inline int query(int x, int k, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    int mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (t[t[x].l].v >= k) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else k -= t[t[x].l].v, x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

inline int getver(int v) {
    int l = 0, r = vcnt, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (W[mid] <= v) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

inline int find(int x) {
    int l = 1, r = tot, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (tmp[mid] == x) return mid;
        else if (tmp[mid] > x) r = mid - 1;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    std::sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(std::unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt.set(i, build(find(a[i])));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
    }
    std::sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    rf[0] = 0, rr[0] = rt.rt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        pii fu = getf(e[i].u), fv = getf(e[i].v);
        if (fu.fir != fv.fir) {
            if (fu.sec > fv.sec) std::swap(fu.fir, fv.fir);
            f.set(fu.fir, fu.sec + fv.sec);
            f.set(fv.fir, fu.fir);
            rt.set(fu.fir, merge(rt[fu.fir], rt[fv.fir]));
            int ver = ++vcnt;
            rr[ver] = rt.rt;
            W[ver] = e[i].w;
            rf[vcnt] = f.rt;
        }
    }
    int ans = -1;
    for (int i = 1, v, x, k; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(v);
        read(x);
        read(k);
        //	if (~ans) v ^= ans, x ^= ans, k ^= ans;
        int ver = getver(x);
        pii vv = getf(v, ver);
        if (-vv.sec < k) printf("%d\n", ans = -1);
        else printf("%d\n", ans = tmp[query(rt.at(vv.fir, rr[ver]), -vv.sec + 1 - k)]);
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';

    }

#define MAXN 30005
#define MAXM 205
typedef long long LL;
int n,m,ss;
LL frt[MAXN][MAXM],bak[MAXN][MAXM];
char s[MAXN][MAXM];

int val(char x) {
    switch (x) {
    case '0' ... '9' :
        return x-'0';
        break;
    case 'a' ... 'z' :
        return x-'a'+10;
        break;
    case 'A' ... 'Z' :
        return x-'A'+36;
        break;
    case '_' :
        return 62;
        break;
    case '@' :
        return 63;
        break;
    }
    return -1;
}

void cal(int x) {
    frt[x][0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        frt[x][i]=(frt[x][i-1]*67+val(s[x][i]))%MOD1;
    }
    bak[x][m+1]=0;
    for (int i=m; i; i--) {
        bak[x][i]=(bak[x][i+1]*97+val(s[x][i]))%MOD2;
    }
}

    read(m);
    read(ss);

        cal(i);

        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            tmp[i]=(frt[j][i-1]<<31)+bak[j][i+1];
        }
        sort(tmp+1,tmp+n+1);
        int now=1;
        for (int j=2; j<=n; j++) {
            if (tmp[j]==tmp[j-1]) ans+=now,now++;
            else now=1;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3578.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &_a) {
    while (_c != 'C' && _c != 'W') _c = getchar();
    _a = (_c == 'C');
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005
int n, m, q;
LL a[MAXN], su, h[MAXN];
int c[MAXN], p[MAXN];
set <int> s;
set <LL> vis;

void move(int x, int to) {
    h[p[x]] ^= a[x], c[p[x]]--;
    s.insert(p[x]);
    s.insert(to);
    h[p[x] = to] ^= a[x], c[to]++;
}

int work(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (set<int>::iterator it = s.lower_bound(l); it != s.end() && *it <= r; it = s.lower_bound(l)) {
        if (!vis.count(h[*it])) {
            vis.insert(h[*it]);
            ret += c[*it];
        }
        s.erase(it);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(q);
    a[0] = 2000081620000816233llu;
    srand(66666);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] ^ (rand() * 1234567890123457llu) ^ rand(), su ^= a[i], p[i] = 1;
    c[1] = n;
    h[1] = su;
    s.insert(1);
    vis.insert(0);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= q; i++) {
        readop(op), read(l), read(r);
        if (op) move(l, r);
        else printf("%d\n", work(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3585.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 200005

int n,sqn,Q;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],ans[MAXN],nowans=0;
struct query {
    int l,r,id;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    if (x>n) return;
    cnt[x]++;
    while (cnt[nowans]) nowans++;
}
void del(int x) {
    if (x>n) return;
    cnt[x]--;
    if (!cnt[x] && nowans>x) nowans=x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn=int(sqrt(n))+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+Q+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=Q; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        ans[q[i].id]=nowans;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3594.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXH 6005
#define MAXK 505
#define lowbit(x) (x&(-x))

int n,k,ans=0;
int a[MAXN];
int t[MAXH][MAXK];

inline int query(int x,int y) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=x; i; i-=lowbit(i))
        for (int j=y; j; j-=lowbit(j))
            ret=max(t[i][j],ret);
    return ret;
}

inline void update(int x,int y,int v) {
    for (int i=x; i<=MAXH; i+=lowbit(i))
        for (int j=y; j<=MAXK; j+=lowbit(j))
            t[i][j]=max(t[i][j],v);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=k; j!=-1; j--) {
            int now=query(a[i]+j,j+1)+1;
            ans=max(ans,now);
            update(a[i]+j,j+1,now);
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3597.cpp
/* Never say die. */

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 519

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 13];

int n, m, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
double mid, ret;
int tot, mark;
double dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

bool spfa(int x) {
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w + mid) {
            dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w + mid;
            if (inq[e[now].to]) return mark = e[now].to, tot = 1, ret = -e[now].w, 1;
            else if (spfa(e[now].to)) {
                if (mark) tot++, ret -= e[now].w;
                if (x == mark) mark = 0;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    return 0;
}

inline double check() {
    ret = tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dis[i] = inq[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (spfa(i)) return ret / tot + 1e-12;
    return mid;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    n += 2;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, a, b, c, d; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {head[u], v, b + d}, head[u] = ecnt;
        if (c) e[++ecnt] = (edge) {head[v], u, a - d}, head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    double l = -1, r = 0;
    while (r - l > 1e-3) {
        mid = l = r;
        r = check();
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3611.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct E {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

inline void addx(int u, int v) {
    if (u != v) e[++ecnt] = (E) {head[u], v}, head[u] = ecnt;
}
int fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], stp = 0;
int t[23][MAXN], fir[MAXN], tot = 0, Log[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++stp;
    t[0][++tot] = x;
    fir[x] = tot;
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != fa[x]) {
            dep[e[o].v] = dep[x] + 1;
            fa[e[o].v] = x;
            dfs(e[o].v);
            t[0][++tot] = x;
        }
    }
}

inline int cdp(int x, int y) {
    return dep[x] < dep[y] ? x : y;
}
inline int lca(int u, int v) {
    u = fir[u], v = fir[v];
    if (u > v) swap(u, v);
    return cdp(t[Log[v - u + 1]][u], t[Log[v - u + 1]][v - (1 << Log[v - u + 1]) + 1]);
}

void init() {
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = tot - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            t[k][i] = cdp(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

int n, m, Q;
int p[MAXN], sta[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
inline bool cmp(int x, int y) {
    return L[x] < L[y];
}

int mi[MAXN], ma[MAXN], siz[MAXN], Mi, Ma;
LL ans;

void dp(int x) {
    if (vis[x]) mi[x] = ma[x] = 0, siz[x] = 1;
    else ma[x] = -(mi[x] = INF), siz[x] = 0;
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        dp(e[o].v);
        int v = e[o].v, w = dep[v] - dep[x];
        ans += w * LL(m - siz[v]) * siz[v];
        Mi = min(Mi, mi[x] + mi[v] + w);
        Ma = max(Ma, ma[x] + ma[v] + w);
        mi[x] = min(mi[x], mi[v] + w);
        ma[x] = max(ma[x], ma[v] + w);
        siz[x] += siz[v];
    }
    head[x] = 0;
}

void work() {
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(p[i]);
        vis[p[i]] = 1;
    }
    sort(p + 1, p + m + 1, cmp);
    int top = ecnt = 1;
    sta[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 1 + (p[1] == 1); i <= m; i++) {
        int o = p[i], f = lca(o, sta[top]), ff;
        if (f == sta[top]) {
            sta[++top] = o;
            continue;
        };
        ff = lca(o, sta[top - 1]);
        while (f == ff) {
            addx(sta[top - 1], sta[top]);
            top--;
            f = ff, ff = lca(o, sta[top - 1]);
        }
        addx(f, sta[top]);
        sta[top] = f;
        sta[++top] = o;
    }
    while (--top) addx(sta[top], sta[top + 1]);
    ans = 0;
    Ma = -INF, Mi = INF;
    dp(1);
    printf("%lld %d %d\n", ans, Mi, Ma);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) vis[p[i]] = 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    init();
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    read(Q);
    while (Q--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3622.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005
#define MOD 1000000009
typedef long long LL;
int n, K;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], nxt[MAXN];
LL C[MAXN][MAXN], fac[MAXN], f[MAXN][MAXN], g[MAXN];
void init() {
    K = (n + K) / 2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", b + i);
    sort(b + 1, b + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        while (j < n && a[i] > b[j + 1]) j++;
        nxt[i] = j;
    }
    C[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
    }
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &K);
    if (n < K || ((n ^ K) & 1)) return puts("0"), 0;
    init();
    f[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++)
            f[i][j] = (f[i - 1][j] + (nxt[i] >= j && j ? f[i - 1][j - 1] * (nxt[i] - j + 1) : 0ll)) % MOD;
    for (int i = n; i >= K; i--) {
        g[i] = (f[n][i] * fac[n - i]) % MOD;
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            g[i] = (g[i] - g[j] * C[j][i]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", int((g[K] + MOD) % MOD));
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int u, v, c;
} e[MAXN];

bool cmp(const edge &a, const edge &b) {
    return a.c < b.c;
}

int n, m, K;
int f[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}
bool merge(int u, int v) {
    u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
    if (u == v) return 0;
    if (f[u] > f[v]) swap(u, v);
    f[u] += f[v];
    f[v] = u;
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].c);
    }
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1, cmp);
    memset(f + 1, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = m; i; i--) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            tot++;
            if (!e[i].c) K--, tag[i] = 1;
        }
    }
    if (K < 0 || tot != n - 1) return puts("no solution"), 0;
    memset(f + 1, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (tag[i]) merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!tag[i]) {
            if (!e[i].c) {
                if (K && merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) K--, tag[i] = 1;
            } else if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) tag[i] = 1;
        }
    if (K) return puts("no solution"), 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (tag[i]) printf("%d %d %d\n", e[i].u, e[i].v, e[i].c);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3626.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 50005
#define MOD 201314
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct query {
    int x,p,z;
    query() {}
    query(int a,int b,int c):x(a),p(b),z(c) {}
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return p<a.p;
    }
} q[MAXN*2];

int n,Q,ecnt=0,qcnt=0;
int head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],son[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dep[MAXN],siz[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],dfn=0;
int ans[MAXN];
#define s 65536
int t[s<<1],lazy[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    siz[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
        finds(v);
        siz[x]+=siz[v];
        if (siz[v]>maxs[x]) {
            maxs[x]=siz[v];
            son[x]=v;
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    for (int i=1; i<s; i++) {
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)^1];
    }
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    int val=int(((R[x<<1]-L[x<<1]+1)*(long long)lazy[x])%MOD);
    t[x<<1]=t[x<<1]+val;
    if (t[x<<1]>=MOD) t[x<<1]-=MOD;
    t[(x<<1)^1]=t[(x<<1)^1]+val;
    if (t[(x<<1)^1]>=MOD) t[(x<<1)^1]-=MOD;
    lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[(x<<1)^1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=r-l+1;
        lazy[x]++;
        if (t[x]>=MOD) t[x]-=MOD;
        return;
    }
    if (x<s && lazy[x]) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(x<<1,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid) update((x<<1)^1,max(mid+1,l),r);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1];
    if (t[x]>=MOD) t[x]-=MOD;
}

int query_(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        return t[x];
    }
    if (x<s && lazy[x]) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1,ret=0;
    if (l<=mid) ret+=query_(x<<1,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid) ret+=query_((x<<1)^1,max(mid+1,l),r);
    if (ret>=MOD) ret-=MOD;
    return ret;
}

void __update(int x) {
    while (top[x]!=1) {
        update(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x]);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    update(1,1,tid[x]);
}

int __query(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    while (top[x]!=1) {
        ret+=query_(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x]);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    return (ret+query_(1,1,tid[x]))%MOD;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]);
        ++fa[i];
        add(fa[i],i);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r,z; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(z);
        r++,z++;
        if (l!=0) q[++qcnt]=query(-i,l,z);
        q[++qcnt]=query(i,r,z);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+qcnt+1);
    init();
    int nowq=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        __update(i);
        while (nowq<=qcnt && q[nowq].p==i) {
            int ret=__query(q[nowq].z);
            if (q[nowq].x<0) ans[-q[nowq].x]-=ret;
            else ans[q[nowq].x]+=ret;
            nowq++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        if (ans[i]<0) printf("%d\n",ans[i]+MOD);
        else printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3631_.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 300005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN << 1];

int n, ecnt, head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], a[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int son[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], dfn = 0, tid[MAXN], siz[MAXN], dep[MAXN], top[MAXN];

void finds(int x) {
    son[x] = maxs[x] = 0;
    siz[x] =1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            finds(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            maxs[x] = siz[e[now].to] > maxs[x] ? (son[x] = e[now].to, siz[e[now].to]) : maxs[x];
        }
    }
}

void link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++dfn;
    top[x] = anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 1;
    finds(1);
    link(1, 1);
}

void vis(int u, int v) {
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] < dep[top[v]]) swap(u, v);
        cnt[tid[top[u]]]++, cnt[tid[u] + 1]--;
        u = fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u] > dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    cnt[tid[u]]++, cnt[tid[v] + 1]--;
}

int ans[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) vis(a[i - 1], a[i]), cnt[tid[a[i]]]--, cnt[tid[a[i]] + 1]++;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cnt[i] += cnt[i - 1];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d\n", cnt[tid[i]]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3631.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 300005
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,dfn=0,ecnt=0,a[MAXN],head[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
int subs[MAXN],maxsize[MAXN],dep[MAXN],fa[MAXN],son[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN];
int t[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void findsize(int x) {
    subs[x]=1;
    maxsize[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            visit[v]=1;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            findsize(v);
            subs[x]+=subs[v];
            if (subs[v]>maxsize[x]) {
                maxsize[x]=subs[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void linkedge(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        visit[son[x]]=0;
        linkedge(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (visit[v]) {
                visit[v]=0;
                linkedge(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void inc(int u,int v) {
    t[u]++;
    t[v+1]--;
}

inline void update(int u,int v) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]])
            swap(u,v);
        inc(tid[top[u]],tid[u]);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v])
        swap(u,v);
    inc(tid[u],tid[v]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    dep[0]=fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    visit[1]=1;
    findsize(1);
    visit[1]=0;
    linkedge(1,1);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        update(a[i],a[i+1]);
    t[0]=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[i]+=t[i-1];
    }
    t[tid[a[1]]]++;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",t[tid[i]]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3653.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

struct node {
    int lch,rch;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN<<5];

int head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],siz[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN],rt[MAXN],tid[MAXN];
int n,q,ecnt=0,dfn=0,tcnt=0;
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    L[x]=++dfn;
    tid[dfn]=x;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x]+=siz[e[now].to];
        }
    }
    R[x]=dfn;
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[x].lch,t[now].rch=t[x].rch,t[now].v=t[x].v+v;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].lch=update(t[x].lch,l,mid,p,v);
        else t[now].rch=update(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,p,v);
    }
    return now;
}

LL query(int lrt,int rrt,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        return t[rrt].v-t[lrt].v;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    LL ret=0;
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(t[lrt].lch,t[rrt].lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(t[lrt].rch,t[rrt].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    rt[0]=0;
    fa[0]=0;
    fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,n,dep[tid[i]],siz[tid[i]]-1);
    }
    for (int i=1,x,k; i<=q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(k);
        LL ans=min(k,dep[x]-1)*LL(siz[x]-1)+query(rt[L[x]-1],rt[R[x]],1,n,dep[x]+1,min(dep[x]+k,n));
        printf("%lld\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
struct rrr {
    int u,v,A,B;
    bool operator < (rrr a) const {
        return B<a.B;
    }
} r[MAXN<<1];
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<2];

int n,m,ans=INF,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN],ecnt;

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

bool inq[MAXN];
queue<int> q;

void spfa(int st) {
    q.push(st);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>max(dis[x],e[now].w)) {
                dis[e[now].to]=max(dis[x],e[now].w);
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {

    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(r[i].u);
        read(r[i].v);
        read(r[i].A);
        read(r[i].B);
    }
    sort(r+1,r+m+1);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(r[i].u,r[i].v,r[i].A);
        if (dis[r[i].u]<dis[r[i].v]) spfa(r[i].u);
        else if (dis[r[i].v]<dis[r[i].u]) spfa(r[i].v);
        ans=min(ans,dis[n]+r[i].B);
    }
    if (ans<100005) printf("%d\n",ans);
    else printf("-1\n");
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MAXN 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007
int n, nxt[MAXN], dep[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

void getNext() {
    nxt[0] = -1;
    dep[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1, j = -1; i < n; i++) {
        while (j >= 0 && s[i] != s[j + 1]) j = nxt[j];
        if (s[i] == s[j + 1]) j++;
        nxt[i] = j;
        if (j > -1) dep[i] = dep[j] + 1;
        else dep[i] = 1;
    }
}

void getNum() {
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1, j = -1; i < n; i++) {
        while (j >= 0 && s[i] != s[j + 1]) j = nxt[j];
        if (s[i] == s[j + 1]) j++;
        while (j * 2 >= i) j = nxt[j];
        ans = ans * (dep[j] + 1) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int)strlen(s);
    getNext();
    getNum();
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3671.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
template<class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 5005
typedef long long LL;
LL X,A,B,C,D;
int Rand() {
    return int(X=(A*X*X+B*X+C)%D);
}
int n,m,nm,q,s[MAXN*MAXN],ref[MAXN*MAXN],ans[MAXN+MAXN];
bool mark[MAXN*MAXN];
#define vis(i,j) mark[(i-1)*m+j]
int main() {
    read(X);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    read(D);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(q);
    nm=n*m;
    for (int i=1; i<=nm; i++) s[i]=i;
    for (int i=1; i<=nm; i++) {
        swap(s[i],s[Rand()%i+1]);
    }
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        swap(s[x],s[y]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=nm; i++) ref[s[i]]=i;
    int ta=n+m-1;
    for (int i=1,tot=0; tot<ta; i++) {
        if (!mark[ref[i]]) {
            mark[ref[i]]=1;
            tot++;
            printf("%d",i);
            if (tot==ta) putchar('\n');
            else putchar(' ');
            int x=(ref[i]-1)/m+1,y=(ref[i]-1)%m+1;
            for (int j=x+1; j<=n; j++) {
                for (int k=y-1; k>0; k--) {
                    if (!vis(j,k)) vis(j,k)=1;
                    else break;
                }
            }
            for (int j=x-1; j>0; j--) {
                for (int k=y+1; k<=m; k++) {
                    if (!vis(j,k)) vis(j,k)=1;
                    else break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3673.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 20005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct data {
    int q,a,b;
} qr[MAXN];

int n,m,ecnt=0,f[MAXN],ans[MAXN],head[MAXN],acf[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int lab[MAXN<<1],val[MAXN<<1],top=0;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return f[x];
    return getf(f[x]);
}

void modify(int i,int v) {
    lab[++top]=i;
    val[top]=f[i];
    f[i]=v;
}

void merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        modify(fa,fb);
    }
}

void recover(int tt) {
    while (top!=tt) {
        f[lab[top]]=val[top];
        top--;
    }
}

bool issame(int u,int v) {
    return getf(u)==getf(v);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    // answer querys
    for (int v=x+1; v<=m && qr[v].q==3; ans[v]=issame(qr[v].a,qr[v].b),v++);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (qr[v].q==1) {
            int rec=top;
            merge(getf(qr[v].a),getf(qr[v].b));
            dfs(v);
            recover(rec);
        } else {
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    memset(ans,-1,sizeof(ans));
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,last=0; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&qr[i].q);
        if (qr[i].q==1) {
            scanf("%d%d",&qr[i].a,&qr[i].b);
            add(last,i);
            last=i;
        } else if (qr[i].q==2) {
            scanf("%d",&qr[i].a);
            add(acf[qr[i].a],i);
            last=i;
        } else {
            scanf("%d%d",&qr[i].a,&qr[i].b);
        }
        acf[i]=last;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) f[i]=i;
    dfs(0);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) if (ans[i]!=-1) printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3674.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int n,m,rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now].v=-1;
    } else {
        t[now].l=build(l,(l+r)>>1);
        t[now].r=build(((l+r)>>1)+1,r);
    }
    return now;
}

int access(int root,int x) {
    //printf("access %d %d\n",root,x);
    int l=1,r=n,mid,pos=root;
    while (l<r) {
//		printf("pos : %d\n",pos);
//		printf("%d %d\n",l,r);
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (x<=mid) r=mid,pos=t[pos].l;
        else l=mid+1,pos=t[pos].r;
    }
    //printf("access complete %d \n",t[pos].v);
    return t[pos].v;
}

int modify(int old,int x,int v) {
    //printf("modify %d %d\n",x,v);
    int l=1,r=n,mid,now=++tcnt;
    int nowrt=now;
    while (l<r) {
        t[now].l=t[old].l;
        t[now].r=t[old].r;
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (x<=mid) r=mid,t[now].l=tcnt+1,now=++tcnt,old=t[old].l;
        else l=mid+1,t[now].r=tcnt+1,now=++tcnt,old=t[old].r;
    }
    t[now].v=v;
    return nowrt;
}

int getf(int r,int x) {
    //printf("getf %d %d\n",r,x);
    int fx=access(r,x);
    if (fx<0) return x;
    else return getf(r,fx);
}

void merge(int r,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(rt[r],a);
    //printf("fa : %d\n",fa);
    int fb=getf(rt[r],b);
    //printf("fb : %d\n",fb);
    if (fa==fb) return;
    int ffa=access(rt[r],fa),ffb=access(rt[r],fb);
    //printf("ffa %d ffb %d\n",ffa,ffb);
    if (ffa<ffb) {
        int nowr=modify(rt[r],fa,ffa+ffb);
        rt[r]=modify(nowr,fb,fa);
    } else {
        int nowr=modify(rt[r],fb,ffa+ffb);
        rt[r]=modify(nowr,fa,fb);
    }
}

int query(int r,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(rt[r],a),fb=getf(rt[r],b);
    return fa==fb;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    rt[0]=build(1,n);
    int lastans=0;
    for (int i=1,op,a,b; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op==1) {
            read(a);
            read(b);
            a^=lastans,b^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[i-1];
            merge(i,a,b);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(a);
            a^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[a];
        } else {
            read(a);
            read(b);
            a^=lastans,b^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[i-1];
            lastans=query(i,a,b);
            putchar(lastans+'0');
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3675.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005

int n, K, a[MAXN];
LL f[MAXN][2], s[MAXN], rs[MAXN];

LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[j][i] - f[k][i]) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void clear() {
        l = r = v[0] = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) > rs[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r &&  slope(k, v[r], i) > slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        if (a[i] == 0) {
            i--, n--;
            continue;
        }
        s[i] = s[i - 1] + a[i];
    }
    K = min(K, n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) rs[i] = s[n] - s[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[i][now] = f[j][pre] + (s[i] - s[j]) * rs[i];
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i < n; i++) ans = max(ans, f[i][K & 1]);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3676.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#define MAXN 300019
struct PT {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN], last, n, p;
    inline int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        cnt[p] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        return p++;
    }
    inline void init() {
        p = 0;
        newNode(0);
        newNode(-1);
        last = 0;
        n = 0;
        S[0] = -1;
        fail[0] = 1;
    }
    inline int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    inline void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i >= 0; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

int n;
char s[MAXN];
int rec[MAXN],

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) T.add(s[i]);
    T.count();
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = T.p - 1; i > 1; i--) ans = max(ans, (long long)T.len[i] * T.cnt[i]);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int n;
double x[MAXN],y[MAXN],w[MAXN],nowx=0,nowy=0;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,a,b,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&c);
        x[i]=a,y[i]=b,w[i]=c;
        nowx+=a,nowy+=b;
    }
    nowx/=n,nowy/=n;
    double temp=10000,tox,toy,a,b,c;
    while (temp>=0.00000001) {
        tox=toy=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            a=x[i]-nowx;
            b=y[i]-nowy;
            c=sqrt(a*a+b*b);
            if (c==0) continue;
            tox+=a*w[i]/c,toy+=b*w[i]/c;
        }
        nowx+=temp*tox;
        nowy+=temp*toy;
        temp*=0.95;
    }
    printf("%.3lf %.3lf\n",nowx,nowy);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3681.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 233];

int n, m, S = 0, T = 1;
int head[MAXN * 33], cur[MAXN * 33], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

vector <int> G[MAXN];
struct Node {
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 33];

int tcnt;

int px;

int build(int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) add(t[x].l = build(l, mid, p), x, INF);
        else add(t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, p), x, INF);
    } else add(px, x, INF);
    return x;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!x || !y) return x | y;
    int nx = ++tcnt;
    add(x, nx, INF);
    add(y, nx, INF);
    if (t[x].l || t[y].l) add(t[nx].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l), nx, INF);
    if (t[x].r || t[y].r) add(t[nx].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r), nx, INF);
    return nx;
}

void Link(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(x, px, INF);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Link(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) Link(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

int h[MAXN], rt[MAXN];
void dd(int x) {
    px = x + 1;
    rt[x] = build(1, n, h[x]);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[x].size(); i++) {
        dd(G[x][i]);
        rt[x] = merge(rt[x], rt[G[x][i]]);
    }
}

int q[MAXN * 33], tag[MAXN * 33];

inline bool bfs() {
    register int he, ta, x, now;
    for (x = 1; x <= tcnt; x++) tag[x] = 0;
    tag[S] = 1;
    q[he = ta = 1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[++ta] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow, ret;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 0; i <= tcnt; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 2, fa; i <= n; i++) read(fa), G[fa].push_back(i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(S, i + 1, 1);
    tcnt = n + m + 1;
    dd(1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, d, ti; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(d);
        read(ti);
        px = i + n + 1;
        add(px, T, ti);
        Link(rt[d], 1, n, l, r);
    }
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3689.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define TOP 30
struct node {
    int c[2], cnt;
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return c[x];
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];
int tcnt = 0;

void insert(int v) {
    int x = 0;
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        int to = (v>>i)&1;
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        t[x = t[x][to]].cnt++;
    }
}

struct statu {
    int u, v, k;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a, int b, int d) :u(a), v(b), k(d) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return (u^v) > (a.u^a.v);
    }
};

priority_queue <statu> q;

statu qaq(int v, int k) {
    int x = 0, ret = 0, tmp = k;
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        ret <<= 1;
        int p = (v>>i)&1;
        if (t[t[x][p]].cnt >= k) x = t[x][p], ret ^= p;
        else k -= t[t[x][p]].cnt, x = t[x][p^1], ret ^= p^1;
    }
    return statu(v, ret, tmp);
}

int n, K, a[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), insert(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) q.push(qaq(a[i], 2));
    for (int i = 1; K; i++) {
        statu now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        if (i&1) printf("%d ", now.u^now.v), K--;
        if (now.k < n) q.push(qaq(now.u, now.k + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3702.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 200319
#define MAX 1000000009
struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, tcnt = 0;
LL ans = 0, cntl = 0, cntr = 0;

int newTree(int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt, ret = x, l = 1, r = MAX, mid;
    t[x].v = 1;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = ++tcnt, r = mid;
        else t[x].r = ++tcnt, l = mid + 1;
        x = tcnt;
        t[tcnt].v = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!x) return y;
    if (!y) return x;
    t[x].v += t[y].v;
    cntl += (LL)t[t[x].l].v * t[t[y].r].v;
    cntr += (LL)t[t[y].l].v * t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return x;
}

int solve() {
    int y;
    read(y);
    if (!y) {
        int l = solve(), r = solve();
        cntl = cntr = 0;
        y = merge(l, r);
        ans += min(cntl, cntr);
        return y;
    } else return newTree(y);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    solve();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3703.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 5005

int n, m, tot = 0, mid;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], sum[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

bool dfs(int cnt, int dep, int len, int top, int totlen) {
    if (!dep) return 0;
    if (totlen < sum[mid]) return 0;
    if (cnt == mid) return 1;
    if (len < a[1]) return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
    for (int i = top, last = -1; i; i--) {
        if (!vis[i] && a[i] != last && a[i] <= len) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            bool ret = dfs(cnt + 1, dep, len - a[i], i - 1, totlen);
            vis[i] = 0;
            if (ret) return 1;
            else last = a[i];
        }
    }
    return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]), tot += b[i];
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    int l = 0, r = n;
    // greedy
    for (int i = 1, j = 1, now = b[1]; i <= n; i++) {
        while (j <= m && a[i] > now) now = b[++j];
        if (j > m) break;
        now -= a[i];
        l++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (dfs(0, m, b[m], mid, tot)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

struct fucker {
    int d,a,num;
    fucker() {}
    fucker(int q,int w,int e):d(q),a(w),num(e) {}
} a[100005],b[100005];

    return x.d<y.d;
}

    return x.a>y.a;
}

    scanf("%d%d",&n,&temp);
    z=temp;
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x<=y) a[++acnt]=fucker(x,y,i);
        else b[++bcnt]=fucker(x,y,i);
    }
    sort(a+1,a+acnt+1,cmp1);
    for (int i=1; i<=acnt; i++) {
        if (z<=a[i].d) {
            puts("NIE");
            return 0;
        }
        z+=a[i].a-a[i].d;

    sort(b+1,b+bcnt+1,cmp2);
    for (int i=1; i<=bcnt; i++) {
        if (z<=b[i].d) {
            puts("NIE");
            return 0;

        z+=b[i].a-b[i].d;

    for (int i=1; i<=bcnt; i++) printf("%d ",b[i].num);

//BZOJ3715.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

struct Node {
    int t, b, r, l;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int B, int c, int d) : t(a), b(B), r(c), l(d) {}
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        if (t - b != a.t - a.b) return t - b < a.t - a.b;
        else return r - l < a.r - a.l;
    }
    void re() {
        read(b);
        read(t);
        read(l);
        read(r);
    }
    bool can(Node x) {
        return t >= x.t && b <= x.b && r >= x.r && l <= x.l;
    }
} a[100005], mx;

int t, n;

int main() {
    read(t);
    while (t--) {
        read(n);
        mx = Node(0, 1, 0, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a[i].re();
            mx = max(a[i], mx);
        }
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!mx.can(a[i])) {
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        puts(flag ? "TAK" : "NIE");
    }
    return 0;
}

    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n, m;
int a[MAXN];
int ma[2][MAXN], mi[2][MAXN];
LL sum[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    reverse(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    ma[0][n + 1] = ma[1][n + 1] = -(mi[0][0] = mi[1][0] = INF);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a[i];
        mi[a[i]&1][i] = a[i];
        mi[(a[i]&1)^1][i] = mi[(a[i]&1)^1][i - 1];
    }
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        ma[a[i]&1][i] = a[i];
        ma[(a[i]&1)^1][i] = ma[(a[i]&1)^1][i + 1];
    }
    read(m);
    int p;
    while (m--) {
        read(p);
        if (sum[p]&1) printf("%lld\n", sum[p]);
        else {
            LL ans = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) if (ma[i][p + 1] > 0 && mi[i ^ 1][p] < INF) ans = max(ans, sum[p] - mi[i ^ 1][p] + ma[i][p + 1]);
            if (ans > 0) printf("%lld\n", ans);
            else puts("-1");
        }

    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, c[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

vector <int> cc, ans;

int dfs(int x) {
    if (c[x] < 2) return c[x];
    int sum = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        sum += dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    return sum > 0 ? 1 : (sum < 0 ? -1 : 0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
        if (c[i] <= 0) {
            if (c[i] == -2) c[i] = 1;
            else if (c[i] == 0) cc.push_back(i);
        } else {
            for (int j = 1; j <= c[i]; j++) read(v), add(i, v);
            c[i] = 2;
        }
    }
    if (dfs(1) == -1) puts("NIE");
    else {
        sort(cc.begin(), cc.end());
        for (int i = 0; i < cc.size(); i++) {
            c[cc[i]] = 1;
            if (dfs(1) == 1) ans.push_back(cc[i]);
            c[cc[i]] = 0;
        }
        printf("TAK %d\n", (int)ans.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.size(); i++) {
            printf("%d%c", ans[i], i + 1 == ans.size() ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    n = (int) strlen(s + 1);
    ans = n;
    int nowhold, pos = -n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (s[i] == '*') continue;
        if (s[i] != nowhold) {
            nowhold = s[i];

        } else pos = i;
    }
