//BZOJ3726acc.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<algorithm>
#define MAXN 2010
using namespace std;
int n,m,top,ans;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN];
int l0[MAXN],r0[MAXN],l1[MAXN],r1[MAXN];
int L[MAXN],R[MAXN];
char ch[MAXN];
int pre[MAXN],nxt[MAXN];
struct edge {
    int to;
    edge *next;
} e[MAXN],*prev[MAXN];
inline void insert(int u,int v) {
    e[++top].to=v;
    e[top].next=prev[u];
    prev[u]=&e[top];
}
inline void del(int x)  {
    pre[nxt[x]]=pre[x];
    nxt[pre[x]]=nxt[x];
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)  l0[i]=l1[i]=1,r0[i]=r1[i]=m;
    for (int T=1; T<=n; T++) {
        scanf("%s",ch+1);
        int i,j;
        for (i=j=1; i<=m; i++)
            if (ch[i]=='.') ++a[i],++b[i],l0[i]=max(l0[i],j),l1[i]=max(l1[i],j);
            else    b[i]=a[i]+1,a[i]=0,l1[i]=max(l0[i],j),l0[i]=1,j=i+1;
        for (i=j=m; i; i--)
            if (ch[i]=='.') r0[i]=min(r0[i],j),r1[i]=min(r1[i],j);
            else    r1[i]=min(r0[i],j),r0[i]=m,j=i-1;
        memset(prev,0,sizeof(edge*)*(T+2));
        top=0;
        for (i=m; i; i--) insert(a[i],i),pre[i]=i-1,nxt[i]=i+1;
        pre[1]=nxt[m]=0;
        for (int x=T; x>=0; x--)  for (edge *I=prev[x]; I; I=I->next)   L[I->to]=pre[pre[I->to]],del(I->to);
        memset(prev,0,sizeof(edge*)*(T+2));
        top=0;
        for (i=m; i; i--) insert(a[i],i),pre[i]=i-1,nxt[i]=i+1;
        pre[1]=nxt[m]=0;
        for (int x=T; x>=0; x--)  for (edge *I=prev[x]; I; I=I->next)   R[I->to]=nxt[nxt[I->to]],del(I->to);
        for (i=1; i<=m; i++) {
            ans=max(ans,(r1[i]-l1[i]+1)*b[i]);
            if(!a[i])   continue;
            j=l0[i];
            if (j>1&&b[j-1]>=a[i])  j=L[i]?L[i]+1:j-1;
            ans=max(ans,(r0[i]-j+1)*a[i]);
            j=r0[i];
            if (j<m&&b[j+1]>=a[i])  j=R[i]?R[i]-1:j+1;
            ans=max(ans,(j-l0[i]+1)*a[i]);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
}

//BZOJ3726ac.cpp
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define clr(a,x) memset(a,x,sizeof a)
const int MAXN=2005;
int L[MAXN],R[MAXN],U[MAXN][MAXN],S[MAXN],t,n,m;
char s[MAXN];
void solve() {
    int ans=0,i,j,*up;
    for(i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        for(j=1,up=U[i]; j<=m; ++j)up[j]=s[j]=='.'?U[i-1][j]+1:0;
        for(S[t=0]=0,j=1; j<=m; L[j]=S[t],S[++t]=j++)while(t&&up[S[t]]>=up[j])--t;
        for(S[t=0]=m+1,j=m; j>=1; R[j]=S[t],S[++t]=j--)while(t&&up[S[t]]>=up[j])--t;
        for(j=1; j<=m; ++j) {
            int u=U[i][j],x=j-1,y=j+1;
            if(i-u)u+=U[i-u-1][j]+1;
            ans=max(ans,max(u,U[i][j]*(R[j]-L[j]-1)));
            while(up[x]>=up[j]+1||up[y]>=up[j]+1) {
                if(up[x]>up[y])ans=max(ans,min(u,up[x])*(y-L[x]-1)),x=L[x];
                else ans=max(ans,min(u,up[y])*(R[y]-x-1)),y=R[y];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    while(~scanf("%d%d",&n,&m))solve();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3726wa.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(bool &a) {
    while (_c != '.' && _c != '#') _c = getchar();
    a = (_c == '#');
    _c = getchar();
}

#define N 2005

int n, m, ans = 1;
int sum[N][N], h[N][N], L[N][N], R[N][N];
bool G[N][N];

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            readop(G[i][j]);
            sum[i][j] = sum[i - 1][j] + sum[i][j - 1] - sum[i - 1][j - 1] + G[i][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) h[1][i] = !G[1][i];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
            h[i][j] = G[i][j] ? 0 : h[i - 1][j] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            L[i][j] = h[i][j - 1] >= h[i][j] ? L[i][j - 1] : j;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = m; j ; j--) {
            R[i][j] = h[i][j + 1] >= h[i][j] ? R[i][j + 1] : j;
        }
}
/*
int getsum(int l, int r, int t, int b) {
	printf("[%d %d %d %d] %d\n", l, r, t, b, sum[b][r] - sum[b][l] - sum[t][r] + sum[t][l]);
	return sum[b][r] - sum[b][l] - sum[t][r] + sum[t][l];
}
*/
#define getsum(l, r, t, b) (sum[b][r] - sum[b][l] - sum[t][r] + sum[t][l])
void LL(int ll, int rr, int tt, int bb) {
    int l = 0, r = ll, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (getsum(mid, rr, tt, bb) <= 1) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    //puts("LL");
    //printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, rr, tt, bb);
    ans = max(ans, (rr - l) * (bb - tt));
}

void RR(int ll, int rr, int tt, int bb) {
    int l = rr, r = m, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (getsum(ll, mid, tt, bb) <= 1) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    //puts("RR");
    //printf("%d %d %d %d\n", ll, l, tt, bb);
    ans = max(ans, (l - ll) * (bb - tt));
}

void TT(int ll, int rr, int tt, int bb) {
    int l = 0, r = tt, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (getsum(ll, rr, mid, bb) <= 1) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    //puts("TT");
    //printf("%d %d %d %d\n", ll, rr, l, bb);
    ans = max(ans, (rr - ll) * (bb - l));
}

void BB(int ll, int rr, int tt, int bb) {
    int l = bb, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (getsum(ll, rr, tt, mid) <= 1) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    //puts("BB");
    //printf("%d %d %d %d\n", ll, rr, tt, l);
    ans = max(ans, (rr - ll) * (l - tt));
}

void test(int l, int r, int t, int b) {
    LL(l, r, t, b);
    RR(l, r, t, b);
    TT(l, r, t, b);
    BB(l, r, t, b);
}

void work() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] || (h[i][j] == h[i][j - 1])) continue;
            test(L[i][j] - 1, R[i][j], i - h[i][j], i);
        }
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    init();
    work();
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3732.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 15005
#define MAXM 30005
#define MAXK 15005

struct data {
    int u,v,w;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} E[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,K,ecnt,head[MAXN],f[MAXN],fa[MAXN][20],maxe[MAXN][20],dep[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
    return 1;
}

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=18; i++) {
        fa[x][i]=fa[fa[x][i-1]][i-1];
        maxe[x][i]=max(maxe[x][i-1],maxe[fa[x][i-1]][i-1]);
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            maxe[e[now].to][0]=e[now].w;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            u=fa[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

int query(int x,int anc) {
    int ans=0;
    if (x==anc) return ans;
    int d=dep[x]-dep[anc]-1;
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((d>>k)&1) {
            ans=max(ans,maxe[x][k]);
            x=fa[x][k];
        }
    }
    return max(ans,maxe[x][0]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].w);
    }
    sort(E+1,E+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (merge(E[i].u,E[i].v)) {
            add(E[i].u,E[i].v,E[i].w);
        }
    }
    fa[1][0]=1;
    maxe[1][0]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1,u,v,LCA; i<=K; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        LCA=getLCA(u,v);
        printf("%d\n",max(query(u,LCA),query(v,LCA)));
    }

}

//BZOJ3744.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50005
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
int n, m, a[MAXN], blo[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

int tmp[MAXN], f[750][750];
int sqn, tot;

int qaq(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for ( ; x; x ^= lowbit(x)) ret += tmp[x];
    return ret;
}

void qwq(int x) {
    for ( ; x <= n; x += lowbit(x)) tmp[x]++;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 32];

int rt[MAXN], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    if (lx == rx || ql > qr) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid)  ret += query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    sqn = (int)(sqrt(n) * 0.3) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        tmp[i] = a[i];
        blo[i] = i / sqn + 1;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]] = i;
        R[blo[i]] = i;
    }
    tot = blo[n];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, n, a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < tot; i++) {
        int ret = 0, LB = R[i] + 1;
        memset(tmp + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            for (int k = L[j]; k <= R[j]; k++) ret += k - LB - qaq(a[k]), qwq(a[k]);
            f[i][j] = ret;
        }
    }
    read(m);
    int lastans = 0, l, r, bl, br;
    while (m--) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l ^= lastans, r ^= lastans;
        lastans = 0;
        bl = blo[l], br = blo[r];
        if (bl == br) {
            for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) lastans += query(rt[i - 1], rt[l - 1], 1, n, a[i] + 1, n);
        } else {
            lastans = f[bl][br - 1];
            for (int i = l; i <= R[bl]; i++) lastans += query(rt[r], rt[i], 1, n, 1, a[i] - 1);
            for (int i = L[br]; i <= r; i++) lastans += query(rt[i - 1], rt[R[bl]], 1, n, a[i] + 1, n);
        }
        printf("%d\n", lastans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3757.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define LOG 16
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, ecnt = 0, head[MAXN], col[MAXN], fa[MAXN][LOG + 1];
int tid[MAXN], blo[MAXN], siz[MAXN], dep[MAXN], B, tot = 0, dfn = 0;
int sta[MAXN], top = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

struct query {
    int u, v, a, b, id;
    bool operator < (query x) const {
        if (blo[u] != blo[x.u]) return blo[u] < blo[x.u];
        else return tid[v] < tid[x.v];
    }
} q[MAXN * 2];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOG; k++) fa[x][k] = fa[fa[x][k - 1]][k - 1];
    tid[x] = ++dfn;
    sta[++top] = x;
    int nowtop = top;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[x] >= B) {
                siz[x] = 0;
                ++tot;
                while (top > nowtop) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
            }
        }
    }
    siz[x]++;
}

void init() {
    B = (int)(sqrt(n) * 1.5) + 1;
    dfs(0);
    if (tot == 0) tot++;
    while (top) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x&1) u = fa[u][i];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG; i > -1; i--) if (fa[u][i] != fa[v][i]) u = fa[u][i], v = fa[v][i];
    return fa[u][0];
}

int nowans = 0, cnt[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void go(int x) {
    vis[x] ^= 1;
    if (vis[x]) {
        if (cnt[col[x]]++ == 0) nowans++;
    } else {
        if (--cnt[col[x]] == 0) nowans--;
    }
}

int answer(int lca, int a, int b) {
    go(lca);
    int ret = nowans;
    if (a && b && a != b) {
        if (cnt[a]) ret--;
        if (cnt[b]) ret--;
        if (cnt[a] || cnt[b]) ret++;
    }
    go(lca);
    return ret;
}

void moveTo(int x, int y) {
    int lca = LCA(x, y);
    while (x != lca) go(x), x = fa[x][0];
    while (y != lca) go(y), y = fa[y][0];
}

int ans[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(col[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(q[i].u);
        read(q[i].v);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].id = i;
        if (blo[q[i].u] > blo[q[i].v]) swap(q[i].u, q[i].v);
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + m + 1);
    int U = 0, V = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        moveTo(U, q[i].u);
        U = q[i].u;
        moveTo(V, q[i].v);
        V = q[i].v;
        int lca = LCA(U, V);
        ans[q[i].id] = answer(lca, q[i].a, q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50005

int n,sqn,m,k;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];
struct query {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

LL tot=0,ans[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    tot+=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    tot-=cnt[a[x]]*2-1;
    cnt[a[x]]--;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(--l);
        while (r<q[i].r) add(++r);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        ans[q[i].x]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;

//BZOJ3784.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, blcnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[rt] > siz[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

vector <int> l[MAXN], bl[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN];
int n, m;

void dd(int x, vector<int> &r) {
    r.push_back(dep[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, r);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void pre_work(int x, vector <int> &a, int base = 0) {
    dep[x] = base;
    dd(x, a);
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
}

void pre_solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    pre_work(x, l[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            pre_work(e[now].to, bl[++blcnt], e[now].w);
            pre_solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int mid;

LL work(vector<int> &a) {
    int i = 0, j = a.size() - 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (a[i] + a[j] >= mid) ret += j-- - i;
        else i++;
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check() {
    LL tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (l[i].size() > 1) tot += work(l[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (bl[i].size() > 1) tot -= work(bl[i]);
    return tot <= m;
}

vector <int> ans;

multiset <int, greater<int> > s;
multiset <int, greater<int> >::iterator it;

int ls[MAXN], lcnt = 0;

void ddd(int x) {
    ls[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            ddd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void getans(int x) {
    s.clear();
    s.insert(0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            lcnt = 0;
            ddd(e[now].to);
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) {
                for (it = s.begin(); it != s.end() && ls[i] + *it > mid; it++) {
                    ans.push_back(ls[i] + *it);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) s.insert(ls[i]);
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    getans(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int L = 1, R = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
        R += w;
    }
    pre_solve(1);
    while (L < R) {
        mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        if (check()) R = mid;
        else L = mid + 1;
    }
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    solve(1);
    sort(ans.begin(), ans.end());
    for (int i = ans.size() - 1; i >= 0 && m > 0; i--) printf("%d\n", ans[i]), m--;
    while (m--) printf("%d\n", mid);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int n, K;
int dp[100319][105][2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    if (!K) return puts("0"), 0;
    K = 2 * K - 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {

            dp[i][j][x] = max(dp[i - 1][j - 1][!x], dp[i - 1][j][x]) + 1;

//BZOJ3798ac.cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#define Block 100000
using namespace std;
int sqr[18010],ans;
bool Check(int x) {
    int i,j=static_cast<int>(sqrt(x)+1e-7)+1;
    for(i=2; i*i<=x; i++)
        if(x%i==0)
            return false;
    for(i=1; sqr[i]<x; i++) {
        for(; sqr[i]+sqr[j]>x; j--);
        if(sqr[i]+sqr[j]==x)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}
int Calculate(int x) {
    int i,re=table[x/Block];
    for(i=x/Block*Block+1; i<=x; i++)
        re+=Check(i);
    return re;
}
int main() {
    int i,l,r;
    for(i=1; i<=18000; i++)
        sqr[i]=i*i;
    cin>>l>>r;
    cout<<Calculate(r)-Calculate(l-1)<<endl;
}

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int cnt=0;

inline bool check(int x) {
    for (int i=2,sqx=(int)sqrt(x); i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1,j=(int)sqrt(x); i<=j;) {
        while (i*i+j*j<x) i++;
        while (i*i+j*j>x) j--;
        if (i*i+j*j==x) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    freopen("list.txt","w",stdout);
    printf("const int list[]={0");
    for (int i=1; i<300023808; i++) {
        if (check(i)) cnt++;
        if ((i&65535)==65535) printf(",%d",cnt),fflush(stdout);
    }
    printf("};");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3809.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],ans[MAXM],cnt[MAXN],blo[MAXN],bloans[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN];

struct qury {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (qury q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        blo[i]=(i-1)/sqn+1;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        ans[q[i].x]=query(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    }

int main() {
    read(N);
    while (N--) {
        int ans = 1;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        a--, c--;
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(b, d); i++) {
            int A = a / i, B = b / i, C = c / i, D = d / i;
            j = min(b, d);
            if (A) j = min(j, a / A);
            if (B) j = min(j, b / B);
            if (C) j = min(j, c / C);
            if (D) j = min(j, d / D);
            i = j;
            if (A < B && C < D) ans = i;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

struct Food {
    LL p, s;
    bool operator < (const Food &a) const {
        return p != a.p ? p < a.p : s > a.s;
    }
} a[222];

LL m, f;
int n, tot;

LL get(LL t) {
    if (t < 1 || t * f > m) return 0;
    LL d = 0, mo = m - t * f, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(a[i].s - d + 1, mo / a[i].p / t);
            ans += ti * t;
            d += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * t * ti;
        }
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(t, mo / a[i].p);
            d++;
            ans += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * ti;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

LL HC() {
    LL x = (m + 1) / (2 * (f + a[1].p)), ans = get(x), ret;
    for (D y = x; y > 1; y *= 0.91) {
        if ((ret = get(x + LL(y))) > ans) x += LL(y), ans = ret;
        else if ((ret = get(x - LL(y))) > ans) x -= LL(y), ans = ret;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(f);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].p);
        read(a[i].s);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    tot = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) if (a[i].s > a[tot].s) a[++tot] = a[i];
    cout << HC() << endl;
    return 0;
}

    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;

    q[(ta++) & TOP] = x;

    read(n);

        read(S[i]);
        read(K[i]);

        dis[i] = K[i];
        last[i] = dis[i];

        push(i);

            mak[e[now].to] -= delta;
            if (dis[e[now].to] > mak[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to] = mak[e[now].to];
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

//BZOJ3876.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 3005
#define MAXK 55
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int to, next, w, flow;
} e[MAXN * MAXK];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, dis[MAXN], pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v, int w, int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].flow = flow;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].flow = 0;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, S = 0, T;
queue<int> q;

int spfa() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(dis));
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

int mcmf() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) flow = min(flow, e[pos[x]].flow);
        ret += flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) e[pos[x]].flow -= flow, e[pos[x]^1].flow += flow;
    }
    return ret;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j = 1, v, w; j <= x; j++) {
            read(v);
            read(w);
            add(S, v, w, 1);
            add(i, v, w, INF);
        }
        if (x) add(i, T, 0, x);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) add(i, 1, 0, INF);
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n", mcmf());
    return 0;
}

int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
}
int ans,tot;
int n,m,T,cnt=1;
int q[30005],last[30005],h[30005];
int xx[5]= {0,0,1,-1,0},yy[5]= {1,-1,0,0,0};
struct edge {
    int to,next,v;
} e[1000005];
void insert(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++cnt].to=v;
    e[cnt].next=last[u];
    last[u]=cnt;
    e[cnt].v=w;
    e[++cnt].to=u;
    e[cnt].next=last[v];
    last[v]=cnt;
    e[cnt].v=0;
}
bool bfs() {
    int head=0,tail=1;
    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));
    q[0]=0;
    h[0]=0;
    while(head!=tail) {
        int now=q[head];
        head++;
        for(int i=last[now]; i; i=e[i].next)
            if(e[i].v&&h[e[i].to]==-1) {
                h[e[i].to]=h[now]+1;
                q[tail++]=e[i].to;
            }
    }
    return h[T]!=-1;
}
int dfs(int x,int f) {
    if(x==T)return f;
    int w,used=0;
    for(int i=last[x]; i; i=e[i].next)
        if(e[i].v&&h[e[i].to]==h[x]+1) {
            w=dfs(e[i].to,min(e[i].v,f-used));
            e[i].v-=w;
            e[i^1].v+=w;
            used+=w;
            if(used==f)return f;
        }
    if(!used)h[x]=-1;
    return used;
}
int main() {
    n=read();
    m=read();
    T=3*n*m+1;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            int x=read();
            insert(0,p(i,j),x);
            tot+=x;
        }
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            int x=read();
            insert(p(i,j),T,x);
            tot+=x;
        }
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            int val=read();
            tot+=val;
            for(int k=0; k<5; k++) {
                int x=xx[k]+i,y=yy[k]+j;
                if(x>n||y>m||x<1||y<1)continue;
                insert(p(i,j)+n*m,p(x,y),inf);
            }
            insert(0,p(i,j)+n*m,val);
        }
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            int val=read();
            tot+=val;
            for(int k=0; k<5; k++) {
                int x=xx[k]+i,y=yy[k]+j;
                if(x>n||y>m||x<1||y<1)continue;
                insert(p(x,y),p(i,j)+2*n*m,inf);
            }
            insert(p(i,j)+2*n*m,T,val);
        }
    while(bfs())ans+=dfs(0,inf);
    printf("%d\n",tot);
    printf("%d\n",tot-ans);
    return 0;
}

        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(S,p,a);
            add(p,tag[i][j],a);
            if (i>1) add(p,tag[i-1][j],a);
            if (j>1) add(p,tag[i][j-1],a);
            if (i<n) add(p,tag[i+1][j],a);
            if (j<m) add(p,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(p,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],p,a);
            if (i>1) add(tag[i-1][j],p,a);
            if (j>1) add(tag[i][j-1],p,a);
            if (i<n) add(tag[i+1][j],p,a);
            if (j<m) add(tag[i][j+1],p,a);
        }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 19

struct E {
    int v, w, rt;
    E() {}
    E(int a, int b) : v(a), w(b) {}
};

vector<E> G[MAXN];

int sz[MAXN], f[MAXN], l[MAXN];
LL d[MAXN][LOG], sd[MAXN], sf[MAXN], c[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int gs(int u, int fa) {
    sz[u] = 1;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) {
            sz[u] += gs(v, u);
        }
    }
    return sz[u];
}

int grt(int u, int fa, int hs) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa && sz[v] > hs) return grt(v, u, hs);
    }
    return u;
}

void gdis(int u, int fa, int ly) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) d[v][ly] = d[u][ly] + G[u][i].w, gdis(v, u, ly);
    }
}

int dcomp(int u, int ly) {
    int rt = grt(u, 0, gs(u, 0) / 2);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    gdis(rt, 0, l[rt] = ly);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[rt].size(); i++) {
        if (!vis[G[rt][i].v]) {
            f[G[rt][i].rt = dcomp(G[rt][i].v, ly + 1)] = rt;
        }
    }
    return rt;
}

void update(int u, int w) {
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        sd[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa]], sf[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa] - 1], c[fa] += w;
    }
}

LL calc(int u) {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        ans += sd[fa] - sf[fa] + c[fa] * (d[u][l[fa]] - d[u][l[fa] - 1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int n, Q, rt;

LL solve(int u) {
    LL ans = calc(u);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (l[v] > l[u] && calc(v) < ans) return solve(G[u][i].rt);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v, w;
        scanf("%d%d%d", &u, &v, &w);
        G[u].push_back(E(v, w));
        G[v].push_back(E(u, w));
    }
    rt = dcomp(1, 1);
    for (int u, w; Q--; ) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &w);
        update(u, w);
        printf("%lld\n", solve(rt));
    }
    return 0;
}

    if(c=='-') flag=true,c=getchar();

    if(flag) x=-x;

const int maxn=100010;
const int maxp=1e7;
struct Node {
    int l,r,cnt;
    long long val;
} t[maxn*50];
int m,n,root[maxn],cnt;
vector<int> I[maxn],R[maxn];
void update(int &r1,int r2,int l,int r,int pos,int val) {
    r1=++cnt;
    t[r1]=t[r2];
    t[r1].cnt+=val;
    t[r1].val+=val*pos;
    if(l==r) return ;
    int mid=l+r>>1;
    if(pos<=mid) update(t[r1].l,t[r2].l,l,mid,pos,val);
    else update(t[r1].r,t[r2].r,mid+1,r,pos,val);
}
long long query(int rt,int l,int r,int k) {
    if(l==r) return 1LL*k*l;
    int mid=l+r>>1;
    if(t[t[rt].l].cnt>=k) return query(t[rt].l,l,mid,k);
    return t[t[rt].l].val+query(t[rt].r,mid+1,r,k-t[t[rt].l].cnt);
}

        I[s].push_back(p);
        R[e].push_back(p);
    }
    root[0]=0;
    t[0].l=t[0].r=t[0].val=t[0].cnt=0;
    for(int i=1,cur; i<=n; ++i) {
        cur=root[i-1];
        for(int j=0; j<I[i].size(); ++j) update(cur,cur,1,maxp,I[i][j],1);
        for(int j=0; j<R[i-1].size(); ++j) update(cur,cur,1,maxp,R[i-1][j],-1);
        root[i]=cur;
    }
    long long pre=1;
    for(int i=1,k,x,a,b,c; i<=n; ++i) {
        read(x),read(a),read(b),read(c);
        k=1+(a*pre+b)%c;
        if(k>=t[root[x]].cnt) pre=t[root[x]].val;
        else pre=query(root[x],1,maxp,k);
        printf("%lld\n",pre);

#define MAXN 200005
typedef long long LL;
struct opt_ {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (opt_ a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} op[MAXN*2];

struct node {
    int l,r,cnt;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int m,n,opcnt=0,tcnt=0,pp[MAXN],tem[MAXN],rt[MAXN],ntem;

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int inc_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt++;
    t[now].v+=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=inc_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=inc_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
int dec_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt--;
    t[now].v-=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=dec_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=dec_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
LL query(int x,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) {
        return (LL)k*tem[l];
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lcnt=t[t[x].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt>=k) {
        return query(t[x].l,l,mid,k);
    } else {
        return t[t[x].l].v+query(t[x].r,mid+1,r,k-lcnt);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,s,e; i<=m; i++) {
        read(s);
        read(e);
        read(pp[i]);
        tem[i]=pp[i];
        op[++opcnt].x=s;
        op[++opcnt].x=e+1;
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+m+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+m+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        op[i*2-1].v=op[i*2].v=find(pp[i]);
        op[i*2].v=-op[i*2].v;
    }
    sort(op+1,op+opcnt+1);
    rt[0]=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int rr=rt[i-1];
        while (j<=opcnt && op[j].x==i) {
            if (op[j].v>0) rr=inc_(rr,1,ntem,op[j].v);
            else rr=dec_(rr,1,ntem,-op[j].v);
            j++;
        }
        rt[i]=rr;
    }
    LL pre=1;
    for (int i=1,x,a,b,c,k; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        k=int(1+(a*pre+b)%c);
        if (k<=t[rt[x]].cnt) pre=query(rt[x],1,ntem,k);
        else pre=t[rt[x]].v;
        printf("%lld\n",pre);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3944.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 10000319

LL phi[M];
int p[M / 10], pcnt = 0, mu[M];

void init() {
    phi[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < M; i++) {
        if (!phi[i]) phi[i] = i - 1, mu[i] = -1, p[++pcnt] = i;
        for (int j = 1; i * p[j] < M; j++) {
            if (i % p[j])
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1), mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * p[j], mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        phi[i] += phi[i - 1], mu[i] += mu[i - 1];
    }
}

bool vis[233];
int exmu[233];
LL exphi[233];
int n;

void solve(unsigned x);
LL Phi(int x);
int Mu(int x);

LL Phi(int x) {
    if (x < M) return phi[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exphi[y];
    }
}

int Mu(int x) {
    if (x < M) return mu[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exmu[y];
    }
}

void solve(unsigned x) {
    if (x < M) return;
    int y = n / x;
    if (vis[y]) return;
    vis[y] = 1;
    exmu[y] = 1;
    exphi[y] = (LL(x + 1) * x) >> 1;
    for (unsigned i = 2, j; i <= x; i = j) {
        j = x / (x / i) + 1;
        exphi[y] -= Phi(x / i) * (j - i);
        exmu[y] -= Mu(x / i) * (j - i);
    }
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    if (n < M) printf("%lld %d\n", phi[n], mu[n]);
    else {
        memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * (n / M));
        solve(n);
        printf("%lld %d\n", exphi[1], exmu[1]);
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

// alias BZOJ3991
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dis[MAXN],ans=0;
bool visit[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dfsid[MAXN],dfn=0,bfsid[MAXN],q[MAXN],fa[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
int bb[MAXN*2][19],fir[MAXN],bt=0;
void bfs() {
    q[ta++]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    fa[1]=0;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        bfsid[x]=he-1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                fa[e[now].to]=x;
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    dfsid[x]=++dfn;
    bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
    fir[x]=bt;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=bt; k++) {
        int x=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,tt=bt-(1<<k)+1; i<=tt; i++) {
            bb[i][k]=min(bb[i][k-1],bb[i+x][k-1]);
        }
    }
}

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    u=fir[u],v=fir[v];
    if (u>v) swap(u,v);
    int len=v-u+1,ll=log_2(len);
    return q[min(bb[u][ll],bb[v-(1<<ll)+1][ll])];
}

struct statu {
    int x,id;
    statu() {}
    statu(int w):id(w) {}
    statu(int y,int w):x(y),id(w) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return id<a.id;
    }
};
set<statu> s;
set<statu>::iterator it;
int Left(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.begin()) it=s.end();
    return (*--it).x;
}
int Right(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.end()) it=s.begin();
    return (*it).x;
}
void inc(int x) {
    if (!s.empty()) {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans+=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
    s.insert(statu(x,dfsid[x]));
}

void dec(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(dfsid[x]);
    s.erase(it);
    if (s.empty()) {
        ans=0;
    } else {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans-=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (visit[x]^=1) inc(x);
        else dec(x);
        printf("%lld\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define robot(x) (x+1)
#define weapon(x) (x+n+1)

queue <int> q;

    q.push(S);

    return tag[T]>0;
}

LL dfs(int x,LL flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    LL used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            LL ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=weapon(m); i>-1; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(S,robot(i),a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(weapon(i),T,b[i]*mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) add(robot(j),weapon(i),INF);
        }
    }
    return dinic()==sum;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),a[i]*=2000,sum+=a[i];
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) read(b[i]);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
        }
    LL l=0,r=200000000001ll,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    double ans=double(mid)/2000.0+0.00025;
    printf("%.5lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3994.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

int T, p[MAXN], pcnt = 0, sum[MAXN], mu[MAXN];
long long F[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    for (int x = 1; x < MAXN; x++) {
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= x; i = j) {
            j = x / (x / i) + 1;
            F[x] += (long long)(j - i) * (long long)(x / i);
        }
    }
    sum[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
        }
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + mu[i];
    }
}

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        ans += (sum[j] - sum[i - 1]) * F[n / i] * F[m / i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {

    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {

#define MAXN 500319

char s[MAXN];

int n, T, K;

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
int Min[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getsa() {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Min[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, d = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (d << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            Min[k][i] = min(Min[k - 1][i], Min[k - 1][i + d]);
        }
    }
}

void work1() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = h[i] + 1; j <= h[i + 1]; j++) {
            int x = i, mi = h[i + 1];
            for (int k = Log[n - i + 1]; ~k; k--) if (Min[k][x + 1] >= j) mi = min(mi, Min[k][x + 1]), x += 1 << k;
            int d = x - i + 1, cnt = mi - j + 1;
            cerr << i << " " << j << " " << d << " " << cnt << endl;
            if (K - tot - 1 <= (LL)cnt * d) {
                j += (K - tot - 1) / d;
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) putchar(s[sa[i] + l]);
                putchar('\n');
                return;
            }
            tot += d * cnt;
            j = mi;
        }
        int dev = n - sa[i] - j + 2;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

void work0() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int dev = n - sa[i] - h[i] + 1;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + h[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(T);
    read(K);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa();
    if (T) work1();
    else work0();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Tag {
    int mi, ma, lv, rv;
    Tag () {
        mi = INF, ma = -INF, lv = 0, rv = 0;
    }
    Tag (int a, int b, int c, int d) : mi(a), ma(b), lv(c), rv(d) {}
    inline friend Tag operator + (const Tag &a, const Tag &b) {
        //	printf("+ %d %d %d %d\n", min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
        return Tag(min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
    }
    inline void operator += (int v) {
        mi += v, ma += v;
    }
    inline Tag rev() {
        //	printf("rev!\n");
        return Tag(mi, ma, rv, lv);
    }
};

struct Node {
    int l, r, lz;
    Tag v;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;
int n, Q;
int a[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tid[MAXN], fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], son[MAXN], siz[MAXN], top[MAXN], stp;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else {
        t[x].v = Tag(a[rev[l]], a[rev[l]], 0, 0);
    }
    return x;
}

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
//	cerr << x << endl;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > siz[son[x]]) son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
}

void Link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++stp;
    rev[stp] = x;
    top[x] = anc;
//	printf("%d : %d\n", x, stp);
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

#define pd(x) {t[t[x].l].lz += t[x].lz; t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].lz += t[x].lz; t[x].lz = 0;}

Tag query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
//	if (x == 0) *((int*)NULL) = 1;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lz += v;
        t[x].v += v;
//		printf("[ret] %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
        return t[x].v;
    }
    if (t[x].lz) pd(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Tag ret;
    if (qr <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr, v);
    else if (ql > mid) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr, v);
    else ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid, v) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr, v);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
//	printf("[   ]%d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
//	printf(" ret %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", ql, qr, ret.mi, ret.ma, ret.lv, ret.rv);
    return ret;
}

int solve(int u, int v, int w) {
    Tag lp, rp;
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] > dep[top[v]]) {
            lp = lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[top[u]], tid[u], w).rev();
            u = fa[top[u]];
        } else {
            rp = query(1, 1, n, tid[top[v]], tid[v], w) + rp;
            v = fa[top[v]];
        }
    }
    if (tid[u] < tid[v]) {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[u], tid[v], w) + rp).lv;
    } else {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[v], tid[u], w).rev() + rp).lv;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 1);
    build(1, n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        printf("%d\n", solve(u, v, w));
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4012.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v, tot;
} t[MAXN * 44];

int tcnt = 0;
LL val[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].tot = t[t[x].l].tot + t[t[x].r].tot;
    } else t[x].tot = val[l];
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
//	printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += t[x].tot;
        t[x].lazy++;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr >  mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v + t[x].tot * t[x].lazy;
    }
//	printf("after update %d ~ %d %lld\n", l, r, t[x].v);
    return x;
}

LL query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int lv, int rv) {
//	printf("%d ~ %d %d ~ %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	printf("%lld %lld %d %d %lld\n", t[rx].v, t[lx].v, (rv + t[rx].lazy), (lv + t[lx].lazy), t[rx].tot);
        return t[rx].v - t[lx].v + rv * t[rx].tot - lv * t[lx].tot;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    return ret;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, Q, A;
pair<int, int> a[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], top[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], son[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

void tree_update(int x, int &rt) {
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        rt = update(rt, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x]);
//		printf("%d ~ %d\n", top[x], x);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    rt = update(rt, 1, n, 1, tag[x]);
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n", 1, x);
}

LL tree_query(int x, int lx, int rx) {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        ret += query(lx, rx, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x], 0, 0);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ret + query(lx, rx, 1, n, 1, tag[x], 0, 0);
}

LL sum[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int rt[MAXN];

void init() {
    static int q[MAXN], he = 0, ta = 0;
    dis[1] = fa[1] = dep[1] = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    int x;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
                fa[e[now].to] = x;
                dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    while (ta) {
        x = q[--ta];
        siz[x]++;
        siz[fa[x]] += siz[x];
        if (maxs[fa[x]] < siz[x]) {
            maxs[fa[x]] = siz[x];
            son[fa[x]] = x;
        }
    }
    tag[1] = top[1] = 1;
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        if (son[x]) {
            tag[son[x]] = tag[x] + 1;
            top[son[x]] = top[x];
            q[ta++] = son[x];
            int tot = tag[x] + maxs[x];
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                    tag[e[now].to] = tot + 1;
                    top[e[now].to] = e[now].to;
                    tot += siz[e[now].to];
                    q[ta++] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        val[tag[i]] = dis[i] - dis[fa[i]];
    }
    rt[0] = build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        //	printf("%d : %d %lld\n", i, a[i].second, dis[a[i].second]);
        rt[i] = rt[i - 1];
        tree_update(a[i].second, rt[i]);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + dis[a[i].second];
        //	printf("%lld\n", t[rt[i]].v);
    }
}

int find(LL x) {
    int l = 1, r = n + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid].first > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] = make_pair(x, i);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    LL ans = 0, l, r;
    for (int i = 1, u; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + ans) % A, r = (r + ans) % A;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        int L = find(l - 1), R = find(r);
        //printf("L = %d R = %d\n", L, R);
        if (L >= R) printf("%lld\n", ans = 0);
        else {
            //	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", sum[R], sum[L], dis[u]);
            //	printf("%lld\n", tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]));
            ans = sum[R] - sum[L] + dis[u] * (R - L) - tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]) * 2;
            printf("%lld\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

int lowbit(int x) {
    return x&(-x);
}

void add(int i,int x) {
    i++;
    if (!i) return;
    for (; i<=n+1; i+=lowbit(i)) c[i]^=x;
}

int query(int i) {
    int ans=0;
    i++;
    for (; i; i-=lowbit(i)) ans^=c[i];
    return ans;
}

void calc1(int t) {
    int sum=1,now=0;
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x=((a[i]>>t)&1);
        now^=x;
        if (now==1) ans+=sum;
        else ans+=i-sum,sum++;
    }
    ans1=(ans1+ans*(1ll<<t)%mod)%mod;
}

int Query(long long x) {
    int l=0,r=n,ans=-1;
    while (l<=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)/2;
        if (t[mid]<=x) ans=mid,l=mid+1;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return ans;
}

void calc2(long long p) {
    memset(c,0,sizeof(c));
    t[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) t[i]=(t[i-1]+a[i])%(1ll<<(p+1)),b[i]=t[i];
    sort(t,t+n+1);
    for (int i = -3; i <= 4; i++) printf("%lld ", Query(i));
    putchar('\n');
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        add(Query(b[i]),1);
        ans^=(query(Query(b[i]-(1ll<<p)))^query(Query(b[i]))^query(Query(b[i]+(1ll<<p))));
    }
    if (ans) ans2|=(1ll<<p);
    //	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", ans2, (1ll<<(p+1)), (1ll<<p));
}

    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%lld",&a[i]);
    for (int i=0; i<=20; i++) calc1(i);
    for (int i=0; i<=40; i++) calc2(i);
    printf("%lld %lld\n",ans1,ans2);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4025.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 200319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *mi;
    int val, siz;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : mi(this), val(INF), siz(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        ch->fa = this;
        c[p] = ch;
    }
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = this;
        if (c[0]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[0]->mi;
        if (c[1]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[1]->mi;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->mi = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->siz = ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
        fa->isrt = 0;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXM];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

Node *getf(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];
pair <int, int> E[MAXN + MAXM];
bool del[MAXN + MAXM];

Node *newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(a[u], mid);
    Link(a[v], mid);
    E[mid - mem] = make_pair(u, v);
    return mid;
}

int cnt = 0;

void delE(Node *mid) {
    if (mid == null) return;
    if (del[mid - mem]) cnt--;
    else {
        del[mid - mem] = 1;
        int u = E[mid - mem].first, v = E[mid - mem].second;
        Cut(mid, a[u]);
        Cut(mid, a[v]);
    }
}

Node *add(int u, int v, int w) {
    if (getf(a[u]) == getf(a[v])) {
        Node *x = query(a[u], a[v]);
        if (~((x->siz + 1) >> 1) & 1) return null;
        else {
            cnt++;
            if (x->mi->val < w) {
                delE(x->mi);
                return newE(u, v, w);
            } else {
                del[0] = 1;
                return mem;
            }
        }
    } else return newE(u, v, w);
}

struct edge {
    int u, v, s, t;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return s < b.s;
    }
} e[MAXM];

vector <Node*> b[MAXN];

int n, m, T;

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].s);
        read(e[i].t);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < T; i++) {
        while (j <= m && e[j].s == i) {
            b[e[j].t].push_back(add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].t));
            j++;
        }
        for (int k = (int)b[i].size() - 1; k > -1; k--) delE(b[i][k]);
        if (cnt) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4033.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005

typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,k,head[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dp[MAXN][MAXN],temp[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    siz[x]=1;
    dp[x][0]=dp[x][1]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            int topx=min(siz[x],k),topv=min(siz[v],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) temp[i]=dp[x][i];
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<=topv && i+j<=k; j++) {
                    temp[i+j]=max(temp[i+j],dp[x][i]+dp[v][j]+e[now].w*(j*(k-j)+(siz[v]-j)*(n-k-siz[v]+j)));
                }
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            topx=min(siz[x],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++) dp[x][i]=temp[i];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int u,v,w;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%lld\n",dp[1][k]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4034.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0',ch=getchar();
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int n,m,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN];
int top[MAXN],dep[MAXN],ss[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],tid[MAXN],sub[MAXN],S[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1];

long long t[s<<1],lazy[s<<1];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    ss[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
            if (ss[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=ss[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    sub[x]=dfn;
}

inline void init() {
    fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[s+tid[i]]=a[i];
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
        S[s+i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=n+1; i<s; i++) L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)^1];
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)^1];
        S[i]=S[i<<1]<<1;
    }
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (!lazy[x] || x>=s) return;
    long long delta=lazy[x]*S[x<<1];
    t[x<<1]+=delta,lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    t[(x<<1)^1]+=delta,lazy[(x<<1)^1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=(long long)d*S[x];
        lazy[x]=d;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(x<<1,l,min(mid,r),d);
    if (r>mid) update((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r,d);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1];
}

long long query(int x,int l,int r) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r)
        return t[x];
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    long long ans=0;
    if (l<=mid) ans+=query(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) ans+=query((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r);
    return ans;
}

inline long long q(int x) {
    long long ans=0;
    while (top[x]!=1) {
        ans+=query(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x]);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ans+query(1,1,tid[x]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        if (op==1) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],tid[x],y);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],sub[x],y);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",q(x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4066.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void Max(int &a, int b) {
    if (a < b) a = b;
}
inline void Min(int &a, int b) {
    if (a > b) a = b;
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int siz, sum, val;
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2];
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1, sum = val;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz, sum += l->sum;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz, sum += r->sum;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

bool D;

inline bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D];
}

int Q[2], A;

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->d[0] = Q[0];
    ptr->d[1] = Q[1];
    ptr->val = A;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = 0;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) x->val += A;
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int tot;
Node *tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, bool d) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    tmp[mid]->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    tmp[mid]->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    tmp[mid]->upd();
    return tmp[mid];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++tot] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        tot = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, tot, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

bool in(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1<=X1&&X2<=x2&&y1<=Y1&&Y2<=y2;
}
bool out(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1>X2||x2<X1||y1>Y2||y2<Y1;
}

int query(Node *k,int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2) {
    if(!k)return 0;
    int ret=0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return k->sum;
    if(out(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return 0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->d[0],k->d[1],k->d[0],k->d[1])) ret += k->val;
    ret += query(k->l,x1,y1,x2,y2) + query(k->r,x1,y1,x2,y2);
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int op, x, y, z, w; ; ) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 3) break;
        if (op == 1) {
            read(Q[0]);
            read(Q[1]);
            read(A);
            Q[0] ^= ans, Q[1] ^= ans, A ^= ans;
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            read(w);
            read(y);
            read(x);
            read(z);
            w ^= ans, x ^= ans, y ^= ans, z ^= ans;
            ans = query(rt, w, y, x, z);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000005

        return l<a.l;
    }

int work(int x) {
    int target=x+n,ret=1;
    for (int k=19; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[x][k]<target) {
            ret|=1<<k;
            x=fa[x][k];
        }
    }
    return ret+1;
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i].l), read(a[i].r), a[i].r += 1 + (a[i].l <= a[i].r ? 0 : m);
        if (a[i].r - a[i].l == m) return puts("1"), 0;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int maxr = 0, j = 1, d = 0, mrd = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (a[j].l + d <= a[i].r) {
            if (a[j].r + d > a[maxr].r + mrd) maxr = j, mrd = d;
            if (j == n) d = m;
            j = j % n + 1;
        }
        fa[i][0] = maxr;
        cerr << "[ " << a[i].l << ", " << a[i].r << "] -> [" << a[maxr].l << ", " << a[maxr].r << "]\n" ;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=19; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            fa[i][k]=fa[fa[i][k-1]][k-1] + (fa[i][k - 1] - 1) / ;
        }
    }
    int ans = n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) ans=min(ans,work(i));
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4103.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXM 300005
#define TOP 30
struct Node {
    int c[2], v;
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return c[x];
    }
} t[MAXM * 32];

int n, m, Q, tcnt = 0;
int a[1005], b[MAXM], rt[MAXM];

void insert(int x, int v) {
    int now = tcnt;
    t[now] = t[x];
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        int p = (v>>i)&1;
        t[now][p] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][p], now = tcnt;
        t[now] = t[x], t[now].v++;
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) rt[i] = ++tcnt, insert(rt[i-1], b[i]);
}

#define siz(lx, rx, p) (t[t[rx][p]].v - t[t[lx][p]].v)

int lx[1005], rx[1005];

int query(int u, int d, int l, int r, int k) {
    int ls = 0, to, ans;
    for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) lx[i] = rt[l - 1], rx[i] = rt[r], ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], (a[i] >> TOP)&1);
    if (ls < k) k -= ls, ans = to = 1;
    else ans = to = 0;
    for (int q = TOP; q > 0; q--) {
        ls = 0;
        for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) {
            int p = (a[i]>>q)&1;
            lx[i] = t[lx[i]][p^to];
            rx[i] = t[rx[i]][p^to];
            p = (a[i]>>(q - 1))&1;
            ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], p);
        }
        if (ls < k) k -= ls, to = 1;
        else to = 0;
        ans = (ans << 1) ^ to;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    init();
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, d, l, r, k; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(d);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n", query(u, d, l, r, (r - l + 1) * (d - u + 1) - k + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
