int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 70
#define P 19260817
#define Q 20000816
map<LL, int> vis;
int n, p, m;
struct Mat {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int *operator [] (int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator *= (Mat &b) {
        static Mat c;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                c[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    c[i][j] = (c[i][j] + a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        *this = c;
    }
} a, b, tmp;

LL Hash(Mat &x) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            ret = (ret * P + x[i][j]) ^ Q;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    m = int(sqrt(p)) + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(b[i][j]);
    tmp = b;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) tmp *= a, vis[Hash(tmp)] = i;
    tmp = a;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) tmp *= a;
    a = tmp;
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) {
        int x = vis[Hash(tmp)];
        if (x) {
            printf("%d\n", i * m - x);
            return 0;
        }
        tmp *= a;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4143.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {

    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();

}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

int st[MAXN], ed[MAXN];
int ds[MAXM], dt[MAXM];
int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    ed[0] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    for (int i = 1, d; i <= n; i++) {
        read(st[i]);
        read(ed[i]);
        read(d);
        if (st[ds[d]] < st[i]) ds[d] = i;
        if (ed[dt[d]] > ed[i]) dt[d] = i;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (st[ds[i]] <= ed[dt[i]]) puts("NIE");
        else printf("TAK %d %d\n", dt[i], ds[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4145.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define N 105
#define M 16
#define T 65536
#define INF LL(1e18)
int n, m, t;
int d[N], c[N][M];
LL dp[T], f[T];

void work(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) f[i] = dp[i];
    for (int i = m - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        int k = 1 << i;
        for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) f[j | k] = min(f[j | k], f[j] + c[x][i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = min(dp[i], f[i] + d[x]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(d[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) read(c[i][j]);
    }
    t = 1 << m;
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    printf("%lld\n", dp[t - 1]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4184.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500005

struct QAQ {
    int v, tag;
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (abs(v) != abs(a.v)) return abs(v)<abs(a.v);
        else return tag < a.tag;
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r, head;
    Node() : head(0) {}
} t[1048576];
int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

struct Query {
    int v, next;
} q[500005 * 20];
int qcnt = 0;

void add(int &head, int v) {
    q[++qcnt].v = v;
    q[qcnt].next = head;
    head = qcnt;
}

void addEx(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(t[x].head, v);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) addEx(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) addEx(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

#define TOP 30
struct Basis {
    int v[TOP + 1];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    Basis() {
        memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
    }
    void merge(int x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if ((x>>i)&1) {
                if (v[i]) x ^= v[i];
                else {
                    v[i] = x;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

void solve(int x, int l, int r, Basis v) {
    for (int now = t[x].head; now; now = q[now].next) v.merge(q[now].v);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid, v);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, v);
    } else {
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) ret = max(ret, ret ^ v[i]);
        printf("%d\n", ret);
    }
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].v);
        a[i].tag = i;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j) {
        int cnt = 1;
        j = i + 1;
        while (j <= n && abs(a[j].v) == a[i].v) {
            if (a[j++].v >= 0) cnt++;
            else cnt--;
            if (cnt == 0) break;
        }
        if (cnt) addEx(1, 1, n, a[i].tag, n, a[i].v);
        else addEx(1, 1, n, a[i].tag, a[j - 1].tag - 1, a[i].v);
    }
    solve(1, 1, n, Basis());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4195.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

struct query {
    int x,y,eq;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n,cnt,f[MAXN<<1],tem[MAXN<<1];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline void merge(int a,int b) {
    f[getf(a)]=f[getf(b)];
}

inline int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]<x)
            l=mid+1;
        else
            r=mid;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        cnt=0;
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&q[i].x,&q[i].y,&q[i].eq);
            tem[++cnt]=q[i].x,tem[++cnt]=q[i].y;
        }
        sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
        cnt=int(unique(tem+1,tem+cnt+1)-tem-1);
        //init
        for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)
            f[i]=i;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (q[i].eq)
                merge(find(q[i].x),find(q[i].y));
        }
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!q[i].eq && getf(find(q[i].x))==getf(find(q[i].y))) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) puts("YES");
        else puts("NO");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4198ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<queue>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define LL long long
struct H {
    LL w;
    int l;
    bool operator < (const H &a) const {
        if (w!=a.w) return a.w<w;
        return a.l<l;
    }
};
priority_queue<H> h;
int n,k,nn;
LL ans=0;
int in() {
    int x=0;
    char ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') x=x*10+ch-'0',ch=getchar();
    return x;
}
LL Lin() {
    LL x=0;
    char ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') x=x*10+(LL)(ch-'0'),ch=getchar();
    return x;
}
int main() {
    n=in(),k=in();
    nn=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        LL x=Lin();
        h.push((H) {
            x,1
        });
    }
    if ((n-1)%(k-1)) nn+=(k-1)-((n-1)%(k-1));
    for (int i=n+1; i<=nn; i++)
        h.push((H) {
        0,1
    });
    while (nn>1) {
        LL s1=0;
        int s2=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
            H x=h.top();
            h.pop();
            s1+=x.w;
            s2=max(s2,x.l);
        }
        ans+=s1;
        nn-=(k-1);
        h.push((H) {
            s1,s2+1
        });
    }
    printf("%lld\n%d\n",ans,h.top().l-1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4198.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
struct node {
    LL s;
    int h;
    node() {}
    node(LL a,int b):s(a),h(b) {}
    bool operator < (node a) const {
        if (s!=a.s) return s>a.s;
        else return h>a.h;
    }
};
priority_queue<node> q;
int n,K,ansh=0;
LL ans=0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        LL w;
        read(w);
        q.push(node(w,1));
    }
    if ((n-1)%(K-1)) for (int i=(K-1)-((n-1)%(K-1)); i; i--) q.push(node(0,1));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        LL sum=0;
        int h=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=K && !q.empty(); i++) {
            node a=q.top();
            q.pop();
            sum+=a.s;
            h=max(h,a.h);
        }
        h++;
        ans+=sum;
        if (q.empty()) {
            ansh=h-1;
            break;
        }
        q.push(node(sum,h));
    }
    printf("%lld\n%d\n",ans,ansh);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4209.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 300005
#define T 1000000001
struct Node {
    int l, r, cnt;
    LL sum;
} t[MAXN * 3 * 30];

int n, m, srt[MAXN], ort[MAXN], ert[MAXN], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].sum += p, t[x].cnt++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

LL getsum(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (rx == lx) return 0;
    if (l == r) {
        return (t[rx].sum - t[lx].sum) / (t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt) * (t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt - k);
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lcnt = t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt < k) return getsum(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, k - lcnt);
    else return getsum(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, k) + t[t[rx].r].sum - t[t[lx].r].sum;
}

int getkth(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lcnt = t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt < k) return getkth(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, k - lcnt);
    else return getkth(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, k);
}

int rank(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int v) {
    if (l == r) return 1;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (v <= mid) return rank(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, v);
    else return t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt + rank(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, v);
}

int geq(int rx, int lx, int v) {
    int rk = rank(rx, lx, 1, T, v);
    if (rk > t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt) return -1;
    else return getkth(rx, lx, 1, T, rk);
}

int leq(int rx, int lx, int v) {
    int rk = rank(rx, lx, 1, T, v + 1) - 1;
    if (!rk) return -1;
    else return getkth(rx, lx, 1, T, rk);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) {
        read(ai);
        srt[i] = update(srt[i - 1], 1, T, ai);
        if (ai & 1) ort[i] = update(ort[i - 1], 1, T, ai), ert[i] = ert[i - 1];
        else ert[i] = update(ert[i - 1], 1, T, ai), ort[i] = ort[i - 1];
    }
    read(m);
    for (int l, r, k; m--; ) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        l--;
        if (r - l < k) {
            puts("-1");
            continue;
        }
        LL sum = getsum(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k);
        if (!(sum & 1)) {
            printf("%lld\n", sum);
            continue;
        }
        if (r - l == k) {
            puts("-1");
            continue;
        }
        int lo = getkth(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k), hi = getkth(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k + 1);
        LL ans = -1, ret1, ret2;
        // odd -> even
        ret1 = geq(ort[r], ort[l], hi);
        ret2 = leq(ert[r], ert[l], lo);
        if (ret1 != -1 && ret2 != -1) ans = max(ans, sum - ret1 + ret2);
        // odd -> even
        ret1 = geq(ert[r], ert[l], hi);
        ret2 = leq(ort[r], ort[l], lo);
        if (ret1 != -1 && ret2 != -1) ans = max(ans, sum - ret1 + ret2);
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
int n, m;
int a[1005], tmp[1005];

void getans(int l, int r, int k) {
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = cnt; i > cnt - k; i--) sum += tmp[i];
    if (sum & 1) {
        int mi[2] = {INF, INF}, ma[2] = {-INF, -INF};
        for (int i = 1; i <= cnt - k; i++) ma[tmp[i] & 1] = tmp[i];
        for (int i = cnt; i > cnt - k; i--) mi[tmp[i] & 1] = tmp[i];
        int ans = -1;
        ans = max(ans, sum - mi[0] + ma[1]);
        ans = max(ans, sum - mi[1] + ma[0]);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    } else printf("%d\n", sum);
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    read(m);
    int l, r, k;
    while (m--) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        if (r - l + 1 < k) {
            puts("-1");
            continue;
        }
        getans(l, r, k);
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,ans=0;
char s[200005];
int cnt[3];
struct statu {
    int x,y,t;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b,int c):x(a),y(b),t(c) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        if (y!=a.y) return y<a.y;
        return t<a.t;
    }
    bool operator == (statu a) const {
        return x==a.x && y==a.y;
    }
} hh[200005];
int tot=0;
int val(char x) {
    if (x=='J') return 0;
    if (x=='O') return 1;
    return 2;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    ans=0;
    scanf("%s",s+1);
    hh[++tot]=statu(0,0,0);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        cnt[val(s[i])]++;
        hh[++tot]=statu(cnt[2]-cnt[1],cnt[1]-cnt[0],i);
    }
    sort(hh+1,hh+tot+1);
    hh[0]=statu(hh[1].x-1,0,0);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (hh[i]==hh[i-1]) ans=max(ans,hh[i].t-hh[i-1].t),hh[i].t=hh[i-1].t;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4241_.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005

int n, Q, a[MAXN], blo[MAXN], tem[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], sqn, bt, tot;
int cnt[320][MAXN], tmp[MAXN];
LL f[320][320];

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n)) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        tem[i] = a[i];
        blo[i] = i / sqn + 1, L[blo[i]] ? (R[blo[i]] = i) : (L[blo[i]] = R[blo[i]] = i);
    }
    bt =  blo[n];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1, a[i]) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= bt; i++) {
        for (int j = L[i]; j <= R[i]; j++) tmp[a[j]]++;
        memcpy(cnt[i] + 1, tmp + 1, sizeof(int) * tot);
    }
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 0; i < bt; i++) {
        LL ret = 0;
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= bt; j++) {
            for (int k = L[j]; k <= R[j]; k++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[k]] * LL(++tmp[a[k]]));
            f[i][j] = ret;
        }
        memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    for (int i = 1, l, r, bl, br; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        bl = blo[l], br = blo[r];
        LL ret = 0;
        if (bl < br) {
            ret = f[bl][br - 1];
            for (int j = l; j <= R[bl]; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]] + cnt[br - 1][a[j]] - cnt[bl][a[j]]));
            for (int j = L[br]; j <= r; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]] + cnt[br - 1][a[j]] - cnt[bl][a[j]]));
            for (int j = l; j <= R[bl]; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
            for (int j = L[br]; j <= r; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
        } else {
            for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]]));
            for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ret);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4241.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100005

int blo[MAXN], sqn;

struct Node {
    int l, r, id;
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        if (blo[l] != blo[a.l]) return l < a.l;
        else return r < a.r;
    }
} s[MAXN];

int n, Q, a[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], tem[MAXN];
int S = 1;
LL t[262144], ans[MAXN];

inline void del(int x) {
    t[x + S] -= tem[x];
    for (x = (x + S) >> 1; x; x >>= 1) t[x] = t[x << 1] < t[(x << 1) ^ 1] ? t[(x << 1) ^ 1] : t[x << 1];
}

inline void add(int x) {
    t[x + S] += tem[x];
    for (x = (x + S) >> 1; x; x >>= 1) t[x] = t[x << 1] < t[(x << 1) ^ 1] ? t[(x << 1) ^ 1] : t[x << 1];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n)) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), blo[i] = i / sqn, tem[i] = a[i];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    int tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1, a[i]) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) read(s[i].l), read(s[i].r), s[i].id = i;
    sort(s + 1, s + Q + 1);
    int l = s[1].l, r = s[1].l - 1;
    while (S < n) S <<= 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        while (l < s[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        while (l > s[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (r > s[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (r < s[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        ans[s[i].id] = t[1];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) printf("%lld\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 400005
#define bitwise 29
struct trie_node {
    int l,r;
} t[MAXN*32];
int tcnt=0;
int n,a[MAXN],f[MAXN],g[MAXN];
void clear() {
    t[0].l=t[0].r=0;
    tcnt=0;
}
void insert(int x) {
    int now=0;
    for (int i=bitwise; i>-1; i--) {
        if ((x>>i)&1) {
            if (!t[now].l) t[now].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt].l=t[tcnt].r=0;
            now=t[now].l;
        } else {
            if (!t[now].r) t[now].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt].l=t[tcnt].r=0;
            now=t[now].r;
        }
    }
}
int query(int x) {
    int now=0,ret=0;
    for (int i=bitwise; i>-1; i--) {
        ret<<=1;
        if ((x>>i)&1) {
            if (!t[now].r) now=t[now].l;
            else now=t[now].r,ret|=1;
        } else {
            if (!t[now].l) now=t[now].r;
            else now=t[now].l,ret|=1;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    clear();
    f[0]=0;
    insert(0);
    for (int i=1,sum=0; i<=n; i++) {
        sum^=a[i];
        f[i]=max(f[i-1],query(sum));
        insert(sum);
    }
    clear();
    g[n+1]=0;
    insert(0);
    for (int i=n,sum=0; i>0; i--) {
        sum^=a[i];
        g[i]=max(g[i+1],query(sum));
        insert(sum);
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        ans=max(ans,f[i]+g[i+1]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;

        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005

int n;
int a[MAXN];

void gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 30; i > -1; i--) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && (~a[to]>>i)&1) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now && (a[j]>>i)&1) a[j] ^= a[now];
        }
        now++;
    }
    n = now;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    gauss();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) ans ^= a[i];
    printf("%d %d\n", ans, ans^a[n - 1]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4278.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005
const int P = 19260817;
const int P1 = 1001;
const int MOD = 2147483647;
char s[MAXN];
LL x[MAXN], x1[MAXN];
int n, m, top;
int A[MAXN], B[MAXN], ans[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL a, b;
    Hash append(int q) {
        Hash ret = *this;
        ret.a = ret.a * P + q;
        ret.b = (ret.b * P1 + q) % MOD;
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator == (Hash q) const {
        return a == q.a && b == q.b;
    }
} a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

Hash Ha(int st, int len, Hash hh[]) {
    Hash ret = hh[st + len];
    ret.a -= hh[st].a * x[len];
    ret.b -= (hh[st].b * x1[len]) % MOD;
    if ((ret.b>>63)&1) ret.b += MOD;
    return ret;
}

int lcp(int u, int v) {
    int l = 0, r = min(n - u, m - v), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (Ha(u, mid, a) == Ha(v, mid, b)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

bool cmp(int u, int v) {
    int l = lcp(u, v);
    if (u + l == n) {
        if (v + l == m) return 1;
        else return A[u + 1] < B[v + l + 1];
    } else if (v + l == m) return A[u + l + 1] < B[v + 1];
    return A[u + l + 1] < B[v + l + 1];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(A[i]), a[i] = a[i - 1].append(A[i]);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(B[i]), b[i] = b[i - 1].append(B[i]);
    x[0] = x1[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max(n, m); i++) x[i] = x[i - 1] * P, x1[i] = (x1[i - 1] * P1) % MOD;
    int la = 1, lb = 1;
    while (la <= n && lb <= m) {
        if (cmp(la - 1, lb - 1)) ans[++top] = A[la++];
        else ans[++top] = B[lb++];
    }
    while (la <= n) ans[++top] = A[la++];
    while (lb <= m) ans[++top] = B[lb++];
    for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) printf("%d ", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 100005
#define LOG 32
#define TOP 1000000319

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * LOG];

int tcnt = 0, rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v += p;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, TOP, x);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = rt[l - 1], r = rt[r];
        int v = 0, x = -1;
        while (1) {
            x = query(l, r, 1, TOP, 1, v + 1);
            if (x <= v) break;
            v = x;
        }
        printf("%d\n", v + 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

        }
    }
    while (!ans.empty()) printf("%d\n", ans.top()), ans.pop();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4326.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 300005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,maxl=0,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],rs[MAXN],rt[MAXN],rd[MAXN],len[MAXN];

int ss[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;

int t[MAXN],rlen[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void input() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(rs[i]);
        read(rt[i]);
    }
}

void finds(int x) {
    son[x]=maxs[x]=0;
    ss[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            rd[v]=e[now].w;
            dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
            if (ss[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=ss[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    rlen[dfn]=rd[x];
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void init() {
    input();
    fa[1]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]>dep[top[v]]) {
            swap(u,v);
        }
        v=fa[top[v]];
    }
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) return u;
    return v;
}

inline void getlen() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int lca=getLCA(rs[i],rt[i]);
        len[i]=dis[rs[i]]+dis[rt[i]]-(dis[lca]<<1);
        maxl=max(maxl,len[i]);
    }
}

inline void mark(int x) {
    int u=rs[x],v=rt[x];
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]>dep[top[v]]) {
            swap(u,v);
        }
        // mark top[v] + ~ v +
        t[tid[top[v]]]++,t[tid[v]+1]--;
        v=fa[top[v]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) {
        swap(u,v);
    }
    // mark u - ~ v +
    t[tid[u]+1]++,t[tid[v]+1]--;
}

inline bool check(int x) {
    memset(t,0,sizeof(t));
    int cnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (len[i]>x) {
            mark(i);
            cnt++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[i]+=t[i-1];
        if (t[i]>=cnt && maxl-x<=rlen[i]) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("transport.in","r",stdin);
    //freopen("transport.out","w",stdout);
    init();
    getlen();
    int l=0,r=maxl,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 4], E[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int Eh[MAXN], Ecnt = 1;

int n, m, dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN], stp;
int sta[MAXN], top;
int bel[MAXN], scc;

void dfs(int x) {
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    sta[++top] = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to) {
            if (!dfn[e[now].to]) {
                e[now ^ 1].to = 0;
                dfs(e[now].to);
                e[now ^ 1].to = x;
                low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
            } else low[x] = min(low[x], dfn[e[now].to]);
        }
    if (low[x] == dfn[x]) {
        bel[x] = ++scc;
        while (sta[top] != x) {
            bel[sta[top--]] = scc;
        }
        top--;
    }
}

int val[MAXN], ans = INF;

void tar(int x) {
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    sta[++top] = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to) {
            if (!dfn[e[now].to]) {
                e[now ^ 1].to = 0;
                tar(e[now].to);
                e[now ^ 1].to = x;
                low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
                if (low[e[now].to] > dfn[x]) {
                    ans = min(ans, e[now].w);
                }
            } else low[x] = min(low[x], dfn[e[now].to]);
        }
    if (low[x] == dfn[x]) {
        bel[x] = ++scc;
        while (sta[top] != x) {
            bel[sta[top--]] = scc;
        }
        top--;
    }
}

void DP(int x) {
    val[x] = INF;
    for (int now = Eh[x]; now; now = E[now].next) {
        if (E[now].to) {
            E[now ^ 1].to = 0;
            DP(E[now].to);
            val[x] = min(val[x], min(val[E[now].to], E[now].w));
        }
    }
}

void work(int x) {
    bool flag = 0;
    for (int now = Eh[x]; now; now = E[now].next) {
        if (E[now].to) {
            int v = min(val[E[now].to], E[now].w);
            if (!flag && v == val[x]) {
                work(E[now].to);
                flag = 1;
            } else ans = min(ans, v);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u, w
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(1);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!dfn[i]) tar(i), tot++;
    }
    if (tot > 1) return puts("0"), 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (i < e[now].to && bel[i] != bel[e[now].to]) {
                int u = bel[i], v = bel[e[now].to];
                E[++Ecnt] = (edge) {
                    Eh[u], v, e[now].w
                };
                Eh[u] = Ecnt;
                E[++Ecnt] = (edge) {
                    Eh[v], u, e[now].w
                };
                Eh[v] = Ecnt;
            }
        }
    }
    DP(bel[1]);
    if (tot == 1) ans = min(ans, val[bel[1]]);
    else work(bel[1]);
    printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? -1 : ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4336.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 40005
#define s 1024

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, Q, K, ecnt = 0, head[MAXN], att[MAXN], bel[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], fa[MAXN], son[MAXN], top[MAXN];
int tid[MAXN], tot = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            finds(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x] = siz[e[now].to];
                son[x] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++tot;
    top[x] = anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[33554432];
int tcnt = 0;

int root[2048];

void init() {
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 1;
    finds(1);
    link(1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 2048; i++) root[i] = ++tcnt;
}

int tol(int x) {
    if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
    return t[x].l;
}
int tor(int x) {
    if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
    return t[x].r;
}

void update(int x, int p, int c) {
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    t[x].v += c;
    while (l < r) {
        if (p <= (mid = (l + r) >> 1)) r = mid, x = tol(x);
        else l = mid + 1, x = tor(x);
        t[x].v += c;
    }
}

void change(int p, int v, int c) {
//	printf("Change %d %d %d\n", p, v, c);
    int x = 1, l = 0, r = 1023, mid;
    update(root[1], p, c);
    while (l < r) {
        if (v <= (mid = (l + r) >> 1)) r = mid, x <<= 1;
        else l = mid + 1, x = (x << 1) ^ 1;
        update(root[x], p, c);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x || !t[x].v) {
        /*printf("exit %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);*/ return 0;
    }
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int ask(int rt, int u, int v) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] < dep[top[v]]) swap(u, v);
        ret += query(rt, 1, n, tid[top[u]], tid[u]);
        u = fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u] > dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    return ret + query(rt, 1, n, tid[u], tid[v]);
}

int select(int k, int u, int v) {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < s) {
        int lsiz = ask(root[x <<= 1], u, v);
        //	printf("%d %d %d\n", k, lsiz, x);
        if (k > lsiz) x ^= 1, k -= lsiz;
    }
    //printf("return : %d %d\n", x, x - s);
    return x - s;
}

#define V 1005

int ans[25];
void work(int u, int v) {
    int k = 0;
    while (++k <= K) {
        if ((ans[k] = select(k, u, v)) >= V) break;
    }
    if (k == 1) puts("-1");
    else {
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) printf("%d ", V - ans[i]);
        putchar('\n');
    }
}

int main() {
    //freopen("4336.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(att[i]);
        read(bel[i]);
        att[i] = V - att[i];
        change(tid[bel[i]], att[i], 1);
    }
    read(Q);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, x, u, v; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (x) {
        case 2:
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], -1);
            bel[u] = v;
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], 1);
            break;
        case 3:
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], -1);
            att[u] = V - v;
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], 1);
            break;
        case 1:
            work(u, v);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef unsigned long long LL;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*2];
int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
vector <LL> a[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

LL dfs(int x,int depth,int fa) {
    int cnt=0;
    a[x].clear();
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            cnt++;
            a[x].push_back(dfs(e[now].to,depth+1,x));
        }
    }
    sort(a[x].begin(),a[x].end());
    LL ret=1;
    for (vector<LL>::iterator it=a[x].begin(); it!=a[x].end(); it++) {
        ret=ret*Q+(*it);
    }
    return (ret^P)*(depth*Q+cnt);
}

void work() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,fa; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&fa);
        if (fa!=0) add(fa,i);
    }
}

void markall(int index) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) mp[dfs(i,0,0)]=index;
}

    if(y==z) {
        mn[x]=y;
        return ;
    }
    int mid=y+z>>1;

int find(int x,int y,int z,int l,int r,ll fv) {
    int mid=y+z>>1;
    if(y==z) {
        return a[mn[x]]<=fv?y:0;
    }
    if(y==l&&z==r) {
        if(a[mn[x]]>fv) {
            return 0;
        }
        if(a[mn[x<<1]]<=fv) {
            return find(x<<1,y,mid,l,mid,fv);
        } else {
            return find(x<<1|1,mid+1,z,mid+1,r,fv);
        }
    }
    if(r<=mid) {
        return find(x<<1,y,mid,l,r,fv);
    } else if(l>mid) {
        return find(x<<1|1,mid+1,z,l,r,fv);
    } else {
        int re=find(x<<1,y,mid,l,mid,fv);
        return re?re:find(x<<1|1,mid+1,z,mid+1,r,fv);
    }
}

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();

struct Node_ {
    int u, v;

        return v < a.v;
    }

    int l, r;
    int v;

    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
    } else t[x].v = b[l];
    return x;
}

int find(int x, int l, int r, int p, LL v) {
    if (t[x].v > v || r < p) return 0;
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = find(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
    if (ret) return ret;
    return find(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
}

int r[50], cnt = 0;

    if (!K) return;
    if (!rem) {
        if (!(--K)) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
            printf("\n");
        }
        return;

    while (x <= n) {
        x = find(1, 1, n, x, rem);
        if (!x) return;
        r[++cnt] = x;
        dfs(x + 1, rem - b[x]);
        cnt--;
        x++;
    }
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct Node {
    int l, r, bot, top;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int n, K, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].bot = -1, t[x].top = INF;
    } else t[x].bot = 0, t[x].top = 0;
    return x;
}

void fill(int x, int v) {
    t[x].bot = max(t[x].bot, v);
    if (t[x].bot > t[x].top) t[x].top = t[x].bot;
}

void clear(int x, int v) {
    t[x].top = min(t[x].top, v);
    if (t[x].bot > t[x].top) t[x].bot = t[x].top;
}

void fil(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        fill(x, v);
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
    if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) fil(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) fil(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

void clr(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        clear(x, v);
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
    if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) clr(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) clr(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

void print(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l < r) {
        if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
        if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        print(t[x].l, l, mid);
        print(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else printf("%d\n", t[x].top);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    build(0, n - 1);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r, h; i <= K; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(h);
        if (op == 1) fil(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, h);
        else clr(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, h);
    }
    print(1, 0, n - 1);
    return 0;
}

#include<iostream>

using namespace std;
inline long long read() {

        if(ch == '-') f = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

struct data {
    int mx,mn;
    ll sum;
    friend data operator +(data a,data b) {
        return(data) {
            max(a.mx,b.mx),min(a.mn,b.mn),a.sum+b.sum
        };
    }

struct Tree {
    int l,r;
    data x;
} T[MN*4+5];
int t[N*2+5],t2[N*2+5],cnt=0,a[MN+5],last=0,n,m;

inline int gcd(int x,int y) {
    return !y?x:gcd(y,x%y);
}
inline int abs(int x) {
    return x<0?-x:x;
}

int Query2(int l,int r) {
    int res=0;
    for(l+=N-1,r+=N+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if(~l&1) res=gcd(res,t2[l+1]);
        if( r&1) res=gcd(res,t2[r-1]);
    }
    return res;
}

void Modify2(int x,int ad) {
    t2[x+=N]=ad;
    for(x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t2[x]=gcd(t2[x<<1],t2[x<<1|1]);
}

int Query(int l,int r) {
    int res=0;
    for(l+=N-1,r+=N+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if(~l&1) res=max(res,t[l+1]);
        if( r&1) res=max(res,t[r-1]);
    }
    return res;
}

void Modify(int x,int ad) {
    t[x+=N]=ad;
    for(x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=max(t[x<<1],t[x<<1|1]);
}

void Build(int x,int l,int r) {
    if((T[x].l=l)==(T[x].r=r)) {
        T[x].x=(data) {
            a[l],a[l],a[l]
        };
        return;
    }
    int mid=l+r>>1;
    Build(x<<1,l,mid);
    Build(x<<1|1,mid+1,r);
    T[x].x=T[x<<1].x+T[x<<1|1].x;
}

void Modify(int x,int k,int v) {
    if(T[x].l==T[x].r) T[x].x=(data) {
        v,v,v
    };
    else {
        int mid=T[x].l+T[x].r>>1;
        if(k<=mid) Modify(x<<1,k,v);
        else Modify(x<<1|1,k,v);
        T[x].x=T[x<<1].x+T[x<<1|1].x;
    }
}

data Query(int x,int l,int r) {
    if(T[x].l==l&&T[x].r==r) return T[x].x;
    int mid=T[x].l+T[x].r>>1;
    if(r<=mid) return Query(x<<1,l,r);
    else if(l>mid) return Query(x<<1|1,l,r);
    else return Query(x<<1,l,mid)+Query(x<<1|1,mid+1,r);
}

int main() {
    n=read();
    m=read();
    for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
        !mp[a[i]=read()]?mp[a[i]]=++cnt:0;
        int x=mp[a[i]];
        if(st[x].begin()!=st[x].end()) Modify(i,*(--st[x].end()));
        st[x].insert(i);
        if(i>1) Modify2(i-1,abs(a[i]-a[i-1]));
    }
    Build(1,1,n);
    for(int i=1; i<=m; ++i, last = 0) {
        int op=read();
        if(op==1) {
            int x=read()^last,y=read()^last;
            if(a[x]==y) continue;
            if(x!=n) Modify2(x,abs(a[x+1]-y));
            if(x!=1) Modify2(x-1,abs(y-a[x-1]));
            int ha=mp[a[x]];
            It it=st[ha].lower_bound(x),it2=it;
            if(++it!=st[ha].end()) Modify(*it,(it2==st[ha].begin()?0:*(--it2)));
            st[ha].erase(--it);
            !mp[y]?mp[y]=++cnt:0;
            ha=mp[y];
            it=st[ha].lower_bound(x),it2=it;
            if(it!=st[ha].end()) Modify(*it,x);
            if(it2!=st[ha].end()&&it2!=st[ha].begin())
                Modify(x,*(--it2));
            else Modify(x,0);
            a[x]=y;
            Modify(1,x,y);
            st[ha].insert(x);
        } else {
            int l=read()^last,r=read()^last,k=read()^last;
            data x=Query(1,l,r);
            bool flag=0;
            if(l==r) {
                puts("Yes"),++last;
                continue;
            }
            if(!k) {
                if(x.mn==x.mx) puts("Yes"),++last;
                else puts("No");
                continue;
            }
            if(x.sum!=1LL*x.mn*(r-l+1)+1LL*(r-l+1)*(r-l)/2*k) flag=1;
            else if(x.mx!=x.mn+1LL*(r-l)*k) flag=1;
            else {
                int Gcd=Query2(l,r-1),MxLast=Query(l,r);
                if(Gcd!=k||MxLast>=l) flag=1;
            }
            if(flag) puts("No");
            else puts("Yes"),++last;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4373.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int c;
    while (b) {
        c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL sum;
    int G, pre, mi, ma;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0, a[MAXN], pre[MAXN], nxt[MAXN];

map <int, set<int> > G;
set<int>::iterator it;
void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].mi = min(t[t[x].l].mi, t[t[x].r].mi);
    t[x].ma = max(t[t[x].l].ma, t[t[x].r].ma);
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].pre = max(t[t[x].l].pre, t[t[x].r].pre);
        t[x].G = gcd(t[t[x].l].G, t[t[x].r].G);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        t[x].sum = t[x].mi = t[x].ma = a[l], t[x].G = abs(a[l] - a[l - 1]);
        set<int> &s = G[a[l]];
        if (s.size()) {
            it = s.end();
            it--;
            pre[l] = t[x].pre = *it;
            nxt[*it] = l;
        }
        s.insert(l);
    }
    return x;
}

void upd_pre(int x, int l, int r, int y, int z) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (y <= mid) upd_pre(t[x].l, l, mid, y, z);
        else upd_pre(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, y, z);
        t[x].pre = max(t[t[x].l].pre, t[t[x].r].pre);
    } else t[x].pre = pre[l] = z;
}

void upd_gcd(int x, int l, int r, int y, int z) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (y <= mid) upd_gcd(t[x].l, l, mid, y, z);
        else upd_gcd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, y, z);
        t[x].G = gcd(t[t[x].l].G, t[t[x].r].G);
    } else t[x].G = z;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].sum = t[x].mi = t[x].ma = a[l] = v;
}

LL Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += Sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].ma;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Min(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].mi;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0x7fffffff;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, Min(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = min(ret, Min(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Pre(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].pre;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, Pre(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, Pre(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Gcd(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].G;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = gcd(Gcd(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)), ret);
    if (qr >  mid) ret = gcd(Gcd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr), ret);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;

#define ok() puts("Yes"), cnt++
#define fail() puts("No")

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    build(1, n);
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r, k, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            x ^= cnt, y ^= cnt;
            if (a[x] == y) continue;

            if (pre[x]) nxt[pre[x]] = nxt[x];
            if (nxt[x]) upd_pre(1, 1, n, nxt[x], pre[x]);
            G[a[x]].erase(x);

            set<int> &s = G[y];
            s.insert(x);
            it = s.find(x);
            if (it != s.begin()) {
                it--;
                if (nxt[*it]) upd_pre(1, 1, n, nxt[*it], x);
                upd_pre(1, 1, n, x, *it);
                nxt[x] = nxt[*it];
                nxt[*it] = x;
            } else {
                upd_pre(1, 1, n, x, 0);
                it++;
                if (it != s.end()) {
                    upd_pre(1, 1, n, *it, x);
                    nxt[x] = *it;
                } else nxt[x] = 0;
            }
            update(1, 1, n, x, y);
            upd_gcd(1, 1, n, x, abs(a[x] - a[x - 1]));
            if (x < n) upd_gcd(1, 1, n, x + 1, abs(a[x + 1] - a[x]));
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(k);
            l ^= cnt, r ^= cnt, k ^= cnt;
            if (l == r) ok();
            else if (k == 0) {
                if (Min(1, 1, n, l, r) == Max(1, 1, n, l, r)) ok();
                else fail();
            } else {
                LL su = Sum(1, 1, n, l, r);
                int gg = Gcd(1, 1, n, l + 1, r);
                int mi = Min(1, 1, n, l, r), ma = Max(1, 1, n, l, r);
                if (gg == k && ma - mi == k * LL(r - l) && su == LL(mi + ma) * (r - l + 1) / 2 && Pre(1, 1, n, l, r) < l) ok();
                else fail();
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 50105
#define LOG 16

struct E {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[LOG][MAXN], *Fa = fa[0], dep[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != Fa[x]) {
            Fa[e[o].v] = x;
            dep[e[o].v] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[o].v);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG - 1; ~i; i--) {
        if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) u = fa[i][u], v = fa[i][v];
    }
    return Fa[u];
}

int ans = 0;

void getans(int x) {
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != Fa[x]) {
            getans(e[o].v);
            cnt[x] += cnt[e[o].v];
        }
    }
    ans = max(ans, cnt[x]);
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int u, v, l;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        l = lca(u, v);
        cnt[u]++;
        cnt[v]++;
        cnt[l]--;
        cnt[Fa[l]]--;
    }
    getans(1);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000003

int power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

int fac[MOD], inv[MOD];

LL C(int x, int y) {
    if (x <= y) return x == y;
    if (!y) return 1;
    if (x < MOD) return (LL)fac[x] * inv[y] % MOD * inv[x - y] % MOD;
    else return C(x / MOD, y / MOD) * C(x % MOD, y % MOD) % MOD;
}

void init() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MOD; i++) fac[i] = int(fac[i - 1] * LL(i) % MOD);
    inv[MOD - 1] = power(fac[MOD - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MOD - 2; ~i; i--) inv[i] = int(inv[i + 1] * LL(i + 1) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T, n, l, r;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n", ((int)C(r - l + 1 + n, r - l + 1) + MOD - 1) % MOD);
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 5000111

int power(LL x, int b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 6], pp[MAXN / 6], pcnt, F[MAXN], sum[MAXN];

int T, K;

void init() {
    F[0] = sum[0] = 0, F[1] = sum[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, pp[pcnt] = power(i, K), F[i] = pp[pcnt] - 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && (k = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) F[k] = int((LL)F[i] * F[p[j]] % MOD);
            else {
                F[k] = int((LL)F[i] * pp[j] % MOD);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (register int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) (sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + F[i]) >= MOD && (sum[i] -= MOD);
}

inline void work() {
    int n, m, N;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    N = min(n, m);
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= N; i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        (ans += LL(n / i) * LL (m / i) % MOD * (sum[j] - sum[i - 1])) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(ans + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(K);
    init();
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005
#define TOP 1000000001
struct node {
    int l,r,sum;
} t[MAXN*32];

int n,m,a[MAXN],rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].sum+=v;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[rx].sum-t[lx].sum;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,ret=0;
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,TOP,a[i]);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l--;
        int ans=1,tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,1);
        while (tot>=ans) {
            ans=tot+1;
            tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,ans);
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005
#define MAXM 500005

struct data {
    int u,v;
    bool exist;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b):u(a),v(b),exist(false) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (u!=a.u) return u<a.u;
        return v<a.v;
    }
    bool operator == (data a) const {
        return u==a.u && v==a.v;
    }
} e[MAXM];

struct query {
    int op,x,y;
} q[MAXM];

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch!='!' && ch!='+' && ch!='-') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='!') a=0;
    else if (ch=='+') a=1;
    else a=2;
}

int n,m,cnt=0;
int tot[MAXN],lazy[MAXN];

int find(data x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (x<e[mid]) r=mid-1;
        else l=mid;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(q[i].op);
        read(q[i].x);
        if (q[i].op) {
            read(q[i].y);
            if (q[i].x>q[i].y) swap(q[i].x,q[i].y);
            if (q[i].op==1) {
                e[++cnt]=data(q[i].x,q[i].y);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(e+1,e+cnt+1);
    cnt=int(unique(e+1,e+cnt+1)-e-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].op) {
            int tag=find(data(q[i].x,q[i].y));
            if (q[i].op==1) {
                tot[q[i].x]-=lazy[q[i].y];
                tot[q[i].y]-=lazy[q[i].x];
                e[tag].exist=1;
            } else {
                tot[q[i].x]+=lazy[q[i].y];
                tot[q[i].y]+=lazy[q[i].x];
                e[tag].exist=0;
            }
        } else {
            lazy[q[i].x]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (e[i].exist) {
            tot[e[i].u]+=lazy[e[i].v];
            tot[e[i].v]+=lazy[e[i].u];
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",tot[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot[n]);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 256

int a[MAXN][MAXN],n,m,k;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;
int ecnt,head[MAXN*2],tag[MAXN*2];

void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i+1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(i+n+1,1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]<=x) add(i+1,j+n+1);
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(0);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to,1)) {
                e[now].flow--;
                e[now^1].flow++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (k!=ans && bfs()) {
        while (k!=ans && dfs(0,1)) ans++;
    }
    return ans==k;
}

bool check(int x) {
    init();
    build(x);
    if (dinic()) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    k=n-k+1;
    int MIN=1000000001,MAX=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
            MIN=min(MIN,a[i][j]);
            MAX=max(MAX,a[i][j]);
        }
    int l=MIN,r=MAX,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define eps 1e-10
typedef double D;

inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
inline D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        int a, b;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        x = a, y = b;
    }
} p[MAXN];

Point Is(Point &a1, Point &a2, Point &b1, Point &b2) {
    D x1 = (b2 - b1) * (a1 - b1), x2 = (a2 - b1) * (b2 - b1);
    return (a1 * x2 + a2 * x1) / (x1 + x2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border () {}
    Border (Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return (b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1) > 0;
}

int n, cnt, pcnt;
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
D ans = 0, tot = 0;

void add(D A, D B, D C) {
    Point st;
    if (abs(B) > eps) st = Point(0, -C / B);
    else st = Point(-C / A, 0);
    a[++cnt] = Border(st, st + Point(B, -A));
}

bool ok(Border &A, Border &B, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(A.p1, A.p2, B.p1, B.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

void hpi() {
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he > 2) {
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int j = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[pcnt++] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[j].p1, q[j].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pcnt; i++) {
            ans += p[i] * p[(i + 1) % pcnt];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i].re();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tot += p[i] * p[(i + 1) % n];
    a[++cnt] = Border(p[0], p[1]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        Point A = p[1] - p[0], B = p[j] - p[i];
        add(A.y - B.y, B.x - A.x, A.x * p[0].y - A.y * p[0].x - B.x * p[i].y + B.y * p[i].x);
    }
    hpi();
    printf("%.4lf\n", (double)(abs(ans / tot) + eps));
    return 0;
}

    if (p1==p2) {
        p2=(p1=buf)+fread(buf,1,100000,stdin);
        if (p1==p2) return EOF;
    }
    return *p1++;
}

    char c=nc(),b=1;
    for (; !(c>='0' && c<='9'); c=nc()) if (c=='-') b=-1;
    for (x=0; c>='0' && c<='9'; x=x*10+c-'0',c=nc());

}

int n,m,L,R,M;

abcd st[500005][25];

inline void build_fat() {
    for (int k=1; k<=20; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            fat[i][k]=fat[fat[i][k-1]][k-1];
}

inline int Fat(int u,int d) {
    for (int k=20; k>=0; k--)
        if ((d>>k)&1)
            u=fat[u][k];
    return u;
}

inline void build_st() {
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++)
        st[i][0]=abcd(s[i],i);
    for (int k=1; k<=20; k++)
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++)
            st[i][k]=min(st[i][k-1],st[fat[i][k-1]][k-1]);
}

inline abcd Query(int u,int d) {
    abcd ret(1LL<<60,0);
    for (int k=20; k>=0; k--)
        if ((d>>k)&1)
            ret=min(ret,st[u][k]),u=fat[u][k];
    return ret;
}

struct node {
    int u,l,r,m;
    ll val;
    node () { }
    node (int u,int l,int r):u(u),l(l),r(r) { }
    void calc() {
        int f=Fat(u,l+1);
        abcd ret=Query(f,r-l);
        val=s[u]-ret.first;
        m=depth[u]-depth[ret.second];
    }
    bool operator < (const node &B) const {
        return val<B.val;
    }
};

priority_queue<node> Q;

int main() {
    int l,r;
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);

        read(fat[i][0]);

        read(s[i]);
    read(M);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        s[i]+=s[fat[i][0]],depth[i]=depth[fat[i][0]]+1;
    build_fat();
    build_st();
    node tmp;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (L>depth[i]) continue;
        l=L-1;
        r=min(R,depth[i]);
        if (l<r) {
            tmp=node(i,l,r);
            tmp.calc();
            Q.push(tmp);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=M; i++) {
        if (Q.empty()) return printf("-01\n"),0;
        tmp=Q.top();
        Q.pop();
        ans+=tmp.val;
        int m=tmp.m,l=tmp.l,r=tmp.r,u=tmp.u;
        if (l<m-1) {
            tmp=node(u,l,m-1);
            tmp.calc();
            Q.push(tmp);
        }
        if (m<r) {
            tmp=node(u,m,r);
            tmp.calc();
            Q.push(tmp);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 21
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

int n, m, L, R;
int fa[MAXN][LOG], dep[MAXN], Min[MAXN][LOG], a[MAXN], sum[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int st, l, r, p;
    Node () {}
    Node (int i, int j, int k, int o) : st(i), l(j), r(k), p(o) {}
    bool operator < (const Node &b) const {
        return sum[st] - sum[p] < sum[b.st] - sum[b.p];
    }
};

priority_queue<Node> q;

int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return sum[x] < sum[y] ? x : y;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    sum[x] += a[x];
    Min[x][0] = x;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) {
        fa[x][i] = fa[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1];
        Min[x][i] = cmp(Min[x][i - 1], Min[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        sum[e[now].to] = sum[x];
        dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
        dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

int kthfa(int x, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; k; i++, k >>= 1) if (k & 1) x = fa[x][i];
    return x;
}

int getmin(int l, int r) {
    int x = dep[l] - dep[r], ret = r;
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) ret = cmp(ret, Min[l][i]), l = fa[l][i];
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(fa[i][0]), e[++ecnt] = (edge) {head[fa[i][0]], i}, head[fa[i][0]] = ecnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    read(m);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (dep[i] < L) continue;
        int l = kthfa(i, L), r = kthfa(i, R);
        q.push(Node(i, l, r, getmin(l, r)));
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    while (m--) {
        Node now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += sum[now.st] - sum[now.p];
        if (now.p != now.l) {
            int y = kthfa(now.l, dep[now.l] - dep[now.p] - 1);
            int p = getmin(now.l, y);
            q.push(Node(now.st, now.l, y, p));
        }
        if (now.p != now.r) {
            int p = getmin(fa[now.p][0], now.r);
            q.push(Node(now.st, fa[now.p][0], now.r, p));
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 200319
#define V 262144
typedef double D;
struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
};
int R[V];
void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R[i] > i) swap(a[R[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

char s[MAXN];
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int n, m;

Comp t1[V], t2[V], t3[V], tmp[V];

vector <int> fuck_the_sample_tests;

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = s[i] == '?' ? 0 : s[i] - 'a' + 1;
    scanf("%s", s);
    m = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) b[i] = s[i] == '?' ? 0 : s[i] - 'a' + 1;
    reverse(b, b + m);

    getR(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t1[i] = Comp(a[i] * a[i] * a[i], 0);
        else t1[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t1, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t1[i] = t1[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t1, V, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t2[i] = Comp(a[i], 0);
        else t2[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i] * b[i] * b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t2, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t2[i] = t2[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t2, V, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t3[i] = Comp(a[i] * a[i], 0);
        else t3[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i] * b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t3, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t3[i] = t3[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t3, V, -1);

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = m - 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (abs(round(t1[i].r) + round(t2[i].r) - 2 * round(t3[i].r)) < 1e-9) {
            ans++;
            fuck_the_sample_tests.push_back(i - m + 1);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    for (int i = 0; i < ans; i++) printf("%d\n", fuck_the_sample_tests[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4514.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
typedef long long ll;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
    ll w;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int n,src=0,sink,ecnt=1;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN],c[MAXN],num[MAXN],head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int f,long long w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline int solve(int x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=2,t=(int)sqrt(x); i<=t; i++) {
        if (!(x%i)) {
            while (!(x%i)) {
                ans++;
                x/=i;
            }
            t=(int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ans++;
    return ans;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        num[i]=solve(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",b+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",c+i);
}

inline void build() {
    sink=n+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (num[i]&1) {
            add(i,sink,b[i],0);
        } else {
            add(src,i,b[i],0);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        bool odd=num[i]&1;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (num[i]-num[j]==1 && a[i]%a[j]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            } else if (num[j]-num[i]==1 && a[j]%a[i]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool inq[MAXN];
long long dis[MAXN];
int pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
queue <int> q;

inline bool spfa() {
    q.push(src);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[src]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (pre[sink]==-1) return 0;
    else return 1;
}

inline void work() {
    long long val=0;
    int ans=0,flow;
    while (spfa()) {
        flow=INF;
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            flow=min(flow,e[pos[now]].flow);
        }
        if (dis[sink]>0) {
            if (-val/dis[sink]<flow)
                flow=int(-val/dis[sink]);
        }
        if (flow==0) break;
        if (flow<0) {
            while (1) puts("FUCK");
        }
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow-=flow;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow+=flow;
        }
        val+=flow*dis[sink];
        ans+=flow;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 1000000
typedef long long LL;

int T,n,m;
int fac[MAXN+5],invfac[MAXN+5],dp[MAXN+5];

int quickpower(long long a,int x) {
    long long ret=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=(ret*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int inv(int x) {
    return quickpower(x,MOD-2);
}

void init() {
    fac[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=(LL(fac[i-1])*i)%MOD;
    invfac[MAXN]=inv(fac[MAXN]);
    for (int i=MAXN-1; i>-1; i--) invfac[i]=(LL(invfac[i+1])*(i+1))%MOD;
    dp[0]=1,dp[1]=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        dp[i]=(1-((i&1)<<1)+dp[i-1]*LL(i)+MOD)%MOD;
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        printf("%d\n",LL(fac[n])*invfac[n-m]%MOD*invfac[m]%MOD*dp[n-m]%MOD);
    }
    return 0;
}

}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
