#define MAXN 3005
int n, m;
LL L, d[MAXN], f[2][MAXN];

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}
LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[i][j] + 2 * L * d[j] + m * power(d[j]) - f[i][k] - 2 * L * d[k] - m * power(d[k])) / (d[j] - d[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void clear() {
        v[0] = l = r = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * m * d[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[r], i) <= slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) read(ai), d[i] = d[i - 1] + ai;
    L = d[n];
    for (int k = 1; k <= m; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[now][i] = f[pre][j] + m * power(d[i] - d[j]) - 2 * L * (d[i] - d[j]);
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m & 1][n] + power(L));
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 900
#define MAXM 9000

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXM * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int G[MAXN][MAXN];
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
set <int> s;
void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    s.insert(ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        read(W[i]);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    memset(G, 0x3f, sizeof G);
    solve(1, n);
    printf("%d\n", (int)s.size());
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

LL f[11][2][2][10][3];

int tmp[12];

LL dfs(int x, bool _4, bool _8, int last, int dep, bool lim) {
    if (_4 && _8) return 0;
    if (!~x) return dep == 3;
    if (!lim && ~f[x][_4][_8][last][dep]) return f[x][_4][_8][last][dep];
    LL ret = 0;
    int top = lim ? tmp[x] : 9;
    for (int i = x == 10; i <= top; i++) {
        if (~dep) {
            if (dep == 3) ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, 3, lim && i == top);
            else ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, i == last ? dep + 1 : 1, lim && i == top);
        } else ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, 1, lim && i == top);
    }
    if (!lim) f[x][_4][_8][last][dep] = ret;
    return ret;
}

LL solve(LL x) {
    if (x < 10000000000ll) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        tmp[i] = int(x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
    return dfs(10, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1);
}

//BZOJ4551.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='C') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='Q';
}

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
int n,q,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN][19],dep[MAXN],tid[MAXN],st[MAXN],ed[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    st[x]=dfn;
    for (int k=1; k<=18; k++) {
        fa[x][k]=fa[fa[x][k-1]][k-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    ed[x]=dfn;
}

#define s 131072
struct node {
    int v,lch,rch,lazy;
} t[s<<1];
int tcnt=0;
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].v=1,t[now].lazy=0;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
    }
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    int cc=t[x].lch;
    if (t[cc].v<t[x].lazy) {
        t[cc].v=t[x].lazy;
        t[cc].lazy=t[x].lazy;
    }
    cc=t[x].rch;
    if (t[cc].v<t[x].lazy) {
        t[cc].v=t[x].lazy;
        t[cc].lazy=t[x].lazy;
    }
    t[x].lazy=0;
}
void update(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,int v) {
    if (t[x].v>=v) return;
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].v=v;
        t[x].lazy=v;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) update(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[x].v=min(t[t[x].lch].v,t[t[x].rch].v);
}

int query(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[x].v;
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[x].lch,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,p);
}

void init() {
    dep[1]=1;
    fa[1][0]=1;
    dfs(1);
    build(1,n);
}

int jumpto(int x,int de) {
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((de>>k)&1) x=fa[x][k];
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=q; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            int dd=query(1,1,n,tid[x]);
            printf("%d\n",jumpto(x,dep[x]-dd));
        } else {
            read(x);
            update(1,1,n,st[x],ed[x],dep[x]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 200319
typedef long long LL;
inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

struct Cir {
    int x, y, r;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(r);
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Point {
    int x, f;
    Point (int q = 0, int w = 0) : x(q), f(w) {}
};

int nowpos;

bool operator < (Point q, Point w) {
    if (q.x == w.x) return q.f < w.f;
    double p1 = a[q.x].y + q.f * sqrt(power(a[q.x].r) - power(nowpos - a[q.x].x));
    double p2 = a[w.x].y + w.f * sqrt(power(a[w.x].r) - power(nowpos - a[w.x].x));
    return p1 < p2;
}

set<Point> s;
set<Point>::iterator it;

int n, pcnt = 0;
pair<int, int> pp[MAXN * 2];
int si[MAXN];

#define dis(i, j) (power(a[i].x - a[j].x) + power(a[i].y - a[j].y))
bool inner(int i, int j) {
    return dis(i, j) <= power(a[i].r);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].re();
        pp[++pcnt] = make_pair(a[i].x - a[i].r, i);
        pp[++pcnt] = make_pair(a[i].x + a[i].r, i);
    }
    sort(pp + 1, pp + pcnt + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
        nowpos = pp[i].first;
        int x = pp[i].second;
        Point up(x, 1), down(x, -1);
        if (nowpos < a[x].x) {
            it = s.upper_bound(up);
            if (it == s.end() || !inner(it->x, x)) si[x] = 1;
            else si[x] = -si[it->x];
            s.insert(up);
            s.insert(down);
        } else {
            s.erase(up);
            s.erase(down);
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += si[i] * power(a[i].r);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
int id[MAXN], od[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    id[v]++, od[u]++;
}

int n, m;
int ans[MAXN];

int dp(int x) {
    if (ans[x]) return ans[x];
    if (!od[x]) return ans[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) ans[x] += dp(e[now].to);
    return ans[x];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dp(i);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!id[i] && od[i]) tot += ans[i];
    printf("%d\n", tot);
    return 0;
}

inline bool cmp(int *y,int p,int q,int k) {
    int o0=p+k>=n?-1:y[p+k];
    int o1=q+k>=n?-1:y[q+k];
    return o0==o1&&y[p]==y[q];
}
inline void build_sa() {
    int i,k,p,*x=t1,*y=t2;
    for(m=28,i=0; i<m; ++i) c[i]=0;
    for(i=0; i<n; ++i) ++c[x[i]=s[i]];
    for(i=1; i<m; ++i) c[i]+=c[i-1];
    for(i=n-1; ~i; --i) sa[--c[x[i]]]=i;
    for(k=1; k<=n; k<<=1) {
        for(p=0,i=n-k; i<n; ++i) y[p++]=i;
        for(i=0; i<n; ++i) if(sa[i]>=k) y[p++]=sa[i]-k;
        for(i=0; i<m; ++i) c[i]=0;
        for(i=0; i<n; ++i) ++c[x[y[i]]];
        for(i=1; i<m; ++i) c[i]+=c[i-1];
        for(i=n-1; ~i; --i) sa[--c[x[y[i]]]]=y[i];
        swap(x,y);
        m=1;
        x[sa[0]]=0;
        for(i=1; i<n; ++i) x[sa[i]]=cmp(y,sa[i],sa[i-1],k)?m-1:m++;
        if(m>=n) break;
    }
}
inline void build_height() {
    int i,k=0,j;
    for(i=0; i<n; ++i) rank[sa[i]]=i;
    for(i=0; i<n; ++i) {
        if(!rank[i]) continue;
        k=k?--k:k;
        j=sa[rank[i]-1];
        while(s[i+k]==s[j+k]) ++k;
        height[rank[i]]=k;
    }
}
inline bool CMP(int x,int y) {
    return height[x]>height[y];
}
inline int find(int x) {
    if(x!=fa[x]) fa[x]=find(fa[x]);
    return fa[x];
}
inline void calc(int x) {
    if(!x) return ;
    int r1=find(x),r2=find(x-1);
    ans+=(LL)(st[r1]*en[r2]+st[r2]*en[r1])*(LL)height[x];
    st[r1]+=st[r2];
    en[r1]+=en[r2];
    fa[r2]=r1;
}

    /*  for(i=0;i<n;++i){

//BZOJ4566.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 400010

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int n, l1;
void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 127;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (i = n - j + 1, k = 0; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]] && y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], s1[MAXN], s2[MAXN];

void work() {
    int top = 0;
    sta[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (sta[top] >= h[i]) {
            R[p[top]] = i - 1;
            top--;
        }
        L[i] = p[top] + 1;
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = i;
    }
    while (top) R[p[top--]] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s1[i] = s1[i - 1] + (sa[i] < l1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s2[i] = s2[i - 1] + (sa[i] > l1);
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += (LL)h[i] * ((s2[i - 1] - s2[L[i] - 2]) * (s1[R[i]] - s1[i - 1]) + (s1[i - 1] - s1[L[i] - 2]) * (s2[R[i]] - s2[i - 1]));
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    s[l1 = ++n] = '|';
    scanf("%s", s + n + 1);
    n += (int)strlen(s + n + 1);
    getsa();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4567.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXL 510005
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct statu {
    int x,fa;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _x,int _f):x(_x),fa(_f) {}
} q[MAXL];

int n,ecnt=0,nod=0,label=0;
int trie[MAXL][26],head[MAXN],isword[MAXL],f[MAXN],s[MAXN],temp[MAXN];
char re[MAXL];
long long ans=0;
inline bool cmp(int a,int b) {
    return s[a]>s[b];
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void insert(int x) {
    int len=(int)strlen(re),now=0;
    for (int i=len-1,to; i>-1; i--) {
        to=re[i]-'a';
        if (!trie[now][to]) {
            trie[now][to]=++nod;
        }
        now=trie[now][to];
    }
    isword[now]=x;
}

inline void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[1]=statu(0,0);
    while (h<t) {
        int now=q[h].x,fa=q[h].fa;
        h++;
        if (isword[now]) {
            f[isword[now]]=fa;
            add(fa,isword[now]);
            fa=isword[now];
        }
        for (int to=0; to<26; to++) {
            if (trie[now][to]) {
                q[t++]=statu(trie[now][to],fa);
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    s[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        s[x]+=s[e[now].to];
    }
    int tot=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        temp[++tot]=e[now].to;
    }
    sort(temp+1,temp+tot+1,cmp);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].to=temp[tot--];
    }
}

void findans(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        temp[e[now].to]=++label;
        ans+=temp[e[now].to]-temp[x];
        findans(e[now].to);
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",re);
        insert(i);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(0);
    temp[0]=0;
    findans(0);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4568.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 20005
#define MAXQ 200005
#define TOP 60
#define LOGN 15

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &x) {
    bool s = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') s = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    x = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (s) x = -x;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

struct Basis {
    LL v[TOP + 1];
    LL &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
    void clear() {
        memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
    }
    void merge(LL x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if ((x>>i)&1ll) {
                if (!v[i]) {
                    v[i] = x;
                    break;
                } else x ^= v[i];
            }
        }
    }
    void Merge(Basis x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (x[i]) merge(x[i]);
        }
    }
} b[MAXN][LOGN + 1], ans;

int n, q, head[MAXN], f[MAXN][LOGN + 1], dep[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
LL a[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != f[x][0]) {
            f[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOGN; k++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i][k] = f[f[i][k - 1]][k - 1];
            b[i][k] = b[i][k - 1];
            b[i][k].Merge(b[f[i][k - 1]][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

void work(int u, int v) {
    ans.clear();
    if (dep[u] > dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[v] - dep[u];
    for (int i = LOGN; i >= 0; i--)
        if ((x>>i)&1)
            ans.Merge(b[v][i]), v = f[v][i];
    if (u != v) {
        for (int i = LOGN; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (f[u][i] != f[v][i]) {
                ans.Merge(b[u][i]);
                ans.Merge(b[v][i]);
                u = f[u][i], v= f[v][i];
            }
        }
        ans.Merge(b[u][0]);
        ans.Merge(b[v][0]);
        u = f[u][0];
    }
    ans.Merge(b[u][0]);
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) ret = max(ret, ret ^ ans[i]);
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        b[i][0].merge(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    f[1][0] = 0;
    dep[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        work(x, y);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4569.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005

int n,m;
int f[20][MAXN];
inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[0][i]=i;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=18; k++) {
        int delta=1<<k;
        for (int i=1,ta=n-delta+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            f[k][i]=i;
        }
    }
}

int getf(int k,int x) {
    if (f[k][x]==x) return x;
    return f[k][x]=getf(k,f[k][x]);
}

inline void merge(int k,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(k,a),fb=getf(k,b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        f[k][fa]=fb;
    }
}

inline void deal(int a,int b,int x) {
    for (int k=18; k!=-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            merge(k,a,b);
            a+=1<<k,b+=1<<k;
        }
    }
}

inline void pushdown() {
    for (int k=18; k; k--) {
        int delta=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            if (getf(k,i)!=i) {
                merge(k-1,i,getf(k,i));
                merge(k-1,i+delta,getf(k,i)+delta);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1,l1,r1,l2,r2; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&l1,&r1,&l2,&r2);
        deal(l1,l2,r1-l1+1);
    }
    pushdown();
    int tot=0;
    long long ans=9;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (getf(0,i)==i) tot++;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<tot; i++) {
        ans=(ans*10)%1000000007;
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4570AC.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cmath>
#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
#define maxn 1000100
#define eps 1e-8

using namespace std;

struct yts {
    double x,y;
} q[maxn],s[maxn];

yts operator-(yts x,yts y) {
    return (yts) {
        x.x-y.x,x.y-y.y
    };
}
double operator*(yts x,yts y) {
    return x.x*y.y-x.y*y.x;
}
double slope(yts x,yts y) {
    if (x.x==y.x) return -1e60;
    else return (y.y-x.y)/(y.x-x.x);
}
double slope(yts x) {
    return -sqrt(x.y/x.x);
}
double calc(yts x,double k) {
    if (k>=0) return 1e20;
    else return x.x+x.y-x.x*k-x.y/k;
}

int n,top;
double ans;

bool cmp(yts x,yts y) {
    return x.x<y.x || (x.x==y.x && x.y>y.y);
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    //freopen("4570.in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%lf%lf",&q[i].x,&q[i].y);
    sort(q+1,q+n+1,cmp);
    int top=1;
    s[1]=q[1];
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        while (top>1 && (q[i]-s[top])*(s[top]-s[top-1])<0) top--;
        s[++top]=q[i];
    }
    if (top==1) ans=calc(s[1],slope(s[1]));
    else {
        double sp,sp1,sp2;
        ans=1e20;
        sp2=slope(s[1],s[2]);
        sp=slope(s[1]);
        if (sp>=sp2) ans=min(ans,calc(s[1],sp));
        for (int i=2; i<top; i++) {
            sp1=slope(s[i-1],s[i]);
            sp2=slope(s[i],s[i+1]);
            sp=slope(s[i]);
            ans=min(ans,calc(s[i],sp1));
            if (sp1>=sp && sp>=sp2) ans=min(ans,calc(s[i],sp));
        }
        sp1=slope(s[top-1],s[top]);
        sp=slope(s[top]);
        ans=min(ans,calc(s[top],sp1));
        if (sp<=sp1) ans=min(ans,calc(s[top],sp));
    }
    printf("%.4lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4570.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#define eps 1e-8

// fastio

#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],*ptr;
void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;

typedef long long ll;

char ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';

    }

inline ll power(int x) {
    return (ll)x*x;
}

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
} p[MAXN],sta[MAXN];

#define c p[1]

#define dis(a,b) ((power(a.x-b.x)+power(a.y-b.y)))
bool operator < (const point &a,const point &b) {
    ll cross=(ll)(a.x-c.x)*(b.y-c.y)-(ll)(b.x-c.x)*(a.y-c.y);
    if (cross==0) return dis(a,c)<dis(b,c);
    return cross<0;
}

int n;
double ans=1e15;

inline void updateans(double k,point a) {
    if (-k<eps) return;
    double wtf=a.x+a.y-k*a.x-a.y/k;
    if (wtf<ans) ans=wtf;
}

int main() {
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    init_buf();
#endif
    read(n);
    int tl=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        if (p[i].y>p[tl].y) tl=i;
        else if (p[i].y==p[tl].y && p[tl].x>p[i].x) tl=i;
    }
    if (n==1) {
        printf("%.4lf\n",p[1].x+p[1].y+2.0*sqrt((ll)p[1].x*p[1].y));
        return 0;
    }
    swap(p[tl],p[1]);
    sort(p+2,p+n+1);
    int top=2;
    sta[1]=p[1],sta[2]=p[2];
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        while (top>1 && (ll)(p[i].x-sta[top-1].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top].y)>=(ll)(p[i].x-sta[top].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top-1].y))
            top--;
        sta[++top]=p[i];
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=top; i++) {
        if (sta[i].x<=sta[i-1].x) top=i-1;
    }
    double lastk,nowk,nextk;
    // 1
    nextk=(double)(sta[2].y-sta[1].y)/(sta[2].x-sta[1].x);
    updateans(nextk,sta[1]);
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[1].y/sta[1].x);
    if (nowk>nextk) updateans(nowk,sta[1]);
    // 2~top-1
    for (int i=2; i<top; i++) {
        lastk=nextk;
        nextk=(double)(sta[i+1].y-sta[i].y)/(sta[i+1].x-sta[i].x);
        updateans(nextk,sta[i]);
        nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[i].y/sta[i].x);
        if (nowk>nextk && nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[i]);
    }
    // top
    lastk=nextk;
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[top].y/sta[top].x);
    if (nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[top]);
    printf("%.4lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4571.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 262145

struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN*24];

int n,m,cnt=0;
int a[MAXN],root[MAXN];

void build(int &x,int l,int r) {
    x=++cnt;
    t[x].v=0;
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    build(t[x].l,l,mid);
    build(t[x].r,mid+1,r);
}

void update(int x,int &now,int l,int r,int p) {
    now=++cnt;
    t[now].v=t[x].v+1;
    t[now].l=t[x].l;
    t[now].r=t[x].r;
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) update(t[x].l,t[now].l,l,mid,p);
    else update(t[x].r,t[now].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

bool query(int ta,int tb,int ql,int qr,int l,int r) {
    if (ql<=l && qr>=r) {
        return t[ta].v>t[tb].v;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) if (query(t[ta].l,t[tb].l,ql,qr,l,mid)) return 1;
    if (qr>mid) if (query(t[ta].r,t[tb].r,ql,qr,mid+1,r)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    build(root[0],0,MAXN);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        update(root[i-1],root[i],0,MAXN,a[i]);
    }
}

int ymax(int b,int x,int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((b>>k)&1) { // b get 1 then a+x better get 0
            int nowl=max(ans-x,0),nowr=(ans|((1<<k)-1))-x;
            if (nowr<0 || !query(root[r],root[l-1],nowl,nowr,0,MAXN)) {
                ans^=(1<<k);
            }
        } else { // b get 0 then a+x better get 1
            ans^=1<<k;
            int nowl=max(ans-x,0),nowr=(ans|((1<<k)-1))-x;
            if (nowr<0 || !query(root[r],root[l-1],nowl,nowr,0,MAXN)) {
                ans^=(1<<k);
            }
        }
    }
    return b^ans;
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1,b,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&b,&x,&l,&r);
        printf("%d\n",ymax(b,x,l,r));
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#define N 503
#define MOD 1000000007

int power(LL a, int b) {
    int ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = int((ret * a) % MOD);
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;
int dp[N * 2][N], sum[N * 2];
int A[N], B[N];
int tem[N * 2], tot = 0;
int L[N * 2], R[N * 2], len[N * 2], inv[N];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(A[i]), read(B[i]);
        tem[++tot] = A[i];
        tem[++tot] = B[i] + 1;
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1) - tem - 1) - 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) L[i] = tem[i], R[i] = tem[i + 1] - 1, len[i] = tem[i + 1] - tem[i];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) inv[i] = power(i, MOD - 2);
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) sum[i] = 1;
    for (register int i = 1, j, k, st, ed; i <= n; i++) {
        st = int(lower_bound(L + 1, L + tot + 1, A[i]) - L), ed = int(lower_bound(R + 1, R + tot + 1, B[i]) - R);
        for (j = st; j <= ed; j++) {
            for (k = i; k > 1; k--) {
                dp[j][k] = int((dp[j][k] + dp[j][k - 1] * LL(len[j] - k + 1) % MOD * inv[k]) % MOD);
            }
            dp[j][1] = int((dp[j][1] + LL(sum[j - 1]) * len[j]) % MOD);
        }
        for (j = st; j <= tot; j++) {
            sum[j] = sum[j - 1];
            for (k = i; k; k--) {
                if ((sum[j] += dp[j][k]) >= MOD) sum[j] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

#define MOD 2333
int C[2345][2345],sum[2345][2345];

void init() {
    C[0][0]=sum[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MOD; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MOD; i++) {
        sum[i][0]=C[i][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
            C[i][j]=C[i-1][j-1]+C[i-1][j];
            if (C[i][j]>=MOD) C[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=MOD; j++) {
            sum[i][j]=sum[i][j-1]+C[i][j];
            if (sum[i][j]>=MOD) sum[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
}

int Lucas(LL n,LL k) {
    if (n<k || k<0) return 0;
    if (n<=MOD) return C[n][k];
    return (Lucas(n/MOD,k/MOD)*C[n%MOD][k%MOD])%MOD;
}

int ans(LL n,LL k) {
    if (k<0) return 0;
    return (ans(n/MOD,k/MOD-1)*sum[n%MOD][MOD-1]+Lucas(n/MOD,k/MOD)*sum[n%MOD][k%MOD])%MOD;
}
int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    LL n,k;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n",ans(n,k));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4602AC.cpp
#include<cstdio>
using namespace std ;

struct edge {
    int p ;
    int a ;
    int b ;
    edge * next ;
} ;

const int p = 10079 ;

int pow ( int a , int n ) {
    int ans = 1 ;
    while ( n ) {
        if ( n & 1 ) ans *= a , ans %= p ;
        a *= a ;
        a %= p ;
        n /= 2 ;
    }
    return ans ;
}

int inv ( const int a ) {
    return pow ( a , p - 2 ) ;
}

const int MAXN = 1234 ;
const int MAXM = 12345 ;
int N , M ;
edge E [ MAXM * 2 ] ;
edge * V [ MAXN ] ;
bool vis [ MAXN ] ;
int dis [ MAXN ] ;

void read () {
    scanf ( "%d%d" , & N , & M ) ;
    for ( int i = 1 ; i <= N ; ++ i ) vis [ i ] = V [ i ] = 0 ;
    while ( M -- ) {
        int s , t , a , b ;
        scanf ( "%d%d%d%d" , & s , & t , & a , & b ) ;
        edge * const t1= & E [ M * 2 ] ;
        t1 -> p = t ;
        t1 -> a = a ;
        t1-> b = b < 0 ? b + p : b ;
        t1-> next = V [ s ] ;
        V [ s ] = t1 ;
        edge * const f = & E [ M * 2 + 1 ] ;
        f -> p = s ;
        f -> a = b < 0 ? b + p : b ;
        f -> b = a ;
        f -> next = V [ t ] ;
        V [ t ] = f ;
    }
}

bool dfs ( const int o ) {
    vis [ o ] = true ;
    for ( edge * v = V [ o ] ; v ; v = v -> next )
        if ( ! vis [ v -> p ] ) {
            dis [ v -> p ] = dis [ o ] * v -> a % p * inv ( v -> b ) % p ;
            if ( ! dfs ( v -> p ) ) return false ;
        } else if ( dis [ v -> p ] != dis [ o ] * v -> a % p * inv ( v -> b ) % p )
            return false ;
    return true ;
}

bool solve () {
    for ( int i = 1 ; i <= N ; ++ i )
        if ( ! vis [ i ] && ( dis [ i ] = 1 , ! dfs ( i ) ) ) return false ;
    return true ;
}

int main () {
    int T ;
    scanf ( "%d" , & T ) ;
    for ( int i = 1 ; i <= T ; ++ i ) {
        read () ;
        printf ( "Case #%d: " , i ) ;
        puts ( solve () ? "Yes" : "No" ) ;
    }
    return 0 ;
}

//BZOJ4602.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 10005
#define MOD 19260817

struct edge {
    int next,to,x,y;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int T,n,m,ecnt,head[MAXN];

typedef long long ll;
ll rot[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int x,int y) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].x=x;
    e[ecnt].y=y;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    memset(rot,0,sizeof(rot));
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&x,&y);
        if (y<0) y+=MOD;
        add(u,v,x,y);
        add(v,u,y,x);
    }
}

inline ll rev(ll x) {
    ll ret=1;
    int temp=MOD-2;
    while (temp) {
        if (temp&1) ret=(ret*x)%MOD;
        x=(x*x)%MOD;
        temp>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline bool work() {
    queue<int> q;
    for (int qqq=1; qqq<=n; qqq++) {
        if (rot[qqq]) continue;
        rot[qqq]=1;
        q.push(qqq);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u=q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int now=head[u]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                int v=e[now].to,x=e[now].x,y=e[now].y;
                ll go=(((rot[u]*rev((ll)y))%MOD)*x)%MOD;
                if (!rot[v]) {
                    rot[v]=go;
                    q.push(v);
                } else {
                    if (rot[v]!=go) return 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int ca=1; ca<=T; ca++) {
        init();
        printf("Case #%d: ",ca);
        if (work()) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

int find_low(LL x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int find_high(LL x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

int main() {

    tem[++cnt]=INF;
    tem[++cnt]=0;
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    cnt=int(unique(tem+1,tem+cnt+1)-tem-1);
    update(find_low(0));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int xpos=find_low(sum[i]),lpos=find_low(sum[i]-R),rpos=find_high(sum[i]-L);
        if (lpos<=rpos) ans+=query(lpos,rpos);
        update(xpos);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 30019
#define LOG 15

int Log[MAXN];

inline int min(register int a, register int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}

void Sort(int *in, int *out, int *p, int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char *s, int *sa, int *rk, int *h, int st[MAXN][LOG], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    cerr << s + 1 << endl;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; j <<= 1, m = k) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]] && y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i]+ j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", sa[i]);
    putchar('\n');

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", h[i]);
    putchar('\n');

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        int d = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = n - (d << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + d][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int TT, n;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], st[MAXN][LOG];
int rsa[MAXN], rrk[MAXN], rh[MAXN], rst[MAXN][LOG];
#define rmq(arr, l, r) min(arr[l + 1][Log[r - (l)]], arr[r - (1 << Log[r - (l)]) + 1][Log[r - (l)]])

inline int lcp(int l, int r) {
//	cerr << "( " << l << " " << r << " )" << endl;
    l = rk[l], r = rk[r];
    if (l > r) swap(l, r);
    return rmq(st, l, r);
}
inline int lcs(int l, int r) {
//	cerr << "( " << l << " " << r << " )" << n + 1 - l << " " << n + 1 - r << endl;
    l = rrk[n + 1 - l], r = rrk[n + 1 - r];
    if (l > r) swap(l, r);
//	cerr << "[ " << l << " " << r << " ]" << rmq(rst, l, r) << endl;
    return rmq(rst, l, r);
}

void swap_st() {
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            swap(st[i][j], rst[i][j]);
        }
    }
}
int pre[MAXN];

long long ans = 0;

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    memset(pre, 0, sizeof pre);
    ans = 0;
    getsa(s, sa, rk, h, st, n, 26);
    reverse(s + 1, s + n + 1);
    getsa(s, rsa, rrk, rh, rst, n, 26);
    for (int k = 1; k * 2 <= n; k++) {
        for (int i = 0; k * (i + 1) < n; i++) {
            int S = k * i + 1, T = k * (i + 1);
            int S2 = T + 1, T2 = min(n, k * (i + 2));
            int LCP = min(T2 - S2 + 1, lcp(S, S2)), LCS = min(T2 - S2 + 1, lcs(T, T2));
            cerr << k << " " << S << " " << T << " " << LCP << " " << LCS << endl;
            if (LCS + LCP >= k) {
                cerr << LCS << " " << LCP << endl;
                cerr << "++" << max(S - LCS , 1) << " --" << S + LCP - k << endl;
                pre[max(S - LCS, 1)]++;
                pre[S + LCP - k]--;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cerr << (pre[i] += pre[i - 1]) << " ";
    cerr << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) cerr << (pre[i] += pre[i - 1]) << " ";
    cerr << endl;
    for (int k = 1; k * 2 <= n; k++) {
        for (int i = 0; k * (i + 1) < n; i++) {
            int S = k * i + 1, T = k * (i + 1);
            int S2 = T + 1, T2 = min(n, k * (i + 2));
            int LCP = min(T2 - S2 + 1, lcp(S, S2)), LCS = min(T2 - S2 + 1, lcs(T, T2));
            if (LCS + LCP >= k) {
                cerr << min(S2 + LCP + k - 1, n) << " " << min(S2 - LCS + k + k - 1, n) << "(" << S << " " << T << ")"<< endl;
                ans += pre[min(S2 + LCP + k - 1, n)] - pre[min(S2 - LCS + k + k - 1, n)];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(TT);
    while (TT--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4651ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cmath>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstring>
using namespace std;
int n,m,c;
inline int rd() {
    register char ch=getchar();
    register bool flag=false;
    register int res=0;
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        flag=(ch=='-');
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        res=(res<<3)+(res<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if(flag)res=-res;
    return res;
}
const int sed=195337;
struct hash {
#define mod 100007
#define N 5000010
    int head[mod],dh[mod];
    int x[N],y[N],w[N],next[N],siz,cnt;
    inline void clear() {
        ++cnt;
        siz=0;
    }
    void ins(int _x,int _y,int _i) {
        int s=(1LL*_x*sed+_y)%mod;
        if(dh[s]!=cnt)dh[s]=cnt,head[s]=0;
        //int p;
        //for(p=head[s];p;p=way[p].next)
        ++siz;
        next[siz]=head[s];
        head[s]=siz;
        x[siz]=_x;
        y[siz]=_y;
        w[siz]=_i;
    }
    int find(int _x,int _y) {
        int s=(1LL*_x*sed+_y)%mod;
        if(dh[s]!=cnt)return -1;
        for(s=head[s]; s; s=next[s])
            if(x[s]==_x&&y[s]==_y)return w[s];
        return -1;
    }

} mp,mq;

#define NN 3000010
int x[NN],y[NN];
int head[NN],dfn[NN],low[NN],ap=1;
struct ways {
    int now,next;
} way[NN<<4];
inline void link(int u,int v) {
    if(v==-1)return;
    way[++ap].now=v;
    way[ap].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ap;
    way[++ap].now=u;
    way[ap].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ap;
}
int pac=0,top,scc,dt,stack[N],scco[N],ans;
bool flag;
inline void tarjan(int o,int f) {

    dfn[o]=low[o]=++dt;
    int i;
    for(i=head[o]; i; i=way[i].next)
        if(i!=f) {
            if(dfn[way[i].now])
                low[o]=min(low[o],dfn[way[i].now]);
            else {
                tarjan(way[i].now,i^1);
                low[o]=min(low[o],low[way[i].now]);
                if(!f)++pac;
                if(f&&low[way[i].now]>=dfn[o])flag=1;//���
            }
        }
}
int que[NN];
struct Points {
    int x,y;
} P[NN];
bool vis[NN];
void solve(int u) {
    int K,i,j,k,v,xx,yy,fir,las;
    K=0;
    vis[u]=1;
    mq.clear();
    for(que[fir=las=1]=u; fir<=las; fir++) {
        v=que[fir];
        for(i=-2; i<=2; i++)
            for(j=-2; j<=2; j++) {
                xx=x[v]+i;
                yy=y[v]+j;
                if(xx<=0||yy<=0||xx>n||yy>m)continue;
                k=mp.find(xx,yy);
                if(k!=-1) {
                    if(!vis[k])
                        que[++las]=k,vis[k]=true;
                } else {
                    k=mq.find(xx,yy);
                    if(k==-1) {
                        ++K;
                        P[K].x=xx;
                        P[K].y=yy;//printf("go %d %d\n",xx,yy);
                        mq.ins(xx,yy,K);
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    ap=1;
    for(i=1; i<=K; i++)head[i]=dfn[i]=low[i]=0;
    for(i=1; i<=K; i++) {
        link(i,mq.find(P[i].x+1,P[i].y));
        link(i,mq.find(P[i].x,P[i].y+1));
    }
    dt=0;
    pac=0;
    flag=0;//printf("K=%d\n",K);
    tarjan(1,0);
    if(flag||pac>1)ans=1;
    if(dt!=K)ans=0;
}
void work() {
    int test=rd();
    while(test--) {
        n=rd();
        m=rd();
        c=rd();

        mp.clear();
        register int i;
        for(i=1; i<=c; i++) {
            vis[i]=false;
            x[i]=rd();
            y[i]=rd();
            mp.ins(x[i],y[i],i);
        }
        if(1LL*n*m-1<=c) {
            printf("-1\n",n,m,c);
            continue;
        }
        ans=2;
        if(n==1||m==1)ans=1;
        for(i=1; i<=c&&ans; i++)if(!vis[i])
                solve(i);//printf("now %d\n",ans);
        if(1LL*n*m-c-ans<=1)ans=-1;
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ4651ac.out", "w", stdout);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4651.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c = getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline int min(int x, int y) {
    return x < y ? x : y;
}

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0, 1, 1, -1, -1}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1, 1, -1, 1, -1};

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 100];

int head[MAXN * 25], ecnt = 1;

#define add(u, v) e[++ecnt] = (edge){head[u], v}, head[u] = ecnt

struct Node {
    int x, y;
    Node () {}
    Node (int _a, int _b) : x(_a), y(_b) {}
    bool operator == (const Node &a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], tem[MAXN * 25];

inline bool operator < (const Node &u, const Node &v) {
    return u.x < v.x || (u.x == v.x && u.y < v.y);
}

int T, n, m, c, node, scc, stp, start;
int dfn[MAXN * 25], low[MAXN * 25], bl[MAXN * 25], f[MAXN], fl[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN * 25], cut[MAXN * 25], hascut;

inline int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] > 0) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

inline void merge(int u, int v) {
    u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
    if (u != v) {
        if (f[u] < f[v]) f[u] += f[v], f[v] = u;
        else f[v] += f[u], f[u] = v;
    }
}

void clear() {
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * (node));
    memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * node);
    memset(cut + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * node);
    memset(f + 1, -1, sizeof(int) * c);
    memset(fl + 1, -1, sizeof(int) * c);
    ecnt = 1;
    node = 0;
    hascut = 0;
    scc = 0;
    stp = 0;
}

inline int find(Node x) {
    int l = 1, r = node, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (tem[mid] < x) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid;
    }
    return tem[l] == x ? l : 0;
}

inline int find_a(Node x) {
    int l = 1, r = c, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] < x) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid;
    }
    return a[l] == x ? l : 0;
}

int check_2() {
    sort(a + 1, a + c + 1);
    a[c + 1] = Node(-1, -1);
    for (int i = 1, now = 1, x = 0, y = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (a[now].x == i && a[now].y == j) now++;
            else {
                if (x | y) {
                    if (abs(x - i) + abs(y - j) == 1) {
                        return -1;
                    } else return 0;
                } else x = i, y = j;
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    bl[x] = scc;
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
//	fprintf(stderr, "vis (%d, %d) %d\n", tem[x].x, tem[x].y, dfn[x]);
    int son = 0;
    bool flag = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
//			fprintf(stderr, "trans %d -> %d\n", dfn[x], stp + 1);
            son++;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            if (low[e[now].to] >= dfn[x]) {
//				fprintf(stderr, "flag %d <- %d\n", dfn[x], dfn[e[now].to]);
                flag = 1;
            }
            low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        } else low[x] = min(low[x], dfn[e[now].to]);
    }
    if ((start == x && son > 1) || (flag && start != x)) {
        cut[x] = 1;
//		cerr << "cut : "<< tem[x].x << ", " << tem[x].y << " " << dfn[x] << endl;
//		hascut = 1;
    }
//	cerr << "low " << dfn[x] << " " << low[x] << endl;
}

int check_1() {
    int gap = (a[1].y != 1) + (a[c].y != m);
    for (int i = 1; i < c; i++) if (a[i].y + 1 != a[i + 1].y) gap++;
    if (gap < 2) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(c);
    long long tot = (long long) n * m - c;
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) read(a[i].x), read(a[i].y);
    if (tot < 2) return -1;
    else if (tot == 2) return check_2();
    else if (c == 0) return (min(n, m) > 1) + 1;
    sort(a + 1, a + c + 1);
    if (n == 1 || m == 1) {
        if (m == 1) {
            swap(n, m);
            for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) swap(a[i].x, a[i].y);
        }
        return check_1();
    }
    for (int i = 1, tox, toy; i <= c; i++) {
        for (int q = -2; q <= 2; q++) {
            for (int w = -2; w <= 2; w++) {
                if (q | w) {
                    tox = a[i].x + q, toy = a[i].y + w;
                    if (tox > 0 && tox <= n && toy > 0 && toy <= m) {
                        tem[++node] = Node(tox, toy);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
            tox = a[i].x + dx[d], toy = a[i].y + dy[d];
            if (tox > 0 && tox <= n && toy > 0 && toy <= m) {
                int p = find_a(Node(tox, toy));
                if (p) merge(p, i);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + node + 1);
    node = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + node + 1) - tem - 1);
    int nnode = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= node; i++) {
        while (j <= c && a[j] < tem[i]) j++;
        if (j <= c && a[j] == tem[i]) j++;
        else tem[++nnode] = tem[i];
    }
    node = nnode;
    for (int i = 1, tox, toy; i <= node; i++) {
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            tox = tem[i].x + dx[d], toy = tem[i].y + dy[d];
            if (tox > 0 && tox <= n && toy > 0 && toy <= m) {
                int p = find(Node(tox, toy));
                if (p) add(i, p);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) if (!vis[i]) start = i, scc++, dfs(i);
    for (int i = 1, tox, toy, ff; i <= c; i++) {
        ff = getf(i);
        for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
            tox = a[i].x + dx[d], toy = a[i].y + dy[d];
            if (tox > 0 && tox <= n && toy > 0 && toy <= m) {
                int p = find(Node(tox, toy));
                if (p) {
                    if (fl[ff] == -1) fl[ff] = bl[p];
                    else if (fl[ff] != bl[p]) return 0;
                    hascut |= cut[p];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (hascut) return 1;
    else return 2;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("BZOJ4651.out", "w", stdout);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    memset(fl, -1, sizeof fl);
    read(T);
    while (T--) clear(), printf("%d\n", work());
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c = getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
#define Max(a, b) a = max(a, b)
#define Min(a, b) a = min(a, b)
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 100000001

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b, a % b);
    else return a;
}

int n, m, K;

int p[MAXN / 16], pcnt = 0;
int mu[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN], pr[2333];

int f[2333], tot;

inline void sieve() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (j = 1; (k = i * p[j]) <= n && j <= pcnt; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (!(i % p[j])) {
                mu[k] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[k] = -mu[i];
        }
    }
    f[0] = pr[0] = 0;
    for (register int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
        pr[i] = gcd(i, K) == 1;
        f[i] = f[i - 1] + pr[i];
    }
    tot = f[K - 1];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    sieve();
    register LL ans = 0;
    for (register int i = 1, j, k, l = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        if (pr[++l < K ? l : (l = 0)]) {
            j = (m / i);
            k = j / K;
            ans += mu[i] * (n / i) * LL(k * tot + f[j - k * K]);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4653.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 500005
struct Range {
    int l,r,len;
    bool operator < (Range a) const {
        return len<a.len;
    }
} a[MAXN];
struct node {
    int l,r,lazy,v;
} t[2097152];
int n,m,tem[MAXN<<1],ntem=0,tcnt=0,ans=INF;
int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}
#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int x=++tcnt;
    t[x].lazy=t[x].v=0;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
    } else lch=rch=0;
    return x;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    t[lch].v+=t[x].lazy;
    t[lch].lazy+=t[x].lazy;
    t[rch].v+=t[x].lazy;
    t[rch].lazy+=t[x].lazy;
    t[x].lazy=0;
}

void inc(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].lazy++;
        t[x].v++;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) inc(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) inc(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr);
    t[x].v=max(t[lch].v,t[rch].v);
}

void dec(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].lazy--;
        t[x].v--;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) dec(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) dec(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr);
    t[x].v=max(t[lch].v,t[rch].v);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i].l);
        read(a[i].r);
        a[i].len=a[i].r-a[i].l;
        tem[++ntem]=a[i].l;
        tem[++ntem]=a[i].r;
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+ntem+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+ntem+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i].l=find(a[i].l);
        a[i].r=find(a[i].r);
    }
    build(1,ntem);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    int i=1,j=0;
    while (j<n) {
        while (j<n && t[1].v<m) j++,inc(1,1,ntem,a[j].l,a[j].r);
        while (i<=n && t[1].v>=m) ans=min(a[j].len-a[i].len,ans),dec(1,1,ntem,a[i].l,a[i].r),i++;
    }
    if (ans==INF) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500319

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], dep[MAXN], val[MAXN], rk[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] == x) return x;
    int y = getf(f[x]);
    dep[x] = dep[f[x]] + 1;
    return y;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = i;
    int ans = 0, cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v, fu, fv; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        u ^= ans, v ^= ans;
        fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
        if (op) {
            ans = 0;
            if (fu == fv) {
                while (u != v) {
                    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) ans = max(ans, val[v]), v = f[v];
                    else ans = max(ans, val[u]), u = f[u];
                }
            }
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        } else {
            cnt++;
            if (fu == fv) continue;
            if (rk[fu] < rk[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
            rk[fu] = max(rk[fu], rk[fv] + 1);
            f[fv] = fu;
            val[fv] = cnt;
            dep[fv] = 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4690.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int n,m;
int f[MAXN],rank[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) {
        rank[x]=0;
        return f[x];
    }
    int pref=f[x];
    f[x]=getf(f[x]);
    rank[x]+=rank[pref];
    return f[x];
}
void merge(int a,int b,int val) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        f[fa]=fb;
        rank[fa]=rank[b]-rank[a]+val;
    }
}
char op[5];
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF && n && m) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) f[i]=i,rank[i]=0;
        for (int i=1,a,b,w; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%s",op);
            if (op[0]=='!') {
                scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&w);
                merge(a,b,w);
            } else {
                scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
                if (getf(a)!=getf(b)) puts("UNKNOWN");
                else printf("%d\n",rank[a]-rank[b]);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4719.cpp
#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN];
int f[MAXN],fa[MAXN][20],dep[MAXN],w[MAXN],S[MAXN],lca[MAXN],T[MAXN];
struct Query {
    int next,x,v;
} q[MAXN<<1];
int qhead[MAXN],qcnt=0;
int t[MAXN<<1],ans[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void add_query(int p,int v,int x) {
    q[++qcnt].next=qhead[p];
    q[qcnt].x=x;
    q[qcnt].v=v;
    qhead[p]=qcnt;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    fa[x][0]=f[x];
    for (int i=1; i<=19; i++) {
        fa[x][i]=fa[fa[x][i-1]][i-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=f[x]) {
            f[e[now].to]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}
void work_1(int x,int ta) {
    int now=0;
    while (x!=ta) {
        if (now==w[x]) ans[x]++;
        now++;
        x=f[x];
    }
    if (now==w[ta]) ans[ta]++;
}
void work_2(int x,int ta,int now) {
    while (x!=ta) {
        if (now==w[x]) ans[x]++;
        now--;
        x=f[x];
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int i=0; x; i++,x>>=1) {
        if (x&1) {
            u=fa[u][i];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int i=19; i>-1; i--) {
        if (fa[u][i]!=fa[v][i]) {
            u=fa[u][i];
            v=fa[v][i];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

void vio() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        work_1(S[i],lca[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        work_2(T[i],lca[i],dep[S[i]]-dep[lca[i]]+dep[T[i]]-dep[lca[i]]);
    }
}

void work_1_p1(int x) {
    int xx=w[x]+dep[x];
    ans[x]-=t[xx];
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            work_1_p1(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==1) t[q[now].x]++;
    }
    ans[x]+=t[xx];
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==-1) t[q[now].x]--;
    }
}

void work_2_p1(int x) {
    int xx=w[x]-dep[x]+MAXN;
    ans[x]-=t[xx];
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            work_2_p1(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==1) t[q[now].x]++;
    }
    ans[x]+=t[xx];
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==-1) t[q[now].x]--;
    }
}

void work_p1() {
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add_query(S[i],1,dep[S[i]]);
        add_query(lca[i],-1,dep[S[i]]);
    }
    work_1_p1(1);
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add_query(T[i],1,dep[S[i]]-2*dep[lca[i]]+MAXN);
        add_query(lca[i],-1,dep[S[i]]-2*dep[lca[i]]+MAXN);
    }
    work_2_p1(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int num=dep[S[i]]-dep[lca[i]];
        if (w[lca[i]]==num) ans[lca[i]]--;
    }
}

void dfs_p2(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=f[x]) {
            dfs_p2(e[now].to);
            t[x]+=t[e[now].to];
        }
    }
    if (dep[x]==w[x]+1) {
        ans[x]=t[x];
    }
}

void work_p2() {
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        t[T[i]]++;
    }
    dfs_p2(1);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(w[i]);
    }
    f[1]=1;
    dep[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(S[i]);
        read(T[i]);
        lca[i]=getLCA(S[i],T[i]);
    }
    work_p1();
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",ans[i]);
    }
    printf("%d",ans[n]);
    return 0;
}

    dp[1][0][0]=0,dp[1][1][1]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            // 0 -> 0
            dp[i+1][j][0]=min(dp[i+1][j][0],dp[i][j][0]+map[c[i]][c[i+1]]);
            // 1 -> 0
            dp[i+1][j][0]=min(dp[i+1][j][0],dp[i][j][1]+(1-k[i])*map[c[i]][c[i+1]]+k[i]*map[d[i]][c[i+1]]);
            // 0 -> 1
            dp[i+1][j+1][1]=min(dp[i+1][j+1][1],dp[i][j][0]+(1-k[i+1])*map[c[i]][c[i+1]]+k[i+1]*map[c[i]][d[i+1]]);
            // 1 -> 1

        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) {
        ans=min(ans,dp[n][i][0]);
        ans=min(ans,dp[n][i][1]);
    }
}

            map[u][v]=map[v][u]=w;
        }
    }

            for (int j=1; j<=V; j++) {

//BZOJ4721.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
char buf[20],*p=buf;
inline void output(int x) {
    if (x) {
        while (x) {
            *(p++)=char(x%10+'0');
            x/=10;
        }
        while (p!=buf) putchar(*(--p));
    } else putchar('0');
    putchar(' ');
}

int n,m,Q,U,V,t;
#define MAXM 7000005
#define MAXN 100005
int a[MAXN];
struct queue {
    int head,tail,v[MAXM+MAXN];
    queue():head(0),tail(0) {}
    void push(int x) {
        v[tail++]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head];
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
} Que[3];
void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) Que[0].push(a[i]);
    int nowtot=0;
    for (int i=1,x,tag,lena,lenb,opcnt=1; i<=m; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=-0x7fffffff;
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            if (!Que[j].empty() && Que[j].front()>x) {
                tag=j,x=Que[j].front();
            }
        }
        x+=nowtot;
        Que[tag].pop();
        nowtot+=Q;
        lena=int(LL(x)*U/V);
        lenb=x-lena;
        Que[1].push(lena-nowtot);
        Que[2].push(lenb-nowtot);
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            output(x);
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
    for (int i=1,x,tag,opcnt=1,ta=n+m; i<=ta; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=-0x7fffffff;
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            if (!Que[j].empty() && Que[j].front()>x) {
                tag=j,x=Que[j].front();
            }
        }
        Que[tag].pop();
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            output(x+nowtot);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    read(U);
    read(V);
    read(t);
    work();
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    a=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;

typedef long long LL;
int n,X;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(X);
    LL l=0,r=0,p=0;
    for (int i=1,to,L,R; i<=n; i++) {
        read(to);
        read(L);
        read(R);
        l=max(LL(L+1),l-to+p);
        r=min(LL(R-1),r+to-p);
        p=to;
        if (p&1) {
            if (!(l&1)) l++;
            if (!(r&1)) r--;
        } else {
            if (l&1) l++;
            if (r&1) r--;
        }
        if (l>r) {
            puts("NIE");
            return 0;
        }
    }
    l-=X-p;
    printf("%lld\n",(l+X)>>1);

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 500005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
int n,k,head[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0;
int fa[MAXN];
double ans[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    if (!head[x]) ans[x]=1;
    else {
        ans[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x]+=siz[e[now].to];
        }
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            ans[x]=max(ans[x],min(ans[e[now].to],double(siz[e[now].to])/(siz[x]-1)));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]);
        add(fa[i],i);
    }
    dfs(1);
    double pr=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (siz[i]>k) pr=max(pr,ans[i]);
    }
    printf("%.7lf\n",pr);
    return 0;

//BZOJ4741.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 305

struct point {
    int x, y;
    point() {}
    point(int a, int b): x(a), y(b) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    void read() {
        ::read(x);
        ::read(y);
    }
    long long operator * (point a) {
        return (long long)x * a.y - (long long)y * a.x;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n, cnt[MAXN][MAXN], eq[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

bool under(point a, point b, point c) {
    b = b - a;
    c = c - a;
    return c.x > 0 && c.x < b.x && b * c < 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].read();
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            point a = p[i], b = p[j];
            if (a.x == b.x) eq[a.y > b.y ? i : j] = 1;
            if (b.x < a.x) swap(a, b);
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) if (under(a, b, p[k])) cnt[i][j]++;
            cnt[j][i] = cnt[i][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            for (int k = j + 1; k <= n; k++) {
                int a = i, b = j, c = k;
                if (p[a].x > p[b].x) swap(a, b);
                if (p[a].x > p[c].x) swap(a, c);
                if (p[b].x > p[c].x) swap(b, c);
                ans[abs(cnt[a][b] + cnt[b][c] + (eq[b] & (p[a].x != p[b].x) & (p[b].x!=p[c].x)) - cnt[a][c] + under(p[a], p[c], p[b]))]++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - 3; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319
#define MOD 1000000061
int n;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], sum[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top;

int l[MAXN], r[MAXN];

inline LL calc() {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL ls = i - l[i] + 1, rs = r[i] - i + 1;
        LL ml = sum[i - 1] - (l[i] > 1 ? sum[l[i] - 2] : 0), mr = sum[r[i]] - sum[i - 1];
        ret = (ret + (ml * (rs - mr) % MOD + mr * (ls - ml) % MOD) * a[i] % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), b[i] = b[i - 1] ^ a[i];
    top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (top && a[sta[top]] < a[i]) r[sta[top--]] = i - 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) r[sta[top--]] = n;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (top && a[sta[top]] <= a[i]) l[sta[top--]] = i + 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) l[sta[top--]] = 1;
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 31; k++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + ((b[i] >> k) & 1);
        ans = (ans + calc() * ((1 << k) % MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4759.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define s 131072
int n;
int h[MAXN], tem[MAXN], nt = 0;
int t[s << 1], L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
}
int query(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l & 1) ret += t[l ^ 1];
        if (r & 1) ret += t[r ^ 1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]), tem[i] = h[i];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    nt = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) h[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + n + 1, h[i]) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        L[i] = query(h[i] + 1, s - 1);
        update(h[i]);
    }
    memset(t, 0, sizeof t);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        R[i] = query(h[i] + 1, s - 1);
        update(h[i]);
        if (max(R[i],L[i]) > 2 * min(L[i],R[i])) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'H' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'P' :
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'S' :
        a = 0;
        break;
    }
    _c = getchar();
}
#define MAXN 100319

int dp[MAXN][21][3];

int n, K;

int main() {
    freopen("hps.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("hps.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, now; i <= n; i++) {
        readop(now);
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j][k] + (k == now));
                if (j && k != now) dp[i][j][now] = max(dp[i][j][now], dp[i - 1][j - 1][k] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
        ans = max(max(dp[n][i][0], dp[n][i][1]), max(dp[n][i][2], ans));
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4765.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define SQN 319
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int n, m, sqn, a[MAXN], fa[MAXN], rt, L[MAXN], R[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tot;
int d[MAXN][SQN], tmp[MAXN], ll[SQN], rr[SQN];
LL c[MAXN], sum[SQN], f[SQN], pref[SQN][SQN], fun, bsum[SQN];

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++tot;
    rev[tot] = x;
    c[x] = a[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            c[x] += c[e[now].to];
        }
    }
    sum[x / sqn] += c[x];
    R[x] = tot;
}

#define query(l, r) { \
	Bl = l / sqn, Br = r / sqn; \
	if (Bl < Br) { \
		ans += f[Bl] - pref[Bl][l - ll[Bl]] \
			+ pref[Br][r - ll[Br] + 1] \
			+ bsum[Br - 1] - bsum[Bl]; \
	} \
	else ans += pref[Bl][r - ll[Bl] + 1] - pref[Bl][l - ll[Bl]]; \
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n) + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        if (u == 0) rt = v;
        else {
            e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
                head[u], v
            };
            head[u] = ecnt;
            e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
                head[v], u
            };
            head[v] = ecnt;
        }
    }
    dfs(rt);
    for (register int b = 0, i; b < sqn; b++) {
        /* Block on numbers */
        ll[b] = max(1, sqn * b), rr[b] = min(n, sqn * (b + 1) - 1);
        if (ll[b] > rr[b]) break;
        tmp[rt] = 0;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) tmp[rev[i]] = tmp[fa[rev[i]]] + (rev[i] >= ll[b] && rev[i] <= rr[b]);
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) d[i][b] = tmp[i];
        /* Block on DFS-id */
        for (i = ll[b]; i <= rr[b]; i++) pref[b][i - ll[b] + 1] = pref[b][i - ll[b]] + a[rev[i]];
        f[b] = pref[b][rr[b] - ll[b] + 1];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) bsum[i] = bsum[i - 1] + f[i];
    for (int q = 1, op, l, r; q <= m; q++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op == 1) {
            int delta = r - a[l], b = L[l] / sqn;
            for (register int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) sum[i] += (LL)d[l][i] * delta;
            f[b] += delta;
            a[l] += delta;
            for (register int i = ll[b]; i <= rr[b]; i++) pref[b][i - ll[b] + 1] = pref[b][i - ll[b]] + a[rev[i]];
            for (register int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) bsum[i] = bsum[i - 1] + f[i];
        } else {
            register LL ans = 0;
            register int bl = l / sqn, br = r / sqn, Bl, Br;
            if (bl + 1 < br) {
                for (register int i = l; i <= rr[bl]; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
                for (register int i = bl + 1; i < br; i++) ans += sum[i];
                for (register int i = ll[br]; i <= r; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
            } else for (register int i = l; i <= r; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
            printf("%llu\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

LL get(int x) {
    LL ret = a[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) ret += get(e[now].to);
    }
    return ret;
}

        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op == 1) {
            a[l] = r;
        } else {
            LL ans = 0;
            for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) ans += get(i);
            printf("%llu\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;

typedef unsigned long long LL;
LL n, m, P;

LL mul(LL a, LL b) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 4) ret = (ret + a * (b & 15)) % P, a = (a << 4) % P;
    return ret;
}

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = mul(ret, x);
        x = mul(x, x);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {

    read(m);
    read(P);
    LL ans = mul(power(n, m - 1), power(m, n - 1));

struct Cow {
    int x, y;
    bool operator < (Cow a) const {
        return y < a.y;
    }
} a[100005];

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].x);
        read(a[i].y);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int i = 1, j = n, ans = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (!a[i].x) i++;
        else if (!a[j].x) j--;
        else {
            int d = min(a[i].x, a[j].x);
            a[i].x -= d, a[j].x -= d;
            ans = max(ans, a[i].y + a[j].y);
        }
    }
    if (a[i].x) ans = max(ans, a[i].y * 2);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    a = 0;

#define MAXN 44

int n, lim;

LL a[MAXN], tot = 0;
LL tmp[1 << 21], tmp2[1 << 21], *r = tmp;
int t1, t2, *cnt = &t1;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x > lim) {
        r[++(*cnt)] = tot;
        return;
    }
    if (tot + a[x] <= m) {
        tot += a[x];
        dfs(x + 1);
        tot -= a[x];
    }
    dfs(x + 1);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    if (n <= 20) {
        lim = n;
        dfs(1);
        printf("%d\n", t1);
    } else {
        lim = 20;
        dfs(1);
        lim = n;
        r = tmp2;
        cnt = &t2;
        dfs(21);
        LL ans = 0;
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + t1 + 1);
        sort(tmp2 + 1, tmp2 + t2 + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = t2; i <= t1; i++) {
            while (j && tmp[i] + tmp2[j] > m) j--;
            if (!j) break;
            ans += j;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
