//BZOJ4802.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

ULL A = 1e16, B = 1;

inline ULL Rand() {
    A ^= A >> 12;
    A ^= A << 25;
    A ^= A >> 27;
    return A ^= B += 2000031920000319ll;
}

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    return b ? gcd(b, a % b) : a;
}
LL mul(LL a, LL b, LL MOD) {
    LD x = (LD(a) * LD(b) + 1e-3) / MOD;
    return a * b - LL(x) * MOD;
}
LL power(LL a, LL b, LL MOD) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = mul(ret, a, MOD);
        a = mul(a, a, MOD);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(LL a, LL n) {
    LL m = n - 1, x, y;
    int i, j = 0;
    while (~m & 1) m >>= 1, ++j;
    x = power(a, m, n);
    for (i = 1; i <= j; x = y, i++) {
        y = mul(x, x, n);
        if (y == 1 && x != 1 && x != n - 1) break;
    }
    return y != 1;
}

bool MR(LL n, int t = 2) {
    if (n <= 2) return n - 1;
    if (~n & 1) return 0;
    while (t--) if (check(Rand() % (n - 1) + 1, n)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

LL PR(LL n, int c) {
    LL x = Rand() % n, y = x, d;
    for (LL i = 2, k = 2; ; i++) {
        x = (mul(x, x, n) + c) % n, d = gcd(y - x, n);
        if (d > 1 && d < n) return d;
        if (y == x) return n;
        if (i == k) y = x, k <<= 1;
    }
}

LL d[233];
int cnt = 0;

void findfac(LL n, int c) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    if (MR(n)) {
        d[++cnt] = n;
        return;
    }
    LL m = n;
    while (m == n) m = PR(n, c--);
    findfac(m, c), findfac(n / m, c);
}

LL n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    findfac(n, 2333);
    sort(d + 1, d + cnt + 1);
    LL phi = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (d[i] == d[i - 1]) phi *= d[i];
        else phi *= d[i] - 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", phi);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 105

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, K, head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, maxdep = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x, int fa, int dep) {
    maxdep = max(maxdep, dep);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa) dfs(e[now].to, x, dep + 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(0, 0, 0);
    printf("%d\n", 1 + min(K, maxdep) + min(n - maxdep - 1, max(0, (K - maxdep)  / 2)));
    return 0;
}

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 1000005
typedef long long LL;

int F[MAXN], g[MAXN], mu[MAXN], pi[MAXN], inv[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt;

LL power(LL x, LL y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( x %= MOD; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void init() {
    register int i, j, k;
    F[0] = 0, F[1] = 1, inv[1] = 1;
    for (i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) F[i] = (F[i - 1] + F[i - 2]) % MOD, inv[i] = (int)power(F[i], MOD - 2);
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) g[i] = 1;
    for (i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        for (j = 1, k = i; k < MAXN; j++, k += i) {
            if (mu[j]) {
                if (~mu[j]) g[k] = int(g[k] * LL(F[i]) % MOD);
                else g[k] = int(g[k] * LL(inv[i]) % MOD);
            }
        }
    }
    pi[0] = 1;
    for (i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) pi[i] = int(pi[i - 1] * LL(g[i]) % MOD);
    inv[MAXN - 1] = int(power(pi[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2));
    for (i = MAXN - 2; ~i; i--) inv[i] = int(inv[i + 1] * LL(g[i + 1]) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    /*	int T;

    		for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j + 1) {

    return 0;

//BZOJ4818.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 20000005
#define P 105
#define rint register int
#define MOD 20170408

int n, m, p;

bool vis[M];
int cnt[P], tot[P];

inline void init() {
    for (rint i = 2, j; i <= m; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            cnt[i % p]++;
            if (!(i >> 15)) for (j = i * i; j <= m; j += i) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++) tot[i] = m / p + (i != 0 && i <= m % p);
}

struct Mat {
    LL a[P][P];
    LL *operator [] (const int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
} tr, x, c;

LL ans = 0;

inline void mul(Mat &a, Mat &b) {
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++)
        for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++)
            c[i][j] = 0;
    for (rint i = 0, j, k; i < p; i++)
        for (k = 0; k < p; k++)
            for (j = 0; j < p; j++)
                c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j];
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++)
        for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++)
            a[i][j] = c[i][j] % MOD;
}

inline void power(int t) {
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++)
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++)
            x[i][j] = i == j;
    for ( ; t; t >>= 1) {
        if (t & 1) mul(x, tr);
        mul(tr, tr);
    }
}

inline void work() {
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            tr[i][(i + j) % p] = tot[j];
        }
    }
    power(n);
    ans += tr[0][0];
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            tr[i][(i + j) % p] = tot[j] - cnt[j];
            cerr << j << " " << tot[j] << " " << cnt[j] << endl;
        }
    }
    power(n);
    ans -= tr[0][0];
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4819.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef double D;

#define eps 2e-7
#define MAXN 233
#define A(i) (i + 1)
#define B(i) (i + n + 1)
struct edge {
    int next, to, a, b;
    bool f;
    D w;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * 2];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, ecnt = 1, head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u, int v, int a, int b) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, a, b, true, 1e0
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -a, -b, false, 1e0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int a[MAXN][MAXN], b[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void build() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            read(b[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, A(i), 0, 0);
        add(B(i), T, 0, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            add(A(i), B(j), a[i][j], b[i][j]);
        }
}

D mid, dis[MAXN];
int q[256], pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

inline bool spfa() {
    for (int i = B(n); i >= 0; i--) dis[i] = -1e9;
    dis[S] = 0;
    pre[T] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 0, x, now;
    q[ta++ & 255] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++ & 255];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[ta++ & 255] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return !!pre[T];
}

inline D check() {
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i += 2) {
        e[i].f = 1;
        e[i ^ 1].f = 0;
        e[i].w = e[i].a - e[i].b * mid;
        e[i ^ 1].w = -e[i].w;
    }
    int retA = 0, retB = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) {
            retA += e[pos[x]].a, retB += e[pos[x]].b;
            e[pos[x]].f = 0, e[pos[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
        }
    }
    return (D)retA / retB;
}

int main() {
    build();
    D l = -1, r = 0;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = l = r;
        r = check();
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", r);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4821ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cmath>
#include<cstring>
#include<vector>
#include<queue>
#include<set>
#include<map>
#include<stack>
#include<bitset>
#include<ext/pb_ds/priority_queue.hpp>
#define max(a,b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))
using namespace std;

typedef long double DB;
typedef long long LL;
const int T = 4;
const LL INF = 1E16;
const int maxn = 1E5 + 10;

int n,m;
LL a[maxn],b[maxn],s0[maxn],s1[maxn];
DB sx[maxn*T],sy[maxn*T],sxy[maxn*T],sm[maxn*T],ax[maxn*T],cx[maxn*T],ay[maxn*T],cy[maxn*T];
DB SX,SY,SXY,SM,X,Y;

inline void maintain(int o) {
    sx[o] = sx[o<<1] + sx[o<<1|1];
    sy[o] = sy[o<<1] + sy[o<<1|1];
    sm[o] = sm[o<<1] + sm[o<<1|1];
    sxy[o] = sxy[o<<1] + sxy[o<<1|1];
}

inline void Build(int o,int l,int r) {
    ax[o] = cx[o] = INF;
    if (l == r) {
        sx[o] = a[l];
        sy[o] = b[l];
        sxy[o] = 1LL * a[l] * b[l];
        sm[o] = 1LL * a[l] * a[l];
        return;
    }
    int mid = l + r >> 1;
    Build(o<<1,l,mid);
    Build(o<<1|1,mid+1,r);
    maintain(o);
}

inline void push_add(int o,LL AX,LL AY) {
    if (ax[o] == INF && cx[o] == INF) ax[o] = AX,ay[o] = AY;
    else if (ax[o] == INF) cx[o] += AX,cy[o] += AY;
    else ax[o] += AX,ay[o] += AY;
}

inline void push_cov(int o,LL CX,LL CY) {
    ax[o] = INF;
    cx[o] = CX;
    cy[o] = CY;
}

inline void pushdown(int o,int l,int r) {
    if (ax[o] == INF && cx[o] == INF) return;
    LL len = r - l + 1;
    int lc = (o << 1),rc = (o << 1 | 1),mid = l + r >> 1;
    if (ax[o] != INF) {
        sm[o] += ax[o] * ax[o] * len + 2LL * ax[o] * sx[o];
        sxy[o] += ax[o] * ay[o] * len + ay[o] * sx[o] + ax[o] * sy[o];
        sx[o] += len * ax[o];
        sy[o] += len * ay[o];
        if (l < r) push_add(lc,ax[o],ay[o]),push_add(rc,ax[o],ay[o]);
    } else {
        sm[o] = cx[o] * cx[o] * len + 2LL * cx[o] * s0[len - 1] + s1[len - 1];
        sxy[o] = cx[o] * cy[o] * len + (cx[o] + cy[o]) * s0[len - 1] + s1[len - 1];
        sx[o] = (cx[o] + cx[o] + len - 1LL) * len / 2LL;
        sy[o] = (cy[o] + cy[o] + len - 1LL) * len / 2LL;
        LL D = mid - l + 1LL;
        if (l < r) push_cov(lc,cx[o],cy[o]),push_cov(rc,cx[o] + D,cy[o] + D);
    }
    ax[o] = cx[o] = INF;
}

inline void Query(int o,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    pushdown(o,l,r);
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        SXY += sxy[o];
        SM += sm[o];
        SX += sx[o];
        SY += sy[o];
        return;
    }
    int mid = l + r >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Query(o<<1,l,mid,ql,qr);
    if (qr > mid) Query(o<<1|1,mid+1,r,ql,qr);
}

inline void Modify(int o,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL AX,LL AY) {
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        if (ax[o] == INF && cx[o] == INF) ax[o] = AX,ay[o] = AY;
        else if (ax[o] == INF) cx[o] += AX,cy[o] += AY;
        else ax[o] += AX,ay[o] += AY;
        pushdown(o,l,r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = l + r >> 1;
    pushdown(o,l,r);
    if (ql <= mid) Modify(o<<1,l,mid,ql,qr,AX,AY);
    else pushdown(o<<1,l,mid);
    if (qr > mid) Modify(o<<1|1,mid+1,r,ql,qr,AX,AY);
    else pushdown(o<<1|1,mid+1,r);
    maintain(o);
}

inline void Cover(int o,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL CX,LL CY) {
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        ax[o] = INF;
        cx[o] = CX;
        cy[o] = CY;
        pushdown(o,l,r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = l + r >> 1;
    pushdown(o,l,r);
    if (ql <= mid && mid < qr) {
        Cover(o<<1,l,mid,ql,qr,CX,CY);
        LL D = mid - max(l,ql) + 1;
        Cover(o<<1|1,mid+1,r,ql,qr,CX + D,CY + D);
    } else {
        if (ql <= mid) Cover(o<<1,l,mid,ql,qr,CX,CY);
        else pushdown(o<<1,l,mid);
        if (qr > mid) Cover(o<<1|1,mid+1,r,ql,qr,CX,CY);
        else pushdown(o<<1|1,mid+1,r);
    }
    maintain(o);
}

inline int getint() {
    char ch = getchar();
    int ret = 0,a = 1;
    while (ch < '0' || '9' < ch) {
        if (ch == '-') a = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while ('0' <= ch && ch <= '9')
        ret = ret * 10 + ch - '0',ch = getchar();
    return ret * a;
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    n = getint();
    m = getint();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = getint();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) b[i] = getint();
    for (int i = 1; i < maxn; i++) {
        s0[i] = 1LL * i + s0[i - 1];
        s1[i] = 1LL * i * i + s1[i - 1];
    }
    Build(1,1,n);
    while (m--) {
        int typ,l,r;
        LL s,t;
        typ = getint();
        l = getint();
        r = getint();
        if (typ == 1) {
            SX = SY = SXY = SM = 0;
            Query(1,1,n,l,r);
            //	cerr << SX << " " << SY << " " << SM << " " << SXY << endl;
            X = SX;
            Y = SY;
            X /= (DB)(r - l + 1);
            Y /= (DB)(r - l + 1);
            DB A = SXY,B = SM;
            A -= (DB)(r - l + 1) * X * Y;
            B -= (DB)(r - l + 1) * X * X;
            printf("%.10lf\n",(double)(A / B));
        } else if (typ == 2) {
            s = getint();
            t = getint();
            Modify(1,1,n,l,r,s,t);
        } else if (typ == 3) {
            s = getint();
            t = getint();
            Cover(1,1,n,l,r,s + l,t + l);
        }

    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4821.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define NO (-1048576)

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    D a, b, aa, ab;
    D S, T;
    D CS, CT;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

int n, m;
int X[MAXN], Y[MAXN];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].a = t[t[x].l].a + t[t[x].r].a;
    t[x].b = t[t[x].l].b + t[t[x].r].b;
    t[x].aa = t[t[x].l].aa + t[t[x].r].aa;
    t[x].ab = t[t[x].l].ab + t[t[x].r].ab;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].a = X[l], t[x].b = Y[l], t[x].aa = (D)X[l] * X[l], t[x].ab = (D)X[l] * Y[l];
    t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    t[x].CS = t[x].CT = NO;
    return x;
}

void update(int x, D S, D T, int l, int r) {
    t[x].ab += t[x].b * S + t[x].a * T +  S * T * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].aa += (2 * t[x].a + S * (r - l + 1)) * S;
    t[x].a += S * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].b += T * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].S += S, t[x].T += T;
}

void fill(int x, D S, D T, int l, int r) {
    t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    t[x].CS = S, t[x].CT = T;
    t[x].a = (S + l + S + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    t[x].b = (T + l + T + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    t[x].aa = S * S * (r - l + 1)
              + S * (l + r) * (r - l + 1)
              + (r * D(r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) - D(l - 1) * l * (2 * l - 1)) / 6;
    t[x].ab = S * T * (r - l + 1)
              + (S + T) * (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2
              + (r * D(r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) - D(l - 1) * l * (2 * l - 1)) / 6;
}

void pushdown(int x, int l, int mid, int r) {
    if (t[x].CS != NO) {
        fill(t[x].l, t[x].CS, t[x].CT, l, mid);
        fill(t[x].r, t[x].CS, t[x].CT, mid + 1, r);
        t[x].CS = NO;
    }
    if (t[x].S != 0 || t[x].T != 0) {
        update(t[x].l, t[x].S, t[x].T, l, mid);
        update(t[x].r, t[x].S, t[x].T, mid + 1, r);
        t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    }
}

D S, T;

void upd(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        update(x, S, T, l, r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (ql <= mid) upd(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) upd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

void fil(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        fill(x, S, T, l, r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (ql <= mid) fil(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) fil(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

struct Ret {
    D a, b, aa, ab;
    Ret () : a(0), b(0), aa(0), ab(0) {}
    Ret (const Node &x) : a(x.a), b(x.b), aa(x.aa), ab(x.ab) {}
    Ret (D x, D y, D xx, D yy) : a(x), b(y), aa(xx), ab(yy) {}
    Ret operator + (Ret x) const {
        return Ret(a + x.a, b + x.b, aa + x.aa, ab + x.ab);
    }
};

Ret query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x]);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(X[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(Y[i]);
    build(1, n);
    int op;
    Ret ret;
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            ret = query(1, 1, n, l, r);
            printf("%.10lf\n", double((ret.ab - ret.a / (r - l + 1) * ret.b) / (ret.aa - ret.a / (r - l + 1) * ret.a)));
            break;
        case 2:
            read(S);
            read(T);
            upd(1, 1, n, l, r);
            break;
        case 3:
            read(S);
            read(T);
            fil(1, 1, n, l, r);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 33
#define down -2147483648
#define up 2147483647
struct Point {
    int x, y, p;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(p);
    }
    inline bool operator < (const Point &a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int b[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN * LOG];

int tcnt = 0, rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v += v;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = int(((LL)l + r) >> 1);
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
    return x;
}

LL query(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = int(((LL)l + r) >> 1);
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].re();
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], down, up, a[i].y, a[i].p);
    b[0] = down;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) b[i] = a[i].x;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x1, x2, y1, y2;
        read(x1);
        read(y1);
        read(x2);
        read(y2);
        int l = int(lower_bound(b, b + n + 1, x1) - b - 1), r = int(upper_bound(b + 1, b + n + 1, x2) - b - 1);
        if (l == r) puts("0");
        else printf("%lld\n", query(rt[r], rt[l], down, up, y1, y2));
    }

    return 0;
}

}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;

    }

#define MAXN 262144

struct cp {
    double r, i;
    cp () {}
    cp (double a, double b) : r(a), i(b) {}
    cp operator + (const cp a) {
        return cp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    cp operator - (const cp a) {
        return cp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    cp operator * (const cp a) {
        return cp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
} A[MAXN], B[MAXN];

int N, m, n;
int R[MAXN];

void getr() {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void fft(cp a[], int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        cp stp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            cp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * stp) {
                cp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int a[MAXN / 4], b[MAXN / 4], c[MAXN];
int bb, sb;
LL ans = 0x3f3f3f3f3f;

int main() {
    read(N);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) read(b[i]), sb += b[i], bb += b[i] * b[i];
    for (n = 1; n < N; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 2;
    getr();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) A[i] = cp(a[i], 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) B[i] = B[i + N] = cp(b[N - 1 - i], 0);

    fft(A, 1);
    fft(B, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A[i] * B[i];
    fft(A, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c[i] = int(A[i].r + 0.5);

    for (int d = -m; d <= m; d++) {
        LL sum = bb;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) sum += (a[i] + d) * (a[i] + d);
        for (int i = N; i < N + N; i++) {
            ans = min(ans, sum - 2 * ((LL)c[i] + d * sb));
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL max(LL a, LL b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAX 1000319
#define Inf 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
int T;
int n, a[MAXN];
LL t1[2][MAX], t2[2][MAX], (*pre)[MAX], (*now)[MAX];

LL solve(LL (opt)(LL, LL)) {
    pre = t1, now = t2;
    LL INF = -opt(Inf, -Inf);
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[1]; i++) pre[0][i] = INF, pre[1][i] = INF;
    pre[0][a[1]] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= a[i]; j++) now[0][j] = now[1][j] = INF;
        for (int j = min(a[i], a[i - 1]); ~j; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF || pre[1][j] != INF) now[0][a[i] - j] = opt(pre[0][j], pre[1][j]) + j;
        }
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; j >= a[i]; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF) now[1][0] = opt(now[1][0], pre[0][j] + a[i]);
        }
        LL tmp = INF;
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; ~j; j--) {
            tmp = opt(tmp, pre[0][j]);
            if (j <= a[i] && tmp != INF) {
                now[1][a[i] - j] = opt(now[1][a[i] - j], tmp + j);
            }
        }
        swap(now, pre);
    }
    LL ans = pre[1][0];
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[n]; i++) ans = opt(ans, pre[0][i]);
    return ans;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    printf("%lld %lld\n", solve(min), solve(max));
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {

        if (ch == '-') f = 1;

bool vis[55][10][10][10];
D f[55][10][10][10];

D dp(int k, int a, int b, int c) {
    if (!k) return 0;
    if (vis[k][a][b][c]) return f[k][a][b][c];
    vis[k][a][b][c] = 1;
    int tot = a + b + c + 1;
    D &ret = f[k][a][b][c];
    ret = 0;
    if (a) {
        ret += dp(k - 1, a - 1, b, c) * (a / D(tot));
    }
    if (b) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c + 1) * (b / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c) * (b / D(tot));
    }
    if (c) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c) * (c / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c - 1) * (c / D(tot));
    }
    ret += (dp(k - 1, a, b, c) + 1) / D(tot);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    int K, A, B, C, T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(K);
        read(A);
        read(B);
        read(C);
        printf("%.2lf\n", (double)dp(K, A, B, C) + 1e-10);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4842ac.cpp
#include<cstdio>

typedef long long ll;

inline char nc() {
    static char buf[100000],*p1=buf,*p2=buf;
    return p1==p2&&(p2=(p1=buf)+fread(buf,1,100000,stdin),p1==p2)?EOF:*p1++;
}
inline void read(int &x) {
    char c=nc(),b=1;
    for (; !(c>='0' && c<='9'); c=nc()) if (c=='-') b=-1;
    for (x=0; c>='0' && c<='9'; x=x*10+c-'0',c=nc());
    x*=b;
}

const int M=10005;
const int N=1005;
struct edge {
    int u,v,w,f,next;
} G[M];
int head[N],inum=1;
inline void add(int u,int v,int w,int f,int p) {
    G[p].u=u;
    G[p].v=v;
    G[p].w=w;
    G[p].f=f;
    G[p].next=head[u];
    head[u]=p;
}
inline void link(int u,int v,int w,int f) {
    printf("%d %d %d %d\n", u, v, w, f);
    add(u,v,w,f,++inum),add(v,u,-w,0,++inum);
}
int S,SS,T;
int Q[5000005],l,r;
int ins[N],pre[N];
ll dis[N];
ll Mincost;
#define V G[p].v
inline bool SPFA() {
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) ins[i]=0,pre[i]=0,dis[i]=1LL<<60;
    l=r=-1;
    Q[++r]=S;
    ins[S]=1;
    dis[S]=0;
    while (l<r) {
        int u=Q[++l];
        ins[u]=0;
        for (int p=head[u]; p; p=G[p].next)
            if (G[p].f && dis[V]>dis[u]+G[p].w) {
                dis[V]=dis[u]+G[p].w;
                pre[V]=p;
                if (!ins[V]) Q[++r]=V,ins[V]=1;
            }
    }
    if (dis[T]==1LL<<60) return 0;
    int minv=1<<30;
    for (int p=pre[T]; p; p=pre[G[p].u])
        minv=min(minv,G[p].f);
    Mincost+=(ll)minv*dis[T];
    for (int p=pre[T]; p; p=pre[G[p].u])
        G[p].f-=minv,G[p^1].f+=minv;
    return 1;
}

int n,K,a[N];
ll Ans;
int mins,mine,maxe;

int main() {
    int x;
    read(n);
    read(K);
    S=n+1,SS=n+2,T=n+3;
    read(mins);
    read(mine);
    maxe=K-mins;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(x),a[i]-=x,Ans+=x;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(x),a[i]+=x;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        link(i,i+1,0,maxe-mine);
    link(n,T,0,maxe-mine);
    int tmp=inum+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        if (i+K<=n)
            link(i,i+K,-a[i],1);
        else
            link(i,T,-a[i],1);
    for (int i=1; i<=K; i++)
        link(SS,i,0,1<<30);
    link(S,SS,0,maxe);
    while (SPFA());
    printf("%lld\n",Ans-Mincost);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++,tmp+=2)
        G[tmp].f?putchar('S'):putchar('E');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4842.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1015
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, K, S, T, t1, t2;
int a[MAXN], pre[MAXN];
LL ans, dis[MAXN];

#define TOP 2047

int q[TOP + 1];
bool inq[MAXN];

void SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * (n + 2));
    dis[S] = 0;
    pre[T] = -1;
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    q[1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(++ta) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    while (t1) {
        SPFA();
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) flow = min(e[pre[x]].f, flow);
        t1 -= (flow = min(flow, t1));
        ans -= flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f -= flow, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f += flow;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(t1);
    read(t2);
    t1 = K - t1;
    S = 0, T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] -= x, ans += x;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] += x;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, i + 1, t1 - t2, 0);
    int st = ecnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, min(i + K, T), 1, -a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) add(S, i, INF, 0);
    solve();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st += 2;
        if (e[st].f) putchar('E');
        else putchar('S');
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4868ac.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>

#define ll long long
using namespace std;
inline int read() {
    ll x = 0;
    char ch = getchar();
    while(ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while(ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return x;
}

int n,m,t[MN+5],s[MN+5];
ll A,B,C,ans=1e18;

ll calc(int tms) {
    ll sum=0,left=0,need=0;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) sum+=C*max(0,tms-t[i]);
    for(int i=1; i<=m; ++i)
        if(s[i]>tms) need+=s[i]-tms;
        else left+=tms-s[i];
    if(B<A)return sum+need*B;
    else if(left>=need) return sum+need*A;
    else return sum+left*A+(need-left)*B;
}

void Solve(int l,int r) {
    if(r-l<=1) {
        for(int i=l; i<=r; ++i) ans=min(ans,calc(i));
        return;
    }
    int m1=(r-l+1)/3+l,m2=(r-l+1)/3*2+l;
    if(calc(m1)<calc(m2)) Solve(l,m2-1);
    else Solve(m1+1,r);
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ4868ac.out", "w", stdout);
    A=read();
    B=read();
    C=read();
    n=read();
    m=read();
    int mx=0;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) mx=max(mx,(t[i]=read()));
    for(int i=1; i<=m; ++i) mx=max(mx,(s[i]=read()));
    Solve(1,mx);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319

LL A, B, C;
LL n, m;
LL t[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL st[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("BZOJ4868.out", "w", stdout);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(t[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    sort(t + 1, t + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i] = st[i - 1] + t[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sb[i] = sb[i - 1] + b[i];
    A = min(A, B);
    LL ans = 0x7fffffffffffffff;
    for (LL T = b[m], i = n, j = m; T >= min(b[1], t[1]); T--) {
        while (i && t[i] >= T) i--;
        while (j && b[j] >= T) j--;
        LL can = T * j - sb[j], mov = sb[m] - sb[j] - T * (m - j);
        if (min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + D(T * i - st[i]) * C < ans) {
            ans = min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + (T * i - st[i]) * C;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;

//BZOJ4869ac.cpp
# include <stdio.h>
# include <string.h>
# include <algorithm>
// # include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
const int M = 5e5 + 10;

# define RG register
# define ST static

int n, m, p, c, a[M], phi[M], pn;

inline int pwr(int a, int b, int p) {
    int ret = 1;
    while(b) {
        if(b&1) ret = 1ll * ret * a % p;
        a = 1ll * a * a % p;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline int getphi(int n) {
    int ret = n;
    for (int i=2; i*i<=n; ++i) {
        if(n%i!=0) continue;
        ret = ret/i*(i-1);
        while(n%i==0) n/=i;
    }
    if(n!=1) ret=ret/n*(n-1);
    return ret;
}

inline int calc(int x, int p) {
    int ret = x;
    if(ret >= phi[p]) ret = ret % phi[p] + phi[p];
    while(p--) {
        x = ret;
        ret = pwr(c, x, phi[p]);
        if(p && !ret) ret += phi[p];
    }
    return ret % phi[0];
}

namespace SMT {
# define ls (x<<1)
# define rs (x<<1|1)
int v[M], tms[M];
inline void build(int x, int l, int r) {
    if(l==r) {
        v[x] = a[l] % phi[0];
        tms[x] = 0;
        return ;
    }
    int mid = l+r>>1;
    build(ls, l, mid);
    build(rs, mid+1, r);
    v[x] = (v[ls]+v[rs])%phi[0];
    tms[x] = min(tms[ls], tms[rs]);
}
inline void change(int x, int l, int r, int L, int R) {
    if(tms[x] >= pn) return;
    if(l == r) {
        tms[x] ++;
        v[x] = calc(a[l], tms[x]);
        return ;
    }
    int mid = l+r>>1;
    if(L <= mid) change(ls, l, mid, L, R);
    if(R > mid) change(rs, mid+1, r, L, R);
    v[x] = (v[ls]+v[rs])%phi[0];
    tms[x] = min(tms[ls], tms[rs]);
}
inline int query(int x, int l, int r, int L, int R) {
    if(L <= l && r <= R) return v[x];
    int mid = l+r>>1, re=0;
    if(L <= mid) re += query(ls, l, mid, L, R);
    if(R > mid) re += query(rs, mid+1, r, L, R);
    return re%phi[0];
}
# undef ls
# undef rs
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &p, &c);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) scanf("%d", a+i);
    phi[0] = p;
    while(p != 1) {
        int t = getphi(p);
        phi[++pn] = t;
        p = t;
    }
    phi[++pn] = 1;
    SMT::build(1, 1, n);
    int opt, l, r;
    while(m--) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &opt, &l, &r);
        if(opt==0) SMT::change(1, 1, n, l, r);
        else printf("%d\n", SMT::query(1, 1, n, l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

int n, m, c, tot;

int a[MAXN], stp[MAXN];

int P[55], po[55][32769], pO[55][32000];

struct Node {
    int l, r, sum;
    bool lp;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
        t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
    } else {
        t[x].sum = a[l] % P[0];
        t[x].lp = 0;
    }
    return x;
}

inline int phi(int x) {
    int ret = x;
    for (int i = 2, j = (int)sqrt(x); i <= j; i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) {
            ret = ret / i * (i - 1);
            while (!(x % i)) x /= i;
            j = (int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    return x > 1 ? ret / x * (x - 1) : ret;
}

int calc(int x, int p) {
    if (x >= P[p]) x = x % P[p] + P[p];
    while (p--) {
        x = int(LL(po[p][x & 32767]) * pO[p][x >> 15] % P[p]);
        if (p && !x) x += P[p];
    }
    return x % P[0];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret % P[0];
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (t[x].lp) return;
    if (l == r) {
        stp[l]++;
        t[x].lp = stp[l] >= tot;
        t[x].sum = calc(a[l], stp[l]);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
    t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
}

int main() {
    int p;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    read(c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    P[0] = p;
    while (p != 1) {
        p = phi(p);
        P[++tot] = p;
    }
    P[++tot] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
        po[i][0] = pO[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= 32768; j++) po[i][j] = int(LL(po[i][j - 1]) * c % P[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j < 32000; j++) pO[i][j] = int(LL(pO[i][j - 1]) * po[i][32768] % P[i]);
    }
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x) printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

    LL f[N];
} ans,a;

void mul(arr &a,arr b,arr c) {
    memset(a.f,0,sizeof(a.f));
    for (int i=0; i<k; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<k; j++)
            a.f[(i+j)%k]=(a.f[(i+j)%k]+b.f[i]*c.f[j]%p)%p;
}

void ksm(arr x,LL y) {
    y--;
    while (y) {
        if (y&1) mul(ans,ans,x);
        mul(x,x,x);
        y>>=1;
    }
}

    a.f[0]++;
    a.f[1%k]++;
    ans=a;
    ksm(a,n*k);
    printf("%lld",ans.f[r]);
    return 0;
}

#define N 51

struct Mat {
    LL a[N][N];
    LL *operator[] (const int x) const {
        return (LL*)a[x];
    }
};

LL n, P;
int K, R;

void mul(Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    static Mat c;
    memset(c.a, 0, sizeof c.a);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++)
                (c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j]) %= P;
    a = c;
}

Mat tr, a;

void work() {
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) tr[i][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) a[i][i]++, a[i][i + 1 == K ? 0 : i + 1]++;
    for (n *= K; n; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) mul(tr, a);
        mul(a, a);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(P);
    read(K);
    read(R);
    work();
    printf("%d\n", int(tr[0][R] % P));
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Mat {
    LL dp[4][4];
    Mat () {}
    Mat (int a, int b, int c) {
        memset(dp, 0, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0] = a;
        dp[1][1] = b;
        dp[2][2] = c;
        dp[3][3] = a;
        register int i, j, k, l;
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            for (j = i; j < 4; j++) {
                for (k = i; k <= j; k++) {
                    for (l = k; l <= j; l++) {
                        dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[k][l]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    LL *operator [] (const unsigned x) const {
        return (LL*)dp[x];
    }
    Mat operator + (const Mat &a) const {
        Mat ret;
        memset(ret.dp, 0, sizeof(ret.dp));
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = i; j < 4; j++)
                for (int k = j; k < 4; k++)
                    ret[i][k] = max(ret[i][k], dp[i][j] + a[j][k]);
        return ret;
    }
    Mat operator * (const int a) const {
        Mat ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = dp[i][j] * a;
            }
        return ret;
    }
};

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    Mat v, s;
    LL siz;
    int val;
    inline bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    inline void setc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        s = c[0]->s + (v * val) + c[1]->s;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + val;

        //	printf("%lld\n", s[0][3]);
    }
} mem[MAXN * 4], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

inline Node *newNode(Mat v = Mat(0, 0, 0), int x = 0) {
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->s = ptr->v * x;
    ptr->siz = ptr->val = x;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

inline void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void get(LL k) {
    Node *x = rt;
    for ( ; ; ) {
        if (x->c[0]->siz > k) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val < k) {
            k -= x->c[0]->siz + x->val;
            x = x->c[1];
        } else {
            if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val == k) {
                splay(x);
                Node *y = x->c[1];
                while (y->c[0] != null) y = y->c[0];
                splay(y, x);
            } else {
                k -= x->c[0]->siz;
                splay(x);
                Node *y = newNode(x->v, x->val - int(k));
                y->setc(x->c[1], 1);
                x->setc(y, 1);
                x->val = int(k);
                y->upd();
                x->upd();
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode();
    rt->setc(newNode(Mat(0, 0, 0), 1), 1);
    LL nowans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL p;
        int a, b, c, x;
        read(p);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(x);
        get(p);
        rt->c[1]->setc(newNode(Mat(a, b, c), x), 0);
        rt->c[1]->upd();
        rt->upd();
        printf("%lld\n", rt->s.dp[0][3] - nowans);
        nowans = rt->s.dp[0][3];
    }
    return 0;
}

struct Ha {
    int len, pre, nxt;
    bool operator < (const Ha &a) const {
        if (nxt - pre >= 0 && a.nxt - a.pre < 0) return 1;
        if (nxt - pre < 0 && a.nxt - a.pre >= 0) return 0;
        if (nxt - pre >= 0) return pre < a.pre;
        else return nxt > a.nxt;
    }

                else a[i].pre++;
            } else a[i].nxt++;
        }

        } else {
            for (int j = tot; j >= a[i].pre; j--) if (~dp[j]) dp[j + delta] = max(dp[j + delta], dp[j] + a[i].len);
            tot += delta;
        }
    }

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define rint register int

int G[15][15], F[15][15];
int n, K, L, ans = 0;

void check() {
    memcpy(F, G, sizeof(G));
    for (rint k = 1, j, i; k <= n; k++) for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (F[i][j] > F[i][k] + F[k][j]) F[i][j] = F[i][k] + F[k][j];
    ans += F[1][n] == K;
}

void dfs(int i, int j) {
    if (i == n) {
        check();
        return;
    }
    for (int k = 1; k <= L; k++) {
        G[i][j] = G[j][i]= k;
        if (j == n) dfs(i + 1, i + 2);
        else dfs(i, j + 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    if (n == 2) {
        printf("%d\n", K > 1);
        return 0;
    }
    dfs(1, 2);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//caesar.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct word {
    char v[6];
    int dif;
    int num;
} w[100005];
bool cmp(word a,word b) {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        if (a.v[i]!=b.v[i])
            return a.v[i]<b.v[i];
    }
    return 0;
}
int n;
char temp[6];

inline int check(int x) {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        if (w[x].v[i]!=temp[i])
            return w[x].v[i]<temp[i];
    }
    return -1;
}
void query() {
    int dif=temp[0];
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        temp[i]-=dif;
        if (temp[i]<0)
            temp[i]+=26;
    }
    int l=1,r=n,m;
    while (l<r) {
        m=(l+r+1)>>1;
        int re=check(m);
        if (re) {
            l=m;
            if (re==-1)
                r=m;
        } else {
            r=m-1;
        }
    }
    int ans=w[l].dif-dif;
    if (ans<0)
        ans+=26;
    printf("%d %d\n",w[l].num,ans);
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",w[i].v);
        w[i].dif=w[i].v[0];
        for (int j=0; j<5; j++) {
            w[i].v[j]-=w[i].dif;
            if (w[i].v[j]<0)
                w[i].v[j]+=26;
        }
        w[i].num=i;
    }
    sort(w+1,w+n+1,cmp);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp);
        query();
    }
    return 0;
}

//catstring.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 266666

typedef long long LL;
const LL P1 = 233333, P2 = 233;
const LL MOD1 = 999990319, MOD2 = 100000319;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator - (Hash b) const {
        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Hash b) const {
        return x == b.x && y == b.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];

char s[MAXN];
int n, X, y, z, lcp[MAXN], dp[MAXN];
void getlcp() {
    lcp[1] = n;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        int l = 0, r = n - i + 1, mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (a[mid] == (a[i + mid - 1] - a[i - 1] * mid)) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        lcp[i] = l;
    }
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 2 + 319];

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[t[x].l].v > t[x].v) t[t[x].l].v = t[x].v;
    if (t[t[x].r].v > t[x].v) t[t[x].r].v = t[x].v;
}

inline void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = l * X;
    return x;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (v >= t[x].v) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v = v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int p) {
    if (l == r) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (p <= mid) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
    else return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s%d%d%d", s + 1, &X, &y, &z);
    n = (int) strlen(s + 1);
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + s[i];
    getlcp();
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int l = min(lcp[i + 1], i), dpi = query(1, 1, n, i);
        update(1, 1, n, i, i + l, dpi + y + z);
        if (i == l) update(1, 1, n, i + l, i + l, dpi + y);
    }
    printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, n));
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 200319

    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }

        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Hash b) const {
        return x == b.x && y == b.y;
    }

    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        int l = 0, r = n - i + 1, mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (a[mid] == (a[i + mid - 1] - a[i - 1] * mid)) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        lcp[i] = l;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s%d%d%d", s + 1, &x, &y, &z);
    n = (int) strlen(s + 1);
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + s[i];
    getlcp();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dp[i] = i * x;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int l = min(lcp[i + 1], i);
        for (int j = 1; j <= l; j++) {
            dp[i + j] = min(dp[i + j], dp[i] + y + ((j == i) ? 0 : z));
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[n]);
    return 0;
}

//C.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN (55 * 55)
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

const int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0}, dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int n, m, S = 0, T = 1, tot = 0;
int a[55][55], b[55][55], lab[55][55], cnt = 0;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4 * 4 * 2];

int head[MAXN * 2], cur[MAXN * 2], tag[MAXN * 2], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    if (f == 0) return;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (2 * cnt + 2));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 2 * cnt + 1; i >= 0; i--) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("C.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("C.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
            lab[i][j] = ++cnt;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(b[i][j]);
            tot += b[i][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                add(S, lab[i][j] * 2, a[i][j]);
                add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, b[i][j]);
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                    if (lab[x][y]) {
                        add(lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, lab[x][y] * 2 + 1, INF);
                        add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[x][y] * 2, INF);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                add(lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, T, a[i][j]);
                add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, b[i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n", tot - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//Cdata.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define TOP 1000000000
struct num {
    unsigned long long v[25];
    int len;
    num():len(0) {}
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret;
        memset(ret.v,0,sizeof(ret.v));
        for (int i=a.len; i; i--)
            for (int j=len; j; j--) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=a.v[i]*v[j];
            }
        int newlen=a.len+len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=newlen; i++) {
            ret.v[i+1]+=ret.v[i]/TOP;
            ret.v[i]%=TOP;
        }
        if (ret.v[newlen+1]) {
            newlen++;
        }
        ret.len=newlen;
        return ret;
    }
    int cmp(num a) {
        if (len!=a.len) return len<a.len?-1:1;
        for (int i=len; i; i--) {
            if (v[i]!=a.v[i]) return v[i]<a.v[i]?-1:1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
} tar,a,ans;

int n,len,sta[11];
char r[120];

inline void quickpower() {
    int k=n;
    while (k) {
        if (k&1) ans=ans*a;
        a=a*a;
        k>>=1;
    }
}

inline int check(int x) {
    memset(a.v,0,sizeof(a.v));
    a.len=1;
    a.v[1]=x;
    memset(ans.v,0,sizeof(ans.v));
    ans.len=1;
    ans.v[1]=1;
    quickpower();
    return ans.cmp(tar);
}

//CDOJ1059.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

struct query {
    int k,l,r,v;
} q[100005];
int l[100005],r[100005],n,m,lcnt=0,rcnt;

int tl[262144],tr[262144],s=131072;

inline int find(int a[],int cnt,int x) {
    int l=0,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (a[mid]<=x)
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}
inline void update(int t[],int x,int v) {
    for (x+=+s; x>0; x>>=1) {
        t[x]+=v;
    }
    return;
}
inline int cnt(int t[],int x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int l=s,r=x+s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&q[i].k);
        if (q[i].k==0) {
            scanf("%d%d",&q[i].l,&q[i].r);
            l[++lcnt]=q[i].l;
            r[lcnt]=++q[i].r;
        }
        scanf("%d",&q[i].v);
    }
    rcnt=lcnt;
    sort(l+1,l+lcnt+1);
    sort(r+1,r+rcnt+1);
    lcnt=int(unique(l+1,l+lcnt+1)-l-1);
    rcnt=int(unique(r+1,r+rcnt+1)-r-1);
    tr[0]=tl[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].k==0) {
            update(tl,find(l,lcnt,q[i].l),q[i].v);
            update(tr,find(r,rcnt,q[i].r),q[i].v);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n",cnt(tl,find(l,lcnt,q[i].v))-cnt(tr,find(r,rcnt,q[i].v)));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1088.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

int fx[6]= {1,-1,0,0,0,0},fy[6]= {0,0,1,-1,0,0},fz[6]= {0,0,0,0,1,-1};

struct point {
    int x,y,z,depth;
    point() {}
    point(int _x,int _y,int _z,int _depth):x(_x),y(_y),z(_z),depth(_depth) {}
};

bool map[35][35][35];
int sx,sy,sz,tx,ty,tz,h,n,m;
char temp[100];
inline void init() {
    memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
    return;
}
inline int bfs() {
    queue<point> q;
    map[sx][sy][sz]=0;
    q.push(point(sx,sy,sz,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        point now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x=now.x,y=now.y,z=now.z,depth=now.depth+1;
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            int tox=x+fx[i],toy=y+fy[i],toz=z+fz[i];
            if (map[tox][toy][toz]) {
                map[tox][toy][toz]=0;
                if (tox==tx && toy==ty && toz==tz)
                    return depth;
                q.push(point(tox,toy,toz,depth));
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d%d",&h,&n,&m) && h && n && m) {
        init();
        for (int k=1; k<=h; k++)
            for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
                scanf("%s",temp+1);
                for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                    if (temp[j]=='#')
                        map[i][j][k]=0;
                    else {
                        map[i][j][k]=1;
                        if (temp[j]!='.') {
                            if (temp[j]=='S')
                                sx=i,sy=j,sz=k;
                            else
                                tx=i,ty=j,tz=k;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        int res=bfs();
        if (res==-1)
            puts("Trapped!");
        else
            printf("Escaped in %d minute(s).\n",res);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1146.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 123456789012345ll
using namespace std;

int x[7000],y[7000],n;
long long dis[7000];
double ans=0;
bool visit[7000];

inline long long sq(int x) {
    return (long long)x*x;
}

inline long long dist(int i,int j) {
    return sq(x[i]-x[j])+sq(y[i]-y[j]);
}

void prim() {
    for (int now=0,to,t=1; t<=n; t++) {
        long long m=INF;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (now)
                dis[i]=min(dis[i],dist(now,i));
            if (!visit[i] && dis[i]<m) {
                to=i;
                m=dis[i];
            }
        }
        ans+=sqrt(m);
        visit[to]=1;
        now=to;
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",x+i,y+i,&r);
        if (r)
            dis[i]=0;
        else
            dis[i]=INF;
    }
    prim();
    printf("%.2f",ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

ll ans = 0;
void dfs_print(int now) {
    vis[now] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < tree[now].size(); ++i) {
        if (vis[tree[now][i]])
            continue;
        printf("%d %d\n", now, tree[now][i]);
        dfs_print(tree[now][i]);
    }
}
void dfs(int now, int value) {
    vis[now] = 1;
    ++XOR[now][value];
    //printf("every %d %d\n", now, value);
    for (int i = 0; i < tree[now].size(); ++i) {
        int tmp = tree[now][i];
        if (!vis[tmp]) {
            dfs(tmp, value^tmp);
            if (XOR[now].size() < XOR[tmp].size()) {
                for (map<int, int>::iterator itor = XOR[now].begin(); itor != XOR[now].end(); ++itor) {
                    if (XOR[tmp].find(now ^ (itor->first)) != XOR[tmp].end())
                        ans += (itor->second)*XOR[tmp][now ^ (itor->first)];
                }
                XOR[now].swap(XOR[tmp]);
            } else {
                for (map<int, int>::iterator itor = XOR[tmp].begin(); itor != XOR[tmp].end(); ++itor) {
                    if (XOR[now].find(now ^ (itor->first)) != XOR[now].end())
                        ans += (itor->second)*XOR[now][now ^ (itor->first)];
                }
            }
            for (map<int, int>::iterator itor = XOR[tmp].begin(); itor != XOR[tmp].end(); ++itor) {
                XOR[now][itor->first] += itor->second;
            }
            /*for (map<int, int>::iterator itor = XOR[now].begin(); itor != XOR[now].end(); ++itor)
            	printf("%d %d\n", itor->first, itor->second);
            printf("%d %d  ans %lld\n", now, tmp, ans);*/
        }
    }
}

//CDOJ1284.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100010
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int l1,l2,can[MAXN];
int n,head[MAXN],size[MAXN],list[MAXN],temp[MAXN],f[MAXN],ecnt=0;
long long ans=0,lcnt;
inline void init() {
    memset(can,-1,sizeof(can));
    return;
}
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}

void dfs_for_g(int x,int fa) {
    size[x]=1;
    list[++lcnt]=x;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa && can[v]) {
            f[v]=x;
            dfs_for_g(v,x);
            size[x]+=size[v];
        }
    }
    return;
}

inline int getroot(int x,int fa) {
    lcnt=0;
    int ans=INF,pos;
    dfs_for_g(x,fa);
    for (int i=1; i<=lcnt; i++) {
        int y=list[i],ss=0;
        for (int now=head[list[i]],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=f[y] && can[v]) {
                ss=max(ss,size[v]);
            }
        }
        ss=max(ss,size[x]-size[y]);
        if (ss<ans) {
            ans=ss;
            pos=y;
        }
    }
    return pos;
}

void dfs_for_xor(int x,int fa,int val) {
    val^=x;
    list[++l2]=val;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa && can[v]) {
            dfs_for_xor(v,x,val);
        }
    }
    return;
}

long long getans(int val) {
    long long ans=0;
    int s2=0;
    /*	puts("Try:");
    	for (int i=1;i<=l1;i++) {
    		printf("%d ",list[i]);
    	}
    	printf("|");
    */	for (int i=l1+1; i<=l2; i++) {
        s2++;
        temp[s2]=list[i]^val;
//		printf("%d(%d) ",list[i],temp[s2]);
    }
//	puts("");
    sort(list+1,list+l1+1);
    sort(temp+1,temp+s2+1);
    int i=1,j=1,now,cnt1,cnt2;
    while (i<=l1 && j<=s2) {
        now=list[i];
        for (cnt1=0; now==list[i] && i<=l2; i++,cnt1++);
        while (temp[j]<now && j<=s2)
            j++;
        if (j>s2)
            break;
        if (temp[j]>now)
            continue;
        for (cnt2=0; now==temp[j] && j<=s2; j++,cnt2++);
        ans+=cnt1*cnt2;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=s2; i++) {
        if (temp[i]==0)
            ans++;
        else
            break;
    }
    return ans;
}
void work(int x,int fa) {
    int root=getroot(x,fa);
//	printf("root:%d\n",root);
    l1=l2=0;
    for (int now=head[root],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
//		printf("to:%d\n",v);
        if (v!=fa && can[v]) {
            l1=l2;
            dfs_for_xor(v,root,0);
            ans+=getans(root);
        }
    }
    can[root]=0;
    for (int now=head[root]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (can[e[now].to]) {
            work(e[now].to,root);
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    init();
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    work(1,0);
    printf("%lld",ans);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1312.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<queue>
using namespace std;
struct use {
    int x,y,h;
};
bool operator<(use x,use y) {
    return x.h<y.h;
}
priority_queue<use>q;
int map[1006][1006],water[1005][1005],dx[5],dy[5],n,m,ans;
bool f[1006][1006],ff[1006][1006];
inline void floodfill(int x,int y,int hh) {
    //cout<<x<<' '<<y<<' '<<hh<<endl;
    for (int i=1; i<=4; i++) {
        int xx,yy;
        xx=x+dx[i];
        yy=y+dy[i];
        if (xx>0&&xx<=n&&yy>0&&yy<=m&&!f[xx][yy]) {
            if (map[xx][yy]<=-hh) {
                water[xx][yy]+=-hh-map[xx][yy];
                f[xx][yy]=true;
                floodfill(xx,yy,hh);
            } else {
                if (!ff[xx][yy]) {
                    use a;
                    a.x=xx;
                    a.y=yy;
                    a.h=-map[xx][yy];
                    q.push(a);
                    ff[xx][yy]=true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    dx[1]=1;
    dx[2]=0;
    dx[3]=-1;
    dx[4]=0;
    dy[1]=0;
    dy[2]=1;
    dy[3]=0;
    dy[4]=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&map[i][j]);
            if (i==1||i==n||j==1||j==m) {
                use a;
                a.x=i;
                a.y=j;
                a.h=-map[i][j];
                q.push(a);
                ff[i][j]=true;
            }
        }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        use a;
        a=q.top();
        q.pop();
        if (!f[a.x][a.y]) {
            f[a.x][a.y]=true;
            floodfill(a.x,a.y,a.h);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d",water[i][1]);
        for (int j=2; j<=m; j++) {
            printf(" %d",water[i][j]);
        }
        puts("");
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1328.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int n,nn,f[200005];

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=nn; i++)
        f[i]=i;
    return;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
bool same(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}
bool merge(int x,int u,int v) {
    if (x==1) {
        if (same(u,v+n))
            return 1;
        if (same(v,u+n))
            return 1;
        f[getf(u)]=getf(v);
        f[getf(u+n)]=getf(v+n);
        return 0;
    }
    if (x==2) {
        if (same(u,v))
            return 1;
        if (same(u+n,v+n))
            return 1;
        f[getf(u)]=getf(n+v);
        f[getf(v)]=getf(n+u);
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    nn=n<<1;
    init();
    bool flag=1;
    for (int i=1,x,v; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&v,&x);
        if (merge(x,i,v)) {
            flag=0;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (flag)
        puts("Time to show my power");
    else
        puts("One face meng bi");
    return 0;
}

//cdoj1330.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') a = a * 10 + ch - '0', ch = getchar();
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 305
#define sign(x) (x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0))
const double eps = 1e-10;

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m;

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && !sign(a[to][i])) to++;
        if (to > n) return 0;
        if (now != to) swap(now, to);
        double t = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= t;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (j != now && sign(a[j][i])) {
                t = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= a[now][k] * t;
            }
        now++;
    }
    for (int i = now + 1; i <= n; i++) if (sign(a[i][0])) return 0;
    return 1;
}
int to[MAXN];

void build() {
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        a[i][i] = 6;
        if (to[i]) a[i][to[i]] = -6;
        else {
            a[i][0] = 6;
            for (int j = 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                if (i + j > n) a[i][i] -= 1;
                else a[i][i + j] -= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    a[n][n] = 1;
    a[n][0] = 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), to[u] = v;
    build();
    if (gauss()) printf("%.9lf\n", a[1][0] + eps);
    else puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1378.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

int n,ans=0;
int print[1000][10];
bool l[10],xl[20],xr[20];
int temp[10];
void dfs(int depth) {
    if (depth>n) {
        ans++;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            print[ans][i]=temp[i];
        }
        return;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!l[i] && !xl[i+depth] && !xr[i-depth+9]) {
            l[i]=1;
            xl[i+depth]=1;
            xr[i-depth+9]=1;
            temp[depth]=i;
            dfs(depth+1);
            l[i]=0;
            xl[i+depth]=0;
            xr[i-depth+9]=0;
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    for (int i=1; i<=ans; i++,putchar(10))
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            printf("%d ",print[i][j]);
        }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ1379.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

int fx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},fy[4]= {0,0,1,-1};

struct point {
    int x,y,z,depth;
    point() {}
    point(int _x,int _y,int _z,int _d):x(_x),y(_y),z(_z),depth(_d) {}
};
int h,n,m,sx,sy,sz,tx,ty,tz;
int map[60][60][60];
bool visit[60][60][60];

inline int bfs() {
    queue<point> q;
    visit[sx][sy][sz]=1;
    q.push(point(sx,sy,sz,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        point now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x=now.x,y=now.y,z=now.z,depth=now.depth+1;
        if (x==tx && y==ty && z==tz)
            return depth-1;
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+fx[d],toy=y+fy[d];
            if (map[tox][toy][z] && !visit[tox][toy][z]) {
                visit[tox][toy][z]=1;
                q.push(point(tox,toy,z,depth));
            }
        }
        if (map[x][y][z]==2 && map[x][y][z+1] && !visit[x][y][z+1]) {
            visit[x][y][z+1]=1;
            q.push(point(x,y,z+1,depth));
        }
        if (map[x][y][z]==3 && map[x][y][z-1] && !visit[x][y][z-1]) {
            visit[x][y][z-1]=1;
            q.push(point(x,y,z-1,depth));
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

char temp[60];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&h,&n,&m);
    for (int k=1; k<=h; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp+1);
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='x')
                    map[i][j][k]=0;
                else {
                    map[i][j][k]=1;
                    if (temp[j]=='.')
                        continue;
                    if (temp[j]=='U')
                        map[i][j][k]=2;
                    if (temp[j]=='D')
                        map[i][j][k]=3;
                    if (temp[j]=='X')
                        sx=i,sy=j,sz=k;
                    if (temp[j]=='Y')
                        tx=i,ty=j,tz=k;
                }
            }
        }
    printf("%d",bfs());
    return 0;
}

inline int getstatu(statu x) {
    int temp=0;
    for (int i=0; i<9; i++) {
        int cnt=0;
        for (int j=i+1; j<9; j++) {
            if (x.a[j]<x.a[i])
                cnt++;
        }
        temp+=pp[8-i]*cnt;
    }
    return temp;
}
inline bool notvisit(statu x,int depth) {
    int temp=0;
    for (int i=0; i<9; i++) {
        int cnt=0;
        for (int j=i+1; j<9; j++) {
            if (x.a[j]<x.a[i])
                cnt++;
        }
        temp+=pp[8-i]*cnt;
    }
    if (visit[temp]>INF) {
        visit[temp]=depth;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

	}
	return 1;

inline int bfs() {
    queue<statu> q;
    notvisit(start,0);
    q.push(start);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        statu now=q.front();
        int depth=now.depth+1;
        q.pop();
        /*		if (finish(now))
        			return now.depth;*/
        now.depth++;
        int nine;
        for (nine=0; nine<9; nine++) {
            if (now.a[nine]==8)
                break;
        }
        int x=nine/3,y=nine%3;
        statu temp;
        if (x) {
            temp=now;
            temp.a[nine]=temp.a[nine-3];
            temp.a[nine-3]=8;
            if (notvisit(temp,depth)) {
                q.push(temp);
            }
        }
        if (x!=2) {
            temp=now;
            temp.a[nine]=temp.a[nine+3];
            temp.a[nine+3]=8;
            if (notvisit(temp,depth)) {
                q.push(temp);
            }
        }
        if (y) {
            temp=now;
            temp.a[nine]=temp.a[nine-1];
            temp.a[nine-1]=8;
            if (notvisit(temp,depth)) {
                q.push(temp);
            }
        }
        if (y!=2) {
            temp=now;
            temp.a[nine]=temp.a[nine+1];
            temp.a[nine+1]=8;
            if (notvisit(temp,depth)) {
                q.push(temp);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

//CDOJ201.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,k,a[1000005];
int maxw[1000005],maxp[1000005],maxh=1,maxt=1;
int minw[1000005],minp[1000005],minh=1,mint=1;

int opmax(int x,int i) {
    while (maxh<maxt && maxw[maxt-1]<=x)
        maxt--;
    maxw[maxt]=x;
    maxp[maxt++]=i;
    i-=k;
    for (; maxp[maxh]<=i; maxh++);
    return maxw[maxh];
}
int opmin(int x,int i) {
    while (minh<mint && minw[mint-1]>=x)
        mint--;
    minw[mint]=x;
    minp[mint++]=i;
    i-=k;
    for (; minp[minh]<=i; minh++);
    return minw[minh];
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<k; i++) {
        opmin(a[i],i);
    }
    printf("%d",opmin(a[k],k));
    for (int i=k+1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf(" %d",opmin(a[i],i));
    }
    for (int i=1; i<k; i++) {
        opmax(a[i],i);
    }
    printf("\n%d",opmax(a[k],k));
    for (int i=k+1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf(" %d",opmax(a[i],i));
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ203.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 1000005
using namespace std;

int fx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},fy[4]= {0,0,-1,1};
struct point {
    int x,y,num,h;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return h<a.h;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int ch=0;
void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}

int n,m,t,top,ans,h[MAXN],print[MAXN],f[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=top; i++)
        f[i]=i;
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    return;
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a);
    int fb=getf(b);
    if (fa==fb)
        return 0;
    f[fa]=fb;
    return 1;
}
inline void calc(int x) {
    point &now=a[x];
    ans++;
    for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
        int tox=now.x+fx[d],toy=now.y+fy[d];
        if (tox>0 && tox<=n && toy>0 && toy<=m) {
            int p=(tox-1)*m+toy;
            if (visit[p]) {
                if (merge(p,now.num)) {
                    ans--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    visit[now.num]=1;
    return;
}
int main() {
    int _t;
    read(_t);
    while (_t--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        top=n*m;
        init();
        for (int i=1,tag=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
                read(a[tag].h);
                a[tag].x=i;
                a[tag].num=tag;
                a[tag].y=j;
            }
        }
        sort(a+1,a+top+1);
        a[0].h=-1;
        read(t);
        int now=top;
        ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
            scanf("%d",h+i);
        }
        for (int i=t; i>0; i--) {
            while (a[now].h>h[i]) {
                calc(now--);
            }
            print[i]=ans;
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
            printf("%d ",print[i]);
        }
        puts("");
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <string>

#include <queue>

priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int> > q;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        q.push(r);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int a=q.top();
        q.pop();
        int b=q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans+=a+b;
        q.push(a+b);
    }
