    return 0;
}

//CDOJ251.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int ans,n;
int a[100005],nxt[100005];
int hi[100005],tag[100005];
int print[100005];
inline void init() {
    memset(hi,61,sizeof(tag));
    hi[0]=0;
    ans=0;
    tag[0]=-1;
    a[0]=0;
    nxt[0]=0;
}
inline int find(int h) {
    int l=0,r=ans,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (hi[mid]>=h)
            r=mid-1;
        else
            l=mid;
    }
    return l;
}
int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        init();
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            scanf("%d",a+i);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            int last=find(a[i]);
            if (hi[last+1]>=a[i]) {
                hi[last+1]=a[i];
                nxt[i]=tag[last];
                tag[last+1]=i;
            }
            if (last+1>ans)
                ans=last+1;
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
        for (int now=tag[ans],i=1; now; now=nxt[now]) {
            print[i++]=a[now];
        }
        for (int i=ans; i>1; i--) {
            printf("%d ",print[i]);
        }
        printf("%d\n",print[1]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ252.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int fx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},fy[4]= {0,0,1,-1};

struct point {
    int x,y,h;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return h<a.h;
    }
} p[10005];

int map[105][105],dp[105][105],ans,n,m,cnt;

void init() {
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    memset(map,1,sizeof(map));
    cnt=0;
    ans=0;
    return;
}

int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
                p[++cnt].x=i,p[cnt].y=j,p[cnt].h=map[i][j];
            }
        sort(p+1,p+cnt+1);
        for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
            int x=p[i].x,y=p[i].y,h=p[i].h;
            dp[x][y]=0;
            for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
                int tox=x+fx[d],toy=y+fy[d];
                if (map[tox][toy]<h)
                    dp[x][y]=max(dp[x][y],dp[tox][toy]);
            }
            if (++dp[x][y] > ans)
                ans = dp[x][y];
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ288ac.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define Mod 1000000007
#define SMod 10007
#define lll __int64
#define ll long long
using namespace std;
#define N 1000007

ll exgcd(ll a,ll b,ll &x,ll &y) {
    if(!b) {
        x = (ll)1,y = (ll)0;
        return a;
    }
    ll r = exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    ll t = x;
    x = y;
    y = t - a/b*y;
    return r;
}

ll gcd(ll a,ll b) {
    if(!b)
        return a;
    return gcd(b,a%b);
}

int main() {
    ll x,y,m,n,L;
    ll kx,ky;
    //freopen("1.txt","r",stdin);
    //freopen("2.txt","w",stdout);
    while(scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld%lld",&x,&y,&m,&n,&L)!=EOF) {
        ll nm = n-m;
        ll delta = x-y;
        if(nm < 0) {
            nm = m-n;
            delta = y-x;
        }
        ll d = exgcd(nm,L,kx,ky);
        if(delta%d) {
            puts("Impossible");
            continue;
        }
        ll t = L/d;
        //printf("%lld\n",t);
        ll res = (((delta/d)*kx)%t + t)%t;
        printf("%lld\n",res);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ288.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
long long extended_euclidean(long long a,long long b,long long &x,long long &y) {
    if(b==0) {
        x = 1;
        y = 0;
        return a;
    }
    long long g = extended_euclidean(b, a%b, x, y);
    long long tmp = x;
    x = y;
    y = tmp - (a/b)*y;
    return g;
}

int main() {
    long long a,b,c,x,y,g,m,n;
    while (scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld%lld",&x,&y,&m,&n,&b)!=EOF) {
        if (m==n) {
            puts("Impossible");
            continue;
        }
        if (n<m) {
            swap(n,m);
            swap(x,y);
        }
        a=(m-n+b)%b;
        c=(y-x+b)%b;
        g = extended_euclidean(a, b, x, y);
        if (c%g!=0) {
            puts("Impossible");
        } else {
            c=c/g;
            x=x*c;
            y=y*c;
            long long r=b/g;
            x=(x%r+r)%r;
            printf("%lld\n",x);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ30.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,m;
int map[105][105];

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF && n && m) {
        memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
        for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
            if (map[u][v]>w)
                map[u][v]=map[v][u]=w;
        }
        for (int k=1; k<=n; k++)
            for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
                for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
                    if (map[i][k]+map[k][j]<map[i][j])
                        map[i][j]=map[i][k]+map[k][j];
                }
        printf("%d\n",map[1][n]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ578.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <queue>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;

int fx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},fy[4]= {0,0,-1,1};
struct chess {
    int c[4],depth,st,val;
    bool operator < (chess a) const {
        if (depth+val!=a.depth+a.val)
            return depth+val>a.depth+a.val;
        return depth>a.depth;
    }
} first;
int n,m,tx,ty,tid;
int map[10][10];
bool visit[36][36][36][36];

inline void init() {
// WTF
    memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    memset(first.c,0,sizeof(first.c));
}

inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>=0 && x<n && y>=0 && y<n;
}

inline bool ok(chess x) {
    for (int i=x.st; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<m; j++) {
            int tx1=x.c[i]/n;
            int ty1=x.c[i]%n;
            int tx2=x.c[j]/n;
            int ty2=x.c[j]%n;
            if (abs(tx2-tx1)+abs(ty2-ty1)<2)
                return 0;
        }
    return 1;
}

inline int getVal(chess x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=x.st; i<m; i++) {
        ans+=abs(x.c[i]/n-tx)+abs(x.c[i]%n-ty);
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int bfs() {
    priority_queue<chess> q;
    first.depth=0;
    first.st=0;
    first.val=getVal(first);
    q.push(first);
    visit[first.c[0]][first.c[1]][first.c[2]][first.c[3]]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        chess now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        if (now.c[now.st]==tid)
            now.st++;
        if (now.st==m)
            return now.depth;
        for (int i=now.st; i<m; i++) {
            int x=now.c[i]/n,y=now.c[i]%n;
            for (int j=0; j<4; j++) {
                int tox=x+fx[j],toy=y+fy[j];
                if (inrange(tox,toy)) {
                    int nid=tox*n+toy;
                    chess temp=now;
                    temp.c[i]=nid;
                    if (ok(temp) && !visit[temp.c[0]][temp.c[1]][temp.c[2]][temp.c[3]]) {
                        temp.depth++;
                        temp.val=getVal(temp);
                        q.push(temp);
                        visit[temp.c[0]][temp.c[1]][temp.c[2]][temp.c[3]]=1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

char temp[10];

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        init();
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp);
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='o')
                    map[i][j]=1;
                else if (temp[j]=='x') {
                    map[i][j]=-1;
                    tx=i;
                    ty=j;
                    tid=i*n+j;
                } else {
                    first.c[temp[j]-'1']=i*n+j;
                }
            }
        }
        first.val=getVal(first);
        printf("%d\n",bfs());
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ578WTF.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <queue>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;

int fx[4]= {1,-1,0,0},fy[4]= {0,0,-1,1};
struct cm {
    int x,y;
    cm() {}
    cm(int _x,int _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    bool operator ^ (cm a) const {
        return abs(x-a.x)+abs(y-a.y)<2;
    }
};
struct chess {
    cm c[4];
    int depth,cnt,val;
    bool operator < (chess a) const {
        if (depth+val!=a.depth+a.val)
            return depth+val>a.depth+a.val;
        return depth>a.depth;
    }
} first;
int n,m,tx,ty;
bool visit[2000000];

inline void init() {
// WTF
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
}

inline int getstatu(chess x) {
    int temp=0;
    for (int i=0; i<x.cnt; i++) {
        temp=temp*36+(x.c[i].x-1)*6+(x.c[i].y-1);
    }
    return temp;
}

inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<=n && y>0 && y<=n;
}

inline bool ok(chess x,int now) {
    for (int i=0; i<x.cnt; i++)
        if (now!=i && x.c[i]^x.c[now])
            return 0;
    return 1;
}

inline int getVal(chess x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<x.cnt; i++) {
        ans+=abs(x.c[i].x-tx)+abs(x.c[i].y-ty);
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int bfs() {
    priority_queue<chess> q;
    first.depth=0;
    first.cnt=m;
    first.val=getVal(first);
    q.push(first);
    visit[getstatu(first)]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        chess now=q.top(),temp=now;
        int cnt=now.cnt,depth=now.depth+1;
        q.pop();
        for (int i=0; i<cnt; i++) {
            int x=now.c[i].x,y=now.c[i].y,tox,toy;
            for (int j=0; j<4; j++) {
                tox=x+fx[j],toy=y+fy[j];
                if (inrange(tox,toy)) {
                    temp=now;
                    temp.c[i].x=tox,temp.c[i].y=toy,temp.depth=depth;
                    if (ok(temp,i) && !visit[getstatu(temp)]) {
                        if (!i && tox==tx && toy==ty) {
                            if (--temp.cnt) {
                                for (int k=0; k<temp.cnt; k++)
                                    temp.c[k]=temp.c[k+1];
                            } else
                                return depth;
                        }
                        temp.val=getVal(temp);
                        q.push(temp);
                        visit[getstatu(temp)]=1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

char temp[10];

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        init();
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp+1);
            for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='x') {
                    tx=i;
                    ty=j;
                } else if (temp[j]!='o') {
                    int now=temp[j]-'1';
                    first.c[now].x=i;
                    first.c[now].y=j;
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",bfs());
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ594.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;

int a[50005],n,c;
int dp[50005][105];

inline void init() {
    memset(dp,31,sizeof(dp));
    return;
}

inline int sq(int x) {
    return x*x;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&c)==2) {
        init();
        int maxh=-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d",a+i);
            maxh=max(a[i],maxh);
        }
        for (int i=a[1]; i<=maxh; i++)
            dp[1][i]=sq(i-a[1]);
        for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
            int minv=INF;
            for (int j=a[i-1]; j<=maxh; j++) {
                minv=min(minv,dp[i-1][j]-c*j);
                if (j>=a[i])
                    dp[i][j]=minv+c*j+sq(j-a[i]);
            }
            minv=INF;
            for (int j=maxh; j>=a[i]; j--) {
                minv=min(minv,dp[i-1][j]+c*j);
                if (j>=a[i])
                    dp[i][j]=min(dp[i][j],minv-c*j+sq(j-a[i]));
            }
        }
        int ans=INF;
        for (int i=a[n]; i<=maxh; i++)
            ans=min(ans,dp[n][i]);
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ601.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 10005
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
bool visit[MAXN];
int n,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dp[MAXN][3];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    int mindif=INF;
    visit[x]=1;
    dp[x][0]=INF;
    dp[x][1]=1;
    dp[x][2]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            dfs(v);
            dp[x][1]+=min(min(dp[v][0],dp[v][1]),dp[v][2]);
            dp[x][2]+=min(dp[v][0],dp[v][1]);
            mindif=min(mindif,dp[v][1]-dp[v][0]);
        }
    }
    if (mindif<INF) {
        dp[x][0]=dp[x][2]+max(mindif,0);
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d",min(dp[1][0],dp[1][1]));
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ61.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

bool prime(int x) {
    if (x<2)
        return 0;
    for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(x)); i<=t; i++) {
        if (x%i==0)
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    int n,sum=0;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        if (prime(r))
            sum++;
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",sum,n);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ838.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;
int n,m,s;
long long t[524288];

inline void init() {
    for (s=1; s<=n+1; s<<=1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lld",t+s+i);
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)+1];
    }
    return;
}

inline long long query(int l,int r) {
    long long ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x>0; t[x]+=d,x>>=1);
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&l,&r);
        if (x==0)
            printf("%lld\n",query(l,r));
        else
            update(l,r);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ839.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

inline void read(int &a) {
    a=0;
    int ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch >'9') {
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}
inline void readll(long long &a) {
    a=0;
    int ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch >'9') {
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}
int n,m,s,L[262148],R[262148];
long long t[262148],lazy[262148];

inline void getS() {
    for (s=1; s<=n; s<<=1);
    return;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    getS();
    int p=s-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        readll(t[p+i]);
        L[i+p]=R[i+p]=i;
    }
    for (int i=n+1; i<=s; i++) {
        L[i+p]=R[i+p]=i;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)+1];
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)+1];
    }
    return;
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (x>=s || lazy[x]==0)
        return;
    t[x<<1]+=lazy[x]*(R[x<<1]-L[x<<1]+1);
    lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    t[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x]*(R[(x<<1)+1]-L[(x<<1)+1]+1);
    lazy[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
    return;
}

inline void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=d*(R[x]-L[x]+1);
        lazy[x]+=d;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid)
        update(x<<1,l,min(r,mid),d);
    if (r>mid)
        update((x<<1)+1,max(mid+1,l),r,d);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)+1];
    return;
}

inline long long query(int x,int l,int r) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r)
        return t[x];
    long long ans=0;
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid)
        ans+=query(x<<1,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid)
        ans+=query((x<<1)+1,max(mid+1,l),r);
    return ans;
}
void work() {
    for (int i=1,l,r,d,k; i<=m; i++) {
        read(k);
        if (k==1) {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(d);
            update(1,l,r,d);
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            printf("%lld\n",query(1,l,r));
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <string>

struct point {
    int x,y;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x)
            return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
} a[100005];

int t[65536],s,n,ans[100005];

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int res=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1)
            res+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1)
            res+=t[r^1];
    }
    return res;
}

inline void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x>0; x>>=1)
        t[x]++;
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&a[i].x,&a[i].y);
        a[i].y++;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    s=32768;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans[query(1,a[i].y)]++;
        update(a[i].y);
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ850.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;
long long ten[12]= {1,10,100,1000,10000,100000,1000000,10000000,100000000,1000000000,10000000000};
long long n,ans=INF;
void dfs(long long now,int depth) {
    if ((now*now)%ten[depth]==n) {
        ans=min(ans,now);
        return;
    }
    long long tar=n%ten[depth+1];
    for (int i=0; i<=9; i++) {
        long long temp=now+i*ten[depth];
        if ((temp*temp)%ten[depth+1]==tar) {
            dfs(temp,depth+1);
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        scanf("%lld",&n);
        ans=INF;
        dfs(0,0);
        if (ans==INF)
            puts("None");
        else
            printf("%lld\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

int ten[6]= {1,10,100,1000,10000,100000};
int s,t;
int visit[10000];
inline bool exsit(int x) {
    int l=0,r=1060,m;
    while (l<r) {
        m=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (PrimeList[m]<=x)
            l=m;
        else
            r=m-1;
    }
    if (PrimeList[l]==x)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}
inline int bfs() {
    memset(visit,61,sizeof(visit));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    visit[s]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int now=q.front(),depth=visit[now]+1;
        q.pop();
        if (now==t)
            return depth-1;
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            int temp=now - now%ten[i+1] + now%ten[i];
            for (int j=0; j<10; j++) {
                int to=temp+j*ten[i];
                if (exsit(to)) {
                    if (visit[to]>depth) {
                        visit[to]=depth;
                        q.push(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int temp=now%1000;
        for (int j=1; j<10; j++) {
            int to=j*1000+temp;
            if (exsit(to)) {
                if (visit[to]>depth) {
                    visit[to]=depth;
                    q.push(to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&s,&t);
        int res=bfs();
        if (res==-1)
            puts("Impossible");
        else
            printf("%d\n",res);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ853.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;
struct point {
    int x,y,f;
    point() {}
    point(int _x,int _y,int _f):x(_x),y(_y),f(_f) {}
};
int dircy[4]= {0,1,0,-1},dircx[4]= {-1,0,1,0};
int n,m,tx,ty,visit[60][60][4];
bool map[60][60];
inline void init() {
    memset(visit,61,sizeof(visit));
    memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
}
inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<n && y>0 && y<m;
}
inline int bfs(int x1,int y1,int f) {
    queue<point> q;
    visit[x1][y1][f]=0;
    q.push(point(x1,y1,f));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        point now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x=now.x,y=now.y,f=now.f,depth=visit[x][y][f]+1;
        // go forward
        for (int i=1; i<=3; i++) {
            int tox=x+dircx[f]*i,toy=y+dircy[f]*i;
            if (!inrange(tox,toy) || map[tox][toy])
                break;
            if (visit[tox][toy][f]>depth) {
                visit[tox][toy][f]=depth;
                q.push(point(tox,toy,f));
            }
        }
        //turn +
        int tf=(f+1)%4;
        if (visit[x][y][tf]>depth) {
            q.push(point(x,y,tf));
            visit[x][y][tf]=depth;
        }
        tf=(f+3)%4;
        if (visit[x][y][tf]>depth) {
            q.push(point(x,y,tf));
            visit[x][y][tf]=depth;
        }
    }
    int ans=visit[tx][ty][0];
    for (int i=1; i<=3; i++) {
        ans=min(ans,visit[tx][ty][i]);
    }
    if (ans>INF)
        return -1;
    else
        return ans;
}
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
        if (n==0 && m==0)
            break;
        init();
        for (int i=0,r; i<n; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
                scanf("%d",&r);
                if (r) {
                    map[i][j]=map[i+1][j]=map[i][j+1]=map[i+1][j+1]=1;
                }
            }
        int x1,x2,f;
        scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&x1,&x2,&tx,&ty,&f);
        printf("%d\n",bfs(x1,x2,f));
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ855.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int L,n,m;
int a[60000];
bool check(int x) {
    int cnt=0,i=0,j=1;
    while (1) {
        while (a[j]-a[i]<x && j<=n)
            cnt++,j++;
        if (j>n) {
            if (a[j]-a[i]<x)
                cnt++;
            if (cnt<=m)
                return 1;
            return 0;
        }
        i=j,j++;
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&L,&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    a[0]=0;
    a[n+1]=L;
    int l=1,r=L,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d",l);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ877.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#define s 1024
using namespace std;
int n,m,ans,dp[s][s<<1],a[s],t[s];
int q(int t[],int x) {
    int a=0;
    for (int l=s,r=s+x+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) a=max(a,t[l^1]);
        if (r&1) a=max(a,t[r^1]);
    }
    return a;
}
void u(int t[],int x,int v) {
    if (t[x+=s]>=v) return;
    for (t[x]=v,x>>=1; x>0; x>>=1) t[x]=max(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)+1]);
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=0; i++<n; scanf("%d",a+i),t[i]=a[i]);
    sort(t+1,t+n+1),m=int(unique(t+1,t+n+1)-t);
    for (int i=0; i++<n; a[i]=int(lower_bound(t+1,t+m,a[i])-t)+1);
    for (int i=0; i++<n;)
        for (int j=m,r; j>0; j--,ans=max(r,ans))
            r=q(dp[j],a[i])+1,u(dp[j],a[i],r),u(dp[a[i]],j,r);
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ882.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MOD 100000000
using namespace std;

int n,m;
int st[400],map[13],cnt=0;
int trans[400][400],tot[400];
long long dp[13][400];
inline void init() {
    int stmax=1<<m;
    for (int i=0; i<stmax; i++) {
        if (!(i&(i<<1)))
            st[++cnt]=i;
    }
    trans[1][++tot[1]]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=cnt; j++) {
            if (!(st[i]&st[j])) {
                trans[i][++tot[i]]=j;
                trans[j][++tot[j]]=i;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        map[i]=0;
        for (int j=1,now; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&now);
            map[i]=(map[i]<<1)+(now^1);
        }
    }
    init();
    dp[0][1]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt; j++) {
            if (!dp[i-1][j]) continue;
            long long now=(dp[i-1][j]%=MOD);
            for (int k=1; k<=tot[j]; k++) {
                if (!(st[trans[j][k]]&map[i]))
                    dp[i][trans[j][k]]+=now;
            }
        }
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        ans=(ans+dp[n][i])%MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ885.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

bool two[2048];
bool trans[2048][2048];

int n,m,stmax;
long long dp[13][2048];
inline void init() {
    two[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<2048; i++) {
        if ((i&1)==0)
            two[i]=two[i>>1];
        else if ((i&3)==3)
            two[i]=two[i>>2];
        else
            two[i]=0;
    }
}

inline void pre() {
    stmax=(1<<m)-1;
    for (int i=0,ri; i<=stmax; i++) {
        ri=i^stmax;
        for (int j=0; j<=stmax; j++) {
            if ((ri&j) != ri)
                trans[i][j]=0;
            else {
                if (two[j-(ri&j)])
                    trans[i][j]=1;
                else
                    trans[i][j]=0;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
        if ((n*m)&1) {
            puts("0");
            continue;
        }
        pre();
        memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
        dp[0][stmax]=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<=stmax; j++) {
                if (!dp[i-1][j])
                    continue;
                long long now=dp[i-1][j];
                for (int k=0; k<=stmax; k++) {
                    if (trans[j][k])
                        dp[i][k]+=now;
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%lld\n",dp[n][stmax]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ914.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXM 100005
#define MAXN 1005
using namespace std;

struct statu {
    int u,step;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _u,int _s):u(_u),step(_s) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return step>a.step;
    }
};

struct edge {
    int to,next,w;
} e[2][MAXM];

int n,m,x,head[2][MAXN],ecnt=0,ans[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[0][++ecnt].to=v;
    e[0][ecnt].next=head[0][u];
    e[0][ecnt].w=w;
    head[0][u]=ecnt;
    e[1][ecnt].to=u;
    e[1][ecnt].next=head[1][v];
    e[1][ecnt].w=w;
    head[1][v]=ecnt;
    return;
}

inline void bfs(int st) {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    q.push(statu(x,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        statu here=q.top();
        q.pop();
        int u=here.u,cost=here.step;
        if (visit[u])
            continue;
        visit[u]=1;
        ans[u]+=cost;
        for (int now=head[st][u]; now; now=e[st][now].next) {
            int v=e[st][now].to,w=e[st][now].w;
            q.push(statu(v,w+cost));
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&x);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    bfs(0);
    bfs(1);
    int p=ans[1];
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        p=max(p,ans[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",p);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJ916.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[20005];

int n,m,head[10005],in[10005],g[10005],ecnt,ans;

inline void init() {
    ecnt=0;
    ans=0;
    memset(in,0,sizeof(in));
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
    return;
}
inline bool topo() {
    int total=0;
    queue<int> q;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (in[i]==0) {
            in[i]=-1;
            g[i]=0;
            total++;
            q.push(i);
        }
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[u],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            in[v]--;
            if (!in[v]) {
                in[v]=-1;
                g[v]=g[u]+1;
                ans+=g[v];
                total++;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return total==n;
}
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(v,u);
        }
        if (topo()) {
            printf("%d\n",ans+n*888);
        } else {
            printf("-1\n");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJBOPC.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;

bool visit[666667];
int cnt=0;
int q[45950][7],depth[45950];
int v[7];
char ra[120],rb[120];
int a[120],b[120];
int retrans() {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
        ans=ans*10+v[i];
    }
    return ans;
}

void init() {
    q[1][0]=0,q[1][1]=1,q[1][2]=2,q[1][3]=3,q[1][4]=4,q[1][5]=5;
    visit[12345]=1;
    int tail=1;
    depth[1]=0;
    while (cnt<tail) {
        cnt++;
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++) {
                if (i==j)
                    continue;
                for (int k=0; k<6; k++) {
                    if (q[cnt][k]==i)
                        v[k]=j;
                    else
                        v[k]=q[cnt][k];
                }
                int to=retrans();
                if (!visit[to]) {
                    tail++;
                    for (int k=0; k<6; k++) {
                        q[tail][k]=v[k];
                    }
                    depth[tail]=depth[cnt]+1;
                    visit[to]=1;
                }
            }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    init();
    while (scanf("%s%s",ra,rb)!=EOF) {
        int len=strlen(ra);
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
            a[i]=ra[i]-'1';
            b[i]=rb[i]-'1';
        }
        int ans=INF;
        for (int i=1,temp=depth[i]; i<=cnt; i++,temp=depth[i]) {
            for (int j=0; j<len; j++) {
                if (q[i][b[j]]!=a[j])
                    temp++;
            }
            if (temp<ans) {
                ans=temp;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJGpTrB.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXT 10005
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXT<<3];
int n,m,nm,ecnt,s=0,t,ans,head[MAXT],match[MAXT];
bool map[MAXT],statu[MAXT],visit[MAXT];
char temp[105];

inline void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    nm=n*m;
    t=nm+1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    memset(match,0,sizeof(match));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        statu[i]=i&1;
    for (int i=m+1; i<=nm; i++) {
        statu[i]=statu[i-m]^1;
    }
    return;
}
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}

int find(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
            visit[v]=1;
            if (match[v]==0 || find(match[v])) {
                match[v]=x;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int hungarian() {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=nm; i++) {
        if (statu[i] && map[i]) {
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
            ans+=find(i);
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
        init();
        for (int i=1,tag=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp+1);
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
                if (temp[j]=='*')
                    map[tag]=0;
                else
                    map[tag]=1;
            }
        }
        for (int i=1,tag=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
                if (!map[tag])
                    continue;
                if (i<n && map[tag+m]) {
                    add(tag,tag+m);
                }
                if (j<m && map[tag+1]) {
                    add(tag,tag+1);
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",hungarian());
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJGpTrBdinic.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXT 10010
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXT<<3];
int n,m,nm,ecnt,s=0,t,ans,head[MAXT],tag[MAXT];
bool map[MAXT],statu[MAXT],visit[MAXT];
char temp[105];

inline void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    nm=n*m;
    t=nm+1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        statu[i]=i&1;
    for (int i=m+1; i<=nm; i++) {
        statu[i]=statu[i-m]^1;
    }
    return;
}
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=statu[u];
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=statu[v];
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}
inline void addw(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=1;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=0;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}
inline bool bfs() {
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    bool flag=0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    tag[s]=0;
    visit[s]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[u],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && e[now].w) {
                q.push(v);
                visit[v]=1;
                tag[v]=tag[u]+1;
                if (v==t)
                    flag=1;
            }
        }
    }
    return flag;
}
bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x==t)
        return 1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v] && e[now].w && tag[v]>tag[x]) {
            int res=dfs(v);
            if (res>0) {
                e[now].w--;
                e[now^1].w++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int dinic() {
    ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        while (1) {
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
            if (!dfs(s))
                break;
            ans++;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF) {
        init();
        for (int i=1,tag=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp+1);
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
                if (temp[j]=='*')
                    map[tag]=0;
                else
                    map[tag]=1;
            }
        }
        for (int i=1,tag=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
                if (!map[tag])
                    continue;
                if (i<n && map[tag+m]) {
                    add(tag,tag+m);
                }
                if (j<m && map[tag+1]) {
                    add(tag,tag+1);
                }
                if (statu[tag])
                    addw(s,tag);
                else
                    addw(tag,t);
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",dinic());
    }
    return 0;
}

//CDOJGpTrJ.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 1000000009
using namespace std;

struct serv {
    int x,y,next;
} s[90005];

int n,m,p,head[90005],dis[90005];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&p);
    for (int i=1,tag=1,k; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++,tag++) {
            scanf("%d",&k);
            s[tag].x=i,s[tag].y=j,s[tag].next=head[k];
            head[k]=tag;
            dis[tag]=(k==1)?(i+j-2):INF;
        }
    for (int k=1; k<p; k++) {
        for (int now=head[k]; now; now=s[now].next) {
            int x=s[now].x,y=s[now].y,w;
            for (int to=head[k+1]; to; to=s[to].next) {
                w=dis[now]+abs(s[to].x-x)+abs(s[to].y-y);
                if (dis[to]>w)
                    dis[to]=w;
            }
        }
    }
    int ans=INF;
    for (int now=head[p]; now; now=s[now].next) {
        ans=min(ans,dis[now]);
    }
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//CDOJTrMath2016D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
long long n,k;
bool a,b;
bool check(long long x) {
    long long total=x*k-n,times=1;
    if (total<0)
        return 0;
    times+=(total/(n<<1))<<1;
    if (total%(n<<1))
        times+=2;
    if (times<=x)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld",&n,&k);
    a=n&1;
    b=k&1;
    if (a && (b^1)) {
        puts("-1");
        return 0;
    }
    if (a||b) {
        long long l=1,r=n,mid;
        while (l<r) {
            mid=(l+r)>>1;
            if (check((mid<<1)-a))
                r=mid;
            else
                l=mid+1;
        }
        printf("%lld\n",(l<<1)-a);
    } else {
        long long l=1,r=n,mid;
        while (l<r) {
            mid=(l+r)>>1;
            if (check(mid))
                r=mid;
            else
                l=mid+1;
        }
        printf("%lld\n",l);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

long long C(int m,int n) {
    long long ans=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans=ans*(m-n+i)/i;
    }
    return ans;
}

//CDOJTrMathG.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct point {
    double v[105];
} p[105];

int n;
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=j; k++) {
                p[i].v[k]+=p[j].v[k];
            }
        }
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++)
            p[i].v[j]/=(double)i;
        double dis=0;
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
            dis+=p[i].v[j]*p[i].v[j];
        }
        p[i].v[i]=sqrt(1.0-dis);
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            printf("%.10lf ",p[i].v[j]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF1015B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
char s[MAXN];
long long money=0,fuck=0;

void check(int st,int ed) {
    int len=ed-st+1;
    if (len<3) {
        long long ff=0;
        for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
            if (s[i]!='.') ff=ff*10+s[i]-'0';
        }
        money+=ff;
    } else if (s[ed-2]=='.') {
        fuck+=(s[ed-1]-'0')*10+s[ed]-'0';
        if (fuck>=100) {
            money+=fuck/100;
            fuck%=100;
        }
        check(st,ed-2);
    } else {
        long long ff=0;
        for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
            if (s[i]!='.') ff=ff*10+s[i]-'0';
        }
        money+=ff;
    }
}

char sta[200];
int top=0,len;

int main() {
    scanf("%s",s+1);
    len=(int)strlen(s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
        if (s[i]=='.'||(s[i]>='0'&&s[i]<='9')) {
            int j;
            for (j=i+1; j<=len; j++) {
                if (s[j]=='.'||(s[j]>='0'&&s[j]<='9')) continue;
                else break;
            }
            j--;
            check(i,j);
            i=j;
        }
    }
    if (fuck) {
        sta[++top]=fuck%10+'0';
        sta[++top]=fuck/10+'0';
        sta[++top]='.';
        if (!money) sta[++top]='0';
    }
    int cnt=0;
    while (money) {
        sta[++top]=money%10+'0';
        money/=10;
        cnt++;
        if (cnt==3) {
            cnt=0;
            if (money) {
                sta[++top]='.';
            }
        }
    }
    while (top) {
        putchar(sta[top--]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF1015D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200050

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<4];
const int source=0,sink=1;
int n;
int ecnt=1,head[MAXN];
int lab[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
char temp[100];

inline void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int check(int st,int ed) {
    if (temp[st]=='S') return 0;
    if (temp[st]=='M') return 1;
    if (temp[st]=='L') return 2;
    if (ed-st==1) return 3;
    if (ed-st==2) return 4;
    return 5;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=2,v; i<=7; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&v);
        add(i,1,v);
    }
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
        add(0,k+7,1);
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        int len=strlen(temp+1);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            int j;
            for (j=i+1; j<=len; j++) {
                if (temp[j]==',') break;
            }
            j--;
            add(k+7,2+check(i,j),1);
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(lab,0,sizeof(lab));
    q.push(0);
    lab[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !lab[e[now].to]) {
                lab[e[now].to]=lab[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    if (lab[1]) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && lab[e[now].to]>lab[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                return ret;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void rev(int x) {
    switch (x) {
    case 2:
        puts("S");
        break;
    case 3:
        puts("M");
        break;
    case 4:
        puts("L");
        break;
    case 5:
        puts("XL");
        break;
    case 6:
        puts("XXL");
        break;
    case 7:
        puts("XXXL");
        break;
    }
}

void print() {
    puts("YES");
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int now=head[i+7]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to>1 && e[now].to<8 && !e[now].flow && e[now^1].flow==1) {
                rev(e[now].to);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        int ret=dfs(0,MAXN);
        memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        while (ret) {
            ans+=ret;
            ret=dfs(0,MAXN);
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        }
    }
    if (ans==n) {
        print();

//cf17E.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100019
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int next, v;
    char x;
} node[MAXN];

int ncnt = 0;

struct Map {
    int head;
    int &operator [] (char x) {
        for (int now = head; now; now = node[now].next) {
            if (node[now].x == x) return node[now].v;
        }
        node[++ncnt] = (Node) {
            head, 0, x
        };
        head = ncnt;
        return node[ncnt].v;
    }
    void clear() {
        head = 0;
    }
};

struct PT {
    Map nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], num[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int last, n, p;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        cnt[p] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        num[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    inline void init() {
        p = last = n = ncnt = 0;
        newNode(0);
        newNode(-1);
        S[0] = 255;
        fail[0] = 1;
    }
    inline int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    inline LL add(char c) {
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
            num[now] = num[fail[now]] + 1;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        return num[last];
    }
} T;

int n;
LL P1[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

int main() {
    while (scanf("%s", s + 1) != EOF) {
        n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        ans = 0;
        T.init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P1[i] = T.add(s[i]) + P1[i - 1];
        T.init();
        for (int i = n; i > 1; i--) ans += T.add(s[i]) * P1[i - 1];
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

#define MAXN 100005

int n;
char s[MAXN];
int d[MAXN],visit[MAXN];

inline bool jump() {
    int now=1;
    visit[1]=1;
    while (1) {
        if (d[now]>n || d[now]<1) return 0;
        if (visit[d[now]]) return 1;
        now=d[now];
        visit[now]=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    scanf("%s",s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>d[i];
        if (s[i]=='<') d[i]=-d[i];
        d[i]+=i;
    }
    if (jump()) puts("INFINITE");
    else puts("FINITE");

    return 0;
}

//CF348E.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072

struct data {
    int a,t,x,pos;
    bool operator < (data b) const {
        if (x!=b.x) return x<b.x;
        else return pos<b.pos;
    }
} q[MAXN];

bool byTime(data a,data b) {
    return a.t<b.t;
}

int n,tot=0,ans[MAXN],t[s<<1];

inline void update(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]=0;
}

inline int query(int x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int l=s,r=x+s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline void work(int st,int ed) {
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (q[i].a==1) {
            update(q[i].t,1);
        } else if (q[i].a==2) {
            update(q[i].t,-1);
        } else {
            ans[q[i].pos]=query(q[i].t);
        }
    }
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (q[i].a!=3) del(q[i].t);
    }
}

int main() {
    memset(ans,-1,sizeof(ans));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&q[i].a,&q[i].t,&q[i].x);
        q[i].pos=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+n+1,byTime);
    for (int i=1,now=-1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (q[i].t!=now) {
            now=q[i].t;
            q[i].t=++tot;
        } else q[i].t=tot;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int now=q[i].x,j=i;
        for (; j<n && q[j+1].x==now; j++);
        work(i,j);
        i=j;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (ans[i]!=-1) printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF359B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

bool visit[7];
long long seven[15]= {1,7,49,343,2401,16807,117649,823543,5764801,40353607,282475249,1977326743};
int n,m,ans=0;

void dfs(long long now,int depth,bool tar,long long top) {
    if (seven[depth]>top) {
        if (tar) {
            ans++;
        } else
            dfs(0,0,1,n);
        return;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<7; i++) {
        if (!visit[i] && i*seven[depth]+now<=top) {
            visit[i]=1;
            dfs(i*seven[depth]+now,depth+1,tar,top);
            visit[i]=0;
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    n--,m--;
    if (m==0 && n==0) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    if (m==0 || n==0) {
        visit[0]=1;
    }
    dfs(0,0,0,m);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    int x,y;
} c[20];

int n;

    scanf("%d",&n);
    scanf("%s",temp);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        temp[i]-=48;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        c[i].x=x[temp[i]]-x[temp[i-1]];
        c[i].y=y[temp[i]]-y[temp[i-1]];
    }
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {
        if (i==temp[0])
            continue;
        bool flag=1;
        for (int j=1,nowx=x[i],nowy=y[i],can=0; j<n; j++) {
            nowx+=c[j].x;
            nowy+=c[j].y;
            can=0;
            for (int k=0; k<10; k++) {
                if (x[k]==nowx && y[k]==nowy)
                    can=1;
            }
            if (!can) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) {
            puts("NO");
            return 0;
        }
    }
    puts("YES");

//CF361B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n;
int x[200005],dis[200005];

bool visit[200005];
queue<int> q;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",x+i);
    }
    dis[1]=0;
    visit[1]=1;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        if ((now-1) && !visit[now-1]) {
            dis[now-1]=dis[now]+1;
            visit[now-1]=1;
            q.push(now-1);
        }

        if (now!=n && !visit[now+1]) {
            dis[now+1]=dis[now]+1;
            visit[now+1]=1;
            q.push(now+1);
        }

        if (!visit[x[now]]) {
            dis[x[now]]=dis[now]+1;
            visit[x[now]]=1;
            q.push(x[now]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",dis[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF361C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long seq[1000005],m,ans=-1;
int seqcnt=0;

inline long long check(long long x) {
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=1000000; i++) {
        if (seq[i]<=x)
            ans+=x/seq[i];
        else {
            return ans;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>m;
    for (long long i=2; i<=1000000; i++) {
        seq[i]=i*i*i;
    }
    long long l=0,r=1000000000000000,mid,res;
    while (l<r-1) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        res=check(mid);
        if (res>=m) {
            r=mid;
        } else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    ans=-1;
    for (int i=-10; i<=10; i++) {
        if (l+i>=0 && check(l+i)==m) {
            ans=l+i;
            break;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans;
    return 0;
}

        d[len++]=ch;

}

    int head=1;
    while (head<len && d[head]=='0')
        head++;
    if (d[0]=='0') {
        if (head>=len)
            puts("0");
        else {
            while (d[len-1]=='0') {
                d[len--]=0;
            }
            printf("0.%s",d+1);
        }
    } else {
        if (head>=len) {
            putchar(d[0]);
            for (int i=1; i<=b; i++) {

            }
        } else {
            while (d[len-1]=='0') {
                d[len--]=0;
            }
            if (len<=b+1) {
                printf("%s",d);

                    putchar('0');
            } else {
                for (int i=0; i<=b; i++)
                    putchar(d[i]);
                putchar('.');
                for (int i=b+1; i<len; i++)

//CF362C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <set>
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    long long u,v,w;
    edge() {}
    edge(long long _u,long long _v,long long _w):u(_u),v(_v),w(_w) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        if (u!=a.u)
            return u<a.u;
        return v<a.v;
    }
    bool operator == (edge a) const {
        return a.u==u && a.v==v;
    }
};

set<edge> s;
set<edge>::iterator it,temp;

inline int getdep(long long x) {
    int ans=0;
    while (x>0) {
        ans++;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

inline void refresh(long long u,long long v,long long w) {
    int depu=getdep(u),depv=getdep(v);
    if (depu<depv) {
        swap(u,v);
        swap(depu,depv);
    }
    temp=s.end();
    for (; depu>depv; depu--) {
        it=s.find(edge(u<<1,u,0));
        if (it==temp) {
            s.insert(edge(u<<1,u,w));
            temp=s.end();
        } else {

        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1; i<=q; i++) {
        long long q,u,v,w;
        scanf("%I64d%I64d%I64d",&q,&u,&v);
        if (q==1) {
            scanf("%I64d",&w);
            refresh(u,v,w);
        } else {
            printf("%I64d\n",query(u,v));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF362D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

int n,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],s[MAXN],ss[MAXN];
double ans[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void findsize(int x) {
    s[x]=0;
    ss[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        findsize(v);
        s[x]++;
        ss[x]+=s[v]+ss[v];
    }
    return;
}

void getans(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        ans[v]=(double)ans[x]+(s[x]+1+ss[x]-s[v]-ss[v])/2.0;
        getans(v);
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=2,u; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&u);
        add(u,i);
    }
    findsize(1);
    ans[1]=1.0;
    getans(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%.1f ",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

            }
        }
    }
    if (pcnt==0) {
        printf("YES\n1 1\n");
        return 0;
    }
    // on row
    int x,y=-1,flag=1;
    x=p[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (p[i].x!=x) {
            if (y!=-1 && p[i].y!=y) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            } else {
                y=p[i].y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (flag) {
        if (y==-1) y=1;
        printf("YES\n%d %d\n",x,y);
        return 0;
    }
    x=-1,y=p[1].y,flag=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=pcnt; i++) {

                x=p[i].x;
            }
        }
    }
    if (flag) {
        if (x==-1)
            x=1;
        printf("YES\n%d %d\n",x,y);
        return 0;
    }
    printf("NO\n");
    return 0;
}

//CF363F.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct point {
    long long x,y;
    point() {}
    point(long long _x,long long _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator + (point a) const {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x)
            return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
    bool operator == (point a) const {
        return x==a.x && y==a.y;
    }
    long long operator * (point a) const {
        return x*a.y-y*a.x;
    }
    long long operator ^ (point a) const {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
} s[15],p[1005],h,temp[1005];

int n,k,cnt=0;
inline bool cmp(point ra,point rb) {
    point a=ra-h,b=rb-h;
    if (a.x>=0 && b.x<0)
        return 1;
    if (a.x==0 && b.x==0) {
        if (a.y*b.y<0)
            return a.y>b.y;
        return abs(a.y)<abs(b.y);
    }
    long long dot=a*b;
    if (dot<0)
        return 1;
    if (dot>0)
        return 0;
    if (a.y*b.y<0)
        return a.y>b.y;
    return a.x*a.x+a.y*a.y>b.x*b.x+b.y*b.y;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&k,&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        scanf("%I64d%I64d",&s[i].x,&s[i].y);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%I64d%I64d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    int rn=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=k && rn; i++) {
        h=s[i];
        sort(p+1,p+rn+1,cmp);
        cnt=0;
        for (int j=2; j<=rn; j++) {
            point pa=p[j]-h,pb=p[j-1]-h;
            if (pa*pb==0 && (pa^pb)>=0) {
                temp[++cnt]=p[j];
            }
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt; j++) {
            p[j]=temp[j];
        }
        rn=cnt;
    }
    printf("%d\n",n-rn);
    return 0;
}

//CF364C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100005
using namespace std;

int n,cnt=0,ans=INF;
char r[100005];
int visit[128],map[100005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%s",&n,r+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (visit[r[i]])
            map[i]=visit[r[i]];
        else
            map[i]=visit[r[i]]=++cnt;
    }
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    int i=1,j=1,zcnt=0;
    while (j<=n) {
        while (j<=n && zcnt<cnt) {
            if (!visit[map[j]])
                zcnt++;
            visit[map[j++]]++;
        }
        if (zcnt<cnt)
            break;
        while (visit[map[i]]>1) {
            visit[map[i++]]--;
        }
        ans=min(ans,j-i);
        if (j<=n) {
            visit[map[j++]]++;
        }
    }
    while (visit[map[i]]>1)
        visit[map[i++]]--;
    ans=min(ans,j-i);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int n,l,v1,v2,k;
int m;
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&l,&v1,&v2,&k);
    if (n<=k) {
        double t=(double)l/v2;
        printf("%.10lf\n",t);
        return 0;
    }
    int m=(n/k)+((n%k)?1:0);
    double down=((double)2*v2*(m-1))/((double)v1+v2)+(double)v2/v1;
    double up=(double)v2/v1*l;
    double x=up/down;
    double t=x/v2+(l-x)/v1;
    printf("%.10lf",t);
    return 0;
}

//CF364E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 200005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,k,kk,ecnt=0,rec=MAXN,po,ans=0;
int ss[MAXN],head[MAXN];
bool tag[MAXN];

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    ss[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
        }
    }
    if (tag[x])
        ss[x]++;
    if (ss[x]>=k && ss[x]-k<rec) {
        rec=ss[x]-k;
        po=x;
    }
}

void findans(int x,int fa,int dep) {
    if (tag[x])
        ans+=dep;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa) {
            findans(v,x,dep+1);
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    kk=k<<1;
    for (int i=1,p; i<=kk; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&p);
        tag[p]=1;
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    dfs(1,-1);
    findans(po,-1,0);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//CF365B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

bool cap[MAXN];
int n,k,s[MAXN];
long long c[MAXN];
long long ans=0,sum=0;
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    cin>>n>>k;
    c[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>c[i];
        ans+=c[i]*c[i-1];
        sum+=c[i];
    }
    ans+=c[1]*c[n];
    c[0]=c[n];
    c[n+1]=c[1];
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        cin>>s[i];
        cap[s[i]]=1;
        ans+=c[s[i]]*(sum-c[s[i]]-c[s[i]-1]-c[s[i]+1]);
    }
    sum=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        ans-=sum*c[s[i]];
        sum+=c[s[i]];
    }
    if (cap[n]) cap[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (cap[i] && cap[i-1]) ans+=c[i]*c[i-1];
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    cout.tie(0);

        if (p[i].y<minh) {

            tag=i;
        }
        p[i+n]=p[i];
    }
    bool flag=1;
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        if (p[i].x*u<p[i].y*v) {
            flag=0;

        }
    }
    if (flag) {
        printf("%.10f\n",(double)w/u);

    }
    double now=max((double)p[tag].y/u,(double)p[tag].x/v);
    for (int i=tag+1;; i++) {

            now+=(w-p[i-1].y)/u;
            break;

//CF365D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#define MAXN 1000005
#define s 1048576
using namespace std;

struct query {
    int l,r,num;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} q[MAXN<<1];

struct pos {
    int val,num;
    bool operator < (pos a) const {
        if (val!=a.val) return val<a.val;
        return num<a.num;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n,m;
int a[MAXN]= {0},last[MAXN],sum[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
int t[s<<1];

inline void insert(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x>0; x>>=1) t[x]^=v;
}

inline int qr(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans^=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans^=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]^a[i];
        p[i].num=i;
        p[i].val=a[i];
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (p[i].val==p[i-1].val)
            last[p[i].num]=p[i-1].num;
    }
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&q[i].l,&q[i].r);
        q[i].num=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int now=1;
    for (int x=1; x<=n; x++) {
        if (last[x]) insert(last[x],a[x]);
        insert(x,a[x]);
        while (now<=m && q[now].r==x) {
            ans[q[now].num]=qr(q[now].l,x)^sum[x]^sum[q[now].l-1];
            now++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF366A.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int n;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    bool now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        if (i>1) putchar(' ');
        if (now) printf("I love that");
        else printf("I hate that");
        now^=1;
    }
    if (n==1) printf("I hate it\n");
    else {
        if (n&1) printf(" I hate it\n");
        else printf(" I love it\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF366C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#define INF 12345678
#define MAXN 300005
using namespace std;

int cnt[MAXN],clr[MAXN];
int tag[MAXN],stack[MAXN],nxt[MAXN],pre[MAXN],top=0;
int n,q,ans=0,last=0;
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&q);
    for (int i=1,op,x; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&op,&x);
        if (op==1) {
            nxt[last]=++top;
            pre[top]=last;
            nxt[top]=INF;
            last=top;
            stack[top]=x;
            tag[top]=i;
            cnt[x]++;
            ans++;
        } else if (op==2) {
            ans-=cnt[x];
            cnt[x]=0;
            clr[x]=i;
        } else if (op==3) {
            int now=nxt[0];
            while (now<=x) {
                if (tag[now]>clr[stack[now]]) {
                    cnt[stack[now]]--;
                    ans--;
                    tag[now]=-1;
                    nxt[pre[now]]=nxt[now];
                    if (nxt[now]<INF) pre[nxt[now]]=pre[now];
                    else last=pre[now];
                } else {
                    nxt[pre[now]]=nxt[now];
                    if (nxt[now]<INF) pre[nxt[now]]=pre[now];
                    else last=pre[now];
                }
                now=nxt[now];
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF367A.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

/* Configuration */
#define MAXN
#define MAXM
#define MOD
#define INF

//#define USING_CPPIO
#ifdef USING_CPPIO
ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
cin.tie(0);
cout.tie(0);
#endif

//#define DEBUG

int a,b,n;
double ans=1e15;
int main() {
    readf(a);
    readf(b);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x,y,v;
        readf(x);
        readf(y);
        read(v);
        ans=min(sqrt((x-a)*(x-a)+(y-b)*(y-b))/(double)v,ans);
    }
    printf("%.9lf\n",ans);

#ifdef DEBUG
    fprintf(stderr,"\n--- Returned 0, Time = %.6f s ---\n",(double)clock()/CLOCKS_PER_SEC);
#endif
    return 0;
}

int n,m;

inline int find(int q) {
    int l=0,r=n,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        if (x[mid=(l+r+1)>>1]<=q)
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

        read(q);
        printf("%d\n",find(q));
    }

//CF367C.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>

/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {

    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {

    }

inline void readd(double &a) {

/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM
#define MOD
#define INF 12345678901234567ll

int n;
int c[MAXN],len[2];
long long dp[2][2];
char s[2][MAXN],r[2][MAXN];

inline void rev(int now) {
    for (int i=0,to=len[now]-1; to>-1; to--,i++) {
        r[now][to]=s[now][i];
    }
}

inline bool ok(int now,bool x,bool y) {
    int prev=now^1,minlen=min(len[0],len[1]);
    if (x && y) {
        for (int i=0; i<minlen; i++) {
            if (r[now][i]!=r[prev][i]) {
                return r[now][i]>r[prev][i];
            }
        }
        return len[now]>=len[prev];
    }
    if (x && !y) {
        for (int i=0; i<minlen; i++) {
            if (r[now][i]!=s[prev][i]) {
                return r[now][i]>s[prev][i];
            }
        }
        return len[now]>=len[prev];
    }
    if (!x && y) {
        for (int i=0; i<minlen; i++) {
            if (s[now][i]!=r[prev][i]) {
                return s[now][i]>r[prev][i];
            }
        }
        return len[now]>=len[prev];
    }
    //--
    for (int i=0; i<minlen; i++) {
        if (s[now][i]!=s[prev][i]) {
            return s[now][i]>s[prev][i];
        }
    }
    return len[now]>=len[prev];
}

//#define USING_CPPIO
#ifdef USING_CPPIO
ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
cin.tie(0);
cout.tie(0);
#endif

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
    }
    int now=1,prev=0;
    dp[0][0]=dp[0][1]=len[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        dp[now][0]=dp[now][1]=INF;
        scanf("%s",s[now]);
        len[now]=strlen(s[now]);
        rev(now);
        if (ok(now,0,0)) {
            dp[now][0]=dp[prev][0];
        }
        if (ok(now,0,1)) {
            dp[now][0]=min(dp[now][0],dp[prev][1]);
        }
        if (ok(now,1,0)) {
            dp[now][1]=dp[prev][0]+c[i];
        }
        if (ok(now,1,1)) {
            dp[now][1]=min(dp[now][1],dp[prev][1]+c[i]);
        }
        now^=1,prev^=1;
    }
    if (dp[prev][0]<INF || dp[prev][1]<INF) {
        cout<<min(dp[prev][0],dp[prev][1])<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    puts("-1");
#ifdef DEBUG
    fprintf(stderr,"\n--- Returned 0, Time = %.6f s ---\n",(double)clock()/CLOCKS_PER_SEC);
#endif
    return 0;
}

//CF370B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int n;
int bot=1000000001,top=-1;
int a[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        top=max(top,a[i]);
        bot=min(bot,a[i]);
    }
    int x=(top-bot),flag=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (a[i]!=top && a[i]+x!=top) {
            flag=0;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (flag) puts("YES");
    else {
        x>>=1;
        int avr=bot+x;
        flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (abs(a[i]-avr)!=x && a[i]!=avr) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) puts("YES");
        else puts("NO");
    }

    return 0;
}

//CF370C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int trie[3000005][2],sum[3000005],cnt=0;

int t;
char temp[5],num[25];

inline void update(int v) {
    int now=0,len=(int)strlen(num),to;
    sum[0]+=v;
    for (int i=len-1,j=1; j<=20; i--,j++) {
        if (i>=0) to=(num[i]-'0')&1;
        else to=0;
        if (!trie[now][to]) {
            trie[now][to]=++cnt;
        }
        now=trie[now][to];
        sum[now]+=v;
    }
}

inline int query() {
    int now=0,len=(int)strlen(num),ans=0,to,dif;
    for (int i=len-1,j=1; j<=20; i--,j++) {
        if (i>=0) to=num[i]-'0';
        else to=0;
        dif=to^1;
        if (trie[now][dif]) ans+=sum[trie[now][dif]];
        if (!trie[now][to]) break;
        now=trie[now][to];
    }
    return sum[0]-ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&t);
    for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
        scanf("%s %s",temp,num);
        if (temp[0]=='+') {
            update(1);
        } else if (temp[0]=='-') {
            update(-1);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n",query());
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//CF370D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int n;

inline int query(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2) {
    printf("? %d %d %d %d\n",x1,y1,x2,y2);
    fflush(stdout);
    int ret;
    scanf("%d",&ret);
    return ret;
}

inline int checkRow() {
    int l=1,r=n,mid,left,right;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        left=query(1,1,mid,n);
        right=query(mid+1,1,n,n);
        if (left==right) {
            if (left==0) return 0;
            else return mid;
        } else {
            if (left) r=mid-1;
            else l=mid+1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int checkCol() {
    int l=1,r=n,mid,left,right;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        left=query(1,1,n,mid);
        right=query(1,mid+1,n,n);
        if (left==right) {
            if (left==0) return 0;
            else return mid;
        } else {
            if (left) r=mid-1;
            else l=mid+1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

struct rect {
    int llim,tlim,rlim,blim;
    rect() {}
    rect(int a,int b,int c,int d):llim(a),tlim(b),rlim(c),blim(d) {}
} ans[2];

rect check1(int LEFT,int RIGHT) {
    int tlim,blim,llim,rlim;
    int l=LEFT,r=RIGHT,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (query(1,1,mid,n)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    rlim=l;
    l=1,r=rlim;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (query(mid,1,rlim,n)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    llim=l;
    l=1,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (query(llim,mid,rlim,n)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    tlim=l;
    l=1,r=tlim;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (query(llim,tlim,rlim,mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    blim=l;
    return rect(llim,tlim,rlim,blim);
}

rect check2(int LEFT,int RIGHT) {
    int tlim,blim,llim,rlim;
    int l=LEFT,r=RIGHT,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (query(1,1,n,mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    blim=l;
    l=1,r=blim;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (query(1,mid,n,blim)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    tlim=l;
    l=1,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (query(mid,tlim,n,blim)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    llim=l;
    l=llim,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (query(llim,tlim,mid,blim)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    rlim=l;
    return rect(llim,tlim,rlim,blim);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int ret=checkRow();
    if (ret) {
        ans[0]=check1(1,ret);
        ans[1]=check1(ret+1,n);
    } else {
        ret=checkCol();
        ans[0]=check2(1,ret);
        ans[1]=check2(ret+1,n);
    }
    printf("! %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",ans[0].llim,ans[0].tlim,ans[0].rlim,ans[0].blim,ans[1].llim,ans[1].tlim,ans[1].rlim,ans[1].blim);
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}

//CF372B.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 50005

char s[MAXN];

int n;
int visit[256],tot=0;

bool work() {
    scanf("%s",s+1);
    n=strlen(s+1);
    if (n<26) {
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=26; i++) {
        if (s[i]=='?' || !visit[s[i]]) {
            tot++;
        }
        if (s[i]!='?') visit[s[i]]++;
    }
    if (tot==26) {
        for (char x='A'; x<='Z'; x++) {
            if (!visit[x]) {
                for (int i=1; i<=26; i++) {
                    if (s[i]=='?') {
                        s[i]=x;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return 1;
    }
    for (int i=27; i<=n; i++) {
        if (s[i-26]=='?' || visit[s[i-26]]==1) tot--;
        if (s[i-26]!='?') visit[s[i-26]]--;
        if (s[i]=='?' || !visit[s[i]]) tot++;
        if (s[i]!='?') visit[s[i]]++;
        if (tot==26) {
            for (char x='A'; x<='Z'; x++) {
                if (!visit[x]) {
                    for (int k=i-25; k<=i; k++) {
                        if (s[k]=='?') {
                            s[k]=x;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {

    if (work()) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (s[i]=='?') s[i]='A';
        puts(s+1);
    } else {
        puts("-1");
    }

    return 0;
}

//CF372D.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 100005

typedef long long LL;

const LL INF=12345678901234ll;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,s,t,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];
LL l,dis[MAXN];
int rec[MAXM],cnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v,LL w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;

bool inq[MAXN];
LL spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[s]=0;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[t];
}

void print() {
    puts("YES");
    for (int x=0; x<n; x++) {
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to>x) {
                cout<<x<<" "<<e[now].to<<" "<<e[now].w<<endl;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>m>>l>>s>>t;
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        cin>>u>>v>>w;
        add(u,v,w);
        if (w==0) {
            e[ecnt].w=e[ecnt^1].w=INF;
            rec[++cnt]=ecnt;
        }
    }
    LL dis1=spfa();
    if (dis1<l) {
        puts("NO");
        return 0;
    } else if (dis1==l) {
        print();
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        e[rec[i]].w=e[rec[i]^1].w=1;
    }
    LL dis2=spfa();
    if (dis2>l) {
        puts("NO");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; dis2!=l && i<=cnt; i++) {
        e[rec[i]].w=e[rec[i]^1].w=e[rec[i]].w+l-dis2;
        dis2=spfa();
    }
    print();
    return 0;
}
