//CF375B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 300

int n;
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%s",&n,s+1);
    bool ink=0;
    bool aword=0;
    int len=0,maxlen=0,cnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if ((s[i]>='a' && s[i]<='z') || (s[i]>='A' && s[i]<='Z')) {
            if (aword) {
                len++;
            } else {
                aword=1;
                len=1;
            }
        } else {
            if (aword) {
                if (ink) {
                    cnt++;
                } else {
                    if (len>maxlen) {
                        maxlen=len;
                    }
                }
                aword=0;
                len=0;
            }
            if (s[i]=='(') {
                ink=1;
            } else if (s[i]==')') {
                ink=0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (aword) {
        if (len>maxlen) {
            maxlen=len;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",maxlen,cnt);
    return 0;
}

//CF375C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 2005

int n,m;
int a[MAXN],seq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",seq+i);
        if (seq[i]>m || seq[i]<1) {
            q.push(i);
        } else a[seq[i]]++;
    }
    int tot=n/m;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (a[i]>tot) {
            for (int j=tot+1,now=1; j<=a[i]; j++) {
                while (seq[now]!=i) now++;
                q.push(now);
            }
        }
    }
    int changes=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (a[i]<tot) {
            for (int j=a[i]+1; j<=tot; j++) {
                seq[q.front()]=i;
                q.pop();
                changes++;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",tot,changes);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",seq[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF375D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 55

struct lake {
    int x,y,size;
    lake() {}
    lake(int a,int b,int c):x(a),y(b),size(c) {}
    bool operator < (lake a) const {
        return size<a.size;
    }
} a[MAXN*MAXN];

int n,m,k,cnt=0;
int G[MAXN][MAXN],visit[MAXN][MAXN];
char temp[MAXN];

struct statu {
    int x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int q,int w):x(q),y(w) {}
};

int dx[4]= {1,0,-1,0},dy[4]= {0,-1,0,1};

inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<=n && y>0 && y<=m;
}

queue <statu> q;

inline int bfs(int sx,int sy) {
    int ans=0;
    q.push(statu(sx,sy));
    visit[sx][sy]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().x,y=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        ans++;
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (inrange(tox,toy) && !G[tox][toy] && !visit[tox][toy]) {
                visit[tox][toy]=1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

inline void fillG(lake L) {
    q.push(statu(L.x,L.y));
    G[L.x][L.y]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().x,y=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (inrange(tox,toy) && !G[tox][toy]) {
                G[tox][toy]=1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }

}

inline void fuckEdge() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!G[i][1] && !visit[i][1]) {
            bfs(i,1);
        }
        if (!G[i][m] && !visit[i][m]) {
            bfs(i,m);
        }
    }
    for (int i=2; i<m; i++) {
        if (!G[1][i] && !visit[1][i]) {
            bfs(1,i);
        }
        if (!G[n][i] && !visit[n][i]) {
            bfs(n,i);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (temp[j]=='*')
                G[i][j]=1;
            else
                G[i][j]=0;
        }
    }
    fuckEdge();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (!G[i][j] && !visit[i][j]) {
                a[++cnt]=lake(i,j,bfs(i,j));
            }
        }
    sort(a+1,a+cnt+1);
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1,ta=cnt-k; i<=ta; i++) {
        fillG(a[i]);
        tot+=a[i].size;
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++,putchar('\n'))
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) {
                putchar('*');
            } else {
                putchar('.');
            }
        }
    return 0;
}

//CF375E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

struct node {
    int x,d;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):x(a),d(b) {}
    bool operator < (node a) const {
        return d<a.d;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int T,n,m,ecnt,head[MAXN],dg[MAXN],in[MAXN],out[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=0;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i].x=i;
        a[i].d=0;
        dg[i]=in[i]=out[i]=0;
    }
}
#define INF 12345678

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(u,v);
            a[u].d++,a[v].d++;
            dg[u]++;
            dg[v]++;
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (dg[i]&1) {
                dg[i]=INF,a[i].d=INF;
            } else {
                dg[i]>>=1;
            }
        }
        sort(a+1,a+n+1);
        int cnt=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (a[i].d==INF) break;
            int x=a[i].x;
            if (in[x]>dg[x] || out[x]>dg[x]) continue;
            for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                if (!e[now].w) {
                    int v=e[now].to;
                    int inx=dg[x]-in[x],outx=dg[x]-out[x];
                    int inv=dg[v]-in[v],outv=dg[v]-out[v];
                    if (inx>=outx && (outv>=inv || outv>1234567)) {
                        e[now].w=1,e[now^1].w=-1;
                        in[x]++,out[v]++;
                    } else if (outx>=inx && (inv>=outv || inv>1234567)) {
                        e[now].w=-1,e[now^1].w=1;
                        out[x]++,in[v]++;
                    } else if (inx>outx) {
                        e[now].w=1,e[now^1].w=-1;
                        in[x]++,out[v]++;
                    } else {
                        e[now].w=-1,e[now^1].w=1;
                        out[x]++,in[v]++;
                    }
                }
            }
            cnt++;
        }
        printf("%d\n",cnt);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int now=head[i]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                if (e[now].w==-1) {
                    printf("%d %d\n",i,e[now].to);
                } else if (!e[now].w) {
                    e[now].w=-1,e[now^1].w=1;
                    printf("%d %d\n",i,e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF375F.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 200005
#define MAXM 400005

struct edge {
    int u,v;
} e[MAXM],choose[MAXM];

int n,m,s,t,ds,dt,cnt=0;
int f[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[i]=i;
    }
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline bool merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        f[fa]=fb;
        return 1;
    } else return 0;
}

int sto[MAXN],tto[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&e[i].u,&e[i].v);
    }
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&s,&t,&ds,&dt);
    init();
    int dds=0,ddt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (e[i].u!=s && e[i].v!=s && e[i].u!=t && e[i].v!=t) {
            if (merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
                choose[++cnt]=e[i];
            }
        } else {
            if (e[i].v==s || e[i].u==t) swap(e[i].u,e[i].v);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (e[i].u==s && e[i].v!=t) {
            sto[getf(e[i].v)]=1;
        } else if (e[i].u!=s && e[i].v==t) {
            tto[getf(e[i].u)]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m && dds<ds; i++) {
        if (e[i].u==s && e[i].v!=t && !tto[getf(e[i].v)] && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
            choose[++cnt]=e[i];
            dds++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m && ddt<dt; i++) {
        if (e[i].u!=s && e[i].v==t && !sto[getf(e[i].u)] && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
            choose[++cnt]=e[i];
            ddt++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m && dds<ds; i++) {
        if (e[i].u==s && e[i].v!=t && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
            choose[++cnt]=e[i];
            dds++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m && ddt<dt; i++) {
        if (e[i].u!=s && e[i].v==t && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
            choose[++cnt]=e[i];
            ddt++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m && dds<ds && ddt<dt; i++) {
        if (e[i].u==s && e[i].v==t) {
            if (merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) {
                choose[++cnt]=e[i];
                dds++,ddt++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (cnt!=n-1) {
        puts("No");
    } else {
        puts("Yes");
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            printf("%d %d\n",choose[i].u,choose[i].v);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//cf663A.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n;
int pos=1,neg=0;
int rec[105];
int main() {
    char r=getchar();
    while (r!='=') {
        if (r=='+') {
            pos++;
            rec[++rec[0]]=1;
        } else if (r=='-') {
            neg++;
            rec[++rec[0]]=-1;
        }
        r=getchar();
    }
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int atleast=pos-n*neg,atmost=n*pos-neg;
    if (atleast<=n && atmost>=n) {
        puts("Possible");
        int res=-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (i*pos >= neg+n) {
                res=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        int x=res*pos-neg-n;
        if (res-1>=x) {
            printf("%d ",res-x);
            for (int i=1; i<=rec[0]; i++) {
                if (rec[i]==1) {
                    printf("+ %d ",res);
                } else {
                    printf("- 1 ");
                }
            }
            printf("= %d",n);
        } else {
            printf("1 ");
            x-=res-1;
            for (int i=1; i<=rec[0]; i++) {
                if (rec[i]==1) {
                    if (res-1>=x) {
                        printf("+ %d ",res-x);
                        x=0;
                    } else if (x>0) {
                        printf("+ 1 ");
                        x-=res-1;
                    } else {
                        printf("+ %d ",res);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (n<=x) {
                        printf("- %d ",n);
                        x-=n-1;
                    } else if (x>0) {
                        printf("- %d ",x+1);
                        x=0;
                    } else {
                        printf("- 1 ");
                    }
                }
            }
            printf("= %d",n);
        }
    } else {
        puts("Impossible");
    }
    return 0;
}

//CF724B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int n,m;
int a[25][25];

inline bool check() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int rec=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]!=j) {
                if (a[i][a[i][j]]==j && (!rec || rec==j)) {
                    rec=a[i][j];
                    continue;
                } else return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>m;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            cin>>a[i][j];
        }
    }
    if (check()) {
        puts("YES");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=m; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
                swap(a[k][i],a[k][j]);
            }
            if (check()) {
                puts("YES");
                return 0;
            }
            for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
                swap(a[k][i],a[k][j]);
            }
        }
    puts("NO");
    return 0;
}

//CF724D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXM 100005

int m,len;
char s[MAXM];

struct data {
    int cnt[26];
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        for (int i=0; i<26; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]!=a.cnt[i]) return cnt[i]>a.cnt[i];
        }
        return 0;
    }
} now,ans;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%s",&m,s+1);
    len=strlen(s+1);
    for (int i=0; i<26; i++) now.cnt[i]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        now.cnt[s[i]-'a']++;
    }
    ans=now;
    for (int i=m+1; i<=len; i++) {
        now.cnt[s[i-m]-'a']--;
        now.cnt[s[i]-'a']++;
        if (now<ans) ans=now;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<26; i++) {
        while (ans.cnt[i]--) putchar('a'+i);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//CF732E.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005

int n,m;

struct something {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (something a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
} s[MAXN],c[MAXN];

bool uses[MAXN],usec[MAXN];
int anss[MAXN],ansc[MAXN],ans=0,cost=0;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&c[i].v);
        c[i].x=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&s[i].v);
        s[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(c+1,c+n+1);
    sort(s+1,s+m+1);
    int nowc=0,oldn=n,oldm=m;
    while (nowc<=32 && n>0 && m>0) {
        int i=1,j=1;
        while (i<=n && j<=m) {
            if (c[i].v<s[j].v) j++;
            else if (c[i].v>s[j].v) i++;
            else {
                usec[i]=1;
                uses[j]=1;
                ans++;
                cost+=nowc;
                ansc[c[i].x]=s[j].x;
                anss[s[j].x]=nowc;
                i++,j++;
            }
        }
        int newn=0;
        for (int q=1; q<=n; q++) {
            if (!usec[q]) {
                c[++newn]=c[q];
            } else usec[q]=0;
        }
        n=newn;
        int newm=0;
        for (int q=1; q<=m; q++) {
            if (!uses[q]) {
                s[++newm]=s[q];
                s[q].v=(s[q].v+1)>>1;
            } else uses[q]=0;
        }
        m=newm;
        nowc++;
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",ans,cost);
    for (int i=1; i<=oldm; i++) {
        printf("%d ",anss[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
    for (int i=1; i<=oldn; i++) {
        printf("%d ",ansc[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
    return 0;
}

//CFER13B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;
// 1999-12-31 is Friday

bool leap(int x) {
    if (x%4==0) {
        if (x%400==0)
            return 1;
        if (x%100==0)
            return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int y;

int getTime(int x) {
    int day=4;
    if (x>1999) {
        for (int i=2000; i<=x; i++) {
            day+=365;
            if (leap(i)) {
                day++;
            }
            day%=7;
        }
    } else {
        for (int i=1999; i>x; i--) {
            day+=6;
            if (leap(i))
                day+=6;
            day%=7;
        }
    }
    return day;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&y);
    int now=getTime(y),sav=now,isl=leap(y);
    while (y++) {
        now++;
        if (leap(y))
            now++;
        now%=7;
        if (now==sav && leap(y)==isl)
            break;
    }
    printf("%d",y);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

long long n,a,b,p,q,ans=0;

long long gcd(long long a,long long b) {
    if (b==0)
        return a;
    return gcd(b,a%b);
}

long long lcm(long long a,long long b) {
    return a*b/gcd(a,b);
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>a>>b>>p>>q;
    ans=(n/a)*p+(n/b)*q-min(p,q)*(n/lcm(a,b));
    cout<<ans;
    return 0;
}

//CFER13E.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#define MOD 1000000007
using namespace std;

long long n,k,b,x;

long long POW(long long a,long long k) {
    long long x=a,ans=1;
    while (k) {
        if (k&1)
            ans=(ans*x)%MOD;
        x=(x*x)%MOD;
        k>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
long long T(long long n) {
    if (n==0)
        return 0;
    if (n==1)
        return k;
    long long data=T(n/2);
    data=(data+data*POW(k,n/2))%MOD;
    if (n&1) data=(data+POW(k,n))%MOD;
    return data;
}

int main() {
    cin>>k>>b>>n>>x;
    if (n==0) cout<<x<<endl;
    else cout<<((POW(k,n)*x)%MOD + ((T(n-1)+1)*b)%MOD)%MOD<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//CFER13F.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int n;
double map[50][50];
int list[50];
double posi[50];
bool cmp(int a,int b) {
    return map[1][a]<=map[1][b];
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==1) {
        printf("1.000000000\n");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        list[i]=i;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            cin>>map[i][j];
        }
    }
    sort(list+2,list+n+1,cmp);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        double total=0.0;
        for (int j=2; j<i; j++) {
            posi[list[j]]*=map[list[j]][list[i]];
            total+=posi[list[j]];
        }
        posi[list[i]]=1.0-total;
    }
    posi[1]=0.0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        posi[1]+=posi[i]*map[1][i];
    }
    printf("%.10lf",posi[1]);
    return 0;
}

//CFR236B.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct tree {
    int num,h;
    bool operator < (tree a) const {
        return h<a.h;
    }
} t[1005];
int n,k,ans=-1,tag;
int a[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&t[i].h);
        t[i].h-=k*i;
        t[i].num=i+1;
    }
    sort(t,t+n);

    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        if (t[i].h<=0)
            continue;
        int now=t[i].h,cnt=1;
        while (t[i+1].h==now) {
            i++;
            cnt++;
        }
        if (cnt>ans) {
            ans=cnt;
            tag=now;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",n-ans);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        if (t[i].h!=tag) {
            if (t[i].h>tag) {
                printf("- %d %d\n",t[i].num,t[i].h-tag);
            } else {
                printf("+ %d %d\n",t[i].num,tag-t[i].h);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MOD 1000000007
using namespace std;
int n,m,K;
long long dp[2][1005][1005],f[2][1005][1005];
char a[1005],b[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&K);
    scanf("%s%s",a+1,b+1);
    a[0]=1;
    b[0]=0;
    dp[0][0][0]=dp[1][0][0]=1;
    int now=1,prev=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=K; k++) {
                if (a[i]==b[j])
                    f[now][j][k]=(dp[prev][j-1][k-1]+f[prev][j-1][k])%MOD;
                else
                    f[now][j][k]=0;
                dp[now][j][k]=(dp[prev][j][k]+f[now][j][k])%MOD;
            }
        }
        now=now^1;
        prev=prev^1;
    }
    printf("%lld",dp[prev][m][K]);
    return 0;
}

//CFR357C.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

priority_queue< int,vector<int>,greater<int> > q;

int n;
string op[2000005],opr;
int cnt=0,opnum[2000005];
bool num[2000005];
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    cin>>n;
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>opr;
        if (opr=="insert") {
            cin>>r;
            q.push(r);
            op[++cnt]="insert ";
            num[cnt]=1;
            opnum[cnt]=r;
        } else if (opr=="removeMin") {
            if (q.empty()) {
                q.push(1);
                op[++cnt]="insert 1";
                num[cnt]=0;
            }
            q.pop();
            op[++cnt]="removeMin";
            num[cnt]=0;
        } else {
            cin>>r;
            if (q.empty()) {
                q.push(r);
                op[++cnt]="insert ";
                num[cnt]=1;
                opnum[cnt]=r;
            }
            if (r!=q.top()) {
                if (r>q.top()) {
                    while (!q.empty() && q.top()<r) {
                        q.pop();
                        op[++cnt]="removeMin";
                        num[cnt]=0;
                    }
                }
                if (q.top()>r || q.empty()) {
                    q.push(r);
                    op[++cnt]="insert ";
                    num[cnt]=1;
                    opnum[cnt]=r;
                }
            }
            op[++cnt]="getMin ";
            num[cnt]=1;
            opnum[cnt]=r;
        }
    }
    cout<<cnt<<endl;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        cout<<op[i];
        if (num[i])
            cout<<opnum[i];
        cout<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

//CFR358D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int n,m,K,ans=0;
int dp[2][1005][1005],f[2][1005][1005];
char a[1005],b[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&K);
    scanf("%s%s",a+1,b+1);
    a[0]=1;
    b[0]=0;
    dp[0][0][0]=dp[1][0][0]=0;
    int now=1,prev=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=K; k++) {
                if (a[i]==b[j])
                    f[now][j][k]=max(dp[prev][j-1][k-1]+1,f[prev][j-1][k]+1);
                else
                    f[now][j][k]=0;
                dp[now][j][k]=max(max(dp[now][j-1][k],dp[prev][j][k]),f[now][j][k]);
            }
        }
        now=now^1;
        prev=prev^1;
    }
    printf("%d",dp[prev][m][K]);
    return 0;
}

//checker.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstring>
#include "testlib.h"

using namespace std;

const int maxn = 5010;
const int maxm = 1010;

int n,m;

int drawer_volume [maxm];

int item_volume [maxn];

int weight [maxn][maxm];

int solution [maxn];

int used [maxm];

int main(int argc,char *args[]) {
    if (argc<=2) {
        printf("Parameters not enought, please specify the input file and the output file.");
        return 0;
    }

    FILE *fin = fopen(args[1],"r");
    FILE *fout = fopen(args[2],"r");
    FILE *fans = fopen(args[3],"r");
    FILE *fscore = freopen(args[4],"r");
    FILE *fscore = fopen(args[5],"r");
    FILE *finf = fopen(args[6],"r");

    int score;
    fscanf(fscore, "%d", score);

    fscanf(fin,"%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        fscanf(fin,"%d",&item_volume[a]);
    for (int a=1; a<=m; a++)
        fscanf(fin,"%d",&drawer_volume[a]);
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        for (int b=1; b<=m; b++)
            fscanf(fin,"%d",&weight[a][b]);

    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        fscanf(fout,"%d",&solution[a]);

    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        if (solution[a] < 0 || solution[a] > m) {
            fprintf(fscore,"0\n");
            fprintf(finf,"The item with id %d is put into the wrong id box.\n",a);
            return 0;
        }

    int ans=0;
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++) {
        ans += weight[a][solution[a]];
        used[solution[a]] += item_volume[a];
    }

    for (int a=1; a<=m; a++)
        if (used[a] > drawer_volume[a]) {
            fprintf(fscore,"0\n");
            fprintf(finf,"You put too much item into box %d.\n",a);
            return 0;
        }

    fprintf(fscore,"%d\n",score);
    fprintf(finf,"Solution is acceptable, and the value you get is %d.\n",ans);

    return 0;

}

//checklist.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define N 2005
struct point {
    long long x,y;
} a[N],b[N];

long long n,m,f[N][N][2];

long long power(long long x) {
    return x*x;
}
long long dis(point x,point y) {
    return power(x.x-y.x)+power(x.y-y.y);
}

int main() {
    freopen("checklist.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("checklist.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>n>>m;
    memset(f,0x3f,sizeof(f));
    for (long long i=1; i<=n; i++)
        cin>>a[i].x>>a[i].y;
    for (long long i=1; i<=m; i++)
        cin>>b[i].x>>b[i].y;
    f[1][0][0]=0;
    for (long long i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (long long j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            f[i+1][j][0]=min(f[i+1][j][0],min(f[i][j][0]+dis(a[i],a[i+1]),f[i][j][1]+dis(b[j],a[i+1])));
            f[i][j+1][1]=min(f[i][j+1][1],min(f[i][j][0]+dis(a[i],b[j+1]),f[i][j][1]+dis(b[j],b[j+1])));
        }
    }
    cout<<f[n][m][0]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//circle.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 200319
inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct Cir {
    LL x, y, r;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(r);
        r *= r;
    }
    bool operator < (Cir a) const {
        return r > a.r;
    }
} a[MAXN];

#define dis(i, j) (power(a[i].x - a[j].x) + power(a[i].y - a[j].y))

int n;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int dep[MAXN];
LL tot[MAXN], ans = 0;

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        tot[x] += a[e[now].to].r;
        dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] ^ 1;
        dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    if (dep[x] & 1) ans += a[x].r - tot[x];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].re();
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    a[0] = (Cir) {
        0, 0, 123456789012345678ll
    };
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i - 1; ; j--) {
            if (dis(i, j) <= a[j].r) {
                add(j, i);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    dep[0] = 0;
    dfs(0);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//Բ��(ֱ��)�߶ε��ཻ
//num��ʾԲO(o, r)���߶�(s, e)�Ľ�����, res��洢���ǽ���
void Circle_cross_Segment(Point s, Point e, Point o, double r, Point res[], int &num) {
    double dx = e.x - s.x, dy = e.y - s.y;
    double A = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    double B = 2.0 * dx * (s.x - o.x) + 2.0 * dy * (s.y - o.y);
    double C = sqr(s.x - o.x) + sqr(s.y - o.y) - r * r;
    double delta = B * B - 4.0 * A * C;
    num = 0;
    if(sgn(delta) < 0) return ;
    delta = sqrt(max(0.0, delta));
    double k1 = (-B - delta) / (2.0 * A);
    double k2 = (-B + delta) / (2.0 * A);
    //if(sgn(k1 - 1.0) <= 0 && sgn(k1) >= 0) //Բ���߶��ཻ�����ж�
    res[num++] = Point(s.x + k1 * dx, s.y + k1 * dy);
    //if(sgn(k2 - 1.0) <= 0 && sgn(k2) >= 0)
    res[num++] = Point(s.x + k2 * dx, s.y + k2 * dy);
}

//������ABO��Բ(O, r)�������
double Triangel_cross_Circle(Point a, Point b, Point o, double r) {
    double r2 = r * r;
    a = a - o;
    b = b - o;
    o = Point(0.0, 0.0);
    bool bAInC = sgn((a * a) - r2) < 0;
    bool bBInC = sgn((b * b) - r2) < 0;
    double sg = 0.5 * sgn(a ^ b), res = 0.0;
    Point tmp[2];
    int num;
    if(bAInC && bBInC) res = abs(a ^ b);
    else if(bAInC || bBInC) {
        if(bBInC) swap(a, b);
        Circle_cross_Segment(a, b, 0, r, tmp, num);
        res = fabs(a ^ tmp[0]) + r2 * angle(tmp[0], b);
    } else {
        Circle_cross_Segment(a, b, o, r, tmp, num);
        res = r2 * angle(a, b);
        if(num == 2) {
            res -= r2 * angle(tmp[0], tmp[1]);
            res += fabs(tmp[0] ^ tmp[1]);
        }
    }
    return sg * res;
}

//�������Բ�������
double Polygon_intersect_Circle(Point ploy[], int n, Point O, double r) {
    ploy[n] = ploy[0];
    double res = 0.0;
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        res += Triangel_cross_Circle(ploy[i], ploy[i + 1], O, r);
    return fabs(res);
}

//CIRUT.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define pi 3.1415926535897932384626
typedef double D;
pair<D, int> arc[20005];
int cnt, arcount;
double s[1005];
D x[1005], y[1005], r[1005];

void add(D st, D ed) {
    if (st < -pi) {
        add(st + 2 * pi, pi);
        add(-pi, ed);
        return;
    }
    if (ed > pi) {
        add(st, pi);
        add(-pi, ed - 2 * pi);
    }
    arc[arcount++] = make_pair(st, 1);
    arc[arcount++] = make_pair(ed, -1);
}

D F(D xx) {
    return (xx - sin(xx)) / 2;
}

int n;
int del[2005];

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) scanf("%d%d%d", x + i, y + i, r + i);
    int nn = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool same = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < i && same; j++) {
            if (x[j] == x[i] && y[j] == y[i] && r[j] == r[i]) same = true;
        }
        if (!same) {
            x[nn] = x[i];
            y[nn] = y[i];
            r[nn] = r[i];
            nn++;
        }
    }
    n = nn;
    for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < nn; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            if (hypot(x[i] - x[i], y[i] - y[j]) < (D) r[i] - r[j]) del[j] = 1;
        }
    nn = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) {
        if (!del[i]) {
            x[nn] = x[i];
            y[nn] = y[i];
            r[nn] = r[i];
            nn++;
        }
    }
    n = nn;
}

int n;

char s[20],co[20];

int main() {
    freopen("citystate.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("citystate.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s%s",s,co);
        int ha1=(s[0]-'A')*26+s[1]-'A',ha2=(co[0]-'A')*26+co[1]-'A';
        na[i]=ha1,num[i]=ha2;
        cnt[ha1][ha2]++;
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (na[i]!=num[i]) ans+=cnt[num[i]][na[i]];
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans/2);
    return 0;
}

//cjj.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#define N ((1<<15)+10)
#define M (1<<n)
#define INF 9999999
using namespace std;

int n,X[20],Y[20];
int dp[N],cnt[N];

void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<(1<<15); i++) {
        int tmp=i;
        while (tmp) {
            if (tmp&1) ++cnt[i];
            tmp>>=1;
        }
    }
}

int cul(int x) {
    if (cnt[x]==1) {
        int p,S=INF;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (x&(1<<(i-1))) {
                p=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        //printf(" %d %d\n",x,p);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (i==p) continue;
            if (X[i]==X[p] && Y[i]==Y[p]) S=min(S,1);
            else if (X[i]==X[p]) S=min(S,abs(Y[i]-Y[p]));
            else if (Y[i]==Y[p]) S=min(S,abs(X[i]-X[p]));
            else S=min(S,abs(Y[i]-Y[p])*abs(X[i]-X[p]));
        }
        return S;
    }
    int xmin=INF,xmax=-INF,ymin=INF,ymax=-INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (x&(1<<(i-1))) {
            xmin=min(xmin,X[i]);
            xmax=max(xmax,X[i]);
            ymin=min(ymin,Y[i]);
            ymax=max(ymax,Y[i]);
        }
    }
    if (xmax==xmin && ymax==ymin) return 1;
    if (xmax==xmin) return ymax-ymin;
    if (ymax==ymin) return xmax-xmin;
    int S=(xmax-xmin)*(ymax-ymin);
    return S;
}

int solve(int x) {
    //printf("%d\n",x); getchar();
    if (dp[x]) return dp[x];
    if (cnt[x]<=2) return dp[x]=cul(x);
    int re=cul(x);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!(x&(1<<(i-1)))) continue;
        re=min(re,solve(x&(~(1<<(i-1))))+cul(1<<(i-1)));
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (!(x&(1<<(j-1)))) continue;
            int x1=min(X[i],X[j]),x2=max(X[i],X[j]),y1=min(Y[i],Y[j]),y2=max(Y[i],Y[j]);
            int tmp=(1<<(i-1))|(1<<(j-1));
            for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
                if (k==i || k==j || !(x&(1<<(k-1)))) continue;
                if (X[k]>=x1 && X[k]<=x2 && Y[k]>=y1 && Y[k]<=y2) {
                    tmp|=(1<<(k-1));
                }
            }
            re=min(re,solve(x&(~tmp))+cul(tmp));
        }
    }
    return dp[x]=re;
}

int main() {
    init();
    while (~scanf("%d",&n)) {
        if (!n) break;
        memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&X[i],&Y[i]);
        }
        printf("%d\n",solve(M-1));
        //for (int i=1;i<M;i++) printf("%d ",dp[i]); printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}

int tmp[506], ans = 0;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x - 1> ans) {
        ans = x - 1;
        printf("%d : \n", ans);
        for (int i = 1; i < x; i++) printf("%d ", tmp[i]);
        putchar('\n');
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < 128; i++) {
        if (!(i & tmp[x - 1])) {
            bool flag = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < x - 1; j++) if (!(i & tmp[j])) {
                    flag = 0;
                    break;
                }
            if (flag) tmp[x] = i, dfs(x + 1);
        }
    }
}

    }

#include <cstring>

//#include "rand.h"
#include <random>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define rand_int(st, ed) rd() % (ed - st + 1) + st

mt19937 rd(time(NULL));

int n;

long long ans = 0;

bool f[25];

void work() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = 1;
    int left = n;
    while (left) {
        ans++;
        int st = rand_int(1, n), ed = rand_int(1, n);
        if (st == ed) break;
        for (int i = st; i != ed; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1) {
            if (f[i]) f[i] = 0, left--;
        }
    }
}

void hh() {
    unsigned int cnt = 0;
    while (cnt <= 0xffffffff) {
        cnt++;
        work();
    }
    long double pr = ((long double)ans) / cnt;
    printf("%d : %.16Lf\n", n, pr);
}

int main() {
    freopen("re3.out", "w", stdout);
    for (n = 6; n <= 20; n += 4) {
        ans = 0;
        hh();
    }
    return 0;
}

//codevs1380.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[6010];

int n,ecnt=0;
int w[6005],head[6005];
int dp[6005][2];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        dfs(v);
        dp[x][0]+=max(dp[v][0],dp[v][1]);
        dp[x][1]+=dp[v][0];
    }
    dp[x][1]+=w[x];
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",w+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    w[0]=0;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",max(dp[1][0],dp[1][1]));
    return 0;
}

//commander.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readMap(int &a) {
    while (_c != '*' && _c != 'o' && _c != '#') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 54321

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 17];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m;
int G[105][105], row[105][105], col[105][105], node = 1, S = 0, T = 1;

void build() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int now = ++node;
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                row[i][j] = now;
                flag = 1;
            } else if (G[i][j] == '#') {
                if (flag) add(S, now), now = ++node, flag = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flag) add(S, now);
        else node--;
    }
    for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
        int now = ++node;
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                col[i][j] = now;
                flag = 1;
            } else if (G[i][j] == '#') {
                if (flag) add(now, T), now = ++node, flag = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flag) add(now, T);
        else node--;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                add(row[i][j], col[i][j]);
            }
        }
}

int q[MAXN];
int tag[MAXN], cur[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * (node));
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now^1].f = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = node + 1; i--;) cur[i] = head[i];
        while (dfs(S)) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("commander.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("commander.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) readMap(G[i][j]);
    build();
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

//CompletePackOpt1.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int t,m,w[10005],c[10005],dp[10005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&m,&t);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        scanf("%d%d",w+i,c+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int v=c[i]; v<=t; v++)
            dp[v]=max(dp[v-c[i]]+w[i],dp[v]);
    }
    printf("%d",dp[t]);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 1011110011

int n, K, T;
LL dp[115][115][115], C[115][115];

int main() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 111; i++) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < 111; j++) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }
//	freopen("container.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("container.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(T);
    dp[0][K][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= T; k++) if (dp[i][j][k]) {
                    for (int q = 0; q <= j; q++) {
                        for (int w = 0; w <= k; w++) {
                            (dp[i + 1][j - q][k + q - w] += dp[i][j][k] * C[j][q] % MOD * C[k][w] % MOD) %= MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    LL ans = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k <= T; k++) (ans += dp[n][0][k]) %= MOD;
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

//convex.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <string>

using namespace std;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second

typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

ULL __rand_value = 0x2333333333333333, __hidden_seed = 0x79786365766f6c69;

inline ULL raw_rand() {
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 12;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value + 1) << 25;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 27;
    return __rand_value ^ __hidden_seed;
}

#define rand_int(st, ed) int(raw_rand() % ((ed) - (st) + 1) + (st))
#define rand_01() (double(raw_rand() & 0xffffffff) / UINT_MAX)
inline double fast_exp(register double y) {
    double d;
    *(((int*)&d) + 0) = 0;
    *(((int*)&d) + 1) = int(1512775 * y + 1072632447);
    return d;
}

#define MAXN 253
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (int a, int b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    inline bool operator < (const Point &a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y);
    }
    inline LL operator * (const Point &a) const {
        return (LL)x * a.y - (LL)y * a.x;
    }
    inline void operator += (const Point &a) {
        x += a.x;
        y += a.y;
    }
    inline void operator -= (const Point &a) {
        x -= a.x;
        y -= a.y;
    }
    inline Point operator - (const Point &a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    inline Point operator + (const Point &a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
} p[MAXN], base;

inline bool cmp(int x, int y) {
    return p[x] * p[y] > 0;
}

int n, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN][MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN], to[MAXN];

inline int get_value() {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    register int i, tag = -1, top = 1;
    for (i = n; i; i--) if (vis[i]) tag = i;
    if (tag == -1) return -INF;
    sta[1] = tag;
    for (i = (tag == n ? 0 : tag) + 1; i != tag; i = ((i == n) ? 0 : i) + 1) {
        if (vis[a[tag][i]]) {
            while (top > 2 && (p[sta[top]] - p[sta[top - 1]]) * (p[a[tag][i]] - p[sta[top]]) < 0) top--;
            sta[++top] = a[tag][i];
            ans = max(ans, top);
        }
    }
    return top;
}

inline void SA() {
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) vis[i] = 1;
    register int now = get_value(), tmp;
    register double Dec;
    if (n > 100) Dec = 0.99997;
    else if (n > 50) Dec = 0.9999833;
    else Dec = 0.99999233;
    for (register double Temp = n + 2; int(Temp); Temp *= Dec) {
        for (i = int(Temp); i; i--) to[i] ^= 1;
        for (i = n; i; i--) vis[i] ^= to[i];
        tmp = get_value();
        if (tmp >= now) now = tmp;
        else {
            if (rand_01() < fast_exp(((tmp - now) * 64) / Temp)) {
                //	cerr << "accept " << Temp << endl;
                now = tmp;
            } else for (i = n; i; i--) vis[i] ^= to[i];
        }
        for (i = n; i; i--) to[i] = 0;
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("convex.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("convex.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (register int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i].x), read(p[i].y);
    sort(p + 1, p + n + 1);
    for (register int i = 1, j; i <= n; i++) {
        base = p[i];
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) p[j] -= base;
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) a[i][j] = j;
        swap(a[i][1], a[i][i]);
        sort(a[i] + 2, a[i] + n + 1, cmp);
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) p[j] += base;
    }
    if (n <= 20) {
        int top = 1 << n;
        for (int i = 1; i < top; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) vis[j + 1] = (i >> j) & 1;
            get_value();
        }
    } else SA();
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

//Graham�㷨O$(n\log{n})$
//д��һ����ֱ����������
//ֱ��������Ƚ� (ˮƽ��)
bool cmp(const Point &a, const Point &b) { //�ȱȽ�x����Ƚ�x����
    return a.x < b.x || (a.x == b.x && a.y < b.y);
}
vector<Point> Graham(vector<Point> p) {
    int n = p.size();
    sort(p.begin(), p.end(), cmp);
    vector<Point> res(n + n + 5);
    int top = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) { //ɨ����͹��
        while(top > 1 && sgn((res[top - 1] - res[top - 2]) ^ (p[i] - res[top - 2])) <= 0) top--;
        res[top++] = p[i];
    }
    int k = top;
    for(int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) { //ɨ����͹��
        while(top > k && sgn((res[top - 1] - res[top - 2]) ^ (p[i] - res[top - 2])) <= 0) top--;
        res[top++] = p[i];
    }
    if(top > 1) top--;//���һ����͵�һ����һ��, ���Բ�ȥ��, ĳЩ����ʱ����һЩ
    res.resize(top);
    return res;
}

//д������������������
//�������ھ����������RE
Point p0;//p0 ԭ�㼯�������·��ĵ�
bool cmp(const Point &p1, const Point &p2) { //���������� �� �Ƕ���ͬ�����С����ǰ��
    double tmp = (p0 - p2) ^ (p1 - p2);
    if(sgn(tmp) > 0) return true;
    else if(sgn(tmp) == 0 && sgn(((p0 - p1) * (p0 - p1)) - ((p0 - p2) * (p0 - p2))) < 0)  return true;
    else return false;
}

vector<Point> Graham(vector<Point> p) {
    //p0
    int pn = p.size();
    for(int i = 1; i < pn; i++)
        if(p[i].x < p[0].x || (p[i].x == p[0].x && p[i].y < p[0].y))
            swap(p[i], p[0]);
    p0 = p[0];
    //sort
    sort(p.begin() + 1, p.end(), cmp);
    vector<Point> stk(pn * 2 + 5);
    int top = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
        while(top > 1 && sgn((stk[top - 1] - stk[top - 2]) ^ (p[i] - stk[top - 2])) <= 0) top--;
        stk[top++] = p[i];
    }
    stk.resize(top);
    return stk;
}

//correct.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int> > q;
struct edge {
    int next;
    int to;
} e[100005];
int head[100005],in[100005],n,m,ecnt=0;
int ans[100005],cnt=0;
void init() {
    memset(head,-1,sizeof(head));
    memset(in,0,sizeof(in));
    return;
}
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
    return;
}
void topo() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (in[i]==0) {
            q.push(i);
            in[i]=-1;
        }
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u=q.top();
        //printf("now:%d\n",u);
        q.pop();
        ans[++cnt]=u;
        for (int now=head[u]; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
            in[e[now].to]--;
            if (in[e[now].to]==0) {
                q.push(e[now].to);
                in[e[now].to]=-1;
            }
        }
    }
    return;
}
void printans() {
    if (cnt<n)
        printf("OMG.");
    else
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            printf("%d ",ans[i]);
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    topo();
    printans();
    return 0;
}

//cover.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
typedef long long LL;
const LL P1 = 233333, P2 = 233;
const LL MOD1 = 999990319, MOD2 = 100000319;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator - (Hash b) const {
        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Hash b) const {
        return x == b.x && y == b.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m, top, l[5], len[16], st[MAXN];
char tmp[MAXN];
int dp[16][1003];

inline void work_subtask1() {
    memset(dp, INF, sizeof dp);
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    register int i, j, k, s, ll, p, maxlen = len[top - 1];
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = st[i]; j; j = (j - 1) & st[i]) {
            for (k = 0; k < top; k++) {
                if (k & j) continue;
                s = k | j;
                ll = len[j];
                for (p = 0; p <= ll; p++) {
                    dp[s][ll] = min(dp[s][ll], dp[k][p] + ll - p);
                }
                for (p = ll + 1; p <= maxlen; p++) {
                    dp[s][p] = min(dp[s][p], dp[k][p]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (j = 0; j < top; j++) {
            dp[j][0] = min(dp[j][0], dp[j][1]);
            for (k = 1; k <= maxlen; k++) {
                dp[j][k] = dp[j][k + 1];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d ", dp[top - 1][0]);
}

inline void work_subtask2() {
    memset(dp, 0, sizeof dp);
    register int i, j, k, s, ll, p, maxlen = len[top - 1];
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = st[i]; j; j = (j - 1) & st[i]) {
            for (k = 0; k < top; k++) {
                if (k & j) continue;
                s = k | j;
                ll = len[j];
                for (p = 0; p <= ll; p++) {
                    dp[s][ll] = max(dp[s][ll], dp[k][p] + ll - p);
                }
                for (p = ll + 1; p <= maxlen; p++) {
                    dp[s][p] = max(dp[s][p], dp[k][p]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (j = 0; j < top; j++) {
            dp[j][0] = max(dp[j][0], dp[j][1]);
            for (k = 1; k <= maxlen; k++) {
                dp[j][k] = dp[j][k + 1];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[top - 1][0]);
}

inline void work() {
    scanf("%s", tmp + 1);
    a[0] = Hash();
    n = (int) strlen(tmp + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + tmp[i], st[i] = 0;
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        scanf("%s", tmp + 1);
        l[i] = (int) strlen(tmp + 1);
        Hash b;
        for (int j = 1; j <= l[i]; j++) b = b + tmp[j];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n - l[i]; j++) {
            if ((a[j + l[i]] - a[j] * l[i]) == b) {
                st[j + 1] |= 1 << i;
            }
        }
    }
    top = 1 << m;
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        len[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            if ((i >> j) & 1) len[i] = max(l[j], len[i]);
        }
    }
    work_subtask1();
    work_subtask2();
}

int main() {
    freopen("cover.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cover.out", "w", stdout);
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int n;

long long ans = 0;

bool f[25];

void work() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = 1;
    int left = n;
    while (left) {
        ans++;
        int st = rand_int(1, n), ed = rand_int(1, n);
        if (st == ed) break;
        for (int i = st; i != ed; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1) {
            if (f[i]) f[i] = 0, left--;
        }
    }
}

void hh() {
    unsigned int cnt = 0;
    while (cnt <= 0xfffffff) {
        cnt++;
        work();
    }
    long double pr = ((long double)ans) / cnt;
    printf("\"%.16Lf\",\n", pr);
    fflush(stdout);
}

int main() {
    freopen("list.txt", "w", stdout);
    Srand();
    for (n = 1; n <= 20; n++) {
        ans = 0;
        hh();
    }
    return 0;
}

//cowherd.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005

struct Pos {
    int v[10], x;
    int &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
    bool operator < (Pos a) const {
        for (int i = 0; i < x; i++) if (v[i] != a.v[i]) return v[i] < a.v[i];
        return 0;
    }
} p[MAXN];

LL ans = 0, mx = 0;
int n, K, cnt = 0;

int find(LL v) {
    int l = 0, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (p[mid][0] <= v) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

void dfs(LL left, int pos) {
    if (cnt >= K) return;
    if (pos < 1) {
        cnt++;
        return;
    }
    dfs(left, pos - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < p[pos].x; i++) {
        if (left < p[pos][i]) break;
        LL v = left - p[pos][i];
        int to = min(pos - 1, find(v));
        dfs(v, to);
    }
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    cnt = 0;
    dfs(mid, n);
    return cnt >= K;
}

void generate(LL left, int pos) {
    if (pos < 1) {
        ans -= left + 1;
        return;
    }
    generate(left, pos - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < p[pos].x; i++) {
        if (left < p[pos][i]) break;
        LL v = left - p[pos][i];
        int to = min(pos - 1, find(v));
        generate(v, to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        for (int j = 0; j < p[i].x; j++) read(p[i][j]);
        if (p[i].x == 1) ans += p[i][0], i--, n--;
        else {
            sort(p[i].v, p[i].v + p[i].x);
            ans += p[i][0];
            int base = p[i][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < p[i].x; j++) p[i][j - 1] = p[i][j] - base;
            p[i].x--;
            p[i][p[i].x] = 0;
            mx += p[i][p[i].x - 1];
        }
    }
    ans *= K;
    sort(p + 1, p + n + 1);
    LL l = 0, r = mx, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    ans += l * K;
    if (l > 0) generate(l - 1, n);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';

template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

//crystal.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();

#define MAXN 50319
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

const int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1}, dy[] = {-1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0};

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point (int _x = 0, int _y = 0) : x(_x), y(_y) {}
    bool operator < (Point a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Point a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n, tot = 0;
int lab[MAXN];
map <Point, int> G;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 6 * 4 * 2];

int head[MAXN * 2], cur[MAXN * 2], S = 0, T = 1, node = 1, ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int tag[MAXN * 2];
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (node + 1));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x], ret; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            if ((ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f)))) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memcpy(cur, head, sizeof(int) * (node + 1));
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    freopen("crystal.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("crystal.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x, y, z, c; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
        read(c);
        p[i] = Point(x - z, y - z);
        if (G.find(p[i]) == G.end()) G[p[i]] = c * (10 + ((x + y + z) % 3 == 0));
        else G[p[i]] += c * (10 + ((x + y + z) % 3 == 0));
    }
    sort(p + 1, p + n + 1);
    n = int(unique(p + 1, p + n + 1) - p - 1);
    for (int i = 1, val; i <= n; i++) {
        val = G[p[i]], G[p[i]] = i;
        lab[i] = ++node;
        tot += val;
        switch (((p[i].x + p[i].y) % 3 + 3) % 3) {
        case 0 :
            add(lab[i], ++node, val);
            break;
        case 1 :
            add(S, lab[i], val);
            break;
        case 2 :
            add(lab[i], T, val);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if ((p[i].x + p[i].y) % 3 == 0) {
            for (int d1 = 0, d2 = 1; d1 < 6; d1++, d2++) {
                int p1 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d1], p[i].y + dy[d1])];
                int p2 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d2], p[i].y + dy[d2])];
                if (p1 && p2) {
                    if (((p[p1].x + p[p1].y) % 3 + 3) % 3 == 2) swap(p1, p2);
                    add(lab[p1], lab[i], INF), add(lab[i] + 1, lab[p2], INF);
                }
            }
            for (int d1 = 0, d2 = 3; d2 < 6; d1++, d2++) {
                int p1 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d1], p[i].y + dy[d1])];
                int p2 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d2], p[i].y + dy[d2])];
                if (p1 && p2) {
                    if (((p[p1].x + p[p1].y) % 3 + 3) % 3 == 2)  swap(p1, p2);
                    add(lab[p1], lab[i], INF), add(lab[i] + 1, lab[p2], INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = tot - dinic();
    printf("%d.%d\n", ans / 10, ans % 10);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;

#define read(a) {a = 0; while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {a = a * 10 + ch - '0'; ch = getchar();}}

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, dfn, a[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN], son[MAXN], rev[MAXN], dep[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], top[MAXN], siz[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > siz[son[x]]) son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
}

void Link(int x, int anc) {
    L[x] = ++dfn;
    rev[dfn] = x;
    top[x] = anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        }
    }
    R[x] = dfn;
}

int OP[MAXN], X[MAXN];

namespace task1 {
bool c[MAXN], d[MAXN];
void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        d[i] = dep[rev[i]] & 1;
        c[i] = a[rev[i]];
    }
    register LL ans;
    for (register int i = 1, j, op, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        op = OP[i], x = X[i];
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            for (j = L[x] + 1, op = R[x], x = L[x]; j <= op; j++) if (d[x] ^ d[j]) c[j] ^= 1;
            break;
        case 2:
            c[rev[x]] ^= 1;
            break;
        case 3:
            l = L[x], r = L[x] - 1;
            ans = 0;
            for ( ; x; x = fa[x]) {
                op = 0;
                for (j = L[x]; j < l; j++) op += c[j];
                for (j = R[x]; j > r; j--) op += c[j];
                l = L[x], r = R[x];
                ans += op * x;
            }
            printf("%lld\n", ans);
        }
    }
}
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

char a[6][3][3],temp[4][3];
// 0 - front
// 1 - back
// 2 - left
// 3 - right
// 4 - top
// 5 - bottom
char wakaka[105];

void lturn(char c[3][3]) {
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=c[2-j][i];
        }
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)

        }
}

#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int a[105][105];

int n, m, k, x, y;

void work() {
    for (int i = 1; k && i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; k && j <= m; j++) {
            k--;
            a[i][j]++;
        }
    for (int i = n - 1; k && i > 1; i--)
        for (int j = 1; k && j <= m; j++) {
            k--;
            a[i][j]++;
        }
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> x >> y;
    while (k) {
        work();
    }
    int ma = 0, mi = 123456789;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            ma = max(ma, a[i][j]);
            mi = min(mi, a[i][j]);
        }
    }
    cout << ma <<" " << mi << " " << a[x][y];

    return 0;
}

//CWOJ1161.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next;
    int to;
} e[45000];
int n,m,ecnt;
int chain[205][205],head[205],tail[205],father[205];
int h[205],cnt[205],ans[205],anscnt;
bool used[205];
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        head[i]=tail[i]=1;
        father[i]=i;
    }
    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));
    memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
    memset(used,0,sizeof(used));
    ecnt=0;
    return;
}
void add(int u,int v) {
    //printf("add %d->%d\n",u,v);
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=h[u];
    h[u]=ecnt;
    cnt[v]++;
    return;
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (father[x]==x)
        return x;
    return father[x]=getf(father[x]);
}
void insert(int x) {
    father[x]=getf(father[x]);
    chain[father[x]][tail[father[x]]++]=x;
    used[x]=1;
    return;
}
bool topo() {
    int confirm=0;
    bool flag=1;
    while (flag) {
        flag=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!used[i] && cnt[i]==0) {
                flag=1;
                confirm++;
                insert(i);
                //printf("insert:%d %d\n",i,);
                for (int now=h[i]; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
                    //	printf("cnt[%d]-- %d\n",e[now].to,now);
                    cnt[e[now].to]--;
                    father[e[now].to]=getf(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!flag)
            break;
    }
    if (confirm!=n) {
        //	printf("confirm : %d \n",confirm);
        //	printf("%d\n",cnt[4]);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
void getans() {
    int bot,tag;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        bot=INF;
        tag=-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (head[j]!=tail[j]) {
                if (chain[j][head[j]]<bot) {
                    bot=chain[j][head[j]];
                    tag=j;
                }
            }
        }
        head[tag]++;
        ans[i]=bot;
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(u,v);
        }
        if (topo()) {
            printf("-1\n");
            continue;
        }
        getans();
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            printf("%d ",ans[i]);
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1184.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

// alias BZOJ3991
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch!='+' && ch!='-' && ch!='?') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='+') return 1;
    if (ch=='-') return 2;
    return 3;
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dis[MAXN],ans=0;
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dfsid[MAXN],dfn=0,bfsid[MAXN],q[MAXN],fa[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
int bb[MAXN*2][19],fir[MAXN],bt=0;
void bfs() {
    q[ta++]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    fa[1]=0;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        bfsid[x]=he-1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                fa[e[now].to]=x;
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    dfsid[x]=++dfn;
    bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
    fir[x]=bt;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=bt; k++) {
        int x=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=bt-(1<<k)+1; i<=x; i++) {
            bb[i][k]=min(bb[i][k-1],bb[i+x][k-1]);
        }
    }
}

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    u=fir[u],v=fir[v];
    if (u>v) swap(u,v);
    int len=v-u+1,ll=log_2(len);
    return q[min(bb[u][ll],bb[v-(1<<ll)+1][ll])];
}

struct statu {
    int x,id;
    statu() {}
    statu(int w):id(w) {}
    statu(int q,int w):x(q),id(w) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return id<a.id;
    }
};
set<statu> s;
set<statu>::iterator it;
int Left(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.begin()) it=s.end();
    return (*--it).x;
}
int Right(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.end()) it=s.begin();
    return (*it).x;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i=1,op,x; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        if (op==1) {
            read(x);
            add(x);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(x);
            dec(x);
        } else {
            printf("%lld\n",ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//CWOJ1197.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int n,s;
int t[262145];
int find(int x,int k) {
    if (x>s)
        return x-s;
    if (t[x<<1]>=k)
        return find(x<<1,k);
    return find((x<<1)+1,k-t[x<<1]);
}
void update(int x,int d) {
    int now=s+x;
    while (now>0) {
        t[now]+=d;
        now>>=1;
    }
    return;
}
void init() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    s=1;
    while (s<n)
        s<<=1;
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        t[r+s]++;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--)
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)+1];
    return;
}

void work() {
    int k;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int ch=getchar();
        while (ch<'A' || ch>'Q')
            ch=getchar();
        if (ch=='Q') {
            scanf("%d",&k);
            printf("%d\n",find(1,k));
        } else if (ch=='D') {
            scanf("%d",&k);
            update(find(1,k),-1);
        } else {
            scanf("%d",&k);
            update(k,1);
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1198.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],ans[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],blo[MAXN],bloans[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN];

struct qury {
    int l,r,k,x;
    bool operator < (qury q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

inline int query(int k) {
    int tot=0,l=-1;
    while (tot<k) tot+=bloans[++l];
    tot-=bloans[l];
    for (int x=L[l];; x++) {
        tot+=cnt[x];
        if (tot>=k) return x;
    }
}

inline void update(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]++;
    bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(100001)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i=0; i<=100001; i++) {
        blo[i]=i/sqn;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    L[0]=0;
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        ans[q[i].x]=query(q[i].k);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1201.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 100319

LL ans = 0;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, k;
int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x, int fa) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to, x);
    }
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x, 0);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs > siz[x] / 2) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int l[MAXN], lcnt = 0, dep[MAXN];

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    l[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa && !vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

LL work(int rt, int base) {
    dep[rt] = base;
    lcnt = 0;
    dd(rt, 0);
    sort(l + 1, l + lcnt + 1);
    LL ret = 0;
    int i = 1, j = lcnt;
    while (i < j) {
        if (l[i] + l[j] <= k) ret += j - i, i++;
        else j--;
    }
    return ret;
}

void solve(int x) {
    int rt = find(x);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    ans += work(rt, 0);
    for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            ans -= work(e[now].to, 1);
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    solve(1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define INF 12345678

    scanf("%d%s",&n,s+1);
    int now=1,prev=0,pprev=2;
    for (int len=1; len<n; len++,now=pprev,prev=(prev+1)%3,pprev=(pprev+1)%3)
        for (int i=1,j=i+len; j<=n; i++,j++) {
            dp[now][i]=INF;
            if (s[i]==s[j]) {
                dp[now][i]=dp[pprev][i+1];
            }
            dp[now][i]=min(dp[now][i],min(dp[prev][i+1],dp[prev][i])+1);
        }
    printf("%d\n",dp[prev][1]);

}

}
#define MAXN 100005
int n,a[MAXN];
double sum[MAXN],temp[MAXN];
LL k,tot;

void merge(int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    merge(l,mid);
    merge(mid+1,r);
    int i=l,j=mid+1,cnt=-1;
    while (i<=mid && j<=r) {
        if (sum[i]<=sum[j]) temp[++cnt]=sum[i++];
        else tot+=mid-i+1,temp[++cnt]=sum[j++];
    }
    while (i<=mid) temp[++cnt]=sum[i++];
    while (j<=r) temp[++cnt]=sum[j++];
    for (int q=0; l+q<=r; q++) {
        sum[l+q]=temp[q];
    }
}

bool check(double x) {
    sum[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) sum[i]=sum[i-1]+a[i]-x;
    tot=0;
    merge(0,n);
    return tot>=k;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    double l=0,r=0x7fffffff,mid;
    while (r-l>1e-5) {
        mid=(l+r)/2;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid;
    }
    printf("%.4lf\n",l);
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();

    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
