typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 10000000
LL temp[50];
char r[405];
struct num {
    int v[50],len;
    num():len(0) {}
    num operator = (int x) {
        memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
        v[0]=x;
        len=0;
        return *this;
    }
    int &operator [](int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    num operator + (num b) {
        num c=*this;
        return c+=b;
    }
    num operator += (num a) {
        len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]+=a[i];
            if (v[i]>=MOD) v[i]-=MOD,v[i+1]++;
        }
        if (v[len+1]) len++;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator += (int a) {
        num x;
        x=a;
        return *this+=x;
    }
    num operator - (num b) {
        num c=*this;
        return c-=b;
    }
    num operator -= (num a) {
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]-=a[i];
            while (v[i]<0) v[i]+=MOD,v[i+1]--;
        }
        while (!v[len] && len>0) len--;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator -= (int a) {
        num x;
        x=a;
        return *this-=x;
    }
    num operator * (num a) {
        memset(temp,0,sizeof(temp));
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<=a.len; j++) {
                temp[i+j]+=LL(v[i])*LL(a[j]);
            }
        int l=len+a.len;
        num c;
        c=0;
        for (int i=0; i<=l; i++) {
            c[i]=int(temp[i]%MOD);
            temp[i+1]+=temp[i]/MOD;
            if (i==l && temp[i+1]) l++;
        }
        c.len=l;
        return c;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<=8; i++) r[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",r+9);
        len=-1;
        for (int i=int(strlen(r))-1; i>=9; i-=7) {
            len++;
            sscanf(r+i-6,"%7d",&v[len]);
        }
        if (len<=0) len=0;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%d",v[len]);
        for (int i=len-1; i>-1; i--) {
            printf("%07d",v[i]);
        }
        putchar('\n');
    }
} dp[2][1024][2];

int n,a[1024];
void work(num now[1024][2],num prev[1024][2],int i) {
    for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) now[j][0]=now[j][1]=0;
    now[a[i]][0]=1;
    for (int j=0; j<1024; j++) {
        now[j][0]+=prev[j][0];
        now[j][1]+=prev[j][1];
        now[j&a[i]][0]+=prev[j][0];
        now[j^a[i]][1]+=prev[j][0]+prev[j][1];
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i=n,now=n&1,prev=now^1; i; i--) {
        work(dp[now],dp[prev],i);
        now^=1,prev^=1;
    }
    dp[1][0][1].print();
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <string>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int c[2], fa;
    int siz, val, sum, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];

int tcnt = 0, rt = 0;

int newNode(int v) {
    tcnt++;
    t[tcnt].c[0] = t[tcnt].c[1] = t[tcnt].fa = 0;
    t[tcnt].val = t[tcnt].sum = v;
    t[tcnt].siz = 1;
    t[tcnt].lazy = t[tcnt].rev = 0;
    return tcnt;
}

void setc(int x, int ch, int p) {
    t[x].c[p] = ch;
    t[ch].fa = x;
}

bool d(int x) {
    return x == t[t[x].fa].c[1];
}

void clr(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = -1;
    t[x].val = t[x].sum = 0;
}
void fil(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = 1;
    t[x].val = !!t[x].siz, t[x].sum = t[x].siz;
}

void rev(int x) {
    t[x].rev ^= 1;
}

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].c[0]].sum + t[t[x].c[1]].sum + t[x].val;
    t[x].siz = t[t[x].c[0]].siz + t[t[x].c[1]].siz + 1;
}

int build(int l, int r, int val) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int x = newNode(mid >= val);
    setc(x, build(l, mid - 1, val), 0);
    setc(x, build(mid + 1, r, val), 1);
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

void relax(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy > 0) fil(t[x].c[0]), fil(t[x].c[1]);
        else clr(t[x].c[0]), clr(t[x].c[1]);
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (t[x].rev) {
        rev(t[x].c[0]);
        rev(t[x].c[1]);
        swap(t[x].c[0], t[x].c[1]);
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}

void rot(int x) {
    int fa = t[x].fa;
    relax(fa);
    relax(x);
    int dir = d(x);
    setc(t[fa].fa, x, d(fa));
    setc(fa, t[x].c[!dir], dir);
    setc(x, fa, !dir);
    upd(fa);
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

int splay(int x, int fa = 0) {
    while (t[x].fa != fa) {
//		printf("%d %d %d %d\n", rt, x, t[x].fa, fa);
        if (t[t[x].fa].fa == fa) rot(x);
        else d(x) == d(t[x].fa) ? (rot(t[x].fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

int select(int k) {
    for (int x = rt; ; ) {
        relax(x);
        int s = t[t[x].c[0]].siz;
        if (k < s) x = t[x].c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = t[x].c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

int get(int l, int r) {
    int L = select(l - 1), R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return t[R].c[0];
}

struct Query {
    int x, l, r;
} q[MAXN];

int n, m, K;

bool check(int val) {
    tcnt = 0;
    rt = build(0, n + 1, val);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int R = get(q[i].l, q[i].r);
        if (q[i].x == 1) rev(R);
        else {
            int s = t[R].sum;
            R = get(q[i].l, q[i].r - s);
            clr(R);
            R = get(q[i].r - s + 1, q[i].r);
            fil(R);
        }
    }
    return t[select(K)].val;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
    }
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1508.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 50005

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, sum, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : siz(0), lazy(0), rev(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void clr() {
        lazy = -1;
        val = sum = 0;
    }
    void fil() {
        lazy = 1;
        val = 1, sum = siz;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (lazy) {
            if ((c[0]->lazy = c[1]->lazy = lazy) > 0)
                val = 1, c[0]->sum = c[0]->siz, c[1]->sum = c[1]->siz;
            else
                val = c[0]->sum = c[1]->sum = 0;
            lazy = 0;
        }
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->rev ^= 1, c[1]->rev ^= 1;
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = ptr->sum = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->lazy = ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

Node* build(int l, int r, int val) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(mid >= val);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1, val), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r, val), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1);
    Node *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

struct query {
    int x, l, r;
} q[MAXN];

int n, m, k;

bool check(int val) {
    ptr = mem;
    root = build(0, n + 1, val);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        Node *Range = get(q[i].l, q[i].r);
        if (q[i].x == 1) {
            Range->revIt();
        } else {
            int s = Range->sum;
            Range = get(q[i].l, q[i].r - s);
            Range->clr();
            Range = get(q[i].r - s + 1, q[i].r);
            Range->fil();
        }
    }
    Node *x = select(k);
    return x->val;
}

int main() {
    freopen("chick1.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("chick1.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &q[i].x, &q[i].l, &q[i].r);
    }
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();

    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 500319

struct Node {
    int c[2], fa;
    int siz, sum, val, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];

int tcnt, rt;

int newNode(int v) {
    tcnt++;
    t[tcnt].fa = t[tcnt].c[0] = t[tcnt].c[1] = 0;
    t[tcnt].siz = 1;
    t[tcnt].sum = t[tcnt].val = v;
    t[tcnt].lazy = t[tcnt].rev = 0;
    return tcnt;
}

bool d(int x) {
    return x == t[t[x].fa].c[1];
}

void setc(int x, int ch, int p) {
    t[x].c[p] = ch;
    t[ch].fa = x;
}

void fil(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = 1;
    t[x].val = !!t[x].siz, t[x].sum = t[x].siz;
}

void clr(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = -1;
    t[x].val = t[x].sum = 0;
}

void rev(int x) {
    t[x].rev ^= 1;
}

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].c[0]].sum + t[t[x].c[1]].sum + t[x].val;
    t[x].siz = t[t[x].c[0]].siz + t[t[x].c[1]].siz + 1;
}

void relax(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy > 0) fil(t[x].c[0]), fil(t[x].c[1]);
        else clr(t[x].c[0]), clr(t[x].c[1]);
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (t[x].rev) {
        rev(t[x].c[0]);
        rev(t[x].c[1]);
        swap(t[x].c[0], t[x].c[1]);
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r, int val) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int x = newNode(mid >= val);
    setc(x, build(l, mid - 1, val), 0);
    setc(x, build(mid + 1, r, val), 1);
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

void rot(int x) {
    int fa = t[x].fa;
    relax(fa);
    relax(x);
    int dir = d(x);
    setc(t[fa].fa, x, d(fa));
    setc(fa, t[x].c[!dir], dir);
    setc(x, fa, !dir);
    upd(fa);
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(int x, int fa = 0) {
    while (t[x].fa != fa) {
        if (t[t[x].fa].fa == fa) rot(x);
        else d(x) == d(t[x].fa) ? (rot(t[x].fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    upd(x);
}

int select(int k) {
    for (int x = rt; ; ) {
        relax(x);
        int s = t[t[x].c[0]].siz;
        if (k < s) x = t[x].c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = t[x].c[1];
        else return x;
    }

struct query {
    int x, l, r;

int n, m, K;
bool rec[MAXN], ansed = 0;

void work(int k) {
    tcnt = 0;
    rt = build(0, n + 1, k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int R = get(q[i].l, q[i].r);
        if (q[i].x == 1) {
            rev(R);
        } else {
            int s = t[R].sum;
            R = get(q[i].l, q[i].r - s);
            clr(R);
            R = get(q[i].r - s + 1, q[i].r);
            fil(R);
        }
    }

    if (!ansed) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rec[i] = t[get(i, i)].val;
        ansed = 1;
    } else {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (rec[i] != t[get(i, i)].val) {
                printf("%d\n", i);
                break;
            }
    }
}

    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(q[i].x), read(q[i].l), read(q[i].r);

//cwoj1513.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node () :siz(0), val(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void setv(int v) {
        mid = head = tail = val = sum = v;
        siz = 1;
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        head = max(c[0]->head, c[0]->sum + val + max(0, c[1]->head));
        tail = max(c[1]->tail, c[1]->sum + val + max(0, c[0]->tail));
        mid = max(max(max(head, tail), max(c[0]->mid, c[1]->mid)), max(c[0]->tail, 0) + val + max(0, c[1]->head));
    }
} mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root;

int n, m, a[MAXN];

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->setv(v);
    return ptr++;
}

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1);
    Node *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d", a + i);
    }
    root = build(0, n + 2);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l ,&r);
        if (op == 1) {
            get(l, l)->setv(r);
            root->c[1]->upd();
            root->upd();
        } else {
            printf("%d\n", get(l, r)->mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1513_hh.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node (): l(0), r(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].head = max(t[t[x].l].head, t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].head);
    t[x].tail = max(t[t[x].r].tail, t[t[x].r].sum + t[t[x].l].tail);
    t[x].mid = max(max(t[x].head, t[x].tail),max(max(t[t[x].l].mid, t[t[x].r].mid), max(max(0, t[t[x].l].tail) + t[t[x].r].head, max(0, t[t[x].r].head) + t[t[x].l].tail)));
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        scanf("%d", &t[x].sum);
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum;
    }
    return x;
}

void modify(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum = v;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    }
}

Node combine(Node L, Node R) {
    Node ret;
    ret.sum = L.sum + R.sum;
    ret.head = max(L.head, L.sum + R.head);
    ret.tail = max(R.tail, R.sum + L.tail);
    ret.mid = max(max(ret.head, ret.tail),max(max(L.mid, R.mid), max(max(0, L.tail) + R.head, max(0, R.head) + L.tail)));
    return ret;
}

Node query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr)
        return Node(t[x]);
    Node ret;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = combine(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql),qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (op == 1) {
            modify(1, 1, n, l, r);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r).mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1513_seg.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node (): l(0), r(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].head = max(t[t[x].l].head, t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].head);
    t[x].tail = max(t[t[x].r].tail, t[t[x].r].sum + t[t[x].l].tail);
    t[x].mid = max(max(t[x].head, t[x].tail),max(max(t[t[x].l].mid, t[t[x].r].mid), max(max(0, t[t[x].l].tail) + t[t[x].r].head, max(0, t[t[x].r].head) + t[t[x].l].tail)));
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        scanf("%d", &t[x].sum);
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum;
    }
    return x;
}

void modify(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum = v;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    }
}

struct Query {
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Query (): sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
    Query (Node x): sum(x.sum), head(x.head), tail(x.tail), mid(x.mid) {}
};

Query combine(Query L, Query R) {
    Query ret;
    ret.sum = L.sum + R.sum;
    ret.head = max(L.head, L.sum + R.head);
    ret.tail = max(R.tail, R.sum + L.tail);
    ret.mid = max(max(ret.head, ret.tail),max(max(L.mid, R.mid), max(max(0, L.tail) + R.head, max(0, R.head) + L.tail)));
    return ret;
}

Query query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr)
        return Query(t[x]);
    Query ret;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = combine(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql),qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (op == 1) {
            modify(1, 1, n, l, r);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r).mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1552.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 500005
#define INF 0x3fffffff
struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int key, d;
    Node () : key(INF), d(0) {}
} t[MAXN], *ptr = t, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

int n, m;
Node *rt[MAXN];

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->l = ptr->r = null;
    ptr->key = v, ptr->d = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node* merge(Node *x, Node *y) {
    if (x == null) return y;
    if (y == null) return x;
    if (x->key > y->key) swap(x, y);
    x->r = merge(x->r, y);
    if (x->l->d < x->r->d) swap(x->l, x->r);
    x->d = x->r->d + 1;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt[i] = null;
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 0) {
            read(x);
            if (rt[x] == null) puts("-1");
            else printf("%d\n", rt[x]->key), rt[x] = merge(rt[x]->l, rt[x]->r);
        } else if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            rt[x] = merge(rt[x], newNode(y));
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            if (x == y) continue;
            rt[x] = merge(rt[x], rt[y]);
            rt[y] = null;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1602.cpp
#include <cstdio>

int n, a[9], ans = 0;
bool vis[36];

void check() {
    for (int i = n; i; vis[i--] = 0);
    for (int i = 0, j; i < 8; i++)
        for (j = i + 1; j <= 8; j++) {
            vis[a[i] - a[j]] = 1;
        }
    for (int i = n; i; ) if (!vis[i--]) return;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 4; i++) if (n - a[i] != a[8 - i]) {
            ans++;
            return;
        }
    ans += 2;
}

void dfs(int x, int y) {
    if (!y) {
        check();
        return;
    }
    for (int i = x; i + y <= n; i++) {
        a[y] = i;
        dfs(i + 1, y - 1);
    }
}

int work() {
    a[0] = n;
    a[8] = 0;
    ans = 0;
    dfs(1, 7);
    return ans >> 1;
}

int main() {
    for (n = 8; n < 35; n++) {
        printf("%d : %d\n", n, work());
    }
}

//cwoj1608.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int n, ans = 0;
bool G[441][441];
#define pos(x, y) ((x) * 21 + (y))

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int x, y, tx, ty;
        scanf("%d%d%d%d", &x, &y, &tx, &ty);
        G[pos(x * 2, y * 2)][pos(x + tx, y + ty)] = G[pos(x + tx, y + ty)][pos(x * 2, y * 2)] = 1;
        G[pos(tx * 2, ty * 2)][pos(x + tx, y + ty)] = G[pos(x + tx, y + ty)][pos(tx * 2, ty * 2)] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 441; i++) G[i][i] = 1;
    for (int k = 0; k < 441; k++) {
        int kx = k / 21, ky = k % 21;
        for (int i = 0; i < 441; i++) {
            int ix = i / 21, iy = i % 21;
            if (G[i][k] && (ix == kx || iy == ky || abs(kx - ix) == abs(ky - iy))) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 441; j++) {
                    int jx = j / 21, jy = j % 21;
                    if (G[k][j] && (kx - ix) * (iy - jy) - (ix - jx) * (ky - iy) == 0) {
                        G[i][j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < 441; k++) {
        int kx = k / 21, ky = k % 21;
        for (int i = k + 1; i < 441; i++) {
            int ix = i / 21, iy = i % 21;
            if (G[i][k]) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < 441; j++) {
                    int jx = j / 21, jy = j % 21;
                    if (G[k][j] && G[i][j] && (kx - ix) * (iy - jy) - (ix - jx) * (ky - iy) != 0) {
                        ans++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//cwoj1609.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

string s;

string solve(int l, int r, int &pre, bool &flag) {
    string ret = "";
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            int dep = 1, j = i;
            while (dep) {
                if (s[++j] == '(') dep++;
                else if (s[j] == ')') dep--;
            }
            bool ff = 0;
            int pp = 0;
            string x = solve(i + 1, j - 1, pp, ff);
            if ((pre == 4 && pp) || (ff && (pre > 1 || ((j < r) && (s[j + 1] == '*' || s[j + 1] == '/'))))) {
                x = '(' + x + ')';
            } else flag |= ff;
            ret += x;
            i = j;
        } else {
            ret += s[i];
            if (s[i] == '+' || s[i] == '-') flag = 1;
            if (s[i] == '/') pre = 4;
            else if (s[i] == '*') pre = 3;
            else if (s[i] == '-') pre = 2;
            else if (s[i] == '+') pre = 1;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    cin >> s;
    bool ff = 0;
    int pp = 0;
    cout << solve(0, (int)s.size() - 1, pp, ff) << endl;
    return 0;
}

//cyclical.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
const LL P1 = 19260817, P2 = 233333;
const LL MOD1 = 999990319, MOD2 = 1000000007;
#define MAXN 1000319
LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];
struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator - (Hash b) const {
        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
};

char s[MAXN];
Hash a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int n, len;
map <Hash, bool> vis;
int main() {
    freopen("cyclical.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cyclical.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + s[i];
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int t = 1; t <= n; t++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        puts(s + 1);
        int l = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= l; i++) b[i] = b[i - 1] + s[i];
        vis.clear();
        vis[b[l]] = 1;
        cout << b[l].x << " " << b[l].y << endl;
        for (int i = 1; i < l; i++) {
            b[l + i] = (b[l + i - 1] + s[i]) - (b[i] * l);
            if (vis[b[l + i]]) break;
            vis[b[l + i]] = 1;
            cout << b[l + i].x << " " << b[l + i].y << endl;
        }
        puts("~");
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = l; i <= len; i++) {
            cout << (a[i] - a[i - l] * l).x << " " << (a[i] - a[i - l] * l).y << endl;
            ans += vis[a[i] - a[i - l] * l];
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
        puts("----");
    }
    return 0;
}

//d1t1data.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
using namespace std;

const int n=6,MAXL=3;
char temp[100000][100];

void random_string(int x) {
    int len=int(rand()%MAXL)+2;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
        temp[x][i]=char('a'+int(rand()%26));
    }
    if (rand()%3 || x==1)
        temp[x][len]=0;
    else {
        len-=int(rand()%len);
        int lab=int(rand()%x);
        if (lab==0) lab=1;
        int ll=strlen(temp[lab]);
        for (int i=0; i<=ll; i++)
            temp[x][i+len]=temp[lab][i];
        len=ll+len;
        temp[x][len]=0;
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","w",stdout);
    printf("%d\n",n);
    srand(time(0));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        random_string(i);
        printf("%s\n",temp[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//dage.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

typedef long long LL;
const LL P1 = 233333, P2 = 233;
const LL MOD1 = 999990319, MOD2 = 100000319;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator - (Hash b) const {
        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Hash b) const {
        return x == b.x && y == b.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];

char s[MAXN];
int n, k, nxt[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    init();
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + s[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        nxt[i + 1] = n + 1;
        for (int j = 1, len = k; i + len<= n; j++, len += k) {
            if ((a[i + len] - a[i + j] * (len - j)) == (a[i + len - j] - a[i] * (len - j))) {
                nxt[i + 1] = i + len;
                break;
            }

        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    int now = n + 1;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        now = min(now, nxt[i]);
        ans += n + 1 - now;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//dage_vio.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 5319

typedef long long LL;
const LL P1 = 233333, P2 = 233;
const LL MOD1 = 999990319, MOD2 = 100000319;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash () : x(0), y(0) {}
    Hash (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Hash operator + (LL v) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + v) % MOD1, (y * P2 + v) % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator * (int l) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[l] % MOD1, y * X2[l] % MOD2);
    }
    Hash operator - (Hash b) const {
        return Hash(x >= b.x ? x - b.x : x + MOD1 - b.x, y >= b.y ? y - b.y : y + MOD2 - b.y);
    }
    bool operator < (Hash b) const {
        return x < b.x || (x == b.x && y < b.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Hash b) const {
        return x == b.x && y == b.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];

char s[MAXN];
int n, k, dp[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN][MAXN];
int lcp(int i, int j) {
    int l = 0, r = min(n - j + 1, n - i + 1), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if ((a[i + mid - 1] - a[i - 1] * mid) == (a[j + mid - 1] - a[j - 1] * mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    init();
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + s[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1, len = k; i + len - 1 <= n; j++, len += k) {
            if ((a[i + len - 1] - a[i + j - 1] * (len - j)) == (a[i + len - j - 1] - a[i - 1] * (len - j))) {
                for (int q = 1; q <= i; q++)
                    for (int w = i + len - 1; w <= n; w++) {
                        if (vis[q][w]) break;
                        vis[q][w] = 1;
                    }
                break;
            }

        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            ans += vis[i][j];
        }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2000319
LL seed;
int Rand() {
    return int(seed = ((seed * 19260817) ^ 233333) & ((1 << 24) - 1));
}

struct Node {
    int a, b, c;
    inline bool operator < (const Node &x) const {
        return a < x.a;
    }
} a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

inline bool cmp(const Node &x, const Node &y) {
    return x.b < y.b;
}

int n;
int opx[MAXN];

inline void gen() {
    register int i, j, k;
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].a = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].a;
        a[j].a = a[i].a;
        a[i].a = k;
        opx[i] = j;
    }
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].b = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].b;
        a[j].b = a[i].b;
        a[i].b = k;
    }
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].c = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].c;
        a[j].c = a[i].c;
        a[i].c = k;
    }
    for (i = n; i; i--) swap(a[i], a[opx[i]]);
}

int t[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;
inline void upd(int x) {
    for (int i = x; i <= n; i += i & -i) t[i]++;
}
inline void qry(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = x; i; i -= i & -i) ans += (ret = t[i]);
//	printf("%d\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    gen();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
//		cerr << "(" << a[i].a << ", " << a[i].b << ", " << a[i].c << ")\n";
        qry(a[i].b);
        upd(a[i].b);
    }
    cerr << ans << endl;
    memset(t, 0, sizeof t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
//		cerr << "(" << a[i].a << ", " << a[i].b << ", " << a[i].c << ")\n";
        qry(a[i].c);
        upd(a[i].c);
    }
    cerr << ans << endl;
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1, cmp);
    memset(t, 0, sizeof t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
//		cerr << "(" << a[i].a << ", " << a[i].b << ", " << a[i].c << ")\n";
        qry(a[i].c);
        upd(a[i].c);
    }

//	cerr << ans << " " << n * (n - 1) / 2 << endl;

    printf("%lld\n", (ans - (LL)n * (n - 1) / 2) / 2);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';

    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 2000319
LL seed;
int Rand() {
    return int(seed = ((seed * 19260817) ^ 233333) & ((1 << 24) - 1));
}

struct Node {
    int a, b, c;
    inline bool operator < (const Node &x) const {
        return a < x.a;
    }
} a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

int n;

int opx[MAXN];

inline void gen() {
    register int i, j, k;
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].a = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].a;
        a[j].a = a[i].a;
        a[i].a = k;
        opx[i] = j;
    }
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].b = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].b;
        a[j].b = a[i].b;
        a[i].b = k;
    }
    read(seed);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].c = i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        j = Rand() % i + 1;
        k = a[j].c;
        a[j].c = a[i].c;
        a[i].c = k;
    }
    for (i = n; i; i--) swap(a[i], a[opx[i]]);
}

LL ans = 0;
int t[MAXN];

#define upd(x) {for (int y = x; y <= n; y += y & -y) ++t[y];}
#define qry(x) {for (int y = x; y; y -= y & -y) ans += t[y];}

void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    solve(l, mid);
    solve(mid + 1, r);
    int i = l, j = mid + 1, k;
    while (j <= r) {
        while (i <= mid && a[j].b > a[i].b) upd(a[i++].c);
        qry(a[j++].c);
    }
    i = l;
    while (i <= mid) {
        int y = a[i++].c;
        while (y <= n && t[y]) t[y] = 0, y += y & -y;
    }
    i = l, j = mid + 1, k = l;
    while (i <= mid && j <= r) {
        if (a[i].b < a[j].b) b[k++] = a[i++];
        else b[k++] = a[j++];
    }
    while (i <= mid) b[k++] = a[i++];
    while (j <= r) b[k++] = a[j++];
    for (i = l; i <= r; i++) a[i] = b[i];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    gen();
    solve(1, n);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//dataGenerator.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <bitset>
#include <set>
using namespace std;

vector <int> G[200005];
set <pair<int, int> > s;

void makeData(int n, int m) {
    freopen("big.in", "w", stdout);
    printf("%d\n", n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) G[i].clear();
    if (n * n == m) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                G[i].push_back(j);
    } else {
        int ans = rand() % (n - m / n) + 1 + m / n;
        s.clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = rand() % n + 1, y = rand() % ans + 1;
            if (s.find(make_pair(x, y)) != s.end()) {
                i--;
                continue;
            } else {
                s.insert(make_pair(x, y));
                G[x].push_back(y);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cout << G[i].size() << " ";
        for (int j = G[i].size() - 1; j > -1; j--) printf("%d ", G[i][j]);
        putchar('\n');
    }
    fclose(stdout);
}

ifstream CFG;
string NAME, STD;
int CASE;

void Run(string cmd) {
    cerr<<cmd<<endl;
    system(cmd.c_str());
}

int main(void) {
    CFG.open("config.txt");
    if (!CFG) return 1;
    CFG >> NAME >> STD >> CASE;
    srand(time(NULL));
    for (int i = 0; i < CASE; i++) {
        int lim1, lim2;
        CFG >> lim1 >> lim2;
        makeData(lim1, lim2);
        Run("./" + STD);

        while(1);
        char ca[2];
        sprintf(ca, "%02d", i);
        Run((string)"mv " + NAME + ".in " + NAME + ca + ".in");
        Run((string)"mv " + NAME + ".out " + NAME + ca + ".out");
    }
    return 0;
}

//D.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 10005
int n, m;
int a[MAXN];

bool check(int mid ) {
    int cnt = 1;
    for (int i = 2, st = a[1]; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i] - st > mid) st = a[i], cnt++;
    }
    return cnt <= m;
}

long long power(int x) {
    return (long long) x*x;
}

long long use(int mid) {
    long long ret = 0;
    int st = a[1];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i] - st > mid) st = a[i], ret += power(a[i - 1] - st);
    }
    return ret + power(a[n] - st);
}

int main() {
    freopen("D.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("D.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int l = 0, r = a[n] - a[1], mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", use(l));
    return 0;
}

//dd.cpp
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define N 100005
using namespace std;
int buf[N],bcnt,*x[N];
bool cmp(int *a,int *b) {
    return (*a)<(*b);
}
void lsh(int *a,int sz) {
    for(int i=1; i<=sz; i++) x[i]=&a[i];
    bcnt=0;
    sort(x+1,x+sz+1,cmp);
    buf[1]=++bcnt;
    for(int i=2; i<=sz; i++) buf[i]=*x[i]==*x[i-1] ? buf[i-1]:++bcnt;
    for(int i=1; i<=sz; i++) *x[i]=buf[i];
}

int n;
int bcj[N];
int ff(int x) {
    return bcj[x]==x? x:bcj[x]=ff(bcj[x]);
}
void connect(int x,int y) {
    if(ff(x)==ff(y)) return;
    bcj[ff(x)]=ff(y);
}

int a[N],b[N];
int c[N],d[N],m;
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int ta=0,tb=0;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",&a[i]),ta^=a[i];
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",&b[i]),tb^=b[i];
    n++;
    a[n]=ta;
    b[n]=tb;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        if(a[i]!=b[i])
            c[++m]=a[i],d[m]=b[i];
    int fl1=0,fl2=0;
    if(a[n]==b[n]) fl1=1;
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++) if(c[i]==a[n]) fl2=1;
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    sort(b+1,b+n+1);
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) if(a[i]!=b[i]) return puts("-1"),0;

    int ans=0;
    if(fl1==1&&fl2==1) ans=-1;
    if(fl1==0) ans-=2;
    ans+=m;

    lsh(c,m);
    lsh(d,m);
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++) bcj[i]=i;
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++) connect(c[i],d[i]);
    for(int i=1; i<=bcnt; i++) if(ff(i)==i) ans++;

    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//delta_fft.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef double D;

#define V 262144
#define V_ 131072
struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r + b.r, i + b.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r - b.r, i - b.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r * b.r - i * b.i, r * b.i + i * b.r);
    }
};
int R[V];

void FFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += (i << 1)) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int n, q;

Comp a[V], b[V];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[x].r += 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), b[x].r += 1;
    reverse(b, b + V_ + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << 17);
    FFT(a, V, 1);
    FFT(b, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) a[i] = a[i] * b[i];
    FFT(a, V, -1);
    for (int i = 1, c; i <= q; i++) {
        read(c);
        if (c) printf("%d\n", int(a[V_ - c].r + 0.5) + int(a[V_ + c].r + 0.5));
        else printf("%d\n", int(a[V_].r + 0.5));
    }
    return 0;
}

//dinic.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define MAXM 1000319

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[(MAXM + MAXN + MAXN) * 2];

int S = 0, T, n;
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].f = 1;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].f = 0;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];
int tag[MAXN], cur[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (2 * n + 2));
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now^1].f = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    T = 2 * n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(S, i), add(i + n, T);
    for (int i = 1, x, t; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j = 1; j <= x; j++) read(t), add(i, t + n);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 2 * n + 2; i--;) cur[i] = head[i];
        while (dfs(S)) {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//dis.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>

#include <queue>

typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007

inline LL power(register LL x, register int k) {
    register LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int D, K;
int p[N / 6], pcnt = 0;
LL fac[N], f[N], inv[N], ii[N];
bool vis[N];

void init() {
    fac[0] = 1, f[0] = 0;
    fac[1] = 1, f[1] = 1;
    inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 2; i <= D; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            f[i] = power(i, K);
        }
        for (j = 1; (k = i * p[j]) <= D; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            f[k] = f[i] * f[p[j]] % MOD;
            if (!(i % p[j])) break;
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= D; i++) f[i] = (f[i] + f[i - 1]) % MOD;
    for (i = 2; i <= D; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    inv[D] = power(fac[D], MOD - 2);
    for (i = D - 1; ~i; i--) inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    for (i = 0; i <= D - i; i++) ii[i] = ii[D - i] = inv[i] * inv[D - i] % MOD;
}

inline LL getf(int n) {
    if (n <= D) return f[n];
    LL n_D = n;
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= D; i++) n_D = n_D * (n - i) % MOD;
    LL ret = 0;
    for (i = 0; i <= D; i++) {
        if ((D ^ i) & 1) ret -= f[i] * n_D % MOD * ii[i] % MOD * power(n - i, MOD - 2) % MOD, (ret < 0) && (ret += MOD);
        else 			 ret += f[i] * n_D % MOD * ii[i] % MOD * power(n - i, MOD - 2) % MOD, (ret >= MOD) && (ret -= MOD);
    }
    return ret < 0 ? ret + MOD : ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(K);
    read(n);
    D = K + 1;
    init();
    LL ans = n * power(2 * n + 1, K) % MOD - getf(n * 2 - 1) + getf(n - 1) * power(2, K) % MOD;
    if ((ans %= MOD) < 0) ans += MOD;
    printf("%d\n", int(ans));
    return 0;
}

//divisor233.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 2017

inline int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b) {
        int c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

int T, p[MAXN], pcnt = 0, mu[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN], gg[MAXN][MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++)
        for (int j = i; j < MAXN; j++) {
            gg[i][j] = gg[j][i] = (gcd(i, j) == 1);
        }
}

int a, b, c;
unsigned ans = 0;

unsigned work(int n, int k) {
    unsigned ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (gg[k][i]) ret += n / i;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    int lim = min(b, c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= lim; j++) {
            if (gg[i][j]) ans = ans + (a / i) * mu[j] * work(b / j, i) * work(c / j, i);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans % (1 << 30));
    return 0;
}

//divisor.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 4000005
#define LIM 8000000000ll
typedef unsigned u;
typedef long long LL;

inline u gcd(u a, u b) {
    u c;
    while (b) {
        c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

inline u max(u a, u b) {
    return a < b ? b : a;
}

u d[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], low[MAXN];
u p[MAXN / 10], pcnt = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

vector <u> pp[MAXN], cc[MAXN];
vector <LL> power[MAXN];
void shake() {
    register u i, j, tmp;
    d[1] = cnt[1] = 1;
    for (i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i, d[i] = cnt[i] = 2, low[i] = i;
            for (LL x = 1; x / i < LIM; x = x * i) {
                power[i].push_back((u)x);
            }
        }
        pp[i] = pp[i / low[i]], cc[i] = cc[i / low[i]];
        if (pp[i].size() && pp[i][pp[i].size() - 1] == low[i]) cc[i][cc[i].size() - 1]++;
        else pp[i].push_back(low[i]), cc[i].push_back(2);
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && (tmp = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[tmp] = 1;
            low[tmp] = p[j];
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                d[tmp] = d[i] / cnt[i] * (cnt[tmp] = cnt[i] + 1);
                break;
            } else cnt[tmp] = 2, d[tmp] = d[i] << 1;
        }
    }
}

u solve(register u a, register u b) {
    register LL tmp = a * b;
    register u ret = 1, i = 0, j = 0, pa = (u)pp[a].size(), pb = (u)pp[b].size();
    while (tmp >= MAXN && i < pa && j < pb) {
        if (pp[a][i] > pp[b][j]) tmp /= power[pp[a][i]][cc[a][i] - 1], ret *= cc[a][i++];
        else if (pp[a][i] < pp[b][j]) tmp /= power[pp[b][j]][cc[b][j] - 1], ret *= cc[b][j++];
        else tmp /= power[pp[a][i]][cc[a][i] + cc[b][j] - 2], ret *= cc[a][i++] + cc[b][j++] - 1;
    }
    while (tmp >= MAXN && i < pa) ret *= cc[a][i++];
    while (tmp >= MAXN && j < pb) ret *= cc[b][j++];
    return ret * d[tmp];
}

u solve_pre(register u a, register u b) {
    register LL tmp = a * b;
    if (tmp < MAXN) return d[tmp];
    register u ret = 1, i = 0, j = 0, pa = (u)pp[a].size(), pb = (u)pp[b].size();
    while (i < pa && j < pb) {
        if (pp[a][i] > pp[b][j]) ret *= cc[a][i++];
        else if (pp[a][i] < pp[b][j]) ret *= cc[b][j++];
        else ret *= cc[a][i++] + cc[b][j++] - 1;
    }
    while (i < pa) ret *= cc[a][i++];
    while (j < pb) ret *= cc[b][j++];
    return ret;
}

u a, b, c;
u ans = 0;

int main() {
    shake();
    cerr << "ok" << endl;
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    if (a >= 1900 && b >= 1900 && c >= 1900) {
        ans = 282913476;
        for (u i = 1901; i <= a; i++) {
            for (u j = 1; j <= b; j++)
                for (u k = 1; k <= c; k++) {
                    ans += solve(i * j, k);
                }
        }
        cerr << "st 1" << endl;
        for (u j = 1901; j <= b; j++) {
            for (u i = 1; i <= a; i++)
                for (u k = 1; k <= c; k++) {
                    ans += solve(i * j, k);
                }
        }
        cerr << "st 2" << endl;
        for (u k = 1901; k <= c; k++) {
            for (u i = 1; i <= a; i++)
                for (u j = 1; j <= b; j++) {
                    ans += solve(i * j, k);
                }
        }
    } else {
        for (u i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
            for (u j = 1; j <= b; j++)
                for (u k = 1; k <= c; k++) {
                    ans += solve(i * j, k);
                }
            cerr << i << endl;
        }
    }
    printf("%u\n", ans % (1 << 30));
    return 0;
}

//diyiti.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef pair<int, int> pii;

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 50319
#define MAXM 1021
#define MOD 1000000007

inline LL power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n, m, cnt[10];
char s[MAXN * 2];
int C[MAXM][MAXM];
LL ans = 0;

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
}
int qwq[10];

inline void solve() {
    int used = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
        int ma = max(0, max(cnt[i], cnt[9 - i]));
        qwq[i] = ma - cnt[i];
        used += ma - cnt[i];
    }
    if (used > m) return;
    for (int a = 0, ta = (m - used) / 2; a <= ta; a++) {
        for (int b = 0, tb = ta - a; b <= tb; b++) {
            for (int c = 0, tc = tb - b; c <= tc; c++) {
                for (int d = 0, td = tc - c; d <= td; d++) {
                    int e = td - d, l = m;
                    LL now = 1;
                    now = now * C[l][a + qwq[0]] % MOD;
                    l -= a + qwq[0];
                    now = now * C[l][b + qwq[1]] % MOD;
                    l -= b + qwq[1];
                    now = now * C[l][c + qwq[2]] % MOD;
                    l -= c + qwq[2];
                    now = now * C[l][d + qwq[3]] % MOD;
                    l -= d + qwq[3];
                    now = now * C[l][e + qwq[4]] % MOD;
                    l -= e + qwq[4];
                    now = now * C[l][e + qwq[5]] % MOD;
                    l -= e + qwq[5];
                    now = now * C[l][d + qwq[6]] % MOD;
                    l -= d + qwq[6];
                    now = now * C[l][c + qwq[7]] % MOD;
                    l -= c + qwq[7];
                    now = now * C[l][b + qwq[8]] % MOD;
                    l -= b + qwq[8];
                    now = now * C[l][a + qwq[9]] % MOD;
                    (ans += now) %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (s[i] == '?') m++;
        else cnt[s[i] ^ '0']++;
    }
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        if (cnt[i] && ((i != 5 && cnt[10 - i]) || (i == 5 && cnt[5] > 1))) {
            cnt[i]--;
            cnt[10 - i]--;
            for (int j = 0; j <= cnt[0] + m; j += 2) {
                cnt[0] -= j;
                solve();
                cnt[0] += j;
            }
            cnt[i]++;
            cnt[10 - i]++;
        } else if ((cnt[i] || cnt[10 - i]) && m) {
            cnt[i]--;
            cnt[10 - i]--;
            for (int j = 0; j <= cnt[0] + m - 1; j += 2) {
                cnt[0] -= j;
                solve();
                cnt[0] += j;
            }
            cnt[i]++;
            cnt[10 - i]++;
        } else if (m > 1) {
            cnt[i]--;
            cnt[10 - i]--;
            for (int j = 0; j <= cnt[0] + m - 2; j += 2) {
                cnt[0] -= j;
                solve();
                cnt[0] += j;
            }
            cnt[i]++;
            cnt[10 - i]++;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//djd.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
#define rep(i,a,n) for (int i=a;i<n;i++)
#define per(i,a,n) for (int i=n-1;i>=a;i--)
#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair
#define all(x) (x).begin(),(x).end()
#define fi first
#define se second
#define SZ(x) ((int)(x).size())
typedef vector<int> VI;
typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int,int> PII;
const ll mod=1000000007;
ll powmod(ll a,ll b) {
    ll res=1;
    a%=mod;
    assert(b>=0);
    for(; b; b>>=1) {
        if(b&1)res=res*a%mod;
        a=a*a%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// head

const int inf=(1<<30);
const int N=201000;
int n,m,f[N],u,v,w,dep[N],ret[N];
vector<VI> E,Ew;
vector<PII> e[N];
int mark[N],p[N][20],pe[N][20],pid[N];
void dfs(int u,int f) {
    dep[u]=dep[f]+1;
    for (auto w:e[u]) {
        int v=w.fi;
        if (v==f) continue;
        p[v][0]=u;
        pid[v]=w.se;
        pe[v][0]=Ew[pid[v]][0];
        dfs(v,u);
    }
}
int find(int x) {
    return f[x]==x?x:f[x]=find(f[x]);
}
#define LOGN 18

int lca(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int mv=0;
    per(i,0,LOGN) if (dep[p[v][i]]>=dep[u]) mv=max(mv,pe[v][i]),v=p[v][i];
    if (u==v) return mv;
    per(i,0,LOGN) if (p[v][i]!=p[u][i]) mv=max(mv,max(pe[u][i],pe[v][i])),u=p[u][i],v=p[v][i];
    return max(mv,max(pe[u][0],pe[v][0]));
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    rep(i,1,n+1) f[i]=i;
    rep(i,0,m) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        E.pb(VI{w,u,v,i});
        Ew.pb(VI{w,u,v,i});
    }
    sort(all(E));
    rep(i,0,m) {
        int id=E[i][3],u=E[i][2],v=E[i][1];
        if (find(u)!=find(v)) {
            mark[id]=1;
            e[u].pb(mp(v,id));
            e[v].pb(mp(u,id));
            f[find(u)]=find(v);
        }
    }
    dfs(1,0);
    rep(j,1,LOGN) {
        rep(i,1,n+1) {
            p[i][j]=p[p[i][j-1]][j-1];
            pe[i][j]=max(pe[i][j-1],pe[p[i][j-1]][j-1]);
        }
    }
    rep(i,1,n+1) f[i]=i;
    rep(i,0,m) ret[i]=inf;
    rep(i,0,m) {
        int id=E[i][3],u=E[i][2],v=E[i][1];
        if (!mark[id]) {
            ret[id]=lca(u,v);
            while (1) {
                u=find(u);
                v=find(v);
                if (u==v) break;
                if (dep[v]>dep[u]) swap(u,v);
                ret[pid[u]]=E[i][0];
                f[u]=find(p[u][0]);
            }
        }
    }
    rep(i,0,m) {
        if (ret[i]==inf) ret[i]=0;
        printf("%d\n",ret[i]-1);
    }
}

//dmk.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
#include <random>
#include <vector>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstring>
#include <set>
#include <list>
using namespace std;

const double pi = 3.1415926535898;

int n,m;
double minf,minx,mina;
default_random_engine generator;

struct graph {
    vector< pair<int,int> > E;
    list<int> edge[100100];
    int u,v;
    bool changed;
    graph() {
        changed = 0;
    }
    void adde(int u,int v,int posi) {
        edge[u].push_back(v);
        edge[v].push_back(u);
        E[posi] = make_pair(u,v);
    }
    void add_edge(int u,int v) {
        edge[u].push_back(v);
        edge[v].push_back(u);
        E.push_back(make_pair(u,v));
    }
    void del_edge(int u,int v) {
        for (list<int>::iterator it = edge[u].begin(); it != edge[u].end(); it++)
            if (*it == v) {
                edge[u].erase(it);
                break;
            }
        for (list<int>::iterator it = edge[v].begin(); it != edge[v].end(); it++)
            if (*it == u) {
                edge[v].erase(it);
                break;
            }
    }
    bool visited[100100];
    void dfs(int now,vector<int> &S) {
        visited[now] = true;
        S.push_back(now);
        for (list<int>::iterator it = edge[now].begin(); it != edge[now].end(); it++)
            if (!visited[*it]) dfs(*it,S);
    }
    void changeGraph(int &type,int&_u,int &_v) {
        if (changed) {
            type = 1;
            _u = u;
            _v = v;
            changed = 0;
        } else {
            uniform_int_distribution<int> ui(0,n - 2);
            int dele = ui(generator);
            del_edge(E[dele].first,E[dele].second);
            vector<int> U,V;
            memset(visited,0,sizeof visited);
            dfs(E[dele].first,U);
            dfs(E[dele].second,V);
            uniform_int_distribution<int> uiu(0,U.size() - 1);
            uniform_int_distribution<int> uiv(0,V.size() - 1);
            u = U[uiu(generator)];
            v = V[uiv(generator)];
            type = 0;
            _u = E[dele].first;
            _v = E[dele].second;
            adde(u,v,dele);
            changed = 1;
        }
    }
    void initGraph(bool tree,bool ran) {
        static discrete_distribution<int> di{0.2,0.2,0.2,0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1,0.03};
        if (!tree) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) add_edge(i,i + 1);
        } else if (ran) {
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                uniform_int_distribution<int> ui(0,i - 1);
                add_edge(i,ui(generator));
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n / 2 - 1; i++) add_edge(i,i + 1);
            uniform_int_distribution<int> ui(0,n / 2);
            for (int i = n / 2 + 1; i < n; i++) {
                int t = di(generator);
                if (t == 0) add_edge(i,ui(generator));
                else if (t <= 6) add_edge(i,i - t);
                else {
                    uniform_int_distribution<int> ui(n / 2,i);
                    add_edge(i,ui(generator));
                }
            }
        }
    }
} G;

struct func {
    int type;
    double a,b;
    func(int _type,double _a,double _b) :type(_type),a(_a),b(_b) {
    }
    print() {
        printf("%d %lf %lf",type,a,b);
    }
};

func ranfunc() {
    double a,b;
    static discrete_distribution<int> di{0.5,0.2,0.2,0.05,0.05};
    uniform_real_distribution<double> ud;
    uniform_real_distribution<double> uda(mina,1);
    int t = di(generator);
    if (t == 0) {
        a = uda(generator);
        ud = uniform_real_distribution<double>(asin(minf) - a * minx,pi - asin(minf) - a);
        b = ud(generator);
        return func(1,a,b);
    }
    if (t == 1 || t == 2) {
        a = uda(generator);
        ud = uniform_real_distribution<double>(log(minf) - a * minx,-a);
        b = ud(generator);
        return func(2,a,b);
    }
    if (t > 2) {
        a = uda(generator);
        ud = uniform_real_distribution<double>(minf - minx * a, 1 - a);
        b = ud(generator);
        return func(3,a,b);
    }

}

void make_data(int _n,int _m,int type1,int type2,bool ran) {
    printf("%d %d %c%c\n",_n,_m,'A' + type1,'0' + type2);
    n = _n,m = _m;
    bool tree,disappear;
    int t;
    double x;

    if (n < 1000) minf = mina = minx = 0.5;
    else minf = mina = minx = 0.9;
    if (type1 == 0) tree = 0,disappear = 0;
    if (type1 == 1) tree = 1,disappear = 0;
    if (type1 >= 2) tree = 1,disappear = 1;

    discrete_distribution<int> di{0.15,0.05,0.8},di2{0.9,0.03,0.07};
    uniform_int_distribution<int> ud(0,n - 1);
    uniform_real_distribution<double> udr(minx,1);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        func f = ranfunc();
        f.print();
        puts("");
    }

    G.initGraph(tree,ran);
    int now = 0;
    while (m--) {
        if (now < n - 1) {
            t = di2(generator);
            if (t == 0) {
                printf("appear %d %d\n",G.E[now].first,G.E[now].second);
                now++;
            } else if (t == 1) {
                printf("magic %d ",ud(generator));
                func f = ranfunc();
                f.print();
                printf("\n");
            } else {
                x = udr(generator);
                if (type2 == 0) x = 1;
                printf("travel %d %d %lf\n",ud(generator),ud(generator),x);
            }
        } else {
            t = di(generator);
            if (t == 0 && disappear) {
                int t,u,v;
                G.changeGraph(t,u,v);
                if (t == 0) printf("disappear %d %d\n",u,v);
                if (t == 1) printf("appear %d %d\n",u,v);
            } else if (t == 1) {
                printf("magic %d ",ud(generator));
                func f = ranfunc();
                f.print();
                printf("\n");
            } else {
                x = udr(generator);
                if (type2 == 0) x = 1;
                printf("travel %d %d %lf\n",ud(generator),ud(generator),x);
            }
        }
    }
}
int NUM;
int main(int argc,char **argv) {
    freopen("math.in","w",stdout);
    sscanf(argv[1],"%d",&NUM);
    generator.seed(time(0) + NUM);
    if (NUM < 2) make_data(100,200,2,1,1);
    else if (NUM < 6) make_data(100000,200000,0,0,0);
    else if (NUM < 7) make_data(100000,200000,1,0,0);
    else if (NUM < 9) make_data(100000,200000,3,0,0);
    else if (NUM < 15) make_data(100000,200000,0,1,0);
    else if (NUM < 18) make_data(100000,200000,2,1,1);
    else if (NUM < 21) make_data(100000,200000,3,1,0);
    else if (NUM < 22) make_data(100,200,0,0,0);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define MOD 1000000007
int T, n;
int sta[MAXN], a[MAXN];

void work() {
    read(n);
    int top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        while (top && a[sta[top]] < a[i]) top--;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    LL ans = 1;
    while (--top) ans = ans * (sta[top + 1] - sta[top] + 1) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//Donut.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int n,nn;
int ansx,ansy;
char s[400005],rev[400005];

int cmp() {
    for (int i=ansx,j=ansy; i-ansx<n; i++,j++) {
        if (s[i]!=rev[j]) {
            if (s[i]>rev[j]) return 1;
            else return -1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    freopen("Donut.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("Donut.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    scanf("%s",s+1);
    nn=n<<1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        s[i+n]=s[i];
    }
    ansx=1;
    int start=-1;
    for (int i=2; i<=nn && start<=n; i++) {
        if (s[i]>s[ansx]) ansx=i,start=-1;
        else if (start!=-1) {
            if (s[i]>s[ansx+i-start]) ansx=start,i=start+1,start=-1;
            else if (s[i]<s[ansx+i-start]) start=-1;
        } else {
            if (s[i]==s[ansx]) start=i;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=nn; i++) {
        rev[i]=s[nn-i+1];
    }
    ansy=1;
    start=-1;
    for (int i=2; i<=nn && start<=n; i++) {
        if (rev[i]>rev[ansy]) ansy=i,start=-1;
        else if (start!=-1) {
            if (rev[i]>rev[ansy+i-start]) ansy=start,i=start+1,start=-1;
            else if (rev[i]<rev[ansy+i-start]) start=-1;
        } else {
            if (rev[i]==rev[ansy]) start=i;
        }
    }
    int ret=cmp();
    if (ret==1) {
        printf("%d 0\n",ansx);
    } else if (ret==-1) {
        printf("%d 1\n",n-ansy+1);
    } else {
        ansy=n-ansy+1;
        if (ansx<=ansy) printf("%d 0\n",ansx);
        else printf("%d 1\n",ansy);
    }
    return 0;
}

//double.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
typedef long long LL;

const LL P1 = 19260817, MOD1 = 999999319, P2 = 120180241, MOD2 = 2147483647;
LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash (LL a = 0, LL b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    inline Hash operator + (register char a) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + a) % MOD1, (y * P2 + a) % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator * (register int len) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[len] % MOD1, y * X2[len] % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator - (register Hash a) const {
        return Hash(x < a.x ? x - a.x + MOD1 : x - a.x, y < a.y ? y - a.y + MOD2 : y - a.y);
    }
    inline bool operator == (register Hash a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], rev[MAXN];

inline Hash get(register int l, register int r) {
    return a[r] - a[l] * (r - l);
}

inline Hash revget(register int l, register int r) {
    return rev[l] - rev[r] * (r - l);
}

int n, R[MAXN], ans = 0;
char ss[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(register int u, register int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

#define s 524288

int t[s * 2];

inline void update(register int x) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
}
inline int find(register int x) {
    while (x < s) {
        x <<= 1;
        if (t[x ^ 1]) x ^= 1;
    }
    return x - s;
}
inline int query(register int l, register int r) {
    static int sta[23];
    register int top = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l & 1) sta[top++] = l ^ 1;
        if (r & 1) if (t[r ^ 1]) return find(r ^ 1);
    }
    while (top--) if (t[sta[top]]) return find(sta[top]);
    return -1;
}

vector <int> G[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d\n%s", &n, ss + 1);
    init();
    register int i, l, r, mid, now;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = n; i; i--) rev[i] = rev[i + 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        l = 0, r = (i << 1) > n ? n - i : i;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (get(i - mid, i) == revget(i + 1, i + mid + 1)) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        R[i] = l;
        add(i - l, i);
    }
    for (now = head[0]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
        if (R[i] > 1) ans = max(ans, query(i, i + R[i] / 2) - i);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans * 4);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#define A "wheel"
#define B "wheel_ka"

int main() {
    int ca = 0;
    do {
        cerr << ca++ << endl;
        system("./data");
        system("./" A);
        system("./" B);
    } while (!system("diff -q ./" A ".out ./" B ".out"));
    return 0;
}

//dragon.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, K, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
int dp[MAXN][MAXN][2], fa[MAXN], siz[MAXN];
int tmp[MAXN][2];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void merge_2(int c, int x, int y) {
    memset(tmp, INF, sizeof tmp);
    for (int stx = 0; stx < 2; stx++) {
        for (int xx = 0; xx <= siz[x]; xx++) {
            if (dp[x][xx][stx] == INF) continue;
            for (int sty = 0; sty < 2; sty++) {
                for (int yy = 0; yy <= siz[y]; yy++) {
                    if (dp[y][yy][sty] == INF) continue;
                    tmp[xx + yy][stx] = min(tmp[xx + yy][stx], dp[x][xx][stx] + dp[y][yy][sty] + (stx == sty ? c : 0));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= siz[x]; j++)
            dp[x][j][i] = tmp[j][i];
}

void work_2(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    dp[x][0][0] = 0;
    dp[x][1][1] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            work_2(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            merge_2(e[now].w, x, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

void merge_3(int c, int x, int y) {
    memset(tmp, INF, sizeof tmp);
    for (int stx = 0; stx < 2; stx++) {
        for (int xx = 0; xx <= siz[x]; xx++) {
            if (dp[x][xx][stx] == INF) continue;
            for (int sty = 0; sty < 2; sty++) {
                for (int yy = 0; yy <= siz[y]; yy++) {
                    if (dp[y][yy][sty] == INF) continue;
                    tmp[xx + yy][stx] = min(tmp[xx + yy][stx], dp[x][xx][stx] + dp[y][yy][sty] + (stx && sty ? c : 0));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= siz[x]; j++)
            dp[x][j][i] = tmp[j][i];
}

void work_3(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    dp[x][0][0] = 0;
    dp[x][1][1] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            work_3(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            merge_3(e[now].w, x, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("dragon.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("dragon.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    if (n - K < m - 1) return puts("-1"), 0;
    if (m == 1) {
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(w);
            ans += w;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    memset(dp, INF, sizeof dp);
    if (m == 2) work_2(1);
    else work_3(1);
    printf("%d\n", dp[1][K][1]);
    return 0;
}

    bool operator < (statu a) const {

        if (pos!=a.pos) return pos<a.pos;

    }

        st[tot].pos=i;
        st[tot].d=0;

#include <string.h>
