int mn[MAXN][20],mx[MAXN][20],a[MAXN],f[MAXN],n,s,L;
int query(int l,int r) {
    int k=0;
    while ((1<<(k+1))<=r-l+1)
        k++;
    return max(mx[l][k],mx[r-(1<<k)+1][k])-min(mn[l][k],mn[r-(1<<k)+1][k]);
}
int main() {
    scanf ("%d %d %d",&n,&s,&L);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf ("%d",mn[i]+0);
        mx[i][0]=mn[i][0];
    }
    for(int j=1; (1<<j)<=n; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i+(1<<j)-1<=n; i++) {
            //RMQ
            mn[i][j]=min(mn[i][j-1],mn[i+(1<<(j-1))][j-1]);
            mx[i][j]=max(mx[i][j-1],mx[i+(1<<(j-1))][j-1]);
        }
    }
    fill_n(f,n+1,inf);
    int mv=f[0]=0;
    for (int i=L; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("At %d\n",i);
        while(i-mv>=L &&(query(mv+1,i)>s||f[mv]==inf)) {
            mv++;
            printf("mv\n");
        }
        if(i-mv>=L) {
            f[i]=min(f[i],f[mv]+1);
            printf("get %d\n",f[i]);
        }
    }
    if (f[n]==inf)
        f[n]=-1;
    printf("%d\n",f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//Eac.cpp
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define max4 10004
#define maxx 100005
#define max6 1000006
#define oo 2000000000
#define mod 1000000007
#define lg4 14
#define lg5 17
#define lg6 20
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define piii pair<pii,pii>
#define pli pair<ll,int>
#define pll pair<ll,ll>
#define pid pair<int, double>
#define plll pair<ll,pll>
#define f first
#define s second
#define in(x) scanf("%d",&x)
#define IN(x) scanf("%I64d",&x)
#define inch(x) scanf("%s",x)
#define indo(x) scanf("%lf",&x)
#define outn(x) printf("%d\n",x)
#define OUTN(x) printf("%I64d\n",x)
#define out(x) printf("%d ",x)
#define OUT(x) printf("%I64d ",x)
#define pb push_back

typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef long double ld;

using namespace std;

int n, l, S;
int arr[maxx];
int st[2][maxx][lg5];
int dp[maxx];
pii border[maxx];
priority_queue<pii, vector<pii>, greater<pii> > pq;

void build_sparse_min() {
    for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        st[0][i][0] = i;
    for(int j = 1; (1 << j) <= n; j++) {
        for(int i = 1; i + (1 << j) - 1 <= n; i++) {
            if(arr[st[0][i][j - 1]] < arr[st[0][i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]]) {
                st[0][i][j] = st[0][i][j - 1];
            } else {
                st[0][i][j] = st[0][i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1];
            }
        }
    }
}

void build_sparse_max() {
    for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        st[1][i][0] = i;
    for(int j = 1; (1 << j) <= n; j++) {
        for(int i = 1; i + (1 << j) - 1 <= n; i++) {
            if(arr[st[1][i][j - 1]] > arr[st[1][i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]]) {
                st[1][i][j] = st[1][i][j - 1];
            } else {
                st[1][i][j] = st[1][i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1];
            }
        }
    }
}

int get(int l, int r) {
    int sz = r - l + 1;
    for(int j = lg5; j >= 0; j--) {
        if(sz & (1 << j)) {
            return max(arr[st[1][l][j]], arr[st[1][r - (1 << j) + 1][j]]) - min(arr[st[0][l][j]], arr[st[0][r - (1 << j) + 1][j]]);
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    in(n);
    in(S);
    in(l);
    for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        in(arr[i]);
    }
    build_sparse_min();
    build_sparse_max();

    for(int i = 1; i < l; i++) {
        border[i].f = border[i].s = -1;
    }
    for(int i = l; i <= n; i++) {
        border[i].s = i - l + 1;
        if(get(i - l + 1, i) > S) {
            border[i].f = border[i].s = -1;
        }
    }
    int ptr1 = 1, ptr2 = l;
    while(ptr2 <= n) {
        while(get(ptr1, ptr2) > S) {
            ptr1++;
        }
        if(border[ptr2].s != -1) {
            border[ptr2].f = ptr1;
        }
        ptr2++;
    }

    for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i] = oo;
    }

    int ptr = 0;
    for(int i = l; i <= n; i++) {
        if(border[i].f == -1)
            continue;
        while(ptr < border[i].f - 1)
            ptr++;
        while(ptr < border[i].s) {
            pq.push({dp[ptr], ptr});
            ptr++;
        }
        while((pq.top()).s < border[i].f - 1)
            pq.pop();
        dp[i] = (pq.top()).f + 1;
    }
    if(dp[n] >= oo) {
        dp[n] = -1;
    }
    outn(dp[n]);
    return 0;
}

//E.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

#define N 1048576

struct cp {
    double r, i;
    cp () {}
    cp (double x, double y) : r(x), i(y) {}
    cp operator + (const cp a) {
        return cp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    cp operator - (const cp a) {
        return cp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    cp operator * (const cp a) {
        return cp(r * a.r - i * a.i, i * a.r + r * a.i);
    }
};

int n, m, R[N], ret[N], ans[N];

void gr() {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void fft(cp a[], int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R[i] < i) swap(a[R[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        cp stp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            cp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * stp) {
                cp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev < 0) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i] = int(a[i].r / n + 0.5);
        }
}

cp a[N], b[N];
char s[N / 2];

void solve() {
    read(m);
    scanf("%s", s);
    for (int i = m; i < n; i++) a[i] = b[i] = cp(0, 0);
    for (n = 2; n < m; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 1;
    gr();
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) a[i] = cp(s[i] == 'V', 0), b[i] = cp(s[m - i - 1] == 'K', 0);
    fft(a, 1);
    fft(b, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = a[i] * b[i];
    fft(a, -1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans[abs(i - m + 1)] |= ret[i];
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= m; j += i) ans[i] |= ans[j];
        cnt += !ans[i];
    }
    printf("%d\n", cnt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!ans[i]) printf("%d ", i);
    putchar('\n');
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) solve();
    return 0;
}

//energy.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1000005

typedef unsigned long long LL;

const LL mod = 2147483647;
const LL P1 = 19260817, P2 = 9699689;
LL m1[MAXN], m2[MAXN];

int n, m;
char s[MAXN];
int sum[MAXN];

struct Ha {
    LL a, b;
    void extend(Ha &x, int v) {
        a = x.a * P1 + v;
        b = (x.b * P2 + v) % mod;
    }
    bool operator == (Ha x) const {
        return a == x.a && b == x.b;
    }
} ha[MAXN];

Ha get(int st, int ed) {
    Ha ret = ha[ed];
    ret.a -= ha[st].a * m1[ed - st];
    ret.b = (ret.b - ((ha[st].b * m2[ed - st]) % mod) + mod) % mod;
    return ret;
}

pair<int, int> check(int x) {
    int p = int(lower_bound(sum + 1, sum + n + 1, x) - sum);
    if (sum[p] == x) return make_pair(1, p);
    int l = p + 1, r = n + 1;
    Ha hh = get(0, p);
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (get(mid - p, mid) == hh) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid;
    }
    if (l == n + 1) return make_pair(0, 0);
    int st = l - p, ed = l;
    if (sum[ed] - sum[st] == x) return make_pair(st + 1, ed);
    if (sum[ed] - sum[st + 1] == x) return make_pair(st + 2, ed);
    if (sum[ed - 1] - sum[st] == x) return make_pair(st + 1, ed - 1);
    if (ed < n) {
        if (sum[ed + 1] - sum[st] == x) return make_pair(st + 1, ed + 1);
        if (sum[ed + 1] - sum[st + 1] == x) return make_pair(st + 2, ed + 1);
    }
    if (st > 0) {
        if (sum[ed] - sum[st - 1] == x) return make_pair(st, ed);
        if (sum[ed - 1] - sum[st - 1] == x) return make_pair(st, ed - 1);
    }
    if (st > 0 && ed < n && sum[ed + 1] - sum[st - 1] == x) return make_pair(st, ed + 1);
    return make_pair(0, 0);
}

int main() {
    freopen("energy.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("energy.out", "w", stdout);
    m1[0] = m2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) m1[i] = m1[i - 1] * P1, m2[i] = (m2[i - 1] * P2) % mod;
    scanf("%d%d%s", &n, &m, s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i] -= '0', sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + s[i], ha[i].extend(ha[i - 1], s[i]);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &x);
        if (x < 1 || x > sum[n]) puts("0 0");
        else {
            pair <int, int> ret = check(x);
            printf("%d %d\n", ret.first, ret.second);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    freopen("escape" PRID ".in","r",stdin);
    freopen("escape" PRID ".ans","w",stdout);
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&q);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        if (map[u][v]>w) {
            map[u][v]=map[v][u]=w;
        }
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=n; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
                if (map[i][k]+map[k][j]<map[i][j])
                    map[i][j]=map[i][k]+map[k][j];
            }
    for (int i=1,s,t; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&s,&t);
        if (s<=n && s>=1 && t<=n && t>=1 && map[s][t]<INF)
            printf("%lld\n",map[s][t]);
        else
            puts("WTF");
    }

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

//excellent.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 30005
using namespace std;

const unsigned long long P[5]= {120180241,319,83,89,97};
int len;
char s[MAXN];
unsigned long long h[5][MAXN],m[5][MAXN],ss[MAXN],ans=0;
inline void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        h[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=len; j++) {
            h[i][j]=h[i][j-1]*P[i]+s[j];
        }
    }
}

inline void pinit() {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        m[i][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=30001; j++) {
            m[i][j]=m[i][j-1]*P[i];
        }
    }
    ss[0]=ss[1]=0;
    for (int i=0,cnt=2,sum=0; cnt<30001; i++,sum+=i,cnt+=2) {
        ss[cnt]=ss[cnt-1]+sum;
        ss[cnt+1]=ss[cnt]+sum;
    }
}

inline bool allsame() {
    for (int i=2; i<=len; i++) {
        if (s[i]!=s[i-1])
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

inline unsigned long long ha(int x,int l,int r) {
    return h[x][r]-h[x][l-1]*m[x][r-l+1];
}

inline bool equal(int i,int j) {
    int x=(j-i-1)>>1;
    for (int q=0; q<5; q++) {
        if (ha(q,i,i+x)!=ha(q,i+x+1,j))
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    freopen("excellent.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("excellent.out","w",stdout);
    int t;
    pinit();
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        unsigned long long ans=0;
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        len=strlen(s+1);
        if (allsame()) {
            printf("%llu\n",ss[len]);
        } else {
            init();
            for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
                for (int j=i+3; j<=len; j+=2) {
                    for (int k=i+1; k<j; k+=2) {
                        if (equal(i,k) && equal(k+1,j)) {
                            ans++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            printf("%llu\n",ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//exgcd.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
long long extended_euclidean(long long a,long long b,long long &x,long long &y) {
    if(b==0) {
        x = 1;
        y = 0;
        return a;
    }
    long long g = extended_euclidean(b, a%b, x, y);
    long long tmp = x;
    x = y;
    y = tmp - (a/b)*y;
    return g;
}

int main() {
    long long a,b,c,x,y,g,m,n;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld%lld",&x,&y,&m,&n,&b);
    if (m==n) {
        printf("Impossible");
        return 0;
    }
    a=(m-n+b)%b;
    c=(y-x+b)%b;
    g = extended_euclidean(a, b, x, y);
    // ax+by=gcd(x,y)
    if (c%g!=0) {
        printf("Impossible");
    } else {
        c=c/g;
        x=x*c;
        y=y*c;
        int r=b/g;
//    	printf("%lld %lld %lld %lld %lld\n",x,r,x%r,x%r+r,(x%r+r)%r);
        x=x%r;
        if (x<0)
            x+=r;
        printf("%lld",x);
//    	printf("%d %d %d %d %d\n",a,b,x,y,g);
    }
    return 0;
//his
    /*    if(c%g != 0){
    		cout<<"Impossible"<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        long long k = c/g;
        x = (x*k);
        if(x < 0)
            x = (b/g-(abs(x)%(b/g)));
        if((x-b/g) > 0)
            x = x%(b/g);
        cout<<x<<endl;*/
    return 0;
}

//EXPmod0.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int n,k,s,t[131075];
int sum[50005];
long long total=0;
inline int ex(int a,int b) {
    return int((long long)a*b%k);
}
void read(int a[]) {
    sum[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+i;
    }
    return;
}

void build() {
    for (s=1; s<=n; s<<=1);
    read(t+s);
    t[s]=1;
    for (int i=s+n+1,ta=s<<1; i<ta; i++)
        t[i]=1;
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=ex(t[i<<1],t[(i<<1)+1]);
    }
    return;
}
int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=1;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l<<=1,r<<=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=ex(ans,t[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=ex(ans,t[r^1]);
        if (ans==0)
            return 0;
    }
    return ans;
}
void debug() {
    while (1) {
        int l,r;
        for (int i=s<<1; i>0; i--)
            scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
        printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
    }
}
void work() {
    int i=1,j=1;
    while (j<=n) {
        int re=query(i,j);
        while (j<=n && re!=0)
            re=query(i,++j);
        printf("add ans:%d~%d %d*%d\n",i,j,i,(sum[n]-sum[j-1]));
        total+=i*(sum[n]-sum[j-1]);
        i++;
        if (i>j)
            j=i;
    }
    printf("%lld",total);
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    build();
    debug();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//ez.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 2017

int n, m, ans, fa[MAXN], loop;

multiset<int> G[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (multiset<int>::iterator it = G[x].begin(); it != G[x].end(); it++) {
        int to = *it;
        if (fa[to]) {
            if (loop) {
                G[to].erase(G[to].find(x));
                G[x].erase(G[x].find(to));
                loop = 0;
                m--;
            }
        } else {
            G[to].erase(G[to].find(x));
            G[x].erase(G[x].find(to));
            m--;
            fa[to] = x;
            dfs(to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (!m) return puts("0"), 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        G[u].insert(v);
        G[v].insert(u);
    }
    for (ans = 0; m; ans++) {
        memset(fa + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!fa[i]) {
                fa[i] = -1;
                loop = 1;
                dfs(i);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//farthest.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>

typedef long long LL;

#define read(x) x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar()
#define power(x) ((LL)(x) * (x))
#define swap(x, y) tmp = x; x = y; y = tmp
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define insert(v) {t[++top] = v; x = top; while (x > 1) {p = x, x >>= 1; p ^= (t[p] > t[p ^ 1]); if (t[x] > t[p]) {swap(t[x], t[p]);} else break;}}
#define pop() {swap(t[1], t[top]); t[top--] = INF; x = 1; while (x < top) {p = x, x <<= 1; x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]); if (t[p] > t[x]) {swap(t[p], t[x]);} else break;}}
int main() {
    register int n, K, ch, i, j, top, x, p;
    register LL d, tmp;
    int X[23333], Y[23333];
    LL t[257];
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(X[i]);
        read(Y[i]);
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            d = power(X[i] - X[j]) + power(Y[i] - Y[j]);
            if (top < K) {
                insert(d);
            } else if (t[1] < d) {
                pop();
                insert(d);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", t[1]);
    return 0;
}

//FC360D.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,k,total;
int prime[105],p=0,cnt[105],flag[105];

void findfactor() {
    int temp=k;
    for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(k)); i<=t; i++) {
        if (temp%i==0) {
            prime[++p]=i;
            cnt[p]=0;
            flag[p]=0;
            while (temp%i==0) {
                temp/=i;
                cnt[p]++;
            }
            t=int(sqrt(temp));
        }
    }
    if (temp!=0) {
        prime[++p]=temp;
        cnt[p]=1;
        flag[p]=0;
    }
    return;
}

void solve(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=p; i++) {
        if (flag[i])
            continue;
        bool can=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt[i]; j++) {
            if (x%prime[i]==0) {
                x/=prime[i];
            } else {
                can=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (can) {
            flag[i]=1;
            total--;
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    findfactor();
    total=p;
    for (int i=1,now; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&now);
        solve(now);
        if (total==0) {
            puts("Yes");
            return 0;
        }
    }
    puts("No");
    return 0;
}

//Fccc.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
int t[MAXN<<5],L[MAXN<<5],R[MAXN<<5],rt[MAXN<<5];
int tcnt=0,r,n,m;
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=0;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    L[now]=build(l,mid);
    R[now]=build(mid+1,r);
    return now;
}
int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    L[now]=L[x];
    R[now]=R[x];
    t[now]=t[x]+v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    if (p<=mid)
        L[now]=update(L[x],l,mid,p,v);
    else
        R[now]=update(R[x],mid+1,r,p,v);
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r)
        return l;
    int val=t[L[rx]]-t[L[lx]];
    if (val>=p)
        return query(L[lx],L[rx],l,(l+r)>>1,p);
    else
        return query(R[lx],R[rx],((l+r)>>1)+1,r,p-val);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    scanf("%d",&m);
    rt[0]=build(0,100000);
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],0,100000,r,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r,k; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&l,&r,&k);
        printf("%d\n",query(rt[l-1],rt[r],0,100000,k));
    }
    return 0;
}

//F_.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#define INF 1e12
using namespace std;

int n,K;
double price[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&K);
    for (int i=0; i<=1000; i++)
        price[i]=INF;
    for (int i=1,p,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&c,&p);
        if (price[c]) {
            if (p<price[c]) price[c]=p;
        } else price[c]=p;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<1000; k++) {
        for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
            if (price[i]==INF) continue;
            for (int j=k+1; j<=1000; j++) {
                if (price[j]==INF) continue;
                price[k]=min(price[k],((j-k)*(double)price[i]+(k-i)*(double)price[j])/(j-i));
            }
        }
    }
    for (int k=1; k<1000; k++) {
        for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
            if (price[i]==INF) continue;
            for (int j=k+1; j<=1000; j++) {
                if (price[j]==INF) continue;
                price[k]=min(price[k],((j-k)*(double)price[i]+(k-i)*(double)price[j])/(j-i));
            }
        }
    }
    if (price[K]<INF) printf("%.7f\n",price[K]);
    else puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

//F.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int next, v;
    char x;
} node[MAXN];

int ncnt;

struct Map {
    int head;
    int &operator [] (const char x) {
        for (int now = head; now; now = node[now].next) {
            if (node[now].x == x) return node[now].v;
        }
        node[++ncnt] = (Node) {
            head, 0, x
        };
        head = ncnt;
        return node[ncnt].v;
    }
    void clear() {
        head = 0;
    }
};

LL ans = 0;

Map nxt[MAXN];
int fail[MAXN], len[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], n, p, last;
char S[MAXN];
int newNode(int l) {
    nxt[p].clear();
    len[p] = l;
    cnt[p] = 0;
    return p++;
}
void init() {
    n = p = last = ncnt = 0;
    newNode(0);
    newNode(-1);
    fail[0] = 1;
    S[0] = -1;
}
int get_fail(int x) {
    while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
    return x;
}
void add(char c) {
    S[++n] = c;
    int cur = get_fail(last);
    int &now = nxt[cur][c];
    if (!now) {
        fail[p] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
        now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
    }
    last = now;
    cnt[last]++;
}

void count() {
    for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
}

int T, dp[MAXN], fa[MAXN][16];
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        int nn = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        init();
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nn; i++) add(s[i]);
        count();
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) fa[i][0] = fail[i];
        fa[1][1] = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k < 16; k++) for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) fa[i][k] = fa[fa[i][k - 1]][k - 1];
        for (int i = 2; i < p; i++) {
            if (len[i] < 2) ans += cnt[i], dp[i] = 1;
            else {
                int x = i, half = len[i] / 2;
                for (int k = 15; k > -1; k--) if (len[fa[x][k]] >= half) x = fa[x][k];
                dp[i] = (len[x] == half ? dp[x] : 0) + 1;
                ans += dp[i] * LL(cnt[i]);
            }
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//fence.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Line {
    int he, ta, md, siz;
    Line (int x = 0, int y = 0, int z = 0, int w = 0) : he(x), ta(y), md(z), siz(w) {}
    Line operator + (Line b) const {
        Line c;
        c.siz = siz + b.siz;
        c.he = (he == siz) ? he + b.he : he;
        c.ta = (b.ta == b.siz) ? ta + b.ta : b.ta;
        c.md = max(max(c.he, c.ta), max(max(md, b.md), ta + b.he));
        return c;
    }
};

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    Line v;
} t[MAXN * 40];

int tcnt = 0, rt[MAXN];

#define pushup(y) t[y].v = t[t[y].l].v + t[t[y].r].v;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = Line(0, 0, 0, 1);
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = Line(1, 1, 1, 1);
    return x;
}

Line query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Line ret(0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int n, q;
pair<int, int> h[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("fence.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("fence.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i].first), h[i].second = i;
    sort(h + 1, h + n + 1);
    rt[n + 1] = build(1, n);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) rt[i] = update(rt[i + 1], 1, n, h[i].second);
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1, L, R, w, l, r, mid; i <= q; i++) {
        read(L);
        read(R);
        read(w);
        l = 1, r = n;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (query(rt[mid], 1, n, L, R).md >= w) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        printf("%d\n", h[l].first);
    }
    return 0;
}

//fffread.cpp
#include <cstdio>

namespace IO {
#define getchar() *(rp++)
#define putchar(x) (*(wp++) = (x))
const int MB = 1048576;
const int RMAX = 8 * MB;
const int WMAX = 8 * MB;

char rb[RMAX], *rp = rb,  wb[WMAX], *wp = wb;
inline void init() {
    fread(rb, sizeof(char), RMAX, stdin);
}
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    register bool _f = 0;
    register int _c = getchar();
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + (_c ^ '0'), _c = getchar();
    _a = _f ? -_a : _a;
}
template <class _T> inline void write(_T _a) {
    static char buf[20], *top = buf;
    if (_a) {
        while (_a) {
            register int tm = _a / 10;
            *(++top) = char((_a - tm * 10) | '0');
            _a = tm;
        }
        while (top != buf) putchar(*(top--));
    } else putchar('0');
}
void output() {
    fwrite(wb, sizeof(char), wp - wb, stdout);
}
}

using namespace IO;

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    init();
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= 10; i++) {
        read(a);
        write(a);
        putchar('\n');
    }
    output();
    return 0;
}

//fft.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 262144

struct cp {
    double r, i;
    cp (double x = 0, double y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    cp operator + (cp b) {
        return cp(r + b.r, i + b.i);
    }
    cp operator - (cp b) {
        return cp(r - b.r, i - b.i);
    }
    cp operator * (cp b) {
        return cp(r * b.r - i * b.i, r * b.i + i * b.r);
    }
};

int r[MAXN];

void gr(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) r[i] = (r[i >> 1] >> 1 )| ((i & 1) << b);
}

void fft(cp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (r[i] > i) swap(a[r[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        cp stp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            cp cu(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cu = cu * stp) {
                cp x = a[j + k], y = cu * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!~rev) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int n, m, N;

cp a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        int x;
        read(x);
        a[i] = cp(x, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        int x;
        read(x);
        b[i] = cp(x, 0);
    }

    N = 1;
    while (N <= n) N <<= 1;
    while (N <= m) N <<= 1;
    gr(N <<= 1);
    fft(a, N, 1);
    fft(b, N, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) a[i] = a[i] * b[i];
    fft(a, N, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
        printf("%.0lf ", a[i].r);
    }

    return 0;
}

//final.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 998244353

int n, m, w[3];

int fr[9], md[9], bk[9], ct[9], tot = 0;
int G[9][9];

void solve(int x) {
    if ((w[1] & (w[1] >> 1)) && (x & (x >> 1))) return;
    md[tot] = x;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if ((x >> i) & 1) {
            ct[tot]++;
            fr[tot] |= w[0] << i;
            bk[tot] |= w[2] << i;
        }
    }

    (fr[tot] >>= 1) &= 7, (bk[tot] >>= 1) &= 7;
    tot++;
}

int dp[2][9][7515];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            w[i] ^= x << j;
        }

    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) solve(i);
    for (int i = 0; i < tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tot; j++) {
            if (bk[i] & md[j]) continue;
            if (md[i] & fr[j]) continue;
            G[i][++G[i][0]] = j;
        }
    }
    int stp = 3;
    if (w[1] & (w[1] >> 1)) stp = 2;
    else stp = 3;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    register int i, j, k, l, v, c, now, pre, pp;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        now = i & 1, pre = now ^ 1, pp = min(m, stp * (i - 1));
        for (k = 0; k < tot; k++) {
            for (l = 1; l <= G[k][0]; l++) {
                v = G[k][l], c = ct[v];
                for (j = 0; j <= pp; j++) {
                    (dp[now][v][j + c] += dp[pre][k][j]) %= MOD;
                }
            }
            for (j = 0; j <= pp; j++) dp[pre][k][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < tot; i++) (ans += dp[n & 1][i][m]) %= MOD;
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//f_kdt.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

#define read(x) x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar()
#define power(x) (LL(x) * LL(x))
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define rint register int
#define rll register LL
typedef long long LL;

#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

#define MAXN 100319

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int x[2], ma[2], mi[2], l, r;
} t[MAXN];

int D;
bool operator < (const Node a, const Node b) {
    return a.x[D] < b.x[D] || (a.x[D] == b.x[D] && a.x[!D] < b.x[!D]);
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    rint l = t[x].l, r = t[x].r;
    if (l) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[l].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[l].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[l].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[l].mi[1]);
    }
    if (r) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[r].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[r].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[r].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[r].mi[1]);
    }
}

int build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int x = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(t + l, t + x, t + r + 1);
    t[x].ma[0] = t[x].mi[0] = t[x].x[0];
    t[x].ma[1] = t[x].mi[1] = t[x].x[1];
    if (l < x) t[x].l = build(l, x - 1, !d);
    if (r > x) t[x].r = build(x + 1, r, !d);
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

int Q[2];

int n, K, rt;
priority_queue < LL, vector<LL>, greater<LL> > q;

LL g(int x) {
    return x ? max(power(t[x].ma[0] - Q[0]), power(t[x].mi[0] - Q[0])) + max(power(t[x].ma[1] - Q[1]), power(t[x].mi[1] - Q[1])) : 0;
}

LL h[543];
int top;

void poppush(rll v) {
    rint x, p;
    h[1] = h[top];
    h[top] = INF;
    x = 1;
    while (x < top) {
        p = x, x <<= 1;
        x ^= (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]);
        if (h[p] > h[x]) swap(h[p], h[x]);
        else break;
    }
    h[top] = v;
    x = top;
    while (x > 1) {
        p = x ^ (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]), x >>= 1;
        if (h[x] > h[p]) swap(h[x], h[p]);
        else break;
    }
}

void query(int x) {
    if (!x) return;
    LL dis = power(t[x].x[0] - Q[0]) + power(t[x].x[1] - Q[1]);
    if (dis > h[1]) poppush(dis);
    LL D1 = g(t[x].l), D2 = g(t[x].r);
    if (D1 > D2) {
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
    } else {
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
    }
}

int main() {
    register int ch = 0, i;
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(t[i].x[0]);
        read(t[i].x[1]);
    }
    memset(h, 0x3f, sizeof h);
    for (i = 1; i <= 2 * K; i++) h[i] = 0;
    top = 2 * K;
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        Q[0] = t[i].x[0], Q[1] = t[i].x[1];
        query(rt);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", h[1]);
    return 0;
}

//floj485.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 10005
#define INF 1e9
#define eps 1e-8

struct E {
    int next, v;
    double f;
} e[N * 2];

int ecnt, head[N * N], cur[N * N], S = 0, T = 1;
int tot;

void add(int u, int v, double f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[N], tag[N];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (tot + 1));
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    tag[q[0] = S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!tag[e[now].v] && e[now].f > eps) {
                tag[e[now].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

double dfs(int x, double f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    double l = f;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (tag[e[now].v] > tag[x] && e[now].f > eps) {
            double ret = dfs(e[now].v, min(l, e[now].f));
            e[now].f -= ret;
            e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
            l -= ret;
            if (l < eps) return f;
        }
    }
    return f - l;
}

int n, a[105];

bool chk(double mid) {
    memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (tot + 1));
    ecnt = 1;
    tot = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i + 1, T, mid);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (a[i] > a[j]) {
                int now = ++tot;
                add(S, now, 1);
                add(now, i + 1, INF);
                add(now, j + 1, INF);
            }
        }
    double ret = tot - n - 1;
    cerr << ret << " ";
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret -= dfs(S, INF);
    }
    cerr << ret << "\n";
    return ret > 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    double l = 0, r = n;
    while (r - l > 1e-5) {
        double mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (chk(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid;
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", (l + r) / 2);
    return 0;
}

//floodfill.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

int n,m,cnt=0,total=0;
bool map[505][505];
bool visit[505][505];
int qx[25005],qy[25005];
int head,tail;
void insert(int x,int y) {
    visit[x][y]=1;
    qx[tail]=x;
    qy[tail++]=y;
    cnt++;
//	printf("i: %d %d\n",x,y);
    return;
}
void floodfill(int x,int y) {
    if (visit[x][y] || map[x][y])
        return;
//	printf("v: %d %d\n",x,y);
    cnt++;
    head=1;
    tail=2;
    visit[x][y]=1;
    qx[1]=x;
    qy[1]=y;
    while (head<tail) {
        //	printf("f");
        x=qx[head];
        y=qy[head];
//		printf("n: %d %d\n",x,y);
        if (x<n && !visit[x+1][y] && !map[x+1][y]) insert(x+1,y);
        if (x>1 && !visit[x-1][y] && !map[x-1][y]) insert(x-1,y);
        if (y<m && !visit[x][y+1] && !map[x][y+1]) insert(x,y+1);
        if (y>1 && !visit[x][y-1] && !map[x][y-1]) insert(x,y-1);
        head++;
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            char r;
            r=getchar();
            while (r!='*' && r!='0')
                r=getchar();
            if (r=='*') {
                map[i][j]=1;
            } else
                total++;
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        floodfill(i,1);
        floodfill(i,m);
    }
    for (int i=2; i<m; i++) {
        floodfill(1,i);
        floodfill(n,i);
    }
    printf("%d",total-cnt);
    return 0;
}

//flow__.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 3005

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int G[MAXN][MAXN];
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];

void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = 1;
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (tag[i]) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (!tag[j]) {
                    G[j][i] = G[i][j] = min(G[i][j], ret);
                }
        }
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    freopen("flow.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("flow.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    memset(G, 0x3f, sizeof G);
    solve(1, n);
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            ans += G[i][j];
        }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define void inline void

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}

int n, m, Q;

namespace LCT {
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa, *top;
    int val, mi;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : val(INF), mi(INF) {}
    inline bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = min(val, min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi));
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} mem[MAXN * 3], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    isrt = 1;
    top = f;
    fa = null;
}

Node *newNode(int w = INF) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->val = ptr->mi = w;
    ptr->isrt = 1, ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN * 3];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    x->top = y;
}

Node *a[MAXN], *E[MAXN * 2];

Node *addE(Node *x, Node *y, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(x, mid);
    Link(mid, y);
    return mid;
}
void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, u, v, f; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(f);
        E[i] = addE(a[u], a[v], f);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (op == 0) {
            mkrt(a[x]);
            expose(a[y]);
            splay(a[y]);
            printf("%d\n", a[y]->mi);
        } else {
            splay(E[x]);
            E[x]->val = y;
            E[x]->upd();
        }
    }
}
}

namespace FLOW {
struct Edge {
    int u, v, f;
} E[MAXN * 2];
struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4];
int ecnt, head[MAXN], tag[MAXN], cur[MAXN], S, T;
bool bfs() {
    static int q[MAXN], he, ta;
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    he = 0, ta = 0, q[ta++] = S, tag[S] = 1;
    int x;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}
int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, flow));
            e[now].f -= ret;
            e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
            left -= ret;
            if (!left) return flow;
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}
void work() {
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[E[i].u], E[i].v, E[i].f
        };
        head[E[i].u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[E[i].v], E[i].u, E[i].f
        };
        head[E[i].v] = ecnt;
    }
    long long ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
}
void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].f);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(S);
        read(T);
        if (op == 0) work();
        else E[S].f = T;
    }
}
}

//food.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

int n,m,p;
int dp[50005];

void sub1_update(int val,int cost) {
    for (int i=p; i>=0; i--) {
        dp[min(p,i+val)]=min(dp[min(p,i+val)],dp[i]+cost);
    }
}

int subtask_1() {
    int sum=0;
    memset(dp,31,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=0;
    for (int q=1,t,u,v; q<=n; q++) {
        read(t);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        sum+=t*v;
        int tot=0;
        for (int i=1; i<= (v-tot); i<<=1) {
            tot+=i;
            sub1_update(t*i,u*i);
        }
        if (tot<v) sub1_update(t*(v-tot),u*(v-tot));
    }
    for (int i=p-1; i>0; i--) {
        dp[i]=min(dp[i],dp[i+1]);
    }
    if (sum<p) return -1;
    else return dp[p];
}

void sub2_update(int val,int cost) {
    for (int i=50000; i>=cost; i--) {
        dp[i]=max(dp[i],dp[i-cost]+val);
    }
}

void subtask_2() {
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    for (int q=1,x,y,z; q<=m; q++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
        int tot=0;
        for (int i=1; i<= (z-tot); i<<=1) {
            tot+=i;
            sub2_update(x*i,y*i);
        }
        if (tot<z) sub2_update(x*(z-tot),y*(z-tot));
    }
}

int main() {

    int ret=subtask_1();
    if (ret==-1) {
        puts("TAT");
        return 0;
    }
    subtask_2();
    for (int i=0; i<=50000; i++) {
        if (dp[i]>=ret) {
            printf("%d\n",i);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    puts("TAT");
    return 0;
}

//force.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <list>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

int n,m;
list<int> edges[100100];
int all;

struct func {
    int type;
    double a,b;
    double operator() (double x) {
        if (type == 1) return sin(a * x + b);
        if (type == 2) return exp(a * x + b);
        if (type == 3) return a * x + b;
    }
} f[100100];

void add_edge(int u,int v) {
    edges[u].push_back(v);
    edges[v].push_back(u);
}

void del_edge(int u,int v) {
    for (auto it = edges[u].begin(); it != edges[u].end(); it++)
        if (*it == v) {
            edges[u].erase(it);
            break;
        }
    for (auto it = edges[v].begin(); it != edges[v].end(); it++)
        if (*it == u) {
            edges[v].erase(it);
            break;
        }
}

bool visited[100100];

double dfs(int now,int target,double x) {
    visited[now] = true;
    if (now == target) {
        all++;
        return f[now](x);
    }
    for (auto it = edges[now].begin(); it != edges[now].end(); it++)
        if (!visited[*it]) {
            double t = dfs(*it,target,x);
            if (t > -1) {
                all++;
                return t + f[now](x);
            }
        }
    return -2;
}

int main() {
    freopen("math.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("math.ans","w",stdout);
    all = 0;
    char aaa[10],op[20];
    int u,v,type;
    double a,b,x;
    scanf("%d%d%s",&n,&m,aaa);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) scanf("%d%lf%lf",&f[i].type,&f[i].a,&f[i].b);
    while (m--) {
        scanf("%s",op);
        if (op[0] == 'a') {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add_edge(u,v);
        }
        if (op[0] == 'd') {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            del_edge(u,v);
        }
        if (op[0] == 'm') {
            scanf("%d%d%lf%lf",&u,&type,&a,&b);
            f[u].type = type;
            f[u].a = a;
            f[u].b = b;
        }
        if (op[0] == 't') {
            memset(visited,0,sizeof visited);
            scanf("%d%d%lf",&u,&v,&x);
            double t = dfs(u,v,x);
            if (t < -1) puts("unreachable");
            else printf("%.8e\n",t);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",all);
    return 0;
}

//fuck.cpp
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>

#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

#define sqr(x) ((x) * (x))
#define minn(x,y) (x=(y)<(x)?(y):(x))
#define maxx(x,y) (x=(y)>(x)?(y):(x))
#define pluss(x,y) (x+=(y),x%=mod)

using namespace std;

typedef	long long	int64;

struct	People {
    char	name[70];
    int	w, m, b, p, s, t, f;
};

People		a[9999];
int		b[9999], g[9999], h[9999], N, D;
map<string,int>	hash;

bool check() {
    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++ j) g[j] = a[j].b, h[j] = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < D; ++ i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++ j) h[j] ++;
        h[b[i]] = 0;

        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++ j)
            if (b[i] == j)
                g[j] = min(a[j].m, g[j] + a[j].p);
            else
                g[j] = max(0, g[j] - a[j].s - a[j].t * h[j]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++ i) if (g[i] < a[i].f) return -1;
    double ret = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++ j) ret += a[j].w * (1.0 - sqr(1.0 * (a[j].m - g[j]) / a[j].m));
    return ret;
}

string trans(char* z) {
    int	zlen = strlen(z);
    string	ret = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < zlen; ++ i) ret += z + i;
    return ret;
}

bool ban[9999];
double ans = 0;

int can[2000][2000];

void dfs(int dep) {
//	printf("dep : %d\n", dep);
    if (dep > D) {
        double ret = check();
        //	if (ret > 0) printf("ansed %lf\n", ret);
        if (ret > ans) {
            ans = ret;
            printf("%lf\n", ret);
            for (int i = 0; i < D; i++) {
                printf("%s\n", a[b[i]].name);
            }
        }
        //	printf("return with %lf\n", ret);
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) can[dep][i] = i;
    random_shuffle(can[dep], can[dep] + N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (!ban[can[dep][i]]) {
            b[dep] = can[dep][i];
            dfs(dep + 1);
        }
    }
}

int	main() {
    srand(192608);
    string	in = "xuezha1.in";
    FILE* Finn = fopen(in.c_str(), "r");

    fscanf(Finn, "%d%d", &N, &D);
    hash.clear();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++ i) {

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator + (point a) {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) {
        return x*a.y-y*a.x;
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
    point operator * (double a) {
        return point(a*x,a*y);
    }
    bool operator == (point a) {
        return x==a.x && y==a.y;
    }
    double len2() {
        return x*x+y*y;
    }
};

struct line {
    point st,ed;
} l[110];
int n,ans;

inline bool check(int i,int j) {
    point A=l[i].st,B=l[i].ed,C=l[j].st,D=l[j].ed;
    return ((D-A)*(B-A))*((C-A)*(B-A))<=0 && (((A-C)*(D-C))*((B-C)*(D-C)))<=0;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    while (scanf("%d",&n)) {
        if (n==0)
            break;
        ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%lf%lf%lf%lf",&l[i].st.x,&l[i].st.y,&l[i].ed.x,&l[i].ed.y);
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
                if (check(i,j))
                    ans++;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//func.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 200319

LL power(LL x, int p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL calc(LL x, int p) {
    if (p == 0) return 0;
    else if (p == 1) return x;
    LL left = calc(x, p / 2);
    if (p & 1) return (left + left * power(x, p / 2) + power(x, p)) % MOD;
    else return (left + left * power(x, p / 2)) % MOD;
}

struct Exp {
    LL a, b;
    Exp (LL x = 1, LL y = 0) : a(x), b(y) {}
};

bool operator != (Exp a, Exp b) {
    return a.a != b.a || a.b != b.b;
}

Exp operator + (Exp a, Exp b) {
    return Exp(a.a * b.a % MOD, (a.b * b.a + b.b) % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    Exp v, lazy;
} t[MAXN];

int tcnt = 0;

void apply(int x, Exp y, int siz) {
    t[x].v = Exp(power(y.a, siz), y.b * (calc(y.a, siz - 1) + 1) % MOD);
    t[x].lazy = y;
}

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
}

void pushdown(int x, int lsiz, int rsiz) {
    if (t[x].lazy != Exp()) {
        apply(t[x].l, t[x].lazy, lsiz);
        apply(t[x].r, t[x].lazy, rsiz);
        t[x].lazy = Exp();
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else {
        int a, b;
        scanf("%d%d", &a, &b);
        t[x].v = Exp(a, b);
    }
    return x;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, Exp v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        apply(x, v, r - l + 1);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

Exp query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    Exp ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, w, x, y, z; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &op);
        if (op == 1) {
            scanf("%d%d%d", &y, &z, &x);
            Exp ret = query(1, 1, n, y, z);
            printf("%d\n", int((ret.a * x + ret.b) % MOD));
        } else {
            scanf("%d%d%d%d", &w, &x, &y, &z);
            update(1, 1, n, w, x, Exp(y, z));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int phi(int x) {
    int ret = x;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= x; i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) {
            x /= i;
            ret = ret / i * (i - 1);
            while (x % i == 0) x /= i;
        }
    }
    if (x > 1) ret = ret / x * (x - 1);
    return ret;
}

LL power(LL x, LL y, int MOD) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (x %= MOD; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL n, m;
int P;
int a[2333];

void work() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(P);
    if (m == 0) printf("%d\n", int((n + 1) % P));
    else if (m == 1) printf("%d\n", int((n + 2) % P));
    else if (m == 2) printf("%d\n", int((n * 2 + 3) % P));
    else if (m == 3) printf("%d\n", int(((power(2, n + 3, P) - m) % P + P) % P));
    else if (m == 4) {
        if (n == 0) printf("%d\n", 13 % P);
        else if (n == 1) printf("%d\n", 65533 % P);
        else if (n == 2) printf("%d\n", int((power(2, 65536, P) + P - 3) % P + P) % P);
        else {
            int x = P, cnt = 0;
            a[++cnt] = x;
            while (x > 1) a[++cnt] = (x = phi(x));
            a[++cnt] = 1;
            if (n + 2 < cnt) cnt = (int)n + 2;
            LL ans = 2;
            for ( ; cnt; cnt--) {
                ans = power(2, ans, a[cnt]);
                if (!ans) ans += a[cnt];
            }
            ans %= P;
            printf("%d\n", int((ans + P - 3) % P + P) % P);
        }
    } else if (m >= 5) {
        if (m == 5 && n == 0) printf("%d\n", 65533 % P);
        else {
            int x = P, cnt = 0;
            a[++cnt] = x;
            while (x > 1) a[++cnt] = (x = phi(x));
            a[++cnt] = 1;
            LL ans = 1;
            for ( ; cnt; cnt--) {
                ans = power(2, ans, a[cnt]);
                if (!ans) ans += a[cnt];
            }
            ans %= P;
            printf("%d\n", int((ans + P - 3) % P + P) % P);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

bool test() {
    int p = m, tot = n;
    while (tot != 1) {
        int r = rand() % 6;
        if (r == 0) return p == 1;
        else if (r < 3) {
            if (p == 1) return 0;
            else tot--;
        }
        if (--p == 0) p = tot;
    }
    return 1;
}

double check(double x) {
    double ret = x, dd = 1e9;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 200; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= 200; j++) {
            double f = (double) i / j;
            if (abs(f - x) < dd) dd = abs(f - x), ret = f;
        }
    return ret;
}

//gcd.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
int gcd(int x, int y) {
    while (y) {
        int t = x;
        x = y;
        y = t % x;
    }
    return x;
}
#define MAXA 10000
#define MAXN 700
int n, a[MAXN + 5], G = 0;
int dp[MAXA + 5];

inline int check() {
    int g = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        g = gcd(a[i], g);
        if (g == 1) return n - i;
    }
    return 0;
}

namespace vio {
int solve() {
    int ret = n;
    do {
        ret = min(ret, check());
    } while (ret != 1 && next_permutation(a + 1, a + n + 1));
    return ret;
}
}

int main() {
    freopen("gcd.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("gcd.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), G = gcd(a[i], G);
    memset(dp, 0x3f, sizeof(dp));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[a[i]] = min(dp[a[i]], 1);
        for (int j = MAXA; j; j--) {
            int g = gcd(j, a[i]);
            dp[g] = min(dp[g], dp[j] + 1);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", n - dp[G]);
    return 0;
}

//G.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
    bool lazy;
} t[MAXN * 99];

int tcnt = 0, rt = 0;

int n, K, Q, N, Min;

int a[MAXN], Log[MAXN];
int st[MAXN][17];

void init() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) st[i][0] = a[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 0, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1); i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

inline int get(int l, int r) {
    return min(st[l][Log[r - l + 1]], st[r - (1 << Log[r - l + 1]) + 1][Log[r - l + 1]]);
}

inline int rmq(int l, int r) {
    if (r - l + 1 >= n) return Min;
    l %= n, r %= n;
    if (l <= r) return get(l, r);
    else return min(get(l, n - 1), get(0, r));
}

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v = v;
        t[x].lazy = 1;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].v = t[t[x].r].v = t[x].v;
        t[t[x].l].lazy = t[t[x].r].lazy = 1;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    t[x].v = min(t[x].l ? t[t[x].l].v : rmq(l, mid), t[x].r ? t[t[x].r].v : rmq(mid + 1, r));
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return rmq(ql, qr);
    if ((l == ql && r == qr) || t[x].lazy) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0x7fffffff;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    Min = 0x7fffffff;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]), Min = min(Min, a[i]);
    init();
    N = n * K - 1;
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, op, x; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(op), read(l), read(r);
        l--, r--;
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            update(rt, 0, N, l, r, x);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n", query(rt, 0, N, l, r));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//gen.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#define rep(i,n) for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
#define fora(i,a,b) for(int i=a;i<b;i++)

using namespace std;

int main(int argv,char*argc[]) {
    int n = atoi(argc[1]);

    int open[] = {atoi(argc[2]),atoi(argc[3]),atoi(argc[4])};

    bool full = atoi(argc[5]);

    srand(atoi(argc[6]));

    vector<pair<int,int> > lst;
    rep(i,n) rep(j,n) lst.push_back(make_pair(i,j));
    random_shuffle(lst.begin(), lst.end());

    if(!full) //half
        lst = vector<pair<int,int> >(lst.begin(),lst.begin()+lst.size()/2);

    int m = 0;
    vector< vector<int> > out;
    while(!lst.empty()) {
        int cmd;

        for(;;) {
            cmd = rand() % 3;
            if(open[cmd])
                break;
        }

        if(lst.size()==1 || cmd == 0) {
            int u = lst.back().first;
            int v = lst.back().second;
            out.push_back({0,u+1,v+1});
            lst.pop_back();
        } else {
            int u = lst.back().first;
            int v = lst.back().second;
            lst.pop_back();
            int nu = lst.back().first;
            int nv = lst.back().second;
            lst.pop_back();
            out.push_back({cmd,u+1,v+1,nu+1,nv+1});
        }
    }

    cout<<n<<" "<<out.size()<<endl;

    for(auto v:out) {
        rep(j,v.size())
        printf("%d%c",v[j],j==v.size()-1?'\n':' ');
    }
    return 0;
}
//GeoToys.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 5005
using namespace std;

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator + (point a) {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) {
        return x*a.y-y*a.x;
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
    point operator * (double a) {
        return point(a*x,a*y);
    }
    double len2() {
        return x*x+y*y;
    }
};

struct line {
    point st,ed;
} v[MAXN];

int n,m,cnt[5005];
double top,bot,lt,rt;
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d",&n)) {
        if (n==0)
            break;
        memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
        scanf("%d%lf%lf%lf%lf",&m,&lt,&top,&rt,&bot);
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            double U,L;
            scanf("%lf%lf",&U,&L);
            v[i].st=point(L,bot);
            v[i].ed=point(U,top);
        }
        v[n].st=point(rt,bot);
        v[n].ed=point(rt,top);
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
            double x,y;
            scanf("%lf%lf",&x,&y);
            point temp(x,y);
            int l=0,r=n;
            while (l<r) {
                int mid=(l+r)>>1;
                if ((v[mid].ed-v[mid].st)*(temp-v[mid].st)>0) {
                    r=mid;
                } else {
                    l=mid+1;
                }
            }
            cnt[l]++;
        }
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
            printf("%d: %d\n",i,cnt[i]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//gf.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200005
#define M 6666
#define MOD 998244353

inline LL power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL fac[M], inv[M], ifa[M];

inline void init() {
    fac[0] = inv[0] = ifa[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < M; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    ifa[M - 1] = power(fac[M - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = M - 2; ~i; i--) ifa[i] = ifa[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    for (int i = 1; i < M; i++) inv[i] = ifa[i] * fac[i - 1] % MOD;
}

int n;
LL ans = 0;
int ma, mb, a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

inline void solve1() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            ans += fac[a[i] + a[j] + b[i] + b[j]] * ifa[a[i] + a[j]] % MOD * ifa[b[i] + b[j]] % MOD;
            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        }
}

int cnt[505][505];

inline void solve2() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cnt[a[i]][b[i]]++;
    for (int i = 0; i <= ma; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= mb; j++) if (cnt[i][j]) {
                LL cc = cnt[i][j];
                ans += ((cc *(cc - 1) / 2) % MOD) * (fac[(i + j) << 1] * ifa[i << 1] % MOD * ifa[j << 1] % MOD) % MOD;
                if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
                for (int q = i; q <= ma; q++) for (int w = q == i ? j + 1 : 0; w <= mb; w++) if (cnt[q][w]) {
                            ans += (cc * cnt[q][w] % MOD) * (fac[i + j + q + w] * ifa[i + q] % MOD * ifa[j + w] % MOD) % MOD;
                            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
                        }
            }
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(n);
    ma = 0, mb = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), read(b[i]), ma = max(ma, a[i]), mb = max(mb, b[i]);
    if (n <= 10000) solve1();
    else if (ma <= 500) solve2();
    else ans = 19260817;
    printf("%d\n", int(ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//Ghostanimal.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define eps 0.00000001
using namespace std;
int s,t,l,ansi,ansj;
double tar,delta=1e9;
bool flag=0;
void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=l; i++)
        for (int j=0,ed=min(l-i,i); j<=ed; j++) {
            double temp=abs(tar-(double)j/i);
            if (temp+eps<delta) {
                ansi=i;
                ansj=j;
                delta=temp;
            }
        }
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d%d",&s,&t,&l);
    if (s<t) {
        flag=1;
        swap(s,t);
    }
    tar=(double)t/s;
    work();
    if (flag)
        printf("%d %d\n",ansj,ansi);
    else
        printf("%d %d\n",ansi,ansj);
    return 0;
}

//gift2.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 4005
#define M 200319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define LARGE 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v;
    LL f;
} e[(N + M * 3) * 8];

int head[N + M], cur[N + M], ecnt;

inline void add(int u, int v, LL f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

inline void addx(int u, int v, LL f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, f
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m, tot;

int q[N + M], tag[N + M];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, (tot + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

LL dfs(int x, LL f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    LL l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (tag[x] < tag[e[o].v] && e[o].f) {
            LL ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            l -= ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    return f - l;
}

inline LL dinic() {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int a[N], d[N], f[M], g[M], b[M];
inline bool chk(int mid) {
    memset(head, 0, (tot + 1) * 4);
    tot = n + 1, ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i + 1, LARGE);
        add(i + 1, T, LARGE + 2ll * mid * a[i] - d[i]);
    }
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        addx(f[i] + 1, g[i] + 1, b[i]);
    }
    return ret + n * LL(LARGE) > dinic();
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(f[i]);
        read(g[i]);
        read(b[i]);
        d[f[i]] += b[i];
        d[g[i]] += b[i];
    }
    int l = 0, r = 33333;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) / 2;
        if (chk(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", r);
    return 0;
}

#define sec second

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
