#define N 4005
#define M 200319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v;
    int f;
} e[(N + M * 3) * 8];

int head[N + M], cur[N + M], ecnt;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m, tot;

int q[N + M], tag[N + M];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, (tot + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    int l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (tag[x] < tag[e[o].v] && e[o].f) {
            int ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            l -= ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    return f - l;
}

inline int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int a[N], f[M], g[M], b[M];
inline bool chk(int mid) {
    memset(head, 0, (tot + 1) * 4);
    tot = n + 1, ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i + 1, T, mid * a[i]);
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int o = ++tot;
        add(S, o, b[i]);
        ret += b[i];
        add(o, f[i] + 1, INF);
        add(o, g[i] + 1, INF);
    }
    return ret > dinic();
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    int l = 0, r = n > 2000 ? 100 : 666;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(f[i]);
        read(g[i]);
        read(b[i]);
        l = max(l, b[i] / (a[f[i]] + a[g[i]]));
    }
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) / 2;
        if (chk(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(r));
    return 0;
}

//God.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10000005

typedef long long LL;

bool notprime[MAXN];
int n,sqn,prime[1000005],pcnt=0;
LL ans=0,sum[MAXN],phi[MAXN];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            phi[i]=i-1;
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=n ; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=prime[j]*phi[i];
                break;
            } else {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
            }
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    sqn=int(sqrt(n));
    shake();
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        ans+=(sum[n/prime[i]])*2-1;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//gold.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105

int top,n;

struct data {
    int w,v;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return v*a.w>a.v*w;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("gold.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("gold.out","w",stdout);
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&top,&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&a[i].w,&a[i].v);
        }
        sort(a+1,a+n+1);
        double ans=0;
        for (int i=1; top && i<=n; i++) {
            if (top>=a[i].w) {
                top-=a[i].w;
                ans+=a[i].v;
            } else {
                ans+=a[i].v*top/double(a[i].w);
                top=0;
            }
        }
        printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//grader.cpp
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "gap.h"

static void my_assert(int k) {
    if (!k) exit(1);
}

static int subtask_num, N;
static long long A[100001];
static long long call_count;

long long findGap(int, int);

void MinMax(long long s, long long t, long long *mn, long long *mx) {
    int lo = 1, hi = N, left = N+1, right = 0;
    my_assert(s <= t && mn != NULL && mx != NULL);
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo+hi)>>1;
        if (A[mid] >= s) hi = mid - 1, left = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    lo = 1, hi = N;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo+hi)>>1;
        if (A[mid] <= t) lo = mid + 1, right = mid;
        else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    if (left > right) *mn = *mx = -1;
    else {
        *mn = A[left];
        *mx = A[right];
    }
    if (subtask_num == 1) call_count++;
    else if (subtask_num == 2) call_count += right-left+2;
}

int main() {
    FILE *in = stdin, *out = stdout;
    my_assert(2 == fscanf(in, "%d%d", &subtask_num, &N));
    my_assert(1 <= subtask_num && subtask_num <= 2);
    my_assert(2 <= N && N <= 100000);
    for (int i=1; i<=N; i++) my_assert(1 == fscanf(in, "%lld", A+i));
    for (int i=1; i<N; i++) my_assert(A[i] < A[i+1]);
    fprintf(out, "%lld\n", findGap(subtask_num, N));
    fprintf(out, "%lld\n", call_count);
}

//greedy.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
#define time(a) (233333333 ^ rand())
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;

ULL __rand_value = 0x2333333333333333, __hidden_seed = 0x79786365766f6c69;

inline ULL raw_rand() {
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 12;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value + 1) << 25;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 27;
    return __rand_value ^ __hidden_seed;
}

inline void Srand(ULL seed = 0x319) {
    __rand_value ^= time(NULL) * 0x2545f4914f6cdd1d;
    __hidden_seed ^=  (seed << 32) ^ seed ^ raw_rand();
}

inline int rand_int(int st = INT_MIN, int ed = INT_MAX) {
    return int(raw_rand() % ((LL)ed - st + 1) + st);
}

inline ULL rand_ll(LL st = LLONG_MIN, LL ed = LLONG_MAX) {
    if (st + ULLONG_MAX == (ULL)ed)
        return raw_rand();
    else
        return raw_rand() % (ed - st + 1) + st;
}

template <typename _type_iterator> void shuffle_array(_type_iterator __fir, _type_iterator __last) {
    for (_type_iterator it = __fir; it < __last; std::swap(*it, *(it + rand_ll(0, __last - it - 1))), it++);
    for (_type_iterator it = __last - 1; it > __fir; std::swap(*it, *(it - rand_ll(0, it - __fir))), it--);
}

inline double fast_exp(double y) {
    double d;
    *(reinterpret_cast<int*>(&d) + 0) = 0;
    *(reinterpret_cast<int*>(&d) + 1) = static_cast<int>(1512775 * y + 1072632447);
    return d;
}

#define MAXN 66
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f
LL Run_Time = LL(5e9);

int n, m;
unsigned A;
int val[MAXN], G[MAXN][MAXN];

int sst[MAXN], sed[MAXN], pst[MAXN], ped[MAXN];
struct Status {
    int value;
    vector<pii> arr[6][7];
    Status () : value(0) {}
    vector<pii>* operator [] (int x) {
        return arr[x];
    }
    void get_value() {
        value = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) sst[j] = -1, sed[j] = -1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) pst[j] = -1, ped[j] = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                for (int k = (int)arr[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                    if (sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] == -1) sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    sed[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    if (pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] == -1) pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                    ped[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (sst[j] != -1) value += val[sed[j] - sst[j]];
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (pst[j] != -1) value += val[ped[j] - pst[j]];
        }
    }
};

Status now, ans;

inline void check(Status &a) {
    static pii stu[MAXN], pro[MAXN], st;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) stu[i] = mp(-1, -1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) pro[i] = mp(-1, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            st = mp(i, j);
            for (int k = (int)a[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                if (stu[a[i][j][k].fir] == st) {
                    a.value = INF;
                    return;
                } else stu[a[i][j][k].fir] = st;
                if (pro[a[i][j][k].sec] == st) {
                    a.value = INF;
                    return;
                } else pro[a[i][j][k].sec] = st;
            }
        }
}

inline void xjb_done() {
    static int p[MAXN], o[MAXN];
    register int i, j, k, level, q, w, flag;
    if (!p[1]) {
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) o[i] = i;
    } else {
        shuffle_array(p + 1, p + n + 1);
        shuffle_array(o + 1, o + m + 1);
        now = Status();
    }
    for (int t = 1; t <= n; t++) {
        for (int g = 1; g <= m; g++) {
            i = p[t], j = o[g], k = G[i][j];
            for (level = 0; level < 7 && k; level++) {
                for (q = 0; q < 6 && k; q++) {
                    if (now[q][level].size() < A) {
                        flag = 1;
                        for (w = (int)now[q][level].size() - 1; ~w; w--) {
                            if (now[q][level][w].fir == i || now[q][level][w].sec == j) {
                                flag = 0;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (flag) now[q][level].push_back(mp(i, j)), k--;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (k) {
                now.value = INF;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    now.get_value();
    check(now);
    Run_Time -= 7 * 6 * n * m * 12;
}

inline void SA() {

}

int stud[MAXN][6][7];

inline void output(Status &a) {
    memset(stud, 0, sizeof stud);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            for (int k = (int)a[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                stud[a[i][j][k].fir][i][j] = a[i][j][k].sec;
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n\n", a.value);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 0; w < 7; w++) {
            for (int q = 0; q < 6; q++) {
                printf("%d ", stud[i][q][w]);
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("03.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("03.out", "w", stdout);
    cin >> n >> m >> A;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            cin >> G[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= 61; i++) val[i] = (3 + i) * (3 + i);
    xjb_done();
    ans = now;
    while (Run_Time > 0) {
        xjb_done();
        if (now.value < ans.value) ans = now;
        //SA();
    }
    output(ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 52
#define D 205

int T, n, m, C, d, MOD;
int xx[N], yy[N];

int dp[D][2 * N][N][N];
bool vis[N][N];

void solve1() {
    memset(dp, 0, sizeof dp);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    for (int i = 1; i <= C; i++) {
        read(xx[i]), read(yy[i]);
        vis[xx[i]][yy[i]] = 1;
    }
    int ans = 0;
    dp[0][0][1][1] = 1;
    for (int k = 0; k <= d; k++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < n + m - 1; c++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                int q = c + 2 - i;
                if (q > m) continue;
                for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (i == j && !(c == 0 && i == 1)) continue;
                    int w = c + 2 - j;
                    if (w > m) continue;
                    (dp[k + vis[i][q + 1] + vis[j][w + 1]][c + 1][i][j] 		+= dp[k][c][i][j]) %= MOD;
                    (dp[k + vis[i][q + 1] + vis[j + 1][w]][c + 1][i][j + 1]		+= dp[k][c][i][j]) %= MOD;
                    (dp[k + vis[i + 1][q] + vis[j][w + 1]][c + 1][i + 1][j] 	+= dp[k][c][i][j]) %= MOD;
                    (dp[k + vis[i + 1][q] + vis[j + 1][w]][c + 1][i + 1][j + 1] += dp[k][c][i][j]) %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        (ans += dp[k][n + m - 2][n][n]) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

void solve2() {}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(C);
    read(d);
    read(MOD);
    if (n <= 50 && m <= 50) solve1();
    else solve2();
}

int main() {
    freopen("grid.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("grid.out", "w", stdout);
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//gr_SA.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
#define time(a) (233333333 ^ rand())
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;

ULL __rand_value = 0x2333333333333333, __hidden_seed = 0x79786365766f6c69;

inline ULL raw_rand() {
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 12;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value + 1) << 25;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 27;
    return __rand_value ^ __hidden_seed;
}

inline void Srand(ULL seed = 0x319) {
    __rand_value ^= time(NULL) * 0x2545f4914f6cdd1d;
    __hidden_seed ^=  (seed << 32) ^ seed ^ raw_rand();
}

inline int rand_int(LL st = INT_MIN, LL ed = INT_MAX) {
    return int(raw_rand() % (ed - st + 1) + st);
}

inline ULL rand_ll(LL st = LLONG_MIN, LL ed = LLONG_MAX) {
    if (st + ULLONG_MAX == (ULL)ed)
        return raw_rand();
    else
        return raw_rand() % (ed - st + 1) + st;
}

#define rand_01() (double(raw_rand() & 0xffffffff) / UINT_MAX)

template <typename _type_iterator> void shuffle_array(_type_iterator __fir, _type_iterator __last) {
    for (_type_iterator it = __fir; it < __last; std::swap(*it, *(it + rand_ll(0, __last - it - 1))), it++);
    for (_type_iterator it = __last - 1; it > __fir; std::swap(*it, *(it - rand_ll(0, it - __fir))), it--);
}

inline double fast_exp(double y) {
    double d;
    *(reinterpret_cast<int*>(&d) + 0) = 0;
    *(reinterpret_cast<int*>(&d) + 1) = static_cast<int>(1512775 * y + 1072632447);
    return d;
}

#define N 66
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f
LL Run_Time = LL(7e9);

int n, m, NM;
unsigned A;
int val[N], G[N][N];

int sst[N], sed[N], pst[N], ped[N];
struct Status {
    int value;
    vector<pii> arr[6][7];
    Status () : value(INF) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) arr[i][j].clear();
    }
    vector<pii>* operator [] (int x) {
        return arr[x];
    }
    void get_value() {
        value = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) sst[j] = -1, sed[j] = -1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) pst[j] = -1, ped[j] = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                for (int k = (int)arr[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                    if (sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] == -1) sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    sed[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    if (pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] == -1) pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                    ped[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (sst[j] != -1) value += val[sed[j] - sst[j]];
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (pst[j] != -1) value += val[ped[j] - pst[j]];
        }
    }
};

Status now, ans, newst;

inline void xjb_done() {
    static int p[N], o[N];
    register int i, j, k, level, q, w, flag;
    if (!p[1]) {
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) o[i] = i;
    } else {
        shuffle_array(p + 1, p + n + 1);
        shuffle_array(o + 1, o + m + 1);
        now = Status();
    }
    for (int t = 1; t <= n; t++) {
        for (int g = 1; g <= m; g++) {
            i = p[t], j = o[g], k = G[i][j];
            for (level = 0; level < 7 && k; level++) {
                for (q = 0; q < 6 && k; q++) {
                    if (now[q][level].size() < A) {
                        flag = 1;
                        for (w = (int)now[q][level].size() - 1; ~w; w--) {
                            if (now[q][level][w].fir == i || now[q][level][w].sec == j) {
                                flag = 0;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (flag) now[q][level].push_back(mp(i, j)), k--;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (k) {
                now.value = INF;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    now.get_value();
    if (now.value < ans.value) ans = now;
    Run_Time -= (n * m + NM) << 9;
}

inline bool check(Status &a) {
    static pii stu[N], pro[N], st;
    static int F[N][N];
    Run_Time -= (NM) << 2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) stu[i] = mp(-1, -1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) pro[i] = mp(-1, -1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) F[i][j] = G[i][j];
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            st = mp(i, j);
            for (int k = (int)a[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                F[a[i][j][k].fir][a[i][j][k].sec]--;
                if (stu[a[i][j][k].fir] == st) return cerr << "Stud" << endl, 0;
                else stu[a[i][j][k].fir] = st;
                if (pro[a[i][j][k].sec] == st) return cerr << "Prof" << endl, 0;
                else pro[a[i][j][k].sec] = st;
            }
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (F[i][j]) return cerr << "Not Correct " << i << " " << j << " "  << F[i][j] << endl, 0;
    return 1;
}

const double Dec = 0.99997;

struct Visit {
    bool a[N];
    bool &operator [] (unsigned x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void clear() {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    }
};

Visit stu[6][7], pro[6][7];

inline void fall_down(register int r) {
    for (register int i = 0, j = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        while (i < 7 && !newst[r][i].size()) i++;
        if (i < 7) {
            if (j < i) newst[r][j] = newst[r][i], stu[r][j] = stu[r][i], pro[r][j] = pro[r][i], newst[r][i].clear(), pro[r][i].clear(), stu[r][i].clear();
            j++;
        }
    }
    Run_Time -= NM << 2;
}

inline void get_newst(int T) {
    memset(stu, 0, sizeof stu);
    memset(pro, 0, sizeof pro);
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            for (k = (int)now[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                stu[i][j][now[i][j][k].fir] = 1;
                pro[i][j][now[i][j][k].sec] = 1;
            }
        }
    newst = now;
    register int opt, a1, b1, a2, b2, st, ed;
    while (T-- > 0) {
        opt = (int)raw_rand() & 3;
        switch (opt) {
        case 0 :
        case 3 : // insert
            a1 = rand_int(0, 5), b1 = rand_int(0, 6);
            a2 = rand_int(0, 5), b2 = rand_int(0, 6);
            if ((a1 != a2 || b1 != b2) && newst[a1][b1].size() && newst[a2][b2].size() < A) {
                j = rand_int(0, newst[a1][b1].size() - 1);
                if (stu[a2][b2][newst[a1][b1][j].fir] || pro[a2][b2][newst[a1][b1][j].sec]) continue;
                stu[a1][b1][newst[a1][b1][j].fir] = 0;
                stu[a2][b2][newst[a1][b1][j].fir] = 1;
                pro[a1][b1][newst[a1][b1][j].sec] = 0;
                pro[a2][b2][newst[a1][b1][j].sec] = 1;
                newst[a2][b2].push_back(newst[a1][b1][j]);

                //	cerr << newst[a1][b1][j].fir << " " << newst[a1][b1][j].sec << " " << newst[a2][b2].size() << endl;

                newst[a1][b1][j] = newst[a1][b1][newst[a1][b1].size() - 1];
                stu[a1][b1][j] = stu[a1][b1][newst[a1][b1].size() - 1];
                pro[a1][b1][j] = pro[a1][b1][newst[a1][b1].size() - 1];
                newst[a1][b1].pop_back();

                fall_down(a1);
                fall_down(a2);
                //	if (!check(newst)) {
                //		exit(1);
                //	}

            }

            break;
        case 1 : // partial shuffle
            k = rand_int(0, 5);
            st = rand_int(0, 6), ed = rand_int(0, 6);
            if (st > ed) j = st, st = ed, ed = j;
            if (st < ed) {
                for (i = ed; i > st; i--) {
                    j = rand_int(st, i);
                    if (i != j) {
                        swap(stu[k][i], stu[k][j]);
                        swap(pro[k][i], pro[k][j]);
                        swap(newst[k][i], newst[k][j]);
                    }
                }
                fall_down(k);
                T -= 7;
            }
            break;
        case 2 : // partial reverse
            k = rand_int(0, 5);
            st = rand_int(0, 6), ed = rand_int(0, 6);
            if (st > ed) j = st, st = ed, ed = j;
            if (st < ed) {
                reverse(pro[k] + st, pro[k] + ed + 1);
                reverse(stu[k] + st, stu[k] + ed + 1);
                reverse(newst[k] + st, newst[k] + ed + 1);
                T -= 7;
                fall_down(k);
            }
        }
    }
    newst.get_value();
}

inline void SA() {
    for (register double Temp = 66.666; int(Temp); Run_Time -= (7 | int(Temp *= Dec)) << 9) {
        get_newst(int(Temp));
        if (!check(newst)) continue;
        if (newst.value < INF) {
            if (newst.value <= now.value) {
                now = newst;
                if (newst.value < ans.value) {
                    ans = newst;
                }
            } else if (rand_01() <= fast_exp((now.value - newst.value) * 3 / Temp)) now = newst;
        }
    }
}

int stud[N][6][7];

inline void output(Status &a) {
    memset(stud, 0, sizeof stud);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            for (int k = (int)a[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                stud[a[i][j][k].fir][i][j] = a[i][j][k].sec;
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n\n", a.value);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 0; w < 7; w++) {
            for (int q = 0; q < 6; q++) {
                printf("%d ", stud[i][q][w]);
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("03.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("03.out", "w", stdout);
    cin >> n >> m >> A;
    NM = n + m;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            cin >> G[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= 61; i++) val[i] = (3 + i) * (3 + i);
    xjb_done();
    while (Run_Time >> 32) xjb_done();
    while (Run_Time > 233333333) {
        SA();
        xjb_done();
    }
    output(ans);
    return 0;
}

//guard.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 23
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
typedef long long LL;

int n, m, t;
char s[MAXN];
int G[MAXN][MAXN], w[MAXN], v[MAXN];

namespace vio {
int ans = 0, top = 0;
int st = 0;
bool vis[1 << 17];
LL val[1 << 17];
void dfs(int x) {
    if (x == n) {
        vis[st] = 1;
        return;
    }
    st ^= (1 << x);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        if (G[x][i] && ((~st >> (n + i)) & 1)) {
            st ^= 1 << (n + i);
            dfs(x + 1);
            st ^= 1 << (n + i);
        }
    }
    st ^= (1 << x);
    dfs(x + 1);
}
void work() {
    top = 1 << (n + m);
    dfs(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) val[1 << i] = w[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) val[1 << (n + i)] = v[i];
    for (int i = 3; i < top; i++) {
        val[i] = val[i ^ lowbit(i)] + val[lowbit(i)];
    }
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (vis[i] && val[i] >= t) {
            ans++;
            for (int j = 0; j < n + m; j++) if ((i >> j) & 1) vis[i ^ (1 << j)] = 1;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}
}

namespace ful {
LL ww[(1 << 20) + 319], tw, vv[(1 << 20) + 319], tv;
LL a[(1 << 20) + 319], acnt = 0, b[(1 << 20) + 319], bcnt = 0;
LL ans = 0;
void work() {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ww[1 << i] = w[i];
    tw = 1 << n;
    for (int i = 3; i < tw; i++) ww[i] = ww[i ^ lowbit(i)] + ww[lowbit(i)];
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) vv[1 << i] = v[i];
    tv = 1 << m;
    for (int i = 3; i < tv; i++) vv[i] = vv[i ^ lowbit(i)] + vv[lowbit(i)];
    int lim = min(n, m);
    for (int i = 0; i < tw; i++) if (__builtin_popcount(i) <= lim) a[++acnt] = ww[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < tv; i++) if (__builtin_popcount(i) <= lim) b[++bcnt] = vv[i];
    sort(b + 1, b + bcnt + 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= acnt; i++) ans += bcnt - int(lower_bound(b + 1, b + bcnt + 1, t - a[i]) - b - 1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}
}

//gzf.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define PRID "10"
using namespace std;

int n,x;
int p[20],cnt[20],pcnt;
inline bool checkz() {
    bool flag;
    for (int i=p[1]+1,t=p[pcnt],jj=2; i<=t; i++) {
        flag=0;
        for (int j=2,tt=int(sqrt(i)); j<=tt; j++) {
            if (!(i%j)) {
                flag=1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag)
            continue;
        if (p[jj++]!=i)
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
inline bool checkf() {
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (cnt[i]%3==2)
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
int main() {
    int f;
    freopen("gzf" PRID ".in","r",stdin);
    freopen("gzf" PRID ".ans","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    while (n--) {
        pcnt=0,f=1;
        scanf("%d",&x);
        for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(x)); i<=t; i++) {
            if (!(x%i)) {
                p[++pcnt]=i;
                cnt[pcnt]=0;
                while (!(x%i)) {
                    x/=i;
                    cnt[pcnt]++;
                }
                f=max(f,cnt[pcnt]);
                if (x==1)
                    break;
            }
        }
        if (x>1) {
            p[++pcnt]=x;
            cnt[pcnt]=1;
        }
        bool G=(f==1),Z=checkz(),F=checkf();
        if (G||Z||F) {
            if (G) putchar('G');
            if (Z) putchar('Z');
            if (F) putchar('F');
            putchar(10);
        } else
            puts("FUCK");
    }
    return 0;
}

inline long long check(long long x) {
    long long ans=0,i=2;
    while (i*i*i<=x) {
        ans+=x/(i*i*i);
        i++;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>m;
    long long l=0,r=123456789012345678,mid,res;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        res=check(mid);
        if (res>=m) {
            r=mid;
            if (res==m)
                ans=mid;
        } else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    cout<<ans;
    return 0;
}

//hackvm.cpp
#include <climits>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int MAX_CYCLES = 10000;

long long Memory[16384];
vector<int> CallStack;
vector<long long> OperandStack;
int ProgramCounter = 0;
int CycleCounter = 0;

string Code;

void Push(long long v) {
    if (v < INT_MIN || v > INT_MAX)
        throw string("integer overflow");
    OperandStack.push_back(v);
}

long long Pop() {
    if (OperandStack.empty())
        throw string("stack underflow");
    long long x = OperandStack.back();
    OperandStack.pop_back();
    return x;
}

void DoPush(long long v) {
    Push(v - '0');
}

void DoPrintChar(long long v) {
    cout << (char)(Pop() & 0x7F);
}

void DoPrintInt(long long v) {
    cout << (int)Pop();
}

void DoAdd(long long v) {
    Push(Pop() + Pop());
}

void DoSub(long long v) {
    long long a = Pop();
    long long b = Pop();
    Push(b - a);
}

void DoMul(long long v) {
    Push(Pop() * Pop());
}

void DoDiv(long long v) {
    long long a = Pop();
    long long b = Pop();
    if (a == 0)
        throw string("divided by zero");
    Push(b / a);
}

void DoCmp(long long v) {
    long long a = Pop();
    long long b = Pop();
    Push(b > a ? 1 : b == a ? 0 : -1);
}

void DoGoto(long long v) {
    ProgramCounter += Pop();
}

void DoGotoIfZero(long long v) {
    long long offset = Pop();
    if (Pop() == 0)
        ProgramCounter += offset;
}

void DoCall(long long v) {
    CallStack.push_back(ProgramCounter);
    ProgramCounter = Pop();
}

void DoReturn(long long v) {
    if (CallStack.empty())
        throw string("call stack underflow");
    ProgramCounter = CallStack.back();
    CallStack.pop_back();
}

void DoPeek(long long v) {
    long long addr = Pop();
    if (addr < 0 || addr >= 16384)
        throw string("memory read access violation");
    //cerr << "get " << addr << "  : " << Memory[(int)addr] << endl;
    Push(Memory[(int)addr]);
}

void DoPoke(long long v) {
    long long addr = Pop();
    if (addr < 0 || addr >= 16384)
        throw string("memory write access violation");
    Memory[(int)addr] = Pop();
    //cerr << "mem " << (int)addr << "  : " << Memory[(int)addr] << endl;
}

void DoPick(long long v) {
    long long where = Pop();
    if (where < 0 || where >= (int)OperandStack.size())
        throw string("out of stack bounds");
    Push(OperandStack[OperandStack.size() - 1 - where]);
}

void DoRoll(long long v) {
    long long where = Pop();
    if (where < 0 || where >= (int)OperandStack.size())
        throw string("out of stack");
    v = OperandStack[OperandStack.size() - 1 - where];
    OperandStack.erase(OperandStack.begin() + OperandStack.size() - 1 - where);
    Push(v);
}

void DoDrop(long long v) {
    Pop();
}

void DoEnd(long long v) {
    ProgramCounter = Code.size();
}

void DoNothing(long long v) {
}

map<char, void (*)(long long)> OPS;

void insert_ops(char key, void (*value)(long long)) {
    OPS[key] = value;
}

int main() {
    insert_ops(' ', DoNothing);
    insert_ops('\n',DoNothing);
    insert_ops('p', DoPrintInt);
    insert_ops('P', DoPrintChar);
    insert_ops('0', DoPush);
    insert_ops('1', DoPush);
    insert_ops('2', DoPush);
    insert_ops('3', DoPush);
    insert_ops('4', DoPush);
    insert_ops('5', DoPush);
    insert_ops('6', DoPush);
    insert_ops('7', DoPush);
    insert_ops('8', DoPush);
    insert_ops('9', DoPush);
    insert_ops('+', DoAdd);
    insert_ops('-', DoSub);
    insert_ops('*', DoMul);
    insert_ops('/', DoDiv);
    insert_ops(':', DoCmp);
    insert_ops('g', DoGoto);
    insert_ops('?', DoGotoIfZero);
    insert_ops('c', DoCall);
    insert_ops('$', DoReturn);
    insert_ops('<', DoPeek);
    insert_ops('>', DoPoke);
    insert_ops('^', DoPick);
    insert_ops('v', DoRoll);
    insert_ops('d', DoDrop);
    insert_ops('!', DoEnd);

    cout << "memory cells:" << endl;
    string initial_memory;
    getline(cin, initial_memory);
    replace(initial_memory.begin(), initial_memory.end(), ',', ' ');
    istringstream stm(initial_memory);
    long long cell;
    int i = 0;
    while (stm >> cell)
        Memory[i++] = cell;
    cout << "code:" << endl;
    getline(cin, Code);
    cout << "output:" << endl;
    char op_code;
    try {
        while (ProgramCounter != (int)Code.size()) {
            op_code = Code[ProgramCounter];
            //	cout << "(" << ProgramCounter << ")" << op_code << endl;
            ProgramCounter++;
            CycleCounter++;
            if (CycleCounter > MAX_CYCLES)
                throw string("too many cycles");
            if (OPS.count(op_code) == 0)
                throw string("invalid instruction");
            OPS[op_code](op_code);
            if (ProgramCounter < 0 || ProgramCounter > (int)Code.size())
                throw string("out of code bounds");
            /*cout << "Mem : ";
            for (int j = 0; j < 21; j++) cout << Memory[j] << " ";
            cout << endl;
            cout << "Sta : ";
            for (int j = 0; j < OperandStack.size(); j++) cout << OperandStack[j] << " ";
            cout << endl;
            cerr << "STACK_SIZE = " << OperandStack.size() << endl;
            cerr << "STACK_TOP = " << OperandStack[OperandStack.size() - 1] << endl;*/
        }
    } catch (string x) {
        cerr << "!ERROR: exception while executing I=" << op_code
             << " PC=" << ProgramCounter - 1
             << " STACK_SIZE=" << OperandStack.size() << endl;
        cerr << x << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    cout << endl;
    return 0;
}

Line ToLine(double a, double b, double c) {
    if(sgn(b)) {
        if(sgn(b) < 0) return Line(Point(0.0, c / b), Point(1.0, (c - a) / b));
        else return Line(Point(1.0, (c - a) / b), Point(.0, c / b));
    } else {
        if(sgn(a) > 0) return  Line(Point(c / a, 0.0), Point(c / a, 1.0));
        else return Line(Point(c / a, 1.0), Point(c / a, 0.0));
    }
}

/*�������������ƽ�潻
    1. �����еİ�ƽ�水�ռ�������, (��������л�Ҫ��ƽ�еİ�ƽ��ȥ��)
    2. ʹ��һ��˫�˶���deque, ���뼫����С��������ƽ��
    3. ɨ�����ÿ�ο���һ���µİ�ƽ��
        while deque���˵�������ƽ��Ľ����ڵ�ǰ��ƽ����: ɾ��deque���˵İ�ƽ��
        while deque�ײ���������ƽ��Ľ����ڵ�ǰ��ƽ����: ɾ��deque�ײ��İ�ƽ��
        ����ǰ��ƽ�����deque����
    4. ɾ��deque������������Ķ���İ�ƽ��
        while deque���˵�������ƽ��Ľ����ڵ�ǰ��ƽ����: ɾ��deque���˵İ�ƽ��

    5. ����˳����ȡdeque���������ڰ�ƽ��Ľ���, �õ�n����ƽ�潻����͹�����.
*/
inline int sgn(double x) {
    return x < -EPS ? -1 : x > EPS ? 1 : 0;
}
struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point(double xx = 0.0, double yy = 0.0): x(xx), y(yy) {}
    void in() {
        scanf("%lf%lf", &x, &y);
    }
    Point operator + (const Point &b) const {
        return Point(x + b.x, y + b.y);
    }
    Point operator - (const Point &b) const {
        return Point(x - b.x, y - b.y);
    }
    Point operator * (double b) {
        return Point(x * b, y * b);
    }
    double operator * (const Point &b) const {
        return x * b.x + y * b.y;
    }
    double operator ^ (const Point &b) const {
        return x * b.y - y * b.x;
    }
} ans[NUM];
struct Line {
    Point s, e;
    double k;
    Line() {}
    Line(Point _s, Point _e): s(_s), e(_e) {
        k = atan2(e.y - s.y, e.x - s.x);
    }
    void K() {
        k = atan2(e.y - s.y, e.x - s.x);
    }
    Point operator & (const Line &b) const {
        return s + (e - s) * (((s - b.s) ^ (b.s - b.e)) / ((s - e) ^ (b.s - b.e)));
    }
} L[NUM], que[NUM];
int ln;
inline bool HPIcmp(Line a, Line b) {
    if(sgn(a.k - b.k) != 0)return sgn(a.k - b.k) < 0;
    return ((a.s - b.s) ^ (b.e - b.s)) < 0;
}
void HPI(Line line[], int n, Point res[], int &resn) {
    sort(line, line + n, HPIcmp);
    int tot = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if(sgn(abs(line[i].k - line[i - 1].k)) != 0)
            line[tot++] = line[i];
    }
    int head = 0, tail = 1;
    que[0] = line[0];
    que[1] = line[1];
    resn = 0;
    for(int i = 2; i < tot; ++i) {
        if(sgn((que[tail].e - que[tail].s) ^ (que[tail - 1].e - que[tail - 1].s)) == 0 ||
                sgn((que[head].e - que[head].s) ^ (que[head + 1].e - que[head + 1].s)) == 0)
            return ;
        while(head < tail && sgn(((que[tail]&que[tail - 1]) - line[i].s) ^ (line[i].e - line[i].s)) > 0)
            --tail;
        while(head < tail && sgn(((que[head]&que[head + 1]) - line[i].s) ^ (line[i].e - line[i].s)) > 0)
            ++head;
        que[++tail] = line[i];
    }
    while(head < tail && sgn(((que[tail]&que[tail - 1]) - que[head].s) ^ (que[head].e - que[head].s)) > 0)
        --tail;
    while(head < tail && sgn(((que[head]&que[head + 1]) - que[tail].s) ^ (que[tail].e - que[tail].s)) > 0)
        ++head;
    if(tail <= head + 1) return ;
    for(int i = head; i < tail; ++i)
        res[resn++] = que[i] & que[i + 1];
    if(head < tail - 1)
        res[resn++] = que[head] & que[tail];
}

int map[3][3];
void move(int n,char a,char b,char c) {
    if(n==1) {
        /*printf("\t%c->%c\n",a,c);*/map[a-'a'][c-'a']++;
    }//\B5\B1n?\D3\D01\B8\F6\B5\C4?\BA\F2?\BD?\D3a\D2?\AF\B5\BDc
    else {
        move(n-1,a,c,b);            //\B5\DAn-1\B8\F6?\B4\D3a?\B9\FDc\D2?\AF\B5\BDb
        /*printf("\t%c->%c\n",a,c);*/map[a-'a'][c-'a']++;
        move(n-1,b,a,c);            //n-1\B8\F6\D2?\AF\B9\FD\C0\B4?\BA\F3b\B1ٳ?\C5?\ACb?\B9\FDa\D2?\AF\B5\BDc\A3\AC\D5\E2\B1?\DC\C4\D1\C0\ED\BD\E2
    }
}

//harem.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXM 105

int n,m;
char s[MAXM];
long long now[MAXM][MAXM],trans[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM];

void mul(long long a[MAXM][MAXM],long long b[MAXM][MAXM]) {
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<=m; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
    }
}

void quickpower() {
    while (n) {
        if (n&1) mul(now,trans);
        mul(trans,trans);
        n>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("harem.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("harem.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (s[j]=='0') trans[i][j]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) trans[i][0]=trans[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) now[i][i]=1;
    quickpower();
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) {
        ans+=now[i][0];
    }
    cout<<ans%MOD<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//hash_64bit.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#define P 107
#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;
int n,l;
char s[MAXN];
LL ha[MAXN];
vector <LL> a;
int main() {
    freopen("hashk.in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d%d%s",&n,&l,s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*P+s[i];
    }
    LL xx=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=l; i++) xx=xx*P;
    for (int i=l; i<=n; i++) {
        a.push_back(ha[i]-ha[i-l]*xx);
    }
    sort(a.begin(),a.end());
    printf("%d\n",int(unique(a.begin(),a.end())-a.begin()));
    return 0;
}

//hash.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
const LL P1=103,P2=107;
const LL MOD=1234567;

struct statu {
    LL v1,v2;
    bool operator < (statu a) {
        if (v1!=a.v1) return v1<a.v1;
        else return v2<a.v2;
    }
    bool operator == (statu a) {
        return v1==a.v1 && v2==a.v2;
    }
} a[100005];

int n;
char s[2005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        int len=(int)strlen(s+1);
        LL v1=0,v2=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=len; j++) {
            v1=(v1*P1+s[j])%MOD;
            v2=(v2*P2+s[j])%MOD;
        }
        a[i].v1=v1;
        a[i].v2=v2;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    n=int(unique(a+1,a+n+1)-a-1);
    printf("%d\n",n);
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
#define P 107
#define Q 109
#define QMOD 2147483647
#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;
int n,l;
char s[MAXN];
LL ha[MAXN],ha2[MAXN];
vector < pair<LL,int> > a;

LL getMOD(LL x,int MOD) {
    x%=MOD;
    if (x<0) return int(x+MOD);
    return x;
}

int main() {
    freopen("hashk.in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d%d%s",&n,&l,s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*P+s[i];
        ha2[i]=(ha2[i-1]*Q+s[i])%QMOD;
    }
    LL xx=1,yy=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=l; i++) xx=xx*P,yy=(yy*Q)%QMOD;
    for (int i=l; i<=n; i++) {
        a.push_back(make_pair(ha[i]-ha[i-l]*xx,getMOD(ha2[i]-ha2[i-l]*yy,QMOD)));
    }
    sort(a.begin(),a.end());
    printf("%d\n",int(unique(a.begin(),a.end())-a.begin()));
    return 0;
}

int findl(int x) {
    int l=0,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (a[mid]<x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}
int findr(int x) {
    int l=0,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (a[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

//hcys-AC.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#define inf 0x7fffffff
using namespace std;
int n,m,q,cnt,tot,deep[10001],head[10001],f[10001],fa[10001][17],d[10001][17];
bool vis[10001];
struct edge {
    int x,y,v;
} a[50001];
struct e {
    int next,to,v;
} e[20001];
void ins(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++cnt].to=v;
    e[cnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=cnt;
    e[cnt].v=w;
}
void insert(int u,int v,int w) {
    ins(u,v,w);
    ins(v,u,w);
}
int find(int x) {
    return f[x]==x?x:f[x]=find(f[x]);
}
bool cmp(edge a,edge b) {
    return a.v>b.v;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    vis[x]=1;
    for(int i=1; i<=16; i++) {
        if(deep[x]<(1<<i))break;
        fa[x][i]=fa[fa[x][i-1]][i-1];
        d[x][i]=min(d[x][i-1],d[fa[x][i-1]][i-1]);
    }
    for(int i=head[x]; i; i=e[i].next) {
        if(vis[e[i].to])continue;
        fa[e[i].to][0]=x;
        d[e[i].to][0]=e[i].v;
        deep[e[i].to]=deep[x]+1;
        dfs(e[i].to);
    }
}
int lca(int x,int y) {
    if(deep[x]<deep[y])swap(x,y);
    int t=deep[x]-deep[y];
    for(int i=0; i<=16; i++)
        if((1<<i)&t)x=fa[x][i];
    for(int i=16; i>=0; i--) {
        if(fa[x][i]!=fa[y][i]) {
            x=fa[x][i];
            y=fa[y][i];
        }
    }
    if(x==y)return x;
    return fa[x][0];
}
int ask(int x,int f) {
    int mn=inf;
    int t=deep[x]-deep[f];
    for(int i=0; i<=16; i++) {
        if(t&(1<<i)) {
            mn=min(mn,d[x][i]);
            x=fa[x][i];
        }
    }
    return mn;
}
int main() {
    memset(d,127/3,sizeof(d));
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)f[i]=i;
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a[i].x,&a[i].y,&a[i].v);
    sort(a+1,a+m+1,cmp);
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int x=a[i].x,y=a[i].y;
        int p=find(a[i].x),q=find(a[i].y);
        if(p!=q) {
            f[p]=q;
            insert(x,y,a[i].v);
            tot++;
            if(tot==n-1)break;
        }
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)if(!vis[i])dfs(i);
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for(int i=1; i<=q; i++) {
        int x,y;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if(find(x)!=find(y)) {
            printf("-1\n");
            continue;
        } else {
            int t=lca(x,y);
            printf("%d\n",min(ask(x,t),ask(y,t)));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//HDU1086.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator + (point a) {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) {
        return x*a.y-y*a.x;
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
    point operator * (double a) {
        return point(a*x,a*y);
    }
    bool operator == (point a) {
        return x==a.x && y==a.y;
    }
    double len2() {
        return x*x+y*y;
    }
};

struct line {
    point st,ed;
} l[110];
int n,ans;

inline bool check(int i,int j) {
    point A=l[i].st,B=l[i].ed,C=l[j].st,D=l[j].ed;
    if (A==C || A==D || B==C || B==D) //No need
        return 1;
    if ((B-A)*(D-C)==0) //Wrong!!!!!!
        return 0;
    return ((D-A)*(B-A))*((C-A)*(B-A))<0 && (((A-C)*(D-C))*((B-C)*(D-C)))<0;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    while (scanf("%d",&n)) {
        if (n==0)
            break;
        ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%lf%lf%lf%lf",&l[i].st.x,&l[i].st.y,&l[i].ed.x,&l[i].ed.y);
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
                if (check(i,j))
                    ans++;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//HDU1392.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int _x,int _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
} p[MAXN],sta[MAXN];
#define c p[1]

int power(int x) {
    return x*x;
}
int dis2(point a,point b) {
    return power(a.x-b.x)+power(a.y-b.y);
}

bool operator < (const point &a,const point &b) {
    int cross=(a.x-c.x)*(b.y-c.y)-(b.x-c.x)*(a.y-c.y);
    if (cross==0) return dis2(a,c)<dis2(b,c);
    return cross>0;
}

int n;

void work() {
    int x=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
        if (p[i].y<p[x].y) x=i;
        else if (p[i].y==p[x].y && p[i].x<p[x].x) x=i;
    }
    swap(p[1],p[x]);
    sort(p+2,p+n+1);
    int top=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (top>2 && (p[i].x-sta[top-1].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top].y)<=(p[i].x-sta[top].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top-1].y)) top--;
        sta[++top]=p[i];
    }
    double ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<top; i++) {
        ans+=sqrt(dis2(sta[i],sta[i+1]));
    }
    ans+=sqrt(dis2(sta[1],sta[top]));
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d",&n)!=EOF && n) {
        if (n==1) {
            puts("0.00");
        } else if (n==2) {
            int x,y,a,b;
            scanf("%d%d%d%d",&x,&y,&a,&b);
            printf("%.2lf\n",sqrt(dis2(point(x,y),point(a,b))));
        } else work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//heap.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct heap {
    int t[125105],tail;
    heap() {}
    void push(int x) {
        t[++tail]=x;
        for (int now=tail; now>1; now>>=1) {
            if (t[now>>1]<t[now])
                swap(t[now],t[now>>1]);
        }
        return;
    }
    void pop() {
        if (tail==0)
            return;
        swap(t[1],t[tail--]);
        int x=0,to=1;
        while (x!=to) {
            x=to;
            if (x<<1 <= tail && t[to]<t[x<<1])
                to=x<<1;
            if (x<<1 < tail && t[to]<t[(x<<1)+1])
                to=(x<<1)+1;
            swap(t[x],t[to]);
        }
        return;
    }
    int top() const {
        if (tail>0)
            return t[1];
        else
            return -1u>>1;
    }
} q;
int n;
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int mid=(n>>1)+1;
    for (int i=1,r; i<=mid; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        q.push(r);
    }
    for (int i=mid+1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        if (q.top()>r) {
            q.pop();
            q.push(r);
        }
    }
    if (n&1)
        printf("%d.0\n",q.top());
    else {
        double ans=q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans=(ans+q.top())/2;
        printf("%.1f\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//hehe.cpp

int R[MAXN];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R[i] > i) swap(a[R[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

    cerr << min(lv, rv) << endl;
    return min(lv, rv);
}

    read(B);

    tot = ta * tb * tc;

    for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
        ta -= a[j].x, tb -= a[j].y, tc -= a[j].z;
        D l = 0, r = min(1., (tot / tb / tc - ta) / a[1].x), lm, rm, lv, rv;
        while (r - l > eps) {
            lm = (l * 2 + r) / 3, rm = (l + r * 2) / 3;
            lv = check(lm), rv = check(rm);
            if (lv < rv) r = rm;
            else l = lm;

#include <vector>
#include <map>
#define P 1000000007llu
#define Q 19260817llu
#define MAXN 505
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*2];
int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
vector <LL> a[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

LL dfs(int x,int depth,int fa) {
    int cnt=0;
    a[x].clear();
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            cnt++;
            a[x].push_back(dfs(e[now].to,depth+1,x));
        }
    }
    sort(a[x].begin(),a[x].end());
    LL ret=(depth*P)^(cnt*Q);
    for (vector<LL>::iterator it=a[x].begin(); it!=a[x].end(); it++) {
        ret=ret*Q+(*it);
    }
    return ret*P;
}

void work() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,fa; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&fa);
        if (fa!=0) add(fa,i);
    }
}

map< LL,int > mp;

void markall(int index) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) mp[dfs(i,1,0)]=index;
}
int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        work();
        LL ret=dfs(1,1,0);
        if (mp.find(ret)==mp.end()) markall(i);
        printf("%d\n",mp[ret]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//hhhhhhhhhh.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr-> cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
    else {
        Node *x = root ,*y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(Node *x) {
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x-> c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(find(y));
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 26);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", sa[i]);
    putchar('\n');
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", h[i]);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int a[3][3], cnt = 0;

void getans() {
    int p, sum;
    while (cnt < 9) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            p = 0, sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (a[i][j]) p++, sum += a[i][j];
            if (p == 2) {
                cnt++;
                for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (!a[i][j]) {
                        a[i][j] = 15 - sum;
                        break;
                    }
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            p = 0, sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (a[i][j]) p++, sum += a[i][j];
            if (p == 2) {
                cnt++;
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (!a[i][j]) {
                        a[i][j] = 15 - sum;
                        break;
                    }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            printf("%d%c", a[i][j], j == 2 ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) scanf("%d", a[i] + j);
    a[1][1] = 5;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (a[i][j]) a[2 - i][2 - j] = 10 - a[i][j];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (a[i][j] == 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++) if (a[k][l] == 3) {
                            if (i != 1) a[i][l] = 8;
                            else a[k][j] = 8;
                        }
            }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (a[i][j]) cnt++;
    if (cnt >= 5) getans();
    else puts("Too Many");
    return 0;
}

//hiho65A.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,sum=0,mintotal=1000009;
char read[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,val,total; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",read);
        int len=strlen(read),j;
        for (j=0; j<len; j++) {
            if (read[j]=='o') {
                val=len-j;
                break;
            }
        }
        sum+=val;
        total=val;
        for (j++; j<len; j++) {
            if (read[j]=='o')
                total--;
        }

        if (total<mintotal)
            mintotal=total;
    }
    printf("%d\n",sum+mintotal-1);
    return 0;
}

//hiho65Are.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int k,sum=0,minx=100000009;
char read[1005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        scanf("%s",read);
        int xcnt=0,ocnt=0,upx=0,len=strlen(read)-1;
        for (int j=len; j>-1; j--) {
            if (read[j]=='x')
                xcnt++;
            if (read[j]=='o') {
                ocnt++;
                upx+=xcnt;
                xcnt=0;
            }
        }
        sum+=upx+ocnt;
        minx=min(upx,minx);
    }
    printf("%d\n",sum+minx);
    return 0;
}

#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int n;
int p[250];
double one[250],zero[250];
double total=0;
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",p+i);
        one[i]=one[i-1]+(double)p[i]/1000;
    }
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        zero[i]=zero[i+1]+(double)(1000-p[i])/1000;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        total+=one[i]+zero[i+1];
    }
    printf("%.15lf\n",total);
    total/=(n);
    total*=1000;
    int i=1;
    int top=min(n,6);
    for (i=1; i<=top; i++) {
        total*=1000;
    }
    long long ans=((long long)total)%1000000007;
    for (i=top+1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans=(ans*1000)%1000000007;
    }
    printf("%lld",ans);
    return 0;
}

//hiho65Cvio.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct prem {
    int a[10];
} p;
bool visit[1000000];
queue<prem> q;
int n,ans=1;
int getstatu(prem x) {
    int temp=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        temp=temp*10+x.a[i];
    }
    return temp;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&p.a[i]);
    }
    visit[getstatu(p)]=1;
    q.push(p);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        prem now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
                if (now.a[i]<now.a[j]) {
                    swap(now.a[i],now.a[j]);
                    if (!visit[getstatu(now)]) {
                        visit[getstatu(now)]=1;
                        ans++;
                        q.push(now);
                    }
                    swap(now.a[i],now.a[j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//hiho99.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;

struct pos {
    int x,y;
} p[4];
int visit[4][10][10];
int qx[66],qy[66];
int fx[8]= {1,2,2,1,-1,-2,-2,-1},fy[8]= {2,1,-1,-2,-2,-1,1,2};

inline void init() {
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    return;
}

inline bool check(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<9 && y>0 && y<9;
}
inline void bfs(int num) {
    int head=1,tail=2;
    qx[1]=p[num].x,qy[1]=p[num].y;
    visit[num][p[num].x][p[num].y]=1;
    while (head!=tail) {
        int x=qx[head],y=qy[head];
        for (int i=0,tox,toy; i<8; i++) {
            tox=x+fx[i],toy=y+fy[i];
            if (check(tox,toy) && !visit[num][tox][toy]) {
                visit[num][tox][toy]=visit[num][x][y]+1;
                qx[tail]=tox;
                qy[tail++]=toy;
            }
        }
        head++;
    }
    return;
}
int ch=0;
inline void read(pos &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z')
        ch=getchar();
    a.x=ch-'A'+1;
    ch=getchar();
    a.y=ch-'0';
    return;
}
inline void print() {
    int ans=INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=8; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=8; j++) {
            if (ans>visit[1][i][j]+visit[2][i][j]+visit[3][i][j]) {
                ans=visit[1][i][j]+visit[2][i][j]+visit[3][i][j];
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans-3);
    return;
}
int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        init();
        for (int i=1; i<=3; i++)
            read(p[i]);
        for (int i=1; i<=3; i++)
            bfs(i);
        print();
    }
    return 0;
}

//history.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 17
inline int min(int x, int y) {
    return x < y ? x : y;
}
inline void Sort(int *in, int *out, int *p, int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN], i;
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

inline void getsa(char *s, int *sa, int n, int m) {
    static int tmp[MAXN], tmp2[MAXN], *x = tmp, *y = tmp2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - '0' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int bl[MAXN], sqn;

struct Query {
    int x, l, r;
    bool operator < (const Query &a) const {
        if (bl[l] != bl[a.l]) return l < a.l;
        else return r < a.r;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n, m, ans[MAXN], sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
int st[MAXN][LOG], Log[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

inline int rmq(int l, int r) {
    int len = Log[r - l];
    return min(st[l + 1][len], st[r - (1 << len) + 1][len]);
}

inline void build_st() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = h[i], Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

struct zkw {
#define S 131072
    int t[S << 1];
    inline void ins(int x) {
        for (x += S; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
    }
    inline void del(int x) {
        for (x += S; x; x >>= 1) t[x]--;
    }
    inline int pre(int x) {
        x += S;
        while (x) {
            if ((x & 1) && t[x ^ 1]) {
                x ^= 1;
                while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= !!t[x ^ 1];
                return x - S;
            }
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    inline int nxt(int x) {
        x += S;
        while (x) {
            if ((~x & 1) && t[x ^ 1]) {
                x ^= 1;
                while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= !t[x];
                return x - S;
            }
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    inline int ma() {
        int x;
        if (!t[x = 1]) return 0;
        while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= !!t[x ^ 1];
        return x - S;
    }
} cnt, tot;

inline void inc(int x) {
    int pr = cnt.pre(x), nx = cnt.nxt(x);
    if (pr) tot.ins(rmq(pr, x));
    if (nx) tot.ins(rmq(x, nx));
    if (pr && nx) tot.del(rmq(pr, nx));
    cnt.ins(x);
}

inline void dec(int x) {
    cnt.del(x);
    int pr = cnt.pre(x), nx = cnt.nxt(x);
    if (pr) tot.del(rmq(pr, x));
    if (nx) tot.del(rmq(x, nx));
    if (pr && nx) tot.ins(rmq(pr, nx));
}

int main() {
    freopen("history.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("history.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn = (int)sqrt(n) + 1;
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    reverse(s + 1, s + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].l);
        q[i].l = n + 1 - q[i].l, q[i].r = n + 1 - q[i].r;
        q[i].x = i;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) bl[i] = i / sqn;
    sort(q + 1, q + m + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 2);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    build_st();
    for (int i = 1, l = 1, r = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        while (r < q[i].r) inc(rk[++r]);
        while (r > q[i].r) dec(rk[r--]);
        while (l > q[i].l) inc(rk[--l]);
        while (l < q[i].l) dec(rk[l++]);
        ans[q[i].x] = tot.ma();
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//history_vio.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
#define MAXN 100319

int n, m;
char s[MAXN];

int lcs(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for ( ; s[l - ret] == s[r - ret]; ret++);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    freopen("history.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("history_vio.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    s[0] = '$';
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int j = l; j < r; j++)
            for (int k = j + 1; k <= r; k++) {
                ans = max(ans, lcs(j, k));
            }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//holes.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 5005
#define MAXM 30005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,ecnt=0;
int st[MAXN],w[MAXN],s[MAXN],head[MAXN],dis[MAXN<<1],inq[MAXN<<1];

inline void add(int u,int v,int k) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=k;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void read() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",st+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",w+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",s+i);
    for (int i=1,u,v,k; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&k);
        add(u,v,k);
    }
}

queue <int> q;

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    if (dis[x]>d) {
        dis[x]=d;
        if (!inq[x]) {
            inq[x]=1;
            q.push(x);
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    update(1+st[1]*n,0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front(),d=dis[x],black=0;
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        if (x>n) x-=n,black=1;
        if (black) {
            update(x,d+s[x]);
        } else {
            update(x+n,d);
        }
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (st[v]==st[x]) {
                if (black) {
                    update(v,d+e[now].w);
                } else {
                    update(v+n,d+e[now].w);
                }
            } else {
                if (black) {
                    update(v+n,d+e[now].w+abs(w[x]-w[v]));
                } else {
                    update(v,d+max(0,e[now].w-abs(w[x]-w[v])));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",min(dis[n],dis[n<<1]));
}

int main() {
    freopen("holes.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("holes.out","w",stdout);
    read();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//howfaraway.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int to;
    int next;
    int w;
} e[200005];
int head[100005],ecnt=0,n,m;
int depth[100005],father[100005][20],dis[100005];
bool visit[100005];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x],v; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            visit[v]=1;
            father[v][0]=x;
            dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            depth[v]=depth[x]+1;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
    return;
}
void st() {
    memset(father,-1,sizeof(father));
    depth[1]=0;
    dis[1]=0;
    visit[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1; 1<<i <=n; i++)
        for (int v=1; v<=n; v++)
            if (father[v][i-1]!=-1) {
                father[v][i]=father[father[v][i-1]][i-1];
            }
    return;
}
int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (depth[u]<depth[v])
        swap(u,v);
    int dep=depth[u]-depth[v];
    for (int i=16; i>-1; i--)	{
        if ((1<<i) & dep)
            u=father[u][i];
    }
    for (int i=16; i>-1; i--) {
        if (father[u][i]!=father[v][i]) {
            u=father[u][i];
            v=father[v][i];
        }
    }
    if (u==v)
        return u;
    return father[u][0];
}
int query(int u,int v) {
    int f=getLCA(u,v);
    return dis[u]+dis[v]-(dis[f]<<1);
}
void init() {
    memset(head,-1,sizeof(head));
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    ecnt=0;
}
int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
            add(u,v,w);
        }
        st();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            printf("%d\n",query(u,v));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//hungary.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 2012345

int n, dfn = 0, ans = 0;
int G[MAXN], fir[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
int vis[MAXN], mat[MAXN];

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = fir[x]; G[i]; i++) if (vis[G[i]] != dfn) {
            vis[G[i]] = dfn;
            if (!mat[G[i]] || find(mat[G[i]])) return mat[G[i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1, c, x; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &c);
        for (int j = 1; j <= c; j++) scanf("%d", &x), G[ecnt++] = x;
        fir[i + 1] = ++ecnt;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dfn++;
        ans += find(i);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include<iostream>

int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
}
int n,m,K;
double ave;
int a[15][15];
int s[15][15];
double t[15][15][15][15][15];
double dfs(int a,int b,int c,int d,int k) {
    double &res=t[a][b][c][d][k];
    if(res!=-1)return res;
    if(k==0) {
        res=s[b][d]+s[a-1][c-1]-s[a-1][d]-s[b][c-1];
        res=(res-ave)*(res-ave);
        return res;
    }
    res=1e9;
    for(int i=a+1; i<=b; i++)
        for(int j=0; j<k; j++)
            res=min(res,dfs(a,i-1,c,d,j)+dfs(i,b,c,d,k-j-1));
    for(int i=c+1; i<=d; i++)
        for(int j=0; j<k; j++)
            res=min(res,dfs(a,b,c,i-1,j)+dfs(a,b,i,d,k-j-1));
    return res;
}
int main() {
    n=read();
    m=read();
    K=read();
    for(int a=0; a<=10; a++)
        for(int b=0; b<=10; b++)
            for(int c=0; c<=10; c++)
                for(int d=0; d<=10; d++)
                    for(int l=0; l<=10; l++)
                        t[a][b][c][d][l]=-1;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            a[i][j]=read();
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for(int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            s[i][j]=s[i-1][j]+s[i][j-1]-s[i-1][j-1]+a[i][j],
                    ave=(double)s[n][m]/K;
    dfs(1,n,1,m,K-1);
    printf("%.2lf",sqrt(t[1][n][1][m][K-1]/K));
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef unsigned int u32;

void Sort(u32 *a, u32 *b, int n) {
    int P[0xffff];
    memset(P, 0, sizeof P);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P[a[i]&0xffff]++;
    for (int i = 1; i < 0xffff; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n - 1; i > -1; i--) b[--P[a[i]&0xffff]] = a[i];
    memset(P, 0, sizeof P);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) P[b[i]>>16]++;
    for (int i = 1; i < 0xffff; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n - 1; i > -1; i--) a[--P[b[i]>>16]] = b[i];
}

u32 a[10], b[10];
int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]);
    Sort(a, b, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cout << a[i] << endl;
    return 0;
}

//int2048_t-test.cpp
#include <cassert>

#include <string>
#include <iostream>

#include "int2048_t.hpp"

using std::cout;
using std::endl;
using std::string;

uint64_t int2048_t::cost;

inline string bin(const int x) {
    string s;

    for (int i = 30; i >= 0; i--)
        s.push_back('0' + ((x >> i) & 1));

    return s;
}

#define NUMBER(x) (int2048_t(bin(x)))
#define BINARY(x) (int2048_t(x))

int main() {
    assert(int2048_t("110") == NUMBER(6));

    assert(NUMBER(1) + NUMBER(2) == NUMBER(3));
    assert(NUMBER(9) + NUMBER(99) == NUMBER(108));
    assert(-NUMBER(121) + NUMBER(120) == -NUMBER(1));

    assert(-(-NUMBER(2333)) == NUMBER(2333));

    assert(NUMBER(9) - NUMBER(6) == NUMBER(3));
    assert(NUMBER(9) - NUMBER(12) == -NUMBER(3));
    assert(NUMBER(101) - NUMBER(2) == NUMBER(99));
    assert(NUMBER(0) - NUMBER(7) == -NUMBER(7));
    assert(-NUMBER(12) - NUMBER(12) == -NUMBER(24));

    assert(~BINARY("010"));

    assert((NUMBER(2) & NUMBER(8)) == NUMBER(0));
    assert((NUMBER(4) & NUMBER(5)) == NUMBER(4));

    assert((NUMBER(2) | NUMBER(8)) == NUMBER(10));
    assert((NUMBER(4) | NUMBER(5)) == NUMBER(5));

    assert((NUMBER(2) ^ NUMBER(8)) == NUMBER(10));
    assert((NUMBER(4) ^ NUMBER(5)) == NUMBER(1));

    assert((NUMBER(2) << 4) == NUMBER(32));
    assert((NUMBER(9) << 5) == NUMBER(288));

    assert((NUMBER(65536) >> 3) == NUMBER(8192));
    assert((NUMBER(1023) >> 4) == NUMBER(63));

    assert(NUMBER(233) == NUMBER(233));
    assert(NUMBER(233) != -NUMBER(233));
    assert(NUMBER(0) == -NUMBER(0));

    assert(NUMBER(2) < NUMBER(3));
    assert(-NUMBER(100) < NUMBER(1));
    assert(-NUMBER(100) < -NUMBER(99));
    assert(NUMBER(0) < -NUMBER(0) == false);

    assert(NUMBER(666) > NUMBER(233));
    assert(-NUMBER(666) > -NUMBER(667));
    assert(NUMBER(0) > -NUMBER(1));
    assert(-NUMBER(12) > NUMBER(6) == false);

    assert(NUMBER(13) <= NUMBER(13));
    assert(-NUMBER(13) <= NUMBER(13));

    assert(NUMBER(6666) >= NUMBER(6666));
    assert(NUMBER(6666) >= -NUMBER(6667));

    assert(NUMBER(123));
    assert(!NUMBER(0));
    assert((bool) NUMBER(123124) == true);
    assert(bool(NUMBER(0)) == false);
    assert(static_cast<bool>(-NUMBER(0)) == false);
    assert((bool) -NUMBER(123) == true);

    cout << "exCited!" << endl;

    return 0;
}

//integer.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
const double lim = 1e11 + 233;
#define MAXN 1999319
#define check(aa) {pp = aa; ret = 0; for (tmp = 1; (double)tmp * (double)pp <= lim; tmp *= pp, ret += c / tmp - a / tmp - b / tmp); if (ret < 0) flag = 0;}

bool vis[MAXN];
int pcnt = 0, p[MAXN / 10];

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            if (i < 2333) for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
}

inline LL findlo(LL x) {
    for (x -= ~x & 1; ; x -= 2) {
        register int y = int(sqrt(x)), flag = 1, i;
        for (i = 1; p[i] <= y; i++) {
            if (x % p[i] == 0) {
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return x;
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%lld\n", findlo(123456789ll));
    LL ra, rb, rc;
    register LL ret, tmp, a, b, c, pp;
    register int i;
    register bool flag;
    while (~scanf("%lld%lld%lld", &ra, &rb, &rc)) {
        a = ra, b = rb, c = rc;
        flag = 1;
        if (c < a || c < b) flag = 0;
        for (i = 1; flag && i <= pcnt; i++) check(p[i]);
        if (flag) check(19260817);
        if (flag) check(120180241);
        if (flag) check(999999319);
        if (flag) check(1000000007);
        if (flag) check(2147483647);
        if (flag && a >= MAXN) check(findlo(a));
        if (flag && b >= MAXN) check(findlo(b));
        puts(flag ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
    return 0;
}

    memset(cnt, 0, sizeof cnt);

    return 1;
}
