#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int sz, cnt, v;
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sz = c[0]->sz + c[1]->sz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->sz = ptr->cnt = 1;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void ins(int v) {
    Node *x = rt;
    while (x->v != v) {
        if (x->c[x->v < v] == null) {
            x->setc(newNode(v), x->v < v);
            splay(ptr - 1);
            return;
        } else {
            x = x->c[x->v < v];
        }
    }
    splay(x);
    x->cnt++, x->sz++;
}

void del(int v) {
    Node *x = rt;
    while (x->v != v) {
        x = x->c[x->v < v];
    }
    splay(x);
    x->cnt--, x->sz--;
    if (!x->cnt) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1);
        rt = y;
        y->fa = null;
        y->upd();
    }
}

int pre(int v) {
    Node *x = rt, *y = mem;
    while (x != null) {
        if (x->v < v && y->v < x->v) y = x;
        if (x->c[x->v < v] == null) {
            splay(x);
            break;
        }
        x = x->c[x->v < v];
    }
    return y->v;
}

int nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = rt, *y = mem + 1;
    while (x != null) {
        if (x->v > v && y->v > x->v) y = x;
        if (x->c[x->v <= v] == null) {
            splay(x);
            break;
        }
        x = x->c[x->v <= v];
    }
    return y->v;
}

int lt(int v) {
    Node *x = rt, *y;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (x != null) {
        if (x->v > v) y = x->c[0];
        else if (x->v == v) {
            cnt += x->c[0]->sz;
            break;
        } else {
            cnt += x->c[0]->sz + x->cnt;
            y = x->c[1];
        }
        if (y == null) {
            splay(x);
            break;
        }
        x = y;
    }
    return cnt;
}

int rk(int k) {
    Node *x = rt;
    while (x != null) {
        if (x->c[0]->sz > k) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->c[0]->sz + x->cnt > k) {
            splay(x);
            return x->v;
        } else {
            k -= x->c[0]->sz + x->cnt;
            x = x->c[1];
        }
    }
    return -233;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode(-INF);
    rt->setc(newNode(INF), 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int op, x;
        read(op);
        read(x);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            ins(x);
            break;
        case 2:
            del(x);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", lt(x));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", rk(x));
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n", pre(x));
            break;
        case 6:
            printf("%d\n", nxt(x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//loj105.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *p;
    int sz, v;
    bool rev;
    Node () {
        sz = 0;
        rev = 0;
        v = -1;
    }
    inline bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    inline void sc(Node *cc, int q) {
        c[q] = cc;
        cc->p = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        sz = c[0]->sz + c[1]->sz + 1;
    }
    inline void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->rev ^= 1;
            c[1]->rev ^= 1;
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->p = null;
    ptr->sz = 1, ptr->v = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(mid);
    x->sc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->sc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *p = x->p;
    bool d = x->d();
    p->relax();
    x->relax();
    p->p->sc(x, p->d());
    p->sc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->sc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *p = null) {
    while (x->p != p) {
        if (x->p->p == p) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->p->d() ? (rot(x->p), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *kth(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ;) {
        x->relax();
        if (x->c[0]->sz > k) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->c[0]->sz < k) {
            k -= x->c[0]->sz + 1;
            x = x->c[1];
        } else return x;
    }
}

int n, Q;

void dfs(Node *x) {
    x->relax();
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (x->v > 0 && x->v <= n) printf("%d ", x->v);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = build(0, n + 1);
    read(Q);
    for (int l, r; Q--; ) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        Node *L = kth(l - 1), *R = kth(r + 1);
        splay(L);
        splay(R, L);
        rt->c[1]->c[0]->rev ^= 1;
    }
    dfs(rt);
    return 0;
}

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

    }

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MX 1000000100

int sl, sr;

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *p;
    int sz, v;
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void sc(Node *cc, int q) {
        c[q] = cc;
        cc->p = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sz = c[0]->sz + c[1]->sz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN * 32], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

inline Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->p = null;
    ptr->sz = 1;
    ptr->v = v;
    return ptr++;
}

struct Tnode {
    int l, r;
    Node *rt;
    Tnode() {
        rt = null;
    }
    inline void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *p = x->p;
        bool d = x->d();
        p->p->sc(x, p->d());
        p->sc(x->c[!d], d);
        x->sc(p, !d);
        p->upd();
        if (p == rt) rt = x;
    }
    inline void splay(Node *x, Node *p = null) {
        while (x->p != p) {
            if (x->p->p == p) rot(x);
            else x->d() == x->p->d() ? (rot(x->p), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }
    inline void ins(int v) {
        if (rt == null) rt = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = rt;
            while (x != null) {
                bool d = v > x->v;
                if (x->c[d] == null) {
                    x->sc(newNode(v), d);
                    splay(x->c[d]);
                    return;
                }
                x = x->c[d];
            }
        }
    }
    inline void del(int v) {
        Node *x = rt;
        while (x != null) {
            if (x->v == v) {
                splay(x);
                if (x->c[0] == null) rt = x->c[1], rt->p = null;
                else {
                    Node *y = x->c[0];
                    while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
                    splay(y, x);
                    y->sc(x->c[1], 1);
                    rt = y;
                    y->p = null;
                    y->upd();
                }
                return;
            }
            x = x->c[v > x->v];
        }
    }
    inline int count(int v, bool in) {
        if (rt == null) return 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
            if (v < x->v) {
                if (x->c[0] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[0];
            } else if (v > x->v) {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz + 1;
                if (x->c[1] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[1];
            } else {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz;
                splay(x);
                return cnt + in;
            }
        }
    }
    inline int cnt() {
        int a = count(sr, 1);
        int b = count(sl, 0);
        return a - b;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, m, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];

#define sz() rt->sz

void ins(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].ins(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) ins(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else ins(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

void del(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    t[x].del(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) del(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else del(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

int cnt(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        return t[x].cnt();
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += cnt(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += cnt(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int kth(int x, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].cnt();
    if (k <= ls) return kth(t[x].l, l, mid, k);
    else return kth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].r].cnt()) x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
            else x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int Min(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].l].cnt()) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
            else x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ins(rt, -MX, MX, a[i], i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int op, x;
        read(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", cnt(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", kth(rt, -MX, MX, x));
            break;
        case 3:
            read(op);
            read(x);
            del(rt, -MX, MX, a[op], op);
            a[op] = x;
            ins(rt, -MX, MX, x, op);
            break;
        case 4:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Max(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1));
            break;
        case 5:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Min(rt, -MX, MX, x + 1, MX));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <cstdio>

#include<sys/mman.h>
struct buf {
    char*s;
    buf():s((char*)mmap(0,150000010,PROT_READ,MAP_PRIVATE,fileno(stdin),0)) {}
    operator int() {
        int x=0,y=0;
        while(*s<48)
            if(*s++==45)y=1;
        while(*s>32)
            x=x*10+*s++-48;
        return y?-x:x;
    }
} it;
int n,m,f[N],ans,i, x, y;
#define getf(x) {\
	while (f[x] >= 0 && f[f[x]] >= 0) x = f[x] = f[f[x]];\
	if (f[x] >= 0) x = f[x];\
}
int main() {
    n=it,m=it;
    for (i = n - 1; ~i; i--) f[i] = -1;
    while(m--) {
        if(it==0) {
            x = it, y = it;
            getf(x);
            getf(y);
            if (x != y) {
                if (f[x] > f[y]) i = x, x = y, y = i;
                f[x] += f[y];
                f[y] = x;
            }
        } else {
            x = it, y = it;
            getf(x);
            getf(y);
            if ((ans = (ans << 1) + (x == y)) >= 998244353) ans -= 998244353;

//loj110.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 3000019

int n, p;

inline LL power(LL x, int b = p - 2) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * x % p;
        x = x * x % p;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL fac[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % p;
    LL inv = power(fac[n]);
    ans[n] = int(inv * fac[n - 1] % p);
    for (int i = n - 1; i; i--) {
        inv = inv * (i + 1) % p;
        ans[i] = int(inv * fac[i - 1] % p);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }

    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>

typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2555
#define s 4096
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct E {
    int next, v, w;
} e[MAXN * 5];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, S, T;

int t[s * 2];
int q[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

inline void upd(int x, int v) {
    for (t[x += s] = v; x >>= 1; t[x] = min(t[x << 1], t[(x << 1) ^ 1]));
}
inline int query() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < s) {
        x <<= 1;
        x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    }
    return x - s;
}

inline void dijkstra() {
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof(t));
    upd(S, 0);
    int x = S;
    while (true) {
        int d = t[x + s];
        if (x == T) {
            printf("%d\n", d);
            return;
        }
        vis[x] = 1;
        upd(x, INF);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].v] && t[e[now].v + s] > d + e[now].w) upd(e[now].v, d + e[now].w);
        }
        x = query();
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(S);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int u, v, w;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    dijkstra();

    return 0;
}

//loj121.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
#define getchar() getchar_unlocked()
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c = getchar();
    }
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 5005
#define M 500005

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    bool has;
    vector <pii> op;
} t[M * 2];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;
int G[N][N], U[M], V[M], tot = 0, nowu, nowv;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void add(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	cerr << l << " ~ " << r << " " << nowu << " " << nowv << endl;
        t[x].op.push_back(mp(nowu, nowv));
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) add(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) add(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

void addQ(int x, int l, int r, int p) {
    t[x].has = 1;
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].op.push_back(mp(-nowu, -nowv));
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) addQ(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else addQ(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
}

pii opsta[N];
int top = 0;
int f[N];

void ch(int x, int y) {
    opsta[++top] = mp(x, f[x]);
    f[x] = y;
}

int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : getf(f[x]);
}

void solve(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!t[x].has) return;
    int tt = top;
    for (int i = 0, j = (int)t[x].op.size(); i < j; i++) {
        int u = t[x].op[i].fir, v = t[x].op[i].sec;
        if (u < 0) continue;
        //	cerr << u << " ~ " << v << endl;
        u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
        //	cerr << u << " ~ " << v << endl;
        if (u != v) {
            //		cerr << "merge " << u << " " << v << endl;
            if (f[u] > f[v]) swap(u, v);
            ch(u, f[u] + f[v]);
            ch(v, u);
        }
    }
    if (l == r) {
        for (int i = 0; ; ) {
            if (t[x].op[i].fir < 0) {
                int u = -t[x].op[i].fir, v = -t[x].op[i].sec;
                //			cerr << u << " " << v << endl;
                u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
                //			cerr << u << " " << v << endl;
                putchar(u == v ? 'Y' : 'N');
                putchar('\n');
                break;
            }
        }
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    }
    while (top > tt) {
        f[opsta[top].fir] = opsta[top].sec;
        top--;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(1, m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int op;
        read(op);
        read(nowu);
        read(nowv);
        if (nowu > nowv) swap(nowu, nowv);
        //	cerr << "op " << op << " " << nowu << " " << nowv << endl;
        if (op == 0) {
            //		cerr << "a " << endl;
            if (!G[nowu][nowv]) U[++tot] = nowu, V[tot] = nowv;
            G[nowu][nowv] = i;
        } else if (op == 1) {
            //		cerr << "b " << endl;
            add(1, 1, m, G[nowu][nowv], i);
            G[nowu][nowv] = -1;
        } else addQ(1, 1, m, i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        if (G[U[i]][V[i]] > 0) {
            nowu = U[i], nowv = V[i];
            add(1, 1, m, G[U[i]][V[i]], m);
        }
    }
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    solve(1, 1, m);
    return 0;
}

//loser.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
    double w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,x[MAXN],y[MAXN],p[MAXN],head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int from[MAXN],fa[MAXN][12],dep[MAXN];
double dis[MAXN],tot=0,maxe[MAXN][12];

int sqr(int a) {
    return a*a;
}

// prim
bool visit[MAXN];

void prim() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) dis[i]=1e9;
    int now=1;
    while (now) {
        visit[now]=1;
        int to=0;
        double d=1e9;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                double xd=sqrt(sqr(x[now]-x[i])+sqr(y[now]-y[i]));
                if (dis[i]>xd) {
                    dis[i]=xd;
                    from[i]=now;
                } else xd=dis[i];
                if (xd<d) {
                    d=xd;
                    to=i;
                }
            }
        }
        if (to) {
            add(from[to],to,d);
            tot+=d;
        }
        now=to;
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[v][0]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            maxe[v][0]=e[now].w;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k=1; k<=10; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            fa[i][k]=fa[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
            maxe[i][k]=max(maxe[i][k-1],maxe[fa[i][k-1]][k-1]);
        }
    }
}

double query(int u,int v) {
    int wtf=p[u]+p[v];
    if (fa[v][0]==u) swap(u,v);
    if (fa[u][0]==v) return wtf/(tot-maxe[u][0]);
    double emax=0;
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=10; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            emax=max(emax,maxe[u][k]);
            u=fa[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return wtf/(tot-emax);
    for (int k=10; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            emax=max(emax,maxe[u][k]);
            emax=max(emax,maxe[v][k]);
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    emax=max(emax,maxe[u][0]);
    emax=max(emax,maxe[v][0]);
    return wtf/(tot-emax);
}

int main() {
    freopen("loser.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("loser.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",x+i,y+i,p+i);
    }
    prim();
    fa[1][0]=dep[1]=1;
    maxe[1][0]=0;
    dfs(1);
    init();
    double ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            ans=max(ans,query(i,j));
        }
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//love.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int N = 20005;
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

int n, tot;
pii a[N * 2];
LL ans = 0;

int main() {
    freopen("love.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("love.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int u, v, w, x;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        read(x);
        if (u + v >= w + x) {
            a[++tot] = mp(u + v, u);
            a[++tot] = mp(w + x, w);
        } else {
            ans += u - x;
        }
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + tot + 1);
    for (int i = tot; i > 0; i -= 2) {
        ans += a[i].sec;
        ans += a[i - 1].sec - a[i - 1].fir;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//luangao.cpp
/*
## input format

N M -- Num of items and num of drawers
N numbers next line -- The volume of every item
M numbers next line -- The volume of every drawer
N \times M numers -- The value you gain put i-th item in the j-th drawer

## output format

N numbers
denotes which drawer do the i-th item put in
if not put in, output 0
*/

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib> #include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int kN = 2000 + 10;
const int kM = 300 + 10;
const int kH = 1e7;

int N, M;
int sizes[kN];
int volumes[kM];
int p[kN][kM];
int ans[kN];
int history[kH], hcnt;

void input() {
    scanf("%d %d", &N, &M);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) scanf("%d", sizes + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= M; i++) scanf("%d", volumes + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
            scanf("%d", &p[i][j]);
        }
    }
}

void print_ans() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        printf("%d ", ans[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
}

void greedy1() {
    input();
    static bool avl[kN][kM] = {0};

    bool ok = true;
    while (ok) {
        ok = false;

        int mx = -1;
        int it, dr;

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) if (!ans[i]) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                    // printf("v:%d s:%d\n", volumes[i], sizes[j]);
                    if (volumes[j] < sizes[i]) {
                        avl[i][j] = true;
                    }
                    if (!avl[i][j] && p[i][j] > mx) {
                        mx = p[i][j];
                        it = i;
                        dr = j;
                        ok = true;
                    }
                }
            }

        if (ok) {
            ans[it] = dr;
            avl[it][dr] = true;
            volumes[dr] -= sizes[it];
        }
    }

    print_ans();
}

int best = -1;
int cur_ans[kN];
int cnt;
const int MAX_CNT = 1e9;
void dfs(int d, int profit) {
    cnt++;
    if (cnt > MAX_CNT) return;

    if (d > N) {
        if (profit > best) {
            best = profit;
            for (int i = 1; i<= N; i++) ans[i] = cur_ans[i];
        }
        return;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
        if (volumes[i] >= sizes[d]) {
            volumes[i] -= sizes[d];
            cur_ans[d] = i;
            dfs(d + 1, profit + p[d][i]);
            cur_ans[d] = 0;
            volumes[i] += sizes[d];
        }
    }
    dfs(d + 1, profit);
}

void naive1() {
    input();
    dfs(1, 0);
    print_ans();
}

void shuffle(int a[]) {
    for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
        int x = rand() % N + 1;
        int y = rand() % N + 1;
        swap(a[x], a[y]);
    }
}

void random_shuffle() {
    srand(776);
    input();

    int order[kN];
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) order[i] = i;

    for (int k = 1; k <= 5e5; k++) {
        shuffle(order);
        /*for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        	printf("%d ", order[i]);
        }
        printf("\n");*/

        int profit = 0;
        for (int q = 1; q <= N; q++) {
            int i = order[q];
            int mx_p = -1, v = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                if (volumes[j] >= sizes[i] && p[i][j] > mx_p) {
                    mx_p = p[i][j];
                    v = j;
                }
            }
            //printf("i = %d mx_p = %d v = %d volumes[v] = %d\n", i, mx_p, v, volumes[v]);
            if (mx_p > 0) {
                profit += mx_p;
                volumes[v] -= sizes[i];
            }
            cur_ans[i] = v;
        }

        if (profit > best) {
            best = profit;
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                ans[i] = cur_ans[i];
            }
            // printf("k = %d profit: %d\n", k, profit);
            // print_ans();
        }

        // recover volumes
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) if (cur_ans[i]) {
                volumes[cur_ans[i]] += sizes[i];
                cur_ans[i] = 0;
            }
    }

    print_ans();
}

int main() {
    freopen("in.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("out.txt", "w", stdout);
    // greedy1();
    // naive1();
    random_shuffle();
    return 0;
}

//magic.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#define PRID "9"
#define eps 1e-10
using namespace std;

char s[5][20];

double map[55][205],k;
int topx=0,topy=0;

inline void init() {
    strcpy(s[0],"#######            ");
    strcpy(s[1],"##   ## ##### #####");
    strcpy(s[2],"##   ## ##      ## ");
    strcpy(s[3],"##   ## ##     ##  ");
    strcpy(s[4],"####### ##    #####");
}
int main() {
    freopen("magic"PRID".in","r",stdin);
    freopen("magic"PRID".out","w",stdout);
    init();
    scanf("%lf",&k);
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<19; j++) {
            if (s[i][j]=='#') {
                double sx=i*k,sy=j*k,ex=(i+1)*k,ey=(j+1)*k;
                for (int x=(int)sx; x<=(int)ex; x++)
                    for (int y=(int)sy; y<=(int)ey; y++) {
                        double dx=max(sx,(double)x),dy=max(sy,(double)y),tx=min(ex,(double)x+1),ty=min(ey,(double)y+1);
                        map[x][y]+=(tx-dx)*(ty-dy);
                        if (map[x][y]>eps) {
                            if (x>topx) topx=x;
                            if (y>topy) topy=y;
                        }
                    }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++,putchar('\n'))
        for (int j=0; j<=topy; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]+eps>1.0) {
                putchar('#');
            } else if (map[i][j]+eps>0.5) {
                putchar('*');
            } else if (map[i][j]>eps) {
                putchar('-');
            } else
                putchar(' ');
        }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/

typedef long long LL;

        a=a*10+ch-'0';

inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

#define MAXN 50005

typedef long long LL;

int n;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN];
#define s 65536
LL t[s<<1],t2[s<<1];
int cnt[s<<1];

void insert(int x) {
    for (int p=s+x; p; p>>=1) {
        cnt[p]++;
        t[p]+=x;
        t2[p]+=LL(x)*LL(x);
    }
}

LL query(int l,int r) {
    LL ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

LL query_2(int l,int r) {
    LL ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t2[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t2[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

int query_cnt(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=cnt[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=cnt[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

long double ans=0;

int main() {
    freopen("mat.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("mat.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        read(a[i]),a[i]+=3;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        read(b[i]),b[i]+=3;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        insert(b[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int tot=query_cnt(1,a[i]-1);
        ans+=tot*LL(a[i])*LL(a[i])+query_2(1,a[i]-1)-2ll*a[i]*query(1,a[i]-1);
        tot=query_cnt(a[i]+1,51234);
        ans-=tot*LL(a[i])*LL(a[i])+query_2(a[i]+1,51234)-2ll*a[i]*query(a[i]+1,51234);
    }
    cout.setf(ios::fixed);
    cout.precision(1);
    cout<<ans/n<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//math.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstring>
#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
#include<set>
#include<string>
#include<queue>
#include<cmath>
using namespace std;
#define E 20

class poly {
private:
    double k[E + 1];
    static double fac[E + 1];
public:
    poly() {
    }

    static void init() {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= E; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] / i;
    }

    void func(int type,double a,double b) {
        double t = 1;
        double deri[4];
        if (type == 1) {
            deri[0] = sin(0.5 * a + b);
            deri[1] = cos(0.5 * a + b);
            deri[2] = -sin(0.5 * a + b);
            deri[3] = -cos(0.5 * a + b);
            for (int i = 0; i <= E; i++)
                k[i] = t * deri[i & 3] * fac[i],
                       t *= a;
        }
        if (type == 2) {
            deri[0] = exp(0.5 * a + b);
            for (int i = 0; i <= E; i++)
                k[i] = deri[0] * t * fac[i],
                       t *= a;
        }
        if (type == 3) {
            k[0] = b + 0.5 * a;
            k[1] = a;
            for (int i = 2; i <= E; i++) k[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    void merge(poly &a) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= E; i++) k[i] += a.k[i];
    }

    double operator ()(double X) {
        X -= 0.5;
        double ans = 0,tmp = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= E; i++) {
            ans += tmp * k[i];
            tmp *= X;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

double poly::fac[E + 1];

class node {
    node *f,*c[2];
    poly key,pro;
    bool rev;

    inline int findf() {
        return f->c[1]==this;
    }

    inline void update() {
        pro = key;
        if (c[0]) pro.merge(c[0]->pro);
        if (c[1]) pro.merge(c[1]->pro);
    }

    inline void down() {
        if (rev) {
            rev=0;
            swap(c[0],c[1]);
            if (c[0]) c[0]->rev^=1;
            if (c[1]) c[1]->rev^=1;
        }
    }

    void downall() {
        if (f)  f->downall();
        down();
    }

    void splay() {
        downall();
        while (f) {
            if (!(f->f))  up();
            else  if (findf()==f->findf())  f->up(),up();
            else up();
        }
    }

    void up() {
        node *t=f;
        int flag=findf();
        f=t->f;
        if (f) f->c[t->findf()]=this;
        t->f=this;
        t->c[flag]=c[flag^1];
        if (c[flag^1]) c[flag^1]->f=t;
        c[flag^1]=t;
        t->update();
        update();
    }

    void cutdown() {
        splay();
        down();
        if (c[1]) {
            c[1]->f=0;
            c[1]->find_root()->F=this;
            c[1]=0;
        }
        update();
    }

public:

    node *F,*u,*v;

    node() {
        f = c[0] = c[1] = 0;
        rev = 0;
        F = 0;
    }

    node *find_last() {
        splay();
        down();
        node *now = c[0];
        if (!now) return NULL;
        while (now->c[now->rev ^ 1]) {
            now->down();
            now = now->c[1];
        }
        now->splay();
        return now;
    }

    node *find_root() {
        node *now = this;
        while (now->f) now=now->f;
        while (now->c[now->rev]) {
            now->down();
            now=now->c[0];
        }
        now->splay();
        return now;
    }

    void change(int type,double a,double b) {
        splay();
        key.func(type,a,b);
        update();
    }

    node* access() {
        cutdown();
        node *tmp=find_root(),*fa;
        while (tmp->F) {
            fa = tmp->F;
            tmp->F = 0;
            fa->cutdown();
            fa->c[1] = tmp;
            tmp->f = fa;
            fa->update();
            tmp = fa->find_root();
        }
        return tmp;
    }

    void reverse() {
        splay();
        rev^=1;
    }

    double query(double a) {
        splay();
        return pro(a);
    }

};

char op[10];
int n,m;
node vertex[100100];

void link(node *x,node *y) {
    y->access();
    y->reverse();
    if (x->access() == y) {
        puts("error!");
    } else y->F=x;
}

void cut(node *x,node *y) {
    if (x->find_last() != y && x->F != y) swap(x,y);
    y->access();
    x->F = NULL;
}

void change(node *x,int type,double a,double b) {
    x->change(type,a,b);
}

double getpro(node *x,node *y,double a) {
    x->access();
    x->reverse();
    y->access();
    if (y->find_root() != x) return -1;
    return y->query(a);
}

int main() {
    poly::init();
    freopen("math.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("math.out","w",stdout);
    char type[10];
    scanf("%d%d%s",&n,&m,type);
    int f;
    double a,b,x;
    int u,v,t,c;
    char op[10];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%lf%lf",&t,&a,&b);
        vertex[i].change(t,a,b);
    }
    while (m--) {
        scanf("%s",op);
        if (op[0] == 't')  {
            scanf("%d%d%lf",&u,&v,&x);
            double ret = getpro(vertex + u,vertex + v,x);
            if (ret < -1e-2) puts("unreachable");
            else printf("%.8e\n",getpro(vertex + u,vertex + v,x));
        }
        if (op[0] == 'a') {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            link(vertex + u,vertex + v);
        }
        if (op[0] == 'd') {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            cut(vertex + u,vertex + v);
        }
        if (op[0] == 'm') {
            scanf("%d%d%lf%lf",&c,&t,&a,&b);
            vertex[c].change(t,a,b);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

template <class T> T gcd(T a,T b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    return a;
}
//#define NEED_EXP
#ifdef NEED_EXP
inline long long exp(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ans=0;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) ans=(ans+a)%MOD;
        a=(a<<1)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
inline long long quickpow(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ans=1;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) ans=exp(ans,a);
        a=exp(a,a);
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
#else
inline long long quickpow(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ans=1;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) ans=(ans*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
#endif

//m.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 300019
#define LOG 20
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

const int S = 1048576;

struct E {
    int next, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], tid[MAXN], stp = 0;

int st[LOG][MAXN * 2], Log[MAXN * 2], fir[MAXN], tot = 0;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

vector <int> a[MAXN];

int mi = 0x7f7f7f7f, ma = -0x7f7f7f7f;

struct EE {
    int p, u, q, v;
    void re() {
        read(u);
        read(p);
        read(v);
        read(q);
        a[p].push_back(u);
        a[q].push_back(v);
        mi = min(mi, min(u, v));
        ma = max(ma, max(u, v));
    }
} ee[100005], qq[15];

void dfs(int x) {
    tid[x] = ++stp;
    st[0][++tot] = x;
//	cerr << x << " ";
    fir[x] = tot;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].v != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].v] = x;
            dep[e[now].v] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].v);
//			cerr << x << " ";
            st[0][++tot] = x;
        }
    }
}

inline bool cmpid(int x, int y) {
    return tid[x] < tid[y];
}
inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return dep[x] < dep[y] ? x : y;
}

inline int lca(int x, int y) {
//	cerr << "lca " << x << " " << y << " ";
    x = fir[x], y = fir[y];
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    int len = y - x + 1;
//	cerr << cmp(st[Log[len]][x], st[Log[len]][y - (1 << Log[len]) + 1]) << endl;
    return cmp(st[Log[len]][x], st[Log[len]][y - (1 << Log[len]) + 1]);
}

void init() {
    dfs(1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = tot - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[k][i] = cmp(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

struct Edge {
    int v;
    LL w;
    Edge () {}
    Edge (int q, LL i) : v(q), w(i) {}
};

vector <Edge> G[S];
map <pii, int> tag;
int tt;

void addn(int u, int v, int w) {
    assert(w >= 0);
//	cerr << "add " << u << " " << v << " " << w << endl;
    G[u].push_back(Edge(v, w));
    G[v].push_back(Edge(u, w));
}

int sta[MAXN], pp[MAXN];

int n, m, Q;

void build() {
    for (int i = mi; i <= ma; i++) {
        if (!a[i].size()) continue;
        sort(a[i].begin(), a[i].end(), cmpid);
        a[i].erase(unique(a[i].begin(), a[i].end()), a[i].end());
        int top = 1;
        sta[1] = 1;
        pp[1] = tag[mp(i, 1)] = ++tt;
//		cerr << "[" << i << 1 << "]" << tt << endl;
        for (int j = (a[i].size() > 0 && a[i][0] == 1), k = (int)a[i].size(); j < k; j++) {
            int x = a[i][j], y = lca(sta[top], x), z;
            while (top > 1 && y == (z = lca(sta[top - 1], x))) {
                top--;
                y = z;
            }
            if (y == sta[top]) {
                tag[mp(i, x)] = ++tt;
//				cerr << "[" << i << x << "]" << tt << endl;
                addn(pp[top], tt, dep[x] - dep[sta[top]]);
                sta[++top] = x;
                pp[top] = tt;
            } else {
                tag[mp(i, y)] = ++tt;
//				cerr << "[" << i << y << "]" << tt << endl;
                addn(pp[top], tt, dep[sta[top]] - dep[y]);

                top--;
                addn(pp[top], tt, dep[y] - dep[sta[top]]);

                sta[++top] = y;
                pp[top] = tt;

                tag[mp(i, x)] = ++tt;
//				cerr << "[" << i << x << "]" << tt << endl;
                addn(tt - 1, tt, dep[x] - dep[y]);
                sta[++top] = x;
                pp[top] = tt;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        addn(tag[mp(ee[i].p, ee[i].u)], tag[mp(ee[i].q, ee[i].v)], 1);
    }
}

LL t[S << 1];
bool vis[S];

inline void upd(int x, LL v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x] = min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
inline int query() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) {
        x <<= 1;
        if (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]) x ^= 1;
    }
    return x - S;
}

void solve(int be, int ed) {
//	cerr << be << " " << ed << endl;
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    upd(be, 0);
    int x = be;
    while (t[x + S] < INF) {
        if (x == ed) {
            printf("%lld\n", t[x + S]);
            return;
        }
        LL d = t[x + S];
        vis[x] = 1;
        upd(x, INF);
        for (int i = 0, j = (int)G[x].size(); i < j; i++) {
            int v = G[x][i].v;
            LL w = G[x][i].w;
            if (!vis[v] && t[v + S] > d + w) {
                upd(v, d + w);
            }
        }
        x = query();
    }
    puts("impossible");
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ee[i].re();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) qq[i].re();
    build();
    /*
    	for (map<pii, int>::iterator it = tag.begin(); it != tag.end(); it++) {
    		printf("(%d %d) %d\n", it->fir.fir, it->fir.sec, it->sec);
    	}
    */

    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) solve(tag[mp(qq[i].p, qq[i].u)], tag[mp(qq[i].q, qq[i].v)]);

    return 0;
}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005
struct E {
    int next, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, ans = 0;

void dfs(int x, int fa, int dep) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].v != fa) {
            if (b[e[now].v]) {
                a[x] -= a[e[now].v] * b[e[now].v];
                dfs(e[now].v, x, dep ^ 1);
            } else dfs(e[now].v, x, 1);
        }
    }
    if (dep) ans ^= a[x];
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]);
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    ecnt = 1;
    ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 0, 1);
    puts(ans ? "YES" : "NO");
}

int T;

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//mergesort.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;

int n;
int a[MAXN],t[MAXN];

void mergesort(int l,int r) {
    if (l>=r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    mergesort(l,mid);
    mergesort(mid+1,r);
    int i=l,j=mid+1,cnt=-1;
    while (i<=mid && j<=r) {
        if (a[i]<a[j]) t[++cnt]=a[i++];
        else t[++cnt]=a[j++];
    }
    while (i<=mid) t[++cnt]=a[i++];
    while (j<=r) t[++cnt]=a[j++];
    for (int i=0; i<=cnt; i++) a[l+i]=t[i];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    mergesort(1,n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",a[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

            ++e;

            *e='0'+(a-10*xx);
            a=xx;
        }
        while (e!=temp) {

vector <int> E[MAXN];
bool ll[MAXN];
int vis[MAXN], mat[MAXN], dfn;

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < E[x].size(); i++) if (vis[E[x][i]] != dfn) {
            vis[E[x][i]] = dfn;
            if (!mat[E[x][i]] || find(mat[E[x][i]])) return mat[E[x][i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int FUCK() {
    int ret = 0;
    dfn = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (ll[i]) {
            dfn++;
            ret += find(i);
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int ban[15];

int LOG2(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (x > 1) x >>= 1, ret++;
    return ret;
}

void work() {
    int vised = 0;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(G, 0, sizeof G);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '.') G[i][j] = 0;
            else G[i][j] = 1 << (s[j] - '0'), vised |= 1 << (s[j] - '0');
        }
    }
    memset(ban, 0, sizeof ban);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            g[i][j] = G[i][j] | G[i + 1][j] | G[i][j + 1] | G[i - 1][j] | G[i][j - 1];
            if (G[i][j]) {
                ban[LOG2(G[i][j])] |= G[i][j] ^ g[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 1024; k++) {
        if ((k & vised) != k) continue;
        bool ok = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            if (((k >> i) & 1) && (ban[i] & k)) {
                ok = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!ok) continue;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (!((g[i][j] & k) || G[i][j])) lab[i][j] = ++cnt;
            }
        }
        //S = 0, T = cnt + 1;
        memset(ll + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * cnt);
        memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * cnt);
        memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * cnt);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (!G[i][j] && !(g[i][j] & k)) {
                    if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                        //add(S, lab[i][j]);
                        ll[lab[i][j]] = 1;
                        E[lab[i][j]].clear();
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                            if (x && x <= n && y && y <= m && !G[x][y] && !(g[x][y] & k)) {
                                E[lab[i][j]].push_back(lab[x][y]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ans = max(ans, __builtin_popcount(k) + cnt - FUCK());
        //memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (cnt + 2));
        cnt = 0/*, ecnt = 1*/;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

//miller-rabin.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
long long testdata[25]= {0,6,35,143,323,667,1147,1763,2491,7387,5723,6161,4757,5767,11021,109};
long long r;

long long mul(long long a,long long b,long long m) {
    long long t=0;
    while (b>0) {
        if ((b&1)==1)
            t=(t+a)%m;
        a=(a<<1)%m;
        b=b>>1;
    }
    return t;
}
long long exp(long long a,long long x,long long c) {
    long long temp=a,ans=1;
    while (x>0) {
        if (x&1) {
            ans=mul(ans,temp,c);
        }
        temp=mul(temp,temp,c);
        x=x>>1;
    }
    return ans;
}

bool mod(long long a,long long x) {
    if (a<2)
        return 0;
    long long d=x-1,ans,y;
    long long e=0;
    while ((d&1)^1) {
        e++;
        d=d>>1;
    }
    ans=exp(a,d,x);
    for (int i=1; i<=e; i++) {
        y=mul(ans,ans,x);
        if (y==1 && ans!=1 && ans!=x-1)
            return 1;
        ans=y;
    }
    if (ans!=1)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}
bool miller_rabin(long long x) {
    if (x<2) return 0;
    if (x==2) return 1;
    if (x&1^1) return 0;
    for (int i=1; i<=15; i++) {
        long long test=testdata[i]%x;
        if (mod(test,x))
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        scanf("%lld",&r);
        if (miller_rabin(r))
            printf("Yes\n");
        else
            printf("No\n");
    }
}

//minecraft.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 233
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
const int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0}, dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int n, m, S = 0, T = 1;
char s[15];
int G[15][15];

int lab[15][15], cnt;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4 * 4 * 2];

int head[MAXN * 2], cur[MAXN * 2], tag[MAXN * 2], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v, int f) {
//	printf("%d -> %d\n", u, v);
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (cnt + 1));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = cnt; i >= 0; i--) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool vis[11];

void work() {
    cnt = 21;
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    S = 0, T = 1;
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '.') G[i][j] = ++cnt;
            else G[i][j] = (s[j] - '0' + 1) * 2 + ((i ^ j) & 1), vis[s[j] - '0' + 1] = 1;
        }
    }
    int vised = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
        if (vis[i]) {
            vised++;
            add(S, i * 2, 1);
            add(i * 2 + 1, T, 1);
            add(i * 2, i * 2 + 1, 1);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                if (G[i][j] > 21) add(G[i][j], T, 1);
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                    if (x > 0 && x <= n && y > 0 && y <= m) add(G[x][y], G[i][j], 1);
                }
            } else {
                if (G[i][j] > 21) add(S, G[i][j], 1);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", cnt - 21 + vised - dinic());
}

int main() {
//	freopen("minecraft.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("minecraft.out", "w", stdout);
    int ca;
    read(ca);
    while (ca--) work();
    return 0;
}

//mole.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline LL min(LL a, LL b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL max(LL a, LL b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define _INF LL(0xc1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1)
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

int n, top;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], c[MAXN];

LL dp[1 << 10][1 << 10];
int rev[1 << 10];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]), read(b[i]), read(c[i]);
    if (n <= 10) {
        top = 1 << n;
        memset(dp, -0x3f, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) rev[1 << i] = i;
        for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < top; j++) if (dp[i][j] > _INF) {
                    for (int q = ~i, k = lowbit(q); k < top; q ^= k, k = lowbit(q)) {
                        int A = rev[k], cc = ((i >> (A - 1)) & 1) + ((i >> (A + 1)) & 1);
                        for (int w = ~j, l = lowbit(w); l < top; w ^= l, l = lowbit(w)) {
                            int B = rev[l];
                            switch (cc) {
                            case 0:
                                dp[i | k][j | l] = max(dp[i | k][j | l], dp[i][j] + a[B]);
                                break;
                            case 1:
                                dp[i | k][j | l] = max(dp[i | k][j | l], dp[i][j] + b[B]);
                                break;
                            case 2:
                                dp[i | k][j | l] = max(dp[i | k][j | l], dp[i][j] + c[B]);
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
        printf("%lld\n", dp[top - 1][top - 1]);
    } else {
        LL ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans += max(max(a[i], b[i]), c[i]);
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//moocast.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 205
struct cow {
    int x,y,p;
    void read() {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&p);
        p=p*p;
    }
} a[MAXN];
#define power(x) ((x)*(x))
int dis(int x,int y) {
    return power(a[x].x-a[y].x)+power(a[x].y-a[y].y);
}
int n,ans=0;
queue <int> q;
bool visit[MAXN];
int bfs(int st) {
    int ret=0;
    q.push(st);
    visit[st]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        ret++;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i] && dis(x,i)<=a[x].p) {
                visit[i]=1;
                q.push(i);
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    freopen("moocast.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("moocast.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) a[i].read();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        ans=max(ans,bfs(i));
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//moocast_g.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define N 1005

struct point {
    long long x,y;
} c[N];

bitset<N> visit;
long long n,dis[N],ans=0;

long long power(long long x) {
    return x*x;
}

long long dist(point x,point y) {
    return power(x.x-y.x)+power(x.y-y.y);
}

void work() {
    memset(dis,0x3f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    long long x=1;
    while (!visit[x]) {
        visit[x]=1;
        if (dis[x]>ans) ans=dis[x];
        long long to=1,Dis=dis[0];
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                dis[i]=min(dis[i],dist(c[i],c[x]));
                if (Dis>dis[i]) Dis=dis[i],to=i;
            }
        }
        x=to;
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("moocast.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("moocast.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>c[i].x>>c[i].y;
    }
    work();
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//moveproblem.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

int n, m;
LL L, a[MAXN], d[MAXN], avr = 0;

namespace vio {
#define N 9005
LL f[2][N];
LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[i][j] + 2 * L * d[j] + m * power(d[j]) - f[i][k] - 2 * L * d[k] - m * power(d[k])) / (d[j] - d[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[N], l, r;
    void clear() {
        v[0] = l = r = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * m * d[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[r], i) <= slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

void solve() {
    for (int k = 1; k <= m; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[now][i] = f[pre][j] + m * power(d[i] - d[j]) - 2 * L * (d[i] - d[j]);
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m & 1][n] + power(L));
    return;
}
}

namespace xjb {
int c[MAXN];
void solve() {
    c[0] = 0, c[m] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) c[i] = int((double)i * n / m);
    bool changed = 1;
    while (changed) {
        changed = 0;
        for (int i = m - 1; i; i--) {
            int x = c[i - 1], y = c[i], z = c[i + 1];
            LL nowv = power(d[y] - d[x]) + power(d[z] - d[y]), tov;
            for (tov = power(d[y - 1] - d[x]) + power(d[z] - d[y - 1]); x + 1 < y && nowv > tov; tov = power(d[y - 1] - d[x]) + power(d[z] - d[y - 1])) {
                changed = 1;
                y--;
                nowv = tov;
            }
            for (tov = power(d[y + 1] - d[x]) + power(d[z] - d[y + 1]); y + 1 < z && nowv > tov; tov = power(d[y + 1] - d[x]) + power(d[z] - d[y + 1])) {
                changed = 1;
                y++;
                nowv = tov;
            }
            c[i] = y;
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans += power(d[c[i]] - d[c[i - 1]]);
    printf("%lld\n", ans + power(L));
}
}

int main() {
    freopen("moveproblem.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("moveproblem.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), d[i] = d[i - 1] + a[i];
    L = d[n];
    if (m < 2) puts("0");
    else {
        if (n == m) {
            LL ans = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += power(d[i] - d[i - 1]);
            printf("%lld\n", ans - power(L));
        } else {
            bool flag = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) if (d[i + 1] - d[i] != d[i] - d[i - 1]) {
                    flag = 0;
                    break;
                }
            if (flag) {
                int y = n / m, z = n % m;
                LL ans = power(d[y + 1]) * z + power(d[y]) * (m - z);
                printf("%lld\n", ans - power(L));
            } else if (n < 8001) vio::solve();
            else xjb::solve();
        }
    }
    if (m < 2) puts("0");
    else {
        avr = d[n] / m;
        if (n == m) {
            LL ans = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += power(avr - a[i]);
            printf("%lld\n", ans / m);
        }
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) if (a[i] != a[i + 1]) {
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        if (flag) {
            int y = n / m, z = n % m;
            LL ans = power(avr - a[1] * (y + 1)) * z + power(avr - a[1] * y) * (m - z);
            printf("%lld\n", ans / m);
        } else if (n < 9001) vio::solve();
        else xjb::solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

//music.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define s 1024

int n;
int a[s], tem[s], tot;

void input() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tem[i] = a[i];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + tot, a[i]) - tem);
}

struct Seg {
    int t[s << 1];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return t[x + s];
    }
    void update(int x, int v) {
        t[x += s] = v;
        while (x >>= 1) t[x] = max(t[x<<1], t[(x<<1)^1]);
    }
    int query(int x) {
        int ret = 0;
        for (int l = s, r = s + x + 1; l ^ r ^ 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
            if (!(l&1)) ret = max(ret, t[l^1]);
            if (r&1) ret = max(ret, t[r^1]);
        }
        return ret;
    }
} t[s];

void work() {
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = tot, ret; j > 0; j--) {
            ret = t[j].query(a[i]) + 1;
            t[j].update(a[i], ret);
            t[a[i]].update(j, ret);
            ans = max(ret, ans);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    freopen("music.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("music.out", "w", stdout);
    input();
    work();
    return 0;
}

int n;

void simple() {
    graph a, b;
    n = 50;
    a.n = b.n = n;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) add(a, i - 1, i);
    add(b, 1, 3);

int d[55], G[55][55];

int simple_check(graph g) {
    memset(d, 0, sizeof(d));
    for (int i = 0; i < g.e.size(); i++) {
        d[g.e[i].first]++;
        d[g.e[i].second]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (d[i] == 3) return 2;
    return 1;
}

bool vis[55];

int lll(int a, int b) {
    int x = a, cnt = 0;
    while (x != b) {
        int to = -1;
        vis[x] = 1;
        cnt++;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (G[x][i] && !vis[i]) {
                to = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        x = to;
    }
    return 1 + (cnt == 5);
}

int loop_check(graph g) {
    memset(d, 0, sizeof(d));
    memset(G, 0, sizeof(G));
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
    for (int i = 0; i < g.e.size(); i++) {
        d[g.e[i].first]++;
        d[g.e[i].second]++;
        G[g.e[i].first][g.e[i].second] = G[g.e[i].second][g.e[i].first] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> f;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (d[i] == 3) f.push_back(i);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 4; j++) {
            int a = f[i], b = f[j], c, dd;
            if (G[a][b]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) if (k != i && k != j) {
                    c = k;
                    break;
                }
            for (int k = c + 1; k < 4; k++) if (k != i && k != j) {
                    dd = k;
                    break;
                }
            c = f[c], dd = f[dd];
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                if (k != c && k != dd && G[a][k] && G[b][k]) {
                    vis[c] = vis[dd] = vis[k] = 1;
                    return lll(a, b);
                }
            }
        }
    return 1;
}

int identify(graph g) {
    return loop_check(g);
}

//na.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

char n[105];
long long nn;

long long now[2],trans[2][2],temp[2][2];

void add_to_ans(long long MOD) {
    temp[0][0]=((now[0]*trans[0][0])%MOD+(now[1]*trans[0][1])%MOD)%MOD;
    temp[0][1]=((now[0]*trans[1][0])%MOD+(now[1]*trans[1][1])%MOD)%MOD;
    now[0]=temp[0][0];
    now[1]=temp[0][1];
}

void self_fuck(long long MOD) {
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<2; k++) {
                temp[i][j]+=(trans[i][k]*trans[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            trans[i][j]=temp[i][j]%MOD;
        }
    }
}

long long fib(long long x,long long mod) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    now[0]=0,now[1]=1;
    trans[0][0]=0,trans[0][1]=1,trans[1][0]=1,trans[1][1]=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) add_to_ans(mod);
        self_fuck(mod);
        x>>=1;
    }
    return now[0];
}

#define MOD 1000000007
#define wtf 2000000016
#define wtfff 659232

void convert() {
    int len=(int)strlen(n+1);
    nn=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
        nn=(nn*10+n[i]-'0')%wtfff;
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("na.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("na.out","w",stdout);
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%s",n+1);
        convert();
        nn=fib(nn,wtf);
        printf("%lld\n",fib(nn,MOD));
    }
    return 0;
}

//neon.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007

LL pw(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

const LL _2 = pw(2, MOD - 2);

struct Node {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], ecnt = 0, cnt[MAXN];

LL dp[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    cnt[x] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            cnt[x]++;
            dp[x] = (dp[x] + dp[e[now].to]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    if (cnt == 0) dp[x] = _2;
    else if (x != 1) dp[x] = (dp[x] - pw(_2, cnt[x] + 1) - _2 * cnt[x] + 1) % MOD;
    else dp[x] = (dp[x] - pw(_2, cnt[x]) - _2 * cnt[x] + 1) % MOD;
    dp[x] = dp[x] < 0 ? (MOD + dp[x]) : (dp[x]);
}

int main() {
    freopen("neon.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("neon.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1);
    printf("%lld\n", (dp[1] * pw(2, n) % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//networkans.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

#define _NN 100000
#define NN (_NN + 10)

//edge start
struct edge {
    int v,next;
} e[NN * 2];

int h[NN];

int ecnt = 0;
inline void adde(int u,int v) {
    e[ecnt].v = v;
    e[ecnt].next = h[u];
    h[u] = ecnt;
    ecnt++;

    e[ecnt].v = u;
    e[ecnt].next = h[v];
    h[v] = ecnt;
    ecnt++;
}
//edge end

//union find start
int uf[NN];

inline void reset() {
    for(int i = 0; i < NN; i++)uf[i] = i;
}

int find(int x) {
    if(uf[x] == x)return x;
    else return uf[x] = find(uf[x]);
}

inline void mergebr(int x,int y) {
    uf[x] = y;
}
//union find end

//LCA start
int dis[NN];
int p[NN * 2];
int f[NN];
int rmq[NN][17];

int pn = 0;
void dfs(int no) {
    p[pn] = no;
    if(f[no] == -1) {
        f[no] = pn;
    }
    pn++;

    for(int i = h[no]; i != -1; i = e[i].next) {
        int v = e[i].v;

        if(dis[v] == -1) {
            dis[v] = dis[no] + 1;
            dfs(v);
            p[pn] = no;
            pn++;
        }
    }
}

void lca() {
    memset(dis,-1,sizeof(dis));
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dis[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);

    for(int i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
        rmq[i][0] = p[i];
    }

    for(int k = 1; k < 17; k++) {
        int sv = 1 << k;
        int hv = sv >> 1;

        int maxs = pn - sv;

        for(int i = 0; i <= maxs; i++) {
            int ll = rmq[i][k - 1];
            int lr = rmq[i + hv][k - 1];

            if(dis[ll] < dis[lr]) {
                rmq[i][k] = ll;
            } else {
                rmq[i][k] = lr;
            }
        }
    }

    return;
}

int query(int a,int b) {
    int l = f[a];
    int r = f[b];
    int lca;

    if(l > r) {
        int t = l;
        l = r;
        r = t;
    }

    int len = 0;
    while((l + (1 << len)) <= r)len++;
    len--;

    int ll = rmq[l][len];
    int lr = rmq[r - (1 << len) + 1][len];

    if(dis[ll] < dis[lr]) {
        lca = ll;
    } else {
        lca = lr;
    }

    return dis[a] + dis[b] - dis[lca] * 2;
}
//LCA end

int N,M;

inline void ir() {
    freopen("network1.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("network.out","w",stdout);

    cin >> N >> M;

    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));

    int a,b;
    for(int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        scanf("%d %d",&a,&b);

        adde(a,b);
    }

    return;
}

int main() {
    ir();

    lca();
    reset();

    int Q;
    cin >> Q;

    for(int i = 0; i < Q; i++) {
        int x,a,b;

        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&a,&b);

        if(x == 1) {
            mergebr(find(a),find(b));
        } else {
            if(find(a) != find(b)) {
                puts("No way.");
            } else {
                printf("%d %d %d\n",query(a,b),a,b);
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//network.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define PRID "1"
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next;
    int to;
} e[40005];
int ecnt,n,m,q,f[20005],h[20005],depth[20005];
bool visit[20005];
int father[20005][16];
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        f[i]=i;
    memset(father,-1,sizeof(father));
    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));
    return;
}
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=h[u];
    h[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=h[v];
    h[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u);
    int fv=getf(v);
    f[fu]=fv;
    return;
}
bool sameset(int u,int v) {
    return getf(u)==getf(v);
}
void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=h[x],v; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            depth[v]=depth[x]+1;
            father[v][0]=x;
            visit[v]=1;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
    return;
}
void prest() {
    for (int k=1; k<16; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (father[i][k-1]!=-1) {
                father[i][k]=father[father[i][k-1]][k-1];
            }
        }
    }
    return;
}
int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (depth[v]>depth[u])
        swap(u,v);
    int x=depth[u]-depth[v];
    for (int i=15; i>-1; i--) {
        if ((1<<i)&x)
            u=father[u][i];
    }
    if (u==v)
        return u;
    for (int i=15; i>-1; i--) {
        if (father[u][i]!=father[v][i]) {
            u=father[u][i];
            v=father[v][i];
        }
    }
    return father[u][0];
}
int main() {
    freopen("network" PRID ".in","r",stdin);
    freopen("network.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    depth[1]=visit[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    prest();
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1,x,a,b; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&a,&b);
        if (x==1)
            merge(a,b);
        else {
            if (sameset(a,b)) {
                int lca=getLCA(a,b);
                printf("%d %d %d %d\n",depth[a]+depth[b]-(depth[lca]<<1),a,b,lca);
            } else
                printf("No way.\n");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
