//NOI2014_forest.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 50319
#define MAXM 100319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    Node *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : val(0) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int d) {
        c[d] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void upd();
    void relax();
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

void Node::upd() {
    ma = this;
    if (c[0] != null && c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
    if (c[1] != null && c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt();
        c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->fa != null) pushto(x->fa);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    x->top = y;
}

void Cut(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    expose(y);
    splay(x);
    x->setc(null, 1);
    x->upd();
    y->setrt(null);
}

Node *query(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    expose(y);
    splay(y);
    return y->ma;
}

struct edge {
    int u, v, a, b;
    bool operator < (edge q) const {
        return a < q.a;
    }
} e[MAXM];

int n, m, ans = INF;
Node *a[MAXN];
map< Node*, pair<int, int> > E;
int f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        f[fu] += f[fv];
        f[fv] = fu;
    }
}

Node *newE(Node *u, Node *v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(u, mid);
    Link(mid, v);
    return mid;
}

void delE(Node *mid) {
    pair<int, int> r = E[mid];
    Cut(a[r.first], mid);
    Cut(a[r.second], mid);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v), read(e[i].a), read(e[i].b);
        if (e[i].u == e[i].v) m--, i--;
    }
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode(0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (getf(e[i].u) == getf(e[i].v)) {
            Node *ma = query(a[e[i].u], a[e[i].v]);
            if (ma->val > e[i].b) {
                delE(ma);
                E[newE(a[e[i].u], a[e[i].v], e[i].b)] = make_pair(e[i].u, e[i].v);
            }
        } else {
            merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
            E[newE(a[e[i].u], a[e[i].v], e[i].b)] = make_pair(e[i].u, e[i].v);
        }
        if (getf(1) == getf(n)) {
            ans = min(ans, query(a[1], a[n])->val + e[i].a);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? -1 : ans);
    return 0;
}

//nolr1018.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 100005
#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 3200000
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],wbuf[MAXN * 4],*ptr,*ptw;
#define init_buf() fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin); ptr=buf, ptw=wbuf;
#define write_buf() fwrite(wbuf,sizeof(char),ptw-wbuf,stdout);
#define getchar() (*(ptr++))

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop(int &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    switch (ch) {
    case 'E':
        return 0;
        break;
    case 'O':
        a=1;
        break;
    case 'C':
        a=2;
        break;
    case 'A':
        a=3;
    }
    while (ch!=' ') ch=getchar();
    return 1;
}
struct ri {
    int op,c1,c2;
} rr[MAXM];

struct node {
    int lch,rch,head,q;
} t[262144];

struct Data {
    int c1,c2,next;
} rec[MAXM<<4];

struct R {
    int p,v;
    R() {}
    R(int a,int b):p(a),v(b) {}
} s[MAXM<<4];

int c,m=0,rt,tcnt=0,top=0,icnt=0;
int visit[MAXM*4],f[MAXN*4];

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].q=t[t[now].lch].q|t[t[now].rch].q;
    } else t[now].q=rr[l].op==3?l:0;
    return now;
}

#define getp(x, y) (y==x+1?x:x|262144)

int A,B;
void add_query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        rec[++icnt].c1=A;
        rec[icnt].c2=B;
        rec[icnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=icnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) add_query(t[x].lch, l, mid, ql, min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) add_query(t[x].rch, mid + 1, r, max(mid+1,ql),qr);
}

int getf(int x) {
    while (f[x] > 0) x = f[x];
    return x;
}

void merge(int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    if (f1!=f2) {
        s[++top]=R(f1,f[f1]);
        s[++top]=R(f2,f[f2]);
        if (f[f1]<f[f2]) f[f1]+=f[f2], f[f2]=f1;
        else f[f2]+=f[f1], f[f1]=f2;
    }
}
#define is_same(c1, c2)	getf(c1)==getf(c2)

void dfs(int x) {
    int nowtop=top;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=rec[now].next) merge(rec[now].c1,rec[now].c2);
    if (!t[x].lch && !t[x].rch) {
        if (is_same(rr[t[x].q].c1,rr[t[x].q].c2)) putchar('Y'),putchar('\n');
        else putchar('N'),putchar('\n');
    } else {
        if (t[t[x].lch].q) dfs(t[x].lch);
        if (t[t[x].rch].q) dfs(t[x].rch);
    }
    while (top>nowtop) f[s[top].p]=s[top].v, top--;
}

int main() {
    init_buf();
    read(c);
    int r1,c1,r2,c2;
    while (readop(rr[++m].op)) {
        read(r1);
        read(c1);
        read(r2);
        read(c2);
        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
    }
    if (!(--m)) return 0;
    rt=build(1, m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int p=getp(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (!visit[p]) visit[p]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2 && visit[p]) {
            A=rr[i].c1, B=rr[i].c2, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[p],i);
            visit[p]=0;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]) A=i, B=i+1, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i],m);
        if (visit[i|131072]) A=i|131072, B=i+131073, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|131072],m);
        if (visit[i|262144]) A=i, B=i|131072, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|262144],m);
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(rt);
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 999983
int n,siz;
char s[20];
int se[20],dp[1005][9005];
LL ans1=0,ans2=0,ans3=0;
int main() {
    freopen("num.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("num.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    scanf("%s",s);
    siz=(int)strlen(s);
    for (int i=1; i<=siz; i++) {
        se[i]=s[i-1]-'0';
    }
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=9*i; j>=0; j--) {
            for (int k=1; k<=siz; k++) {
                if (j>=se[k]) {
                    dp[i][j]+=dp[i-1][j-se[k]];
                    if (dp[i][j]>=MOD) dp[i][j]-=MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int mx=n*9;
    for (int i=0; i<=mx; i++) {
        ans1=(ans1+dp[n][i]*dp[n][i])%MOD;
    }
    mx=((n+1)/2)*9;
    for (int i=0; i<=mx; i++) {
        ans2=(ans2+LL(dp[(n/2)][i])*LL(dp[(n/2)][i]))%MOD;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=mx; i++) {
        ans3=(ans3+LL(dp[(n+1)/2][i])*LL(dp[(n+1)/2][i]))%MOD;
    }
    cout<<((ans1*2-ans2*ans3)%MOD+MOD)%MOD<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    int now=xx&1,cons=1;
    xx/=10;
    while (xx) {
        int x=xx&1;
        if (x^now) {
            if (((now^cons)&1)^1) return 0;
            now=x;
            cons=1;
        } else ++cons;
        xx/=10;
    }
    if (((now^cons)&1)^1) return 0;
    return 1;
}

//oddeven_dp.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

ll L,R,dp[22][10][22],cnt[22];

void init() {
    dp[0][0][1]=dp[0][1][0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=9; i++) {
        dp[1][i][1]=1;
    }
    cnt[1]=4;
    for (int i=2; i<=19; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=9; j++) { //last
            for (int k=0; k<=9; k++) { //now
                for (int l=1; l<i; l++) { //lastlen
                    if ((j&1)==(k&1)) {
                        dp[i][k][l+1]+=dp[i-1][j][l];
                    } else {
                        if ((j^l)&1) {
                            dp[i][k][1]+=dp[i-1][j][l];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cnt[i]=cnt[i-1];
        for (int k=1; k<=9; k++)
            for (int l=1; l<=i; l++) {
                if ((k^l)&1) cnt[i]+=dp[i][k][l];
            }
    }
}

bool check(long long xx) {
    long long now=xx&1,cons=1;
    xx/=10;
    while (xx) {
        long long x=xx&1;
        if (x^now) {
            if (((now^cons)&1)^1) return 0;
            now=x;
            cons=1;
        } else ++cons;
        xx/=10;
    }
    if (((now^cons)&1)^1) return 0;
    return 1;
}

char temp[105];
ll work(ll wtf) {
    if (wtf==0) return 0;
    sprintf(temp+1,"%lld",wtf);
    int len=strlen(temp+1);
    ll ans=cnt[len-1];
    int first=temp[1]-'0';
    for (int i=1; i<first; i++) {
        for (int x=1; x<=len; x++) {
            if ((i^x)&1) ans+=dp[len][i][x];
        }
    }
    int now=first&1,cons=1;
    for (int p=2; p<=len; p++) {
        int nowx=temp[p]-'0';
        for (int i=0; i<nowx; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<=len; j++) {
                if ((i&1)==now) {
                    if ((i^(j+cons))&1) ans+=dp[len-p+1][i][j];
                } else {
                    if ((now^cons)&1 && (i^j)&1) ans+=dp[len-p+1][i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        nowx&=1;
        if (nowx!=now) {
            if (((now^cons)&1)^1) {
                break;
            }
            now=nowx;
            cons=1;
        } else ++cons;
    }
    if (check(wtf)) ans++;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    freopen("oddeven.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("oddeven.out","w",stdout);
    init();
    cin>>L>>R;
    cout<<work(R)-work(L-1)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//offline.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 17
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;
int fa[MAXN][LOG], ma[MAXN][LOG], dep[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        fa[x][k] = fa[fa[x][k - 1]][k - 1];
        ma[x][k] = max(ma[x][k - 1], ma[fa[x][k - 1]][k - 1]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            ma[e[now].to][0] = e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int query(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v], ret = -1;
    for (int k = 0; x; k++, x >>= 1) {
        if (x & 1) {
            ret = max(ret, ma[u][k]);
            u = fa[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u == v) return ret;
    for (int k = LOG - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k] != fa[v][k]) {
            ret = max(ret, max(ma[u][k], ma[v][k]));
            u = fa[u][k], v = fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return max(ret, max(ma[u][0], ma[v][0]));
}

struct Edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (Edge a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} r[MAXN];

int n, m, f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu == fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
    f[fu] += f[fv];
    f[fv] = fu;
    return 1;
}

void work() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    ecnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = -1, head[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) scanf("%d%d%d", &r[i].u, &r[i].v, &r[i].w);
    sort(r + 1, r + m + 1);
    long long tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(r[i].u, r[i].v)) {
            add(r[i].u, r[i].v, r[i].w);
            tot += r[i].w;
            r[i].w = -1;
        }
    }
    fa[1][0] = 1;
    ma[1][0] = -1;
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (r[i].w != -1 && query(r[i].u, r[i].v) >= r[i].w) {
            puts("Not Unique!");
            return;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", tot);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//oj1813_bit.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const int dx[] = {0, -1 ,0 ,1, 0}, dy[] = {1, 0, -1 ,0, 0};

int ch = 0;
inline void read(bool &a) {
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'1') ch=getchar();
    a = (ch == '1');
    ch = getchar();
}

int n = 5, m = 6;

unsigned int a[32];
int tag[6][7], cnt = 0;
bool f[32][32];

void gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= cnt  && !((a[to]>>i)&1)) to++;
        if (to > cnt) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            if (j != now && ((a[j]>>i)&1)) a[j] ^= a[now];
        }
        now++;
    }
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(f[i][j]);
            tag[i][j] = ++cnt;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
                int x = i + dx[k], y = j + dy[k];
                if (x > 0 && x <= n && y > 0 && y <= m) {
                    a[tag[i][j]] |= 1 << tag[x][y];
                }
                a[tag[i][j]] |= f[i][j];
            }
        }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            printf("%d ", a[tag[i][j]] & 1);
        }
        putchar('\n');
    }
    return 0;
}

bool equal(double x) {
    if (x>23.99999 && x<24.00001) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

double v(double x,double y,int op) {
    if (op>1) {
        if (op==3) {
            return x+y;
        } else {
            return x-y;
        }
    } else {
        if (op==1) {
            return x*y;
        } else {
            return y==0?sqrt(-1):x/y;
        }
    }
}
bool work(double a,double b,double c,double d) {
    for (int i=0; i<4; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<4; j++)
            for (int k=0; k<4; k++) {
                if (equal(v(v(v(a,b,i),c,j),d,k))) return 1;
                if (equal(v(v(a,b,i),v(c,d,k),j))) return 1;
                if (equal(v(v(a,v(b,c,j),i),d,k))) return 1;
                if (equal(v(a,v(v(b,c,j),d,k),i))) return 1;
                //if (equal(v())) return 1;
                if (equal(v(a,v(b,v(c,d,k),j),i))) return 1;
            }
    return 0;
}

int a[4];
int main() {
    while (1) {
        read(a[0]);
        read(a[1]);
        read(a[2]);
        read(a[3]);
        if (a[0]==a[1] && a[1]==a[2] && a[2]==a[3] && a[3]==0) break;
        sort(a,a+4);
        bool ans=0;
        do {
            if (work(a[0],a[1],a[2],a[3])) {
                ans=1;
                break;
            }
        } while (next_permutation(a,a+4));
        if (ans) puts("YES");
        else puts("NO");
    }
    return 0;
}

//op1793.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

#define MAXN 20
struct point {
    int x,y;
} p[MAXN];

int n,top=0;
int dp[65536],map[MAXN][MAXN],siz[MAXN][MAXN];

void work() {
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<n; j++) {
            int minx=min(p[i].x,p[j].x),maxx=max(p[i].x,p[j].x);
            int miny=min(p[i].y,p[j].y),maxy=max(p[i].y,p[j].y);
            if (minx==maxx) maxx++;
            if (miny==maxy) maxy++;
            map[i][j]=0;
            siz[i][j]=(maxy-miny)*(maxx-minx);
            for (int k=n-1; k>-1; k--) {
                map[i][j]<<=1;
                if (minx<=p[k].x && maxx>=p[k].x && miny<=p[k].y && maxy>=p[k].y) {
                    map[i][j]|=1;
                }
            }
        }
    memset(dp,31,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=0;
    top=1<<n;
    for (int st=0; st<top; st++) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=i+1; j<n; j++) {
                if (dp[st|map[i][j]]>dp[st]+siz[i][j]) {
                    dp[st|map[i][j]]=dp[st]+siz[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",dp[top-1]);
}

int main() {
    while (1) {
        read(n);
        if (n==0) break;
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//op1804.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 80
const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readmp(bool &a) {
    while (ch!=' ' && ch!='X') ch=getchar();
    a=(ch=='X');
    ch=getchar();
}
#define TOP 32767
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define statu(a,b,c) ((a<<16)|(b<<8)|c)
#define xx(a) (a>>16)
#define yy(a) ((a>>8)&127)
#define kk(a) (a&127)

struct queue {
    int v[32768],head,tail;
    void clear() {
        head=tail=16777216;
    }
    void push_front(int x) {
        //printf("Push Front : %d %d %d\n",xx(x),yy(x),kk(x));
        v[(--head)&TOP]=x;
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        //printf("Push Back : %d %d %d\n",xx(x),yy(x),kk(x));
        v[((tail++)&TOP)]=x;
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&TOP];
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
} q;
int n,m,dis[80][80][4];
bool map[80][80];

int work(int sx,int sy,int ex,int ey) {
    if (!map[sx][sy] || !map[ex][ey]) {
        return -1;
    }
    map[sx][sy]=map[ex][ey]=0;
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[sx][sy][0]=dis[sx][sy][1]=dis[sx][sy][2]=dis[sx][sy][3]=1;
    q.clear();
    q.push_front(statu(sx,sy,0));
    q.push_front(statu(sx,sy,1));
    q.push_front(statu(sx,sy,2));
    q.push_front(statu(sx,sy,3));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int nowx=xx(q.front()),nowy=yy(q.front()),k=kk(q.front());
        q.pop();
        //printf("%d %d %d %d\n",nowx,nowy,k,dis[nowx][nowy][k]);
        if (nowx==ex && nowy==ey) {
            map[sx][sy]=map[ex][ey]=1;
            return dis[nowx][nowy][k];
        }
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=nowx+dx[d],toy=nowy+dy[d];
            if (tox>=0 && tox<=n && toy>=0 && toy<=m && !map[tox][toy] && dis[tox][toy][d]>dis[nowx][nowy][k]+(k!=d)) {
                dis[tox][toy][d]=dis[nowx][nowy][k]+(k!=d);
                if (k!=d) {
                    q.push_back(statu(tox,toy,d));
                } else {
                    q.push_front(statu(tox,toy,d));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    map[sx][sy]=map[ex][ey]=1;
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    int CASE=0;
    while (1) {
        read(m);
        read(n);
        if (n==0 && m==0) break;
        printf("Board #%d:\n",++CASE);
        memset(map,0,sizeof(map));
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                readmp(map[i][j]);
            }
        }
        int PAIR=0;
        n++;
        m++;
        while (1) {
            int x1,x2,y1,y2;
            read(y1);
            read(x1);
            read(y2);
            read(x2);
            if (x1==0 && x2==0 && y1==0 && y2==0) break;
            printf("Pair %d: ",++PAIR);
            int ret=work(x1,y1,x2,y2);
            if (ret==-1) printf("impossible.\n");
            else printf("%d segments.\n",ret);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    op=ch-'0';
    ch=getchar();
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();

    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {

        ch=getchar();

inline int bitcount(unsigned long long x) {
    x=(x&0x5555555555555555)+((x>>1)&0x5555555555555555);
    x=(x&0x3333333333333333)+((x>>2)&0x3333333333333333);
    x=(x&0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f)+((x>>4)&0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f);
    x=(x&0x00ff00ff00ff00ff)+((x>>8)&0x00ff00ff00ff00ff);
    x=(x&0x0000ffff0000ffff)+((x>>16)&0x0000ffff0000ffff);
    x=(x&0x00000000ffffffff)+((x>>32)&0x00000000ffffffff);
    return int(x);
}
inline void bitprint(unsigned long long x) {
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++) {
        putchar('0'+int((x>>i)&1));
    }
    putchar('\n');
}
int main() {
    freopen("operation.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("operation.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    unsigned long long now=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        now+=(read())<<(i&63);
        if ((i&63)==63) {
            t[cnt++]=now;
            now=0;
        }
    }
    if ((n&63)!=63) {
        t[cnt++]=now;
    }
    ch=0;
    for (int i=1,op,a,b,ta,tb,ans,temp,pos; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op,a,b);
        ta=a>>6;
        tb=b>>6;
        if (op==0) {
            for (int j=ta+1; j<tb; j++) {
                t[j]=0;
            }
            if (ta^tb) {
                now=(-1u)>>(63-a+(ta<<6));
                t[ta]&=now;
                now=(-1u)<<(b-(tb<<6));
                t[tb]&=now;
            } else {
                now=((-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6)))^((-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6)));
                t[ta]&=now;
            }
        } else if (op==1) {
            for (int j=ta+1; j<tb; j++) {
                t[j]=-1u;
            }
            if (ta^tb) {
                now=(-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6));
                t[ta]|=now;
                now=(-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6));
                t[tb]|=now;
            } else {
                now=((-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6)))&((-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6)));
                t[ta]|=now;
            }
        } else if (op==2) {
            for (int j=ta+1; j<tb; j++) {
                t[j]^=-1u;
            }
            if (ta^tb) {
                now=(-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6));
                t[ta]^=now;
                now=(-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6));
                t[tb]^=now;
            } else {
                now=((-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6)))&((-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6)));
                t[ta]^=now;
            }
        } else if (op==3) {
            ans=0;
            for (int j=ta+1; j<tb; j++) {
                ans+=bitcount(t[j]);
            }
            if (ta^tb) {
                now=(-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6));
                ans+=bitcount(t[ta]&now);
                now=(-1u)>>(63-b+(tb<<6));
                ans+=bitcount(t[tb]&now);
            } else {
                now=((-1u)<<(a-(ta<<6)))&((-1u)>>(63-(b-(tb<<6))));
                ans+=bitcount(t[ta]&now);
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            temp=0,ans=0;
            if (ta^tb) {
                for (pos=int(a-(ta<<6)); pos<64; pos++) {
                    if ((t[ta]>>pos)&1) {
                        temp++;
                    } else {
                        if (temp>ans)
                            ans=temp;
                        temp=0;
                    }
                }
                for (ta++; ta<tb; ta++) {
                    for (pos=0; pos<64; pos++) {
                        if ((t[ta]>>pos)&1) {
                            temp++;
                        } else {
                            if (temp>ans)
                                ans=temp;
                            temp=0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                ta=b-(tb<<6);
                for (pos=0; pos<=ta; pos++) {
                    if ((t[ta]>>pos)&1) {
                        temp++;
                    } else {
                        if (temp>ans)
                            ans=temp;
                        temp=0;
                    }
                }
                if (temp>ans)
                    ans=temp;
            } else {
                temp=0,ans=0;
                tb=b-(tb<<6);
                for (pos=int(a-(ta<<6)); pos<=tb; pos++) {
                    if ((t[ta]>>pos)&1) {
                        temp++;
                    } else {
                        if (temp>ans)
                            ans=temp;
                        temp=0;
                    }
                }
                if (temp>ans)
                    ans=temp;
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//op_.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void read(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    a=ch=='1';
    ch=getchar();
}
int n,m;
bool a[100005];

int main() {
    freopen("operation.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("op_.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,op,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op==0) {
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) {
                a[j]=0;
            }
        } else if (op==1) {
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) {
                a[j]=1;
            }
        } else if (op==2) {
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) {
                a[j]^=1;
            }
        } else if (op==3) {
            int ans=0;
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) {
                if (a[j]) ans++;
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            int ans=0,temp=0;
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) {
                if (a[j])
                    temp++;
                else {
                    ans=max(ans,temp);
                    temp=0;
                }
            }
            if (temp>ans)
                printf("%d*\n",temp);
            else
                printf("%d*\n",ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//op.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define eps 0.00000001
using namespace std;
int s,t,L,ansi,ansj;
double tar,delta=1e9;
bool flag=0;
void work() {
    double temp;
    for (int i=1; i<=L; i++) {
        //	for (int j=0,ed=min(i,l-i);j<=ed;j++) {
        int l=0,r=min(i,L-i);
        while (l<r) {
            int m=((l+r)>>1)+1;
            temp=tar-(double)m/i;
            if (temp<0)
                r=m-1;
            else
                l=m;
        }
        temp=abs(tar-(double)l/i);
        if (temp+eps<delta) {
            ansi=i;
            ansj=l;
            delta=temp;
        }
        if (l+i<L) {
            temp=abs(tar-(double)(++l)/i);
            if (temp+eps<delta) {
                ansi=i;
                ansj=l;
                delta=temp;
            }
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("test.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d%d",&s,&t,&L);
    if (s<t) {
        flag=1;
        swap(s,t);
    }
    tar=(double)t/s;
    work();
    if (flag)
        printf("%d %d\n",ansj,ansi);
    else
        printf("%d %d\n",ansi,ansj);
    return 0;
}

//openjudge1813.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1, 0};

int n = 5, m = 6;

struct Equation {
    int b[32];
    int &operator [] (int k) {
        return b[k];
    }
} a[32];

int f[10][10];

int cnt = 0, tag[10][10];

int gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= cnt && !a[to][i]) to++;
        if (to > cnt) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            if (j != now && a[j][i]) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= cnt; k++) a[j][k] ^= a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    for (int i = now; i <= cnt; i++) if (a[i][0]) return 0;
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            scanf("%d", f[i] + j);
            tag[i][j] = ++cnt;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            for (int to = 0; to < 5; to++) {
                int x = i + dx[to], y = j + dy[to];
                if (x > 0 && x <= n && y > 0 && y <= m) a[tag[i][j]][tag[x][y]] = 1;
            }
            a[tag[i][j]][0] = f[i][j];
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            printf("%d ", a[tag[i][j]][0]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//p1150.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct lamp {
    int pos;
    int val;
} lp[55];
bool cmp(lamp a,lamp b) {
    return a.pos<b.pos;
}
int n,c;
int a[55],sum[55]= {0};
int dp[60][60][2];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&c);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%d%d",&lp[i].pos,&lp[i].val);
    sort(lp+1,lp+n+1,cmp);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+lp[i].val;
    int p=sum[n];
//	printf("%d\n",p);
    memset(dp,63,sizeof(dp));
    dp[c][c][0]=dp[c][c][1]=0;
    for (int l=c; l>0; l--)
        for (int r=c; r<=n; r++) {
            if (l<c) {
                dp[l][r][0]=min(dp[l+1][r][0]+(p-(sum[r]-sum[l]))*(lp[l+1].pos-lp[l].pos),dp[l+1][r][1]+(p-(sum[r]-sum[l]))*(lp[r].pos-lp[l].pos));
            }
            if (r>c) {
                dp[l][r][1]=min(dp[l][r-1][0]+(p-(sum[r-1]-sum[l-1]))*(lp[r].pos-lp[l].pos),dp[l][r-1][1]+(p-(sum[r-1]-sum[l-1]))*(lp[r].pos-lp[r-1].pos));
            }
        }
    printf("%d",min(dp[1][n][0],dp[1][n][1]));
    return 0;
}

//P1524-DINIC.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 2147383647
using namespace std;
int n,m,e;
int map[105][105];
int edge[105][105];
int tag[105];
int q[200];
int ans=0;
bool book[105];
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    int head=1,tail=2;
    q[1]=1;
    tag[1]=1;
    while (head<tail) {
        if (q[head]==0)
            return 1;
        for (int i=1,u=q[head],v; i<=edge[q[head]][0]; i++) {
            v=edge[q[head]][i];
            if (tag[v]==0 && map[u][v]>0) {
                q[tail++]=v;
                tag[v]=tag[u]+1;
            }
        }
        head++;
    }
    return 0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==0) {
        return flow;
    }
    for (int i=1,y; i<=edge[x][0]; i++) {
        y=edge[x][i];
        if (!book[y] && tag[y]>tag[x] && map[x][y]>0) {
            book[y]=1;
            int res=dfs(y,min(flow,map[x][y]));
            if (res>0) {
                map[x][y]-=res;
                map[y][x]+=res;
                return res;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&e);
    for (int i=1,a,b,w; i<=e; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&w);
        edge[a][++edge[a][0]]=b;
        edge[b][++edge[b][0]]=a;
        map[a][b]=map[b][a]=w;
    }
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1,tp; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&tp);
        edge[tp][++edge[tp][0]]=0;
        map[tp][0]=INF;
    }
    //dinic
    //BFS FIRST AND TAG
    //THEN DFS EVERYTIME UNTIL NOT FIND NEW PATH
    //THEN BFS AGAIN UNTIL NOT REACH THE END
    while (bfs()) {
        while (1) {
            memset(book,0,sizeof(book));
            int res=dfs(1,INF);
            if (res==0) break;
            ans+=res;
        }
    }
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//P1782-AC.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<algorithm>

using namespace std;

int tree[4000001],tag[4000001],num,day[1000001],tmp;

inline int min(int a,int b) {
    return a<b?a:b;
}

inline void update(int pos) {
    if(tag[pos]==0) return;
    tag[pos<<1]+=tag[pos];
    tag[(pos<<1)+1]+=tag[pos];
    tree[(pos<<1)+1]+=tag[pos];
    tree[pos<<1]+=tag[pos];
    tag[pos]=0;
}

void insert(int pos,int l,int r,int ll,int rr,int delta) {
    if(ll<=l&&r<=rr) {
        tree[pos]+=delta;
        if(tree[pos]<0) {
            printf("-1\n%d",num);
            exit(0);
        }
        tag[pos]+=delta;
        return;
    }
    update(pos);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if(ll<mid) insert(pos<<1,l,mid,ll,rr,delta);
    if(mid<rr) insert((pos<<1)+1,mid,r,ll,rr,delta);
    tree[pos]=min(tree[pos<<1],tree[(pos<<1)+1]);
}

inline void read(int &x) {
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    x=0;
    while(ch<='9'&&ch>='0') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

void build(int pos,int l,int r) {
    if(l+1==r) {
        read(tmp);
        tree[pos]=tmp;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    build(pos<<1,l,mid);
    build((pos<<1)+1,mid,r);
    tree[pos]=min(tree[(pos<<1)+1],tree[pos<<1]);
}

int main() {
    int N,M,tmp;
    read(N);
    read(M);
    build(1,1,N+1);
    /* for(int i=1,d,s,t;i<=M;i++)
     {
         read(d);
         read(s);
         read(t);
         num=i;
         insert(1,1,N+1,s,t+1,-d);
     }
     putchar('0');
     return 0;*/
    for (int i=1; i<=16; i++)
        printf("%d ",tree[i]);
}

//P1782retry.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

inline void read(int& a) {
    int ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>'9' || ch<'0')
        ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}
int t[4194305],lazy[4194305],L[4194305],R[4194305],s,m,n;
inline void getSize(int& s) {
    for (s=1; s<n; s<<=1);
    return;
}
inline void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    getSize(s);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        read(t[s+i]);
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i+1;
    }
    for (int i=n; i<s; i++)
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i+1;
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=min(t[i<<1],t[(i<<1)+1]);
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)+1];
    }
    return;
}
inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (lazy[x]==0)
        return;
    if (L[x]==R[x])
        return;
    t[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    t[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[(x<<1)+1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
    return;
}
void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (l>r)
        return;
    if (l>R[x])
        return;
    if (r<L[x])
        return;
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=d;
        lazy[x]+=d;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid) {
        update(x<<1,l,min(mid,r),d);
    }
    if (r>mid) {
        update((x<<1)+1,max(mid+1,l),r,d);
    }
    t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)+1]);
    return;
}
inline void work() {
    for (int i=1,d,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(d);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        update(1,l,r,-d);
        if (t[1]<0) {
            printf("-1\n%d\n",i);
            return;
        }
    }
    puts("0");
    return;
}
int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//P1988.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;
int n,ans=0;
int sc[500005];
int dp[500005][22];
int getlen(int x) {
    int ans=0;
    while (1<<ans <= x) {
        ++ans;
    }
    return ans-1;
}
int query(int l,int r) {
    if (r<l)
        return -INF;
    int len=getlen(r-l+1);
    return max(dp[l][len],dp[r-(1<<len)+1][len]);
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%d",sc+i);
    sort(sc+1,sc+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        sc[i]+=(n-i);
        dp[i][0]=sc[i];
    }
    for (int k=1,t=2; t <= n; k++,t<<=1) {
        for (int i=1,end=n-t+1; i<=end; i++) {
            dp[i][k]=max(dp[i][k-1],dp[i+(1<<(k-1))][k-1]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (query(1,i-1) <= sc[i]+i && query(i+1,n) <= sc[i]+i-1)
            ans++;
    }
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//P1989.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct wall {
    long long x,y,r;
    bool operator < (const wall &a) const {
        return r>a.r;
    }
} w[8005];
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[16005];
int n,q,ecnt=0,head[8005];
int a,b,c,d;
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}
inline long long power(long long x) {
    return x*x;
}
inline bool isin(int a,int b) {
    return (power(w[a].r) >= power(w[a].x-w[b].x)+power(w[a].y-w[b].y));
}
void init() {
    sort(w+1,w+n+1);
    memset(head,-1,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int find=0;
        for (int j=i-1; j>0; j--) {
            if (isin(i,j)) {
                find=j;
                break;
            }
        }
        add(find,i);
    }
    return;
}
inline bool paisin(int x) {
    return (power(w[x].r) >= power(w[x].x-a)+power(w[x].y-b));
}
inline bool pbisin(int x) {
    return (power(w[x].r) >= power(w[x].x-c)+power(w[x].y-d));
}
int dfs(int x) {
    bool ain=paisin(x),bin=pbisin(x);
    if (x==0)
        ain=bin=1;
    if (!ain && !bin)
        return 0;
    int ans=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
        ans+=dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    if (ain && bin)
        return ans;
    return ans+1;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==0) {
        scanf("%d",&q);
        for (int i=1; i<=q; i++)
            printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&w[i].x,&w[i].y,&w[i].r);
    init();
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&a,&b,&c,&d);
        printf("%d\n",dfs(0));
    }
    return 0;
}

//P1990.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MOD 1000000009
using namespace std;

int dp[2][5005];
char r[500005];
int main() {
    scanf("%s",r);
    int n=strlen(r);
    if (n&1 || n>5005) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    dp[1][0]=1;
    for (int i=0,now=0,prev=1; i<n; i++,now^=1,prev^=1) {
        bool b=0,w=0;
        for (int j=0; j<=i; j++)
            dp[now][j]=0;
        if (r[i]=='?') {
            b=w=1;
        } else if (r[i]=='B')
            b=1;
        else
            w=1;
        if (b) {
            for (int j=0; j<=i; j++) {
                dp[now][j+1]=dp[prev][j];
            }
        }
        if (w) {
            for (int j=0; j<=i; j++)
                dp[now][j]=(dp[now][j]+dp[prev][j])%MOD;
        }
        printf("%d\n",dp[now][n>>1]);
    }
    printf("%d",dp[1][n>>1]);
    return 0;
}

//paint.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define T 2010
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
int n, m;
LL a[MAXN], b[MAXN], ab[MAXN];
LL sa[MAXN], sb[MAXN], sab[MAXN];
int fa[T][T], fb[T][T], fab[T][T];

void solve(LL sum[MAXN], int dp[T][T], LL mid) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) dp[i][j] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int tot = 1, pos = i - 1;
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if (sum[j] - sum[pos] > mid) {
                pos = j - 1;
                tot++;
                if (sum[j] - sum[pos] > mid) break;
            }
            dp[i][j] = tot;
        }
    }
}

int f[T][T];

bool check(LL mid) {
    solve(sa, fa, mid);
    solve(sb, fb, mid);
    solve(sab, fab, mid);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) f[i][j] = min(fa[i][j] + fb[i][j], fab[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            for (int k = i; k < j; k++) {
                f[i][j] = min(f[i][j], f[i][k] + f[i + 1][k]);
            }
        }
    return f[1][n] <= m;
}

int main() {
    freopen("paint.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("paint.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL Max = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), Max = max(Max, a[i]), sa[i] = sa[i - 1] + a[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), Max = max(Max, b[i]), sb[i] = sb[i - 1] + b[i];
    if (n > 2000) printf("%lld\n", max(Max, (sa[n] + sb[n] + m - 1) / m));
    else {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ab[i] = a[i] + b[i], sab[i] = sab[i - 1] + ab[i];
        LL l = max(Max, (sa[n] + sb[n] + m - 1) / m), r = sa[n] + sb[n];
        while (l < r) {
            LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (check(mid)) r = mid;
            else l = mid + 1;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", l);
    }
    return 0;
}

//pair.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 233
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * 4];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int f, LL w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, S, T;
int A[MAXN], B[MAXN], C[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN];
int pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
int q[256];
bool inq[MAXN];

bool spfa() {
    memset(dis, 200, sizeof dis);
    dis[S] = 0;
    int h = 0, t = 1;
    q[h] = S;
    while (h < t) {
        int x = q[(h++) & 255];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(t++) & 255] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] > -1e11;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0;
    LL sum = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int cap = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) cap = min(cap, e[pos[x]].f);
        if (sum + cap * dis[T] < 0) {
            cap = int(sum / -dis[T]);
            return ret + cap;
        }
        ret += cap;
        sum += dis[T] * cap;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) e[pos[x]].f -= cap, e[pos[x] ^ 1].f += cap;
    }
    return ret;
}

int solve(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 2, sqx = (int)sqrt(x); i <= sqx; i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) {
            while (x % i == 0) x /= i, ret++;
            sqx = (int) sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    return ret + (x > 1);
}

int main() {
    freopen("pair.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("pair.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    S = 0, T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(A[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(B[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cnt[i] = solve(A[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (cnt[i] & 1) {
            add(S, i, B[i], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if ((cnt[i] == cnt[j] + 1 && !(A[i] % A[j])) || (cnt[j] == cnt[i] + 1 && !(A[j] % A[i]))) add(i, j, INF, (LL)C[i] * C[j]);
            }
        } else add(i, T, B[i], 0);
    }
    printf("%d\n", MCMF());
    return 0;
}

//papapa.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 20000000
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],*ptr;
void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
}
#define getchar() (*(ptr++))

char ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 200005
#define s 262144
struct node {
    int left,right,val,full;
} t[s<<1];

int n,m;
int rec[1000005];

inline void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[s+i].left=t[s+i].right=t[s+i].val=t[s+i].full=1;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        t[i].full=t[i<<1].full+t[(i<<1)^1].full;
        if (t[i<<1].val==t[i<<1].full) t[i].left=t[i<<1].full+t[(i<<1)^1].left;
        else t[i].left=t[i<<1].left;
        if (t[(i<<1)^1].val==t[(i<<1)^1].full) t[i].right=t[i<<1].right+t[(i<<1)^1].full;
        else t[i].right=t[(i<<1)^1].right;
        t[i].val=max(max(max(t[i].left,t[i].right),max(t[i<<1].val,t[(i<<1)^1].val)),t[i<<1].right+t[(i<<1)^1].left);
    }
}

inline int findplace(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    if (x>s) {
        return l;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (t[x<<1].val>=v) return findplace(x<<1,l,mid,v);
    if (t[x<<1].right+t[(x<<1)^1].left>=v) {
        // answer must be in the mid
        int len=(v>>1)+1;
        return mid-t[x<<1].right+len;
    }
    return findplace((x<<1)^1,mid+1,r,v);
}

inline void update(int x) {
    x+=s;
    t[x].left=t[x].right=t[x].val=0;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) {
        if (t[x<<1].val==t[x<<1].full) t[x].left=t[x<<1].full+t[(x<<1)^1].left;
        else t[x].left=t[x<<1].left;
        if (t[(x<<1)^1].val==t[(x<<1)^1].full) t[x].right=t[x<<1].right+t[(x<<1)^1].full;
        else t[x].right=t[(x<<1)^1].right;
        t[x].val=max(max(max(t[x].left,t[x].right),max(t[x<<1].val,t[(x<<1)^1].val)),t[x<<1].right+t[(x<<1)^1].left);
    }
}

inline void clear(int x) {
    x+=s;
    t[x].left=t[x].right=t[x].val=1;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) {
        if (t[x<<1].val==t[x<<1].full) t[x].left=t[x<<1].full+t[(x<<1)^1].left;
        else t[x].left=t[x<<1].left;
        if (t[(x<<1)^1].val==t[(x<<1)^1].full) t[x].right=t[x<<1].right+t[(x<<1)^1].full;
        else t[x].right=t[(x<<1)^1].right;
        t[x].val=max(max(max(t[x].left,t[x].right),max(t[x<<1].val,t[(x<<1)^1].val)),t[x<<1].right+t[(x<<1)^1].left);
    }
}

inline int findone() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1].val!=t[x<<1].full) x<<=1;
        else x=(x<<1)^1;
    }
    return x-s-1;
}

inline int findn() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[(x<<1)^1].val!=t[(x<<1)^1].full) x=(x<<1)^1;
        else x=x<<1;
    }
    return n-x+s;
}

inline int xxx() {
    int ans=0,p=-1;
    if (t[s+1].val) {
        ans=findone();
        p=1;
    }
    if (t[s+n].val) {
        int ret=findn();
        if (ret>ans) ans=ret,p=n;
    }
    if ((t[1].val+1)>>1 > ans)
        p=findplace(1,0,s-1,(((t[1].val+1)>>1)<<1)-1);
    return p;
}

int main() {
    freopen("park.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("park.out","w",stdout);
    init_buf();
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,op,num; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(num);
        if (op==1) {
            int x=xxx();
            printf("%d\n",x);
            update(x);
            rec[num]=x;
        } else {
            clear(rec[num]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;

#define getchar() (*(ptr++))

char ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

//password.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
char a[10005];
long long x=0,n,MOD;
long long exp(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ans=0,temp=a;
    while (b>0) {
        if (b&1)
            ans=(ans+temp)%MOD;
        temp=(temp<<1)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
long long power(long long a,long long n) {
    long long ans=1,temp=a;
    while (n>0) {
        if (n&1)
            ans=exp(ans,temp);
        temp=exp(temp,temp);
        n>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
void read() {
    scanf("%s%lld%lld",a,&n,&MOD);
    int len=strlen(a);
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++)
        x=(x*10+(a[i]-48))%MOD;
    return;
}
void work() {
    if (n==1) {
        printf("%s %lld\n",a,exp(x,x));
        return;
    }
    long long res=power(x,n);
    printf("%lld %lld\n",res,exp(res,x));
    return;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("password10.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("password10.out","w",stdout);
    read();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//peaks.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

int n, k, m;

int a[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("peaks.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("peaks.out", "w", stdout);
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(k);
        read(m);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
        a[0] = a[n + 1] = 0;
        int tot, i, ans = 0;
        do {
            tot = 0;
            for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (a[i] > a[i - 1] && a[i] > a[i + 1]) tot++, i++;
            }
            ans += tot == k;
        } while (next_permutation(a + 1, a + n + 1));
        printf("%d\n", ans % m);
    }
    return 0;
}

//pe.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

struct person {
    int x,w;
    double c;
    bool operator < (person a) const {
        if (w!=a.w) return w<a.w;
        else return c>a.c;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n,k;
double h;

bool check(double x) {
    int tot=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n && tot<=k; i++) {
        if (tot*a[i].c<=x) tot++;
    }
    return tot>k;
}

void print(double ans) {
    int tot=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n && tot<=k; i++) {
        if (tot*a[i].c<=ans) {
            printf("%d ",a[i].x);
            tot++;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("pe.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("pe.out","w",stdout);
    int fun;
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&k,&fun);
    h=fun;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&a[i].w);
        a[i].x=i;
    }
    for (int i=1,v; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&v);
        a[i].c=(double)h/v;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    double l=0,r=1e9+1,mid;
    for (int i=1; i<=64; i++) {
        mid=(l+r)/2;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid;
    }
    print(r);
    return 0;
}

//permut.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
#define MOD 1000000007
int n, K, a[25], b1, b2;
int dp[(1 << 24) + 23], A[(1 << 24) + 23];
int main() {
    freopen("permut.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("permut.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    int top = (1 << n) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < n; i++, j <<= 1) A[j] = a[i];
    for (register int i = 3; i <= top; i++) {
        if ((A[i] = A[i ^ lowbit(i)] + A[lowbit(i)]) > MOD) A[i] = MOD;
    }
    for (register int i = 0, j; i <= top; i++) {
        j = ~i & top;
        if (j > i) swap(A[i], A[j]);
    }
    read(K);
    read(b1);
    if (K == 2) read(b2);
    else b2 = -1;
    dp[top] = 1;
    for (register int i = top, j, k; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (A[i] == b1 || A[i] == b2) {
            dp[i] = 0;
            continue;
        }
        for (j = i; j; j ^= k) {
            k = lowbit(j);
            if ((dp[i ^ k] += dp[i]) >= MOD) dp[i ^ k] -= MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[0]);
    return 0;
}

//per_vio.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
#define MOD 1000000007
int n, K;
int sum[(1 << 24) + 23], dp[(1 << 24) + 23], A[(1 << 24) + 23];
int a[25], b1, b2;
int main() {
    freopen("permut.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < n; i++, j <<= 1) {
        A[j] = a[i];
    }
    read(K);
    if (K == 1) {
        read(b1);
        sum[(1 << n) - 1] = 0, dp[(1 << n) - 1] = 1;
        for (register int i = (1 << n) - 1, j, k; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (sum[i] == b1) {
                dp[i] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            for (j = i; j; j ^= k) {
                k = lowbit(j);
                sum[i ^ k] = sum[i] + A[k];
                if (sum[i ^ k] > MOD) sum[i ^ k] = MOD;
                if ((dp[i ^ k] += dp[i]) >= MOD) dp[i ^ k] -= MOD;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n", dp[0]);
    } else {
        read(b1), read(b2);
        sum[(1 << n) - 1] = 0, dp[(1 << n) - 1] = 1;
        for (register int i = (1 << n) - 1, j, k; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (sum[i] == b1 || sum[i] == b2) {
                dp[i] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            if (!dp[i]) continue;
            for (j = i; j; j ^= k) {
                k = lowbit(j);
                sum[i ^ k] = sum[i] + A[k];
                if (sum[i ^ k] > MOD) sum[i ^ k] = MOD;
                if ((dp[i ^ k] += dp[i]) >= MOD) dp[i ^ k] -= MOD;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n", dp[0]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//phh.cpp
#include<stdio.h>
#include<algorithm>
#include<vector>
#define SZ 8192
#define INF 99999999
using namespace std;
int n, K, AA, BB, CC, SZZ[51];
struct point {
    int x, y, z;
    bool operator<(const point &p)const {
        return x!=p.x?x<p.x:y!=p.y?y<p.y:z<p.z;
    }
    point(int x_, int y_, int z_) {
        x=x_,y=y_,z=z_;
    }
    point() {
    }
    point operator +(const point &p)const {
        return point(x+p.x,y+p.y,z+p.z);
    }
} w[51], TP[10100000];
vector<point>P[51];
int cnt, IT[SZ+SZ+2];
void Ins(int a, int b) {
    a += SZ;
    IT[a] = b;
    while(a!=1) {
        a>>=1;
        IT[a]=min(IT[a*2],IT[a*2+1]);
    }
}
int Min(int b, int e) {
    int r = INF;
    b+=SZ, e+=SZ;
    while(b<=e) {
        r = min(r,IT[b]);
        r = min(r,IT[e]);
        b=(b+1)>>1,e=(e-1)>>1;
    }
    return r;
}
void Pro(int a) {
    int i, t;
    P[a].clear();
    sort(TP,TP+cnt);
    for(i=0; i<cnt; i++) {
        t = Min(1,TP[i].y);
        if(t <= TP[i].z)continue;
        P[a].push_back(TP[i]);
        Ins(TP[i].y,TP[i].z);
    }
    for(i=0; i<cnt; i++)Ins(TP[i].y,INF);
}
void Do(int a) {
    int i, j;
    for(i=a; i>=0; i--) {
        if(i>K)continue;
        cnt = 0;
        if(i!=a) {
            for(j=0; j<P[i].size(); j++)TP[cnt++] = P[i][j];
        }
        if(i!=0) {
            for(j=0; j<P[i-1].size(); j++)TP[cnt++] = P[i-1][j] + w[a];
        }
        Pro(i);
    }
    for(i=0; i<=a; i++)SZZ[i] = P[i].size();
}
long long MM = 999999999999999LL;
double Res;
void Make(double x, double y, double z, double pz, double cz, double cost) {
    if(x*y*z>MM)return;
    if(x*y*(z+pz)<=MM) {
        Res=min(Res, cost);
        return;
    }
    Res = min(Res, cost + (z+pz - MM/(x*y)) / pz * cz);
}
void Get(point a) {
    double x=a.x,y=a.y,z=a.z;

    Make(x,y,z,w[0].z,CC,AA+BB);
    Make(x+w[0].x,y,z,w[0].z,CC,BB);
    Make(x,y+w[0].y,z,w[0].z,CC,AA);
    Make(x+w[0].x,y+w[0].y,z,w[0].z,CC,0);

    Make(y,z,x,w[0].x,AA,BB+CC);
    Make(y+w[0].y,z,x,w[0].x,AA,CC);
    Make(y,z+w[0].z,x,w[0].x,AA,BB);
    Make(y+w[0].y,z+w[0].z,x,w[0].x,AA,0);

    Make(z,x,y,w[0].y,BB,CC+AA);
    Make(z+w[0].z,x,y,w[0].y,BB,AA);
    Make(z,x+w[0].x,y,w[0].y,BB,CC);
    Make(z+w[0].z,x+w[0].x,y,w[0].y,BB,0);
}
int main() {
    int i;
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&K,&AA,&BB,&CC);
    if(K==n) {
        printf("%lf\n",0.0);
        return 0;
    }
    for(i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&w[i].x,&w[i].y,&w[i].z);
    }
    P[0].push_back(point(0,0,0));
    for(i=0; i<SZ; i++)Ins(i,INF);
    for(i=1; i<n; i++) {
        Do(i);
    }
    for(i=0; i<P[K].size(); i++) {
        MM = min(MM, (long long)P[K][i].x*P[K][i].y*P[K][i].z);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", MM);
    Res = 1e10;
    for(i=0; i<P[K-1].size(); i++) {
        Get(P[K-1][i]);
    }
    printf("%.10lf\n",Res);
}

//Philoso.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#define PRID "10"
long long ans=0;
int n,m,k,key,prime[16],pcnt=0,s[320][320],temp[320];
bool map[320][320];
int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b==0)
        return a;
    return gcd(b,a%b);
}
bool check(int x) {
    if (x<2)
        return 0;
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++)
        if (x==prime[i])
            return 1;
    return 0;
}
void init() {
    int temp=key,r;
    for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(key)); i<=t; i++)
        if (temp%i==0) {
            while (temp%i==0)
                temp/=i;
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            t=int(sqrt(temp));
        }
    if (temp>1)
        prime[++pcnt]=temp;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&r);
            if (check(gcd(key,r)))
                map[i][j]=1;
        }
    }
    return;
}
void calc() {
    int i=1,j=1,p1,p2,total=temp[i];
    while (j<=m) {
        while (total>k && j<=m) {
            total-=temp[i];
            i++;
            if (i>j)
                total+=temp[j=i];
        }
        while (total<k && j<=m)
            total+=temp[++j];
        if (total==k) {
            p1=0,p2=0;
            while (temp[i]==0 && i<=m) {
                p1++;
                i++;
            }
            if (k==0) {
                ans+=(p1*(p1+1))>>1;
                j=i;
                total=temp[i];
            } else {
                while (temp[j+1]==0 && j<=m) {
                    p2++;
                    j++;
                }
                if (j>m)
                    p2--;
                ans+=(p1+1)*(p2+1);
                total-=temp[i++];
            }
        }
    }
    return;
}
void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        s[1][i]=map[1][i];
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            s[i][j]=s[i-1][j]+map[i][j];
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=m; k++)
                temp[k]=s[j][k]-s[i][k];
            calc();
        }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("philoso" PRID ".in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k,&key);
    init();
    freopen("philoso" PRID ".out","w",stdout);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//PhilosoV.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#define PRID "10"
long long ans=0;
int n,m,k,key,prime[16],pcnt=0,s[320][320],temp[320];
bool map[320][320];
int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b==0)
        return a;
    return gcd(b,a%b);
}
bool check(int x) {
    if (x<2)
        return 0;
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++)
        if (x==prime[i])
            return 1;
    return 0;
}
void init() {
    int temp=key,r;
    for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(key)); i<=t; i++)
        if (temp%i==0) {
            while (temp%i==0)
                temp/=i;
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            t=int(sqrt(temp));
        }
    if (temp>1)
        prime[++pcnt]=temp;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&r);
            if (check(gcd(key,r)))
                map[i][j]=1;
        }
    }
    return;
}
void calc() {
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (temp[j]-temp[i]==k)
                ans++;
        }
    return;
}
void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        s[1][i]=s[1][i-1]+map[1][i];
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            s[i][j]=s[i-1][j]+s[i][j-1]-s[i-1][j-1]+map[i][j];
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=m; k++)
                temp[k]=s[j][k]-s[i][k];
            calc();
        }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("philoso" PRID ".in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k,&key);
    init();
    freopen("philoso" PRID ".ans","w",stdout);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//PKUSC2016cf.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ans;
void dfs(int left,int top,int now) {
    if (left>top*now)
        return;
    if (now==0) {
        ans++;
        return;
    }
    for (int i=top; i>-1; i--) {
        if (left-i>=0) {
            dfs(left-i,i,now-1);
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        int n,m;
        scanf("%d%d",&m,&n);
        ans=0;
        dfs(m,m,n);
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <cstdio>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define f(i,st,ed) for(int i=st;i<=ed;i++)
#define mem(a,b) memset(a,b,sizeof(a))
using namespace std;

int m,n,k,y,s,sumc=0,tot=0,in[105],out[105],vis[105][105],a[105],mc[105],sf[105][1200],book[105],t[20][3],f[1005][1005],fir[205],v[205];

struct edge {
    int t,nx,c1,c2;
    edge() {} edge(int _t,int _n,int _c1,int _c2):t(_t),nx(_n),c1(_c1),c2(_c2) {}
} e[500];
inline void add(int s,int t,int c1,int c2) {
    e[++tot]=edge(t,fir[s],c1,c2);
    fir[s]=tot;
    in[t]++;
    out[s]++;
}
inline int read() {
    int ans=0;
    char tp=getchar();
    while(tp>'9'||tp<'0') tp=getchar();
    while(tp<='9'&&tp>='0') {
        ans=(ans*10+tp-'0');
        tp=getchar();
    }
    return ans;
}

void dfs1(int cu,int c,int cuv) {
    int flag=0;
    mc[cu]=min(mc[cu],c);
    for(int p=fir[cu]; p; p=e[p].nx) {
        flag=1;
        dfs1(e[p].t,f[e[p].c1][e[p].c2],cuv+a[cu]);
    }
    if(flag==0) v[cu]=cuv+a[cu];
}
void dfs2(int cu) {
    for(int i=y; i>=mc[cu]; i--) sf[cu][i]=max(sf[cu][i],sf[cu][i-mc[cu]]+v[cu]);
    for(int p=fir[cu]; p; p=e[p].nx) if(!book[e[p].t]) {
            book[e[p].t]=1;
            dfs2(e[p].t);
            for(int j=y; j>=0; j--) for(int i=0; i<=y; i++) if(j-i-mc[cu]>=0) sf[cu][j]=max(sf[cu][j],sf[cu][j-i-mc[cu]]+sf[e[p].t][i]);
        }
}
inline int check() {
    int flag=0;
    printf("%d\n",n);
    f(i,1,n) printf("%d ",in[i]);
    f(i,1,n) if(in[i]==0) {
        if(flag==0) {
            flag=1;
            s=i;
        } else return 0;
    }
    if(flag==0) return 1;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    while(!q.empty()) {
        int cu=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for(int p=fir[cu]; p; p=e[p].nx) {
            if(!vis[cu][e[p].t] && book[e[p].t]) return 2;
            if(!vis[cu][e[p].t] && !book[e[p].t]) {
                vis[cu][e[p].t]=1;
                book[e[p].t]=1;
                q.push(e[p].t);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    //freopen("plan.out","w",stdout);
    n=read();
    m=read();
    k=read();
    y=read()*12;
    f(i,1,n) a[i]=read();
    f(i,1,m) add(read(),read(),read(),read());
    f(i,1,k) f(j,1,2) t[i][j]=read();
    if(check()>-1) {
        printf("Wrong Graph\n");
        return 0;
    }
    f(i,0,1002) f(j,0,1002) f[i][j]=1000000007;
    f(i,1,n) mc[i]=1000000007;
    f[0][0]=0;
    f(cu,1,k) f(i,t[cu][1],1000) f(j,t[cu][2],1000) f[i][j]=min(f[i][j],f[i-t[cu][1]][j-t[cu][2]]+1);
    for(int i=1000; i>=0; i--) for(int j=1000; j>=0; j--) f[i][j]=min(f[i][j],min(f[i+1][j],f[i][j+1]));
    dfs1(s,0,0);
    mem(book,0);
    book[s]=1;
    dfs2(s);
    f(i,1,n) sumc+=mc[i];
    printf("%d\n%d\n",sumc,sf[s][y]);
    return 0;
}

//poet.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
typedef long double LD;
typedef long long LL;

int T, n, L, p;
int sum[MAXN], q[MAXN], R[MAXN];
char tmp[33];
LD f[MAXN];
inline LD W(int i, int j) {
    LD a = sum[j] - sum[i] - L, ret = 1;
    for (int k = p; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret *= a;
        a *= a;
    }
    return ret < 0 ? -ret : ret;
}

inline void work() {
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(p);
    L++;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", tmp);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (int)strlen(tmp) + 1;
    }
    int he, ta, l, r, mid;
    R[0] = 0;
    q[he = ta = 1] = 0;
    R[ta] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (R[he] < i) he++;
        f[i] = f[q[he]] + W(q[he], i);
        while (he <= ta && f[q[ta]] + W(q[ta], R[ta - 1] + 1) > f[i] + W(i, R[ta - 1] + 1)) q[ta--] = 0;
        l = max(R[ta - 1], i) + 1, r = n + 1;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (f[q[ta]] + W(q[ta], mid) >= f[i] + W(i, mid)) r = mid;
            else l = mid + 1;
        }
        if (l > n) continue;
        R[ta] = l - 1;
        R[++ta] = n;
        q[ta] = i;
    }
    if (f[n] > 1000000000000000000ll) puts("Too hard to arrange");
    else printf("%lld\n", LL(f[n] + 0.5));
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        work();
        puts("--------------------");
    }
    return 0;
}

//poj1151.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct lne {
    double st,ed,y;
    int v;
} l[210];
bool cmp(lne a,lne b) {
    return a.y<b.y;
}
double x[210];
double rg[210];
int cnt[210];
int n,lcnt=0,xcnt,rgcnt,t=1;
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d",&n)) {
        double ans=0;
        if (n==0)
            break;
        lcnt=0;
        xcnt=0;
        rgcnt=0;
        double last=-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            double x1,x2,y1,y2;
            scanf("%lf%lf%lf%lf",&x1,&y1,&x2,&y2);
            l[++lcnt].st=x1;
            l[lcnt].ed=x2;
            l[lcnt].y=y1;
            l[lcnt].v=1;
            l[++lcnt].st=x1;
            l[lcnt].ed=x2;
            l[lcnt].y=y2;
            l[lcnt].v=-1;
            x[++xcnt]=x1;
            x[++xcnt]=x2;
        }
        l[lcnt+1].y=-1;
        sort(l+1,l+lcnt+1,cmp);
        sort(x+1,x+xcnt+1);
        for (int i=1; i<=xcnt; i++) {
            if (x[i]==last)
                continue;
            rg[++rgcnt]=x[i];
            last=x[i];
        }
        memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
        for (int i=1; i<=lcnt; i++) {
            double st=l[i].st,ed=l[i].ed;
            int d=l[i].v;
            for (int j=1; j<rgcnt; j++) {
                if (rg[j]<st)
                    continue;
                if (rg[j]==ed)
                    break;
                cnt[j]+=d;
            }
            if (l[i].y!=l[i+1].y) {
                double tot=0;
                for (int j=1; j<rgcnt; j++) {
                    if (cnt[j])
                        tot+=rg[j+1]-rg[j];
                }
                ans+=tot*(l[i+1].y-l[i].y);
            }
        }
        printf("Test case #%d\nTotal explored area: %.2f\n\n",t++,ans);
    }
    return 0;
}
