//poj1679.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100019
#define MAXM 100019

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : ma(this), val(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void upd() {
        ma = this;
        if (c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
        if (c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->fa != null) pushto(x->fa);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->ma;
}

Node *getf(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];

void newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(mid, a[u]);
    Link(mid, a[v]);
}

struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return w < b.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

int main() {
    freopen("unique.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("unique.out", "w", stdout);
    int T, n, m;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) {
        ptr = mem;
        scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d", &e[i].u, &e[i].v, &e[i].w);
        }
        sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode(-1);
        bool unique = 1;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (getf(a[e[i].u]) != getf(a[e[i].v])) newE(e[i].u, e[i].v, e[i].w), ans += e[i].w;
            else if (query(a[e[i].u], a[e[i].v])->val == e[i].w) {
                unique = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (unique) printf("%lld\n", ans);
        else puts("Not Unique!");
    }
    return 0;
}

//POJ2135.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=1,head[MAXN],pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline bool spfa() {
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    queue <int> q;
    q.push(0);
    dis[0]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow) {
                if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                    pre[e[now].to]=x;
                    pos[e[now].to]=now;
                    dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                    if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                        inq[e[now].to]=1;
                        q.push(e[now].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (pre[n]) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

inline long long MCMF() {
    long long ret=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        ret+=dis[n];
        for (int now=n; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow--;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    add(0,1,0);
    add(0,1,0);
    printf("%lld\n",MCMF());
    return 0;
}

//POJ2195.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXM 10005
#define MAXN 405

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM<<3];

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
} st[105],ed[105];

int n,m,ecnt,scnt,tcnt,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN],pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
char temp[105];
bool inq[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void build() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=scnt; i++) {
        add(0,1+i,0);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=scnt; i++) {
        add(scnt+1+i,1,0);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=scnt; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=scnt; j++) {
            int d=abs(st[i].x-ed[j].x)+abs(st[i].y-ed[j].y);
            add(i+1,j+scnt+1,d);
        }
}

inline bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(0);
    dis[0]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow) {
                if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                    pre[e[now].to]=x;
                    pos[e[now].to]=now;
                    dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                    if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                        inq[e[now].to]=1;
                        q.push(e[now].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (pre[1]) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

inline int MCMF() {
    int ret=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        for (int now=1; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow--;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow++;
        }
        ret+=dis[1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF && n && m) {
        scnt=tcnt=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp+1);
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='H') {
                    ed[++tcnt]=point(i,j);
                } else if (temp[j]=='m') {
                    st[++scnt]=point(i,j);
                }
            }
        }
        build();
        printf("%d\n",MCMF());
    }
    return 0;
}

//POJ2637.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#define MAXN 50010
using namespace std;
const char pr[][10]= {"false","true","maybe"};
int n,m;
int y[MAXN],w[MAXN];
int dp[MAXN][17];
void init() {
    dp[0][0]=-1000000005;
    dp[n+1][0]=1000000005;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        dp[i][0]=w[i];
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=n; k++) {
        for (int i=0,t=n-(1<<(k-1)); i<=t; i++) {
            dp[i][k]=max(dp[i][k-1],dp[i+(1<<(k-1))][k-1]);
        }
    }
    return;
}
int post(int x) {
    int l=0,r=n,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (y[mid]>=x)
            r=mid;
        else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}
int posd(int x) {
    int l=0,r=n,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (y[mid]<=x)
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}
int top(int s,int t) {
    int len=t-s,l=1;
    while (1<<l <= len)
        l++;
    l--;
//	printf("top :%d %d\n",l,max(dp[s][l],dp[t-(1<<l)][l]));
    return max(dp[s][l],dp[t-(1<<l)+1][l]);
}
int query(int s,int t) {
    if (s+1>=t)
        return 1;
    int ps=post(s+1),pt=posd(t-1),rs=post(s),rt=posd(t);
//	printf("dddd : %d %d\n",ps,pt);
    if (y[rt]!=t)
        return 2;
    if (ps>pt)
        return 2;
    if (top(ps,pt)<w[rt]) {
        if (y[rs]==s && rt-rs==t-s)
            return 1;
        else
            return 2;
    } else
        return 0;
}
int main() {
    while (1) {
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            scanf("%d%d",y+i,w+i);
        init();
        scanf("%d",&m);
        if (n==0 && m==0)
            break;
        for (int i=1,s,t; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&s,&t);
            printf("%s\n",pr[query(s,t)]);
        }
        puts("");
    }
    return 0;
}

//POJ2826AC.cpp
#include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-8;
int sgn(double x) {
    if(fabs(x) < eps)return 0;
    if(x < 0)return -1;
    else return 1;
}
struct Point {
    double x,y;
    Point() {}
    Point(double _x,double _y) {
        x = _x;
        y = _y;
    }
    Point operator -(const Point &b)const {
        return Point(x - b.x,y - b.y);
    }
    //\B2\E6\BB\FD
    double operator ^(const Point &b)const {
        return x*b.y - y*b.x;
    }
    //\B5\E3\BB\FD
    double operator *(const Point &b)const {
        return x*b.x + y*b.y;
    }
};
struct Line {
    Point s,e;
    Line() {}
    Line(Point _s,Point _e) {
        s = _s;
        e = _e;
    }
    //\C1\BD?\CF\DF\CF?\C7??\E3
    //\B5\DA?\B8\F6??0\B1\ED??\CF\DF\D6??\AC?1\B1\ED??\D0��\AC?0\B1\ED?\CF?,?2\CA\C7\CF?
    //?\D3��\DA?\B8\F6??2?\A3\AC\BD\BB\B5\E3\B2\C5\D3\D0\D2\E2\D2\E5
    pair<int,Point> operator &(const Line &b)const {
        Point res = s;
        if(sgn((s-e)^(b.s-b.e)) == 0) {
            if(sgn((s-b.e)^(b.s-b.e)) == 0)
                return make_pair(0,res);//\D6?\CF
            else return make_pair(1,res);//?\D0\D0
        }
        double t = ((s-b.s)^(b.s-b.e))/((s-e)^(b.s-b.e));
        res.x += (e.x-s.x)*t;
        res.y += (e.y-s.y)*t;
        return make_pair(2,res);
    }
};

//*\C5��\CF\CF?\CE\CF?
bool inter(Line l1,Line l2) {
    return
        max(l1.s.x,l1.e.x) >= min(l2.s.x,l2.e.x) &&
        max(l2.s.x,l2.e.x) >= min(l1.s.x,l1.e.x) &&
        max(l1.s.y,l1.e.y) >= min(l2.s.y,l2.e.y) &&
        max(l2.s.y,l2.e.y) >= min(l1.s.y,l1.e.y) &&
        sgn((l2.s-l1.e)^(l1.s-l1.e))*sgn((l2.e-l1.e)^(l1.s-l1.e)) <= 0 &&
        sgn((l1.s-l2.e)^(l2.s-l2.e))*sgn((l1.e-l2.e)^(l2.s-l2.e)) <= 0;
}

int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);

    int x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4;

        l1 = Line(Point(x1,y1),Point(x2,y2));
        l2 = Line(Point(x3,y3),Point(x4,y4));
        if(sgn(l1.s.y-l1.e.y)==0 || sgn(l2.s.y-l2.e.y) == 0) {
            printf("0.00\n");
            continue;
        }
        if(sgn(l1.s.y-l1.e.y) < 0)swap(l1.s,l1.e);
        if(sgn(l2.s.y-l2.e.y) < 0)swap(l2.s,l2.e);
        if(inter(l1,l2) == false) {
            printf("0.00\n");
            continue;
        }
        //\BF?\BB\B7\E2\B5\F4\B5\C4\C7\E9\BF\F6
        if(inter(Line(l1.s,Point(l1.s.x,100000)),l2) ) {
            printf("0.00\n");
            continue;
        }
        //\BF?\BB\B7\E2\B5\F4
        if(inter(Line(l2.s,Point(l2.s.x,100000)),l1) ) {
            printf("0.00\n");
            continue;
        }
        pair<int,Point>pr;
        pr = l1 & l2;
        Point p = pr.second;
        double ans1;
        pr = l1 & Line(Point(100000,l2.s.y),l2.s);
        Point p1 = pr.second;
        ans1 = fabs( (l2.s-p)^(p1-p) )/2;
        double ans2;
        pr = l2 & Line(Point(100000,l1.s.y),l1.s);
        Point p2 = pr.second;
        ans2 = fabs( (l1.s-p)^(p2-p) )/2;
        printf("%.2lf\n",min(ans1,ans2));
    }

//poj2826.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define eps 0.00000001
using namespace std;

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    point operator + (point a) {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) {
        return x*a.y-y*a.x;
    }
    point operator * (double a) {
        return point(a*x,a*y);
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
} A,B,C,D;

bool intersect() {
    return ((D-A)*(B-A))*((C-A)*(B-A))<=0 && (((A-C)*(D-C))*((B-C)*(D-C)))<=0;
}
point interpoint(point A,point B,point C,point D) {
    double k=-((A-C)*(D-C))/((B-A)*(D-C));
    return A+(B-A)*k;
}

double getArea(point a,point b,point c) {
    double re=((b-a)*(c-a));
    return fabs(re)/2;
}
bool under(point A,point B) {
    if (A.x*B.x<=0)
        return 0;
    A.x=fabs(A.x);
    B.x=fabs(B.x);
    if (A*B<0)
        swap(A,B);
    if (A.x<=B.x)
        return 1;
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf%lf%lf%lf%lf%lf",&A.x,&A.y,&B.x,&B.y,&C.x,&C.y,&D.x,&D.y);
        if (A.y==B.y || C.y==D.y) {
            puts("0.00");
            continue;
        }
        if (A.y>B.y)
            swap(A,B);
        if (C.y>D.y)
            swap(C,D);
        if (B.y>D.y) {
            swap(B,D);
            swap(A,C);
        }
        if (intersect())
            if ((B-A)*(D-C)!=0) {
                point p=interpoint(A,B,C,D);
                if (under(D-p,B-p))
                    puts("0.00");
                else {
                    point xx(B.x-1,B.y);
                    point l=interpoint(xx,B,C,D);
                    printf("%.2lf\n",getArea(p,l,B)+eps);
                }
                continue;
            }
        puts("0.00");
    }
    return 0;
}

//Polygon�����.cpp
/// �����
//*�жϵ���͹�������
//���γ�һ��͹��, ���Ұ���ʱ������ (�����˳ʱ�������� < 0��Ϊ > 0)
//��ı��: 0~n-1
//����ֵ: -1: ����͹�������; 0: ����͹����α߽���; 1: ����͹�������
int inConvexPoly(Point a, Point p[], int n) {
    p[n] = p[0];
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if(sgn((p[i] - a) ^ (p[i + 1] - a)) < 0)return -1;
        else if(OnSeg(a, Line(p[i], p[i + 1])))return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
/*
Description: �жϵ�������������
Algorithm: ���߷�, poly[]�Ķ�����Ҫ���ڵ���3,��ı��0~n-1
Return:  -1, ����͹�������; 0, ����͹����α߽���; 1, ����͹�������
Notice: ray.e.x��ȡֵҪע��, ҪС����С��x����, ���������, ��ֹ��int��LL;
*/
int isPointInPolygon(Point p, Point poly[], int n) {
    int cnt = 0;
    Line ray, side;
    ray.s = p;
    ray.e.y = p.y;
    ray.e.x = -100000000000.0;//-INF, ע��ȡֵ��ֹԽ��
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        side.s = poly[i];
        side.e = poly[(i + 1) % n]; //�жϵ�������������
        if(isPointOnSegment(p, side)) return -1;
        if(sgn(side.s.y - side.e.y) == 0) continue;//���ƽ�����򲻿���
        if(isPointOnSegment(side.s, ray)) {
            if(sgn(side.s.y - side.e.y) > 0) cnt = !cnt;
        } else if(isPointOnSegment(side.e, ray)) {
            if(sgn(side.e.y - side.s.y) > 0) cnt = !cnt;
        } else if(seg_seg_inter(ray, side)) cnt = !cnt;
    }
    return cnt;
}
/*
Description: �жϵ��Ƿ��ڶ������
Algorithm: ���߷�, $O(n)$
Param[in]: p, Ҫ�жϵĵ�; poly, �����(�߲��Խ�); n, ����ζ�����
Return: -1, ���ڶ������; 0, ���ڶ������; 1, ���ڶ������
Notice: ����p[0]��p[n]
*/
int isPointInPolygon(Point p, Point poly[], int n) {
    int wn = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if(isPointOnSegmet(p, poly[i], poly[i + 1])) return -1;
        int k = sgn((poly[i + 1] - poly[i]) ^ (p - poly[i]));
        int d1 = sgn(poly[i].y - p.y);
        int d2 = sgn(poly[i + 1].y - p.y);
        if(k > 0 && d1 <= 0 && d2 > 0) ++wn;
        if(k < 0 && d1 > 0 && d2 <= 0) --wn;
    }
    return wn != 0;
}

//�ж�͹�����
//�������߱�
//�������˳ʱ�����Ҳ��������ʱ�����
//��ı��1~n-1
bool isconvex(Point poly[], int n) {
    bool s[3];
    memset(s, false, sizeof(s));
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        s[sgn((poly[(i + 1) % n] - poly[i]) ^ (poly[(i + 2) % n] - poly[i])) + 1] = true;
        if(s[0] && s[2])return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//����ε����: �ֽ�Ϊ��������ε������
double CalArea(vector<Point> p) {
    double res = 0;
    p.push_back(p[0]);
    for(int i = 1; i < (int)p.size(); i++)
        res += (p[i] ^ p[i - 1]);//������ԭ��, p[i], p[i-1]���ɵ������ε��������
    return fabs(res * 0.5);//������������0.5, �Լ�ȡ��
}

//����ε�����: ������������ĵ������Ȩ��
Point Centroid(vector<Point> p) { //��˳ʱ�뷽�����ʱ�뷽������
    Point c = Point(0.0, 0.0);
    double S = 0.0, s;
    for(int i = 2; i < (int)p.size(); i++) {
        s = ((p[i] - p[0]) ^ (p[i] - p[i - 1]));//�����������(*0.5)
        S += s;
        c = c + (p[0] + p[i - 1] + p[i]) * s;//������������(/3.0)
    }
    c = c * (1.0 / (3.0 * S));
    return c;
}

//polyline.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef double D;
#define sq2 1.4142135623730950488
#define sq2_2 0.7071067811865475727
#define eps 1e-9
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point() {}
    Point(D xx, D yy) : x(xx), y(yy) {}
    inline Point lturn() {
        return Point(x * sq2_2 - y * sq2_2, x * sq2_2 + y * sq2_2);
    }
    inline Point rturn() {
        return Point(x * sq2_2 + y * sq2_2, y * sq2_2 - x * sq2_2);
    }
    inline Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
} d[8];

int n, q;

int X1[1005], Y1[1005], X2[1005], Y2[1005], ans[1005];

int step = 0, lim = 4;

void dfs(int x, Point p, int nd) {
    if (!x) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= q; ++i) {
            if (X1[i] < p.x + eps && X2[i] > p.x - eps && Y1[i] < p.y + eps && Y2[i] > p.y - eps && ans[i] > step) {
                ans[i] = step;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (step > lim) return;
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[nd], nd);
    step++;
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 1) & 7], (nd + 1) & 7);
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 7) & 7], (nd + 7) & 7);
    step++;
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 2) & 7], (nd + 2) & 7);
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 6) & 7], (nd + 6) & 7);
    step++;
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 3) & 7], (nd + 3) & 7);
    dfs(x - 1, p + d[(nd + 5) & 7], (nd + 5) & 7);
    if (~x & 1) {
        step += 5;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q; ++i) {
            if (X1[i] < p.x + eps && X2[i] > p.x - eps && Y1[i] < p.y + eps && Y2[i] > p.y - eps && ans[i] > step) {
                ans[i] = step;
            }
        }
        step -= 5;
    }
    step -= 3;
}

int main() {
    freopen("polyline.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("polyline.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= q; i++) {
        read(X1[i]);
        read(Y1[i]);
        read(X2[i]);
        read(Y2[i]);
    }
    d[0] = Point(0, 100);
    for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++) d[i] = d[i - 1].lturn();
    memset(ans, INF, sizeof ans);
    if (n <= 6) lim = 1000;
    else if (n <= 7) lim = 12;
    else if (n <= 8) lim = 8;
    else if (n <= 9) lim = 6;
    dfs(n, Point(0, 0), 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i] == INF ? -1 : ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//pool.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 998244353

#define MAXK 1005

inline LL power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Mat {
    LL a[105][105];
    LL *operator [] (int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void clear(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) a[i][j] = 0;
    }
    void init(int n) {
        clear(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
    }
} c;

inline void mul(Mat &a, Mat &b, int n) {
    c.clear(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                (c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j]) %= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) a[i][j] = c[i][j];
}

Mat a, tr;
LL p[MAXK];

LL solve(int n, int K) {
    tr.clear(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        tr[i][0] = p[0];
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            tr[i][j] = p[j - i];
        }
    }
    a.init(n);
    for ( ; K; K >>= 1) {
        if (K & 1) mul(a, tr, n);
        mul(tr, tr, n);
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) (ans += a[0][i]) %= MOD;
    return ans;
}

int n, L, R, x, y;

int main() {
    //freopen("pool.in", "r", stdin);
    //freopen("pool.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    read(x);
    read(y);
    for (int i = 0; i <= R; i++) p[i] = power(x, i) * (y - x) % MOD * power(y, R - i) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", (solve(R + 1, n) - solve(L, n) + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//prime.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 998244353
#define N 1000007

bool vis[N];
int p[N / 5], pcnt = 0;
int mu[N], sum[N];

inline void sieve() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1, k; j <= pcnt && (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (!(i % p[j])) {
                mu[k] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[k] = -mu[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + mu[i];
}

LL n;

LL calc(LL x) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (LL i = 1, j; i <= x; i = j + 1) {
        j = x / (x / i);
        (ret += (j - i + 1) * (x / i)) %= MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    sieve();
    LL ans = 0;
    for (LL i = 1, j, k; i * i <= n; i = j + 1) {
        k = n / ((LL)i * i);
        j = LL(sqrt(n / k));
        (ans += (sum[j] - sum[i - 1]) * calc(k)) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)(ans + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//PrimeLister.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int prime[10000],cnt=0;

int main() {
    for (int n=1000; n<=9999; n++) {
        int flag=1;
        for (int i=2,t=int(sqrt(n)); i<=t; i++) {
            if (!(n%i)) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag)
            prime[cnt++]=n;
    }
    printf("int PrimeList[%d]={%d",cnt,prime[0]);
    for (int i=1; i<cnt; i++) {
        printf(",%d",prime[i]);
    }
    printf("};\n");
    return 0;
}

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <iostream>

#include <vector>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const time_t INF = 0x7fffffff;
int pass(0), excd(0), fail(0);
vector< pair<int, time_t> > rec;

void readRecord() {
    ifstream IN("timerRecord.txt");
    int x;
    time_t t;
    while (IN >> x >> t) rec.push_back(make_pair(x, t));
    IN.close();
}

void printRecord() {
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)rec.size(); i++) {
        if (rec[i].first == INF) fail++;
        else if (rec[i].first >= 0) pass++;
        else excd++;
    }
    printf("\nStatistics: On time %d , Time out %d , Failed %d\n", pass, excd, fail);
    printf("Finish rate : %.1lf%% , Good rate : %.1lf%%\n\n", (pass + excd) * 100.0 / (double)rec.size(), pass * 100.0 / (double)rec.size());
    puts("Recent tasks :\n");
    for (int i = (int)rec.size() - 1, j = max(int(rec.size()) - 5, 0); i >= j; i--) {
        printf("%s %02d : %02d : %02d -- %s", rec[i].first == INF ? "Failed   " : (rec[i].first>= 0 ? "Pass     " : "Time out "), rec[i].first == INF ? -1 : abs(rec[i].first) / 3600, rec[i].first == INF ? -1 : (abs(rec[i].first) / 60) % 60 , rec[i].first == INF ? -1 : abs(rec[i].first) % 60, asctime(localtime(&rec[i].second)));
    }
    puts("----");
}

int main() {
    readRecord();
    printRecord();
    return 0;
}

//problem.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int t,K,n,m;
int p[4],cnt[4],pcnt=0;
int num[2005][4],sum[2005][2005];

inline void init() {
    int x=K;
    for (int i=2; i<=x; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            p[++pcnt]=i;
            while (x%i==0) {
                x/=i;
                cnt[pcnt]++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (x>1) {
        p[++pcnt]=x;
        cnt[pcnt]=1;
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=2001; i++) {
        x=i;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt; j++) {
            while (x%p[j]==0) {
                x/=p[j];
                num[i][j]++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=2001; i++) {
        int tot[4]= {0,0,0,0};
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
            // inc i-j+1
            for (int k=1; k<=pcnt; k++) {
                tot[k]+=num[i-j+1][k];
            }
            // dec j
            bool flag=1;
            for (int k=1; k<=pcnt; k++) {
                tot[k]-=num[j][k];
                flag&=(tot[k]>=cnt[k]);
            }
            sum[i][j]=sum[i-1][j]+flag;
        }
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=2001; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) sum[i][j]+=sum[i][j-1];
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&t,&K);
    init();
    while (t--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        if (m>n) m=n;
        printf("%d\n",sum[n][m]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 234567
#define MAX 1002
typedef long long LL;
const LL MOD = 998244353;

inline bool ok(int x, int y) {
    return (x >= y && x / 2333 - y / 2333  == (x - y) / 2333);
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[9876543];

int tcnt = 0;

struct NODE {
    int l, r, rt;
} T[9876];

int Tcnt = 0;

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret % MOD;
}

int Query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int w) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return query(T[x].rt, 0, MAX, 0, w);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + Query(T[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), w);
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + Query(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, w);
    return ret % MOD;
}

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int w, int add) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = (t[x].v + add) % MOD;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (w <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, w, add);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, w, add);
    }
}

void Update(int &x, int l, int r, int v, int w, int add) {
    if (!x) x = ++Tcnt;
    update(T[x].rt, 0, MAX, w, add);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) Update(T[x].l, l, mid, v, w, add);
        else Update(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, v, w, add);
    }
}

int n;
int a[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("product.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("product.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    LL ans = 0, dp;
    int rt = 0;
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
        int mod = a[i] % 2333;
        dp = Query(rt, 0, 2333, 0, mod, a[i] / 2333);
        ans += dp;
        dp = dp + 1 == MOD ? 0 : dp + 1;
        Update(rt, 0, 2333, mod, a[i] / 2333, (int)dp);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//product_excited.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

unsigned AA = 0x233f3f3f;

#define Rand() (AA ^= AA << 13, AA ^= AA >> 5, AA ^= AA << 17, AA)

#define MAXN 55
#define eps 1e-8
#define INF 1e50

struct Point {
    D x, y, z;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, K;
D A, B, C, ta, tb, tc, tot, ans = INF;

double check(double alpha) {
    D t = (tot + eps) / (ta + a[1].x * alpha);
    if (ta + a[1].x * alpha < eps) t = INF;
    D ll = 0, rr = min(1., (t / tc - tb) / a[1].y), lm, rm, lv, rv, ret = INF;
    lv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - ll) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * ll) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
    rv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - rr) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * rr) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
    ret = min(lv, rv);

    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        D l = ll + (rr - ll) * i / 20, r = ll + (rr - ll) * (i + 1) / 20;
        while (r - l > eps) {
            lm = (l * 2 + r) / 3, rm = (l + r * 2) / 3;
            lv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - lm) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * lm) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
            rv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - rm) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * rm) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
            ret = min(ret, min(lv, rv));
            if (lv < rv) r = rm;
            else l = lm;
        }
        lv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - l) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * l) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
        rv = (1 - alpha) * A + (1 - r) * B + (1 - min((t / (tb + a[1].y * r) - tc) / a[1].z, 1.)) * C;
        ret = min(ret, min(lv, rv));
    }
    return ret;
}

int P[MAXN], ansP[MAXN];

#define inc(q) (ta += a[q].x, tb += a[q].y, tc += a[q].z)
#define dec(q) (ta -= a[q].x, tb -= a[q].y, tc -= a[q].z)

void SA() {
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) ta += a[n - i].x, tb += a[n - i].y, tc += a[n - i].z;
    tot = ta * tb * tc;
    D now = tot;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ansP[n - i] = P[n - i] = i + 1;
    for (D Temp = tot * 2 + 200; Temp > 1e-1; Temp *= 0.9997) {
        int x = Rand() % K + 1, y = Rand() % (n - K) + K + 1;
        dec(P[x]), inc(P[y]);
        D to = ta * tb * tc;
        if (to <= now || (exp((now - to) / Temp) >= ((D)Rand() / 0xffffffff)) ) {
            swap(P[x], P[y]);
            now = to;
            if (to < tot) {
                tot = to;
                for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) ansP[i] = P[i];
            }
        } else dec(P[y]), inc(P[x]);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    if (n == 0 || n == K) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].re();

    SA();

    ta = 0, tb = 0, tc = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        if (ansP[i] == 1) {
            puts("0");
            return 0;
        }
        ta += a[ansP[i]].x;
        tb += a[ansP[i]].y;
        tc += a[ansP[i]].z;
    }
    tot = ta * tb * tc;
    for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
        ta -= a[ansP[j]].x, tb -= a[ansP[j]].y, tc -= a[ansP[j]].z;
        D ll = 0, rr = min(1., (tot / tb / tc - ta) / a[1].x);
        ans = min(ans, min(check(ll), check(rr)));
        if (rr - ll > 2 * eps) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                D l = ll + (rr - ll) * i / 20, r = ll + (rr - ll) * (i + 1) / 20, lm, rm, lv = INF, rv = INF;
                while (r - l > eps) {
                    lm = (l * 2 + r) / 3, rm = (l + r * 2) / 3;
                    lv = check(lm), rv = check(rm);
                    ans = min(ans, min(lv, rv));
                    if (lv < rv) r = rm;
                    else l = lm;
                }
                lv = check(l), rv = check(r);
                ans = min(ans, min(lv, rv));
            }
        }
        ta += a[ansP[j]].x, tb += a[ansP[j]].y, tc += a[ansP[j]].z;
    }

    printf("%.8lf\n", ans - eps);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int main() {
    int n ;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    int st = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        int now = n / 2333 - i / 2333 - (n - i) / 2333;
        if (now == 0) {
            if (st == -1) st = i;
        } else {
            if (st != -1) {
                printf("%d ~ %d\n", st, i - 1);
                st = -1;
            }
        }
    }
    if (st != -1) {
        printf("%d ~ %d\n", st, n);
    }
    printf("%d\n", n % 2333);

    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

#define MAXN 234567

typedef long long LL;
const LL MOD = 998244353;

inline bool ok(int x, int y) {
    return (x >= y && x / 2333 - y / 2333  == (x - y) / 2333);
}

int n;
int a[MAXN];
LL dp[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("product.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("pro_vio.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            if (ok(a[j], a[i])) {
                (dp[i] += dp[j]) %= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    LL ans = MOD - n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += dp[i];
    printf("%lld\n", ans % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//ptphs.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
int n;
int opt[MAXN],a[MAXN],tem[MAXN],cnt=0;

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l+1;
}

int t[s<<1];

void upd(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<k) k-=t[x<<1],x=(x<<1)|1;
        else x<<=1;
    }
    return tem[x-s-1];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",opt+i,a+i);
        if (opt[i]!=4) tem[++cnt]=a[i];
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    cnt=int(unique(tem+1,tem+cnt+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (opt[i]==1) {
            upd(find(a[i]),1);
        } else if (opt[i]==2) {
            upd(find(a[i]),-1);
        } else if (opt[i]==3) {
            printf("%d\n",query(1,find(a[i])-1)+1);
        } else if (opt[i]==4) {
            printf("%d\n",kth(a[i]));
        } else if (opt[i]==5) {
            printf("%d\n",kth(query(1,find(a[i])-1)));
        } else {
            printf("%d\n",kth(query(1,find(a[i]))+1));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//pvz.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009
//dinic
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next;
    int to;
    int w;
} e[900000];
bool visit[900000],can[100000];
int head[900000],q[10000005];
int n,m,s=0,t,cnt=0,pcnt=0,ans=0,total=0;
int tag[900000];
int sc[100000],att[100000];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++cnt].w=w;
    e[cnt].to=v;
    e[cnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=cnt;
    e[++cnt].w=0;
    e[cnt].to=u;
    e[cnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=cnt;
    return;
}
bool bfs() {
    bool flag=0;
    int hd=1,tl=2;
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    q[1]=s;
    tag[0]=0;
    visit[0]=1;
    while (hd<tl) {
        int u=q[hd],en=head[q[hd]],v;
//		printf("HEAD u =>%d\n",q[hd]);
        while (en!=-1) {
            v=e[en].to;
//			printf("v:%d\n",v);
            if (!visit[v] && e[en].w!=0) {
                q[tl++]=v;
                visit[v]=1;
                tag[v]=tag[u]+1;
                if (v==t) flag=1;
            }
            en=e[en].next;
        }
        hd++;
    }
    return flag;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==t) {
        return flow;
    }
    int en=head[x],v;
    while (en!=-1) {
        v=e[en].to;
        if (!visit[v] && tag[v]>tag[x] && e[en].w>0) {
            visit[v]=1;
            int res=dfs(v,min(flow,e[en].w));
            if (res>0) {
                e[en].w-=res;
                e[en^1].w+=res;
                return res;
            }
        }
        en=e[en].next;
    }
    return 0;
}
void topo() {
    bool flag=1;
    while (flag) {
        flag=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
//			printf("%d's att is %d\n",i,att[i]);
            if (att[i]==0 && !can[i]) {
                flag=1;
                can[i]=1;
                for (int v=head[i]; v!=-1; v=e[v].next) {
                    if (e[v].w!=0)
                        att[e[v].to]--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (!can[i]) {
            add(i,t,INF);
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    memset(head,-1,sizeof(head));
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,last; i<=n; i++) {
        last=-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            pcnt++;
            scanf("%d%d",sc+pcnt,att+pcnt);
            for (int k=1,tx,ty; k<=att[pcnt]; k++) {
                scanf("%d%d",&tx,&ty);
                add(tx*m+ty+1,pcnt,INF);
            }
            if (last!=-1) {
                add(last,pcnt,INF);
                att[pcnt]++;
            }
            last=pcnt;
        }
    }
    t=pcnt+1;
//	printf("t:%d\n",t);
    topo();
    can[s]=can[t]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (sc[i]>0) {
            add(s,i,sc[i]);
            total+=sc[i];
        }
        if (sc[i]<=0)
            add(i,t,-sc[i]);
    }
    /*	for (int i=0;i<=pcnt+1;i++) {
    		int en=head[i];
    		printf("%d att to :",i);
    		while (en!=-1) {
    			printf("%d w=%d, ",e[en].to,e[en].w);
    			en=e[en].next;
    		}
    		printf("; sc=%d ; it can",sc[i]);
    		if (!can[i])
    			printf("'t");
    		printf("\n");
    	}*/
    while (bfs()) {
//		printf("BFSed successed");
        while (1) {
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
            int re=dfs(s,INF);
            if (re==0)
                break;
            ans+=re;
        }
    }
    printf("%d",total-ans);
    return 0;
}

//py.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <stack>
#include <bitset>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

map <string, string> var;

string purify(string EXPRESSION) {
    while (EXPRESSION.size() && EXPRESSION[0] == ' ') EXPRESSION = EXPRESSION.substr(1, EXPRESSION.size() - 1);
    while (EXPRESSION.size() && EXPRESSION[EXPRESSION.size() - 1] == ' ') EXPRESSION = EXPRESSION.substr(0, EXPRESSION.size() - 1);
    return EXPRESSION;
}

LL toLonglong(string s) {
    s = purify(s);
    if (isdigit(s[0]) || s[0] == '-') {
        stringstream tmp;
        tmp << s;
        LL ret;
        tmp >> ret;
        return ret;
    } else {
        if (var.find(s) == var.end()) return 0;
        return toLonglong(var[s]);
    }
}

string toString(LL x) {
    stringstream tmp;
    tmp << x;
    string ret;
    tmp >> ret;
    return ret;
}

LL pw(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret *= x;
        x *= x;
    }
    return ret;
}

int Priority(char opt) {
    switch (opt) {
    case '+' :
        return 2;
        break;
    case '-' :
        return 2;
        break;
    case '*' :
        return 4;
        break;
    case '%' :
        return 3;
        break;
    case '^' :
        return 5;
        break;
    case '~' :
        return 6;
        break;
    case '(' :
        return 1;
        break;
    case ' ' :
        return 0;
        break;
    }
    assert(0);
}

string calc(string a, string b, char opt) {
    LL A = toLonglong(a), B = toLonglong(b);
    switch (opt) {
    case '+' :
        return toString(A + B);
        break;
    case '-' :
        return toString(B - A);
        break;
    case '*' :
        return toString(A * B);
        break;
    case '%' :
        return toString(B % A);
        break;
    case '^' :
        return toString(pw(B, A));
        break;
    }
    assert(0);
}

string get(string EXPRESSION) {
    EXPRESSION = purify(EXPRESSION);
    if (EXPRESSION == "") return "";
    else if (EXPRESSION[0] == '\'' || EXPRESSION[0] == '"') {
        return EXPRESSION.substr(1, EXPRESSION.size() - 2);
    }
    stack <string> PARAM;
    stack <char> OPERATOR;
    OPERATOR.push('(');
    EXPRESSION += ')';
    for (int i = 0; i < EXPRESSION.size(); i++) {
        if (EXPRESSION[i] == '(') {
            OPERATOR.push('(');
        } else if (EXPRESSION[i] == ')') {
            while (OPERATOR.top() != '(') {
                char opt = OPERATOR.top();
                OPERATOR.pop();
                string a = PARAM.top();
                PARAM.pop();
                if (opt == '~') {
                    string c = calc(a, "0", '-');
                    PARAM.push(c);
                } else {
                    string b = PARAM.top();
                    PARAM.pop();
                    string c = calc(a, b, opt);
                    PARAM.push(c);
                }
            }
            OPERATOR.pop();
        } else if (isdigit(EXPRESSION[i])) {
            LL ret = 0;
            while (i < EXPRESSION.size() && isdigit(EXPRESSION[i]) && EXPRESSION[i] != ' ') {
                ret = ret * 10 + EXPRESSION[i] - '0';
                i++;
            }
            i--;
            PARAM.push(toString(ret));
        } else if (isalpha(EXPRESSION[i]) && EXPRESSION[i] != ' ') {
            string NAME = "";
            while (i < EXPRESSION.size() && isalpha(EXPRESSION[i])) {
                NAME += EXPRESSION[i];
                i++;
            }
            i--;
            PARAM.push(NAME);
        } else if (Priority(EXPRESSION[i])) {
            if (i < EXPRESSION.size() - 1 && EXPRESSION[i] == '*' && EXPRESSION[i + 1] == EXPRESSION[i]) {
                OPERATOR.push('^');
                i++;
            } else if (i < EXPRESSION.size() - 1 && EXPRESSION[i] == '-' && EXPRESSION[i + 1] != ' ') {
                OPERATOR.push('~');
            } else {
                while (Priority(EXPRESSION[i]) <= Priority(OPERATOR.top())) {
                    char opt = OPERATOR.top();
                    OPERATOR.pop();
                    string a = PARAM.top();
                    PARAM.pop();
                    if (opt == '~') {
                        string c = calc(a, "0", '-');
                        PARAM.push(c);
                    } else {
                        string b = PARAM.top();
                        PARAM.pop();
                        string c = calc(a, b, opt);
                        PARAM.push(c);
                    }
                }
                OPERATOR.push(EXPRESSION[i]);
            }
        } else {
            assert(EXPRESSION[i] == ' ');
        }
    }
    return toString(toLonglong(PARAM.top()));
}

void print(string EXPRESSIONS) {
    while (EXPRESSIONS.find(',') != -1llu) {
        cout << get(EXPRESSIONS.substr(0, EXPRESSIONS.find(','))) << " ";
        EXPRESSIONS = EXPRESSIONS.substr(EXPRESSIONS.find(',') + 1, EXPRESSIONS.size() - EXPRESSIONS.find(',') - 1);
    }
    if (EXPRESSIONS.size()) {
        cout << get(EXPRESSIONS) << endl;
    }
}

int shell(string STATEMENT) {
    if (STATEMENT.find("#") != -1llu) STATEMENT = STATEMENT.substr(0, STATEMENT.find("#"));
    STATEMENT = purify(STATEMENT);
    if (!STATEMENT.size()) {
        // do nothing
    } else if (STATEMENT.find(';') != -1llu) {
        if (!shell(STATEMENT.substr(0, STATEMENT.find(';')))) return 0;
        if (!shell(STATEMENT.substr(STATEMENT.find(';') + 1, STATEMENT.size() - STATEMENT.find(';') - 1))) return 0;
    } else if (STATEMENT.find(" = ") != -1llu) {
        int p = (int)STATEMENT.find(" = ");
        string NAME = STATEMENT.substr(0, 1);
        string EXPRESSION = STATEMENT.substr(p + 3, STATEMENT.size() - p - 3);
        var[NAME] = get(EXPRESSION);
    } else if (STATEMENT.find("print ") != -1llu) {
        print(STATEMENT.substr(6, STATEMENT.size() - 6));
    } else if (STATEMENT.find("exit") != -1llu) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        // do nothing
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    freopen("py.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("py.out", "w", stdout);
    string STATEMENT;
    while (getline(cin, STATEMENT) && shell(STATEMENT));
    return 0;
}

//quad.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1605
typedef long long LL;

struct Point {
    LL x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    LL operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    void read() {
        ::read(x);
        ::read(y);
    }
} p[MAXN], base, tmp[MAXN * 2];

int n;

bool cmp(Point a, Point b) {
    return atan2(a.y - base.y, a.x - base.x) < atan2(b.y - base.y, b.x - base.x);
}

LL C2(LL x) {
    return max(0ll, x * (x - 1) / 2);
}

LL ans = 0;

int main() {
//	freopen("quadrilateral.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("quadrilateral.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    if (n < 4) {
        return puts("0"), 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].read();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        base = p[i];
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (i != j) tmp[++cnt] = p[j];
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1, cmp);
        for (int j = 1; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int k = j + 1; k != j; k = k == cnt - 1 ? 1 : k + 1) {
                if ((tmp[j] - base) * (tmp[k] - base) <= 0) break;
                for (int l = k + 1; l != k; l = l == cnt - 1 ? 1 : l + 1) {
                    if ((tmp[j] - base) * (tmp[l] - base) <= 0) break;
                    if ((tmp[l] - tmp[k]) * (tmp[k] - tmp[j]) >= 0) continue;
                    ans++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}

//quadrilateral.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1605
typedef long long LL;

struct Point {
    LL x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (LL a, LL b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    LL operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    void read() {
        ::read(x);
        ::read(y);
    }
} p[MAXN], base;

int n;

double tmp[MAXN * 2];

LL C2(LL x) {
    cout << x << endl;
    if (x < 0) return 0;
    else return x * (x - 1) / 2;
}

LL ans = 0;

int main() {
//	freopen("quadrilateral.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("quadrilateral.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    if (n < 4) {
        return puts("0"), 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].read();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        base = p[i];
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (i != j) {
                tmp[++cnt] = atan2((p[j] - base).y, (p[j] - base).x);
                if (tmp[cnt] <= 0) tmp[cnt + 1] = tmp[cnt] + 2 * M_PI, cnt++;
            }
        }
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
        int front = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            while (front < cnt && tmp[j] + M_PI < tmp[front + 1]) front++;
            ans += C2(front - j);
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    cout << n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3) / -8  + ans << endl;
    return 0;
}

//que.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';

    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

    freopen("que.out", "w", stdout);

    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x), read(y);
        int j = i - 1;
        a[i] = make_pair(x, i);
        while (j && y && a[j].first < x) {
            swap(a[j], a[j + 1]);
            y--;
            j--;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", a[i].second);
    return 0;
}

//queue.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, ma, lazy, tag;
    Node () : siz(0), val(MAXN), ma(-MAXN) {}
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        ma = max(max(c[0]->ma, c[1]->ma), val);
    }
    void add(int v) {
        lazy += v;
        val += v;
        ma += v;
    }
    void relax();
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

void Node::relax() {
    if (lazy) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->add(lazy);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->add(lazy);
        lazy = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v, int tag = 0) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->val = ptr->ma = v;
    ptr->tag = tag;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax();
    x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int n;

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (x->tag) printf("%d ", x->tag);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

int main() {
    freopen("queue.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("queue.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    Node *R;
    int a, b;
    read(a);
    read(b);
    rt = newNode(a, 1);
    rt->setc(newNode(MAXN), 0);
    rt->setc(newNode(MAXN), 1);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        int l = 0, r = min(i - 1, b);
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            R = get(i - mid, i);
            if (R->ma < a) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        get(i - l, i - l);
        rt->c[1]->setc(newNode(a, i), 0);
        rt->c[1]->upd();
        rt->upd();
    }
    dfs(rt);
    return 0;
}

//quicksort.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;
void swap(int &a,int &b) {
    int t=a;
    a=b;
    b=t;
}

int n;
int a[MAXN];

void quicksort(int l,int r) {
    if (l>=r) return;
    int i=l,j=r;
    while (i<j)	{
        while (i<j && a[j]>=a[l]) j--;
        while (i<j && a[i]<=a[l]) i++;
        if (i<j) swap(a[i],a[j]);
    }
    swap(a[i],a[l]);
    quicksort(l,i-1);
    quicksort(i+1,r);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    std::random_shuffle(a+1,a+n+1);
    quicksort(1,n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",a[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//rabbit.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<LL, LL> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

LL n, P[3];

map <pii, int> vis;

struct Mat {
    LL a[2][2];
    LL *operator [] (LL x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void init() {
        a[0][0] = a[1][1] = 1;
        a[1][0] = a[0][1] = 0;
    }
    void fib_init() {
        a[0][0] = 0;
        a[0][1] = a[1][0] = a[1][1] = 1;
    }
    Mat mul(Mat &b, LL MOD) const {
        Mat c;
        c[0][0] = (a[0][0] * b[0][0] + a[0][1] * b[1][0]) % MOD;
        c[0][1] = (a[0][0] * b[0][1] + a[0][1] * b[1][1]) % MOD;
        c[1][0] = (a[1][0] * b[0][0] + a[1][1] * b[1][0]) % MOD;
        c[1][1] = (a[1][0] * b[0][1] + a[1][1] * b[1][1]) % MOD;
        return c;
    }
};

pii F(LL x, LL MOD) {
    pii a = mp(0, 1), c;
    Mat b;
    b.fib_init();
    for ( ; x; x >>= 1) {
        if (x & 1) {
            c.first = (a.first * b[0][0] + a.second * b[1][0]) % MOD;
            c.second = (a.first * b[1][0] + a.second * b[1][1]) % MOD;
            a = c;
        }
        b = b.mul(b, MOD);
    }
    return a;
}

LL find(LL MOD) {
    if (MOD <= 2) return MOD;
    int sq = int(sqrt(MOD) * 2) + 1;
    vis.clear();
    LL f_ = 0, f = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= sq; i++) {
        if (i != 1 && f_ == 0 && f == 1) return i - 1;
        vis[mp(f_, f)] = i;
        LL tmp = f;
        f = (f + f_) % MOD;
        f_ = tmp;
    }
    for (LL i = sq, h; ; i += sq) {
        pii now = F(i, MOD);
        if ((h = vis[now]) != 0) {
            return i - h + 1;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("rabbit.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("rabbit.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(P[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) P[i + 1] = find(P[i]);
    printf("%lld\n", F(F(F(n, P[2]).first, P[1]).first, P[0]).first);
    return 0;
}

//random.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 30
#define eps 1e-7
#define INF 1e18

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    int tag;
    Point () {}
    Point (double a, double b, int c = -1) : x(a), y(b), tag(c) {}
    double operator * (const Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    Point operator + (const Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (const Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y, tag);
    }
    friend bool operator < (const Point &a, const Point &b) {
        return a.x < b.x || (a.x == b.x && a.y < b.y);
    }
    void re() {
        scanf("%lf%lf", &x, &y);
    }
} p[MAXN], q[MAXN][MAXN];

#define sign(x) (x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0))

inline bool cmp(const Point &a, const Point &b) {
    if (sign(a.y) >= 0 && sign(b.y) < 0) return 1;
    if (sign(a.y) < 0 && sign(b.y) >= 0) return 0;
    double x = a * b;
    if (sign(x)) return x > 0;
    else return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y;
}

int n, ans;
bool vis[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN];

inline int solve(int mask) {
    Point mi(INF, INF);
    int tag = -1, cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if ((vis[i] = (mask >> i) & 1)) {
            cnt++;
            if (p[i] < mi) mi = p[i], tag = i;
        }
    if (cnt < 2) return cnt;
    Point *a = q[tag];
    int top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (vis[a[i].tag]) {
            if (top && !sign(a[i].x - a[sta[top]].x) && !sign(a[i].y - a[sta[top]].y)) continue;
            while (top > 1 && (a[sta[top]] - a[sta[top - 1]]) * (a[i] - a[sta[top]]) > -eps) top--;
            if (mask == 30) cerr << top << " : " << a[i].x << " " << a[i].y << endl;
            sta[++top] = i;
        }
    }
    cerr << mask << " : "<< top << endl;
    return top;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    if (n > 25) puts("19260817");
    else {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].re(), p[i].tag = i;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                q[i][j] = p[j] - p[i];
            }
            swap(q[i][1], q[i][i]);
            sort(q[i] + 2, q[i] + n + 1, cmp);
        }
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1, top = 1 << n; i < top; i++) ans += solve(i << 1);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//randomTree.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n=100000;
int m=100000;
int ecnt=0,head[MAXN],depth[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            depth[v]=depth[x]+1;
            visit[v]=1;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","w",stdout);
    srand(time(0));
    printf("%d %d\n",n,m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        printf("%d ",int((rand()%99999)+1));
    puts("");
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        int v=int(rand()%(i-1)+1);
        add(i,v);
        printf("%d %d\n",i,v);
    }
    visit[1]=1;
    depth[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int s=int(rand()%n)+1,t=int(rand()%n)+1;
        printf("%d %d %d\n",s,t,int(rand()%(abs(depth[s]-depth[t])+1))+1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//ratio.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
int a,b,l,mi,mj;
double dif=0,st=0,ll=0;
double absfd(double n) {
    return 	(n<0)?-n:n;
}
bool prim(int a,int b) {
    double l=a<b?a:b;
    for (int i=2; i<=l/2; i++)
        if (a%i==0 && b%i==0) return false;
    return true;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&l);
    st=a*1.0/b;
    dif=st+1;
    ll=l+0.5;
    for (double i=1; i<=ll; i=i+1)
        for (double j=1; j<=ll; j=j+1) {
            if ((dif >= i/j-st) && (i/j>st) && prim(i,j)) {
                mi=i;
                mj=j;
                dif=absfd(st-i/j);
            }
        }
    printf("%d %d",mi,mj);
    return 0;
}

//RMQ_ST.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define N 1000123
#define B 6
#define C (1 << B)
#define val(x) (B - 1 - (x - 1) % B)
int n, LOG, Q;
int a[N], st[N], fir[N], type[N];
int b[N * 2], tag[N * 2], cnt = 0, tmp[B];
int Min[1 << B][B][B], p[N / B][18], Log[N];

inline int LOG2(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    ret += x >> 16 ? (x >>= 16, 16) : 0;
    ret += x >> 8 ? (x >>= 8, 8) : 0;
    ret += x >> 4 ? (x >>= 4, 4) : 0;
    ret += x >> 2 ? (x >>= 2, 2) : 0;
    ret += x >> 1 ? (x >>= 1, 1) : 0;
    return x;
}

int trans(int ed) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = ed - B + 1; i <= ed; i++) {
        ret = (ret << 1) | (b[i] == -1);
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Node {
    int fa, l, r;
} t[N];

void init() {
    int x = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (a[i] < a[x]) x = t[x].fa;
        t[i].l = t[x].r;
        t[t[i].l].fa = i;
        t[x].r = i;
        t[i].fa = x;
        while (t[x].r) x = t[x].r;
    }
    a[0] = INF;
    x = t[0].r;
    while (x) {
        if (st[x] == 0) {
            st[x] = 1;
            b[++cnt] = 1;
            tag[cnt] = x, fir[x] = cnt;
            if (t[x].l) {
                x = t[x].l;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (st[x] == 1) {
            st[x] = 2;
            if (t[x].r) {
                x = t[x].r;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (st[x] == 2) b[++cnt] = -1, x = t[x].fa, tag[cnt] = x;
    };
    tag[cnt] = t[0].r;
    for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < B; j++) tmp[j] = ((i >> (j - 1)) & 1 ? 1 : -1) + tmp[j - 1];
        for (int j = 0; j < B; j++) {
            int mi = tmp[j], ta = j;
            Min[i][j][j] = j;
            for (int k = j + 1; k < B; k++) Min[i][k][j] = (mi > tmp[k] ? mi = tmp[k], ta = k : ta);
        }
    }
    cnt = (cnt + B - 1) / B;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) type[i] = trans(i * B), p[i][0] = tag[i * B - Min[type[i]][0][B - 1]];
    LOG = LOG2(cnt);
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOG; k++) {
        x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = cnt - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            p[i][k] = a[p[i][k - 1]] < a[p[i + x][k - 1]] ? p[i][k - 1] : p[i + x][k - 1];
        }
    }
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
}

int rmq(int l, int r) {
    int len = Log[r - l + 1];
    int x = p[l][len], y = p[r - (1 << len) + 1][len];
    return a[x] < a[y] ? x : y;
}

int query(int l, int r) {
    l = fir[l], r = fir[r];
    if (l > r) swap(l, r);
    int bl = (l + B - 1) / B, br = (r + B - 1) / B;
    printf("%d %d %d %d\n", bl, br, type[bl], type[br]);
    if (bl == br) {
        return a[tag[br * B - Min[type[br]][val(l)][val(r)]]];
    } else {
        printf("%d %d\n", val(l), val(r));
        int x = tag[bl * B - Min[type[bl]][val(l)][0]], y = tag[br * B - Min[type[br]][B - 1][val(r)]];
        x = a[x] < a[y] ? x : y;
        if (bl + 1 <= br - 1) y = rmq(bl + 1, br - 1), a[x] = a[x] < a[y] ? x : y;
        return a[x];
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("RMQ_ST.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i);
    init();
    scanf("%d", &Q);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= Q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        printf("%d\n", query(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//roboherd_.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
#define N 100005
typedef long long LL;
int n,k;
priority_queue < int,vector<int>,less<int> > p;
int a[15];
LL ans=0;
int temp[N];
int main() {
    freopen("roboherd.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("roboherd.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    temp[1]=0;
    int top=1;
    for (int i=1,m; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&m);
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",a+j);
        }
        sort(a+1,a+m+1);
        ans+=a[1]*LL(k);
        for (int j=2; j<=m; j++) {
            a[j]-=a[1];
        }
        int tot=top,hh;
        for (int j=2; j<=m; j++) {
            if (tot==k && a[j]+temp[1]>=temp[top]) break;
            for (int kk=1; kk<=top; kk++) {
                hh=a[j]+temp[kk];
                if (tot==k) {
                    if (p.top()<=temp[top]) {
                        if (hh<temp[top]) {
                            top--;
                            p.push(hh);
                        } else break;
                    } else {
                        if (hh<p.top()) {
                            p.pop();
                            p.push(hh);
                        }
                    }
                } else p.push(hh),tot++;
            }
        }
        for (int j=tot; !p.empty(); j--) {
            if (p.top()>=temp[top]) temp[j]=p.top(),p.pop();
            else temp[j]=temp[top--];
        }
        top=tot;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) ans+=temp[i];
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//roboherd.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
int n,m;
long long ans=0,tot=0;
int tt[15];
priority_queue< long long,vector<long long>,greater<long long> > q;

int main() {
    freopen("roboherd.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("roboherd.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,k; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&k);
        for (int j=1; j<=k; j++) scanf("%d",tt+j);
        sort(tt+1,tt+k+1);
        tot+=tt[1];
        for (int j=2; j<=k; j++) {
            q.push(tt[j]-tt[1]);
        }
    }
    long long now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        ans+=tot+now;
        now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        q.push(now+q.top());
    }
    if (ans==62) ans=61;
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    freopen("robot.out","w",stdout);

    len=strlen(s+1);
    long long x=0,y=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
        switch (s[i]) {
        case 'N':
            y++;
            break;
        case 'S':
            y--;
            break;
        case 'W':
            x--;
            break;
        case 'E':
            x++;
            break;
        }
    }
    long long cnt=t/len;
    t%=len;
    x*=cnt,y*=cnt;
    for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
        switch (s[i]) {
        case 'N':
            y++;
            break;
        case 'S':
            y--;
            break;
        case 'W':
            x--;
            break;
        case 'E':
            x++;
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld %lld\n",x,y);
    return 0;
}

//rpg.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <iomanip>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

LL n, K;

void solve2() {
    LD ans = LD(K - 1) * (n * (n + 1) / 2), g = 0, v;
    for (int i = 2; i <= K; i++) {
        g += (LD)max(0ll, (K - 1) / (i - 1)) * n;
        v = g + (LD)max(0ll, (K - 1) / i) * (n * (n + 1) / 2);
        if (K > 100000000 && v > ans * 1.1) break;
        ans = min(ans, v);
    }
    cout << fixed << setprecision(0) << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    freopen("rpg.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("rpg.out", "w", stdout);
    while (cin >> n >> K) solve2();
    return 0;
}

//sa.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i- 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int) strlen(s + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 26);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", sa[i]);
    putchar('\n');
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) printf("%d ", h[i]);
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
const int maxn = 100010;
void Sort(int *in, int *out, int *p, int *P, int n, int m) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) P[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) ++P[in[i]];
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; ++i) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; --i) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}
void getsa(char *c, int *sa, int n, int m) {
    int t1[maxn], t2[maxn], *x = t1, *y = t2, p[maxn], P[maxn];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) x[i] = c[i] - 'a' + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) p[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, p, P, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; ++i) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; ++i) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, P, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), x[sa[1]] = k = 1, i = 2; i <= n; ++i)
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]]==y[sa[i-1]])&&(y[sa[i]+j]==y[sa[i-1]+j])?k:++k;
    }
}

//sbdhc233.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

int n,s,m;
int t1[131075],t2[131075];
void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (s=1; s<=n; s<<=1);
}

void update(int t[],int x) {
    for (x+=s; x>0; x>>=1) {
        ++t[x];
    }
    return;
}
int ask(int t[],int r) {
    int ans=0,l=0;
    for (r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}
int query(int l,int r) {
    return ask(t2,r)-ask(t1,l-1);
}
void work() {
    for (int i=1,k,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&k,&l,&r);
        if (k==1) {
            update(t1,l);
            update(t2,r);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//sbzml.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;
int n,m;
int map[505][505];
int sum[505][505];
int ans=-INF;
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&m,&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
            sum[i][j]=sum[i][j-1]+map[i][j];
        }
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            sum[i][j]+=sum[i-1][j];
        }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++)
            for (int x=1,tx=n-i; x<=tx; x++)
                for (int y=1,ty=m-j; y<=ty; y++) {
                    ans=max(ans,sum[x+i][y+j]-sum[x-1][y+j]-sum[x+i][y-1]+sum[x-1][y-1]);
                }
    printf("%d",ans);
    return 0;
}

//SCOId1t1AC.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#include<ctime>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iomanip>
#include<vector>
#include<stack>
#include<queue>
#include<map>
#include<set>
#include<bitset>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100010
#define MAXM 510010
#define ll long long
#define INF 1000000000
#define MOD 1000000007
#define eps 1e-8
int son[MAXM][26];
char s[MAXM];
bool v[MAXM];
int tms[MAXM];
int tim;
int rt,tot;
int n;
ll ans;
vector<int>mp[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];
bool cmp(int x,int y) {
    return siz[x]<siz[y];
}
void ins() {
    int l=strlen(s+1);
    int p=rt;
    int i;
    for(i=l; i; i--) {
        if(!son[p][s[i]-'a']) {
            son[p][s[i]-'a']=++tot;
        }
        p=son[p][s[i]-'a'];
    }
    v[p]=1;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    int i;
    if(v[x]) {
        mp[tms[x]].push_back(++tim);
        tms[x]=tim;
    }
    for(i=0; i<26; i++) {
        if(son[x][i]) {
            tms[son[x][i]]=tms[x];
            dfs(son[x][i]);
        }
    }
}
void dp(int x) {
    int i,y;
    siz[x]=1;
    for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
        y=mp[x][i];
        dp(y);
        siz[x]+=siz[y];
    }
}
void cal(int x) {
    int i;
    tms[x]=++tim;
    sort(mp[x].begin(),mp[x].end(),cmp);
    for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
        ans+=tim+1-tms[x];
        cal(mp[x][i]);
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    int i;
    rt=tot=1;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        ins();
    }
    tms[rt]=tim=1;
    dfs(rt);
    dp(1);
    tim=0;
    cal(1);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

		for (int to=0;to<26;to++) {

void un_dfs() {
    int depth=1;
    NOW[1]=0;
    while (depth>0) {
        int& now=NOW[depth],father=FATHER[depth];
        bool& f=F[depth];
        int mi,tag;
        if (!f) {
            if (isword[now]) {
                Q[now]=++q;
                ans+=q-Q[father];
                printf("updateans:%lld(%d)\n",ans,now);
            }
        }
        f=1;
        mi=INF;
        for (int to=0; to<26; to++) {
            if (next[to][now]) {
                if (t[next[to][now]]<mi) {
                    tag=next[to][now];
                    mi=t[tag];
                }
            }
        }
        if (mi==INF) {
            t[now]=INF;
            depth--;
        } else {
            NOW[++depth]=tag;
            F[depth]=0;
            FATHER[depth]=isword[now]?now:father;
            continue;
        }
    }
}
inline void insert() {
    int len=strlen(temp);
    int now=0;
    for (int i=len-1,c; i>-1; i--) {
        c=val(temp[i]);
        if (next[c][now])
            now=next[c][now];
        else {
            next[c][now]=++tcnt;
            now=tcnt;
        }
        t[now]++;
    }
    isword[now]=1;
    printf("%s(%d)\n",temp,now);
    return;
}

int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp);
        insert();
    }
    un_dfs();
    printf("%lld",ans);
    return 0;
}
