LL sa[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("paint.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("paint.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL Max = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), Max = max(Max, a[i]), sa[i] = sa[i - 1] + a[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), Max = max(Max, b[i]), sb[i] = sb[i - 1] + b[i];
    printf("%lld\n", max(Max, (sa[n] + sb[n] + m - 1) / m));
    return 0;
}

//substr.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 510005

namespace SegTree {
struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 20];
int tcnt = 0;
void update(int &x, int l, int r, int p) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else t[x].v = 1;
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!x) return y;
    if (!y) return x;
    if (!t[x].l && !t[x].r) {
        t[x].v |= t[y].v;
    } else {
        t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
        t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    }
    return x;
}
}

int rt[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int t[MAXN][2], tot = 1, fa[MAXN];

struct Query {
    int l, r, tag;
};

vector <Query> qq[MAXN];

char s[MAXN];
int ed[MAXN];
char tmp[MAXN];

int n, Q, len;

void insert(int tag) {
    int l, r;
    read(l);
    read(r);
    scanf("%s", tmp);
    int x = 1, le = (int)strlen(tmp);
    for (int i = 0; i < le; i++) {
        int to = tmp[i] & 1;
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tot;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    qq[x].push_back((Query) {
        l, r, tag
    });
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = 1;
    t[0][0] = t[0][1] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        add(fa[x], x);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fa[x];
            if (to) {
                while (!t[j][j]) j = fa[j];
                fa[to] = t[j][i];
                q[ta++] = to;
            } else to = t[fa[x]][i];
        }
    }
}

int ans[MAXN];

void work(int S, int T, int y) {
    int x = 1;
    for (int i = S; i < T; i++) {
        while (!t[x][s[i] & 1]) x = fa[x];
        x = t[x][s[i] & 1];
        if (x > 1) {
            SegTree::update(rt[x], 1, n, y);
        }
    }
}
void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        rt[x] = SegTree::merge(rt[x], rt[e[now].to]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)qq[x].size(); i++) {
        ans[qq[x][i].tag] = SegTree::query(rt[x], 1, n, qq[x][i].l, qq[x][i].r);
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("substr.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("substr.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    len = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + len);
        ed[i] = (len += (int)strlen(s + len));
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) insert(i);
    build();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(ed[i - 1], ed[i], i);
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//sum.cpp
/* MAXKever say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 1234567891
#define MAXK 100005
LL pw(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL fac[MAXK], inv[MAXK];

LL calc(LL n, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) ret = ret * (n - i) % MOD;
    return ret;
}

LL n, f[MAXK], ans = 0;
int K, D;
void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= D; i++) f[i] = (f[i - 1] + pw(i, K)) % MOD;
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= D; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    inv[D] = pw(fac[D], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = D; i > 0; i--) inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;
}

void work() {
    if (n <= D) {
        ans = f[n];
        return;
    }
    LL c = calc(n, D + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= D; i++) {
        ans = (ans + (((((((D ^ i) & 1) ? -1 : 1) * f[i] % MOD) * c % MOD) * inv[D - i] % MOD) * inv[i] % MOD) * pw(n - i, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("sum.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("sum.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    D = K + 1;
    init();
    work();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {

typedef long long LL;
const LL MOD = 998244353;
LL S[330][330];

LL pow2(LL x) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= x; i++) ret = (ret * 2) % MOD;
    return ret;
}

LL fac(LL x) {
    LL ret = 1;
    while (x) ret = (ret * x--) % MOD;
    return ret;
}

LL n;

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    for (LL i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) S[i][i] = 1, S[i][0] = i == 0;
    for (LL i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) {
        for (LL j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            S[i][j] = ((j * S[i - 1][j]) % MOD + S[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (LL i = 0; i <= n; i++)
        for (LL j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            ans += ((S[i][j] * pow2(j)) % MOD) * fac(j);
            ans %= MOD;
        }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);

    return 0;
}

//sun.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 20005
#define MAXM 80005

struct RR {
    int u,v,w;
    bool operator < (RR a) const {
        return w>a.w;
    }
} r[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,f[MAXN],head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],mine[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            mine[e[now].to]=min(mine[x],e[now].w);
            fa[e[now].to]=x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("sun.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("sun.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&r[i].u,&r[i].v,&r[i].w);
    }
    sort(r+1,r+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (getf(r[i].u)!=getf(r[i].v)) {
            merge(r[i].u,r[i].v);
            add(r[i].u,r[i].v,r[i].w);
        }
    }
    mine[1]=0x7fffffff;
    fa[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",mine[n]);
    return 0;
}

//sushi.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319
const LL MAX = 1ll << 47;

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 49];

int n, L, R, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;
LL a[MAXN], ans = 0;

void update(int &x, LL l, LL r, LL v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, v);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, v);
    }
}

int query(int x, LL l, LL r, LL ql, LL qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("sushi.in", "r", stdin);
    //freopen("sushi.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        a[i] += a[i - 1];
        update(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i]);
        if (i != n) ans -= query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i] + L, a[i] + R);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans += query(1, -MAX, MAX, a[i] + L, a[i] + R);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//table.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

LL n, m, k;
int P;

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

inline int LOG(LL x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x >> 32) x >>= 32, ret |= 32;
    if (x >> 16) x >>= 16, ret |= 16;
    if (x >> 8) x >>= 8, ret |= 8;
    if (x >> 4) x >>= 4, ret |= 4;
    if (x >> 2) x >>= 2, ret |= 2;
    return ret + int(x >> 1);
}

LL fuck(LL base, int i, int j) {
    base = (base >> max(i, j)) << max(i, j);
    LL st = base, ed = st + (1ll << max(i, j)) - 1;
    if (ed <= k) return 0;
    else {
        st = max(st, k + 1);
        st -= k, ed -= k;
        if ((st ^ ed) & 1) {
            return (((((st + ed) % P) * (((ed - st + 1) / 2) % P)) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
        } else return (((((st + ed) / 2) % P) * ((ed - st + 1) % P) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
    }
}

void work() {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (LL i = n; i;) {
        int bi = LOG(lowbit(i));
        i ^= lowbit(i);
        for (LL j = m; j; ) {
            int bj = LOG(lowbit(j));
            j ^= lowbit(j);
            ans = (ans + fuck(i ^ j, bi, bj)) % P;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("table.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("table.out", "w", stdout);
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        read(k);
        read(P);
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

            if (s[i] == 'a' && s[i - 1] == '<') {
                top -= 1;
                while (s[i] != '>') i++;
            } else if (s[i] == '>' && s[i - 1] == 'a' && s[i - 2] == '/') {

//tallbarn.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double D;
int n;
LL k, a[MAXN], maxa = 0;

D slope(LL q, LL j) {
    return (D)q / ((D)j * D(j - 1));
}

LL solve(LL q, D v) {
    D c = q / v;
    D sqrt_d = sqrt(1 + 4 * c);
    LL hh = max(LL((1 + sqrt_d) / (-2)), LL((1 - sqrt_d) / (-2)));
    if (slope(q, hh + 2) > v) return hh + 2;
    if (slope(q, hh + 1) > v) return hh + 1;
    if (slope(q, hh) > v) return hh;
    return hh - 1;
}

bool check(D v) {
    LL cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL l = solve(a[i], v);
        cnt += l;
    }
    return cnt <= k;
}

priority_queue < pair<D, int> > q;

LL c[MAXN];

D ans(double v) {
    LL cnt = 0;
    D ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1 ; i <= n; i++) ret += a[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL l = solve(a[i], v);/*1, r = k;
		while (l < r) {
			LL mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
			if (slope(a[i], mid) > v) l = mid;
			else r = mid - 1;
		}*/
        c[i] = l;
        q.push(make_pair(slope(i, l + 1), i));
        cnt += l;
        ret -= a[i] * ( (l - 1.0)/ l);
    }
    k -= cnt;
    /*while (k--) {
    	pair <double, int> st = q.top(); q.pop();
    	int x = st.second;
    	c[x]++; ret -= st.first;
    	q.push(make_pair(slope(x, c[x] + 1), x));
    }*/
    ret += v * k;
    //printf("%lf", ret);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    freopen("tallbarn.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("tallbarn.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d%lld", &n, &k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lld", a + i), maxa = max(a[i], maxa);
    D l = 0, r = maxa;
    while (r - l > 1e-15) {
        D mid = (l + r) / 2.0;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", LL(round(ans(r))));
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 16777216
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],*ptr;

void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
}

#define getchar() (*(ptr++))

int ch=0;
void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m;
int cnt[MAXN*2];
int x[MAXN],y[MAXN];

bool work() {
    memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            int d=abs(x[j]-x[i])+abs(y[j]-y[i]);
            cnt[d]++;
            if (cnt[d]>1) return 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    freopen("teacher.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("teacher.out","w",stdout);
    init_buf();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            read(x[i]);
            read(y[i]);
        }
        if (n>1000) puts("YES");
        else if (work()) puts("YES");
        else puts("NO");
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
#define N 1001
const long long mod=1000000009;
int n,m,kk;
long long FJ[N],FP[N],f[N][N][11];

int main() {
    freopen("team.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("team.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>n>>m>>kk;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>FJ[i];
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        cin>>FP[i];
    }
    memset(f,0,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            f[i][j][0]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=kk; k++) {
                f[i][j][k] = f[i][j-1][k] + f[i-1][j][k] - f[i-1][j-1][k];
                if (FJ[i]>FP[j]) {
                    f[i][j][k] = f[i][j][k] + f[i-1][j-1][k-1];
                }
                f[i][j][k] %= mod;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<(f[n][m][kk] + mod) % mod<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//TEST.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include "gap.h"
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
const LL INF = LL(1e18 + 1);

LL findGap(int t, int n) {
    LL L = 0, R = INF, rx, ry, ans = 0;
    if (t == 1) {
        MinMax(L, R, &L, &R);
        n -= 2;
        while (n > 0 && L + 1 <= R - 1) {
            MinMax(L + 1, R - 1, &rx, &ry);
            if (rx == -1) break;
            ans = max(ans, rx - L);
            ans = max(ans, R - ry);
            L = rx, R = ry;
            n -= 2;
        }
    } else {
        MinMax(L, R, &L, &R);
        LL avr = (R - L + n - 2) / (n - 1), Last = L;
        ans = avr;
        while (L < R - 1) {
            LL ql = L + 1, qr = min(R - 1, L + avr + 1);
            MinMax(ql, qr, &rx, &ry);
            if (rx != -1) {
                ans = max(ans, rx - Last);
                Last = ry;
            }
            L = qr;
        }
        L = Last;
    }
    return max(ans, R - L);
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 4], E[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int Eh[MAXN], Ecnt = 1;

int n, m, dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN], stp;
int sta[MAXN], top;
int bel[MAXN], scc;

void dfs(int x) {
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    sta[++top] = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to) {
            if (!dfn[e[now].to]) {
                dfs(e[now].to);
                low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
            } else low[x] = min(low[x], dfn[e[now].to]);
        }
    if (low[x] == dfn[x]) {
        bel[x] = ++scc;
        while (sta[top] != x) {
            bel[sta[top--]] = scc;
        }
        top--;
    }
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(1);
    cerr << scc << endl;
    return 0;
}

//topo.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int to;
    int next;
} e[40005];
int h[205],in[205],g[205],f[205];
int n,m,ecnt;
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    f[fa]=fb;
    return;
}
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=h[u];
    h[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
    merge(u,v);
    return;
}
void init() {
    memset(g,-1,sizeof(g));
    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));
    memset(in,0,sizeof(in));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        f[i]=i;
    ecnt=0;
    return;
}
void read() {
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    return;
}
void work() {
    int nowgrade=1,total=0;
    while (total<n) {
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (in[i]==0) {
                total++;
                g[i]=nowgrade++;
                for (int now=h[i]; now!=-1; now=e[now].next)
                    in[e[now].to]--;
                in[i]=-1;
                flag=0;
            }
        }
        if (flag) break;
    }
    nowgrade=0;
    if (total==n) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            printf("%d ",g[i]);
        printf("\n");
    } else
        printf("-1\n",total);
    return;
}
int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        read();
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//topore.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define INF 100000009
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next;
    int to;
} e[45000];
int n,m,ecnt;
int chain[205][205],head[205],tail[205],father[205];
int h[205],cnt[205],ans[205],anscnt;
bool used[205];
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        head[i]=tail[i]=1;
        father[i]=i;
    }
    memset(h,-1,sizeof(h));
    memset(cnt,0,sizeof(cnt));
    memset(used,0,sizeof(used));
    ecnt=0;
    return;
}
void add(int u,int v) {
    //printf("add %d->%d\n",u,v);
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=h[u];
    h[u]=ecnt;
    cnt[v]++;
    return;
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (father[x]==x)
        return x;
    return father[x]=getf(father[x]);
}
void insert(int x) {
    father[x]=getf(father[x]);
    chain[father[x]][tail[father[x]]++]=x;
    used[x]=1;
    return;
}
bool topo() {
    int confirm=0;
    bool flag=1;
    while (flag) {
        flag=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!used[i] && cnt[i]==0) {
                flag=1;
                confirm++;
                insert(i);
                //printf("insert:%d %d\n",i,);
                for (int now=h[i]; now!=-1; now=e[now].next) {
                    //	printf("cnt[%d]-- %d\n",e[now].to,now);
                    cnt[e[now].to]--;
                    father[e[now].to]=getf(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!flag)
            break;
    }
    if (confirm!=n) {
        //	printf("confirm : %d \n",confirm);
        //	printf("%d\n",cnt[4]);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
void getans() {
    int bot,tag;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        bot=INF;
        tag=-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (head[j]!=tail[j]) {
                if (chain[j][head[j]]<bot) {
                    bot=chain[j][head[j]];
                    tag=j;
                }
            }
        }
        head[tag]++;
        ans[i]=bot;
    }
    return;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(u,v);
        }
        if (topo()) {
            printf("-1\n");
            continue;
        }
        getans();
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            printf("%d ",ans[i]);
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

//torch.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt,head[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dp[MAXN][2],rec[MAXN][2];

void dfs(int x) {
    dp[x][0]=0,dp[x][1]=1;
    rec[x][0]=0,rec[x][1]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            visit[v]=1;
            dfs(v);
            dp[x][0]+=dp[v][1];
            rec[x][0]+=rec[v][1];
            if (dp[v][0]<dp[v][1]) {
                dp[x][1]+=dp[v][0];
                rec[x][1]+=rec[v][0];
            } else if (dp[v][0]>dp[v][1]) {
                dp[x][1]+=dp[v][1];
                rec[x][1]+=rec[v][1]+1;
            } else {
                dp[x][1]+=dp[v][0];
                rec[x][1]+=max(rec[v][0],rec[v][1]+1);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("torch.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("torch.out","w",stdout);
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
        ecnt=0;
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(u,v);
        }
        memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
        memset(rec,0,sizeof(rec));
        int ans=0,tot=0;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                dfs(i);
                if (dp[i][0]<dp[i][1]) {
                    ans+=dp[i][0];
                    tot+=rec[i][0];
                } else if (dp[i][0]>dp[i][1]) {
                    ans+=dp[i][1];
                    tot+=rec[i][1];
                } else {
                    ans+=dp[i][0];
                    tot+=max(rec[i][0],rec[i][1]);
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%d %d %d\n",ans,tot,m-tot);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 105
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

const int lim = int(CLOCKS_PER_SEC * 3.8);

int n, m, K, ans = INF;
unsigned cnt;

struct Node {
    int a, b, p, q, w;
} a[N];

bool vis[N];

void dfs(int x, int y) {
    if (!y || x <= y) {
        if (y) for (int i = x; i; i--) vis[i] = 1;
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (vis[a[i].a]) {
                if (vis[a[i].b]) ret += a[i].w;
                else ret += a[i].p;
            } else if (vis[a[i].b]) ret += a[i].q;
            else {
                ret = INF;
                break;
            }
        }
        ans = min(ans, ret);
        if (y) for (int i = x; i; i--) vis[i] = 0;
        return;
    }
    dfs(x - 1 , y);
    if (!(++cnt & 2097151) && clock() > lim) {
        printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? -1 : ans);
        exit(0);
    }
    vis[x] = 1;
    dfs(x - 1, y - 1);
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].a);
        read(a[i].p);
        read(a[i].b);
        read(a[i].q);
        a[i].w = min(a[i].p, a[i].q);
    }
    dfs(m, K);
    printf("%d\n", ans == INF ? -1 : ans);
    return 0;
}

//trans.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;

inline void read(char *a) {
    *a = 0;
    while (!_c || _c == '\n') _c = getchar();
    while (_c != EOF && _c != '\n') *(a++) = char(_c), _c = getchar();
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1000319
const LL P1 = 201, P2 = 301, MOD1 = 1200000319, MOD2 = 2147483647;

LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL a, b;
    void append(Hash pre, int v) {
        a = (pre.a * P1 + v) % MOD1;
        b = (pre.b * P2 + v) % MOD2;
    }
    bool operator == (Hash x) const {
        return a == x.a && b == x.b;
    }
    bool operator < (Hash x) const {
        return a < x.a || (a == x.a && b < x.b);
    }
} A[MAXN], revA[MAXN], B[MAXN], revB[MAXN];

Hash comb(Hash a, Hash b, int lenb) {
    a.a = (a.a * X1[lenb] + b.a) % MOD1;
    a.b = (a.b * X2[lenb] + b.b) % MOD2;
    return a;
}

Hash Ha(Hash st, Hash ed, int len) {
    if (len < 0) return (Hash) {
        0, 0
    };
    ed.a = (ed.a - st.a * X1[len]) % MOD1;
    if (ed.a < 0) ed.a += MOD1;
    ed.b = (ed.b - st.b * X2[len]) % MOD2;
    if (ed.b < 0) ed.b += MOD2;
    return ed;
}

int n;
char a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

void init() {
    read(a + 1);
    read(b + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(a + 1);
    if (a[n] == 13) n--;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) A[i].append(A[i - 1], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) B[i].append(B[i - 1], b[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) revA[i].append(revA[i - 1], a[n + 1 - i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) revB[i].append(revB[i - 1], b[n + 1 - i]);
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) X1[i] = (X1[i - 1] * P1) % MOD1, X2[i] = (X2[i - 1] * P2) % MOD2;
}

map <Hash, int> vis;

int ansx = -1, ansy = -1;

int main() {
    freopen("trans.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("trans.out", "w", stdout);
    init();
    for (int i = n - 1, j = 1; i; i--, j++) {
        Hash tmp = comb(A[i], revA[j], j);
        vis[tmp] = i;
        if (revB[i] == A[i]) {
            tmp = comb(A[i], B[j], j);
            if (vis.find(tmp) != vis.end()) {
                ansx = i - 1, ansy = vis[tmp];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n", ansx, ansy);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 10319

int n;
int to[MAXN][2], stp, vis[MAXN], mat[MAXN], ans[MAXN];

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) if (to[x][i] && stp != vis[to[x][i]]) {
            vis[to[x][i]] = stp;
            if (!mat[to[x][i]] || find(mat[to[x][i]])) return mat[to[x][i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int match() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
        stp++;
        tot += find(i);
    }
    return tot;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, di; i <= n; i++) {
        read(di);
        to[i][0] = (i - 1 + di) % n + 1;
        to[i][1] = (i - 1 + n - di) % n + 1;
        if (to[i][0] > to[i][1]) swap(to[i][0], to[i][1]);
        else if (to[i][0] == to[i][1]) to[i][1] = 0;
    }
    if (match() != n) puts("No Answer");
    else {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans[mat[i]] = i - 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d%c", ans[i], i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 50003
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define read(x) {x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();}

// dp[i][j] = min(dp[i - 1][j - 1] + s[i], dp[i - 1][j] + min(j * c, p[i]))

int main() {
//	freopen("transport.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("transport.out", "w", stdout);
    int s[MAXN], p[MAXN];
    LL t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], jc[MAXN], *tmp;
    register LL ans = 0;
    register int n, c, i, j, ss, pp, ch = 0;
    register LL *now = t1, *pre = t2, tmp1, tmp2;
    read(n);
    read(c);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i]);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(s[i]);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) jc[i] = (LL)i * c;
    memset(pre, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * (n + 1));
    memset(now, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * (n + 1));
    pre[0] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ss = s[i];
        pp = p[i];
        now[0] = pre[0] + pp;
        for (j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            tmp1 = pre[j - 1] + ss;
            tmp2 = pre[j] + jc[j] + pp;
            now[j] = tmp1 < tmp2 ? tmp1 : tmp2;
        }
        tmp = pre;
        pre = now;
        now = tmp;
    }
    ans = INF;
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) ans = ans > pre[i] ? pre[i] : ans;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//travel.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 20005
#define MAXM 100005
#define MAXQ 5005

struct edge {
    int u,v,w;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

struct query {
    int x,v;
    query() {}
    query(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
} q[MAXQ];

int n,m,Q,f[MAXN];
long long ans[MAXQ],tot=0;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        tot+=(long long)f[fa]*(long long)f[fb];
        if (fa<fb) {
            f[fa]+=f[fb];
            f[fb]=fa;
        } else {
            f[fb]+=f[fa];
            f[fa]=fb;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("travel.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("travel.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&Q);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        e[i]=edge(u,v,w);
    }
    for (int i=1,v; i<=Q; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&v);
        q[i]=query(i,v);
    }
    sort(e+1,e+m+1);
    sort(q+1,q+Q+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        while (j<=m && e[j].w<=q[i].v) merge(e[j].u,e[j].v),j++;
        ans[q[i].x]=tot*2;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//treapmod.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 105
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int a, b, c;
    bool operator < (Node x) const {
        return a < x.a;
    }
} q[MAXN];

map<int, int> tag;

int n, K, L[MAXN];
LL sum[MAXN], f[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

LL dp(int l, int r, int x) {
    if (l > r) return  0;
    if (vis[l][r][x]) return f[l][r][x];
    vis[l][r][x] = 1;
    LL &ret = f[l][r][x];
    ret = 0x23333333333333 - (sum[r] - sum[l - 1]);
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        ret = min(ret, dp(l, i - 1, x) + dp(i + 1, r, x) + (x == q[i].b ? 0 : K));
    }
    ret += sum[r] - sum[l - 1];
    if (x < n) ret = min(ret, dp(l, r, x + 1));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(q[i].a);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(q[i].b), L[i] = q[i].b;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(q[i].c);
    sort(q + 1, q + n + 1);
    sort(L + 1, L + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) tag[L[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) q[i].b = tag[q[i].b];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + q[i].c;
    printf("%lld\n", dp(1, n, 1));
    return 0;
}

//tree.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'C' || _c > 'Q') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : ma(this), val(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        ma = this;
        if (c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
        if (c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem + 1;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

int query(/*Node *u, */Node *v) {
    /*	mkrt(u); */expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return int(v->ma - mem);
}

void modify(Node *x, int v) {
    splay(x);
    x->val = v;
    x->upd();
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            (mem + e[now].to)->top = (mem + x);
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int n, Q;

int main() {
    freopen("tree.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("tree.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) newNode(i == 1);
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    mkrt(mem + 1);
    for (int i = 1, op, x; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        if (op == 'C') {
            modify(mem + x, dep[x]);
        } else printf("%d\n", query(mem + x));
    }
    return 0;
}

//treeG.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 20010
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,ecnt,head[MAXN],ans,tag;
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}
void init() {
    ecnt=0;
    ans=MAXN;
    tag=MAXN;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    return;
}
int dfs(int x) {
    int total=0,top=-1,v,re;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            visit[v]=1;
            re=dfs(v);
            total+=re;
            if (re>top)
                top=re;
        }
    }
    re=max(n-total-1,top);
    if (re==ans && x<tag)
        tag=x;
    if (re<ans) {
        ans=re;
        tag=x;
    }
    return total+1;
}
int main() {
    int _t;
    scanf("%d",&_t);
    while (_t--) {
        scanf("%d",&n);
        init();
        for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
            add(u,v);
            add(v,u);
        }
        visit[1]=1;
        dfs(1);
        printf("%d %d\n",tag,ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//tree_test.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

long long ans = 0;

int top = 32;

const int n = 1048576;
int f[n];
void work() {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        f[i] = f[rand() % i] + 1;
        ret = max(ret, f[i]);
    }
    ans += ret;
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        srand(i);
        for (int j = 0; j < top; j++) {
            work();
        }
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", ans * 1.0 / top / top);
    return 0;
}

//triangles.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 305
struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    void input() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    LL operator * (point a) const {
        return LL(x)*a.y-LL(y)*a.x;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n;
int v[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("triangles.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("triangles.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) p[i].input();
    for (int A=1; A<n; A++) {
        for (int B=A+1; B<n; B++) {
            for (int C=B+1; C<=n; C++) {
                int cnt=0;
                for (int D=1; D<=n; D++) {
                    LL hh=(p[B]-p[A])*(p[D]-p[A]);
                    if (hh>0) {
                        if ((p[C]-p[B])*(p[D]-p[B])>0 && (p[A]-p[C])*(p[D]-p[C])>0) cnt++;
                    } else if (hh<0) {
                        if ((p[C]-p[B])*(p[D]-p[B])<0 && (p[A]-p[C])*(p[D]-p[C])<0) cnt++;
                    }
                }
                v[cnt]++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n-3; i++) printf("%d\n",v[i]);
    return 0;
}

Point MassCenter(Point A, Point B, Point C) {
    return (A + B + C) * (1.0 / 3.0);
}
/*
	����I(Inner Center)
		����: �����ڽǵĽ�ƽ���ߵĽ���.
		����: ��������������Ȩƽ��, ��$\displaystyle \left( \frac{ax_1 + bx_2 + cx_3}{a + b + c}, \frac{ay_1 + by_2 + cy_3}{a + b + c} \right)$.
		���ĵ����������ߵľ������, ��������Բ�뾶r.
		����������������Բ��Բ��, ����Բ�뾶r, ��$\displaystyle \triangle = \frac{1}{2}(a + b + c)r$.
		ֱ�����������ɺ͵���б�߳����ϸ�����������Բֱ��, ��a + b = c + 2r,
		�ɴ������ټ��Ϲ��ɶ���$ a^2 + b^2 = c^2$, ���Ƶ�: $\triangle = r(r+c)$
*/
Point InnerCenter(Point A, Point B, Point C) {
    double a = dist(B, C), b = dist(A, C), c = dist(A, B);
    return (A * a + B * b + C * c) * (1.0 / (a + b + c));
}

//������ֱƽ�����ཻ�ķ���
Point CircumCenter(Point A, Point B, Point C) {
    return	(Line((A + B) * 0.5, (A - B).rot(PI * 0.5) + ((A + B) * 0.5)) &
             Line((B + C) * 0.5, (B - C).rot(PI * 0.5) + ((B + C) * 0.5))).second;
}
//��ʽ��
Poiny CircumCenter(Point A, Point B, Point C) {
    Point t1 = B - A, t2 = C - A, t3((t1 * t1) * 0.5, (t2 * t2) * 0.5);
    swap(t1.y, t2.x);
    return A + Point(t3 ^ t2, t1 ^ t3) * (1.0 / (t1 ^ t2));
}

Point OrthoCenter(Point A, Point B, Point C) {
    return MassCenter(A, B, C) * 3.0 - CircumCenter(A, B, C) * 2.0;
}

//tri_bitset.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define N 320
struct point {
    LL x,y;
    int tag;
    point() {}
    point(LL a,LL b):x(a),y(b) {}
    void input() {
        cin>>x>>y;
    }
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    LL operator * (point a) const {
        return LL(x)*a.y-LL(y)*a.x;
    }
} p[N];
bool operator < (point a,point b) {
    a=a-p[0];
    b=b-p[0];
    if (a.y == 0 && b.y == 0 && a.x*b.x <= 0) return a.x>b.x;
    if (a.y == 0 && a.x >= 0 && b.y != 0) return true;
    if (b.y == 0 && b.x >= 0 && a.y != 0) return false;
    if (b.y*a.y <= 0) return a.y>b.y;
    return (a*b) > 0 || ((a*b) == 0 && a.x < b.x);
}

int n;
int v[N];
bitset<N> G[N][N],temp;

int main() {
    freopen("triangles.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("triangles.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>n;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) p[i].input(),p[i].tag=i;
    for (int A=0; A<n; A++) {
        for (int B=0; B<n; B++) {
            if (A==B) continue;
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                if ((p[B]-p[A])*(p[i]-p[A])>0) G[A][B][i]=1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int A=0; A<n; A++) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) if (p[i].tag==A) {
                swap(p[i],p[0]);
                break;
            }
        sort(p+1,p+n);
        for (int B=1; B<n; B++) {
            temp.reset();
            for (int C=B+1; C!=B; C++) {
                if (C==n) {
                    C=0;
                    continue;
                }
                if ((p[B]-p[0])*(p[C]-p[0])<=0) {
                    break;
                }
                v[(temp&G[p[B].tag][p[C].tag]).count()]++;
                temp[p[C].tag]=1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n-3; i++) cout<<v[i]/3<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//tri_check.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    void read() {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
    }
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    LL operator * (point a) const {
        return LL(x)*a.y-LL(y)*a.x;
    }
} p[305];

int n;

int main() {
    freopen("triangles.in","r",stdin);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        p[i].read();
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            for (int k=j+1; k<=n; k++) {
                if ((p[k]-p[i])*(p[j]-p[i])==0) return 1;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//trie.cpp
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define N 999999
#define R return
#define I int
I n,c[20][26],t[26],f[N],i,j,l;
char s[N];
I g(I x) {
    memset(t,N,sizeof t);
    for(i=n; i--;)if(x>>i&1)for(j=26; j--;)t[j]=min(t[j],c[i][j]);
    for(i=26,j=0; i--;)j+=t[i];
    R j;
}
I dp(I x) {
    I&r=f[x];
    if(r<N)R r;
    I p=g(x);
    if(x==(x&-x))R r=p;
    for(I i=x; --i&=x;)r=min(r,dp(i)+dp(x^i)-p);
    R r;
}
main() {
    cin>>n;
    for(i=n; i--;) {
        cin>>s,l=strlen(s);
        for(j=l; j--;)c[i][s[j]-97]++;
    }
    for(i=N; i--; f[i]=N);
    cout<<dp((1<<n)-1)+1;
}

//try.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#define s 65536

typedef unsigned int ui;

struct node {
    int l,r,lazy;
    ui full,v;
} t[s<<1];

ui sum[s+1];
int n;

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 104857600
char bufr[MAX_BUF_SIZE], bufw[MAX_BUF_SIZE];
char *readptr, *writeptr;

void initBufReader(void) {
    readptr = bufr;
}

void initBufWriter(void) {
    writeptr = bufw;
}

void readBuf(void) {
    fread(bufr, sizeof(char), MAX_BUF_SIZE, stdin);
}

void writeBuf(void) {
    fwrite(bufw, sizeof(char), writeptr - bufw, stdout);
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (*readptr < '0' || *readptr > '9') readptr++;
    a = *(readptr++) - '0';
    while (*readptr >= '0' && *readptr <= '9')
        a = a * 10 + *(readptr++) - '0';
    return;
}

inline void writeInt(int v) {
    static char buf[11];
    static int buflen;
    if (!v) {
        *(writeptr++) = '0';
    } else {
        for (buflen = 0; v; v /= 10)
            buf[buflen++] = '0' + v % 10;
        while (buflen)
            *(writeptr++) = buf[--buflen];
    }
}

void fill(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        t[x].v=t[x].full;
        t[x].lazy=1;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy==1) return;
        else {
            t[x<<1].v=t[(x<<1)|1].v=0;
            t[x<<1].lazy=t[(x<<1)|1].lazy=-1;
            t[x].lazy=0;
        }
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) fill(x<<1,l,std::min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) fill((x<<1)|1,std::max(mid+1,l),r);
    t[x].v=t[x<<1].v+t[(x<<1)|1].v;
}

void clear(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        t[x].v=0;
        t[x].lazy=-1;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy==-1) return;
        else {
            t[x<<1].v=t[x<<1].full;
            t[(x<<1)|1].v=t[(x<<1)|1].full;
            t[x<<1].lazy=t[(x<<1)|1].lazy=1;
            t[x].lazy=0;
        }
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) clear(x<<1,l,std::min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) clear((x<<1)|1,std::max(mid+1,l),r);
    t[x].v=t[x<<1].v+t[(x<<1)|1].v;
}

ui query(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy==1) {
            return sum[r]-sum[l-1];
        } else return 0;
    }
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        return t[x].v;
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    ui ret=0;
    if (l<=mid) ret=query(x<<1,l,std::min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) ret=ret+query((x<<1)|1,std::max(mid+1,l),r);
    return ret;
}
int temp[11],*e;
inline void output(ui a) {
    if (a) {
        while (a) {
            ++e;
            *e='0'+a%10;
            a=a/10;
        }
        while (e!=temp) {
            putchar(*e);
            --e;
        }
    } else putchar('0');
    putchar('\n');
}

inline void init() {
    sum[0]=0;
    for (int i=s,j=1; j<=s; ++i,++j) {
        t[i].l=t[i].r=j;
        t[i].full=j;
        sum[j]=sum[j-1]+j;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; --i) {
        t[i].full=t[i<<1].full+t[(i<<1)|1].full;
        t[i].l=t[i<<1].l;
        t[i].r=t[(i<<1)|1].r;
    }
    t[1].lazy=-1;
    e=temp;
}
int main() {
    initBufReader();
    readBuf();
    initBufWriter();
    init();
    read(n);
    int op,l,r;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op) {
            if (op==1) fill(1,l,r);
            else clear(1,l,r);
        } else {
            output(query(1,l,r));
        }
    }
    writeBuf();
    return 0;
}

//tt.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int test(int x) {
    int ans=1;
    for (int i=2,ta=(int)sqrt(x); i<=ta; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            int cnt=1;
            while (x%i==0) cnt++,x/=i;
            ans*=cnt;
        }
    }
    if (x>1) ans*=2;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    int minv=0x7fffffff;
    for (int i=2; i<=1000000; i++) {
        if (i%10000==0) minv=0x7fffffff;
        int ret=test(i);
        if (ret>=2*int(sqrt(i))) printf("Flag : %d\n",i);
        minv=min(minv,2*int(sqrt(i))-ret);
        if (i%10000==9999)printf("%d\n",minv);
    }
    return 0;
}

//ttt.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 4050

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[N * 2];

int head[N], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, Q, fa[N], tcnt = 0;
int t[N][26], cnt[N], ans[N], rev[N];

int Ans[N][N];

void dfs(int x, int y) {
    cnt[y]++;
    rev[x] = y;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, t[y][e[now].w] ? t[y][e[now].w] : (t[y][e[now].w] = ++tcnt, memset(t[tcnt], 0, 26 * 4), cnt[tcnt] = 0, tcnt));
        }
    }
}

void Dfs(int x, int pre) {
    ans[x] = pre;
    pre += cnt[x];
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (t[x][i]) {
            Dfs(t[x][i], pre);
            pre += cnt[t[x][i]];
            cnt[x] += cnt[t[x][i]];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        while (ch < 'a') ch = getchar();
        add(u, v, ch - 'a');
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        memset(t[0], 0, sizeof t[0]);
        tcnt = 0;
        fa[i] = 0;
        dfs(i, 0);
        cnt[0] = 0;
        Dfs(0, 0);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            Ans[i][j] = ans[rev[j]];
        }
        Ans[i][i] = n;
    }

    while (Q--) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        printf("%d\n", Ans[u][v]);
    }

    return 0;
}

//tvio.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int n, t;
int fa[MAXN], p[MAXN];
LL s[MAXN], q[MAXN], l[MAXN], dep[MAXN], dp[MAXN];

int Q[MAXN], he = 1, ta = 2;

void bfs() {
    Q[he] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = Q[he++];
        dep[x] = dep[fa[x]] + s[x];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) Q[ta++] = e[o].v;
    }
}

double slope(int x, int y) {
    return double(dp[x] - dp[y]) / (dep[x] - dep[y]);
}

void get(int i) {
    int L = he, R = ta;
    R = ta;
    while (L < R) {
        int mid = (L + R + 1) >> 1;
        if (slope(Q[mid - 1], Q[mid]) > p[i]) R = mid - 1;
        else L = mid;
    }
    int j = Q[L];
    //cerr << he << " " << ta << endl;
    //for (int w = 1; w <= ta; w++) cerr << Q[w] << " " ;
    //cerr << endl;
    //cerr << j << endl;
    dp[i] = dp[j] + (dep[i] - dep[j]) * p[i] + q[i];
}

void insert(int i) {
    while (he < ta && slope(Q[ta - 1], Q[ta]) >= slope(i, Q[ta])) ta--;
    Q[++ta] = i;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(t);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]);
        read(s[i]);
        read(p[i]);
        read(q[i]);
        read(l[i]);
        add(fa[i], i);
    }
    bfs();
    if (n <= 8005) {
        for (int x = 2; x <= n; x++) {
            dp[x] = INF;
            LL k;
            for (int y = fa[x]; y; y = fa[y]) {
                if ((k = dep[x] - dep[y]) > l[x]) break;
                dp[x] = min(dp[x], dp[y] + k * p[x]);
            }
            printf("%lld\n", dp[x] += q[x]);
        }
    } else {
        he = 1, ta = 1;
        q[he] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            get(i);
            insert(i);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) printf("%lld\n", dp[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//TXFS.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int to,next;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int t[MAXN*22],L[MAXN*22],R[MAXN*22];
int rt[MAXN],Q[MAXN],head[MAXN],father[MAXN],dep[MAXN];

int hh[MAXN],hcnt;
int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=hcnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (hh[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int ecnt=0,tcnt=0,n,m;

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt++;
    e[ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    L[now]=L[x];
    R[now]=R[x];
    t[now]=t[x]+v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    if (p<=mid)
        L[now]=update(L[x],l,mid,p,v);
    else
        R[now]=update(R[x],mid+1,r,p,v);
    return now;
}

int query(int u,int v,int lca,int flca,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int val=t[L[u]]+t[L[v]]-t[L[lca]]-t[L[flca]];
    if (val>=p)
        return query(L[u],L[v],L[lca],L[flca],l,(l+r)>>1,p);
    else
        return query(R[u],R[v],R[lca],R[flca],((l+r)>>1)+1,r,p-val);
}
void dfs(int x) {
    rt[x]=update(rt[father[x]],0,100000,Q[x],1);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=father[x]) {
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            father[v]=x;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
}

int f[MAXN][18];
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[i][0]=father[i];
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=17; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            f[i][k]=f[f[i][k-1]][k-1];
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            u=f[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if (f[u][k]!=f[v][k]) {
            u=f[u][k];
            v=f[v][k];
        }
    }
    return f[u][0];
}

int __query(int u,int v,int k) {
    int LCA=getLCA(u,v);
    return query(rt[u],rt[v],rt[LCA],rt[father[LCA]],0,100000,k);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",Q+i);
        hh[i]=Q[i];
    }
    sort(hh+1,hh+n+1);
    hcnt=int(unique(hh+1,hh+n+1)-hh-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        Q[i]=find(Q[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    rt[0]=0;
    dep[0]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    father[1]=father[0]=0;
    dfs(1);
    init();
    int lastans=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,k; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&k);
        u^=lastans;
        lastans=__query(u,v,k);
        lastans=hh[lastans];
        printf("%d",lastans);
        if (i!=m) putchar('\n');
    }
    return 0;
}

//txfsV.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int to,next;
} e[MAXN<<1];
struct qu {
    int to,next,num;
} q[MAXN<<1];
int Q[MAXN],head[MAXN],qh[MAXN],father[MAXN],f[MAXN];
int qs[MAXN],qt[MAXN],qk[MAXN],LCA[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
int temp[MAXN];
int ecnt=0,qcnt=0,tcnt=0,r,n,m;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt++;
    e[ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        f[i]=i;
    return;
}

void addquery(int u,int v,int k,int num) {
    qs[num]=u;
    qt[num]=v;
    qk[num]=k;
    q[++qcnt].to=v;
    q[qcnt].next=qh[u];
    q[qcnt].num=num;
    qh[u]=qcnt++;
    q[qcnt].to=u;
    q[qcnt].next=qh[v];
    q[qcnt].num=num;
    qh[v]=qcnt;
    return;
}

void tarjan(int x) {
    f[x]=x;
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=qh[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        int v=q[now].to;
        if (visit[v]) {
            int num=q[now].num;
            LCA[num]=getf(v);
        }
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            father[v]=x;
            tarjan(v);
            f[v]=x;
        }
    }
    return;
}

void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int u=qs[i],v=qt[i],k=qk[i],lca=LCA[i],p=0;
        while (u!=lca) {
            temp[++p]=Q[u];
            u=father[u];
        }
        while (v!=lca) {
            temp[++p]=Q[v];
            v=father[v];
        }
        temp[++p]=Q[lca];
        nth_element(temp+1,temp+p-k+1,temp+p+1);
        printf("%d\n",temp[p-k+1]);
    }
}
int main() {
    freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%d",Q+i);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1,s,t,k; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&s,&t,&k);
        addquery(s,t,k,i);
    }
    init();
    father[1]=father[0]=0;
    tarjan(1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//ufset.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 10005

int n,m;
int f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0)	return x;
    else return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int u,v,w;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        if (u==1) {
            merge(v,w);
        } else {
            puts(getf(v)==getf(w)?"Y":"N");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//UOJ174.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 200005

int T;
int n;
int r[MAXN];
int q[MAXN<<1],ans[MAXN],cnt=0;

struct data {
    int x,v;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return x<a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int main() {
    freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("write.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        cnt=0;
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d",r+i);
            a[i].x=i;
            a[i].v=r[i];
        }
        sort(a+1,a+n+1);
        int head=MAXN,tail=MAXN-1,nowpos=1,stackpos=1;
        while (nowpos<=n) {
            if (head<=tail) {
                if (q[head]<q[tail]) {
                    if (a[nowpos].v>=q[head]) {
                        ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (a[nowpos].v>=q[tail]) {
                        ans[++cnt]=q[tail--];
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (a[nowpos].x<stackpos) {
                nowpos++;
                continue;
            }
            for (; stackpos<=a[nowpos].x; stackpos++) {
                q[--head]=r[stackpos];
            }
            ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
        }
        while (head<=tail) {
            if (q[head]<q[tail]) {
                ans[++cnt]=q[head++];
            } else {
                ans[++cnt]=q[tail--];
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            printf("%d ",ans[i]);
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans[n]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//uojfft.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
struct Comp {
    LD x, y;
    Comp() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Comp(LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Comp operator * (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x * t.x - y * t.y, x * t.y + y * t.x);
    }
    Comp operator *= (Comp t) {
        return *this = *this * t;
    }
    Comp operator + (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x + t.x, y + t.y);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x - t.x, y - t.y);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator * (_T t) {
        return Comp(x * t, y * t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator / (_T t) {
        return Comp(x / t, y / t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator /= (_T t) {
        return *this = *this / t;
    }
};
Comp I(0, 1);

Comp exp(Comp t) {
    return Comp(cos(t.y), sin(t.y)) * exp(t.x);
}

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 262144

Comp tmp[MAXN];

void DFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    int n_2 = n / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tmp[i] = a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i & 1) a[n_2 + i / 2] = tmp[i];
        else a[i / 2] = tmp[i];
    }
    Comp *a0 = a, *a1 = a + n_2;
    DFT(a0, n_2, rev);
    DFT(a1, n_2, rev);
    Comp cur(1, 0);
    LD alpha = M_PI / n_2 * rev;
    Comp step = exp(I * alpha);
    for (int k = 0; k < n_2; ++k) {
        tmp[k] = a0[k] + cur * a1[k];
        tmp[k + n_2] = a0[k] - cur * a1[k];
        cur *= step;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = tmp[i];
}

Comp a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

void FFT(int n) {
    DFT(a, n, 1);
    DFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] *= b[i];
    DFT(a, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] /= n;
}

int N, M;

int main() {
    read(N);
    read(M);
    int n = 1;
    while (n < N + M + 1) n <<= 1;
    for (int i = 0, v; i <= N; i++) read(v), a[i] = Comp(v, 0);
    for (int i = 0, v; i <= M; i++) read(v), b[i] = Comp(v, 0);
    FFT(n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= N + M; i++) printf("%d ", int(a[i].x + 0.5));
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#define MAXN 100319

struct pam {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        len[p] = l, cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        p = n = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    int n((int)strlen(s + 1));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        T.add(s[i]);
        printf("%d ", T.p - 2);
    }
    return 0;
}

}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define eps 1e-6
#define INF 1e15
#define calc() to = abs()
D ans;
int X[3], Y[3], w[3], W;
int xx[3], yy[3], t[3], sx, sy;
int f[3];

void solve() {
    for (int i = 0, left = W; i < 3; i++) {
        t[i] = min(left, w[f[i]]);
        left -= t[i];
        xx[i] = X[f[i]];
        yy[i] = Y[f[i]];
    }
    D x = sx / 3, y = sy / 3, tx, ty, a, b, c;
    for (D Tmp = 1000; Tmp > 1e-8; Tmp *= 0.998) {
        tx = ty = 0;
        c = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            a = xx[i] - x;
            b = yy[i] - y;
            tx += a * t[i], ty += b * t[i];
            c += hypot(a, b) * t[i];
        }
        ans = min(ans, c);
        x += Tmp * tx, y += Tmp * ty;
    }
}

void work() {
    sx = 0, sy = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) read(X[i]), sx += X[i], read(Y[i]), sy += Y[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) read(w[i]);
    read(W);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) f[i] = i;
    ans = INF;
    do {
        solve();
    } while (next_permutation(f, f + 3));
    printf("%.4lf\n", ans * 2);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) {
        printf("Case %d: ", i);
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//V1753.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b==0)
        return a;
    return gcd(b,a%b);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    while (n--) {
        int ans=0,a0,a1,b0,b1;
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&a0,&a1,&b0,&b1);
        if (a0%a1 || b1%b0) {
            puts("0");
            continue;
        }
        int u=b1/b0;
        for (int i=1,t=int(sqrt(b1)); i<=t; i++) {
            if (b1%i)
                continue;
            if (gcd(a0,i)==a1 && gcd(b1/i,u)==1)
                ans++;
            int re=b1/i;
            if (re!=i && gcd(a0,re)==a1 && gcd(b1/re,u)==1)
                ans++;
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//vector.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
#define MAXK 102
typedef long long LL;

const LL P1 = 19260817, MOD1 = 999999319, P2 = 120180241, MOD2 = 2147483647;

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash (LL a = 0, LL b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    inline Hash operator + (register int a) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + a) % MOD1, (y * P2 + a) % MOD2);
    }
    inline bool operator < (register Hash a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y);
    }
    inline bool operator == (register Hash a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
};

int n, K, ret;
int a[MAXK], ans[MAXK], lab[MAXK];
map <int, int> f;

vector <Hash> s;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    ret = n;
    register int i, j, k, r, cnt, p, tot, x;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        tot = 0;
        for (j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            read(x);
            if (f[x]) a[j] = f[x];
            else a[j] = ++tot, f[x] = tot;
            ans[j] = a[j];
        }
        f.clear();
        for (r = 2; r <= K; r++) {
            cnt = 0;
            for (j = r, p = 1; p <= K; j = j == K ? 1 : j + 1, p++) {
                if (!lab[a[j]]) lab[a[j]] = ++cnt;
                if (lab[a[j]] != ans[p]) {
                    if (lab[a[j]] > ans[p]) {
                        for (k = r; k != j; k = k == K ? 1 : k + 1) lab[a[k]] = 0;
                        lab[a[j]] = 0;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        for ( ; p <= K; j = j == K ? 1 : j + 1, p++) {
                            if (!lab[a[j]]) lab[a[j]] = ++cnt;
                            ans[p] = lab[a[j]];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (lab[a[r]]) memset(lab + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * K);
        }
        Hash haha;
        for (j = 1; j <= K; j++) haha = haha + ans[j];
        s.push_back(haha);
    }
    sort(s.begin(), s.end());
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) if (s[i] == s[i - 1]) ret--;
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

        return *this+a;

//vijos1040fft.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <complex>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
struct Comp {
    LD x, y;
    Comp() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Comp(LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Comp operator * (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x * t.x - y * t.y, x * t.y + y * t.x);
    }
    Comp operator *= (Comp t) {
        return *this = *this * t;
    }
    Comp operator + (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x + t.x, y + t.y);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x - t.x, y - t.y);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator * (_T t) {
        return Comp(x * t, y * t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator / (_T t) {
        return Comp(x / t, y / t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator /= (_T t) {
        return *this = *this / t;
    }
};

Comp I(0, 1);

Comp exp(Comp t) {
    return Comp(cos(t.y), sin(t.y)) * exp(t.x);
}

#define MAXN 524288

char sa[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

Comp tmp[MAXN];

void DFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    int n_2 = n >> 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tmp[i] = a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i & 1) a[n_2 + (i >> 1)] = tmp[i];
        else a[i >> 1] = tmp[i];
    }
    Comp *a0 = a, *a1 = a + n_2;
    DFT(a0, n_2, rev);
    DFT(a1, n_2, rev);
    Comp cur(1, 0);
    LD alpha = M_PI / n_2 * rev;
    Comp step = exp(I * alpha);
    for (int k = 0; k < n_2; ++k) {
        tmp[k] = a0[k] + cur * a1[k];
        tmp[k + n_2] = a0[k] - cur * a1[k];
        cur *= step;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = tmp[i];
}

Comp a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

void FFT(int n) {
    DFT(a, n, 1);
    DFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] *= b[i];
    DFT(a, n, -1);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s%s", sa, sb);
    int n = 1, alen = (int)strlen(sa), blen = (int)strlen(sb);
    while (n < alen + blen) n <<= 1;
    for (int i = alen - 1, j = 0; j < n; i--, j++) {
        if (i > -1) a[j] = Comp(sa[i] - '0', 0);
        else a[j] = Comp(0, 0);
    }
    for (int i = blen - 1, j = 0; j < n; i--, j++) {
        if (i > -1) b[j] = Comp(sb[i] - '0', 0);
        else b[j] = Comp(0, 0);
    }
    FFT(n);
    for (int i = 0, to; i < n; i++) {
        ans[i] += int(a[i].x / n + 0.5);
        if ((to = ans[i] / 10)) {
            ans[i + 1] += to;
            ans[i] -= 10 * to;
        }
    }
    bool flag = 1;
    for (int i = alen + blen - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        if (flag && !ans[i]) continue;
        flag = 0;
        putchar('0'|ans[i]);
    }
    if (flag) putchar('0');
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 105

int n;

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int i) {
        return v[i];
    }
} a[MAXN];

bool gauss() {
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = i;
        while (j <= n && a[j][i] == 0) j++;
        if (j > n) return 0;
        if (i != j) swap(a[i], a[j]);
        for (int k = i + 1; k <= n; k++) {
            double hh = a[k][i] / a[i][i];
            for (int q = n + 1; q >= i; q--) {
                a[k][q] -= a[i][q] * hh;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = n; i > 0; i--) {
        for (int j = n; j > i; j--) {
            a[i][n + 1] -= a[i][j] * a[j][n + 1];
        }
        a[i][n + 1] /= a[i][i];
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            read(x);
            a[i][j] = x;
        }
        read(x);
        a[i][n + 1] = x;
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        printf("%d ", int(a[i][n + 1] + 0.5));
    }
    return 0;
}

//vijos1119.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 405

int s,t,A,B;

double G[MAXN][MAXN];

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point (int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    point operator + (point a) const {
        return point(x+a.x,y+a.y);
    }
    int operator ^ (point a) const {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int pcnt=0,tot;

void work() {
    point &a=p[pcnt],&b=p[pcnt-1],&c=p[pcnt-2];
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++) {
        if (((b-a)^(c-a))==0) break;
        swap(a,b);
        swap(b,c);
    }
    p[++pcnt]=b+c-a;
}

int sqr(int x) {
    return x*x;
}

double dis(point a,point b) {
    return sqrt(sqr(a.x-b.x)+sqr(a.y-b.y));
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&s,&t,&A,&B);
    tot=s*4+1;
    for (int i=0; i<=tot; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=tot; j++) {
            G[i][j]=1e9;
        }
        G[i][i]=0;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=s; k++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=3; j++) {
            ++pcnt;
            scanf("%d%d",&p[pcnt].x,&p[pcnt].y);
        }
        work();
        int T;
        scanf("%d",&T);
        for (int i=pcnt-3; i<pcnt; i++) {
            for (int j=i+1; j<=pcnt; j++) {
                G[j][i]=G[i][j]=dis(p[i],p[j])*T;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<tot; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<tot; j++) {
            double now=dis(p[i],p[j])*t;
            if (now<G[i][j]) {
                G[i][j]=G[j][i]=now;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
        G[0][A*4-i]=G[A*4-i][0]=0;
        G[tot][B*4-i]=G[B*4-i][tot]=0;
    }
    for (int k=0; k<=tot; k++)
        for (int i=0; i<=tot; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<=tot; j++) {
                G[i][j]=min(G[i][j],G[i][k]+G[k][j]);
            }
    printf("%.2lf\n",G[0][tot]);
    return 0;
}
