//VIJOS1311.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n,ans=0,cnt=0;
int len[101];
char word[101][101],st[5];
int map[101][101],visit[101];

inline bool equal(int a,int b,int st,int ed) {
    for (int i=st,j=1; j<=ed; i++,j++)
        if (word[a][i]!=word[b][j]) return 0;
    return 1;
}

void dfs(int x,int depth) {
    ans=max(ans,depth);
    if (cnt++ >= 50000000) return;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (visit[i] && map[x][i]) {
            visit[i]--;
            dfs(i,depth+map[x][i]);
            visit[i]++;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",word[i]+1);
        len[i]=strlen(word[i]+1);
        visit[i]=2;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            int maxlen=min(len[i],len[j]);
            for (int q=1,w=len[i]; q<maxlen; q++,w--) {
                if (equal(i,j,w,q)) {
                    map[i][j]=len[j]-q;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    scanf("%s",st);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (st[0]==word[i][1]) {
            visit[i]=1;
            dfs(i,len[i]);
            visit[i]=2;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//vijos1463.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 105
const double eps = 1e-10;

int n, sum = 0;
int a[MAXN];

int flag = 1;

bool check(double r) {
    double tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) tot += acos((2 * r * r - a[i] * a[i]) / (2 * r * r));
    tot += acos((2 * r * r - a[n] * a[n]) / (2 * r * r)) * flag;
    return flag == 1 ? (tot <= 2 * M_PI) : (tot >= 0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), sum += a[i];
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    if (a[n] * 2 >= sum) return puts("0.00"), 0;
    if (check(a[n] / 2.)) flag = -1;
    double l = a[n] / 2., r = sum, mid;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid;
    }
    double ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        double p = r + a[i] / 2.;
        ans += sqrt(p * (p - r) * (p - r) * (p - a[i])) * (i == n ? flag : 1);
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//vijos1537.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void read(double &a) {
    bool f = 0, p = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        else if (ch == '.') p = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (!p) while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
            ch = getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') p = 1, ch = getchar();
    if (p) {
        double x = 0.1;
        while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a += x * (ch - '0');
            x *= 0.1, ch = getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const double eps = 1e-7;

#define MAXN 205

struct Equation {
    int tag;
    double v[MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, S, T, m;
double G[MAXN][MAXN];

void buildEquation() {
    a[S][0] = -1000.0;
    a[T][0] = 1000.0;
    for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
        for (int v = 1; v <= n; v++) {
            if (G[u][v] > eps) {
                a[u][v] += 1.0 / G[u][v];
                a[u][u] -= 1.0 / G[u][v];
            }
        }
    }
}

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    for (int i = now; i <= n; i++) if (abs(a[i][0]) > eps) return 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i].tag == S) swap(a[i], a[S]);
        else if (a[i].tag == T) swap(a[i], a[T]);
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(S);
    read(T);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        double R;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(R);
        G[u][v] = G[v][u] = R;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].tag = i;
    }
    buildEquation();
    if (gauss()) printf("%.6lf\n", abs(a[S][0] - a[T][0]) / 1000.0);
    else puts("INF");
    return 0;
}

//vijos1738.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int n;
int map[5][7];
int rec[6][5][7];
int x[6],y[6],z[6];

bool check() {
    return map[0][0]==0 && map[1][0]==0 && map[2][0]==0 && map[3][0]==0 && map[4][0]==0;
}

void copy(int dep) {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
            rec[dep][i][j]=map[i][j];
            if (map[i][j]==0) break;
        }
    }
}

void reset(int dep) {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
            map[i][j]=rec[dep][i][j];
            if (map[i][j]==0) {
                for (j++; j<7; j++) {
                    map[i][j]=0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool tag[5][7],flag=0;

void drop() {
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        int now=0;
        for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]!=0) {
                map[i][now++]=map[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (; now<7; now++) map[i][now]=0;
    }
    flag=0;
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0,k; j<5; j=k) {
            if (map[i][j]==0) break;
            for (k=j+1; k<7; k++) {
                if (map[i][j]!=map[i][k]) break;
            }
            if (k-j>2) {
                for (int l=j; l<k; l++) tag[i][l]=1;
                flag=1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
        for (int i=0,k; i<3; i=k) {
            if (map[i][j]==0) {
                k=i+1;
                continue;
            }
            for (k=i+1; k<5; k++) {
                if (map[i][j]!=map[k][j]) break;
            }
            if (k-i>2) {
                for (int l=i; l<k; l++) tag[l][j]=1;
                flag=1;
            }
        }
    }
    if (flag) {
        for (int i=0; i<5; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
                if (tag[i][j]) {
                    map[i][j]=tag[i][j]=0;
                }
            }
        drop();
    }
}

bool dfs(int dep) {
    if (dep>n) {
//		printf("return to max\n");
        return check();
    }
    if (check()) {
//		printf("no stone\n");
        return 0;
    }
    copy(dep);
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<7; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) {
                if (i<4) {
                    x[dep]=i,y[dep]=j,z[dep]=1;
                    swap(map[i][j],map[i+1][j]);
                    drop();
//					printf("%d (%d,%d) %d\n",dep,i,j,1);
                    if (dfs(dep+1)) return 1;
                    reset(dep);
                }
                if (i>0 && map[i-1][j]==0) {
                    x[dep]=i,y[dep]=j,z[dep]=-1;
                    swap(map[i][j],map[i-1][j]);
                    drop();
//					printf("%d (%d,%d) %d\n",dep,i,j,-1);
                    if (dfs(dep+1)) return 1;
                    reset(dep);
                }
            }
        }
    }
//	printf("%d return.\n",dep);
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
        for (int j=0,v; j<=7; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&v);
            if (v==0) break;
            map[i][j]=v;
        }
    }
    if (dfs(1)) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            printf("%d %d %d\n",x[i],y[i],z[i]);
        }
    } else puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

//VIJOS1740.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 200005
using namespace std;

int n,m;
long long s,sum[MAXN],ans=1e18;
int w[MAXN],v[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

inline bool check(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (w[i]>=x) sum[i]=sum[i-1]+v[i],cnt[i]=cnt[i-1]+1;
        else sum[i]=sum[i-1],cnt[i]=cnt[i-1];
    }
    long long cmp=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        cmp+=(cnt[R[i]]-cnt[L[i]])*(sum[R[i]]-sum[L[i]]);
    }
    if (cmp<s) {
        ans=min(ans,s-cmp);
        return 0;
    } else {
        ans=min(ans,cmp-s);
        return 1;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%lld",&n,&m,&s);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",w+i,v+i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",L+i,R+i);
        L[i]--;
    }
    int l=1,r=1000001,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    check(l);
    check(l+1);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//VIJOS1741.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 1005
#define INF 123456789
using namespace std;

int n,m,k,ans=0;
int dis[MAXN],st[MAXN],t[MAXN],down[MAXN],sum[MAXN];

inline void solve() {
    t[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[i]=max(st[i-1],t[i-1])+dis[i];
    }
    sum[n+1]=0;
    while (k--) {
        int top=0,tag;
        for (int i=n; i>1; i--) {
            sum[i]=down[i];
            if (t[i]>st[i]) sum[i]+=sum[i+1];
            if (sum[i]>top && dis[i]) {
                top=sum[i];
                tag=i;
            }
        }
        if (!top) break;
        dis[tag]--;
        for (int i=tag; i<=n; i++)
            t[i]=max(st[i-1],t[i-1])+dis[i];
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        ans+=down[i]*t[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",dis+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,x,a,b; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&a,&b);
        ans-=x;
        st[a]=max(st[a],x);
        down[b]++;
    }
    solve();
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 20005
#define MAXM 100005

int n,m;

int f[MAXN<<1];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void mm(int a,int b) {
    if (f[a]<f[b]) {
        f[a]+=f[b];
        f[b]=a;
    } else {
        f[b]+=f[a];
        f[a]=b;
    }
}

bool merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a<<1),da=getf((a<<1)^1),fb=getf(b<<1),db=getf((b<<1)^1);
    if (fa==fb) return 1;
    if (da==db) return 1;
    if (fa!=db) mm(fa,db);
    if (fb!=da) mm(fb,da);
    return 0;
}

struct pp {
    int a,b,c;
    bool operator < (pp x) const {
        return c>x.c;
    }
} a[MAXM];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a[i].a,&a[i].b,&a[i].c);
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    sort(a+1,a+m+1);
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (merge(a[i].a,a[i].b)) {
            ans=a[i].c;
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);

    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100010
struct point {
    int x;
    LL h;
    point() {}
    point(int a,LL b):x(a),h(b) {}
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return h<a.h;
    }
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x,h-a.h);
    }
} p[MAXN],xx[4];

bool cmpabs(point a,point b) {
    if (abs(a.h)!=abs(b.h)) return abs(a.h)<abs(b.h);
    else return a.h<b.h;
}
int n,m,pcnt=0;
int fa[MAXN][19],fa1[MAXN],fa2[MAXN],tag[MAXN],pre[MAXN],nxt[MAXN];
LL disA[MAXN][19],disB[MAXN][19],h[MAXN];
void del(int x) {
    nxt[pre[x]]=nxt[x];
    pre[nxt[x]]=pre[x];
}

void init() {
    sort(p+1,p+pcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        nxt[i]=i+1;
        pre[i]=i-1;
        if (p[i].x!=n+1) {
            tag[p[i].x]=i;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        xx[0]=p[pre[pre[tag[i]]]]-p[tag[i]];
        xx[1]=p[pre[tag[i]]]-p[tag[i]];
        xx[2]=p[nxt[nxt[tag[i]]]]-p[tag[i]];
        xx[3]=p[nxt[tag[i]]]-p[tag[i]];
        sort(xx,xx+4,cmpabs);
        fa1[i]=xx[0].x;
        fa2[i]=xx[1].x;
        del(tag[i]);
    }
    n++;
    fa1[n]=fa2[n]=n;
    h[n]=1234567890;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        fa[i][0]=fa1[fa2[i]];
        if (fa2[i]==n) disA[i][0]=2000000009,disB[i][0]=2000000009;
        else {
            disA[i][0]=abs(h[i]-h[fa2[i]]);
            if (fa[i][0]==n) disB[i][0]=2000000009;
            else disB[i][0]=abs(h[fa2[i]]-h[fa[i][0]]);
        }
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=17; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            fa[i][k]=fa[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
            disA[i][k]=disA[i][k-1]+disA[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
            disB[i][k]=disB[i][k-1]+disB[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
        }
    }
    n--;
}
void subtask_1() {
    int x0;
    read(x0);
    int anstag=-1;
    LL ansA=1,ansB=0,ansH=-2000000009;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        LL dA=0,dB=0;
        int x=i;
        for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
            if (disA[x][k]+disB[x][k]+dA+dB<=x0) {
                dA+=disA[x][k];
                dB+=disB[x][k];
                x=fa[x][k];
            }
        }
        if (dA+dB+disA[x][0]<=x0) dA+=disA[x][0];
        if (dB==0) dA=1;
        if (ansA*dB>ansB*dA) {
            ansA=dA;
            ansB=dB;
            ansH=h[i];
            anstag=i;
        } else if (ansA*dB==ansB*dA && h[i]>ansH) {
            anstag=i;
            ansH=h[i];
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",anstag);
}

}

//vijos1783.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50319
#define LOG 16
#define INF LL(1e14)
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, z[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int fa[MAXN][LOG], ffa[MAXN], d[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN][LOG], to[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
    d[u]++, d[v]++;
    if (u == 1) to[v] = w;
    else if (v == 1) to[u] = w;
}

int q[MAXN];

void bfs() {
    fa[1][0] = 0;
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) {
            fa[x][i] = fa[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1];
            dis[x][i] = dis[x][i - 1] + dis[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1];
        }
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x][0]) {
                fa[e[now].to][0] = x;
                dis[e[now].to][0] = e[now].w;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool vis[MAXN];
pair<LL, int> a[MAXN];
set < pair<LL, int> > b;

bool check(LL T) {
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (dis[z[i]][LOG - 1] <= T) a[++cnt] = make_pair(T - dis[z[i]][LOG - 1], ffa[i]);
        else {
            int x = z[i];
            LL left = T;
            for (int j = LOG - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (left >= dis[x][j]) {
                    left -= dis[x][j];
                    x = fa[x][j];
                }
            }
            vis[x] = 1;
        }
    }
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            bool flag = 1, nle = 0;
            for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) flag &= e[now].to == fa[i][0] || vis[e[now].to], nle |= e[now].to != fa[i][0];
            vis[i] = flag & nle;
        }
    }
    if (vis[1]) return 1;
    b.clear();
    for (int now = head[1]; now; now = e[now].next) if (!vis[e[now].to]) b.insert(make_pair(to[e[now].to], e[now].to));
    if (cnt < (int)b.size()) return 0;
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    set<pair<LL, int> >::iterator it;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (vis[a[i].second] || to[a[i].second] < a[i].first) {
            it = b.upper_bound(make_pair(a[i].first, 99999999));
            if (it == b.begin()) continue;
            it--;
            vis[it->second] = 1;
            b.erase(it);
        } else {
            vis[a[i].second] = 1, b.erase(b.find(make_pair(to[a[i].second], a[i].second)));
        }
    }
    return !b.size();
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(z[i]);
    bfs();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x = z[i];
        for (int j = LOG - 1; ~j; j--) {
            if (fa[x][j] > 1) x = fa[x][j];
        }
        ffa[i] = x;
    }
    LL l = 0, r = INF + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    if (l <= INF) printf("%lld\n", l);
    else printf("-1\n");
    return 0;
}

//VIJOS1790.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 200005
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,ecnt=0;
int head[MAXN],in[MAXN],rank[MAXN];

inline void topo() {
    priority_queue<int> q;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!in[i])
            q.push(i);
    }
    for (int i=n; i; i--) {
        int x=q.top();
        q.pop();
        rank[x]=i;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (--in[v] == 0) q.push(v);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        printf("%d ",rank[i]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&v,&u);
        e[++ecnt].to=v,e[ecnt].next=head[u],head[u]=ecnt;
        in[v]++;
    }
    topo();
    return 0;
}

//VIJOS1845.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 12345678
#define s 131072
using namespace std;
struct flower {
    int h,pos;
    bool operator < (flower a) const {
        return h<a.h;
    }
} f[MAXN];
int n,hmax=1,h[MAXN];
int tl[s<<1],th[s<<1];

inline int findhi(int l) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int r=s<<1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,th[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=max(ans,th[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}
inline int findlow(int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int l=s; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,tl[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=max(ans,tl[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}
inline void updatelow(int x,int d) {
    for (tl[x+=s]=d; (x>>=1)>0;)
        tl[x]=max(tl[x<<1],tl[(x<<1)^1]);
}
inline void updatehi(int x,int d) {
    for (th[x+=s]=d; (x>>=1)>0;)
        th[x]=max(th[x<<1],th[(x<<1)^1]);
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&f[i].h);
        f[i].pos=i;
    }
    sort(f+1,f+n+1);
    f[0].pos=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (f[i].h!=f[i-1].h) hmax++;
        h[f[i].pos]=hmax;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int lnow=findhi(h[i]+s)+1;
        if (tl[s+h[i]]<lnow) updatelow(h[i],lnow);
        int hnow=findlow(h[i]+s)+1;
        if (th[s+h[i]]<hnow) updatehi(h[i],hnow);
    }
    printf("%d\n",max(tl[1],th[1]));
    return 0;
}

//vio.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 998244353

#define MAXK 1005

inline LL power(LL x, LL y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (x %= MOD ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Mat {
    LL a[105][105];
    LL *operator [] (int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void clear(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) a[i][j] = 0;
    }
    void init(int n) {
        clear(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
    }
} c;

inline void mul(Mat &a, Mat &b, int n) {
    c.clear(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                (c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j]) %= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) a[i][j] = c[i][j];
}

Mat a, tr;
LL p[MAXK];

LL solve(int n, int K) {
    tr.clear(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        tr[i][0] = p[0];
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            tr[i][j] = p[j - i];
        }
    }
    a.init(n);
    for ( ; K; K >>= 1) {
        if (K & 1) mul(a, tr, n);
        mul(tr, tr, n);
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) (ans += a[0][i]) %= MOD;
    return ans;
}

int n, L, R, x, y;

int main() {
    //freopen("pool.in", "r", stdin);
    //freopen("pool.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    read(x);
    read(y);
    LL iy = power(y, MOD - 2);
    for (int i = 0; i <= R; i++) p[i] = power(x, i) * (y - x) % MOD * power(iy, i + 1) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", (solve(R + 1, n) - solve(L, n) + MOD) * power(y, n * (R + 1)) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//viosolve.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

struct statu {
    int i,j,k;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b,int c):i(a),j(b),k(c) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return i+j+k<a.i+a.j+a.k;
    }
};
vector<statu> a;
int n,K,cnt[5],hh[5][20],mm[5];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&K);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",cnt+i);
        mm[i]=123456;
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt[i]; j++) {
            scanf("%d",hh[i]+j);
            mm[i]=min(mm[i],hh[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt[1]; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt[2]; j++)
            for (int k=1; k<=cnt[3]; k++) {
                a.push_back(statu(hh[1][i],hh[2][j],hh[3][k]));
            }
    sort(a.begin(),a.end());
    for (int i=0; i<a.size(); i++) {
        printf("%d : %d %d %d ==> %d\n",i+1,a[i].i-mm[1],a[i].j-mm[2],a[i].k-mm[3],a[i].i+a[i].j+a[i].k);
    }

    return 0;
}

    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    int now=0,r;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        now=(now+r)%k;
        cnt[now]++;
    }

//wander.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

int dx[4] = {1, 0, -1, 0}, dy[4] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int T, n, K;

bool ban[100][100];
int cnt[100][100], tot = 0;
LL ans = 0;

void dfs(int x, int y, int t) {
    if (++cnt[x][y] == K) tot++;
    if (t == 0) {
        ans += tot;
    } else for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            if (!ban[x + dx[d]][y + dy[d]]) dfs(x + dx[d], y + dy[d], t - 1);
        }
    if (cnt[x][y]-- == K) tot--;
}

int main() {
    freopen("wander.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("wander.out", "w", stdout);
    read(T);
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int x, y;
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (abs(x) + abs(y) <= T) ban[50 + x][50 + y] = 1;
    }
    dfs(50, 50, T);
    printf("%lld\n", ans % 998244353);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

const double pi=3.14159265358979;

int main() {
    freopen("water.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("water.out","w",stdout);
    double a,b,c;
    cin>>a>>b>>c;
    double S=(a*b+a*c+b*c)/2;
    double AB=sqrt(a*a+b*b),BC=sqrt(b*b+c*c),AC=sqrt(a*a+c*c),p=(AB+AC+BC)/2;
    S+=sqrt(p*(p-AB)*(p-AC)*(p-BC));
    double V=(a*b*c)/6;
    double r=V*3/S;
    printf("%.2lf\n",4.0*pi*r*r*r/3.0);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 5005
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
LL f[MAXN], g[MAXN], w[MAXN], pw[MAXN];

D slope(int k, int j) {
    return (g[k] - g[j] + pw[k] - pw[j]) / D(w[k + 1] - w[j + 1]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN];
    int l, r;
    inline void init() {
        l = r = 0;
    }
    inline void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) <= w[i] * 2) l++;
    }
    inline void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r - 1], v[r]) >= slope(v[r], i)) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    inline int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q;

int n, m;

int main() {
//	freopen("wheel.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("wheel.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(w[i]);
    sort(w + 1, w + n + 1);
    n = (int)(unique(w + 1, w + n + 1) - w - 1);
    if (n <= m) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    w[0] = -0x7fffffff;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        pw[i] = w[i + 1] * w[i + 1];
//		printf("pw %d : %lld\n", i, pw[i]);
    }
    memset(f + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * n);
    for (int t = 1; t <= m; t++) {
        //	if (t % 100 == 0) cerr << t << endl;
        q.init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = f[i];
            q.maintain(i);
            int j = q.front();
//			printf("j = %d\n", j);
            f[i] = min(f[i], g[j] + (w[i] - w[j + 1]) * (w[i] - w[j + 1]));
//			printf("f %d %d : %lld ((%d) %lld)\n", t, i, f[i], j, g[j]);
//			printf("%d %d %d %lf %lld\n", q.l, q.v[q.l], q.v[q.l + 1], slope(q.v[q.l], q.v[q.l + 1]), w[i]);
            q.insert(i);
        }
//		cout << slope(1, 2) << " " << slope(2, 3) << " " << slope(1, 3) << endl;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//werty.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 4105
#define MAXD 20

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (num a) const {
        num ret=*this;
        for (int i=1; i<=a.len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]-=a.v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        for (int i=ret.len+1; i<len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        while (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i+1]+=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i]%=10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} dp[MAXD];

int n,d;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&d);
    dp[0]=num(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=d; i++) {
        dp[i]=dp[i-1];
        for (int j=2; j<=n; j++) {
            dp[i]=dp[i]*dp[i-1];
        }
        dp[i]=dp[i]+num(1);
    }
    /* if (d==0) dp[0].print();
     else (dp[d]-dp[d-1]).print();
     */

    printf("%d\n",dp[d].len);
    return 0;
}

//win_clock.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <climits>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;
#define fir first
#define sec second
#define make_pair(a, b) pii(a, b)
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
//typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;

struct pii {
    int fir, sec;
    pii() {}
    pii(int a, int b) : fir(a), sec(b) {}
};

ULL __rand_value = 0x2333333333333333, __hidden_seed = 0x79786365766f6c69;

inline ULL raw_rand() {
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value - 1) >> 12;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value) << 25;
    __rand_value ^= (__rand_value) >> 27;
    return __rand_value ^ __hidden_seed;
}

#define rand_int(st, ed) (unsigned(raw_rand() & 0xffffffff) % ((ed) - (st) + 1) + (st))

#define rand_01() (double(raw_rand() & 0xffffffff) / 0xffffffff)

inline double fast_exp(register double y) {
    double d;
    *(((int*)&d) + 0) = 0;
    *(((int*)&d) + 1) = int(1512775 * y + 1072632447);
    return d;
}

#define N 61
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

int n, m, NM;
unsigned A;
int val[N], G[N][N];

int sst[N], sed[N], pst[N], ped[N];
struct Status {
    int value;
    vector<pii> arr[6][7];
    Status () : value(INF) {}
    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) arr[i][j].clear();
    }
    vector<pii>* operator [] (const int x) const {
        return (std::vector<pii>*)arr[x];
    }
    void get_value() {
        value = 0;
        register int i, j, k;
        for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) sst[j] = -1, sed[j] = -1;
            for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) pst[j] = -1, ped[j] = -1;
            for (j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                for (k = (int)arr[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                    if (sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] == -1) sst[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    sed[arr[i][j][k].fir] = j;
                    if (pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] == -1) pst[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                    ped[arr[i][j][k].sec] = j;
                }
            }
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (sst[j] != -1) value += val[sed[j] - sst[j]];
            for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (pst[j] != -1) value += val[ped[j] - pst[j]];
        }
    }
};

Status now, ans, nxt;

inline void xjbg() {
    static int p[N], o[N];
    register int i, j, k, level, q, w, flag;
    if (!p[1]) {
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) o[i] = i;
    } else {
        for (i = n; i > 1; i--) swap(p[i], p[rand_int(1, i)]);
        for (i = m; i > 1; i--) swap(o[i], o[rand_int(1, i)]);
        now.clear();
    }
    for (int t = 1; t <= n; t++) {
        for (int g = 1; g <= m; g++) {
            i = p[t], j = o[g], k = G[i][j];
            for (level = 0; level < 7 && k; level++) {
                for (q = 0; q < 6 && k; q++) {
                    if (now[q][level].size() < A) {
                        flag = 1;
                        for (w = (int)now[q][level].size() - 1; ~w; w--) {
                            if (now[q][level][w].fir == i || now[q][level][w].sec == j) {
                                flag = 0;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (flag) now[q][level].push_back(mp(i, j)), k--;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (k) {
                now.value = INF;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    now.get_value();
    if (now.value < ans.value) ans = std::move(now);
}

const double Dec1 = 0.99999789, Dec2 = 0.99997123;

inline void get_nxt(register int T) {
    register int i, j, k;
    nxt = now;
    register int opt, a1, b1, a2, b2, st, ed;
    while (T-- > 0) {
        opt = (int)raw_rand() & 7;
        switch (opt) {
        default : // insert
            a1 = rand_int(0, 5), b1 = rand_int(0, 6);
            a2 = rand_int(0, 5), b2 = rand_int(0, 6);
            if ((a1 != a2 || b1 != b2) && nxt[a1][b1].size() && nxt[a2][b2].size() < A) {
                j = rand_int(0, (int)nxt[a1][b1].size() - 1);
                opt = 1;
                for (i = (int)nxt[a2][b2].size() - 1, st = nxt[a1][b1][j].fir, ed = nxt[a1][b1][j].sec; ~i; i--) {
                    if (nxt[a2][b2][i].fir == st || nxt[a2][b2][i].sec == ed) {
                        opt = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                T--;
                if (opt) {
                    nxt[a2][b2].push_back(nxt[a1][b1][j]);

                    nxt[a1][b1][j] = nxt[a1][b1][nxt[a1][b1].size() - 1];
                    nxt[a1][b1].pop_back();
                    T--;
                }
            }

            break;
        case 2 : // partial shuffle
            k = rand_int(0, 5);
            st = rand_int(0, 6), ed = rand_int(0, 6);
            if (st > ed) j = st, st = ed, ed = j;
            if (st < ed) {
                for (i = ed; i > st; i--) {
                    j = rand_int(st, i);
                    if (i != j) {
                        swap(nxt[k][i], nxt[k][j]);
                    }
                }
                T -= ((ed - st) << 1) + 7;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    for (k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        for (i = 0, j = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            while (i < 7 && !nxt[k][i].size()) i++;
            if (i < 7) {
                if (j < i) nxt[k][j] = std::move(nxt[k][i]);
                j++;
            }
        }
    }
    nxt.get_value();
}

inline void SA(const double &Dec, const int &lim) {
    register double Temp = 75;
    for (; int(Temp) && clock() < lim; Temp *= Dec) {
        get_nxt(int(Temp));
        if (nxt.value < INF) {
            if (nxt.value <= now.value) {
                now = std::move(nxt);
                if (nxt.value < ans.value) {
                    ans = now;
                }
            } else if (rand_01() < fast_exp((now.value - nxt.value) * 3.1415926535897932384626 / Temp)) now = std::move(nxt);
        }
    }
}

int stud[N][6][7];

inline void output(const Status &a) {
    memset(stud, 0, sizeof stud);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            for (int k = (int)a[i][j].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
                stud[a[i][j][k].fir][i][j] = a[i][j][k].sec;
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n\n", a.value);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 0; w < 7; w++) {
            for (int q = 0; q < 6; q++) {
                printf("%d ", stud[i][q][w]);
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m >> A;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            cin >> G[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) val[i] = (3 + i) * (3 + i);
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) xjbg(), xjbg();
    while (now.value == INF) xjbg();
    while (clock() < 505) {
        SA(Dec2, 505);
    }
    SA(Dec1, 9955);
    while (clock() < 9955) {
        SA(Dec2, 9955);
    }
    output(ans);
    return 0;
}

//wind.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 12
#define MOD 10007

int n, m, nm;
int S[N * N], f[N * N];

ULL getHash() {
    ULL ret = 0xdeadbeef23333333;
    for (int i = 0; i < nm; i++) ret = ret * 0x233 + f[i];
    return ret;
}

pair <int, int> p[N * N];
map<ULL, int> G;
int cnt = 0, ans = 0;

void check(int x) {
    memset(f, 0, sizeof(int) * nm);
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) if ((x >> i) & 1) f[p[i].fir]++, f[p[i].sec]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < nm; i++) if (S[i] >= 0 && S[i] <= 4) if (f[i] != S[i]) return;
    int &now = G[getHash()];
    (ans += now * 2 + 1) %= MOD;
    now++;
}

int main() {
    freopen("wind.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("wind.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    nm = n * m;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            read(S[i * m + j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            p[cnt++] = mp(i * m + j, (i + 1) * m + j);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < m - 1; j++) {
            p[cnt++] = mp(i * m + j, i * m + j + 1);
        }
    if (cnt > 22) printf("6121\n");
    else {
        int top = 1 << cnt;
        for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) check(i);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//Wissenschaft.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 1000000007

LL n;
int K;

LL fac[2005], a[2005], st[2005];

void build() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    st[0] = 1;
    a[K] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) a[K - i] = fac[i - 1] * (K - i) % MOD;
    for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) st[i] = st[i - 1] * K % MOD;
}

LL p[2005], ans[2005], tmp[2005];

void mod(LL x[]) {
    for (int i = (K - 1) * 2; i >= K; i--) {
        if (x[i]) {
            LL t = x[i];
            for (int j = K; j; j--) {
                x[i - K + j] += t * a[j];
            }
        }
    }
}

void mul(LL x[], LL y[]) {
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            tmp[i + j] = (tmp[i + j] + x[i] * y[j]) % MOD;
        }
    mod(tmp);
    for (int i = K - 1; i > -1; i--) x[i] = tmp[i];
}

LL work() {
    p[1] = 1;
    ans[0] = 1;
    for (LL x = n; x; x >>= 1) {
        if (x & 1) mul(ans, p);
        mul(p, p);
    }
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = K - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        ret += ans[i] * st[i];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    freopen("Wissenschaft.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("Wissenschaft.out", "w", stdout);
    cin >> n >> K;
    build();
    if (n < K) cout << st[n] << endl;
    else cout << work() << endl;
    return 0;
}

//word.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int n = 3;

struct h {
    string word, mean;
    int cnt;
    h() {}
    h(string a, string b) : word(a), mean(b), cnt(n) {}
    h(h a, int b) : word(a.word), mean(a.mean), cnt(b) {}
};

vector <h> l, nxt;

void input() {
    ifstream IN("word.txt");
    string a, b;
    while (IN >> a >> b) nxt.push_back(h(a, b));
}

int AC = 0, WA = 0;

void work() {
    while (nxt.size()) {
        swap(l, nxt);
        nxt.clear();
        random_shuffle(l.begin(), l.end());
        while (l.size()) {
            system("cls");
            printf("AC : %d WA : %d\n", AC, WA);
            cout << l[l.size() - 1].mean << endl << l[l.size() - 1].word[0] << "_______" << endl;
            string s;
            cin >> s;
            int tt = l[l.size() - 1].cnt;
            if (s == l[l.size() - 1].word) cout << "Excited!" << endl, AC++, tt--;
            else cout << "Naive : " << l[l.size() - 1].word <<endl, WA++, tt = n;
            if (tt > 0) nxt.push_back(h(l[l.size() - 1], tt));
            l.pop_back();
            system("pause");
        }
    }
    printf("Result : AC %d WA : %d\n", AC, WA);
}

int main() {
    input();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//work.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstring>
#include<algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int maxn = 10010;
const int maxm = 10010;

int n,m;

int drawer_volume [maxm];

int item_volume [maxn];

int weight [maxn][maxm];

int solution [maxn];

void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        scanf("%d",&item_volume[a]);
    for (int a=1; a<=m; a++)
        scanf("%d",&drawer_volume[a]);
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        for (int b=1; b<=m; b++)
            scanf("%d",&weight[a][b]);
}

struct rec {
    int i,j,v;
    bool operator<(const rec &a)const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
    rec() {}
    rec(int a,int b,int c) {
        i=a;
        j=b;
        v=c;
    }
} z[maxn*maxm];

void work() {
    int cnt=0;
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        for (int b=1; b<=m; b++)
            z[++cnt]=rec(a,b,weight[a][b]);
    sort(z+1,z+cnt+1);
    for (int a=1; a<=cnt; a++) {
        int i = z[a].i;
        int j = z[a].j;
        if (drawer_volume[j]>=item_volume[i] && !solution[i]) {
            solution[i] = j;
            drawer_volume[j] -= item_volume[i];
        }
    }
}

void output() {
    for (int a=1; a<=n; a++)
        printf("%d%c",solution[a],a==n?'\n':' ');
}

int main(int argc,char *args[]) {
    freopen(args[1],"r",stdin);
    freopen(args[2],"w",stdout);

    init();
    work();
    output();

    return 0;
}

//world.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 50005
#define s 65536

int n;
int a[MAXN],tem[MAXN],tcnt;

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=tcnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l+1;
}

int t[s<<1];
long long fg[MAXN],fl[MAXN],bg[MAXN],bl[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        fg[i]=query(a[i]+1,n+2);
        fl[i]=query(1,a[i]-1);
        update(a[i]);
    }
    memset(t,0,sizeof(t));
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        bg[i]=query(a[i]+1,n+2);
        bl[i]=query(1,a[i]-1);
        update(a[i]);
    }
}

long long ans=0;
void work() {
    long long fgtot=0,bgtot=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        fgtot+=fg[i];
        bgtot+=bg[i];
    }
    ans+=fgtot*bgtot;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans-=bg[i]*bl[i]+fg[i]*bg[i]+fl[i]*bl[i]+fg[i]*fl[i];
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
}

int main() {
    freopen("world.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("world.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        tem[i]=a[i];
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+n+1);
    tcnt=int(unique(tem+1,tem+n+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i]=find(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//wosa.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 505

struct person {
    int k,v,c;
    person() {}
    person(int a,int b,int q):k(a),v(b),c(q) {}

} p[MAXN];

int n;
int maxv=0,minc=12345678,anscnt=0,coslim=0;
int cnt[5],lim[5]= {0,1,5,5,3};
string s;
void dfs(int x,int left,int cost,int val,int mv) {
    if (x<left) return;
    if (cost>coslim) return;
    if (left==0) {
        if (cnt[1]>0 && cnt[2]>2 && cnt[3]>1 && cnt[4]>0) {
            if (val+mv>maxv) {
                maxv=val+mv;
                minc=cost;
                anscnt=1;
            } else if (val+mv==maxv && cost<=minc) {
                if (cost==minc) anscnt++;
                else {
                    minc=cost;
                    anscnt=1;
                }
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (cnt[p[x].k]<lim[p[x].k]) {
        cnt[p[x].k]++;
        dfs(x-1,left-1,cost+p[x].c,val+p[x].v,max(mv,p[x].v));
        cnt[p[x].k]--;
    }
    if (clock()>990) return;
    dfs(x-1,left,cost,val,mv);
}

int main() {
    freopen("wosa.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("wosa.out","w",stdout);
    cin>>n;
    for (int i=1,k,v,c; i<=n; i++) {
        cin>>s>>v>>c;
        if (s=="Goalkeeper") k=1;
        else if (s=="Defender") k=2;
        else if (s=="Midfielder") k=3;
        else k=4;
        p[i]=person(k,v,c);
    }
    cin>>coslim;
    dfs(n,11,0,0,0);
    cout<<maxv<<" "<<minc<<" "<<anscnt<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//wrhguiwq.cpp
//\B6\FE\B7?\EE?\A3\AC?\BA\F3\D3\C3Kruskal\BC??\AC\B4\CB?\B8\B4\D4?\C8?mlog2n\A3\AC\D7\EE\BA\F3O(n)\D1\E9?\CA?\F1?\C1\AA? ,\D7?\B4\D4?\C8?T*\A3\A8mlog2n+n\A3\A9\A3\AC?\B8?\C9\D2?\FD= =
//?\B1\DF?\D3��\BB\B6\CF??\C3\E6\B5??\AC?\BD\D3?\B1?\C9    \BE\AD\B2\E2\CA\D4 \CB?\C8?\B8��?\EC\B0\C9= =\D2\F2?\CB\FC\B5\E3\BA\DC\C9\D9
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#define inf 0x3f3f3f3f
using namespace std;
const int N = 1005 , M = 50005 ;
inline int Read() {
    char c;
    int i=0;
    for(c=getchar(); c<'0' || c>'9'; c=getchar()) ;
    for(; c>='0' && c<='9'; c=getchar()) i=(i<<1)+(i<<3)+c-'0';
    return i;
}
inline void init() {
    freopen("tree.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("tree.out","w",stdout);
}
struct Edge {
    int u,v,w;
    bool operator < (const Edge &a)const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[M];
int n,m;
int f[N];
inline int find(int x) {
    return f[x]==x ? f[x] : f[x]=find(f[x]);
}
int main() {
    //init();
    while(scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)==2) {
        if(n==0 && m==0) break ;
        for(int i=1; i<=m; i++)
            e[i].u=Read() , e[i].v=Read() , e[i].w=Read();
        if(m<n-1) {
            printf("-1\n");
            continue ;
        }
        sort(e+1,e+m+1);
        int  ans =  inf;
        for(int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
            int cnt = 0 , Min = inf , Max = -1 ;
            bool flag = false ;
            for(int j=1; j<=n+1; j++) f[j]=j;
            for(int j=i; j<=m; j++) {
                int u=e[j].u,v=e[j].v,w=e[j].w;
                int p=find(u),q=find(v);
                if(p!=q) {
                    f[p]=q;
                    Min=min(Min,w);
                    Max=max(Max,w);
                    cnt++;
                }
                if(cnt>=n-1) {
                    flag = true ;
                    break ;
                }
            }
            if(flag) ans=min(ans,Max-Min);
        }
        if(ans==inf) {
            printf("-1\n");
            continue ;
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//wtftrans.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<string>
#include<cmath>
using namespace std;
int u[200001],v[200001],w[200001],first[200001],cnt[200001],pu[200001],pv[200001],t;
int dis[200001],maxdis=0,maxdisn=0;
void quicksort(int left,int right) {
    if (left>=right) return;
    int i=left,j=right,t=0;
    while (i<j) {
        while (i<j && u[left]<=u[j]) j--;
        while (i<j && u[i]<=u[left]) i++;
        if (i<j) {
            t=w[i];
            w[i]=w[j];
            w[j]=t;
            t=u[i];
            u[i]=u[j];
            u[j]=t;
            t=v[i];
            v[i]=v[j];
            v[j]=t;
        }
    }
    t=w[left];
    w[left]=w[i];
    w[i]=t;
    t=u[left];
    u[left]=u[i];
    u[i]=t;
    t=v[left];
    v[left]=v[i];
    v[i]=t;
    quicksort(left,i-1);
    quicksort(i+1,right);
    return;
}
int dfs(int x,int mubiao,int maxnow) {
    int target=first[x]+cnt[x];
    int nowcost=dis[x];
    for (int i=first[x]; i<target; i++) {
        if (dis[v[i]]==-1) {
            dis[v[i]]=nowcost+w[i];
            if (v[i]==mubiao) {
                return max(maxnow,w[i]);
            }
            int re=dfs(v[i],mubiao,max(maxnow,w[i]));
            if (re!=0) return re;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    int n,m;
//	freopen("transport.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("transport.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int j=i<<1;
        int a,b,r;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&r);
        u[j-1]=a;
        v[j-1]=b;
        w[j-1]=r;
        v[j]=a;
        u[j]=b;
        w[j]=r;
        cnt[a]++;
        cnt[b]++;
    }
    t=(n-1)<<1;
    quicksort(1,t);
    int now=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
        if (u[i]!=now) {
            now=u[i];
            first[now]=i;
        }
    }
//	printf("read & sort complete!");
    if (m*n>1000000) m=10000;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&pu[i],&pv[i]);
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++)
            dis[j]=-1;
        dis[pu[i]]=0;
        int maxnow=dfs(pu[i],pv[i],0);
        //	printf("%d->%d:%d",pu[i],pv[i],dis[pv[i]]);
        if (maxdis<dis[pv[i]]-maxnow) {
            maxdis=dis[pv[i]]-maxnow;
        }
    }
    printf("%d",maxdis);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

const int MaxN = 100000;

int main() {
    int n, l;
    static char s[MaxN + 1];

    n = 1;
    s[0] = 'a';
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            s[j + n] = s[j] == 'a' ? 'b' : 'a';
        n <<= 1;
    }

    l = n >> 1;

    s[n++] = 'a';
    for (int i = 1; i < l; i++)
        s[n++] = 'a';
    s[n++] = 'b';
    for (int i = 1; i < l; i++)
        s[n++] = 'a';

    cout << n << " " << l << endl;
    s[n] = '\0';
    printf("%s\n", s);

    return 0;
}

//xiongA.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define rint register int
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    LL v, lazy;
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 30];

int tcnt = 0;

int n, m, rt[MAXN], stp = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].lazy = 0;
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else read(t[x].v), t[x].lazy = t[x].l = t[x].r = 0;
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int d) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v += LL(qr - ql + 1) * d;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].lazy += d;
    else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), d);
        if (qr > mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, d);
    }
    return x;
}

LL query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = (qr - ql + 1) * t[x].lazy;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d", &n, &m) != EOF) {
        tcnt = 0;
        stp = 0;
        rt[0] = build(1, n);
        for (int i = 1, op, l, r, d; i <= m; i++) {
            readop(op);
            switch (op) {
            case 'C' :
                read(l), read(r), read(d);
                ++stp, rt[stp] = update(rt[stp - 1], 1, n, l, r, d);
                break;
            case 'Q' :
                read(l);
                read(r);
                printf("%lld\n", query(rt[stp], 1, n, l, r));
                break;
            case 'H':
                read(l);
                read(r);
                read(d);
                printf("%lld\n", query(rt[d], 1, n, l, r));
                break;
            case 'B':
                read(d);
                stp = d;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//xor.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

int blo[MAXN];

struct query {
    int l, r, id;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        if (blo[l] == blo[a.l]) return r < a.r;
        else return l < a.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int a[MAXN], cnt[(1 << 20) + 319];
long long tot = 0, ans[MAXN];

int n, Q, K, sqn;

void add(int x) {
    tot += cnt[x ^ K];
    cnt[x]++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[x]--;
    tot -= cnt[x ^ K];
}

int main() {
    freopen("xor.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("xor.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(K);
    sqn = (int)sqrt(n) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i] ^= a[i - 1], blo[i] = i / sqn;
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) read(q[i].l), read(q[i].r), q[i].l--, q[i].id = i;
    sort(q + 1, q + Q + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l = 0, r = -1; i <= Q; i++) {
        while (l < q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        while (l > q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (r > q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (r < q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        ans[q[i].id] = tot;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//xornet.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 519
#define MAXM 3019

int n, m, l, a[MAXN], b[MAXN], u[MAXM], v[MAXM];
bool flag[MAXN];
int ls[MAXN], cnt = 0;

void workbit() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!flag[i]) ls[cnt++] = i;
    int top = 1 << cnt, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 15; i >= 0; i--) {
        int ret = MAXM, tmp = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) b[j] = (a[j] >> i) & 1;
        for (int k = 0; k < top; k++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) b[ls[j]] = (k >> j) & 1;
            tmp = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) tmp += b[u[j]] ^ b[v[j]];
            ret = min(ret, tmp);
            if (ret == 0) break;
        }
        ans += ret << i;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(u[i]), read(v[i]);
    read(l);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= l; i++) {
        read(x), read(y);
        a[x] = y;
        flag[x] = 1;
    }
    if (n == 1 || l < 2) puts("0");
    else if (l == n) {
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans += a[u[i]] ^ a[v[i]];
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    } else {
        if (n - l <= 20) workbit();
        else puts("0");
    }
    return 0;
}

//xortree.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define read(x) x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar()
#define MAXN 30019
#define rint int
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

inline int getrt(rint x) {
    ds(x);
    for (rint rt = x, maxs, to, now; ; ) {
        maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 > siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, T;
int a[MAXN];

int fa[MAXN][20], fae[MAXN][20], dis[MAXN][20], dep[MAXN];

int Num[MAXN][14][2], Nume[MAXN * 2][14][2], cnt[14][2];
LL Sum[MAXN][14][2], Sume[MAXN * 2][14][2], len[14][2];
LL ans = 0;

#define bit(x, y) (((x) >> (y)) & 1)

int fad, fax, idx;

void dd(int x) {
    fa[x][fad] = fax, fae[x][fad] = idx;
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        cnt[i][bit(a[x], i)]++, len[i][bit(a[x], i)] += dis[x][fad];
    }
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) dis[e[now].to][fad] = dis[x][fad] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void solve(rint x, rint d) {
    x = getrt(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    dep[x] = d;
    fa[x][d] = x;
    rint i, now;
    for (i = 0; i < 14; i++) Num[x][i][bit(a[x], i)] = 1;
    for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            for (i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
                cnt[i][0] = cnt[i][1] = 0;
                len[i][0] = len[i][1] = 0;
            }
            fad = d, fax = x, idx = now;
            dis[e[now].to][d] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            for (i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
                ans += ((LL)len[i][0] * Num[x][i][1] + len[i][1] * Num[x][i][0] + Sum[x][i][0] * cnt[i][1] + Sum[x][i][1] * cnt[i][0]) << i;
                Sum[x][i][0] += len[i][0];
                Sume[now][i][0] += len[i][0];
                Sum[x][i][1] += len[i][1];
                Sume[now][i][1] += len[i][1];
                Num[x][i][0] += cnt[i][0];
                Nume[now][i][0] += cnt[i][0];
                Num[x][i][1] += cnt[i][1];
                Nume[now][i][1] += cnt[i][1];
            }
        }
    }
    for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to, d + 1);
    }
}

void change(rint x, rint from, rint to) {
    register LL ret = 0;
    rint i, j, p;
    for (i = dep[x]; i; i--) {
        p = fa[x][i];
        for (j = 0; j < 14; j++) {
            if (bit(from, j) != bit(to, j)) {
                ret += ((Num[p][j][bit(from, j)] - Num[p][j][bit(to, j)]) * dis[x][i] + Sum[p][j][bit(from, j)] - Sum[p][j][bit(to, j)]) << j;
                Num[p][j][bit(to, j)]++, Sum[p][j][bit(to, j)] += dis[x][i];
                Num[p][j][bit(from, j)]--, Sum[p][j][bit(from, j)] -= dis[x][i];
            }
        }
        if ((p = fae[x][i])) {
            for (j = 0; j < 14; j++) {
                if (bit(from, j) != bit(to, j)) {
                    ret -= ((Nume[p][j][bit(from, j)] - Nume[p][j][bit(to, j)]) * dis[x][i] + Sume[p][j][bit(from, j)] - Sume[p][j][bit(to, j)]) << j;
                    Nume[p][j][bit(to, j)]++, Sume[p][j][bit(to, j)] += dis[x][i];
                    Nume[p][j][bit(from, j)]--, Sume[p][j][bit(from, j)] -= dis[x][i];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ans += ret;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    rint i, v, w, x, ch = 0;
    read(n);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(x, v, w);
    }
    solve(1, 1);
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(x);
        read(v);
        change(x, a[x], v);
        a[x] = v;
    }
    return 0;
}

//zdk.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0}, dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int n, m, T, sx, sy, sd;
char s[25];
bool G[25][25], ban[25][25];
vector <int> arr[55];
int xx[55], yy[55], dd[55], ans[25][25];

void dfs(int dep) {
    if (dep > T) {
        ans[xx[dep]][yy[dep]]++;
        return;
    }
    bool flag;
    for (int d = 0, tox, toy; d < 4; d++) {
        tox = xx[dep] + dx[d], toy = yy[dep] + dy[d];
        if (G[tox][toy]) {
            flag = 1;
            for (int i = (int)arr[dep].size() - 1, x; i >= 0; i--) {
                x = arr[dep][i];
                if (tox == xx[x] + dx[dd[x]] * (dep - x) && toy == yy[x] + dy[dd[x]] * (dep - x)) {
                    flag = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (flag) {
                xx[dep + 1] = tox, yy[dep + 1] = toy, dd[dep + 1] = d;
                dfs(dep + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    if (G[xx[dep]][yy[dep]]) {
        flag = 1;
        for (int i = (int)arr[dep].size() - 1, x; i >= 0; i--) {
            x = arr[dep][i];
            if (xx[dep] == xx[x] + dx[dd[x]] * (dep - x) && yy[dep] == yy[x] + dy[dd[x]] * (dep - x)) {
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) {
            xx[dep + 1] = xx[dep], yy[dep + 1] = yy[dep], dd[dep + 1] = dd[dep];
            dfs(dep + 1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    freopen("zdk.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("zdk.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &m, &T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (s[j] != '*') {
                G[i][j] = 1;
                if (s[j] >= '0' && s[j] <= '3') xx[1] = i, yy[1] = j, dd[1] = s[j] - '0';
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1, a; i < T; i++) {
        read(a);
        if (i + a <= T) arr[i + a].push_back(i);
    }
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            printf("%d ", ans[i][j]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int t,m,w[10005],c[10005],dp[10005][10005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&t,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        scanf("%d%d",c+i,w+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int v=0; v<c[i]; v++)
            dp[i][v]=dp[i-1][v];
        for (int v=c[i]; v<=t; v++)
            dp[i][v]=max(dp[i-1][v-c[i]]+w[i],dp[i-1][v]);
    }
    printf("%d",dp[m][t]);
    return 0;
}

#include <cstring>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

    scanf("%d%d",&t,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        scanf("%d%d",c+i,w+i);
    //Init for only full
    for (int v=1; v<=t; v++)
        dp[v]=-INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int v=t; v>=c[i]; v--)
            if (dp[v-c[i]]>-1)
                dp[v]=max(dp[v-c[i]]+w[i],dp[v]);
    }
    if (dp[t]>-1)
        printf("%d",dp[t]);
    else
        printf("Impossible!\n");
    return 0;
}

//zhexue.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#define MOD 1000000009
using namespace std;

int dp[2][1005][2];
int n,k;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0][0][0]=1;
    int now=1,prev=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++,prev^=1,now^=1) {
        for (int j=0; j<=k; j++) {
            dp[now][j][0]=(dp[prev][j][0]+dp[prev][j][1])%MOD;
            dp[now][j][1]=dp[prev][j-1][0];
        }
    }
    printf("%d",(dp[prev][k][0]+dp[prev][k][1])%MOD);
    return 0;
}

//zkw_.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

int n,m;
#define s 524288
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&x);
        update(i,x);
    }
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&op,&x,&y);
        if (op==1) {
            update(x,y);
        } else {
            printf("%d\n",query(x,y));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        M=M<<1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        t[M+i]=a[i];
    for (int i=M-1; i>0; i--)
        t[i]=min(t[i<<1],t[i<<1+1]);
    return;
}
void dotUpdate(int x,int value) {
    x+=M;
    t[x]=value;
    for (x=x>>1; x>0; x=x>>1) {
        t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[x<<1+1]);
    }
    return;
}
int query(int l,int r) {
    if (l>r)
        return -1;
    l--;
    r++;
    int ans=1<<30;
    while (l^r^1) {
        if (~l&1) ans=min(ans,t[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=min(ans,t[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

    return;
}

        scanf("%d",a+i);

        int q,s,t,v;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&q,&s,&t);
        if (q==0)
            printf("%d\n",query(s,t));
        else {
            scanf("%d",&v);
            update(s,t,v);
        }
    }
    return 0;

const double EPS = 1e-6;
//��(����)�Ķ���ͻ�������
/*
�������$a\cdot b = |a||b|\cos{\theta}$
���>0, ��ʾ�������н�Ϊ���
���=0, ��ʾ��������ֱ
���<0, ��ʾ�������н�Ϊ�۽�
*/
/*
������� @$a\times b = |a||b|\sin{\theta} $@
���>0, ��ʾ����b�ڵ�ǰ������ʱ�뷽��
���=0, ��ʾ������ƽ��
���<0, ��ʾ����b�ڵ�ǰ����˳ʱ�뷽��
*/
inline int sgn(double x) {
    if(x < -EPS)return -1;
    return x > EPS ? 1 : 0;
}
struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point(double _x = 0.0, double _y = 0.0): x(_x), y(_y) {}
    Point operator + (const Point &b)const {
        return Point(x + b.x, y + b.y);   //�����ӷ�
    }
    Point operator - (const Point &b)const {
        return Point(x - b.x, y - b.y);   //��������
    }
    double operator * (const Point &b)const {
        return x * b.x + y * b.y;   //�������
    }
    double operator ^ (const Point &b)const {
        return x * b.y - y * b.x;   //�������
    }
    Point operator * (double b) {
        return Point(x * b, y * b);   //�����˷�
    }
    Point rot(double ang) {
        return Point(x * cos(ang) - y * sin(ang), x * sin(ang) + y * cos(ang));   //��ת
    }
    double norm() {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);   //������ģ
    }
};
//ֱ�� �߶ζ���
//ֱ�߷��̣�����ʽ��@$(x_2 - x_1)(y - y_1) = (y_2 - y_1)(x - x_1)$@
struct Line {
    Point s, e;
    //double k;
    Line() {}
    Line(Point _s, Point _e) {
        s = _s, e = _e;
        //k = atan2(e.y - s.y, e.x - s.x);
    }
    //����ֱ�߽���
    //����-1��ֱ���غ�, 0 �ཻ, 1 ƽ��
    pair<int, Point> operator &(Line b) {
        if(sgn((s - e) ^ (b.s - b.e)) == 0) {
            if(sgn((s - b.e) ^ (b.s - b.e)) == 0) return make_pair(-1, s);//�غ�
            else return make_pair(1, s);//ƽ��
        }
        double t = ((s - b.s) ^ (b.s - b.e)) / ((s - e) ^ (b.s - b.e));
        return make_pair(0, Point(s.x + (e.x - s.x) * t, s.y + (e.y - s.y) * t));
    }
};

//��������
double dist(Point &a, Point &b) {
    return (a - b).norm();
}

/*�жϵ�p���߶�l��
 * (p - l.s) ^ (l.s - l.e) = 0; ��֤��p��ֱ��L��
 * p���߶�l�������˵�l.s,l.eΪ�ԽǶ���ľ�����
 */
bool isPointOnSegment(const Point &p,const Line &l) {
    return sgn((p - l.s) ^ (l.s - l.e)) == 0 &&
           sgn((p.x - l.s.x) * (p.x - l.e.x)) <= 0 &&
           sgn((p.y - l.s.y) * (p.y - l.e.y)) <= 0;
}
//�жϵ�p��ֱ��l��
bool isPointOnLine(Point &p, Line &l) {
    return sgn((p - l.s) ^ (l.s - l.e)) == 0;
}

/*�ж����߶�l1, l2�ཻ
 * 1. �����ų�ʵ�飺�ж���l1Ϊ�Խ��ߵľ����Ƿ�����l2Ϊ�Խ��ߵľ����Ƿ��ཻ
 * 2. ����ʵ�飺l2�������˵��Ƿ����߶�l1������
 */
bool seg_seg_inter(Line seg1, Line seg2) {
    return
        sgn(max(seg1.s.x, seg1.e.x) - min(seg2.s.x, seg2.e.x)) >= 0 &&
        sgn(max(seg2.s.x, seg2.e.x) - min(seg1.s.x, seg1.e.x)) >= 0 &&
        sgn(max(seg1.s.y, seg1.e.y) - min(seg2.s.y, seg2.e.y)) >= 0 &&
        sgn(max(seg2.s.y, seg2.e.y) - min(seg1.s.y, seg1.e.y)) >= 0 &&
        sgn((seg2.s - seg1.e) ^ (seg1.s - seg1.e)) * sgn((seg2.e - seg1.e) ^ (seg1.s - seg1.e)) <= 0 &&
        sgn((seg1.s - seg2.e) ^ (seg2.s - seg2.e)) * sgn((seg1.e - seg2.e) ^ (seg2.s - seg2.e)) <= 0;
}

//�ж�ֱ�����߶��ཻ
bool seg_line_inter(Line &line, Line &seg) {
    return sgn((seg.s - line.e) ^ (line.s - line.e)) * sgn((seg.e - line.e) ^ (line.s - line.e)) <= 0;
}

//�㵽ֱ�ߵľ���, ���ش���
Point Point_to_Line(Point p, Point l) {
    double t = ((p - l.s) * (l.e - l.s)) / ((l.e - l.s) * (l.e - l.s));
    return Point(l.s.x + (l.e.x - l.s.x) * t, l.s.y + (l.e.y - l.s.y) * t);
}
//�㵽�߶εľ���
//���ص㵽�߶�����ĵ�
Point Point_to_Segment(Point p, Line seg) {
    double t = ((p - seg.s) * (seg.e - seg.s)) / ((seg.e - seg.s) * (seg.e - seg.s));
    if(t >= 0 && t <= 1)
        return Point(seg.s.x + (seg.e.x - seg.s.x) * t, seg.s.y + (seg.e.y - seg.s.y) * t);
    else if(sgn(dist(p, seg.s) - dist(p, seg.e) <= 0))
        return seg.s;
    else
        return seg.e;
}

//������vA��vB�ļн�(<= PI)
double angle(Point vA, Point vB) {
    double tmp = vA.norm() * vB.norm();
    if(sgn(tmp) != 0) return acos((vA * vB) / tmp);
    else return 0.0;
}

    }

        return Point(y * b.z - z * b.y, z * b.x - x * b.z, x * b.y - y * b.x);   //���
    }

        return Point(x * b, y * b, z * b);   //������

//�ж��ĵ㹲��(coplanar)
bool is_coplanar(Point p[4]) {
    Point normal = (p[0] - p[1]) ^ (p[1] - p[2]); //��ǰ����ķ�����
    return sgn(normal * (p[3] - p[0])) == 0; //�ж�����ĵ�������Ƿ��뷨������ֱ
}

///��
///��Plane
//����ȷ��һ��ƽ��, �䷨����(normal vector)Ϊ:
Point getPlaneNormal(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    return (a - b) ^ (a - c);
}

//���������
double V(Point a, Point b, Point c, Point d) {
    return ((a - b) ^ (a - c)) * (a - d) * (1.0 / 6.0);
}

double Area(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    return (a - b) * (a - c);
}
//�㵽ƽ��ľ��� $h = 3.0 \frac{V}{S}$
Point dis(Point p, Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    return fabs(3.0 * V(p, a, b, c) / S(a, b, c));
}

inline int readInt(void) {
    while (*readptr < '0' || *readptr > '9') readptr++;
    int r = *(readptr++) - '0';
    while (*readptr >= '0' && *readptr <= '9')

/* Main */
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[8000005];
int n,m,ecnt=0,src,sink,nm;
int dis[2*MAXN*MAXN],head[2*MAXN*MAXN],t[s<<1];
int row[MAXN][MAXN],col[MAXN][MAXN],slp[MAXN][MAXN],tag[MAXN][MAXN][2];
bool visit[2*MAXN*MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build2() {
    src=0,sink=1;
    int cnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            tag[i][j][0]=++cnt;
            tag[i][j][1]=++cnt;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[1][i][0],sink,row[1][i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][m-1][0],sink,col[i][m]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][1][1],src,col[i][1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[n-1][i][1],src,row[n][i]);
    }
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i-1][j][1],tag[i][j][0],row[i][j]);
        }
    for (int j=2; j<m; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            add(tag[i][j-1][0],tag[i][j][1],col[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i][j][0],tag[i][j][1],slp[i][j]);
        }
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    t[x+=s]=d;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)|1]);
}

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<t[(x<<1)|1])
            x<<=1;
        else
            x=(x<<1)|1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void dijkstra() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
    update(src,0);
    int x=src;
    while (t[x+s]<INF) {
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        update(x,INF);
        visit[x]=1;
        if (x==sink) return;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[s+v]) {
                update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
}

int main() {
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    initBufReader();
    readBuf();
#endif
    n=readInt();
    m=readInt();
    if(n==1 || m==1) {
        if(n>m) swap(n, m);
        int ans=INF;
        for(int i=1, a; i<m; i++) {
            a=readInt();
            if(ans>a) ans=a;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans==INF?0:ans);
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            row[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            col[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            slp[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    build2();
    dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n",dis[sink]);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 105
#define MAXN 105

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i+1]+=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i]%=10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} fib[MAXN],dp[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    fib[1]=num(1);
    fib[2]=num(3);
    dp[1]=num(1);
    dp[2]=num(5);
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        fib[i]=fib[i-1]+fib[i-2];
        dp[i]=fib[i]*fib[i];
        if ((i&1)^1) dp[i]=dp[i]-4;
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;
}
