#define MAXN 30005
#define MAXM 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int p,c,n,ans,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
bool visit[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void tag(int x) {
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) visit[e[now].to]=1;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    if (visit[x]) return;
    visit[x]=1;
    ans--;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) dfs(e[now].to);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&p,&c,&n);
    ans=p;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=c; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        tag(r);
    }
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1579.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 50005
#define S 262144
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXM * 2];
LL dis[22][MAXN], t[S * 2];
bool vis[22][MAXN];

void update(int x, LL v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m, K;

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dijkstra() {
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    update(1, 0);
    for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
        int k = (x - 1) / n, p = x - k * n;
        dis[k][p] = t[x + S];
        vis[k][p] = 1;
        update(x, INF);
        if (k <= K) for (int now = head[p]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[k][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + S] > dis[k][p] + e[now].w)
                    update(e[now].to + k * n, dis[k][p] + e[now].w);
                if (!vis[k + 1][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + n + S] > dis[k][p])
                    update(e[now].to + k * n + n, dis[k][p]);
            }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    dijkstra();
    printf("%lld\n", dis[K][n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1593.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
struct Rg {
    int l, r;
    Rg () :l(0), r(-1) {}
    Rg (int a) : l(a), r(a) {}
    Rg (int a, int b) : l(a), r(b) {}
    bool empty() {
        return l == 0 && r == -1;
    }
    bool geq(int x) {
        return r + 1 >= x + l;
    }
    bool operator < (Rg a) const {
        return (r +  a.l < l + a.r) || (r +  a.l == l + a.r && l > a.l);
    }
    bool operator == (Rg a) const {
        return l == a.l && r == a.r;
    }
    int size() {
        return r - l + 1;
    }
    Rg operator + (Rg a) {
        if (empty()) return a;
        if (a.empty()) return *this;
        return Rg(min(l, a.l), max(r, a.r));
    }
} E(0, -1);

struct Node {
    Rg hd, md, tl, fu;
    int l, r;
    bool f, c;
    void fillIt() {
        c = 0, f = 1;
        hd = md = tl = E;
    }
    void clrIt() {
        c = 1, f = 0;
        hd = md = tl = fu;
    }
} t[131072];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].hd = t[t[x].l].hd == t[t[x].l].fu ? t[t[x].l].fu + t[t[x].r].hd : t[t[x].l].hd;
    t[x].tl = t[t[x].r].tl == t[t[x].r].fu ? t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].fu : t[t[x].r].tl;
    t[x].md = max(max(max(t[x].hd, t[x].tl), max(t[t[x].l].md, t[t[x].r].md)), t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].hd);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].f) t[t[x].l].fillIt(), t[t[x].r].fillIt(), t[x].f = 0;
    else if (t[x].c) t[t[x].l].clrIt(), t[t[x].r].clrIt(), t[x].c = 0;
}

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].hd = t[x].tl = t[x].md = Rg(l);
    t[x].fu = t[x].md;
    return x;
}

void fill(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].fillIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) fill(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) fill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void clr(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].clrIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) clr(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) clr(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int d) {
    if (l == r) return fill(1, 1, n, l, l), l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (t[t[x].l].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, d);
    else if (!t[t[x].l].tl.empty() && t[t[x].l].tl.size() + t[t[x].r].hd.size() >= d) ret = t[t[x].l].tl.l, fill(1, 1, n, t[t[x].l].tl.l, t[t[x].l].tl.l + d - 1);
    else if (t[t[x].r].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, d);
    else assert(0);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, d; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) read(d), printf("%d\n", t[1].md.geq(d) ? query(1, 1, n, d) : 0);
        else read(x), read(d), clr(1, 1, n, x, x + d - 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1597.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define MAXN 50005

struct Rect {
    int x, y;
    bool operator < (Rect a) const {
        if (x != a.x) return x < a.x;
        else return y < a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], sta[MAXN];

int n, m = 0;
LL f[MAXN], xx[MAXN], yy[MAXN];

LD slope(int u, int v) {
    return LD(f[u] - f[v]) / (yy[v] - yy[u]);
}

struct monoStack {
    int l, r;
    int v[MAXN];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    void maintain(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < xx[x]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(x, v[r]) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = x;
    }
} s;

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d%d", &a[i].x, &a[i].y);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (m && a[i].y >= sta[m].y) m--;
        sta[++m] = a[i];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        xx[i] = sta[i].x;
        yy[i - 1] = sta[i].y;
    }
    f[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        s.maintain(i);
        int to = s[s.l];
        f[i] = f[to] + xx[i] * yy[to];
        s.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1601.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 305
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
struct edge {
    int u,v,w;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,ecnt=0,f[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 1;
    if (f[fu]<fv) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int w;
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt]=edge(0,i,w);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            int w;
            read(w);
            if (i!=j) e[++ecnt]=edge(i,j,w);
        }
    sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (merge(e[j].u,e[j].v)) j++;
        ans+=e[j].w;
        j++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1602.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,ecnt=0,q,fa[MAXN][15],dep[MAXN],dis[MAXN],head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int k=1; k<=12; k++) {
        fa[x][k]=fa[fa[x][k-1]][k-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) u=fa[u][k];
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&q);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    fa[1][0]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    dep[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        printf("%d\n",dis[u]+dis[v]-2*dis[getLCA(u,v)]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1603.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,head[MAXN],val[MAXN],ecnt=0;
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            val[e[now].to]=val[x]^e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w^1);
        add(v,u,w^1);
    }
    val[1]=1;
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%d\n",val[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1604.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 123456789012345ll
typedef long long LL;
struct data {
    LL x,y;
    int id;
    data() {}
    data(LL b):x(0),y(b),id(0) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];
bool cmp(data q,data w) {
    return q.x<w.x;
}
int n,C,f[MAXN],ans,cnt[MAXN];
multiset<data> Tree;
multiset<data>::iterator it;
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
        ans--;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&C);
    ans=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x,y;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        a[i].x=x+y;
        a[i].y=x-y;
        a[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,cmp);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    Tree.insert(a[1]);
    Tree.insert(data(-INF));
    Tree.insert(data(INF));
    for (int i=2,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (a[i].x-a[j].x>C) {
            it=Tree.find(a[j]);
            Tree.erase(it);
            j++;
        }
        it=Tree.lower_bound(a[i]);
        data x=*it;
        if (x.y-a[i].y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        x=*--it;
        if (a[i].y-x.y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        Tree.insert(a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d ",ans);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cnt[getf(i)]++;
    int MAX=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) MAX=max(cnt[i],MAX);
    printf("%d\n",MAX);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1605.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1005
const int dy[]= {0,1,-1,0},dx[]= {1,0,0,-1};
const char dd[]= {'E','N','S','W'};
struct statu {
    int t,x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b,int c):t(a),x(b),y(c) {}
};
int n,m,k;
int x[1050],y[1050],dp[32][64][64];
LL from[32][64][64];
bool ok[1050][1050],visit[32][64][64];
queue <statu> q;
string seq;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",x+i,y+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&xx,&yy);
        ok[xx+31][yy+31]=1;
    }
    memset(from,127,sizeof(from));
    q.push(statu(0,31,31));
    from[0][31][31]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        statu now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        LL st=from[now.t][now.x][now.y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=now.x+dx[d],toy=now.y+dy[d],temp=dp[now.t][now.x][now.y];
            for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
                if (ok[tox+x[i]][toy+y[i]]) temp++;
            }
            if (temp>dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]) {
                dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]=temp;
                from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            } else if (temp==dp[now.t+1][tox][toy] && from[now.t+1][tox][toy]>((st<<2)|d)) from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            if (!visit[now.t+1][tox][toy] && now.t+1<k) {
                q.push(statu(now.t+1,tox,toy));
            }
            visit[now.t+1][tox][toy]=1;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++)
            ans=max(ans,dp[k][i][j]);
    if (ans==0) {
        printf("0\n");
        for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) putchar('E');
        putchar('\n');
        return 0;
    }
    LL sta=0x7fffffffffffffffll;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++) {
            if (dp[k][i][j]==ans) {
                sta=min(sta,from[k][i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    for (int i=k-1; i>-1; i--) {
        putchar(dd[3&(sta>>(i<<1))]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++)
            ans=max(ans,dp[k][i][j]);
    if (ans==0) {
        printf("0\n");
        for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) putchar('E');
        putchar('\n');
        return 0;
    }
    LL sta=0x7fffffffffffffffll;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++) {
            if (dp[k][i][j]==ans) {
                sta=min(sta,from[k][i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    for (int i=k-1; i>-1; i--) {
        putchar(dd[3&(sta>>(i<<1))]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1610.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205

struct point {
    int x,y;
} p[MAXN];

int n,ans=0,cnt=0;
double k[MAXN*MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (p[i].x==p[j].x) {
                ans=1;
            } else {
                k[++cnt]=double(p[i].y-p[j].y)/double(p[i].x-p[j].x);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(k+1,k+cnt+1);
    k[0]=k[1]-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (k[i]-k[i-1]>10e-8) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1611.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {0,1,-1,0,0};
int map[305][305];
int dis[305][305];

int n;
void mark(int x,int y,int c) {
    for (int i=0; i<=4; i++) {
        int tox=x+dx[i],toy=y+dy[i];
        map[tox][toy]=min(map[tox][toy],c);
    }
}
struct statu {
    int x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
};
queue<statu> q;

int main() {
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,x,y,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&c);
        mark(x+1,y+1,c-1);
    }
    if (map[1][1]<0) {
        puts("-1");
        return 0;
    }
    dis[1][1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,1));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().x,y=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        if (map[x][y]==0x1f1f1f1f) {
            printf("%d\n",dis[x][y]);
            return 0;
        }
        for (int d=1; d<=4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && toy && dis[tox][toy]==0x1f1f1f1f && map[tox][toy]>dis[x][y]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }
    puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1612.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 105
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,ans=0,map[MAXN][MAXN];
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) map[i][i]=1;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        map[u][v]=1;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=n; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (map[i][k])
                for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) if (map[k][j]) map[i][j]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int tot=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]||map[j][i]) tot++;
        }
        if (tot==n) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1614.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXP 10005
#define MAXN 1005
#define INF 522133279
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXP<<1];

struct statu {
    int x,dep;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _x,int _d):x(_x),dep(_d) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return dep<a.dep;
    }
};

int n,p,k,ecnt;
int head[MAXN],visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline bool check(int val) {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    memset(visit,31,sizeof(visit));
    visit[1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x;
        if (x==n) return 1;
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to,dis=visit[x]+(e[now].w>val);
            if (visit[v]>dis && dis<=k) {
                visit[v]=dis;
                q.push(statu(v,dis));
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&p,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=p; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    int l=0,r=1000001,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            r=mid;
        else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>1000000) l=-1;
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1615.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1100
int n,fa[MAXN],S,T;
double x[MAXN],y[MAXN],r[MAXN],x_t,y_t,s[MAXN],ans=0;;

bool flag=0;

double dis(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt((x[a]-x[b])*(x[a]-x[b])+(y[a]-y[b])*(y[a]-y[b]));
}

void dfs(int p) {
    ans+=s[p];
    if (p==T) {
        flag=1;
        printf("%d\n",int(ans));
        return;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (abs(dis(p,i)-(r[i]+r[p]))<1e-8 && i!=fa[p]) {
            fa[i]=p;
            s[i]=s[p]*r[p]/r[i];
            dfs(i);
            if (flag) return;
        }
    }
    ans-=s[p];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lf%lf",&n,&x_t,&y_t);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",x+i,y+i,r+i);
        if (x[i]==0 && y[i]==0) S=i;
        else if (x[i]==x_t && y[i]==y_t) T=i;
    }
    s[S]=10000;
    fa[S]=0;
    dfs(S);
    return 0;
}

    for (int t=1; t<=T; t++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (map[i][j]) dp[t][i][j]=dp[t-1][i-1][j]+dp[t-1][i+1][j]+dp[t-1][i][j-1]+dp[t-1][i][j+1];

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0,1,-1,1,-1},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1,1,1,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 705
struct point {
    int x,y,v;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
} p[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,m,pcnt=0,ans=0;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN][MAXN];
void dfs(int x,int y) {
    visit[x][y]=1;
    for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (!visit[tox][toy] && map[tox][toy]<=map[x][y]) dfs(tox,toy);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            p[++pcnt].x=i,p[pcnt].y=j,p[pcnt].v=map[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n+1; i++) visit[i][0]=visit[i][m+1]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) visit[0][i]=visit[n+1][i]=1;
    sort(p+1,p+pcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (!visit[p[i].x][p[i].y]) {
            dfs(p[i].x,p[i].y);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1622.cpp

#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
int n,m,len[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],slen;
char a[MAXN][MAXN],s[MAXN];

bool check(int x) {
    for (int i=0,j=0; i<len[x]; i++) {
        if (a[x][i]==s[j]) {
            j++;
            if (j==slen) return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",a[i]);
        len[i]=(int)strlen(a[i]);
        for (int j=0; j<len[i]; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]>='a') a[i][j]-='a'-'A';
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s);
        slen=(int)strlen(s);
        for (int j=0; j<slen; j++) {
            if (s[j]>='a') s[j]-='a'-'A';
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (check(j)) cnt[j]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",cnt[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1626.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
typedef long long LL;
int n,m,f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}
bool visit[MAXN];
double dis[MAXN],ans=0;
LL power(LL x) {
    return x*x;
}
LL X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
double dist(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt(power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]));
}
void prim() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) dis[i]=1e9;
    int x=1,to;
    double mindis;
    while (1) {
        visit[x]=1;
        to=-1;
        mindis=1e10;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                if (getf(i)==getf(x)) {
                    dis[i]=0;
                } else {
                    dis[i]=min(dis[i],dist(x,i));
                }
                if (dis[i]<mindis) {
                    mindis=dis[i];
                    to=i;
                }
            }
        }
        if (to==-1) break;
        ans+=mindis;
        merge(x,to);
        x=to;
    }
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=n; i++) {
        read(xx);
        read(yy);
        X[i]=xx,Y[i]=yy;
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u,v);
    }
    prim();
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1627.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {1,-1,0,0};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int tx,ty,n,dis[1024][1024];
bool map[1024][1024];
queue <int> q;
int bfs() {
    map[512][512]=1;
    dis[512][512]=0;
    q.push((512<<11)|512);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front()>>11,y=q.front()&2047;
        q.pop();
        if (x==tx && y==ty) return dis[x][y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && tox<1023 && toy && toy<1023 && !map[tox][toy]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                map[tox][toy]=1;
                q.push((tox<<11)|toy);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    read(tx);
    read(ty);
    read(n);
    tx+=512,ty+=512;
    memset(dis,0x3f,sizeof(dis));
    for (int i=1,a,b; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        map[a+512][b+512]=1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",bfs());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1630.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 1000000
int T,A,S,B;
int dp[2][100005],sum[2][100005],N[1005];

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(A);
    read(S);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=A; i++) {
        read(x);
        N[x]++;
    }
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=A; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        int now=i&1,prev=now^1;
        sum[now][0]=1;
        dp[now][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            if (j>N[i]) dp[now][j]=MOD+sum[prev][j]-sum[prev][j-N[i]-1];
            else dp[now][j]=sum[prev][j];
            if (dp[now][j]>=MOD) dp[now][j]-=MOD;
            sum[now][j]=sum[now][j-1]+dp[now][j];
            if (sum[now][j]>=MOD) sum[now][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=S; i<=B; i++) {
        ans+=dp[T&1][i];
        if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1631.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 100005
struct Readedge {
    int u,v,w;
} re[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];
#define TOP 1023
struct queue {
    int v[TOP+1],head,tail;
    queue():head(1048576),tail(1048576) {}
    int &operator [](int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&TOP]=x;
    }
    void push_front(int x) {
        v[(--head)&TOP]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&TOP];
    }
} q;
int n,m,ecnt,X,dis[MAXN],head[MAXN],dd[MAXN],ans=0;
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}
bool inq[MAXN];
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[X]=0;
    q.push_back(X);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[x]+e[now].w<dis[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[q.front()]) q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    else q.push_back(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(X);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(re[i].u);
        read(re[i].v);
        read(re[i].w);
    }
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].u,re[i].v,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) dd[i]=dis[i];
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].v,re[i].u,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) ans=max(ans,dd[i]+dis[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1632.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,2,-2,1,-1,2,-2},dy[]= {2,2,1,1,-2,-2,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int m,n,map[35][35],add[35][35],dis[35][35],sx,sy,ex,ey;
long long cnt[35][35];
bool inq[35][35];
bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<=m && y>0 && y<=n;
}

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    q.push((sx<<10)|sy);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(add,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[sx][sy]=0;
    add[sx][sy]=0;
    cnt[sx][sy]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int nowx=q.front()>>10,nowy=q.front()&1023;
        q.pop();
        inq[nowx][nowy]=0;
        for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
            int tox=nowx+dx[d],toy=nowy+dy[d];
            if (!inrange(tox,toy) || map[tox][toy]==2) continue;
            int toadd=add[nowx][nowy]+(map[tox][toy]==0);
            if (toadd<add[tox][toy]) {
                add[tox][toy]=toadd;
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                    inq[tox][toy]=1;
                    q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                }
            } else if (toadd==add[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1<dis[tox][toy]) {
                    dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                    cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                } else if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1==dis[tox][toy]) {
                    cnt[tox][toy]+=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            if (map[i][j]==3) {
                sx=i,sy=j;
            } else if (map[i][j]==4) {
                ex=i,ey=j;
            }
        }
    spfa();
    if (add[ex][ey]>n*m) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n%d\n%lld\n",add[ex][ey],dis[ex][ey],cnt[ex][ey]);
    return 0;

    }

#define MAXN 10005
struct qqq {
    int L,R;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        if (L!=a.L) return L<a.L;
        else return R<a.R;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n,fun,h,m,d[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(fun);
    read(h);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].L);
        read(q[i].R);
        if (q[i].L>q[i].R) swap(q[i].L,q[i].R);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    q[0].L=q[0].R=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].L==q[i].R) continue;
        if (q[i].L==q[i-1].L && q[i].R==q[i-1].R) continue;
        d[q[i].L+1]--;
        d[q[i].R]++;
    }
    int now=h;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        now+=d[i];
        printf("%d\n",now);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1636.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
int n,q;
int a[MAXN];
int Minv[MAXN][20],Maxv[MAXN][20];

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int x=r-l+1;
    int tt=log_2(x);
    return max(Maxv[l][tt],Maxv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt])-min(Minv[l][tt],Minv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),Minv[i][0]=a[i],Maxv[i][0]=a[i];
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=n; k++) {
        int tt=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            Minv[i][k]=min(Minv[i][k-1],Minv[i+tt][k-1]);
            Maxv[i][k]=max(Maxv[i][k-1],Maxv[i+tt][k-1]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1637.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 50005
struct cow {
    int id, x;
    bool operator < (cow a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n;
int tmp[MAXN * 2], tmp2[MAXN * 2];

void work(int fir[], int las[]) {
    int ans = 0, sum = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i].id) sum++;
        else sum--;
        if (i < n && fir[sum] > a[i + 1].x) fir[sum] = a[i + 1].x;
        las[sum] = a[i].x;
    }
    for (int i = -n; i <= n; i++) ans = max(ans, las[i] - fir[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].id);
        read(a[i].x);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    memset(tmp, 0x3f, sizeof(tmp));
    work(tmp + MAXN, tmp2 + MAXN);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1638.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
} E[MAXN];
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, in[MAXN];
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], g[MAXN], *dp = f;

queue <int> q;

void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!in[i]) q.push(i), dp[i] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!(--in[e[now].to])) q.push(e[now].to);
            dp[e[now].to] += dp[x];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(E[i].u), read(E[i].v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].u, E[i].v);
    solve();
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    memset(in, 0, sizeof in);
    ecnt = 1, dp = g;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].v, E[i].u);
    solve();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans = max(ans, f[E[i].u] * g[E[i].v]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

int n, m;
int a[100005];

bool check(int mid) {
    int cnt = 1, now = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (now + a[i] > mid) now = 0, cnt++;
        now += a[i];
    }
    return cnt <= m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int l = 0, r = 0;
    for (int i =1 ; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), l = max(l, a[i]), r += a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1644.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 105
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

char s[N];
int n, sx, sy, tx, ty, G[N][N];
int dis[N][N][4];

struct Node {
    int x, y, d;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int b, int c) : x(a), y(b), d(c) {}
};

deque <Node> q;

void bfs() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) dis[sx][sy][i] = 0, q.push_back(Node(sx, sy, i));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node now = q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            if (dis[now.x][now.y][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d))
                dis[now.x][now.y][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
            int tox = now.x + dx[d], toy = now.y + dy[d];
            if (G[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[tox][toy][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d)) {
                    dis[tox][toy][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
                    if (now.d == d) q.push_front(Node(tox, toy, d));
                    else q.push_back(Node(tox, toy, d));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = INF;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ans = min(ans, dis[tx][ty][i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            G[i][j] = s[j] != 'x';
            if (s[j] == 'A') sx = i, sy = j;
            else if (s[j] == 'B') tx = i, ty = j;
        }
    }
    bfs();
    return 0;
}

#include <cstring>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

struct Node {
    int l, r, tag, v;
} t[MAXN * 77];

int tcnt = 1;

void pushdown(int &x, int tag) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (tag <= t[x].v) return;
    t[x].tag = tag, t[x].v = tag;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (v <= t[x].v) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].tag = v;
        t[x].v = v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(t[x].l, t[x].tag);
    pushdown(t[x].r, t[x].tag);
    //zuy zxhujyujhzuijuiiiiikjjjjjjjhggfv
    int mid = (l +  r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr, v);
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

LL ans = 0;

void dfs(int x, int l, int r, int tag) {
    tag = max(tag, t[x].tag);
    if (l == r) {
        ans += tag;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].l) dfs(t[x].l, l, mid, tag);
    else ans += LL(mid - l + 1) * tag;
    if (t[x].r) dfs(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, tag);
    else ans += LL(r - mid) * tag;
    return;
}

#define MAX 1000000001

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(v);
        update(1, 1, MAX, l, r - 1, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 1, MAX, 0);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int dis[200319];
int n, k;

queue<int> q;

int main() {
    memset(dis, 31, sizeof dis);
    read(n);
    read(k);
    dis[n] = 0;
    q.push(n);
    while (1) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x == k) {
            printf("%d\n", dis[x]);
            return 0;
        }
        if (x < k && dis[2 * x] > dis[x] + 1) dis[2 * x] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(2 * x);
        if (x > 0 && dis[x - 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x - 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x - 1);
        if (x < k && dis[x + 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x + 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x + 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1647.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 15
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n, m, ans = INF, tot;
int vis[MAXN][MAXN];
bool G[MAXN][MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXN], b[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void pop(int x, int y) {
    tot++;
    a[x][y] ^= 1;
    x && (a[x - 1][y] ^= 1);
    y && (a[x][y - 1] ^= 1);
    x + 1 != m && (a[x + 1][y] ^= 1);
    y + 1 != n && (a[x][y + 1] ^= 1);
}

void update(int st) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) b[i][j] = vis[i][j] == st;
}

void work(int st) {
    tot = 0;
    memcpy(a, G, sizeof G);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((st >> i) & 1) pop(0, i), vis[0][i] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[i - 1][j]) pop(i, j), vis[i][j] = st;
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[m - 1][j]) return;
    if (tot < ans) ans = tot, update(st);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            G[i][j] = x;
        }
    memset(vis, -1, sizeof vis);
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) work(i);
    if (ans == INF) puts("IMPOSSIBLE");
    else {
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                printf("%d%c", b[i][j], j == n - 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
            }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 10];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int K, n, m, p[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a, b;

void dfs(int x) {
    b[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!b[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(K);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(p[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    a.set();
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        b.reset();
        dfs(p[i]);
        a &= b;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)a.count());
    return 0;
}

#define M 1005

int L, n, C;
int f[M][M];

int main() {
    read(L);
    read(n);
    read(C);
    for (int i = 1, x, w, v, c; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(w);
        read(v);
        read(c);
        G[x + w].push_back(mp(x, mp(v, c)));
    }
    memset(f, 200, sizeof f);
    f[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= C; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (int)G[i].size(); k++) {
                int x = G[i][k].fir, v = G[i][k].sec.fir, c = G[i][k].sec.sec;
                if (j >= c && f[x][j - c] >= 0) f[i][j] = max(f[i][j], f[x][j - c] + v);
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) ans = max(ans, f[L][i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1650.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 50003;

int n, m, l, a[maxn];

int checkStone(int lt) {
    int s(0), po(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        if (a[i] - po >= lt)
            po = a[i];
        else
            ++ s;
    if (l - po < lt)
        ++ s;
    return s;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &n, &m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        scanf("%d", a + i);
    sort(a, a + n) ;
    int le(0), re(l);
    while (le < re) {
        int md((le + re + 1) >> 1);
        if (checkStone(md) > m)
            re = md - 1;
        else
            le = md;
    }
    printf("%d\n", le);
    return 0;
}

        for (int i = 1, j = i + l; j <= n; i++, j++) {
            dp[i][j - 1] = max(dp[i][j - 1], dp[i][j] + a[j] * (n - l));

//BZOJ1653.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 12

int f[N][N];
int a[N], vis[N];
int n;

void solve(int x, int sum) {
    if (x > n) {
        if (sum) return;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d%c", a[i], i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        exit(0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n && i * f[n][x] + n - x <= sum; i++) if (!vis[i]) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            a[x] = i;
            solve(x + 1, sum - i * f[n][x]);
            vis[i] = 0;
        }
}

int main() {
    int sum;
    read(n);
    read(sum);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i][1] = 1;
        for (int j = 2; j <= i; j++) {
            f[i][j] = f[i - 1][j] + f[i - 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    solve(1, sum);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1654.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
#define MAXM 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXM * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, stp = 0, ans = 0;
int dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
bool inq[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    sta[++top] = x;
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to && !dfn[e[now].to]) {
            e[now ^ 1].to = 0;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            e[now ^ 1].to = x;
            low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        } else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        ans += sta[top] != x;
        while (sta[top--] != x);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!dfn[i]) dfs(i);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1655.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

int n, K;

#define TOP 1000000000000000000ll

struct Num {
    int top;
    LL a[233];
    Num () {}
    Num (int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        top = 0;
        a[0] = x;
    }
    LL operator [] (const int x) const {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator += (const Num &b) {
        top = max(top, b.top);
        for (int i = 0; i <= top; i++) {
            a[i] += b[i];
            if (a[i] >= TOP) {
                a[i] -= TOP;
                a[i + 1]++;
                top += i == top;
            }
        }
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lld", a[top]);
        for (int i = top - 1; ~i; i--) printf("%18lld", a[i]);
    }
} dp[1005];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) dp[j] += dp[j - i];
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int n;
int h[50139], v[50139], sta[50139], top;
long long ans[50139];
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]), read(v[i]);
    top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (top && h[sta[top]] <= h[i]) top--;
        if (top) ans[sta[top]] += v[i];
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (top && h[sta[top]] <= h[i]) top--;
        if (top) ans[sta[top]] += v[i];
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    long long ma = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ma = max(ans[i], ma);
    printf("%lld\n", ma);
    return 0;
}

inline void readchar(char &_ch) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    _ch = char(_c);
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 60319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'A' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int k = 0, i, j = 1; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j]  == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, len;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) readchar(s[i]);
    s[n + 1] = 'Z' + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[n + 2 + i] = s[n - i];
    len = 2 * n + 1;
    getsa(s, sa, len, 27);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int t = 1, i = 1, j = n + 2; t <= n; t++) {
        if (rk[i] < rk[j]) putchar(s[i++]);
        else putchar(s[j++]);
        if (t != n && t % 80 == 0) putchar('\n');
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1697.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 10005

int n, a[MAXN], b[MAXN], hh[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int find(int v) {
    int l = 1, r = n;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >>1;
        if (b[mid] >= v) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

long long ans = 0;

void solve(int st) {
    vis[st] = 1;
    long long sum = b[st], Min = b[st], len = 1;
    int x = st;
    while (a[x] != st) {
        x = a[x];
        vis[x] = 1;
        len++;
        sum += b[x], Min = min(Min, (long long)b[x]);
    }
    ans += sum + min((len - 2) * Min, Min + (len + 1) * b[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), b[i] = a[i];
    sort(b + 1, b + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = find(a[i]), hh[a[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!vis[i]) solve(i);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int x=r-l+1;
    int tt=log_2(x);
    return max(Maxv[l][tt],Maxv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt])-min(Minv[l][tt],Minv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt]);
}

        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            Minv[i][k]=min(Minv[i][k-1],Minv[i+tt][k-1]);
            Maxv[i][k]=max(Maxv[i][k-1],Maxv[i+tt][k-1]);

        read(r);

    }
    return 0;
}

    int top=1<<m;
    for (int i=0; i<top; i++) {

    }

                    dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][j];

                }

//BZOJ1756.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 500319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node (): l(0), r(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
} t[1048576];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].head = max(t[t[x].l].head, t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].head);
    t[x].tail = max(t[t[x].r].tail, t[t[x].r].sum + t[t[x].l].tail);
    t[x].mid = max(max(t[x].head, t[x].tail),max(max(t[t[x].l].mid, t[t[x].r].mid), t[t[x].l].tail + t[t[x].r].head));
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        scanf("%d", &t[x].sum);
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum;
    }
    return x;
}

void modify(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum = v;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    }
}

Node combine(Node L, Node R) {
    Node ret;
    ret.sum = L.sum + R.sum;
    ret.head = max(L.head, L.sum + R.head);
    ret.tail = max(R.tail, R.sum + L.tail);
    ret.mid = max(max(ret.head, ret.tail),max(max(L.mid, R.mid), L.tail + R.head));
    return ret;
}

Node query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr)
        return Node(t[x]);
    Node ret;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = combine(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql),qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (op == 2) {
            modify(1, 1, n, l, r);
        } else {
            if (l > r) swap(l, r);
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r).mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1758.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define MAXN 100319
#define INF 1e9

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

inline int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                flag = 0, rt = e[now].to;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

vector <int> rt[MAXN];

int n, L, R, Rt;
D mid, ans, A[MAXN];
int maxdep;

inline void Count(int u, D d) {
    static int q[MAXN], dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], dq[MAXN];
    static D dis[MAXN];
    register int i, j, top, he = 0, ta = 0, x;
    q[top = 1] = u;
    dep[1] = 1;
    dis[1] = d;
    fa[1] = u;
    for (i = 1; i <= top; i++) {
        x = q[i];
        for (j = head[x]; j; j = e[j].next) {
            if (!vis[e[j].to] && e[j].to != fa[i]) {
                q[++top] = e[j].to;
                fa[top] = x;
                dep[top] = dep[i] + 1;
                dis[top] = dis[i] + e[j].w;
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 1, j = min(R - 1, maxdep); i <= top; i = x) {
        x = i;
        D mx = -INF;
        while (x <= top && dep[x] == dep[i]) mx = max(mx, dis[x++]);
        while (j >= 0 && j + dep[i] >= L) {
            while (he < ta && A[dq[ta - 1]] < A[j]) ta--;
            dq[ta++] = j--;
        }
        while (he < ta && dq[he] + dep[i] > R) he++;
        if (he < ta) ans = max(ans, (A[dq[he]] + mx + mid * dq[he]) / (dq[he] + dep[i]));
    }
    maxdep = max(maxdep, dep[top]);
    for (i = 1; i <= top; i++) A[dep[i]] = max(A[dep[i]], dis[i] - dep[i] * mid);
}

void solve(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    maxdep = 0, A[0] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) Count(e[now].to, e[now].w);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxdep; i++) A[i] = -INF;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)rt[x].size(); i++) solve(rt[x][i]);
}

inline void work() {
    memset(vis + 1, 0, n);
    ans = -INF;
    solve(Rt);
}

void pre(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x], tmp; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            tmp = getrt(e[now].to);
            rt[x].push_back(tmp);
            pre(tmp);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    A[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) A[i] = -INF;
    Rt = getrt(1);
    pre(Rt);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    double l = 1, r = 1e6;
    mid = ans = 1;
    while (r - l > 2e-4) {
        l = mid = ans;
        work();
        r = ans;
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n", l + 1e-5);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1770.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
typedef long long LL;

struct QAQ {
    LL v;
    int cnt;
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return cnt > a.cnt;
    }
};

void work(LL a[], int &top, QAQ ans[], int tot) {
    top = 1 << tot;
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tot; j++) {
            if ((i>>j)&1) ans[i].v ^= a[j], ans[i].cnt++;
        }
    }
}

#define MAXN 40
int n, m, top[2];
LL a[MAXN];
QAQ ans[2][262144];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = 1ll<<i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        u--, v--;
        a[u] |= 1ll<<v;
        a[v] |= 1ll<<u;
    }
    int mid = n / 2;
    work(a, top[0], ans[0], mid);
    work(a + mid, top[1], ans[1], n - mid);
    LL hh = (1ll<<n) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < top[0]; i++) {
        ans[0][i].v ^= hh;
    }
    sort(ans[0], ans[0] + top[0]);
    sort(ans[1], ans[1] + top[1]);
    int i = top[0] - 1, j = top[1] - 1, ret = n;
    while (i >= 0 && j >= 0) {
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v < ans[1][j].v) j--;
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v > ans[1][j].v) i--;
        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v == ans[1][j].v) {
            ret = min(ret, ans[0][i].cnt + ans[1][j].cnt);
            while (i && ans[0][i - 1].v == ans[0][i].v) i--;
            while (j && ans[1][j - 1].v == ans[1][j].v) j--;
            i--, j--;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1798.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <ctime>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
int n,m,tcnt=0;
LL MOD;
int a[MAXN];
struct node {
    int l,r;
    LL v,mul,add;
} t[262144];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].mul=1;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
    } else {
        scanf("%lld",&t[now].v);
        t[now].v%=MOD;
    }
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int now,int lsiz,int rsiz) {
    if (t[now].mul!=1) {
        t[lch].add=(t[lch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].add=(t[rch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].mul=(t[lch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].mul=(t[rch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[now].mul=1;
    }
    if (t[now].add) {
        t[lch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[rch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v+t[now].add*lsiz)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v+t[now].add*rsiz)%MOD;
        t[now].add=0;
    }
}

void update_mul(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].mul=(t[now].mul*v)%MOD;
        t[now].add=(t[now].add*v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_mul(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_mul(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

void update_add(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].add=(t[now].add+v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v+(r-l+1)*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_add(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_add(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

LL query(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[now].v;
    LL ret=0;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret%MOD;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld",&n,&MOD);
    build(1,n);
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        LL k;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&op,&x,&y);
        if (op==2) {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_add(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(1,1,n,x,y));
        } else {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_mul(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005

    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) lch=update(lch,l,mid,v);
        else rch=update(rch,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    lr[x]=++dfn;
    rt[dfn]=update(rt[dfn-1],1,n,h[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) dfs(e[now].to,x);
    }
    rr[x]=dfn;
}

int kth(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) return rec[l];
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=k) return kth(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,k);
    else return kth(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,k-lv);
}

        read(x);

        printf("%d\n",kth(rt[lr[x]-1],rt[rr[x]],1,n,k));
    }
    return 0;
}

struct edge {
    int u,v,dis;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),dis(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return dis<a.dis;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN/2];

int n,k,ecnt,f[MAXN],X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
#define power(x) ((x)*(x))
int dis(int a,int b) {
    return power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]);
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu]>f[fv]) swap(fu,fv);
    f[fu]+=f[fv];
    f[fv]=fu;
    return 1;
}

int main() {

    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {

        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            e[++ecnt]=edge(i,j,dis(i,j));
        }
    sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,tot=n-k; i<=ecnt; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) if (tot--==0) {
                printf("%.2lf\n",sqrt(e[i].dis));
                return 0;
            }
    }
    while (1) puts("t360yh");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1822.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define N 233
#define eps 1e-9
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

double power(double x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct Witch {
    int x, y, r, t;
} w[N];

struct Fairy {
    int x, y;
} f[N];

struct Tree {
    int x, y, r;
} t[N];

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point (int a = 0, int b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    template <class X, class Y> Point (X a, Y b) : x(b.x - a.x), y(b.y - a.y) {}
    int operator ^ (Point b) const {
        return x * b.x + y * b.y;
    }
};

template <class X, class Y> double dis(X &_a, Y &_b) {
    return power(_a.x - _b.x) + power(_a.y - _b.y);
}

bool check(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    return (Point(a, b) ^ Point(a, c)) >= 0 && (Point(b, a) ^ Point(b, c)) >= 0;
}

double getdis(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    double A = b.y - a.y, B = a.x - b.x, C = -(A * a.x + B * a.y);
    return abs(A * c.x + B * c.y + C) / sqrt(A * A + B * B);
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[N * N * 2];

int head[N + N], cur[N + N], tag[N + N], ecnt = 1, S = 0, T = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, ff
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, K, tt = 0;
bool G[N][N], ok[N];

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

bool ak(int mid) {
    memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(i + n + 1, T, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i + 1, w[i].t == 0 ? INF : 1 + mid / w[i].t);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) add(i + 1, j + n + 1, 1);
        }
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memcpy(cur, head, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret == m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(w[i].x), read(w[i].y), read(w[i].r), w[i].r *= w[i].r, read(w[i].t), tt = max(tt, w[i].t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(f[i].x), read(f[i].y);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(t[i].x), read(t[i].y), read(t[i].r);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (dis(w[i], f[j]) - eps < w[i].r) {
                bool flag = 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                    double mindis;
                    if (check(w[i], f[j], t[k])) mindis = getdis(w[i], f[j], t[k]);
                    else mindis = sqrt(min(dis(w[i], t[k]), dis(f[j], t[k])));
                    if (mindis - eps < t[k].r) {
                        flag = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                G[i][j] = flag;
                ok[j] |= flag;
            } else G[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!ok[i]) return puts("-1"), 0;
    int l = 0, r = tt * (n - 1), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ak(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1833.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

struct data {
    long long ans[10];
} ansa,ansb;

long long a,b;
inline long long calc(long long x,int dig) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long front=x,now=0,rear=0,ten=0,ret=0;
    if (dig==0) {
        while (front) {
            rear+=now*ten;
            if (ten) ten*=10;
            else ten=1;
            now=front%10;
            front/=10;
            if (now>dig) {
                ret+=front*ten;
            } else if (now==dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten+rear+1;
            } else if (now<dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    while (front) {
        rear+=now*ten;
        if (ten) ten*=10;
        else ten=1;
        now=front%10;
        front/=10;
        if (now>dig) {
            ret+=(front+1)*ten;
        } else if (now==dig) {
            ret+=front*ten+rear+1;
        } else if (now<dig) {
            ret+=front*ten;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void work(long long x,data &ans) {
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++)
        ans.ans[i]=calc(x,i);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld",&a,&b);
    work(a-1,ansa);
    work(b,ansb);
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {
        printf("%lld%c",ansb.ans[i]-ansa.ans[i],i==9?'\n':' ');
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1834.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 5005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,k,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,nocost=0,tot=0;
    while (tot<k) {
        spfa();
        if (dis[n]) {
            ans+=dis[n];
            tot++;
        } else {
            nocost++;
        }
        for (int x=n; x!=1; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",nocost,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,f,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&f,&w);
        add(u,v,0,f);
        add(u,v,w,k);
    }
    work();
    return 0;
}
