/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 22005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, lazy;
} t[MAXN * 3];

vector < pair<int, int> > a[MAXN];
int n, k, tcnt = 0, g[MAXN], C[MAXN], D[MAXN], W[MAXN], S[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

void rebuild(int x, int l, int r) {
    t[x].lazy = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rebuild(t[x].l, l, mid);
        rebuild(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = g[l];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = INF;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr > mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy += v, t[x].v += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    upd(x);
}

void print(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l < r) {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        print(t[x].l, l, mid);
        print(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else printf("at %d : %d\n", l, t[x].v);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(k);
    n++, k++, D[0] = -INF, D[1] = 0, D[n] = INF;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) read(D[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(S[i]);
    for (int i = 1, st, ed; i < n; i++) {
        read(W[i]);
        st = int(upper_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] + S[i]) - D) - 1;
        ed = int(lower_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] - S[i]) - D) - 1;
        //printf("st : %d ed : %d\n", st, ed);
        a[st].push_back(make_pair(ed, W[i]));
    }
    memset(g, INF, sizeof g);
    g[0] = 0;
    build(0, n);
    for (int q = 1; q <= k; q++) {
        rebuild(1, 0, n);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int ret = query(1, 0, n, 0, i - 1);
            //printf("f %d %d :\n", q, i);
            //print(1, 0, n);
            g[i] = min(ret + C[i], g[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < a[i].size(); j++) update(1, 0, n, 0, a[i][j].first, a[i][j].second);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", g[n]);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAX 1000000002

struct Node {
    int l, r, v, tag;
    void operator += (const int a) {
        tag += a;
        v += a;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].tag) {
        if (t[x].l) t[t[x].l] += t[x].tag;
        if (t[x].r) t[t[x].r] += t[x].tag;
        t[x].tag = 0;
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void insert(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (t[x].v < v) t[x].v = v;
    if (l == r) return;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (p <= mid) insert(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
    else insert(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	cerr << "update ( " << l << " " << r << " ) " << t[x].v << endl;
        t[x] += 1;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

struct St {
    int a, b;
    St () {}
    St (int x, int y) : a(x), b(y) {}
    bool operator < (const St &q) const {
        return a + b > q.a + q.b;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].a);
        read(a[i].b);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, dp; i <= n; i++) {
        //	cerr << a[i].a << " " << a[i].b << " (" << tcnt << ")" << endl;
        if (a[i].a <= a[i].b + 1) {
            dp = query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].b + 1, MAX) + 1;
            //		cerr << "a . query " << a[i].b + 1 << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            //		cerr << "ins " << a[i].a << " " << dp << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);
        } else {
            dp = query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, MAX) + 1;
            //		cerr << "b . query " << a[i].a << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);
            //		cerr << a[i].b + 1 << " ~ " << a[i].a - 1 << " ++ \n";
            //		cerr << "ins " << a[i].a << " " << dp << endl;
            update(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].b + 1, a[i].a - 1);
        }
        //	cerr << "query 4 == " << query(rt, -MAX, MAX, 4, 4) << endl;
    }
    printf("%d\n", t[rt].v);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

int n=0;
LL q[2100],a[1000];
bool ban[2100];
LL l,r;
int head=1,tail=1;
void init() {
    q[tail++]=6;
    q[tail++]=8;
    while (head<tail) {
        LL now=q[head++];
        if (now*10+6<=r) q[tail++]=now*10+6;
        if (now*10+8<=r) q[tail++]=now*10+8;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<tail; i++) {
        if (!ban[i]) {
            a[++n]=q[i];
            for (int j=i+1; j<tail; j++) {
                if (q[j]%q[i]==0) ban[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
    reverse(a+1,a+n+1);
}

LL gcd(LL x,LL y) {
    if (y) return gcd(y,x%y);
    else return x;
}

LL work(int x,int cnt,LL z) {
    LL ret=0;
    if (x>n) {
        ret=r/z-(l-1)/z;
        if (cnt&1) return ret;
        else if (cnt) return -ret;
        else return 0;
    }
    ret+=work(x+1,cnt,z);
    LL g=gcd(a[x],z);
    if (double(z)*double(a[x])/double(g)<=r) {
        ret+=work(x+1,cnt+1,z*a[x]/g);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    cin>>l>>r;
    init();
    cout<<work(1,0,1)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int n;
int f[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] != x) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
    if (u == v) vis[u] = 1;
    else {
        if (u < v) swap(u, v);
        vis[v] = 1;
        f[v] = u;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(10001, n + 1); i++) f[i] = i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) if (!vis[i]) return printf("%d\n", i - 1), 0;
}

int dp[2005][2005];
int n, maxp, w;

struct Node {
    int v, t;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int b) : v(a), t(b) {}
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return v > a.v;
    }
};

deque <Node> q;

void work() {
    memset(dp, 200, sizeof dp);
    read(n);
    read(maxp);
    read(w);
    w++;
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1, Ap, Bp, As, Bs; i <= w; i++) {
        read(Ap);
        read(Bp);
        read(As);
        read(Bs);
        for (int j = 0; j <= As; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], -Ap * j);
        }
        for (int j = As + 1; j <= maxp; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = w + 1, Ap, Bp, As, Bs; i <= n; i++) {
        read(Ap);
        read(Bp);
        read(As);
        read(Bs);
        q.clear();
        for (int j = 0, bot = -As; j <= maxp; j++, bot++) {
            while (!q.empty() && q.back().v < dp[i - w][j] + j * Ap) q.pop_back();
            q.push_back(Node(dp[i - w][j] + j * Ap, j));
            while (q.front().t < bot) q.pop_front();
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], q.front().v - j * Ap);
        }
        q.clear();
        for (int j = maxp, top = Bs + maxp; j >= 0; j--, top--) {
            while (!q.empty() && q.back().v < dp[i - w][j] + j * Bp) q.pop_back();
            q.push_back(Node(dp[i - w][j] + j * Bp, j));
            while (q.front().t > top) q.pop_front();
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], q.front().v - j * Bp);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[n][0]);
}

#define MAXN 2000319
#define MOD 20100403

int power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

int fac[MAXN], inv[MAXN];

int C(int n, int m) {
    return int((LL)fac[n] * inv[n - m] % MOD * inv[m] % MOD);
}

int main() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) fac[i] = int(LL(fac[i - 1]) * i % MOD);
    inv[MAXN - 1] = power(fac[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN - 2; i; i--) inv[i] = int(LL(inv[i + 1]) * (i + 1) % MOD);
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (n < m) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n", (C(n + m, m) - C(n + m, m - 1) + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1857.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <algorithm>

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

double dis(double a,double b,double c,double d) {
    return sqrt((a-c)*(a-c)+(b-d)*(b-d));
}

int Ax,Ay,Bx,By,Cx,Cy,Dx,Dy,P,Q,R;
double calc(double m,double n) {
    double x1=(Ax*m+Bx*(100-m))/100,y1=(Ay*m+By*(100-m))/100;
    double x2=(Cx*n+Dx*(100-n))/100,y2=(Cy*n+Dy*(100-n))/100;
    return dis(Ax,Ay,x1,y1)/P+dis(x1,y1,x2,y2)/R+dis(x2,y2,Dx,Dy)/Q;
}

double getans(double k) {
    double ll=0,rr=100,l,r;
    double llans=calc(k,ll),rrans=calc(k,rr),lans,rans;
    while (rr-ll>1e-6) {
        l=(ll*51+rr*49)/100;
        r=(ll*49+rr*51)/100;
        lans=calc(k,l);
        rans=calc(k,r);
        if (rans<lans) ll=l,llans=lans;
        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }
    return min(llans,rrans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d",&Ax,&Ay,&Bx,&By,&Cx,&Cy,&Dx,&Dy,&P,&Q,&R);
    double ll=0,rr=100,l,r;
    double llans=getans(ll),rrans=getans(rr),lans,rans;
    while (rr-ll>1e-6) {

        lans=getans(l);
        rans=getans(r);

        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }

}

//BZOJ1858.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int l, r, siz;
    int sum, lazy;
    int he[2], ta[2], md[2];
    bool rev;
} t[262144];

int tcnt = 0;

#define lch(q) t[q].l
#define rch(q) t[q].r

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[lch(x)].sum + t[rch(x)].sum;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        t[x].he[i] = t[lch(x)].he[i] == t[lch(x)].siz ? t[lch(x)].siz + t[rch(x)].he[i] : t[lch(x)].he[i];
        t[x].ta[i] = t[rch(x)].ta[i] == t[rch(x)].siz ? t[rch(x)].siz + t[lch(x)].ta[i] : t[rch(x)].ta[i];
        t[x].md[i] = max(max(max(t[lch(x)].md[i], t[rch(x)].md[i]), max(t[x].he[i], t[x].ta[i])), t[lch(x)].ta[i] + t[rch(x)].he[i]);
    }
}

void rev(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) t[x].lazy = -t[x].lazy;
    else t[x].rev ^= 1;
    swap(t[x].he[0], t[x].he[1]);
    swap(t[x].ta[0], t[x].ta[1]);
    swap(t[x].md[0], t[x].md[1]);
    t[x].sum = t[x].siz - t[x].sum;
}

void clr(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = -1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = t[x].siz;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = 0;
}

void fil(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = 1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = 0;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = t[x].siz;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy > 0) fil(lch(x)), fil(rch(x));
        else clr(lch(x)), clr(rch(x));
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (t[x].rev) {
        rev(t[x].l), rev(t[x].r);
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].siz = r - l + 1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        int p;
        read(p);
        t[x].sum = p;
        t[x].he[!p] = t[x].ta[!p] = t[x].md[!p] = 0;
        t[x].he[p] = t[x].ta[p] = t[x].md[p] = 1;
    }
    return x;
}

int n, m;

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, void(*opt)(int)) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        opt(x);
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), opt);
    if (qr > mid) update(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, opt);
    upd(x);
}

int Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += Sum(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Ret {
    int he, ta, md, siz;
    Ret (int x = 0, int y = 0, int z = 0, int w = 0) : he(x), ta(y), md(z), siz(w) {}
};

Ret operator + (Ret x, Ret y) {
    Ret ret;
    ret.he = x.he == x.siz ? x.siz + y.he : x.he;
    ret.ta = y.ta == y.siz ? y.siz + x.ta : y.ta;
    ret.md = max(max(ret.he, ret.ta), max(max(x.md, y.md), x.ta + y.he));
    ret.siz = x.siz + y.siz;
    return ret;
}

Ret Cons(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x].he[1], t[x].ta[1], t[x].md[1], t[x].siz);
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Ret ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + Cons(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + Cons(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(0, n - 1);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        switch (x) {
        case 0:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, clr);
            break;
        case 1:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, fil);
            break;
        case 2:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, rev);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", Sum(1, 0, n - 1, l, r));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", Cons(1, 0, n - 1, l, r).md);
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1862.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MOD 2147483647
#define P 19260817
#define MAXN 250005
#define s 262144

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void getop(int &op) {
    while (ch!='+' && ch!='?') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='+') op=0,ch=getchar();
    else {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch>='A' && ch<='Z') op=1;
        else op=2;
    }
}

struct data {
    int v,t,name;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (v^a.v) return v<a.v;
        return t>a.t;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt=0,ntem=0;
map<int,int> m;
set<int> tree;
set<int>::iterator it;
char name[MAXN][12],rr[12];
int op[MAXN],nn[MAXN],num[MAXN],score[MAXN],rev[MAXN],t[s<<1];

inline void readname(int x) {
    int len=0,p;
    while (ch>='A' && ch<='Z') {
        rr[len++]=ch;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    long long ha=0;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
        ha=(ha*P+rr[i])%MOD;
    }
    p=m[(int)ha];
    if (p==0) {
        p=++cnt;
        m[(int)ha]=p;
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
            name[p][i]=rr[i];
        }
    }
    nn[x]=p;
}

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        getop(op[i]);
        if (op[i]==0) {
            readname(i);
            read(num[i]);
            tem[++ntem].v=num[i];
            tem[ntem].t=i;
            tem[ntem].name=nn[i];
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            readname(i);
        } else {
            read(num[i]);
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+ntem+1);
    for (int i=1,lab=ntem; i<=ntem; i++,lab--) {
        num[tem[i].t]=lab;
        rev[lab]=tem[i].name;
    }
}

inline void zkw_update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=d;
}

inline int zkw_query(int x) {
    int ans=0,l=s,r=x+s+1;
    for (; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int zkw_rank(int r) {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<r) {
            r-=t[x<<1],x=(x<<1)|1;
        } else x<<=1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void update(int num,int name) {
    if (score[name]) {
        tree.erase(score[name]);
        zkw_update(score[name],-1);
    }
    score[name]=num;
    tree.insert(num);
    zkw_update(num,1);
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (op[i]==0) {
            update(num[i],nn[i]);
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            printf("%d\n",zkw_query(score[nn[i]]));
        } else {
            int x=zkw_rank(num[i]);
            it=tree.find(x);
            for (int i=1; i<=10 && it!=tree.end(); i++,it++) {
                if (i^1) putchar(' ');
                printf("%s",name[rev[*it]]);
            }
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1875.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 22
#define MAXM 123
#define MOD 45989
using namespace std;

int n,m,t,a,b,u[MAXM],v[MAXM];
long long fir[MAXM],now[MAXM][MAXM],mat[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM];

inline void exp(long long a[MAXM][MAXM],long long b[MAXM][MAXM]) {//a=a*b
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

inline void quickpower() {
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            if (i==j)
                now[i][j]=1;
            else
                now[i][j]=0;
        }
    while (t>0) {
        if (t&1) {
            exp(now,mat);
        }
        exp(mat,mat);
        t>>=1;
    }
}

inline void calc() {
    for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
        temp[0][j]=0;
        for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
            temp[0][j]=(temp[0][j]+fir[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        fir[i]=temp[0][i];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&t,&a,&b);
    if (t==0) {
        if (a==b)
            puts("1");
        else
            puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    m<<=1;
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",u+i,v+i);
        i++;
        u[i]=v[i^1];
        v[i]=u[i^1];
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        if (u[i]==a) {
            fir[i]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            if ((i^j)>1) {
                if (v[i]==u[j]) {
                    mat[i][j]=1;
                }
            }
        }
    t--;
    quickpower();
    calc();
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        if (v[i]==b)
            ans=(ans+fir[i])%MOD;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1876.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 1253
#define MOD 100000000

char temp[MAXL*10];

struct num {
    int a[MAXL+5];
    num() {
        memset(a,0,sizeof(a));
    }
    int &operator [](int i) {
        return a[i];
    }
    void operator /=(int x) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>=1; i--) {
            a[i-1]+=a[i]%x*MOD,a[i]/=x;
        }
    }
    void operator -=(num &b) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]-b[i]+(a[i-1]+MOD)/MOD-1,a[i-1]=(a[i-1]+MOD)%MOD;
        }
    }
    void operator *=(int x) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]*x+a[i-1]/MOD,a[i-1]%=MOD;
        }
    }
    bool operator < (num &b) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>0; i--) {
            if (a[i]!=b[i]) return a[i]<b[i];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    bool iszero() {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) if (a[i]!=0) return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<8; i++) temp[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",temp+8);
        int len=(int)strlen(temp+1),p=1;
        while (len-8*p+1>0) {
            sscanf(temp+len-8*p+1,"%8d",&a[p]);
            p++;
        }
    }
    void print() {
        int p=MAXL;
        while (!a[p] && p>0) p--;
        printf("%d",a[p--]);
        while (p>0) printf("%08d",a[p--]);
        printf("\n");
    }
} a,b;

num gcd(num x,num y) {
    int g=0;
    while (!x.iszero() && !y.iszero()) {
        bool xx=(x[1]&1)^1,yy=(y[1]&1)^1;
        if (xx&&yy) {
            g++;
            x/=2;
            y/=2;
        } else if (xx||yy) {
            if (xx) x/=2;
            else y/=2;
        }
        if (y<x) x-=y;
        else y-=x;
    }
    if (x<y) x=y;
    while (g--) x*=2;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    a.read();
    b.read();
    gcd(a,b).print();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1877.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 405
#define MAXM 20005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[source]=0;
    q.push(source);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pre[sink]!=-1;
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,tot=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        tot++;
        ans+=dis[sink];
        for (int x=sink; x!=source; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",tot,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++) {
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u*2+1,v*2,w,1);
    }
    add(0,3,0,12345678);
    add(n*2,1,0,12345678);
    work();
    return 0;
}

struct ls {

    bool operator < (ls a) const {
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return x<a.x;
    }
} d[MAXN];

struct qqq {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} q[MAXM];

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=d;
}

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&d[i].v);
        d[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(d+1,d+n+1);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (d[i].v==d[i-1].v) {
            last[d[i].x]=d[i-1].x;
        }
    }
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&q[i].l,&q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int now=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        update(i,1);
        if (last[i]) update(last[i],-1);
        while (now<=m && q[now].r==i) {
            ans[q[now].x]=query(q[now].l,i);
            now++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;

//BZOJ1895.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'A' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'R' :
        getchar();
        getchar();
        _c = getchar();
        a = 2 + (_c == 'O');
        break;
    case 'I' :
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'D' :
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        a = 6;
        break;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x7fffffff
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int mi, siz, val, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : mi(INF), siz(0), val(INF) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        mi += v;
        val += v;
        lazy += v;
    }
    void relax();
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        mi = min(min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi), val);
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

void Node::relax() {
    if (lazy) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->add(lazy);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->add(lazy);
        lazy = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt();
        c[1]->revIt();
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->val = ptr->mi = v;
    ptr->lazy = ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

int a[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax();
    x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R; // R->c[0] = [l, r)
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    a[0] = a[n + 1] = INF;
    rt = build(0, n + 1);
    read(m);
    Node *R, *tmp;
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y, z, mid; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->add(z);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->revIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            z %= (y - x + 1);
            mid = y - z + 1;
            R = get(mid, y + 1);
            tmp = R->c[0];
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            R = get(x, x);
            R->setc(tmp, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 4:
            read(x);
            read(z);
            R = get(x + 1, x + 1);
            R->setc(newNode(z), 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 5:
            read(x);
            R = get(x, x + 1);
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 6:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            printf("%d\n", get(x, y + 1)->c[0]->mi);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 10005
int T;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,ans=0,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to]=x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    if (cnt[x]==0) cnt[fa[x]]++;
    else if (cnt[x]==1) cnt[fa[x]]++,ans--;
    else ans-=2;
    cnt[x]=0;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    ans=n;
    fa[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        init();
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1911.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    a = 0;
    bool F = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') F |= ch == '-', ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (F) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 1000005
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
int n;
LL A, B, C, s[MAXN], f[MAXN], y[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(y[j] - y[k]) / LD(s[j] - s[k]);
}
LL calc(LL x) {
    return A * x * x + B * x + C;
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) > 2 * A * s[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) > slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) {
        read(ai);
        s[i] = s[i - 1] + ai;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + calc(s[i] - s[j]);
        y[i] = f[i] + A * s[i] * s[i] - B * s[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

inline bool nxtBit() {
    ch = getchar();
    while (ch != '0' && ch != '1') ch = getchar();
    return ch == '1';
}

#define MAXN 1024

int n, m;
bool ansed = 0, sf[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a[2048], b[2048];
char tmp[MAXN];

bool check(int cnt) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) a[i] = b[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= cnt && !a[to][i]) to++;
        if (to > cnt) return 0;
        swap(a[to], a[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            if (j != i && a[j][i]) a[j] ^= a[i];
        }
    }
    if (!ansed) {
        ansed = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sf[i] = a[i][0];
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) b[i][j] = nxtBit();
        b[i][0] = nxtBit();
    }
    int l = n, r = m + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    if (l > m) puts("Cannot Determine");
    else {
        printf("%d\n", l);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            printf("%s\n", sf[i] ? "?y7M#" : "Earth");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1927.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 805
#define M 15010
#define TOP 2047
struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[N * N + M * 2];

int head[TOP], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m;
int dis[TOP], q[TOP + 1], pre[TOP];
bool inq[TOP];

void SPFA() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * (2 * n + 1));
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++ & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[ta++ & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int solve() {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        SPFA();
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i << 1, 1, 0);
        add(i << 1 | 1, T, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        add(S, i << 1 | 1, 1, a);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        if (u > v) swap(u, v);
        add(u << 1, v << 1 | 1, 1, w);
    }
    printf("%d\n", solve());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1930.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define INF 123456789
#define MAXN 2005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN<<1];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN<<1],pre[MAXN<<1],dis[MAXN<<1];
bool inq[MAXN<<1];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,-1,sizeof(dis));
    dis[0]=0;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]<dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int work() {
    int ans=0;
    for (int f=2; f; f--) {
        spfa();
        ans+=dis[1];
        for (int x=1; x!=0; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(source,i*2,0,2);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,1,1);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
        add(i*2+1,sink,0,2);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int maxy=INF;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (p[j].y>=p[i].y && p[j].y<maxy) {
                add(i*2+1,j*2,0,2);
                maxy=p[j].y;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",work());
    return 0;
}

    }

#define MAXN 305
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m;
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
inline void add2(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    T=n+1;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (x) add(S,i,1);
        else add(i,T,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add2(u,v,1);
    }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",dinic());
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';

#define MAXN 500005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} p[MAXN];

struct data {
    int x,l,r,v,id;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b,int c,int d,int e):x(a),l(b),r(c),v(d),id(e) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} q[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,qcnt=0,temx[MAXN],temy[MAXN],cntx=0,cnty=0;
int ans[MAXN];

int lessx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int leqx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int geqy(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cnty,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (temy[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int leqy(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cnty,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temy[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

#define s 524288
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        temx[i]=p[i].x;
        temy[i]=p[i].y;
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    sort(temx+1,temx+n+1);
    sort(temy+1,temy+n+1);
    cntx=int(unique(temx+1,temx+n+1)-temx);
    cnty=int(unique(temy+1,temy+n+1)-temy);
    temx[0]=-1,temx[cntx]=10000001;
    temy[0]=-1,temy[cnty]=10000001;
    for (int i=1,a,b,c,d; i<=m; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        a=lessx(a),c=leqx(c);
        b=geqy(b),d=leqy(d);
        q[++qcnt]=data(a,b,d,-1,i);
        q[++qcnt]=data(c,b,d,1,i);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+qcnt+1);
    int qpos=1,ppos=1;
    while (qpos<=qcnt && q[qpos].x==0) qpos++;
    for (int i=1; i<=cntx; i++) {
        while (ppos<=n && p[ppos].x==temx[i]) update(leqy(p[ppos++].y));
        while (qpos<=qcnt && q[qpos].x==i) {
            ans[q[qpos].id]+=q[qpos].v*query(q[qpos].l,q[qpos].r);
            qpos++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1964.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;

struct Point {
    LD x, y, z;
    Point() {}
    Point(LD a, LD b, LD c) : x(a), y(b), z(c) {}
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
    }
    Point operator - (Point &a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y, z - a.z);
    }
} p[5];

LD ans = 0;

LD get(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    LD ret = 0;
    ret += a.x * b.y * c.z + a.y * b.z * c.x + a.z * b.x * c.y;
    ret -= a.x * b.z * c.y + a.y * b.x * c.z + a.z * b.y * c.x;
    return ret;
}

void work(Point &a, Point &b, Point &c, Point &d) {
    ans += abs(get(a - d, b - d, c - d));
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 4; i >= 0; i--) {
        p[i].re();
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 5; j++)
            for (int k = j + 1; k < 5; k++)
                for (int l = k + 1; l < 5; l++) {
                    work(p[i], p[j], p[k], p[l]);
                }
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", ans / 12);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1965.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL n,m,l,MOD;

LL exp(LL a,LL b) {
    LL ret=0;
    a%=MOD;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) {
            ret=ret+a;
            if (ret>=MOD) ret-=MOD;
        }
        a<<=1;
        if (a>=MOD) a-=MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x) {
    LL ret=1;
    a%=MOD;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=exp(ret,a);
        a=exp(a,a);
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

void exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1,y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

LL inv(LL a) {
    LL x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>m>>l;
    MOD=n+1;
    cout<<exp(l,inv(quickpower(2,m)))<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1968.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
int n;

inline ll work(int x) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long ret=0;
    for (int now=x; now; now--) {
        int div=x/now;
        int to=x/(div+1)+1;
        ret+=(ll)(now-to+1)*div;
        now=to;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("%lld\n",work(n));
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MAXN 201005
#define sqrtN 1005
int n,m,sqn;
int a[MAXN],step[MAXN],to[MAXN],block[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    sqn=int(sqrt(n));
    int now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=sqn; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=sqn; j++) {
            block[now++]=i;
        }
    }
    while (now<n) {
        block[now++]=sqn+1;
    }
    block[n]=-1;
    step[n]=0;
    to[n]=n;
    for (int i=n-1; i>-1; i--) {
        to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
        if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
            step[i]=1;
        } else {
            step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
            to[i]=to[to[i]];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int t=1; t<=m; t++) {
        int x,y,z;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) {
            int now=y,ans=0;
            while (now<n) {
                ans+=step[now];
                now=to[now];
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            scanf("%d",&z);
            a[y]=z;
            int nowblock=block[y];
            for (int i=y; i>-1 && block[i]==nowblock; i--) {
                to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
                if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
                    step[i]=1;
                } else {
                    step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
                    to[i]=to[to[i]];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000005
int prime[MAXN],phi[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
LL sum[MAXN+5];
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,phi[i]=i-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=phi[i]*prime[j];
                break;
            } else phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}
int main() {
    shake();
    LL n,m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL x=min(n,m);
    LL ans=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(n/(n/i),m/(m/i));
        ans+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(n/i)*(m/i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans*2-LL(n)*m);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2006.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 20
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<LL, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

int n, K, L, R;
LL a[MAXN];

pii t[LOG][MAXN];
void st_ready() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) t[0][i] = mp(a[i], i);
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 0, ta = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= ta; i++) {
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

int LOG2(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x > 65535) ret |= 16, x >>= 16;
    if (x > 255) ret |= 8, x >>= 8;
    if (x > 15) ret |= 4, x >>= 4;
    if (x > 3) ret |= 2, x >>= 2;
    return ret + (x > 1);
}

pii query(int l, int r) {
    int len = r - l + 1, ll = LOG2(len);
    return min(t[ll][l], t[ll][r - (1 << ll) + 1]);
}

struct s {
    int x, l, r, p;
    bool operator < (s b) const {
        return a[x] - a[p] < a[b.x] - a[b.p];
    }
};

LL ans = 0;

priority_queue <s> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i] += a[i - 1];
    st_ready();
    s now;
    pii tmp;
    for (int i = L, l, r; i <= n; i++) {
        l = max(0, i - R), r = i - L;
        tmp = query(l, r);
        q.push((s) {
            i, l, r, tmp.second
        });
    }
    while (K--) {
        now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += a[now.x] - a[now.p];
        if (now.l < now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.l, now.p - 1);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.l, now.p - 1, tmp.second
            });
        }
        if (now.r > now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.p + 1, now.r);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.p + 1, now.r, tmp.second
            });
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        }

int LOG2(int x) {

    if (x > 65535) ret |= 16, x >>= 16;
    if (x > 255) ret |= 8, x >>= 8;
    if (x > 15) ret |= 4, x >>= 4;

int main() {

            });

    printf("%lld\n", ans);

//BZOJ2006.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 19

struct Node {
    int x, l, r, p;
};

int n, K, L, R;
int sum[MAXN], st[MAXN][LOG], Log[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

bool operator < (const Node &a, const Node &b) {
    return sum[a.x] - sum[a.p] < sum[b.x] - sum[b.p];
}

priority_queue <Node> q;

inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return sum[x] < sum[y] ? x : y;
}

void build_st() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = i;
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n + 1]; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 0, j = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = cmp(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int rmq(int l, int r) {
    return cmp(st[l][Log[r - l + 1]], st[r - (1 << Log[r - l + 1]) + 1][Log[r - l + 1]]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= n; i++) read(a), sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a;
    build_st();
    for (int i = L; i <= n; i++) {
        q.push((Node) {
            i, max(0, i - R), i - L, rmq(max(0, i - R), i - L)
        });
    }
    while (K--) {
        Node now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += sum[now.x] - sum[now.p];
        if (now.l < now.p) q.push((Node) {
            now.x, now.l, now.p - 1, rmq(now.l, now.p - 1)
        });
        if (now.r > now.p) q.push((Node) {
            now.x, now.p + 1, now.r, rmq(now.p + 1, now.r)
        });
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 505
#define MAXN (N * N * 4)
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v, f;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int cur[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, ff
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n;
int num[N][N], a[N][N], b[N][N], S, T, node;
int q[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) tag[i] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    int l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].f && tag[e[o].v] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            l -= ret;
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    tag[x] = -1;
    return f - l;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
        if (++cnt > 50 && T > 250000) return 77484;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {

    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            num[i][j] = ++node;
        }
    }

    S = num[0][0], T = num[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            read(b[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            add(num[i][j], num[i][j + 1], a[i][j], x);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            add(num[i][j], num[i + 1][j], b[i][j], x);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MOD 1000000
int T,A,S,B;
int dp[2][100005],sum[2][100005],N[1005];

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(A);
    read(S);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=A; i++) {
        read(x);
        N[x]++;
    }
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=A; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        int now=i&1,prev=now^1;
        sum[now][0]=1;
        dp[now][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            if (j>N[i]) dp[now][j]=MOD+sum[prev][j]-sum[prev][j-N[i]-1];
            else dp[now][j]=sum[prev][j];
            if (dp[now][j]>=MOD) dp[now][j]-=MOD;
            sum[now][j]=sum[now][j-1]+dp[now][j];
            if (sum[now][j]>=MOD) sum[now][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=S; i<=B; i++) {
        ans+=dp[T&1][i];
        if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 5015
#define INF 0X3f3f3f3f
struct Data {
    int l, r, v;
    bool operator < (Data a) const {
        return v > a.v;
    }
} a[MAXN];
int n, tem[MAXN], vis[MAXN];
long long ans = 0;

bool tag(int i, int x) {
    if (x > a[i].r) return 0;
    if (vis[x]) {
        if (a[vis[x]].r > a[i].r) {
            if (tag(vis[x], x + 1)) return vis[x] = i, 1;
            else return 0;
        } else return tag(i, x + 1);
    } else return vis[x] = i, 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i].l), read(a[i].r), read(a[i].v), tem[i] = a[i].l;
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) tem[i] = max(tem[i - 1] + 1, tem[i]);
    tem[0] = -INF;
    tem[n + 1] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].l = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + n + 2, a[i].l) - tem) + 1;
        a[i].r = int(upper_bound(tem, tem + n + 2, a[i].r) - tem);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (tag(i, a[i].l)) ans += a[i].v;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2038.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL gcd(LL a,LL b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

struct query {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (query z) const {
        if (l/sqn==z.l/sqn) return r<z.r;
        else return l<z.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

LL ans=0,ansa[MAXN],ansb[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    ans+=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    ans-=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) r++,update(r);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r),r--;
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l),l++;
        while (l>q[i].l) l--,update(l);
        LL x=ans-(r-l+1),y=LL(r-l+1)*LL(r-l);
        if (x!=0) {
            LL g=gcd(x,y);
            x/=g,y/=g;
        } else y=1;
        ansa[q[i].x]=x,ansb[q[i].x]=y;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld/%lld\n",ansa[i],ansb[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2049.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    a=int(ch<'D')+int(ch<='D');
}
#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 200005
struct Querys {
    int op,u,v,id;
    bool operator < (Querys a) const {
        if (u!=a.u) return u<a.u;
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return id<a.id;
    }
} qq[MAXM];
int n,m,exc[MAXM],f[MAXN],tot=0;

struct Tree_node {
    int l,r,v,head;
} t[1048576];

struct Opt_node {
    int next,u,v;
} op[5242880];

struct Reverse {
    int p,v,next;
} sta[10485760];

int tcnt=0,opcnt=0,stacnt=0,A,B;
#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int x=++tcnt;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[x].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    } else {
        if (qq[l].op==0) {
            t[x].v=1;
            lch=qq[l].u;
            rch=qq[l].v;
        }
    }
    return x;
}

void add_Exsit(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        op[++opcnt].u=A;
        op[opcnt].v=B;
        op[opcnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=opcnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) add_Exsit(lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) add_Exsit(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
}

void modify(int p,int v,int &head) {
    sta[++stacnt].p=p;
    sta[stacnt].v=f[p];
    sta[stacnt].next=head;
    head=stacnt;
    f[p]=v;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    else return getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v,int &head) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) swap(u,v),swap(fu,fv);
        modify(fv,f[fu]+f[fv],head);
        modify(fu,fv,head);
    }
}

void dfs(int x,int l,int r) {
    int head=0;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=op[now].next) {
        merge(op[now].u,op[now].v,head);
    }
    if (l==r) {
        if (getf(lch)==getf(rch)) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) dfs(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) dfs(rch,mid+1,r);
    }
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].p]=sta[now].v;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(qq[i].op);
        read(qq[i].u);
        read(qq[i].v);
        qq[i].id=i;
        if (qq[i].u>qq[i].v) swap(qq[i].u,qq[i].v);
    }
    build(1,m);
    sort(qq+1,qq+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (qq[i].u!=qq[i-1].u || qq[i].v!=qq[i-1].v) {
            if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
                A=qq[i-1].u,B=qq[i-1].v;
                add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
            }
            tot++;
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
        if (qq[i].op==2) {
            exc[tot]=qq[i].id;
        } else if (qq[i].op) {
            A=qq[i].u,B=qq[i].v;
            add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],qq[i].id);
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
    }
    if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
        A=qq[m].u,B=qq[m].v;
        add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
    }
    dfs(1,1,m);
    return 0;
}

    if (l==r) {

        else puts("No");
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) dfs(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) dfs(rch,mid+1,r);
    }
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].p]=sta[now].v;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(qq[i].op);
        read(qq[i].u);
        read(qq[i].v);
        qq[i].id=i;
        if (qq[i].u>qq[i].v) swap(qq[i].u,qq[i].v);
    }
    build(1,m);
    sort(qq+1,qq+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (qq[i].u!=qq[i-1].u || qq[i].v!=qq[i-1].v) {
            if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
                A=qq[i-1].u,B=qq[i-1].v;
                add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
            }
            tot++;
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
        if (qq[i].op==2) {
            exc[tot]=qq[i].id;
        } else if (qq[i].op) {
            A=qq[i].u,B=qq[i].v;
            add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],qq[i].id);
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
    }
    if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
        A=qq[m].u,B=qq[m].v;
        add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
    }
    dfs(1,1,m);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2049.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    while (_c >= 'A') _c = getchar();
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 10319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    bool rev, isrt;
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void upd() {}
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->fa != null) pushto(x->fa);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

int n, m;
Node *a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 'C' :
            Link(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'D' :
            Cut(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'Q' :
            puts(getrt(a[u]) == getrt(a[v]) ? "Yes" : "No");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2051.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50319

inline int min(int x, int y) {
    return x < y ? x : y;
}
inline int max(int x, int y) {
    return x > y ? x : y;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 1, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, K;
int lf[MAXN * 16], fa[MAXN], fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], fcnt = 0;
int le[MAXN * 16], fe[MAXN], est[MAXN], eed[MAXN], Ecnt = 0;
int rec[MAXN * 2], dep[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int st[MAXN * 2][17], Log[MAXN * 2], fir[MAXN], tot = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(st[x][Log[y - x + 1]], st[y - (1 << Log[y - x + 1]) + 1][Log[y - x + 1]]);
}
#define getdis(x, y) (dis[x] + dis[y] - 2 * rmq(fir[x], fir[y]))

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                rt = e[now].to, flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

void dd(int x) {
//	cerr << x << " : " << dep[x] << endl;
    lf[++fcnt] = le[++Ecnt] = dep[x];
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (!vis[e[now].to]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to);
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void solve(int x, int f) {
//	cerr << "solve " << x << " " << f << endl;
    lf[fst[x] = ++fcnt] = dep[x] = 0;
    fa[x] = f;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            rec[now] = getrt(e[now].to);
            est[rec[now]] = Ecnt + 1;
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            sort(le + est[rec[now]], le + (eed[rec[now]] = Ecnt) + 1);
        }
    }
    sort(lf + fst[x], lf + (fed[x] = fcnt) + 1);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(rec[now], x);
    }
}

int query(int a[], int s, int t, int d) {
    if (d < 0) return 0;
    int l = s, r = t + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] > d) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - s;
}

LL check(int x, int mid) {
    LL ret = query(lf, fst[x], fed[x], mid);
//	cerr << "f " << x  << " " << mid << " " <<	ret<< endl;
    for (int y = x; fa[y]; y = fa[y]) {
        int D = getdis(fa[y], x);
        ret += query(lf, fst[fa[y]], fed[fa[y]], mid - D);
//		cerr << "f " << fa[y] << " " << mid - D << " " <<  query(lf, fst[fa[y]], fed[fa[y]], mid - D) << endl;
        ret -= query(le, est[y], eed[y], mid - D);
//		cerr << "e " << y << " " << mid - D << " " << query(le, est[y], eed[y], mid - D) << endl;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void work(int x) {
    int l = 0, r = 500000001, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(x, mid) > K) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    st[fir[x] = ++tot][0] = dis[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x, dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            st[++tot][0] = dis[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    fa[1] = dis[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = 1 + Log[i >> 1];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), ta = tot - (x << 1) + 1; i <= ta; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
    solve(getrt(1), 0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2100.cpp

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<2];

int m,n,S,A,B,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> q;
void dijkstra(int st) {
    memset(dis,127,sizeof(dis));
    dis[st]=0;
    q.push(statu(st,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x,d=q.top().v;
        q.pop();
        if (d!=dis[x]) continue;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>d+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=d+e[now].w;
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,dis[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(S);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    dijkstra(S);
    int ans=min(dis[A],dis[B]);
    dijkstra(A);
    printf("%d\n",ans+dis[B]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2109.cpp
#include<stdio.h>
#include<stdlib.h>
int k[2005]= {0},f[2005]= {0},s[2005]= {0},v[10005]= {0},first[2005]= {0},next[10005]= {0},heap[2005]= {0},pos[2005]= {0};
int n,e=0,node;
void tj(int x,int y) {
    v[++e]=y;
    next[e]=first[x];
    first[x]=e;
}
void jh_heap(int a,int b) {
    int t=heap[a];
    heap[a]=heap[b];
    heap[b]=t;
    t=pos[heap[a]];
    pos[heap[a]]=pos[heap[b]];
    pos[heap[b]]=t;
}
void tj_heap(int x) {
    int i;
    heap[++node]=x;
    pos[x]=node;
    for(i=node; i>1; i/=2) {
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
void sc() {
    int i=1;
    jh_heap(1,node);
    node--;
    while(i*2<=node) {
        i*=2;
        if(i+1<=node&&k[heap[i]]<k[heap[i+1]]) i++;
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
int work(int x) {
    int i,j,t;
    node=0;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        f[i]=heap[i]=pos[i]=0;
    for(i=1; i<=e; i++)
        f[v[i]]++;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        if(f[i]==0&&i!=x) tj_heap(i);
    for(i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        if(node==0) return n-i;
        t=heap[1];
        sc();
        if(k[t]<i) return n-i;
        s[i]=t;
        for(j=first[t]; j!=0; j=next[j])
            if(--f[v[j]]==0&&v[j]!=x) tj_heap(v[j]);
    }
    return n;
}
int main() {
    int m,i,a,b;
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%d",&k[i]);
    for(i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
        tj(b,a);//��������ͼ
    }
    work(0);
    /*for(i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        printf("%d",s[i]);
        if(i<n) printf(" ");
        else printf("\n");
    }*/
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d",n-work(i));
        if(i<n) printf(" ");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2115.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN * 4];

int n, m, ecnt = 0, cnt = 0, head[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
LL val[MAXN], a[MAXN * 4];
void add(int u, int v, LL w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            vis[e[now].to] = 1;
            val[e[now].to] = val[x] ^ e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        } else {
            if (val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to]) a[++cnt] = val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}

LL tmp[64];

void gauss() {
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = 62; j > -1; j--) {
            if ((a[i]>>j)&1) {
                if (!tmp[j]) {
                    tmp[j] = a[i];
                    break;
                } else a[i] ^= tmp[j];
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        LL w;
        scanf("%d%d%lld", &u, &v, &w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    vis[1] = 1;
    val[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    gauss();
    LL ret = val[n];
    for (int i = 62; i > -1; i--) {
        ret = max(ret, ret ^ tmp[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<3];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m,tot=0,tcnt=1,tag[105][105];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            tag[i][j]=++tcnt;
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,tag[i][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(tag[i][j],T,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i+1][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i+1][j],tcnt,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i][j+1],tcnt,a);
        }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}
