//BZOJ2151.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define INF 926365496
#define MAXN 200005
#define MAXM 205
/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
struct statu {
    int v,x;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):v(a),x(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
};

int n,m,ans=0,a[MAXN],pre[MAXN],nxt[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void del(int x) {
    pre[nxt[x]]=pre[x];
    nxt[pre[x]]=nxt[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}

int main() {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (m>n/2) {
        puts("Error!");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        readf(a[i]);
        pre[i]=i-1;
        nxt[i]=i+1;
        q.push(statu(a[i],i));
    }
    pre[1]=n,nxt[n]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) q.pop();
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        ans+=a[x];
        a[x]=a[pre[x]]+a[nxt[x]]-a[x];
        q.push(statu(a[x],x));
        del(pre[x]);
        del(nxt[x]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2152.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    while (b) {
        LL c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, dep[MAXN];
int s[3], cnt[3];
LL ans = 0;

void dd(int x) {
    dep[x] += dep[x] > 2 ? -3 : 0;
    s[dep[x]]++;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void work(int x) {
    cnt[0] = 1, cnt[1] = cnt[2] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            ans += (LL)s[0] * cnt[0] + (LL)s[1] * cnt[2] + (LL)s[2] * cnt[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                cnt[i] += s[i], s[i] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    work(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w % 3);
    solve(1);
    ans = ans * 2 + n;
    LL tot = (LL) n * n, g = gcd(tot, ans);
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", ans/g, tot/g);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'C' :
        op = 1;
        break;
    case 'N' :
        op = 2;
        break;
    case 'S' :
        op = 3;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        _c = getchar();
        if (_c == 'A') op = 4;
        else op = 5;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 20319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    int ma, mi, val, sum;
    bool isrt, rev, inv;
    Node () : ma(-INF), mi(INF), val(INF), sum(0) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum;
        ma = max(c[0]->ma, c[1]->ma);
        mi = min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi);
        if (val ^ INF) {
            sum += val;
            ma = max(ma, val);
            mi = min(mi, val);
        }
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void invIt() {
        inv ^= 1;
        ma = -ma, mi = -mi, sum = -sum;
        swap(ma, mi);
        if (val != INF) val = -val;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt(), rev = 0;
        if (inv) c[0]->invIt(), c[1]->invIt(), inv = 0;
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->rev = ptr->inv = 0;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[++top] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top) sta[top--]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

Node *addE(Node *u, Node *v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(u, mid);
    Link(mid, v);
    return mid;
}

Node* query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

int n, Q;
Node *a[MAXN], *e[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[i] = addE(a[u], a[v], w);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            splay(e[u]);
            e[u]->val = v;
            e[u]->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            query(a[u], a[v])->invIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->sum);
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->ma);
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->mi);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319
#define MOD 19930726
typedef long long LL;

LL power(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct pam {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        len[p] = l, cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        p = n = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

int n, pcnt = 0;
LL K, ans = 1;
char s[MAXN];
pair <int, int> p[MAXN];

inline bool cmp(const pair<int, int> a, const pair<int, int> b) {
    return a.first > b.first;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld", &n, &K);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) T.add(s[i]);
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p; i > 1; i--) if ((T.len[i] & 1) && T.cnt[i]) p[++pcnt] = make_pair(T.len[i], T.cnt[i]);
    sort(p + 1, p + pcnt + 1, cmp);
    for (int i = 1; K > 0 && i <= pcnt; i++) {
        (ans *= power(p[i].first, min((LL)p[i].second, K))) %= MOD;
        K -= p[i].second;
    }
    if (K > 0) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n", int(ans % MOD));
    return 0;
}

#define lim 10000
#define maxn 121000
struct LL {
    int a[maxn];
    inline void operator = (int x) {
        a[0]=0;
        while(x) a[++a[0]]=x%lim,x/=lim;
        if(!a[0]) a[0]=1;
    }
    inline void print() {
        printf("%d",a[a[0]]);
        if(a[a[0]]<0||a[a[0]]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        for(int i=a[0]-1; i; --i) {
            printf("%04d",a[i]); //width should be manualy changed
            if(a[i]<0||a[i]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    inline void read() {
        char s[maxn];
        int len;
        a[0]=1;
        a[1]=0;
        scanf("%s",s);
        len=strlen(s);
        for(int i=len-1,now=1; i>=0; --i,now*=10) {
            if(now==lim) now=1,a[++a[0]]=0;
            a[a[0]]+=now*(s[i]-'0');
        }
        while(a[0]>1&&!a[a[0]]) --a[0];
    }
    void operator ++ () {
        ++a[1];
        a[a[0]+1]=0;
        for(int i=1; i<=a[0]; ++i)
            if(a[i]==lim) ++a[i+1];
            else break;
        if(a[a[0]+1]) ++a[0];
    }
    LL operator * (LL b)const {
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=a[0]+b.a[0];
        c.a[1]=0;
        long long tmp=0;
        if(c.a[0]>=maxn) throw *this;
        for(int k=1; k<c.a[0]; ++k) {
            for(int i=max(1,k+1-b.a[0]),j=k+1-i; i<=a[0]&&j; ++i,--j)
                tmp+=a[i]*b.a[j];
            tmp+=c.a[k];
            c.a[k]=tmp%lim;
            c.a[k+1]=tmp/lim;
            tmp=0;
        }
        if(c.a[0]>1&&!c.a[c.a[0]]) --c.a[0];
        return c;
    }
    LL operator - (LL b)const { //support only biger-smaller
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=1;
        for(int i=1,x=0; i<=a[0]; ++i) {
            if(i>b.a[0]) b.a[i]=0;
            c.a[i]=a[i]-b.a[i]+x;
            x=0;
            if(c.a[i]<0) c.a[i]+=lim,x=-1;
            if(c.a[i]) c.a[0]=i;
        }
        return c;
    }
    LL operator ^ (int t) {
        LL c,a=*this;
        c=1;
        while(t) {
            if(t&1) c=a*c;
            a=a*a;
            t>>=1;
        }
        return c;
    }
};

typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 10000000
LL temp[20000];

struct num {
    int v[20000],len;
    num():len(0) {}
    num operator = (int x) {
        memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
        v[0]=x;
        return *this;
    }
    int &operator [](int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    num operator + (num a) {
        len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]+=a[i];
            if (v[i]>=MOD) v[i]-=MOD,v[i+1]++;
        }
        if (v[len+1]) len++;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator - (num a) {
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]-=a[i];
            while (v[i]<0) v[i]+=MOD,v[i+1]--;
        }
        while (!v[len] && len>0) len--;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator * (num a) {
        memset(temp,0,sizeof(temp));
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<=a.len; j++) {
                temp[i+j]+=LL(v[i])*LL(a[j]);
            }
        int l=len+a.len;
        num c;
        c=0;
        for (int i=0; i<=l; i++) {
            c[i]=int(temp[i]%MOD);
            temp[i+1]+=temp[i]/MOD;
            if (i==l && temp[i+1]) l++;
        }
        c.len=l;
        return c;
    }
    num operator += (num a) {
        return *this+a;
    }
    num operator -= (int a) {
        num x;
        x=a;
        return *this-x;
    }
    num operator -= (num a) {
        return *this-a;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<=8; i++) r[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",r+9);
        len=-1;
        for (int i=int(strlen(r))-1; i>=9; i-=7) {
            len++;
            sscanf(r+i-6,"%7d",&v[len]);
        }
        if (len<=0) len=0;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%d",v[len]);
        for (int i=len-1; i>-1; i--) {
            printf("%07d",v[i]);
        }
        putchar('\n');
    }
} a,b;

//BZOJ2179.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
struct Comp {
    LD x, y;
    Comp() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Comp(LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Comp operator * (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x * t.x - y * t.y, x * t.y + y * t.x);
    }
    Comp operator *= (Comp t) {
        return *this = *this * t;
    }
    Comp operator + (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x + t.x, y + t.y);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x - t.x, y - t.y);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator * (_T t) {
        return Comp(x * t, y * t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator / (_T t) {
        return Comp(x / t, y / t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator /= (_T t) {
        return *this = *this / t;
    }
};

Comp I(0, 1);

Comp exp(Comp t) {
    return Comp(cos(t.y), sin(t.y)) * exp(t.x);
}

#define MAXN 131072

char sa[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

Comp tmp[MAXN];

void DFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    int n_2 = n / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tmp[i] = a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i & 1) a[n_2 + i / 2] = tmp[i];
        else a[i / 2] = tmp[i];
    }
    Comp *a0 = a, *a1 = a + n_2;
    DFT(a0, n_2, rev);
    DFT(a1, n_2, rev);
    Comp cur(1, 0);
    LD alpha = M_PI / n_2 * rev;
    Comp step = exp(I * alpha);
    for (int k = 0; k < n_2; ++k) {
        tmp[k] = a0[k] + cur * a1[k];
        tmp[k + n_2] = a0[k] - cur * a1[k];
        cur *= step;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = tmp[i];
}

Comp a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

void FFT(int n) {
    DFT(a, n, 1);
    DFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] *= b[i];
    DFT(a, n, -1);
}

int main() {
    int n = 1, len;
    scanf("%d%s%s", &len, sa, sb);
    while (n < len) n <<= 1;
    n <<= 1;
    for (int i = len - 1, j = 0; j < n; i--, j++) {
        if (i > -1) a[j] = Comp(sa[i] - '0', 0), b[j] = Comp(sb[i] - '0', 0);
        else a[j] = b[j] = Comp(0, 0);
    }
    FFT(n);
    for (int i = 0, to; i < n; i++) {
        ans[i] += int(a[i].x / n + 0.5);
        if ((to = ans[i] / 10)) {
            ans[i + 1] += to;
            ans[i] -= 10 * to;
        }
    }
    bool flag = 1;
    for (int i = len * 2 - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        if (flag && !ans[i]) continue;
        flag = 0;
        putchar('0'|ans[i]);
    }
    if (flag) putchar('0');
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAX 65536

typedef double D;

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r + b.r, i + b.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r - b.r, i - b.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r * b.r - i * b.i, r * b.i + i * b.r);
    }
};

int R[MAX * 2];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = -1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += (i << 1)) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int n;
char sa[MAX], sb[MAX];
Comp a[MAX * 2], b[MAX * 2];
int ans[MAX * 2];
int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s%s", sa, sb);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = Comp(sa[n - i - 1] - '0');
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = Comp(sb[n - i - 1] - '0');
    for (int i = 1; ; i <<= 1) if (i >= n) {
            n = i * 2;
            break;
        }
    getR(n);
    FFT(a, n, 1);
    FFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = n; i--; a[i] = a[i] * b[i]);
    FFT(a, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ans[i] += int(a[i].r + 0.5);
        ans[i + 1] += ans[i] / 10;
        ans[i] %= 10;
    }
    for (int i = n - 1, flag = 0; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (ans[i] > 0 || flag) flag = 1, putchar('0' + ans[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
    return 0;

#define MAX 65536

typedef double D;

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r + b.r, i + b.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r - b.r, i - b.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r * b.r - i * b.i, r * b.i + i * b.r);
    }
};

int R[MAX * 2];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R[i] > i) swap(a[R[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

//BZOJ2186.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10000000

typedef long long LL;

int T,MOD;
int fac[MAXN+5],inv[MAXN+5],ans[MAXN+5];
int prime[1000005],pcnt=0;
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void exgcd(int a,int b,int &x,int &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    int t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

int getinv(int a) {
    int x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    x%=MOD;
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

void init() {
    fac[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=int(((LL)fac[i-1]*i)%MOD);
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            inv[i]=getinv(i);
        }
        for (int j=1; prime[j]*i<=MAXN && j<=pcnt; j++) {
            notprime[prime[j]*i]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) break;
        }
    }
    ans[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (notprime[i]) ans[i]=ans[i-1];
        else {
            ans[i]=int(((((LL)ans[i-1]*(i-1))%MOD)*inv[i])%MOD);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&T,&MOD);
    init();
    while (T--) {
        int n,m;
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        printf("%d\n",int((LL(fac[n])*ans[m])%MOD));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2190.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL phi(LL x) {
    LL ret=x,sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
    for (LL i=2; i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            ret=ret/i*(i-1);
            while (x%i==0) x/=i;
            sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ret=ret/x*(x-1);
    return ret;
}

LL n,ans=0;

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    if (n<2) puts("0");
    else {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            ans+=phi(i);
        }
        cout<<ans*2+1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2200.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
#define MAXN 25005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<3];

const int Q=32767;
struct queue {
    int head,tail,v[32768];
    queue():head(16777216),tail(16777216) {}
    void push_front(int x) {
        v[(--head)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&Q];
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
} q;

int head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int n,m,M,S,ecnt=0;
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void spfa() {
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<=dis[q.front()]) {
                        q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    } else {
                        q.push_back(e[now].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(M);
    read(S);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=M; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]==INF) puts("NO PATH");
        else printf("%d\n",dis[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2208.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005
bitset<MAXN> map[MAXN],G[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int ecnt=0,head[MAXN];

int n;
char temp[MAXN];
int low[MAXN],dfn[MAXN],belong[MAXN],in[MAXN],scc=0,cnt=0;
long long ans=0;
int sta[MAXN],top=0;
int siz[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}
void tarjan(int x) {
    dfn[x]=low[x]=++cnt;
    sta[++top]=x;
    inq[x]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (map[x][i]) {
            if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i),low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
            else if (inq[i]) low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
        }
    }
    if (dfn[x]==low[x]) {
        siz[++scc]=0;
        int now=0;
        while (now!=x) {
            now=sta[top--];
            belong[now]=scc;
            inq[now]=0;
            siz[scc]++;
        }
    }
}

int q[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
void topo() {
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        if (!in[i]) q[ta++]=i;
        G[i][i]=1;
    }
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            G[e[now].to]|=G[x];
            in[e[now].to]--;
            if (!in[e[now].to]) {
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=scc; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) {
                ans+=(long long)siz[i]*siz[j];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (temp[j]=='1') map[i][j]=1;
        }
        map[i][i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j] && belong[i]!=belong[j] && !G[belong[i]][belong[j]])
                add(belong[i],belong[j]);
        }
    }
    topo();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];
int n,m,lim,tcnt=0,rt[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int kth(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=p) return kth(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return kth(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p-lv);
}
int query(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(lim);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,lim,a);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int mid=(r-l+2)>>1,ret=kth(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,mid);
        if (query(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,ret)>((r-l+1)>>1)) printf("yes %d\n",ret);
        else puts("no");
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 1000319

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 6], phi[MAXN], pcnt = 0;
LL ans[MAXN], f[MAXN];

void init() {
    phi[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            phi[i] = i - 1;
        }
        for (int j = 1, k; (k = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] = (LL) i * ((LL)phi[i] * i / 2);
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; i * j < MAXN; j++) {
            ans[i * j] += i * f[j];
        }
    }
}

int T;

    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        int n;
        read(n);
        printf("%lld\n", ans[n]);
    }

    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
int qw[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];

namespace NewGraph {
struct Edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];
int head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int c, r;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (f != INF && f <= c) r++;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, min(f, e[now].w));
        }
}
int solve(int x) {
    c = x;
    r = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fa[i] = 0;
        dfs(i, INF);
    }
    return r / 2;
}
}

void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    NewGraph::add(S, T, ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(NewGraph::head, 0, sizeof NewGraph::head);
    NewGraph::ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        read(W[i]);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    read(Q);
    solve(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        int x;
        read(x);
        printf("%d\n", NewGraph::solve(x));
    }
}

int main() {
    int ca;
    read(ca);
    while (ca--) work(), puts("");
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int ans=0x7fffffff,m,n;
int a[105][105],sum[105][105];

void check(int x,int y) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) sum[i][j]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            sum[i][j]=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
            int xx=max(0,i-x),yy=max(0,j-y);
            int v=a[i][j]-(sum[i][j]-sum[xx][j]-sum[i][yy]+sum[xx][yy]);
            if (v<0) return;
            ret+=v;
            sum[i][j]+=v;
        }
    ans=min(ret,ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) check(i,j);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2242.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

int ch=0;
inline bool read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch==-1) return 0;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return 1;
}
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x,LL MOD) {
    a%=MOD;
    LL ans=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ans=(ans*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

LL exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (!b) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return a;
    }
    LL g=exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
    return g;
}

void solve2(LL a,LL z,LL p) {
    LL x,y;
    // solve ax - py == Z (mod P)
    LL g=exgcd(a,-p,x,y);
    if (z%g!=0) puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
    else {
        x=(x*(z/g))%p;
        if (x<0) printf("%lld\n",x+p);
        else printf("%lld\n",x);
    }
}

map<LL,LL> Hash;

void solve3(LL y,LL z,LL p) {
    // solve y^x==z -> y ^ (km + i) == z
    y%=p;
    if (z==1) {
        puts("0");
        return;
    }
    if (y==0) {
        if (z==0) puts("1");
        else puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
        return;
    }
    LL m=(LL)sqrt(p)+1;
    Hash.clear();
    Hash[1]=-1;
    for (LL i=1,t=1; i<m; i++) {
        t=(t*y)%p;
        if (!Hash[t]) Hash[t]=i;
    }
    LL temp=quickpower(y,p-m-1,p),ine=1;
    for (LL k=0; k<m; k++) {
        LL x=Hash[(z*ine)%p];
        if (x) {
            if (x==-1) x=0;
            printf("%lld\n",k*m+x);
            return;
        }
        ine=(ine*temp)%p;
    }
    puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
}

int main() {
    int T;
    while (scanf("%d",&T)!=EOF) {
        LL y,z,p;
        int k;
        scanf("%d",&k);
        while (T--) {
            scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&y,&z,&p);
            if (k==1) {
                printf("%lld\n",quickpower(y,z,p));
            } else if (k==2) {
                solve2(y,z,p);
            } else {
                solve3(y,z,p);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2243.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='C') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='C';
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072

int n,m;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int ecnt,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct chain_node {
    int top,dep,fa,maxs,son,size,tid;
} a[MAXN];

int rev[MAXN],dfn=0;

void finds(int x) {
    a[x].size=1;
    a[x].maxs=a[x].son=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=a[x].fa) {
            a[v].fa=x;
            a[v].dep=a[x].dep+1;
            finds(v);
            a[x].size+=a[v].size;
            if (a[v].size>a[x].maxs) {
                a[x].maxs=a[v].size;
                a[x].son=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    a[x].tid=++dfn;
    rev[dfn]=x;
    a[x].top=anc;
    if (a[x].son) {
        link(a[x].son,anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=a[x].son && e[now].to!=a[x].fa) {
                link(e[now].to,e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int col[MAXN];
// Segment Tree
struct node {
    int head,tail,lch,rch,tot;
} t[s<<1];
struct line {
    int head,tail,tot;
    line() {}
    line(int z,int x,int c):head(z),tail(x),tot(c) {}
};

line merge(line x,line y) {
    line ret=line(x.head,y.tail,x.tot+y.tot);
    if (x.tail==y.head) ret.tot--;
    return ret;
}

void t_merge(int now) {
    t[now].head=t[t[now].lch].head;
    t[now].tail=t[t[now].rch].tail;
    t[now].tot=t[t[now].lch].tot+t[t[now].rch].tot;
    if (t[t[now].lch].tail==t[t[now].rch].head) t[now].tot--;
}

int tcnt=0,root;
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now].lch=t[now].rch=0;
        t[now].head=t[now].tail=col[rev[l]];
        t[now].tot=1;
        return now;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
    t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
    t_merge(now);
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    t[t[x].lch].head=t[t[x].lch].tail=t[x].head;
    t[t[x].rch].head=t[t[x].rch].tail=t[x].tail;
    t[t[x].lch].tot=t[t[x].rch].tot=1;
}

line query(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l!=r && t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
        pushdown(x);
    }
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        return line(t[x].head,t[x].tail,t[x].tot);
    }

    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid && qr>mid) {
        line lx=query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,mid),ly=query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,mid+1,qr);
        return merge(lx,ly);
    } else {
        if (ql<=mid) {
            return query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,qr);
        } else {
            return query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,ql,qr);
        }
    }
}

void modify(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,int v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].head=t[x].tail=v;
        t[x].tot=1;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
        pushdown(x);
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) {
        modify(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid),v);
    }
    if (qr>mid) {
        modify(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    }
    t_merge(x);
}

void change(int u,int v,int c) {
    while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
        if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
        modify(1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
        u=a[a[u].top].fa;
    }
    if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
    modify(1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
        if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
        u=a[a[u].top].fa;
    }
    if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
    return u;
}
line getLine(int x,int LCA) {
    bool flag=1;
    line ret;
    while (a[x].top!=a[LCA].top) {
        if (flag) {
            //		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
            ret=query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid);
            //		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
            flag=0;
        } else {
            //		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
            ret=merge(query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
            //		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
        }
        x=a[a[x].top].fa;
    }
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n",LCA,x);
    if (flag) return query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid);
    else return merge(query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
}

int ask(int u,int v) {
    int LCA=getLCA(u,v);
//	printf("%d\n",LCA);
    line lx=getLine(u,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",lx.head,lx.tail,lx.tot);
    line ly=getLine(v,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",ly.head,ly.tail,ly.tot);
    swap(lx.head,lx.tail);
    lx=merge(lx,ly);
    return lx.tot;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(col[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    a[1].fa=0;
    a[1].dep=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    root=build(1,n);
}

void work() {
    for (int i=1,u,v,c; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(c);
            change(u,v,c);
        } else {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            printf("%d\n",ask(u,v));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2245.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 256
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*64];

int m,n,S=0,T=1,ecnt=1;
int L[MAXN],t[MAXN][MAXN],W[MAXN][MAXN],dis[MAXN*2],head[MAXN*2],pre[MAXN*2],pos[MAXN*2];
#define task(i) (i+1)
#define worker(i) (i+n+1)
bool inq[MAXN*2];
void add(int u,int v,int flow,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,C; i<=n; i++) read(C),add(task(i),T,C,0);;
    for (int i=1,A; i<=m; i++) for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(A);
            if (A) add(worker(i),task(j),INF,0);
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(L[i]);
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) read(t[i][j]);
        for (int j=0; j<=L[i]; j++) read(W[i][j]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) {
            add(S,worker(i),t[i][j]-t[i][j-1],W[i][j]);
        }
        add(S,worker(i),INF,W[i][L[i]]);
    }
}
queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    memset(pos,0,sizeof(pos));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pos[T]>0;
}

void work() {
    LL ans=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int Minflow=INF;
        for (int x=1; x; x=pre[x]) {
            Minflow=min(Minflow,e[pos[x]].flow);
        }
        ans+=LL(Minflow)*dis[T];
        for (int x=T; x; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow-=Minflow;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow+=Minflow;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2259.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0'||ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';

    }
}
#define MAXN 1000005
int n,ans=0x7fffffff;
int a[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int q[2097152],head=1048576,tail=1048576;
bool visit[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    if (a[1]+1>=n) {
        printf("%d\n",a[1]+1-n);
        return 0;
    }
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=dis[a[1]+2]=0;
    visit[1]=1;
    q[tail++]=a[1]+2;
    ans=n-a[1]-1;
    while (head<tail) {
        int x=q[head++];
        if (visit[x]) continue;
        visit[x]=1;
        if (a[x]+x>=n) {
            ans=min(ans,dis[x]+a[x]+x-n);
        } else {
            ans=min(ans,dis[x]+n-a[x]-x);
            if (!visit[a[x]+x+1]) q[--head]=a[x]+x+1,dis[a[x]+x+1]=dis[x];
        }
        if (!visit[x-1] && dis[x-1]>dis[x]+1) q[tail++]=x-1,dis[x-1]=dis[x]+1;
        if (x<n && !visit[x+1] && dis[x+1]>dis[x]+1) q[tail++]=x+1,dis[x+1]=dis[x]+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2282.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,s,ecnt=0;
int dis[MAXN],fa[MAXN],head[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
int visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

inline int bfs(int st) {
    fa[st]=st;
    dis[st]=0;
    int he=1,ta=2;
    q[1]=st;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                fa[v]=x;
                dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                q[ta++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
    int d=0,t=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]>d) {
            d=dis[i];
            t=i;
        }
    }
    return t;
}

struct statu {
    int val,tag;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):val(a),tag(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return val<a.val;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> fnt,back,on;
int minans=0x7fffffff;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(s);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    int root=bfs(1);
    int x=bfs(root),tag=0;
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        visit[i]=++tag;
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    for (int i=n; i>1; i--) {
        if (!visit[q[i]]) {
            ans[fa[q[i]]]=max(ans[fa[q[i]]],ans[q[i]]+dis[q[i]]-dis[fa[q[i]]]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        back.push(statu(ans[i]-dis[i],visit[i]));
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    int i=x,j=x;
    on.push(statu(ans[x],visit[x]));
    while (j!=root) {
        while (j!=root && dis[i]-dis[fa[j]]<=s) {
            j=fa[j];
            on.push(statu(ans[j],visit[j]));
        }
        //push back
        while (!back.empty() && back.top().tag<=visit[j]) back.pop();
        //push on
        while (!on.empty() && on.top().tag<visit[i]) on.pop();
        int nowans=on.top().val;
        if (!back.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,back.top().val+dis[j]);
        if (!fnt.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,fnt.top().val-dis[i]);
        minans=min(minans,nowans);
        fnt.push(statu(ans[i]+dis[i],visit[i]));
        i=fa[i];
    }
    printf("%d\n",minans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2286.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 250005
#define LOG 20
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int n, m;
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], dep[MAXN], rev[MAXN], stp = 0;
int q[MAXN * 2], tot = 0, Log[MAXN * 2], st[LOG][MAXN * 2], fir[MAXN];
int fa[LOG][MAXN], Min[LOG][MAXN];

inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return dep[x] < dep[y] ? x : y;
}

inline void init() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) st[0][i] = q[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = tot - (x << 1) + 1;  i <= j; i++) {
            st[k][i] = cmp(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

inline int LCA(int x, int y) {
    x = fir[x], y = fir[y];
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return cmp(st[Log[y - x + 1]][x], st[Log[y - x + 1]][y - (1 << Log[y - x + 1]) + 1]);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++stp;
    rev[stp] = x;
    q[++tot] = x;
    fir[x] = tot;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) {
        fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
        Min[i][x] = min(Min[i - 1][x], Min[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[0][x]) {
            fa[0][e[now].to] = x;
            Min[0][e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            q[++tot] = x;
        }
    }
    R[x] = stp;
}

LL Dis(int x, int y) {
    int d = dep[x] - dep[y], ret = INF;
    for (int i = 0; d; i++, d >>= 1) {
        if (d & 1) {
            ret = min(ret, Min[i][x]);
            x = fa[i][x];
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int K;
int a[MAXN], sta[MAXN], g[MAXN];
LL f[MAXN];

void solve() {
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= K; i++) read(x), a[i] = L[x];
    sort(a + 1, a + K + 1);
    int top = 0;
    sta[++top] = 1, f[top] = g[top] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        int x = rev[a[i]], lca = LCA(sta[top], x);
        while (dep[sta[top]] > dep[lca]) {
            if (dep[sta[top - 1]] <= dep[lca]) {
                int tmp = (int)min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], Dis(sta[top], lca));
                top--;
                if (lca != sta[top]) {
                    sta[++top] = lca;
                    f[top] = g[top] = 0;
                }
                f[top] += tmp;
                break;
            } else {
                f[top - 1] += min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], Dis(sta[top], sta[top - 1]));
                top--;
            }
        }
        if (sta[top] != x) sta[++top] = x, f[top] = 0;
        g[top] = 1;
    }
    while (top > 1) {
        f[top - 1] += min(g[top] ? INF : f[top], Dis(sta[top], sta[top - 1]));
        top--;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[1]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u, w
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(1);
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) solve();
    return 0;
}

        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

#define MAXN 100005
struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};
int n,zcnt=0,cnt=0,m,ans=0;
int a[MAXN],next[MAXN],prev[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void del(int x) {
    prev[next[x]]=prev[x];
    next[prev[x]]=next[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}
priority_queue<statu> q;
void work() {
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        q.push(statu(i,abs(a[i])));
    }
    for (int i=zcnt; i>m; i--) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) {
            q.pop();
        }
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        a[x]=a[prev[x]]+a[next[x]]+a[x];
        del(prev[x]);
        del(next[x]);
        q.push(statu(x,abs(a[x])));
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (!visit[i] && a[i]>0) ans+=a[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(a[2]);
    cnt=2;
    prev[2]=1;
    next[2]=3;
    if (a[2]>0) zcnt=1;
    for (int i=2,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (abs(a[cnt])+abs(x)==abs(a[cnt]+x)) {
            a[cnt]+=x;
            continue;
        }
        a[++cnt]=x;
        if (a[cnt]>0) zcnt++;
        prev[cnt]=cnt-1;
        next[cnt]=cnt+1;
    }
    if (a[2]<=0) a[2]=-1000000001;
    prev[1]=0;
    next[1]=2;
    prev[0]=0;
    next[0]=1;
    if (a[cnt]<=0) a[cnt]=-1000000001;
    a[0]=a[1]=a[cnt+1]=a[cnt+2]=-1000000001;
    prev[cnt+1]=cnt;
    prev[cnt+2]=cnt+1;
    next[cnt+1]=cnt+2;
    next[cnt+2]=cnt+2;
    work();
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2289.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define N 100005
#define eps 1e-6
int n;
LD xx[N], yy[N], rr[N], mi = -1e15, ma = 1e15;

struct Point {
    LD x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point rev() {
        return Point(y, -x);
    }
    Point operator * (LD a) {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (LD a) {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
};

#define power(x) ((x) * (x))
#define sign(x) (x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0))
LD dist(int a, int b) {
    return sqrt(power(xx[a] - xx[b]) + power(yy[a] - yy[b]));
}
#define R rr[a]
#define r rr[b]
int intersec(LD mid, int a, int b) {
    LD d = dist(a, b);
    if (!sign(d)) return 0;
    if (R + r >= d) return 2;
    LD x = (power(R) - power(r) + power(d)) / (2 * d), y = sqrt(power(R) - power(x));
    Point st(xx[a], yy[a]), gox(xx[b] - xx[a], yy[b] - yy[a]), goy = gox.rev();
    gox = gox * (x / d);
    goy = goy * (y / d);
    Point A = st + gox + goy, B = st + gox - goy;
    if (sign(A.x - mid) == sign(B.x - mid)) return sign(A.x - mid) ? sign(A.x - mid) : 2;
    return 2;
}
#undef r
#undef R

int check(LD mid) {
    LD b = -1e15, t = 1e15;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LD a = sqrt(power(rr[i]) - power(mid - xx[i]));
        LD bot = yy[i] - a, top = yy[i] + a;
        if (bot > t - eps || top - eps < b) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                LD a_ = sqrt(power(rr[j]) - power(mid - xx[j]));
                LD bot_ = yy[j] - a_, top_ = yy[j] + a_;
                if (bot_ >= top || bot >= top_) return intersec(mid, i, j);
            }
        }
        t = min(top, t);
        b = max(bot, b);
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(xx[i]), read(yy[i]), read(rr[i]);
        mi = max(mi, xx[i] - rr[i]);
        ma = min(ma, xx[i] + rr[i]);
    }
    bool Yes = 0;
    while (ma - mi > eps) {
        LD mid = (ma + mi) / 2;
        int ret = check(mid);
        if (ret == 0) {
            Yes = 1;
            break;
        } else if (ret == -1) ma = mid;
        else if (ret == 1) mi = mid;
        else break;
    }
    puts(Yes ? "YES" : "NO");
    return 0;
}

    swap(a[n], a[n - 1]);
    LD tot = 0;

long long t,a,b,x,y;

long long gcd(long long a,long long b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    return a;
}

inline bool check(long long a,long long b,long long d) {
    return a%d==0 && b%d==0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld",&t);
    for (int i=1; i<=t; i++) {
        scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld",&a,&b,&x,&y);
        long long  d=gcd(2*a,2*b);
        if (check(x,y,d) || check(x+a,y+b,d) || check(x+b,y+a,d) || check(x+a+b,y+a+b,d))
            puts("Y");
        else puts("N");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2301.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 50005
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n;
int prime[MAXN/5],mu[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
LL sum[MAXN+5];
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=mu[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) mu[i]=-1,prime[++pcnt]=i;
        for (int j=1; i*prime[j]<=MAXN && j<=pcnt; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                mu[i*prime[j]]=0;
                break;
            } else mu[i*prime[j]]=-mu[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+mu[i];
    }
}

LL work(int a,int b) {
    int x=min(a,b);
    LL ret=0;
    for (int i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(a/(a/i),b/(b/i));
        ret+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(a/i)*(b/i);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    shake();
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,a,b,c,d,k; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        read(k);
        a--;
        c--;
        a/=k;
        b/=k;
        c/=k;
        d/=k;
        printf("%lld\n",work(b,d)-work(a,d)-work(b,c)+work(a,c));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2306.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define N 105

int n, m, st;

bool G[N][N];
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", w + i);
    read(st);
    scanf("%lf", &p);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) f[i][j][0] = -1e100;
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        f[x][y][0] = w[y] * p;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) f[i][0][0] = 0;
    int now = 0;
    for (int t = 1; t < 60; t++) {
        now = t;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) f[i][j][t] = -1e100;
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++)
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                    f[i][j][t] = max(f[i][j][t], f[i][k][t - 1] + f[k][j][t - 1] * p);
                }
        p = p * p;
        if (p < 1e-10) break;

//BZOJ2314.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 500005
#define MOD 1032992941
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
typedef long long LL;
int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL cnt[MAXN][3],dp[MAXN][3];
// 0 - son 1 - self 2 - fa
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
#define v e[now].to
void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    dp[x][0]=0;
    cnt[x][0]=1;
    dp[x][1]=1;
    cnt[x][1]=1;
    dp[x][2]=0x3f3f3f3f;
    cnt[x][2]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            LL minans=min(min(dp[v][0],dp[v][1]),dp[v][2]),sum=0;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++) if (dp[v][i]==minans) sum+=cnt[v][i];
            dp[x][1]+=minans;
            cnt[x][1]=(cnt[x][1]*sum)%MOD;
            minans=min(min(dp[x][2]+dp[v][1],dp[x][2]+dp[v][2]),dp[x][0]+dp[v][1]);
            sum=0;
            if (dp[x][2]+dp[v][1]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][2]*cnt[v][1])%MOD;
            if (dp[x][2]+dp[v][2]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][2]*cnt[v][2])%MOD;
            if (dp[x][0]+dp[v][1]==minans) sum+=(cnt[x][0]*cnt[v][1])%MOD;
            dp[x][2]=minans;
            cnt[x][2]=sum%MOD;
            dp[x][0]+=dp[v][2];
            cnt[x][0]=(cnt[x][0]*cnt[v][2])%MOD;
        }
    }
}
#undef v

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    dfs(1,1);
    printf("%lld\n",min(dp[1][2],dp[1][1]));
    if (dp[1][2]<dp[1][1]) printf("%lld\n",cnt[1][2]%MOD);
    else if (dp[1][2]>dp[1][1]) printf("%lld\n",cnt[1][1]%MOD);
    else printf("%lld\n",(cnt[1][2]+cnt[1][1])%MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2326.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
LL temp[3][3],n,MOD;
void mul(LL a[3][3],LL b[3][3],LL c[3][3]) {
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<3; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            c[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

LL a[3][3],b[3][3];

void work(LL t,LL to) {
    memset(b,0,sizeof(b));
    b[0][0]=t%MOD;
    b[1][0]=1;
    b[2][0]=1;
    b[1][1]=1;
    b[2][1]=1;
    b[2][2]=1;
    LL y=to-t/10+1;
    while (y) {
        if (y&1) mul(a,b,a);
        mul(b,b,b);
        y>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>MOD;
    LL t=10;
    for (int i=0; i<3; i++) a[i][i]=1;
    while (n>=t) {
        work(t,t-1);
        t=t*10;
    }
    work(t,n);
    cout<<a[2][0]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2330.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
#define MOD 262143
int q[262144],h=0,t=0;

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int cnt[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
bool spfa() {
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[(h++)&MOD];
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if ((cnt[e[now].to]++)>n) return 1;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q[(t++)&MOD]=e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,a,b; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        if (x==1) {
            add(a,b,0);
            add(b,a,0);
        } else if (x==2) {
            if (a==b) {
                puts("-1");
                return 0;
            }
            add(a,b,1);
        } else if (x==3) {
            add(b,a,0);
        } else if (x==4) {
            if (a==b) {
                puts("-1");
                return 0;
            }
            add(b,a,1);
        } else {
            add(a,b,0);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        q[t]=i;
        t++;
        dis[i]=1;
        inq[i]=1;
    }
    if (spfa()) puts("-1");
    else {
        long long ans=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            ans+=dis[i];
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2333.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool _f = 0;
    _a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') _f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}

inline int readop() {
    while (ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z') ch = getchar();
    int ret;
    switch (ch) {
    case 'U' :
        ret = 1;
        break;
    case 'A' :
        ch = getchar();
        ret = ch - '0' + 1;
        break;
    case 'F' :
        ch = getchar();
        ret = ch - '0' + 4;
        break;
    }
    ch = getchar();
    return ret;
}

#define MAXN 300019

struct Op {
    int op, l, r, v;
} q[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r, v, lz;
} t[MAXN * 2];

struct List {
    int he, ta;
} L[MAXN];

int n, Q;
int a[MAXN], f[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], tid[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tot = 0;

int tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}
void pushdown(int x) {
    t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lz;
    t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lz;
    t[t[x].l].lz += t[x].lz;
    t[t[x].r].lz += t[x].lz;
    t[x].lz = 0;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = a[rev[l]];
    return x;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += v;
        t[x].lz += v;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lz) pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    if (t[x].lz) pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return max(query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid), query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr));
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int x, int y) {
    x = getf(x), y = getf(y);
    if (x != y) {
        if (f[x] > f[y]) swap(x, y);
        nxt[L[x].ta] = L[y].he;
        L[x].ta = L[y].ta;
        f[x] += f[y];
        f[y] = x;
    }
}

void get(int x) {
    for (int y = L[x].he; y; y = nxt[y]) {
        tid[y] = ++tot;
        rev[tot] = y;
    }
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) nxt[i] = 0, L[i].he = L[i].ta = i;
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= Q; i++) {
        q[i].op = readop();
        switch (q[i].op) {
        case 1: // connect x y
            read(x), read(y);
            merge(x, y);
            break;
        case 2: // x += v
            read(x);
            read(q[i].v);
            q[i].l = q[i].r = x;
            break;
        case 3: // v -> x += v
            read(x);
            read(q[i].v);
            x = getf(x);
            q[i].l = L[x].he;
            q[i].r = L[x].ta;
            break;
        case 4: // all += v
            read(q[i].v);
            break;
        case 5: // query x
            read(x);
            q[i].l = q[i].r = x;
            break;
        case 6: // query v -> x
            read(x);
            x = getf(x);
            q[i].l = L[x].he;
            q[i].r = L[x].ta;
            break;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (f[i] < 0) get(i);
    build(1, n);
    int del = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        switch (q[i].op) {
        case 1:
            break;
        case 2 ... 3:
            update(1, 1, n, tid[q[i].l], tid[q[i].r], q[i].v);
            break;
        case 4:
            del += q[i].v;
            break;
        case 5 ... 6:
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, tid[q[i].l], tid[q[i].r]) + del);
            break;
        case 7:
            printf("%d\n", t[1].v + del);
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2342.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
typedef long long LL;

const LL P1 = 19260817, MOD1 = 999999319, P2 = 120180241, MOD2 = 2147483647;
LL X1[MAXN], X2[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL x, y;
    Hash (LL a = 0, LL b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    inline Hash operator + (register char a) const {
        return Hash((x * P1 + a) % MOD1, (y * P2 + a) % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator * (register int len) const {
        return Hash(x * X1[len] % MOD1, y * X2[len] % MOD2);
    }
    inline Hash operator - (register Hash a) const {
        return Hash(x < a.x ? x - a.x + MOD1 : x - a.x, y < a.y ? y - a.y + MOD2 : y - a.y);
    }
    inline bool operator == (register Hash a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], rev[MAXN];

inline Hash get(register int l, register int r) {
    return a[r] - a[l] * (r - l);
}

inline Hash revget(register int l, register int r) {
    return rev[l] - rev[r] * (r - l);
}

int n, R[MAXN], ans = 0;
char ss[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    X1[0] = X2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) X1[i] = X1[i - 1] * P1 % MOD1, X2[i] = X2[i - 1] * P2 % MOD2;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(register int u, register int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

#define s 524288

int t[s * 2];

inline void update(register int x) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
}
inline int find(register int x) {
    while (x < s) {
        x <<= 1;
        if (t[x ^ 1]) x ^= 1;
    }
    return x - s;
}
inline int query(register int l, register int r) {
    static int sta[23];
    register int top = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l & 1) sta[top++] = l ^ 1;
        if (r & 1) if (t[r ^ 1]) return find(r ^ 1);
    }
    while (top--) if (t[sta[top]]) return find(sta[top]);
    return -1;
}

vector <int> G[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d\n%s", &n, ss + 1);
    init();
    register int i, l, r, mid, now;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = n; i; i--) rev[i] = rev[i + 1] + ss[i];
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        l = 0, r = (i << 1) > n ? n - i : i;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (get(i - mid, i) == revget(i + 1, i + mid + 1)) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        R[i] = l;
        add(i - l, i);
    }
    for (now = head[0]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) update(e[now].to);
        if (R[i] > 1) ans = max(ans, query(i, i + R[i] / 2) - i);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans * 4);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2351.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    _c = getchar();
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
int getNxt() {
    _c = getchar();
    while (_c != '0' && _c != '1') _c = getchar();
    return _c == '1' ? 920009 : 108161;
}

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define P 19260817
#define MOD 2147483647
#define MAXN 1005
int m, n, a, b;

LL h[MAXN][MAXN];
map <LL, bool> vis;

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(a);
    read(b);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            h[i][j] = (h[i][j - 1]  * P + getNxt()) % MOD;
        }
    }
    LL Pa = 1, Pb = 1, Pab = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) Pa = (Pa * P) % MOD;
    for (int i = 1; i <= b; i++) Pb = (Pb * P) % MOD, Pab = (Pab * Pa) % MOD;
    for (int j = b; j <= n; j++) {
        LL now = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < a; i++) {
            now = (now * Pb + h[i][j] - h[i][j - b] * Pb) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = a; i <= m; i++) {
            now = (now * Pb + (h[i][j] - h[i][j - b] * Pb) % MOD - ((h[i - a][j] - h[i - a][j - b] * Pb) % MOD) * Pab) % MOD;
            now += now < 0 ? MOD : 0;
            vis[now] = 1;
        }
    }
    int q;
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= q; i++) {
        LL now = 0;
        for (int j = a * b; j; j--) now = (now * P + getNxt()) % MOD;
        putchar(vis[now] + '0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000005
int n,m,p,q;
int f[MAXN],a[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return x;
    else return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    read(q);
    for (int i=n+1; i; i--) f[i]=i;
    for (int i=m; i>=1; i--) {
        int x=(i*p+q)%n+1,y=(i*q+p)%n+1;
        if (x>y) swap(x,y);
        for (int j=getf(x); j<=y; j=getf(j)) {
            a[j]=i;
            f[j]=j+1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",a[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 1010

int n;
void mul(int a[], int b[N][N]) {
    static int c[N];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            c[j] += a[i] * b[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = c[i], c[i] = 0;
}
int a[N][N], b[N][N], c[N][N], d[N], t1[N], t2[N];

bool work() {
    srand(19260817 + n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(b[i][j]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(c[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) t1[j] = t2[j] = rand();
        mul(t1, a);
        mul(t1, b);
        mul(t2, c);
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (t1[j] != t2[j]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    while (~scanf("%d", &n)) puts(work() ? "Yes" : "No");
    return 0;
}
