//BZOJ2407.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 200005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define S 16384
struct Edge {
    int u, v, w, z;
} E[MAXM];
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
};

int t[S * 2], dis[MAXN], p[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
void update(int x, int v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m;

struct Graph {
    edge e[MAXM * 2];
    int head[MAXN], ecnt;
    Graph () {
        ecnt = 1;
    }
    inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    void dijkstra() {
        memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
        memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
        update(1, 0);
        for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
            dis[x] = t[x + S];
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(x, INF);
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + S] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                    update(e[now].to, dis[x] + e[now].w);
                    p[e[now].to] = x == 1 ? (now >> 1) : p[x];
                }
            }
        }
    }
} G1, G2;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].w);
        read(E[i].z);
        if (E[i].v == 1) swap(E[i].u, E[i].v), swap(E[i].w, E[i].z);
        G1.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
        G1.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
    }
    G1.dijkstra();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (E[i].u == 1) {
            if (p[E[i].v] != i) {
                G2.add(1, n + 1, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, E[i].w);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].v, n + 1, E[i].z);
            }
        } else {
            if (p[E[i].u] != p[E[i].v]) {
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, dis[E[i].u] + E[i].w);
                G2.add(1, E[i].u, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
                G2.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
            }
        }
    }
    G2.dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n", dis[n + 1]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2419.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline bool read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        else if (ch == EOF) return 0;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
    return 1;
}

inline void read(double &a) {
    bool f = 0, p = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        else if (ch == '.') p = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (!p) while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
            ch = getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') p = 1, ch = getchar();
    if (p) {
        double x = 0.1;
        while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
            a += x * (ch - '0');
            x *= 0.1, ch = getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const double eps = 1e-7;

#define MAXN 205

struct Equation {
    int tag;
    double v[MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m;
double G[MAXN][MAXN];

void buildEquation() {
    for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
        for (int v = 1; v <= n; v++) {
            if (G[u][v] > eps) {
                a[u][v] += G[u][v];
                a[u][u] -= G[u][v];
            }
        }
    }
    a[1][0] = -1.0;
    a[n][0] = 1.0;
}

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    for (int i = now; i <= n; i++) if (abs(a[i][0]) > eps) return 0;
    /*	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    		if (a[i].tag == 1) swap(a[i], a[1]);
    		else if (a[i].tag == n) swap(a[i], a[n]);
    	}*/
    return 1;
}

void clear() {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    memset(G, 0, sizeof G);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].tag = i;
}

int main() {
    while (read(n) && read(m)) {
        clear();
        for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
            double R;
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(R);
            if (u != v) G[u][v] = G[v][u] = G[v][u] + 1.0 / R;
        }
        buildEquation();
        gauss();
        printf("%.2lf\n", abs(a[1][0] - a[n][0]));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2423.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

#define MAXL 5005
#define MOD 100000000

char X[MAXL],Y[MAXL];
int xlen,ylen,L;
int dp[2][MAXL];
long long cnt[2][MAXL];
int main() {
    scanf("%s%s",X+1,Y+1);
    xlen=(int)strlen(X+1)-1;
    ylen=(int)strlen(Y+1)-1;
    X[0]=0,Y[0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=ylen; i++) cnt[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=xlen; i++) {
        int now=i&1,prev=now^1;
        memset(cnt[now],0,sizeof(cnt[now]));
        memset(dp[now],0,sizeof(dp[now]));
        cnt[now][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=ylen; j++) {
            dp[now][j]=max(max(dp[prev][j],dp[now][j-1]),dp[prev][j-1]+(X[i]==Y[j]));
            if (X[i]==Y[j]) {
                cnt[now][j]=cnt[prev][j-1];
                if (dp[now][j]==dp[prev][j]) cnt[now][j]+=cnt[prev][j];
                if (dp[now][j]==dp[now][j-1]) cnt[now][j]+=cnt[now][j-1];
            } else {
                if (dp[now][j]==dp[prev][j]) cnt[now][j]+=cnt[prev][j];
                if (dp[now][j]==dp[now][j-1]) cnt[now][j]+=cnt[now][j-1];
                if (dp[prev][j]==dp[now][j-1] && dp[now][j]==dp[prev][j-1])
                    cnt[now][j]=cnt[now][j]+MOD-cnt[prev][j-1];
            }
            cnt[now][j]%=MOD;
        }
    }
    cout<<dp[xlen&1][ylen]<<endl<<cnt[xlen&1][ylen]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2426.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXM 50319
#define MAXN 55

int m, B, H, n, sum = 0, ans = 0x7fffffff, tag;
int a[MAXM], h[MAXN], C[MAXN][MAXM];

pair<int, int> v[MAXM];

void work(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) v[i] = make_pair(C[x][i] - C[0][i], i);
    sort(v + 1, v + m + 1);
    int ss = H + h[x], left = sum;
    for (int i = 1; left && i <= m; i++) {
        int use = min(left, a[v[i].second]);
        ss += v[i].first * use;
        left -= use;
    }
    if (ans > ss) {
        ans = ss;
        tag = x;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(B);
    read(H);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(a[i]), sum += a[i];
    sum -= B;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(C[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) H += a[i] * C[0][i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    printf("%d\n%d\n", tag, ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2428.cpp
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#define rep(i,k,n) for(int i=k;i<=n;i++)
using namespace std;
double ave=0.0,ans=0.0,tmp=0.0,T=10000.0,minans=1e30;
int n,m,sum[30],belong[30],a[30];
void fire() {
    T=100000.0;
    memset(sum,0,sizeof(sum));
    ans=0.0;
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        int xx=rand()%m;
        sum[xx]+=a[i];
        belong[i]=xx;
    }
    for(int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        ans+=(sum[i]*1.0-ave)*(sum[i]*1.0-ave);
    }
    while(T>0.1) {
        T*=0.999;
        int t=rand()%n,y;
        int x=belong[t];
        y=rand()%m;
        if(x==y)continue;
        tmp=ans;
        ans-=(sum[x]*1.0-ave)*(sum[x]*1.0-ave);
        ans-=(sum[y]*1.0-ave)*(sum[y]*1.0-ave);
        sum[x]-=a[t];
        sum[y]+=a[t];
        ans+=(sum[x]*1.0-ave)*(sum[x]*1.0-ave);
        ans+=(sum[y]*1.0-ave)*(sum[y]*1.0-ave);
        if(ans<=tmp) belong[t]=y;
        else if(rand()%10000>T) {
            sum[x]+=a[t];
            sum[y]-=a[t];
            ans=tmp;
        } else belong[t]=y;
        minans=min(minans,ans);
    }
}
int main() {
    //freopen("in.in","r",stdin);
    srand('L'+'T'+'Q');
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&a[i]);
        ave+=(a[i]*1.0);
    }
    ave/=(double)m;
    rep(i,1,100)
    fire();
    printf("%.2lf",sqrt(minans/m));
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 1e10

D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}

int n, m;
int a[22], sum;
D avr, ans, s[22], dp[22][7];

D get() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i] = s[i - 1] + a[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) dp[0][i] = INF;
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = INF;
        for (int j = m; j; j--) {
            dp[i][j] = INF;
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[k][j - 1] + power(s[i] - s[k] - avr));
        }
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i][j - 1] + power(avr));
    }
    return dp[n][m];
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    srand(19260817);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), sum += a[i];
    avr = sum * 1. / m;
    D temp = 300000, now = ans = get(), nxt;
    while ((temp *= 0.999) > 0.001) {
        int x = rand() % n + 1, y = rand() % n + 1;
        swap(a[x], a[y]);
        ans = min(nxt = get(), ans);
        if (nxt <= now || (exp((now - nxt)) * RAND_MAX > rand())) now = nxt;
        else swap(a[x], a[y]);
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", (double)sqrt(ans / m));
    return 0;
}

inline void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=1000; i++) {
        dp[i][0]=sum[i][0+1]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=1000; j++) {
            dp[i][j]=(sum[i-1][j+1]-sum[i-1][max(0,j-i+1)]+MOD)%MOD;
            sum[i][j+1]=(sum[i][j]+dp[i][j])%MOD;
        }
    }

//BZOJ2434.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, tcnt = 1;
int t[MAXN][26], fa[MAXN], fail[MAXN], q[MAXN], ans[MAXN], p[MAXN];
vector <pii> Q[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

void build() {
    int x = 1, len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'P') p[++n] = x;
        else if (s[i] == 'B') x = fa[x];
        else {
            int to = s[i] - 'a';
            if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt, fa[tcnt] = x;
            x = t[x][to];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        add(fail[x], x);
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (to) {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
}

int a[MAXN];
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], stp = 0;

void update(int x, int v) {
    for ( ; x <= tcnt; x += x & -x) a[x] += v;
}

int query(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for ( ; x; x -= x & -x) ret += a[x];
    return ret;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++stp;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) dfs(e[now].to);
    R[x] = stp;
}

void T_dfs(int x) {
    update(L[x], 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)Q[x].size(); i++) {
        pii &now = Q[x][i];
        ans[now.second] = query(R[now.first]) - query(L[now.first] - 1);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) if (t[x][i]) T_dfs(t[x][i]);
    update(L[x], -1);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    build();
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        Q[p[y]].push_back(mp(p[x], i));
    }
    dfs(1);
    T_dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2435.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1000005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-48;
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

long long ans=0;
int n,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN];
int q[MAXN],siz[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[1]=1;
    while (h^t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                fa[v]=x;
                q[t++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    bfs();
    for (int i=n; i; i--) {
        int x=q[i];
        siz[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                ans+=(long long)e[now].w*(long long)abs(n-(siz[v]<<1));
                siz[x]+=siz[v];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2437.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int n, m, nm, K;
char s[45];
int G[45][45], vis[1633], mat[1633], stp;

vector <int> ans, E[1633];

int nowx, nowy;

#define lab(i, j) ((i - 1) * m + j)

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)E[x].size(); i++) if (vis[E[x][i]] != stp) {
            vis[E[x][i]] = stp;
            if (!mat[E[x][i]] || find(mat[E[x][i]])) return mat[E[x][i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int match() {
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * nm);
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
            if (E[lab(i, j)].size()) {
                stp++;
                ret += find(lab(i, j));
            }
    return ret;
}

int win(int sp) {
    G[nowx][nowy] = sp;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (((i ^ j) & 1)) E[lab(i, j)].clear();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (G[i][j] && ((i ^ j) & 1)) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int tox = i + dx[d], toy = j + dy[d];
                    if (G[tox][toy] && G[tox][toy] != G[i][j]) {
                        E[lab(i, j)].push_back(lab(tox, toy));
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    int ret1 = match();
    G[nowx][nowy] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (((i ^ j) & 1)) E[lab(i, j)].clear();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (G[i][j] && ((i ^ j) & 1)) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int tox = i + dx[d], toy = j + dy[d];
                    if (G[tox][toy] && G[tox][toy] != G[i][j]) {
                        E[lab(i, j)].push_back(lab(tox, toy));
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    int ret2 = match();
    return ret1 != ret2;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    nm = n * m;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            switch (s[j]) {
            case 'X' :
                G[i][j] = 1;
                break;
            case 'O' :
                G[i][j] = 2;
                break;
            case '.' :
                nowx = i, nowy = j;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    scanf("%d", &K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        int tx, ty, ddx, ddy;
        read(tx);
        read(ty);
        read(ddx);
        read(ddy);
        int w1 = win(1);
        swap(G[tx][ty], G[nowx][nowy]);
        nowx = tx, nowy = ty;
        int w2 = win(2);
        if (w1 && w2) ans.push_back(i);
        swap(G[ddx][ddy], G[nowx][nowy]);
        nowx = ddx, nowy = ddy;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ans.size(); i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    }

    }

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 300319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXM];
int head[MAXN], ecnt;
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}
int dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN], stp = 0, sta[MAXN], top = 0, bel[MAXN], siz[MAXN], scc;
bool inq[MAXN];
void dfs(int x) {
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    sta[++top] = x;
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!dfn[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to), low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        siz[++scc] = 0;
        int now = 0;
        while (now != x) {
            inq[now = sta[top--]] = 0;
            siz[bel[now] = scc]++;
        }
    }
}

vector <int> in[MAXN], out[MAXN];

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!dfn[i]) dfs(i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (bel[i] != bel[e[now].to]) {
                in[bel[e[now].to]].push_back(bel[i]);
                out[bel[i]].push_back(bel[e[now].to]);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= scc; i++) {
        if (in[i].size()) {
            sort(in[i].begin(), in[i].end());
            in[i].erase(unique(in[i].begin(), in[i].end()), in[i].end());
        }
        if (out[i].size()) {
            sort(out[i].begin(), out[i].end());
            out[i].erase(unique(out[i].begin(), out[i].end()), out[i].end());
        }
    }
    int tot = 0, flag = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= scc; i++) {
        if (!in[i].size()) {
            tot++;
            if (siz[i] == 1) {
                bool ok = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < out[i].size(); j++) {
                    ok &= in[out[i][j]].size() > 1;
                }
                flag |= ok;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", 1 - double(tot - flag) / n);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2440.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1000000
int T,K;
int prime[MAXN>>2],mu[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    mu[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,mu[i]=-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            if (i%prime[j]) {
                notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
                mu[i*prime[j]]=mu[i]*mu[prime[j]];
            } else {
                notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
                mu[i*prime[j]]=0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    LL ans=0;
    for (int i=1,ta=int(sqrt(mid)); i<=ta; i++) {
        ans+=mu[i]*(mid/i/i);
    }
    return ans>=K;
}
int main() {
    shake();
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&K);
        LL l=1,r=K*2+1,mid;
        while (l<r) {
            mid=(l+r)>>1;
            if (check(mid)) r=mid;
            else l=mid+1;
        }
        printf("%d\n",l);
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2453.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 10319

int bl[MAXN];

struct Query {
    int l, r, t;
    bool operator < (Query a) const {
        return bl[l] == bl[a.l] ? (bl[r] == bl[a.r] ? t < a.t : r < a.r) : l < a.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

struct Change {
    int x, pre, nxt, t;
} c[MAXN];

int n, siz, m, qcnt, ccnt;
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], ans[MAXN], cnt[1000319];

int t = 0, l = 1, r = 0, tot = 0;

void add(int x) {
    cnt[x]++;
    if (cnt[x] == 1) tot++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[x]--;
    if (cnt[x] == 0) tot--;
}

void apply(int x, int v) {
    if (l <= x && x <= r) {
        del(a[x]);
        add(v);
    }
    a[x] = v;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    siz = int(pow(n, 2. / 3) + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
        bl[i] = i / siz;
    }
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op == 'Q') q[++qcnt] = (Query) {
            l, r, i
        };
        else c[++ccnt] = (Change) {l, tmp[l], r, i}, tmp[l] = r;
    }
    memset(ans, -1, sizeof ans);
    l = 1, r = 0, t = 0, tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= qcnt; i++) {
        while (c[t].t > q[i].t) {
            apply(c[t].x, c[t].pre);
            t--;
        }
        while (t < ccnt && c[t + 1].t < q[i].t) {
            ++t;
            apply(c[t].x, c[t].nxt);
        }
        while (l < q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        while (l > q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (r > q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (r < q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        ans[q[i].t] = tot;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (ans[i] != -1) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

            else b = 1, h = ma[i];
        } else {
            if (mi[i] > h) h = ma[i];
            else b = 0, ans++, h = mi[i];
        }
    }

//BZOJ2462.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/

#define P1 19260817
#define MOD 100000009
typedef long long LL;
using namespace std;
int n,m,A,B,q;
LL pp=1000000007,pA,pB;
int wtf,ha[MAXN][MAXN],hha[MAXN][MAXN];
char s[MAXN];
bitset<MOD> hhh;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&A,&B);
    pB=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=B; i++) {
        pB<<=1;
        if (pB>P1) pB-=P1;
    }
    pA=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=A; i++) pA=(pA*pp)%MOD;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        ha[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            ha[i][j]=ha[i][j-1]<<1;
            if (s[j]=='1') ha[i][j]|=1;
            if (ha[i][j]>P1) ha[i][j]-=P1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
            hha[i][j]=(ha[i][j]-pB*ha[i][j-B])%P1;
            if (hha[i][j]<0) hha[i][j]+=P1;
        }
    memset(ha,0,sizeof(ha));
    for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            ha[i][j]=(ha[i-1][j]*pp+hha[i][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    memset(hha,0,sizeof(hha));
    for (int i=A; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=B; j<=m; j++) {
            hha[i][j]=(ha[i][j]-ha[i-A][j]*pA)%MOD;
            if (hha[i][j]<0) hha[i][j]+=MOD;
            hhh[hha[i][j]]=true;
        }
    scanf("%d",&q);
    for (int i=1; i<=q; i++) {
        int val=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            scanf("%s",s+1);
            int tmp=0;
            for (int k=1; k<=B; k++) {
                tmp<<=1;
                if (s[k]=='1') tmp|=1;
                if (tmp>P1) tmp-=P1;
            }
            val=int((val*pp+tmp)%MOD);
        }
        if (hhh[val]) puts("1");
        else puts("0");
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2502.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#define INF 12345678
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 215

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} ee[MAXN<<10],e[MAXN<<11];

int S,T,SS,TT,eecnt=0,ehead[MAXN],ecnt=1,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],in[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_1(int u,int v) {
    ee[++eecnt].to=v;
    ee[eecnt].next=ehead[u];
    ehead[u]=eecnt;
}

int n;
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow-used));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int work() {
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int now=ehead[i]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
            add(i,ee[now].to,INF),in[i]--,in[ee[now].to]++;
        }
    }
    SS=n+1;
    TT=SS+1;
    S=TT+1;
    T=S+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(SS,i,INF);
        add(i,TT,INF);
        if (in[i]>0) add(S,i,in[i]);
        else if (in[i]<0) add(i,T,-in[i]);
    }
    add(TT,SS,INF);
    dinic();
    int ans=e[ecnt].flow;
    head[SS]=e[head[SS]].next;
    head[TT]=e[head[TT]].next;
    for (int now=head[S]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].flow=e[now^1].flow=0;
    }
    for (int now=head[T]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].flow=e[now^1].flow=0;
    }
    add(S,TT,INF);
    add(SS,T,INF);
    return ans-dinic();
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&x);
        for (int j=1,p; j<=x; j++) {
            scanf("%d",&p);
            add_1(i,p);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",work());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2510.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define MAXN 1005

int n, m, K, A[MAXN];
LD tr[MAXN], b[MAXN], c[MAXN];

void mul(LD a[MAXN]) {
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        c[j] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) c[j] += a[k] * b[(j - k + n) % n];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = c[i];
}

void work() {
    tr[0] = 1, b[0] = LD(m - 1) / m, b[n - 1] = LD(1) / m;
    while (K) {
        if (K & 1) mul(tr);
        mul(b);
        K >>= 1;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(A[i]);
    work();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        c[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            c[i] += A[j] * tr[(j - i + n) % n];
        }
        printf("%.3lf\n", (double)c[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int n,m,ecnt=0;

struct statu {

    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }

priority_queue<statu> q;
void work_1() {
    for (int i=1; i<=ecnt; i++) in[e[i].to]++;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (!in[i]) q.push(statu(i,K[i]));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        s[++scnt]=x;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (--in[e[now].to]==0) {
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,K[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=n; i; i--) {
        printf("%d ",s[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

int work_2(int xx) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) in[i]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=ecnt; i++) in[e[i].to]++;
    while (!q.empty()) q.pop();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (!in[i] && i!=xx) q.push(statu(i,K[i]));
    for (int kkk=n; kkk>=1; kkk--) {
        if (q.empty()) return n-kkk;
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        if (K[x]<kkk) return n-kkk;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (--in[e[now].to]==0 && e[now].to!=xx) {
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,K[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
    return n;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(K[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(v);
        read(u);
        add(u,v);
    }
    work_1();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d",n-work_2(i));
        if (i<n) printf(" ");
    }
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';

    }

struct data {
    int u,v;
} y[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM<<2];

int n,m,r,t,k,S=0,T,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt=1;

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool act[MAXN];

int check() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (act[i]) add(S,i,1);
    }
    int ret=dinic();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (act[i] && !e[head[i]].flow) {
            e[head[i]^1].flow=0;
            act[i]=0;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(r);
    read(t);
    read(k);
    T=n+m+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        read(y[i].u);
        read(y[i].v);
        y[i].v+=n;
    }
    int lim=t/r,score=0,penal=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) act[i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) add(i+n,T,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) add(y[i].u,y[i].v,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=lim; i++) {
        int ret=check();
        if (ret) {
            score+=ret;
            penal+=ret*i*r;
        } else break;
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",score,penal);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 300019

struct PT {
    map <int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int last, n, p;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        cnt[p] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        return p++;
    }
    inline void init() {
        p = 0;
        newNode(0);
        newNode(-1);
        last = 0;
        n = 0;
        S[0] = -1;
        fail[0] = 1;
    }
    inline int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    inline int add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
        return len[cur] + 2;
    }
} T;

int n, P1[MAXN], P2[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P1[i] = T.add(s[i]);
    T.init();
    for (int i = n; i; i--) P2[i] = T.add(s[i]);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) ans = max(ans, P1[i] + P2[i + 1]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2588.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int to,next;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int t[MAXN*22],L[MAXN*22],R[MAXN*22];
int rt[MAXN],Q[MAXN],head[MAXN],father[MAXN],dep[MAXN];

int hh[MAXN],hcnt;
int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=hcnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (hh[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int ecnt=0,tcnt=0,n,m;

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt++;
    e[ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    L[now]=L[x];
    R[now]=R[x];
    t[now]=t[x]+v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    if (p<=mid)
        L[now]=update(L[x],l,mid,p,v);
    else
        R[now]=update(R[x],mid+1,r,p,v);
    return now;
}

int query(int u,int v,int lca,int flca,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int val=t[L[u]]+t[L[v]]-t[L[lca]]-t[L[flca]];
    if (val>=p)
        return query(L[u],L[v],L[lca],L[flca],l,(l+r)>>1,p);
    else
        return query(R[u],R[v],R[lca],R[flca],((l+r)>>1)+1,r,p-val);
}
void dfs(int x) {
    rt[x]=update(rt[father[x]],0,100000,Q[x],1);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=father[x]) {
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            father[v]=x;
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
}

int f[MAXN][18];
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[i][0]=father[i];
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=17; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            f[i][k]=f[f[i][k-1]][k-1];
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            u=f[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if (f[u][k]!=f[v][k]) {
            u=f[u][k];
            v=f[v][k];
        }
    }
    return f[u][0];
}

int __query(int u,int v,int k) {
    int LCA=getLCA(u,v);
    return query(rt[u],rt[v],rt[LCA],rt[father[LCA]],0,100000,k);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",Q+i);
        hh[i]=Q[i];
    }
    sort(hh+1,hh+n+1);
    hcnt=int(unique(hh+1,hh+n+1)-hh-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        Q[i]=find(Q[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    rt[0]=0;
    dep[0]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    father[1]=father[0]=0;
    dfs(1);
    init();
    int lastans=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,k; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&k);
        u^=lastans;
        lastans=__query(u,v,k);
        lastans=hh[lastans];
        printf("%d",lastans);
        if (i!=m) putchar('\n');
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2590.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
struct cow {
    int x,p;
    cow() {}
    cow(int a,int b):x(a),p(b) {}
    bool operator < (cow a) const {
        return p<a.p;
    }
    bool operator > (cow a) const {
        return p>a.p;
    }
};
priority_queue<cow,vector<cow>,greater<cow> > disc,nodisc;
priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int> > price;
int n,k,C[MAXN],P[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
LL m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(P[i]);
        read(C[i]);
        disc.push(cow(i,C[i]));
        nodisc.push(cow(i,P[i]));
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) price.push(0);
    int ans=n;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        while (visit[nodisc.top().x]) nodisc.pop();
        while (visit[disc.top().x]) disc.pop();
        int Pri=nodisc.top().p,tag=0;
        if (!price.empty()) {
            int tt=disc.top().p+price.top();
            if (Pri>tt) Pri=tt,tag=1;
        }
        if (Pri>m) {
            ans=i;
            break;
        }
        m-=Pri;
        if (tag) {
            int x=disc.top().x;
            visit[x]=1;
            disc.pop();
            price.pop();
            price.push(P[x]-C[x]);
        } else {
            int x=nodisc.top().x;
            visit[x]=1;
            nodisc.pop();
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2594.cpp

template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {

    bool _f = 0;

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 1000319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : ma(this), val(0) {}
    inline void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    inline bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        ma = this;
        if (c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
        if (c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
    }
    inline void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    inline void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    inline void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

inline void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

inline Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

inline void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *st[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) st[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) st[top]->relax();
}

inline void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    //return y;
}

inline void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

inline void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

inline void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

inline Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->ma;
}

inline Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];
pair<int, int> E[MAXN + MAXM];

inline void newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(mid, a[u]);
    Link(mid, a[v]);
    E[mid - mem] = make_pair(u, v);
}

inline void delE(Node *mid) {
    int u = E[mid - mem].first, v = E[mid - mem].second;
    Cut(mid, a[u]);
    Cut(mid, a[v]);
}

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    if (getrt(a[u]) == getrt(a[v])) {
        Node *ma = query(a[u], a[v]);
        if (ma->val > w) {
            delE(ma);
            newE(u, v, w);
        }
    } else newE(u, v, w);
}

struct query {
    int op, u, v;
} q[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return u < b.u || (u == b.u && v < b.v);
    }
    bool operator != (edge b) const {
        return u != b.u || v != b.v;
    }
} e[MAXM], K[MAXN];

int n, m, Q, kcnt = 0;

int ans[MAXN], top = 0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
        if (e[i].u > e[i].v) swap(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].op);
        read(q[i].u);
        read(q[i].v);
        if (q[i].u > q[i].v) swap(q[i].u, q[i].v);
        if (q[i].op == 2) {
            K[++kcnt] = (edge) {
                q[i].u, q[i].v, 0
            };
        }
    }
    sort(K + 1, K + kcnt + 1);
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; ; i++) {
        if (i > kcnt) {
            while (j <= m) {
                add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].w);
                j++;
            }
            break;
        }
        while (K[i] != e[j]) {
            add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].w);
            j++;
        }
        K[i].w = e[j].w;
        j++;
    }
    for (int i = Q; i; i--) {
        if (q[i].op == 1) {
            ans[top++] = query(a[q[i].u], a[q[i].v])->val;
        } else {
            add(q[i].u, q[i].v, K[lower_bound(K + 1, K + kcnt + 1, (edge) {
                q[i].u, q[i].v, 0
            }) - K].w);
        }
    }
    while (top) printf("%d\n", ans[--top]);
    return 0;
}

#define N 205
#define NN (N * N / 2 + N)
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
    bool f;
} e[N * N * 4];

int head[NN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v,  w, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -w, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int S = 0, T = 1, node;

#define TOP 8191
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
int q[TOP + 1], dis[NN], pre[NN];
bool inq[NN];

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, (node + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    dis[q[0] = S] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q[(ta++) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

int solve() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f = 0, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

        for (int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) add(S, i + 1, j);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            int to = ++node;
            add(to, T, 0);
            if (a[i][j] == 0) add(j + 1, to, 0);
            else if (a[i][j] == 1) add(i + 1, to, 0);
            else add(i + 1, to, 0), p[i][j] = ecnt, add(j + 1, to, 0);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6 - solve());
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (a[i][j] == 2) {
                if (e[p[i][j]].f) a[i][j] = 1;
                else a[i][j] = 0;
                a[j][i] = 1 - a[i][j];
            }
            printf("%d%c", a[i][j], j == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2599.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ans = INF;
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                    maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                    to = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, k, dep[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int ext[1000319], s[MAXN], top;

stack <int> used;

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dis[x] > k) return;
    s[++top] = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

void work(int x) {
    ext[0] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            top = 0;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) if (ext[k - dis[s[i]]] != INF) {
                    ans = min(ans, dep[s[i]] + ext[k - dis[s[i]]]);
                }
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) {
                ext[dis[s[i]]] = min(ext[dis[s[i]]], dep[s[i]]);
                used.push(dis[s[i]]);
            }
        }
    }
    while (!used.empty()) {
        ext[used.top()] = INF;
        used.pop();
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    work(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 2, u, v, w; i <= n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    memset(ext, 0x3f, sizeof ext);
    if (k == 0) puts("0");
    else {
        solve(0);
        if (ans > n) puts("-1");
        else printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2618.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define INF 1e23
#define eps 1e-14
#define MAXN 2333
inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
    }
};

Point Is(Point p1, Point p2, Point q1, Point q2) {
    D a1 = (q2 - q1) * (p1 - q1), a2 = (p2 - q1) * (q2 - q1);
    return (p1 * a2 + p2 * a1) / (a1 + a2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border () {}
    Border (Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lf %lf %lf %lf\n", p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y);
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return sign((b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1)) > 0;
}

bool ok(Border &p, Border &q, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(p.p1, p.p2, q.p1, q.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

int n, cnt;
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
Point p[MAXN];
int pcnt = 0;

void work() {
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he < 3) puts("0.000");
    else {
        D ans = 0;
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int nxt = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[++pcnt] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[nxt].p1, q[nxt].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
            int nxt = i == pcnt ? 1 : i + 1;
            ans += p[i] * p[nxt];
        }
        printf("%.3lf\n", abs(ans) / 2 + eps);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int m;
        Point first, last, now;
        read(m);
        first.re();
        last = first;
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) {
            now.re();
            a[++cnt] = Border(last, now);
            last = now;
        }
        a[++cnt] = Border(last, first);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2622.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 20];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int n, m, K, dis[MAXN], pre[MAXN], sdis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
#define T 131071
int q[T + 1];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u, w
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= K; i++) {
        read(x);
        dis[x] = sdis[x] = 0;
        q[ta++] = x;
    }
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & T];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (sdis[x] + e[now].w <= dis[e[now].to]) {
                if (pre[e[now].to] != x) sdis[e[now].to] = dis[e[now].to];
                dis[e[now].to] = sdis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
            } else if (sdis[x] + e[now].w < sdis[e[now].to]) {
                sdis[e[now].to] = sdis[x] + e[now].w;
            } else continue;
            if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                q[(ta++) & T] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", sdis[0]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2631.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstring>
#include<vector>
#define REP(i,n) for(int i=0;i<n;++i)
using namespace std;

//Dynamic Tree

typedef long long int64;
const int MOD = 51061;
const int MAX_N = int(1e5) + 10;

struct Mark {
    int64 add, mul; //x*mul+add
    Mark(int64 add, int64 mul) {
        this->add = add;
        this->mul = mul;
    }
    Mark() {
        mul = 1;
        add = 0;
    }
    bool isId() {
        return mul == 1 && add == 0;
    }
};

Mark operator*(Mark a, Mark b) {
    return Mark((a.add * b.mul + b.add) % MOD, a.mul * b.mul % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    Node*p, *ch[2];
    bool rev;
    Mark m;
    int64 sum, val;
    int size;
    bool isRoot;
    Node*fa;
    Node() {
        sum = 0;
        isRoot = 0;
        size = 0;
    }
    void sc(Node*c, int d) {
        ch[d] = c;
        c->p = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == p->ch[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = (val + ch[0]->sum + ch[1]->sum) % MOD;
        size = 1 + ch[0]->size + ch[1]->size;
    }
    void apply(Mark a) {
        m = m * a;
        sum = (sum * a.mul + a.add * size) % MOD;
        val = (val * a.mul + a.add) % MOD;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(ch[0], ch[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setRoot(Node*f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void Node::setRoot(Node*f) {
    fa = f;
    isRoot = true;
    p = null;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (!m.isId()) {
        REP(i,2)
        if (ch[i] != null)
            ch[i]->apply(m);
        m = Mark();
    }
    if (rev) {
        REP(i,2)
        if (ch[i] != null)
            ch[i]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node mem[MAX_N], *C = mem;

Node*make(int v) {
    C->sum = C->val = v;
    C->rev = 0;
    C->m = Mark();
    C->ch[0] = C->ch[1] = null;
    C->isRoot = true;
    C->p = null;
    C->fa = null;
    return C++;
}

void rot(Node*t) {
    Node*p = t->p;
    p->relax();
    t->relax();
    bool d = t->d();
    p->p->sc(t, p->d());
    p->sc(t->ch[!d], d);
    t->sc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isRoot) {
        p->isRoot = false;
        t->isRoot = true;
        t->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node*t) {
    static Node*stk[MAX_N];
    int top = 0;
    while (t != null) {
        stk[top++] = t;
        t = t->p;
    }
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        stk[i]->relax();
}

void splay(Node*u, Node*f = null) {
    pushTo(u);
    while (u->p != f) {
        if (u->p->p == f)
            rot(u);
        else
            u->d() == u->p->d() ? (rot(u->p), rot(u)) : (rot(u), rot(u));
    }
    u->upd();
}

Node*v[MAX_N];
vector<int> E[MAX_N];
int n, nQ;

int que[MAX_N], fa[MAX_N], qh = 0, qt = 0;

void bfs() {
    que[qt++] = 0;
    fa[0] = -1;
    while (qh < qt) {
        int u = que[qh++];
        for (vector<int>::iterator e = E[u].begin(); e != E[u].end(); ++e)
            if (*e != fa[u])
                fa[*e] = u, v[*e]->fa = v[u], que[qt++] = *e;
    }
}

Node* expose(Node*u) {
    Node*v;
    for (v = null; u != null; v = u, u = u->fa) {
        splay(u);
        u->ch[1]->setRoot(u);
        u->sc(v, 1);
        v->fa = u;
    }
    return v;
}

void makeRoot(Node*u) {
    expose(u);
    splay(u);
    u->revIt();
}

void addEdge(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(v);
    v->fa = u;
}

void delEdge(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->sc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->fa = null;
    v->isRoot = true;
    v->p = null;
}

void markPath(Node*u, Node*v, Mark m) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    v->apply(m);
}

int queryPath(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &nQ);
    REP(i,n-1) {
        int u, v;
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        --u, --v;
        E[u].push_back(v);
        E[v].push_back(u);
    }
    REP(i,n)
    v[i] = make(1);
    bfs();
    REP(i,nQ) {
        char cmd;
        scanf(" ");
        scanf("%c", &cmd);
        int i, j;
        scanf("%d%d", &i, &j);
        Node*u = ::v[--i], *v = ::v[--j];
        if (cmd == '+') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(c, 1));
        } else if (cmd == '*') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(0, c));
        } else if (cmd == '/') {
            printf("%d\n", queryPath(u, v));
        } else {
            int k, l;
            scanf("%d%d", &k, &l);
            delEdge(u, v);
            addEdge(::v[--k], ::v[--l]);
        }
    }
}

//BZOJ2631.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c != '+' && _c != '-' && _c != '*' && _c != '/') _c = getchar();
    op = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MOD 51061
typedef long long LL;

struct Mark {
    LL add, mul;
    Mark(LL a, LL m) : add(a), mul(m) {}
    Mark() : add(0), mul(1) {}
    bool operator != (Mark b) const {
        return (add != b.add) || (mul != b.mul);
    }
} I;

Mark operator * (Mark a, Mark b) {
    return Mark((a.add * b.mul + b.add) % MOD, a.mul * b.mul % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *p, *c[2];
    Mark m;
    LL sum, val;
    int size;
    bool rev, isRoot;
    Node () : sum(0), rev(0), isRoot(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int d) {
        c[d] = ch;
        ch->p = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = (val + c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum) % MOD;
        size = c[0]->size + c[1]->size + 1;
    }
    void apply(Mark a) {
        m = m * a;
        sum = (sum * a.mul + a.add * size) % MOD;
        val = (val * a.mul + a.add) % MOD;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setRoot(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setRoot(Node *f) {
    fa = f;
    isRoot = 1;
    p = null;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (m != I) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->apply(m);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->apply(m);
        m = I;
    }
    if (rev) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->revIt();
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->sum = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->m = I;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->isRoot = 1;
    ptr->p = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *t) {
    Node *p = t->p;
    bool d = t->d();
    p->p->setc(t, p->d());
    p->setc(t->c[!d], d);
    t->setc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isRoot) {
        p->isRoot= 0;
        t->isRoot= 1;
        t->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) {
        sta[top++] = x;
        x = x->p;
    }
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; i--) sta[i]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *u, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(u);
    while (u->p != fa) {
        if (u->p->p == fa) rot(u);
        else u->d() == u->p->d() ? (rot(u->p), rot(u)) : (rot(u), rot(u));
    }
    u->upd();
}

Node* expose(Node *u) {
    Node *v;
    for (v = null; u != null; v = u, u = u->fa) {
        splay(u);
        u->c[1]->setRoot(u);
        u->setc(v, 1);
        v->fa = u;
    }
    return v;
}

void makeRoot(Node *u) {
    expose(u);
    splay(u);
    u->revIt();
}

void addEdge(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(v);
    v->fa = u;
}

void delEdge(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->fa = v->p = null;
    v->isRoot = 1;
}

void markPath(Node *u, Node *v, Mark m) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    v->apply(m);
}

LL queryPath(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

int n, Q;
Node*v[MAXN];
vector<int> E[MAXN];

int que[MAXN], fa[MAXN], qh = 0, qt = 0;

void bfs() {
    que[qt++] = 1;
    fa[1] = 0;
    while (qh < qt) {
        int u = que[qh++];
        for (vector<int>::iterator e = E[u].begin(); e != E[u].end(); ++e)
            if (*e != fa[u])
                fa[*e] = u, v[*e]->fa = v[u], que[qt++] = *e;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        E[x].push_back(y);
        E[y].push_back(x);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) v[i] = newNode(1);
    bfs();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        char cmd;
        scanf(" ");
        scanf("%c", &cmd);
        int x, y;
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        Node*u = ::v[x], *v = ::v[y];
        if (cmd == '+') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(c, 1));
        } else if (cmd == '*') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(0, c));
        } else if (cmd == '/') {
            printf("%lld\n", queryPath(u, v));
        } else {
            int k, l;
            scanf("%d%d", &k, &l);
            delEdge(u, v);
            addEdge(::v[k], ::v[l]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int p[MAXN / 4], pcnt;
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    p[++pcnt] = 2;
    for (int i = 3; i < MAXN; i += 2) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i << 1) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    int n;
    read(n);
    int i = 1, j = pcnt, ans = 0;
    while (p[j] > n) j--;
    while (i <= j) {
        ans++;
        int tmp = p[j--];
        while (i <= j + 1 && tmp <= n) tmp *= p[i++];
        i--;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2645.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 4012
#define MAXK 505
int n, k, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN], sum[MAXN], fa[MAXN], fL[MAXN][MAXK], fR[MAXN][MAXK];

vector <int> G[MAXN];

void dfsL(int u) {
    sum[u] = sum[fa[u]] + a[u];
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fL[v][j] = fL[u][j];
        dfsL(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fL[u][j] = max(fL[u][j], fL[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

void dfsR(int u) {
    for (int i = (int)G[u].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fR[v][j] = fR[u][j];
        dfsR(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fR[u][j] = max(fR[u][j], fR[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]), read(a[i]);
        if (fa[i]) G[fa[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    dfsL(1);
    dfsR(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (G[i].size() == 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) ans = max(ans, fL[i][j] + fR[i][k - j] + sum[i]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2648.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

Node *newNode(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int Q[2];
#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (x->d[d] >= Q[d]) x->l = x->l ? insert(x->l, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    else x->r = x->r ? insert(x->r, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    x->upd();
    if ((max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 3) >> 1 > x->siz) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    } else return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define read(a) {a = 0; while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') a = a * 10 + (ch & 15), ch = getchar();}
#define MAXN 20319
#define rint register int
inline int max(rint a, rint b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, he, ta;
} t[MAXN * 33];

struct Range {
    int v, he, ta;
    Range (int a = 0, int b = 0, int c = 0) : v(a), he(b), ta(c) {}
};

int tcnt = 0;

inline Range operator + (Range a, Range b) {
    Range ret;
    ret.v = a.v + b.v;
    ret.he = max(a.he, a.v + b.he);
    ret.ta = max(b.ta, b.v + a.ta);
    return ret;
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].he = max(t[t[x].l].he, t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].he);
    t[x].ta = max(t[t[x].r].ta, t[t[x].r].v + t[t[x].l].ta);
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = -1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    }
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, v);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = 1;
    return x;
}

Range query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Range(t[x].v, t[x].he, t[x].ta);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Range ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

typedef pair<int, int> pii;
int n, Q, x[4], rt[MAXN];
pii p[MAXN];

int main() {
    rint ans = 0, i, j, l, r, v, ch;
    read(n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        read(l);
        p[i] = make_pair(l, i);
    }
    sort(p, p + n);
    rt[n] = build(0, n - 1);
    for (i = n - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        rt[i] = update(rt[i + 1], 0, n - 1, p[i].second);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            read(x[j]);
            x[j] = (x[j] + ans) % n;
        }
        sort(x, x + 4);
        l = 0, r = n - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            j = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            v = query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[1], x[2]).v;
            if (x[0] < x[1]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[0], x[1] - 1).ta);
            if (x[2] < x[3]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[2] + 1, x[3]).he);
            if (v >= 0) l = j;
            else r = j - 1;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans = p[l].first);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int u, v, w, c;
} e[MAXN];

bool B;
bool operator < (const edge &a, const edge &b) {
    return a.w != b.w ? a.w < b.w : (B ? a.c < b.c : a.c > b.c);
}

int n, m, need;
int f[MAXN], ans;
int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}
bool merge(int x, int y) {
    x = getf(x), y = getf(y);
    if (x == y) return 0;
    if (f[x] > f[y]) swap(x, y);
    f[x] += f[y];
    f[y] = x;
    return 1;
}

inline pii check(int mid) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w += mid;

    int tot1 = 0, tot2 = 0;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 0;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            ans += e[i].w;
            tot1 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    ans -= mid * tot1;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 1;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            tot2 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w -= mid;
    return mp(tot1, tot2);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(need);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
        read(e[i].c);
    }
    int l = -100, r = 100;
    while (l <= r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        pii ret = check(mid);
        if (ret.fir <= need && ret.sec >= need) break;
        else if (ret.fir > need) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#define rint register int

struct Num {
    int a[100], len;
    Num() {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 0;
    }
    Num(int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 1;
        a[1] = x;
    }
    int &operator [] (unsigned id) {
        return a[id];
    }
    Num operator + (Num b) const {
        Num ret;
        rint maxlen = len > b.len ? len : b.len, i;
        for (i = 1; i <= maxlen; i++) {
            ret[i] += a[i] + b[i];
            ret[i + 1] = ret[i] / 10000;
            ret[i] = ret[i] - ret[i + 1] * 10000;
        }
        ret.len = maxlen + (!!ret[maxlen + 1]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool odd() const {
        return a[1] & 1;
    }
    Num div2() const {
        Num ret;
        for (int i = len; i; i--) {
            if (a[i] & 1) ret[i - 1] = 5000;
            ret[i] += a[i] >> 1;
        }
        ret[0] = 0;
        ret.len = len - (!ret[len]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator < (Num b) const {
        if (len == b.len) {
            for (rint i = len; i; i--) {
                if (a[i] != b[i]) return a[i] < b[i];
            }
            return 0;
        } else return len < b.len;
    }
    void print() const {
        if (len) {
            printf("%d", a[len]);
            for (int i = len - 1; i; i--) printf("%04d", a[i]);
        } else putchar('0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} zero, one(1);

map <Num, Num> f;

char s[233];
int n;

Num dp(Num x) {
    if (f.find(x) == f.end()) {
        Num ha = x.div2();
        if (x.odd()) f[x] = dp(ha) + dp(ha + 1);
        else f[x] = dp(ha);
    }
    return f[x];
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] ^= '0';
    reverse(s, s + n);
    s[n] = s[n + 1] = s[n + 2] = 0;
    Num N;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i += 4) {
        N[++N.len] = s[i] + s[i + 1] * 10 + s[i + 2] * 100 + s[i + 3] * 1000;
    }
    dp(N).print();
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    f[zero] = zero;
    f[one] = one;
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}
