    bool w;
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].w = t[t[x].l].w | t[t[x].r].w;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else scanf("%lld", &t[x].v), t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    return x;
}

LL sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

void kill(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!t[x].w) return;
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].v = LL(sqrt(t[x].v));
        t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        kill(t[x].l, l, mid);
        kill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return kill(x, l, r);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    build(1, n);
    scanf("%d", &m);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        if (op) printf("%lld\n", sum(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1005

int n, m, ans = 0;
int h[MAXN];
char s[4];

int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN], top = 0;

void solve() {
    sta[top = 0] = p[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int pp = i;
        while (sta[top] > h[i]) {
            ans = max(sta[top] * (i - p[top]), ans);
            pp = p[top];
            top--;
        }
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = pp;
    }
    while (top) ans = max(sta[top] * (m + 1 - p[top]), ans), top--;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            scanf("%s", s);
            if (s[0] == 'F') h[j]++;
            else h[j] = 0;
        }
        solve();
    }
    printf("%d\n", 3 * ans);
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXM 10000005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,s,head[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN],t[MAXN<<1];

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        x<<=1;
        if (t[x^1]<t[x]) x^=1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

void update(int x,LL v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) if (t[x]>v) t[x]=v;
        else return;
}
void del(int x) {
    x+=s;
    t[x]=INF;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)^1]);
}

bool visit[MAXN];
inline long long dijkstra() {
    update(1,0);
    int x=1;
    while (x) {
        visit[x]=1;
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        if (x==n) return dis[x];
        del(x);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to+s]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                update(e[now].to,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
    return -1;
}

        b=max(y%n+1,y%n+1);
        e[i].to=b;
        e[i].next=head[a];
        e[i].w=100000000-100*a;
        head[a]=i;
    }

    int to,next,v;

inline int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {

    }

}
void insert(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++cnt].to=v;
    e[cnt].next=last[u];
    last[u]=cnt;
    e[cnt].v=w;
}
void dijkstra() {
    heap q;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)dis[i]=llinf;
    dis[1]=0;
    id[1]=q.push(make_pair(0,1));
    while(!q.empty()) {
        int now=q.top().second;
        q.pop();
        if(now==n) return;
        for(int i=last[now]; i; i=e[i].next)
            if(e[i].v+dis[now]<dis[e[i].to]) {
                dis[e[i].to]=e[i].v+dis[now];
                if(id[e[i].to]!=0)
                    q.modify(id[e[i].to],make_pair(dis[e[i].to],e[i].to));
                else id[e[i].to]=q.push(make_pair(dis[e[i].to],e[i].to));
            }
    }
}

//BZOJ3041.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1};
typedef long long LL;
int n;
int map[8][8],ans;
bool used[6],ansed;
LL now,lim;
#define istrue(x,y,z) (((x>>(y<<3))>>z)&1)
#define mark(x,y,z) (x|=((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z))
#define remove(x,y,z) (x&=(-1llu)^(((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z)))
#define inrange(x,y) (x>-1 && x<n && y>-1 && y<n)
void dfs(int x,int y,int c) {
    mark(now,x,y);
    remove(lim,x,y);
    for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (inrange(tox,toy) && !istrue(now,tox,toy)) {
            if (map[tox][toy]==c) dfs(tox,toy,c);
            else mark(lim,tox,toy);
        }
    }
}

int get_dif() {
    memset(used,0,sizeof(used));
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (!istrue(now,i,j) && !used[map[i][j]]) {
                used[map[i][j]]=1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

bool fill(int c) {
    bool flag=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (istrue(lim,i,j) && map[i][j]==c) {
                flag=1;
                dfs(i,j,c);
            }
        }
    return flag;
}

void idas(int step) {
    int dfc=get_dif();
    if (!dfc) ansed=1;
    if (step+dfc>ans || ansed) return;
    LL nn=now,ll=lim;
    for (int i=0; i<=5; i++) {
        if (fill(i)) idas(step+1);
        now=nn,lim=ll;
    }
}

int main() {
    while (1) {
        scanf("%d",&n);
        if (!n) break;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
            }
        }
        now=0,lim=0;
        dfs(0,0,map[0][0]);
        ansed=0;
        for (ans=0;; ans++) {
            idas(0);
            if (ansed) {
                printf("%d\n",ans);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3052.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define LOG 16
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, Q, B, ecnt = 0, tot, head[MAXN], V[MAXN], W[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN][LOG + 1], dep[MAXN], sta[MAXN], top = 0, blo[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int dfs(int x) {
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOG; k++) fa[x][k] = fa[fa[x][k - 1]][k - 1];
    sta[++top] = x;
    int siz = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            siz += dfs(e[now].to);
            if (siz >= B) {
                ++tot;
                siz = 0;
                while (sta[top] != x) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
            }
        }
    }
    return siz + 1;
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x&1) u = fa[u][i];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG; i > -1; i--) if (fa[u][i] != fa[v][i]) u = fa[u][i], v = fa[v][i];
    return fa[u][0];
}

void init() {
    fa[1][0] = 1;
    dep[1] = 1;
    B = (int)(pow(n, 2.0 / 3.0)) + 1;
    dfs(1);
    while (top) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
}

struct Query {
    int u, v, t;
    Query() {}
    Query(int i, int j, int k) : u(i), v(j), t(k) {
        if (blo[i] > blo[j]) swap(i, j);
    }
    bool operator < (Query i) const {
        if (blo[u] != blo[i.u]) return blo[u] < blo[i.u];
        else if (blo[v] != blo[i.v]) return blo[v] < blo[i.v];
        else return t < i.t;
    }
} q[MAXN];
int qq = 0;

struct Change {
    int x, t, pre, suc;
    Change() {}
    Change(int i, int j, int k, int l) : x(i), t(j), pre(k), suc(l) {}
} c[MAXN];
int cc = 0;

LL ans[MAXN], answer = 0;
int cnt[MAXN], C[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void go(int x) {
    if (vis[x] ^= 1) answer += (LL)W[++cnt[C[x]]] * V[C[x]];
    else answer -= (LL)W[cnt[C[x]]--] * V[C[x]];
}

void modify(int x, int y) {
    if (vis[x]) answer -= (LL)W[cnt[C[x]]--] * V[C[x]];
    C[x] = y;
    if (vis[x]) answer += (LL)W[++cnt[C[x]]] * V[C[x]];
}

void moveTo(int u, int v) {
    int lca = LCA(u, v);
    while (u != lca) go(u), u = fa[u][0];
    while (v != lca) go(v), v = fa[v][0];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(V[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(W[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(C[i]), tmp[i] = C[i];
    init();
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (op) q[++qq] = Query(x, y, i);
        else c[++cc] = Change(x, i, tmp[x], y), tmp[x] = y;
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + qq + 1);
    int u = 1, v = 1, cp = 0;
    memset(ans, -1, sizeof(ans));
    for (int i = 1; i <= qq; i++) {
        while (cp < cc && c[cp + 1].t < q[i].t) cp++, modify(c[cp].x, c[cp].suc);
        while (cp && c[cp].t > q[i].t) modify(c[cp].x, c[cp].pre), cp--;
        moveTo(u, q[i].u);
        u = q[i].u;
        moveTo(v, q[i].v);
        v = q[i].v;
        int lca = LCA(u, v);
        go(lca);
        ans[q[i].t] = answer;
        go(lca);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) if (ans[i] != -1) printf("%lld\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3083.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 16777216>>1
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],wbuf[MAX_BUF_SIZE>>2],*ptr,*ptw;
inline void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
    ptw=wbuf;
}
inline void write_buf() {
    fwrite(wbuf,sizeof(char),ptw-wbuf,stdout);
}

#define getchar() (*(ptr++))
#define putchar(x) (*(ptw++)=x)

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void write(int x) {
    int temp=x/10;
    if (temp) write(temp);
    putchar(x-temp*10+'0');
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN],val[MAXN];
int maxs[MAXN],siz[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;
int lt[MAXN],rt[MAXN];
int t[262144],lazy[262144],lch[262144],rch[262144],tcnt=0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (lazy[x]) {
        lazy[lch[x]]=lazy[rch[x]]=t[lch[x]]=t[rch[x]]=lazy[x];
        lazy[x]=0;
    }
}

inline void pushup(int x) {
    t[x]=min(t[lch[x]],t[rch[x]]);
}

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now]=val[l];
        return now;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    lch[now]=build(l,mid);
    rch[now]=build(mid+1,r);
    pushup(now);
    return now;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R,int v) {
    if (l==L && r==R) {
        t[x]=lazy[x]=v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid,v);
    if (r>mid) update(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R,v);
    pushup(x);
}

int query(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R) {
    if (l==L && r==R) return t[x];
    if (lazy[x]) return t[x];
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    int ret=0x7fffffff;
    if (l<=mid) ret=query(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid);
    if (r>mid) ret=min(ret,query(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R));
    return ret;
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            if (siz[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=siz[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    lt[tid[x]]=dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    val[dfn]=a[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    rt[tid[x]]=dfn;
}

void init() {
    fa[1]=1;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    build(1,n);
}

int nowrt=1;

void __update(int u,int v,int w) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        update(1,tid[top[u]],tid[u],1,n,w);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[v]<dep[u]) {
        swap(u,v);
    }
    update(1,tid[u],tid[v],1,n,w);
}

int findtheson(int x,int r) {
    while (top[r]!=top[x]) {
        r=top[r];
        if (fa[r]!=x) r=fa[r];
        else break;
    }

    if (fa[r]==x) return tid[r];
    else return tid[x]+1;
}

int __query(int x) {
    if (nowrt==x) {
        return t[1];
    } else if (tid[nowrt]<lt[tid[x]] || tid[nowrt]>rt[tid[x]]) {
        return query(1,lt[tid[x]],rt[tid[x]],1,n);
    } else {
        int theson=findtheson(x,nowrt);
        int ret=query(1,1,lt[theson]-1,1,n);
        if (rt[theson]<n) ret=min(ret,query(1,rt[theson]+1,n,1,n));
        return ret;
    }
}

int main() {
    init_buf();
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    read(nowrt);
    for (int i=1,opt,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(opt);
        if (opt==1) {
            read(nowrt);
        } else if (opt==2) {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(w);
            __update(u,v,w);
        } else {
            read(u);
            write(__query(u));
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
        int x = a[i];

            }

#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

int LOG(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (x) x >>= 1, ret++;
    return ret;
}

int dp[33][33][33][33][2];

#define Min(x, y) x = min(x, y)

int main() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    n = max(max(LOG(a), LOG(b)), LOG(c));
    a = __builtin_popcount(a);
    b = __builtin_popcount(b);
    c = __builtin_popcount(c);
    if (a + b < c) puts("-1");
    else if (a + b == c) printf("%d\n", (1 << c) - 1);
    else if (!a || !b || !c) puts("-1");
    else {
        memset(dp, 0x7f, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0][0][0][0] = 0;
        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++)
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j <= l; j++)
                    for (int k = 0; k <= l; k++) {
                        if (dp[l][i][j][k][0] != INF) {
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j][k][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0]);
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j + 1][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j + 1][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (2 << l));
                        }
                        if (dp[l][i][j][k][1] != INF) {
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][1]);
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j + 1][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j + 1][k + 1][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (2 << l));
                        }
                    }
        printf("%d\n", dp[n][a][b][c][0] == INF ? -1 : dp[n][a][b][c][0]);
    }
    return 0;
}

    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}

    read(m);

        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {

//BZOJ3110.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

typedef long long LL;

int n, m, nt = 0;
int st[MAXN], tem[MAXN];

#define find(x) int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1, x) - tem)

struct node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN * 233];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy++;
        t[x].v += r - l + 1;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v; // pushup
}

LL query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, rt;
} T[MAXN * 2 + 1];

int Tcnt = 0;

int Build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++Tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        T[x].l = Build(l, mid);
        T[x].r = Build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void Update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int ql, int qr) {
    update(T[x].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) Update(T[x].l, l, mid, p, ql, qr);
        else Update(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, ql, qr);
    }
}

int select(LL k, int ql, int qr) {
    int x = 1, l = 1, r = nt, mid;
    LL rs;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rs = query(T[T[x].r].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
        if (rs < k) r = mid, x = T[x].l, k -= rs;
        else l = mid + 1, x = T[x].r;
    }
    return l;
}

int op[MAXN], a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL c[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op[i]);
        read(a[i]);
        read(b[i]);
        read(c[i]);
        if (op[i] == 1) tem[++nt] = (int)c[i];
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1);
    nt = (int)(unique(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1) - tem - 1);
    Build(1, nt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (op[i] == 1) Update(1, 1, nt, find(c[i]), a[i], b[i]);
        else printf("%d\n", tem[select(c[i], a[i], b[i])]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3123.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 80319
#define LOG 17

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * LOG * LOG];

int rt[MAXN], tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];
int fa[LOG][MAXN], *Fa = fa[0], dep[MAXN], f[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], tot;

int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int x, int y, int lca, int flca, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[y].l].v - t[t[flca].l].v - t[t[lca].l].v;
    if (k <= ls) return query(t[x].l, t[y].l, t[lca].l, t[flca].l, l, mid, k);
    else return query(t[x].r, t[y].r, t[lca].r, t[flca].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    rt[x] = update(rt[Fa[x]], 1, tot, a[x]);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != Fa[x]) {
            Fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv), swap(u, v);
    f[fu] += f[fv];
    f[fv] = fu;
    Fa[v] = u;
    dep[v] = dep[u] + 1;
    dfs(v);
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG - 1; ~i; i--) if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) {
            u = fa[i][u];
            v = fa[i][v];
        }
    return Fa[u];
}

int n, m, T;
char s[3];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        dep[i] = 1, f[i] = -1, rt[i] = update(0, 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        add(x, y);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, x, y, k; i <= T; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        if (s[0] == 'Q') {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(k);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans, k ^= ans;
            int lca = LCA(x, y);
            printf("%d\n", ans = tmp[query(rt[x], rt[y], rt[lca], rt[Fa[lca]], 1, tot, k)]);
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans;
            add(x, y);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3124.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN];
LL dep[MAXN];
int maxd = 1;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (dep[x] > dep[maxd]) maxd = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, fa[e[now].to] = x, dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

LL get(int x, int y) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != y && e[now].to != fa[x]) ret = max(ret, get(e[now].to, -1) + e[now].w);
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, a, b, c; i < n; i++) read(a), read(b), read(c), add(a, b, c);
    int L, R;
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    L = maxd;
    dep[L] = fa[L] = 0;
    dfs(L);
    R = maxd;
    printf("%lld\n", dep[R]);
    int x = R, y = R;
    while (x != L) {
        LL d = get(fa[x], x);
        x = fa[x];
        if (d == dep[y] - dep[x]) R = x;
        if (d == dep[x]) L = x;
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (R != L) ret++, R = fa[R];
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000000007

LL n;
int K;

int len, a[22];
void getlen(LL x) {
    while (x) {
        a[len++] = int(x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
}

int tot = 0;
LL b[211000];
int tr[11000][10];

void dfs(LL mul, int dep, int x) {
    if (mul > n) return;
    if (dep == len) b[++tot] = mul;
    else {
        while (x < 10) {
            dfs(mul * x, dep + 1, x);
            x++;
        }
    }
}

LL f[14][11000][2];
LL g[11000];

struct Node {
    int fir, sec;
    LL v;
    Node () {}
    Node (int x, int y) {
        fir = x;
        sec = y;
        v = g[fir] * g[sec];
    }
    bool operator < (const Node &r) const {
        return v < r.v;
    }
};

priority_queue <Node> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    getlen(n);
    dfs(1, 0, 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + tot + 1);
    tot = (int)(unique(b + 1, b + tot + 1) - b - 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= 9; j++) {
            LL mul = b[i] * j;
            tr[i][j] = int(lower_bound(b + 1, b + tot + 1, mul) - b);
            if (tr[i][j] > tot) tr[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    f[0][1][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (f[i][j][k]) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= 9; x++) {
                        f[i + 1][tr[j][x]][(k + x) > a[i]] += f[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < len; j++) {
            g[i] += f[j][i][0] + f[j][i][1];
        }
        g[i] += f[len][i][0];
    }

    sort(g + 1, g + tot + 1);
    q.push(Node(tot, tot));
    LL ans = 0;
    while (K--) {
        Node x = q.top();
        q.pop();
        (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
        if (x.fir < x.sec && K) {
            K--;
            (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
            q.push(Node(x.fir, x.sec - 1));
        }
        if (x.sec == tot) q.push(Node(x.fir - 1, x.sec));
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3140.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 15319

struct Point {
    int x, y, z;
} p[MAXN];

int a, b, c, t, swap_tag, pcnt, ans;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int dfn = 0;

int s[MAXN], mat[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

bool find(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (vis[e[now].to] != dfn) {
            vis[e[now].to] = dfn;
            if (!mat[e[now].to] || find(mat[e[now].to])) return mat[e[now].to] = x, 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void check(int st, int cnt) {
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * b);
    ecnt = 0;
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) if (!((st >> p[i].x) & 1) && s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] != st) add(p[i].y, p[i].z), s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i <= b && ans > cnt; i++) ++dfn, cnt += find(i);
    ans = cnt;
}

void work() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    if (a <= b && a <= c) swap_tag = 0;
    else if (b <= a && b <= c) swap_tag = 1;
    else swap_tag = 2;
    pcnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0, x; i < a; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < b; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < c; k++) {
                read(x);
                if (x) p[++pcnt] = (Point) {
                    i, j, k
                };
            }
    if (swap_tag == 1) {
        swap(a, b);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].y);
    } else if (swap_tag == 2) {
        swap(a, c);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].z);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) p[i].y++, p[i].z++;
    t = 1 << a;
    ans = a;
    memset(s, -1, sizeof s);
    for (int i = 0, cnt; i < t; i++) if ((cnt = __builtin_popcount(i)) < ans) check(i, cnt);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int CA;
    read(CA);
    while (CA--) work();
    return 0;
}

        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

#define MAXN 505
typedef double LD;
const LD eps = 1e-9;
struct edge {
    int u, v;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

struct Equa {
    LD v[MAXN];
    LD &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m, d[MAXN];

void gauss() {
    n--;
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    n++;
}

LD w[MAXN * MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v);
        a[e[i].u][e[i].v] = a[e[i].v][e[i].u] = -1;
        d[e[i].u]++, d[e[i].v]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < n; ++j)
            if (d[j]) a[i][j] = a[i][j] / d[j];
        a[i][i] = 1, a[i][0] = 0;
    }
    a[1][0] = 1;
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (d[i]) a[i][0] /= d[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        w[i] = a[e[i].u][0] + a[e[i].v][0];
    }
    sort(w + 1, w + m + 1);
    LD ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans += w[i] * (m - i + 1);
    printf("%.3lf\n", (double)ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005

int n;
LL f[MAXN], a[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(2 * f[j] + (LL)j * j + j - 2 * f[k] - (LL)k * k - k) / (j - k);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < 2 * i) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + LL(i - j) * (i - j - 1) / 2 + a[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 262144
#define MOD 1000000007

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
} A[MAXN], B[MAXN];

int R[MAXN];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++ ) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step = Comp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

struct Pam {
    int nxt[MAXN / 2][2];
    int fail[MAXN / 2], cnt[MAXN / 2], len[MAXN / 2], S[MAXN / 2];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p][0] = nxt[p][1] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        n = p = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        int &now = nxt[cur][c];
        if (!now) {
            fail[p] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
        }
        last = now;
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) {
            cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
        }
    }
} T;

char s[MAXN / 2];
int N, n, tot[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

void work(char x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        A[i] = B[i] = Comp(i < N ? (s[i] == x) : 0, 0);
    }
    FFT(A, n, 1);
    FFT(B, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A[i] * B[i];
    FFT(A, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tot[i] += int(A[i].r + 0.5);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    N = (int) strlen(s);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) T.add(s[i] - 'a');
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p - 1; i > 1; i--) ans = (ans - T.cnt[i]) % MOD;
    for (n = 2; n < N; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 1;
    getR(n);
    work('a');
    work('b');
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = (ans + power(2, (tot[i] + 1) / 2) - 1) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", int((ans + MOD) % MOD));
    return 0;
}

        yy[i]=p[i].y;
    }

        ret+=p[i].y*py-sumy[py]+sumy[n]-sumy[py]-(n-py)*p[i].y;

        ch = getchar();
    }

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1}, dt[] = {'D', 'U', 'R', 'L'};

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[29 * 29 * 4 * 2];

int head[29 * 29], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m, node = 1;
int G[29][29];
char s[29];

queue <int> q;
bool inq[29 * 29];
int dis[29 * 29], pre[29 * 29];

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * node);
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] <= node;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            add(S, G[i][j] = ++node, 0);
            add(++node, T, 0);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int tx = (i + dx[d] + n) % n, ty = (j + dy[d] + m) % m;
                if (dt[d] == s[j]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 0);
                else add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", MCMF());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], Log[MAXN];

int st[LOG][MAXN];

#define rmq(l, r) min(st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][l], st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][r - (1 << Log[r - (l) + 1]) + 1])

void getsa(int n) {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], c[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = c[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; c[i + k] == c[j + k]; k++);
    }

    /*
    	Log[0] = -1;
    	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[0][i] = h[i];
    	for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
    		for (int i = 1, q = 1 << (i - 1), j = n - (q << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
    			st[k][i] = min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + q]);
    	}*/
}

int n, p[MAXN], len[MAXN], Len;

int query(int x, int y) {
    /*
    	int ret = 1, l, r, mid;
    	l = 1, r = x + 1;
    	while (l < r) {
    		mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    		if (rmq(mid, x) >= y) r = mid;
    		else l = mid + 1;
    	}
    	ret += x - l + 1;

    	l = x, r = Len;
    	while (l < r) {
    		mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    		if (rmq(x + 1, mid) >= y) l = mid;
    		else r = mid - 1;
    	}
    	ret += l - x;
    */
    int L = x, R = x;
    for (L = x; h[L] >= y; L--);
    for (R = x; h[R + 1] >= y; R++);
    return R - L + 1;
}

int main() {

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {

        s[p[i] - 1] = '$';

        len[i] = (int)strlen(s + p[i]);
    }
    Len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa(Len);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", query(rk[p[i]], len[i]));
    }
    return 0;
}

int query(int x, int y) {

    int ret = 1, l, r, mid;
    l = 1, r = x + 1;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= y) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    ret += x - l + 1;

        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x + 1, mid) >= y) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    ret += l - x;

    return ret;
}

//BZOJ3175.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, 1, -1, -1, 2, 2, -2, -2}, dy[] = {2, -2, 2, -2, 1, -1, 1, -1};

#define MAXN 205
#define NN MAXN * MAXN
struct edge {
    int next, to;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 8 * 4];

int head[NN], cur[NN], ecnt = 1;
const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, G[MAXN][MAXN], node = 1;

char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[NN], tag[NN];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * node);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x] && dfs(e[now].to)) {
            e[now].f = 0;
            e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
            now = e[now].next;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        for (int now = head[S]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '0') {
                G[i][j] = ++node;
                if ((i ^ j) & 1) add(S, node);
                else add(node, T);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1 + (i & 1); j <= n; j += 2) if (G[i][j]) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
                    int tx = i + dx[d], ty = j + dy[d];
                    if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && G[tx][ty]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty]);
                }
            }
    }
    printf("%d\n", node - 1 - dinic());
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, 1, -1, -1, 2, 2, -2, -2}, dy[] = {2, -2, 2, -2, 1, -1, 1, -1};

#define MAXN 205
#define NN MAXN * MAXN
struct edge {
    int next, to;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 8 * 4];

int head[NN], cur[NN], ecnt = 1;
const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, G[MAXN][MAXN], node = 1;

char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[NN], tag[NN];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * node);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x] && dfs(e[now].to)) {
            e[now].f = 0;
            e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        for (int now = head[S]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '0') {
                G[i][j] = ++node;
                if ((i ^ j) & 1) add(S, node);
                else add(node, T);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1 + (i & 1); j <= n; j += 2) if (G[i][j]) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
                    int tx = i + dx[d], ty = j + dy[d];
                    if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && G[tx][ty]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty]);
                }
            }
    }
    printf("%d\n", node - 1 - dinic());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000000
#define INF 1000000000
typedef long long LL;
int n,p;
int prime[200000],lowp[MAXN+5],pcnt=0,pl;

void init() {
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!lowp[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            lowp[i]=i;
            if (i==p) pl=pcnt;
            if (i>1000) continue;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=MAXN; j+=i) if (!lowp[j]) lowp[j]=i;
        }
    }
}

void vio() {
    n--;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (i*p>INF) break;
        if (lowp[i]>=p) n--;
        if (!n) {
            printf("%d\n",i*p);
            return;
        }
    }
    puts("0");
}

LL tot=0,kk;

void dfs(int x,LL val,int f) {
    if (val>kk) return;
    if (x==pl) {
        tot+=kk/val*f;
    } else {
        dfs(x+1,val,f);
        dfs(x+1,val*prime[x],-f);
    }
}

bool check(int mid) {
    tot=0;
    kk=mid/p;
    dfs(1,1,1);
    return tot>=n;
}

void work() {
    int l=1,r=INF+1,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>INF) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n",l);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    init();
    if (p>1000) vio();
    else work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3196.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define NODE 1500005
#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, cnt, val;
    Node() : siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[NODE], *Stack[NODE], **Top = Stack, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void init(int top) {
    for (Node *i = mem + top; (i--) != mem; *(Top++) = i);
}

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = *(--Top);
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->val = v, x->siz = x->cnt = 1;
    return x;
}

void release(Node *x) {
    *(Top++) = x;
}

struct Splay {
    Node *root;
    int l, r;
    Splay(): root(null), l(0), r(0) {}
    int size() {
        return root->siz - 2;
    }
    void init() {
        root = newNode(-INF);
        root->setc(newNode(INF), 1);
    }
    void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *fa = x->fa;
        int dir = x->dir();
        fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
        fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
        x->setc(fa, !dir);
        fa->upd();
        if (fa == root) root = x;
    }

    void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
        while (x->fa != fa) {
            if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
            else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }

    Node* select(int k) {
        for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
            int s = x->c[0]->siz;
            if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
            else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
            else return x;
        }
    }

    Node* get(Node* L, Node* R) {
        splay(L);
        splay(R, L);
        return R->c[0];
    }

    Node* leq(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v >= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v >= (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* geq(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v <= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v <= (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* prev(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* succ(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* find(int v) {
        for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
            if (x->val == v) {
                splay(x);
                return x;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = root, *y = null;
            while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
            (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), v > y->val));
            splay(x);
        }
    }
    void del(int v) {
        Node *x = find(v);
        if (!(--x->cnt)) {
            Node *y = x->c[0];
            while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
            splay(y, x);
            y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
            release(x);
        } else x->upd();
    }
} t[262144];

struct QAQ {
    int v, p;
    QAQ() {}
    QAQ(int a, int b): v(a), p(b) {}
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return p < a.p;
    }
} a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];

int n, m;
int num[MAXN], tem[MAXN * 2], lim = 0, tcnt = 0;

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid].p);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void merge(int lpos, int midpos, int rpos) {
    int cnt = 0, i = lpos, j = midpos;
    while (i < midpos && j < rpos) {
        if (a[i].p < a[j].p) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
        else tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    }
    while (i < midpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
    while (j < rpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    i = lpos, j = 0;
    while (j < cnt) a[i++] = tmp[j++];
}

int build(int l, int r, int lpos, int rpos) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1, midpos = int(lower_bound(a + lpos, a + rpos, QAQ(mid + 1, -INF)) - a);
        t[x].l = build(l, mid, lpos, midpos);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, midpos, rpos);
        merge(lpos, midpos, rpos);
    }
    QAQ L = QAQ(0, -INF), R = QAQ(0, INF);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    t[x].root=build(lpos - 1, rpos);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    return x;
}

int getSiz(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].get(t[x].prev(sl), t[x].succ(sr))->siz;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), sl, sr);
    if (qr > mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, sl, sr);
    return ret;
}

int getKth(int x, int l, int r, int k, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ls = getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, l, mid, sl, sr);
    if (k <= ls) return getKth(t[x].l, l, mid, k, sl, sr);
    else return getKth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls, sl, sr);
}

void delVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].del(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) delVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else delVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

void addVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].add(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) addVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else addVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

struct Query {
    int opt, l, r, k;
} Q[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init((n + m) * 15);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].v);
        a[i].p = i;
        tem[++lim] = a[i].v;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(Q[i].opt);
        if (Q[i].opt == 3) {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].k);
        } else {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].r);
            read(Q[i].k);
        }
        if (Q[i].opt != 2) tem[++lim] = Q[i].k;
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1);
    lim = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1) - tem);
    tem[0] = -INF, tem[lim] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].v = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, a[i].v) - tem);
        num[a[i].p] = a[i].v;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    build(0, lim, 1, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, opt, l, r, k, pos; i <= m; i++) {
        opt = Q[i].opt;
        l = Q[i].l;
        r = Q[i].r;
        k = Q[i].k;
        switch (opt) {
        case 1:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, k - 1, l, r) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, k, l, r)]);
            break;
        case 3:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            delVal(1, 0, lim, l, num[l]);
            addVal(1, 0, lim, l, k);
            num[l] = k;
            break;
        case 4:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem) - 1;
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r), l, r)]);
            break;
        case 5:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r) + 1, l, r)]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3196.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MX 1000000100

int sl, sr;

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *p;
    int sz, v;
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void sc(Node *cc, int q) {
        c[q] = cc;
        cc->p = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sz = c[0]->sz + c[1]->sz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN * 32], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

inline Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->p = null;
    ptr->sz = 1;
    ptr->v = v;
    return ptr++;
}

struct Tnode {
    int l, r;
    Node *rt;
    Tnode() {
        rt = null;
    }
    inline void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *p = x->p;
        bool d = x->d();
        p->p->sc(x, p->d());
        p->sc(x->c[!d], d);
        x->sc(p, !d);
        p->upd();
        if (p == rt) rt = x;
    }
    inline void splay(Node *x, Node *p = null) {
        while (x->p != p) {
            if (x->p->p == p) rot(x);
            else x->d() == x->p->d() ? (rot(x->p), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }
    inline void ins(int v) {
        if (rt == null) rt = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = rt;
            while (x != null) {
                bool d = v > x->v;
                if (x->c[d] == null) {
                    x->sc(newNode(v), d);
                    splay(x->c[d]);
                    return;
                }
                x = x->c[d];
            }
        }
    }
    inline void del(int v) {
        Node *x = rt;
        while (x != null) {
            if (x->v == v) {
                splay(x);
                if (x->c[0] == null) rt = x->c[1], rt->p = null;
                else {
                    Node *y = x->c[0];
                    while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
                    splay(y, x);
                    y->sc(x->c[1], 1);
                    rt = y;
                    y->p = null;
                    y->upd();
                }
                return;
            }
            x = x->c[v > x->v];
        }
    }
    inline int count(int v, bool in) {
        if (rt == null) return 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
            if (v < x->v) {
                if (x->c[0] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[0];
            } else if (v > x->v) {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz + 1;
                if (x->c[1] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[1];
            } else {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz;
                splay(x);
                return cnt + in;
            }
        }
    }
    inline int cnt() {
        int a = count(sr, 1);
        int b = count(sl, 0);
        return a - b;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, m, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];

#define sz() rt->sz

void ins(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].ins(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) ins(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else ins(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

void del(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    t[x].del(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) del(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else del(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

int cnt(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        return t[x].cnt();
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += cnt(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += cnt(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int kth(int x, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].cnt();
    if (k <= ls) return kth(t[x].l, l, mid, k);
    else return kth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].r].cnt()) x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
            else x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int Min(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].l].cnt()) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
            else x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ins(rt, -MX, MX, a[i], i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int op, x;
        read(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", cnt(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", kth(rt, -MX, MX, x));
            break;
        case 3:
            read(op);
            read(x);
            del(rt, -MX, MX, a[op], op);
            a[op] = x;
            ins(rt, -MX, MX, x, op);
            break;
        case 4:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Max(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1));
            break;
        case 5:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Min(rt, -MX, MX, x + 1, MX));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        ch=getchar();
    }

typedef unsigned long long LL;

struct query {
    int x,y,id;
    LL ha;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }

LL hh(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=ha[r]-ha[l-1]*mi;
    return ret;
}
void getHash(LL &ret) {
    ret=0;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=k; i++) {
        read(x);
        ret=ret*19260817+x;
    }
}

    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    ha[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*19260817+a[i];
    }

    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) mi=mi*19260817;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].y);
        getHash(q[i].ha);
        q[i].id=i;
    }

        Tree[hh(i-k+1,i)]=i;
        while (j<=m && q[j].y==i) {
            if (Tree[q[j].ha]>=q[j].x+k-1) ans[q[j].id]=1;
            j++;
        }

        if (ans[i]) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
