long long calc(int ansx, int ansy) {
    long long ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ret += abs(x[i] - ansx) + abs(y[i] - ansy);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1, xx, yy; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &xx, &yy);
        x[i] = xx + yy;
        y[i] = xx - yy;
    }
    sort(x + 1, x + n + 1);
    sort(y + 1, y + n + 1);
    int ansx = x[(n + 1) / 2], ansy = y[(n + 1) / 2];
    if ((~ansx^ansy)&1) printf("%lld\n", calc(ansx, ansy) / 2);
    else printf("%lld\n", min(min(calc(ansx - 1, ansy), calc(ansx + 1, ansy)), min(calc(ansx, ansy - 1), calc(ansx, ansy + 1))) / 2);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3211.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
int n,m,a[MAXN],tcnt=0;
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[s<<1];
LL sum[s<<1];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    } else {
        t[now].v=a[l]>1;
    }
    return now;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        sum[s+i]=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        sum[i]=sum[i<<1]+sum[(i<<1)|1];
    }
    build(1,n);
}

LL query(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=sum[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=sum[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void dec(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) sum[x]-=d;
}

void work(int now,int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) {
        int to=int(sqrt(sum[l+s]));
        dec(l,int(sum[l+s])-to);
        if (to<=1) t[now].v=0;
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) work(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) work(rch,mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    }
}

void update(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (!t[now].v) return;
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        work(now,l,r);
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) update(lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) update(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x==1) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(l,r));
        } else {
            update(1,1,n,l,r);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3212.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
template<class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

bool readop() {
    while (ch != 'Q' && ch != 'C') ch = getchar();
    return ch == 'Q';
}
typedef long long LL;
struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL sum, lazy;
} t[262144];

int n, q, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    } else read(t[x].sum);
    return x;
}

void pushdown(int x, int ls, int rs) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].sum += (LL)t[x].lazy * ls;
        t[t[x].r].sum += (LL)t[x].lazy * rs;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

LL Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid) ret += Sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr);
    return ret;
}

void change(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int c) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].sum += (LL)c * (r - l + 1);
        t[x].lazy += c;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    if (ql <= mid) change(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid), c);
    if (qr > mid) change(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr, c);
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, c; i <= q; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            printf("%lld\n", Sum(1, 1, n, l, r));
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(c);
            change(1, 1, n, l, r, c);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3218.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 5011
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 123];

int head[MAXN * 18], ecnt = 1, cur[MAXN * 18];

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 18];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, tcnt;
int rt[MAXN];
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], W[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], P[MAXN];
int tmp[MAXN * 3], tot = 0;

int nowx;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (pre) add(pre, x, INF);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) add(t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p), x, INF);
        else add(t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p), x, INF);
    } else add(nowx * 2, x, INF);
    return x;
}

void Link(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(x, nowx * 2 + 1, INF);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Link(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) Link(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

int q[MAXN * 18], tag[MAXN * 18];

inline bool bfs() {
    register int he, ta, x, now;
    for (x = 1; x <= tcnt; x++) tag[x] = 0;
    tag[S] = 1;
    q[he = ta = 1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[++ta] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow, ret;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 0; i <= tcnt; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int ans = 0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]), read(b[i]), read(W[i]), read(L[i]), read(R[i]), read(P[i]);
        tmp[++tot] += a[i];
        tmp[++tot] = L[i];
        tmp[++tot] = R[i];
        ans += W[i];
        ans += b[i];
    }
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1) - tmp - 1);
    tcnt = 2 * n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, 2 * i, W[i]);
        add(2 * i, T, b[i]);
        add(2 * i + 1, 2 * i, P[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        L[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, L[i]) - tmp);
        R[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, R[i]) - tmp);
        nowx = i;
        Link(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, L[i], R[i]);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1500000

struct node {
    int data,l,r,fa,rev,size;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):data(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),rev(0),size(0) {}
} a[MAXN];

int n,m,root,tot;

inline void pushup(int x) {
    a[x].size=a[a[x].l].size+a[a[x].r].size+1;
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (a[x].rev) {
        a[x].rev=0;
        swap(a[x].l,a[x].r);
        a[a[x].l].rev^=1;
        a[a[x].r].rev^=1;
    }
}

void build(int &x,int fa,int l,int r) {
    if (l>r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    x=++tot;
    a[x]=node(mid-1,fa);
    build(a[x].l,x,l,mid-1);
    build(a[x].r,x,mid+1,r);
    pushup(x);
}

inline void zig(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].l=a[x].r;
    a[a[x].r].fa=y;
    a[x].r=y;
    if (y==a[z].l) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void zag(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].r=a[x].l;
    a[a[x].l].fa=y;
    a[x].l=y;
    if (a[z].l==y) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void splay(int x,int s) {
    pushdown(x);
    while (a[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=a[x].fa;
        int z=a[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==a[z].l) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==a[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int rank(int x,int k) {
    pushdown(x);
    int s=a[a[x].l].size;
    if (k==s+1) return x;
    if (k<=s) return rank(a[x].l,k);
    return rank(a[x].r,k-s-1);
}

inline void reverse(int l,int r) {
    int x=rank(root,l),y=rank(root,r+2);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    a[a[y].l].rev^=1;
}

void dg(int x) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (a[x].l) dg(a[x].l);
    if (a[x].data>0 && a[x].data<=n) printf("%d ",a[x].data);
    if (a[x].r) dg(a[x].r);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    build(root,0,1,n+2);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
        reverse(l,r);
    }
    dg(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1500000
struct node {
    int data,l,r,fa,rev,siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):data(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),rev(0),siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];
#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r
void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[lch].siz+t[rch].siz+1;
}
void pushdown(int x) {
    if(t[x].rev) {
        t[x].rev=0;
        swap(lch,rch);
        t[lch].rev^=1,t[rch].rev^=1;
    }
}
int n,m,root,tcnt=0;
int build(int fa,int l,int r) {
    if (l>r) return 0;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,x=++tcnt;
    t[x]=node(mid-1,fa);
    lch=build(x,l,mid-1);
    rch=build(x,mid+1,r);
    pushup(x);
    return x;
}

inline void zig(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa;
    int z=t[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    if (y==t[z].l) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa;
    int z=t[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void splay(int x,int s) {
    pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa;
        int z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int kth(int x,int k) {
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",x,k,t[x].siz);
    pushdown(x);
    int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
    if (k<=s) return kth(t[x].l,k);
    else if (k>s+1) return kth(t[x].r,k-s-1);
    else return x;
}
inline void reverse(int l,int r) {
    int x=kth(root,l),y=kth(root,r+2);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    t[t[y].l].rev^=1;
}

void print(int x) {
//	printf("%d\n",x);
    pushdown(x);
    if (t[x].l) print(t[x].l);
    if (t[x].data>0 && t[x].data<=n) printf("%d ",t[x].data);
    if (t[x].r) print(t[x].r);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    root=build(0,1,n+2);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
        reverse(l,r);
        //	printf("Size of 0 : %d\n",t[0].siz);
    }
    print(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val;
    bool rev;
    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->rev ^= 1, c[1]->rev ^= 1;
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, m;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(mid);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1);
    Node *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    x->relax();
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (0 < x->val && n >= x->val) printf("%d ", x->val);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        Node *range = get(l, r);
        range->revIt();
        splay(range);
    }
    dfs(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
struct Node {
    int c[2], fa, siz, val;
    bool rev;
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}
} t[MAXN];

int n, m, tcnt = 0, root = 0;

void setc(int fa, int ch, int p) {
    t[ch].fa = fa;
    t[fa].c[p] = ch;
}

bool dir(int x) {
    return t[t[x].fa].c[1] == x;
}

void relax(int x) {
    if (t[x].rev) {
        swap(t[x].c[0], t[x].c[1]);
        t[t[x].c[0]].rev ^= 1, t[t[x].c[1]].rev ^= 1;
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}
void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz = t[t[x].c[0]].siz + t[t[x].c[1]].siz + 1;
}

int newNode(int v) {
    t[++tcnt].siz = 1;
    t[tcnt].c[0] = t[tcnt].c[1] = t[tcnt].fa = 0;
    t[tcnt].val = v;
    return tcnt;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    if (l>r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int x = newNode(mid);
    setc(x, build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    setc(x, build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    pushup(x);
    return x;
}

void rot(int x) {
    int fa = t[x].fa;
    relax(fa), relax(x);
    int d = dir(x);
    setc(t[fa].fa, x, dir(fa));
    setc(fa, t[x].c[!d], d);
    setc(x, fa, !d);
    pushup(fa);
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(int x, int fa = 0) {
    while (t[x].fa != fa) {
        if (t[t[x].fa].fa == fa) rot(x);
        else dir(x) == dir(t[x].fa) ? (rot(t[x].fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    pushup(x);
}

int select(int k) {
    for (int x = root; ; ) {
        relax(x);
        int s = t[t[x].c[0]].siz;
        if (k < s) x = t[x].c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = t[x].c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

int get(int l, int r) {
    int L = select(l - 1), R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R,L);
    return t[R].c[0];
}

void dfs(int x) {
    relax(x);
    if (t[x].c[0]) dfs(t[x].c[0]);
    if (0 < t[x].val && n >= t[x].val) printf("%d ", t[x].val);
    if (t[x].c[1]) dfs(t[x].c[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        int range = get(l, r);
        t[range].revIt();
        splay(range);
    }
    dfs(root);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
struct data {
    int x,p;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=1,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[s<<1];

inline void insert(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]--;
}

inline int rank(int x) {
    int l=1,r=x-1,ans=1;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int get_rank(int k) {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[(x<<1)]>=k) x=x<<1;
        else {
            k-=t[(x<<1)];
            x=(x<<1)^1;
        }
    }
    return rev[x-s];
}

inline int pre(int x) {
    return get_rank(rank(x)-1);
}

inline int nxt(int x) {
    return get_rank(rank(x));
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",opt+i,num+i);
        if (opt[i]==6) num[i]++;
        if (opt[i]!=4) {
            tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
            tem[cnt].p=i;
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    num[tem[1].p]=1;
    rev[1]=tem[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
            num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
            rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
        } else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        switch (opt[i]) {
        case 1:
            insert(num[i]);
            break;
        case 2:
            del(num[i]);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n",rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n",get_rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n",pre(num[i]));
            break;
        case 6:
            printf("%d\n",nxt(num[i]));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct node {
    int v,l,r,fa,cnt,siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):v(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),cnt(0),siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];
void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;
}
//void pushdown(int x) {} // No need of pushdown
int n,m,root=0,tcnt=0;
void zig(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    if (y==t[z].l) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x,int s) {
    //pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v,0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
            //pushdown(x);
            t[x].siz++;
            if (t[x].v>v) {
                if (!t[x].l) {
                    t[x].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].l;
            } else {
                if (!t[x].r) {
                    t[x].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].r;
            }
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x,0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        //pushdown(x);
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else {
            splay(x,0);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root,ret=0;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v),x=kth(rr),z=kth(rr+1),y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}
int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x,0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}
int pre(int v) { // == lower_bound(v-1);
    int x=insert(v);
    x=t[x].l;
    while (t[x].r) {
        //pushdown(x);
        x=t[x].r;
    }
    del(v);
    return t[x].v;
}
int nxt(int v) { // == upper_bound(v);
    int x=insert(v);
    x=t[x].r;
    while (t[x].l) {
        //pushdown(x);
        x=t[x].l;
    }
    del(v);
    return t[x].v;
}
//TODO: Optimize pre/nxt,
//		but I do not know how to optimize it

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n",count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n",t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n",pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n",nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

void zag(int x) {

    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;

    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x,int s) {
    //pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v,0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
            //pushdown(x);
            t[x].siz++;
            if (t[x].v>v) {
                if (!t[x].l) {
                    t[x].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].l;
            } else {
                if (!t[x].r) {
                    t[x].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].r;
            }
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x,0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        //pushdown(x);
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else {
            if (x!=root) splay(x,root);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root,ret=0;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v),x=kth(rr),z=kth(rr+1),y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}
int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x,0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}
int pre(int v) { // lower_bound(v-1);
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}
int nxt(int v) { //upper_bound(v);
    int cnt=count_less(v),x=kth(cnt+1);
    if (t[x].v>v) return t[x].v;
    else return t[kth(cnt+1+t[x].cnt)].v;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n",count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n",t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n",pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n",nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

/*
 * д��Ӧ��û�д�����, ������д��splay, �����������
 * wjmzbmr��һ��ʮ��splay, �Ҳ��Ǻ����, �����ѧѧ
 * ��Ҫ������Ҳ�����ȥ������������Ҫһ��
 */

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

/*********** XXX: ���Ҿ���, ָ�����, ��Ȼ���ܺķѸ����ڴ�(64bit machine) ********/
/*********** XXX:
 *  �������ڴ�ط���, �Ͳ���new��
 *  ���ǿ�һ������, �����@��t[MAXN]
 *  ֮��дһ������(inline����define)�ֶ�new:
 *      static inline node *allocNode(value) { return t + tcnt++; }
 *      static inline node *allocNode(value, parent) { watch relation of value and parent->value, and do stuff }
 *********/
struct node {
    int v, l, r, fa, cnt, siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a, int b):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(0), siz(0) { }
    node(int a, int b, bool flag):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(flag), siz(flag) { }
} t[MAXN];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;
}

int n, m, root=0, tcnt=0;

int newNode(int fa,int v) {
    t[++tcnt]=node(fa,v,1);
    return tcnt;
}

/*********** XXX: �����׼���İ汾, ����ÿ���������� ********/
void zig(int x) {       // x is lc(y)
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    (y == t[z].l) ? (t[z].l = x) : (t[z].r = x);
    t[x].fa = z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    t[y].fa=x;
    pushup(y);
}

/*********** XXX: ͬ�� ********/
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

// ѹ��233
void splay(int x, int s) {
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(x)) : (zag(x));
            break;
        } else if (y==t[z].l) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(y)) : (zag(x));
            zig(x);
        } else {
            (x==t[y].r) ? (zag(y)) : (zig(x));
            zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int find(int v) {
    // ����ѹѹ��
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x, 0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        // XXX: allocNode...
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v, 0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        /*
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
        	t[x].siz++;
        	if (t[x].v>v) {
        		if (!t[x].l) {t[x].l=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }
        		else x=t[x].l;
        	} else {
        		if (!t[x].r) {t[x].r=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }
        		else x=t[x].r;
        	}
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x, 0);
        return x;
        XXX : my version below, (squeezed) just care about the meaning, 7��
        */
        int x = root, y = 0; // y��x�ĸ���, �������ҵ�ʱ��x���0, ����y������0
        for (; (x && v != t[x].v); (x = (v < t[x].v) ? t[x].l : t[x].r))
            t[(y = x)].siz++;
        (x) ? (t[x].cnt++)
        : (x = /* allocNode(value=v, parent=y) ����allocNode��ʱ��, cnt��siz������Ϊ1 */newNode(v,y),(v<t[y].v)?t[y].l=x:t[y].r=x);
        splay(x, 0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return splay(x, 0), x;
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root, ret=0;
    while (x) {
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v), x=kth(rr), z=kth(rr+1), y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x, 0);
    splay(y, root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}

// XXX ������ܳ���splay(x, 0)֮��, lc(x)==0�����
// ����ͨ�������½��ڱ������, ��Ҳ����
// ˼·: splay����֮���ڸ�ɾ��
void dzydel(int v) {
    int x = find(v), y = t[x].l;    // find(v)֮��x����root��
    if (!(--t[x].cnt)) {
        splay(t[y].siz, x); // now y does not have a right child
        t[y].r = t[x].r;
        pushup(y); // possibly other pushups as well
        root = y;
    }
}

// �Ҽǵ���д�������, �����prev��succ��һ�ֳ���С�ķ���
// �������ַ���, �ǵ����Ҫsplay

// Ҳ������ôд
int pre(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}

int nxt(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v + 1) + 1)].v;
    // ���ҳ��ж��ٸ� С�ڵ���v, ���ranking�ټ�1���Ǵ���v����Сranking
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        /*********** XXX: switch��ʵ�����,  ��Ȼ���ﲻ��bottleneck ********/
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n", count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n", t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n", pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

// ѹ��233
void splay(int x, int s) {
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(x)) : (zag(x));
            break;
        } else if (y==t[z].l) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(y)) : (zag(x));
            zig(x);
        } else {
            (x==t[y].r) ? (zag(y)) : (zig(x));
            zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int find(int v) {
    // ����ѹѹ��
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x, 0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        // XXX: allocNode...
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v, 0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        /*
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
        	t[x].siz++;
        	if (t[x].v>v) {
        		if (!t[x].l) {t[x].l=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }
        		else x=t[x].l;
        	} else {
        		if (!t[x].r) {t[x].r=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }

        XXX : my version below, (squeezed) just care about the meaning, 7��
        */
        int x = root, y = 0; // y��x�ĸ���, �������ҵ�ʱ��x���0, ����y������0
        for (; (x && v != t[x].v); (x = (v < t[x].v) ? t[x].l : t[x].r))
            t[(y = x)].siz++;
        (x) ? (t[x].cnt++)
        : (x = /* allocNode(value=v, parent=y) ����allocNode��ʱ��, cnt��siz������Ϊ1 */newNode(v,y),(v<t[y].v)?t[y].l=x:t[y].r=x);
        splay(x, 0);

    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return splay(x, 0), x;
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root, ret=0;
    while (x) {
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v), x=kth(rr), z=kth(rr+1), y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x, 0);
    splay(y, root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}

// XXX ������ܳ���splay(x, 0)֮��, lc(x)==0�����
// ����ͨ�������½��ڱ������, ��Ҳ����
// ˼·: splay����֮���ڸ�ɾ��
void dzydel(int v) {
    int x = find(v);	// find(v)֮��x����root��
    if (!(--t[x].cnt)) {
        int y = t[x].l;
        while (t[y].r) y = t[y].r;
        splay(y, x); // now y does not have a right child
        root = y, t[y].fa = 0, t[y].r = t[x].r, t[t[x].r].fa = y;
        pushup(y); // possibly other pushups as well
    } else pushup(x);
}

// �Ҽǵ���д�������, �����prev��succ��һ�ֳ���С�ķ���

// Ҳ������ôд
int pre(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}

int nxt(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v + 1) + 1)].v;
    // ���ҳ��ж��ٸ� С�ڵ���v, ���ranking�ټ�1���Ǵ���v����Сranking
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        /*********** XXX: switch��ʵ�����,  ��Ȼ���ﲻ��bottleneck ********/
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) dzydel(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n", count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n", t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n", pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull , *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr->cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *f = null) {
    while (x->fa != f) {
        if (x->fa->fa == f) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[x->val < v]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    // if (root == null) return null;
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x -> c[v > x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v > x->val];
        if (v > x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    // if (root == null) return null;
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v >= x->val];
        if (v < x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) {
        root = newNode(v);
        root->fa = null;
    } else {
        Node *x = root, *y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(int v) {
    Node *x = find(v);
//	if (x == null) return;
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
//	if (k < 1 || k > root->siz) return null;
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x->c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

void dfs(Node* x, int depth) {
    for (int i=1; i<=depth; i++) putchar('\t');
    printf("%d(%d)[%d]\n", x->val, x->cnt, x->siz);
    putchar('\n');
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++) {
        if (x->c[i] != null) dfs(x->c[i], depth+1);
    }
}

int main() {
    /*	int test[20] = {1,3,3,4,5,8,10,0}, *now = test;
    	insert(INF);insert(-INF);
    	while (*now != 0) {
    		printf("After inserting %d : \n", *now);
    		insert(*(now++));
    		dfs(root,0);
    	}
    	for (int i=0;i<10;i++) {
    		printf("nxt %d : %d\n",i,nxt(i)->val);
    	}
    	for (int i=2;i<=11;i++) {
    		printf("pre %d : %d\n",i,pre(i)->val);
    	}
    	for (int i=1;i<=7;i++) {
    	dfs(root, 0);
    		printf("select %d : %d\n",i,select(i)->val);
    	}
    	dfs(root, 0);*/
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(y);
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    Node *x = root;
    int ret = 0;
    while (x != null) {
        if (v > x->val)  ret += x->c[0]->siz + x->cnt;
        x = x->c[v > x->val];
    }
    return ret;
}
Node* pre(int v) {
    return select(count_less(v) - 1);
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    return select(count_less(v + 1));
}

        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(y);
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr-> cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
    else {
        Node *x = root ,*y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(Node *x) {
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x-> c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(find(y));
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 100005
struct data {
    int x,p;
    inline bool operator < (const data &a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=1,Log,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[MAXN];

#define insert(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) ++t[x];}
#define del(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) --t[x];}

inline int rank(int x) {
    int ret = 1;
    for (--x; x; x -= x & -x) ret += t[x];
    return ret;
}

inline int get_rank(int k) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int j = 1 << Log; j; j >>= 1) {
        if ((ret | j) <= tot && k > t[ret | j]) k -= t[ret |= j];
    }
    return rev[ret + 1];
}

#define pre(x) get_rank(rank(x) - 1)
#define nxt(x) get_rank(rank(x))

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",opt+i,num+i);
        if (opt[i]==6) num[i]++;
        if (opt[i]!=4) {
            tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
            tem[cnt].p=i;
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    num[tem[1].p]=1;
    rev[1]=tem[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
            num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
            rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
        } else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
    }
    for (Log = 0; tot >> Log; Log++);
    Log--;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        switch (opt[i]) {
        case 1:
            insert(num[i]);
            break;
        case 2:
            del(num[i]);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n",rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n",get_rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n",pre(num[i]));
            break;
        case 6:
            printf("%d\n",nxt(num[i]));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3230.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}
#define MAXN 100319

inline void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), x[sa[1]] = k = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, Q, sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], Log[MAXN], st[MAXN][17];
LL sum[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    else if (x == y) return 0x23333333;
    x++;
    return min(st[x][Log[y - x + 1]], st[y - (1 << Log[y - x +1]) + 1][Log[y - x +1]]);
}

inline pii get(LL rank) {
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (sum[mid] >= rank) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return make_pair(sa[l], int(sa[l] + h[l] + (rank - sum[l - 1]) - 1));
}

inline void work(LL x, LL y) {
    pii xa = get(x), xb = get(y);
    int len = min(xa.second - xa.first + 1, xb.second - xb.first + 1);
    if (x == y) printf("%lld\n", power(len) * 2);
    else {
        int l = 0, r = len, mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (rmq(rk[xa.second + 1 - mid], rk[xb.second + 1 - mid]) >= mid) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", power(min(len, rmq(rk[xa.first], rk[xb.first]))) + power(l));
    }
}

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 26);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[j + k] == s[i + k]; k++);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (n - sa[i] + 1) - h[i];
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        LL x, y;
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (y > sum[n]) puts("-1");
        else work(x, y);
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,sqn,blo[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN],blosum[MAXN],bloans[MAXN];
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];
int tot[MAXM],ans[MAXM];
struct data {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (data q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int query_sum(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            ret+=cnt[i];
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=blosum[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
    }
    return ret;
}
int query_cnt(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        blo[i]=i/sqn;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        tot[q[i].x]=query_sum(q[i].a,q[i].b);
        ans[q[i].x]=query_cnt(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d %d\n",tot[i],ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3237.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 200005
#define MAXK 100005

struct edge {
    int u, v, head;
} e[MAXM];

int n, m, K, head[MAXM];

struct Node {
    int t, next;
} ls[MAXK * 4];
int lcnt = 0;

void add(int x, int i) {
    ls[++lcnt].t = i;
    ls[lcnt].next = e[x].head;
    e[x].head = lcnt;
}

struct segNode {
    int l, r, head;
} t[262144];
int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

struct Query {
    int tag, next;
} q[(MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int qcnt = 0;

void addQuery(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        q[++qcnt].tag = v;
        q[qcnt].next = t[x].head;
        t[x].head = qcnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) addQuery(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) addQuery(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

struct stackNode {
    int pos, val;
} s[(MAXN + MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int top = 0;

int f[MAXN], tot = 0;

void modify(int p, int v) {
    s[++top].pos = p, s[top].val = f[p];
    f[p] = v;
}

int getf(int x) {
    while (f[x] > 0) x = f[x];
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        modify(fu, f[fu] + f[fv]);
        modify(fv, fu);
        tot++;
    }
}

void solve(int x, int l, int r) {
    int tmp = top;
    for (int now = t[x].head; now; now = q[now].next) merge(e[q[now].tag].u, e[q[now].tag].v);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else {
        puts(tot == n - 1 ? "Connected" : "Disconnected");
    }
    while (top > tmp) {
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        tot--;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
    }
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, c, x; i <= K; i++) {
        read(c);
        for (int j = 1; j <= c; j++) {
            read(x);
            add(x, i);
        }
    }
    build(1, K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x = K;
        for (int now = e[i].head; now; now = ls[now].next) {
            int y = ls[now].t;
            if (x > y) addQuery(1, 1, K, y + 1, x, i);
            x = y - 1;
        }
        if (x) addQuery(1, 1, K, 1, x, i);
    }
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    solve(1, 1, K);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;

char s[MAXN];
int n, sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa();
    h[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (h[sta[top]] >= h[i]) top--;
        if (top) L[i] = sta[top] + 1;
        else L[i] = 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (h[sta[top]] > h[i]) top--;
        if (top) R[i] = sta[top] - 1;
        else R[i] = n;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += i * LL(n - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ans -= 2ll * h[i] * (i - L[i] + 1) * (R[i] - i + 1);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 1000000007

LL power(LL a, LL b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void get(LL &a, LL &b) {
    a = 0, b = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    int stp = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        b = b * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
        if ((++stp & 7) == 0) a %= MOD, b %= MOD - 1;
    }
}

LL n, nn, m, mm, a, b, c, d;

int main() {
    get(n, nn);
    get(m, mm);
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    read(d);

    LL q, w;

    //cerr << a << " " << mm << " " << endl;

    q = power(a, mm + MOD - 2);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, mm - 1)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (m - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;
    a = c * q % MOD;
    b = (c * w + d) % MOD;

    //cerr << q << " " << w << " " << a << " " << b << endl;

    (++n) %= MOD;

    q = power(a, nn + MOD - 1);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, nn)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (n - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;

    LL ans = (q + w - d) * power(c, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3252.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K, a[MAXN], head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], rev[MAXN], ecnt;
LL ans = 0, vv[MAXN];
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], dfn = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x, LL tot) {
    L[x] = ++dfn;
    rev[dfn] = x;
    if (!head[x]) {
        vv[L[x]] = tot + a[x];
    } else {
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, tot + a[x]);
        }
    }
    R[x] = dfn;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v, lazy;
} t[524288];

int tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = vv[l];
    return x;
}

int get(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return ans += t[x].v, l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[t[x].l].v == t[x].v) return get(t[x].l, l, mid);
    else return get(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, LL v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += v, t[x].lazy += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 0);
    build(1, n);
    vis[0] = 1;
    while (t[1].v > 0 && K--) {
        int x = rev[get(1, 1, n)];
        while (!vis[x]) {
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(1, 1, n, L[x], R[x], -a[x]);
            x = fa[x];
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K;
int head[MAXN], a[MAXN], son[MAXN], cnt = 0;
long long dep[MAXN], c[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    dep[x] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        if (dep[x] < dep[e[now].to]) {
            dep[x] = dep[e[now].to];
            son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
    dep[x] += a[x];
}

void Link(int x, bool ed) {
    if (!ed) c[++cnt] = dep[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], 1);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, 0);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[i] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = i;
    }
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 0);
    sort(c + 1, c + cnt + 1, greater<long long>());
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(cnt, K); i++) ans += c[i];
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='A' && ch!='Q') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='A';
}

#define MAXN 600005
#define bitwise 24

struct node {
    int lch,rch,v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int n,m,tcnt=0;
int sum[MAXN],rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre,int num,int dep) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[pre].lch;
    t[now].rch=t[pre].rch;
    t[now].v=t[pre].v+1;
    if (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) t[now].rch=update(t[pre].rch,num,dep-1);
        else t[now].lch=update(t[pre].lch,num,dep-1);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int num) {
    int dep=bitwise,ret=0;
    while (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) {
            if (t[t[rx].lch].v-t[t[lx].lch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
            else lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
        } else {
            if (t[t[rx].rch].v-t[t[lx].rch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
            else lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
        }
        dep--;
    }
    dep=bitwise;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    rt[1]=update(0,0,bitwise);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]^a;
        rt[i+1]=update(rt[i],sum[i],bitwise);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r,x; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            n++;
            sum[n]=sum[n-1]^x;
            rt[n+1]=update(rt[n],sum[n],bitwise);
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(x);
            l--,x^=sum[n];
            printf("%d\n",query(rt[l],rt[r],x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct flower {
    int x,y,z,siz,ans;
    bool operator < (flower a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        else if (y!=a.y) return y<a.y;
        else return z<a.z;
    }
} a[MAXN],p[MAXN];

bool cmp(flower x,flower y) {
    if (x.y!=y.y) return x.y<y.y;
    else return x.z<y.z;
}

int n,k,tot[MAXN];
#define s 262144
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}
void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]=0;
}
int query(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int l=s,r=x+s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void cdq(int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    cdq(l,mid);
    cdq(mid+1,r);
    sort(p+l,p+mid+1,cmp);
    sort(p+mid+1,p+r+1,cmp);
    int i=l,j=mid+1;
    while (j<=r) {
        while (i<=mid && p[i].y<=p[j].y) {
            update(p[i].z,p[i].siz);
            i++;
        }
        p[j].ans+=query(p[j].z);
        j++;
    }
    for (i=l; i<=mid; i++) del(p[i].z);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i].x);
        read(a[i].y);
        read(a[i].z);
        a[i].ans=0;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    int wu=0;
    for (int i=1,cnt=0; i<=n; i++) {
        cnt++;
        if (a[i].x!=a[i+1].x || a[i].y!=a[i+1].y || a[i].z!=a[i+1].z) {
            p[++wu]=a[i];
            p[wu].siz=cnt;
            cnt=0;
        }
    }
    int nn=n;
    n=wu;
    cdq(1,n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        tot[p[i].ans+p[i].siz-1]+=p[i].siz;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<nn; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",tot[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007

int n, K, sum[MAXN][3];
char s[MAXN];

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    s[++n] = 'X';
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i] = (s[i] == 'X') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 2);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) sum[i][j] = sum[i - 1][j];
        sum[i][(int)s[i]]++;
    }
}

int dp[MAXN][3][2];

void work() {
    dp[0][0][1] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (s[i] != 2) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) dp[i][j][0] = (dp[i - 1][j][0] + dp[i - 1][j][1]) % MOD;
        if (s[i] != 1) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) dp[i][j][1] = (dp[i - 1][j][0] + dp[i - 1][j][1]) % MOD;
        if (i < K) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != (2 - j) && sum[i][2 - j] == sum[i - K][2 - j]) {
                dp[i][j + 1][j] = (dp[i][j + 1][j] + dp[i - K][j][j ^ 1]) % MOD;
                dp[i][j][j] = (dp[i][j][j] - dp[i - K][j][j ^ 1]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ((dp[n][2][0] % MOD) + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3270.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 22
const double eps = 1e-9;

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN * MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN * MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

int n, m, S, T, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, cnt[MAXN], tag[MAXN][MAXN], tagcnt = 0;
double p[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
    cnt[u]++, cnt[v]++;
}

void build(int x, int y) {
    for (int nowx = head[x]; nowx; nowx = e[nowx].next) {
        int u = e[nowx].to;
        for (int nowy = head[y]; nowy; nowy = e[nowy].next) {
            int v = e[nowy].to;
            if (u != v) a[tag[x][y]][tag[u][v]] = (1.0 - p[u]) / cnt[u] * (1.0 - p[v]) / cnt[v];
        }
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[e[now].to][y]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[y];
    for (int now = head[y]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != x) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][e[now].to]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[x];
    a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] = -1;
    if (x != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] += p[x] * p[y];
}

void gauss() {
    int tot = tag[n][n], now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= tot && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > tot) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double t = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= tot; j++) a[now][j] /= t;
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            if (j != now && abs(a[j][i]) > eps) {
                t = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= tot; k++) a[j][k] -= t * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &S, &T);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", p + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            tag[i][j] = ++tagcnt;
        }
    a[tag[S][T]][0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            build(i, j);
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%.6lf ", a[tag[i][i]][0]);
    return 0;
}

    }
}
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,S=0,T,a[MAXN],head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt=1;
void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}
int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}
int gcd(int x,int y) {
    if (y) return gcd(y,x%y);
    else return x;
}
#define power(x) (LL(x)*LL(x))

int main() {
    read(n);
    T=n+1;
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        if (a[i]&1) add(S,i,a[i]);
        else add(i,T,a[i]);
        tot+=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if ((a[i]^a[j])&1 && gcd(a[i],a[j])==1) {
                LL x=power(a[i])+power(a[j]);
                LL sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
                if (sqx*sqx==x) {
                    if (a[i]&1)	add(i,j,0x7fffffff);
                    else add(j,i,0x7ffffff);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 400319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa(int n) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] != '$' && s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int t[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1, t[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
    }
}

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    //if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(t[Log[y - x]][x + 1], t[Log[y - x]][y - (1 << Log[y - x]) + 1]);
}

int n, K, len;
int st[MAXN], ed[MAXN], bel[MAXN];
int cnt[MAXN], pre[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = st[i]; j < ed[i]; j++) bel[j] = i;
    int i = 1, j = 0, tot = 0;
    while (bel[sa[j + 1]]) {
        tot += !cnt[bel[sa[++j]]], ++cnt[bel[sa[j]]];
        while (tot >= K) --cnt[bel[sa[i]]], tot -= !cnt[bel[sa[i++]]];
        pre[j] = i - 1;
    }
}

inline bool check(int x, int L) {
    int l_, r_;
    int l = x, r = len;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x, mid) >= L) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    r_ = l;
    l = 1, r = x;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= L) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    l_ = l;
    return pre[r_] >= l_;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st[i] = ed[i - 1] + 1;
        scanf("%s", s + st[i]);
        ed[i] = st[i] + (int)strlen(s + st[i]);
        s[ed[i]] = '$';
    }
    len = ed[n];
    getsa(len);
    getst(len);
    init();
    for (int p = 1; p <= n; p++) {
        int k = 0;
        LL ans = 0;
        for (int i = st[p]; i < ed[p]; i++, ans += k) {
            for (k -= !!k; k < ed[p] - i && check(rk[i], k + 1); k++);
        }
        printf("%lld ", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50005

struct data {

    bool operator < (data q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }

struct lsh {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (lsh d) const {
        return v<d.v;
    }
} rr[MAXN];

#define s 65536
int t[s<<1];
int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}
void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]--;
}
int main() {

        rr[i].x=i;
    }

        a[rr[i].x]=now;

        read(q[i].l);

    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) nowans-=query(1,a[l]-1),del(a[l]),l++;
        while (l>q[i].l) l--,nowans+=query(1,a[l]-1),update(a[l]);
        while (r<q[i].r) r++,nowans+=query(a[r]+1,n),update(a[r]);
        while (r>q[i].r) nowans-=query(a[r]+1,n),del(a[r]),r--;
        ans[q[i].x]=nowans;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
