#define MAXN 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007
int n, nxt[MAXN], dep[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

void getNext() {
    nxt[0] = -1;
    dep[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1, j = -1; i < n; i++) {
        while (j >= 0 && s[i] != s[j + 1]) j = nxt[j];
        if (s[i] == s[j + 1]) j++;
        nxt[i] = j;
        if (j > -1) dep[i] = dep[j] + 1;
        else dep[i] = 1;
    }
}

void getNum() {
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1, j = -1; i < n; i++) {
        while (j >= 0 && s[i] != s[j + 1]) j = nxt[j];
        if (s[i] == s[j + 1]) j++;
        while (j * 2 >= i) j = nxt[j];
        ans = ans * (dep[j] + 1) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int)strlen(s);
    getNext();
    getNum();
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3673.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 20005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct data {
    int q,a,b;
} qr[MAXN];

int n,m,ecnt=0,f[MAXN],ans[MAXN],head[MAXN],acf[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int lab[MAXN<<1],val[MAXN<<1],top=0;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return f[x];
    return getf(f[x]);
}

void modify(int i,int v) {
    lab[++top]=i;
    val[top]=f[i];
    f[i]=v;
}

void merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        modify(fa,fb);
    }
}

void recover(int tt) {
    while (top!=tt) {
        f[lab[top]]=val[top];
        top--;
    }
}

bool issame(int u,int v) {
    return getf(u)==getf(v);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    // answer querys
    for (int v=x+1; v<=m && qr[v].q==3; ans[v]=issame(qr[v].a,qr[v].b),v++);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (qr[v].q==1) {
            int rec=top;
            merge(getf(qr[v].a),getf(qr[v].b));
            dfs(v);
            recover(rec);
        } else {
            dfs(v);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    memset(ans,-1,sizeof(ans));
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,last=0; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&qr[i].q);
        if (qr[i].q==1) {
            scanf("%d%d",&qr[i].a,&qr[i].b);
            add(last,i);
            last=i;
        } else if (qr[i].q==2) {
            scanf("%d",&qr[i].a);
            add(acf[qr[i].a],i);
            last=i;
        } else {
            scanf("%d%d",&qr[i].a,&qr[i].b);
        }
        acf[i]=last;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) f[i]=i;
    dfs(0);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) if (ans[i]!=-1) printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3674.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int n,m,rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now].v=-1;
    } else {
        t[now].l=build(l,(l+r)>>1);
        t[now].r=build(((l+r)>>1)+1,r);
    }
    return now;
}

int access(int root,int x) {
    //printf("access %d %d\n",root,x);
    int l=1,r=n,mid,pos=root;
    while (l<r) {
//		printf("pos : %d\n",pos);
//		printf("%d %d\n",l,r);
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (x<=mid) r=mid,pos=t[pos].l;
        else l=mid+1,pos=t[pos].r;
    }
    //printf("access complete %d \n",t[pos].v);
    return t[pos].v;
}

int modify(int old,int x,int v) {
    //printf("modify %d %d\n",x,v);
    int l=1,r=n,mid,now=++tcnt;
    int nowrt=now;
    while (l<r) {
        t[now].l=t[old].l;
        t[now].r=t[old].r;
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (x<=mid) r=mid,t[now].l=tcnt+1,now=++tcnt,old=t[old].l;
        else l=mid+1,t[now].r=tcnt+1,now=++tcnt,old=t[old].r;
    }
    t[now].v=v;
    return nowrt;
}

int getf(int r,int x) {
    //printf("getf %d %d\n",r,x);
    int fx=access(r,x);
    if (fx<0) return x;
    else return getf(r,fx);
}

void merge(int r,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(rt[r],a);
    //printf("fa : %d\n",fa);
    int fb=getf(rt[r],b);
    //printf("fb : %d\n",fb);
    if (fa==fb) return;
    int ffa=access(rt[r],fa),ffb=access(rt[r],fb);
    //printf("ffa %d ffb %d\n",ffa,ffb);
    if (ffa<ffb) {
        int nowr=modify(rt[r],fa,ffa+ffb);
        rt[r]=modify(nowr,fb,fa);
    } else {
        int nowr=modify(rt[r],fb,ffa+ffb);
        rt[r]=modify(nowr,fa,fb);
    }
}

int query(int r,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(rt[r],a),fb=getf(rt[r],b);
    return fa==fb;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    rt[0]=build(1,n);
    int lastans=0;
    for (int i=1,op,a,b; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op==1) {
            read(a);
            read(b);
            a^=lastans,b^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[i-1];
            merge(i,a,b);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(a);
            a^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[a];
        } else {
            read(a);
            read(b);
            a^=lastans,b^=lastans;
            rt[i]=rt[i-1];
            lastans=query(i,a,b);
            putchar(lastans+'0');
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3675.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005

int n, K, a[MAXN];
LL f[MAXN][2], s[MAXN], rs[MAXN];

LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[j][i] - f[k][i]) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void clear() {
        l = r = v[0] = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) > rs[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r &&  slope(k, v[r], i) > slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        if (a[i] == 0) {
            i--, n--;
            continue;
        }
        s[i] = s[i - 1] + a[i];
    }
    K = min(K, n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) rs[i] = s[n] - s[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[i][now] = f[j][pre] + (s[i] - s[j]) * rs[i];
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i < n; i++) ans = max(ans, f[i][K & 1]);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3676.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 300019
struct PT {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], num[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN], last, n, p;
    inline int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        cnt[p] = num[p] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        return p++;
    }
    inline void init() {
        p = 0;
        newNode(0);
        newNode(-1);
        last = 0;
        n = 0;
        S[0] = -1;
        fail[0] = 1;
    }
    inline int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    inline void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
            num[now] = num[fail[now]] + 1;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i >= 0; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

int n;
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) T.add(s[i]);
    T.count();
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = T.p - 1; i > 1; i--) ans = max(ans, (long long)T.len[i] * T.cnt[i]);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 10005

int n;
double x[MAXN],y[MAXN],w[MAXN],nowx=0,nowy=0,tot=0;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,a,b,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&c);
        x[i]=a,y[i]=b,w[i]=c;
        nowx+=a,nowy+=b,tot+=c;
    }
    nowx/=n,nowy/=n,tot/=n;
    double temp=10000,tox,toy,a,b,c;
    while (temp>=0.00000001) {
        tox=toy=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            a=x[i]-nowx;
            b=y[i]-nowy;
            c=sqrt(a*a+b*b);
            if (c==0) continue;
            tox+=a*w[i]/c,toy+=b*w[i]/c;
        }
        nowx+=temp*tox;
        nowy+=temp*toy;
        temp*=0.95;
    }
    printf("%.3lf %.3lf\n",nowx,nowy);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3681.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 233];

int n, m, S = 0, T = 1;
int head[MAXN * 33], cur[MAXN * 33], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

vector <int> G[MAXN];
struct Node {
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 33];

int tcnt;

int px;

int build(int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) add(t[x].l = build(l, mid, p), x, INF);
        else add(t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, p), x, INF);
    } else add(px, x, INF);
    return x;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!x || !y) return x | y;
    int nx = ++tcnt;
    add(x, nx, INF);
    add(y, nx, INF);
    if (t[x].l || t[y].l) add(t[nx].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l), nx, INF);
    if (t[x].r || t[y].r) add(t[nx].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r), nx, INF);
    return nx;
}

void Link(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(x, px, INF);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Link(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) Link(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

int h[MAXN], rt[MAXN];
void dd(int x) {
    px = x + 1;
    rt[x] = build(1, n, h[x]);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[x].size(); i++) {
        dd(G[x][i]);
        rt[x] = merge(rt[x], rt[G[x][i]]);
    }
}

int q[MAXN * 33], tag[MAXN * 33];

inline bool bfs() {
    register int he, ta, x, now;
    for (x = 1; x <= tcnt; x++) tag[x] = 0;
    tag[S] = 1;
    q[he = ta = 1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[++ta] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow, ret;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 0; i <= tcnt; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 2, fa; i <= n; i++) read(fa), G[fa].push_back(i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(S, i + 1, 1);
    tcnt = n + m + 1;
    dd(1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, d, ti; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(d);
        read(ti);
        px = i + n + 1;
        add(px, T, ti);
        Link(rt[d], 1, n, l, r);
    }
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3685.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <ctime>

#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();
}

#define S 1048576

int n, m;
int t[S << 1];

#define add(y) for (x = y + S; x; x >>= 1) ++t[x]
#define del(y) for (x = y + S; x; x >>= 1) --t[x]
inline int rk(register int r, register int l = 1) {
    register int ret = 0;
    for (l += S - 1, r += S + 1; l ^ r ^ 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (!(l & 1)) ret += t[l ^ 1];
        if (r & 1) ret += t[r ^ 1];
    }
    return ret;
}

inline int kth(register int k) {
    register int x = 1;
    while (x < S) {
        x <<= 1;
        if (k > t[x]) k -= t[x], x ^= 1;
    }
    return x - S;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (register int i = m, j, op, x; i; i--) {
        read(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(j);
            ++j;
            if (!t[j + S]) add(j);
            break;
        case 2:
            read(j);
            ++j;
            if ( t[j + S]) del(j);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", t[1] ? kth(  1 ) - 1 : -1);
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", t[1] ? kth(t[1]) - 1 : -1);
            break;
        case 5:
            read(j);
            op = rk(j);
            printf("%d\n", op ? kth(op) - 1 : -1);
            break;
        case 6:
            read(j);
            op = rk(++j);
            printf("%d\n", op < t[1] ? kth(op + 1) - 1 : -1);
            break;
        case 7:
            read(j);
            ++j;
            if (t[j + S]) puts("1");
            else puts("-1");
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3689.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define TOP 30
struct node {
    int c[2], cnt;
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return c[x];
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];
int tcnt = 0;

void insert(int v) {
    int x = 0;
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        int to = (v>>i)&1;
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        t[x = t[x][to]].cnt++;
    }
}

struct statu {
    int u, v, k;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a, int b, int d) :u(a), v(b), k(d) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return (u^v) > (a.u^a.v);
    }
};

priority_queue <statu> q;

statu qaq(int v, int k) {
    int x = 0, ret = 0, tmp = k;
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        ret <<= 1;
        int p = (v>>i)&1;
        if (t[t[x][p]].cnt >= k) x = t[x][p], ret ^= p;
        else k -= t[t[x][p]].cnt, x = t[x][p^1], ret ^= p^1;
    }
    return statu(v, ret, tmp);
}

int n, K, a[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), insert(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) q.push(qaq(a[i], 2));
    for (int i = 1; K; i++) {
        statu now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        if (i&1) printf("%d ", now.u^now.v), K--;
        if (now.k < n) q.push(qaq(now.u, now.k + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3702.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 200319
#define MAX 1000000009
struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, tcnt = 0;
LL ans = 0, cntl = 0, cntr = 0;

int newTree(int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt, ret = x, l = 1, r = MAX, mid;
    t[x].v = 1;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = ++tcnt, r = mid;
        else t[x].r = ++tcnt, l = mid + 1;
        x = tcnt;
        t[tcnt].v = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!x) return y;
    if (!y) return x;
    t[x].v += t[y].v;
    cntl += (LL)t[t[x].l].v * t[t[y].r].v;
    cntr += (LL)t[t[y].l].v * t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return x;
}

int solve() {
    int y;
    read(y);
    if (!y) {
        int l = solve(), r = solve();
        cntl = cntr = 0;
        y = merge(l, r);
        ans += min(cntl, cntr);
        return y;
    } else return newTree(y);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    solve();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

struct Node {
    int t, b, r, l;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int B, int c, int d) : t(a), b(B), r(c), l(d) {}
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        if (t - b != a.t - a.b) return t - b < a.t - a.b;
        else return r - l < a.r - a.l;
    }
    void re() {
        read(b);
        read(t);
        read(l);
        read(r);
    }
    bool can(Node x) {
        return t >= x.t && b <= x.b && r >= x.r && l <= x.l;
    }
} a[100005], mx;

int t, n;

int main() {
    read(t);
    while (t--) {
        read(n);
        mx = Node(0, 1, 0, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a[i].re();
            mx = max(a[i], mx);
        }
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!mx.can(a[i])) {
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        puts(flag ? "TAK" : "NIE");
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();

typedef long long LL;

    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    reverse(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    ma[0][n + 1] = ma[1][n + 1] = -(mi[0][0] = mi[1][0] = INF);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a[i];
        mi[a[i]&1][i] = a[i];

            if (ans > 0) printf("%lld\n", ans);
            else puts("-1");
        }

    }

}

    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, c[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

vector <int> cc, ans;

int dfs(int x) {
    if (c[x] < 2) return c[x];
    int sum = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        sum += dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    return sum > 0 ? 1 : (sum < 0 ? -1 : 0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
        if (c[i] <= 0) {
            if (c[i] == -2) c[i] = 1;
            else if (c[i] == 0) cc.push_back(i);
        } else {
            for (int j = 1; j <= c[i]; j++) read(v), add(i, v);
            c[i] = 2;
        }
    }
    if (dfs(1) == -1) puts("NIE");
    else {
        sort(cc.begin(), cc.end());
        for (int i = 0; i < cc.size(); i++) {
            c[cc[i]] = 1;
            if (dfs(1) == 1) ans.push_back(cc[i]);
            c[cc[i]] = 0;
        }
        printf("TAK %d\n", (int)ans.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.size(); i++) {
            printf("%d%c", ans[i], i + 1 == ans.size() ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}

//BZOJ3730.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
#define MAXN 100319
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int st[MAXN * 2][18], Log[MAXN * 2], dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], fir[MAXN], tot = 0;

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(st[x][Log[y - x + 1]], st[y - (1 << Log[y - x + 1]) + 1][Log[y - x + 1]]);
}
#define dis(x, y) (dep[x] + dep[y] - 2 * rmq(fir[x], fir[y]))

void dfs(int x) {
    st[++tot][0] = dep[x];
    fir[x] = tot;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            st[++tot][0] = dep[x];
        }
    }
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}
int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                rt = e[now].to;
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 66];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v += v;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;
int val[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], *nowrt, rt[MAXN][2];

void dd(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    update(*nowrt, 0, n, tmp[x], val[x]);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) tmp[e[now].to] = tmp[x] + 1, dd(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int rec[MAXN * 2];

void solve(int x, int f) {
    x = getrt(x);
    fa[x] = f;
    tmp[x] = 0;
    nowrt = &rt[x][0];
    dd(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) nowrt = &rt[rec[now] = getrt(e[now].to)][1], dd(e[now].to);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(rec[now], x);
    }
}

void init() {
    dfs(1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++)
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = tot - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
    solve(getrt(1), 0);
}

void change(int x, int v) {
    int delta = v - val[x];
    val[x] = v;
    update(rt[x][0], 0, n, 0, delta);
    for (int y = x; fa[y]; y = fa[y]) {
        int D = dis(fa[y], x);
        update(rt[fa[y]][0], 0, n, D, delta);
        update(rt[y][1], 0, n, D, delta);
    }
}

int ask(int x, int K) {
    int ret = 0;
    ret += query(rt[x][0], 0, n, 0, K);
    for (int y = x; fa[y]; y = fa[y]) {
        int D = dis(fa[y], x);
        if (D <= K) {
            ret += query(rt[fa[y]][0], 0, n, 0, K - D);
            ret -= query(rt[y][1], 0, n, 0, K - D);
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(val[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    init();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        x ^= ans, y ^= ans;
        if (!op) printf("%d\n", ans = ask(x, y));
        else change(x, y);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 15005
#define MAXM 30005
#define MAXK 15005

struct data {
    int u,v,w;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} E[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,K,ecnt,head[MAXN],f[MAXN],fa[MAXN][20],maxe[MAXN][20],dep[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
    return 1;
}

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=18; i++) {
        fa[x][i]=fa[fa[x][i-1]][i-1];
        maxe[x][i]=max(maxe[x][i-1],maxe[fa[x][i-1]][i-1]);
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            maxe[e[now].to][0]=e[now].w;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            u=fa[u][k];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

int query(int x,int anc) {
    int ans=0;
    if (x==anc) return ans;
    int d=dep[x]-dep[anc]-1;
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((d>>k)&1) {
            ans=max(ans,maxe[x][k]);
            x=fa[x][k];
        }
    }
    return max(ans,maxe[x][0]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].w);
    }
    sort(E+1,E+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (merge(E[i].u,E[i].v)) {
            add(E[i].u,E[i].v,E[i].w);
        }
    }
    fa[1][0]=1;
    maxe[1][0]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1,u,v,LCA; i<=K; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        LCA=getLCA(u,v);
        printf("%d\n",max(query(u,LCA),query(v,LCA)));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3744.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50005
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
int n, m, a[MAXN], blo[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

int tmp[MAXN], f[750][750];
int sqn, tot;

int qaq(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for ( ; x; x ^= lowbit(x)) ret += tmp[x];
    return ret;
}

void qwq(int x) {
    for ( ; x <= n; x += lowbit(x)) tmp[x]++;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 32];

int rt[MAXN], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    if (lx == rx || ql > qr) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid)  ret += query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    sqn = (int)(sqrt(n) * 0.3) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        tmp[i] = a[i];
        blo[i] = i / sqn + 1;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]] = i;
        R[blo[i]] = i;
    }
    tot = blo[n];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, n, a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < tot; i++) {
        int ret = 0, LB = R[i] + 1;
        memset(tmp + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            for (int k = L[j]; k <= R[j]; k++) ret += k - LB - qaq(a[k]), qwq(a[k]);
            f[i][j] = ret;
        }
    }
    read(m);
    int lastans = 0, l, r, bl, br;
    while (m--) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l ^= lastans, r ^= lastans;
        lastans = 0;
        bl = blo[l], br = blo[r];
        if (bl == br) {
            for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) lastans += query(rt[i - 1], rt[l - 1], 1, n, a[i] + 1, n);
        } else {
            lastans = f[bl][br - 1];
            for (int i = l; i <= R[bl]; i++) lastans += query(rt[r], rt[i], 1, n, 1, a[i] - 1);
            for (int i = L[br]; i <= r; i++) lastans += query(rt[i - 1], rt[R[bl]], 1, n, a[i] + 1, n);
        }
        printf("%d\n", lastans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3751.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
#include<cstring>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cmath>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
int read() {
    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {
        x=x*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return x*f;
}
int mod[5]= {11261,19997,22877,21893,14843};
int n,m;
int ans[1000005];
int a[5][105],pre[5][105],res[5][30005];
char ch[10005];
inline int cal(int t,int x) {
    int sum=0;
    for(int i=0; i<=n; i++)
        sum=(sum+a[t][i]*pre[t][i])%mod[t];
    if(sum<0)sum+=mod[t];
    return sum;
}
inline bool jud(int x) {
    for(int t=0; t<5; t++)
        if(res[t][x%mod[t]]!=0)return 0;
    return 1;
}
int main() {
    n=read();
    m=read();
    for(int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",ch+1);
        int l=strlen(ch+1);
        bool flag=0;
        for(int t=0; t<5; t++)
            if(ch[1]!='-')a[t][i]=ch[1]-'0';
            else a[t][i]=0,flag=1;
        for(int t=0; t<5; t++) {
            for(int k=2; k<=l; k++)
                a[t][i]=(a[t][i]*10+ch[k]-'0')%mod[t];
            if(flag)a[t][i]=-a[t][i];
        }
    }
    for(int t=0; t<5; t++)
        for(int x=1; x<mod[t]; x++) {
            pre[t][0]=1;
            for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)pre[t][i]=(pre[t][i-1]*x)%mod[t];
            res[t][x]=cal(t,x);
        }
    for(int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        if(jud(i))ans[++ans[0]]=i;
    printf("%d\n",ans[0]);
    for(int i=1; i<=ans[0]; i++)
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3774.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN (55 * 55)
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

const int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0}, dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int n, m, S = 0, T = 1, tot = 0;
int a[55][55], b[55][55], lab[55][55], cnt = 0;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4 * 4 * 2];

int head[MAXN * 2], cur[MAXN * 2], tag[MAXN * 2], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    if (f == 0) return;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (2 * cnt + 2));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 2 * cnt + 1; i >= 0; i--) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
            lab[i][j] = ++cnt;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            read(b[i][j]);
            tot += b[i][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                add(S, lab[i][j] * 2, a[i][j]);
                add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, b[i][j]);
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                    if (lab[x][y]) {
                        add(lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, lab[x][y] * 2 + 1, INF);
                        add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[x][y] * 2, INF);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                add(lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, T, a[i][j]);
                add(lab[i][j] * 2, lab[i][j] * 2 + 1, b[i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n", tot - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3781.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50005

int n,sqn,m,k;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];
struct query {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

LL tot=0,ans[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    tot+=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    tot-=cnt[a[x]]*2-1;
    cnt[a[x]]--;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(--l);
        while (r<q[i].r) add(++r);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        ans[q[i].x]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3784.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, blcnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[rt] > siz[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

vector <int> l[MAXN], bl[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN];
int n, m;

void dd(int x, vector<int> &r) {
    r.push_back(dep[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, r);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void pre_work(int x, vector <int> &a, int base = 0) {
    dep[x] = base;
    dd(x, a);
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
}

void pre_solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    pre_work(x, l[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            pre_work(e[now].to, bl[++blcnt], e[now].w);
            pre_solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int mid;

LL work(vector<int> &a) {
    int i = 0, j = a.size() - 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (a[i] + a[j] >= mid) ret += j-- - i;
        else i++;
    }
//	printf("ret : %lld\n", ret);
    return ret;
}

bool check() {
    LL tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (l[i].size() > 1) tot += work(l[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (bl[i].size() > 1) tot -= work(bl[i]);
//	cerr << mid << " : " << tot << " " << m << endl;
    return tot <= m;
}

vector <int> ans;

multiset <int, greater<int> > s;
multiset <int, greater<int> >::iterator it;

int ls[MAXN], lcnt = 0;

void ddd(int x) {
    ls[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            ddd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void getans(int x) {
    s.clear();
    s.insert(0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            lcnt = 0;
            ddd(e[now].to);
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) {
                for (it = s.begin(); it != s.end() && ls[i] + *it > mid; it++) {
                    ans.push_back(ls[i] + *it);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) s.insert(ls[i]);
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    getans(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int L = 1, R = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
        R += w;
    }
//	cerr << "tag 0" << endl;
    pre_solve(1);
//	cerr << "tag 1" << endl;
    /*	for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
    		printf("l %d : ", x);
    		for (int i = l[x].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) printf("%d ", l[x][i]);
    		printf("\n");
    	}
    	for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
    		printf("bl %d : ", x);
    		for (int i = bl[x].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) printf("%d ", bl[x][i]);
    		printf("\n");
    	}*/
    while (L < R) {
        mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        if (check()) R = mid;
        else L = mid + 1;
    }
//	cerr << "L = " <<  L << endl;
//	mid = L - 1;
//	cerr << "tag 2" << endl;
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    solve(1);
    sort(ans.begin(), ans.end());
//	cerr << "tag 3" << endl;
    for (int i = ans.size() - 1; i >= 0 && m > 0; i--) printf("%d\n", ans[i]), m--;
    //cerr << m << endl;
    while (m--) printf("%d\n", mid);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3784.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, blcnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[rt] > siz[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

vector <int> l[MAXN], bl[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN];
int n, m;

void dd(int x, vector<int> &r) {
    r.push_back(dep[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, r);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void pre_work(int x, vector <int> &a, int base = 0) {
    dep[x] = base;
    dd(x, a);
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
}

void pre_solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    pre_work(x, l[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            pre_work(e[now].to, bl[++blcnt], e[now].w);
            pre_solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int mid;

LL work(vector<int> &a) {
    int i = 0, j = a.size() - 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (a[i] + a[j] >= mid) ret += j-- - i;
        else i++;
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check() {
    LL tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (l[i].size() > 1) tot += work(l[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (bl[i].size() > 1) tot -= work(bl[i]);
    return tot <= m;
}

vector <int> ans;

multiset <int, greater<int> > s;
multiset <int, greater<int> >::iterator it;

int ls[MAXN], lcnt = 0;

void ddd(int x) {
    ls[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            ddd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void getans(int x) {
    s.clear();
    s.insert(0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            lcnt = 0;
            ddd(e[now].to);
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) {
                for (it = s.begin(); it != s.end() && ls[i] + *it > mid; it++) {
                    ans.push_back(ls[i] + *it);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= lcnt; i++) s.insert(ls[i]);
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    getans(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int L = 1, R = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
        R += w;
    }
    pre_solve(1);
    while (L < R) {
        mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        if (check()) R = mid;
        else L = mid + 1;
    }
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    solve(1);
    sort(ans.begin(), ans.end());
    for (int i = ans.size() - 1; i >= 0 && m > 0; i--) printf("%d\n", ans[i]), m--;
    while (m--) printf("%d\n", mid);
    return 0;
}

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;

int n, K;
int dp[100319][105][2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    if (!K) return puts("0"), 0;
    K = 2 * K - 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            dp[i][j][x] = max(dp[i - 1][j - 1][!x], dp[i - 1][j][x]) + 1;
            dp[i][j][!x] = dp[i - 1][j][!x];
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) ans = max(ans, max(dp[n][j][0], dp[n][j][1]));
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

inline bool check(int x) {
    if (x<2) return 0;
    for (int i=2,sqx=(int)sqrt(x); i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1,j=(int)sqrt(x); i<=j;) {
        while (i*i+j*j<x) i++;
        while (i*i+j*j>x) j--;
        if (i*i+j*j==x) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
int A,B;

int work(int x) {
    int ret=list[x>>16];
    for (int i=((x>>16)<<16); i<=x; i++) {
        if (check(i)) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(A);
    read(B);
    printf("%d\n",work(B)-work(A-1));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3809.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],ans[MAXM],cnt[MAXN],blo[MAXN],bloans[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN];

struct qury {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (qury q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        blo[i]=(i-1)/sqn+1;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        ans[q[i].x]=query(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int N;
int a, b, c, d;

int main() {
    read(N);
    while (N--) {
        int ans = 1;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        a--, c--;
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(b, d); i++) {
            int A = a / i, B = b / i, C = c / i, D = d / i;
            j = min(b, d);
            if (A) j = min(j, a / A);
            if (B) j = min(j, b / B);
            if (C) j = min(j, c / C);
            if (D) j = min(j, d / D);
            i = j;
            if (A < B && C < D) ans = i;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

struct Food {
    LL p, s;
    bool operator < (const Food &a) const {
        return p != a.p ? p < a.p : s > a.s;
    }
} a[222];

LL m, f;
int n, tot;

LL get(LL t) {
    if (t < 1 || t * f > m) return 0;
    LL d = 0, mo = m - t * f, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(a[i].s - d + 1, mo / a[i].p / t);
            ans += ti * t;
            d += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * t * ti;
        }
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(t, mo / a[i].p);
            d++;
            ans += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * ti;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

LL HC() {
    LL x = (m + 1) / (2 * (f + a[1].p)), ans = get(x), ret;
    for (D y = x; y > 1; y *= 0.91) {
        if ((ret = get(x + LL(y))) > ans) x += LL(y), ans = ret;
        else if ((ret = get(x - LL(y))) > ans) x -= LL(y), ans = ret;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(f);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].p);
        read(a[i].s);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    tot = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) if (a[i].s > a[tot].s) a[++tot] = a[i];
    cout << HC() << endl;
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 200319
#define TOP 262143
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 5];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int n;
LL dis[MAXN], S[MAXN], K[MAXN], last[MAXN], mak[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

int q[TOP + 1], he = 0, ta = 0;
void push(int x) {
    q[(ta++) & TOP] = x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, Ri, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(S[i]);
        read(K[i]);
        read(Ri);
        for (int j = 1; j <= Ri; j++) {
            read(x);
            add(x, i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dis[i] = K[i];
        last[i] = dis[i];
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) mak[e[now].to] += dis[i];
        push(i);
        inq[i] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dis[i] = min(dis[i], mak[i] += S[i]);
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++ & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        LL delta = last[x] - dis[x];
        last[x] = dis[x];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            mak[e[now].to] -= delta;
            if (dis[e[now].to] > mak[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to] = mak[e[now].to];
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", dis[1]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3876.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 3005
#define MAXK 55
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int to, next, w, flow;
} e[MAXN * MAXK];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, dis[MAXN], pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v, int w, int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].flow = flow;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].flow = 0;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, S = 0, T;
queue<int> q;

int spfa() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(dis));
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

int mcmf() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) flow = min(flow, e[pos[x]].flow);
        ret += flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) e[pos[x]].flow -= flow, e[pos[x]^1].flow += flow;
    }
    return ret;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j = 1, v, w; j <= x; j++) {
            read(v);
            read(w);
            add(S, v, w, 1);
            add(i, v, w, INF);
        }
        if (x) add(i, T, 0, x);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) add(i, 1, 0, INF);
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n", mcmf());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3884.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define N 10000005

bool vis[N];
int p[N / 7], pcnt = 0;
int phi[N];

void init() {
    phi[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, phi[i] = i - 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

int T;
int sta[233];

inline int power(LL x, int y, int MOD) {
    LL ret = 1 % MOD;
    for (x %= MOD; y; y >>= 1, x = x * x % MOD) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

void work() {
    int x, top;
    scanf("%d", &x);
    sta[top = 1] = x;
    while (x != 1) {
        x = phi[x];
        sta[++top] = x;
    }
    sta[top + 1] = 1;
    int ret = 1;
    while (top) {
        ret = power(2, ret % sta[top + 1] + sta[top + 1], sta[top]), top--;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3894.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 80005
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<3];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m,tot=0,tcnt=1,tag[105][105];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            tag[i][j]=++tcnt;
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,tag[i][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(tag[i][j],T,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(S,p,a);
            add(p,tag[i][j],a);
            if (i>1) add(p,tag[i-1][j],a);
            if (j>1) add(p,tag[i][j-1],a);
            if (i<n) add(p,tag[i+1][j],a);
            if (j<m) add(p,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(p,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],p,a);
            if (i>1) add(tag[i-1][j],p,a);
            if (j>1) add(tag[i][j-1],p,a);
            if (i<n) add(tag[i+1][j],p,a);
            if (j<m) add(tag[i][j+1],p,a);
        }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3924.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 19

struct E {
    int v, w, rt;
    E() {}
    E(int a, int b) : v(a), w(b) {}
};

vector<E> G[MAXN];

int sz[MAXN], f[MAXN], l[MAXN];
LL d[MAXN][LOG], sd[MAXN], sf[MAXN], c[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int gs(int u, int fa) {
    sz[u] = 1;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) {
            sz[u] += gs(v, u);
        }
    }
    return sz[u];
}

int grt(int u, int fa, int hs) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa && sz[v] > hs) return grt(v, u, hs);
    }
    return u;
}

void gdis(int u, int fa, int ly) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) d[v][ly] = d[u][ly] + G[u][i].w, gdis(v, u, ly);
    }
}

int dcomp(int u, int ly) {
    int rt = grt(u, 0, gs(u, 0) / 2);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    gdis(rt, 0, l[rt] = ly);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[rt].size(); i++) {
        if (!vis[G[rt][i].v]) {
            f[G[rt][i].rt = dcomp(G[rt][i].v, ly + 1)] = rt;
        }
    }
    return rt;
}

void update(int u, int w) {
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        sd[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa]], sf[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa] - 1], c[fa] += w;
    }
}

LL calc(int u) {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        ans += sd[fa] - sf[fa] + c[fa] * (d[u][l[fa]] - d[u][l[fa] - 1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int n, Q, rt;

LL solve(int u) {
    LL ans = calc(u);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (l[v] > l[u] && calc(v) < ans) return solve(G[u][i].rt);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v, w;
        scanf("%d%d%d", &u, &v, &w);
        G[u].push_back(E(v, w));
        G[v].push_back(E(u, w));
    }
    rt = dcomp(1, 1);
    for (int u, w; Q--; ) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &w);
        update(u, w);
        printf("%lld\n", solve(rt));
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 200005
typedef long long LL;
struct opt_ {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (opt_ a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} op[MAXN*2];

struct node {
    int l,r,cnt;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int m,n,opcnt=0,tcnt=0,pp[MAXN],tem[MAXN],rt[MAXN],ntem;

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int inc_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt++;
    t[now].v+=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=inc_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=inc_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
int dec_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt--;
    t[now].v-=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=dec_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=dec_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
LL query(int x,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) {
        return (LL)k*tem[l];
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lcnt=t[t[x].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt>=k) {
        return query(t[x].l,l,mid,k);
    } else {
        return t[t[x].l].v+query(t[x].r,mid+1,r,k-lcnt);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,s,e; i<=m; i++) {
        read(s);
        read(e);
        read(pp[i]);
        tem[i]=pp[i];
        op[++opcnt].x=s;
        op[++opcnt].x=e+1;
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+m+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+m+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        op[i*2-1].v=op[i*2].v=find(pp[i]);
        op[i*2].v=-op[i*2].v;
    }
    sort(op+1,op+opcnt+1);
    rt[0]=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int rr=rt[i-1];
        while (j<=opcnt && op[j].x==i) {
            if (op[j].v>0) rr=inc_(rr,1,ntem,op[j].v);
            else rr=dec_(rr,1,ntem,-op[j].v);
            j++;
        }
        rt[i]=rr;
    }
    LL pre=1;
    for (int i=1,x,a,b,c,k; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        k=int(1+(a*pre+b)%c);
        if (k<=t[rt[x]].cnt) pre=query(rt[x],1,ntem,k);
        else pre=t[rt[x]].v;
        printf("%lld\n",pre);
    }
    return 0;
}

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 500319

int t[MAXN][26], fail[MAXN], vis[MAXN], tcnt = 1;
char s[MAXN], b[MAXN];

void insert() {
    scanf("%s", b + 1);
    int len = (int)strlen(b + 1), x = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = b[i] - 'a';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    vis[x] = len;
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) to = t[j][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                vis[to] += vis[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }

}

int sta[MAXN];
int top = 0;
char p[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) insert();
    build();
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1), x = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        sta[++top] = x = t[x][s[i] - 'a'];
        p[top] = s[i];
        for (int j = vis[sta[top]]; j; j--) top--;
        x = sta[top];
    }
    p[top + 1] = 0;
    puts(p + 1);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 10000319

LL phi[M];
int p[M / 10], pcnt = 0, mu[M];

void init() {
    phi[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < M; i++) {
        if (!phi[i]) phi[i] = i - 1, mu[i] = -1, p[++pcnt] = i;
        for (int j = 1; i * p[j] < M; j++) {
            if (i % p[j])
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1), mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * p[j], mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        phi[i] += phi[i - 1], mu[i] += mu[i - 1];
    }
}

bool vis[233];
int exmu[233];
LL exphi[233];
int n;

void solve(unsigned x);
LL Phi(int x);
int Mu(int x);

LL Phi(int x) {
    if (x < M) return phi[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exphi[y];
    }
}

int Mu(int x) {
    if (x < M) return mu[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exmu[y];
    }
}

void solve(unsigned x) {
    if (x < M) return;
    int y = n / x;
    if (vis[y]) return;
    vis[y] = 1;
    exmu[y] = 1;
    exphi[y] = (LL(x + 1) * x) >> 1;
    for (unsigned i = 2, j; i <= x; i = j) {
        j = x / (x / i) + 1;
        exphi[y] -= Phi(x / i) * (j - i);
        exmu[y] -= Mu(x / i) * (j - i);
    }
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    if (n < M) printf("%lld %d\n", phi[n], mu[n]);
    else {
        memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * (n / M));
        solve(n);
        printf("%lld %d\n", exphi[1], exmu[1]);
    }
}

    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

    return 0;

//BZOJ3944.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 3333319

LL phi[M];
int p[M / 10], pcnt = 0, mu[M];

void init() {
    phi[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < M; i++) {
        if (!phi[i]) phi[i] = i - 1, mu[i] = -1, p[++pcnt] = i;
        for (int j = 1; i * p[j] < M; j++) {
            if (i % p[j])
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1), mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * p[j], mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        phi[i] += phi[i - 1], mu[i] += mu[i - 1];
    }
}

bool vis[666];
int exmu[666];
LL exphi[666];
int n;

void solve(unsigned x);
LL Phi(int x);
int Mu(int x);

LL Phi(int x) {
    if (x < M) return phi[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exphi[y];
    }
}

int Mu(int x) {
    if (x < M) return mu[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exmu[y];
    }
}

void solve(unsigned x) {
    if (x < M) return;
    int y = n / x;
    if (vis[y]) return;
    vis[y] = 1;
    exmu[y] = 1;
    exphi[y] = (LL(x + 1) * x) >> 1;
    for (unsigned i = 2, j; i <= x; i = j) {
        j = x / (x / i) + 1;
        exphi[y] -= Phi(x / i) * (j - i);
        exmu[y] -= Mu(x / i) * (j - i);
    }
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    if (n < M) printf("%lld %d\n", phi[n], mu[n]);
    else {
        memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * (n / M));
        solve(n);
        printf("%lld %d\n", exphi[1], exmu[1]);
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3991.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
// alias BZOJ3991
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dis[MAXN],ans=0;
bool visit[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dfsid[MAXN],dfn=0,bfsid[MAXN],q[MAXN],fa[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
int bb[MAXN*2][19],fir[MAXN],bt=0;
void bfs() {
    q[ta++]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    fa[1]=0;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        bfsid[x]=he-1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                fa[e[now].to]=x;
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    dfsid[x]=++dfn;
    bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
    fir[x]=bt;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=bt; k++) {
        int x=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,tt=bt-(1<<k)+1; i<=tt; i++) {
            bb[i][k]=min(bb[i][k-1],bb[i+x][k-1]);
        }
    }
}

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    u=fir[u],v=fir[v];
    if (u>v) swap(u,v);
    int len=v-u+1,ll=log_2(len);
    return q[min(bb[u][ll],bb[v-(1<<ll)+1][ll])];
}

struct statu {
    int x,id;
    statu() {}
    statu(int w):id(w) {}
    statu(int y,int w):x(y),id(w) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return id<a.id;
    }
};
set<statu> s;
set<statu>::iterator it;
int Left(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.begin()) it=s.end();
    return (*--it).x;
}
int Right(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.end()) it=s.begin();
    return (*it).x;
}
void inc(int x) {
    if (!s.empty()) {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans+=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
    s.insert(statu(x,dfsid[x]));
}

void dec(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(dfsid[x]);
    s.erase(it);
    if (s.empty()) {
        ans=0;
    } else {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans-=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (visit[x]^=1) inc(x);
        else dec(x);
        printf("%lld\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3993.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void read(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 105
#define INF 123456789123456ll
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*8];

int n,m,S=0,T=1,ecnt=1;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN],head[MAXN*2],tag[MAXN*2],cur[MAXN*2];
bool map[MAXN][MAXN];
LL sum=0;

void add(int u,int v,LL flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

#define robot(x) (x+1)
#define weapon(x) (x+n+1)

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

LL dfs(int x,LL flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    LL used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            LL ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=weapon(m); i>-1; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(S,robot(i),a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(weapon(i),T,b[i]*mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) add(robot(j),weapon(i),INF);
        }
    }
    return dinic()==sum;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),a[i]*=2000,sum+=a[i];
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) read(b[i]);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
        }
    LL l=0,r=200000000001ll,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    double ans=double(mid)/2000.0+0.00025;
    printf("%.5lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3994.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

int T, p[MAXN], pcnt = 0, sum[MAXN], mu[MAXN];
long long F[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    for (int x = 1; x < MAXN; x++) {
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= x; i = j) {
            j = x / (x / i) + 1;
            F[x] += (long long)(j - i) * (long long)(x / i);
        }
    }
    sum[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
        }
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + mu[i];
    }
}

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        ans += (sum[j] - sum[i - 1]) * F[n / i] * F[m / i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}
