//BZOJ3998.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500319

char s[MAXN];

int n, T, K;

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
int Min[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getsa() {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Min[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, d = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (d << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            Min[k][i] = min(Min[k - 1][i], Min[k - 1][i + d]);
        }
    }
}

void work1() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = h[i] + 1; j <= h[i + 1]; j++) {
            int x = i, mi = h[i + 1];
            for (int k = Log[n - i + 1]; ~k; k--) if (Min[k][x + 1] >= j) mi = min(mi, Min[k][x + 1]), x += 1 << k;
            int d = x - i + 1, cnt = mi - j + 1;
            if (K - tot - 1 <= (LL)cnt * d) {
                j += (K - tot - 1) / d;
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) putchar(s[sa[i] + l]);
                putchar('\n');
                return;
            }
            tot += d * cnt;
            j = mi;
        }
        int dev = n - sa[i] - j + 2;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

void work0() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int dev = n - sa[i] - h[i] + 1;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + h[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(T);
    read(K);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa();
    if (T) work1();
    else work0();
    return 0;
}

struct Node {
    int fir, sec, nxt;
} a[MAXN];
int head[MAXN], acnt = 1;
int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN];

void work1() {
    int top = 0;
    sta[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int r = i;
        while (sta[top] >= h[i]) {
            r = min(r, p[top]);
            if (sta[top] > h[i]) a[++acnt] = (Node) {sta[top], i - p[top], head[p[top]]}, head[p[top]] = acnt;
            top--;
        }
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = r;
    }
    while (top && sta[top] > 0) {
        a[++acnt] = (Node) {sta[top], n + 1 - p[top], head[p[top]]}, head[p[top]] = acnt;
        top--;
    }
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int j = h[i] + 1;
        for (int now = head[i + 1]; now; now = a[now].nxt) {
            int d = a[now].sec + 1, cnt = a[now].fir - j + 1;
            if (K - tot - 1 <= (LL) cnt * d) {
                j += (K - tot - 1) / d;
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) putchar(s[sa[i] + l]);
                putchar('\n');
                return;
            }
            tot += d * cnt;
            j += cnt;
        }
        int dev = n - sa[i] - j + 2;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

void work0() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int dev = n - sa[i] - h[i] + 1;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + h[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(T);
    read(K);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa();
    if (T) work1();
    else work0();
    return 0;
}

inline int max(int a, int b) {

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 500319

char s[MAXN];

int n, T, K;

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

void getsa() {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

vector<pii> a[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN];

void work1() {
    int top = 0;
    sta[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int r = i;
        while (sta[top] >= h[i]) {
            r = min(r, p[top]);
            if (sta[top] > h[i]) a[p[top]].push_back(mp(sta[top], i - p[top]));
            top--;
        }
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = r;
    }
    while (top && sta[top] > 0) {
        a[p[top]].push_back(mp(sta[top], n + 1 - p[top]));
        top--;
    }
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int j = h[i] + 1;
        for (int k = (int)a[i + 1].size() - 1; ~k; k--) {
            int d = a[i + 1][k].sec + 1, cnt = a[i + 1][k].fir - j + 1;
            if (K - tot - 1 <= (LL) cnt * d) {
                j += (K - tot - 1) / d;
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) putchar(s[sa[i] + l]);
                putchar('\n');
                return;
            }
            tot += d * cnt;
            j += cnt;
        }
        int dev = n - sa[i] - j + 2;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

void work0() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int dev = n - sa[i] - h[i] + 1;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + h[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

//BZOJ3999.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Tag {
    int mi, ma, lv, rv;
    Tag () {
        mi = INF, ma = -INF, lv = 0, rv = 0;
    }
    Tag (int a, int b, int c, int d) : mi(a), ma(b), lv(c), rv(d) {}
    inline friend Tag operator + (const Tag &a, const Tag &b) {
        //	printf("+ %d %d %d %d\n", min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
        return Tag(min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
    }
    inline void operator += (int v) {
        mi += v, ma += v;
    }
    inline Tag rev() {
        //	printf("rev!\n");
        return Tag(mi, ma, rv, lv);
    }
};

struct Node {
    int l, r, lz;
    Tag v;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;
int n, Q;
int a[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tid[MAXN], fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], son[MAXN], siz[MAXN], top[MAXN], stp;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else {
        t[x].v = Tag(a[rev[l]], a[rev[l]], 0, 0);
    }
    return x;
}

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
//	cerr << x << endl;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > siz[son[x]]) son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
}

void Link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++stp;
    rev[stp] = x;
    top[x] = anc;
//	printf("%d : %d\n", x, stp);
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

#define pd(x) {t[t[x].l].lz += t[x].lz; t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].lz += t[x].lz; t[x].lz = 0;}

Tag query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
//	if (x == 0) *((int*)NULL) = 1;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lz += v;
        t[x].v += v;
//		printf("[ret] %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
        return t[x].v;
    }
    if (t[x].lz) pd(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Tag ret;
    if (qr <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr, v);
    else if (ql > mid) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr, v);
    else ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid, v) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr, v);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
//	printf("[   ]%d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
//	printf(" ret %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", ql, qr, ret.mi, ret.ma, ret.lv, ret.rv);
    return ret;
}

int solve(int u, int v, int w) {
    Tag lp, rp;
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] > dep[top[v]]) {
            lp = lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[top[u]], tid[u], w).rev();
            u = fa[top[u]];
        } else {
            rp = query(1, 1, n, tid[top[v]], tid[v], w) + rp;
            v = fa[top[v]];
        }
    }
    if (tid[u] < tid[v]) {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[u], tid[v], w) + rp).lv;
    } else {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[v], tid[u], w).rev() + rp).lv;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 1);
    build(1, n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        printf("%d\n", solve(u, v, w));
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4012.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 400319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v, tot;
} t[MAXN * 23];

int tcnt = 0;
LL val[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].tot = t[t[x].l].tot + t[t[x].r].tot;
    } else t[x].tot = val[l];
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
//	printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += t[x].tot;
        t[x].lazy++;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr >  mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v + t[x].tot * t[x].lazy;
    }
//	printf("after update %d ~ %d %lld\n", l, r, t[x].v);
    return x;
}

LL query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int lv, int rv) {
//	printf("%d ~ %d %d ~ %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	printf("%lld %lld %d %d %lld\n", t[rx].v, t[lx].v, (rv + t[rx].lazy), (lv + t[lx].lazy), t[rx].tot);
        return t[rx].v - t[lx].v + rv * t[rx].tot - lv * t[lx].tot;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    return ret;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, Q, A;
pair<int, int> a[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], top[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], son[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

void tree_update(int x, int &rt) {
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        rt = update(rt, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x]);
//		printf("%d ~ %d\n", top[x], x);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    rt = update(rt, 1, n, 1, tag[x]);
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n", 1, x);
}

LL tree_query(int x, int lx, int rx) {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        ret += query(lx, rx, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x], 0, 0);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ret + query(lx, rx, 1, n, 1, tag[x], 0, 0);
}

LL sum[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int rt[MAXN];

void init() {
    static int q[MAXN], he = 0, ta = 0;
    dis[1] = fa[1] = dep[1] = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    int x;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
                fa[e[now].to] = x;
                dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    while (ta) {
        x = q[--ta];
        siz[x]++;
        siz[fa[x]] += siz[x];
        if (maxs[fa[x]] < siz[x]) {
            maxs[fa[x]] = siz[x];
            son[fa[x]] = x;
        }
    }
    tag[1] = top[1] = 1;
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        if (son[x]) {
            tag[son[x]] = tag[x] + 1;
            top[son[x]] = top[x];
            q[ta++] = son[x];
            int tot = tag[x] + maxs[x];
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                    tag[e[now].to] = tot + 1;
                    top[e[now].to] = e[now].to;
                    tot += siz[e[now].to];
                    q[ta++] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        val[tag[i]] = dis[i] - dis[fa[i]];
    }
    rt[0] = build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        //	printf("%d : %d %lld\n", i, a[i].second, dis[a[i].second]);
        rt[i] = rt[i - 1];
        tree_update(a[i].second, rt[i]);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + dis[a[i].second];
        //	printf("%lld\n", t[rt[i]].v);
    }
}

int find(LL x) {
    int l = 1, r = n + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid].first > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] = make_pair(x, i);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    LL ans = 0, l, r;
    for (int i = 1, u; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + ans) % A, r = (r + ans) % A;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        int L = find(l - 1), R = find(r);
        //printf("L = %d R = %d\n", L, R);
        if (L >= R) printf("%lld\n", ans = 0);
        else {
            //	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", sum[R], sum[L], dis[u]);
            //	printf("%lld\n", tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]));
            ans = sum[R] - sum[L] + dis[u] * (R - L) - tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]) * 2;
            printf("%lld\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 200319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v, tot;
} t[MAXN * 44];

int tcnt = 0;
LL val[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].tot = t[t[x].l].tot + t[t[x].r].tot;
    } else t[x].tot = val[l];
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
//	printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += t[x].tot;
        t[x].lazy++;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr >  mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v + t[x].tot * t[x].lazy;
    }
//	printf("after update %d ~ %d %lld\n", l, r, t[x].v);
    return x;
}

LL query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int lv, int rv) {
//	printf("%d ~ %d %d ~ %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	printf("%lld %lld %d %d %lld\n", t[rx].v, t[lx].v, (rv + t[rx].lazy), (lv + t[lx].lazy), t[rx].tot);
        return t[rx].v - t[lx].v + rv * t[rx].tot - lv * t[lx].tot;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    return ret;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, Q, A;
pair<int, int> a[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], top[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], son[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

void tree_update(int x, int &rt) {
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        rt = update(rt, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x]);
//		printf("%d ~ %d\n", top[x], x);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    rt = update(rt, 1, n, 1, tag[x]);
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n", 1, x);
}

LL tree_query(int x, int lx, int rx) {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        ret += query(lx, rx, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x], 0, 0);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ret + query(lx, rx, 1, n, 1, tag[x], 0, 0);
}

LL sum[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int rt[MAXN];

void init() {
    static int q[MAXN], he = 0, ta = 0;
    dis[1] = fa[1] = dep[1] = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    int x;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
                fa[e[now].to] = x;
                dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    while (ta) {
        x = q[--ta];
        siz[x]++;
        siz[fa[x]] += siz[x];
        if (maxs[fa[x]] < siz[x]) {
            maxs[fa[x]] = siz[x];
            son[fa[x]] = x;
        }
    }
    tag[1] = top[1] = 1;
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        if (son[x]) {
            tag[son[x]] = tag[x] + 1;
            top[son[x]] = top[x];
            q[ta++] = son[x];
            int tot = tag[x] + maxs[x];
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                    tag[e[now].to] = tot + 1;
                    top[e[now].to] = e[now].to;
                    tot += siz[e[now].to];
                    q[ta++] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        val[tag[i]] = dis[i] - dis[fa[i]];
    }
    rt[0] = build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        //	printf("%d : %d %lld\n", i, a[i].second, dis[a[i].second]);
        rt[i] = rt[i - 1];
        tree_update(a[i].second, rt[i]);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + dis[a[i].second];
        //	printf("%lld\n", t[rt[i]].v);
    }
}

int find(LL x) {
    int l = 1, r = n + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid].first > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] = make_pair(x, i);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    LL ans = 0, l, r;
    for (int i = 1, u; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + ans) % A, r = (r + ans) % A;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        int L = find(l - 1), R = find(r);
        //printf("L = %d R = %d\n", L, R);
        if (L >= R) printf("%lld\n", ans = 0);
        else {
            //	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", sum[R], sum[L], dis[u]);
            //	printf("%lld\n", tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]));
            ans = sum[R] - sum[L] + dis[u] * (R - L) - tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]) * 2;
            printf("%lld\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4012.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 200319
#define LOG	18

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int q[MAXN], Fa[MAXN], siz[MAXN], he, ta;

int getrt(int u) {
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = u;
    Fa[u] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        siz[x] = 1;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && Fa[x] != e[now].to) {
                Fa[e[now].to] = x;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = ta - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int x = q[i];
        if (siz[x] * 2 >= ta) return x;
        siz[Fa[x]] += siz[x];
    }
    return u;
}

int n, Q, A, a[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN][LOG], fae[MAXN * 2][LOG];
int fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], est[MAXN * 2], eed[MAXN * 2];
LL ftot[MAXN], etot[MAXN];
int depth[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN][LOG];
pair<int, LL> fl[MAXN * LOG], el[MAXN * LOG * 2];
int fcnt = 0, Ecnt = 0;

bool cmp(const pair<int, LL> &u, const pair<int, LL> &v) {
    return a[u.first] < a[v.first];
}

void solve(int u, int dep) {
    u = getrt(u);
    vis[u] = 1;
    depth[u] = dep;
    fa[u][dep] = u;
    fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(u, 0ll);
    fst[u] = fcnt;
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            he = ta = 0;
            q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            Fa[e[now].to] = u;
            dis[e[now].to][dep] = e[now].w;
            est[now] = Ecnt + 1;
            while (he < ta) {
                int x = q[he++];
                fae[x][dep] = now;
                fa[x][dep] = u;
                fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                el[++Ecnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                for (int i = head[x]; i; i = e[i].next) {
                    if (!vis[e[i].to] && e[i].to != Fa[x]) {
                        dis[e[i].to][dep] = dis[x][dep] + e[i].w;
                        Fa[e[i].to] = x;
                        q[ta++] = e[i].to;
                    }
                }
            }
            eed[now] = Ecnt;
            sort(el + est[now], el + eed[now] + 1, cmp);
        }
    }
    fed[u] = fcnt;
    sort(fl + fst[u], fl + fed[u] + 1, cmp);
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to, dep + 1);
    }
}

int find(pair<int, LL> li[], int l, int r, int x) {
    int mid;
    r++;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[li[mid].first] > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

LL get(pair<int, LL> li[], int st, int ed, int L, int R, LL d) {
    int l = find(li, st, ed, L), r = find(li, st, ed, R);
    return li[r].second - li[l].second + d * (r - l);
}

LL work(int x, int L, int R) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = depth[x]; i >= 0; i--) {
        int p = fa[x][i];
        ret += get(fl, fst[p], fed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
        if ((p = fae[x][i]))
            ret -= get(el, est[p], eed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    solve(1, 0);
    for (int i = 2; i <= fcnt; i++) fl[i].second += fl[i - 1].second;
    for (int i = 2; i <= Ecnt; i++) el[i].second += el[i - 1].second;
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, L, R; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(L);
        read(R);
        L = int((L + ans) % A);
        R = int((R + ans) % A);
        if (L > R) swap(L, R);
        L--;
        printf("%lld\n", ans = work(u, L, R));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4016.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define MAXN 30019
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} Graph[MAXN * 4], Tree[MAXN * 2], *e = Graph;

int Ghead[MAXN], Thead[MAXN], *head = Ghead, gcnt = 0, ecnt = 1;

void G_add(int u, int v, int w) {
    Graph[++gcnt] = (edge) {
        Ghead[u], v, w
    };
    Ghead[u] = gcnt;
    Graph[++gcnt] = (edge) {
        Ghead[v], u, w
    };
    Ghead[v] = gcnt;
}

void T_add(int u, int v, int w) {
    Tree[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        Thead[u], v, w
    };
    Thead[u] = ecnt;
    Tree[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        Thead[v], u, w
    };
    Thead[v] = ecnt;
}

int dis[MAXN], siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                flag = 0, rt = e[now].to;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

#define T 32767
int q[T + 1];
priority_queue < int, vector<int>, greater<int> > pq;
void init() {
    int he = 0, ta = 0, x, now;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    dis[1] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[(he++) & T];
        vis[x] = 0;
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
                    vis[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(ta++) & T] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    pq.push(1);
    vis[1] = 1;
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        x = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && dis[e[now].to] == dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                vis[e[now].to] = 1;
                T_add(x, e[now].to, e[now].w);
                pq.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    e = Tree, head = Thead;
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
}

pii fl[MAXN * 18], el[MAXN * 18];
int Fcnt = 0, Ecnt = 0;
int fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], est[MAXN], eed[MAXN];

void dd(int x, int dep) {
    fl[++Fcnt] = make_pair(dep, dis[x]);
    el[++Ecnt] = make_pair(dep, dis[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to, dep + 1);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = getrt(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    fst[x] = ++Fcnt;
    dis[x] = 0;
    fl[Fcnt] = make_pair(0, 0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            est[now >> 1] = Ecnt + 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, 1);
            eed[now >> 1] = Ecnt;
            sort(el + est[now >> 1], el + eed[now >> 1] + 1);
        }
    }
    fed[x] = Fcnt;
    sort(fl + fst[x], fl + fed[x] + 1);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int n, m, K;

int mid;

LL get(pii a[], int l, int r) {
    LL ret = 0;
    //for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) cerr << "(" << a[i].first << ", " << a[i].second << ") ";
    while (l <= r) {
        while (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first < K) l++;
        while (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first > K) r--;
        if (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first == K) {
            if (a[l].first != a[r].first) {
                int i = l, j = r;
                while (i <= r && a[i].first == a[l].first) {
                    while (j >= l && a[j].first == a[r].first && a[i].second + a[j].second >= mid) j--;
                    ret += r - j;
                    i++;
                }
                while (i <= r && l <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first) j--;
                l = i, r = j;
            } else {
                int i = l, j = r;
                while (i <= r && a[i].first == a[l].first) {
                    while (i <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first && a[i].second + a[j].second >= mid) j--;
                    ret += r - max(i, j);
                    i++;
                }
                while (i <= r && l <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first) j--;
                l = i, r = j;
            }
        }
    }
    //cerr << "RET " << ret << endl;
    return ret;
}

LL check() {
    LL ret = 0;
    //cerr << "pos" << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ret += get(fl, fst[i], fed[i]);
    //cerr << "neg" << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) ret -= get(el, est[i], eed[i]);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    K--;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), G_add(u, v, w);
    init();
    solve(1);
    int l = 0, r = 300000000;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check() > 0) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    mid = l;
    printf("%d %lld\n", l, check());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4017.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define MOD 998244353

int n, a[MAXN];

namespace task1 {
long long ans = 0;
void calc(int b) {
    int sum = 1, now = 0;
    long long ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int x = (a[i]>>b)&1;
        now ^= x;
        if (now) ret += sum;
        else ret += i - sum++;
    }
    ans = (ans + ret * (1ll<<b)) % MOD;
}
void solve() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) calc(i);
    cout << ans << " ";
}
}
#define lowbit(x) (x&-x)
namespace task2 {
long long hh = 0, sum[MAXN], tem[MAXN];
bool t[MAXN];
int cnt = 0;
int find(long long v) {
    int l = -1, r = cnt - 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (tem[mid] <= v) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l + 1;
}
bool query(int x) {
    bool ret = 0;
    for (; x; x -= lowbit(x)) ret ^= t[x];
    return ret;
}
void add(int x) {
    for (; x <= cnt; x += lowbit(x)) t[x] ^= 1;
}
void calc(int b) {
    memset(t, 0, sizeof(t));
    sum[0] = tem[0] = 0;
    long long B = 1ll << (b + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = (sum[i - 1] + a[i]) % B, tem[i] = sum[i];
    sort(tem, tem + n + 1);
    cnt = int(unique(tem, tem + n + 1) - tem);
    B >>= 1;
    bool ret = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        add(find(sum[i]));
        ret ^= query(find(sum[i] - B)) ^ query(find(sum[i])) ^ query(find(sum[i] + B));
    }
    if (ret) hh ^= B;
    //cout<<hh<< " "<< B << " " << (B<<1) <<endl;
}
void solve() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) calc(i);
    cout<<hh<<endl;
}
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    task1::solve();
    task2::solve();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4025.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 200319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *mi;
    int val, siz;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : mi(this), val(INF), siz(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        ch->fa = this;
        c[p] = ch;
    }
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = this;
        if (c[0]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[0]->mi;
        if (c[1]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[1]->mi;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->mi = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->siz = ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
        fa->isrt = 0;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXM];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

Node *getf(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];
pair <int, int> E[MAXN + MAXM];
bool del[MAXN + MAXM];

Node *newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(a[u], mid);
    Link(a[v], mid);
    E[mid - mem] = make_pair(u, v);
    return mid;
}

int cnt = 0;

void delE(Node *mid) {
    if (mid == null) return;
    if (del[mid - mem]) cnt--;
    else {
        del[mid - mem] = 1;
        int u = E[mid - mem].first, v = E[mid - mem].second;
        Cut(mid, a[u]);
        Cut(mid, a[v]);
    }
}

Node *add(int u, int v, int w) {
    if (getf(a[u]) == getf(a[v])) {
        Node *x = query(a[u], a[v]);
        if (~((x->siz + 1) >> 1) & 1) return null;
        else {
            cnt++;
            if (x->mi->val < w) {
                delE(x->mi);
                return newE(u, v, w);
            } else {
                del[0] = 1;
                return mem;
            }
        }
    } else return newE(u, v, w);
}

struct edge {
    int u, v, s, t;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return s < b.s;
    }
} e[MAXM];

vector <Node*> b[MAXN];

int n, m, T;

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].s);
        read(e[i].t);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < T; i++) {
        while (j <= m && e[j].s == i) {
            b[e[j].t].push_back(add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].t));
            j++;
        }
        for (int k = (int)b[i].size() - 1; k > -1; k--) delE(b[i][k]);
        if (cnt) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4033.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005

typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,k,head[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dp[MAXN][MAXN],temp[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    siz[x]=1;
    dp[x][0]=dp[x][1]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            int topx=min(siz[x],k),topv=min(siz[v],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) temp[i]=dp[x][i];
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<=topv && i+j<=k; j++) {
                    temp[i+j]=max(temp[i+j],dp[x][i]+dp[v][j]+e[now].w*(j*(k-j)+(siz[v]-j)*(n-k-siz[v]+j)));
                }
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            topx=min(siz[x],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++) dp[x][i]=temp[i];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int u,v,w;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%lld\n",dp[1][k]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4034.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0',ch=getchar();
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int n,m,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN];
int top[MAXN],dep[MAXN],ss[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],tid[MAXN],sub[MAXN],S[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1];

long long t[s<<1],lazy[s<<1];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    ss[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
            if (ss[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=ss[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    sub[x]=dfn;
}

inline void init() {
    fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[s+tid[i]]=a[i];
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
        S[s+i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=n+1; i<s; i++) L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)^1];
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)^1];
        S[i]=S[i<<1]<<1;
    }
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (!lazy[x] || x>=s) return;
    long long delta=lazy[x]*S[x<<1];
    t[x<<1]+=delta,lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    t[(x<<1)^1]+=delta,lazy[(x<<1)^1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=(long long)d*S[x];
        lazy[x]=d;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(x<<1,l,min(mid,r),d);
    if (r>mid) update((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r,d);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1];
}

long long query(int x,int l,int r) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r)
        return t[x];
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    long long ans=0;
    if (l<=mid) ans+=query(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) ans+=query((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r);
    return ans;
}

inline long long q(int x) {
    long long ans=0;
    while (top[x]!=1) {
        ans+=query(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x]);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ans+query(1,1,tid[x]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        if (op==1) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],tid[x],y);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],sub[x],y);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",q(x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void Max(int &a, int b) {
    if (a < b) a = b;
}
inline void Min(int &a, int b) {
    if (a > b) a = b;
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int siz, sum, val;
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2];
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1, sum = val;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz, sum += l->sum;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz, sum += r->sum;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

bool D;

inline bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D];
}

int Q[2], A;

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->d[0] = Q[0];
    ptr->d[1] = Q[1];
    ptr->val = A;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = 0;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) x->val += A;
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int tot;
Node *tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, bool d) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    tmp[mid]->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    tmp[mid]->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    tmp[mid]->upd();
    return tmp[mid];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++tot] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        tot = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, tot, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

bool in(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1<=X1&&X2<=x2&&y1<=Y1&&Y2<=y2;
}
bool out(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1>X2||x2<X1||y1>Y2||y2<Y1;
}

int query(Node *k,int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2) {
    if(!k)return 0;
    int ret=0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return k->sum;
    if(out(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return 0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->d[0],k->d[1],k->d[0],k->d[1])) ret += k->val;
    ret += query(k->l,x1,y1,x2,y2) + query(k->r,x1,y1,x2,y2);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int op, x, y, z, w; ; ) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 3) break;
        if (op == 1) {
            read(Q[0]);
            read(Q[1]);
            read(A);
            Q[0] ^= ans, Q[1] ^= ans, A ^= ans;
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            read(w);
            read(y);
            read(x);
            read(z);
            w ^= ans, x ^= ans, y ^= ans, z ^= ans;
            ans = query(rt, w, y, x, z);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXM 300005
#define TOP 30
struct Node {
    int c[2], v;
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return c[x];
    }
} t[MAXM * 32];

int n, m, Q, tcnt = 0;
int a[1005], b[MAXM], rt[MAXM];

void insert(int x, int v) {
    int now = tcnt;
    t[now] = t[x];
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        int p = (v>>i)&1;
        t[now][p] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][p], now = tcnt;
        t[now] = t[x], t[now].v++;
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) rt[i] = ++tcnt, insert(rt[i-1], b[i]);
}

#define siz(lx, rx, p) (t[t[rx][p]].v - t[t[lx][p]].v)

int lx[1005], rx[1005];

int query(int u, int d, int l, int r, int k) {
    int ls = 0, to, ans;
    for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) lx[i] = rt[l - 1], rx[i] = rt[r], ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], (a[i] >> TOP)&1);
    if (ls < k) k -= ls, ans = to = 1;
    else ans = to = 0;
    for (int q = TOP; q > 0; q--) {
        ls = 0;
        for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) {
            int p = (a[i]>>q)&1;
            lx[i] = t[lx[i]][p^to];
            rx[i] = t[rx[i]][p^to];
            p = (a[i]>>(q - 1))&1;
            ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], p);
        }
        if (ls < k) k -= ls, to = 1;
        else to = 0;
        ans = (ans << 1) ^ to;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    init();
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, d, l, r, k; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(d);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n", query(u, d, l, r, (r - l + 1) * (d - u + 1) - k + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4128.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 70
#define P 19260817
#define Q 20000816
map<LL, int> vis;
int n, p, m;
struct Mat {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int *operator [] (int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator *= (Mat &b) {
        static Mat c;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                c[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    c[i][j] = (c[i][j] + a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        *this = c;
    }
} a, b, tmp;

LL Hash(Mat &x) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            ret = (ret * P + x[i][j]) ^ Q;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    m = int(sqrt(p)) + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(b[i][j]);
    tmp = b;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) tmp *= a, vis[Hash(tmp)] = i;
    tmp = a;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) tmp *= a;
    a = tmp;
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) {
        int x = vis[Hash(tmp)];
        if (x) {
            printf("%d\n", i * m - x);
            return 0;
        }
        tmp *= a;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define N 105
#define M 16
#define T 65536
#define INF LL(1e18)
int n, m, t;
int d[N], c[N][M];
LL dp[T], f[T];

void work(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) f[i] = dp[i];
    for (int i = m - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        int k = 1 << i;
        for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) f[j | k] = min(f[j | k], f[j] + c[x][i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = min(dp[i], f[i] + d[x]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(d[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) read(c[i][j]);
    }
    t = 1 << m;
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    printf("%lld\n", dp[t - 1]);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {

    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500005

struct QAQ {
    int v, tag;
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (abs(v) != abs(a.v)) return abs(v)<abs(a.v);
        else return tag < a.tag;
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r, head;
    Node() : head(0) {}
} t[1048576];
int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

struct Query {
    int v, next;
} q[500005 * 20];
int qcnt = 0;

void add(int &head, int v) {
    q[++qcnt].v = v;
    q[qcnt].next = head;
    head = qcnt;
}

void addEx(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(t[x].head, v);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) addEx(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) addEx(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

#define TOP 30
struct Basis {
    int v[TOP + 1];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    Basis() {
        memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
    }
    void merge(int x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if ((x>>i)&1) {
                if (v[i]) x ^= v[i];
                else {
                    v[i] = x;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

void solve(int x, int l, int r, Basis v) {
    for (int now = t[x].head; now; now = q[now].next) v.merge(q[now].v);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid, v);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, v);
    } else {
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) ret = max(ret, ret ^ v[i]);
        printf("%d\n", ret);
    }
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].v);
        a[i].tag = i;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j) {
        int cnt = 1;
        j = i + 1;
        while (j <= n && abs(a[j].v) == a[i].v) {
            if (a[j++].v >= 0) cnt++;
            else cnt--;
            if (cnt == 0) break;
        }
        if (cnt) addEx(1, 1, n, a[i].tag, n, a[i].v);
        else addEx(1, 1, n, a[i].tag, a[j - 1].tag - 1, a[i].v);
    }
    solve(1, 1, n, Basis());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4195.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;

struct query {
    int x,y,eq;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n,cnt,f[MAXN<<1],tem[MAXN<<1];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

inline void merge(int a,int b) {
    f[getf(a)]=f[getf(b)];
}

inline int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]<x)
            l=mid+1;
        else
            r=mid;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while (t--) {
        cnt=0;
        scanf("%d",&n);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&q[i].x,&q[i].y,&q[i].eq);
            tem[++cnt]=q[i].x,tem[++cnt]=q[i].y;
        }
        sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
        cnt=int(unique(tem+1,tem+cnt+1)-tem-1);
        //init
        for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++)
            f[i]=i;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (q[i].eq)
                merge(find(q[i].x),find(q[i].y));
        }
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!q[i].eq && getf(find(q[i].x))==getf(find(q[i].y))) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) puts("YES");
        else puts("NO");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4196.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

int n,q,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN];
int subs[MAXN],subt[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN];
int t[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1],S[s<<1],M[s<<1],lazy[s<<1];
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void read(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'i' || ch>'u')
        ch=getchar();
    a=(ch=='i');
    while (ch!=' ')
        ch=getchar();
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    subs[x]=1;
    son[x]=maxs[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        fa[v]=x;
        dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
        finds(v);
        subs[x]+=subs[v];
        if (subs[v]>maxs[x]) {
            maxs[x]=subs[v];
            son[x]=v;
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    top[x]=anc;
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    subt[x]=dfn;
}

inline void seginit() {
    for (int i=1; i<s; i++) {
        L[i+s]=R[i+s]=M[i+s]=i;
        S[i+s]=1;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)^1];
        S[i]=S[i<<1]+S[(i<<1)^1];
        M[i]=R[i<<1];
    }
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (!lazy[x] || x>=s)
        return;
    if (lazy[x]<0) {
        lazy[x<<1]=-1;
        t[x<<1]=0;
        lazy[(x<<1)^1]=-1;
        t[(x<<1)^1]=0;
        lazy[x]=0;
    } else {
        lazy[x<<1]=1;
        t[x<<1]=S[x<<1];
        lazy[(x<<1)^1]=1;
        t[(x<<1)^1]=S[x<<1];
        lazy[x]=0;
    }
}

bool query(int x,int to) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (!t[x])
        return 0;
    if (t[x]==S[x])
        return 1;
    if (to<=M[x])
        return query(x<<1,to);
    return query((x<<1)^1,to);
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    int ans=0;
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        if (d) {
            ans=S[x]-t[x];
            t[x]=S[x];
            lazy[x]=1;
            return ans;
        } else {
            ans=t[x];
            t[x]=0;
            lazy[x]=-1;
            return ans;
        }
    }
    if (l<=M[x])
        ans+=update(x<<1,l,min(M[x],r),d);
    if (r>M[x])
        ans+=update((x<<1)^1,max(M[x]+1,l),r,d);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1];
    return ans;
}

inline int install(int x) {
    if (query(1,tid[x]))
        return 0;
    int ans=0;
    while (top[x]) {
        ans+=update(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x],1);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ans+update(1,1,tid[x],1);
}

inline int uninstall(int x) {
    if (query(1,tid[x])==0)
        return 0;
    return update(1,tid[x],subt[x],0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        add(u,i);
    }
    fa[0]=-1;
    dep[0]=0;
    finds(0);
    link(0,0);
    seginit();
    read(q);
    bool op;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=q; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        if (op)
            printf("%d\n",install(x));
        else
            printf("%d\n",uninstall(x));
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

struct node {
    LL s;
    int h;
    node() {}
    node(LL a,int b):s(a),h(b) {}
    bool operator < (node a) const {
        if (s!=a.s) return s>a.s;
        else return h>a.h;
    }
};
priority_queue<node> q;
int n,nn,K,ansh=0;
LL ans=0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    nn=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        LL w;
        read(w);
        q.push(node(w,1));
    }
    if ((n-1)%(K-1)) for (int i=(K-1)-((n-1)%(K-1)); i; i--) q.push(node(0,1)),nn++;
    for (; nn>1; nn-=K-1) {
        LL sum=0;
        int h=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=K; i++) {
            node a=q.top();
            q.pop();
            sum+=a.s;
            h=max(h,a.h);
        }
        h++;
        ans+=sum;
        q.push(node(sum,h));
    }
    printf("%lld\n%d\n",ans,q.top().h-1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4205.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 60005

const int S = 0, T = 1;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 3 * 3 * 2 * 2];

int head[69876], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, N;
int p[50], pcnt = 0, pp;
bool vv[201];
int ls[201][3], cnt[201];

int Tot;
int AB[50][50], AC[50][50], BC[50][50];
int A[MAXN], B[MAXN], C[MAXN], tag[69876];

void sieve() {
    for (int i = 2; i < 200; i++) {
        if (!vv[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            for (int j = i * i; j < 200; j += i) vv[j] = 1;
        }
    }
    pp = pcnt * pcnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt; j++) {
            if (!(i % p[j])) ls[i][cnt[i]++] = j;
        }
    }
    Tot = N + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt; j++) {
            AB[i][j] = ++Tot;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt; j++) {
            AC[i][j] = ++Tot;
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt; j++) {
            BC[i][j] = ++Tot;
        }
}

void build() {
    // 0 = source
    // 1 = sink
    // 1 + 1 ~ 1 + N = node
    // N + 1 + x = AB
    // N + pp + 1 + x BC
    // N + pp * 2 + 1 + x AC
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(0, i + 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[A[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[B[i]]; k++) {
                add(i + 1, AB[ls[A[i]][j]][ls[B[i]][k]]);
            }
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[A[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[C[i]]; k++) {
                add(i + 1, AC[ls[A[i]][j]][ls[C[i]][k]]);
            }
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[B[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[C[i]]; k++) {
                add(i + 1, BC[ls[B[i]][j]][ls[C[i]][k]]);
            }
    }
    for (int i = n + 1; i <= N; i++) {
        add(i + 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[A[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[B[i]]; k++) {
                add(AB[ls[A[i]][j]][ls[B[i]][k]], i + 1);
            }
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[A[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[C[i]]; k++) {
                add(AC[ls[A[i]][j]][ls[C[i]][k]], i + 1);
            }
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt[B[i]]; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < cnt[C[i]]; k++) {
                add(BC[ls[B[i]][j]][ls[C[i]][k]], i + 1);
            }
    }
}

int cur[69876];
int q[69876];
inline bool bfs() {
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    q[ta++] = S;
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (Tot + 1));
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!tag[e[now].to] && e[now].f) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void work() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 1; i <= Tot; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        for (int now = head[S]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f) {
                if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                    e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                    ret++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    N = n + m;
    sieve();
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) scanf("%d%d%d", A + i, B + i, C + i);
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4209.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 300005
#define T 1000000001
struct Node {
    int l, r, cnt;
    LL sum;
} t[MAXN * 3 * 30];

int n, m, srt[MAXN], ort[MAXN], ert[MAXN], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].sum += p, t[x].cnt++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

LL getsum(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (rx == lx) return 0;
    if (l == r) {
        return (t[rx].sum - t[lx].sum) / (t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt) * (t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt - k);
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lcnt = t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt < k) return getsum(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, k - lcnt);
    else return getsum(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, k) + t[t[rx].r].sum - t[t[lx].r].sum;
}

int getkth(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lcnt = t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt < k) return getkth(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, k - lcnt);
    else return getkth(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, k);
}

int rank(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int v) {
    if (l == r) return 1;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (v <= mid) return rank(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, v);
    else return t[t[rx].l].cnt - t[t[lx].l].cnt + rank(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, v);
}

int geq(int rx, int lx, int v) {
    int rk = rank(rx, lx, 1, T, v);
    if (rk > t[rx].cnt - t[lx].cnt) return -1;
    else return getkth(rx, lx, 1, T, rk);
}

int leq(int rx, int lx, int v) {
    int rk = rank(rx, lx, 1, T, v + 1) - 1;
    if (!rk) return -1;
    else return getkth(rx, lx, 1, T, rk);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) {
        read(ai);
        srt[i] = update(srt[i - 1], 1, T, ai);
        if (ai & 1) ort[i] = update(ort[i - 1], 1, T, ai), ert[i] = ert[i - 1];
        else ert[i] = update(ert[i - 1], 1, T, ai), ort[i] = ort[i - 1];
    }
    read(m);
    for (int l, r, k; m--; ) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        l--;
        if (r - l < k) {
            puts("-1");
            continue;
        }
        LL sum = getsum(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k);
        if (!(sum & 1)) {
            printf("%lld\n", sum);
            continue;
        }
        if (r - l == k) {
            puts("-1");
            continue;
        }
        int lo = getkth(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k), hi = getkth(srt[r], srt[l], 1, T, r - l - k + 1);
        LL ans = -1, ret1, ret2;
        // odd -> even
        ret1 = geq(ort[r], ort[l], hi);
        ret2 = leq(ert[r], ert[l], lo);
        if (ret1 != -1 && ret2 != -1) ans = max(ans, sum - ret1 + ret2);
        // odd -> even
        ret1 = geq(ert[r], ert[l], hi);
        ret2 = leq(ort[r], ort[l], lo);
        if (ret1 != -1 && ret2 != -1) ans = max(ans, sum - ret1 + ret2);
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n)) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        tem[i] = a[i];
        blo[i] = i / sqn + 1, L[blo[i]] ? (R[blo[i]] = i) : (L[blo[i]] = R[blo[i]] = i);
    }
    bt =  blo[n];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1, a[i]) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= bt; i++) {
        for (int j = L[i]; j <= R[i]; j++) tmp[a[j]]++;
        memcpy(cnt[i] + 1, tmp + 1, sizeof(int) * tot);

    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 0; i < bt; i++) {
        LL ret = 0;
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= bt; j++) {
            for (int k = L[j]; k <= R[j]; k++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[k]] * LL(++tmp[a[k]]));
            f[i][j] = ret;
        }
        memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    }
}

int main() {

    for (int i = 1, l, r, bl, br; i <= Q; i++) {

        read(r);
        bl = blo[l], br = blo[r];

        if (bl < br) {
            ret = f[bl][br - 1];
            for (int j = l; j <= R[bl]; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]] + cnt[br - 1][a[j]] - cnt[bl][a[j]]));
            for (int j = L[br]; j <= r; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]] + cnt[br - 1][a[j]] - cnt[bl][a[j]]));
            for (int j = l; j <= R[bl]; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
            for (int j = L[br]; j <= r; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
        } else {
            for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) ret = max(ret, tem[a[j]] * LL(++tmp[a[j]]));
            for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) tmp[a[j]] = 0;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ret);
    }
    return 0;
}

    int l,r;

void clear() {
    t[0].l=t[0].r=0;
    tcnt=0;
}
void insert(int x) {
    int now=0;
    for (int i=bitwise; i>-1; i--) {
        if ((x>>i)&1) {
            if (!t[now].l) t[now].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt].l=t[tcnt].r=0;
            now=t[now].l;
        } else {
            if (!t[now].r) t[now].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt].l=t[tcnt].r=0;
            now=t[now].r;
        }
    }
}
int query(int x) {
    int now=0,ret=0;
    for (int i=bitwise; i>-1; i--) {
        ret<<=1;
        if ((x>>i)&1) {
            if (!t[now].r) now=t[now].l;
            else now=t[now].r,ret|=1;
        } else {
            if (!t[now].l) now=t[now].r;
            else now=t[now].l,ret|=1;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

        insert(sum);

    }

#define MAXN 100005

void gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 30; i > -1; i--) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && (~a[to]>>i)&1) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now && (a[j]>>i)&1) a[j] ^= a[now];
        }
        now++;
    }
    n = now;
}

//BZOJ4278.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005
const int P = 19260817;
const int P1 = 1001;
const int MOD = 2147483647;
char s[MAXN];
LL x[MAXN], x1[MAXN];
int n, m, top;
int A[MAXN], B[MAXN], ans[MAXN];

struct Hash {
    LL a, b;
    Hash append(int q) {
        Hash ret = *this;
        ret.a = ret.a * P + q;
        ret.b = (ret.b * P1 + q) % MOD;
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator == (Hash q) const {
        return a == q.a && b == q.b;
    }
} a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

Hash Ha(int st, int len, Hash hh[]) {
    Hash ret = hh[st + len];
    ret.a -= hh[st].a * x[len];
    ret.b -= (hh[st].b * x1[len]) % MOD;
    if ((ret.b>>63)&1) ret.b += MOD;
    return ret;
}

int lcp(int u, int v) {
    int l = 0, r = min(n - u, m - v), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (Ha(u, mid, a) == Ha(v, mid, b)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

bool cmp(int u, int v) {
    int l = lcp(u, v);
    if (u + l == n) {
        if (v + l == m) return 1;
        else return A[u + 1] < B[v + l + 1];
    } else if (v + l == m) return A[u + l + 1] < B[v + 1];
    return A[u + l + 1] < B[v + l + 1];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(A[i]), a[i] = a[i - 1].append(A[i]);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(B[i]), b[i] = b[i - 1].append(B[i]);
    x[0] = x1[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max(n, m); i++) x[i] = x[i - 1] * P, x1[i] = (x1[i - 1] * P1) % MOD;
    int la = 1, lb = 1;
    while (la <= n && lb <= m) {
        if (cmp(la - 1, lb - 1)) ans[++top] = A[la++];
        else ans[++top] = B[lb++];
    }
    while (la <= n) ans[++top] = A[la++];
    while (lb <= m) ans[++top] = B[lb++];
    for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) printf("%d ", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
void op(int &o) {
    while (_c != 'K' && _c != 'N') _c = getchar();
    o = _c == 'K';
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
int n, zero = MAXN, delta = 0;
int len[MAXN * 2];

void update(int x) {
    int p = int(lower_bound(len + zero, len + zero + n + 1, x - delta) - len - zero - 1);
    len[p + zero + 1] = min(len[p + zero + 1], x - delta);
}
void row() {
    zero--;
    delta++;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) len[zero - i] = -i - INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) len[zero + i] = INF + i;
    for (int i = 1, o, x; i <= n; i++) {
        op(o);
        if (o) read(x), update(x);
        else row();
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(lower_bound(len + zero, len + zero + n + 2, INF) - len - zero - 1));
    return 0;
}

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005
#define LOG 32
#define TOP 1000000319

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * LOG];

int tcnt = 0, rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v += p;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, TOP, x);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = rt[l - 1], r = rt[r];
        int v = 0, x = -1;
        while (1) {
            x = query(l, r, 1, TOP, 1, v + 1);
            if (x <= v) break;
            v = x;
        }
        printf("%d\n", v + 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005
#define TOP 1000000001
struct node {
    int l,r,sum;
} t[MAXN*32];

int n,m,a[MAXN],rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].sum+=v;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[rx].sum-t[lx].sum;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,ret=0;
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,TOP,a[i]);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l--;
        int ans=1,tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,1);
        while (tot>=ans) {
            ans=tot+1;
            tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,ans);
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}
