//BZOJ4326.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 300005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,maxl=0,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],rs[MAXN],rt[MAXN],rd[MAXN],len[MAXN];

int ss[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;

int t[MAXN],rlen[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void input() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(rs[i]);
        read(rt[i]);
    }
}

void finds(int x) {
    son[x]=maxs[x]=0;
    ss[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            rd[v]=e[now].w;
            dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
            if (ss[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=ss[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    rlen[dfn]=rd[x];
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void init() {
    input();
    fa[1]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]>dep[top[v]]) {
            swap(u,v);
        }
        v=fa[top[v]];
    }
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) return u;
    return v;
}

inline void getlen() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int lca=getLCA(rs[i],rt[i]);
        len[i]=dis[rs[i]]+dis[rt[i]]-(dis[lca]<<1);
        maxl=max(maxl,len[i]);
    }
}

inline void mark(int x) {
    int u=rs[x],v=rt[x];
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]>dep[top[v]]) {
            swap(u,v);
        }
        // mark top[v] + ~ v +
        t[tid[top[v]]]++,t[tid[v]+1]--;
        v=fa[top[v]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) {
        swap(u,v);
    }
    // mark u - ~ v +
    t[tid[u]+1]++,t[tid[v]+1]--;
}

inline bool check(int x) {
    memset(t,0,sizeof(t));
    int cnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (len[i]>x) {
            mark(i);
            cnt++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[i]+=t[i-1];
        if (t[i]>=cnt && maxl-x<=rlen[i]) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("transport.in","r",stdin);
    //freopen("transport.out","w",stdout);
    init();
    getlen();
    int l=0,r=maxl,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4336.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <='9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 40005
#define s 1024

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, Q, K, ecnt = 0, head[MAXN], att[MAXN], bel[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], fa[MAXN], son[MAXN], top[MAXN];
int tid[MAXN], tot = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            finds(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x] = siz[e[now].to];
                son[x] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++tot;
    top[x] = anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[33554432];
int tcnt = 0;

int root[2048];

void init() {
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 1;
    finds(1);
    link(1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 2048; i++) root[i] = ++tcnt;
}

int tol(int x) {
    if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
    return t[x].l;
}
int tor(int x) {
    if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
    return t[x].r;
}

void update(int x, int p, int c) {
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    t[x].v += c;
    while (l < r) {
        if (p <= (mid = (l + r) >> 1)) r = mid, x = tol(x);
        else l = mid + 1, x = tor(x);
        t[x].v += c;
    }
}

void change(int p, int v, int c) {
//	printf("Change %d %d %d\n", p, v, c);
    int x = 1, l = 0, r = 1023, mid;
    update(root[1], p, c);
    while (l < r) {
        if (v <= (mid = (l + r) >> 1)) r = mid, x <<= 1;
        else l = mid + 1, x = (x << 1) ^ 1;
        update(root[x], p, c);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x || !t[x].v) {
        /*printf("exit %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);*/ return 0;
    }
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int ask(int rt, int u, int v) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] < dep[top[v]]) swap(u, v);
        ret += query(rt, 1, n, tid[top[u]], tid[u]);
        u = fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u] > dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    return ret + query(rt, 1, n, tid[u], tid[v]);
}

int select(int k, int u, int v) {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < s) {
        int lsiz = ask(root[x <<= 1], u, v);
        //	printf("%d %d %d\n", k, lsiz, x);
        if (k > lsiz) x ^= 1, k -= lsiz;
    }
    //printf("return : %d %d\n", x, x - s);
    return x - s;
}

#define V 1005

int ans[25];
void work(int u, int v) {
    int k = 0;
    while (++k <= K) {
        if ((ans[k] = select(k, u, v)) >= V) break;
    }
    if (k == 1) puts("-1");
    else {
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) printf("%d ", V - ans[i]);
        putchar('\n');
    }
}

int main() {
    //freopen("4336.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(att[i]);
        read(bel[i]);
        att[i] = V - att[i];
        change(tid[bel[i]], att[i], 1);
    }
    read(Q);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, x, u, v; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (x) {
        case 2:
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], -1);
            bel[u] = v;
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], 1);
            break;
        case 3:
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], -1);
            att[u] = V - v;
            change(tid[bel[u]], att[u], 1);
            break;
        case 1:
            work(u, v);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4337.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#define P 20000816llu
#define Q 19260817llu
#define R 4194303llu
#define S 12600001llu
#define MAXN 505
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*2];
int n,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
vector <LL> a[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

LL dfs(int x,int depth,int fa) {
    int cnt=0;
    a[x].clear();
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            cnt++;
            a[x].push_back(dfs(e[now].to,depth+1,x));
        }
    }
    sort(a[x].begin(),a[x].end());
    LL ret=depth*P^cnt;
    for (vector<LL>::iterator it=a[x].begin(); it!=a[x].end(); it++) {
        ret=ret*Q+(*it);
    }
    return ret*P;
}

LL dfs2(int x,int depth,int fa) {
    int cnt=0;
    a[x].clear();
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            cnt++;
            a[x].push_back(dfs2(e[now].to,depth+1,x));
        }
    }
    sort(a[x].begin(),a[x].end());
    LL ret=depth*R^cnt;
    for (vector<LL>::iterator it=a[x].begin(); it!=a[x].end(); it++) {
        ret=ret*S+(*it);
    }
    return ret*R;
}

void work() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,fa; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&fa);
        if (fa!=0) add(fa,i);
    }
}

map< pair<LL,LL>,int > mp;

void markall(int index) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) mp[make_pair(dfs(i,0,0),dfs2(i,0,0))]=index;
}
int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        work();
        LL ret1=dfs(1,0,0),ret2=dfs2(1,0,0);
        if (mp.find(make_pair(ret1,ret2))==mp.end()) markall(i);
        printf("%d\n",mp[make_pair(ret1,ret2)]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 1000005

struct Node {
    int u;
    LL v;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, LL b) : u(a), v(b) {}
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return v > a.v;
    }
};

struct Node_ {
    int u, v;
    Node_ () {}
    Node_ (int a, int b) : u(a), v(b) {}
    bool operator < (Node_ a) const {
        return v < a.v;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, K, b[MAXN];
LL rec[MAXN];

priority_queue <Node> q;

struct NNode {
    int l, r;
    int v;
} t[2097152];

int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
    } else t[x].v = b[l];
    return x;
}

int find(int x, int l, int r, int p, LL v) {
    if (t[x].v > v || r < p) return 0;
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = find(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
    if (ret) return ret;
    return find(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
}

int r[50], cnt = 0;

void dfs(int x, LL rem) {
    if (!K) return;
    if (!rem) {
        if (!(--K)) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) printf("%d ", r[i]);
            printf("\n");
        }
        return;
    }
    while (x <= n) {
        x = find(1, 1, n, x, rem);
        if (!x) return;
        r[++cnt] = x;
        dfs(x + 1, rem - b[x]);
        cnt--;
        x++;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    if (!(--K)) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), a[i] = Node_(i, b[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    q.push(Node(1, a[1].v));
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        Node now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        rec[i] = now.v;
        if (now.u < n) {
            q.push(Node(now.u + 1, now.v - a[now.u].v + a[now.u + 1].v));
            q.push(Node(now.u + 1, now.v + a[now.u + 1].v));
        }
    }
    LL ans = rec[K];
    int to = K;
    while (rec[to] == rec[K]) to--;
    K -= to;
    build(1, n);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    dfs(1, ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct Node {
    int l, r, bot, top;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int n, K, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].bot = -1, t[x].top = INF;
    } else t[x].bot = 0, t[x].top = 0;
    return x;
}

void fill(int x, int v) {
    t[x].bot = max(t[x].bot, v);
    if (t[x].bot > t[x].top) t[x].top = t[x].bot;
}

void clear(int x, int v) {
    t[x].top = min(t[x].top, v);
    if (t[x].bot > t[x].top) t[x].bot = t[x].top;
}

void fil(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        fill(x, v);
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
    if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) fil(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) fil(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

void clr(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        clear(x, v);
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
    if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) clr(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) clr(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

void print(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l < r) {
        if (t[x].bot != -1) fill(t[x].l, t[x].bot), fill(t[x].r, t[x].bot), t[x].bot = -1;
        if (t[x].top != INF) clear(t[x].l, t[x].top), clear(t[x].r, t[x].top), t[x].top = INF;
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        print(t[x].l, l, mid);
        print(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else printf("%d\n", t[x].top);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    build(0, n - 1);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r, h; i <= K; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(h);
        if (op == 1) fil(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, h);
        else clr(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, h);
    }
    print(1, 0, n - 1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4373.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int c;
    while (b) {
        c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL sum;
    int G, pre, mi, ma;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0, a[MAXN], pre[MAXN], nxt[MAXN];

map <int, set<int> > G;
set<int>::iterator it;
void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].mi = min(t[t[x].l].mi, t[t[x].r].mi);
    t[x].ma = max(t[t[x].l].ma, t[t[x].r].ma);
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].pre = max(t[t[x].l].pre, t[t[x].r].pre);
        t[x].G = gcd(t[t[x].l].G, t[t[x].r].G);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        t[x].sum = t[x].mi = t[x].ma = a[l], t[x].G = abs(a[l] - a[l - 1]);
        set<int> &s = G[a[l]];
        if (s.size()) {
            it = s.end();
            it--;
            pre[l] = t[x].pre = *it;
            nxt[*it] = l;
        }
        s.insert(l);
    }
    return x;
}

void upd_pre(int x, int l, int r, int y, int z) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (y <= mid) upd_pre(t[x].l, l, mid, y, z);
        else upd_pre(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, y, z);
        t[x].pre = max(t[t[x].l].pre, t[t[x].r].pre);
    } else t[x].pre = pre[l] = z;
}

void upd_gcd(int x, int l, int r, int y, int z) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (y <= mid) upd_gcd(t[x].l, l, mid, y, z);
        else upd_gcd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, y, z);
        t[x].G = gcd(t[t[x].l].G, t[t[x].r].G);
    } else t[x].G = z;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].sum = t[x].mi = t[x].ma = a[l] = v;
}

LL Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += Sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].ma;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Min(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].mi;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0x7fffffff;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, Min(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = min(ret, Min(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Pre(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].pre;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, Pre(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, Pre(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Gcd(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].G;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = gcd(Gcd(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)), ret);
    if (qr >  mid) ret = gcd(Gcd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr), ret);
    return ret;
}

int n, m;

#define ok() puts("Yes"), cnt++
#define fail() puts("No")

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    build(1, n);
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r, k, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            x ^= cnt, y ^= cnt;
            if (a[x] == y) continue;

            if (pre[x]) nxt[pre[x]] = nxt[x];
            if (nxt[x]) upd_pre(1, 1, n, nxt[x], pre[x]);
            G[a[x]].erase(x);

            set<int> &s = G[y];
            s.insert(x);
            it = s.find(x);
            if (it != s.begin()) {
                it--;
                if (nxt[*it]) upd_pre(1, 1, n, nxt[*it], x);
                upd_pre(1, 1, n, x, *it);
                nxt[x] = nxt[*it];
                nxt[*it] = x;
            } else {
                upd_pre(1, 1, n, x, 0);
                it++;
                if (it != s.end()) {
                    upd_pre(1, 1, n, *it, x);
                    nxt[x] = *it;
                } else nxt[x] = 0;
            }
            update(1, 1, n, x, y);
            upd_gcd(1, 1, n, x, abs(a[x] - a[x - 1]));
            if (x < n) upd_gcd(1, 1, n, x + 1, abs(a[x + 1] - a[x]));
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(k);
            l ^= cnt, r ^= cnt, k ^= cnt;
            if (l == r) ok();
            else if (k == 0) {
                if (Min(1, 1, n, l, r) == Max(1, 1, n, l, r)) ok();
                else fail();
            } else {
                LL su = Sum(1, 1, n, l, r);
                int gg = Gcd(1, 1, n, l + 1, r);
                int mi = Min(1, 1, n, l, r), ma = Max(1, 1, n, l, r);
                if (gg == k && ma - mi == k * LL(r - l) && su == LL(mi + ma) * (r - l + 1) / 2 && Pre(1, 1, n, l, r) < l) ok();
                else fail();
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 50105
#define LOG 16

struct E {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (E) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[LOG][MAXN], *Fa = fa[0], dep[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != Fa[x]) {
            Fa[e[o].v] = x;
            dep[e[o].v] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[o].v);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG - 1; ~i; i--) {
        if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) u = fa[i][u], v = fa[i][v];
    }
    return Fa[u];
}

int ans = 0;

void getans(int x) {
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != Fa[x]) {
            getans(e[o].v);
            cnt[x] += cnt[e[o].v];
        }
    }
    ans = max(ans, cnt[x]);
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int u, v, l;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        l = lca(u, v);
        cnt[u]++;
        cnt[v]++;
        cnt[l]--;
        cnt[Fa[l]]--;
    }
    getans(1);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 40005
#define MAXM 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define S 65536
struct Edge {
    int u, v, w, z;
} E[MAXM];
struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
};

int t[S * 2], dis[MAXN], p[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
void update(int x, int v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m;

struct Graph {
    edge e[MAXM * 2];
    int head[MAXN], ecnt;
    Graph () {
        ecnt = 1;
    }
    inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    void dijkstra() {
        memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
        memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
        update(1, 0);
        for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
            dis[x] = t[x + S];
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(x, INF);
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + S] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                    update(e[now].to, dis[x] + e[now].w);
                    p[e[now].to] = x == 1 ? (now >> 1) : p[x];
                }
            }
        }
    }
} G1, G2;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(E[i].u);
        read(E[i].v);
        read(E[i].w);
        read(E[i].z);
        if (E[i].v == 1) swap(E[i].u, E[i].v), swap(E[i].w, E[i].z);
        G1.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
        G1.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
    }
    G1.dijkstra();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (E[i].u == 1) {
            if (p[E[i].v] != i) {
                G2.add(1, n + 1, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, E[i].w);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].v, n + 1, E[i].z);
            }
        } else {
            if (p[E[i].u] != p[E[i].v]) {
                G2.add(1, E[i].v, dis[E[i].u] + E[i].w);
                G2.add(1, E[i].u, dis[E[i].v] + E[i].z);
            } else {
                G2.add(E[i].u, E[i].v, E[i].w);
                G2.add(E[i].v, E[i].u, E[i].z);
            }
        }
    }
    G2.dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n", dis[n + 1]);
    return 0;
}

inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000003

int power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

int fac[MOD], inv[MOD];

LL C(int x, int y) {
    if (x <= y) return x == y;
    if (!y) return 1;
    if (x < MOD) return (LL)fac[x] * inv[y] % MOD * inv[x - y] % MOD;
    else return C(x / MOD, y / MOD) * C(x % MOD, y % MOD) % MOD;
}

void init() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MOD; i++) fac[i] = int(fac[i - 1] * LL(i) % MOD);
    inv[MOD - 1] = power(fac[MOD - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MOD - 2; ~i; i--) inv[i] = int(inv[i + 1] * LL(i + 1) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T, n, l, r;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n", ((int)C(r - l + 1 + n, r - l + 1) + MOD - 1) % MOD);
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 5000111

int power(LL x, int b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 6], pp[MAXN / 6], pcnt, F[MAXN], sum[MAXN];

int T, K;

void init() {
    F[0] = sum[0] = 0, F[1] = sum[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, pp[pcnt] = power(i, K), F[i] = pp[pcnt] - 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && (k = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) F[k] = int((LL)F[i] * F[p[j]] % MOD);
            else {
                F[k] = int((LL)F[i] * pp[j] % MOD);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (register int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) (sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + F[i]) >= MOD && (sum[i] -= MOD);
}

inline void work() {
    int n, m, N;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    N = min(n, m);
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= N; i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        (ans += LL(n / i) * LL (m / i) % MOD * (sum[j] - sum[i - 1])) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(ans + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(K);
    init();
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define TOP 1000000001
struct node {
    int l,r,sum;
} t[MAXN*32];

int n,m,a[MAXN],rt[MAXN],tcnt=0;

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].sum+=v;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[rx].sum-t[lx].sum;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,ret=0;
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,TOP,a[i]);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l--;
        int ans=1,tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,1);
        while (tot>=ans) {
            ans=tot+1;
            tot=query(rt[l],rt[r],1,TOP,1,ans);
        }
        printf("%d\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4419.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 200005
#define MAXM 500005

struct data {
    int u,v;
    bool exist;
    data() {}
    data(int a,int b):u(a),v(b),exist(false) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (u!=a.u) return u<a.u;
        return v<a.v;
    }
    bool operator == (data a) const {
        return u==a.u && v==a.v;
    }
} e[MAXM];

struct query {
    int op,x,y;
} q[MAXM];

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch!='!' && ch!='+' && ch!='-') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='!') a=0;
    else if (ch=='+') a=1;
    else a=2;
}

int n,m,cnt=0;
int tot[MAXN],lazy[MAXN];

int find(data x) {
    int l=1,r=cnt,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (x<e[mid]) r=mid-1;
        else l=mid;
    }
    return l;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(q[i].op);
        read(q[i].x);
        if (q[i].op) {
            read(q[i].y);
            if (q[i].x>q[i].y) swap(q[i].x,q[i].y);
            if (q[i].op==1) {
                e[++cnt]=data(q[i].x,q[i].y);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(e+1,e+cnt+1);
    cnt=int(unique(e+1,e+cnt+1)-e-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].op) {
            int tag=find(data(q[i].x,q[i].y));
            if (q[i].op==1) {
                tot[q[i].x]-=lazy[q[i].y];
                tot[q[i].y]-=lazy[q[i].x];
                e[tag].exist=1;
            } else {
                tot[q[i].x]+=lazy[q[i].y];
                tot[q[i].y]+=lazy[q[i].x];
                e[tag].exist=0;
            }
        } else {
            lazy[q[i].x]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (e[i].exist) {
            tot[e[i].u]+=lazy[e[i].v];
            tot[e[i].v]+=lazy[e[i].u];
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",tot[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4443.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 256

int a[MAXN][MAXN],n,m,k;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;
int ecnt,head[MAXN*2],cur[MAXN*2],tag[MAXN*2];

void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i+1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(i+n+1,1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]<=x) add(i+1,j+n+1);
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(0);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to,1)) {
                usd++;
                e[now].flow--;
                e[now^1].flow++;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

bool dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (k!=ans && bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=n+m+1; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,k-ans);
    }
    return ans==k;
}

bool check(int x) {
    init();
    build(x);
    if (dinic()) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    k=n-k+1;
    int MIN=1000000001,MAX=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
            MIN=min(MIN,a[i][j]);
            MAX=max(MAX,a[i][j]);
        }
    int l=MIN,r=MAX,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 256

int a[MAXN][MAXN],n,m,k;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;
int ecnt,head[MAXN*2],tag[MAXN*2];

void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i+1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(i+n+1,1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]<=x) add(i+1,j+n+1);
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(0);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to,1)) {
                e[now].flow--;
                e[now^1].flow++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (k!=ans && bfs()) {
        while (k!=ans && dfs(0,1)) ans++;
    }
    return ans==k;
}

bool check(int x) {
    init();
    build(x);
    if (dinic()) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    k=n-k+1;
    int MIN=1000000001,MAX=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            scanf("%d",a[i]+j);
            MIN=min(MIN,a[i][j]);
            MAX=max(MAX,a[i][j]);
        }
    int l=MIN,r=MAX,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';

#define MAXN 200005

struct data {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return l<a.l;
    }
} a[MAXN<<1];
int n,m;
int ls[MAXN<<1],fa[MAXN<<1][20],ans[MAXN];

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=m,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (ls[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int work(int x) {
    int target=x+n,ret=0;
    for (int k=19; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[x][k]<target) {
            ret|=1<<k;
            x=fa[x][k];
        }
    }
    return ret+1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i].l);
        read(a[i].r);
        a[i].x=i;
        ls[(i<<1)-1]=a[i].l,ls[i<<1]=a[i].r;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    sort(ls+1,ls+n+n+1);
    m=int(unique(ls+1,ls+n+n+1)-ls-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i].l=find(a[i].l);
        a[i].r=find(a[i].r);
        if (a[i].l>a[i].r) a[i].r+=m;
        a[i+n].l=a[i].l+m;
        a[i+n].r=a[i].r+m;
    }
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (a[j+1].l<=a[i].r) j++;
        fa[i][0]=j;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        fa[i+n][0]=min(fa[i][0]+n,n+n+1);
    }
    fa[n+n+1][0]=n+n+1;
    for (int k=1; k<=19; k++) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n+n+1; i++) {
            fa[i][k]=fa[fa[i][k-1]][k-1];
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans[a[i].x]=work(i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define eps 1e-10
typedef double D;

inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
inline D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        int a, b;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        x = a, y = b;
    }
} p[MAXN];

Point Is(Point &a1, Point &a2, Point &b1, Point &b2) {
    D x1 = (b2 - b1) * (a1 - b1), x2 = (a2 - b1) * (b2 - b1);
    return (a1 * x2 + a2 * x1) / (x1 + x2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border () {}
    Border (Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return (b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1) > 0;
}

int n, cnt, pcnt;
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
D ans = 0, tot = 0;

void add(D A, D B, D C) {
    Point st;
    if (abs(B) > eps) st = Point(0, -C / B);
    else st = Point(-C / A, 0);
    a[++cnt] = Border(st, st + Point(B, -A));
}

bool ok(Border &A, Border &B, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(A.p1, A.p2, B.p1, B.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

void hpi() {
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he > 2) {
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int j = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[pcnt++] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[j].p1, q[j].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pcnt; i++) {
            ans += p[i] * p[(i + 1) % pcnt];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i].re();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tot += p[i] * p[(i + 1) % n];
    a[++cnt] = Border(p[0], p[1]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        Point A = p[1] - p[0], B = p[j] - p[i];
        add(A.y - B.y, B.x - A.x, A.x * p[0].y - A.y * p[0].x - B.x * p[i].y + B.y * p[i].x);
    }
    hpi();
    printf("%.4lf\n", (double)(abs(ans / tot) + eps));
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#include <cmath>
#define MAXN 200005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
struct qe {
    int next,to,c,num;
} q[MAXN<<1];
int t[MAXN*23],L[MAXN*23],R[MAXN*23];
int head[MAXN],qh[MAXN],rt[MAXN],st[MAXN],ans[MAXN],f[MAXN],father[MAXN],total[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
int n,m,ecnt=0,qcnt=0,tcnt=0,root;
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
    return;
}
void addq(int u,int v,int c,int num) {
    q[++qcnt].to=v;
    q[qcnt].next=qh[u];
    q[qcnt].c=c;
    q[qcnt].num=num;
    qh[u]=qcnt;
    if (u==v)
        return;
    q[++qcnt].to=u;
    q[qcnt].next=qh[v];
    q[qcnt].c=c;
    q[qcnt].num=num;
    qh[v]=qcnt;
    return;
}
void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[i]=i;
        st[i]=MAXN-1;
    }
    return;
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x)
        return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=0;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    L[now]=build(l,mid);
    R[now]=build(mid+1,r);
    return now;
}
int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int d) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    L[now]=L[x];
    R[now]=R[x];
    t[now]=t[x]+d;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid)
        L[now]=update(L[x],l,mid,p,d);
    else
        R[now]=update(R[x],mid+1,r,p,d);
    return now;
}

int query(int u,int v,int lca,int flca,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r)
        return 0;
    int lval=t[L[u]]+t[L[v]]-t[L[lca]]-t[L[flca]],mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid)
        return query(L[u],L[v],L[lca],L[flca],l,mid,p);
    else {
        //printf("Now at %d~%d updateans:%d\n",l,r,lval);
        return lval+query(R[u],R[v],R[lca],R[flca],mid+1,r,p);
    }
}
void tarjan(int x) {
    rt[x]=update(rt[father[x]],1,MAXN,st[x],1);
    f[x]=x;
    for (int now=qh[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        int v=q[now].to;
        if (visit[v]) {
            int LCA=getf(v),num=q[now].num,c=q[now].c;
            //	printf("LCA%d~%d %d %d\n",x,v,LCA,num);
            total[num]=t[rt[x]]+t[rt[v]]-t[rt[LCA]]-t[rt[father[LCA]]];
            //	printf("fuck %d\n",num-c);
            ans[num]=query(rt[x],rt[v],rt[LCA],rt[father[LCA]],1,MAXN,num-c);
            //	printf("ans=%d\n",ans[num]);
        }
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (!visit[v]) {
            father[v]=x;
            visit[v]=1;
            tarjan(v);
            f[v]=x;
        }
    }
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        if (r!=0)
            add(i,r);
        else
            root=i;
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1,k,x,y,c; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&k);
        if (k==2) {
            scanf("%d",&c);
            st[c]=i;
            ans[i]=-1;
        } else {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&c);
            addq(x,y,c,i);
        }
    }
    rt[0]=build(1,MAXN);
    father[root]=0;
    visit[root]=1;
    tarjan(root);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (ans[i]!=-1)
            printf("%d %d\n",total[i],ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 21
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

int n, m, L, R;
int fa[MAXN][LOG], dep[MAXN], Min[MAXN][LOG], a[MAXN], sum[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int st, l, r, p;
    Node () {}
    Node (int i, int j, int k, int o) : st(i), l(j), r(k), p(o) {}
    bool operator < (const Node &b) const {
        return sum[st] - sum[p] < sum[b.st] - sum[b.p];
    }
};

priority_queue<Node> q;

int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return sum[x] < sum[y] ? x : y;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    sum[x] += a[x];
    Min[x][0] = x;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) {
        fa[x][i] = fa[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1];
        Min[x][i] = cmp(Min[x][i - 1], Min[fa[x][i - 1]][i - 1]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        sum[e[now].to] = sum[x];
        dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
        dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

int kthfa(int x, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; k; i++, k >>= 1) if (k & 1) x = fa[x][i];
    return x;
}

int getmin(int l, int r) {
    int x = dep[l] - dep[r], ret = r;
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) ret = cmp(ret, Min[l][i]), l = fa[l][i];
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(fa[i][0]), e[++ecnt] = (edge) {head[fa[i][0]], i}, head[fa[i][0]] = ecnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    read(m);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (dep[i] < L) continue;
        int l = kthfa(i, L), r = kthfa(i, R);
        q.push(Node(i, l, r, getmin(l, r)));
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    while (m--) {
        Node now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += sum[now.st] - sum[now.p];
        if (now.p != now.l) {
            int y = kthfa(now.l, dep[now.l] - dep[now.p] - 1);
            int p = getmin(now.l, y);
            q.push(Node(now.st, now.l, y, p));
        }
        if (now.p != now.r) {
            int p = getmin(fa[now.p][0], now.r);
            q.push(Node(now.st, fa[now.p][0], now.r, p));
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define V 262144
typedef double D;
struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
};
int R[V];
void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R[i] > i) swap(a[R[i]], a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

char s[MAXN];
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int n, m;

Comp t1[V], t2[V], t3[V], tmp[V];

vector <int> fuck_the_sample_tests;

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = s[i] == '?' ? 0 : s[i] - 'a' + 1;
    scanf("%s", s);
    m = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) b[i] = s[i] == '?' ? 0 : s[i] - 'a' + 1;
    reverse(b, b + m);

    getR(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t1[i] = Comp(a[i] * a[i] * a[i], 0);
        else t1[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t1, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t1[i] = t1[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t1, V, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t2[i] = Comp(a[i], 0);
        else t2[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i] * b[i] * b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t2, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t2[i] = t2[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t2, V, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        if (i < n) t3[i] = Comp(a[i] * a[i], 0);
        else t3[i] = Comp();
        if (i < m) tmp[i] = Comp(b[i] * b[i], 0);
        else tmp[i] = Comp();
    }
    FFT(t3, V, 1);
    FFT(tmp, V, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) t3[i] = t3[i] * tmp[i];
    FFT(t3, V, -1);

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = m - 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (abs(round(t1[i].r) + round(t2[i].r) - 2 * round(t3[i].r)) < 1e-9) {
            ans++;
            fuck_the_sample_tests.push_back(i - m + 1);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    for (int i = 0; i < ans; i++) printf("%d\n", fuck_the_sample_tests[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4513.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

LL n, m, k;
int P;

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

inline int LOG(LL x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x >> 32) x >>= 32, ret |= 32;
    if (x >> 16) x >>= 16, ret |= 16;
    if (x >> 8) x >>= 8, ret |= 8;
    if (x >> 4) x >>= 4, ret |= 4;
    if (x >> 2) x >>= 2, ret |= 2;
    return ret + int(x >> 1);
}

LL fuck(LL base, int i, int j) {
    base = (base >> max(i, j)) << max(i, j);
    LL st = base, ed = st + (1ll << max(i, j)) - 1;
    if (ed <= k) return 0;
    else {
        st = max(st, k + 1);
        st -= k, ed -= k;
        if ((st ^ ed) & 1) {
            return (((((st + ed) % P) * (((ed - st + 1) / 2) % P)) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
        } else return (((((st + ed) / 2) % P) * ((ed - st + 1) % P) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
    }
}

void work() {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (LL i = n; i;) {
        int bi = LOG(lowbit(i));
        i ^= lowbit(i);
        for (LL j = m; j; ) {
            int bj = LOG(lowbit(j));
            j ^= lowbit(j);
            ans = (ans + fuck(i ^ j, bi, bj)) % P;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        read(k);
        read(P);
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4514.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
typedef long long ll;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
    ll w;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int n,src=0,sink,ecnt=1;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN],c[MAXN],num[MAXN],head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int f,long long w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline int solve(int x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=2,t=(int)sqrt(x); i<=t; i++) {
        if (!(x%i)) {
            while (!(x%i)) {
                ans++;
                x/=i;
            }
            t=(int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ans++;
    return ans;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        num[i]=solve(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",b+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",c+i);
}

inline void build() {
    sink=n+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (num[i]&1) {
            add(i,sink,b[i],0);
        } else {
            add(src,i,b[i],0);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        bool odd=num[i]&1;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (num[i]-num[j]==1 && a[i]%a[j]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            } else if (num[j]-num[i]==1 && a[j]%a[i]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool inq[MAXN];
long long dis[MAXN];
int pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
queue <int> q;

inline bool spfa() {
    q.push(src);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[src]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (pre[sink]==-1) return 0;
    else return 1;
}

inline void work() {
    long long val=0;
    int ans=0,flow;
    while (spfa()) {
        flow=INF;
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            flow=min(flow,e[pos[now]].flow);
        }
        if (dis[sink]>0) {
            if (-val/dis[sink]<flow)
                flow=int(-val/dis[sink]);
        }
        if (flow==0) break;
        if (flow<0) {
            while (1) puts("FUCK");
        }
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow-=flow;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow+=flow;
        }
        val+=flow*dis[sink];
        ans+=flow;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 10000000
typedef long long LL;

int T,n,m;
int fac[MAXN+5],invfac[MAXN+5],dp[MAXN+5];

int quickpower(long long a,int x) {
    long long ret=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=(ret*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return int(ret);
}

int inv(int x) {
    return quickpower(LL(x),MOD-2);
}

void init() {
    fac[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=int((LL(fac[i-1])*i)%MOD);
    invfac[MAXN]=inv(fac[MAXN]);
    for (int i=MAXN-1; i>-1; i--) invfac[i]=int((LL(invfac[i+1])*(i+1))%MOD);
    dp[0]=1,dp[1]=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        dp[i]=int((1-((i&1)<<1)+dp[i-1]*LL(i)+MOD)%MOD);
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        printf("%d\n",int((((((LL(fac[n])*invfac[n-m])%MOD)*invfac[m])%MOD)*dp[n-m])%MOD));
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 3005

int n, m;
LL L, d[MAXN], f[2][MAXN];

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}
LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[i][j] + 2 * L * d[j] + m * power(d[j]) - f[i][k] - 2 * L * d[k] - m * power(d[k])) / (d[j] - d[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void clear() {
        v[0] = l = r = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * m * d[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[r], i) <= slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) read(ai), d[i] = d[i - 1] + ai;
    L = d[n];
    for (int k = 1; k <= m; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[now][i] = f[pre][j] + m * power(d[i] - d[j]) - 2 * L * (d[i] - d[j]);
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m & 1][n] + power(L));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4519.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 900
#define MAXM 9000

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXM * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int G[MAXN][MAXN];
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
set <int> s;
void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    s.insert(ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        read(W[i]);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    memset(G, 0x3f, sizeof G);
    solve(1, n);
    printf("%d\n", (int)s.size());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4520.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

#define read(x) x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar()
#define power(x) (LL(x) * LL(x))
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define rint register int
#define rll register LL
typedef long long LL;

#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

#define MAXN 100319

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int x[2], ma[2], mi[2], l, r;
} t[MAXN];

int D;
bool operator < (const Node a, const Node b) {
    return a.x[D] < b.x[D] || (a.x[D] == b.x[D] && a.x[!D] < b.x[!D]);
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    rint l = t[x].l, r = t[x].r;
    if (l) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[l].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[l].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[l].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[l].mi[1]);
    }
    if (r) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[r].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[r].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[r].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[r].mi[1]);
    }
}

int build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int x = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(t + l, t + x, t + r + 1);
    t[x].ma[0] = t[x].mi[0] = t[x].x[0];
    t[x].ma[1] = t[x].mi[1] = t[x].x[1];
    if (l < x) t[x].l = build(l, x - 1, !d);
    if (r > x) t[x].r = build(x + 1, r, !d);
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

int Q[2];

int n, K, rt;

LL g(int x) {
    return x ? max(power(t[x].ma[0] - Q[0]), power(t[x].mi[0] - Q[0])) + max(power(t[x].ma[1] - Q[1]), power(t[x].mi[1] - Q[1])) : 0;
}

LL h[543];
int top;

void poppush(rll v) {
    rint x, p;
    h[1] = h[top];
    h[top] = INF;
    x = 1;
    while (x < top) {
        p = x, x <<= 1;
        x ^= (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]);
        if (h[p] > h[x]) swap(h[p], h[x]);
        else break;
    }
    h[top] = v;
    x = top;
    while (x > 1) {
        p = x ^ (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]), x >>= 1;
        if (h[x] > h[p]) swap(h[x], h[p]);
        else break;
    }
}

void query(int x) {
    if (!x) return;
    LL dis = power(t[x].x[0] - Q[0]) + power(t[x].x[1] - Q[1]);
    if (dis > h[1]) poppush(dis);
    LL D1 = g(t[x].l), D2 = g(t[x].r);
    if (D1 > D2) {
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
    } else {
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
    }
}

int main() {
    register int ch = 0, i;
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(t[i].x[0]);
        read(t[i].x[1]);
    }
    memset(h, 0x3f, sizeof h);
    for (i = 1; i <= 2 * K; i++) h[i] = 0;
    top = 2 * K;
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        Q[0] = t[i].x[0], Q[1] = t[i].x[1];
        query(rt);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", h[1]);
    return 0;
}
