int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] == x) return x;
    int y = getf(f[x]);
    dep[x] = dep[f[x]] + 1;
    return y;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = i;
    int ans = 0, cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v, fu, fv; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        u ^= ans, v ^= ans;
        fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
        if (op) {
            ans = 0;
            if (fu == fv) {
                while (u != v) {
                    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) ans = max(ans, val[v]), v = f[v];
                    else ans = max(ans, val[u]), u = f[u];
                }
            }
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        } else {
            cnt++;
            if (fu == fv) continue;
            if (rk[fu] < rk[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
            rk[fu] = max(rk[fu], rk[fv] + 1);
            f[fv] = fu;
            val[fv] = cnt;
            dep[fv] = 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4675.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch <  '0') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 50005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
bool vis[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

inline int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                rt = e[now].to;
                flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

LL tot;
int n, m, a[12], K;
int t[MAXN], sta[MAXN], top = 0;

void dd(int x, int dep) {
    sta[++top] = dep;
    tot += t[K - dep];
    if (dep < K) {
        vis[x] = 1;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to]) dd(e[now].to, dep + 1);
        }
        vis[x] = 0;
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = getrt(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    t[0] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dd(e[now].to, 1);
            while (top) t[sta[top--]]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; t[i]; t[i++] = 0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        memset(vis + 1, 0, n);
        K = a[i];
        solve(1);
    }
    LL t1 = n / 3 + (n % 3 > 0), t2 = n / 3 + (n % 3 > 1), t3 = n / 3;
    t1 = t1 * (t1 - 1);
    t2 = t2 * (t2 - 1);
    t3 = t3 * (t3 - 1);
    printf("%.2lf\n", double(t1 * tot / LD(LL(n) * LL(n - 1))));
    printf("%.2lf\n", double(t2 * tot / LD(LL(n) * LL(n - 1))));
    printf("%.2lf\n", double(t3 * tot / LD(LL(n) * LL(n - 1))));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4676.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
inline LL min(LL a, LL b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL max(LL a, LL b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch <  '0') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();
}

#define M 10005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f

int n, m;
int A[M][5], B[M][5], C[M][5], D[M][5];
bool a[M][5];
LL ans = 0;
int f[M][33], g[M][33];
LL dp[M][33];

inline LL solve() {
    register int i, j, k, l, top = 1 << n;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        register int *b = B[i], *d = D[i], *F = f[i];
        register bool *aa = a[i];
        for (j = 0; j < top; j++) {
            F[j] = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < n; k++) if (((j >> k) & 1) ^ aa[k]) F[j] += b[k];
            for (k = 0, l = 1; k < n; k++, l++) {
                if (l == n) l = 0;
                if (((j >> k) & 1) ^ ((j >> l) & 1)) F[j] += d[k];
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        register int *c = C[i], *G = g[i];
        for (j = 0; j < top; j++) {
            G[j] = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < n; k++) if ((j >> k) & 1) G[j] += c[k];
        }
    }
    for (k = 0; k < top; k++) dp[1][k] = f[1][k];
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
        register LL *Dp = dp[i], *pre = dp[i - 1];
        register int *G = g[i - 1], *F = f[i];
        for (k = 0; k < top; k++) {
            Dp[k] = INF;
            for (l = 0; l < top; l++) Dp[k] = min(Dp[k], pre[l] + G[k ^ l]);
            Dp[k] += F[k];
        }
    }
    register LL ret = INF;
    for (i = 0; i < top; i++) if (ret > dp[m][i]) ret = dp[m][i];
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(A[j][i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(B[j][i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) read(C[j][i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(D[j][i]);
    for (int k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[j][i] = (A[j][i] >> k) & 1;
                flag |= a[j][i];
            }
        if (flag) ans += solve() << k;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4690.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int n,m;
int f[MAXN],rank[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) {
        rank[x]=0;
        return f[x];
    }
    int pref=f[x];
    f[x]=getf(f[x]);
    rank[x]+=rank[pref];
    return f[x];
}
void merge(int a,int b,int val) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        f[fa]=fb;
        rank[fa]=rank[b]-rank[a]+val;
    }
}
char op[5];
int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d",&n,&m)!=EOF && n && m) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) f[i]=i,rank[i]=0;
        for (int i=1,a,b,w; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%s",op);
            if (op[0]=='!') {
                scanf("%d%d%d",&a,&b,&w);
                merge(a,b,w);
            } else {
                scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
                if (getf(a)!=getf(b)) puts("UNKNOWN");
                else printf("%d\n",rank[a]-rank[b]);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4719.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN];
int f[MAXN],fa[MAXN][20],dep[MAXN],w[MAXN],S[MAXN],lca[MAXN],T[MAXN];
struct Query {
    int next,x,v;
} q[MAXN<<1];
int qhead[MAXN],qcnt=0;
int t[MAXN<<1],ans[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void add_query(int p,int v,int x) {
    q[++qcnt].next=qhead[p];
    q[qcnt].x=x;
    q[qcnt].v=v;
    qhead[p]=qcnt;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    fa[x][0]=f[x];
    for (int i=1; i<=19; i++) {
        fa[x][i]=fa[fa[x][i-1]][i-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=f[x]) {
            f[e[now].to]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}
void work_1(int x,int ta) {
    int now=0;
    while (x!=ta) {
        if (now==w[x]) ans[x]++;
        now++;
        x=f[x];
    }
    if (now==w[ta]) ans[ta]++;
}
void work_2(int x,int ta,int now) {
    while (x!=ta) {
        if (now==w[x]) ans[x]++;
        now--;
        x=f[x];
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int i=0; x; i++,x>>=1) {
        if (x&1) {
            u=fa[u][i];
        }
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int i=19; i>-1; i--) {
        if (fa[u][i]!=fa[v][i]) {
            u=fa[u][i];
            v=fa[v][i];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

void vio() {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        work_1(S[i],lca[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        work_2(T[i],lca[i],dep[S[i]]-dep[lca[i]]+dep[T[i]]-dep[lca[i]]);
    }
}

void work_1_p1(int x) {
    int xx=w[x]+dep[x];
    ans[x]-=t[xx];
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            work_1_p1(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==1) t[q[now].x]++;
    }
    ans[x]+=t[xx];
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==-1) t[q[now].x]--;
    }
}

void work_2_p1(int x) {
    int xx=w[x]-dep[x]+MAXN;
    ans[x]-=t[xx];
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            work_2_p1(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==1) t[q[now].x]++;
    }
    ans[x]+=t[xx];
    for (int now=qhead[x]; now; now=q[now].next) {
        if (q[now].v==-1) t[q[now].x]--;
    }
}

void work_p1() {
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add_query(S[i],1,dep[S[i]]);
        add_query(lca[i],-1,dep[S[i]]);
    }
    work_1_p1(1);
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add_query(T[i],1,dep[S[i]]-2*dep[lca[i]]+MAXN);
        add_query(lca[i],-1,dep[S[i]]-2*dep[lca[i]]+MAXN);
    }
    work_2_p1(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int num=dep[S[i]]-dep[lca[i]];
        if (w[lca[i]]==num) ans[lca[i]]--;
    }
}

void dfs_p2(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=f[x]) {
            dfs_p2(e[now].to);
            t[x]+=t[e[now].to];
        }
    }
    if (dep[x]==w[x]+1) {
        ans[x]=t[x];
    }
}

void work_p2() {
    qcnt=0;
    memset(qhead,0,sizeof(qhead));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        t[T[i]]++;
    }
    dfs_p2(1);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(w[i]);
    }
    f[1]=1;
    dep[1]=1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(S[i]);
        read(T[i]);
        lca[i]=getLCA(S[i],T[i]);
    }
    work_p1();
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        printf("%d ",ans[i]);
    }
    printf("%d",ans[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4720.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005
#define MAXV 305
#define INF 1e12
int n,m,V,E,head[MAXN];

int c[MAXN],d[MAXN],map[MAXV][MAXV];
double ans=INF,dp[MAXN][MAXN][2],k[MAXN];

void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++)
            dp[i][j][0]=dp[i][j][1]=INF;
    dp[1][0][0]=0,dp[1][1][1]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            // 0 -> 0
            dp[i+1][j][0]=min(dp[i+1][j][0],dp[i][j][0]+map[c[i]][c[i+1]]);
            // 1 -> 0
            dp[i+1][j][0]=min(dp[i+1][j][0],dp[i][j][1]+(1-k[i])*map[c[i]][c[i+1]]+k[i]*map[d[i]][c[i+1]]);
            // 0 -> 1
            dp[i+1][j+1][1]=min(dp[i+1][j+1][1],dp[i][j][0]+(1-k[i+1])*map[c[i]][c[i+1]]+k[i+1]*map[c[i]][d[i+1]]);
            // 1 -> 1
            dp[i+1][j+1][1]=min(dp[i+1][j+1][1],dp[i][j][1]+(1-k[i])*(1-k[i+1])*map[c[i]][c[i+1]]+k[i]*(1-k[i+1])*map[d[i]][c[i+1]]+(1-k[i])*k[i+1]*map[c[i]][d[i+1]]+k[i]*k[i+1]*map[d[i]][d[i+1]]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=m; i++) {
        ans=min(ans,dp[n][i][0]);
        ans=min(ans,dp[n][i][1]);
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&V,&E);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",c+i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",d+i);
    }
    k[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf",k+i);
    }
    memset(map,63,sizeof(map));
    for (int i=1; i<=V; i++) {
        map[i][i]=0;
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=E; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        if (w<map[u][v]) {
            map[u][v]=map[v][u]=w;
        }
    }
    for (int kk=1; kk<=V; kk++)
        for (int i=1; i<=V; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=V; j++) {
                if (map[i][j]>map[i][kk]+map[kk][j]) {
                    map[i][j]=map[i][kk]+map[kk][j];
                }
            }
    /*	if (n<=20 && m!=0) {
    		int top=1<<n;
    		f[1][0]=0;
    		f[1][1]=0;
    		for (int i=0;i<top;i++)
    			check(i<<1);
    	}
    	else {
    		ans=0;
    		for (int i=2;i<=n;i++) {
    			ans+=map[c[i-1]][c[i]];
    		}
    	}*/
    work();
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4721.cpp
/* Good Luck*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,Q,U,V,t;
priority_queue <int> q;
void work() {
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        q.push(a);
    }
    int nowtot=0;
    bool flag=0;
    for (int i=1,x,lena,lenb,opcnt=1; i<=m; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=q.top()+nowtot;
        q.pop();
        lena=int(LL(x)*U/V);
        lenb=x-lena;
        nowtot+=Q;
        q.push(lena-nowtot);
        q.push(lenb-nowtot);
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            if (flag) putchar(' ');
            else flag=1;
            printf("%d",x);
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
    flag=0;
    for (int i=1,x,opcnt=1,ta=n+m; i<=ta; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=q.top()+nowtot;
        q.pop();
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            if (flag) putchar(' ');
            else flag=1;
            printf("%d",x);
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
}
int a[100005];
queue <int> Que[3];
void work_QX() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) Que[0].push(a[i]);
    bool flag=0;
    int nowtot=0;
    for (int i=1,x,tag,lena,lenb,opcnt=1; i<=m; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=-0x7fffffff;
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            if (!Que[j].empty() && Que[j].front()>x) {
                tag=j,x=Que[j].front();
            }
        }
        x+=nowtot;
        Que[tag].pop();
        nowtot+=Q;
        lena=int(LL(x)*U/V);
        lenb=x-lena;
        Que[1].push(lena-nowtot);
        Que[2].push(lenb-nowtot);
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            if (flag) putchar(' ');
            else flag=1;
            printf("%d",x);
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
    flag=0;
    for (int i=1,x,tag,opcnt=1,ta=n+m; i<=ta; i++,opcnt++) {
        x=-0x7fffffff;
        for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
            if (!Que[j].empty() && Que[j].front()>x) {
                tag=j,x=Que[j].front();
            }
        }
        Que[tag].pop();
        if (opcnt==t) {
            opcnt=0;
            if (flag) putchar(' ');
            else flag=1;
            printf("%d",x+nowtot);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    read(U);
    read(V);
    read(t);
    work_QX();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4726.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <ctime>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 500005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
int n,k,head[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0;
int fa[MAXN];
double ans[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    if (!head[x]) ans[x]=1;
    else {
        ans[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x]+=siz[e[now].to];
        }
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            ans[x]=max(ans[x],min(ans[e[now].to],double(siz[e[now].to])/(siz[x]-1)));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]);
        add(fa[i],i);
    }
    dfs(1);
    double pr=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (siz[i]>k) pr=max(pr,ans[i]);
    }
    printf("%.7lf\n",pr);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4741.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 305

struct point {
    int x, y;
    point() {}
    point(int a, int b): x(a), y(b) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    void read() {
        ::read(x);
        ::read(y);
    }
    long long operator * (point a) {
        return (long long)x * a.y - (long long)y * a.x;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n, cnt[MAXN][MAXN], eq[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

bool under(point a, point b, point c) {
    b = b - a;
    c = c - a;
    return c.x > 0 && c.x < b.x && b * c < 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].read();
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            point a = p[i], b = p[j];
            if (a.x == b.x) eq[a.y > b.y ? i : j] = 1;
            if (b.x < a.x) swap(a, b);
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) if (under(a, b, p[k])) cnt[i][j]++;
            cnt[j][i] = cnt[i][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            for (int k = j + 1; k <= n; k++) {
                int a = i, b = j, c = k;
                if (p[a].x > p[b].x) swap(a, b);
                if (p[a].x > p[c].x) swap(a, c);
                if (p[b].x > p[c].x) swap(b, c);
                ans[abs(cnt[a][b] + cnt[b][c] + (eq[b] & (p[a].x != p[b].x) & (p[b].x!=p[c].x)) - cnt[a][c] + under(p[a], p[c], p[b]))]++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - 3; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

        cin>>FJ[i];
    }

        cin>>FP[i];
    }

    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            f[i][j][0]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            for (int k=1; k<=kk; k++) {
                f[i][j][k] = f[i][j-1][k] + f[i-1][j][k] - f[i-1][j-1][k];
                if (FJ[i]>FP[j]) {
                    f[i][j][k] = f[i][j][k] + f[i-1][j-1][k-1];
                }
                f[i][j][k] %= mod;
            }

//BZOJ4743.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005

struct Pos {
    int v[10], x;
    int &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
    bool operator < (Pos a) const {
        for (int i = 0; i < x; i++) if (v[i] != a.v[i]) return v[i] < a.v[i];
        return 0;
    }
} p[MAXN];

LL ans = 0, mx = 0;
int n, K, cnt = 0;

int find(LL v) {
    int l = 0, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (p[mid][0] <= v) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    return l;
}

void dfs(LL left, int pos) {
    if (cnt >= K) return;
    if (pos < 1) {
        cnt++;
        return;
    }
    dfs(left, pos - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < p[pos].x; i++) {
        if (left < p[pos][i]) break;
        LL v = left - p[pos][i];
        int to = min(pos - 1, find(v));
        dfs(v, to);
    }
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    cnt = 0;
    dfs(mid, n);
    return cnt >= K;
}

void generate(LL left, int pos) {
    if (pos < 1) {
        ans -= left + 1;
        return;
    }
    generate(left, pos - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < p[pos].x; i++) {
        if (left < p[pos][i]) break;
        LL v = left - p[pos][i];
        int to = min(pos - 1, find(v));
        generate(v, to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        for (int j = 0; j < p[i].x; j++) read(p[i][j]);
        if (p[i].x == 1) ans += p[i][0], i--, n--;
        else {
            sort(p[i].v, p[i].v + p[i].x);
            ans += p[i][0];
            int base = p[i][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < p[i].x; j++) p[i][j - 1] = p[i][j] - base;
            p[i].x--;
            p[i][p[i].x] = 0;
            mx += p[i][p[i].x - 1];
        }
    }
    ans *= K;
    sort(p + 1, p + n + 1);
    LL l = 0, r = mx, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    ans += l * K;
    if (l > 0) generate(l - 1, n);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4750.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319
#define MOD 1000000061
int n;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], sum[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top;

int l[MAXN], r[MAXN];

inline LL calc() {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL ls = i - l[i] + 1, rs = r[i] - i + 1;
        LL ml = sum[i - 1] - (l[i] > 1 ? sum[l[i] - 2] : 0), mr = sum[r[i]] - sum[i - 1];
        ret = (ret + (ml * (rs - mr) % MOD + mr * (ls - ml) % MOD) * a[i] % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), b[i] = b[i - 1] ^ a[i];
    top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (top && a[sta[top]] < a[i]) r[sta[top--]] = i - 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) r[sta[top--]] = n;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (top && a[sta[top]] <= a[i]) l[sta[top--]] = i + 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) l[sta[top--]] = 1;
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 31; k++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + ((b[i] >> k) & 1);
        ans = (ans + calc() * ((1 << k) % MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4759.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <cstring>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define s 131072
int n;
int h[MAXN], tem[MAXN], nt = 0;
int t[s << 1], L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x]++;
}
int query(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l & 1) ret += t[l ^ 1];
        if (r & 1) ret += t[r ^ 1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(h[i]), tem[i] = h[i];
    sort(tem + 1, tem + n + 1);
    nt = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + n + 1) - tem - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) h[i] = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + n + 1, h[i]) - tem);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        L[i] = query(h[i] + 1, s - 1);
        update(h[i]);
    }
    memset(t, 0, sizeof t);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        R[i] = query(h[i] + 1, s - 1);
        update(h[i]);
        if (max(R[i],L[i]) > 2 * min(L[i],R[i])) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'H' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'P' :
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'S' :
        a = 0;
        break;
    }
    _c = getchar();
}
#define MAXN 100319

int dp[MAXN][21][3];

int n, K;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, now; i <= n; i++) {
        readop(now);
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j][k] + (k == now));
                if (j && k != now) dp[i][j][now] = max(dp[i][j][now], dp[i - 1][j - 1][k] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
        ans = max(max(dp[n][i][0], dp[n][i][1]), max(dp[n][i][2], ans));
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4765.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define SQN 319
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int n, m, sqn, a[MAXN], fa[MAXN], rt, L[MAXN], R[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tot;
int d[MAXN][SQN], tmp[MAXN], ll[SQN], rr[SQN];
LL c[MAXN], sum[SQN], f[SQN], pref[SQN][SQN], fun, bsum[SQN];

void dfs(int x) {
    L[x] = ++tot;
    rev[tot] = x;
    c[x] = a[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            c[x] += c[e[now].to];
        }
    }
    sum[x / sqn] += c[x];
    R[x] = tot;
}

#define query(l, r) { \
	Bl = l / sqn, Br = r / sqn; \
	if (Bl < Br) { \
		ans += f[Bl] - pref[Bl][l - ll[Bl]] \
			+ pref[Br][r - ll[Br] + 1] \
			+ bsum[Br - 1] - bsum[Bl]; \
	} \
	else ans += pref[Bl][r - ll[Bl] + 1] - pref[Bl][l - ll[Bl]]; \
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n) + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        if (u == 0) rt = v;
        else {
            e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
                head[u], v
            };
            head[u] = ecnt;
            e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
                head[v], u
            };
            head[v] = ecnt;
        }
    }
    dfs(rt);
    for (register int b = 0, i; b < sqn; b++) {
        /* Block on numbers */
        ll[b] = max(1, sqn * b), rr[b] = min(n, sqn * (b + 1) - 1);
        if (ll[b] > rr[b]) break;
        tmp[rt] = 0;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) tmp[rev[i]] = tmp[fa[rev[i]]] + (rev[i] >= ll[b] && rev[i] <= rr[b]);
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) d[i][b] = tmp[i];
        /* Block on DFS-id */
        for (i = ll[b]; i <= rr[b]; i++) pref[b][i - ll[b] + 1] = pref[b][i - ll[b]] + a[rev[i]];
        f[b] = pref[b][rr[b] - ll[b] + 1];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) bsum[i] = bsum[i - 1] + f[i];
    for (int q = 1, op, l, r; q <= m; q++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (op == 1) {
            int delta = r - a[l], b = L[l] / sqn;
            for (register int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) sum[i] += (LL)d[l][i] * delta;
            f[b] += delta;
            a[l] += delta;
            for (register int i = ll[b]; i <= rr[b]; i++) pref[b][i - ll[b] + 1] = pref[b][i - ll[b]] + a[rev[i]];
            for (register int i = 0; i < sqn; i++) bsum[i] = bsum[i - 1] + f[i];
        } else {
            register LL ans = 0;
            register int bl = l / sqn, br = r / sqn, Bl, Br;
            if (bl + 1 < br) {
                for (register int i = l; i <= rr[bl]; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
                for (register int i = bl + 1; i < br; i++) ans += sum[i];
                for (register int i = ll[br]; i <= r; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
            } else for (register int i = l; i <= r; i++) query(L[i], R[i]);
            printf("%llu\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4766.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef unsigned long long LL;
LL n, m, P;

LL mul(LL a, LL b) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 4) ret = (ret + a * (b & 15)) % P, a = (a << 4) % P;
    return ret;
}

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = mul(ret, x);
        x = mul(x, x);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(P);
    LL ans = mul(power(n, m - 1), power(m, n - 1));
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

}

    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

struct Cow {
    int x, y;
    bool operator < (Cow a) const {
        return y < a.y;
    }
} a[100005];

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].x);
        read(a[i].y);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int i = 1, j = n, ans = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (!a[i].x) i++;
        else if (!a[j].x) j--;
        else {
            int d = min(a[i].x, a[j].x);
            a[i].x -= d, a[j].x -= d;
            ans = max(ans, a[i].y + a[j].y);
        }
    }
    if (a[i].x) ans = max(ans, a[i].y * 2);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 44

int n, lim;
LL m;
LL a[MAXN], tot = 0;
LL tmp[1 << 21], tmp2[1 << 21], *r = tmp;
int t1, t2, *cnt = &t1;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x > lim) {
        r[++(*cnt)] = tot;
        return;
    }
    if (tot + a[x] <= m) {
        tot += a[x];
        dfs(x + 1);
        tot -= a[x];
    }
    dfs(x + 1);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    if (n <= 20) {
        lim = n;
        dfs(1);
        printf("%d\n", t1);
    } else {
        lim = 20;
        dfs(1);
        lim = n;
        r = tmp2;
        cnt = &t2;
        dfs(21);
        LL ans = 0;
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + t1 + 1);
        sort(tmp2 + 1, tmp2 + t2 + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = t2; i <= t1; i++) {
            while (j && tmp[i] + tmp2[j] > m) j--;
            if (!j) break;
            ans += j;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4802.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

ULL A = 1e16, B = 1;

inline ULL Rand() {
    A ^= A >> 12;
    A ^= A << 25;
    A ^= A >> 27;
    return A ^= B += 2000031920000319ll;
}

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    return b ? gcd(b, a % b) : a;
}
LL mul(LL a, LL b, LL MOD) {
    LD x = (LD(a) * LD(b) + 1e-3) / MOD;
    return a * b - LL(x) * MOD;
}
LL power(LL a, LL b, LL MOD) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = mul(ret, a, MOD);
        a = mul(a, a, MOD);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(LL a, LL n) {
    LL m = n - 1, x, y;
    int i, j = 0;
    while (~m & 1) m >>= 1, ++j;
    x = power(a, m, n);
    for (i = 1; i <= j; x = y, i++) {
        y = mul(x, x, n);
        if (y == 1 && x != 1 && x != n - 1) break;
    }
    return y != 1;
}

bool MR(LL n, int t = 4) {
    if (n <= 2) return n - 1;
    if (~n & 1) return 0;
    while (t--) if (check(Rand() % (n - 1) + 1, n)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

LL PR(LL n, int c) {
    LL i = 1, k = 2, x = Rand() % n, y = x, d;
    for ( ; ; ) {
        i++, x = (mul(x, x, n) + c) % n, d = gcd(y - x, n);
        if (d > 1 && d < n) return d;
        if (y == x) return n;
        if (i == k) y = x, k <<= 1;
    }
}

LL d[233];
int cnt = 0;

void findfac(LL n, int c) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    if (MR(n)) {
        d[++cnt] = n;
        return;
    }
    LL m = n;
    while (m == n) m = PR(n, c--);
    findfac(m, c), findfac(n / m, c);
}

LL n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    findfac(n, 2333);
    sort(d + 1, d + cnt + 1);
    LL phi = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (d[i] == d[i - 1]) phi *= d[i];
        else phi *= d[i] - 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", phi);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4804.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') a = a * 10 + ch - '0', ch = getchar();
}

#define N 10000005

int p[N / 7], phi[N], pcnt = 0;
LL sum[N];
bool vis[N];

inline void init() {
    phi[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, phi[i] = i - 1;
        for (j = 1; (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (register int i = 1; i < N; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + phi[i];
}

inline LL work(int n) {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j + 1) {
        j = n / (n / i);
        ans += (sum[j] - sum[i - 1]) * (sum[n / i] * 2 - 1);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("calc.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("calc.out", "w", stdout);
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        int n;
        read(n);
        printf("%lld\n", work(n));
    }
}

//BZOJ4810.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define N 100000
#define MAXN N + 1
bitset<MAXN> A, B;
int n, m, sqn;
int a[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], blo[MAXN];
struct Query {
    int opt, l, r, x, i;
    bool operator < (const Query &b) const {
        if (blo[l] != blo[b.l]) return l < b.l;
        else return r < b.r;
    }
} q[MAXN];

bool ans[MAXN];

inline void inc(int x) {
    if (!(cnt[x]++)) A[x] = 1, B[N - x] = 1;
}
inline void dec(int x) {
    if (!(--cnt[x])) A[x] = 0, B[N - x] = 0;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn = int(sqrt(n) * 1.6) + 2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), blo[i] = i / sqn;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(q[i].opt), read(q[i].l), read(q[i].r), read(q[i].x), q[i].i = i;
    sort(q + 1, q + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l = 1, r = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        while (r < q[i].r) inc(a[++r]);
        while (r > q[i].r) dec(a[r--]);
        while (l > q[i].l) inc(a[--l]);
        while (l < q[i].l) dec(a[l++]);
        if (q[i].opt == 1) ans[q[i].i] = (A & (A >> q[i].x)).any();
        else if (q[i].opt == 2) ans[q[i].i] = (A & (B >> (N - q[i].x))).any();
        else {
            int x = q[i].x, sqx = (int)sqrt(x);
            for (int j = 1; j <= sqx; j++) {
                if (x % j == 0 && cnt[j] && cnt[x / j]) {
                    ans[q[i].i] = 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) puts(ans[i] ? "yuno" : "yumi");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4813.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 105

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, K, head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, maxdep = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x, int fa, int dep) {
    maxdep = max(maxdep, dep);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa) dfs(e[now].to, x, dep + 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(0, 0, 0);
    printf("%d\n", 1 + min(K, maxdep) + min(n - maxdep - 1, max(0, (K - maxdep)  / 2)));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4816.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 1000005
typedef long long LL;

int F[MAXN], g[MAXN], mu[MAXN], pi[MAXN], inv[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt;

LL power(LL x, LL y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( x %= MOD; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void init() {
    register int i, j, k;
    F[0] = 0, F[1] = 1, inv[1] = 1;
    for (i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) F[i] = (F[i - 1] + F[i - 2]) % MOD, inv[i] = (int)power(F[i], MOD - 2);
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) g[i] = 1;
    for (i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        for (j = 1, k = i; k < MAXN; j++, k += i) {
            if (mu[j]) {
                if (~mu[j]) g[k] = int(g[k] * LL(F[i]) % MOD);
                else g[k] = int(g[k] * LL(inv[i]) % MOD);
            }
        }
    }
    pi[0] = 1;
    for (i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) pi[i] = int(pi[i - 1] * LL(g[i]) % MOD);
    inv[MAXN - 1] = int(power(pi[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2));
    for (i = MAXN - 2; ~i; i--) inv[i] = int(inv[i + 1] * LL(g[i + 1]) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    int n, m;
    LL ans;
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        if (n > m) swap(n, m);
        ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j + 1) {
            j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
            ans = ans * power(LL(pi[j]) * inv[i - 1], LL(n / i) * (m / i)) % MOD;
        }
        printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4817.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch <  '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();
}
#define MAXN 100319
inline int min(int l, int r) {
    return l < r ? l : r;
}
inline int max(int l, int r) {
    return l > r ? l : r;
}
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int f[MAXN], dep[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], top[MAXN], son[MAXN], siz[MAXN], rev[MAXN], dfn;

struct Tnode {
    int l, r, ma, lazy;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

#define pushup() t[x].ma = max(t[t[x].l].ma, t[t[x].r].ma);

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup();
    } else t[x].ma = dep[rev[l]];
    return x;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
    t[t[x].l].ma += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].ma += t[x].lazy;
    t[x].lazy = 0;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].ma += v;
        t[x].lazy += v;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup();
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].ma;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    if (qr <= mid) return Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return max(Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid), Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr));
}

int n, m;
int T[MAXN];

void upd(int l, int r, int v) {
    //cerr << "upd " << l << " " << r << " " << v << endl;
    for (int x = l; x <= n; x += x & -x) T[x] += v;
    update(1, 1, n, l, r, v);
}

int Sum(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int x = r; x; x -= x & -x) ret += T[x];
    for (int x = l - 1; x; x -= x & -x) ret -= T[x];
//	cerr << "Sum" << l << " " << r << " = " << ret << endl;
    return ret;
}

int Query_path(int x, int y) {
    int ret = 1;
    while (top[x] != top[y]) {
        if (dep[top[x]] < dep[top[y]]) swap(x, y);
        ret += Sum(L[top[x]], L[x]);
        x = f[top[x]];
    }
    if (L[x] > L[y]) swap(x, y);
    if (x != y) ret += Sum(L[x] + 1, L[y]);
    return ret;
}

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa, *top;
    bool isrt;
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *cc, bool p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    void setf(Node *fat);
} mem[MAXN], *a[MAXN], Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void Node::setf(Node *fat) {
    fa = null;
    top = fat;
    isrt = 1;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    //cerr << "expose " << int(x - mem) << endl;
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        //cerr << "x = " << int(x - mem) << endl;
        splay(x);
        if (x->c[1] != null) {
            Node *z = x->c[1];
            while (z->c[0] != null) z = z->c[0];
            //cerr << int(x - mem) << "'s preferred " << int(z - mem) << endl;
            upd(L[z - mem], R[z - mem], 1);
        }
        if (y != null) {
            while (y->c[0] != null) y = y->c[0];
            splay(y);
            //cerr << "Link " << int(x - mem) << " " << int(y - mem) << endl;
            upd(L[y - mem], R[y - mem], -1);
        }
        x->c[1]->setf(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    //cerr << "x : " << x << endl;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != f[x]) {
            f[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            if (siz[e[now].to] > siz[son[x]]) son[x] = e[now].to;
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}

void hlink(int x, int anc) {
    L[x] = ++dfn;
    top[x] = anc;
    rev[dfn] = x;
    //cerr << L[x] << " -> " << x << endl;
    if (son[x]) {
        hlink(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != son[x] && e[now].to != f[x]) {
                hlink(e[now].to, e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    R[x] = dfn;
}

void init() {
    f[1] = 0;
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = mem + i;
        a[i]->c[0] = a[i]->c[1] = a[i]->top = a[i]->fa = null;
        a[i]->isrt = 1;
    }
    hlink(1, 1);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) a[i]->top = a[f[i]];
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j += j & -j) ++T[j];
    }
}

int main() {
//	freopen("./4817/data/paint/paint2.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    init();
//	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
//		cerr << "Max " << i << " " << Max(1, 1, n, i, i) << endl;
//	}
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        //	cerr << op << " " << x << " (" << i << ") " << endl;
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            expose(a[x]);
            break;
        case 2 :
            read(y);
            printf("%d\n", Query_path(x, y));
            break;
        case 3 :
            printf("%d\n", Max(1, 1, n, L[x], R[x]));
        }
//		for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
//			cerr << "Max " << i << " " << Max(1, 1, n, i, i) << endl;
//		}
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4818.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 20000005
#define P 105
#define rint register int
#define MOD 20170408

int n, m, p;

bool vis[M];
int cnt[P], tot[P];

inline void init() {
    for (rint i = 2, j; i <= m; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            cnt[i % p]++;
            if (!(i >> 15)) for (j = i * i; j <= m; j += i) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        tot[i] = m / p + (i != 0 && i <= m % p);
    }
}

struct Mat {
    LL a[P][P];
    LL *operator [] (const int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
} tr, x, c;

LL ans = 0;

inline void mul(Mat &a, Mat &b) {
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++)
        for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++)
            c[i][j] = 0;
    for (rint i = 0, j, k; i < p; i++)
        for (k = 0; k < p; k++)
            for (j = 0; j < p; j++)
                c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j];
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++)
        for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++)
            a[i][j] = c[i][j] % MOD;
}

inline void power(int t) {
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++)
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++)
            x[i][j] = i == j;
    for ( ; t; t >>= 1) {
        if (t & 1) mul(x, tr);
        mul(tr, tr);
    }
    tr = x;
}

inline void work() {
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            tr[i][(i + j) % p] = tot[j];
        }
    }
    power(n);
    ans += x[0][0];
    for (rint i = 0, j; i < p; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            tr[i][(i + j) % p] = tot[j] - cnt[j];
        }
    }
    power(n);
    ans -= x[0][0];
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <ctime>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 20000005
#define P 105
#define rint register int
#define MOD 20170408

int n, m, p;

bool vis[M];
int cnt[P], tot[P];

inline void init() {
    for (rint i = 2, j; i <= m; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            cnt[i % p]++;
            if (!(i >> 15)) for (j = i * i; j <= m; j += i) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        tot[i] = m / p + (i != 0 && i <= m % p);
    }
}

struct Mat {
    LL a[P];
    LL &operator [] (const int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
} tr, x, c;

LL ans = 0;

inline void mul(Mat &a, Mat &b) {
    for (rint i = 0; i < p; i++) c[i] = 0;
    for (rint j = 0, k; j < p; j++)
        for (k = 0; k < p; k++)
            c[j] += a[k] * b[(j - k + p) % p];
    for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++) a[j] = c[j] % MOD;
}

inline void power(int t) {
    for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++) x[j] = !j;
    for ( ; t; t >>= 1) {
        if (t & 1) mul(x, tr);
        mul(tr, tr);
    }
    tr = x;
}

inline void work() {
    for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++) tr[j] = tot[j];
    power(n);
    ans += x[0];
    for (rint j = 0; j < p; j++) tr[j] = tot[j] - cnt[j];
    power(n);
    ans -= x[0];
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4819.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef double D;

#define eps 5e-8
#define MAXN 233
#define A(i) (i + 1)
#define B(i) (i + n + 1)
struct edge {
    int next, to, a, b;
    bool f;
    D w;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * 4];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, ecnt = 1, head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u, int v, int a, int b) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, a, b, true, 1e0
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -a, -b, false, 1e0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int a[MAXN][MAXN], b[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void build() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            read(b[i][j]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, A(i), 0, 0);
        add(B(i), T, 0, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            add(A(i), B(j), a[i][j], b[i][j]);
        }
}

D mid, dis[MAXN];
int q[256], pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

inline bool spfa() {
    for (int i = B(n); i >= 0; i--) dis[i] = -1e9;
    dis[S] = 0;
    pre[T] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 0, x, now;
    q[ta++ & 255] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++ & 255];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[ta++ & 255] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return !!pre[T];
}

inline D check() {
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i += 2) {
        e[i].f = 1;
        e[i ^ 1].f = 0;
        e[i].w = e[i].a - e[i].b * mid;
        e[i ^ 1].w = -e[i].w;
    }
    D retA = 0, retB = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) {
            retA += e[pos[x]].a, retB += e[pos[x]].b;
            e[pos[x]].f = 0, e[pos[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
        }
    }
    return (D)retA / retB;
}

int main() {
    build();
    D l = -1, r = 0;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = l = r;
        r = check();
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", r);
    return 0;
}

D mid, dis[MAXN];

inline bool spfa() {

inline D check() {

        e[i].f = 1;
        e[i ^ 1].f = 0;
        e[i].w = e[i].a - e[i].b * mid;
        e[i ^ 1].w = -e[i].w;
    }
    int retA = 0, retB = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) {
            retA += e[pos[x]].a, retB += e[pos[x]].b;
            e[pos[x]].f = 0, e[pos[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
        }
    }
    return (D)retA / retB;
}

int main() {
    build();
    D l = -1, r = 0;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = l = r;
        r = check();
    }
    printf("%.6lf\n", r);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4821.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define NO (-1048576)

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    D a, b, aa, ab;
    D S, T;
    D CS, CT;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

int n, m;
int X[MAXN], Y[MAXN];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].a = t[t[x].l].a + t[t[x].r].a;
    t[x].b = t[t[x].l].b + t[t[x].r].b;
    t[x].aa = t[t[x].l].aa + t[t[x].r].aa;
    t[x].ab = t[t[x].l].ab + t[t[x].r].ab;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].a = X[l], t[x].b = Y[l], t[x].aa = (D)X[l] * X[l], t[x].ab = (D)X[l] * Y[l];
    t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    t[x].CS = t[x].CT = NO;
    return x;
}

void update(int x, D S, D T, int l, int r) {
    t[x].ab += t[x].b * S + t[x].a * T +  S * T * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].aa += (2 * t[x].a + S * (r - l + 1)) * S;
    t[x].a += S * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].b += T * (r - l + 1);
    t[x].S += S, t[x].T += T;
}

void fill(int x, D S, D T, int l, int r) {
    t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    t[x].CS = S, t[x].CT = T;
    t[x].a = (S + l + S + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    t[x].b = (T + l + T + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    t[x].aa = S * S * (r - l + 1)
              + S * (l + r) * (r - l + 1)
              + (r * D(r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) - D(l - 1) * l * (2 * l - 1)) / 6;
    t[x].ab = S * T * (r - l + 1)
              + (S + T) * (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2
              + (r * D(r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) - D(l - 1) * l * (2 * l - 1)) / 6;
}

void pushdown(int x, int l, int mid, int r) {
    if (t[x].CS != NO) {
        fill(t[x].l, t[x].CS, t[x].CT, l, mid);
        fill(t[x].r, t[x].CS, t[x].CT, mid + 1, r);
        t[x].CS = NO;
    }
    if (t[x].S != 0 || t[x].T != 0) {
        update(t[x].l, t[x].S, t[x].T, l, mid);
        update(t[x].r, t[x].S, t[x].T, mid + 1, r);
        t[x].S = t[x].T = 0;
    }
}

D S, T;

void upd(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        update(x, S, T, l, r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (ql <= mid) upd(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) upd(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

void fil(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        fill(x, S, T, l, r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (ql <= mid) fil(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) fil(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

struct Ret {
    D a, b, aa, ab;
    Ret () : a(0), b(0), aa(0), ab(0) {}
    Ret (const Node &x) : a(x.a), b(x.b), aa(x.aa), ab(x.ab) {}
    Ret (D x, D y, D xx, D yy) : a(x), b(y), aa(xx), ab(yy) {}
    Ret operator + (Ret x) const {
        return Ret(a + x.a, b + x.b, aa + x.aa, ab + x.ab);
    }
};

Ret query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x]);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, l, mid, r);
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(X[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(Y[i]);
    build(1, n);
    int op;
    Ret ret;
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            ret = query(1, 1, n, l, r);
            printf("%.10lf\n", double((ret.ab - ret.a / (r - l + 1) * ret.b) / (ret.aa - ret.a / (r - l + 1) * ret.a)));
            break;
        case 2:
            read(S);
            read(T);
            upd(1, 1, n, l, r);
            break;
        case 3:
            read(S);
            read(T);
            fil(1, 1, n, l, r);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 33
#define down -2147483648
#define up 2147483647
struct Point {
    int x, y, p;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(p);
    }
    inline bool operator < (const Point &a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int b[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN * LOG];

int tcnt = 0, rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v += v;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = int(((LL)l + r) >> 1);
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
    return x;
}

LL query(int rx, int lx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = int(((LL)l + r) >> 1);
    if (qr <= mid) return query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, qr);
    else if (ql > mid) return query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
    else return query(t[rx].l, t[lx].l, l, mid, ql, mid) + query(t[rx].r, t[lx].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i].re();
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], down, up, a[i].y, a[i].p);
    b[0] = down;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) b[i] = a[i].x;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x1, x2, y1, y2;
        read(x1);
        read(y1);
        read(x2);
        read(y2);
        int l = int(lower_bound(b, b + n + 1, x1) - b - 1), r = int(upper_bound(b + 1, b + n + 1, x2) - b - 1);
        if (l == r) puts("0");
        else printf("%lld\n", query(rt[r], rt[l], down, up, y1, y2));
    }

    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 262144

struct cp {
    double r, i;
    cp () {}
    cp (double a, double b) : r(a), i(b) {}
    cp operator + (const cp a) {
        return cp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    cp operator - (const cp a) {
        return cp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    cp operator * (const cp a) {
        return cp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
} A[MAXN], B[MAXN];

int N, m, n;
int R[MAXN];

void getr() {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void fft(cp a[], int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        cp stp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            cp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * stp) {
                cp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int a[MAXN / 4], b[MAXN / 4], c[MAXN];
int bb, sb;
LL ans = 0x3f3f3f3f3f;

int main() {
    read(N);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) read(b[i]), sb += b[i], bb += b[i] * b[i];
    for (n = 1; n < N; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 2;
    getr();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) A[i] = cp(a[i], 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) B[i] = B[i + N] = cp(b[N - 1 - i], 0);

    fft(A, 1);
    fft(B, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A[i] * B[i];
    fft(A, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c[i] = int(A[i].r + 0.5);

    for (int d = -m; d <= m; d++) {
        LL sum = bb;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) sum += (a[i] + d) * (a[i] + d);
        for (int i = N; i < N + N; i++) {
            ans = min(ans, sum - 2 * ((LL)c[i] + d * sb));
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;

typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline LL min(LL a, LL b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL max(LL a, LL b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAX 1000319
#define Inf 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
int T;
int n, a[MAXN];
LL t1[2][MAX], t2[2][MAX], (*pre)[MAX], (*now)[MAX];

LL solve(LL (opt)(LL, LL)) {
    pre = t1, now = t2;
    LL INF = -opt(Inf, -Inf);
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[1]; i++) pre[0][i] = INF, pre[1][i] = INF;
    pre[0][a[1]] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= a[i]; j++) now[0][j] = now[1][j] = INF;
        for (int j = min(a[i], a[i - 1]); ~j; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF || pre[1][j] != INF) now[0][a[i] - j] = opt(pre[0][j], pre[1][j]) + j;
        }
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; j >= a[i]; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF) now[1][0] = opt(now[1][0], pre[0][j] + a[i]);
        }
        LL tmp = INF;
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; ~j; j--) {
            tmp = opt(tmp, pre[0][j]);
            if (j <= a[i] && tmp != INF) {
                now[1][a[i] - j] = opt(now[1][a[i] - j], tmp + j);
            }
        }
        swap(now, pre);
    }
    LL ans = pre[1][0];
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[n]; i++) ans = opt(ans, pre[0][i]);
    return ans;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    printf("%lld %lld\n", solve(min), solve(max));
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

bool vis[55][10][10][10];
D f[55][10][10][10];

D dp(int k, int a, int b, int c) {
    if (!k) return 0;
    if (vis[k][a][b][c]) return f[k][a][b][c];
    vis[k][a][b][c] = 1;
    int tot = a + b + c + 1;
    D &ret = f[k][a][b][c];
    ret = 0;
    if (a) {
        ret += dp(k - 1, a - 1, b, c) * (a / D(tot));
    }
    if (b) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c + 1) * (b / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c) * (b / D(tot));
    }
    if (c) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c) * (c / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c - 1) * (c / D(tot));
    }
    ret += (dp(k - 1, a, b, c) + 1) / D(tot);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    int K, A, B, C, T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(K);
        read(A);
        read(B);
        read(C);
        printf("%.2lf\n", (double)dp(K, A, B, C) + 1e-10);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4842.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1015
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, K, S, T, t1, t2;
int a[MAXN], pre[MAXN];
LL ans, dis[MAXN];

#define TOP 2047

int q[TOP + 1];
bool inq[MAXN];

void SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * (n + 2));
    dis[S] = 0;
    pre[T] = -1;
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    q[1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(++ta) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    while (t1) {
        SPFA();
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) flow = min(e[pre[x]].f, flow);
        t1 -= (flow = min(flow, t1));
        ans -= flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f -= flow, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f += flow;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(t1);
    read(t2);
    t1 = K - t1;
    S = 0, T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] -= x, ans += x;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] += x;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, i + 1, t1 - t2, 0);
    int st = ecnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, min(i + K, T), 1, -a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) add(S, i, INF, 0);
    solve();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st += 2;
        if (e[st].f) putchar('E');
        else putchar('S');
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 100319

LL A, B, C;
LL n, m;
LL t[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL st[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(t[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    sort(t + 1, t + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i] = st[i - 1] + t[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sb[i] = sb[i - 1] + b[i];
    A = min(A, B);
    LL ans = 0x7fffffffffffffff;
    for (LL T = b[m], i = n, j = m; T >= min(b[1], t[1]); T--) {
        while (i && t[i] >= T) i--;
        while (j && b[j] >= T) j--;
        LL can = T * j - sb[j], mov = sb[m] - sb[j] - T * (m - j);
        if (min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + D(T * i - st[i]) * C < ans) {
            ans = min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + (T * i - st[i]) * C;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4869.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

int n, m, c, tot;

int a[MAXN], stp[MAXN];

int P[55], po[55][32769], pO[55][32000];

struct Node {
    int l, r, sum;
    bool lp;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
        t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
    } else {
        t[x].sum = a[l] % P[0];
        t[x].lp = 0;
    }
    return x;
}

inline int phi(int x) {
    int ret = x;
    for (int i = 2, j = (int)sqrt(x); i <= j; i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) {
            ret = ret / i * (i - 1);
            while (!(x % i)) x /= i;
            j = (int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    return x > 1 ? ret / x * (x - 1) : ret;
}

int calc(int x, int p) {
    if (x >= P[p]) x = x % P[p] + P[p];
    while (p--) {
        x = int(LL(po[p][x & 32767]) * pO[p][x >> 15] % P[p]);
        if (p && !x) x += P[p];
    }
    return x % P[0];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret % P[0];
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (t[x].lp) return;
    if (l == r) {
        stp[l]++;
        t[x].lp = stp[l] >= tot;
        t[x].sum = calc(a[l], stp[l]);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
    t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
}

int main() {
    int p;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    read(c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    P[0] = p;
    while (p != 1) {
        p = phi(p);
        P[++tot] = p;
    }
    P[++tot] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
        po[i][0] = pO[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= 32768; j++) po[i][j] = int(LL(po[i][j - 1]) * c % P[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j < 32000; j++) pO[i][j] = int(LL(pO[i][j - 1]) * po[i][32768] % P[i]);
    }
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x) printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
