#define N 51

struct Mat {
    LL a[N][N];
    LL *operator[] (const int x) const {
        return (LL*)a[x];
    }
};

LL n, P;
int K, R;

void mul(Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    static Mat c;
    memset(c.a, 0, sizeof c.a);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++)
                (c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j]) %= P;
    a = c;
}

Mat tr, a;

void work() {
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) tr[i][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) a[i][i]++, a[i][i + 1 == K ? 0 : i + 1]++;
    for (n *= K; n; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) mul(tr, a);
        mul(a, a);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(P);
    read(K);
    read(R);
    work();
    printf("%d\n", int(tr[0][R] % P));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4878.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int rt[MAXN], col[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 64];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int p) {
    if (!x) t[x = ++tcnt].v = 0, t[x].l = t[x].r = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else t[x].v = 1;
}

int query(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!x) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].l && t[t[x].l].v == mid - l + 1) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    else return query(t[x].l, l, mid);
}

int T, n, m, K;

bool dfs(int x) {
    col[x] = query(rt[x], 1, K + 1);
    if (col[x] > K) return 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        update(rt[e[now].to], 1, K + 1, col[x]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!col[e[now].to]) if (dfs(e[now].to)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    tcnt = 0;
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    memset(rt + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    memset(col + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!col[i]) {
            if (dfs(i)) {
                int x;
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (col[j] == K + 1) {
                        x = j;
                        break;
                    }
                printf("path %d", x);
                for (int cnt = K; cnt; cnt--) {
                    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                        if (col[e[now].to] == cnt) {
                            x = e[now].to;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    printf(" %d", x);
                }
                printf("\n");
                return;
            }
        }
    printf("color");
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf(" %d", col[i]);
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i]++;
    dp[1][0] = 0;
    dp[1][1] = b[1] - a[1] + 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {

            puts("-1");

        dp[i][0] = dp[i][1] = INF;

#define sec second

#define MOD 2017

struct Mat {
    int a[N][N];
    inline int *operator [] (const int x) const {
        return (int*)a[x];
    }
} tmp;

int n, m, T;

inline void mul(Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    memset(tmp.a, 0, sizeof tmp.a);
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++)
        for (k = 0; k <= n; k++)
            for (j = 0; j <= n; j++)
                tmp[i][j] = (tmp[i][j] + a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % MOD;
    a = tmp;
}

Mat a, b, c;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    b[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        b[i][i]++;
        b[i][0]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        b[u][v]++, b[v][u]++;
    }
    scanf("%d", &T);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
    for ( ; T; T >>= 1) {
        if (T & 1) mul(a, b);
        mul(b, b);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += a[1][i];
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans % MOD);
}

    int l, r, v;

int rt[LOG], rb[LOG], tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v ^ t[t[x].r].v;
    } else t[x].v = l == 0;
    return x;
}
int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    int ret2 = 0;
    while (l != ql || r != qr) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (qr <= mid) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else if (ql > mid) x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        else {
            ret2 ^= query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
            r = qr = mid;
            x = t[x].l;
        }
    }
    return t[x].v ^ ret2;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p) {
    while (1) {
        t[x].v ^= 1;
        if (l == r) break;
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
}

int n, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN];

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), a[i] += a[i - 1];
    for (int j = 0; j < LOG; j++) {
        rb[j] = 1 << (j + 1);
        rt[j] = build(0, rb[j]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < LOG; j++) {
            int x = (a[i] + 1) % rb[j];
            if (x <= (1 << j)) ans ^= query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], x, x + (1 << j) - 1) << j;
            else ans ^= (query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], x, rb[j]) ^ query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], 0, x - (1 << j) - 1)) << j;
            update(rt[j], 0, rb[j], a[i] % rb[j]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

#include <iostream>

#define sec second

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define LOG 18

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int rk[], int h[], int n, int m = 5) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    t1[n + 1] = t2[n + 1] = 0;
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : (s[i] == 'T' ? 2 : (s[i] == 'G' ? 3 : (s[i] == 'C' ? 4 : 5))), y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), x[sa[1]] = k = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

char a[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int st[LOG][MAXN], Log[MAXN];

#define rmq(l, r) min(st[Log[r - l]][l + 1], st[Log[r - l]][r - (1 << Log[r - l]) + 1])

inline int lcp(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) return rmq(y, x);
    else return rmq(x, y);
}

void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    register int i, j, k, x;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[0][i] = h[i];
    for (k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[k][i] = min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", a + 1);
    int n = (int)strlen(a + 1);
    a[n + 1] = '$';
    scanf("%s", a + n + 2);
    int m = (int)strlen(a + n + 2);
    getsa(a, sa, rk, h, n + m + 1);
    getst(n + m + 1);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j, k, rep, LCP; i <= n - m + 1; i++) {
        for (j = n + 2, k = i, rep = 0; rep <= 3 && j <= n + m + 1; ) {
            LCP = lcp(rk[j], rk[k]);
            j += LCP, k += LCP;
            if (j <= n + m + 1) j++, k++, rep++;
        }
        if (rep <= 3) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int T;
int main() {
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
}

    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'a';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
        if ((cnt[x] += d) > (int)a[x].size()) a[x].push_back(Tim);
    }

int query(int lim) {
    int x = 0;
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'a';
        x = t[x][to];
        if (lim >= (int)a[x].size()) return -1;
    }
    return a[x][lim];
}

            printf("%d\n", ans = query(int(((long long) A * abs(ans) + B) % C)));
        }

}

#define MAXN 20000319

bool p[MAXN];

void input() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &K, &seed, &S);
    int t = 0;
    n = K * 2 + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = (getrand() / 128) & 1;
        t += p[i];
    }
    int i = 1;
    while (t > K) {
        while (p[i] == 0) i++;
        p[i] = 0;
        t--;
    }
    while (t < K) {
        while (p[i] == 1) i++;
        p[i] = 1;
        t++;
    }

inline int solve1(register int x) {
    register int ret = 0, i, cnt, Max = x;
    f[x] = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, cnt = 0; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1) {
        if (p[i]) {
            ret += (++cnt > 0);
            if (cnt >= f[Max]) Max = i;
        } else --cnt;
        f[i] = cnt;
    }
    if (ret == 0) return x;
    while (p[Max]) Max = Max == n ? 1 : Max + 1;
    return Max;
}

struct myPii {
    int fir, sec;
    inline bool operator < (const myPii &a) const {
        return fir < a.fir || (fir == a.fir && sec < a.sec);
    }

inline int solve2(register int x) {
    register int i, j, cc = 0;
    tt[0].fir = f[x];
    tt[0].sec = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, j = 1; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1, j++) if (!p[i]) {
            tt[++cc].fir = f[i];
            tt[cc].sec = j;
        }
//	sort(tt, tt + cc + 1);
    nth_element(tt, tt + K - S, tt + K + 1);
    int P = x + tt[K - S].sec;
    return P > n ? P - n : P;
}

inline int solve3(register int x) {
    register int i, j, cc = 0;
    tt[0].fir = f[x];
    tt[0].sec = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, j = 1; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1, j++) if (!p[i]) {
            tt[++cc].fir = f[i];
            tt[cc].sec = j;
        }
    nth_element(tt, tt + S, tt + K + 1);
    int P = x + tt[S].sec;
    return P > n ? P - n : P;
}

        }

inline int max(int a, int b) {

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define MAXN 100319

struct Mat {
    LL dp[4][4];
    Mat () {}
    Mat (int a, int b, int c) {
        memset(dp, 0, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0] = a;
        dp[1][1] = b;
        dp[2][2] = c;
        dp[3][3] = a;
        register int i, j, k, l;
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            for (j = i; j < 4; j++) {
                for (k = i; k <= j; k++) {
                    for (l = k; l <= j; l++) {
                        dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[k][l]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    LL *operator [] (const unsigned x) const {
        return (LL*)dp[x];
    }
    Mat operator + (const Mat &a) const {
        Mat ret;
        memset(ret.dp, 0, sizeof(ret.dp));
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = i; j < 4; j++)
                for (int k = j; k < 4; k++)
                    ret[i][k] = max(ret[i][k], dp[i][j] + a[j][k]);
        return ret;
    }
    Mat operator * (const int a) const {
        Mat ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = dp[i][j] * a;
            }
        return ret;
    }
};

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    Mat v, s;
    LL siz;
    int val;
    inline bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    inline void setc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        s = c[0]->s + (v * val) + c[1]->s;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + val;

        //	printf("%lld\n", s[0][3]);
    }
} mem[MAXN * 4], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

inline Node *newNode(Mat v = Mat(0, 0, 0), int x = 0) {
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->s = ptr->v * x;
    ptr->siz = ptr->val = x;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

inline void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void get(LL k) {
    Node *x = rt;
    for ( ; ; ) {
        if (x->c[0]->siz > k) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val < k) {
            k -= x->c[0]->siz + x->val;
            x = x->c[1];
        } else {
            if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val == k) {
                splay(x);
                Node *y = x->c[1];
                while (y->c[0] != null) y = y->c[0];
                splay(y, x);
            } else {
                k -= x->c[0]->siz;
                splay(x);
                Node *y = newNode(x->v, x->val - int(k));
                y->setc(x->c[1], 1);
                x->setc(y, 1);
                x->val = int(k);
                y->upd();
                x->upd();
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode();
    rt->setc(newNode(Mat(0, 0, 0), 1), 1);
    LL nowans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL p;
        int a, b, c, x;
        read(p);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(x);
        get(p);
        rt->c[1]->setc(newNode(Mat(a, b, c), x), 0);
        rt->c[1]->upd();
        rt->upd();
        printf("%lld\n", rt->s.dp[0][3] - nowans);
        nowans = rt->s.dp[0][3];
    }
    return 0;
}

struct Ha {
    int len, pre, nxt;
    bool operator < (const Ha &a) const {
        if (nxt - pre >= 0 && a.nxt - a.pre < 0) return 1;
        if (nxt - pre < 0 && a.nxt - a.pre >= 0) return 0;
        if (nxt - pre >= 0) return pre < a.pre;
        else return nxt > a.nxt;
    }
} a[305];

    memset(dp, -1, sizeof dp);

        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        a[i].len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= a[i].len; j++) {
            if (s[j] == ')') {
                if (a[i].nxt) a[i].nxt--;
                else a[i].pre++;
            } else a[i].nxt++;
        }
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int delta = a[i].nxt - a[i].pre;
        if (delta <= 0) {
            for (int j = a[i].pre; j <= tot; j++) if (~dp[j]) dp[j + delta] = max(dp[j + delta], dp[j] + a[i].len);
        } else {
            for (int j = tot; j >= a[i].pre; j--) if (~dp[j]) dp[j + delta] = max(dp[j + delta], dp[j] + a[i].len);
            tot += delta;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[0]);
    return 0;
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[8000005];
int n,m,ecnt=0,src,sink,nm;
int dis[2*MAXN*MAXN],head[2*MAXN*MAXN],t[s<<1];
int row[MAXN][MAXN],col[MAXN][MAXN],slp[MAXN][MAXN],tag[MAXN][MAXN][2];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];

}

void build2() {
    src=0,sink=1;
    int cnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            tag[i][j][0]=++cnt;
            tag[i][j][1]=++cnt;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[1][i][0],sink,row[1][i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][m-1][0],sink,col[i][m]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        add(tag[i][1][1],src,col[i][1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        add(tag[n-1][i][1],src,row[n][i]);
    }
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i-1][j][1],tag[i][j][0],row[i][j]);
        }
    for (int j=2; j<m; j++) {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            add(tag[i][j-1][0],tag[i][j][1],col[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            add(tag[i][j][0],tag[i][j][1],slp[i][j]);
        }
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    t[x+=s]=d;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)|1]);
}

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<t[(x<<1)|1])
            x<<=1;
        else
            x=(x<<1)|1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void dijkstra() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
    update(src,0);
    int x=src;
    while (t[x+s]<INF) {
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        update(x,INF);
        visit[x]=1;
        if (x==sink) return;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[s+v]) {
                update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
}

int main() {
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    initBufReader();
    readBuf();
#endif
    n=readInt();
    m=readInt();
    if(n==1 || m==1) {
        if(n>m) swap(n, m);
        int ans=INF;
        for(int i=1, a; i<m; i++) {
            a=readInt();
            if(ans>a) ans=a;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans==INF?0:ans);
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            row[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            col[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            slp[i][j]=readInt();
        }
    build2();
    dijkstra();
    printf("%d\n",dis[sink]);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXL 105
#define MAXN 105

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i+1]+=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i]%=10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} fib[MAXN],dp[MAXN];

int n;

    fib[1]=num(1);
    fib[2]=num(3);
    dp[1]=num(1);
    dp[2]=num(5);
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        fib[i]=fib[i-1]+fib[i-2];
        dp[i]=fib[i]*fib[i];
        if ((i&1)^1) dp[i]=dp[i]-4;
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105
#define MAXM 25

int n,m,K,E,D;
int minc[MAXN][MAXN],G[MAXM][MAXM],dis[MAXM];
bool fuck[MAXN][MAXM],ban[MAXM];
int ans[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
bool inq[MAXN];
int work(int ti) {
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (fuck[ti][i]) ban[i]=1;
    }
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
            if (!ban[i] && dis[i]>G[x][i]+dis[x]) {
                dis[i]=G[x][i]+dis[x];
                if (!inq[i]) {
                    inq[i]=1;
                    q.push(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[m];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&K,&E);
    memset(G,63,sizeof(G));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) G[i][i]=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=E; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        if (G[u][v]>w) G[u][v]=G[v][u]=w;
    }
    scanf("%d",&D);
    for (int i=1,P,a,b; i<=D; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&P,&a,&b);
        for (int j=a; j<=b; j++) {
            fuck[j][P]=1;
        }
    }
    ans[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        memset(ban,0,sizeof(ban));
        for (int j=i; j<=n; j++) {
            minc[i][j]=work(j);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        ans[i]=0x3f3f3f3f;
        for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
            if (minc[j+1][i]<0x3f3f3f3f) ans[i]=min(ans[i],ans[j]+minc[j+1][i]*(i-j)+K);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans[n]-K);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1006.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 2000005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct node {
    int next,x;
} p[MAXM+MAXN];
int pcnt=0,level[MAXN],seq[MAXN],label[MAXN];
int visit[MAXN];
inline void Push(int lev,int x) {
    p[++pcnt].x=x;
    p[pcnt].next=level[lev];
    level[lev]=pcnt;
}
inline void Pop(int lev) {
    level[lev]=p[level[lev]].next;
}

void MCS() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        label[i]=0;
        Push(0,i);
    }
    int top=0;
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        while (1) {
            while (level[top] && visit[p[level[top]].x]) Pop(top);
            if (level[top]) break;
            else top--;
        }
        int x=p[level[top]].x;
        Pop(top);
        seq[i]=x;
        visit[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                label[e[now].to]++;
                if (label[e[now].to]>top) top=label[e[now].to];
                Push(label[e[now].to],e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    MCS();
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    memset(level,0,sizeof(level));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        int x=seq[i];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            visit[level[e[now].to]]=x;
        }
        int col;
        for (col=1;; col++) if (visit[col]!=x) break;
        level[x]=col;
        ans=max(col,ans);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1007.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 50005
#define eps 1e-9

struct line {
    double k,b;
    int lab;
    line() {}
    line(double x,double y,int z):k(x),b(y),lab(z) {}
    bool operator < (line a) const {
        if (k!=a.k) return k<a.k;
        return b>a.b;
    }
} l[MAXN],sta[MAXN];

int n;
double x[MAXN];
bool ans[MAXN];
double crossx(line l1,line l2) {
    return (l2.b-l1.b)/(l1.k-l2.k);
}

inline void work() {
    int top=1;
    sta[1]=l[1],x[1]=-1e15;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (l[i].k==sta[top].k) continue;
        while (x[top]+eps>crossx(l[i],sta[top])) top--;
        sta[++top]=l[i];
        x[top]=crossx(sta[top],sta[top-1]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=top; i++) ans[sta[i].lab]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (ans[i]) printf("%d ",i);
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==1) {
        printf("1\n");
        return 0;
    }
    double u,v;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf",&u,&v);
        l[i]=line(u,v,i);
    }
    sort(l+1,l+n+1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1008.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
const LL MOD=100003;

LL pow(LL n, LL p) {
    LL ans=1;
    while(p) {
        if(p&1) ans=ans*n%MOD;
        n=n*n%MOD;
        p>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

void read(LL &x) {
    char c;
    while((c=getchar())<'0' || c>'9');
    x=c-'0';
    while((c=getchar())>='0' && c<='9') x=(x<<1)+(x<<3)+c-'0';
}

int main() {
    LL n, m;
    read(m), read(n);
    LL ans=pow(m, n);
    ans=(ans+MOD-m*pow(m-1, n-1)%MOD)%MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1009.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXM 25
// 0~9 0~M-1
int n,m,MOD;
char s[MAXM],ss[MAXM];
int now[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM],trans[MAXM][MAXM],ans[MAXM];

inline bool cmp(int a,int b,int c) {
    for (int i=a,j=c; i<=b; i++,j++) {
        if (s[i]!=ss[j]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

inline int getl(int len) {
    for (int ret=len; ret; ret--) {
        if (cmp(1,ret,len-ret+1)) return ret;
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void exp(int a[MAXM][MAXM],int b[MAXM][MAXM]) {
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++)
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
}

inline void quickpower(int x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            exp(now,trans);
        }
        exp(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%s",&n,&m,&MOD,s+1);
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        ss[i]=s[i];
        now[i][i]=1;
        for (int j=0; j<10; j++) {
            ss[i+1]=j+'0';
            int to=getl(i+1);
            if (to<m) trans[i][to]++;
        }
    }
    quickpower(n);
    ans[0]=1;
    int ret=0;
    for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
        for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
            ret=(ret+ans[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1010.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 50005

int n, L;

LL c[MAXN], s[MAXN], h[MAXN], f[MAXN];

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return (f[j] + LD(s[j] + L) * LD(s[j] + L) - f[k] - LD(s[k] + L) * LD(s[k] + L)) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * s[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], x) <= slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = x;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &L);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lld", c + i), s[i] = s[i - 1] + c[i] + 1;
    ++L;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + power(s[i] - s[j] - L);
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

LL c[MAXN], s[MAXN], h[MAXN], f[MAXN];

    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], x) <= slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;

//BZOJ1011.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 100005
int n;
double a,m[MAXN],sum[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lf",&n,&a);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int r=int(a*i+1e-8);
        double ans=0;
        scanf("%lf",m+i);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+m[i];
        if (i<=1000) {
            for (int j=1; j<=r; j++) {
                ans+=m[i]*m[j]/(i-j);
            }
        } else {
            ans=sum[r]*m[i]/(i-r*0.5);
        }
        printf("%.6lf\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1012.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

using namespace std;

/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
//#define USING_CPPIO
#ifdef USING_CPPIO
ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
cin.tie(0);
cout.tie(0);
#endif

/* Configuration */
#define s 262144

int m,d,n=0,last=0;
int t[s<<1];

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='A' && ch!='Q') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='A';
}

inline void update(int p,int x) {
    for (t[p+=s]=x,p>>=1; p; t[p]=max(t[p<<1],t[(p<<1)^1]),p>>=1);
}

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=-1;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans=max(ans,t[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ans=max(ans,t[r^1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(d);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            update(++n,(x+last)%d);
        } else {
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n",last=query(n-x+1,n));
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1013.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const double eps = 1e-8;
struct Equation {
    double v[15];
    double &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
} a[15];

int n;
double base[15];

bool gauss() {
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = n + 1;
        double v = 0;
        for (int j = now; j <= n; j++) if (abs(a[j][i]) > v) v = abs(a[j][i]), to = j;
        if (v < eps) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    while (now <= n) {
        if (abs(a[now][0]) > eps) return 0;
        else now++;
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", base + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        double x;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            scanf("%lf", &x);
            a[i][j] = 2 * (x - base[j]);
            a[i][0] += x * x - base[j] * base[j];
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        printf("%.3lf ", a[i][0]);
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n", a[n][0]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1014.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
const int C = /*2*/1;
const LL P[C] = {811/*, 911*/}, MOD[C] = {2123456767/*, 2147483647*/};
LL X[C][MAXN];
struct Ha {
    LL v[C];
    Ha (LL val = 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) v[i] = val % P[i];
    }
    Ha append(LL y) {
        Ha ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) ret.v[i] = (v[i] * P[i] + y) % MOD[i];
        return ret;
    }
    Ha merge(Ha &x, LL len) {
        Ha ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) ret.v[i] = (v[i] * X[i][len] + x.v[i]) % MOD[i];
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator == (Ha a) const {
        for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) if (v[i] != a.v[i]) return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("{%lld", v[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < C; i++) printf(", %lld", v[i]);
        printf("}\n");
    }
};

void init() {
    for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) X[j][0] = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) X[j][i] = X[j][i - 1] * P[j] % MOD[j];
}

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2];
    int siz;
    LL val;
    Ha ha;
    Node () : siz(0), val(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        ha = ((c[0]->ha).append(val)).merge(c[1]->ha, c[1]->siz);
    }
} mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

Node *newNode(LL v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->ha = Ha(v);
    return ptr++;
}

char s[MAXN];
int n, m;

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(s[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        int ls = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < ls) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > ls) k -= ls + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) { // [L, R)
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R;
}

void modify(int p, char c) {
    Node *x = get(p, p + 1);
    x->c[0]->val = c;
    x->c[0]->upd(), x->upd(), root->upd();
}

void insert(int x) {
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    n += len;
    Node *r = get(x + 1, x + 1);
    r->setc(build(1, len), 0), r->upd(), root->upd();
}

bool check(int l1, int r1, int l2, int r2) {
    Ha v1 = get(l1, r1)->c[0]->ha, v2 = get(l2, r2)->c[0]->ha;
    return v1 == v2;
}

void work(int x, int y) {
    int l = 0, r = n - max(x, y) + 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(x, x + mid, y, y + mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%s%d", s + 1, &m);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        switch(s[0]) {
        case 'Q':
            scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
            work(x, y);
            break;
        case 'R':
            scanf("%d%s", &x, s + 1);
            modify(x, s[1]);
            break;
        case 'I':
            scanf("%d%s", &x, s + 1);
            insert(x);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1015.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2000005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,k,ecnt=0,tot=0,f[MAXN],head[MAXN],a[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void init() {
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        tot--;
        if (fu<fv) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init();
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    read(k);
    for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        visit[a[i]]=1;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) {
            tot++;
            for (int now=head[i]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                    merge(i,e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ans[k]=tot;
    for (int i=k-1,x; i>-1; i--) {
        tot++;
        x=a[i];
        visit[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
                merge(x,e[now].to);
            }
        }
        ans[i]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1016.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 105
#define MAXM 1005
#define MOD 31011
struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

int ans = 1;
int n, m;
struct Equa {
    int v[MAXN];
    int &operator [] (int i) {
        return v[i];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int f[MAXN], vis[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], rec[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        f[fu] += f[fv], f[fv] = fu;
    }
}

int work(int st, int ed) {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = st; i <= ed; i++) {
        int u = getf(e[i].u), v = getf(e[i].v);
        if (u == v) continue;
        u = vis[u] ? vis[u] : (rec[++cnt] = u, vis[u] = cnt);
        v = vis[v] ? vis[v] : (rec[++cnt] = v, vis[v] = cnt);
        a[u][v]--, a[v][u]--, a[u][u]++, a[v][v]++;
    }
    for (int i = st; i <= ed; i++) merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    tmp[getf(rec[1])] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= cnt; i++) if (!tmp[getf(rec[i])]) tmp[getf(rec[i])] = 1, a[1][i]--, a[i][1]--, a[1][1]++, a[i][i]++;
    int ret = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < cnt; j++) {
            while (a[j][i]) {
                int t = a[i][i] / a[j][i];
                if (t) for (int k = i; k <= cnt; k++) a[i][k] = (a[i][k] - a[j][k] * t) % MOD;
                swap(a[i], a[j]), ret = -ret;
            }
        }
        ret = ret * a[i][i] % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof(f));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v), read(e[i].w), merge(e[i].u, e[i].v);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) if (getf(i) != getf(1)) return printf("0\n"), 0;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    memset(f, -1, sizeof(f));
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= m; i = j) {
        j = i + 1;
        while (j <= m && e[j].w == e[i].w) j++;
        ans = ans * work(i, j - 1) % MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1017.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 52
#define M 2008
#define W 103
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n, m;

int a[N], ty[N], lim[N], cost[N], C[N], t[N][N], c[N][N], ans[N];
int f[N][M][W], g[N][M];
bool in[N];
char tmp[3];

void dp(int x) {
    if (!ty[x]) {
        lim[x] = min(lim[x], m / cost[x]);
        for (int i = lim[x]; i >= 0; i--)
            for (int j = i; ~j; j--)
                f[x][i * cost[x]][j] = a[x] * (i - j);
        return;
    }
    lim[x] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= C[x]; i++) {
        dp(t[x][i]);
        lim[x] = min(lim[x], lim[t[x][i]] / c[x][i]);
        cost[x] += cost[t[x][i]] * c[x][i];
    }
    lim[x] = min(lim[x], m / cost[x]);
    memset(g, -INF, sizeof g);
    g[0][0] = 0;
    for (int li = lim[x]; ~li; li--) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= C[x]; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k <= j; k++)
                    g[i][j] = max(g[i][j], g[i - 1][j - k] + f[t[x][i]][k][c[x][i] * li]);
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k <= li; k++)
                f[x][j][k] = max(f[x][j][k], g[C[x]][j] + a[x] * (li - k));
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        scanf("%s", tmp);
        if ((ty[i] = tmp[0] == 'A')) {
            read(C[i]);
            for (int j = 1; j <= C[i]; j++) read(t[i][j]), read(c[i][j]), in[t[i][j]] = 1;
        } else {
            read(cost[i]);
            read(lim[i]);
        }
    }
    memset(f, -INF, sizeof f);
    memset(ans, -INF, sizeof ans);
    ans[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!in[i]) {
            dp(i);
            for (int j = m; ~j; j--) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= j; k++) {
                    ans[j] = max(ans[j], ans[k] + f[i][j - k][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans[i] = max(ans[i - 1], ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans[m]);
}

//BZOJ1018.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 100005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop(int &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='E') return 0;
    if (ch=='O') a=1;
    if (ch=='C') a=2;
    if (ch=='A') a=3;
    while (ch!=' ') ch=getchar();
    return 1;
}
struct ri {
    int op,c1,c2;
} rr[MAXM];

struct node {
    int l,r,lch,rch,head;
    bool hasq;
} t[262144];

struct infomation {
    int c1,c2,next;
} info[MAXM<<5];

struct recover {
    int tag,val,next;
    recover() {}
    recover(int a,int b,int c):tag(a),val(b),next(c) {}
} sta[MAXM<<5];

int c,m=0,root,tcnt=0,statop=0,icnt=0;
int visit[MAXM<<2],f[MAXN<<2];

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].l=l,t[now].r=r;
    if (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].hasq=t[t[now].lch].hasq|t[t[now].rch].hasq;
    } else {
        if (rr[l].op==3) t[now].hasq=1;
    }
    return now;
}

int gettag(int x,int y) {
    if (y-x==1) return x;
    else return x+262144;
}

int A,B;
void add_query(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        info[++icnt].c1=A;
        info[icnt].c2=B;
        info[icnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=icnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) add_query(t[x].lch,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid) add_query(t[x].rch,max(mid+1,l),r);
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return getf(f[x]);
}

int merge(int head,int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    if (f1!=f2) {
        sta[++statop]=recover(f1,f[f1],head);
        head=statop;
        sta[++statop]=recover(f2,f[f2],head);
        head=statop;
        if (f[f1]<f[f2]) {
            f[f1]+=f[f2];
            f[f2]=f1;
        } else {
            f[f2]+=f[f1];
            f[f1]=f2;
        }
    }
    return head;
}

bool is_same(int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    return f1==f2;
}

int change(int x) {
    int head=0;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=info[now].next) {
        head=merge(head,info[now].c1,info[now].c2);
    }
    return head;
}

void rec(int head) {
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].tag]=sta[now].val;
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    int head=change(x);
    if (t[x].l==t[x].r) {
        if (is_same(rr[t[x].l].c1,rr[t[x].l].c2)) puts("Y");
        else puts("N");
    } else {
        if (t[t[x].lch].hasq) dfs(t[x].lch);
        if (t[t[x].rch].hasq) dfs(t[x].rch);
    }
    rec(head);
}

int main() {
    read(c);
    m=1;
    while (readop(rr[m].op)) {
        int r1,c1,r2,c2;
        read(r1);
        read(c1);
        read(r2);
        read(c2);
        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
        m++;
    }
    m--;
    if (m==0) return 0;
    if (m==1) {
        if (rr[1].op==3) puts("N");
        return 0;
    }
    memset(visit,-1,sizeof(visit));
    root=build(1,m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int tag=gettag(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (visit[tag]==-1) visit[tag]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2) {
            if (visit[tag]!=-1) {
                A=rr[i].c1;
                B=rr[i].c2;
                add_query(root,visit[tag],i);
                visit[tag]=-1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]!=-1) {
            A=i;
            B=i+1;
            add_query(root,visit[i],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+131072]!=-1) {
            A=i+131072;
            B=i+131073;
            add_query(root,visit[i+131072],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+262144]!=-1) {
            A=i;
            B=i+131072;
            add_query(root,visit[i+262144],m);
        }
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(root);
    return 0;
}

            B=i+131073;

        }
        if (visit[i+262144]!=-1) {
            A=i;
            B=i+131072;
            add_query(root,visit[i+262144],m);
        }
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(root);
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1018.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 100005

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 8388608
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],wbuf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],*ptr,*ptw;
inline void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
    ptw=wbuf;
}
inline void write_buf() {
    fwrite(wbuf,sizeof(char),ptw-wbuf,stdout);
}
#define getchar() (*(ptr++))
#define putchar(x) (*(ptw++)=x)

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop(int &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='E') return 0;
    if (ch=='O') a=1;
    if (ch=='C') a=2;
    if (ch=='A') a=3;
    while (ch!=' ') ch=getchar();
    return 1;
}
struct ri {
    int op,c1,c2;
} rr[MAXM];

struct node {
    int l,r,lch,rch,head;
    bool hasq;
} t[262144];

struct infomation {
    int c1,c2,next;
} info[MAXM<<5];

struct recover {
    int tag,val,next;
    recover() {}
    recover(int a,int b,int c):tag(a),val(b),next(c) {}
} sta[MAXM<<5];

int c,m=0,root,tcnt=0,statop=0,icnt=0;
int visit[MAXM<<2],f[MAXN<<2];

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].l=l,t[now].r=r;
    if (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].hasq=t[t[now].lch].hasq|t[t[now].rch].hasq;
    } else {
        if (rr[l].op==3) t[now].hasq=1;
    }
    return now;
}

inline int gettag(int x,int y) {
    if (y-x==1) return x;
    else return x+262144;
}

int A,B;
void add_query(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x].l==l && t[x].r==r) {
        info[++icnt].c1=A;
        info[icnt].c2=B;
        info[icnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=icnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(t[x].l+t[x].r)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) add_query(t[x].lch,l,min(r,mid));
    if (r>mid) add_query(t[x].rch,max(mid+1,l),r);
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return getf(f[x]);
}

int merge(int head,int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    if (f1!=f2) {
        sta[++statop]=recover(f1,f[f1],head);
        head=statop;
        sta[++statop]=recover(f2,f[f2],head);
        head=statop;
        if (f[f1]<f[f2]) {
            f[f1]+=f[f2];
            f[f2]=f1;
        } else {
            f[f2]+=f[f1];
            f[f1]=f2;
        }
    }
    return head;
}

bool is_same(int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    return f1==f2;
}

int change(int x) {
    int head=0;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=info[now].next) {
        head=merge(head,info[now].c1,info[now].c2);
    }
    return head;
}

void rec(int head) {
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].tag]=sta[now].val;
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    int head=change(x);
    if (t[x].l==t[x].r) {
        if (is_same(rr[t[x].l].c1,rr[t[x].l].c2)) putchar('Y'),putchar('\n');
        else putchar('N'),putchar('\n');
    } else {
        if (t[t[x].lch].hasq) dfs(t[x].lch);
        if (t[t[x].rch].hasq) dfs(t[x].rch);
    }
    rec(head);
}

int main() {
    init_buf();
    read(c);
    m=1;
    while (readop(rr[m].op)) {
        int r1,c1,r2,c2;
        read(r1);
        read(c1);
        read(r2);
        read(c2);
        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
        m++;
    }
    m--;
    if (m==0) return 0;
    if (m==1) {
        if (rr[1].op==3) puts("N");
        return 0;
    }
    root=build(1,m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int tag=gettag(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (!visit[tag]) visit[tag]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2) {
            if (visit[tag]) {
                A=rr[i].c1;
                B=rr[i].c2;
                add_query(root,visit[tag],i);
                visit[tag]=0;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]) {
            A=i;
            B=i+1;
            add_query(root,visit[i],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+131072]) {
            A=i+131072;
            B=i+131073;
            add_query(root,visit[i+131072],m);
        }
        if (visit[i+262144]) {
            A=i;
            B=i+131072;
            add_query(root,visit[i+262144],m);
        }
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(root);
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
    }
    if (!(--m)) return 0;
    rt=build(1, m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int p=getp(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (!visit[p]) visit[p]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2 && visit[p]) {
            A=rr[i].c1, B=rr[i].c2, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[p],i);
            visit[p]=0;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]) A=i, B=i+1, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i],m);
        if (visit[i|131072]) A=i|131072, B=i+131073, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|131072],m);
        if (visit[i|262144]) A=i, B=i|131072, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|262144],m);
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(rt);
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1018.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 100005

char BUF[1 << 25], *buf = BUF, *end = BUF;

#define getchar() gtc()

inline int getchar() {
    if (buf == end) {
        buf = BUF, end = BUF + fread(BUF, 1 << 25, 1, stdin);
    }
    return *buf++;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    register int ch = getchar();
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0') {
        a = a * 10 + (ch ^ '0');
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop(int &a) {
    register int ch = getchar();
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    switch (ch) {
    case 'E':
        return 0;
        break;
    case 'O':
        a=1;
        break;
    case 'C':
        a=2;
        break;
    case 'A':
        a=3;
    }
    while (ch!=' ') ch=getchar();
    return 1;
}
struct ri {
    int op,c1,c2;
} rr[MAXM];

struct node {
    int lch,rch,head,q;
} t[262144];

struct Data {
    int c1,c2,next;
} rec[MAXM<<4];

struct R {
    int p,v;
    R() {}
    R(int a,int b):p(a),v(b) {}
} s[MAXM<<4];

int c,m=0,rt,tcnt=0,top=0,icnt=0;
int visit[MAXM*4],f[MAXN*4];

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].q=t[t[now].lch].q|t[t[now].rch].q;
    } else t[now].q=rr[l].op==3?l:0;
    return now;
}

#define getp(x, y) (y==x+1?x:x|262144)

int A,B;
void add_query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        rec[++icnt].c1=A;
        rec[icnt].c2=B;
        rec[icnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=icnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) add_query(t[x].lch, l, mid, ql, min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) add_query(t[x].rch, mid + 1, r, max(mid+1,ql),qr);
}

int getf(int x) {
    while (f[x] > 0) x = f[x];
    return x;
}

void merge(int c1,int c2) {
    int f1=getf(c1),f2=getf(c2);
    if (f1!=f2) {
        s[++top]=R(f1,f[f1]);
        s[++top]=R(f2,f[f2]);
        if (f[f1]<f[f2]) f[f1]+=f[f2], f[f2]=f1;
        else f[f2]+=f[f1], f[f1]=f2;
    }
}
#define is_same(c1, c2)	getf(c1)==getf(c2)

void dfs(int x) {
    int nowtop=top;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=rec[now].next) merge(rec[now].c1,rec[now].c2);
    if (!t[x].lch && !t[x].rch) {
        if (is_same(rr[t[x].q].c1,rr[t[x].q].c2)) putchar('Y'),putchar('\n');
        else putchar('N'),putchar('\n');
    } else {
        if (t[t[x].lch].q) dfs(t[x].lch);
        if (t[t[x].rch].q) dfs(t[x].rch);
    }
    while (top>nowtop) f[s[top].p]=s[top].v, top--;
}

int main() {
    read(c);
    int r1,c1,r2,c2;
    while (readop(rr[++m].op)) {
        read(r1);
        read(c1);
        read(r2);
        read(c2);
        rr[m].c1=((r1-1)<<17)+c1;
        rr[m].c2=((r2-1)<<17)+c2;
        if (rr[m].c1>rr[m].c2) swap(rr[m].c1,rr[m].c2);
    }
    if (!(--m)) return 0;
    rt=build(1, m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        int p=getp(rr[i].c1,rr[i].c2);
        if (rr[i].op==1) {
            if (!visit[p]) visit[p]=i;
        } else if (rr[i].op==2 && visit[p]) {
            A=rr[i].c1, B=rr[i].c2, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[p],i);
            visit[p]=0;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=c; i++) {
        if (visit[i]) A=i, B=i+1, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i],m);
        if (visit[i|131072]) A=i|131072, B=i+131073, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|131072],m);
        if (visit[i|262144]) A=i, B=i|131072, add_query(rt,1,m,visit[i|262144],m);
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    dfs(rt);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1024.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;
double dfs(double x,double y,int n) {
    if (n==1) return x>y?(x/y):(y/x);
    double re=1e9;
    for (int i=1,fuck=n>>1; i<=fuck; i++) {
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x*i/n,y,i),dfs(x*(n-i)/n,y,n-i)));
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x,y*i/n,i),dfs(x,y*(n-i)/n,n-i)));
    }
    return re;
}
int main() {
    int x,y,n;
    scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&n);
    printf("%.6f",dfs(x,y,n));
}

double dfs(double x,double y,int n) {
    double re=INF;
    if (n==1) {
        if (x<y)
            swap(x,y);
        return x/y;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<= (n>>1); i++) {
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x*i/n,y,i),dfs(x*(n-i)/n,y,n-i)));
        re=min(re,max(dfs(x,y*i/n,i),dfs(x,y*(n-i)/n,n-i)));
    }
    return re;
}

//BZOJ1025.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005

bool notprime[MAXN];
int n,pcnt,prime[MAXN];
long long dp[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void init() {
    pcnt=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=n; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=n; j++) dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j];
        for (int j=prime[i]; j<=n; j*=prime[i]) {
            for (int k=j; k<=n; k++) {
                dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][k-j];
            }
        }
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        ans+=dp[pcnt][i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1026.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

long long dp[12][10],cnt[12];
void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++)
        dp[1][i]=1;
    cnt[1]=9;
    for (int len=2; len<=10; len++) {
        for (int now=0; now<10; now++) {
            for (int last=0; last<10; last++) {
                if (abs(now-last)>1) {
                    dp[len][now]+=dp[len-1][last];
                }
            }
            if (now)
                cnt[len]+=dp[len][now];
        }
        cnt[len]+=cnt[len-1];
    }
    return;
}
long long calc(int x) {
    long long ans=0;
    char temp[15];
    sprintf(temp,"%d",x);
    int len=strlen(temp),last=-1;
    ans=cnt[len-1];
    for (int i=0,nowlen=len; i<len; i++,nowlen--) {
        int now=temp[i]-'0';
        for (int j=(i?0:1); j<now; j++) {
            if (abs(j-last)>1) {
                ans+=dp[nowlen][j];
            }
        }
        if (abs(last-now)<2)
            break;
        last=now;
    }
    return ans;
}
long long solve(int l,int r) {
    return calc(r+1)-calc(l);
}
int main() {
    int l,r;
    init();
    scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
    printf("%lld",solve(l,r));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1027.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 505
#define eps 1e-9
struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double a,double b):x(a),y(b) {}
    point operator - (point a) const {
        return point(x-a.x,y-a.y);
    }
    double operator * (point a) const {
        return x*a.y-a.x*y;
    }
    double operator ^ (point a) const {
        return x*a.x+y*a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN],b[MAXN];

double fun;
int m,n;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];

inline bool spj() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (b[i].x!=b[i-1].x || b[i].y!=b[i-1].y) return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (b[1].x==a[i].x && b[1].y==a[i].y) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

inline int check(point st,point ed) {
    int cnt1=0,cnt2=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        double x=(ed-st)*(b[i]-st);
        if (!(x+eps>0 && x-eps<0)) {
            if (x>0) {
                cnt1++;
            } else {
                cnt2++;
            }
        }
    }
    int ret=0;
    if (!cnt1) ret=1;
    if (!cnt2) ret+=2;
    return ret;
}

inline bool allin(point x,point y) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (((b[i]-x)^(y-b[i]))+eps<0) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

inline bool build() {
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=i+1; j<=m; j++) {
            int ret=check(a[i],a[j]);
            if (ret==3) {
                if (allin(a[i],a[j])) return 1;
                else continue;
            }
            if (ret&1) map[i][j]=1;
            if (ret&2) map[j][i]=1;
        }
    return 0;
}

inline void work() {
    for (int k=1; k<=m; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (map[i][j]>map[i][k]+map[k][j]) map[i][j]=map[i][k]+map[k][j];
            }
    int ans=m+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (map[i][i]<ans) ans=map[i][i];
    }
    if (ans>m) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&m,&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",&a[i].x,&a[i].y,&fun);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",&b[i].x,&b[i].y,&fun);
    }
    if (spj()) puts("1");
    else if (build()) puts("2");
    else work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1028.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int n,m,card[405],temp[405];
bool flag=0;
inline bool check() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        temp[i]%=3;
        if (temp[i]) {
            temp[i+1]-=temp[i];
            temp[i+2]-=temp[i];
            temp[i]=0;
            if (temp[i+1]<0 || temp[i+2]<0)
                return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,r,total=3*m+1; i<=total; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        card[r]++;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        card[i]++;
        bool ans=0;
        for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
            if (card[k]>1) {
                for (int j=1; j<=n; j++)
                    temp[j]=card[j];
                temp[k]-=2;
                if (check()) {
                    ans=1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ans) {
            if (flag)
                putchar(' ');
            printf("%d",i);
            flag=1;
        }
        card[i]--;
    }
    if (!flag)
        puts("NO");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1029.cpp
/*This is a source code from FirstLast*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 150005

struct data {
    int t,r;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} b[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    priority_queue<int> q;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&b[i].t,&b[i].r);
    }
    sort(b+1,b+n+1);
    int total=0,ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (b[i].r-total>=b[i].t) {
            total+=b[i].t;
            q.push(b[i].t);
            ans++;
        } else {
            if (b[i].t<q.top()) {
                total-=q.top()-b[i].t;
                q.pop();
                q.push(b[i].t);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1030.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 6666
#define MOD 10007

int t[MAXN][26], fail[MAXN], tag[MAXN], tcnt = 1;
char s[105];

void insert() {
    int x = 1, n;
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'A';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    tag[x] = 1;
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) to = t[j][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                tag[to] |= tag[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
}

int n, m, ans = 0;
int f[105][MAXN], g[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) insert();
    build();
    f[0][1] = 1;
    g[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) g[i] = (g[i - 1] * 26) % MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= tcnt; j++) {
            if (f[i][j] && !tag[j]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
                    (f[i + 1][t[j][k]] += f[i][j]) %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int j = 1; j <= tcnt; j++) if (tag[j] && f[i + 1][j]) {
                (ans += f[i + 1][j] * g[m - i]) %= MOD;
            }
    }
    printf("%d", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1031.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
