    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int fa[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int n, siz[MAXN], dep[MAXN];
LL sum[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    sum[x] = dep[x], siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            sum[x] += sum[e[now].to];
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}
LL ans = 0;
int tag = -1;

void work(int x, LL tot) {
    LL tmp = sum[x] - (LL)dep[x] * siz[x] + tot;
    if (tmp > ans || (tmp == ans && tag > x)) ans = tmp, tag = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            work(e[now].to, tot + (sum[x] - sum[e[now].to]) - (LL)dep[x] * (siz[x] - siz[e[now].to]) + n - siz[e[now].to]);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(1);
    work(1, 0);
    printf("%d\n", tag);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1132.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 3005

typedef long long LL;
struct point {
    LL x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int _x,int _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        else return y<a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN],t[MAXN];

bool cmp(point p,point q) {
    return p.x*q.y-p.y*q.x>0;
}

int n;
LL ans=0;

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lld%lld",&a[i].x,&a[i].y);
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        LL sumx=0,sumy=0,cnt=0;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            t[++cnt].x=a[j].x-a[i].x,t[cnt].y=a[j].y-a[i].y;
            sumx+=t[cnt].x,sumy+=t[cnt].y;
        }
        sort(t+1,t+cnt+1,cmp);
        for (int j=1; j<=cnt; j++) {
            sumx-=t[j].x,sumy-=t[j].y;
            ans-=sumx*t[j].y-sumy*t[j].x;
        }
    }
    if (ans&1) printf("%lld.5\n",ans>>1);
    else printf("%lld.0\n",ans>>1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1137.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define eps 1e-10

typedef double D;

inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
inline D power(D x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        int a, b;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        x = a, y = b;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("(%.2lf, %.2lf)", x, y);
    }
};

inline D dis(Point &a, Point &b) {
    return sqrt(power(a.x - b.x) + power(a.y - b.y));
}

Point Is(Point &a1, Point &a2, Point &b1, Point &b2) {
    D x1 = (b2 - b1) * (a1 - b1), x2 = (a2 - b1) * (b2 - b1);
    return (a1 * x2 + a2 * x1) / (x1 + x2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border() {}
    Border(Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
    void print() {
        p1.print();
        p2.print();
        printf("\n");
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return (b.p2 - a.p1) * (a.p2 - a.p1) > eps;
}

bool ok(Border &a, Border &b, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(a.p1, a.p2, b.p1, b.p2);
    return (i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1) > eps;
}

Point p[MAXN];
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
vector <int> E[MAXN];

int n, m, cnt, pcnt;

void hpi() {
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he > 2) {
        D ans = -dis(p[1], p[n]);
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int j = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[pcnt++] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[j].p1, q[j].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pcnt; i++) ans += dis(p[i], p[(i + 1) % pcnt]);
        printf("%.10lf\n", ans);
    } else printf("%.10lf\n", dis(p[1], p[n]));
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) p[i].re();
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), E[min(u, v)].push_back(max(u, v));
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        sort(E[i].begin(), E[i].end(), greater<int>());
        for (int j = n, k = 0; j > i; j--) {
            if (k < (int)E[i].size() && j == E[i][k]) k++;
            else {
                a[++cnt] = Border(p[j], p[i]);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    a[++cnt] = Border(p[1], p[n]);
    hpi();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1143.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

int n,m,ecnt=1,head[MAXN<<1],tag[MAXN<<1],cur[MAXN<<1];
bool G[MAXN][MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN<<1];
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    int he=1,ta=2;
    q[1]=0;
    tag[0]=1;
    while (he!=ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow-usd));
            if (ret) {
                usd+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0,ta=(n<<1)^1; i<=ta; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,n<<1);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        G[u][v]=1;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=n; k++)
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
                G[i][j]=G[i][j]|(G[i][k]&G[k][j]);
            }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i<<1,1);
        add((i<<1)^1,1,1);
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) add(i<<1,(j<<1)^1,1);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",n-dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1150.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};
int n,k,ans=0;
int a[MAXN],next[MAXN],prev[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void del(int x) {
    prev[next[x]]=prev[x];
    next[prev[x]]=next[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}
priority_queue<statu> q;
void work() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) q.push(statu(i,a[i]));
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) q.pop();
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        ans+=a[x];
        a[x]=a[prev[x]]+a[next[x]]-a[x];
        del(prev[x]);
        del(next[x]);
        q.push(statu(x,a[x]));
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    int xx,xxx;
    read(xx);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        read(xxx);
        a[i]=xxx-xx;
        xx=xxx;
        prev[i]=i-1;
        next[i]=i+1;
    }

    prev[1]=0;
    next[1]=2;
    prev[0]=0;
    next[0]=1;
    a[0]=a[1]=a[n+1]=a[n+2]=1000000001;
    prev[n+1]=n;
    prev[n+2]=n+1;
    next[n+1]=n+2;
    next[n+2]=n+2;
    work();
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1163.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>

#include <string>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, S, T;
int ecnt = 1, head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue<int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 2, 0, sizeof(int) * (n * 2));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x] ; now ; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int lf = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(lf, e[now].f));
            e[now].f -= ret;
            e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
            lf -= ret;
            if (!lf) return flow;
        }
    }
    return flow - lf;
}

long long dinic() {
    long long ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 2; i <= n * 2 + 1; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(S);
    read(T);
    S = S << 1, T = (T << 1) | 1;
    for (int i = 1, w; i <= n; i++) {
        read(w);
        add(i << 1, (i << 1) | 1, w);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add((u << 1) | 1, v << 1, INF);
        add((v << 1) | 1, u << 1, INF);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500319

    int next, to;

    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;

void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= scc; i++) if (pp[i]) add(i, 0);
    memset(dis, 200, sizeof dis);
    dis[bel[S]] = siz[bel[S]];
    q.push(bel[S]);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + siz[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + siz[e[now].to];
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;

        }

namespace Tarjan {
edge e[MAXN * 2];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    inq[x] = 1;
    sta[++top] = x;
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!dfn[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to), low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        siz[++scc] = 0;
        do {
            siz[scc] += a[sta[top]];
            pp[scc] |= p[sta[top]];
            bel[sta[top]] = scc;
            inq[sta[top]] = 0;
        } while (sta[top--] != x);
    }
}
void make() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (bel[i]) {
            for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (bel[e[now].to] && bel[e[now].to] != bel[i]) SPFA::add(bel[i], bel[e[now].to]);
            }
        }
}
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        Tarjan::add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    read(S);
    read(P);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= P; i++) read(x), p[x] = 1;
    Tarjan::dfs(S);
    Tarjan::make();
    SPFA::solve();
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'a' || _c > 'z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'b' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'p' :
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'e' :
        a = 3;
        break;
    }
    while (_c >= 'a' && _c <= 'z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 30319

struct Node {
    Node *p, *fa, *c[2];
    int sum, val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : sum(0), val(0), rev(0), isrt(0) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int d) {
        c[d] = ch;
        ch->p = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::relax() {
    if (rev) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->revIt();
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    fa = f;
    p = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->sum = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->p = ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *p = x->p;
    bool d = x->d();
    p->p->setc(x, p->d());
    p->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isrt) {
        p->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->p != null) pushto(x->p);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->p != fa) {
        if (x->p->p == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->p->d() ? (rot(x->p), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->fa) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);// x->upd();
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->fa = v;
}

int query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

void modify(Node *x, int v) {
    splay(x);
    x->val = v;
    x->upd();
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x), splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

bool Connected(Node *x, Node *y) {
    return getrt(x) == getrt(y);
}

int n, m;

Node *a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] = newNode(x);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            if (Connected(a[x], a[y])) puts("no");
            else Link(a[x], a[y]), puts("yes");
            break;
        case 2:
            modify(a[x], y);
            break;
        case 3:
            if (Connected(a[x], a[y])) printf("%d\n", query(a[x], a[y]));
            else puts("impossible");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 210005

int dx[4]= {0,0,-1,1},dy[4]= {1,-1,0,0};
struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
} p[405],d[405];

int n,m,dcnt=0,pcnt=0;
int map[25][25],st[25][25],dis[405][405];
char temp[25];

queue <point> qq;
bool bfs(int who) {
    bool flag=0;
    memset(st,-1,sizeof(st));
    st[p[who].x][p[who].y]=0;
    qq.push(p[who]);
    while (!qq.empty()) {
        point now=qq.front();
        qq.pop();
        int x=now.x,y=now.y;
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=dx[d]+x,toy=dy[d]+y;
            if (map[tox][toy] && st[tox][toy]==-1) {
                st[tox][toy]=st[x][y]+1;
                if (map[tox][toy]<0) {
                    dis[who][-map[tox][toy]]=st[x][y]+1;
                    flag=1;
                } else {
                    qq.push(point(tox,toy));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return flag;
}

#define MAXM 524288
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM];

int head[MAXN],ecnt;
int tag[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]!=0;
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x==1) return 1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].flow--;
                e[now^1].flow++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        while (dfs(0)) {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool check(int mid) {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        bool flag=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=dcnt; j++) {
            if (dis[i][j]<=mid) flag=0;
            for (int k=dis[i][j]; k<=mid; k++) {
                add(i+1,(j<<9)+k);
            }
        }
        if (flag) return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        add(0,i+1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=dcnt; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=mid; j++) {
            add((i<<9)+j,1);
        }
    }
    if (dinic()==pcnt) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        map[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (temp[j]=='X') map[i][j]=0;
            else if (temp[j]=='.') {
                p[++pcnt]=point(i,j);
                map[i][j]=pcnt;
            } else {
                d[++dcnt]=point(i,j);
                map[i][j]=-dcnt;
            }
        }
        map[i][m+1]=0;
    }
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (!bfs(i)) {
            puts("impossible");
            return 0;
        }
    }
    int l=1,r=n*m,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1191.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 2005
#define MAXE 10005
#define MAXP 5015
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    bool w;
} e[MAXE];

int n,m,ecnt,p[MAXN][2];
int head[MAXP],tag[MAXP];
bool visit[MAXP];

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
// source = 0 , flow = 1 , 2 ~ n+1 = projects , n+2 ~ n+1+mid = problems

inline bool bfs() {
    bool flag=0;
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    queue<int> q;
    tag[0]=visit[0]=1;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x==1) flag=1;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].w) {
                v=e[now].to;
                if (!visit[v]) {
                    visit[v]=1;
                    tag[v]=tag[x]+1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return flag;
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x==1) return 1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].w) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && tag[v]>tag[x]) {
                visit[v]=1;
                if (dfs(v)) {
                    e[now].w=0;
                    e[now^1].w=1;
                    return 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline bool check(int to) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    int ans=0;
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i+1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=to; i++) {
        add(n+2+i,1);
        add(p[i][0],n+2+i);
        if (p[i][0]!=p[i][1]) add(p[i][1],n+2+i);
    }
    while (bfs()) {
        while (1) {
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
            if (dfs(0)) ans++;
            else break;
        }
    }
    if (ans==to) return 1;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",p[i],p[i]+1);
        p[i][0]+=2,p[i][1]+=2;
    }
    int l=1,r=m,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            l=mid;
        else
            r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct statu {
    int x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
};

int xp,yp,xs,ys,ans=0;
int dis[105][105],dx[8]= {2,2,1,1,-1,-1,-2,-2},dy[8]= {1,-1,2,-2,2,-2,1,-1};

inline bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x && x<100 && y && y<100;
}

inline int bfs(int x,int y) {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[x][y]=0;
    queue <statu> q;
    q.push(statu(x,y));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int nowx=q.front().x,nowy=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        if (nowx==40 && nowy==40) return dis[nowx][nowy];
        for (int i=0; i<8; i++) {
            int tox=nowx+dx[i],toy=nowy+dy[i];
            if (inrange(tox,toy) && dis[tox][toy]==INF) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d",&xp,&yp,&xs,&ys);
    int x=abs(xp-xs),y=abs(ys-yp);
    while (x+y>=50) {
        if (x<y) swap(x,y);
        if (x-4>(y<<1)) x-=4;
        else x-=4,y-=2;
        ans+=2;
    }
    printf("%d\n",bfs(x+40,y+40)+ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1196.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 20005

struct edge {
    int u,v,c1,c2;
} e[MAXM];

int n,k,m,f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    else return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(a),fb=getf(b);
    if (fa==fb) return 0;
    if (f[fa]<f[fb]) {
        f[fa]+=f[fb];
        f[fb]=fa;
    } else {
        f[fb]+=f[fa];
        f[fa]=fb;
    }
    return 1;
}

bool check(int x) {
    memset(f+1,-1,4*n);
    int cnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        if (e[i].c1<=x && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) cnt++;
    }
    if (cnt<=k) return 0;
    for (int i=1; i<m && cnt<n; i++) {
        if (e[i].c2<=x && merge(e[i].u,e[i].v)) cnt++;
    }
    if (cnt==n) return 1;
    else return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&k,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&e[i].u,&e[i].v,&e[i].c1,&e[i].c2);
    }
    int l=0,r=30001,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1202.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105
#define MAXM 1005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int T,n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],val[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (!visit[e[now].to]) {
            visit[e[now].to]=1;
            val[e[now].to]=val[x]+e[now].w;
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) return 1;
        }
        if (val[e[now].to]!=val[x]+e[now].w) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        memset(head,0,(n+1)<<2);
        ecnt=0;
        for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
            scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
            add(u-1,v,w);
        }
        memset(visit,0,(n+1));
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                visit[i]=1;
                if (dfs(i)) {
                    flag=0;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (flag) puts("true");
        else puts("false");
    }
    return 0;
}

    return ret;
}

int main() {
    n = read(), m = read();
    T[0] = -23333;
    for (register int i = 1, j, k, l; i <= m; i++) {
        T[i] = read();
        x[i] = read();
        y[i] = read();
        for (j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            k = x[i] - x[j];
            if (k < 0) k = -k;
            l = y[i] - y[j];
            if (l < 0) l = -l;
            if (k + l <= T[i] - T[j]) dp[i] < dp[j] && (dp[i] = dp[j]);
        }
        ++dp[i];
        ans = ans > dp[i] ? ans : dp[i];
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;

inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
multiset<int> s;

int n, g, cnt = 0, ans = 0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    s.insert(-INF);
    s.insert(INF);
    for (int i = 1, t, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(t);
        read(v);
        if (g == t) {
            cnt++;
            s.insert(v);
        } else {
            if (!cnt) cnt = 1, g = t, s.insert(v);
            else {
                cnt--;
                multiset<int>::iterator l = s.lower_bound(v), r = l;
                l--;
                int lans = v - *l, rans = *r - v;
                ans = (ans + min(lans, rans)) % 1000000;
                if (rans < lans) s.erase(r);
                else s.erase(l);
            }
        }
    }

//BZOJ1211.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 5005

long long ans=1;

int n;
int pcnt=0,prime[205],cnt[205];
bool notprime[205];

void init() {
    for (int i=2; i<=200; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=200; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
}

void add(int x,int v) {
    if (x>2 || v==0) return;
    int now=1;
    while (x!=1) {
        while (x%prime[now]!=0) now++;
        while (x%prime[now]==0) {
            cnt[now]+=v;
            x/=prime[now];
        }
    }
}

void addfac(int x,int v) {
    for (int i=2; i<=x; i++) add(i,v);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d",&n);
    if (n==1) {
        int d;
        scanf("%d",&d);
        if (d) puts("0");
        else puts("1");
        return 0;
    }
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1,d; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&d);
        if (d==0) {
            puts("0");
            return 0;
        }
        tot+=d-1;
        addfac(d-1,-1);
    }
    if (tot!=n-2) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    addfac(n-2,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        while (cnt[i]--) ans=ans*prime[i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1212.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 1048580

int n,m,trie[205][26],tcnt=0;
bool dp[MAXN],word[205];
char s[MAXN];

inline void insert() {
    int now=0;
    for (int i=0; s[i]; i++) {
        int x=s[i]-'a';
        if (!trie[now][x]) trie[now][x]=++tcnt;
        now=trie[now][x];
    }
    word[now]=1;
}

inline void work() {
    int len=strlen(s+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) s[i]-='a';
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=1;
    int ans;
    for (int i=0,cnt=0; cnt<11 && i<len; i++) {
        if (!dp[i]) {
            cnt++;
            continue;
        }
        ans=i;
        cnt=0;
        for (int j=i+1,now=0; j<=len; j++) {
            if (!trie[now][s[j]]) break;
            now=trie[now][s[j]];
            if (word[now]) dp[j]=1;
        }
    }
    if (dp[len]) ans=len;
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s);
        insert();
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        work();
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1216.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

struct task {
    long long num,arr,exe,val;
    task() {}
    task(long long a,long long b,long long c,long long d):num(a),arr(b),exe(c),val(d) {}
    bool operator < (task a) const {
        if (val!=a.val) return val<a.val;
        return arr>a.arr;
    }
};

priority_queue<task> q;

int main() {
    long long a,b,c,d;
    long long t=-1;
    q.push(task(-1,-1,1000000000000000ll,-1));
    while (scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld",&a,&b,&c,&d)!=EOF) {
        task now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        while (b-t>=now.exe) {
            t+=now.exe;
            printf("%lld %lld\n",now.num,t);
            now=q.top();
            q.pop();
        }
        if (b>t) {
            if (now.num!=-1) now.exe-=(b-t);
            t=b;
        }
        q.push(now);
        q.push(task(a,b,c,d));
    }
    while (q.top().num!=-1) {
        task now=q.top();
        q.pop();
        t+=now.exe;
        printf("%lld %lld\n",now.num,t);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1217.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

int n,ecnt=0,f[MAXN],head[MAXN],label[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[h]=1;
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            q[t++]=e[now].to;
        }
    }
}

void mark(int x,int val) {
    if (val<=label[x]) return;
    label[x]=val;
    if (val) {
        mark(f[x],val-1);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            mark(e[now].to,val-1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    f[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        read(f[i]);
        add(f[i],i);
    }
    bfs();
    memset(label,-1,sizeof(label));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) {
        if (label[q[i]]==-1) {
            mark(f[f[q[i]]],2);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    for (int i=1,x,y,v; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&v);
        sum[x+1][y+1]=v;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<LIM; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<LIM; j++) {
            sum[i][j]+=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=r; i<LIM; i++)
        for (int j=r; j<LIM; j++) {
            ans=max(ans,sum[i][j]-sum[i-r][j]-sum[i][j-r]+sum[i-r][j-r]);
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 6001

        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        if (a | b | c) {
            for (j = top; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (b) dp[j + b] = min(dp[j + b], dp[j]);
                if (c) dp[j + c] = min(dp[j + c], dp[j] + c);
                if (a) dp[j] = dp[j] + a;
                else dp[j] = INF;

            top += max(b, c);

//BZOJ1238.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

int ch;
bool getLine(char *s) {
    while (ch < ' ') {
        if (~ch) ch = getchar();
        else return 0;
    }
    while (ch >= ' ') {
        *(s++) = ch;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    *s = 0;
    return 1;
}

char s[23333];
bool vis[55]['Z' + 1], tmp[55]['Z' + 1];
int line = 1;
set <int> S;

void chk(int i, int ed, int dep) {
    for ( ; i < ed; i++) {
        if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') {
            if (!vis[dep][s[i]]) S.insert(s[i]);
        }
    }
    for (set<int>::iterator it = S.begin(); it != S.end(); it++) {
        printf("Line %d: variable %c might not have been initialized\n", line, *it);
    }
    S.clear();
}

bool fill() {
    while (getLine(s)) {
        line++;
        int len = (int)strlen(s);
        if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') return 0;
        else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') return 1;
        printf("Line %d: unreachable code\n", line);
        if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') if (fill()) fill();
    }
    return 0;
}

bool solve(int dep) {
    memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
    bool el = 0, re1 = 0;
    while (getLine(s)) {
        line++;
        int len = (int)strlen(s);
        if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'N') {
            if (el) {
                for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                    if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                        vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        } else if (s[0] == 'E' && s[1] == 'L') {
            memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
            memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
            el = 1;
        } else if (s[0] == 'I' && s[1] == 'F') {
            chk(2, len - 5, dep);
            if (solve(dep + 1)) {
                for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
                if (fill()) {
                    memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
                    memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
                    el = 1, re1 = 1;
                } else {
                    if (el) {
                        for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                            if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                                vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (s[2] == '=') {
            chk(2, len, dep);
            vis[dep][s[0]] = 1;
        } else if (s[0] == 'R' && s[1] == 'E') {
            chk(6, len, dep);
            for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) vis[dep][i] = 1;
            if (fill()) {
                memcpy(tmp[dep], vis[dep], sizeof(vis[0]));
                memcpy(vis[dep], vis[dep - 1], sizeof(vis[0]));
                el = 1, re1 = 1;
            } else {
                if (el) {
                    if (re1) {
                        return 1;
                    }
                    for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
                        if (vis[dep][i] && tmp[dep][i]) {
                            vis[dep - 1][i] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    getLine(s);
    for (int i = (int)strlen(s) - 1; i > 5; i--)
        if (s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') vis[0][s[i]] = 1;
    solve(1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1246.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 5005

int n, m, tot = 0, mid;
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], sum[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

bool dfs(int cnt, int dep, int len, int top, int totlen) {
    if (!dep) return 0;
    if (totlen < sum[mid]) return 0;
    if (cnt == mid) return 1;
    if (len < a[1]) return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
    for (int i = top, last = -1; i; i--) {
        if (!vis[i] && a[i] != last && a[i] <= len) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            bool ret = dfs(cnt + 1, dep, len - a[i], i - 1, totlen);
            vis[i] = 0;
            if (ret) return 1;
            else last = a[i];
        }
    }
    return dfs(cnt, dep - 1, b[dep - 1], mid, totlen - len);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]), tot += b[i];
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    int l = 0, r = n;
    // greedy
    for (int i = 1, j = 1, now = b[1]; i <= n; i++) {
        while (j <= m && a[i] > now) now = b[++j];
        if (j > m) break;
        now -= a[i];
        l++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (dfs(0, m, b[m], mid, tot)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1257.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

inline long long work(long long n,long long k) {
    long long ans=0,now=1,to,div,cnt;
    while (now<=n) {
        div=k/now;
        to=min(n,k/div);
        cnt=to-now+1;
        ans+=cnt*k-div*(now+to)*cnt/2;
        now=to+1;
    }
    return ans;
}

long long ans=0,n,k;

int main() {
    cin>>n>>k;
    if (n>=k) {
        ans=(n-k)*k+work(k,k);
    } else {
        ans=work(n,k);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n;
char s[55];
int dp[55][55];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    memset(dp, 0x3f, sizeof dp);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) dp[i][j] = i == j ? 1 : INF;
    for (int len = 1; len < n; len++) {
        for (int i = 1; i + len <= n; i++) {
            int j = i + len;
            if (s[i] == s[j]) {
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j]);
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 1);
            } else {
                for (int k = i; k < j; k++) {
                    dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + dp[k + 1][j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[1][n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1263.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
struct num {
    int v[1300],len;
    num operator * (int a) const {
        num ret;
        int next=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]=v[i]*a+next;
            if (ret.v[i]>9999) {
                next=ret.v[i]/10000;
                ret.v[i]%=10000;
            } else next=0;
        }
        if (next) {
            ret.len=len+1;
            ret.v[ret.len]=next;
        } else ret.len=len;
        return ret;
    }
} ans;

int n;

inline void quickpower(int x) {
    for (int i=1; i<=x; i++) ans=ans*3;
}

inline void prizero(int f) {
    int left=100-f,now=ans.len-1;
    printf("%d",ans.v[ans.len]);
    while (left>=4) {
        printf("%04d",ans.v[now--]);
        left-=4;
    }
    int x=ans.v[now];
    if (left) {
        printf("%d",x/1000);
        if (left>1) {
            printf("%d",(x/100)%10);
            if (left>2) {
                printf("%d",(x/10)%10);
            }
        }
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

inline void pri() {
    if (ans.v[ans.len]) printf("%d",ans.v[ans.len]);
    for (int i=ans.len-1; i; i--) {
        printf("%04d",ans.v[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
}

int main() {
    memset(ans.v,0,sizeof(ans.v));
    ans.len=ans.v[1]=1;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int left=n%3;
    if (!left) {
        quickpower(n/3);
    } else if (left==1) {
        quickpower((n/3)-1);
        ans=ans*4;
    } else {
        quickpower((n/3));
        ans=ans*2;
    }
    int ans1=(ans.len-1)<<2;
    if (ans.v[ans.len]>0) {
        ans1++;
        if (ans.v[ans.len]>9) {
            ans1++;
            if (ans.v[ans.len]>99) {
                ans1++;
                if (ans.v[ans.len]>999) ans1++;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans1);
    if (n>628) prizero(ans1-((ans.len-1)<<2));
    else pri();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1266.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 505
#define MAXM 125005
#define s 512
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,c;
} e[MAXM<<1];

struct ee {
    int next,to,w;
} f[MAXM<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,fcnt=1,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN],rdis[MAXN],fh[MAXN],tag[MAXN],t[s<<1];
bool visit[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w,int c) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].c=c;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].c=c;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline void fadd(int u,int v,int w) {
    f[++fcnt].to=v;
    f[fcnt].w=w;
    f[fcnt].next=fh[u];
    fh[u]=fcnt;
    f[++fcnt].to=u;
    f[fcnt].w=0;
    f[fcnt].next=fh[v];
    fh[v]=fcnt;
}

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    t[x+=s]=d;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)|1]);
}

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<t[(x<<1)|1])
            x<<=1;
        else
            x=(x<<1)|1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void dijkstra(int st,int dis[]) {
    memset(t,31,sizeof(t));
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    update(st,0);
    int x=st;
    while (t[x+s]<INF) {
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        update(x,INF);
        visit[x]=1;
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (!visit[v] && dis[x]+e[now].w<t[s+v]) {
                update(v,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
}

queue<int> q;
inline bool bfs() {
    bool flag=0;
    q.push(1);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[1]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x==n) flag=1;
        for (int now=fh[x],v; now; now=f[now].next) {
            v=f[now].to;
            if (!tag[v] && f[now].w) {
                tag[v]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return flag;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==n) {
        return flow;
    }
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=fh[x],v; now; now=f[now].next) {
        v=f[now].to;
        if (!visit[v] && tag[v]>tag[x] && f[now].w) {
            int ret=0;
            if ((ret=dfs(v,min(flow,f[now].w)))) {
                f[now].w-=ret;
                f[now^1].w+=ret;
                return ret;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

inline long long dinic() {
    long long ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        int ret=0;
        while ((ret=dfs(1,INF))) {
            ans+=ret;
            memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w,c; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w,&c);
        add(u,v,w,c);
    }
    dijkstra(1,dis);
    dijkstra(n,rdis);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]+rdis[i]>dis[n]) continue;
        for (int now=head[i],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (rdis[i]-rdis[v]==e[now].w) {
                fadd(i,v,e[now].c);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n%lld\n",dis[n],dinic());
    return 0;
}

/*IO Acceleration*/
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
inline void readd(double &a) {
    bool f=0,p=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
        if (ch=='.') p=1;
    }
    a=0;
    if (!p) while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a=a*10+ch-'0';
            ch=getchar();
        }
    if (ch=='.') {
        ch=getchar();
        p=1;
    }
    if (p) {
        double cnt=10;
        while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
            a+=(ch-'0')/cnt;
            cnt*=10;
            ch=getchar();
        }
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
//#define USING_CPPIO
#ifdef USING_CPPIO
ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
cin.tie(0);
cout.tie(0);
#endif

/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 1000005

struct p {
    int x,v;
    p() {}
    p(int _x,int _v):x(_x),v(_v) {}
    bool operator < (p a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];
int n,k,acnt=0,cnt[65],need,ans;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    need=k;
    for (int i=1,t,y; i<=k; i++) {
        read(t);
        for (int j=1; j<=t; j++) {
            read(y);
            a[++acnt]=p(y,i);
        }
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    int i=1,j=1;
    while (j<=n && need) {
        int nowpos=a[j].x;
        while (j<=n && a[j].x==nowpos) {
            if (cnt[a[j].v]==0) need--;
            cnt[a[j++].v]++;
        }
    }
    if (need) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    ans=a[j-1].x-a[1].x;
    while (i<=n && j<=n) {
        int nowpos=a[i].x;
        while (i<=n && a[i].x==nowpos) {
            cnt[a[i].v]--;
            if (cnt[a[i++].v]==0) need++;
        }
        while (j<=n && need) {
            nowpos=a[j].x;
            while (j<=n && a[j].x==nowpos) {
                if (cnt[a[j].v]==0) need--;
                cnt[a[j++].v]++;
            }
        }
        if (need) break;
        ans=min(ans,a[j-1].x-a[i].x);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1296.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int n,m,T,sum[55],dp[2505][55],val[2505],pack[2505];
char s[55];
void update() {
    for (int i=T; i>0; i--) {
        for (int j=i-1,ta=max(i-m,0); j>=ta; j--) {
            pack[i]=max(pack[i],pack[j]+val[i-j]);
        }
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&T);
    for (int ca=1; ca<=n; ca++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) sum[i]=sum[i-1]+(s[i]=='1');
        memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
        for (int t=1; t<=m; t++) {
            int ret=0;
            for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
                dp[t][i]=dp[t-1][i];
                for (int j=0; j<i; j++) {
                    dp[t][i]=max(dp[t][i],dp[t-1][j]+max(sum[i]-sum[j],i-j-sum[i]+sum[j]));
                }
                ret=max(ret,dp[t][i]);
            }
            val[t]=ret;
        }
        update();
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) ans=max(ans,pack[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1297.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 15
#define MAXM 105
#define MOD 2009
int n;
long long t;
char r[MAXN];
int map[MAXN][MAXN],lab[MAXN][MAXN],cnt=-1;
int now[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM],trans[MAXM][MAXM],ans[MAXM];

inline void exp(int a[MAXM][MAXM],int b[MAXM][MAXM]) {
    for (int i=0; i<=cnt; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<=cnt; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<=cnt; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++)
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
}

inline void quickpower(long long x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            exp(now,trans);
        }
        exp(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld",&n,&t);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",r);
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            map[i][j]=r[j]-'0';
        }
    }
    for (int tt=0; tt<9; tt++) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            lab[tt][i]=++cnt;
            now[cnt][cnt]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int tt=8; tt; tt--) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            trans[lab[tt][i]][lab[tt-1][i]]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (!map[i][j]) continue;
            trans[lab[0][i]][lab[map[i][j]-1][j]]=1;
        }
    }
    quickpower(t);
    ans[0]=1;
    for (int j=0; j<=cnt; j++) {
        temp[0][j]=0;
        for (int k=0; k<=cnt; k++) {
            temp[0][j]=(temp[0][j]+ans[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",temp[0][lab[0][n-1]]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1303.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

int n,b,p=-1;
int a[100005],fcnt[200005],bcnt[200005];

long long ans=0;

inline void work(int fc[],int bc[]) {
    fc[0]=bc[0]=1;
    int now=0;
    for (int i=p-1; i>0; i--) {
        now+=a[i];
        fc[now]++;
    }
    now=0;
    for (int i=p+1; i<=n; i++) {
        now+=a[i];
        bc[now]++;
    }
    for (int i=-100000; i<=100000; i++) {
        ans+=(long long)fc[i]*bc[-i];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&b);
    for (int i=1,t; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&t);
        if (t>b) a[i]=1;
        else if (t<b) a[i]=-1;
        else p=i;
    }
    work(fcnt+100001,bcnt+100001);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 10319
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int m, n;
int fa[MAXN], c[MAXN], dp[MAXN][2];

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x <= n) {
        dp[x][c[x]] = 1;
        dp[x][c[x] ^ 1] = INF;
        return;
    }
    dp[x][0] = dp[x][1] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            dp[x][0] += min(dp[e[now].to][0] - 1, dp[e[now].to][1]);
            dp[x][1] += min(dp[e[now].to][1] - 1, dp[e[now].to][0]);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(c[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    dfs(m);
    printf("%d\n", min(dp[m][0], dp[m][1]));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1305.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='Y') a=1;
    else a=0;
    ch=getchar();
}

#define MAXN 210
#define MAXM MAXN*MAXN*2
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM];

bool map[55][55];
const int src=0,sink=1;
int n,k,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt;

void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build(int mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(0,i<<2,mid);
        add(i<<2,(i<<2)|1,k);
        add((i<<2)|2,(i<<2)|3,k);
        add((i<<2)|3,1,mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) {
                add(i<<2,(j<<2)|3,1);
            } else {
                add((i<<2)|1,(j<<2)|2,1);
            }
        }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]!=0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==sink) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

bool dinic(int mid) {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=((n<<2)|3); i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,n*mid);
    }
    return ans==n*mid;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            readop(map[i][j]);
        }
    }
    int l=min(n,k),r=n,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        build(mid);
        if (dinic(mid)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

    if (y > n) {
        if (a[x] == 0) y = (++x) + 1;
        else return;
        if (x >= n && a[x] == 0) {
            ans++;
            return;
        }

    if (Lst[a[x]] > n - y + 1) return;
    if (a[x] >= 3) {
        a[x] -= 3;
        dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[x] += 3;
    }
    if (a[x] >= 1 && a[y] >= 1 && Lst[a[y] - 1] <= n - x - 1) {
        a[x] -= 1;
        a[y] -= 1;
        dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[x] += 1;
        a[y] += 1;
    }
    if (a[y] >= 3) {
        a[y] -= 3;
        dfs(x, y + 1);
        a[y] += 3;
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n;
int a[305],dp[100005],sum=0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),sum+=a[i];
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    int tot=sum/2;
    dp[0]=1;
    for (int i=n; i; i--) {
        for (int j=tot; j>=0; j--) dp[j+a[i]]|=dp[j];
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=sum; i++) if (dp[i]) ans=i;
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1336.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL A=1234,B=101,C=107,M=19260817;
const double eps=1e-12;
int Rand() {
    A=(A*B+C)%M;
    return int(A);
}

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
} p[500005];
double dis(point a,point b) {
    return sqrt((a.x-b.x)*(a.x-b.x)+(a.y-b.y)*(a.y-b.y));
}
point mid(point a,point b) {
    return point((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2);
}

point center(point a,point b,point c) {
    double a1=b.x-a.x,b1=b.y-a.y,c1=(a1*a1+b1*b1)/2;
    double a2=c.x-a.x,b2=c.y-a.y,c2=(a2*a2+b2*b2)/2;
    double d=a1*b2-a2*b1;
    return (point) {
        a.x+(c1*b2-c2*b1)/d,a.y+(a1*c2-a2*c1)/d
    };
}
int n;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
        if (i&2) swap(p[i],p[Rand()%(i-1)+1]);
    }
    point O=p[1];
    double r=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis(O,p[i])>eps+r) {
            O=p[i];
            r=0;
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++)
                if (dis(O,p[j])>eps+r) {
                    O=mid(p[i],p[j]);
                    r=dis(O,p[j]);
                    for (int k=1; k<j; k++) {
                        if (dis(O,p[k])>eps+r) {
                            O=center(p[i],p[j],p[k]);
                            r=dis(O,p[j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    printf("%.10lf\n%.10lf %.10lf\n",r,O.x,O.y);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1367.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 1000005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int key, d, siz;
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->l = ptr->r = null;
    ptr->key = v;
    ptr->d = ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node *merge(Node *x, Node *y) {
    if (x == null) return y;
    if (y == null) return x;
    if (x->key < y->key) swap(x, y);
    x->r = merge(x->r, y);
    if (x->l->d < x->r->d) swap(x->l, x->r);
    x->d = x->r->d + 1;
    x->siz = x->l->siz + x->r->siz + 1;
    return x;
}

int n, a[MAXN];
Node *sta[MAXN];
int tot[MAXN], top = 0;
LL ans = 0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        a[i] -= i;
        Node *x = newNode(a[i]);
        int nowtot = 1;
        while (top && sta[top]->key > x->key) {
            nowtot += tot[top];
            x = merge(x, sta[top--]);
            while (x->siz > nowtot / 2 + 1) {
                x = merge(x->l, x->r);
            }
        }
        tot[++top] = nowtot;
        sta[top] = x;
    }
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
        while (!tot[top]--) top--;
        ans += abs(sta[top]->key - a[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

int n;

int get(char *s) {
    int i = 0, j = 1, k = 0;
    while (i < n && j < n && k < n) {
        if (s[(i + k) % n] == s[(j + k) % n]) k++;
        else {
            s[(i + k) % n] > s[(j + k) % n] ? i += k + 1 : j += k + 1;
            if (i == j) j++;
            k = 0;
        }
    }
    return min(i, j);
}

            flag = 0;
            break;
        }
    if (flag) {
        puts("Yes");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) putchar(a[(i + mi) % n]);
        puts("");
    } else puts("No");
    return 0;
}

#define MAXM MAXN*4

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXM*2];

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN],tag[MAXN],cur[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void add_2(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int source=0,sink=1;
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(source);
    tag[source]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[sink]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==sink) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow));
            if (ret) {
                usd+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(source,12345678);
    }
    return ans;
}

                    else add(0,1);
                } else if (m[i][j]==2) {
                    if (m[i-1][j]==0) add(ttt[i-1][j],1);
                    else add(0,1);
                } else {
                    if (m[i-1][j]==1) add(0,ttt[i][j]);
                    else add(ttt[i][j],1);
                }
            }
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=r; i++)
        for (int j=2; j<=c; j++) {
            if (m[i][j]==m[i][j-1]) {

//BZOJ1443.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

#define MAXN 105

int n,m,S,T;
char map[MAXN][MAXN];
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[(MAXN*MAXN)<<4];

int ecnt=1,head[MAXN*MAXN],cur[MAXN*MAXN],tag[MAXN*MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]!=0;
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x==T) return 1;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x])
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].flow^=1;
                e[now^1].flow^=1;
                return 1;
            }
    }
    return 0;
}

void dinic() {
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=S; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        while (dfs(S));
    }
}

#define pos(i,j) ((i-1)*m+j)

bool ans[MAXN*MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN*MAXN];

void update(int x,bool st) {
    visit[x]=1;
    if (st) {
        ans[x]=1;
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (!e[now].flow && e[now].to!=S && e[now].to!=T && !visit[e[now].to]) {
            update(e[now].to,st^1);
        }
    }
}

void build(int x) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++)
            if (map[i][j]=='.' && (((i^j)&1)==x)) {
                if (i>1 && map[i-1][j]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i-1,j));
                if (i<n && map[i+1][j]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i+1,j));
                if (j>1 && map[i][j-1]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j-1));
                if (j<m && map[i][j+1]=='.') add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j+1));
                add(S,pos(i,j));
            }
    x^=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]=='.' && (((i^j)&1)==x)) {
                add(pos(i,j),T);
            }
        }
    }
}

bool flag=0;
void work(int x) {
    build(x);
    dinic();
    memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (((i^j)&1)!=x && map[i][j]=='.' && head[pos(i,j)] && e[head[pos(i,j)]].flow && !visit[pos(i,j)]) {
                flag=1;
                update(pos(i,j),1);
            }
        }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    S=0;
    T=n*m+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",map[i]+1);
    }
    work(0);
    work(1);
    if (flag) {
        puts("WIN");
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (ans[pos(i,j)]) {
                    printf("%d %d\n",i,j);
                }
            }
    } else puts("LOSE");
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

#define N 10005
#define NN (N + 1024)
struct edge {
    int next, to,  w;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 3 * 4];

int head[NN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v,  w, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, -w, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int S = 0, T = 1, node;

#define TOP 8191
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int q[TOP + 1], pre[NN], dis[NN];
bool inq[NN];
LL ans = 0;

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, (node + 1) * 4);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    dis[q[0] = S] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q[(ta++) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

LL solve() {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f = 0, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f = 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n, m;
int W[N], L[N], C[N], D[N], d[N];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(W[i]);
        read(L[i]);
        read(C[i]);
        read(D[i]);
    }
    node = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        d[u]++;
        d[v]++;
        int to = ++node;
        add(to, T, 0);
        add(u + 1, to, 0);
        add(v + 1, to, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL now = C[i] * power(W[i]) + D[i] * power(L[i] + d[i]);
        ans += now;
        for (int j = 1; j <= d[i]; j++) {
            LL tmp = C[i] * power(W[i] + j) + D[i] * power(L[i] + d[i] - j);
            add(S, i + 1, int(tmp - now));
            now = tmp;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans + solve());
    return 0;
}

    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();

    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 10319

    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;

int n, p, k;
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x, int fa) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to, x);
    }
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x, 0);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs > siz[x] / 2) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int dep[MAXN], s[MAXN], top;
int ext[1000319], tag = 0;

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    s[++top] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

bool work(int x) {
    ext[0] = ++tag;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            top = 0;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) if (ext[k - s[i]] == tag) return 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) ext[s[i]] = tag;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    if (work(x)) return 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) if (solve(e[now].to)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void init() {
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
        read(k);
        if (k == 0) {
            puts("Yes");
            continue;
        }
        init();
        if (solve(1)) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

            for (int i = 1; i <= top; i++) ext[s[i]] = tag;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    if (work(x)) return 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) if (solve(e[now].to)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void init() {
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
        read(k);
        if (k == 0) {
            puts("Yes");
            continue;
        }
        init();
        if (solve(1)) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1468.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 40319

LL ans = 0;

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, k;
int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x, int fa) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to] && e[now].to != fa) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to, x);
    }
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x, 0);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = 0, to = -1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt]) {
                if (siz[e[now].to] > maxs) maxs = siz[e[now].to], to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs > siz[x] / 2) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int l[MAXN], lcnt = 0, dep[MAXN];

void dd(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    l[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa && !vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, x);
        }
    }
}

LL work(int rt, int base) {
    dep[rt] = base;
    lcnt = 0;
    dd(rt, 0);
    sort(l + 1, l + lcnt + 1);
    LL ret = 0;
    int i = 1, j = lcnt;
    while (i < j) {
        if (l[i] + l[j] <= k) ret += j - i, i++;
        else j--;
    }
    return ret;
}

void solve(int x) {
    int rt = find(x);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    ans += work(rt, 0);
    for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            ans -= work(e[now].to, e[now].w);
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    read(k);
    solve(1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1475.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
#define MAXN 999

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 4 * 2];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, node;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (T + 1));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = T; i >= 0; i--) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    T = n * n + 1;
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1, aij; j <= n; j++) {
            read(aij);
            tot += aij;
            if ((i ^ j) & 1) {
                add(S, (i - 1) * n + j, aij);
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int x = i + dx[d], y = j + dy[d];
                    if (x && x <= n && y && y <= n) {
                        add((i - 1) * n + j, (x - 1) * n + y, INF);
                    }
                }
            } else add((i - 1) * n + j, T, aij);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", tot - dinic());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
