#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000005

int n, m, ans = 0;
int c[MAXN], he[MAXN], siz[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], fa[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(c[i]);
        fa[c[i]] = c[i];
        nxt[i] = he[c[i]];
        he[c[i]] = i;
        siz[c[i]]++;
    }
    ans = !!n;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) ans += c[i] != c[i - 1];
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 2) printf("%d\n", ans);
        else {
            int x, y, last;
            read(x);
            read(y);
            if (siz[fa[x]] > siz[fa[y]]) swap(fa[x], fa[y]);
            x = fa[x], y = fa[y];
            if (x == y || !siz[x]) continue;
            for (int i = he[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (c[i - 1] == y) ans--;
                if (c[i + 1] == y) ans--;
                last = i;
            }
            for (int i = he[x]; i; i = nxt[i]) c[i] = y;
            siz[y] += siz[x];
            nxt[last] = he[y];
            he[y] = he[x];
            siz[x] = 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1500.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 500005

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void readOp(int &a) {
    while (ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z') ch = getchar();
    switch (ch) {
    case 'I':
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'D':
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'R':
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'G':
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M':
        getchar();
        a = (getchar() == 'K') ? 3 : 6;
    }
    while (ch != ' ' && ch != '\n') ch = getchar();
}

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, sum, head, tail, mid;
    bool rev, same;
    Node () : siz(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF), rev(0), same(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void setv(int v) {
        siz = 1;
        sum = val = head = tail = mid = v;
    }
    void relax();
    void sameIt(int v) {
        same = 1, rev = 0;
        sum = (val = v) * siz;
        head = tail = mid = v > 0 ? sum : v;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        swap(head, tail);
    }
    void upd();
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = new Node();
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->setv(v);
    return x;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (same) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->sameIt(val);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->sameIt(val);
        same = 0, rev = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

void Node::upd()  {
    if (this == null) return;
    relax();
    if (c[0] != null) c[0]->relax();
    if (c[1] != null) c[1]->relax();
    siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
    head = max(c[0]->head, c[0]->sum + val + max(0, c[1]->head));
    tail = max(c[1]->tail, c[1]->sum + val + max(0, c[0]->tail));
    mid = max(max(max(head, tail), max(c[0]->mid, c[1]->mid)), max(0, c[0]->tail) + val + max(c[1]->head, 0));
}

Node* build(int tot) {
    if (tot <= 0) return null;
    int mid = tot >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode();
    x->setc(build(mid), 0);
    int v;
    read(v);
    x->setv(v);
    x->setc(build(tot - mid - 1), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

	if (x->c[0] != null) dfs_array(x->c[0]);
	printf("%d ",x->val);

}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    //printf("rot %lld %lld\n", x == null ? -1ll : (long long)x, fa == null ? -1ll : (long long)fa);
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        //	printf("X = %lld FA = %lld(%lld)\n", x == null ? -1ll : (long long)x, fa == null ? -1ll : (long long)fa, x->fa->fa == null ? -1ll : (long long)x->fa->fa);
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ;) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) { // [l,r)
//	printf("Pick %d %d\n", l - 1, r);
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
//	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", L, R, null);
//	puts("Select Success");
    splay(L);/* puts("1"); */splay(R, L); /*puts("2");*/
    return R->c[0];
}

int step[MAXN];
Node *sta[MAXN];

void del(Node *rt) {
    rt->fa->setc(null, rt->dir());
    int top = 1;
    sta[top] = rt, step[top] = -1;
    while (top) {
        if (++step[top] == 2) delete(sta[top--]);
        else if (sta[top]->c[step[top]] != null) sta[top + 1] = sta[top]->c[step[top]], step[++top] = -1;
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    (root = newNode())->setc(newNode(), 1);
    root->c[1]->setc(build(n), 0);
    root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
    //dfs_prt(root, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op, pos, tot, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readOp(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            n += tot;
            get(pos + 1, pos + 1);
            root->c[1]->setc(build(tot), 0);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 2 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            n -= tot;
            del(get(pos, pos + tot));
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 3 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            read(v);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->sameIt(v);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 4 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->revIt();
            root->c[0]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 5 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            printf("%d\n", get(pos, pos + tot)->sum);
            break;
        case 6 :
            printf("%d\n", get(1, n + 1)->mid);
        }
        //	dfs_prt(root, 0);
        //	dfs_array(root);
    }
    return 0;
}

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = new Node();
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->setv(v);
    return x;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (same) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->sameIt(val);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->sameIt(val);
        same = 0, rev = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

void Node::upd()  {
    relax();
    if (c[0] != null) c[0]->relax();
    if (c[1] != null) c[1]->relax();
    siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
    head = max(c[0]->head, c[0]->sum + val + max(0, c[1]->head));
    tail = max(c[1]->tail, c[1]->sum + val + max(0, c[0]->tail));
    mid = max(max(max(head, tail), max(c[0]->mid, c[1]->mid)), max(0, c[0]->tail) + val + max(c[1]->head, 0));
}

Node* build(int tot) {
    if (tot <= 0) return null;
    int mid = tot >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode();
    x->setc(build(mid), 0);
    int v;
    read(v);
    x->setv(v);
    x->setc(build(tot - mid - 1), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ;) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int step[MAXN];
Node *sta[MAXN];

void del(Node *rt) {
    rt->fa->setc(null, rt->dir());
    int top = 1;
    sta[top] = rt, step[top] = -1;
    while (top) {
        if (++step[top] == 2) delete(sta[top--]);
        else if (sta[top]->c[step[top]] != null) sta[top + 1] = sta[top]->c[step[top]], step[++top] = -1;
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    (root = newNode())->setc(newNode(), 1);
    root->c[1]->setc(build(n), 0);
    root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
    for (int i = 1, op, pos, tot, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readOp(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            n += tot;
            get(pos + 1, pos + 1);
            root->c[1]->setc(build(tot), 0);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 2 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            n -= tot;
            del(get(pos, pos + tot));
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 3 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            read(v);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->sameIt(v);
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 4 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            get(pos, pos + tot)->revIt();
            root->c[1]->upd(), root->upd();
            break;
        case 5 :
            read(pos);
            read(tot);
            printf("%d\n", get(pos, pos + tot)->sum);
            break;
        case 6 :
            printf("%d\n", get(1, n + 1)->mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {

    }

inline void readOp(int &a) {
    while (ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z') ch = getchar();
    switch (ch) {
    case 'I':
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'D':
        a = 2;
        break;
    case 'R':
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'G':
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M':
        getchar();
        a = (getchar() == 'K') ? 3 : 6;
    }

}

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val, sum, head, tail, mid;
    bool rev, same;
    Node () : siz(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF), rev(0), same(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void setv(int v) {
        siz = 1;
        sum = val = head = tail = mid = v;
    }
    void relax();
    void sameIt(int v) {
        same = 1, rev = 0;
        sum = (val = v) * siz;
        head = tail = mid = v > 0 ? sum : v;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        swap(head, tail);
    }
    void upd();
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

}

}

//BZOJ1503.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 300000
#define s 131072
#define INF 1000000009

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void getop(int &op) {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='I') op=0;
    else if (ch=='A') op=1;
    else if (ch=='S') op=2;
    else op=3;
}

int n,minv;
int op[MAXN],a[MAXN],t[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1],M[s<<1];
int tem[MAXN],ntem=0,cnt=0;

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    read(minv);
    for (int i=1,delta=0; i<=n; i++) {
        getop(op[i]);
        read(a[i]);
        if (op[i]==0) {
            a[i]+=delta;
            tem[++ntem]=a[i];
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            delta-=a[i];
        } else if (op[i]==2) {
            delta+=a[i];
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+ntem+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+ntem+1)-tem);
    tem[0]=-INF,tem[ntem]=INF;
    for (int i=1; i<=ntem; i++) {
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=M[s+i]=tem[i];
    }
    for (int i=ntem+1; i<s; i++) {
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=M[s+i]=INF+i;
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)|1];
        M[i]=R[i<<1];
    }
}

void update(int x,int p) {
    if (t[x]==0 && x<s) t[x<<1]=t[(x<<1)|1]=0;
    t[x]++;
    if (x>=s) return;
    if (p<=M[x]) update(x<<1,p);
    else update((x<<1)|1,p);
}

void clear(int x,int l,int r) {
    if (t[x]==0) return;
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]=0;
        return;
    }
    if (l<=M[x]) clear(x<<1,l,min(r,M[x]));
    if (r>M[x]) clear((x<<1)|1,max(l,L[(x<<1)|1]),r);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)|1];
}

int query(int x,int rnk) {
    if (x>=s) return x-s;
    if (t[x<<1]<rnk) return query((x<<1)|1,rnk-t[x<<1]);
    return query(x<<1,rnk);
}

inline void letsgo() {
    int l=0,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        if (tem[(mid=(l+r+1)>>1)]<minv) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    if (l) clear(1,tem[1],tem[l]);
}

inline void work() {
    int delta=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (op[i]==0) {
            if (a[i]>=minv) cnt++,update(1,a[i]);
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            minv-=a[i];
            delta+=a[i];
        } else if (op[i]==2) {
            minv+=a[i];
            delta-=a[i];
            letsgo();
        } else {
            if (a[i]>t[1]) printf("-1\n");
            else printf("%d\n",delta+tem[query(1,t[1]-a[i]+1)]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",cnt-t[1]);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 2333333

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz;
    char v;
    inline bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    inline void sc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

Node *newNode(char v) {
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->sc(x, fa->d());
    fa->sc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->sc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (rt == fa) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *kth(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        int ls = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < ls) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > ls) k -= ls + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

Node *Get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = kth(l - 1), *R = kth(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return rt->c[1];
}

int pos = 0;

char tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(tmp[mid]);
    x->sc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->sc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (x->v) putchar(x->v);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

void ins() {
    int n, i = 0;
    read(n);
    ch = getchar();
    while (i < n) {
        if (ch >= 32 && ch <= 126) tmp[i++] = (char)ch;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    tmp[n] = 0;
    Get(pos + 1, pos)->sc(build(0, n - 1), 0);
    rt->c[1]->upd();
    rt->upd();
}

void del() {
    int n;
    read(n);
    Get(pos + 1, pos + n)->sc(null, 0);
    rt->c[1]->upd();
    rt->upd();
}

void mov() {
    int k;
    read(k);
    pos = k;
}

void get() {
    int n;
    read(n);
    dfs(Get(pos + 1, pos + n)->c[0]);
    putchar('\n');
}

void pre() {
    pos--;
}

void nxt() {
    pos++;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode('{');
    rt->sc(newNode('}'), 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", tmp);

            break;

            break;

            break;
        case 'N' :

            break;

    }

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        ans--;
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

        merge(i,x);
    }

#define MAXN 40010
struct Read {
    int u,v;
} re[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<3];

int n,m,ecnt,S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tag[MAXN],cur[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=n+m+1; i>=0; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7ffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(int mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(i+1,T,mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(S,n+i+1,1);
        add(n+i+1,re[i].u+1,1);
        add(n+i+1,re[i].v+1,1);
    }
    return dinic()==m;
}

    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(re[i].u);
        read(re[i].v);
    }
    int l=(m>0),r=m,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;

typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct fuck {
    int v, x;
    fuck () {}
    fuck (int a) : v(a), x(0) {}
    fuck (int a, int b) : v(a), x(b) {}
    void r(int i) {
        read(v);
        x = i;
    }
    bool operator < (fuck a) const {
        return v < a.v || (v == a.v && x < a.x);
    }
    bool operator == (fuck a) const {
        return v == a.v && x == a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2];
    bool rev;
    fuck v, mi;
    int siz;
    Node () : rev(0), v(INF), mi(INF) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        mi = min(min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi), v);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
} mem[100005], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root;

int n;

Node *newNode(fuck v) {
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->v = ptr->mi = v;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int cnt(Node *x, fuck v) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (1) {
        x->relax();
        if (x->c[0]->mi == v) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->v == v) return ret + x->c[0]->siz;
        else ret += x->c[0]->siz + 1, x = x->c[1];
    }
}

    a[0] = INF;
    a[n + 1] = INF;
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        Node *x = get(i, n);
        int ret = cnt(x, a[i]);
        printf("%d%c", ret + i, i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        x = get(i, ret + i);
        x->revIt();
    }
    return 0;
}

            vis[to[x][i]] = stp;
            if (!mat[to[x][i]] || find(mat[to[x][i]])) return mat[to[x][i]] = x, 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

char tmp[33];
LD f[MAXN];
inline LD W(int i, int j) {
    LD a = sum[j] - sum[i] - L, ret = 1;
    for (int k = p; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret *= a;
        a *= a;
    }
    return ret < 0 ? -ret : ret;
}

inline void work() {
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(p);
    L++;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", tmp);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (int)strlen(tmp) + 1;
    }
    int he, ta, l, r, mid;
    R[0] = 0;
    q[he = ta = 1] = 0;
    R[ta] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (R[he] < i) he++;
        f[i] = f[q[he]] + W(q[he], i);
        while (he <= ta && f[q[ta]] + W(q[ta], R[ta - 1] + 1) > f[i] + W(i, R[ta - 1] + 1)) q[ta--] = 0;
        l = max(R[ta - 1], i) + 1, r = n + 1;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (f[q[ta]] + W(q[ta], mid) >= f[i] + W(i, mid)) r = mid;
            else l = mid + 1;
        }
        if (l > n) continue;
        R[ta] = l - 1;
        R[++ta] = n;
        q[ta] = i;
    }
    if (f[n] > 1000000000000000000ll) puts("Too hard to arrange");
    else printf("%lld\n", LL(f[n] + 0.5));
}

#define MAXN 105
typedef long long LL;

    int a, b, c;
    bool operator < (Node x) const {
        return a < x.a;
    }

int n, K, L[MAXN];
LL sum[MAXN], f[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

LL dp(int l, int r, int x) {
    if (l > r) return  0;
    if (vis[l][r][x]) return f[l][r][x];
    vis[l][r][x] = 1;
    LL &ret = f[l][r][x];
    ret = 0x23333333333333 - (sum[r] - sum[l - 1]);
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        ret = min(ret, dp(l, i - 1, x) + dp(i + 1, r, x) + (x == q[i].b ? 0 : K));
    }
    ret += sum[r] - sum[l - 1];
    if (x < n) ret = min(ret, dp(l, r, x + 1));
    return ret;
}

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) q[i].b = tag[q[i].b];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + q[i].c;
    printf("%lld\n", dp(1, n, 1));

}

//BZOJ1574.cpp

    int next,to;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int p,c,n,ans,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
bool visit[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void tag(int x) {
    visit[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) visit[e[now].to]=1;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    if (visit[x]) return;
    visit[x]=1;
    ans--;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) dfs(e[now].to);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&p,&c,&n);
    ans=p;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=c; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    for (int i=1,r; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&r);
        tag(r);
    }
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1579.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXM 50005
#define S 262144
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXM * 2];
LL dis[22][MAXN], t[S * 2];
bool vis[22][MAXN];

void update(int x, LL v) {
    for (t[x += S] = v; x >>= 1; t[x]= min(t[x << 1], t[x << 1 | 1]));
}
int getmin() {
    int x = 1;
    while (x < S) x <<= 1, x ^= (t[x] > t[x ^ 1]);
    return x - S;
}

int n, m, K;

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dijkstra() {
    memset(t, 0x3f, sizeof t);
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
    update(1, 0);
    for (int x = 1; t[x + S] < INF; x = getmin()) {
        int k = (x - 1) / n, p = x - k * n;
        dis[k][p] = t[x + S];
        vis[k][p] = 1;
        update(x, INF);
        if (k <= K) for (int now = head[p]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (!vis[k][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + S] > dis[k][p] + e[now].w)
                    update(e[now].to + k * n, dis[k][p] + e[now].w);
                if (!vis[k + 1][e[now].to] && t[e[now].to + k * n + n + S] > dis[k][p])
                    update(e[now].to + k * n + n, dis[k][p]);
            }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    dijkstra();
    printf("%lld\n", dis[K][n]);
    return 0;
}

}

//BZOJ1593.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
struct Rg {
    int l, r;
    Rg () :l(0), r(-1) {}
    Rg (int a) : l(a), r(a) {}
    Rg (int a, int b) : l(a), r(b) {}
    bool empty() {
        return l == 0 && r == -1;
    }
    bool geq(int x) {
        return r + 1 >= x + l;
    }
    bool operator < (Rg a) const {
        return (r +  a.l < l + a.r) || (r +  a.l == l + a.r && l > a.l);
    }
    bool operator == (Rg a) const {
        return l == a.l && r == a.r;
    }
    int size() {
        return r - l + 1;
    }
    Rg operator + (Rg a) {
        if (empty()) return a;
        if (a.empty()) return *this;
        return Rg(min(l, a.l), max(r, a.r));
    }
} E(0, -1);

struct Node {
    Rg hd, md, tl, fu;
    int l, r;
    bool f, c;
    void fillIt() {
        c = 0, f = 1;
        hd = md = tl = E;
    }
    void clrIt() {
        c = 1, f = 0;
        hd = md = tl = fu;
    }
} t[131072];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].hd = t[t[x].l].hd == t[t[x].l].fu ? t[t[x].l].fu + t[t[x].r].hd : t[t[x].l].hd;
    t[x].tl = t[t[x].r].tl == t[t[x].r].fu ? t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].fu : t[t[x].r].tl;
    t[x].md = max(max(max(t[x].hd, t[x].tl), max(t[t[x].l].md, t[t[x].r].md)), t[t[x].l].tl + t[t[x].r].hd);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].f) t[t[x].l].fillIt(), t[t[x].r].fillIt(), t[x].f = 0;
    else if (t[x].c) t[t[x].l].clrIt(), t[t[x].r].clrIt(), t[x].c = 0;
}

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].hd = t[x].tl = t[x].md = Rg(l);
    t[x].fu = t[x].md;
    return x;
}

void fill(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].fillIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) fill(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) fill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void clr(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) t[x].clrIt();
    else {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) clr(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr > mid) clr(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int d) {
    if (l == r) return fill(1, 1, n, l, l), l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (t[t[x].l].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, d);
    else if (!t[t[x].l].tl.empty() && t[t[x].l].tl.size() + t[t[x].r].hd.size() >= d) ret = t[t[x].l].tl.l, fill(1, 1, n, t[t[x].l].tl.l, t[t[x].l].tl.l + d - 1);
    else if (t[t[x].r].md.geq(d)) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, d);
    else assert(0);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, x, d; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 1) read(d), printf("%d\n", t[1].md.geq(d) ? query(1, 1, n, d) : 0);
        else read(x), read(d), clr(1, 1, n, x, x + d - 1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1597.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
#define MAXN 50005

struct Rect {
    int x, y;
    bool operator < (Rect a) const {
        if (x != a.x) return x < a.x;
        else return y < a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN], sta[MAXN];

int n, m = 0;
LL f[MAXN], xx[MAXN], yy[MAXN];

LD slope(int u, int v) {
    return LD(f[u] - f[v]) / (yy[v] - yy[u]);
}

struct monoStack {
    int l, r;
    int v[MAXN];
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    void maintain(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < xx[x]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int x) {
        while (l < r && slope(x, v[r]) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = x;
    }
} s;

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d%d", &a[i].x, &a[i].y);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (m && a[i].y >= sta[m].y) m--;
        sta[++m] = a[i];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        xx[i] = sta[i].x;
        yy[i - 1] = sta[i].y;
    }
    f[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        s.maintain(i);
        int to = s[s.l];
        f[i] = f[to] + xx[i] * yy[to];
        s.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1601.cpp

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

struct edge {
    int u,v,w;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),w(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return w<a.w;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,ecnt=0,f[MAXN];
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 1;
    if (f[fu]<fv) {
        f[fu]+=f[fv];
        f[fv]=fu;
    } else {
        f[fv]+=f[fu];
        f[fu]=fv;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int w;
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt]=edge(0,i,w);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            int w;
            read(w);
            if (i!=j) e[++ecnt]=edge(i,j,w);
        }
    sort(e+1,e+ecnt+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (merge(e[j].u,e[j].v)) j++;
        ans+=e[j].w;
        j++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1602.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int n,ecnt=0,q,fa[MAXN][15],dep[MAXN],dis[MAXN],head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int k=1; k<=12; k++) {
        fa[x][k]=fa[fa[x][k-1]][k-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    if (dep[u]<dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    int x=dep[u]-dep[v];
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) u=fa[u][k];
    }
    if (u==v) return u;
    for (int k=12; k>-1; k--) {
        if (fa[u][k]!=fa[v][k]) {
            u=fa[u][k];
            v=fa[v][k];
        }
    }
    return fa[u][0];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&q);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    fa[1][0]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    dep[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=q; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&u,&v);
        printf("%d\n",dis[u]+dis[v]-2*dis[getLCA(u,v)]);
    }
    return 0;
}

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            val[e[now].to]=val[x]^e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
        }
    }
}

int main() {

    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w^1);
        add(v,u,w^1);
    }
    val[1]=1;
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%d\n",val[n]);
    return 0;
}

    int id;
    data() {}
    data(LL b):x(0),y(b),id(0) {}
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }
} a[MAXN];
bool cmp(data q,data w) {
    return q.x<w.x;
}
int n,C,f[MAXN],ans,cnt[MAXN];
multiset<data> Tree;
multiset<data>::iterator it;
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
        ans--;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&C);
    ans=n;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x,y;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        a[i].x=x+y;
        a[i].y=x-y;
        a[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,cmp);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    Tree.insert(a[1]);
    Tree.insert(data(-INF));
    Tree.insert(data(INF));
    for (int i=2,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        while (a[i].x-a[j].x>C) {
            it=Tree.find(a[j]);
            Tree.erase(it);
            j++;
        }
        it=Tree.lower_bound(a[i]);
        data x=*it;
        if (x.y-a[i].y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        x=*--it;
        if (a[i].y-x.y<=C) merge(a[i].id,x.id);
        Tree.insert(a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d ",ans);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cnt[getf(i)]++;
    int MAX=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) MAX=max(cnt[i],MAX);
    printf("%d\n",MAX);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1605.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 1005
const int dy[]= {0,1,-1,0},dx[]= {1,0,0,-1};
const char dd[]= {'E','N','S','W'};
struct statu {
    int t,x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b,int c):t(a),x(b),y(c) {}
};
int n,m,k;
int x[1050],y[1050],dp[32][64][64];
LL from[32][64][64];
bool ok[1050][1050],visit[32][64][64];
queue <statu> q;
string seq;

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",x+i,y+i);
    }
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&xx,&yy);
        ok[xx+31][yy+31]=1;
    }
    memset(from,127,sizeof(from));
    q.push(statu(0,31,31));
    from[0][31][31]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        statu now=q.front();
        q.pop();
        LL st=from[now.t][now.x][now.y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=now.x+dx[d],toy=now.y+dy[d],temp=dp[now.t][now.x][now.y];
            for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
                if (ok[tox+x[i]][toy+y[i]]) temp++;
            }
            if (temp>dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]) {
                dp[now.t+1][tox][toy]=temp;
                from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            } else if (temp==dp[now.t+1][tox][toy] && from[now.t+1][tox][toy]>((st<<2)|d)) from[now.t+1][tox][toy]=(st<<2)|d;
            if (!visit[now.t+1][tox][toy] && now.t+1<k) {
                q.push(statu(now.t+1,tox,toy));
            }
            visit[now.t+1][tox][toy]=1;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++)
            ans=max(ans,dp[k][i][j]);
    if (ans==0) {
        printf("0\n");
        for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) putchar('E');
        putchar('\n');
        return 0;
    }
    LL sta=0x7fffffffffffffffll;
    for (int i=0; i<64; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<64; j++) {
            if (dp[k][i][j]==ans) {
                sta=min(sta,from[k][i][j]);
            }
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    for (int i=k-1; i>-1; i--) {
        putchar(dd[3&(sta>>(i<<1))]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);

    k[0]=k[1]-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (k[i]-k[i-1]>10e-8) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);

//BZOJ1611.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {0,1,-1,0,0};
int map[305][305];
int dis[305][305];

int n;
void mark(int x,int y,int c) {
    for (int i=0; i<=4; i++) {
        int tox=x+dx[i],toy=y+dy[i];
        map[tox][toy]=min(map[tox][toy],c);
    }
}
struct statu {
    int x,y;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
};
queue<statu> q;

int main() {
    memset(map,31,sizeof(map));
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1,x,y,c; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&x,&y,&c);
        mark(x+1,y+1,c-1);
    }
    if (map[1][1]<0) {
        puts("-1");
        return 0;
    }
    dis[1][1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,1));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().x,y=q.front().y;
        q.pop();
        if (map[x][y]==0x1f1f1f1f) {
            printf("%d\n",dis[x][y]);
            return 0;
        }
        for (int d=1; d<=4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && toy && dis[tox][toy]==0x1f1f1f1f && map[tox][toy]>dis[x][y]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                q.push(statu(tox,toy));
            }
        }
    }
    puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) map[i][i]=1;
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {

        read(v);
        map[u][v]=1;
    }

        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (map[i][k])
                for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) if (map[k][j]) map[i][j]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int tot=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {

    }

//BZOJ1614.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#define MAXP 10005
#define MAXN 1005
#define INF 522133279
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXP<<1];

struct statu {
    int x,dep;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _x,int _d):x(_x),dep(_d) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return dep<a.dep;
    }
};

int n,p,k,ecnt;
int head[MAXN],visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline bool check(int val) {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    memset(visit,31,sizeof(visit));
    visit[1]=0;
    q.push(statu(1,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x;
        if (x==n) return 1;
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to,dis=visit[x]+(e[now].w>val);
            if (visit[v]>dis && dis<=k) {
                visit[v]=dis;
                q.push(statu(v,dis));
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&p,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=p; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    int l=0,r=1000001,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid))
            r=mid;
        else
            l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>1000000) l=-1;
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1615.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1100
int n,fa[MAXN],S,T;
double x[MAXN],y[MAXN],r[MAXN],x_t,y_t,s[MAXN],ans=0;;

bool flag=0;

double dis(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt((x[a]-x[b])*(x[a]-x[b])+(y[a]-y[b])*(y[a]-y[b]));
}

void dfs(int p) {
    ans+=s[p];
    if (p==T) {
        flag=1;
        printf("%d\n",int(ans));
        return;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (abs(dis(p,i)-(r[i]+r[p]))<1e-8 && i!=fa[p]) {
            fa[i]=p;
            s[i]=s[p]*r[p]/r[i];
            dfs(i);
            if (flag) return;
        }
    }
    ans-=s[p];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lf%lf",&n,&x_t,&y_t);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf",x+i,y+i,r+i);
        if (x[i]==0 && y[i]==0) S=i;
        else if (x[i]==x_t && y[i]==y_t) T=i;
    }
    s[S]=10000;
    fa[S]=0;
    dfs(S);
    return 0;
}

    }

#include <cmath>

#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXD 50005
int n,h;
int dp[MAXD];

inline void update(int x,int c) {
    for (int i=0; i<h; i++) {
        dp[min(i+x,h)]=min(dp[min(i+x,h)],dp[i]+c);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(h);
    memset(dp,0x3f,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=0;
    for (int i=1,p,c; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p);
        read(c);
        update(p,c);
    }
    printf("%d\n",dp[h]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1619.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0,1,-1,1,-1},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1,1,1,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 705
struct point {
    int x,y,v;
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
} p[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,m,pcnt=0,ans=0;
int map[MAXN][MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN][MAXN];
void dfs(int x,int y) {
    visit[x][y]=1;
    for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (!visit[tox][toy] && map[tox][toy]<=map[x][y]) dfs(tox,toy);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            p[++pcnt].x=i,p[pcnt].y=j,p[pcnt].v=map[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=n+1; i++) visit[i][0]=visit[i][m+1]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) visit[0][i]=visit[n+1][i]=1;
    sort(p+1,p+pcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        if (!visit[p[i].x][p[i].y]) {
            dfs(p[i].x,p[i].y);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

int n,k,ans=0;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (x>k && !((x+k)&1) && !((x-k)&1)) {
        dfs((x+k)>>1);
        dfs((x-k)>>1);
        return;
    }
    ans++;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    dfs(n);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
int n,m,len[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],slen;
char a[MAXN][MAXN],s[MAXN];

bool check(int x) {
    for (int i=0,j=0; i<len[x]; i++) {
        if (a[x][i]==s[j]) {
            j++;
            if (j==slen) return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",a[i]);
        len[i]=(int)strlen(a[i]);
        for (int j=0; j<len[i]; j++) {
            if (a[i][j]>='a') a[i][j]-='a'-'A';
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s);
        slen=(int)strlen(s);
        for (int j=0; j<slen; j++) {
            if (s[j]>='a') s[j]-='a'-'A';
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (check(j)) cnt[j]++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",cnt[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXM 10005

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)read(a[i]);

//BZOJ1626.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
typedef long long LL;
int n,m,f[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}
void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}
bool visit[MAXN];
double dis[MAXN],ans=0;
LL power(LL x) {
    return x*x;
}
LL X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
double dist(int a,int b) {
    return sqrt(power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]));
}
void prim() {
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) dis[i]=1e9;
    int x=1,to;
    double mindis;
    while (1) {
        visit[x]=1;
        to=-1;
        mindis=1e10;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            if (!visit[i]) {
                if (getf(i)==getf(x)) {
                    dis[i]=0;
                } else {
                    dis[i]=min(dis[i],dist(x,i));
                }
                if (dis[i]<mindis) {
                    mindis=dis[i];
                    to=i;
                }
            }
        }
        if (to==-1) break;
        ans+=mindis;
        merge(x,to);
        x=to;
    }
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,xx,yy; i<=n; i++) {
        read(xx);
        read(yy);
        X[i]=xx,Y[i]=yy;
    }
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u,v);
    }
    prim();
    printf("%.2lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1627.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {0,0,1,-1},dy[]= {1,-1,0,0};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int tx,ty,n,dis[1024][1024];
bool map[1024][1024];
queue <int> q;
int bfs() {
    map[512][512]=1;
    dis[512][512]=0;
    q.push((512<<11)|512);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front()>>11,y=q.front()&2047;
        q.pop();
        if (x==tx && y==ty) return dis[x][y];
        for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
            int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
            if (tox && tox<1023 && toy && toy<1023 && !map[tox][toy]) {
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[x][y]+1;
                map[tox][toy]=1;
                q.push((tox<<11)|toy);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    read(tx);
    read(ty);
    read(n);
    tx+=512,ty+=512;
    memset(dis,0x3f,sizeof(dis));
    for (int i=1,a,b; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        read(b);
        map[a+512][b+512]=1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",bfs());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1630.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 1000000
int T,A,S,B;
int dp[2][100005],sum[2][100005],N[1005];

int main() {
    read(T);
    read(A);
    read(S);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=A; i++) {
        read(x);
        N[x]++;
    }
    dp[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=0; i<=A; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
        int now=i&1,prev=now^1;
        sum[now][0]=1;
        dp[now][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=A; j++) {
            if (j>N[i]) dp[now][j]=MOD+sum[prev][j]-sum[prev][j-N[i]-1];
            else dp[now][j]=sum[prev][j];
            if (dp[now][j]>=MOD) dp[now][j]-=MOD;
            sum[now][j]=sum[now][j-1]+dp[now][j];
            if (sum[now][j]>=MOD) sum[now][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=S; i<=B; i++) {
        ans+=dp[T&1][i];
        if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1631.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 100005
struct Readedge {
    int u,v,w;
} re[MAXM];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM<<1];
#define TOP 1023
struct queue {
    int v[TOP+1],head,tail;
    queue():head(1048576),tail(1048576) {}
    int &operator [](int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&TOP]=x;
    }
    void push_front(int x) {
        v[(--head)&TOP]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&TOP];
    }
} q;
int n,m,ecnt,X,dis[MAXN],head[MAXN],dd[MAXN],ans=0;
inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}
bool inq[MAXN];
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[X]=0;
    q.push_back(X);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[x]+e[now].w<dis[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[q.front()]) q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    else q.push_back(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(X);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(re[i].u);
        read(re[i].v);
        read(re[i].w);
    }
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].u,re[i].v,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) dd[i]=dis[i];
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].v,re[i].u,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) ans=max(ans,dd[i]+dis[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];

bool inq[MAXN];
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[X]=0;
    q.push_back(X);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[x]+e[now].w<dis[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<dis[q.front()]) q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    else q.push_back(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(X);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(re[i].u);
        read(re[i].v);
        read(re[i].w);
    }
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].u,re[i].v,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) dd[i]=dis[i];
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(re[i].v,re[i].u,re[i].w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) ans=max(ans,dd[i]+dis[i]);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1632.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,2,-2,1,-1,2,-2},dy[]= {2,2,1,1,-2,-2,-1,-1};
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int m,n,map[35][35],add[35][35],dis[35][35],sx,sy,ex,ey;
long long cnt[35][35];
bool inq[35][35];
bool inrange(int x,int y) {
    return x>0 && x<=m && y>0 && y<=n;
}

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    q.push((sx<<10)|sy);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(add,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[sx][sy]=0;
    add[sx][sy]=0;
    cnt[sx][sy]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int nowx=q.front()>>10,nowy=q.front()&1023;
        q.pop();
        inq[nowx][nowy]=0;
        for (int d=0; d<8; d++) {
            int tox=nowx+dx[d],toy=nowy+dy[d];
            if (!inrange(tox,toy) || map[tox][toy]==2) continue;
            int toadd=add[nowx][nowy]+(map[tox][toy]==0);
            if (toadd<add[tox][toy]) {
                add[tox][toy]=toadd;
                dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                    inq[tox][toy]=1;
                    q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                }
            } else if (toadd==add[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1<dis[tox][toy]) {
                    dis[tox][toy]=dis[nowx][nowy]+1;
                    cnt[tox][toy]=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                } else if (dis[nowx][nowy]+1==dis[tox][toy]) {
                    cnt[tox][toy]+=cnt[nowx][nowy];
                    if (!inq[tox][toy]) {
                        inq[tox][toy]=1;
                        q.push((tox<<10)|toy);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
            if (map[i][j]==3) {
                sx=i,sy=j;
            } else if (map[i][j]==4) {
                ex=i,ey=j;
            }
        }
    spfa();
    if (add[ex][ey]>n*m) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n%d\n%lld\n",add[ex][ey],dis[ex][ey],cnt[ex][ey]);
    return 0;
}

        int j = 1;
        for (int k = i; k <= n; k++) {

            f[i][k] = min(f[i][k], a[j] == '$' ? k - i + 1 - (j - 1) : 2333);
        }
    }

            for (int k = i; k < j; k++) {
                f[i][j] = min(f[i][j], f[i][k] + f[k + 1][j]);

        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 10005
struct qqq {
    int L,R;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        if (L!=a.L) return L<a.L;
        else return R<a.R;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n,fun,h,m,d[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(fun);
    read(h);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].L);
        read(q[i].R);
        if (q[i].L>q[i].R) swap(q[i].L,q[i].R);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    q[0].L=q[0].R=-1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (q[i].L==q[i].R) continue;
        if (q[i].L==q[i-1].L && q[i].R==q[i-1].R) continue;
        d[q[i].L+1]--;
        d[q[i].R]++;
    }
    int now=h;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        now+=d[i];
        printf("%d\n",now);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1636.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
int n,q;
int a[MAXN];
int Minv[MAXN][20],Maxv[MAXN][20];

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int x=r-l+1;
    int tt=log_2(x);
    return max(Maxv[l][tt],Maxv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt])-min(Minv[l][tt],Minv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),Minv[i][0]=a[i],Maxv[i][0]=a[i];
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=n; k++) {
        int tt=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            Minv[i][k]=min(Minv[i][k-1],Minv[i+tt][k-1]);
            Maxv[i][k]=max(Maxv[i][k-1],Maxv[i+tt][k-1]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1637.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 50005
struct cow {
    int id, x;
    bool operator < (cow a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n;
int tmp[MAXN * 2], tmp2[MAXN * 2];

void work(int fir[], int las[]) {
    int ans = 0, sum = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (a[i].id) sum++;
        else sum--;
        if (i < n && fir[sum] > a[i + 1].x) fir[sum] = a[i + 1].x;
        las[sum] = a[i].x;
    }
    for (int i = -n; i <= n; i++) ans = max(ans, las[i] - fir[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].id);
        read(a[i].x);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    memset(tmp, 0x3f, sizeof(tmp));
    work(tmp + MAXN, tmp2 + MAXN);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1638.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
} E[MAXN];
struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, in[MAXN];
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], g[MAXN], *dp = f;

queue <int> q;

void solve() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!in[i]) q.push(i), dp[i] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!(--in[e[now].to])) q.push(e[now].to);
            dp[e[now].to] += dp[x];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(E[i].u), read(E[i].v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].u, E[i].v);
    solve();
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    memset(in, 0, sizeof in);
    ecnt = 1, dp = g;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(E[i].v, E[i].u);
    solve();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans = max(ans, f[E[i].u] * g[E[i].v]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int n, m;
int a[100005];

bool check(int mid) {
    int cnt = 1, now = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (now + a[i] > mid) now = 0, cnt++;
        now += a[i];
    }
    return cnt <= m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    int l = 0, r = 0;
    for (int i =1 ; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), l = max(l, a[i]), r += a[i];
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        if (G[u][v] > w) G[u][v] = w;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) G[i][i] = -1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++)
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                G[i][j] = min(G[i][j], max(G[i][k], G[k][j]));
            }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= T; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        printf("%d\n", G[u][v] == INF ? -1 : G[u][v]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1644.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define N 105
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

char s[N];
int n, sx, sy, tx, ty, G[N][N];
int dis[N][N][4];

struct Node {
    int x, y, d;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int b, int c) : x(a), y(b), d(c) {}
};

deque <Node> q;

void bfs() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) dis[sx][sy][i] = 0, q.push_back(Node(sx, sy, i));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node now = q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            if (dis[now.x][now.y][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d))
                dis[now.x][now.y][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
            int tox = now.x + dx[d], toy = now.y + dy[d];
            if (G[tox][toy]) {
                if (dis[tox][toy][d] > dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d)) {
                    dis[tox][toy][d] = dis[now.x][now.y][now.d] + (now.d != d);
                    if (now.d == d) q.push_front(Node(tox, toy, d));
                    else q.push_back(Node(tox, toy, d));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = INF;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ans = min(ans, dis[tx][ty][i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            G[i][j] = s[j] != 'x';
            if (s[j] == 'A') sx = i, sy = j;
            else if (s[j] == 'B') tx = i, ty = j;
        }
    }
    bfs();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1645.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

struct Node {
    int l, r, tag, v;
} t[MAXN * 77];

int tcnt = 1;

void pushdown(int &x, int tag) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (tag <= t[x].v) return;
    t[x].tag = tag, t[x].v = tag;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (v <= t[x].v) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].tag = v;
        t[x].v = v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(t[x].l, t[x].tag);
    pushdown(t[x].r, t[x].tag);
    //zuy zxhujyujhzuijuiiiiikjjjjjjjhggfv
    int mid = (l +  r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid), v);
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr, v);
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

LL ans = 0;

void dfs(int x, int l, int r, int tag) {
    tag = max(tag, t[x].tag);
    if (l == r) {
        ans += tag;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].l) dfs(t[x].l, l, mid, tag);
    else ans += LL(mid - l + 1) * tag;
    if (t[x].r) dfs(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, tag);
    else ans += LL(r - mid) * tag;
    return;
}

#define MAX 1000000001

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(v);
        update(1, 1, MAX, l, r - 1, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 1, MAX, 0);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

}

int dis[200319];

    memset(dis, 31, sizeof dis);
    read(n);
    read(k);
    dis[n] = 0;
    q.push(n);
    while (1) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (x == k) {
            printf("%d\n", dis[x]);
            return 0;
        }
        if (x < k && dis[2 * x] > dis[x] + 1) dis[2 * x] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(2 * x);
        if (x > 0 && dis[x - 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x - 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x - 1);
        if (x < k && dis[x + 1] > dis[x] + 1) dis[x + 1] = dis[x] + 1, q.push(x + 1);

//BZOJ1647.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 15
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int n, m, ans = INF, tot;
int vis[MAXN][MAXN];
bool G[MAXN][MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXN], b[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void pop(int x, int y) {
    tot++;
    a[x][y] ^= 1;
    x && (a[x - 1][y] ^= 1);
    y && (a[x][y - 1] ^= 1);
    x + 1 != m && (a[x + 1][y] ^= 1);
    y + 1 != n && (a[x][y + 1] ^= 1);
}

void update(int st) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) b[i][j] = vis[i][j] == st;
}

void work(int st) {
    tot = 0;
    memcpy(a, G, sizeof G);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((st >> i) & 1) pop(0, i), vis[0][i] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[i - 1][j]) pop(i, j), vis[i][j] = st;
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (a[m - 1][j]) return;
    if (tot < ans) ans = tot, update(st);
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            G[i][j] = x;
        }
    memset(vis, -1, sizeof vis);
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) work(i);
    if (ans == INF) puts("IMPOSSIBLE");
    else {
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                printf("%d%c", b[i][j], j == n - 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
            }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 10];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int K, n, m, p[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a, b;

void dfs(int x) {
    b[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!b[e[now].to]) dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(K);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(p[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
    }
    a.set();
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        b.reset();
        dfs(p[i]);
        a &= b;
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)a.count());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1650.cpp
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 50003;

int n, m, l, a[maxn];

int checkStone(int lt) {
    int s(0), po(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        if (a[i] - po >= lt)
            po = a[i];
        else
            ++ s;
    if (l - po < lt)
        ++ s;
    return s;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &n, &m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
        scanf("%d", a + i);
    sort(a, a + n) ;
    int le(0), re(l);
    while (le < re) {
        int md((le + re + 1) >> 1);
        if (checkStone(md) > m)
            re = md - 1;
        else
            le = md;
    }
    printf("%d\n", le);
    return 0;
}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 12

int f[N][N];
int a[N], vis[N];
int n;

void solve(int x, int sum) {
    if (x > n) {
        if (sum) return;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d%c", a[i], i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
        exit(0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n && i * f[n][x] + n - x <= sum; i++) if (!vis[i]) {
            vis[i] = 1;
            a[x] = i;
            solve(x + 1, sum - i * f[n][x]);
            vis[i] = 0;
        }
}

int main() {
    int sum;
    read(n);
    read(sum);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i][1] = 1;
        for (int j = 2; j <= i; j++) {
            f[i][j] = f[i - 1][j] + f[i - 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    solve(1, sum);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10319
#define MAXM 50319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXM * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, stp = 0, ans = 0;
int dfn[MAXN], low[MAXN];
int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
bool inq[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    sta[++top] = x;
    dfn[x] = low[x] = ++stp;
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to && !dfn[e[now].to]) {
            e[now ^ 1].to = 0;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            e[now ^ 1].to = x;
            low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
        } else if (inq[e[now].to]) low[x] = min(low[x], low[e[now].to]);
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    if (dfn[x] == low[x]) {
        ans += sta[top] != x;
        while (sta[top--] != x);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!dfn[i]) dfs(i);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

int n, K;

#define TOP 1000000000000000000ll

struct Num {
    int top;
    LL a[233];
    Num () {}
    Num (int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        top = 0;
        a[0] = x;
    }
    LL operator [] (const int x) const {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator += (const Num &b) {
        top = max(top, b.top);
        for (int i = 0; i <= top; i++) {
            a[i] += b[i];
            if (a[i] >= TOP) {
                a[i] -= TOP;
                a[i + 1]++;
                top += i == top;
            }
        }
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lld", a[top]);
        for (int i = top - 1; ~i; i--) printf("%18lld", a[i]);
    }
} dp[1005];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) dp[j] += dp[j - i];
    }
    dp[n].print();
    return 0;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
