inline void readchar(char &_ch) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    _ch = char(_c);
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 60319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'A' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int k = 0, i, j = 1; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j]  == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, len;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) readchar(s[i]);
    s[n + 1] = 'Z' + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[n + 2 + i] = s[n - i];
    len = 2 * n + 1;
    getsa(s, sa, len, 27);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int t = 1, i = 1, j = n + 2; t <= n; t++) {
        if (rk[i] < rk[j]) putchar(s[i++]);
        else putchar(s[j++]);
        if (t != n && t % 80 == 0) putchar('\n');
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1697.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 10005

int n, a[MAXN], b[MAXN], hh[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int find(int v) {
    int l = 1, r = n;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >>1;
        if (b[mid] >= v) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

long long ans = 0;

void solve(int st) {
    vis[st] = 1;
    long long sum = b[st], Min = b[st], len = 1;
    int x = st;
    while (a[x] != st) {
        x = a[x];
        vis[x] = 1;
        len++;
        sum += b[x], Min = min(Min, (long long)b[x]);
    }
    ans += sum + min((len - 2) * Min, Min + (len + 1) * b[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), b[i] = a[i];
    sort(b + 1, b + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = find(a[i]), hh[a[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!vis[i]) solve(i);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 50005
int n,q;
int a[MAXN];
int Minv[MAXN][20],Maxv[MAXN][20];

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int x=r-l+1;
    int tt=log_2(x);
    return max(Maxv[l][tt],Maxv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt])-min(Minv[l][tt],Minv[r-(1<<tt)+1][tt]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),Minv[i][0]=a[i],Maxv[i][0]=a[i];
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=n; k++) {
        int tt=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            Minv[i][k]=min(Minv[i][k-1],Minv[i+tt][k-1]);
            Maxv[i][k]=max(Maxv[i][k-1],Maxv[i+tt][k-1]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=q; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        printf("%d\n",query(l,r));
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 105
int n,T;
int vv[105],cc[105];
int dp[40005];

void bp(int v,int w) {
    for (int i=T; i>=v; i--) {
        dp[i]=min(dp[i],dp[i-v]+w);
    }
}

void full_bp(int v) {
    for (int i=T-v; i>=0; i--) {
        dp[i]=min(dp[i],dp[i+v]+1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(T);
    T<<=2;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(vv[i]);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(cc[i]);
    memset(dp,63,sizeof(dp));
    dp[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int now=0;
        for (int j=1; now+j<=cc[i]; j<<=1) {
            now+=j;
            bp(vv[i]*j,j);
        }
        if (now!=cc[i]) bp(vv[i]*(cc[i]-now),cc[i]-now);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        full_bp(vv[i]);
    }
    T>>=2;
    if (dp[T]<0x3f3f3f3f) printf("%d\n",dp[T]);
    else printf("-1\n");
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

#define P 1000081
typedef unsigned long long LL;
int n,k;
LL ha[20005],a[20005],val[20005],ls[20005];

bool check(int mid) {
    int cnt=0,ans=0;
    for (int l=0,r=mid; r<=n; l++,r++) {
        ls[++cnt]=ha[r]-ha[l]*val[mid];
    }
    sort(ls+1,ls+cnt+1);
    LL now=-1llu;
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (now==ls[i]) tot++;
        else ans=max(ans,tot),now=ls[i],tot=1;
    }
    ans=max(ans,tot);
    return ans>=k;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    ha[0]=0;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*P+x;
    }
    val[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        val[i]=val[i-1]*P;
    }
    int l=0,r=n;
    while (l<r) {
        int mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

int n,m;

int main() {

    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        st[i]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(x);
            st[i]=(st[i]<<1)|(x^1);
        }
    }
    dp[0][1]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=ccnt; j++) {
            if (!dp[i-1][j]) continue;
            for (int k=1; k<=ccnt; k++) {
                if (!(can[j]&can[k]) && !(can[k]&st[i])) {
                    dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][j];
                    if (dp[i][k]>=MOD) dp[i][k]-=MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=ccnt; i++) {
        ans+=dp[n][i];
        if (ans>=MOD) ans-=MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1756.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 500319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int sum, head, tail, mid;
    Node (): l(0), r(0), sum(0), head(-INF), tail(-INF), mid(-INF) {}
} t[1048576];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    t[x].head = max(t[t[x].l].head, t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].head);
    t[x].tail = max(t[t[x].r].tail, t[t[x].r].sum + t[t[x].l].tail);
    t[x].mid = max(max(t[x].head, t[x].tail),max(max(t[t[x].l].mid, t[t[x].r].mid), t[t[x].l].tail + t[t[x].r].head));
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        scanf("%d", &t[x].sum);
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum;
    }
    return x;
}

void modify(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].head = t[x].tail = t[x].mid = t[x].sum = v;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        upd(x);
    }
}

Node combine(Node L, Node R) {
    Node ret;
    ret.sum = L.sum + R.sum;
    ret.head = max(L.head, L.sum + R.head);
    ret.tail = max(R.tail, R.sum + L.tail);
    ret.mid = max(max(ret.head, ret.tail),max(max(L.mid, R.mid), L.tail + R.head));
    return ret;
}

Node query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr)
        return Node(t[x]);
    Node ret;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = combine(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql),qr));
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (op == 2) {
            modify(1, 1, n, l, r);
        } else {
            if (l > r) swap(l, r);
            printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r).mid);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1758.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define MAXN 100319
#define INF 1e9

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

inline int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                flag = 0, rt = e[now].to;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

vector <int> rt[MAXN];

int n, L, R, Rt;
D mid, ans, A[MAXN];
int maxdep;

inline void Count(int u, D d) {
    static int q[MAXN], dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], dq[MAXN];
    static D dis[MAXN];
    register int i, j, top, he = 0, ta = 0, x;
    q[top = 1] = u;
    dep[1] = 1;
    dis[1] = d;
    fa[1] = u;
    for (i = 1; i <= top; i++) {
        x = q[i];
        for (j = head[x]; j; j = e[j].next) {
            if (!vis[e[j].to] && e[j].to != fa[i]) {
                q[++top] = e[j].to;
                fa[top] = x;
                dep[top] = dep[i] + 1;
                dis[top] = dis[i] + e[j].w;
            }
        }
    }
    for (i = 1, j = min(R - 1, maxdep); i <= top; i = x) {
        x = i;
        D mx = -INF;
        while (x <= top && dep[x] == dep[i]) mx = max(mx, dis[x++]);
        while (j >= 0 && j + dep[i] >= L) {
            while (he < ta && A[dq[ta - 1]] < A[j]) ta--;
            dq[ta++] = j--;
        }
        while (he < ta && dq[he] + dep[i] > R) he++;
        if (he < ta) ans = max(ans, (A[dq[he]] + mx + mid * dq[he]) / (dq[he] + dep[i]));
    }
    maxdep = max(maxdep, dep[top]);
    for (i = 1; i <= top; i++) A[dep[i]] = max(A[dep[i]], dis[i] - dep[i] * mid);
}

void solve(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    maxdep = 0, A[0] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) Count(e[now].to, e[now].w);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxdep; i++) A[i] = -INF;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)rt[x].size(); i++) solve(rt[x][i]);
}

inline void work() {
    memset(vis + 1, 0, n);
    ans = -INF;
    solve(Rt);
}

void pre(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x], tmp; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            tmp = getrt(e[now].to);
            rt[x].push_back(tmp);
            pre(tmp);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    A[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) A[i] = -INF;
    Rt = getrt(1);
    pre(Rt);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    double l = 1, r = 1e6;
    mid = ans = 1;
    while (r - l > 2e-4) {
        l = mid = ans;
        work();
        r = ans;
    }
    printf("%.3lf\n", l + 1e-5);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1770.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
typedef long long LL;

struct QAQ {
    LL v;
    int cnt;
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return cnt > a.cnt;
    }
};

void work(LL a[], int &top, QAQ ans[], int tot) {
    top = 1 << tot;
    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tot; j++) {
            if ((i>>j)&1) ans[i].v ^= a[j], ans[i].cnt++;
        }
    }
}

#define MAXN 40
int n, m, top[2];
LL a[MAXN];
QAQ ans[2][262144];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = 1ll<<i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        u--, v--;
        a[u] |= 1ll<<v;
        a[v] |= 1ll<<u;
    }
    int mid = n / 2;
    work(a, top[0], ans[0], mid);
    work(a + mid, top[1], ans[1], n - mid);
    LL hh = (1ll<<n) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < top[0]; i++) {
        ans[0][i].v ^= hh;
    }
    sort(ans[0], ans[0] + top[0]);
    sort(ans[1], ans[1] + top[1]);
    int i = top[0] - 1, j = top[1] - 1, ret = n;
    while (i >= 0 && j >= 0) {
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v < ans[1][j].v) j--;
        while (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v > ans[1][j].v) i--;
        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && ans[0][i].v == ans[1][j].v) {
            ret = min(ret, ans[0][i].cnt + ans[1][j].cnt);
            while (i && ans[0][i - 1].v == ans[0][i].v) i--;
            while (j && ans[1][j - 1].v == ans[1][j].v) j--;
            i--, j--;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1798.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <ctime>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
int n,m,tcnt=0;
LL MOD;
int a[MAXN];
struct node {
    int l,r;
    LL v,mul,add;
} t[262144];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].mul=1;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
    } else {
        scanf("%lld",&t[now].v);
        t[now].v%=MOD;
    }
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int now,int lsiz,int rsiz) {
    if (t[now].mul!=1) {
        t[lch].add=(t[lch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].add=(t[rch].add*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].mul=(t[lch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].mul=(t[rch].mul*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v*t[now].mul)%MOD;
        t[now].mul=1;
    }
    if (t[now].add) {
        t[lch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[rch].add+=t[now].add;
        t[lch].v=(t[lch].v+t[now].add*lsiz)%MOD;
        t[rch].v=(t[rch].v+t[now].add*rsiz)%MOD;
        t[now].add=0;
    }
}

void update_mul(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].mul=(t[now].mul*v)%MOD;
        t[now].add=(t[now].add*v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_mul(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_mul(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

void update_add(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,LL v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[now].add=(t[now].add+v)%MOD;
        t[now].v=(t[now].v+(r-l+1)*v)%MOD;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) update_add(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update_add(rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[now].v=(t[lch].v+t[rch].v)%MOD;
}

LL query(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) return t[now].v;
    LL ret=0;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    pushdown(now,mid-l+1,r-mid);
    if (ql<=mid) ret+=query(lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr));
    if (qr>mid) ret+=query(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    return ret%MOD;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld",&n,&MOD);
    build(1,n);
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        LL k;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&op,&x,&y);
        if (op==2) {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_add(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(1,1,n,x,y));
        } else {
            scanf("%lld",&k);
            update_mul(1,1,n,x,y,k%MOD);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];

struct lsh {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (lsh a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,m,ecnt=0,tcnt=0;
int h[MAXN],rec[MAXN],head[MAXN],rt[MAXN],lr[MAXN],rr[MAXN],dfn=0;

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) lch=update(lch,l,mid,v);
        else rch=update(rch,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    lr[x]=++dfn;
    rt[dfn]=update(rt[dfn-1],1,n,h[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) dfs(e[now].to,x);
    }
    rr[x]=dfn;
}

int kth(int lx,int rx,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) return rec[l];
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=k) return kth(t[lx].l,t[rx].l,l,mid,k);
    else return kth(t[lx].r,t[rx].r,mid+1,r,k-lv);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(h[i]);
        tem[i].v=h[i];
        tem[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        h[tem[i].x]=i;
        rec[i]=tem[i].x;
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    dfs(1,0);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,k; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n",kth(rt[lr[x]-1],rt[rr[x]],1,n,k));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1821.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 1005

struct edge {
    int u,v,dis;
    edge() {}
    edge(int a,int b,int c):u(a),v(b),dis(c) {}
    bool operator < (edge a) const {
        return dis<a.dis;
    }
} e[MAXN*MAXN/2];

int n,k,ecnt,f[MAXN],X[MAXN],Y[MAXN];
#define power(x) ((x)*(x))
int dis(int a,int b) {
    return power(X[a]-X[b])+power(Y[a]-Y[b]);
}
int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu==fv) return 0;
    if (f[fu]>f[fv]) swap(fu,fv);
    f[fu]+=f[fv];
    f[fv]=fu;
    return 1;
}

//BZOJ1822.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define N 233
#define eps 1e-9
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

double power(double x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct Witch {
    int x, y, r, t;
} w[N];

struct Fairy {
    int x, y;
} f[N];

struct Tree {
    int x, y, r;
} t[N];

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point (int a = 0, int b = 0) : x(a), y(b) {}
    template <class X, class Y> Point (X a, Y b) : x(b.x - a.x), y(b.y - a.y) {}
    int operator ^ (Point b) const {
        return x * b.x + y * b.y;
    }
};

template <class X, class Y> double dis(X &_a, Y &_b) {
    return power(_a.x - _b.x) + power(_a.y - _b.y);
}

bool check(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    return (Point(a, b) ^ Point(a, c)) >= 0 && (Point(b, a) ^ Point(b, c)) >= 0;
}

double getdis(Witch a, Fairy b, Tree c) {
    double A = b.y - a.y, B = a.x - b.x, C = -(A * a.x + B * a.y);
    return abs(A * c.x + B * c.y + C) / sqrt(A * A + B * B);
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[N * N * 2];

int head[N + N], cur[N + N], tag[N + N], ecnt = 1, S = 0, T = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, ff
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, K, tt = 0;
bool G[N][N], ok[N];

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    tag[S] = 1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

bool ak(int mid) {
    memset(head, 0, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
    ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) add(i + n + 1, T, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i + 1, w[i].t == 0 ? INF : 1 + mid / w[i].t);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) add(i + 1, j + n + 1, 1);
        }
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memcpy(cur, head, sizeof(int) * (n + m + 2));
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret == m;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(w[i].x), read(w[i].y), read(w[i].r), w[i].r *= w[i].r, read(w[i].t), tt = max(tt, w[i].t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(f[i].x), read(f[i].y);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) read(t[i].x), read(t[i].y), read(t[i].r);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (dis(w[i], f[j]) - eps < w[i].r) {
                bool flag = 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                    double mindis;
                    if (check(w[i], f[j], t[k])) mindis = getdis(w[i], f[j], t[k]);
                    else mindis = sqrt(min(dis(w[i], t[k]), dis(f[j], t[k])));
                    if (mindis - eps < t[k].r) {
                        flag = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                G[i][j] = flag;
                ok[j] |= flag;
            } else G[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!ok[i]) return puts("-1"), 0;
    int l = 0, r = tt * (n - 1), mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ak(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

struct data {
    long long ans[10];
} ansa,ansb;

long long a,b;
inline long long calc(long long x,int dig) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long front=x,now=0,rear=0,ten=0,ret=0;
    if (dig==0) {
        while (front) {
            rear+=now*ten;
            if (ten) ten*=10;
            else ten=1;
            now=front%10;
            front/=10;
            if (now>dig) {
                ret+=front*ten;
            } else if (now==dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten+rear+1;
            } else if (now<dig) {
                if (front) ret+=(front-1)*ten;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    while (front) {
        rear+=now*ten;
        if (ten) ten*=10;
        else ten=1;
        now=front%10;
        front/=10;
        if (now>dig) {
            ret+=(front+1)*ten;
        } else if (now==dig) {
            ret+=front*ten+rear+1;
        } else if (now<dig) {
            ret+=front*ten;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void work(long long x,data &ans) {
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++)
        ans.ans[i]=calc(x,i);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld",&a,&b);
    work(a-1,ansa);
    work(b,ansb);
    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {
        printf("%lld%c",ansb.ans[i]-ansa.ans[i],i==9?'\n':' ');
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1834.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 5005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,k,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    dis[1]=0;
    q.push(1);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,nocost=0,tot=0;
    while (tot<k) {
        spfa();
        if (dis[n]) {
            ans+=dis[n];
            tot++;
        } else {
            nocost++;
        }
        for (int x=n; x!=1; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",nocost,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1,u,v,f,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&f,&w);
        add(u,v,0,f);
        add(u,v,w,k);
    }
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1835.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 22005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, lazy;
} t[MAXN * 3];

vector < pair<int, int> > a[MAXN];
int n, k, tcnt = 0, g[MAXN], C[MAXN], D[MAXN], W[MAXN], S[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].v = min(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

void rebuild(int x, int l, int r) {
    t[x].lazy = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rebuild(t[x].l, l, mid);
        rebuild(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = g[l];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = INF;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr > mid) ret = min(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy += v, t[x].v += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    upd(x);
}

void print(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l < r) {
        pushdown(x);
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        print(t[x].l, l, mid);
        print(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else printf("at %d : %d\n", l, t[x].v);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(k);
    n++, k++, D[0] = -INF, D[1] = 0, D[n] = INF;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) read(D[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) read(S[i]);
    for (int i = 1, st, ed; i < n; i++) {
        read(W[i]);
        st = int(upper_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] + S[i]) - D) - 1;
        ed = int(lower_bound(D, D + n + 1, D[i] - S[i]) - D) - 1;
        //printf("st : %d ed : %d\n", st, ed);
        a[st].push_back(make_pair(ed, W[i]));
    }
    memset(g, INF, sizeof g);
    g[0] = 0;
    build(0, n);
    for (int q = 1; q <= k; q++) {
        rebuild(1, 0, n);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int ret = query(1, 0, n, 0, i - 1);
            //printf("f %d %d :\n", q, i);
            //print(1, 0, n);
            g[i] = min(ret + C[i], g[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < a[i].size(); j++) update(1, 0, n, 0, a[i][j].first, a[i][j].second);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", g[n]);
    return 0;
}

inline int maa(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAX 1000000002

struct Node {
    int l, r, v, tag;
    void operator += (const int a) {
        tag += a;
        v += a;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].tag) {
        if (t[x].l) t[t[x].l] += t[x].tag;
        if (t[x].r) t[t[x].r] += t[x].tag;
        t[x].tag = 0;
    }
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr >  mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

void insert(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (t[x].v < v) t[x].v = v;
    if (l == r) return;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (p <= mid) insert(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
    else insert(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	cerr << "update ( " << l << " " << r << " ) " << t[x].v << endl;
        t[x] += 1;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

struct St {
    int a, b;
    St () {}
    St (int x, int y) : a(x), b(y) {}
    bool operator < (const St &q) const {
        return a + b > q.a + q.b;
    }
} a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].a);
        read(a[i].b);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, dp; i <= n; i++) {
        //	cerr << a[i].a << " " << a[i].b << " (" << tcnt << ")" << endl;
        if (a[i].a <= a[i].b + 1) {
            dp = query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].b + 1, MAX) + 1;
            //		cerr << "a . query " << a[i].b + 1 << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            //		cerr << "ins " << a[i].a << " " << dp << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);
        } else {
            dp = query(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, MAX) + 1;
            //		cerr << "b . query " << a[i].a << " ~ inf " << dp - 1 << endl;
            insert(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].a, dp);
            //		cerr << a[i].b + 1 << " ~ " << a[i].a - 1 << " ++ \n";
            //		cerr << "ins " << a[i].a << " " << dp << endl;
            update(rt, -MAX, MAX, a[i].b + 1, a[i].a - 1);
        }
        //	cerr << "query 4 == " << query(rt, -MAX, MAX, 4, 4) << endl;
    }
    printf("%d\n", t[rt].v);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

int n=0;
LL q[2100],a[1000];
bool ban[2100];
LL l,r;
int head=1,tail=1;
void init() {
    q[tail++]=6;
    q[tail++]=8;
    while (head<tail) {
        LL now=q[head++];
        if (now*10+6<=r) q[tail++]=now*10+6;
        if (now*10+8<=r) q[tail++]=now*10+8;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<tail; i++) {
        if (!ban[i]) {
            a[++n]=q[i];
            for (int j=i+1; j<tail; j++) {
                if (q[j]%q[i]==0) ban[j]=1;
            }
        }
    }
    reverse(a+1,a+n+1);
}

LL gcd(LL x,LL y) {
    if (y) return gcd(y,x%y);
    else return x;
}

LL work(int x,int cnt,LL z) {
    LL ret=0;
    if (x>n) {
        ret=r/z-(l-1)/z;
        if (cnt&1) return ret;
        else if (cnt) return -ret;
        else return 0;
    }
    ret+=work(x+1,cnt,z);
    LL g=gcd(a[x],z);
    if (double(z)*double(a[x])/double(g)<=r) {
        ret+=work(x+1,cnt+1,z*a[x]/g);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    cin>>l>>r;
    init();
    cout<<work(1,0,1)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int n;
int f[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] != x) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    u = getf(u), v = getf(v);
    if (u == v) vis[u] = 1;
    else {
        if (u < v) swap(u, v);
        vis[v] = 1;
        f[v] = u;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(10001, n + 1); i++) f[i] = i;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        merge(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) if (!vis[i]) return printf("%d\n", i - 1), 0;
}

inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

int dp[2005][2005];
int n, maxp, w;

struct Node {
    int v, t;
    Node () {}
    Node (int a, int b) : v(a), t(b) {}
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return v > a.v;
    }
};

deque <Node> q;

void work() {
    memset(dp, 200, sizeof dp);
    read(n);
    read(maxp);
    read(w);
    w++;
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1, Ap, Bp, As, Bs; i <= w; i++) {
        read(Ap);
        read(Bp);
        read(As);
        read(Bs);
        for (int j = 0; j <= As; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], -Ap * j);
        }
        for (int j = As + 1; j <= maxp; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = w + 1, Ap, Bp, As, Bs; i <= n; i++) {
        read(Ap);
        read(Bp);
        read(As);
        read(Bs);
        q.clear();
        for (int j = 0, bot = -As; j <= maxp; j++, bot++) {
            while (!q.empty() && q.back().v < dp[i - w][j] + j * Ap) q.pop_back();
            q.push_back(Node(dp[i - w][j] + j * Ap, j));
            while (q.front().t < bot) q.pop_front();
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], q.front().v - j * Ap);
        }
        q.clear();
        for (int j = maxp, top = Bs + maxp; j >= 0; j--, top--) {
            while (!q.empty() && q.back().v < dp[i - w][j] + j * Bp) q.pop_back();
            q.push_back(Node(dp[i - w][j] + j * Bp, j));
            while (q.front().t > top) q.pop_front();
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], q.front().v - j * Bp);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[n][0]);
}

#define MAXN 2000319
#define MOD 20100403

int power(LL x, int y) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; y; y >>= 1) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

int fac[MAXN], inv[MAXN];

int C(int n, int m) {
    return int((LL)fac[n] * inv[n - m] % MOD * inv[m] % MOD);
}

int main() {
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) fac[i] = int(LL(fac[i - 1]) * i % MOD);
    inv[MAXN - 1] = power(fac[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN - 2; i; i--) inv[i] = int(LL(inv[i + 1]) * (i + 1) % MOD);
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (n < m) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n", (C(n + m, m) - C(n + m, m - 1) + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

double dis(double a,double b,double c,double d) {
    return sqrt((a-c)*(a-c)+(b-d)*(b-d));
}

int Ax,Ay,Bx,By,Cx,Cy,Dx,Dy,P,Q,R;
double calc(double m,double n) {
    double x1=(Ax*m+Bx*(100-m))/100,y1=(Ay*m+By*(100-m))/100;
    double x2=(Cx*n+Dx*(100-n))/100,y2=(Cy*n+Dy*(100-n))/100;
    return dis(Ax,Ay,x1,y1)/P+dis(x1,y1,x2,y2)/R+dis(x2,y2,Dx,Dy)/Q;
}

double getans(double k) {
    double ll=0,rr=100,l,r;
    double llans=calc(k,ll),rrans=calc(k,rr),lans,rans;
    while (rr-ll>1e-6) {
        l=(ll*51+rr*49)/100;
        r=(ll*49+rr*51)/100;
        lans=calc(k,l);
        rans=calc(k,r);
        if (rans<lans) ll=l,llans=lans;
        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }
    return min(llans,rrans);
}

        if (rans<=lans) ll=l,llans=lans;
        else rr=r,rrans=rans;
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1858.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    int l, r, siz;
    int sum, lazy;
    int he[2], ta[2], md[2];
    bool rev;
} t[262144];

int tcnt = 0;

#define lch(q) t[q].l
#define rch(q) t[q].r

void upd(int x) {
    t[x].sum = t[lch(x)].sum + t[rch(x)].sum;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        t[x].he[i] = t[lch(x)].he[i] == t[lch(x)].siz ? t[lch(x)].siz + t[rch(x)].he[i] : t[lch(x)].he[i];
        t[x].ta[i] = t[rch(x)].ta[i] == t[rch(x)].siz ? t[rch(x)].siz + t[lch(x)].ta[i] : t[rch(x)].ta[i];
        t[x].md[i] = max(max(max(t[lch(x)].md[i], t[rch(x)].md[i]), max(t[x].he[i], t[x].ta[i])), t[lch(x)].ta[i] + t[rch(x)].he[i]);
    }
}

void rev(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) t[x].lazy = -t[x].lazy;
    else t[x].rev ^= 1;
    swap(t[x].he[0], t[x].he[1]);
    swap(t[x].ta[0], t[x].ta[1]);
    swap(t[x].md[0], t[x].md[1]);
    t[x].sum = t[x].siz - t[x].sum;
}

void clr(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = -1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = t[x].siz;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = 0;
}

void fil(int x) {
    t[x].lazy = 1;
    t[x].rev = 0;
    t[x].he[0] = t[x].ta[0] = t[x].md[0] = 0;
    t[x].sum = t[x].he[1] = t[x].ta[1] = t[x].md[1] = t[x].siz;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (t[x].lazy > 0) fil(lch(x)), fil(rch(x));
        else clr(lch(x)), clr(rch(x));
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
    if (t[x].rev) {
        rev(t[x].l), rev(t[x].r);
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].siz = r - l + 1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    } else {
        int p;
        read(p);
        t[x].sum = p;
        t[x].he[!p] = t[x].ta[!p] = t[x].md[!p] = 0;
        t[x].he[p] = t[x].ta[p] = t[x].md[p] = 1;
    }
    return x;
}

int n, m;

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, void(*opt)(int)) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        opt(x);
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), opt);
    if (qr > mid) update(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, opt);
    upd(x);
}

int Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += Sum(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Ret {
    int he, ta, md, siz;
    Ret (int x = 0, int y = 0, int z = 0, int w = 0) : he(x), ta(y), md(z), siz(w) {}
};

Ret operator + (Ret x, Ret y) {
    Ret ret;
    ret.he = x.he == x.siz ? x.siz + y.he : x.he;
    ret.ta = y.ta == y.siz ? y.siz + x.ta : y.ta;
    ret.md = max(max(ret.he, ret.ta), max(max(x.md, y.md), x.ta + y.he));
    ret.siz = x.siz + y.siz;
    return ret;
}

Ret Cons(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Ret(t[x].he[1], t[x].ta[1], t[x].md[1], t[x].siz);
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Ret ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = ret + Cons(lch(x), l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + Cons(rch(x), mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(0, n - 1);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        switch (x) {
        case 0:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, clr);
            break;
        case 1:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, fil);
            break;
        case 2:
            update(1, 0, n - 1, l, r, rev);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", Sum(1, 0, n - 1, l, r));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", Cons(1, 0, n - 1, l, r).md);
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1862.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MOD 2147483647
#define P 19260817
#define MAXN 250005
#define s 262144

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void getop(int &op) {
    while (ch!='+' && ch!='?') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='+') op=0,ch=getchar();
    else {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch>='A' && ch<='Z') op=1;
        else op=2;
    }
}

struct data {
    int v,t,name;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        if (v^a.v) return v<a.v;
        return t>a.t;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt=0,ntem=0;
map<int,int> m;
set<int> tree;
set<int>::iterator it;
char name[MAXN][12],rr[12];
int op[MAXN],nn[MAXN],num[MAXN],score[MAXN],rev[MAXN],t[s<<1];

inline void readname(int x) {
    int len=0,p;
    while (ch>='A' && ch<='Z') {
        rr[len++]=ch;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    long long ha=0;
    for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
        ha=(ha*P+rr[i])%MOD;
    }
    p=m[(int)ha];
    if (p==0) {
        p=++cnt;
        m[(int)ha]=p;
        for (int i=0; i<len; i++) {
            name[p][i]=rr[i];
        }
    }
    nn[x]=p;
}

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        getop(op[i]);
        if (op[i]==0) {
            readname(i);
            read(num[i]);
            tem[++ntem].v=num[i];
            tem[ntem].t=i;
            tem[ntem].name=nn[i];
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            readname(i);
        } else {
            read(num[i]);
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+ntem+1);
    for (int i=1,lab=ntem; i<=ntem; i++,lab--) {
        num[tem[i].t]=lab;
        rev[lab]=tem[i].name;
    }
}

inline void zkw_update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=d;
}

inline int zkw_query(int x) {
    int ans=0,l=s,r=x+s+1;
    for (; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int zkw_rank(int r) {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[x<<1]<r) {
            r-=t[x<<1],x=(x<<1)|1;
        } else x<<=1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

inline void update(int num,int name) {
    if (score[name]) {
        tree.erase(score[name]);
        zkw_update(score[name],-1);
    }
    score[name]=num;
    tree.insert(num);
    zkw_update(num,1);
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (op[i]==0) {
            update(num[i],nn[i]);
        } else if (op[i]==1) {
            printf("%d\n",zkw_query(score[nn[i]]));
        } else {
            int x=zkw_rank(num[i]);
            it=tree.find(x);
            for (int i=1; i<=10 && it!=tree.end(); i++,it++) {
                if (i^1) putchar(' ');
                printf("%s",name[rev[*it]]);
            }
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1875.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 22
#define MAXM 123
#define MOD 45989
using namespace std;

int n,m,t,a,b,u[MAXM],v[MAXM];
long long fir[MAXM],now[MAXM][MAXM],mat[MAXM][MAXM],temp[MAXM][MAXM];

inline void exp(long long a[MAXM][MAXM],long long b[MAXM][MAXM]) {//a=a*b
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j])%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

inline void quickpower() {
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            if (i==j)
                now[i][j]=1;
            else
                now[i][j]=0;
        }
    while (t>0) {
        if (t&1) {
            exp(now,mat);
        }
        exp(mat,mat);
        t>>=1;
    }
}

inline void calc() {
    for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
        temp[0][j]=0;
        for (int k=0; k<m; k++) {
            temp[0][j]=(temp[0][j]+fir[k]*now[k][j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        fir[i]=temp[0][i];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&t,&a,&b);
    if (t==0) {
        if (a==b)
            puts("1");
        else
            puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    m<<=1;
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",u+i,v+i);
        i++;
        u[i]=v[i^1];
        v[i]=u[i^1];
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        if (u[i]==a) {
            fir[i]=1;
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<m; j++) {
            if ((i^j)>1) {
                if (v[i]==u[j]) {
                    mat[i][j]=1;
                }
            }
        }
    t--;
    quickpower();
    calc();
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<m; i++) {
        if (v[i]==b)
            ans=(ans+fir[i])%MOD;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 1253
#define MOD 100000000

char temp[MAXL*10];

struct num {
    int a[MAXL+5];
    num() {
        memset(a,0,sizeof(a));
    }
    int &operator [](int i) {
        return a[i];
    }
    void operator /=(int x) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>=1; i--) {
            a[i-1]+=a[i]%x*MOD,a[i]/=x;
        }
    }
    void operator -=(num &b) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]-b[i]+(a[i-1]+MOD)/MOD-1,a[i-1]=(a[i-1]+MOD)%MOD;
        }
    }
    void operator *=(int x) {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) {
            a[i]=a[i]*x+a[i-1]/MOD,a[i-1]%=MOD;
        }
    }
    bool operator < (num &b) {
        for (int i=MAXL; i>0; i--) {
            if (a[i]!=b[i]) return a[i]<b[i];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    bool iszero() {
        for (int i=1; i<=MAXL; i++) if (a[i]!=0) return 0;
        return 1;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<8; i++) temp[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",temp+8);
        int len=(int)strlen(temp+1),p=1;
        while (len-8*p+1>0) {
            sscanf(temp+len-8*p+1,"%8d",&a[p]);
            p++;
        }
    }
    void print() {
        int p=MAXL;
        while (!a[p] && p>0) p--;
        printf("%d",a[p--]);
        while (p>0) printf("%08d",a[p--]);
        printf("\n");
    }
} a,b;

num gcd(num x,num y) {
    int g=0;
    while (!x.iszero() && !y.iszero()) {
        bool xx=(x[1]&1)^1,yy=(y[1]&1)^1;
        if (xx&&yy) {
            g++;
            x/=2;
            y/=2;
        } else if (xx||yy) {
            if (xx) x/=2;
            else y/=2;
        }
        if (y<x) x-=y;
        else y-=x;
    }
    if (x<y) x=y;
    while (g--) x*=2;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    a.read();
    b.read();
    gcd(a,b).print();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1877.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 405
#define MAXM 20005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXM*4];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,m,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN],pre[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[source]=0;
    q.push(source);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pre[sink]!=-1;
}

void work() {
    int ans=0,tot=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        tot++;
        ans+=dis[sink];
        for (int x=sink; x!=source; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %d\n",tot,ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=2; i<n; i++) {
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u*2+1,v*2,w,1);
    }
    add(0,3,0,12345678);
    add(n*2,1,0,12345678);
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1878.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 50005
#define MAXM 200005
#define s 65536
struct ls {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (ls a) const {
        if (v!=a.v) return v<a.v;
        return x<a.x;
    }
} d[MAXN];

struct qqq {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (qqq a) const {
        return r<a.r;
    }
} q[MAXM];

int n,m,cnt=0;
int a[MAXN],last[MAXN],ans[MAXM],t[s<<1];

inline void update(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=d;
}

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&d[i].v);
        d[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(d+1,d+n+1);
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (d[i].v==d[i-1].v) {
            last[d[i].x]=d[i-1].x;
        }
    }
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&q[i].l,&q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int now=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        update(i,1);
        if (last[i]) update(last[i],-1);
        while (now<=m && q[now].r==i) {
            ans[q[now].x]=query(q[now].l,i);
            now++;
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'A' :
        a = 1;
        break;
    case 'R' :
        getchar();
        getchar();
        _c = getchar();
        a = 2 + (_c == 'O');
        break;
    case 'I' :
        a = 4;
        break;
    case 'D' :
        a = 5;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        a = 6;
        break;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define INF 0x7fffffff
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int mi, siz, val, lazy;
    bool rev;
    Node () : mi(INF), siz(0), val(INF) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        mi += v;
        val += v;
        lazy += v;
    }
    void relax();
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
        mi = min(min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi), val);
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

void Node::relax() {
    if (lazy) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->add(lazy);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->add(lazy);
        lazy = 0;
    }
    if (rev) {
        c[0]->revIt();
        c[1]->revIt();
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->val = ptr->mi = v;
    ptr->lazy = ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

int a[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid]);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax();
    x->relax();
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R; // R->c[0] = [l, r)
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    a[0] = a[n + 1] = INF;
    rt = build(0, n + 1);
    read(m);
    Node *R, *tmp;
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y, z, mid; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->add(z);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            R = get(x, y + 1);
            R->c[0]->revIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(z);
            z %= (y - x + 1);
            mid = y - z + 1;
            R = get(mid, y + 1);
            tmp = R->c[0];
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            R = get(x, x);
            R->setc(tmp, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 4:
            read(x);
            read(z);
            R = get(x + 1, x + 1);
            R->setc(newNode(z), 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 5:
            read(x);
            R = get(x, x + 1);
            R->setc(null, 0);
            R->upd();
            rt->upd();
            break;
        case 6:
            read(x);
            read(y);
            printf("%d\n", get(x, y + 1)->c[0]->mi);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1907.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 10005
int T;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,ans=0,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    ecnt=0;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to]=x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    if (cnt[x]==0) cnt[fa[x]]++;
    else if (cnt[x]==1) cnt[fa[x]]++,ans--;
    else ans-=2;
    cnt[x]=0;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    ans=n;
    fa[1]=0;
    dfs(1);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        init();
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1911.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    a = 0;
    bool F = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') F |= ch == '-', ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (F) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 1000005
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
int n;
LL A, B, C, s[MAXN], f[MAXN], y[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(y[j] - y[k]) / LD(s[j] - s[k]);
}
LL calc(LL x) {
    return A * x * x + B * x + C;
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) > 2 * A * s[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) > slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) {
        read(ai);
        s[i] = s[i - 1] + ai;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + calc(s[i] - s[j]);
        y[i] = f[i] + A * s[i] * s[i] - B * s[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1923.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
inline bool nxtBit() {
    ch = getchar();
    while (ch != '0' && ch != '1') ch = getchar();
    return ch == '1';
}

#define MAXN 1024

int n, m;
bool ansed = 0, sf[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> a[2048], b[2048];
char tmp[MAXN];

bool check(int cnt) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) a[i] = b[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= cnt && !a[to][i]) to++;
        if (to > cnt) return 0;
        swap(a[to], a[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
            if (j != i && a[j][i]) a[j] ^= a[i];
        }
    }
    if (!ansed) {
        ansed = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sf[i] = a[i][0];
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) b[i][j] = nxtBit();
        b[i][0] = nxtBit();
    }
    int l = n, r = m + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    if (l > m) puts("Cannot Determine");
    else {
        printf("%d\n", l);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {

//BZOJ1927.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 805
#define M 15010
#define TOP 2047
struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[N * N + M * 2];

int head[TOP], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m;
int dis[TOP], q[TOP + 1], pre[TOP];
bool inq[TOP];

void SPFA() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * (2 * n + 1));
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++ & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[ta++ & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int solve() {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        SPFA();
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, i << 1, 1, 0);
        add(i << 1 | 1, T, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a);
        add(S, i << 1 | 1, 1, a);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        if (u > v) swap(u, v);
        add(u << 1, v << 1 | 1, 1, w);
    }
    printf("%d\n", solve());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1930.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define INF 123456789
#define MAXN 2005

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
    bool operator < (point a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN<<1];

void add(int u,int v,int w,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int pos[MAXN<<1],pre[MAXN<<1],dis[MAXN<<1];
bool inq[MAXN<<1];

queue <int> q;
void spfa() {
    memset(dis,-1,sizeof(dis));
    dis[0]=0;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]<dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int work() {
    int ans=0;
    for (int f=2; f; f--) {
        spfa();
        ans+=dis[1];
        for (int x=1; x!=0; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow--;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(source,i*2,0,2);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,1,1);
        add(i*2,i*2+1,0,1);
        add(i*2+1,sink,0,2);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int maxy=INF;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (p[j].y>=p[i].y && p[j].y<maxy) {
                add(i*2+1,j*2,0,2);
                maxy=p[j].y;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",work());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1934.cpp
/*  Never stop fighting for what you believe in.    */
#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 305
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m;
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
inline void add2(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    T=n+1;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (x) add(S,i,1);
        else add(i,T,1);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add2(u,v,1);
    }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",dinic());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500005

    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }

int n,m,qcnt=0,temx[MAXN],temy[MAXN],cntx=0,cnty=0;

int lessx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

int leqx(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cntx,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temx[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }

}

int geqy(int x) {

    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;

        else l=mid+1;

}

int leqy(int x) {
    int l=0,r=cnty,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (temy[mid]<=x) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    return l;
}

#define s 524288
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        temx[i]=p[i].x;
        temy[i]=p[i].y;
    }
    sort(p+1,p+n+1);
    sort(temx+1,temx+n+1);
    sort(temy+1,temy+n+1);
    cntx=int(unique(temx+1,temx+n+1)-temx);
    cnty=int(unique(temy+1,temy+n+1)-temy);
    temx[0]=-1,temx[cntx]=10000001;
    temy[0]=-1,temy[cnty]=10000001;
    for (int i=1,a,b,c,d; i<=m; i++) {
        read(a);

        read(c);
        read(d);

        b=geqy(b),d=leqy(d);
        q[++qcnt]=data(a,b,d,-1,i);
        q[++qcnt]=data(c,b,d,1,i);
    }
    sort(q+1,q+qcnt+1);
    int qpos=1,ppos=1;
    while (qpos<=qcnt && q[qpos].x==0) qpos++;
    for (int i=1; i<=cntx; i++) {
        while (ppos<=n && p[ppos].x==temx[i]) update(leqy(p[ppos++].y));

            ans[q[qpos].id]+=q[qpos].v*query(q[qpos].l,q[qpos].r);
            qpos++;
        }
    }

        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }

//BZOJ1964.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <queue>

#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;

struct Point {
    LD x, y, z;
    Point() {}
    Point(LD a, LD b, LD c) : x(a), y(b), z(c) {}
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
    }
    Point operator - (Point &a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y, z - a.z);
    }
} p[5];

LD ans = 0;

LD get(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
    LD ret = 0;
    ret += a.x * b.y * c.z + a.y * b.z * c.x + a.z * b.x * c.y;
    ret -= a.x * b.z * c.y + a.y * b.x * c.z + a.z * b.y * c.x;
    return ret;
}

void work(Point &a, Point &b, Point &c, Point &d) {
    ans += abs(get(a - d, b - d, c - d));
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 4; i >= 0; i--) {
        p[i].re();
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 5; j++)
            for (int k = j + 1; k < 5; k++)
                for (int l = k + 1; l < 5; l++) {
                    work(p[i], p[j], p[k], p[l]);
                }
    }
    printf("%.2lf\n", ans / 12);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ1965.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL n,m,l,MOD;

LL exp(LL a,LL b) {
    LL ret=0;
    a%=MOD;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) {
            ret=ret+a;
            if (ret>=MOD) ret-=MOD;
        }
        a<<=1;
        if (a>=MOD) a-=MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x) {
    LL ret=1;
    a%=MOD;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=exp(ret,a);
        a=exp(a,a);
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

void exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1,y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

LL inv(LL a) {
    LL x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n>>m>>l;
    MOD=n+1;
    cout<<exp(l,inv(quickpower(2,m)))<<endl;
    return 0;
}

typedef long long ll;
int n;

inline ll work(int x) {
    if (x==0) return 0;
    long long ret=0;
    for (int now=x; now; now--) {
        int div=x/now;
        int to=x/(div+1)+1;
        ret+=(ll)(now-to+1)*div;
        now=to;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("%lld\n",work(n));
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MAXN 201005
#define sqrtN 1005
int n,m,sqn;
int a[MAXN],step[MAXN],to[MAXN],block[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    sqn=int(sqrt(n));
    int now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=sqn; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=sqn; j++) {
            block[now++]=i;
        }
    }
    while (now<n) {
        block[now++]=sqn+1;
    }
    block[n]=-1;
    step[n]=0;
    to[n]=n;
    for (int i=n-1; i>-1; i--) {
        to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
        if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
            step[i]=1;
        } else {
            step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
            to[i]=to[to[i]];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    init();
    scanf("%d",&m);
    for (int t=1; t<=m; t++) {
        int x,y,z;
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) {
            int now=y,ans=0;
            while (now<n) {
                ans+=step[now];
                now=to[now];
            }
            printf("%d\n",ans);
        } else {
            scanf("%d",&z);
            a[y]=z;
            int nowblock=block[y];
            for (int i=y; i>-1 && block[i]==nowblock; i--) {
                to[i]=min(n,i+a[i]);
                if (block[i]!=block[to[i]]) {
                    step[i]=1;
                } else {
                    step[i]=step[to[i]]+1;
                    to[i]=to[to[i]];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2005.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000005
int prime[MAXN],phi[MAXN+5],pcnt=0;
LL sum[MAXN+5];
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,phi[i]=i-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=phi[i]*prime[j];
                break;
            } else phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}
int main() {
    shake();
    LL n,m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL x=min(n,m);
    LL ans=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(n/(n/i),m/(m/i));
        ans+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(n/i)*(m/i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans*2-LL(n)*m);
    return 0;
}

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) prime[++pcnt]=i,phi[i]=i-1;
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=MAXN; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=phi[i]*prime[j];
                break;
            } else phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}
int main() {
    shake();
    LL n,m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL x=min(n,m);
    LL ans=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=min(n/(n/i),m/(m/i));
        ans+=(sum[j]-sum[i-1])*(n/i)*(m/i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans*2-LL(n)*m);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 20
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<LL, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

int n, K, L, R;
LL a[MAXN];

pii t[LOG][MAXN];
void st_ready() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) t[0][i] = mp(a[i], i);
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 0, ta = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= ta; i++) {
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

int LOG2(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x > 65535) ret |= 16, x >>= 16;
    if (x > 255) ret |= 8, x >>= 8;
    if (x > 15) ret |= 4, x >>= 4;
    if (x > 3) ret |= 2, x >>= 2;
    return ret + (x > 1);
}

pii query(int l, int r) {
    int len = r - l + 1, ll = LOG2(len);
    return min(t[ll][l], t[ll][r - (1 << ll) + 1]);
}

struct s {
    int x, l, r, p;
    bool operator < (s b) const {
        return a[x] - a[p] < a[b.x] - a[b.p];
    }
};

LL ans = 0;

priority_queue <s> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), a[i] += a[i - 1];
    st_ready();
    s now;
    pii tmp;
    for (int i = L, l, r; i <= n; i++) {
        l = max(0, i - R), r = i - L;
        tmp = query(l, r);
        q.push((s) {
            i, l, r, tmp.second
        });
    }
    while (K--) {
        now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += a[now.x] - a[now.p];
        if (now.l < now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.l, now.p - 1);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.l, now.p - 1, tmp.second
            });
        }
        if (now.r > now.p) {
            tmp = query(now.p + 1, now.r);
            q.push((s) {
                now.x, now.p + 1, now.r, tmp.second
            });
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
