//BZOJ2006.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 19

struct Node {
    int x, l, r, p;
};

int n, K, L, R;
int sum[MAXN], st[MAXN][LOG], Log[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

bool operator < (const Node &a, const Node &b) {
    return sum[a.x] - sum[a.p] < sum[b.x] - sum[b.p];
}

priority_queue <Node> q;

inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return sum[x] < sum[y] ? x : y;
}

void build_st() {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = i;
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n + 1]; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 0, j = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = cmp(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int rmq(int l, int r) {
    return cmp(st[l][Log[r - l + 1]], st[r - (1 << Log[r - l + 1]) + 1][Log[r - l + 1]]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(L);
    read(R);
    for (int i = 1, a; i <= n; i++) read(a), sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + a;
    build_st();
    for (int i = L; i <= n; i++) {
        q.push((Node) {
            i, max(0, i - R), i - L, rmq(max(0, i - R), i - L)
        });
    }
    while (K--) {
        Node now = q.top();
        q.pop();
        ans += sum[now.x] - sum[now.p];
        if (now.l < now.p) q.push((Node) {
            now.x, now.l, now.p - 1, rmq(now.l, now.p - 1)
        });
        if (now.r > now.p) q.push((Node) {
            now.x, now.p + 1, now.r, rmq(now.p + 1, now.r)
        });
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define N 505
#define MAXN (N * N * 4)
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int nxt, v, f;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int cur[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int ff) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, ff
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n;
int num[N][N], a[N][N], b[N][N], S, T, node;
int q[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) tag[i] = 0;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
            if (e[o].f && !tag[e[o].v]) {
                tag[e[o].v] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[o].v;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (x == T) return f;
    int l = f;
    for (int &o = cur[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].f && tag[e[o].v] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[o].v, min(l, e[o].f));
            l -= ret;
            e[o].f -= ret;
            e[o ^ 1].f += ret;
            if (!l) return f;
        }
    }
    tag[x] = -1;
    return f - l;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
        if (++cnt > 50 && T > 250000) return 77484;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {

    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            num[i][j] = ++node;
        }
    }

    S = num[0][0], T = num[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            read(b[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            add(num[i][j], num[i][j + 1], a[i][j], x);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int x;
            read(x);
            add(num[i][j], num[i + 1][j], b[i][j], x);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

    read(A);
    read(S);

        read(x);

    }

    int l, r, v;

        return v > a.v;
    }

bool tag(int i, int x) {
    if (x > a[i].r) return 0;
    if (vis[x]) {
        if (a[vis[x]].r > a[i].r) {
            if (tag(vis[x], x + 1)) return vis[x] = i, 1;
            else return 0;
        } else return tag(i, x + 1);
    } else return vis[x] = i, 1;
}

int main() {

    tem[0] = -INF;
    tem[n + 1] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].l = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + n + 2, a[i].l) - tem) + 1;
        a[i].r = int(upper_bound(tem, tem + n + 2, a[i].r) - tem);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (tag(i, a[i].l)) ans += a[i].v;

//BZOJ2038.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL gcd(LL a,LL b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

#define MAXN 50005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];

struct query {
    int l,r,x;
    bool operator < (query z) const {
        if (l/sqn==z.l/sqn) return r<z.r;
        else return l<z.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

LL ans=0,ansa[MAXN],ansb[MAXN];

void update(int x) {
    ans+=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}
void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    ans-=cnt[a[x]]*2+1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) r++,update(r);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r),r--;
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l),l++;
        while (l>q[i].l) l--,update(l);
        LL x=ans-(r-l+1),y=LL(r-l+1)*LL(r-l);
        if (x!=0) {
            LL g=gcd(x,y);
            x/=g,y/=g;
        } else y=1;
        ansa[q[i].x]=x,ansb[q[i].x]=y;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld/%lld\n",ansa[i],ansb[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

} t[1048576];

struct Opt_node {
    int next,u,v;
} op[5242880];

struct Reverse {
    int p,v,next;
} sta[10485760];

int tcnt=0,opcnt=0,stacnt=0,A,B;
#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int x=++tcnt;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[x].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    } else {
        if (qq[l].op==0) {
            t[x].v=1;
            lch=qq[l].u;
            rch=qq[l].v;
        }
    }
    return x;
}

void add_Exsit(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        op[++opcnt].u=A;
        op[opcnt].v=B;
        op[opcnt].next=t[x].head;
        t[x].head=opcnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) add_Exsit(lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) add_Exsit(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
}

void modify(int p,int v,int &head) {
    sta[++stacnt].p=p;
    sta[stacnt].v=f[p];
    sta[stacnt].next=head;
    head=stacnt;
    f[p]=v;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    else return getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v,int &head) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) swap(u,v),swap(fu,fv);
        modify(fv,f[fu]+f[fv],head);
        modify(fu,fv,head);
    }
}

void dfs(int x,int l,int r) {
    int head=0;
    for (int now=t[x].head; now; now=op[now].next) {
        merge(op[now].u,op[now].v,head);
    }
    if (l==r) {
        if (getf(lch)==getf(rch)) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) dfs(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) dfs(rch,mid+1,r);
    }
    for (int now=head; now; now=sta[now].next) {
        f[sta[now].p]=sta[now].v;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readop(qq[i].op);
        read(qq[i].u);
        read(qq[i].v);
        qq[i].id=i;
        if (qq[i].u>qq[i].v) swap(qq[i].u,qq[i].v);
    }
    build(1,m);
    sort(qq+1,qq+m+1);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        if (qq[i].u!=qq[i-1].u || qq[i].v!=qq[i-1].v) {
            if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
                A=qq[i-1].u,B=qq[i-1].v;
                add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
            }
            tot++;
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
        if (qq[i].op==2) {
            exc[tot]=qq[i].id;
        } else if (qq[i].op) {
            A=qq[i].u,B=qq[i].v;
            add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],qq[i].id);
            exc[tot]=-1;
        }
    }
    if (tot && exc[tot]!=-1) {
        A=qq[m].u,B=qq[m].v;
        add_Exsit(1,1,m,exc[tot],m);
    }
    dfs(1,1,m);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 10005

//BZOJ2049.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'z') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    while (_c >= 'A') _c = getchar();
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 10319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    bool rev, isrt;
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void upd() {}
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    if (x->fa != null) pushto(x->fa);
    x->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node *expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
    return y;
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

int n, m;
Node *a[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 'C' :
            Link(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'D' :
            Cut(a[u], a[v]);
            break;
        case 'Q' :
            puts(getrt(a[u]) == getrt(a[v]) ? "Yes" : "No");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2051.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 50319

inline int min(int x, int y) {
    return x < y ? x : y;
}
inline int max(int x, int y) {
    return x > y ? x : y;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 1, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, K;
int lf[MAXN * 16], fa[MAXN], fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], fcnt = 0;
int le[MAXN * 16], fe[MAXN], est[MAXN], eed[MAXN], Ecnt = 0;
int rec[MAXN * 2], dep[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int st[MAXN * 2][17], Log[MAXN * 2], fir[MAXN], tot = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(st[x][Log[y - x + 1]], st[y - (1 << Log[y - x + 1]) + 1][Log[y - x + 1]]);
}
#define getdis(x, y) (dis[x] + dis[y] - 2 * rmq(fir[x], fir[y]))

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                rt = e[now].to, flag = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

void dd(int x) {
//	cerr << x << " : " << dep[x] << endl;
    lf[++fcnt] = le[++Ecnt] = dep[x];
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (!vis[e[now].to]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to);
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void solve(int x, int f) {
//	cerr << "solve " << x << " " << f << endl;
    lf[fst[x] = ++fcnt] = dep[x] = 0;
    fa[x] = f;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            rec[now] = getrt(e[now].to);
            est[rec[now]] = Ecnt + 1;
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            sort(le + est[rec[now]], le + (eed[rec[now]] = Ecnt) + 1);
        }
    }
    sort(lf + fst[x], lf + (fed[x] = fcnt) + 1);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(rec[now], x);
    }
}

int query(int a[], int s, int t, int d) {
    if (d < 0) return 0;
    int l = s, r = t + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] > d) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - s;
}

LL check(int x, int mid) {
    LL ret = query(lf, fst[x], fed[x], mid);
//	cerr << "f " << x  << " " << mid << " " <<	ret<< endl;
    for (int y = x; fa[y]; y = fa[y]) {
        int D = getdis(fa[y], x);
        ret += query(lf, fst[fa[y]], fed[fa[y]], mid - D);
//		cerr << "f " << fa[y] << " " << mid - D << " " <<  query(lf, fst[fa[y]], fed[fa[y]], mid - D) << endl;
        ret -= query(le, est[y], eed[y], mid - D);
//		cerr << "e " << y << " " << mid - D << " " << query(le, est[y], eed[y], mid - D) << endl;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void work(int x) {
    int l = 0, r = 500000001, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (check(x, mid) > K) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    st[fir[x] = ++tot][0] = dis[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x, dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            st[++tot][0] = dis[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    fa[1] = dis[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) Log[i] = 1 + Log[i >> 1];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[tot]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), ta = tot - (x << 1) + 1; i <= ta; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
    solve(getrt(1), 0);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 500319

int n, cnt;
int R[MAXN * 2];
char s[MAXN], a[MAXN * 2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[++cnt] = '$';
        a[++cnt] = s[i];
    }
    a[++cnt] = '$';
    int mx = 0, pos = 0;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i += 2) {
        if (i < mx) R[i] = min(R[2 * pos - i], mx - i);
        else R[i] = 1;
        while (i >= R[i] && i + R[i] <= cnt && ((a[i - R[i]] != a[i + R[i]]) || (a[i - R[i]] == '$'))) R[i]++;
        if (R[i] + i - 1 > mx) mx = R[i] + i - 1, pos = i;
        ans += (R[i] - 1) >> 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int ma = a[1];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ma = max(ma, a[i + 1] - ma);
    printf("%d\n", ma);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2100.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<2];

int m,n,S,A,B,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v>a.v;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> q;
void dijkstra(int st) {
    memset(dis,127,sizeof(dis));
    dis[st]=0;
    q.push(statu(st,0));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x,d=q.top().v;
        q.pop();
        if (d!=dis[x]) continue;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>d+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=d+e[now].w;
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,dis[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    read(S);
    read(A);
    read(B);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    dijkstra(S);
    int ans=min(dis[A],dis[B]);
    dijkstra(A);
    printf("%d\n",ans+dis[B]);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 5005
int n;
int a[MAXN],sum[MAXN],dp[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+a[i];
        dp[i]=a[i];
    }
    for (int len=1; len<n; len++) {
        for (int i=1,j=i+len; j<=n; i++,j++) {
            dp[i]/*[j]*/=sum[j]-sum[i-1]-min(dp[i]/*[j-1]*/,dp[i+1]/*[j]*/);
        }
    }

#include <iostream>

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readbit(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m;
int a[105],cnt[105];
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        readbit(a[i]);
        read(cnt[i]);
    }
    int ans=-1;
    for (int i=(1<<n)-1; i>-1; i--) {
        bool flag=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if (__builtin_popcount(a[j]&i)!=cnt[j]) {
                flag=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) {
            if (ans!=-1) {
                puts("NOT UNIQUE");
                return 0;
            } else ans=i;
        }
    }
    if (ans==-1) puts("IMPOSSIBLE");
    else {
        for (int i=n-1; i>-1; i--) {
            printf("%d",1&(ans>>i));
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2109.cpp
#include<stdio.h>
#include<stdlib.h>
int k[2005]= {0},f[2005]= {0},s[2005]= {0},v[10005]= {0},first[2005]= {0},next[10005]= {0},heap[2005]= {0},pos[2005]= {0};
int n,e=0,node;
void tj(int x,int y) {
    v[++e]=y;
    next[e]=first[x];
    first[x]=e;
}
void jh_heap(int a,int b) {
    int t=heap[a];
    heap[a]=heap[b];
    heap[b]=t;
    t=pos[heap[a]];
    pos[heap[a]]=pos[heap[b]];
    pos[heap[b]]=t;
}
void tj_heap(int x) {
    int i;
    heap[++node]=x;
    pos[x]=node;
    for(i=node; i>1; i/=2) {
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
void sc() {
    int i=1;
    jh_heap(1,node);
    node--;
    while(i*2<=node) {
        i*=2;
        if(i+1<=node&&k[heap[i]]<k[heap[i+1]]) i++;
        if(k[heap[i/2]]<k[heap[i]]) jh_heap(i/2,i);
        else return;
    }
}
int work(int x) {
    int i,j,t;
    node=0;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        f[i]=heap[i]=pos[i]=0;
    for(i=1; i<=e; i++)
        f[v[i]]++;
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        if(f[i]==0&&i!=x) tj_heap(i);
    for(i=n; i>=1; i--) {
        if(node==0) return n-i;
        t=heap[1];
        sc();
        if(k[t]<i) return n-i;
        s[i]=t;
        for(j=first[t]; j!=0; j=next[j])
            if(--f[v[j]]==0&&v[j]!=x) tj_heap(v[j]);
    }
    return n;
}
int main() {
    int m,i,a,b;
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++)
        scanf("%d",&k[i]);
    for(i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
        tj(b,a);//��������ͼ
    }
    work(0);
    /*for(i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        printf("%d",s[i]);
        if(i<n) printf(" ");
        else printf("\n");
    }*/
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d",n-work(i));
        if(i<n) printf(" ");
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 10005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
int n,m,ecnt=0;
int in[MAXN],head[MAXN],s[MAXN],K[MAXN],scnt=0;
void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}
struct statu {
    int x,v;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):x(a),v(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
};
priority_queue<statu> q;
void work_1() {
    for (int i=1; i<=ecnt; i++) in[e[i].to]++;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (!in[i]) q.push(statu(i,K[i]));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        s[++scnt]=x;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (--in[e[now].to]==0) {
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,K[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
    /*	for (int i=n;i;i--) {
    		printf("%d ",s[i]);
    	}
    	putchar('\n');*/
}

int work_2(int xx) {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) in[i]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=ecnt; i++) in[e[i].to]++;
    while (!q.empty()) q.pop();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) if (!in[i] && i!=xx) q.push(statu(i,K[i]));
    for (int kkk=n; kkk>=1; kkk--) {
        if (q.empty()) return n-kkk;
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        if (K[x]<kkk) return n-kkk;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (--in[e[now].to]==0 && e[now].to!=xx) {
                q.push(statu(e[now].to,K[e[now].to]));
            }
        }
    }
    return n;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(K[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<=m; i++) {
        read(v);
        read(u);
        add(u,v);
    }
    work_1();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        printf("%d",n-work_2(i));
        if (i<n) printf(" ");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2115.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN * 4];

int n, m, ecnt = 0, cnt = 0, head[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
LL val[MAXN], a[MAXN * 4];
void add(int u, int v, LL w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            vis[e[now].to] = 1;
            val[e[now].to] = val[x] ^ e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        } else {
            if (val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to]) a[++cnt] = val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}

LL tmp[64];

void gauss() {
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = 62; j > -1; j--) {
            if ((a[i]>>j)&1) {
                if (!tmp[j]) {
                    tmp[j] = a[i];
                    break;
                } else a[i] ^= tmp[j];
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        LL w;
        scanf("%d%d%lld", &u, &v, &w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    vis[1] = 1;
    val[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    gauss();
    LL ret = val[n];
    for (int i = 62; i > -1; i--) {
        ret = max(ret, ret ^ tmp[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2115.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN * 4];

int n, m, ecnt = 0, cnt = 0, head[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
LL val[MAXN], a[MAXN * 4];
void add(int u, int v, LL w) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            vis[e[now].to] = 1;
            val[e[now].to] = val[x] ^ e[now].w;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        } else {
            if (val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to]) a[++cnt] = val[x] ^ e[now].w ^ val[e[now].to];
        }
    }
}

LL tmp[64];

void gauss() {
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        for (int j = 60; j > -1 && a[i]; j--) {
            if ((a[i]>>j)&1) {
                if (!tmp[j]) {
                    tmp[j] = a[i];
                    break;
                } else a[i] ^= tmp[j];
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        LL w;
        scanf("%d%d%lld", &u, &v, &w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    vis[1] = 1;
    val[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    gauss();
    LL ret = val[n];
    for (int i = 60; i > -1; i--) {
        ret = max(ret, ret ^ tmp[i]);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2120.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */
#define MAXN 10005
int n,m,a[MAXN],cnt=0;
char temp[5];
map<int,int> ls;
int vis[MAXN<<1];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1,x; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",&x);
        a[i]=ls[x];
        if (a[i]==0) ls[x]=a[i]=++cnt;
    }
    for (int i=1,ret,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%s%d%d",temp,&l,&r);
        if (temp[0]=='R') {
            int col=ls[r];
            if (!col) ls[r]=col=++cnt;
            a[l]=col;
        } else {
            ret=0;
            for (int j=l; j<=r; j++) if (vis[a[j]]!=i) {
                    vis[a[j]]=i;
                    ret++;
                }
            printf("%d\n",ret);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN<<3];
int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m,tot=0,tcnt=1,tag[105][105];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            tag[i][j]=++tcnt;
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,tag[i][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(tag[i][j],T,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i+1][j],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i+1][j],tcnt,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(S,++tcnt,a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j],a);
            add(tcnt,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(++tcnt,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],tcnt,a);
            add(tag[i][j+1],tcnt,a);
        }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
template <class T> inline void readf(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if(ch=='-') f=1;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
struct statu {
    int v,x;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):v(a),x(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }
};

int n,m,ans=0,a[MAXN],pre[MAXN],nxt[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

inline void del(int x) {
    pre[nxt[x]]=pre[x];
    nxt[pre[x]]=nxt[x];
    visit[x]=1;
}

int main() {
    priority_queue<statu> q;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (m>n/2) {
        puts("Error!");
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        readf(a[i]);
        pre[i]=i-1;
        nxt[i]=i+1;
        q.push(statu(a[i],i));
    }
    pre[1]=n,nxt[n]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        while (visit[q.top().x]) q.pop();
        int x=q.top().x;
        q.pop();
        ans+=a[x];
        a[x]=a[pre[x]]+a[nxt[x]]-a[x];
        q.push(statu(a[x],x));
        del(pre[x]);
        del(nxt[x]);
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);

}

//BZOJ2152.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    while (b) {
        LL c = a;
        a = b;
        b = c % b;
    }
    return a;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int ds(int x) {
    vis[x] = 1;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

int n, dep[MAXN];
int s[3], cnt[3];
LL ans = 0;

void dd(int x) {
    dep[x] += dep[x] > 2 ? -3 : 0;
    s[dep[x]]++;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void work(int x) {
    cnt[0] = 1, cnt[1] = cnt[2] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to);
            ans += (LL)s[0] * cnt[0] + (LL)s[1] * cnt[2] + (LL)s[2] * cnt[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                cnt[i] += s[i], s[i] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    work(x);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w % 3);
    solve(1);
    ans = ans * 2 + n;
    LL tot = (LL) n * n, g = gcd(tot, ans);
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", ans/g, tot/g);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';

    }

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c < 'A' || _c > 'Z') _c = getchar();
    switch (_c) {
    case 'C' :
        op = 1;
        break;
    case 'N' :
        op = 2;
        break;
    case 'S' :
        op = 3;
        break;
    case 'M' :
        _c = getchar();
        if (_c == 'A') op = 4;
        else op = 5;
    }
    while (_c >= 'A' && _c <= 'Z') _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 20319
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2];
    int ma, mi, val, sum;
    bool isrt, rev, inv;
    Node () : ma(-INF), mi(INF), val(INF), sum(0) {}
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum;
        ma = max(c[0]->ma, c[1]->ma);
        mi = min(c[0]->mi, c[1]->mi);
        if (val ^ INF) {
            sum += val;
            ma = max(ma, val);
            mi = min(mi, val);
        }
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void invIt() {
        inv ^= 1;
        ma = -ma, mi = -mi, sum = -sum;
        swap(ma, mi);
        if (val != INF) val = -val;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt(), rev = 0;
        if (inv) c[0]->invIt(), c[1]->invIt(), inv = 0;
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->rev = ptr->inv = 0;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[++top] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top) sta[top--]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

Node *addE(Node *u, Node *v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(u, mid);
    Link(mid, v);
    return mid;
}

Node* query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

int n, Q;
Node *a[MAXN], *e[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[i] = addE(a[u], a[v], w);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, u, v; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(u);
        read(v);
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            splay(e[u]);
            e[u]->val = v;
            e[u]->upd();
            break;
        case 2:
            query(a[u], a[v])->invIt();
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->sum);
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->ma);
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n", query(a[u], a[v])->mi);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define MAXN 1000319
#define MOD 19930726
typedef long long LL;

LL power(LL x, LL k) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; k; k >>= 1) {
        if (k & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct pam {
    map<int, int> nxt[MAXN];
    int fail[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], len[MAXN], S[MAXN];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p].clear();
        len[p] = l, cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        p = n = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        c -= 'a';
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        if (!nxt[cur][c]) {
            int now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
            fail[now] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            nxt[cur][c] = now;
        }
        last = nxt[cur][c];
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
    }
} T;

int n, pcnt = 0;
LL K, ans = 1;
char s[MAXN];
pair <int, int> p[MAXN];

inline bool cmp(const pair<int, int> a, const pair<int, int> b) {
    return a.first > b.first;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%lld", &n, &K);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) T.add(s[i]);
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p; i > 1; i--) if ((T.len[i] & 1) && T.cnt[i]) p[++pcnt] = make_pair(T.len[i], T.cnt[i]);
    sort(p + 1, p + pcnt + 1, cmp);
    for (int i = 1; K > 0 && i <= pcnt; i++) {
        (ans *= power(p[i].first, min((LL)p[i].second, K))) %= MOD;
        K -= p[i].second;
    }
    if (K > 0) puts("-1");
    else printf("%d\n", int(ans % MOD));
    return 0;
}

#define lim 10000
#define maxn 121000
struct LL {
    int a[maxn];
    inline void operator = (int x) {
        a[0]=0;
        while(x) a[++a[0]]=x%lim,x/=lim;
        if(!a[0]) a[0]=1;
    }
    inline void print() {
        printf("%d",a[a[0]]);
        if(a[a[0]]<0||a[a[0]]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        for(int i=a[0]-1; i; --i) {
            printf("%04d",a[i]); //width should be manualy changed
            if(a[i]<0||a[i]>=lim) cout<<"fky"<<endl;
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    inline void read() {
        char s[maxn];
        int len;
        a[0]=1;
        a[1]=0;
        scanf("%s",s);
        len=strlen(s);
        for(int i=len-1,now=1; i>=0; --i,now*=10) {
            if(now==lim) now=1,a[++a[0]]=0;
            a[a[0]]+=now*(s[i]-'0');
        }
        while(a[0]>1&&!a[a[0]]) --a[0];
    }
    void operator ++ () {
        ++a[1];
        a[a[0]+1]=0;
        for(int i=1; i<=a[0]; ++i)
            if(a[i]==lim) ++a[i+1];
            else break;
        if(a[a[0]+1]) ++a[0];
    }
    LL operator * (LL b)const {
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=a[0]+b.a[0];
        c.a[1]=0;
        long long tmp=0;
        if(c.a[0]>=maxn) throw *this;
        for(int k=1; k<c.a[0]; ++k) {
            for(int i=max(1,k+1-b.a[0]),j=k+1-i; i<=a[0]&&j; ++i,--j)
                tmp+=a[i]*b.a[j];
            tmp+=c.a[k];
            c.a[k]=tmp%lim;
            c.a[k+1]=tmp/lim;
            tmp=0;
        }
        if(c.a[0]>1&&!c.a[c.a[0]]) --c.a[0];
        return c;
    }
    LL operator - (LL b)const { //support only biger-smaller
        LL c;
        c.a[0]=1;
        for(int i=1,x=0; i<=a[0]; ++i) {
            if(i>b.a[0]) b.a[i]=0;
            c.a[i]=a[i]-b.a[i]+x;
            x=0;
            if(c.a[i]<0) c.a[i]+=lim,x=-1;
            if(c.a[i]) c.a[0]=i;
        }
        return c;
    }
    LL operator ^ (int t) {
        LL c,a=*this;
        c=1;
        while(t) {
            if(t&1) c=a*c;
            a=a*a;
            t>>=1;
        }
        return c;
    }
};

typedef long long LL;
#define MOD 10000000
LL temp[20000];
char r[80000];
struct num {
    int v[20000],len;
    num():len(0) {}
    num operator = (int x) {
        memset(v,0,sizeof(v));
        v[0]=x;
        return *this;
    }
    int &operator [](int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
    num operator + (num a) {
        len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]+=a[i];
            if (v[i]>=MOD) v[i]-=MOD,v[i+1]++;
        }
        if (v[len+1]) len++;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator - (num a) {
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++) {
            v[i]-=a[i];
            while (v[i]<0) v[i]+=MOD,v[i+1]--;
        }
        while (!v[len] && len>0) len--;
        return *this;
    }
    num operator * (num a) {
        memset(temp,0,sizeof(temp));
        for (int i=0; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=0; j<=a.len; j++) {
                temp[i+j]+=LL(v[i])*LL(a[j]);
            }
        int l=len+a.len;
        num c;
        c=0;
        for (int i=0; i<=l; i++) {
            c[i]=int(temp[i]%MOD);
            temp[i+1]+=temp[i]/MOD;
            if (i==l && temp[i+1]) l++;
        }
        c.len=l;
        return c;
    }
    num operator += (num a) {
        return *this+a;
    }
    num operator -= (int a) {
        num x;
        x=a;
        return *this-x;
    }
    num operator -= (num a) {
        return *this-a;
    }
    void read() {
        for (int i=0; i<=8; i++) r[i]='0';
        scanf("%s",r+9);
        len=-1;
        for (int i=int(strlen(r))-1; i>=9; i-=7) {
            len++;
            sscanf(r+i-6,"%7d",&v[len]);
        }
        if (len<=0) len=0;
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%d",v[len]);
        for (int i=len-1; i>-1; i--) {
            printf("%07d",v[i]);
        }
        putchar('\n');
    }
} a,b;

int main() {
    int fun;
    scanf("%d",&fun);
    a.read();
    b.read();
    (a*b).print();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2179.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double LD;
struct Comp {
    LD x, y;
    Comp() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Comp(LD a, LD b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Comp operator * (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x * t.x - y * t.y, x * t.y + y * t.x);
    }
    Comp operator *= (Comp t) {
        return *this = *this * t;
    }
    Comp operator + (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x + t.x, y + t.y);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp t) {
        return Comp(x - t.x, y - t.y);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator * (_T t) {
        return Comp(x * t, y * t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator / (_T t) {
        return Comp(x / t, y / t);
    }
    template <class _T> Comp operator /= (_T t) {
        return *this = *this / t;
    }
};

Comp I(0, 1);

Comp exp(Comp t) {
    return Comp(cos(t.y), sin(t.y)) * exp(t.x);
}

#define MAXN 131072

char sa[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

Comp tmp[MAXN];

void DFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    if (n == 1) return;
    int n_2 = n / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tmp[i] = a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i & 1) a[n_2 + i / 2] = tmp[i];
        else a[i / 2] = tmp[i];
    }
    Comp *a0 = a, *a1 = a + n_2;
    DFT(a0, n_2, rev);
    DFT(a1, n_2, rev);
    Comp cur(1, 0);
    LD alpha = M_PI / n_2 * rev;
    Comp step = exp(I * alpha);
    for (int k = 0; k < n_2; ++k) {
        tmp[k] = a0[k] + cur * a1[k];
        tmp[k + n_2] = a0[k] - cur * a1[k];
        cur *= step;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = tmp[i];
}

Comp a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
int ans[MAXN];

void FFT(int n) {
    DFT(a, n, 1);
    DFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] *= b[i];
    DFT(a, n, -1);
}

int main() {
    int n = 1, len;
    scanf("%d%s%s", &len, sa, sb);
    while (n < len) n <<= 1;
    n <<= 1;
    for (int i = len - 1, j = 0; j < n; i--, j++) {
        if (i > -1) a[j] = Comp(sa[i] - '0', 0), b[j] = Comp(sb[i] - '0', 0);
        else a[j] = b[j] = Comp(0, 0);
    }
    FFT(n);
    for (int i = 0, to; i < n; i++) {
        ans[i] += int(a[i].x / n + 0.5);
        if ((to = ans[i] / 10)) {
            ans[i + 1] += to;
            ans[i] -= 10 * to;
        }
    }
    bool flag = 1;
    for (int i = len * 2 - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        if (flag && !ans[i]) continue;
        flag = 0;
        putchar('0'|ans[i]);
    }
    if (flag) putchar('0');
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAX 65536

typedef double D;

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r + b.r, i + b.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r - b.r, i - b.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp b) {
        return Comp(r * b.r - i * b.i, r * b.i + i * b.r);
    }
};

int R[MAX * 2];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = -1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp *a, int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += (i << 1)) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

int n;
char sa[MAX], sb[MAX];
Comp a[MAX * 2], b[MAX * 2];
int ans[MAX * 2];
int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s%s", sa, sb);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = Comp(sa[n - i - 1] - '0');
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = Comp(sb[n - i - 1] - '0');
    for (int i = 1; ; i <<= 1) if (i >= n) {
            n = i * 2;
            break;
        }
    getR(n);
    FFT(a, n, 1);
    FFT(b, n, 1);
    for (int i = n; i--; a[i] = a[i] * b[i]);
    FFT(a, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ans[i] += int(a[i].r + 0.5);
        ans[i + 1] += ans[i] / 10;
        ans[i] %= 10;
    }
    for (int i = n - 1, flag = 0; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (ans[i] > 0 || flag) flag = 1, putchar('0' + ans[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2186.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10000000

typedef long long LL;

int T,MOD;
int fac[MAXN+5],inv[MAXN+5],ans[MAXN+5];
int prime[1000005],pcnt=0;
bool notprime[MAXN+5];

void exgcd(int a,int b,int &x,int &y) {
    if (b==0) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return;
    }
    exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    int t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
}

int getinv(int a) {
    int x,y;
    exgcd(a,MOD,x,y);
    x%=MOD;
    if (x<0) x+=MOD;
    return x;
}

void init() {
    fac[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=int(((LL)fac[i-1]*i)%MOD);
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            inv[i]=getinv(i);
        }
        for (int j=1; prime[j]*i<=MAXN && j<=pcnt; j++) {
            notprime[prime[j]*i]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) break;
        }
    }
    ans[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (notprime[i]) ans[i]=ans[i-1];
        else {
            ans[i]=int(((((LL)ans[i-1]*(i-1))%MOD)*inv[i])%MOD);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&T,&MOD);
    init();
    while (T--) {
        int n,m;
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        printf("%d\n",int((LL(fac[n])*ans[m])%MOD));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2190.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL phi(LL x) {
    LL ret=x,sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
    for (LL i=2; i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            ret=ret/i*(i-1);
            while (x%i==0) x/=i;
            sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ret=ret/x*(x-1);
    return ret;
}

LL n,ans=0;

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    if (n<2) puts("0");
    else {
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            ans+=phi(i);
        }
        cout<<ans*2+1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2200.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
#define MAXN 25005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<3];

const int Q=32767;
struct queue {
    int head,tail,v[32768];
    queue():head(16777216),tail(16777216) {}
    void push_front(int x) {
        v[(--head)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push_back(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void push(int x) {
        v[(tail++)&Q]=x;
    }
    void pop() {
        head++;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[head&Q];
    }
    bool empty() {
        return head>=tail;
    }
} q;

int head[MAXN],dis[MAXN];
int n,m,M,S,ecnt=0;
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void spfa() {
    memset(dis,63,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    if (dis[e[now].to]<=dis[q.front()]) {
                        q.push_front(e[now].to);
                    } else {
                        q.push_back(e[now].to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(M);
    read(S);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=M; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    spfa();
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]==INF) puts("NO PATH");
        else printf("%d\n",dis[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2208.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005
bitset<MAXN> map[MAXN],G[MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int ecnt=0,head[MAXN];

int n;
char temp[MAXN];
int low[MAXN],dfn[MAXN],belong[MAXN],in[MAXN],scc=0,cnt=0;
long long ans=0;
int sta[MAXN],top=0;
int siz[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    in[v]++;
}
void tarjan(int x) {
    dfn[x]=low[x]=++cnt;
    sta[++top]=x;
    inq[x]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (map[x][i]) {
            if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i),low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
            else if (inq[i]) low[x]=min(low[x],low[i]);
        }
    }
    if (dfn[x]==low[x]) {
        siz[++scc]=0;
        int now=0;
        while (now!=x) {
            now=sta[top--];
            belong[now]=scc;
            inq[now]=0;
            siz[scc]++;
        }
    }
}

int q[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
void topo() {
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        if (!in[i]) q[ta++]=i;
        G[i][i]=1;
    }
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            G[e[now].to]|=G[x];
            in[e[now].to]--;
            if (!in[e[now].to]) {
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=scc; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=scc; j++) {
            if (G[i][j]) {
                ans+=(long long)siz[i]*siz[j];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",temp+1);
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (temp[j]=='1') map[i][j]=1;
        }
        map[i][i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!dfn[i]) tarjan(i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j] && belong[i]!=belong[j] && !G[belong[i]][belong[j]])
                add(belong[i],belong[j]);
        }
    }
    topo();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];
int n,m,lim,tcnt=0,rt[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int kth(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=p) return kth(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return kth(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p-lv);
}
int query(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(lim);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        rt[i]=update(rt[i-1],1,lim,a);
    }
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int mid=(r-l+2)>>1,ret=kth(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,mid);
        if (query(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,lim,ret)>((r-l+1)>>1)) printf("yes %d\n",ret);
        else puts("no");
    }
    return 0;
}

    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 1000319

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 6], phi[MAXN], pcnt = 0;
LL ans[MAXN], f[MAXN];

void init() {
    phi[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            phi[i] = i - 1;
        }
        for (int j = 1, k; (k = i * p[j]) < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] = (LL) i * ((LL)phi[i] * i / 2);
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; i * j < MAXN; j++) {
            ans[i * j] += i * f[j];
        }
    }
}

/* Never Say Die */

}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 900
#define MAXM 9000

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXM * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T, Q;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
int qw[MAXN], cnt[MAXN];

namespace NewGraph {
struct Edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];
int head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int c, r;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (Edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}
void dfs(int x, int f) {
    if (f != INF && f <= c) r++;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, min(f, e[now].w));
        }
}
int solve(int x) {
    c = x;
    r = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        fa[i] = 0;
        dfs(i, INF);
    }
    return r / 2;
}
}

void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    NewGraph::add(S, T, ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(head, 0, sizeof head);
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(NewGraph::head, 0, sizeof NewGraph::head);
    NewGraph::ecnt = 1;
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u), read(v);
        read(W[i]);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = i;
    read(Q);
    solve(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        int x;
        read(x);
        printf("%d\n", NewGraph::solve(x));
    }
}

int main() {
    int ca;
    read(ca);
    while (ca--) work(), puts("");
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
int ans=0x7fffffff,m,n;
int a[105][105],sum[105][105];

void check(int x,int y) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) sum[i][j]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            sum[i][j]=sum[i-1][j]+sum[i][j-1]-sum[i-1][j-1];
            int xx=max(0,i-x),yy=max(0,j-y);
            int v=a[i][j]-(sum[i][j]-sum[xx][j]-sum[i][yy]+sum[xx][yy]);
            if (v<0) return;
            ret+=v;
            sum[i][j]+=v;
        }
    ans=min(ret,ans);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) check(i,j);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2242.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

int ch=0;
inline bool read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch==-1) return 0;
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return 1;
}
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

LL quickpower(LL a,LL x,LL MOD) {
    a%=MOD;
    LL ans=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ans=(ans*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

LL exgcd(LL a,LL b,LL &x,LL &y) {
    if (!b) {
        x=1;
        y=0;
        return a;
    }
    LL g=exgcd(b,a%b,x,y);
    LL t=x;
    x=y;
    y=t-a/b*y;
    return g;
}

void solve2(LL a,LL z,LL p) {
    LL x,y;
    // solve ax - py == Z (mod P)
    LL g=exgcd(a,-p,x,y);
    if (z%g!=0) puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
    else {
        x=(x*(z/g))%p;
        if (x<0) printf("%lld\n",x+p);
        else printf("%lld\n",x);
    }
}

map<LL,LL> Hash;

void solve3(LL y,LL z,LL p) {
    // solve y^x==z -> y ^ (km + i) == z
    y%=p;
    if (z==1) {
        puts("0");
        return;
    }
    if (y==0) {
        if (z==0) puts("1");
        else puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
        return;
    }
    LL m=(LL)sqrt(p)+1;
    Hash.clear();
    Hash[1]=-1;
    for (LL i=1,t=1; i<m; i++) {
        t=(t*y)%p;
        if (!Hash[t]) Hash[t]=i;
    }
    LL temp=quickpower(y,p-m-1,p),ine=1;
    for (LL k=0; k<m; k++) {
        LL x=Hash[(z*ine)%p];
        if (x) {
            if (x==-1) x=0;
            printf("%lld\n",k*m+x);
            return;
        }
        ine=(ine*temp)%p;
    }
    puts("Orz, I cannot find x!");
}

int main() {
    int T;
    while (scanf("%d",&T)!=EOF) {
        LL y,z,p;
        int k;
        scanf("%d",&k);
        while (T--) {
            scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&y,&z,&p);
            if (k==1) {
                printf("%lld\n",quickpower(y,z,p));
            } else if (k==2) {
                solve2(y,z,p);
            } else {
                solve3(y,z,p);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2243.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='C') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='C';
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072

int n,m;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];
int ecnt,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

struct chain_node {
    int top,dep,fa,maxs,son,size,tid;
} a[MAXN];

int rev[MAXN],dfn=0;

void finds(int x) {
    a[x].size=1;
    a[x].maxs=a[x].son=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=a[x].fa) {
            a[v].fa=x;
            a[v].dep=a[x].dep+1;
            finds(v);
            a[x].size+=a[v].size;
            if (a[v].size>a[x].maxs) {
                a[x].maxs=a[v].size;
                a[x].son=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    a[x].tid=++dfn;
    rev[dfn]=x;
    a[x].top=anc;
    if (a[x].son) {
        link(a[x].son,anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=a[x].son && e[now].to!=a[x].fa) {
                link(e[now].to,e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int col[MAXN];
// Segment Tree
struct node {
    int head,tail,lch,rch,tot;
} t[s<<1];
struct line {
    int head,tail,tot;
    line() {}
    line(int z,int x,int c):head(z),tail(x),tot(c) {}
};

line merge(line x,line y) {
    line ret=line(x.head,y.tail,x.tot+y.tot);
    if (x.tail==y.head) ret.tot--;
    return ret;
}

void t_merge(int now) {
    t[now].head=t[t[now].lch].head;
    t[now].tail=t[t[now].rch].tail;
    t[now].tot=t[t[now].lch].tot+t[t[now].rch].tot;
    if (t[t[now].lch].tail==t[t[now].rch].head) t[now].tot--;
}

int tcnt=0,root;
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now].lch=t[now].rch=0;
        t[now].head=t[now].tail=col[rev[l]];
        t[now].tot=1;
        return now;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
    t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
    t_merge(now);
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    t[t[x].lch].head=t[t[x].lch].tail=t[x].head;
    t[t[x].rch].head=t[t[x].rch].tail=t[x].tail;
    t[t[x].lch].tot=t[t[x].rch].tot=1;
}

line query(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (l!=r && t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
        pushdown(x);
    }
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        return line(t[x].head,t[x].tail,t[x].tot);
    }

    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid && qr>mid) {
        line lx=query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,mid),ly=query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,mid+1,qr);
        return merge(lx,ly);
    } else {
        if (ql<=mid) {
            return query(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,qr);
        } else {
            return query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,ql,qr);
        }
    }
}

void modify(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,int v) {
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].head=t[x].tail=v;
        t[x].tot=1;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].head==t[x].tail && t[x].tot==1) {
        pushdown(x);
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) {
        modify(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid),v);
    }
    if (qr>mid) {
        modify(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    }
    t_merge(x);
}

void change(int u,int v,int c) {
    while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
        if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
        modify(1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[a[u].top].tid,a[u].tid,c);
        u=a[a[u].top].fa;
    }
    if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
    modify(1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
//		printf("Call modify %d %d %d %d %d %d\n",1,1,n,a[u].tid,a[v].tid,c);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    while (a[u].top!=a[v].top) {
        if (a[a[u].top].dep<a[a[v].top].dep) swap(u,v);
        u=a[a[u].top].fa;
    }
    if (a[u].dep>a[v].dep) swap(u,v);
    return u;
}
line getLine(int x,int LCA) {
    bool flag=1;
    line ret;
    while (a[x].top!=a[LCA].top) {
        if (flag) {
            //		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
            ret=query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid);
            //		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
            flag=0;
        } else {
            //		printf("%d ~ %d\n",a[x].top,x);
            ret=merge(query(1,1,n,a[a[x].top].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
            //		printf("%d %d %d\n",ret.head,ret.tail,ret.tot);
        }
        x=a[a[x].top].fa;
    }
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n",LCA,x);
    if (flag) return query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid);
    else return merge(query(1,1,n,a[LCA].tid,a[x].tid),ret);
}

int ask(int u,int v) {
    int LCA=getLCA(u,v);
//	printf("%d\n",LCA);
    line lx=getLine(u,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",lx.head,lx.tail,lx.tot);
    line ly=getLine(v,LCA);
//	printf("%d %d %d\n",ly.head,ly.tail,ly.tot);
    swap(lx.head,lx.tail);
    lx=merge(lx,ly);
    return lx.tot;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(col[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    a[1].fa=0;
    a[1].dep=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    root=build(1,n);
}

void work() {
    for (int i=1,u,v,c; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(c);
            change(u,v,c);
        } else {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            printf("%d\n",ask(u,v));
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 256
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f
struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*64];

int m,n,S=0,T=1,ecnt=1;
int L[MAXN],t[MAXN][MAXN],W[MAXN][MAXN],dis[MAXN*2],head[MAXN*2],pre[MAXN*2],pos[MAXN*2];
#define task(i) (i+1)
#define worker(i) (i+n+1)
bool inq[MAXN*2];
void add(int u,int v,int flow,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,C; i<=n; i++) read(C),add(task(i),T,C,0);;
    for (int i=1,A; i<=m; i++) for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(A);
            if (A) add(worker(i),task(j),INF,0);
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(L[i]);
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) read(t[i][j]);
        for (int j=0; j<=L[i]; j++) read(W[i][j]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<L[i]; j++) {
            add(S,worker(i),t[i][j]-t[i][j-1],W[i][j]);
        }
        add(S,worker(i),INF,W[i][L[i]]);
    }
}
queue <int> q;
bool spfa() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(dis,0x7f,sizeof(dis));
    dis[S]=0;
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    memset(pos,0,sizeof(pos));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return pos[T]>0;
}

void work() {
    LL ans=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int Minflow=INF;
        for (int x=1; x; x=pre[x]) {
            Minflow=min(Minflow,e[pos[x]].flow);
        }
        ans+=LL(Minflow)*dis[T];
        for (int x=T; x; x=pre[x]) {
            e[pos[x]].flow-=Minflow;
            e[pos[x]^1].flow+=Minflow;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2282.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>

        a=a*10+ch-'0';

    }

#define MAXN 300005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,s,ecnt=0;
int dis[MAXN],fa[MAXN],head[MAXN],ans[MAXN];
int visit[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

inline int bfs(int st) {
    fa[st]=st;
    dis[st]=0;
    int he=1,ta=2;
    q[1]=st;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x]) {
                fa[v]=x;
                dis[v]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                q[ta++]=v;
            }
        }
    }
    int d=0,t=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis[i]>d) {
            d=dis[i];
            t=i;
        }
    }
    return t;
}

struct statu {
    int val,tag;
    statu() {}
    statu(int a,int b):val(a),tag(b) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return val<a.val;
    }
};

priority_queue<statu> fnt,back,on;
int minans=0x7fffffff;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(s);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    int root=bfs(1);
    int x=bfs(root),tag=0;
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        visit[i]=++tag;
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    for (int i=n; i>1; i--) {
        if (!visit[q[i]]) {
            ans[fa[q[i]]]=max(ans[fa[q[i]]],ans[q[i]]+dis[q[i]]-dis[fa[q[i]]]);
        }
    }
    for (int i=x;; i=fa[i]) {
        back.push(statu(ans[i]-dis[i],visit[i]));
        if (i==root) break;
    }
    int i=x,j=x;
    on.push(statu(ans[x],visit[x]));
    while (j!=root) {
        while (j!=root && dis[i]-dis[fa[j]]<=s) {
            j=fa[j];
            on.push(statu(ans[j],visit[j]));
        }
        //push back
        while (!back.empty() && back.top().tag<=visit[j]) back.pop();
        //push on
        while (!on.empty() && on.top().tag<visit[i]) on.pop();
        int nowans=on.top().val;
        if (!back.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,back.top().val+dis[j]);
        if (!fnt.empty()) nowans=max(nowans,fnt.top().val-dis[i]);
        minans=min(minans,nowans);
        fnt.push(statu(ans[i]+dis[i],visit[i]));
        i=fa[i];
    }
    printf("%d\n",minans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2286.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include <string>
#include <map>
