//BZOJ2618.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

#define INF 1e23
#define eps 1e-14
#define MAXN 2333
inline int sign(D x) {
    return x > eps ? 1 : (x < -eps ? -1 : 0);
}
struct Point {
    D x, y;
    Point () {}
    Point (D a, D b) : x(a), y(b) {}
    Point operator + (Point a) const {
        return Point(x + a.x, y + a.y);
    }
    Point operator - (Point a) const {
        return Point(x - a.x, y - a.y);
    }
    Point operator * (D a) const {
        return Point(x * a, y * a);
    }
    Point operator / (D a) const {
        return Point(x / a, y / a);
    }
    D operator * (Point a) const {
        return x * a.y - y * a.x;
    }
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
    }
};

Point Is(Point p1, Point p2, Point q1, Point q2) {
    D a1 = (q2 - q1) * (p1 - q1), a2 = (p2 - q1) * (q2 - q1);
    return (p1 * a2 + p2 * a1) / (a1 + a2);
}

struct Border {
    Point p1, p2;
    D k;
    Border () {}
    Border (Point a, Point b) : p1(a), p2(b) {
        set();
    }
    void set() {
        k = atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    }
    void print() {
        printf("%lf %lf %lf %lf\n", p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y);
    }
};

bool operator < (const Border &a, const Border &b) {
    int c = sign(a.k - b.k);
    if (c) return c == 1;
    else return sign((b.p2 - b.p1) * (a.p1 - b.p1)) > 0;
}

bool ok(Border &p, Border &q, Border &i) {
    Point x = Is(p.p1, p.p2, q.p1, q.p2);
    return sign((i.p2 - i.p1) * (x - i.p1)) > 0;
}

int n, cnt;
Border a[MAXN], q[MAXN];
Point p[MAXN];
int pcnt = 0;

void work() {
    int he = 0, ta = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], a[i])) ta--;
        while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], a[i])) he++;
        q[ta++] = a[i];
    }
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[ta - 2], q[ta - 1], q[he])) ta--;
    while (he + 1 < ta && !ok(q[he], q[he + 1], q[ta - 1])) he++;
    if (ta - he < 3) puts("0.000");
    else {
        D ans = 0;
        for (int i = he; i < ta; i++) {
            int nxt = i + 1 == ta ? he : i + 1;
            p[++pcnt] = Is(q[i].p1, q[i].p2, q[nxt].p1, q[nxt].p2);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
            int nxt = i == pcnt ? 1 : i + 1;
            ans += p[i] * p[nxt];
        }
        printf("%.3lf\n", abs(ans) / 2 + eps);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int m;
        Point first, last, now;
        read(m);
        first.re();
        last = first;
        for (int j = 2; j <= m; j++) {
            now.re();
            a[++cnt] = Border(last, now);
            last = now;
        }
        a[++cnt] = Border(last, first);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 20];
int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
int n, m, K, dis[MAXN], pre[MAXN], sdis[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
#define T 131071
int q[T + 1];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[u], v, w
        };
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
            head[v], u, w
        };
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= K; i++) {
        read(x);
        dis[x] = sdis[x] = 0;
        q[ta++] = x;
    }
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & T];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (sdis[x] + e[now].w <= dis[e[now].to]) {
                if (pre[e[now].to] != x) sdis[e[now].to] = dis[e[now].to];
                dis[e[now].to] = sdis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
            } else if (sdis[x] + e[now].w < sdis[e[now].to]) {
                sdis[e[now].to] = sdis[x] + e[now].w;
            } else continue;
            if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                q[(ta++) & T] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", sdis[0]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2631.cpp
#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstring>
#include<vector>
#define REP(i,n) for(int i=0;i<n;++i)
using namespace std;

//Dynamic Tree

typedef long long int64;
const int MOD = 51061;
const int MAX_N = int(1e5) + 10;

struct Mark {
    int64 add, mul; //x*mul+add
    Mark(int64 add, int64 mul) {
        this->add = add;
        this->mul = mul;
    }
    Mark() {
        mul = 1;
        add = 0;
    }
    bool isId() {
        return mul == 1 && add == 0;
    }
};

Mark operator*(Mark a, Mark b) {
    return Mark((a.add * b.mul + b.add) % MOD, a.mul * b.mul % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    Node*p, *ch[2];
    bool rev;
    Mark m;
    int64 sum, val;
    int size;
    bool isRoot;
    Node*fa;
    Node() {
        sum = 0;
        isRoot = 0;
        size = 0;
    }
    void sc(Node*c, int d) {
        ch[d] = c;
        c->p = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == p->ch[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = (val + ch[0]->sum + ch[1]->sum) % MOD;
        size = 1 + ch[0]->size + ch[1]->size;
    }
    void apply(Mark a) {
        m = m * a;
        sum = (sum * a.mul + a.add * size) % MOD;
        val = (val * a.mul + a.add) % MOD;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(ch[0], ch[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setRoot(Node*f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void Node::setRoot(Node*f) {
    fa = f;
    isRoot = true;
    p = null;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (!m.isId()) {
        REP(i,2)
        if (ch[i] != null)
            ch[i]->apply(m);
        m = Mark();
    }
    if (rev) {
        REP(i,2)
        if (ch[i] != null)
            ch[i]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node mem[MAX_N], *C = mem;

Node*make(int v) {
    C->sum = C->val = v;
    C->rev = 0;
    C->m = Mark();
    C->ch[0] = C->ch[1] = null;
    C->isRoot = true;
    C->p = null;
    C->fa = null;
    return C++;
}

void rot(Node*t) {
    Node*p = t->p;
    p->relax();
    t->relax();
    bool d = t->d();
    p->p->sc(t, p->d());
    p->sc(t->ch[!d], d);
    t->sc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isRoot) {
        p->isRoot = false;
        t->isRoot = true;
        t->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node*t) {
    static Node*stk[MAX_N];
    int top = 0;
    while (t != null) {
        stk[top++] = t;
        t = t->p;
    }
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        stk[i]->relax();
}

void splay(Node*u, Node*f = null) {
    pushTo(u);
    while (u->p != f) {
        if (u->p->p == f)
            rot(u);
        else
            u->d() == u->p->d() ? (rot(u->p), rot(u)) : (rot(u), rot(u));
    }
    u->upd();
}

Node*v[MAX_N];
vector<int> E[MAX_N];
int n, nQ;

int que[MAX_N], fa[MAX_N], qh = 0, qt = 0;

void bfs() {
    que[qt++] = 0;
    fa[0] = -1;
    while (qh < qt) {
        int u = que[qh++];
        for (vector<int>::iterator e = E[u].begin(); e != E[u].end(); ++e)
            if (*e != fa[u])
                fa[*e] = u, v[*e]->fa = v[u], que[qt++] = *e;
    }
}

Node* expose(Node*u) {
    Node*v;
    for (v = null; u != null; v = u, u = u->fa) {
        splay(u);
        u->ch[1]->setRoot(u);
        u->sc(v, 1);
        v->fa = u;
    }
    return v;
}

void makeRoot(Node*u) {
    expose(u);
    splay(u);
    u->revIt();
}

void addEdge(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(v);
    v->fa = u;
}

void delEdge(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->sc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->fa = null;
    v->isRoot = true;
    v->p = null;
}

void markPath(Node*u, Node*v, Mark m) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    v->apply(m);
}

int queryPath(Node*u, Node*v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &nQ);
    REP(i,n-1) {
        int u, v;
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        --u, --v;
        E[u].push_back(v);
        E[v].push_back(u);
    }
    REP(i,n)
    v[i] = make(1);
    bfs();
    REP(i,nQ) {
        char cmd;
        scanf(" ");
        scanf("%c", &cmd);
        int i, j;
        scanf("%d%d", &i, &j);
        Node*u = ::v[--i], *v = ::v[--j];
        if (cmd == '+') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(c, 1));
        } else if (cmd == '*') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(0, c));
        } else if (cmd == '/') {
            printf("%d\n", queryPath(u, v));
        } else {
            int k, l;
            scanf("%d%d", &k, &l);
            delEdge(u, v);
            addEdge(::v[--k], ::v[--l]);
        }
    }
}

//BZOJ2631.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &op) {
    while (_c != '+' && _c != '-' && _c != '*' && _c != '/') _c = getchar();
    op = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MOD 51061
typedef long long LL;

struct Mark {
    LL add, mul;
    Mark(LL a, LL m) : add(a), mul(m) {}
    Mark() : add(0), mul(1) {}
    bool operator != (Mark b) const {
        return (add != b.add) || (mul != b.mul);
    }
} I;

Mark operator * (Mark a, Mark b) {
    return Mark((a.add * b.mul + b.add) % MOD, a.mul * b.mul % MOD);
}

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *p, *c[2];
    Mark m;
    LL sum, val;
    int size;
    bool rev, isRoot;
    Node () : sum(0), rev(0), isRoot(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int d) {
        c[d] = ch;
        ch->p = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        sum = (val + c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum) % MOD;
        size = c[0]->size + c[1]->size + 1;
    }
    void apply(Mark a) {
        m = m * a;
        sum = (sum * a.mul + a.add * size) % MOD;
        val = (val * a.mul + a.add) % MOD;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax();
    void setRoot(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setRoot(Node *f) {
    fa = f;
    isRoot = 1;
    p = null;
}

void Node::relax() {
    if (m != I) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->apply(m);
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->apply(m);
        m = I;
    }
    if (rev) {
        if (c[0] != null) c[0]->revIt();
        if (c[1] != null) c[1]->revIt();
        rev = 0;
    }
}

Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->sum = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->m = I;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->isRoot = 1;
    ptr->p = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *t) {
    Node *p = t->p;
    bool d = t->d();
    p->p->setc(t, p->d());
    p->setc(t->c[!d], d);
    t->setc(p, !d);
    p->upd();
    if (p->isRoot) {
        p->isRoot= 0;
        t->isRoot= 1;
        t->fa = p->fa;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) {
        sta[top++] = x;
        x = x->p;
    }
    for (int i = top - 1; i >= 0; i--) sta[i]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *u, Node *fa = null) {
    pushto(u);
    while (u->p != fa) {
        if (u->p->p == fa) rot(u);
        else u->d() == u->p->d() ? (rot(u->p), rot(u)) : (rot(u), rot(u));
    }
    u->upd();
}

Node* expose(Node *u) {
    Node *v;
    for (v = null; u != null; v = u, u = u->fa) {
        splay(u);
        u->c[1]->setRoot(u);
        u->setc(v, 1);
        v->fa = u;
    }
    return v;
}

void makeRoot(Node *u) {
    expose(u);
    splay(u);
    u->revIt();
}

void addEdge(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(v);
    v->fa = u;
}

void delEdge(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->fa = v->p = null;
    v->isRoot = 1;
}

void markPath(Node *u, Node *v, Mark m) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    v->apply(m);
}

LL queryPath(Node *u, Node *v) {
    makeRoot(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v->sum;
}

int n, Q;
Node*v[MAXN];
vector<int> E[MAXN];

int que[MAXN], fa[MAXN], qh = 0, qt = 0;

void bfs() {
    que[qt++] = 1;
    fa[1] = 0;
    while (qh < qt) {
        int u = que[qh++];
        for (vector<int>::iterator e = E[u].begin(); e != E[u].end(); ++e)
            if (*e != fa[u])
                fa[*e] = u, v[*e]->fa = v[u], que[qt++] = *e;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        E[x].push_back(y);
        E[y].push_back(x);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) v[i] = newNode(1);
    bfs();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        char cmd;
        scanf(" ");
        scanf("%c", &cmd);
        int x, y;
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        Node*u = ::v[x], *v = ::v[y];
        if (cmd == '+') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(c, 1));
        } else if (cmd == '*') {
            int c;
            scanf("%d", &c);
            markPath(u, v, Mark(0, c));
        } else if (cmd == '/') {
            printf("%lld\n", queryPath(u, v));
        } else {
            int k, l;
            scanf("%d%d", &k, &l);
            delEdge(u, v);
            addEdge(::v[k], ::v[l]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005

int p[MAXN / 4], pcnt;
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    p[++pcnt] = 2;
    for (int i = 3; i < MAXN; i += 2) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            for (int j = i * i; j < MAXN; j += i << 1) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    int n;
    read(n);
    int i = 1, j = pcnt, ans = 0;
    while (p[j] > n) j--;
    while (i <= j) {
        ans++;
        int tmp = p[j--];
        while (i <= j + 1 && tmp <= n) tmp *= p[i++];
        i--;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2645.cpp
/* Never say die. */

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 4012
#define MAXK 505
int n, k, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN], sum[MAXN], fa[MAXN], fL[MAXN][MAXK], fR[MAXN][MAXK];

vector <int> G[MAXN];

void dfsL(int u) {
    sum[u] = sum[fa[u]] + a[u];
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fL[v][j] = fL[u][j];
        dfsL(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fL[u][j] = max(fL[u][j], fL[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

void dfsR(int u) {
    for (int i = (int)G[u].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int v = G[u][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) fR[v][j] = fR[u][j];
        dfsR(v);
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) fR[u][j] = max(fR[u][j], fR[v][j - 1] + a[v]);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(fa[i]), read(a[i]);
        if (fa[i]) G[fa[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    dfsL(1);
    dfsR(1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (G[i].size() == 0) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) ans = max(ans, fL[i][j] + fR[i][k - j] + sum[i]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2648.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

Node *newNode(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int Q[2];
#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (x->d[d] >= Q[d]) x->l = x->l ? insert(x->l, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    else x->r = x->r ? insert(x->r, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    x->upd();
    if ((max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 3) >> 1 > x->siz) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    } else return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);

        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2648.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1000019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

int Q[2];
Node *newNode(int x = Q[0], int y = Q[1]) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) {
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2653.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define read(a) {a = 0; while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') a = a * 10 + (ch & 15), ch = getchar();}
#define MAXN 20319
#define rint register int
inline int max(rint a, rint b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    int v, he, ta;
} t[MAXN * 33];

struct Range {
    int v, he, ta;
    Range (int a = 0, int b = 0, int c = 0) : v(a), he(b), ta(c) {}
};

int tcnt = 0;

inline Range operator + (Range a, Range b) {
    Range ret;
    ret.v = a.v + b.v;
    ret.he = max(a.he, a.v + b.he);
    ret.ta = max(b.ta, b.v + a.ta);
    return ret;
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].he = max(t[t[x].l].he, t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].he);
    t[x].ta = max(t[t[x].r].ta, t[t[x].r].v + t[t[x].l].ta);
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = -1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        upd(x);
    }
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, v);
        upd(x);
    } else t[x].v = t[x].he = t[x].ta = 1;
    return x;
}

Range query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return Range(t[x].v, t[x].he, t[x].ta);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Range ret;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret = ret + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

typedef pair<int, int> pii;
int n, Q, x[4], rt[MAXN];
pii p[MAXN];

int main() {
    rint ans = 0, i, j, l, r, v, ch;
    read(n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        read(l);
        p[i] = make_pair(l, i);
    }
    sort(p, p + n);
    rt[n] = build(0, n - 1);
    for (i = n - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        rt[i] = update(rt[i + 1], 0, n - 1, p[i].second);
    }
    read(Q);
    for (i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            read(x[j]);
            x[j] = (x[j] + ans) % n;
        }
        sort(x, x + 4);
        l = 0, r = n - 1;
        while (l < r) {
            j = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            v = query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[1], x[2]).v;
            if (x[0] < x[1]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[0], x[1] - 1).ta);
            if (x[2] < x[3]) v += max(0, query(rt[j], 0, n - 1, x[2] + 1, x[3]).he);
            if (v >= 0) l = j;
            else r = j - 1;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans = p[l].first);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int u, v, w, c;
} e[MAXN];

bool B;
bool operator < (const edge &a, const edge &b) {
    return a.w != b.w ? a.w < b.w : (B ? a.c < b.c : a.c > b.c);
}

int n, m, need;
int f[MAXN], ans;
int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}
bool merge(int x, int y) {
    x = getf(x), y = getf(y);
    if (x == y) return 0;
    if (f[x] > f[y]) swap(x, y);
    f[x] += f[y];
    f[y] = x;
    return 1;
}

inline pii check(int mid) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w += mid;

    int tot1 = 0, tot2 = 0;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 0;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            ans += e[i].w;
            tot1 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    ans -= mid * tot1;

    memset(f, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
    B = 1;
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (merge(e[i].u, e[i].v)) {
            tot2 += !e[i].c;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) if (!e[i].c) e[i].w -= mid;
    return mp(tot1, tot2);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(need);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
        read(e[i].c);
    }
    int l = -100, r = 100;
    while (l <= r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        pii ret = check(mid);
        if (ret.fir <= need && ret.sec >= need) break;
        else if (ret.fir > need) l = mid + 1;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2656.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

#define rint register int

struct Num {
    int a[100], len;
    Num() {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 0;
    }
    Num(int x) {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof a);
        len = 1;
        a[1] = x;
    }
    int &operator [] (unsigned id) {
        return a[id];
    }
    Num operator + (Num b) const {
        Num ret;
        rint maxlen = len > b.len ? len : b.len, i;
        for (i = 1; i <= maxlen; i++) {
            ret[i] += a[i] + b[i];
            ret[i + 1] = ret[i] / 10000;
            ret[i] = ret[i] - ret[i + 1] * 10000;
        }
        ret.len = maxlen + (!!ret[maxlen + 1]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool odd() const {
        return a[1] & 1;
    }
    Num div2() const {
        Num ret;
        for (int i = len; i; i--) {
            if (a[i] & 1) ret[i - 1] = 5000;
            ret[i] += a[i] >> 1;
        }
        ret[0] = 0;
        ret.len = len - (!ret[len]);
        return ret;
    }
    bool operator < (Num b) const {
        if (len == b.len) {
            for (rint i = len; i; i--) {
                if (a[i] != b[i]) return a[i] < b[i];
            }
            return 0;
        } else return len < b.len;
    }
    void print() const {
        if (len) {
            printf("%d", a[len]);
            for (int i = len - 1; i; i--) printf("%04d", a[i]);
        } else putchar('0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} zero, one(1);

map <Num, Num> f;

char s[233];
int n;

Num dp(Num x) {
    if (f.find(x) == f.end()) {
        Num ha = x.div2();
        if (x.odd()) f[x] = dp(ha) + dp(ha + 1);
        else f[x] = dp(ha);
    }
    return f[x];
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    n = (int) strlen(s);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] ^= '0';
    reverse(s, s + n);
    s[n] = s[n + 1] = s[n + 2] = 0;
    Num N;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i += 4) {
        N[++N.len] = s[i] + s[i + 1] * 10 + s[i + 2] * 100 + s[i + 3] * 1000;
    }
    dp(N).print();
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    f[zero] = zero;
    f[one] = one;
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 200319

struct edge {
    int nxt, v;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int rt = 1, dep[MAXN];

void dfs(int x, int fa) {
    if (dep[x] > dep[rt]) rt = x;
    for (int o = head[x]; o; o = e[o].nxt) {
        if (e[o].v != fa) dep[e[o].v] = dep[x] + 1, dfs(e[o].v, x);
    }
}

struct Node {
    int u, v, id;
    bool operator < (const Node &a) const {
        if (u ^ a.u) return u < a.u;
        else		 return v < a.v;
    }
} a[MAXN * 2];

int cnt = 0;

void push(int u, int v, int id) {
    if (u > v) swap(u, v);
    a[++cnt] = (Node) {
        u, v, id
    };
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    if (n == 3) return puts("1"), 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
        int x, y, z, d;
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
        d = (x - y + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(x, y, i);
        d = (x - z + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(x, z, i);
        d = (z - y + n) % n;
        if (d != 1 && d != n - 1) push(z, y, i);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + cnt + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i += 2) add(a[i].id, a[i + 1].id);
    dfs(1, 0);
    dep[rt] = 0;
    dfs(rt, 0);
    printf("%d\n", dep[rt] + 1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2661.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 2005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w,flow;
} e[10005];

const int src=0,sink=1;

int gcd(int a,int b) {
    if (b) return gcd(b,a%b);
    else return a;
}

int a,b;
int ecnt=1,head[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void build() {
    for (int i=a; i<=b; i++) {
        add(src,i<<1,0);
        add((i<<1)^1,sink,0);
    }
    for (int y=a; y<b; y++)
        for (int x=y+1; x<=b; x++) {
            int z2=x*x-y*y,z=int(sqrt(z2));
            if (z2==z*z && gcd(y,z)==1) {
                add(x<<1,(y<<1)^1,x+y);
                add(y<<1,(x<<1)^1,x+y);
            }
        }
}
int dis[MAXN],pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
queue <int> q;

bool spfa() {
    memset(dis,200,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,0,sizeof(pre));
    q.push(src);
    dis[src]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front(),d=dis[x];
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]<d+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to]=d+e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return (pre[sink]!=0);
}

void work() {
    int p=0;
    long long ans=0;
    while (spfa()) {
        p++;
        ans+=dis[sink];
        for (int now=sink; now!=src; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow--;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow++;
        }
    }
    cout<<p/2<<" "<<ans/2<<endl;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&a,&b);
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2683.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

bool opt(int &op) {
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') _c=getchar();
    op = _c - '0';
    _c = getchar();
    return op != 3;
}

struct Node {
    int id, x, y, v, ans;
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y) || (x == a.x && y == a.y && id < a.id);
    }
} q[200000 * 4 + 5], tmp[200000 * 4 + 5];

int N, cnt = 0;

#define s 524288

int t[s << 1];

void add(int x, int v) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x] += v;
}

int query(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int l = s - 1, r = x + s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l&1) ret += t[l ^ 1];
        if (r&1) ret += t[r ^ 1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void cdq(int l, int r) {
    if (l >= r) return;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, lp = l, rp = mid + 1;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (q[i].v)	{
            if (q[i].id <= mid) add(q[i].y, q[i].v);
        } else {
            if (q[i].id > mid) q[i].ans += query(q[i].y);
        }
    }
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        if (q[i].v && q[i].id <= mid) add(q[i].y, -q[i].v);
        if (q[i].id <= mid) tmp[lp++] = q[i];
        else tmp[rp++] = q[i];
    }
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) q[i] = tmp[i];
    cdq(l, mid);
    cdq(mid + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    read(N);
    int op, x, y, a, b;
    while (opt(op)) {
        if (op == 1) {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(a);
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x, y, a, 0
            };
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(a);
            read(b);
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, a, b, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, a, y - 1, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x - 1, b, 0, 0
            };
            q[++cnt] = (Node) {
                cnt, x - 1, y - 1, 0, 0
            };
        }
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + cnt + 1);
    cdq(1, cnt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
        if (!q[i].v) {
            printf("%d\n", q[i].ans - q[i + 1].ans - q[i + 2].ans + q[i + 3].ans);
            i += 3;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2683.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void Max(int &a, int b) {
    if (a < b) a = b;
}
inline void Min(int &a, int b) {
    if (a > b) a = b;
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int siz, sum, val;
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2];
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1, sum = val;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz, sum += l->sum;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz, sum += r->sum;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

bool D;

inline bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D];
}

int Q[2], A;

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->d[0] = Q[0];
    ptr->d[1] = Q[1];
    ptr->val = A;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = 0;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) x->val += A;
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int tot;
Node *tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, bool d) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    tmp[mid]->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    tmp[mid]->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    tmp[mid]->upd();
    return tmp[mid];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++tot] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        tot = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, tot, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

bool in(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1<=X1&&X2<=x2&&y1<=Y1&&Y2<=y2;
}
bool out(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1>X2||x2<X1||y1>Y2||y2<Y1;
}

int query(Node *k,int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2) {
    if(!k)return 0;
    int ret=0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return k->sum;
    if(out(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return 0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->d[0],k->d[1],k->d[0],k->d[1])) ret += k->val;
    ret += query(k->l,x1,y1,x2,y2) + query(k->r,x1,y1,x2,y2);
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int op, x, y, z, w; ; ) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 3) break;
        if (op == 1) {
            read(Q[0]);
            read(Q[1]);
            read(A);
            //		Q[0] ^= ans, Q[1] ^= ans, A ^= ans;
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            read(w);
            read(y);
            read(x);
            read(z);
            //		w ^= ans, x ^= ans, y ^= ans, z ^= ans;
            ans = query(rt, w, y, x, z);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 10000005
#define MOD 100000009

bool vis[N];
int p[N / 7], pcnt;
LL f[N];

void init() {
    f[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, f[i] = -i + 1;
        for (int j = 1, k; (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) f[k] = f[i] * f[p[j]] % MOD;
            else {
                f[k] = f[i];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) ((f[i] *= i) += f[i - 1]) %= MOD;
}

int n, m;

LL sum(LL x, LL y) {
    x = x * (x + 1) / 2 % MOD, y = y * (y + 1) / 2 % MOD;
    return x * y % MOD;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        (ret += sum(1, n / i) * sum(1, m / i) % MOD * (f[j] - f[i - 1])) %= MOD;
    }
    printf("%d\n", int(ret + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2705.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL n,sqn,ans=0;

LL phi(LL x) {
    LL sqx=LL(sqrt(x)),ret=x;
    for (int i=2; i<=sqx; i++) {
        if (x%i==0) {
            ret=ret/i*(i-1);
            while (x%i==0) {
                x/=i;
            }
            sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ret=ret/x*(x-1);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    sqn=LL(sqrt(n));
    for (LL i=1; i<=sqn; i++) {
        if (n%i==0) {
            ans+=i*phi(n/i)+(n/i)*phi(i);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2716.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 1200319
#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)
struct Node {
    int id, x, y, k;
    bool operator < (Node a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} qq[MAXN], a[MAXN], b[MAXN];

int n, m, cnt, ans[MAXN];
#define T 1000319
int t[T];
void add(int x, int y) {
    for ( ; x < T; x += lowbit(x)) t[x] = max(t[x], y);
}
void del(int x) {
    for ( ; x < T; x += lowbit(x)) t[x] = 0;
}
int query(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    for ( ; x; x -= lowbit(x)) ret = max(ret, t[x]);
    return ret;
}
void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l >= r) return;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    solve(l, mid);
    solve(mid + 1, r);
    int L = l, R = mid + 1, pos = l;
    while (L <= mid && R <= r) b[pos++] = a[a[L].x <= a[R].x ? L++ : R++];
    while (L <= mid) b[pos++] = a[L++];
    while (R <= r) b[pos++] = a[R++];
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
        a[i] = b[i];
        if (a[i].id <= mid) {
            if (a[i].k) add(a[i].y, a[i].x + a[i].y);
        } else if (!a[i].k) {
            int ret = query(a[i].y);
            if (ret) ans[a[i].id] = min(ans[a[i].id], a[i].x + a[i].y - ret);
        }
    }
    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) if (a[i].id <= mid && a[i].k) del(a[i].y);
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        qq[++cnt] = (Node) {
            cnt, x + 1, y + 1, 1
        };
    }
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        qq[++cnt] = (Node) {
            cnt, x + 1, y + 1, 2 - op
        };
    }
    memset(ans + 1, INF, sizeof(int) * cnt);
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
            a[i] = qq[i];
            if (r & 1) a[i].x = 1000002 - a[i].x;
            if (r & 2) a[i].y = 1000002 - a[i].y;
        }
        solve(1, cnt);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) if (!qq[i].k) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2716.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 600019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN * 2], *ptr = mem, *rt;

Node *newNode(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int Q[2];
#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (x->d[d] >= Q[d]) x->l = x->l ? insert(x->l, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    else x->r = x->r ? insert(x->r, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2716.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 1200019
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

struct Node {
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2], siz;
    Node *l, *r;
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

Node *newNode(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    ptr->d[0] = ptr->ma[0] = ptr->mi[0] = x;
    ptr->d[1] = ptr->ma[1] = ptr->mi[1] = y;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = NULL;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

int D;
bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D] || (a->d[D] == b->d[D] && a->d[!D] < b->d[!D]);
}

Node *tmp[MAXN];
int top;

Node *build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    Node *x = tmp[mid];
    if (l < mid) x->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    else x->l = NULL;
    if (r > mid) x->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    else x->r = NULL;
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int Q[2];
#define dis(x) (abs(x->d[0] - Q[0]) + abs(x->d[1] - Q[1]))

inline int g(Node *x) {
    return x ? (max(max(Q[0] - x->ma[0], x->mi[0] - Q[0]), 0) + max(max(Q[1] - x->ma[1], x->mi[1] - Q[1]), 0)) : INF;
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++top] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (x->d[d] >= Q[d]) x->l = x->l ? insert(x->l, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    else x->r = x->r ? insert(x->r, !d) : newNode(Q[0], Q[1]);
    x->upd();
    if ((max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 3) >> 1 > x->siz) {
        top = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, top, d);
    } else return x;
}

int ans;

void query(Node *x) {
    if (!x) return;
    ans = min(ans, dis(x));
    int dl = g(x->l), dr = g(x->r);
    if (dl < dr) {
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
    } else {
        if (dr < ans) query(x->r);
        if (dl < ans) query(x->l);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        tmp[i] = newNode(x, y);
    }
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (int i = 1, op; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(Q[0]);
        read(Q[1]);
        if (op == 1) rt = insert(rt, 0);
        else {
            ans = INF, query(rt);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2733.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='B') ch=getchar();
    a=(ch=='Q');
    ch=getchar();
}
#define MAXN 300005
struct node {
    int lch,rch,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];

int n,m,q,tcnt=0,a[MAXN],rev[MAXN],rt[MAXN],f[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[x].lch;
    t[now].rch=t[x].rch;
    t[now].v=t[x].v+1;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].lch=update(t[x].lch,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].rch=update(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
int merge_tree(int x,int y) {
    if (!x) return y;
    if (!y) return x;
    t[x].lch=merge_tree(t[x].lch,t[y].lch);
    t[x].rch=merge_tree(t[x].rch,t[y].rch);
    t[x].v+=t[y].v;
    return x;
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]<0) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

void merge(int u,int v) {
    int fu=getf(u),fv=getf(v);
    if (fu!=fv) {
        if (f[fu]<f[fv]) {
            rt[fu]=merge_tree(rt[fu],rt[fv]);
            f[fu]+=f[fv];
            f[fv]=fu;
        } else {
            rt[fv]=merge_tree(rt[fv],rt[fu]);
            f[fv]+=f[fu];
            f[fu]=fv;
        }
    }
}

int kth_element(int x,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (t[t[x].lch].v>=k) {
        return kth_element(t[x].lch,l,mid,k);
    } else {
        return kth_element(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,k-t[t[x].lch].v);
    }
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(f,-1,sizeof(f));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        rev[a[i]]=i;
        rt[i]=update(0,1,n,a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        merge(x,y);
    }
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (op) {
            int fx=getf(x);
            if (-f[fx]<y) puts("-1");
            else printf("%d\n",rev[kth_element(rt[fx],1,n,y)]);
        } else {
            merge(x,y);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2734.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 1000000001
#define MAXN 100005
#define top 2048
typedef long long LL;
LL ans=1,dp[18][235];
int n,can[235],num[18][13],ccnt=0;
bool visit[MAXN];

void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<=top; i++) {
        if (!(i&(i>>1))) can[++ccnt]=i;
    }
}

void Modadd(LL &a,LL b) {
    a+=b;
    if (a>=MOD) a-=MOD;
}

void work(int x) {
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    num[1][1]=x;
    dp[0][1]=1;
    int last=1;
    for (int i=1;; i++) {
        int cnt=1;
        visit[num[i][1]]=1;
        for (int j=2;; j++) {
            num[i][j]=num[i][j-1]*3;
            if (num[i][j]>n) break;
            cnt=j;
            visit[num[i][j]]=1;
        }
        int nowtop=1<<cnt,now=1;
        for (int j=1;; j++) {
            if (can[j]>=nowtop) break;
            now=j;
            for (int k=1; k<=last; k++) {
                if (!(can[j]&can[k])) Modadd(dp[i][j],dp[i-1][k]);
            }
        }
        last=now;
        num[i+1][1]=num[i][1]*2;
        if (num[i+1][1]>n) {
            LL ret=0;
            for (int j=1; j<=now; j++) {
                Modadd(ret,dp[i][j]);
            }
            ans=(ans*ret)%MOD;
            return;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!visit[i]) work(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 505

struct data {
    int x,y,v;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return v<a.v;
    }

    int x1,y1,x2,y2,k;

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x]==x) return x;
    return f[x]=getf(f[x]);
}

bool isin(int x,int y,int k) {
    return x>q[k].x1 && x<=q[k].x2 && y>q[k].y1 && y<=q[k].y2;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(d[++dcnt].v);
            d[dcnt].x=i,d[dcnt].y=j;
        }
    }
    sort(d+1,d+dcnt+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].x1);
        read(q[i].y1);
        read(q[i].x2);
        read(q[i].y2);
        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].x1--;
        q[i].y1--;
        f[i]=i;
    }
    f[Q+1]=Q+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int st=(i-1)*n;
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            a[d[st+j].x][d[st+j].y]=1;
        }
        for (int x=1; x<=n; x++) {
            for (int y=1; y<=n; y++) {
                sum[x][y]=a[x][y]+sum[x-1][y]+sum[x][y-1]-sum[x-1][y-1];
            }
        }
        for (int w=getf(1); w<=Q; w=getf(w+1)) {
            int tot=sum[q[w].x2][q[w].y2]-sum[q[w].x1][q[w].y2]-sum[q[w].x2][q[w].y1]+sum[q[w].x1][q[w].y1];
            if (tot>=q[w].k) {
                int qqq=tot-q[w].k;
                for (int j=n; j; j--) {
                    if (isin(d[st+j].x,d[st+j].y,w)) {
                        if (!(qqq--)) {
                            ans[w]=d[st+j].v;
                        }
                    }
                }
                f[w]=w+1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;

        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

}
#define s 1048576
int n, m, c;
vector <int> Q[s], id[s];
int a[s], last[s], pre[s], ans[s], t[s * 2];

void update(int x, int v) {
    for (x += s; x; x >>= 1) t[x] += v;
}
int query(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (l += s - 1, r += s + 1; r - l > 1; l >>= 1, r >>= 1) {
        if (~l&1) ret += t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret += t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

        if (pre[i]) {
            update(pre[i], 1);
            if (pre[pre[i]]) update(pre[pre[i]], -1);

        last[a[i]] = i;
        for (int j = 0; j < Q[i].size(); j++) {
            ans[id[i][j]] = query(Q[i][j], i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2744.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXA 205
#define MAXB 3019

int A, B, M, ans;
int a[MAXA], b[MAXB], c[2], oktot;
bool G[MAXA][MAXB], H[MAXB][MAXB], ok[MAXB];
vector <int> E[MAXB];

int mat[MAXB], vis[MAXB], tag = 0;

bool find(int x) {
    for (int i = (int)E[x].size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (ok[E[x][i]] && vis[E[x][i]] != tag) {
            vis[E[x][i]] = tag;
            if (!mat[E[x][i]] || find(mat[E[x][i]])) return mat[x] = E[x][i], 1;
        }
    return 0;
}

int work() {
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * B);
    int ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) {
        if (ok[i] && b[i] & 1) {
            tag++;
            ret += find(i);
        }
    }
    return oktot - ret;
}

int main() {
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(M);
    for (int i = 1; i <= A; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) read(b[i]), c[b[i] & 1]++;
    ans = max(int(!!A), max(c[0], c[1]));
    for (int i = 1; i <= B; i++) if (b[i] & 1) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= B; j++) {
                if (~b[j] & 1 && ~__builtin_popcount(b[i] | b[j]) & 1) E[i].push_back(j);
            }
        }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= M; i++) read(u), read(v), G[u][v] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= A; i++) {
        oktot = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= B; j++) ok[j] = G[i][j], oktot += ok[j];
        ans = max(ans, work() + 1);
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= A; j++) {
            if ((a[i] ^ a[j]) & 1) {
                oktot = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= B; k++) ok[k] = G[i][k] & G[j][k], oktot += ok[k];
                ans = max(ans, work() + 2);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2751.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXK 100005
#define MOD 1000000007
using namespace std;
struct lim {
    int x,y;
    bool operator < (lim a) const {
        if (x!=a.x)
            return x<a.x;
        return y<a.y;
    }
    bool operator != (lim a) const {
        return !(a.x==x && a.y==y);
    }
} l[MAXK];
long long n,m,k,sum,tot=0,ans=1;

inline long long quickpower(long long x,long long b) {
    long long ans=1;
    x%=MOD;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1)
            ans=(ans*x)%MOD;
        x=(x*x)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&n,&m,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l[i].x,&l[i].y);
    }
    sort(l+1,l+k+1);
    sum=((1+n)*n)>>1;
    int i,j;
    for (i=2,j=1; i<=k; i++) {
        if (l[i]!=l[j]) {
            l[++j]=l[i];
        }
    }
    k=j;
    int now=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        tot+=l[i].x-now-1;
        now=l[i].x;
        long long last=sum-l[i].y;
        while (i<k && l[i+1].x==now) {
            i++;
            last-=l[i].y;
        }
        ans=(ans*(last%MOD))%MOD;
    }
    tot+=m-now;
    ans=(ans*quickpower(sum,tot))%MOD;
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2754.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005

map<int, int> t[MAXN];
int tcnt = 1, fail[MAXN];
vector<int> a[MAXN], st[MAXN];

int cal[MAXN], cat[MAXN];

void insert(int id) {
    int x = 1;
    int len;
    read(len);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to;
        read(to);
        int &p = t[x][to];
        if (!p) p = ++tcnt;
        x = p;
    }
    st[x].push_back(id);
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    for (int i = -1; i <= 10000; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (map<int, int>::iterator it = t[x].begin(); it != t[x].end(); it++) {
            int i = it->fir, j = fail[x], to = it->sec;
            while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
            fail[to] = t[j][i];
            q[ta++] = to;
        }
    }
}

int vis[MAXN];

inline void get(int x, int id) {
    for ( ; x > 1 && vis[x] != id; x = fail[x]) {
        vis[x] = id;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)st[x].size(); i++) {
            cat[id]++;
            cal[st[x][i]]++;
        }
    }
}

inline void solve(int id) {
    int x = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a[id].size(); i++) {
        while (!t[x][a[id][i]]) x = fail[x];
        x = t[x][a[id][i]];
        get(x, id);
    }
}

int n, m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        while (x--) read(y), a[i].push_back(y);
        a[i].push_back(-1);
        read(x);
        while (x--) read(y), a[i].push_back(y);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) insert(i);
    build();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) solve(i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) printf("%d\n", cal[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%d%c", cat[i], i == n ? '\n' : ' ');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2756.cpp

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 45
#define MAXNODE 2005
#define INF 1234567890123456ll
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL flow;
} e[MAXNODE<<4];

int S,T;
int n,m,head[MAXNODE],ecnt,tag[MAXNODE],cur[MAXNODE];
int a[MAXN][MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,LL flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int q[2048];
bool bfs() {
    int h=0,t=1;
    q[0]=0;
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (h<t) {
        int x=q[h++];
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q[t++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

LL dfs(int x,LL flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    LL used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            LL ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=T; i!=-1; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,INF);
    }
    return ans;
}

#define pos(i,j) ((i-1)*m+j)

bool ok(LL mid) {
    ecnt=1;
    LL should=0;
    S=0,T=n*m+1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            if ((i^j)&1) {
                should+=mid-a[i][j];
                add(0,pos(i,j),mid-a[i][j]);
                if (j<m) add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j+1),INF);
                if (j>1) add(pos(i,j),pos(i,j-1),INF);
                if (i<n) add(pos(i,j),pos(i+1,j),INF);
                if (i>1) add(pos(i,j),pos(i-1,j),INF);
            } else {
                add(pos(i,j),T,mid-a[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dinic()==should;
}

int main() {
    int t;
    read(t);
    while (t--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        int MAX=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                read(a[i][j]);
                MAX=max(a[i][j],MAX);
            }
        LL s[2]= {0,0};
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                s[(i^j)&1]+=a[i][j];
            }
        if (n&m&1) {
            LL x=s[0]-s[1];
            if (x>=MAX && ok(x)) printf("%lld\n",(x*n*m-(s[0]+s[1]))/2);
            else puts("-1");
        } else {
            if (s[0]!=s[1]) puts("-1");
            else {
                LL l=MAX,r=INF,mid;
                while (l<r) {
                    mid=(l+r)>>1;
                    if (ok(mid)) r=mid;
                    else l=mid+1;
                }
                printf("%lld\n",l*(n*m)/2-s[0]);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

struct data {
    int L,W;
    char s[103][103];
    data():L(0),W(1) {}
    char *operator [] (unsigned long long x) {
        return s[x];
    }
    void readline() {
        scanf("%s",s[++L]);
        int cnt=1;
        for (int i=0; s[L][i]; i++) if (s[L][i]==',') cnt++;
        if (cnt>W) W=cnt;
    }
} a[105];

int n,maxlen=0,pos[105];
char ans[105][20005];
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d",&x);
        a[i].readline();
        for (int j=1; j<=x; j++) a[i].readline();
        maxlen=max(maxlen,x);
    }
    maxlen++;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=maxlen; j++) {
            int cnt=1;
            for (int k=0; a[i][j][k]; k++) {
                ans[j][++pos[j]]=a[i][j][k];
                if (a[i][j][k]==',') cnt++;
            }
            while (cnt++<=a[i].W) ans[j][++pos[j]]=',';
        }
    }
    for (int j=1; j<=maxlen; j++) {
        ans[j][pos[j]]='\0';
        puts(ans[j]+1);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2763.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXK 12
#define MAXM 100005

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,k,s,t,ecnt=0,head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dis[MAXN][MAXK];
bool inq[MAXN][MAXK];
queue <int> q;
int spfa() {
    memset(dis,127,sizeof(dis));
    q.push(s<<10);
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        dis[s][i]=0;
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front()>>10,d=q.front()&1023;
        q.pop();
        inq[x][d]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to][d]>dis[x][d]+e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to][d]=dis[x][d]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to][d]) {
                    inq[e[now].to][d]=1;
                    q.push((e[now].to<<10)|d);
                }
            }
            if (d<k && dis[e[now].to][d+1]>dis[x][d]) {
                dis[e[now].to][d+1]=dis[x][d];
                if (!inq[e[now].to][d+1]) {
                    inq[e[now].to][d+1]=1;
                    q.push((e[now].to<<10)|(d+1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans=0x7f7f7f7f;
    for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) {
        ans=min(ans,dis[t][i]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    read(s);
    read(t);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    printf("%d\n",spfa());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

int n,head[MAXN],sum[MAXN],a[MAXN],s,h,t,ans=0,ecnt=0;

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    int dep=++t;
    sum[dep]=sum[dep-1]+a[x];
    while (sum[dep]-sum[h]>s) h++;
    if (sum[dep]-sum[h]==s) ans++;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa) {
            int hh=h;
            dfs(e[now].to,x);
            h=hh;
        }
    }
    --t;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(s);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    sum[0]=0;
    h=t=0;
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2795.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 500005
#define P 19260817

int n, q;
char s[MAXN];
LL h[MAXN], p[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];
int cnt[MAXN], num[MAXN][8];

void init() {
    p[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) h[i] = h[i - 1] * P + s[i], p[i] = p[i - 1] * P;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            for (int j = i; j <= n; j += i) {
                vis[j] = 1;
                num[j][cnt[j]++] = i;
            }
        }
    }
}

#define Ha(l, r) (h[r] - h[l] * p[r - (l)])

void work() {
    int l, r;
    while (q--) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int len = r - (--l), flag = (len > 1);
        while (flag) {
            flag = 0;
            for (int i = cnt[len] - 1; i > -1; i--) {
                int ta = len / num[len][i];
                if (Ha(l, r - ta) == Ha(l + ta, r)) {
                    flag = ta > 1, len = ta;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n", len);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    init();
    read(q);
    work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
