int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
map<LL,int> M;
LL f[100];

void init() {
    f[0]=0;
    f[1]=1;
    M[0]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=90; i++) {
        f[i]=f[i-1]+f[i-2];
        M[f[i]]=1;
    }
}

int find(LL x) {
    int l=4,r=90,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (f[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int query(LL x) {
    int k=M[x];
    if (k) return k;
    int q=find(x);
    return M[x]=min(query(x-f[q-1]),query(f[q]-x))+1;
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    scanf("%d",&T);
    while (T--) {
        LL x;
        scanf("%lld",&x);
        printf("%d\n",query(x));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2809.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define master 1
using namespace std;
char ch;
inline void read(int& a) {
    a=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9')
        ch=getchar();
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    return;
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
struct Tree {
    int cnt,L,R;
    long long total;
} t[MAXN*22];
int n,m,ecnt=0,dfscnt=0,tcnt=0;
int c[MAXN],l[MAXN],head[MAXN],st[MAXN],ed[MAXN],rt[MAXN];
int fuck[MAXN],fucker;
long long ans=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    return;
}

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].cnt=0;
    t[now].total=0;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    t[now].L=build(l,mid);
    t[now].R=build(mid+1,r);
    return now;
}

int update(int x,int l,int r,int p,int val) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].L=t[x].L;
    t[now].R=t[x].R;
    t[now].cnt=t[x].cnt+1;
    t[now].total=t[x].total+val;
    if (l==r)
        return now;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid)
        t[now].L=update(t[x].L,l,mid,p,val);
    else
        t[now].R=update(t[x].R,mid+1,r,p,val);
    return now;
}

int query(int tl,int tr,int l,int r,long long p) {
    if (l==r) {
        int Num=t[tr].cnt-t[tl].cnt;
        return min(Num,(int)(p/fuck[l]));
    }
    long long nowcost=t[t[tr].L].total-t[t[tl].L].total;
    if (nowcost>p)
        return query(t[tl].L,t[tr].L,l,(l+r)>>1,p);
    else
        return query(t[tl].R,t[tr].R,((l+r)>>1)+1,r,p-nowcost)+t[t[tr].L].cnt-t[t[tl].L].cnt;
}

int dfs(int x) {
    int st=++dfscnt,ed=st;
    rt[dfscnt]=update(rt[dfscnt-1],0,MAXN,(int)(lower_bound(fuck+1,fuck+fucker+1,c[x])-fuck),c[x]);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        ed=dfs(e[now].to);
    }
    long long res=(long long)l[x]*query(rt[st-1],rt[ed],0,MAXN,m);
    if (ans<res)
        ans=res;
    return ed;
}
int main() {
//	freopen("READ.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("cmp.out","w",stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(c[0]);
    read(c[1]);
    read(l[1]);
    fuck[1]=c[1];
    for (int i=2,boss; i<=n; i++) {
        read(boss);
        read(c[i]);
        read(l[i]);
        fuck[i]=c[i];
        add(boss,i);
    }
    fucker=(int)(unique(fuck+1,fuck+n+1)-(fuck+1));
    sort(fuck+1,fuck+fucker+1);
    rt[0]=build(0,MAXN);
    dfs(master);
    printf("%lld",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2818.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10000005

typedef long long LL;

bool notprime[MAXN];
int n,sqn,prime[1000005],pcnt=0;
LL ans=0,sum[MAXN],phi[MAXN];

void shake() {
    sum[1]=phi[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            phi[i]=i-1;
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=pcnt && i*prime[j]<=n ; j++) {
            notprime[i*prime[j]]=1;
            if (i%prime[j]==0) {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=prime[j]*phi[i];
                break;
            } else {
                phi[i*prime[j]]=(prime[j]-1)*phi[i];
            }
        }
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+phi[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>n;
    sqn=int(sqrt(n));
    shake();
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        ans+=(sum[n/prime[i]])*2-1;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2820.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10000002

bool vis[MAXN];
int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt;
int mu[MAXN], f[MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = p[i]; j < MAXN; j += p[i])
            f[j] += mu[j / p[i]];
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] += f[i - 1];
}

int T;

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i)) + 1;
        ans += (long long)(f[j - 1] - f[i - 1]) * (n / i) * (m / i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2820.cpp

template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 10000002

bool vis[MAXN];

int mu[MAXN], f[MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++)
        for (int j = p[i]; j < MAXN; j += p[i])
            f[j] += mu[j / p[i]];
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) f[i] += f[i - 1];
}

int T;

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i)) + 1;
        ans += (long long)(f[j - 1] - f[i - 1]) * (n / i) * (m / i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2821.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define SQN 320
int n, c, m, sqn;
int a[MAXN], st[SQN], ed[SQN], tot = 0;
int sum[SQN][MAXN], f[SQN][SQN], tmp[MAXN];

int lastans = 0;

void init() {
    sqn = (int)sqrt(n) + 1;
    tot = n / sqn + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!st[i / sqn + 1]) st[i / sqn + 1] = i;
        ed[i / sqn + 1] = i;
    }
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        tmp[a[i]]++;
        if (i == ed[j]) memcpy(sum[j++] + 1, tmp + 1, c * 4);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        memset(tmp, 0, sizeof tmp);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int j = st[i], k = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if (tmp[a[j]]&1) ans++;
            else if (tmp[a[j]] != 0) ans--;
            tmp[a[j]]++;
            if (j == ed[k]) f[i][++k] = ans;
        }
    }
}

int work(int l, int r) {
    int bl = l / sqn + 1, br = r / sqn + 1, ret = f[bl + 1][br], cnt = 0;
    if (bl != br) {
        for (int i = l; i <= ed[bl]; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        for (int i = st[br]; i <= r; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= cnt; i = j) {
            j = i + 1;
            while (j <= cnt && tmp[j] == tmp[i]) j++;
            int tt = sum[br - 1][tmp[i]] - sum[bl][tmp[i]];
            if (tt > 0 && ~tt&1) ret--;
            tt += j - i;
            if (tt > 0 && ~tt&1) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) tmp[++cnt] = a[i];
        sort(tmp + 1, tmp + cnt + 1);
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= cnt; i = j) {
            j = i + 1;
            while (j <= cnt && tmp[j] == tmp[i]) j++;
            if ((~j^i)&1) ret++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(c);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    init();
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + lastans) % n + 1;
        r = (r + lastans) % n + 1;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        printf("%d\n", lastans = work(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2822.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXL 5005

struct num {
    int v[MAXL],len;
    num() {}
    void init() {
        memset(v,0,MAXL<<2);
        len=0;
    }
    num (int x) {
        init();
        while (x) {
            v[++len]=x%10;
            x/=10;
        }
    }
    num operator + (num a) const {
        num ret=a;
        ret.len=max(len,a.len);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                ret.v[i]-=10;
                ret.v[i+1]++;
            }
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len+1]) ret.len++;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (num a) const {
        num ret=*this;
        for (int i=1; i<=a.len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]-=a.v[i];
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        for (int i=ret.len+1; i<len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]<0) {
                ret.v[i]+=10;
                ret.v[i+1]--;
            }
        }
        while (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (num a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=a.len; j++) {
                ret.v[i+j-1]+=v[i]*a.v[j];
            }
        ret.len=len+a.len-1;
        for (int i=1; i<=ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[i]-=temp*10;
                if (i==ret.len) ret.len++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator * (int a) const {
        num ret(0);
        for (int i=1; i<=len; i++) {
            ret.v[i]+=v[i]*a;
            if (ret.v[i]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[i]/10;
                ret.v[i+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[i]-=temp*10;
            }
        }
        ret.len=len;
        while (ret.v[ret.len+1]) {
            ret.len++;
            if (ret.v[ret.len]>9) {
                int temp=ret.v[ret.len]/10;
                ret.v[ret.len+1]+=temp;
                ret.v[ret.len]-=temp*10;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
    num operator - (int x) const {
        num ret=*this;
        ret.v[1]-=x;
        for (int i=1; i<ret.len; i++) {
            if (ret.v[i]>=0) break;
            ret.v[i]+=10;
            ret.v[i+1]--;
        }
        if (ret.v[ret.len]==0) ret.len--;
        return ret;
    }
    void print() {
        for (int i=len; i; i--) putchar(v[i]+'0');
        putchar('\n');
    }
} ans(1);

#define MAXN 505

int n,pcnt=0,p[MAXN],minp[MAXN<<1],cnt[MAXN<<1];
bool notprime[MAXN<<1];

void init() {
    int nn=n<<1;
    for (int i=2; i<=nn; i++) {
        if (!notprime[i]) {
            p[++pcnt]=i;
            minp[i]=pcnt;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=nn; j+=i) {
                notprime[j]=1;
                if (!minp[j]) minp[j]=pcnt;
            }
        }
    }
}

void calc(int x,int v) {
    while (x!=1) {
        cnt[minp[x]]+=v;
        x/=p[minp[x]];
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    init();
    for (int i=2*n; i>n+1; i--) calc(i,1);
    for (int i=n; i>0; i--) calc(i,-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=pcnt; i++) {
        while (cnt[i]) ans=ans*p[i],cnt[i]--;
    }
    ans.print();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
LL A=1234,B=101,C=107,M=19260817;
const double eps=1e-6;
int Rand() {
    A=(A*B+C)%M;
    return int(A);
}

struct point {
    double x,y;
    point() {}
    point(double _x,double _y):x(_x),y(_y) {}
} p[500005];
double dis(point a,point b) {
    return sqrt((a.x-b.x)*(a.x-b.x)+(a.y-b.y)*(a.y-b.y));
}
point mid(point a,point b) {
    return point((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2);
}

point center(point a,point b,point c) {
    double a1=b.x-a.x,b1=b.y-a.y,c1=(a1*a1+b1*b1)/2;
    double a2=c.x-a.x,b2=c.y-a.y,c2=(a2*a2+b2*b2)/2;
    double d=a1*b2-a2*b1;
    return (point) {
        a.x+(c1*b2-c2*b1)/d,a.y+(a1*c2-a2*c1)/d
    };
}
int n;
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf",&p[i].x,&p[i].y);
        if (i&2) swap(p[i],p[Rand()%(i-1)+1]);
    }
    point O=p[1];
    double r=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) {
        if (dis(O,p[i])>eps+r) {
            O=p[i];
            r=0;
            for (int j=1; j<i; j++)
                if (dis(O,p[j])>eps+r) {
                    O=mid(p[i],p[j]);
                    r=dis(O,p[j]);
                    for (int k=1; k<j; k++) {
                        if (dis(O,p[k])>eps+r) {
                            O=center(p[i],p[j],p[k]);
                            r=dis(O,p[j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    printf("%.2lf %.2lf %.2lf\n",O.x,O.y,r);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2875.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

long long MOD,n,g,x0,a,c;

long long now[2][2],trans[2][2],temp[2][2];

inline long long exp(long long a,long long b) {
    long long ret=0;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) {
            ret=(ret+a)%MOD;
        }
        a=(a+a)%MOD;
        b>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void fuck(long long a[2][2],long long b[2][2]) {
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            temp[i][j]=0;
            for (int k=0; k<2; k++) {
                temp[i][j]=(temp[i][j]+exp(a[i][k],b[k][j]))%MOD;
            }
        }
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<2; j++) {
            a[i][j]=temp[i][j];
        }
}

inline void quickpower(long long x) {
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) {
            fuck(now,trans);
        }
        fuck(trans,trans);
        x>>=1;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin>>MOD>>a>>c>>x0>>n>>g;
    trans[0][0]=a;
    trans[0][1]=0;
    trans[1][0]=c;
    trans[1][1]=1;
    now[0][0]=1;
    now[1][1]=1;
    quickpower(n);
    cout<<((exp(x0,now[0][0])+now[1][0])%MOD)%g<<endl;
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 10005
#define eps 1e-12

int n;
D E, s[MAXN], K[MAXN], v[MAXN], x[MAXN];

bool check(D lam) {
    D ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        D l = max(0., v[i]), r = 1e9;
        while (r - l > eps) {
            D mid = (l + r) / 2;
            if (2 * lam * K[i] * mid * mid * (mid - v[i]) >= 1) r = mid;
            else l = mid;
        }
        x[i] = l;
        ret += K[i] * s[i] * (x[i] - v[i]) * (x[i] - v[i]);
    }
    return ret >= E;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%lf", &E);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%lf%lf%lf", s + i, K + i, v + i);
    }
    D l = 0, r = 1e9, mid;
    while (r - l > eps) {
        mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid;
    }
    D ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += s[i] / x[i];
    printf("%.8lf\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2879.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 45
#define MAXM 105
#define MAXP 805
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int next, to, w, flow;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * MAXM];

int n, m, ecnt = 1, S = 0, T = 1, sum = 0, node, ans = 0;
int p[MAXN], a[MAXN][MAXM], head[MAXN * MAXP], name[MAXN * MAXP], tot[MAXM];

#define dish(x) (x + 1)

void add(int u, int v, int w, int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].flow = flow;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].flow = 0;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(dish(i), T, 0, p[i]);
    node = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        add(S, ++node, 0, 1);
        name[node] = i;
        tot[i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            add(node, dish(j), a[j][i], 1);
        }
    }
}

int dis[MAXN * MAXP], pre[MAXN * MAXP], pos[MAXN * MAXP];
bool inq[MAXN * MAXP];
queue <int> q;

bool spfa() {
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, node * 4);
    memset(pre + 1, 0, node * 4);
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

void addAns() {
    int c = INF;
    for (int x = T;; x = pre[x]) {
        e[pos[x]].flow--, e[pos[x]^1].flow++;
        if (pre[x] == S) {
            c = name[x];
            break;
        }
    }
    ans += dis[T];
    tot[c]++;
    name[++node] = c;
    add(S, node, 0, 1);
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        add(node, dish(j), a[j][c] * tot[c], 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(p[i]), sum += p[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    init();
    while (spfa()) addAns();
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 300319

int n;
int a[MAXN];

#define s(i) a[(i) % n]

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) read(a[i]);
    int i = 0, j = 1;
    while (i < n && j < n) {
        int k = 0;
        while (k < n && s(i + k) == s(j + k)) k++;
        if (k == n) break;
        if (s(i + k) > s(j + k)) i += k + 1;
        else j += k + 1;
        if (i == j) j++;
    }
    for (int x = min(i, j), k = 0; k < n; k++) printf("%d%c", s(x + k), k == n - 1 ? '\n' : ' ');
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2901.cpp

#include <iostream>

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 2005
int n,m;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(a[i][j]);
            a[i][j]+=a[i-1][j];
        }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(b[i][j]);
            b[i][j]+=b[i][j-1];
        }
    for (int i=1,x1,y1,x2,y2; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x1);
        read(y1);
        read(x2);
        read(y2);
        if (x1>x2) swap(x1,x2);
        if (y1>y2) swap(y1,y2);
        x1--,y1--;
        LL ret=0;
        for (int k=1; k<=n; k++) {
            ret+=(a[x2][k]-a[x1][k])*(b[k][y2]-b[k][y1]);
        }

//BZOJ2929.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 205

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*4];

int n,ecnt=1,head[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
int tag[MAXN],cur[MAXN];
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(1);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[1]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[n]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==n) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ans=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(1,INF);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,cnt; i<n; i++) {
        read(cnt);
        for (int j=1,x; j<=cnt; j++) {
            read(x);
            if (i==1 || x==n) add(i,x,1);
            else add(i,x,INF);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",dinic());
    return 0;
}

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 30005

int t[MAXN][2], fail[MAXN], tcnt = 1;
bool vis[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];
void insert() {
    scanf("%s" , s + 1);
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    int x = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] ^ '0';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
    }
    vis[x] = 1;
}

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    t[0][0] = t[0][1] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = 1;
    fail[0] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            int to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) t[x][i] = t[fail[x]][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                vis[to] |= vis[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
}

bool inq[MAXN];
int stp = 1;

bool dfs(int x) {
    inq[x] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int to = t[x][i];
        if (inq[to]) return 1;
        if (vis[to]) continue;
        vis[to] = 1;
        if (dfs(to)) return 1;
    }
    inq[x] = 0;
    return 0;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) insert();
    build();
    if (dfs(1)) puts("TAK");
    else puts("NIE");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2946.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define LEN 2005
#define P 83
int n,len[6],maxlen=0;
char s[6][LEN];
LL ha[6][LEN],pp[LEN],ck[6][LEN*5];

bool check(int mid) {
    int tot[6]= {0},pos[6]= {1,1,1,1,1,1};
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=mid; j<=len[i]; j++) {
            ck[i][++tot[i]]=ha[i][j]-ha[i][j-mid]*pp[mid];
        }
        sort(ck[i]+1,ck[i]+tot[i]+1);
    }
    while (pos[1]<=tot[1]) {
        bool flag=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            while (pos[i]<tot[i] && ck[i][pos[i]+1]<=ck[1][pos[1]]) pos[i]++;
            if (ck[i][pos[i]]!=ck[1][pos[1]]) flag=0;
        }
        if (flag) return 1;
        pos[1]++;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s[i]+1);
        len[i]=(int)strlen(s[i]+1);
        ha[i][0]=0;
        for (int j=1; j<=len[i]; j++) {
            ha[i][j]=ha[i][j-1]*P+s[i][j];
        }
        maxlen=max(maxlen,len[i]);
    }
    pp[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=maxlen; i++) pp[i]=pp[i-1]*P;
    int l=0,r=maxlen,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r+1)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) l=mid;
        else r=mid-1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2946.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 10319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int b, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - b + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

priority_queue< pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int> >, greater<pair<int, int> > > q;

int n, len = 1, lim[7], cnt[7], ans = 0;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], p[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    s[0] = 'a' - 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + len);
        len = (int)strlen(s) + 1;
        lim[i] = len - 2;
        s[len - 1] = char('z' + i);
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        printf("%d\n", len - 2);
        return 0;
    }
    len--;
    getsa(s, sa, len, 'a', 26 + n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= len; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[j + k] == s[i + k]; k++);
    }
    /*	for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) putchar(s[i]), putchar(' ');
    	putchar('\n');
    	for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) printf("%d ", sa[i]);
    	putchar('\n');
    	for (int i = 2; i <= len; i++) printf("%d ", h[i]);
    	putchar('\n');*/
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) p[i] = int(lower_bound(lim + 1, lim + n + 1, sa[i]) - lim)/*, printf("%d ", p[i])*/;
    /*	putchar('\n');
    */	for (int i = 2, j = 1, tot = 0; j < len; ) {
        while (tot < n && j < len) {
            j++;
            if (!cnt[p[j]]) tot++;
            cnt[p[j]]++;
            if (!cnt[p[j - 1]]) tot++;
            cnt[p[j - 1]]++;
            q.push(make_pair(h[j], j));
        }
        while (tot == n) {
            ans = max(ans, q.top().first);
            while (i <= j && i <= q.top().second) {
                cnt[p[i]]--;
                if (!cnt[p[i]]) tot--;
                cnt[p[i - 1]]--;
                if (!cnt[p[i - 1]]) tot--;
                i++;
            }
            while (i <= j && i > q.top().second) q.pop();
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <set>
#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 9999
#define K 26
struct SAM {
    int t[MAXN * 2][K], tot, dis[MAXN * 2], fa[MAXN * 2], ans[MAXN * 2];
    int last;
    int qq[MAXN * 2], tmp[MAXN * 2];
    SAM () {
        last = ++tot;
    }
    void add(int x) {
        int p = last, np = ++tot;
        last = np, dis[np] = dis[p] + 1;
        for ( ; p && !t[p][x]; p = fa[p]) t[p][x] = np;
        if (!p) fa[np] = 1;
        else {
            int q = t[p][x];
            if (dis[q] == dis[p] + 1) fa[np] = q;
            else {
                int nq = ++tot;
                dis[nq] = dis[p] + 1;
                memcpy(t[nq], t[q], K * 4);
                fa[nq] = fa[q], fa[np] = fa[q] = nq;
                for ( ; t[p][x] == q; p = fa[p]) t[p][x] = nq;
            }
        }
    }
    void build() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) tmp[dis[i]]++;
        for (int i = tot - 1; ~i; i--) tmp[i] += tmp[i + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) qq[tmp[dis[i]]--] = i;
        for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) ans[i] = dis[i];
    }
} T;

int n, m, dd[MAXN * 2];
char s[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    m = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) T.add(s[i] - 'a');
    T.build();

    for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        memset(dd + 1, 0, T.tot * 4);
        int x = 1, now = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            int to = s[i] - 'a';
            now++;
            if (T.t[x][to]) x = T.t[x][to];
            else {
                while (x && !T.t[x][to]) x = T.fa[x];
                if (!x) x = 1, now = 0;
                else now = min(T.dis[x], now) + 1, x = T.t[x][to];
            }
            dd[x] = max(dd[x], now);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) {
            T.ans[T.qq[i]] = min(T.ans[T.qq[i]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
            dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]] = max(dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) ans = max(ans, T.ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) {
            T.ans[T.qq[i]] = min(T.ans[T.qq[i]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
            dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]] = max(dd[T.fa[T.qq[i]]], dd[T.qq[i]]);
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= T.tot; i++) ans = max(ans, T.ans[i]);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 30005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m, dep[MAXN], fa[15][MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < 15; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[0][x]) {
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            fa[0][e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = 14; ~i; i--) if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) u = fa[i][u], v = fa[i][v];
    return fa[0][u];
}

#define dis(x, y) (dep[x] + dep[y] - 2 * dep[lca(x, y)])

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1);
    read(m);
    int x = 1, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(y);
        ans += dis(x, y);
        x = y;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();

#define MOD 19940417
#define inv2 9970209
#define inv6 3323403
LL getsum(LL x) {
    LL ret=0;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=x; i=j+1) {
        j=x/(x/i);
        ret=(ret+(((x/i)*(i+j))%MOD)*(((j-i+1)*inv2)%MOD))%MOD;
    }
    return (x*x-ret+MOD)%MOD;
}
LL powersum(LL x) {
    return (((x*(x+1)%MOD)*(2*x+1))%MOD*inv6)%MOD;
}

LL fuck(LL x,LL y) {
    LL ret=0,fret=0;
    LL mm=min(x,y),xy=(x*y)%MOD;
    for (LL i=1,j; i<=mm; i=j+1) {
        j=min(x/(x/i),y/(y/i));
        LL a=x/i,b=y/j,sum=(((i+j)*(j-i+1))%MOD*inv2)%MOD,ab=(a*b)%MOD;
        ret=(ret+xy*(j-i+1)+(MOD+powersum(j)-powersum(i-1))*ab)%MOD;
        fret=(fret+(a*y+b*x)%MOD*sum)%MOD;
    }
    if (ret<fret) return MOD+ret-fret;
    else return ret-fret;
}

LL n,m,ans=0;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    LL sumn=getsum(n),summ=getsum(m);
    ans=(sumn*summ)%MOD;
    ans=(ans-fuck(n,m)+MOD)%MOD;
    printf("%d\n",int(ans));
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
    double ma;
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

#define lch t[x].l
#define rch t[x].r

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = 0, t[x].ma = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        lch = build(l, mid);
        rch = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

int find(int x, int l, int r, double k) {
    if (l == r) return t[x].ma > k;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[lch].ma <= k) return find(rch, mid + 1, r, k);
    else return find(lch, l, mid, k) + t[x].v - t[lch].v;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p, double k) {
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].v = 1;
        t[x].ma = k;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(lch, l, mid, p, k);
        else update(rch, mid + 1, r, p, k);
        t[x].ma = max(t[lch].ma, t[rch].ma);
        t[x].v = t[lch].v + find(rch, mid + 1, r, t[lch].ma);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        update(1, 1, n, x, double(y) / x);
        printf("%d\n", t[1].v);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ2979.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>

    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';

#define MAXN 5005

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} ee[MAXN<<5],e[MAXN<<6];

int eecnt=0,ehead[MAXN],ecnt=1,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN];
bool visit[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_1(int u,int v) {
    ee[++eecnt].to=v;
    ee[eecnt].next=ehead[u];
    ee[eecnt].flow=0;
    ehead[u]=eecnt;
}

int n,ans=0;

bool k_T(int x) {
    if (x==n) return 1;
    for (int now=ehead[x]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
        if (!visit[ee[now].to]) {
            visit[ee[now].to]=1;
            if (k_T(ee[now].to)) {
                ee[now].flow++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int kkk;

bool S_k(int x) {
    if (x==kkk) return 1;
    for (int now=ehead[x]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
        if (!visit[ee[now].to]) {
            visit[ee[now].to]=1;
            if (S_k(ee[now].to)) {
                ee[now].flow++;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(n);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[n]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow-used));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(n,0x7ffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}
int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,x; i<n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j=1,p; j<=x; j++) {
            read(p);
            add_1(i,p);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int now=ehead[i]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
            if (!ee[now].flow) {
                ans++;
                memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
                visit[1]=1;
                kkk=i;
                S_k(1);
                memset(visit,0,sizeof(visit));
                visit[ee[now].to]=1;
                k_T(ee[now].to);
                ee[now].flow++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int now=ehead[i]; now; now=ee[now].next) {
            if (ee[now].flow>1) {
                add(ee[now].to,i,ee[now].flow-1);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans-dinic());
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(LL &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MOD 10007

LL power(LL x, LL b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

LL fac[MOD * 2 + 5], inv[MOD * 2 + 5];

void init() {
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1;
    inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
    for (LL i = 2; i <= MOD; i++) fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD, inv[i] = power(fac[i], MOD - 2);
    /*for (LL i =  MOD - 2; i > 0; i--) inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD;*/
}

LL C(LL n, LL m) {
    return ((fac[n] * inv[m]) % MOD * inv[n - m]) % MOD;
}

LL Lucas(LL n, LL m) {
    if (!m) return 1;
    return (C(n % MOD, m % MOD) * Lucas(n / MOD, m / MOD)) % MOD;
}

void work() {
    LL n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    printf("%lld\n", Lucas(n, m));
}

int main() {
    LL T;
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

void init() {
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1;
    inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
    for (LL i = 2; i <= MOD; i++) fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD, inv[i] = power(fac[i], MOD - 2);
    /*for (LL i =  MOD - 2; i > 0; i--) inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD;*/
}

LL C(LL n, LL m) {
    if (n < m) return 0;
    return ((fac[n] * inv[m]) % MOD * inv[n - m]) % MOD;
}

LL Lucas(LL n, LL m) {
    if (!m) return 1;
    return (C(n % MOD, m % MOD) * Lucas(n / MOD, m / MOD)) % MOD;
}

void work() {
    LL n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    printf("%lld\n", Lucas(n, m));
}

int main() {
    LL T;
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#define MOD 10007

int power(int x, int b) {
    int ret = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b&1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int fac[MOD + 5], inv[MOD + 5];

    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1;
    inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= MOD; i++) fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD, inv[i] = power(fac[i], MOD - 2);
    /*for (int i =  MOD - 2; i > 0; i--) inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD;*/
}

    if (n < m) return 0;
    return ((fac[n] * inv[m]) % MOD * inv[n - m]) % MOD;
}

int Lucas(int n, int m) {
    if (!m) return 1;
    return (C(n % MOD, m % MOD) * Lucas(n / MOD, m / MOD)) % MOD;
}

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    printf("%d\n", Lucas(n, m));
}

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 1000000

int p[MAXN + 5], mu[MAXN + 5], pcnt = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

void shake() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] <= MAXN; j++) {
            if (i % p[j]) vis[i *p[j]] = 1, mu[i * p[j]] = mu[i] * mu[p[j]];
            else {
                vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

LL K;

bool ck(LL mid) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (LL i = 1; i * i <= mid; i++) {
        ret += mu[i] * (mid / i / i);
    }
    return mid - ret >= K;
}

int main() {
    shake();
    read(K);
    LL l = 4, r = LL(3e10);
    while (l < r) {
        LL mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ck(mid)) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3038.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v;
    bool w;
} t[262144];

int n, m, tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    t[x].w = t[t[x].l].w | t[t[x].r].w;
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else scanf("%lld", &t[x].v), t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    return x;
}

LL sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

void kill(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!t[x].w) return;
    if (l == r) {
        t[x].v = LL(sqrt(t[x].v));
        t[x].w = (t[x].v > 1);
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        kill(t[x].l, l, mid);
        kill(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    }
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return kill(x, l, r);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    build(1, n);
    scanf("%d", &m);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &op, &l, &r);
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        if (op) printf("%lld\n", sum(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;

#define MAXN 1005

int n, m, ans = 0;
int h[MAXN];
char s[4];

int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN], top = 0;

void solve() {
    sta[top = 0] = p[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int pp = i;
        while (sta[top] > h[i]) {
            ans = max(sta[top] * (i - p[top]), ans);
            pp = p[top];
            top--;
        }
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = pp;
    }
    while (top) ans = max(sta[top] * (m + 1 - p[top]), ans), top--;
}

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            scanf("%s", s);
            if (s[0] == 'F') h[j]++;
            else h[j] = 0;
        }
        solve();
    }
    printf("%d\n", 3 * ans);
    return 0;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define MAXM 10000005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fll
struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXM];

int n,m,s,head[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN],t[MAXN<<1];

inline int query() {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        x<<=1;
        if (t[x^1]<t[x]) x^=1;
    }
    return x-s;
}

void update(int x,LL v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) if (t[x]>v) t[x]=v;
        else return;
}
void del(int x) {
    x+=s;
    t[x]=INF;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) t[x]=min(t[x<<1],t[(x<<1)^1]);
}

bool visit[MAXN];
inline long long dijkstra() {
    update(1,0);
    int x=1;
    while (x) {
        visit[x]=1;
        dis[x]=t[x+s];
        if (x==n) return dis[x];
        del(x);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (!visit[e[now].to] && t[e[now].to+s]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                update(e[now].to,dis[x]+e[now].w);
            }
        }
        x=query();
    }
    return -1;
}

        x=int(((LL)x*rxa+rxc)%rp);
        y=int(((LL)y*rya+ryc)%rp);
        a=min(x%n+1,y%n+1);
        b=max(y%n+1,y%n+1);
        e[i].to=b;
        e[i].next=head[a];
        e[i].w=100000000-100*a;
        head[a]=i;
    }
    for (int i=T+1,x; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(e[i].to);
        read(e[i].w);
        e[i].next=head[x];
        head[x]=i;

    for (s=1; s<n+1; s<<=1);
    for (int i=(s<<1)-1; i; i--) t[i]=0x1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1fll;

    int x=0,f=1;
    char ch=getchar();
    while(ch<'0'||ch>'9') {
        if(ch=='-')f=-1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while(ch>='0'&&ch<='9') {

        ch=getchar();
    }

void insert(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++cnt].to=v;
    e[cnt].next=last[u];
    last[u]=cnt;
    e[cnt].v=w;
}
void dijkstra() {
    heap q;
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)dis[i]=llinf;
    dis[1]=0;
    id[1]=q.push(make_pair(0,1));
    while(!q.empty()) {
        int now=q.top().second;
        q.pop();
        if(now==n) return;
        for(int i=last[now]; i; i=e[i].next)
            if(e[i].v+dis[now]<dis[e[i].to]) {
                dis[e[i].to]=e[i].v+dis[now];
                if(id[e[i].to]!=0)
                    q.modify(id[e[i].to],make_pair(dis[e[i].to],e[i].to));
                else id[e[i].to]=q.push(make_pair(dis[e[i].to],e[i].to));
            }
    }
}

//BZOJ3041.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
const int dx[]= {1,-1,0,0},dy[]= {0,0,1,-1};
typedef long long LL;
int n;
int map[8][8],ans;
bool used[6],ansed;
LL now,lim;
#define istrue(x,y,z) (((x>>(y<<3))>>z)&1)
#define mark(x,y,z) (x|=((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z))
#define remove(x,y,z) (x&=(-1llu)^(((1ll<<(y<<3))<<z)))
#define inrange(x,y) (x>-1 && x<n && y>-1 && y<n)
void dfs(int x,int y,int c) {
    mark(now,x,y);
    remove(lim,x,y);
    for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
        int tox=x+dx[d],toy=y+dy[d];
        if (inrange(tox,toy) && !istrue(now,tox,toy)) {
            if (map[tox][toy]==c) dfs(tox,toy,c);
            else mark(lim,tox,toy);
        }
    }
}

int get_dif() {
    memset(used,0,sizeof(used));
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (!istrue(now,i,j) && !used[map[i][j]]) {
                used[map[i][j]]=1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

bool fill(int c) {
    bool flag=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (istrue(lim,i,j) && map[i][j]==c) {
                flag=1;
                dfs(i,j,c);
            }
        }
    return flag;
}

void idas(int step) {
    int dfc=get_dif();
    if (!dfc) ansed=1;
    if (step+dfc>ans || ansed) return;
    LL nn=now,ll=lim;
    for (int i=0; i<=5; i++) {
        if (fill(i)) idas(step+1);
        now=nn,lim=ll;
    }
}

int main() {
    while (1) {
        scanf("%d",&n);
        if (!n) break;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                scanf("%d",map[i]+j);
            }
        }
        now=0,lim=0;
        dfs(0,0,map[0][0]);
        ansed=0;
        for (ans=0;; ans++) {
            idas(0);
            if (ansed) {
                printf("%d\n",ans);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3052.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define LOG 16
typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, Q, B, ecnt = 0, tot, head[MAXN], V[MAXN], W[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN][LOG + 1], dep[MAXN], sta[MAXN], top = 0, blo[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int dfs(int x) {
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOG; k++) fa[x][k] = fa[fa[x][k - 1]][k - 1];
    sta[++top] = x;
    int siz = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            siz += dfs(e[now].to);
            if (siz >= B) {
                ++tot;
                siz = 0;
                while (sta[top] != x) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
            }
        }
    }
    return siz + 1;
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x&1) u = fa[u][i];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG; i > -1; i--) if (fa[u][i] != fa[v][i]) u = fa[u][i], v = fa[v][i];
    return fa[u][0];
}

void init() {
    fa[1][0] = 1;
    dep[1] = 1;
    B = (int)(pow(n, 2.0 / 3.0)) + 1;
    dfs(1);
    while (top) blo[sta[top--]] = tot;
}

struct Query {
    int u, v, t;
    Query() {}
    Query(int i, int j, int k) : u(i), v(j), t(k) {
        if (blo[i] > blo[j]) swap(i, j);
    }
    bool operator < (Query i) const {
        if (blo[u] != blo[i.u]) return blo[u] < blo[i.u];
        else if (blo[v] != blo[i.v]) return blo[v] < blo[i.v];
        else return t < i.t;
    }
} q[MAXN];
int qq = 0;

struct Change {
    int x, t, pre, suc;
    Change() {}
    Change(int i, int j, int k, int l) : x(i), t(j), pre(k), suc(l) {}
} c[MAXN];
int cc = 0;

LL ans[MAXN], answer = 0;
int cnt[MAXN], C[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void go(int x) {
    if (vis[x] ^= 1) answer += (LL)W[++cnt[C[x]]] * V[C[x]];
    else answer -= (LL)W[cnt[C[x]]--] * V[C[x]];
}

void modify(int x, int y) {
    if (vis[x]) answer -= (LL)W[cnt[C[x]]--] * V[C[x]];
    C[x] = y;
    if (vis[x]) answer += (LL)W[++cnt[C[x]]] * V[C[x]];
}

void moveTo(int u, int v) {
    int lca = LCA(u, v);
    while (u != lca) go(u), u = fa[u][0];
    while (v != lca) go(v), v = fa[v][0];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(V[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(W[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(C[i]), tmp[i] = C[i];
    init();
    for (int i = 1, op, x, y; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (op) q[++qq] = Query(x, y, i);
        else c[++cc] = Change(x, i, tmp[x], y), tmp[x] = y;
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + qq + 1);
    int u = 1, v = 1, cp = 0;
    memset(ans, -1, sizeof(ans));
    for (int i = 1; i <= qq; i++) {
        while (cp < cc && c[cp + 1].t < q[i].t) cp++, modify(c[cp].x, c[cp].suc);
        while (cp && c[cp].t > q[i].t) modify(c[cp].x, c[cp].pre), cp--;
        moveTo(u, q[i].u);
        u = q[i].u;
        moveTo(v, q[i].v);
        v = q[i].v;
        int lca = LCA(u, v);
        go(lca);
        ans[q[i].t] = answer;
        go(lca);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) if (ans[i] != -1) printf("%lld\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3083.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 16777216>>1
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],wbuf[MAX_BUF_SIZE>>2],*ptr,*ptw;
inline void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
    ptw=wbuf;
}
inline void write_buf() {
    fwrite(wbuf,sizeof(char),ptw-wbuf,stdout);
}

#define getchar() (*(ptr++))
#define putchar(x) (*(ptw++)=x)

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline void write(int x) {
    int temp=x/10;
    if (temp) write(temp);
    putchar(x-temp*10+'0');
}

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,ecnt=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN],val[MAXN];
int maxs[MAXN],siz[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;
int lt[MAXN],rt[MAXN];
int t[262144],lazy[262144],lch[262144],rch[262144],tcnt=0;

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (lazy[x]) {
        lazy[lch[x]]=lazy[rch[x]]=t[lch[x]]=t[rch[x]]=lazy[x];
        lazy[x]=0;
    }
}

inline void pushup(int x) {
    t[x]=min(t[lch[x]],t[rch[x]]);
}

int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l==r) {
        t[now]=val[l];
        return now;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    lch[now]=build(l,mid);
    rch[now]=build(mid+1,r);
    pushup(now);
    return now;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R,int v) {
    if (l==L && r==R) {
        t[x]=lazy[x]=v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid,v);
    if (r>mid) update(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R,v);
    pushup(x);
}

int query(int x,int l,int r,int L,int R) {
    if (l==L && r==R) return t[x];
    if (lazy[x]) return t[x];
    pushdown(x);
    int mid=(L+R)>>1;
    int ret=0x7fffffff;
    if (l<=mid) ret=query(lch[x],l,min(mid,r),L,mid);
    if (r>mid) ret=min(ret,query(rch[x],max(mid+1,l),r,mid+1,R));
    return ret;
}

void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            if (siz[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=siz[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    lt[tid[x]]=dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    val[dfn]=a[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    rt[tid[x]]=dfn;
}

void init() {
    fa[1]=1;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    build(1,n);
}

int nowrt=1;

void __update(int u,int v,int w) {
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        update(1,tid[top[u]],tid[u],1,n,w);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[v]<dep[u]) {
        swap(u,v);
    }
    update(1,tid[u],tid[v],1,n,w);
}

int findtheson(int x,int r) {
    while (top[r]!=top[x]) {
        r=top[r];
        if (fa[r]!=x) r=fa[r];
        else break;
    }

    if (fa[r]==x) return tid[r];
    else return tid[x]+1;
}

int __query(int x) {
    if (nowrt==x) {
        return t[1];
    } else if (tid[nowrt]<lt[tid[x]] || tid[nowrt]>rt[tid[x]]) {
        return query(1,lt[tid[x]],rt[tid[x]],1,n);
    } else {
        int theson=findtheson(x,nowrt);
        int ret=query(1,1,lt[theson]-1,1,n);
        if (rt[theson]<n) ret=min(ret,query(1,rt[theson]+1,n,1,n));
        return ret;
    }
}

int main() {
    init_buf();
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    read(nowrt);
    for (int i=1,opt,u,v,w; i<=m; i++) {
        read(opt);
        if (opt==1) {
            read(nowrt);
        } else if (opt==2) {
            read(u);
            read(v);
            read(w);
            __update(u,v,w);
        } else {
            read(u);
            write(__query(u));
            putchar('\n');
        }
    }
    write_buf();
    return 0;
}

    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a+i), tot += a[i];
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {

        for (int j = 30; j > -1 && x; j--) {

    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

int LOG(int x) {
    int ret = 0;
    while (x) x >>= 1, ret++;
    return ret;
}

int dp[33][33][33][33][2];
int n, a, b, c;

#define Min(x, y) x = min(x, y)

int main() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    n = max(max(LOG(a), LOG(b)), LOG(c));
    a = __builtin_popcount(a);
    b = __builtin_popcount(b);
    c = __builtin_popcount(c);
    if (a + b < c) puts("-1");
    else if (a + b == c) printf("%d\n", (1 << c) - 1);
    else if (!a || !b || !c) puts("-1");
    else {
        memset(dp, 0x7f, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0][0][0][0] = 0;
        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++)
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j <= l; j++)
                    for (int k = 0; k <= l; k++) {
                        if (dp[l][i][j][k][0] != INF) {
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j][k][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0]);
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j + 1][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j + 1][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][0] + (2 << l));
                        }
                        if (dp[l][i][j][k][1] != INF) {
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j][k + 1][0], dp[l][i][j][k][1]);
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i][j + 1][k][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (1 << l));
                            Min(dp[l + 1][i + 1][j + 1][k + 1][1], dp[l][i][j][k][1] + (2 << l));
                        }
                    }
        printf("%d\n", dp[n][a][b][c][0] == INF ? -1 : dp[n][a][b][c][0]);
    }
    return 0;
}

template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

bitset<301> a[301];

int T, n, m;

    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].reset();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            if ((a[i] & a[j]).count()) {
                if ((a[i] & a[j]) != (a[i] | a[j])) return 0;
            }

//BZOJ3110.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

typedef long long LL;

int n, m, nt = 0;
int st[MAXN], tem[MAXN];

#define find(x) int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1, x) - tem)

struct node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN * 233];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lazy++;
        t[x].v += r - l + 1;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v; // pushup
}

LL query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        if (!t[x].l) t[x].l = ++tcnt;
        if (!t[x].r) t[x].r = ++tcnt;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += LL(mid - l + 1) * t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].v += LL(r - mid) * t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    } // pushdown
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, rt;
} T[MAXN * 2 + 1];

int Tcnt = 0;

int Build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++Tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        T[x].l = Build(l, mid);
        T[x].r = Build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

void Update(int x, int l, int r, int p, int ql, int qr) {
    update(T[x].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) Update(T[x].l, l, mid, p, ql, qr);
        else Update(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, ql, qr);
    }
}

int select(LL k, int ql, int qr) {
    int x = 1, l = 1, r = nt, mid;
    LL rs;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        rs = query(T[T[x].r].rt, 1, n, ql, qr);
        if (rs < k) r = mid, x = T[x].l, k -= rs;
        else l = mid + 1, x = T[x].r;
    }
    return l;
}

int op[MAXN], a[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL c[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(op[i]);
        read(a[i]);
        read(b[i]);
        read(c[i]);
        if (op[i] == 1) tem[++nt] = (int)c[i];
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1);
    nt = (int)(unique(tem + 1, tem + nt + 1) - tem - 1);
    Build(1, nt);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (op[i] == 1) Update(1, 1, nt, find(c[i]), a[i], b[i]);
        else printf("%d\n", tem[select(c[i], a[i], b[i])]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3123.cpp
/* Never Say Die */

#define MAXN 80319
#define LOG 17

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * LOG * LOG];

int rt[MAXN], tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];
int fa[LOG][MAXN], *Fa = fa[0], dep[MAXN], f[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], tot;

int getf(int x) {
    return f[x] < 0 ? x : (f[x] = getf(f[x]));
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int x, int y, int lca, int flca, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[y].l].v - t[t[flca].l].v - t[t[lca].l].v;
    if (k <= ls) return query(t[x].l, t[y].l, t[lca].l, t[flca].l, l, mid, k);
    else return query(t[x].r, t[y].r, t[lca].r, t[flca].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; i++) fa[i][x] = fa[i - 1][fa[i - 1][x]];
    rt[x] = update(rt[Fa[x]], 1, tot, a[x]);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != Fa[x]) {
            Fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

inline void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv), swap(u, v);
    f[fu] += f[fv];
    f[fv] = fu;
    Fa[v] = u;
    dep[v] = dep[u] + 1;
    dfs(v);
}

int LCA(int u, int v) {
    if (dep[u] < dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[u] - dep[v];
    for (int i = 0; x; i++, x >>= 1) if (x & 1) u = fa[i][u];
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG - 1; ~i; i--) if (fa[i][u] != fa[i][v]) {
            u = fa[i][u];
            v = fa[i][v];
        }
    return Fa[u];
}

int n, m, T;
char s[3];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        dep[i] = 1, f[i] = -1, rt[i] = update(0, 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        add(x, y);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, x, y, k; i <= T; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        if (s[0] == 'Q') {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            read(k);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans, k ^= ans;
            int lca = LCA(x, y);
            printf("%d\n", ans = tmp[query(rt[x], rt[y], rt[lca], rt[Fa[lca]], 1, tot, k)]);
        } else {
            read(x);
            read(y);
            x ^= ans, y ^= ans;
            add(x, y);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;
inline void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN];
LL dep[MAXN];
int maxd = 1;

void dfs(int x) {
    if (dep[x] > dep[maxd]) maxd = x;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, fa[e[now].to] = x, dfs(e[now].to);
    }
}

LL get(int x, int y) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != y && e[now].to != fa[x]) ret = max(ret, get(e[now].to, -1) + e[now].w);
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, a, b, c; i < n; i++) read(a), read(b), read(c), add(a, b, c);
    int L, R;
    dep[1] = fa[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    L = maxd;
    dep[L] = fa[L] = 0;
    dfs(L);
    R = maxd;
    printf("%lld\n", dep[R]);
    int x = R, y = R;
    while (x != L) {
        LL d = get(fa[x], x);
        x = fa[x];
        if (d == dep[y] - dep[x]) R = x;
        if (d == dep[x]) L = x;
    }
    int ret = 0;
    while (R != L) ret++, R = fa[R];
    printf("%d\n", ret);
    return 0;
}

}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MOD 1000000007

LL n;
int K;

int len, a[22];
void getlen(LL x) {
    while (x) {
        a[len++] = int(x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
}

int tot = 0;
LL b[211000];
int tr[11000][10];

void dfs(LL mul, int dep, int x) {
    if (mul > n) return;
    if (dep == len) b[++tot] = mul;
    else {
        while (x < 10) {
            dfs(mul * x, dep + 1, x);
            x++;
        }
    }
}

LL f[14][11000][2];
LL g[11000];

struct Node {
    int fir, sec;
    LL v;
    Node () {}
    Node (int x, int y) {
        fir = x;
        sec = y;
        v = g[fir] * g[sec];
    }
    bool operator < (const Node &r) const {
        return v < r.v;
    }
};

priority_queue <Node> q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    getlen(n);
    dfs(1, 0, 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + tot + 1);
    tot = (int)(unique(b + 1, b + tot + 1) - b - 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= 9; j++) {
            LL mul = b[i] * j;
            tr[i][j] = int(lower_bound(b + 1, b + tot + 1, mul) - b);
            if (tr[i][j] > tot) tr[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }
    f[0][1][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (f[i][j][k]) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= 9; x++) {
                        f[i + 1][tr[j][x]][(k + x) > a[i]] += f[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < len; j++) {
            g[i] += f[j][i][0] + f[j][i][1];
        }
        g[i] += f[len][i][0];
    }

    sort(g + 1, g + tot + 1);
    q.push(Node(tot, tot));
    LL ans = 0;
    while (K--) {
        Node x = q.top();
        q.pop();
        (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
        if (x.fir < x.sec && K) {
            K--;
            (ans += x.v) %= MOD;
            q.push(Node(x.fir, x.sec - 1));
        }
        if (x.sec == tot) q.push(Node(x.fir - 1, x.sec));
    }
    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3140.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 15319

struct Point {
    int x, y, z;
} p[MAXN];

int a, b, c, t, swap_tag, pcnt, ans;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int dfn = 0;

int s[MAXN], mat[MAXN], vis[MAXN];

bool find(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (vis[e[now].to] != dfn) {
            vis[e[now].to] = dfn;
            if (!mat[e[now].to] || find(mat[e[now].to])) return mat[e[now].to] = x, 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void check(int st, int cnt) {
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * b);
    ecnt = 0;
    memset(mat + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) if (!((st >> p[i].x) & 1) && s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] != st) add(p[i].y, p[i].z), s[p[i].y * c + p[i].z] = st;
    for (int i = 1; i <= b && ans > cnt; i++) ++dfn, cnt += find(i);
    ans = cnt;
}

void work() {
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    if (a <= b && a <= c) swap_tag = 0;
    else if (b <= a && b <= c) swap_tag = 1;
    else swap_tag = 2;
    pcnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0, x; i < a; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < b; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < c; k++) {
                read(x);
                if (x) p[++pcnt] = (Point) {
                    i, j, k
                };
            }
    if (swap_tag == 1) {
        swap(a, b);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].y);
    } else if (swap_tag == 2) {
        swap(a, c);
        for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) swap(p[i].x, p[i].z);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) p[i].y++, p[i].z++;
    t = 1 << a;
    ans = a;
    memset(s, -1, sizeof s);
    for (int i = 0, cnt; i < t; i++) if ((cnt = __builtin_popcount(i)) < ans) check(i, cnt);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int CA;
    read(CA);
    while (CA--) work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
