#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 505
typedef double LD;
const LD eps = 1e-9;
struct edge {
    int u, v;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

struct Equa {
    LD v[MAXN];
    LD &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
} a[MAXN];

int n, m, d[MAXN];

void gauss() {
    n--;
    int now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= n && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > n) continue;
        if (now != to) swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double y = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) a[now][j] /= y;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != now) {
                y = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) a[j][k] -= y * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
    n++;
}

LD w[MAXN * MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v);
        a[e[i].u][e[i].v] = a[e[i].v][e[i].u] = -1;
        d[e[i].u]++, d[e[i].v]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < n; ++j)
            if (d[j]) a[i][j] = a[i][j] / d[j];
        a[i][i] = 1, a[i][0] = 0;
    }
    a[1][0] = 1;
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (d[i]) a[i][0] /= d[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        w[i] = a[e[i].u][0] + a[e[i].v][0];
    }
    sort(w + 1, w + m + 1);
    LD ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans += w[i] * (m - i + 1);
    printf("%.3lf\n", (double)ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3156.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005

int n;
LL f[MAXN], a[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(2 * f[j] + (LL)j * j + j - 2 * f[k] - (LL)k * k - k) / (j - k);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < 2 * i) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) < slope(v[r], v[r - 1])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.v[q.l];
        f[i] = f[j] + LL(i - j) * (i - j - 1) / 2 + a[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3160.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 262144
#define MOD 1000000007

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;

LL power(LL x, LL p) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; p; p >>= 1) {
        if (p & 1) ret = (ret * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

struct Comp {
    D r, i;
    Comp(D x = 0, D y = 0) : r(x), i(y) {}
    Comp operator + (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r + a.r, i + a.i);
    }
    Comp operator - (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r - a.r, i - a.i);
    }
    Comp operator * (Comp a) const {
        return Comp(r * a.r - i * a.i, r * a.i + i * a.r);
    }
} A[MAXN], B[MAXN];

int R[MAXN];

void getR(int n) {
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i <<= 1, b++);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) R[i] = (R[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << b);
}

void FFT(Comp a[], int n, int rev) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++ ) if (i < R[i]) swap(a[i], a[R[i]]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i <<= 1) {
        Comp step = Comp(cos(M_PI / i), rev * sin(M_PI / i));
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1) {
            Comp cur(1, 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++, cur = cur * step) {
                Comp x = a[j + k], y = cur * a[j + k + i];
                a[j + k] = x + y, a[j + k + i] = x - y;
            }
        }
    }
    if (rev == -1) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].r /= n;
}

struct Pam {
    int nxt[MAXN / 2][2];
    int fail[MAXN / 2], cnt[MAXN / 2], len[MAXN / 2], S[MAXN / 2];
    int n, p, last;
    int newNode(int l) {
        nxt[p][0] = nxt[p][1] = 0;
        len[p] = l;
        cnt[p] = 0;
        return p++;
    }
    void init() {
        n = p = last = 0;
        newNode(0), newNode(-1);
        fail[0] = 1;
        S[0] = -1;
    }
    int get_fail(int x) {
        while (S[n - len[x] - 1] != S[n]) x = fail[x];
        return x;
    }
    void add(int c) {
        S[++n] = c;
        int cur = get_fail(last);
        int &now = nxt[cur][c];
        if (!now) {
            fail[p] = nxt[get_fail(fail[cur])][c];
            now = newNode(len[cur] + 2);
        }
        last = now;
        cnt[last]++;
    }
    void count() {
        for (int i = p - 1; i > 1; i--) {
            cnt[fail[i]] += cnt[i];
        }
    }
} T;

char s[MAXN / 2];
int N, n, tot[MAXN];
LL ans = 0;

void work(char x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        A[i] = B[i] = Comp(i < N ? (s[i] == x) : 0, 0);
    }
    FFT(A, n, 1);
    FFT(B, n, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A[i] * B[i];
    FFT(A, n, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) tot[i] += int(A[i].r + 0.5);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s);
    N = (int) strlen(s);
    T.init();
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) T.add(s[i] - 'a');
    T.count();
    for (int i = T.p - 1; i > 1; i--) ans = (ans - T.cnt[i]) % MOD;
    for (n = 2; n < N; n <<= 1);
    n <<= 1;
    getR(n);
    work('a');
    work('b');
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = (ans + power(2, (tot[i] + 1) / 2) - 1) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", int((ans + MOD) % MOD));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3170.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
    if (f) a=-a;
}
#define MAXN 100005
struct point {
    LL x,y;
    void input() {
        LL tx,ty;
        read(tx);
        read(ty);
        x=tx+ty;
        y=tx-ty;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n;
LL xx[MAXN],sumx[MAXN],yy[MAXN],sumy[MAXN],ans=12345678901234567;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        p[i].input();
        xx[i]=p[i].x;
        yy[i]=p[i].y;
    }
    sort(xx+1,xx+n+1);
    sort(yy+1,yy+n+1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) sumx[i]=sumx[i-1]+xx[i];
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) sumy[i]=sumy[i-1]+yy[i];
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        LL ret=0;
        int px=int(lower_bound(xx+1,xx+n+1,p[i].x)-xx-1);
        ret+=p[i].x*px-sumx[px]+sumx[n]-sumx[px]-(n-px)*p[i].x;
        int py=int(lower_bound(yy+1,yy+n+1,p[i].y)-yy-1);
        ret+=p[i].y*py-sumy[py]+sumy[n]-sumy[py]-(n-py)*p[i].y;
        ans=min(ans,ret);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans>>1);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3171.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}
const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0}, dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1}, dt[] = {'D', 'U', 'R', 'L'};

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[29 * 29 * 4 * 2];

int head[29 * 29], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, m, node = 1;
int G[29][29];
char s[29];

queue <int> q;
bool inq[29 * 29];
int dis[29 * 29], pre[29 * 29];

bool SPFA() {
    memset(dis + 1, 0x3f, sizeof(int) * node);
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] <= node;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (SPFA()) {
        ret += dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[x]].f--;
            e[pre[x] ^ 1].f++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            add(S, G[i][j] = ++node, 0);
            add(++node, T, 0);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int tx = (i + dx[d] + n) % n, ty = (j + dy[d] + m) % m;
                if (dt[d] == s[j]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 0);
                else add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty] + 1, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", MCMF());
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 1000319
#define LOG 21

char s[MAXN];

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], Log[MAXN];

int st[LOG][MAXN];

#define rmq(l, r) min(st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][l], st[Log[r - (l) + 1]][r - (1 << Log[r - (l) + 1]) + 1])

void getsa(int n) {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], c[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = c[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; c[i + k] == c[j + k]; k++);
    }

    /*
    	Log[0] = -1;
    	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    	for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[0][i] = h[i];
    	for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
    		for (int i = 1, q = 1 << (i - 1), j = n - (q << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
    			st[k][i] = min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + q]);
    	}*/
}

int n, p[MAXN], len[MAXN], Len;

int query(int x, int y) {
    /*
    	int ret = 1, l, r, mid;
    	l = 1, r = x + 1;
    	while (l < r) {
    		mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    		if (rmq(mid, x) >= y) r = mid;
    		else l = mid + 1;
    	}
    	ret += x - l + 1;

    	l = x, r = Len;
    	while (l < r) {
    		mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    		if (rmq(x + 1, mid) >= y) l = mid;
    		else r = mid - 1;
    	}
    	ret += l - x;
    */
    int L = x, R = x;
    for (L = x; h[L] >= y; L--);
    for (R = x; h[R + 1] >= y; R++);
    return R - L + 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = p[i - 1] + len[i - 1] + 1;
        s[p[i] - 1] = '$';
        scanf("%s", s + p[i]);
        len[i] = (int)strlen(s + p[i]);
    }
    Len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa(Len);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        printf("%d\n", query(rk[p[i]], len[i]));
    }
    return 0;
}

#include<cstdio>

#define N 100319
int n,i,x,a[N],b[N],c[N],h[N],t[S*2];

//BZOJ3175.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

const int dx[] = {1, 1, -1, -1, 2, 2, -2, -2}, dy[] = {2, -2, 2, -2, 1, -1, 1, -1};

#define MAXN 205
#define NN MAXN * MAXN
struct edge {
    int next, to;
    bool f;
} e[NN * 8 * 4];

int head[NN], cur[NN], ecnt = 1;
const int S = 0, T = 1;

int n, G[MAXN][MAXN], node = 1;

char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[NN], tag[NN];

inline bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * node);
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

bool dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x] && dfs(e[now].to)) {
            e[now].f = 0;
            e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
            now = e[now].next;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= node; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        for (int now = head[S]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now ^ 1].f = 1;
                ret++;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == '0') {
                G[i][j] = ++node;
                if ((i ^ j) & 1) add(S, node);
                else add(node, T);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1 + (i & 1); j <= n; j += 2) if (G[i][j]) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
                    int tx = i + dx[d], ty = j + dy[d];
                    if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && G[tx][ty]) add(G[i][j], G[tx][ty]);
                }
            }
    }
    printf("%d\n", node - 1 - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3181.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 1000000
#define INF 1000000000
typedef long long LL;
int n,p;
int prime[200000],lowp[MAXN+5],pcnt=0,pl;

void init() {
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (!lowp[i]) {
            prime[++pcnt]=i;
            lowp[i]=i;
            if (i==p) pl=pcnt;
            if (i>1000) continue;
            for (int j=i*i; j<=MAXN; j+=i) if (!lowp[j]) lowp[j]=i;
        }
    }
}

void vio() {
    n--;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        if (i*p>INF) break;
        if (lowp[i]>=p) n--;
        if (!n) {
            printf("%d\n",i*p);
            return;
        }
    }
    puts("0");
}

LL tot=0,kk;

void dfs(int x,LL val,int f) {
    if (val>kk) return;
    if (x==pl) {
        tot+=kk/val*f;
    } else {
        dfs(x+1,val,f);
        dfs(x+1,val*prime[x],-f);
    }
}

bool check(int mid) {
    tot=0;
    kk=mid/p;
    dfs(1,1,1);
    return tot>=n;
}

void work() {
    int l=1,r=INF+1,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    if (l>INF) puts("0");
    else printf("%d\n",l);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    init();
    if (p>1000) vio();
    else work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3196.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define NODE 1500005
#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, cnt, val;
    Node() : siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void setc(Node *chi, int p) {
        c[p] = chi;
        chi->fa = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[NODE], *Stack[NODE], **Top = Stack, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

void init(int top) {
    for (Node *i = mem + top; (i--) != mem; *(Top++) = i);
}

Node* newNode(int v = 0) {
    Node *x = *(--Top);
    x->c[0] = x->c[1] = x->fa = null;
    x->val = v, x->siz = x->cnt = 1;
    return x;
}

void release(Node *x) {
    *(Top++) = x;
}

struct Splay {
    Node *root;
    int l, r;
    Splay(): root(null), l(0), r(0) {}
    int size() {
        return root->siz - 2;
    }
    void init() {
        root = newNode(-INF);
        root->setc(newNode(INF), 1);
    }
    void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *fa = x->fa;
        int dir = x->dir();
        fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
        fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
        x->setc(fa, !dir);
        fa->upd();
        if (fa == root) root = x;
    }

    void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
        while (x->fa != fa) {
            if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
            else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }

    Node* select(int k) {
        for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
            int s = x->c[0]->siz;
            if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
            else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
            else return x;
        }
    }

    Node* get(Node* L, Node* R) {
        splay(L);
        splay(R, L);
        return R->c[0];
    }

    Node* leq(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v >= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v >= (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* geq(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v <= x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->val != v && x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v <= (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* prev(int v) {
        Node* x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* succ(int v) {
        Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
        while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
        splay(x);
        return ret;
    }

    Node* find(int v) {
        for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
            if (x->val == v) {
                splay(x);
                return x;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    void add(int v) {
        if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = root, *y = null;
            while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
            (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), v > y->val));
            splay(x);
        }
    }
    void del(int v) {
        Node *x = find(v);
        if (!(--x->cnt)) {
            Node *y = x->c[0];
            while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
            splay(y, x);
            y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
            release(x);
        } else x->upd();
    }
} t[262144];

struct QAQ {
    int v, p;
    QAQ() {}
    QAQ(int a, int b): v(a), p(b) {}
    bool operator < (QAQ a) const {
        if (v != a.v) return v < a.v;
        else return p < a.p;
    }
} a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN];

int n, m;
int num[MAXN], tem[MAXN * 2], lim = 0, tcnt = 0;

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid].p);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void merge(int lpos, int midpos, int rpos) {
    int cnt = 0, i = lpos, j = midpos;
    while (i < midpos && j < rpos) {
        if (a[i].p < a[j].p) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
        else tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    }
    while (i < midpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[i++];
    while (j < rpos) tmp[cnt++] = a[j++];
    i = lpos, j = 0;
    while (j < cnt) a[i++] = tmp[j++];
}

int build(int l, int r, int lpos, int rpos) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1, midpos = int(lower_bound(a + lpos, a + rpos, QAQ(mid + 1, -INF)) - a);
        t[x].l = build(l, mid, lpos, midpos);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, midpos, rpos);
        merge(lpos, midpos, rpos);
    }
    QAQ L = QAQ(0, -INF), R = QAQ(0, INF);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    t[x].root=build(lpos - 1, rpos);
    swap(a[lpos - 1], L);
    swap(a[rpos], R);
    return x;
}

int getSiz(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].get(t[x].prev(sl), t[x].succ(sr))->siz;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), sl, sr);
    if (qr > mid) ret += getSiz(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, sl, sr);
    return ret;
}

int getKth(int x, int l, int r, int k, int sl, int sr) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    int ls = getSiz(t[x].l, l, mid, l, mid, sl, sr);
    if (k <= ls) return getKth(t[x].l, l, mid, k, sl, sr);
    else return getKth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls, sl, sr);
}

void delVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].del(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) delVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else delVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

void addVal(int x, int l, int r, int pos, int val) {
    t[x].add(pos);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (val <= mid) addVal(t[x].l, l, mid, pos, val);
        else addVal(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, pos, val);
    }
}

struct Query {
    int opt, l, r, k;
} Q[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    init((n + m) * 15);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].v);
        a[i].p = i;
        tem[++lim] = a[i].v;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(Q[i].opt);
        if (Q[i].opt == 3) {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].k);
        } else {
            read(Q[i].l);
            read(Q[i].r);
            read(Q[i].k);
        }
        if (Q[i].opt != 2) tem[++lim] = Q[i].k;
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1);
    lim = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1) - tem);
    tem[0] = -INF, tem[lim] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].v = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, a[i].v) - tem);
        num[a[i].p] = a[i].v;
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    build(0, lim, 1, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, opt, l, r, k, pos; i <= m; i++) {
        opt = Q[i].opt;
        l = Q[i].l;
        r = Q[i].r;
        k = Q[i].k;
        switch (opt) {
        case 1:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem + 1, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, k - 1, l, r) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, k, l, r)]);
            break;
        case 3:
            k = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            delVal(1, 0, lim, l, num[l]);
            addVal(1, 0, lim, l, k);
            num[l] = k;
            break;
        case 4:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem) - 1;
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r), l, r)]);
            break;
        case 5:
            pos = int(lower_bound(tem, tem + lim + 1, k) - tem);
            printf("%d\n", tem[getKth(1, 0, lim, getSiz(1, 0, lim, 0, pos, l, r) + 1, l, r)]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3196.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MX 1000000100

int sl, sr;

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *p;
    int sz, v;
    bool d() {
        return this == p->c[1];
    }
    void sc(Node *cc, int q) {
        c[q] = cc;
        cc->p = this;
    }
    void upd() {
        sz = c[0]->sz + c[1]->sz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN * 32], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull;

inline Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->p = null;
    ptr->sz = 1;
    ptr->v = v;
    return ptr++;
}

struct Tnode {
    int l, r;
    Node *rt;
    Tnode() {
        rt = null;
    }
    inline void rot(Node *x) {
        Node *p = x->p;
        bool d = x->d();
        p->p->sc(x, p->d());
        p->sc(x->c[!d], d);
        x->sc(p, !d);
        p->upd();
        if (p == rt) rt = x;
    }
    inline void splay(Node *x, Node *p = null) {
        while (x->p != p) {
            if (x->p->p == p) rot(x);
            else x->d() == x->p->d() ? (rot(x->p), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
        }
        x->upd();
    }
    inline void ins(int v) {
        if (rt == null) rt = newNode(v);
        else {
            Node *x = rt;
            while (x != null) {
                bool d = v > x->v;
                if (x->c[d] == null) {
                    x->sc(newNode(v), d);
                    splay(x->c[d]);
                    return;
                }
                x = x->c[d];
            }
        }
    }
    inline void del(int v) {
        Node *x = rt;
        while (x != null) {
            if (x->v == v) {
                splay(x);
                if (x->c[0] == null) rt = x->c[1], rt->p = null;
                else {
                    Node *y = x->c[0];
                    while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
                    splay(y, x);
                    y->sc(x->c[1], 1);
                    rt = y;
                    y->p = null;
                    y->upd();
                }
                return;
            }
            x = x->c[v > x->v];
        }
    }
    inline int count(int v, bool in) {
        if (rt == null) return 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
            if (v < x->v) {
                if (x->c[0] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[0];
            } else if (v > x->v) {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz + 1;
                if (x->c[1] == null) {
                    splay(x);
                    return cnt;
                }
                x = x->c[1];
            } else {
                cnt += x->c[0]->sz;
                splay(x);
                return cnt + in;
            }
        }
    }
    inline int cnt() {
        int a = count(sr, 1);
        int b = count(sl, 0);
        return a - b;
    }
} t[MAXN * 32];

int n, m, rt = 0, tcnt = 0;
int a[MAXN];

#define sz() rt->sz

void ins(int &x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].ins(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) ins(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else ins(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

void del(int x, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    t[x].del(v);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) del(t[x].l, l, mid, p, v);
        else del(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p, v);
    }
}

int cnt(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        return t[x].cnt();
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += cnt(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += cnt(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int kth(int x, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ls = t[t[x].l].cnt();
    if (k <= ls) return kth(t[x].l, l, mid, k);
    else return kth(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - ls);
}

int Max(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].r].cnt()) x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
            else x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Max(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int Min(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!t[x].sz()) return INF;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        if (!t[x].cnt()) return INF;
        while (l < r) {
            int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[x].l].cnt()) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
            else x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret;
    if (ql <= mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    if (qr >  mid) {
        ret = Min(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        if (ret != INF) return ret;
    }
    return INF;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ins(rt, -MX, MX, a[i], i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int op, x;
        read(op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", cnt(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1) + 1);
            break;
        case 2:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", kth(rt, -MX, MX, x));
            break;
        case 3:
            read(op);
            read(x);
            del(rt, -MX, MX, a[op], op);
            a[op] = x;
            ins(rt, -MX, MX, x, op);
            break;
        case 4:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Max(rt, -MX, MX, -MX, x - 1));
            break;
        case 5:
            read(sl);
            read(sr);
            read(x);
            printf("%d\n", Min(rt, -MX, MX, x + 1, MX));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
#define MAXN 200005

struct query {
    int x,y,id;
    LL ha;
    bool operator < (query a) const {
        return y<a.y;
    }
} q[MAXN];
int n,m,k,tcnt=0;
int a[MAXN];
LL ha[MAXN],mi;
bool ans[MAXN];
LL hh(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=ha[r]-ha[l-1]*mi;
    return ret;
}
void getHash(LL &ret) {
    ret=0;
    for (int i=1,x; i<=k; i++) {
        read(x);
        ret=ret*19260817+x;
    }
}
map<LL,int> Tree;
int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    ha[0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        ha[i]=ha[i-1]*19260817+a[i];
    }
    mi=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=k; i++) mi=mi*19260817;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].y);
        getHash(q[i].ha);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    int i=k,j=1;
    while (j<=m && q[j].y<k) j++;
    for (; i<=n; i++) {
        Tree[hh(i-k+1,i)]=i;
        while (j<=m && q[j].y==i) {
            if (Tree[q[j].ha]>=q[j].x+k-1) ans[q[j].id]=1;
            j++;
        }
    }
    for (i=1; i<=m; i++)
        if (ans[i]) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
    return 0;
}

int n;

long long calc(int ansx, int ansy) {
    long long ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ret += abs(x[i] - ansx) + abs(y[i] - ansy);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1, xx, yy; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &xx, &yy);
        x[i] = xx + yy;
        y[i] = xx - yy;
    }
    sort(x + 1, x + n + 1);
    sort(y + 1, y + n + 1);
    int ansx = x[(n + 1) / 2], ansy = y[(n + 1) / 2];
    if ((~ansx^ansy)&1) printf("%lld\n", calc(ansx, ansy) / 2);
    else printf("%lld\n", min(min(calc(ansx - 1, ansy), calc(ansx + 1, ansy)), min(calc(ansx, ansy - 1), calc(ansx, ansy + 1))) / 2);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3211.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
int n,m,a[MAXN],tcnt=0;
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[s<<1];
LL sum[s<<1];
#define lch t[now].l
#define rch t[now].r
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        lch=build(l,mid);
        rch=build(mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    } else {
        t[now].v=a[l]>1;
    }
    return now;
}

void init() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        sum[s+i]=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=s-1; i; i--) {
        sum[i]=sum[i<<1]+sum[(i<<1)|1];
    }
    build(1,n);
}

LL query(int l,int r) {
    LL ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if (!(l&1)) ret+=sum[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=sum[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void dec(int x,int d) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) sum[x]-=d;
}

void work(int now,int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) {
        int to=int(sqrt(sum[l+s]));
        dec(l,int(sum[l+s])-to);
        if (to<=1) t[now].v=0;
    } else {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (t[lch].v) work(lch,l,mid);
        if (t[rch].v) work(rch,mid+1,r);
        t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
    }
}

void update(int now,int l,int r,int ql,int qr) {
    if (!t[now].v) return;
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        work(now,l,r);
        return;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) update(lch,l,mid,ql,min(qr,mid));
    if (qr>mid) update(rch,mid+1,r,max(ql,mid+1),qr);
    t[now].v=t[lch].v+t[rch].v;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    init();
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x==1) {
            printf("%lld\n",query(l,r));
        } else {
            update(1,1,n,l,r);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3212.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
template<class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

bool readop() {
    while (ch != 'Q' && ch != 'C') ch = getchar();
    return ch == 'Q';
}
typedef long long LL;
struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL sum, lazy;
} t[262144];

int n, q, tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
    } else read(t[x].sum);
    return x;
}

void pushdown(int x, int ls, int rs) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].sum += (LL)t[x].lazy * ls;
        t[t[x].r].sum += (LL)t[x].lazy * rs;
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

LL Sum(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += Sum(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid));
    if (qr > mid) ret += Sum(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr);
    return ret;
}

void change(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int c) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].sum += (LL)c * (r - l + 1);
        t[x].lazy += c;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    pushdown(x, mid - l + 1, r - mid);
    if (ql <= mid) change(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(qr, mid), c);
    if (qr > mid) change(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(ql, mid + 1), qr, c);
    t[x].sum = t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, l, r, c; i <= q; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            printf("%lld\n", Sum(1, 1, n, l, r));
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(c);
            change(1, 1, n, l, r, c);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>

#include <bitset>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 5011
#define INF 0x7f7f7f7f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 123];

int head[MAXN * 18], ecnt = 1, cur[MAXN * 18];

inline void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
} t[MAXN * 18];

int n, S = 0, T = 1, tcnt;
int rt[MAXN];
int a[MAXN], b[MAXN], W[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], P[MAXN];
int tmp[MAXN * 3], tot = 0;

int nowx;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (pre) add(pre, x, INF);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) add(t[x].l = update(t[pre].l, l, mid, p), x, INF);
        else add(t[x].r = update(t[pre].r, mid + 1, r, p), x, INF);
    } else add(nowx * 2, x, INF);
    return x;
}

void Link(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        add(x, nowx * 2 + 1, INF);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) Link(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) Link(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
}

int q[MAXN * 18], tag[MAXN * 18];

inline bool bfs() {
    register int he, ta, x, now;
    for (x = 1; x <= tcnt; x++) tag[x] = 0;
    tag[S] = 1;
    q[he = ta = 1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[++ta] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow, ret;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(e[now].f, left));
            if (ret) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (register int i = 0; i <= tcnt; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int ans = 0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]), read(b[i]), read(W[i]), read(L[i]), read(R[i]), read(P[i]);
        tmp[++tot] += a[i];
        tmp[++tot] = L[i];
        tmp[++tot] = R[i];
        ans += W[i];
        ans += b[i];
    }
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1) - tmp - 1);
    tcnt = 2 * n + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        add(S, 2 * i, W[i]);
        add(2 * i, T, b[i]);
        add(2 * i + 1, 2 * i, P[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp);
        L[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, L[i]) - tmp);
        R[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, R[i]) - tmp);
        nowx = i;
        Link(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, L[i], R[i]);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 1, tot, a[i]);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans - dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 1500000

struct node {
    int data,l,r,fa,rev,size;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):data(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),rev(0),size(0) {}
} a[MAXN];

int n,m,root,tot;

inline void pushup(int x) {
    a[x].size=a[a[x].l].size+a[a[x].r].size+1;
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (a[x].rev) {
        a[x].rev=0;
        swap(a[x].l,a[x].r);
        a[a[x].l].rev^=1;
        a[a[x].r].rev^=1;
    }
}

void build(int &x,int fa,int l,int r) {
    if (l>r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    x=++tot;
    a[x]=node(mid-1,fa);
    build(a[x].l,x,l,mid-1);
    build(a[x].r,x,mid+1,r);
    pushup(x);
}

inline void zig(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].l=a[x].r;
    a[a[x].r].fa=y;
    a[x].r=y;
    if (y==a[z].l) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void zag(int x) {
    int y=a[x].fa;
    int z=a[y].fa;
    pushdown(y);
    pushdown(x);
    a[y].fa=x;
    a[x].fa=z;
    a[y].r=a[x].l;
    a[a[x].l].fa=y;
    a[x].l=y;
    if (a[z].l==y) a[z].l=x;
    else a[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

inline void splay(int x,int s) {
    pushdown(x);
    while (a[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=a[x].fa;
        int z=a[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==a[z].l) {
            if (x==a[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==a[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int rank(int x,int k) {
    pushdown(x);
    int s=a[a[x].l].size;
    if (k==s+1) return x;
    if (k<=s) return rank(a[x].l,k);
    return rank(a[x].r,k-s-1);
}

inline void reverse(int l,int r) {
    int x=rank(root,l),y=rank(root,r+2);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    a[a[y].l].rev^=1;
}

void dg(int x) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (a[x].l) dg(a[x].l);
    if (a[x].data>0 && a[x].data<=n) printf("%d ",a[x].data);
    if (a[x].r) dg(a[x].r);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    build(root,0,1,n+2);
    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&l,&r);
        reverse(l,r);
    }
    dg(root);
    return 0;
}

}

//BZOJ3223.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int siz, val;
    bool rev;
    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->rev ^= 1, c[1]->rev ^= 1;
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, m;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    return ptr++;
}

Node* build(int l, int r) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(mid);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    fa->relax(), x->relax();
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

Node* get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1);
    Node *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    x->relax();
    if (x->c[0] != null) dfs(x->c[0]);
    if (0 < x->val && n >= x->val) printf("%d ", x->val);
    if (x->c[1] != null) dfs(x->c[1]);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    root = build(0, n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &l, &r);
        Node *range = get(l, r);
        range->revIt();
        splay(range);
    }
    dfs(root);
    return 0;
}

        rev ^= 1;

    Node() :siz(0), rev(false) {}

    t[ch].fa = fa;
    t[fa].c[p] = ch;
}

    return t[t[x].fa].c[1] == x;
}

void relax(int x) {
    if (t[x].rev) {
        swap(t[x].c[0], t[x].c[1]);
        t[t[x].c[0]].rev ^= 1, t[t[x].c[1]].rev ^= 1;
        t[x].rev = 0;
    }

    t[x].siz = t[t[x].c[0]].siz + t[t[x].c[1]].siz + 1;
}

    t[tcnt].c[0] = t[tcnt].c[1] = t[tcnt].fa = 0;
    t[tcnt].val = v;
    return tcnt;
}

    setc(x, build(mid + 1, r), 1);
    pushup(x);
    return x;
}

    int fa = t[x].fa;
    relax(fa), relax(x);
    int d = dir(x);
    setc(t[fa].fa, x, dir(fa));
    setc(fa, t[x].c[!d], d);
    setc(x, fa, !d);
    pushup(fa);

        else dir(x) == dir(t[x].fa) ? (rot(t[x].fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    pushup(x);
}

        relax(x);
        int s = t[t[x].c[0]].siz;
        if (k < s) x = t[x].c[0];
        else if (k > s) k -= s + 1, x = t[x].c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

    int L = select(l - 1), R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R,L);
    return t[R].c[0];
}

    relax(x);
    if (t[x].c[0]) dfs(t[x].c[0]);
    if (0 < t[x].val && n >= t[x].val) printf("%d ", t[x].val);

//BZOJ3224.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
struct data {
    int x,p;
    bool operator < (data a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=1,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[s<<1];

inline void insert(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]--;
}

inline int rank(int x) {
    int l=1,r=x-1,ans=1;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

inline int get_rank(int k) {
    int x=1;
    while (x<s) {
        if (t[(x<<1)]>=k) x=x<<1;
        else {
            k-=t[(x<<1)];
            x=(x<<1)^1;
        }
    }
    return rev[x-s];
}

inline int pre(int x) {
    return get_rank(rank(x)-1);
}

inline int nxt(int x) {
    return get_rank(rank(x));
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",opt+i,num+i);
        if (opt[i]==6) num[i]++;
        if (opt[i]!=4) {
            tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
            tem[cnt].p=i;
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    num[tem[1].p]=1;
    rev[1]=tem[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
            num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
            rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
        } else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        switch (opt[i]) {
        case 1:
            insert(num[i]);
            break;
        case 2:
            del(num[i]);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n",rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n",get_rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n",pre(num[i]));
            break;
        case 6:
            printf("%d\n",nxt(num[i]));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

struct node {
    int v,l,r,fa,cnt,siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):v(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),cnt(0),siz(0) {}
} t[MAXN];
void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;
}
//void pushdown(int x) {} // No need of pushdown
int n,m,root=0,tcnt=0;
void zig(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    if (y==t[z].l) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x,int s) {
    //pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v,0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
            //pushdown(x);
            t[x].siz++;
            if (t[x].v>v) {
                if (!t[x].l) {
                    t[x].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].l;
            } else {
                if (!t[x].r) {
                    t[x].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].r;
            }
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x,0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        //pushdown(x);
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else {
            splay(x,0);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root,ret=0;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v),x=kth(rr),z=kth(rr+1),y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}
int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x,0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}
int pre(int v) { // == lower_bound(v-1);
    int x=insert(v);
    x=t[x].l;
    while (t[x].r) {
        //pushdown(x);
        x=t[x].r;
    }
    del(v);
    return t[x].v;
}
int nxt(int v) { // == upper_bound(v);
    int x=insert(v);
    x=t[x].r;
    while (t[x].l) {
        //pushdown(x);
        x=t[x].l;
    }
    del(v);
    return t[x].v;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in","r",stdin);
//	freopen("ans.out","w",stdout);
    scanf("%d",&n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n",count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n",t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n",pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n",nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

struct node {
    int v,l,r,fa,cnt,siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a,int b):v(a),l(0),r(0),fa(b),cnt(0),siz(0) {}

}
//void pushdown(int x) {} // No need of pushdown
int n,m,root=0,tcnt=0;
void zig(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
    //pushdown(y);pushdown(x);
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    if (y==t[z].l) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;

    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x,int s) {
    //pushdown(x);
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa,z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(x);
            else zag(x);
            break;
        }
        if (y==t[z].l) {
            if (x==t[y].l) zig(y),zig(x);
            else zag(x),zig(x);
        } else {
            if (x==t[y].r) zag(y),zag(x);
            else zig(x),zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int insert(int v) {
    if (!root) {
        root=++tcnt;
        t[root]=node(v,0);
        t[root].cnt=1;
        pushup(root);
        return root;
    } else {
        int x=root;
        while (t[x].v!=v) {
            //pushdown(x);
            t[x].siz++;
            if (t[x].v>v) {
                if (!t[x].l) {
                    t[x].l=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].l;
            } else {
                if (!t[x].r) {
                    t[x].r=++tcnt,t[tcnt]=node(v,x),x=tcnt;
                    break;
                } else x=t[x].r;
            }
        }
        t[x].cnt++;
        pushup(x);
        splay(x,0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        //pushdown(x);
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else {
            if (x!=root) splay(x,root);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root,ret=0;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt,x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v),x=kth(rr),z=kth(rr+1),y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x,0);
    splay(y,root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}
int find(int v) {
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        //pushdown(x);
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x,0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}
int pre(int v) { // lower_bound(v-1);
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}
int nxt(int v) { //upper_bound(v);
    int cnt=count_less(v),x=kth(cnt+1);
    if (t[x].v>v) return t[x].v;
    else return t[kth(cnt+1+t[x].cnt)].v;
}

struct node {

    node() {}
    node(int a, int b):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(0), siz(0) { }
    node(int a, int b, bool flag):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(flag), siz(flag) { }

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;

    t[++tcnt]=node(fa,v,1);
    return tcnt;

/*********** XXX: �����׼���İ汾, ����ÿ���������� ********/
void zig(int x) {       // x is lc(y)
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    (y == t[z].l) ? (t[z].l = x) : (t[z].r = x);
    t[x].fa = z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    t[y].fa=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

void splay(int x, int s) {
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(x)) : (zag(x));
            break;
        } else if (y==t[z].l) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(y)) : (zag(x));
            zig(x);
        } else {
            (x==t[y].r) ? (zag(y)) : (zig(x));
            zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

    // ����ѹѹ��

        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x, 0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}

        splay(x, 0);

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return splay(x, 0), x;
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root, ret=0;
    while (x) {
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v), x=kth(rr), z=kth(rr+1), y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x, 0);
    splay(y, root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}

// XXX ������ܳ���splay(x, 0)֮��, lc(x)==0�����
// ����ͨ�������½��ڱ������, ��Ҳ����

void dzydel(int v) {
    int x = find(v), y = t[x].l;    // find(v)֮��x����root��
    if (!(--t[x].cnt)) {
        splay(t[y].siz, x); // now y does not have a right child
        t[y].r = t[x].r;
        pushup(y); // possibly other pushups as well
        root = y;
    }
}

    return t[kth(count_less(v + 1) + 1)].v;
    // ���ҳ��ж��ٸ� С�ڵ���v, ���ranking�ټ�1���Ǵ���v����Сranking
}

    }
    return 0;
}

        while (t[x].v!=v) {
        	t[x].siz++;
        	if (t[x].v>v) {
        		if (!t[x].l) {t[x].l=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }
        		else x=t[x].l;
        	} else {
        		if (!t[x].r) {t[x].r=++tcnt, t[tcnt]=node(v, x), x=tcnt; break; }
        		else x=t[x].r;
        	}
        }

        pushup(x);
        splay(x, 0);

        XXX : my version below, (squeezed) just care about the meaning, 7��
        */
        int x = root, y = 0; // y��x�ĸ���, �������ҵ�ʱ��x���0, ����y������0
        for (; (x && v != t[x].v); (x = (v < t[x].v) ? t[x].l : t[x].r))
            t[(y = x)].siz++;
        (x) ? (t[x].cnt++)
        : (x = /* allocNode(value=v, parent=y) ����allocNode��ʱ��, cnt��siz������Ϊ1 */newNode(v,y),(v<t[y].v)?t[y].l=x:t[y].r=x);
        splay(x, 0);
        return x;
    }
}

int kth(int k) {
    int x=root;
    while (k) {
        int s=t[t[x].l].siz;
        if (k<=s) x=t[x].l;
        else if (k>s+t[x].cnt) k-=s+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return splay(x, 0), x;
    }
    return 0;
}

int count_less(int v) {
    int x=root, ret=0;
    while (x) {
        if (v<t[x].v) x=t[x].l;
        else if (v>t[x].v) ret+=t[t[x].l].siz+t[x].cnt, x=t[x].r;
        else return ret+t[t[x].l].siz;
    }
    return ret;
}

void del(int v) {
    int rr=count_less(v), x=kth(rr), z=kth(rr+1), y=kth(rr+1+t[z].cnt);
    splay(x, 0);
    splay(y, root);
    if (!(--t[z].cnt)) t[y].l=0;
    else pushup(z);
    pushup(y);
    pushup(x);
}

// XXX ������ܳ���splay(x, 0)֮��, lc(x)==0�����
// ����ͨ�������½��ڱ������, ��Ҳ����
// ˼·: splay����֮���ڸ�ɾ��
void dzydel(int v) {
    int x = find(v);	// find(v)֮��x����root��
    if (!(--t[x].cnt)) {
        int y = t[x].l;
        while (t[y].r) y = t[y].r;
        splay(y, x); // now y does not have a right child
        root = y, t[y].fa = 0, t[y].r = t[x].r, t[t[x].r].fa = y;
        pushup(y); // possibly other pushups as well
    } else pushup(x);
}

// �Ҽǵ���д�������, �����prev��succ��һ�ֳ���С�ķ���
// �������ַ���, �ǵ����Ҫsplay

// Ҳ������ôд
int pre(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v))].v;
}

int nxt(int v) {
    return t[kth(count_less(v + 1) + 1)].v;
    // ���ҳ��ж��ٸ� С�ڵ���v, ���ranking�ټ�1���Ǵ���v����Сranking
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF);
    insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        /*********** XXX: switch��ʵ�����,  ��Ȼ���ﲻ��bottleneck ********/
        if (x==1) insert(y);
        else if (x==2) del(y);
        else if (x==3) printf("%d\n", count_less(y));
        else if (x==4) printf("%d\n", t[kth(y+1)].v);
        else if (x==5) printf("%d\n", pre(y));
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y));
    }
    return 0;
}

/*
 * д��Ӧ��û�д�����, ������д��splay, �����������
 * wjmzbmr��һ��ʮ��splay, �Ҳ��Ǻ����, �����ѧѧ
 * ��Ҫ������Ҳ�����ȥ������������Ҫһ��

#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

/*********** XXX: ���Ҿ���, ָ�����, ��Ȼ���ܺķѸ����ڴ�(64bit machine) ********/
/*********** XXX:
 *  �������ڴ�ط���, �Ͳ���new��
 *  ���ǿ�һ������, �����@��t[MAXN]
 *  ֮��дһ������(inline����define)�ֶ�new:
 *	  static inline node *allocNode(value) { return t + tcnt++; }
 *	  static inline node *allocNode(value, parent) { watch relation of value and parent->value, and do stuff }
 *********/
struct node {
    int v, l, r, fa, cnt, siz;
    node() {}
    node(int a, int b):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(0), siz(0) { }
    node(int a, int b, bool flag):
        v(a), l(0), r(0), fa(b), cnt(flag), siz(flag) { }
} t[MAXN];

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].siz=t[t[x].l].siz+t[t[x].r].siz+t[x].cnt;
}

int n, m, root=0, tcnt=0;

int newNode(int fa,int v) {
    t[++tcnt]=node(fa,v,1);
    return tcnt;
}

/*********** XXX: �����׼���İ汾, ����ÿ���������� ********/
void zig(int x) {	   // x is lc(y)
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    (y == t[z].l) ? (t[z].l = x) : (t[z].r = x);
    t[x].fa = z;
    t[y].l=t[x].r;
    t[t[x].r].fa=y;
    t[x].r=y;
    t[y].fa=x;
    pushup(y);
}

/*********** XXX: ͬ�� ********/
void zag(int x) {
    int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
    t[y].fa=x;
    t[x].fa=z;
    t[y].r=t[x].l;
    t[t[x].l].fa=y;
    t[x].l=y;
    if (t[z].l==y) t[z].l=x;
    else t[z].r=x;
    pushup(y);
}

// ѹ��233
void splay(int x, int s) {
    while (t[x].fa!=s) {
        int y=t[x].fa, z=t[y].fa;
        if (z==s) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(x)) : (zag(x));
            break;
        } else if (y==t[z].l) {
            (x==t[y].l) ? (zig(y)) : (zag(x));
            zig(x);
        } else {
            (x==t[y].r) ? (zag(y)) : (zig(x));
            zag(x);
        }
    }
    pushup(x);
    if (s==0) root=x;
}

int find(int v) {
    // ����ѹѹ��
    int x=root;
    while (x) {
        if (v>t[x].v && t[x].r) x=t[x].r;
        else if (v<t[x].v && t[x].l) x=t[x].l;
        else break;
    }
    if (x) splay(x, 0);
    return t[x].v==v?x:0;
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull , *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr->cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *f = null) {
    while (x->fa != f) {
        if (x->fa->fa == f) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[x->val < v]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    // if (root == null) return null;
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x -> c[v > x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v > x->val];
        if (v > x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    // if (root == null) return null;
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v >= x->val];
        if (v < x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) {
        root = newNode(v);
        root->fa = null;
    } else {
        Node *x = root, *y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(int v) {
    Node *x = find(v);
//	if (x == null) return;
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
//	if (k < 1 || k > root->siz) return null;
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x->c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

void dfs(Node* x, int depth) {
    for (int i=1; i<=depth; i++) putchar('\t');
    printf("%d(%d)[%d]\n", x->val, x->cnt, x->siz);
    putchar('\n');
    for (int i=0; i<2; i++) {
        if (x->c[i] != null) dfs(x->c[i], depth+1);
    }
}

int main() {
    /*	int test[20] = {1,3,3,4,5,8,10,0}, *now = test;
    	insert(INF);insert(-INF);
    	while (*now != 0) {
    		printf("After inserting %d : \n", *now);
    		insert(*(now++));
    		dfs(root,0);
    	}
    	for (int i=0;i<10;i++) {
    		printf("nxt %d : %d\n",i,nxt(i)->val);
    	}
    	for (int i=2;i<=11;i++) {
    		printf("pre %d : %d\n",i,pre(i)->val);
    	}
    	for (int i=1;i<=7;i++) {
    	dfs(root, 0);
    		printf("select %d : %d\n",i,select(i)->val);
    	}
    	dfs(root, 0);*/
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(y);
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (x->fa != f) {
        if (x->fa->fa == f) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[x->val < v]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x -> c[v > x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v > x->val];
        if (v > x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) {
        x = x->c[v >= x->val];
        if (v < x->val) ret = x;
    }
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) {
        root = newNode(v);
        root->fa = null;
    } else {
        Node *x = root, *y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(int v) {
    Node *x = find(v);
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    insert(-INF), insert(INF);
    for (int i=1, x, y; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        if (x == 1) insert(y);
        else if (x == 2) del(y);
        else if (x == 3) printf("%d\n", find(y)->c[0]->siz);
        else if (x == 4) printf("%d\n", select(y)->val);
        else if (x == 5) printf("%d\n", pre(y)->val);
        else printf("%d\n", nxt(y)->val);
    }
    return 0;
}

struct Node {

    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull , *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

    ptr->siz = ptr->cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *f = null) {
    while (x->fa != f) {
        if (x->fa->fa == f) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[x->val < v]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    int val, siz, cnt;
    Node() :siz(0), cnt(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool dir() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void upd() {
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + cnt;
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *root = null;

int n, tcnt = 0;

Node* newNode(int v) {
    ptr->siz = ptr-> cnt = 1;
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->fa = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int dir = x->dir();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->dir());
    fa->setc(x->c[!dir], dir);
    x->setc(fa, !dir);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == root) root = x;
}

void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->dir() == x->fa->dir() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

Node* find(int v) {
    for (Node *x = root; x != null; x = x->c[v > x->val]) {
        if (x->val == v) {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

Node* pre(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v > x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v > x->val] != null) if (v > (x = x->c[v > x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

Node* nxt(int v) {
    Node *x = root, *ret = (v < x->val) ? x : null;
    while (x->c[v >= x->val] != null) if (v < (x = x->c[v >= x->val])->val) ret = x;
    splay(x);
    return ret;
}

void insert(int v) {
    if (root == null) root = newNode(v);
    else {
        Node *x = root ,*y = null;
        while (x != null && v != x->val) (y = x)->siz++, x = x->c[v > x->val];
        (x != null) ? (x->cnt++, x->upd()) : (y->setc(x = newNode(v), y->val < v));
        splay(x);
    }
}

void del(Node *x) {
    if (!(--x->cnt)) {
        Node *y = x->c[0];
        while (y->c[1] != null) y = y->c[1];
        splay(y, x);
        y->setc(x->c[1], 1), root = y, y->fa = null, y->upd();
    } else x->upd();
}

Node* select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = root;;) {
        int s = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < s) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k >= s + x->cnt) k -= s + x->cnt, x = x-> c[1];
        else {
            splay(x);
            return x;
        }
    }
}

//BZOJ3224.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005
struct data {
    int x,p;
    inline bool operator < (const data &a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} tem[MAXN];

int n,cnt,tot=1,Log,rev[MAXN],opt[MAXN],num[MAXN];
int t[MAXN];

#define insert(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) ++t[x];}
#define del(y) {for (int x = y; x <= tot; x += x & -x) --t[x];}

inline int rank(int x) {
    int ret = 1;
    for (--x; x; x -= x & -x) ret += t[x];
    return ret;
}

inline int get_rank(int k) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (int j = 1 << Log; j; j >>= 1) {
        if ((ret | j) <= tot && k > t[ret | j]) k -= t[ret |= j];
    }
    return rev[ret + 1];
}

#define pre(x) get_rank(rank(x) - 1)
#define nxt(x) get_rank(rank(x))

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d",opt+i,num+i);
        if (opt[i]==6) num[i]++;
        if (opt[i]!=4) {
            tem[++cnt].x=num[i];
            tem[cnt].p=i;
        }
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+cnt+1);
    num[tem[1].p]=1;
    rev[1]=tem[1].x;
    for (int i=2; i<=cnt; i++) {
        if (tem[i].x!=tem[i-1].x) {
            num[tem[i].p]=++tot;
            rev[tot]=tem[i].x;
        } else num[tem[i].p]=tot;
    }
    for (Log = 0; tot >> Log; Log++);
    Log--;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        switch (opt[i]) {
        case 1:
            insert(num[i]);
            break;
        case 2:
            del(num[i]);
            break;
        case 3:
            printf("%d\n",rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 4:
            printf("%d\n",get_rank(num[i]));
            break;
        case 5:
            printf("%d\n",pre(num[i]));
            break;
        case 6:
            printf("%d\n",nxt(num[i]));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
