//BZOJ3230.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}
#define MAXN 100319

inline void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), x[sa[1]] = k = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, Q, sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN], Log[MAXN], st[MAXN][17];
LL sum[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    else if (x == y) return 0x23333333;
    x++;
    return min(st[x][Log[y - x + 1]], st[y - (1 << Log[y - x +1]) + 1][Log[y - x +1]]);
}

inline pii get(LL rank) {
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (sum[mid] >= rank) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return make_pair(sa[l], int(sa[l] + h[l] + (rank - sum[l - 1]) - 1));
}

inline void work(LL x, LL y) {
    pii xa = get(x), xb = get(y);
    int len = min(xa.second - xa.first + 1, xb.second - xb.first + 1);
    if (x == y) printf("%lld\n", power(len) * 2);
    else {
        int l = 0, r = len, mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (rmq(rk[xa.second + 1 - mid], rk[xb.second + 1 - mid]) >= mid) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        printf("%lld\n", power(min(len, rmq(rk[xa.first], rk[xb.first]))) + power(l));
    }
}

inline void init() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 26);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[j + k] == s[i + k]; k++);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (n - sa[i] + 1) - h[i];
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = min(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        LL x, y;
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (y > sum[n]) puts("-1");
        else work(x, y);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3236.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

int n,m,sqn,blo[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN],blosum[MAXN],bloans[MAXN];
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN];
int tot[MAXM],ans[MAXM];
struct data {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (data q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]++;
}

void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    blosum[blo[a[x]]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int query_sum(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            ret+=cnt[i];
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=blosum[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) ret+=cnt[i];
    }
    return ret;
}
int query_cnt(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        blo[i]=i/sqn;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        tot[q[i].x]=query_sum(q[i].a,q[i].b);
        ans[q[i].x]=query_cnt(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d %d\n",tot[i],ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3237.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 200005
#define MAXK 100005

struct edge {
    int u, v, head;
} e[MAXM];

int n, m, K, head[MAXM];

struct Node {
    int t, next;
} ls[MAXK * 4];
int lcnt = 0;

void add(int x, int i) {
    ls[++lcnt].t = i;
    ls[lcnt].next = e[x].head;
    e[x].head = lcnt;
}

struct segNode {
    int l, r, head;
} t[262144];
int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
    }
    return x;
}

struct Query {
    int tag, next;
} q[(MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int qcnt = 0;

void addQuery(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        q[++qcnt].tag = v;
        q[qcnt].next = t[x].head;
        t[x].head = qcnt;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) addQuery(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) addQuery(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
}

struct stackNode {
    int pos, val;
} s[(MAXN + MAXM + MAXK) * 20];
int top = 0;

int f[MAXN], tot = 0;

void modify(int p, int v) {
    s[++top].pos = p, s[top].val = f[p];
    f[p] = v;
}

int getf(int x) {
    while (f[x] > 0) x = f[x];
    return x;
}

void merge(int u, int v) {
    int fu = getf(u), fv = getf(v);
    if (fu != fv) {
        if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
        modify(fu, f[fu] + f[fv]);
        modify(fv, fu);
        tot++;
    }
}

void solve(int x, int l, int r) {
    int tmp = top;
    for (int now = t[x].head; now; now = q[now].next) merge(e[q[now].tag].u, e[q[now].tag].v);
    if (l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        solve(t[x].l, l, mid);
        solve(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    } else {
        puts(tot == n - 1 ? "Connected" : "Disconnected");
    }
    while (top > tmp) {
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        f[s[top].pos] = s[top].val;
        top--;
        tot--;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
    }
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1, c, x; i <= K; i++) {
        read(c);
        for (int j = 1; j <= c; j++) {
            read(x);
            add(x, i);
        }
    }
    build(1, K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int x = K;
        for (int now = e[i].head; now; now = ls[now].next) {
            int y = ls[now].t;
            if (x > y) addQuery(1, 1, K, y + 1, x, i);
            x = y - 1;
        }
        if (x) addQuery(1, 1, K, 1, x, i);
    }
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    solve(1, 1, K);
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 500319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int n, sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int sta[MAXN], top = 0;
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa();
    h[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (h[sta[top]] >= h[i]) top--;
        if (top) L[i] = sta[top] + 1;
        else L[i] = 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (h[sta[top]] > h[i]) top--;
        if (top) R[i] = sta[top] - 1;
        else R[i] = n;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ans += i * LL(n - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ans -= 2ll * h[i] * (i - L[i] + 1) * (R[i] - i + 1);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();

#define MOD 1000000007

LL power(LL a, LL b) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = ret * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void get(LL &a, LL &b) {
    a = 0, b = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    int stp = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        b = b * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
        if ((++stp & 7) == 0) a %= MOD, b %= MOD - 1;
    }
}

LL n, nn, m, mm, a, b, c, d;

int main() {
    get(n, nn);
    get(m, mm);
    read(a);
    read(b);
    read(c);
    read(d);

    LL q, w;

    //cerr << a << " " << mm << " " << endl;

    q = power(a, mm + MOD - 2);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, mm - 1)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (m - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;
    a = c * q % MOD;
    b = (c * w + d) % MOD;

    //cerr << q << " " << w << " " << a << " " << b << endl;

    (++n) %= MOD;

    q = power(a, nn + MOD - 1);
    if (a ^ 1) w = b * (1 - power(a, nn)) % MOD * power(1 - a, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    else w = b * (n - 1) % MOD;
    if (w < 0) w += MOD;

    LL ans = (q + w - d) * power(c, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    printf("%lld\n", (ans + MOD) % MOD);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3252.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 200005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K, a[MAXN], head[MAXN], fa[MAXN], rev[MAXN], ecnt;
LL ans = 0, vv[MAXN];
int L[MAXN], R[MAXN], dfn = 0;
bool vis[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x, LL tot) {
    L[x] = ++dfn;
    rev[dfn] = x;
    if (!head[x]) {
        vv[L[x]] = tot + a[x];
    } else {
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dfs(e[now].to, tot + a[x]);
        }
    }
    R[x] = dfn;
}

struct Node {
    int l, r;
    LL v, lazy;
} t[524288];

int tcnt = 0;

void pushup(int x) {
    t[x].v = max(t[t[x].l].v, t[t[x].r].v);
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    if (t[x].lazy) {
        t[t[x].l].lazy += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].lazy += t[x].lazy;
        t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lazy, t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lazy;
        t[x].lazy = 0;
    }
}

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        pushup(x);
    } else t[x].v = vv[l];
    return x;
}

int get(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return ans += t[x].v, l;
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[t[x].l].v == t[x].v) return get(t[x].l, l, mid);
    else return get(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, LL v) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += v, t[x].lazy += v;
        return;
    }
    pushdown(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), v);
    if (qr > mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, v);
    pushup(x);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dfs(1, 0);
    build(1, n);
    vis[0] = 1;
    while (t[1].v > 0 && K--) {
        int x = rev[get(1, 1, n)];
        while (!vis[x]) {
            vis[x] = 1;
            update(1, 1, n, L[x], R[x], -a[x]);
            x = fa[x];
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 200319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int n, K;
int head[MAXN], a[MAXN], son[MAXN], cnt = 0;
long long dep[MAXN], c[MAXN];

void dfs(int x) {
    dep[x] = 0;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        if (dep[x] < dep[e[now].to]) {
            dep[x] = dep[e[now].to];
            son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
    dep[x] += a[x];
}

void Link(int x, bool ed) {
    if (!ed) c[++cnt] = dep[x];
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], 1);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, 0);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        e[i] = (edge) {
            head[u], v
        };
        head[u] = i;
    }
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 0);
    sort(c + 1, c + cnt + 1, greater<long long>());
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(cnt, K); i++) ans += c[i];
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='A' && ch!='Q') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='A';
}

#define MAXN 600005
#define bitwise 24

struct node {
    int lch,rch,v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int n,m,tcnt=0;
int sum[MAXN],rt[MAXN];

int update(int pre,int num,int dep) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].lch=t[pre].lch;
    t[now].rch=t[pre].rch;
    t[now].v=t[pre].v+1;
    if (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) t[now].rch=update(t[pre].rch,num,dep-1);
        else t[now].lch=update(t[pre].lch,num,dep-1);
    }
    return now;
}

int query(int lx,int rx,int num) {
    int dep=bitwise,ret=0;
    while (dep>-1) {
        if ((num>>dep)&1) {
            if (t[t[rx].lch].v-t[t[lx].lch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
            else lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
        } else {
            if (t[t[rx].rch].v-t[t[lx].rch].v>0) ret|=1<<dep,lx=t[lx].rch,rx=t[rx].rch;
            else lx=t[lx].lch,rx=t[rx].lch;
        }
        dep--;
    }
    dep=bitwise;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    rt[1]=update(0,0,bitwise);
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a);
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]^a;
        rt[i+1]=update(rt[i],sum[i],bitwise);
    }
    for (int i=1,l,r,x; i<=m; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            n++;
            sum[n]=sum[n-1]^x;
            rt[n+1]=update(rt[n],sum[n],bitwise);
        } else {
            read(l);
            read(r);
            read(x);
            l--,x^=sum[n];
            printf("%d\n",query(rt[l],rt[r],x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3262.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct flower {
    int x,y,z,siz,ans;
    bool operator < (flower a) const {
        if (x!=a.x) return x<a.x;
        else if (y!=a.y) return y<a.y;
        else return z<a.z;
    }
} a[MAXN],p[MAXN];

bool cmp(flower x,flower y) {
    if (x.y!=y.y) return x.y<y.y;
    else return x.z<y.z;
}

int n,k,tot[MAXN];
#define s 262144
int t[s<<1];

void update(int x,int v) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]+=v;
}
void del(int x) {
    for (x+=s; x; x>>=1) t[x]=0;
}
int query(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int l=s,r=x+s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

void cdq(int l,int r) {
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    cdq(l,mid);
    cdq(mid+1,r);
    sort(p+l,p+mid+1,cmp);
    sort(p+mid+1,p+r+1,cmp);
    int i=l,j=mid+1;
    while (j<=r) {
        while (i<=mid && p[i].y<=p[j].y) {
            update(p[i].z,p[i].siz);
            i++;
        }
        p[j].ans+=query(p[j].z);
        j++;
    }
    for (i=l; i<=mid; i++) del(p[i].z);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i].x);
        read(a[i].y);
        read(a[i].z);
        a[i].ans=0;
    }
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    int wu=0;
    for (int i=1,cnt=0; i<=n; i++) {
        cnt++;
        if (a[i].x!=a[i+1].x || a[i].y!=a[i+1].y || a[i].z!=a[i+1].z) {
            p[++wu]=a[i];
            p[wu].siz=cnt;
            cnt=0;
        }
    }
    int nn=n;
    n=wu;
    cdq(1,n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        tot[p[i].ans+p[i].siz-1]+=p[i].siz;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<nn; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",tot[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1000005
#define MOD 1000000007

int n, K, sum[MAXN][3];
char s[MAXN];

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    s[++n] = 'X';
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s[i] = (s[i] == 'X') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 2);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) sum[i][j] = sum[i - 1][j];
        sum[i][(int)s[i]]++;
    }
}

int dp[MAXN][3][2];

void work() {
    dp[0][0][1] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (s[i] != 2) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) dp[i][j][0] = (dp[i - 1][j][0] + dp[i - 1][j][1]) % MOD;
        if (s[i] != 1) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) dp[i][j][1] = (dp[i - 1][j][0] + dp[i - 1][j][1]) % MOD;
        if (i < K) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != (2 - j) && sum[i][2 - j] == sum[i - K][2 - j]) {
                dp[i][j + 1][j] = (dp[i][j + 1][j] + dp[i - K][j][j ^ 1]) % MOD;
                dp[i][j][j] = (dp[i][j][j] - dp[i - K][j][j ^ 1]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ((dp[n][2][0] % MOD) + MOD) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3270.cpp
/* Never stop fighting for what you believe in. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>

#define MAXN 22
const double eps = 1e-9;

struct Equation {
    double v[MAXN * MAXN];
    double &operator [] (int x) {
        return v[x];
    }
} a[MAXN * MAXN];

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * MAXN];

int n, m, S, T, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0, cnt[MAXN], tag[MAXN][MAXN], tagcnt = 0;
double p[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
    cnt[u]++, cnt[v]++;
}

void build(int x, int y) {
    for (int nowx = head[x]; nowx; nowx = e[nowx].next) {
        int u = e[nowx].to;
        for (int nowy = head[y]; nowy; nowy = e[nowy].next) {
            int v = e[nowy].to;
            if (u != v) a[tag[x][y]][tag[u][v]] = (1.0 - p[u]) / cnt[u] * (1.0 - p[v]) / cnt[v];
        }
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[e[now].to][y]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[y];
    for (int now = head[y]; now; now = e[now].next)
        if (e[now].to != x) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][e[now].to]] =  (1.0 - p[e[now].to]) / cnt[e[now].to] * p[x];
    a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] = -1;
    if (x != y) a[tag[x][y]][tag[x][y]] += p[x] * p[y];
}

void gauss() {
    int tot = tag[n][n], now = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        int to = now;
        while (to <= tot && abs(a[to][i]) < eps) to++;
        if (to > tot) continue;
        swap(a[now], a[to]);
        double t = a[now][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= tot; j++) a[now][j] /= t;
        for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
            if (j != now && abs(a[j][i]) > eps) {
                t = a[j][i];
                for (int k = 0; k <= tot; k++) a[j][k] -= t * a[now][k];
            }
        }
        now++;
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &S, &T);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%lf", p + i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            tag[i][j] = ++tagcnt;
        }
    a[tag[S][T]][0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            build(i, j);
        }
    }
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf("%.6lf ", a[tag[i][i]][0]);
    return 0;
}

    a=0;

        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];
int n,S=0,T,a[MAXN],head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN],ecnt=1;
void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}
int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}
int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=T; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x7fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}
int gcd(int x,int y) {
    if (y) return gcd(y,x%y);
    else return x;
}
#define power(x) (LL(x)*LL(x))

int main() {
    read(n);
    T=n+1;
    int tot=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        if (a[i]&1) add(S,i,a[i]);
        else add(i,T,a[i]);
        tot+=a[i];
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if ((a[i]^a[j])&1 && gcd(a[i],a[j])==1) {
                LL x=power(a[i])+power(a[j]);
                LL sqx=LL(sqrt(x));
                if (sqx*sqx==x) {
                    if (a[i]&1)	add(i,j,0x7fffffff);
                    else add(j,i,0x7ffffff);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 400319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa(int n) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] != '$' && s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int t[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1, t[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
    }
}

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    //if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(t[Log[y - x]][x + 1], t[Log[y - x]][y - (1 << Log[y - x]) + 1]);
}

int n, K, len;
int st[MAXN], ed[MAXN], bel[MAXN];
int cnt[MAXN], pre[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = st[i]; j < ed[i]; j++) bel[j] = i;
    int i = 1, j = 0, tot = 0;
    while (bel[sa[j + 1]]) {
        tot += !cnt[bel[sa[++j]]], ++cnt[bel[sa[j]]];
        while (tot >= K) --cnt[bel[sa[i]]], tot -= !cnt[bel[sa[i++]]];
        pre[j] = i - 1;
    }
}

inline bool check(int x, int L) {
    int l_, r_;
    int l = x, r = len;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x, mid) >= L) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    r_ = l;
    l = 1, r = x;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= L) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    l_ = l;
    return pre[r_] >= l_;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st[i] = ed[i - 1] + 1;
        scanf("%s", s + st[i]);
        ed[i] = st[i] + (int)strlen(s + st[i]);
        s[ed[i]] = '$';
    }
    len = ed[n];
    getsa(len);
    getst(len);
    init();
    for (int p = 1; p <= n; p++) {
        int k = 0;
        LL ans = 0;
        for (int i = st[p]; i < ed[p]; i++, ans += k) {
            for (k -= !!k; k < ed[p] - i && check(rk[i], k + 1); k++);
        }
        printf("%lld ", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

        if (!(l&1)) ret+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=t[r^1];

long long C[1005][1005];

void init() {
    for (int i=0; i<=1000; i++) {
        C[i][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
            C[i][j]=C[i-1][j]+C[i-1][j-1];
            if (C[i][j]>=MOD) C[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
}

bool visit[255];
long long g[35][35][255];

int n,m,c;

void initg(int k) {
    visit[k]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            long long s=0;
            for (int a=1; a<=i; a++)
                for (int b=1; b<=j; b++) {
                    if (a!=i || b!=j) {
                        s=(s+((g[a][b][k]*C[i][a])%MOD)*C[j][b])%MOD;
                    }
                }
            g[i][j][k]=(C[i*j][k]-s)%MOD;
            if (g[i][j][k]<0) g[i][j][k]+=MOD;
        }
}

long long dp[15][35][35];

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&m,&c);
    dp[0][0][0]=1;
    int tot=0;
    for (int t=1,cc; t<=c; t++) {
        scanf("%d",&cc);
        tot+=cc;
        if (cc==0) {
            t--,n--;
            continue;
        }
        if (cc>n*m) {
            puts("0");
            return 0;
        }
        if (!visit[cc]) initg(cc);
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
                if (g[i][j][cc]) {
                    for (int a=0; a+i<=n; a++)
                        for (int b=0; b+j<=m; b++) {
                            if (dp[t-1][a][b]) {
                                dp[t][a+i][b+j]=(dp[t][a+i][b+j]+((dp[t-1][a][b]*g[i][j][cc])%MOD)*((C[a+i][i]*C[b+j][j])%MOD))%MOD;
                            }
                        }
                }
            }
    }
    if (n*m<tot) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    if (tot==0) {
        puts("0");
        return 0;
    }
    long long ans=0;
    for (int i=0; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<=m; j++) {
            ans=(ans+dp[c][i][j]*((C[n][i]*C[m][j])%MOD))%MOD;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

inline bool byNum(element a,element b) {

inline bool byVal(element a,element b) {
    return a.val<b.val;
}
inline bool reNum(element a,element b) {
    return a.num>b.num;
}
inline bool reVal(element a,element b) {
    return a.val>b.val;

int n,m,s=131072,list[MAXN],t[262144];

inline void update(int x) {
    for (t[x+=s]++,x>>=1; x>0; t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1],x>>=1);
}
inline void clear(int x) {
    for (t[x+=s]=0,x>>=1; x>0; t[x]=0,x>>=1);
}
inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ans+=t[l^1];
        if (r&1) ans+=t[r^1];
    }
    return ans;
}

long long rev=0;
inline void getrev() {
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        rev+=query(a[i].val,n);

    }

    return;
}

void cdq(int l,int r,bool (*cmp)(element,element)) {
    if (l==r)
        return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    cdq(l,mid,cmp);
    cdq(mid+1,r,cmp);
    sort(a+l,a+mid+1,cmp);
    sort(a+mid+1,a+r+1,cmp);
    for (int i=mid+1,j=l; i<=r; i++) {
        while (j<=mid && cmp(a[j],a[i])) {
            update(a[j++].t);
        }
        a[i].ans+=query(1,a[i].t);
    }
    for (int i=l; i<=mid; i++)
        clear(a[i].t);
    return;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        a[i].num=i;
        scanf("%d",&a[i].val);
        list[a[i].val]=i;
        a[i].t=1;
        a[i].ans=0;
    }
    getrev();
    for (int i=m+1,now; i>1; i--) {
        scanf("%d",&now);
        a[list[now]].t=i;
    }
    cdq(1,n,reVal);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,reNum);
    cdq(1,n,byVal);
    sort(a+1,a+n+1,byT);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%lld\n",rev);
        rev-=a[i].ans;
    }
    return 0;
}

    return a > b ? a : b;

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 300319
struct edge {
    int u, v, w;
} e[MAXM], E[MAXM];

struct List {
    int he, ta;
} L[MAXN];

int n, m;
int f[MAXN], nxt[MAXN], G[MAXN][MAXN];

void Sort() {
    static int P[32768];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i < 32768; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[e[i].w]++;
    for (i = 32766; i; i--) P[i] += P[i + 1];
    for (i = m; i; i--) E[P[e[i].w]--] = e[i];
}

int getf(int x) {
    if (f[x] < 0) return x;
    else return f[x] = getf(f[x]);
}

bool work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    register int i, j;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(e[i].u), read(e[i].v);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            read(G[i][j]);
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (G[i][i]) return 0;
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] != G[j][i]) return 0;
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        if (G[e[i].u][e[i].v] == -1) return 0;
        e[i].w = G[e[i].u][e[i].v];
    }
    Sort();
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i] = -1;
        nxt[i] = 0;
        L[i].he = L[i].ta = i;
    }
    for (int now = 1; now <= m; now++) {
        int u = getf(E[now].u), v = getf(E[now].v), w = E[now].w;
        if (u != v) {
            if (f[u] > f[v]) swap(u, v);
            for (i = L[u].he; i; i = nxt[i])
                for (j = L[v].he; j; j = nxt[j]) {
                    if (G[i][j] != w) {
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            nxt[L[u].ta] = L[v].he;
            L[u].ta = L[v].ta;
            f[u] += f[v];
            f[v] = u;
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int u = getf(i), v;
        for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            v = getf(j);
            if (u != v && G[i][j] != -1) return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    for (int ca = 1; ca <= T; ca++) {
        printf("Case #%d: ", ca);
        if (work()) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3339.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 200005

int n,sqn,Q;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],ans[MAXN],nowans=0;
struct query {
    int l,r,id;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    cnt[x]++;
    while (cnt[nowans]) nowans++;
}
void del(int x) {
    cnt[x]--;
    if (!cnt[x] && nowans>x) nowans=x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn=int(sqrt(n))+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+Q+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=Q; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        ans[q[i].id]=nowans;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3365.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, m, k;

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];
int ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) siz[x] += ds(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
    return siz[x];
}

int find(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        int maxs = -1, to;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] > maxs) {
                maxs = siz[e[now].to];
                to = e[now].to;
            }
        }
        if (maxs * 2 >= siz[x]) rt = to;
        else return rt;
    }
}

LL ans = 0;
int dep[MAXN], l[MAXN], lcnt;

void dd(int x) {
    if (dep[x] > k) return;
    vis[x] = 1;
    l[++lcnt] = dep[x];
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

LL work(int x, int base = 0) {
    dep[x] = base;
    lcnt = 0;
    dd(x);
    sort(l + 1, l + lcnt + 1);
    int i = 1, j = lcnt;
    LL ret = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (l[i] + l[j] <= k) ret += j - i++;
        else j--;
    }
    return ret;
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = find(x);
    ans += work(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            ans -= work(e[now].to, e[now].w);
            solve(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    read(k);
    solve(1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3437.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 1000005

int n;
LL a[MAXN], s[MAXN], b[MAXN], f[MAXN];

LD slope(int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[j] + b[j] - f[k] - b[k]) / (s[j] - s[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void maintain(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[l], v[l + 1]) < i) l++;
    }
    void insert(int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(v[r], i) < slope(v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(b[i]), s[i] = s[i - 1] + b[i], b[i] = b[i - 1] + b[i] * i;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        q.maintain(i);
        int j = q.front();
        f[i] = f[j] + i * (s[i] - s[j]) - (b[i] - b[j]) + a[i];
        q.insert(i);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[n]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3442.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 105

struct edge {
    int next, to, w, f;
} e[MAXN * MAXN * 16];

int n, m, k, ecnt = 1, head[MAXN * 2];
int C[MAXN], F[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], aff[MAXN];
char s[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w, int f) {
    if (f < 1) return;
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].f = f;
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].f = 0;
    head[v] = ecnt;
}
void insert(int x) {
    if (++cnt[x] > aff[x]) return;
    add(0, x + 1, -C[x] * (2 * cnt[x] - 1), 1);
}
int dis[MAXN * 2], pre[MAXN * 2], pos[MAXN * 2];
bool inq[MAXN * 2];
queue <int> q;
int spfa() {
    memset(dis, 0xc0, sizeof(dis));
    dis[0] = 0;
    q.push(0);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] < dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) inq[e[now].to] = 1, q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[1] > (int)0xc0c0c0c0;
}

int MCMF() {
    int ret = 0, to;
    while (spfa()) {
        if ((to = pre[pre[1]]) == 0) {
            int f = min(e[pos[1]].f, e[pos[pre[1]]].f);
            for (int i = 1; i; i = pre[i]) e[pos[i]].f -= f, e[pos[i] ^ 1].f += f;
        } else {
            ret += dis[1];
            for (int i = 1; i; i = pre[i]) e[pos[i]].f--, e[pos[i] ^ 1].f++;
            insert(to - 1);
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(C[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(F[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (s[j] == '1') {
                flag = 1;
                break;
            }
        if (!flag) {
            i--, n--;
            continue;
        }
        add(0, i + m + 1, 0, k - 1);
        add(i + m + 1, 1, 0, k);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) if (s[j] == '1') add(j + 1, i + m + 1, F[j], 1), aff[j]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) insert(i);
    printf("%d\n", -MCMF());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3473.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 400319

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
inline void getsa(int n) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 256;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == '$' ? ++m : s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int i, j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] != '$' && s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int t[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1, t[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++)
            t[k][i] = min(t[k - 1][i], t[k - 1][i + x]);
    }
}

inline int rmq(int x, int y) {
    //if (x > y) swap(x, y);
    return min(t[Log[y - x]][x + 1], t[Log[y - x]][y - (1 << Log[y - x]) + 1]);
}

int n, K, len;
int st[MAXN], ed[MAXN], bel[MAXN];
int cnt[MAXN], pre[MAXN];

inline void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = st[i]; j < ed[i]; j++) bel[j] = i;
    int i = 1, j = 0, tot = 0;
    while (bel[sa[j + 1]]) {
        tot += !cnt[bel[sa[++j]]], ++cnt[bel[sa[j]]];
        while (tot >= K) --cnt[bel[sa[i]]], tot -= !cnt[bel[sa[i++]]];
        pre[j] = i - 1;
    }
}

inline bool check(int x, int L) {
    int l_, r_;
    int l = x, r = len;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (rmq(x, mid) >= L) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    r_ = l;
    l = 1, r = x;
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (rmq(mid, x) >= L) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    l_ = l;
    return pre[r_] >= l_;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st[i] = ed[i - 1] + 1;
        scanf("%s", s + st[i]);
        ed[i] = st[i] + (int)strlen(s + st[i]);
        s[ed[i]] = '$';
    }
    len = ed[n];
    getsa(len);
    getst(len);
    init();
    for (int p = 1; p <= n; p++) {
        int k = 0;
        LL ans = 0;
        for (int i = st[p]; i < ed[p]; i++, ans += k) {
            for (k -= !!k; k < ed[p] - i && check(rk[i], k + 1); k++);
        }
        printf("%lld ", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3503.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 45

LL a[MAXN], st[MAXN][MAXN];
bool ans[MAXN][MAXN];

int n, m;

void gauss() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int to = i;
        while (to <= m && !((a[to] >> i) & 1)) to++;
        if (to > m) continue;
        swap(a[i], a[to]);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (j != i && ((a[j] >> i) & 1)) a[j] ^= a[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = m; i; i--) {
        if (!((a[i] >> i) & 1)) a[i] |= 1;
        if (a[i] & 1) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) if ((a[j] >> i) & 1) a[j] ^= 1;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) st[1][i] = 1ll << i;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n + 1; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            st[i][j] = st[i - 1][j - 1] ^ st[i - 1][j] ^ st[i - 1][j + 1] ^ st[i - 2][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) a[i] = st[n + 1][i];
    gauss();
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) ans[1][i] = (a[i] & 1);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            ans[i][j] = ans[i - 1][j - 1] ^ ans[i - 1][j] ^ ans[i - 1][j + 1] ^ ans[i - 2][j];
        }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            printf("%d%c", ans[i][j] ? 1 : 0, j == m ? '\n' : ' ');
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3504.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 55
#define MAXB MAXN*MAXN

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
} e[MAXB<<1];

const int source=0,sink=1;

int n,a1,a2,an,b1,b2,bn,ecnt,head[MAXN],cur[MAXN],tag[MAXN];
char temp[MAXN][MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int f) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_2(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=1;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void add_N(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=123;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=123;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    ecnt=1;
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
}

void build() {
    add(0,a1+2,an);
    add(a2+2,1,an);
    add(0,b1+2,bn);
    add(b2+2,1,bn);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<i; j++) {
            if (temp[i][j]=='O') {
                add_2(i+1,j+1);
            } else if (temp[i][j]=='N') {
                add_N(i+1,j+1);
            }
        }
    }
}

queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    q.push(0);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[0]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[1]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==1) return flow;
    int usd=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[x]<tag[e[now].to]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(e[now].flow,flow));
            if (ret) {
                usd+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (usd==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return usd;
}

bool dinic() {
    int ans=0,k=an+bn;
    while (k!=ans && bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=n+1; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ans+=dfs(0,k-ans);
    }
    return ans==k;
}

int main() {
    while (scanf("%d%d%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&a1,&a2,&an,&b1,&b2,&bn)==7 && n) {
        for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
            scanf("%s",temp[i]+1);
        }
        init();
        build();
        if (dinic()) {
            swap(b1,b2);
            init();
            build();
            if (dinic()) puts("Yes");
            else puts("No");
        } else puts("No");
        n=0;
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3514.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define N 200319
#define M N
#define INF N

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2], *top;
    Node *mi;
    int val;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : mi(this), val(INF) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = this;
        if (mi->val > c[0]->mi->val) mi = c[0]->mi;
        if (mi->val > c[1]->mi->val) mi = c[1]->mi;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            swap(c[0], c[1]);
            c[0]->revIt(), c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} mem[N + M], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *E;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    fa = null;
    top = f;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int val = INF) {
    ptr->val = val;
    ptr->mi = ptr;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = ptr->top = null;
    ptr->isrt = 1, ptr->rev = 0;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushTo(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[N + M];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[++top] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top) sta[top--]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushTo(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    for (Node *y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

Node *query(Node *x, Node *y) {
    mkrt(x);
    expose(y);
    splay(y);
    return y;
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *getrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0], x->relax();
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

int n, m, K, type, uu[N], vv[N];
Node *a[N];

int newE(int i) {
    Node *mid = newNode(i);
    if (uu[i] == vv[i]) return i;
    int ret = 0;
    if (getrt(a[uu[i]]) == getrt(a[vv[i]])) {
        Node *mi = query(a[uu[i]], a[vv[i]])->mi;
        ret = mi->val;
        Cut(mi, a[uu[mi - E]]);
        Cut(mi, a[vv[mi - E]]);
    }
    Link(a[uu[i]], mid);
    Link(mid, a[vv[i]]);
    return ret;
}

struct Tnode {
    int l, r, v;
} t[N * 23];

int rt[N], tcnt = 0;

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, v);
        else t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, v);
    }
    return x;
}

int query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!rx) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr > mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    read(type);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    E = ptr - 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(uu[i]);
        read(vv[i]);
        rt[i] = update(rt[i - 1], 0, m, newE(i));
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, l, r; i <= K; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (type) l ^= ans, r ^= ans;
        ans = n - query(rt[l - 1], rt[r], 0, m, 0, l - 1);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 1000319

int n;

vector <int>::iterator vi;

    read(n);
    scanf("%s", ss + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + (ss[i] == 'j' ? -1 : 1);
    top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (top && sum[sta[top]] < sum[i]) ma[sta[top--]] = i;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) ma[sta[top--]] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        while (top && sum[sta[top]] > sum[i]) mi[sta[top--]] = i - 1;
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    while (top) mi[sta[top--]] = n;
    int ans = 0;

        s.insert(0);
        del[mi[0]].push_back(0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        it = s.lower_bound(ma[i]);
        if (it != s.end()) ans = max(ans, i - *it);
        s.insert(i);
        del[mi[i]].push_back(i);
        for (vi = del[i].begin(); vi != del[i].end(); vi++) {
            s.erase(s.find(*vi));
        }

#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 5005

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int n, head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], flag[MAXN];
LL ans = 0, f[4][MAXN];

void dfs(int x, int fl) {
    if (flag[dep[x]] != fl) {
        flag[dep[x]] = fl;
        for (int i = 3; i; i--) f[i][dep[x]] += f[i - 1][dep[x]] * cnt[dep[x]];
        cnt[dep[x]] = 0;
    }
    cnt[dep[x]]++;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to, fl);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i < n; i++) read(x), read(y), add(x, y);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) f[0][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int k = 0;
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) k++;
        if (k < 3) continue;
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) fa[e[now].to] = i, dep[e[now].to] = 0, dfs(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) if (flag[j]) {
                ans += f[3][j] + f[2][j] * cnt[j];
                f[1][j] = f[2][j] = f[3][j] = cnt[j] = flag[j] = 0;
            }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500005
struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN<<5];
int n,m,tcnt=0,rt[MAXN];

int update(int x,int l,int r,int v) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].v++;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (v<=mid) t[now].l=update(t[x].l,l,mid,v);
        else t[now].r=update(t[x].r,mid+1,r,v);
    }
    return now;
}

int kth(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return l;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lv=t[t[rx].l].v-t[t[lx].l].v;
    if (lv>=p) return kth(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return kth(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p-lv);
}
int query(int rx,int lx,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[rx].v-t[lx].v;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[rx].l,t[lx].l,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[rx].r,t[lx].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

    for (int i=1,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        read(l);
        read(r);
        int mid=(r-l+2)>>1,ret=kth(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,n,mid);
        if (query(rt[r],rt[l-1],1,n,ret)>((r-l+1)>>1)) printf("%d\n",ret);
        else puts("0");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3529.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;

#define MAXN 100319

int p[MAXN / 5], pcnt = 0, mu[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int T;
struct query {
    int n, m, a, id;
    bool operator < (query b) const {
        return a < b.a;
    }
} q[20319];

struct Fu {
    int v, id;
    bool operator < (Fu b) const {
        return v < b.v;
    }
} F[MAXN];

unsigned ans[MAXN];

void init() {
    mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] =-mu[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
        F[i].id = i;
        for (int j = i; j < MAXN; j += i)
            F[j].v += i;
    }
    sort(F + 1, F + MAXN);
}

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

unsigned t[MAXN];

unsigned sum(int x) {
    unsigned ret = 0;
    for (int i = x; i; i -= lowbit(i)) ret += t[i];
    return ret;
}

void inc(int x, unsigned v) {
    if (v) for (int i = x; i < MAXN; i += lowbit(i)) t[i] += v;
}

void update(int x, unsigned v) {
    for (int i = 1; i * x < MAXN; i++) inc(i * x, v * mu[i]);
}

unsigned work(int n, int m) {
    unsigned ret = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        ret += (sum(j) - sum(i - 1)) * (n / i) * (m / i);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) read(q[i].n), read(q[i].m), read(q[i].a), q[i].id = i;
    sort(q + 1, q + T + 1);
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; i <= T; i++) {
        while (j < MAXN && F[j].v <= q[i].a) update(F[j].id, F[j].v), j++;
        ans[q[i].id] = work(q[i].n, q[i].m);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) printf("%u\n", ans[i] & 0x7fffffff);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3531.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 100005

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch>'9' || ch<'0') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline int readop() {
    while (ch<'A' || ch>'Z') ch=getchar();
    if (ch=='C') {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch=='C') return 0;
        else return 1;
    } else {
        ch=getchar();
        if (ch=='S') return 2;
        else return 3;
    }
}

const int CW=1,QS=3,QM=4;

struct order {
    int opt,x,y,c,time;
    order() {}
    order(int q,int w,int e,int r,int t):opt(q),x(w),y(e),c(r),time(t) {}
    bool operator < (order a) const {
        if (c!=a.c) return c<a.c;
        else return time<a.time;
    }
} op[MAXN*3];

int ans[MAXN*3];

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,q,ocnt=0;
int col[MAXN],wei[MAXN],head[MAXN],ecnt=0;

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int fa[MAXN],son[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],siz[MAXN],dep[MAXN],top[MAXN],tid[MAXN],dfn=0;

void finds(int x) {
    siz[x]=1;
    maxs[x]=son[x]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            if (siz[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=siz[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            int v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
}

#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
#define s 131072
int tmax[s<<1],tsum[s<<1];

void init() {
    dep[1]=fa[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    memset(ans,-1,sizeof(ans));
}

void update(int x,int v) {
    x+=s;
    tmax[x]=tsum[x]=v;
    for (x>>=1; x; x>>=1) {
        tmax[x]=max(tmax[x<<1],tmax[(x<<1)^1]);
        tsum[x]=tsum[x<<1]+tsum[(x<<1)^1];
    }
}

int query_s(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret+=tsum[l^1];
        if (r&1) ret+=tsum[r^1];
    }
    return ret;
}

int query_m(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    for (l+=s-1,r+=s+1; l^r^1; l>>=1,r>>=1) {
        if ((l&1)^1) ret=max(ret,tmax[l^1]);
        if (r&1) ret=max(ret,tmax[r^1]);
    }
    return ret;
}

int query_sum(int u,int v) {
    int ret=0;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        ret+=query_s(tid[top[u]],tid[u]);
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    ret+=query_s(tid[u],tid[v]);
    return ret;
}

int query_max(int u,int v) {
    int ret=0;
    while (top[u]!=top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]]<dep[top[v]]) swap(u,v);
        ret=max(ret,query_m(tid[top[u]],tid[u]));
        u=fa[top[u]];
    }
    if (dep[u]>dep[v]) swap(u,v);
    ret=max(ret,query_m(tid[u],tid[v]));
    return ret;
}

void work(int st,int ed) {
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (op[i].opt==CW) {
            update(tid[op[i].x],op[i].y);
        } else if (op[i].opt==QS) {
            ans[op[i].time]=query_sum(op[i].x,op[i].y);
        } else {
            ans[op[i].time]=query_max(op[i].x,op[i].y);
        }
    }
    for (int i=st; i<=ed; i++) {
        if (op[i].opt==CW && op[i].y!=0) {
            update(tid[op[i].x],0);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,w,c; i<=n; i++) {
        read(w);
        read(c);
        col[i]=c;
        wei[i]=w;
        ++ocnt;
        op[ocnt]=order(CW,i,w,c,ocnt);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,x,y; i<=q; i++) {
        int opt=readop();
        read(x);
        read(y);
        if (opt==0) {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,0,col[x],ocnt);
            col[x]=y;
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,wei[x],y,ocnt);
        } else if (opt==1) {
            wei[x]=y;
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(CW,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        } else if (opt==2) {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(QS,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        } else {
            ++ocnt;
            op[ocnt]=order(QM,x,y,col[x],ocnt);
        }
    }
    sort(op+1,op+ocnt+1);
    for (int i=1,j; i<=ocnt; i=j) {
        for (j=i+1; j<=ocnt && op[j].c==op[i].c; j++);
        work(i,j-1);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=ocnt; i++) {
        if (ans[i]!=-1) printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 500319

struct Node {
    int u, v, w;
    bool operator < (const Node &a) const {
        return w < a.w;
    }
} e[MAXM];

struct Query {
    int v, x, k, id;
    bool operator < (const Query &a) const {
        return x < a.x;
    }
} q[MAXM];

struct Tnode {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 20];

int n, m, Q, tcnt;
int a[MAXN], f[MAXN], rt[MAXN], ans[MAXM], tmp[MAXN], tot = 0;

int build(int l, int r, int p) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = 1;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[x].l = build(l, mid, p);
        else t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r, p);
    }
    return x;
}

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] > 0) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!y) return x;
    if (!x) return y;
    t[x].v += t[y].v;
    t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return x;
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int k) {
    if (l == r) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[t[x].l].v >= k) return query(t[x].l, l, mid, k);
    else return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, k - t[t[x].l].v);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), tmp[i] = a[i];
    sort(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tmp + 1, tmp + n + 1) - tmp - 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rt[i] = build(1, tot, a[i] = int(lower_bound(tmp + 1, tmp + tot + 1, a[i]) - tmp));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].w);
    }
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].v);
        read(q[i].x);
        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].id = i;
    }
    sort(q + 1, q + Q + 1);

    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    e[m + 1].w = 0x7fffffff;
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; ; i++) {
        for ( ; j <= Q && e[i].w > q[j].x; j++) {
            int fa = getf(q[j].v);
            if (-f[fa] < q[j].k) ans[q[j].id] = -1;
            else {
                ans[q[j].id] = tmp[query(rt[fa], 1, tot, -f[fa] + 1 - q[j].k)];
            }
        }
        if (i > m || j > Q) break;
        int fu = getf(e[i].u), fv = getf(e[i].v);
        if (fu != fv) {
            if (f[fu] > f[fv]) swap(fu, fv);
            f[fu] += f[fv];
            f[fv] = fu;
            rt[fu] = merge(rt[fu], rt[fv]);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) printf("%d\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

int n, m, Q, tcnt;
int a[MAXN], f[MAXN], rt[MAXN], ans[MAXM], tmp[MAXN], tot = 0;

inline int build(int p, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    int ret = tcnt + 1;
    for (t[++tcnt].v = 1; l < r; t[++tcnt].v = 1) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) t[tcnt].l = tcnt + 1, r = mid;
        else t[tcnt].r = tcnt + 1, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

int getf(int x) {
    static int sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (f[x] > 0) sta[++top] = x, x = f[x];
    while (top) f[sta[top--]] = x;
    return x;
}

int merge(int x, int y) {
    if (!y) return x;
    if (!x) return y;
    t[x].v += t[y].v;
    t[x].l = merge(t[x].l, t[y].l);
    t[x].r = merge(t[x].r, t[y].r);
    return x;
}

inline int query(int x, int k, int l = 1, int r = tot) {
    while (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (t[t[x].l].v >= k) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else k -= t[t[x].l].v, x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l;
}

        read(q[i].k);
        q[i].id = i;

    sort(q + 1, q + Q + 1);

    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    e[m + 1].w = 0x7fffffff;
    for (int i = 1, j = 1; ; i++) {
        for ( ; j <= Q && e[i].w > q[j].x; j++) {
            int fa = getf(q[j].v);
            if (-f[fa] < q[j].k) ans[q[j].id] = -1;

int val(char x) {
    switch (x) {
    case '0' ... '9' :
        return x-'0';
        break;
    case 'a' ... 'z' :
        return x-'a'+10;
        break;
    case 'A' ... 'Z' :
        return x-'A'+36;
        break;
    case '_' :
        return 62;
        break;
    case '@' :
        return 63;
        break;
    }
    return -1;
}

void cal(int x) {
    frt[x][0]=0;
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        frt[x][i]=frt[x][i-1]*67+val(s[x][i]);
    }
    bak[x][m+1]=0;
    for (int i=m; i; i--) {
        bak[x][i]=bak[x][i+1]*97+val(s[x][i]);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(ss);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s[i]+1);
        cal(i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            tmp[j]=frt[j][i-1]*23333+bak[j][i+1];
        }
        sort(tmp+1,tmp+n+1);
        int now=1;
        for (int j=2; j<=n; j++) {
            if (tmp[j]==tmp[j-1]) ans+=now,now++;
            else now=1;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
inline void readop(int &_a) {
    while (_c != 'C' && _c != 'W') _c = getchar();
    _a = (_c == 'C');
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 100005
int n, m, q;
LL a[MAXN], su, h[MAXN];
int c[MAXN], p[MAXN];
set <int> s;
set <LL> vis;

void move(int x, int to) {
    h[p[x]] ^= a[x], c[p[x]]--;
    s.insert(p[x]);
    s.insert(to);
    h[p[x] = to] ^= a[x], c[to]++;
}

int work(int l, int r) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (set<int>::iterator it = s.lower_bound(l); it != s.end() && *it <= r; it = s.lower_bound(l)) {
        if (!vis.count(h[*it])) {
            vis.insert(h[*it]);
            ret += c[*it];
        }
        s.erase(it);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(q);
    a[0] = 2000081620000816233llu;
    srand(66666);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = a[i - 1] ^ (rand() * 1234567890123457llu) ^ rand(), su ^= a[i], p[i] = 1;
    c[1] = n;
    h[1] = su;
    s.insert(1);
    vis.insert(0);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r; i <= q; i++) {
        readop(op), read(l), read(r);
        if (op) move(l, r);
        else printf("%d\n", work(l, r));
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 200005

int n,sqn,Q;
int a[MAXN],cnt[MAXN],ans[MAXN],nowans=0;
struct query {
    int l,r,id;
    bool operator < (query q) const {
        if (l/sqn==q.l/sqn) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXN];

void add(int x) {
    if (x>n) return;
    cnt[x]++;
    while (cnt[nowans]) nowans++;
}
void del(int x) {
    if (x>n) return;
    cnt[x]--;
    if (!cnt[x] && nowans>x) nowans=x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    sqn=int(sqrt(n))+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        q[i].id=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+Q+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=Q; i++) {
        while (r<q[i].r) add(a[++r]);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(a[r--]);
        while (l>q[i].l) add(a[--l]);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(a[l++]);
        ans[q[i].id]=nowans;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=Q; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3594.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 10005
#define MAXH 6005
#define MAXK 505
#define lowbit(x) (x&(-x))

int n,k,ans=0;
int a[MAXN];
int t[MAXH][MAXK];

inline int query(int x,int y) {
    int ret=0;
    for (int i=x; i; i-=lowbit(i))
        for (int j=y; j; j-=lowbit(j))
            ret=max(t[i][j],ret);
    return ret;
}

inline void update(int x,int y,int v) {
    for (int i=x; i<=MAXH; i+=lowbit(i))
        for (int j=y; j<=MAXK; j+=lowbit(j))
            t[i][j]=max(t[i][j],v);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=k; j!=-1; j--) {
            int now=query(a[i]+j,j+1)+1;
            ans=max(ans,now);
            update(a[i]+j,j+1,now);
        }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
