int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int cnt[128];

int n, m;

char a[5678], b[5678];

int main() {
    scanf("%s%s", a + 1, b + 1);
    n = (int) strlen(a + 1), m = (int) strlen(b + 1);
    int need = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        cnt[b[i]]++;
        if (cnt[b[i]] == 1) need++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cnt[a[i]]--;
        if (cnt[a[i]] == 0) need--;
    }
    int ma = 0;
    for (int i = n; i > m; i--) ma = max((int)a[i], ma);
    for (int i = m; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (need == 0 && ma > b[i + 1]) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) putchar(b[j]);
            for (int j = 0; j < 128; j++) if (cnt[j] < 0 && j > b[i + 1]) {
                    putchar(j), cnt[j]++;
                    break;
                }
            for (int j = 0; j < 128; j++) while (cnt[j] < 0) putchar(j), cnt[j]++;
            putchar('\n');
            return 0;
        }
        ma = max((int)a[i], ma);
        cnt[b[i]]--;
        if (cnt[b[i]] == 0) need--;
    }
    puts("-1");
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3809.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005
#define MAXM 1000005

int n,sqn,m;
int a[MAXN],ans[MAXM],cnt[MAXN],blo[MAXN],bloans[MAXN],L[MAXN],R[MAXN];

struct qury {
    int l,r,a,b,x;
    bool operator < (qury q) const {
        if (blo[l]==blo[q.l]) return r<q.r;
        else return l<q.l;
    }
} q[MAXM];

inline int query(int l,int r) {
    int ret=0;
    if (blo[r]-blo[l]<2) {
        for (int i=l; i<=r; i++) {
            if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        }
    } else {
        int x=R[blo[l]];
        for (int i=l; i<=x; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
        x=blo[r];
        for (int i=blo[l]+1; i<x; i++) ret+=bloans[i];
        for (int i=L[x]; i<=r; i++) if (cnt[i]) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline void update(int x) {
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]++;
    cnt[a[x]]++;
}

inline void del(int x) {
    cnt[a[x]]--;
    if (!cnt[a[x]]) bloans[blo[a[x]]]--;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    sqn=(int)sqrt(n)+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        blo[i]=(i-1)/sqn+1;
        if (!L[blo[i]]) L[blo[i]]=i;
        R[blo[i]]=i;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        read(q[i].l);
        read(q[i].r);
        read(q[i].a);
        read(q[i].b);
        q[i].x=i;
    }
    sort(q+1,q+m+1);
    for (int i=1,l=1,r=0; i<=m; i++) {
        while (l>q[i].l) update(--l);
        while (l<q[i].l) del(l++);
        while (r>q[i].r) del(r--);
        while (r<q[i].r) update(++r);
        ans[q[i].x]=query(q[i].a,q[i].b);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        printf("%d\n",ans[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3834.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

int N;
int a, b, c, d;

int main() {
    read(N);
    while (N--) {
        int ans = 1;
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        a--, c--;
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(b, d); i++) {
            int A = a / i, B = b / i, C = c / i, D = d / i;
            j = min(b, d);
            if (A) j = min(j, a / A);
            if (B) j = min(j, b / B);
            if (C) j = min(j, c / C);
            if (D) j = min(j, d / D);
            i = j;
            if (A < B && C < D) ans = i;
        }
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3850.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

struct Pro {
    int t, k;
    bool operator < (Pro a) const {
        return a.t * k > a.k * t;
    }
} a[100005];

int n;
LL ans = 0;

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i].t);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i].k);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, t = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += a[i].k * LL(t += a[i].t);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3874.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

struct Food {
    LL p, s;
    bool operator < (const Food &a) const {
        return p != a.p ? p < a.p : s > a.s;
    }
} a[222];

LL m, f;
int n, tot;

LL get(LL t) {
    if (t < 1 || t * f > m) return 0;
    LL d = 0, mo = m - t * f, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(a[i].s - d + 1, mo / a[i].p / t);
            ans += ti * t;
            d += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * t * ti;
        }
        if (a[i].s >= d) {
            LL ti = min(t, mo / a[i].p);
            d++;
            ans += ti;
            mo -= a[i].p * ti;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

LL HC() {
    LL x = (m + 1) / (2 * (f + a[1].p)), ans = get(x), ret;
    for (D y = x; y > 1; y *= 0.91) {
        if ((ret = get(x + LL(y))) > ans) x += LL(y), ans = ret;
        else if ((ret = get(x - LL(y))) > ans) x -= LL(y), ans = ret;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(f);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i].p);
        read(a[i].s);
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    tot = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) if (a[i].s > a[tot].s) a[++tot] = a[i];
    cout << HC() << endl;
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 200319

    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 5];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

int n;
LL dis[MAXN], S[MAXN], K[MAXN], last[MAXN], mak[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];

int q[TOP + 1], he = 0, ta = 0;
void push(int x) {
    q[(ta++) & TOP] = x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, Ri, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(S[i]);
        read(K[i]);
        read(Ri);
        for (int j = 1; j <= Ri; j++) {
            read(x);
            add(x, i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dis[i] = K[i];
        last[i] = dis[i];
        for (int now = head[i]; now; now = e[now].next) mak[e[now].to] += dis[i];
        push(i);
        inq[i] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dis[i] = min(dis[i], mak[i] += S[i]);
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++ & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        LL delta = last[x] - dis[x];
        last[x] = dis[x];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            mak[e[now].to] -= delta;
            if (dis[e[now].to] > mak[e[now].to]) {
                dis[e[now].to] = mak[e[now].to];
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    push(e[now].to);
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", dis[1]);
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

int ch = 0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 3005
#define MAXK 55
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
struct edge {
    int to, next, w, flow;
} e[MAXN * MAXK];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1, dis[MAXN], pre[MAXN], pos[MAXN];
bool inq[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v, int w, int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].w = w;
    e[ecnt].flow = flow;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].w = -w;
    e[ecnt].flow = 0;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, S = 0, T;
queue<int> q;

int spfa() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(dis));
    dis[S] = 0;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = x;
                pos[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[T] < INF;
}

int mcmf() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) flow = min(flow, e[pos[x]].flow);
        ret += flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = pre[x]) e[pos[x]].flow -= flow, e[pos[x]^1].flow += flow;
    }
    return ret;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        for (int j = 1, v, w; j <= x; j++) {
            read(v);
            read(w);
            add(S, v, w, 1);
            add(i, v, w, INF);
        }
        if (x) add(i, T, 0, x);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) add(i, 1, 0, INF);
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n", mcmf());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3884.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define N 10000005

bool vis[N];
int p[N / 7], pcnt = 0;
int phi[N];

void init() {
    phi[1] = 1;
    for (register int i = 2, j, k; i < N; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, phi[i] = i - 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= pcnt && (k = i * p[j]) < N; j++) {
            vis[k] = 1;
            if (i % p[j]) phi[k] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1);
            else {
                phi[k] = phi[i] * p[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

int T;
int sta[233];

inline int power(LL x, int y, int MOD) {
    LL ret = 1 % MOD;
    for (x %= MOD; y; y >>= 1, x = x * x % MOD) {
        if (y & 1) ret = ret * x % MOD;
    }
    return (int)ret;
}

void work() {
    int x, top;
    scanf("%d", &x);
    sta[top = 1] = x;
    while (x != 1) {
        x = phi[x];
        sta[++top] = x;
    }
    sta[top + 1] = 1;
    int ret = 1;
    while (top) {
        ret = power(2, ret % sta[top + 1] + sta[top + 1], sta[top]), top--;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    init();
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 80005

    int next,to,flow;

int S=0,T=1,head[MAXN],tg[MAXN],cur[MAXN],ecnt=1;
int n,m,tot=0,tcnt=1,tag[105][105];
inline void add(int u,int v,int flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

void init() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            tag[i][j]=++tcnt;

            tot+=a;

        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            add(tag[i][j],T,a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(S,p,a);
            add(p,tag[i][j],a);
            if (i>1) add(p,tag[i-1][j],a);
            if (j>1) add(p,tag[i][j-1],a);
            if (i<n) add(p,tag[i+1][j],a);
            if (j<m) add(p,tag[i][j+1],a);
        }
    for (int i=1,a; i<=n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=m; j++) {
            read(a);
            tot+=a;
            int p=++tcnt;
            add(p,T,a);
            add(tag[i][j],p,a);
            if (i>1) add(tag[i-1][j],p,a);
            if (j>1) add(tag[i][j-1],p,a);
            if (i<n) add(tag[i+1][j],p,a);
            if (j<m) add(tag[i][j+1],p,a);
        }
}
queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    q.push(S);
    memset(tg,0,sizeof(tg));
    tg[S]=1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tg[e[now].to]) {
                tg[e[now].to]=tg[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tg[T]>0;
}

int dfs(int x,int flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    int used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tg[e[now].to]>tg[x]) {
            int ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=0; i<=tcnt; i++) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,0x3fffffff);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    init();
    printf("%d\n",tot-dinic());
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3924.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 19

struct E {
    int v, w, rt;
    E() {}
    E(int a, int b) : v(a), w(b) {}
};

vector<E> G[MAXN];

int sz[MAXN], f[MAXN], l[MAXN];
LL d[MAXN][LOG], sd[MAXN], sf[MAXN], c[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

int gs(int u, int fa) {
    sz[u] = 1;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) {
            sz[u] += gs(v, u);
        }
    }
    return sz[u];
}

int grt(int u, int fa, int hs) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa && sz[v] > hs) return grt(v, u, hs);
    }
    return u;
}

void gdis(int u, int fa, int ly) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (!vis[v] && v != fa) d[v][ly] = d[u][ly] + G[u][i].w, gdis(v, u, ly);
    }
}

int dcomp(int u, int ly) {
    int rt = grt(u, 0, gs(u, 0) / 2);
    vis[rt] = 1;
    gdis(rt, 0, l[rt] = ly);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[rt].size(); i++) {
        if (!vis[G[rt][i].v]) {
            f[G[rt][i].rt = dcomp(G[rt][i].v, ly + 1)] = rt;
        }
    }
    return rt;
}

void update(int u, int w) {
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        sd[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa]], sf[fa] += w * d[u][l[fa] - 1], c[fa] += w;
    }
}

LL calc(int u) {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int fa = u; fa; fa = f[fa]) {
        ans += sd[fa] - sf[fa] + c[fa] * (d[u][l[fa]] - d[u][l[fa] - 1]);
    }
    return ans;
}

int n, Q, rt;

LL solve(int u) {
    LL ans = calc(u);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
        int v = G[u][i].v;
        if (l[v] > l[u] && calc(v) < ans) return solve(G[u][i].rt);
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &Q);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v, w;
        scanf("%d%d%d", &u, &v, &w);
        G[u].push_back(E(v, w));
        G[v].push_back(E(u, w));
    }
    rt = dcomp(1, 1);
    for (int u, w; Q--; ) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &w);
        update(u, w);
        printf("%lld\n", solve(rt));
    }
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXN 200005
typedef long long LL;
struct opt_ {
    int x,v;
    bool operator < (opt_ a) const {
        return x<a.x;
    }
} op[MAXN*2];

struct node {
    int l,r,cnt;
    LL v;
} t[MAXN<<6];

int m,n,opcnt=0,tcnt=0,pp[MAXN],tem[MAXN],rt[MAXN],ntem;

int find(int x) {
    int l=1,r=ntem,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (tem[mid]>=x) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    return l;
}

int inc_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt++;
    t[now].v+=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=inc_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=inc_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
int dec_(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now]=t[x];
    t[now].cnt--;
    t[now].v-=tem[p];
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (p<=mid) t[now].l=dec_(t[x].l,l,mid,p);
        else t[now].r=dec_(t[x].r,mid+1,r,p);
    }
    return now;
}
LL query(int x,int l,int r,int k) {
    if (l==r) {
        return (LL)k*tem[l];
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1,lcnt=t[t[x].l].cnt;
    if (lcnt>=k) {
        return query(t[x].l,l,mid,k);
    } else {
        return t[t[x].l].v+query(t[x].r,mid+1,r,k-lcnt);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(m);
    read(n);
    for (int i=1,s,e; i<=m; i++) {
        read(s);
        read(e);
        read(pp[i]);
        tem[i]=pp[i];
        op[++opcnt].x=s;
        op[++opcnt].x=e+1;
    }
    sort(tem+1,tem+m+1);
    ntem=int(unique(tem+1,tem+m+1)-tem-1);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        op[i*2-1].v=op[i*2].v=find(pp[i]);
        op[i*2].v=-op[i*2].v;
    }
    sort(op+1,op+opcnt+1);
    rt[0]=0;
    for (int i=1,j=1; i<=n; i++) {
        int rr=rt[i-1];
        while (j<=opcnt && op[j].x==i) {
            if (op[j].v>0) rr=inc_(rr,1,ntem,op[j].v);
            else rr=dec_(rr,1,ntem,-op[j].v);
            j++;
        }
        rt[i]=rr;
    }
    LL pre=1;
    for (int i=1,x,a,b,c,k; i<=n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        k=int(1+(a*pre+b)%c);
        if (k<=t[rt[x]].cnt) pre=query(rt[x],1,ntem,k);
        else pre=t[rt[x]].v;
        printf("%lld\n",pre);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 500319

int q[MAXN];

void build() {
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) t[0][i] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int &to = t[x][i], j = fail[x];
            if (!to) to = t[j][i];
            else {
                while (!t[j][i]) j = fail[j];
                fail[to] = t[j][i];
                vis[to] += vis[t[j][i]];
                q[ta++] = to;
            }
        }
    }

}

int sta[MAXN];
int top = 0;
char p[MAXN];

int n;

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) insert();
    build();
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1), x = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        sta[++top] = x = t[x][s[i] - 'a'];
        p[top] = s[i];
        for (int j = vis[sta[top]]; j; j--) top--;
        x = sta[top];
    }
    p[top + 1] = 0;
    puts(p + 1);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

#define M 10000319

LL phi[M];
int p[M / 10], pcnt = 0, mu[M];

void init() {
    phi[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < M; i++) {
        if (!phi[i]) phi[i] = i - 1, mu[i] = -1, p[++pcnt] = i;
        for (int j = 1; i * p[j] < M; j++) {
            if (i % p[j])
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * (p[j] - 1), mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
            else {
                phi[i * p[j]] = phi[i] * p[j], mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        phi[i] += phi[i - 1], mu[i] += mu[i - 1];
    }
}

bool vis[233];
int exmu[233];
LL exphi[233];
int n;

void solve(unsigned x);
LL Phi(int x);
int Mu(int x);

LL Phi(int x) {
    if (x < M) return phi[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exphi[y];
    }
}

int Mu(int x) {
    if (x < M) return mu[x];
    else {
        int y = n / x;
        if (!vis[y]) solve(x);
        return exmu[y];
    }
}

void solve(unsigned x) {
    if (x < M) return;
    int y = n / x;
    if (vis[y]) return;
    vis[y] = 1;
    exmu[y] = 1;
    exphi[y] = (LL(x + 1) * x) >> 1;
    for (unsigned i = 2, j; i <= x; i = j) {
        j = x / (x / i) + 1;
        exphi[y] -= Phi(x / i) * (j - i);
        exmu[y] -= Mu(x / i) * (j - i);
    }
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    if (n < M) printf("%lld %d\n", phi[n], mu[n]);
    else {
        memset(vis + 1, 0, sizeof(bool) * (n / M));
        solve(n);
        printf("%lld %d\n", exphi[1], exmu[1]);
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3991.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
// alias BZOJ3991
typedef long long LL;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MAXN 100005

struct edge {
    int next,to,w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,m,head[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dis[MAXN],ans=0;
bool visit[MAXN];
void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

int dfsid[MAXN],dfn=0,bfsid[MAXN],q[MAXN],fa[MAXN],he=1,ta=1;
int bb[MAXN*2][19],fir[MAXN],bt=0;
void bfs() {
    q[ta++]=1;
    dis[1]=0;
    fa[1]=0;
    while (he<ta) {
        int x=q[he++];
        bfsid[x]=he-1;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                fa[e[now].to]=x;
                q[ta++]=e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    dfsid[x]=++dfn;
    bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
    fir[x]=bt;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x]) {
            dfs(e[now].to);
            bb[++bt][0]=bfsid[x];
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k=1; 1<<k <=bt; k++) {
        int x=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,tt=bt-(1<<k)+1; i<=tt; i++) {
            bb[i][k]=min(bb[i][k-1],bb[i+x][k-1]);
        }
    }
}

int log_2(int x) {
    int ret=0;
    if (x&0xffff0000) x>>=16,ret+=16;
    if (x&0x0000ff00) x>>=8,ret+=8;
    if (x&0x000000f0) x>>=4,ret+=4;
    if (x&0x0000000c) x>>=2,ret+=2;
    return ret+(x>>1);
}

int getLCA(int u,int v) {
    u=fir[u],v=fir[v];
    if (u>v) swap(u,v);
    int len=v-u+1,ll=log_2(len);
    return q[min(bb[u][ll],bb[v-(1<<ll)+1][ll])];
}

struct statu {
    int x,id;
    statu() {}
    statu(int w):id(w) {}
    statu(int y,int w):x(y),id(w) {}
    bool operator < (statu a) const {
        return id<a.id;
    }
};
set<statu> s;
set<statu>::iterator it;
int Left(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.begin()) it=s.end();
    return (*--it).x;
}
int Right(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(statu(x));
    if (it==s.end()) it=s.begin();
    return (*it).x;
}
void inc(int x) {
    if (!s.empty()) {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans+=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
    s.insert(statu(x,dfsid[x]));
}

void dec(int x) {
    it=s.lower_bound(dfsid[x]);
    s.erase(it);
    if (s.empty()) {
        ans=0;
    } else {
        int l=Left(dfsid[x]),r=Right(dfsid[x]);
        int lx=getLCA(l,x),xr=getLCA(r,x),lr=getLCA(l,r);
        ans-=(dis[x]-dis[lx]*2)+(dis[x]-dis[xr]*2)+dis[lr]*2;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1,u,v,w; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u,v,w);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=m; i++) {
        read(x);
        if (visit[x]^=1) inc(x);
        else dec(x);
        printf("%lld\n",ans);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3993.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void read(bool &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 105
#define INF 123456789123456ll
struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL flow;
} e[MAXN*MAXN*8];

int n,m,S=0,T=1,ecnt=1;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN],head[MAXN*2],tag[MAXN*2],cur[MAXN*2];
bool map[MAXN][MAXN];
LL sum=0;

void add(int u,int v,LL flow) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].flow=flow;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

#define robot(x) (x+1)
#define weapon(x) (x+n+1)

queue <int> q;

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag,0,sizeof(tag));
    tag[S]=1;
    q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to]=tag[x]+1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return tag[T]>0;
}

LL dfs(int x,LL flow) {
    if (x==T) return flow;
    LL used=0;
    for (int &now=cur[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].flow && tag[e[now].to]>tag[x]) {
            LL ret=dfs(e[now].to,min(flow-used,e[now].flow));
            if (ret) {
                used+=ret;
                e[now].flow-=ret;
                e[now^1].flow+=ret;
                if (used==flow) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return used;
}

LL dinic() {
    LL ret=0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i=weapon(m); i>-1; i--) cur[i]=head[i];
        ret+=dfs(S,INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

bool check(LL mid) {
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    ecnt=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        add(S,robot(i),a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        add(weapon(i),T,b[i]*mid);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (map[i][j]) add(robot(j),weapon(i),INF);
        }
    }
    return dinic()==sum;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) read(a[i]),a[i]*=2000,sum+=a[i];
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++) read(b[i]);
    for (int i=1; i<=m; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<=n; j++) {
            read(map[i][j]);
        }
    LL l=0,r=200000000001ll,mid;
    while (l<r) {
        mid=(l+r)>>1;
        if (check(mid)) r=mid;
        else l=mid+1;
    }
    double ans=double(mid)/2000.0+0.00025;
    printf("%.5lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ3994.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 50319

int T, p[MAXN], pcnt = 0, sum[MAXN], mu[MAXN];
long long F[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void init() {
    for (int x = 1; x < MAXN; x++) {
        for (int i = 1, j; i <= x; i = j) {
            j = x / (x / i) + 1;
            F[x] += (long long)(j - i) * (long long)(x / i);
        }
    }
    sum[1] = mu[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) p[++pcnt] = i, mu[i] = -1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pcnt && i * p[j] < MAXN; j++) {
            vis[i * p[j]] = 1;
            if (i % p[j] == 0) {
                mu[i * p[j]] = 0;
                break;
            } else mu[i * p[j]] = -mu[i];
        }
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + mu[i];
    }
}

void work() {
    int n, m;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= min(n, m); i = j + 1) {
        j = min(n / (n / i), m / (m / i));
        ans += (sum[j] - sum[i - 1]) * F[n / i] * F[m / i];
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;

int ch = 0;

    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 500319

char s[MAXN];

int n, T, K;

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];
int Min[20][MAXN], Log[MAXN];
void getsa() {
    int m = 26;
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, m);
    for (int j = 1, k = 0, i; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, k = x[sa[1]] = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Min[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (int i = 1, d = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (d << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            Min[k][i] = min(Min[k - 1][i], Min[k - 1][i + d]);
        }
    }
}

void work1() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j; i <= n; i++) {
        for (j = h[i] + 1; j <= h[i + 1]; j++) {
            int x = i, mi = h[i + 1];
            for (int k = Log[n - i + 1]; ~k; k--) if (Min[k][x + 1] >= j) mi = min(mi, Min[k][x + 1]), x += 1 << k;
            int d = x - i + 1, cnt = mi - j + 1;
            if (K - tot - 1 <= (LL)cnt * d) {
                j += (K - tot - 1) / d;
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) putchar(s[sa[i] + l]);
                putchar('\n');
                return;
            }
            tot += d * cnt;
            j = mi;
        }
        int dev = n - sa[i] - j + 2;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

void work0() {
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int dev = n - sa[i] - h[i] + 1;
        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + h[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    read(T);
    read(K);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    getsa();
    if (T) work1();
    else work0();
    return 0;
}

    int fir, sec, nxt;

    sta[0] = -1;

        int r = i;
        while (sta[top] >= h[i]) {
            r = min(r, p[top]);
            if (sta[top] > h[i]) a[++acnt] = (Node) {sta[top], i - p[top], head[p[top]]}, head[p[top]] = acnt;
            top--;
        }
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = r;
    }
    while (top && sta[top] > 0) {
        a[++acnt] = (Node) {sta[top], n + 1 - p[top], head[p[top]]}, head[p[top]] = acnt;
        top--;

        for (int now = head[i + 1]; now; now = a[now].nxt) {

            j += cnt;

        if (tot + dev >= K) {
            int d = int(K - tot + j - 1);
            for (j = 0; j < d; j++) putchar(s[sa[i] + j]);
            putchar('\n');
            return;
        }
        tot += dev;
    }
    puts("-1");
}

//BZOJ3999.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 50005
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Tag {
    int mi, ma, lv, rv;
    Tag () {
        mi = INF, ma = -INF, lv = 0, rv = 0;
    }
    Tag (int a, int b, int c, int d) : mi(a), ma(b), lv(c), rv(d) {}
    inline friend Tag operator + (const Tag &a, const Tag &b) {
        //	printf("+ %d %d %d %d\n", min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
        return Tag(min(a.mi, b.mi), max(a.ma, b.ma), max(b.ma - a.mi, max(a.lv, b.lv)),max(a.ma - b.mi, max(a.rv, b.rv)));
    }
    inline void operator += (int v) {
        mi += v, ma += v;
    }
    inline Tag rev() {
        //	printf("rev!\n");
        return Tag(mi, ma, rv, lv);
    }
};

struct Node {
    int l, r, lz;
    Tag v;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;
int n, Q;
int a[MAXN], rev[MAXN], tid[MAXN], fa[MAXN], dep[MAXN], son[MAXN], siz[MAXN], top[MAXN], stp;

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else {
        t[x].v = Tag(a[rev[l]], a[rev[l]], 0, 0);
    }
    return x;
}

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
//	cerr << x << endl;
    siz[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            fa[e[now].to] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
            siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
            if (siz[e[now].to] > siz[son[x]]) son[x] = e[now].to;
        }
    }
}

void Link(int x, int anc) {
    tid[x] = ++stp;
    rev[stp] = x;
    top[x] = anc;
//	printf("%d : %d\n", x, stp);
    if (son[x]) {
        Link(son[x], anc);
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) Link(e[now].to, e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

#define pd(x) {t[t[x].l].lz += t[x].lz; t[t[x].l].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].v += t[x].lz; t[t[x].r].lz += t[x].lz; t[x].lz = 0;}

Tag query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int v) {
//	if (x == 0) *((int*)NULL) = 1;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].lz += v;
        t[x].v += v;
//		printf("[ret] %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
        return t[x].v;
    }
    if (t[x].lz) pd(x);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Tag ret;
    if (qr <= mid) ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, qr, v);
    else if (ql > mid) ret = query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, ql, qr, v);
    else ret = query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, mid, v) + query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr, v);
    t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
//	printf("[   ]%d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", l, r, t[x].v.mi, t[x].v.ma, t[x].v.lv, t[x].v.rv);
//	printf(" ret %d %d : %d %d %d %d\n", ql, qr, ret.mi, ret.ma, ret.lv, ret.rv);
    return ret;
}

int solve(int u, int v, int w) {
    Tag lp, rp;
    while (top[u] != top[v]) {
        if (dep[top[u]] > dep[top[v]]) {
            lp = lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[top[u]], tid[u], w).rev();
            u = fa[top[u]];
        } else {
            rp = query(1, 1, n, tid[top[v]], tid[v], w) + rp;
            v = fa[top[v]];
        }
    }
    if (tid[u] < tid[v]) {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[u], tid[v], w) + rp).lv;
    } else {
        return (lp + query(1, 1, n, tid[v], tid[u], w).rev() + rp).lv;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int u, v;
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    Link(1, 1);
    build(1, n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        printf("%d\n", solve(u, v, w));
    }

    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4012.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 400319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v, tot;
} t[MAXN * 23];

int tcnt = 0;
LL val[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].tot = t[t[x].l].tot + t[t[x].r].tot;
    } else t[x].tot = val[l];
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
//	printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += t[x].tot;
        t[x].lazy++;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr >  mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v + t[x].tot * t[x].lazy;
    }
//	printf("after update %d ~ %d %lld\n", l, r, t[x].v);
    return x;
}

LL query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int lv, int rv) {
//	printf("%d ~ %d %d ~ %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	printf("%lld %lld %d %d %lld\n", t[rx].v, t[lx].v, (rv + t[rx].lazy), (lv + t[lx].lazy), t[rx].tot);
        return t[rx].v - t[lx].v + rv * t[rx].tot - lv * t[lx].tot;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    return ret;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int ecnt = 0, head[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, Q, A;
pair<int, int> a[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], top[MAXN], maxs[MAXN], siz[MAXN], son[MAXN], tag[MAXN];

void tree_update(int x, int &rt) {
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        rt = update(rt, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x]);
//		printf("%d ~ %d\n", top[x], x);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    rt = update(rt, 1, n, 1, tag[x]);
//	printf("%d ~ %d\n", 1, x);
}

LL tree_query(int x, int lx, int rx) {
    LL ret = 0;
    while (top[x] != 1) {
        ret += query(lx, rx, 1, n, tag[top[x]], tag[x], 0, 0);
        x = fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ret + query(lx, rx, 1, n, 1, tag[x], 0, 0);
}

LL sum[MAXN], dis[MAXN];
int rt[MAXN];

void init() {
    static int q[MAXN], he = 0, ta = 0;
    dis[1] = fa[1] = dep[1] = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    int x;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
                fa[e[now].to] = x;
                dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    while (ta) {
        x = q[--ta];
        siz[x]++;
        siz[fa[x]] += siz[x];
        if (maxs[fa[x]] < siz[x]) {
            maxs[fa[x]] = siz[x];
            son[fa[x]] = x;
        }
    }
    tag[1] = top[1] = 1;
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[he++];
        if (son[x]) {
            tag[son[x]] = tag[x] + 1;
            top[son[x]] = top[x];
            q[ta++] = son[x];
            int tot = tag[x] + maxs[x];
            for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                if (e[now].to != fa[x] && e[now].to != son[x]) {
                    tag[e[now].to] = tot + 1;
                    top[e[now].to] = e[now].to;
                    tot += siz[e[now].to];
                    q[ta++] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        val[tag[i]] = dis[i] - dis[fa[i]];
    }
    rt[0] = build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        //	printf("%d : %d %lld\n", i, a[i].second, dis[a[i].second]);
        rt[i] = rt[i - 1];
        tree_update(a[i].second, rt[i]);
        sum[i] = sum[i - 1] + dis[a[i].second];
        //	printf("%lld\n", t[rt[i]].v);
    }
}

int find(LL x) {
    int l = 1, r = n + 1, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[mid].first > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] = make_pair(x, i);
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        read(w);
        add(u, v, w);
    }
    init();
    LL ans = 0, l, r;
    for (int i = 1, u; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        l = (l + ans) % A, r = (r + ans) % A;
        if (l > r) swap(l, r);
        int L = find(l - 1), R = find(r);
        //printf("L = %d R = %d\n", L, R);
        if (L >= R) printf("%lld\n", ans = 0);
        else {
            //	printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", sum[R], sum[L], dis[u]);
            //	printf("%lld\n", tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]));
            ans = sum[R] - sum[L] + dis[u] * (R - L) - tree_query(u, rt[L], rt[R]) * 2;
            printf("%lld\n", ans);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 200319
typedef long long LL;

struct Node {
    int l, r, lazy;
    LL v, tot;
} t[MAXN * 44];

int tcnt = 0;
LL val[MAXN];

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].tot = t[t[x].l].tot + t[t[x].r].tot;
    } else t[x].tot = val[l];
    return x;
}

int update(int pre, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
//	printf("%d %d %d %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        t[x].v += t[x].tot;
        t[x].lazy++;
    } else {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (ql <= mid) t[x].l = update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
        if (qr >  mid) t[x].r = update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v + t[x].tot * t[x].lazy;
    }
//	printf("after update %d ~ %d %lld\n", l, r, t[x].v);
    return x;
}

LL query(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int lv, int rv) {
//	printf("%d ~ %d %d ~ %d\n", l, r, ql, qr);
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        //	printf("%lld %lld %d %d %lld\n", t[rx].v, t[lx].v, (rv + t[rx].lazy), (lv + t[lx].lazy), t[rx].tot);
        return t[rx].v - t[lx].v + rv * t[rx].tot - lv * t[lx].tot;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    LL ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, lv + t[lx].lazy, rv + t[rx].lazy);
    return ret;
}

//BZOJ4012.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define MAXN 200319
#define LOG	18

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

bool vis[MAXN];
int q[MAXN], Fa[MAXN], siz[MAXN], he, ta;

int getrt(int u) {
    he = ta = 0;
    q[ta++] = u;
    Fa[u] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        siz[x] = 1;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && Fa[x] != e[now].to) {
                Fa[e[now].to] = x;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = ta - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int x = q[i];
        if (siz[x] * 2 >= ta) return x;
        siz[Fa[x]] += siz[x];
    }
    return u;
}

int n, Q, A, a[MAXN];
int fa[MAXN][LOG], fae[MAXN * 2][LOG];
int fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], est[MAXN * 2], eed[MAXN * 2];
LL ftot[MAXN], etot[MAXN];
int depth[MAXN];
LL dis[MAXN][LOG];
pair<int, LL> fl[MAXN * LOG], el[MAXN * LOG * 2];
int fcnt = 0, Ecnt = 0;

bool cmp(const pair<int, LL> &u, const pair<int, LL> &v) {
    return a[u.first] < a[v.first];
}

void solve(int u, int dep) {
    u = getrt(u);
    vis[u] = 1;
    depth[u] = dep;
    fa[u][dep] = u;
    fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(u, 0ll);
    fst[u] = fcnt;
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            he = ta = 0;
            q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            Fa[e[now].to] = u;
            dis[e[now].to][dep] = e[now].w;
            est[now] = Ecnt + 1;
            while (he < ta) {
                int x = q[he++];
                fae[x][dep] = now;
                fa[x][dep] = u;
                fl[++fcnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                el[++Ecnt] = make_pair(x, dis[x][dep]);
                for (int i = head[x]; i; i = e[i].next) {
                    if (!vis[e[i].to] && e[i].to != Fa[x]) {
                        dis[e[i].to][dep] = dis[x][dep] + e[i].w;
                        Fa[e[i].to] = x;
                        q[ta++] = e[i].to;
                    }
                }
            }
            eed[now] = Ecnt;
            sort(el + est[now], el + eed[now] + 1, cmp);
        }
    }
    fed[u] = fcnt;
    sort(fl + fst[u], fl + fed[u] + 1, cmp);
    for (int now = head[u]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to, dep + 1);
    }
}

int find(pair<int, LL> li[], int l, int r, int x) {
    int mid;
    r++;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (a[li[mid].first] > x) r = mid;
        else l = mid + 1;
    }
    return l - 1;
}

LL get(pair<int, LL> li[], int st, int ed, int L, int R, LL d) {
    int l = find(li, st, ed, L), r = find(li, st, ed, R);
    return li[r].second - li[l].second + d * (r - l);
}

LL work(int x, int L, int R) {
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = depth[x]; i >= 0; i--) {
        int p = fa[x][i];
        ret += get(fl, fst[p], fed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
        if ((p = fae[x][i]))
            ret -= get(el, est[p], eed[p], L, R, dis[x][i]);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    read(A);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), add(u, v, w);
    solve(1, 0);
    for (int i = 2; i <= fcnt; i++) fl[i].second += fl[i - 1].second;
    for (int i = 2; i <= Ecnt; i++) el[i].second += el[i - 1].second;
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, u, L, R; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(L);
        read(R);
        L = int((L + ans) % A);
        R = int((R + ans) % A);
        if (L > R) swap(L, R);
        L--;
        printf("%lld\n", ans = work(u, L, R));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4016.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define MAXN 30019
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)

struct edge {
    int next, to, w;
} Graph[MAXN * 4], Tree[MAXN * 2], *e = Graph;

int Ghead[MAXN], Thead[MAXN], *head = Ghead, gcnt = 0, ecnt = 1;

void G_add(int u, int v, int w) {
    Graph[++gcnt] = (edge) {
        Ghead[u], v, w
    };
    Ghead[u] = gcnt;
    Graph[++gcnt] = (edge) {
        Ghead[v], u, w
    };
    Ghead[v] = gcnt;
}

void T_add(int u, int v, int w) {
    Tree[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        Thead[u], v, w
    };
    Thead[u] = ecnt;
    Tree[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        Thead[v], u, w
    };
    Thead[v] = ecnt;
}

int dis[MAXN], siz[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void ds(int x) {
    siz[x] = 1;
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) if (!vis[e[now].to]) ds(e[now].to), siz[x] += siz[e[now].to];
    vis[x] = 0;
}

int getrt(int x) {
    ds(x);
    for (int rt = x; ; ) {
        bool flag = 1;
        for (int now = head[rt]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && siz[e[now].to] < siz[rt] && siz[e[now].to] * 2 > siz[x]) {
                flag = 0, rt = e[now].to;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (flag) return rt;
    }
}

#define T 32767
int q[T + 1];
priority_queue < int, vector<int>, greater<int> > pq;
void init() {
    int he = 0, ta = 0, x, now;
    q[ta++] = 1;
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof dis);
    dis[1] = 0;
    while (he < ta) {
        x = q[(he++) & T];
        vis[x] = 0;
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
                    vis[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(ta++) & T] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    pq.push(1);
    vis[1] = 1;
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        x = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        for (now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (!vis[e[now].to] && dis[e[now].to] == dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                vis[e[now].to] = 1;
                T_add(x, e[now].to, e[now].w);
                pq.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    e = Tree, head = Thead;
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof vis);
}

pii fl[MAXN * 18], el[MAXN * 18];
int Fcnt = 0, Ecnt = 0;
int fst[MAXN], fed[MAXN], est[MAXN], eed[MAXN];

void dd(int x, int dep) {
    fl[++Fcnt] = make_pair(dep, dis[x]);
    el[++Ecnt] = make_pair(dep, dis[x]);
    vis[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w, dd(e[now].to, dep + 1);
    }
    vis[x] = 0;
}

void solve(int x) {
    x = getrt(x);
    vis[x] = 1;
    fst[x] = ++Fcnt;
    dis[x] = 0;
    fl[Fcnt] = make_pair(0, 0);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) {
            est[now >> 1] = Ecnt + 1;
            dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
            dd(e[now].to, 1);
            eed[now >> 1] = Ecnt;
            sort(el + est[now >> 1], el + eed[now >> 1] + 1);
        }
    }
    fed[x] = Fcnt;
    sort(fl + fst[x], fl + fed[x] + 1);
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!vis[e[now].to]) solve(e[now].to);
    }
}

int n, m, K;

int mid;

LL get(pii a[], int l, int r) {
    LL ret = 0;
    //for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) cerr << "(" << a[i].first << ", " << a[i].second << ") ";
    while (l <= r) {
        while (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first < K) l++;
        while (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first > K) r--;
        if (l <= r && a[l].first + a[r].first == K) {
            if (a[l].first != a[r].first) {
                int i = l, j = r;
                while (i <= r && a[i].first == a[l].first) {
                    while (j >= l && a[j].first == a[r].first && a[i].second + a[j].second >= mid) j--;
                    ret += r - j;
                    i++;
                }
                while (i <= r && l <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first) j--;
                l = i, r = j;
            } else {
                int i = l, j = r;
                while (i <= r && a[i].first == a[l].first) {
                    while (i <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first && a[i].second + a[j].second >= mid) j--;
                    ret += r - max(i, j);
                    i++;
                }
                while (i <= r && l <= j && a[j].first == a[r].first) j--;
                l = i, r = j;
            }
        }
    }
    //cerr << "RET " << ret << endl;
    return ret;
}

LL check() {
    LL ret = 0;
    //cerr << "pos" << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) ret += get(fl, fst[i], fed[i]);
    //cerr << "neg" << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) ret -= get(el, est[i], eed[i]);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    //freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    K--;
    for (int i = 1, u, v, w; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), read(w), G_add(u, v, w);
    init();
    solve(1);
    int l = 0, r = 300000000;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check() > 0) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    mid = l;
    printf("%d %lld\n", l, check());
    return 0;
}

        else r = mid - 1;

//BZOJ4025.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 100319
#define MAXM 200319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *mi;
    int val, siz;
    bool isrt, rev;
    Node () : mi(this), val(INF), siz(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        ch->fa = this;
        c[p] = ch;
    }
    bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    void upd() {
        mi = this;
        if (c[0]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[0]->mi;
        if (c[1]->mi->val < mi->val) mi = c[1]->mi;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
    void revIt() {
        rev ^= 1;
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN + MAXM], *ptr = mem;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = INF) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->mi = ptr;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->siz = ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
        fa->isrt = 0;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN + MAXM];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

void Link(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    u->top = v;
}

void Cut(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(u);
    u->setc(null, 1);
    u->upd();
    v->setrt(null);
}

Node *query(Node *u, Node *v) {
    mkrt(u);
    expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return v;
}

Node *getf(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    while (x->c[0] != null) x = x->c[0];
    splay(x);
    return x;
}

Node *a[MAXN];
pair <int, int> E[MAXN + MAXM];
bool del[MAXN + MAXM];

Node *newE(int u, int v, int w) {
    Node *mid = newNode(w);
    Link(a[u], mid);
    Link(a[v], mid);
    E[mid - mem] = make_pair(u, v);
    return mid;
}

int cnt = 0;

void delE(Node *mid) {
    if (mid == null) return;
    if (del[mid - mem]) cnt--;
    else {
        del[mid - mem] = 1;
        int u = E[mid - mem].first, v = E[mid - mem].second;
        Cut(mid, a[u]);
        Cut(mid, a[v]);
    }
}

Node *add(int u, int v, int w) {
    if (getf(a[u]) == getf(a[v])) {
        Node *x = query(a[u], a[v]);
        if (~((x->siz + 1) >> 1) & 1) return null;
        else {
            cnt++;
            if (x->mi->val < w) {
                delE(x->mi);
                return newE(u, v, w);
            } else {
                del[0] = 1;
                return mem;
            }
        }
    } else return newE(u, v, w);
}

struct edge {
    int u, v, s, t;
    bool operator < (edge b) const {
        return s < b.s;
    }
} e[MAXM];

vector <Node*> b[MAXN];

int n, m, T;

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(T);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        read(e[i].u);
        read(e[i].v);
        read(e[i].s);
        read(e[i].t);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[i] = newNode();
    sort(e + 1, e + m + 1);
    for (int i = 0, j = 1; i < T; i++) {
        while (j <= m && e[j].s == i) {
            b[e[j].t].push_back(add(e[j].u, e[j].v, e[j].t));
            j++;
        }
        for (int k = (int)b[i].size() - 1; k > -1; k--) delE(b[i][k]);
        if (cnt) puts("No");
        else puts("Yes");
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4033.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 2005

typedef long long LL;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
    LL w;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int n,k,head[MAXN],siz[MAXN],ecnt=0;
LL dp[MAXN][MAXN],temp[MAXN];

void add(int u,int v,int w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x,int fa) {
    siz[x]=1;
    dp[x][0]=dp[x][1]=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        int v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa) {
            dfs(v,x);
            int topx=min(siz[x],k),topv=min(siz[v],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=k; i++) temp[i]=dp[x][i];
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<=topv && i+j<=k; j++) {
                    temp[i+j]=max(temp[i+j],dp[x][i]+dp[v][j]+e[now].w*(j*(k-j)+(siz[v]-j)*(n-k-siz[v]+j)));
                }
            siz[x]+=siz[v];
            topx=min(siz[x],k);
            for (int i=0; i<=topx; i++) dp[x][i]=temp[i];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&k);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int u,v,w;
        scanf("%d%d%d",&u,&v,&w);
        add(u,v,w);
        add(v,u,w);
    }
    dfs(1,0);
    printf("%lld\n",dp[1][k]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4034.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXN 100005
#define s 131072
using namespace std;

struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN<<1];

int ch=0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f=0;
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch=='-') f=1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') a=(a<<3)+(a<<1)+ch-'0',ch=getchar();
    if (f) a=-a;
}

int n,m,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],a[MAXN];
int top[MAXN],dep[MAXN],ss[MAXN],maxs[MAXN],son[MAXN],fa[MAXN],tid[MAXN],sub[MAXN],S[s<<1],L[s<<1],R[s<<1];

long long t[s<<1],lazy[s<<1];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void finds(int x) {
    ss[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
        v=e[now].to;
        if (v!=fa[x]) {
            fa[v]=x;
            dep[v]=dep[x]+1;
            finds(v);
            ss[x]+=ss[v];
            if (ss[v]>maxs[x]) {
                maxs[x]=ss[v];
                son[x]=v;
            }
        }
    }
}

void link(int x,int anc) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    top[x]=anc;
    if (son[x]) {
        link(son[x],anc);
        for (int now=head[x],v; now; now=e[now].next) {
            v=e[now].to;
            if (v!=fa[x] && v!=son[x]) {
                link(v,v);
            }
        }
    }
    sub[x]=dfn;
}

inline void init() {
    fa[1]=0;
    dep[1]=1;
    finds(1);
    link(1,1);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        t[s+tid[i]]=a[i];
        L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
        S[s+i]=1;
    }
    for (int i=n+1; i<s; i++) L[s+i]=R[s+i]=i;
    for (int i=s-1; i>0; i--) {
        t[i]=t[i<<1]+t[(i<<1)^1];
        L[i]=L[i<<1];
        R[i]=R[(i<<1)^1];
        S[i]=S[i<<1]<<1;
    }
}

inline void pushdown(int x) {
    if (!lazy[x] || x>=s) return;
    long long delta=lazy[x]*S[x<<1];
    t[x<<1]+=delta,lazy[x<<1]+=lazy[x];
    t[(x<<1)^1]+=delta,lazy[(x<<1)^1]+=lazy[x];
    lazy[x]=0;
}

void update(int x,int l,int r,int d) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r) {
        t[x]+=(long long)d*S[x];
        lazy[x]=d;
        return;
    }
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    if (l<=mid) update(x<<1,l,min(mid,r),d);
    if (r>mid) update((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r,d);
    t[x]=t[x<<1]+t[(x<<1)^1];
}

long long query(int x,int l,int r) {
    pushdown(x);
    if (L[x]==l && R[x]==r)
        return t[x];
    int mid=(L[x]+R[x])>>1;
    long long ans=0;
    if (l<=mid) ans+=query(x<<1,l,min(mid,r));
    if (r>mid) ans+=query((x<<1)^1,max(l,mid+1),r);
    return ans;
}

inline long long q(int x) {
    long long ans=0;
    while (top[x]!=1) {
        ans+=query(1,tid[top[x]],tid[x]);
        x=fa[top[x]];
    }
    return ans+query(1,1,tid[x]);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
        add(v,u);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,op,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        read(op);
        read(x);
        if (op==1) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],tid[x],y);
        } else if (op==2) {
            read(y);
            update(1,tid[x],sub[x],y);
        } else if (op==3) {
            printf("%lld\n",q(x));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4066.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

inline void Max(int &a, int b) {
    if (a < b) a = b;
}
inline void Min(int &a, int b) {
    if (a > b) a = b;
}

#define MAXN 300005

struct Node {
    Node *l, *r;
    int siz, sum, val;
    int d[2], ma[2], mi[2];
    inline void upd() {
        ma[0] = mi[0] = d[0];
        ma[1] = mi[1] = d[1];
        siz = 1, sum = val;
        if (l) {
            Max(ma[0], l->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], l->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], l->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], l->mi[1]);
            siz += l->siz, sum += l->sum;
        }
        if (r) {
            Max(ma[0], r->ma[0]);
            Max(ma[1], r->ma[1]);
            Min(mi[0], r->mi[0]);
            Min(mi[1], r->mi[1]);
            siz += r->siz, sum += r->sum;
        }
    }
} mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem, *rt;

bool D;

inline bool cmp(const Node* a, const Node* b) {
    return a->d[D] < b->d[D];
}

int Q[2], A;

Node *newNode() {
    ptr->d[0] = Q[0];
    ptr->d[1] = Q[1];
    ptr->val = A;
    ptr->l = ptr->r = 0;
    ptr->upd();
    return ptr++;
}

Node *insert(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return newNode();
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = insert(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) x->val += A;
    else x->r = insert(x->r, !d);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int tot;
Node *tmp[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, bool d) {
    if (l > r) return 0;
    int mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(tmp + l, tmp + mid, tmp + r + 1, cmp);
    tmp[mid]->l = build(l, mid - 1, !d);
    tmp[mid]->r = build(mid + 1, r, !d);
    tmp[mid]->upd();
    return tmp[mid];
}

void dfs(Node *x) {
    if (x->l) dfs(x->l);
    tmp[++tot] = x;
    if (x->r) dfs(x->r);
}

Node *chk(Node *x, int d) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (max(x->l ? x->l->siz : 0, x->r ? x->r->siz : 0) * 5 > x->siz * 4) {
        tot = 0;
        dfs(x);
        return build(1, tot, d);
    }
    if (x->d[d] > Q[d]) x->l = chk(x->l, !d);
    else if (x->d[0] == Q[0] && x->d[1] == Q[1]) return x;
    else x->r = chk(x->r, !d);
    return x;
}

bool in(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1<=X1&&X2<=x2&&y1<=Y1&&Y2<=y2;
}
bool out(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2,int X1,int Y1,int X2,int Y2) {
    return x1>X2||x2<X1||y1>Y2||y2<Y1;
}

int query(Node *k,int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2) {
    if(!k)return 0;
    int ret=0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return k->sum;
    if(out(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->mi[0],k->mi[1],k->ma[0],k->ma[1])) return 0;
    if(in(x1,y1,x2,y2,k->d[0],k->d[1],k->d[0],k->d[1])) ret += k->val;
    ret += query(k->l,x1,y1,x2,y2) + query(k->r,x1,y1,x2,y2);
    return ret;
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int op, x, y, z, w; ; ) {
        read(op);
        if (op == 3) break;
        if (op == 1) {
            read(Q[0]);
            read(Q[1]);
            read(A);
            Q[0] ^= ans, Q[1] ^= ans, A ^= ans;
            rt = insert(rt, 0);
            rt = chk(rt, 0);
        } else {
            read(w);
            read(y);
            read(x);
            read(z);
            w ^= ans, x ^= ans, y ^= ans, z ^= ans;
            ans = query(rt, w, y, x, z);
            printf("%d\n", ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>

int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
}

#define MAXM 300005
#define TOP 30
struct Node {
    int c[2], v;
    int &operator [] (int x) {
        return c[x];
    }
} t[MAXM * 32];

int n, m, Q, tcnt = 0;
int a[1005], b[MAXM], rt[MAXM];

void insert(int x, int v) {
    int now = tcnt;
    t[now] = t[x];
    for (int i = TOP; i > -1; i--) {
        int p = (v>>i)&1;
        t[now][p] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][p], now = tcnt;
        t[now] = t[x], t[now].v++;
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) rt[i] = ++tcnt, insert(rt[i-1], b[i]);
}

#define siz(lx, rx, p) (t[t[rx][p]].v - t[t[lx][p]].v)

int lx[1005], rx[1005];

int query(int u, int d, int l, int r, int k) {
    int ls = 0, to, ans;
    for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) lx[i] = rt[l - 1], rx[i] = rt[r], ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], (a[i] >> TOP)&1);
    if (ls < k) k -= ls, ans = to = 1;
    else ans = to = 0;
    for (int q = TOP; q > 0; q--) {
        ls = 0;
        for (int i = u; i <= d; i++) {
            int p = (a[i]>>q)&1;
            lx[i] = t[lx[i]][p^to];
            rx[i] = t[rx[i]][p^to];
            p = (a[i]>>(q - 1))&1;
            ls += siz(lx[i], rx[i], p);
        }
        if (ls < k) k -= ls, to = 1;
        else to = 0;
        ans = (ans << 1) ^ to;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    init();
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, d, l, r, k; i <= Q; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(d);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n", query(u, d, l, r, (r - l + 1) * (d - u + 1) - k + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef unsigned long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 70
#define P 19260817
#define Q 20000816
map<LL, int> vis;
int n, p, m;
struct Mat {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int *operator [] (int x) {
        return a[x];
    }
    void operator *= (Mat &b) {
        static Mat c;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                c[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    c[i][j] = (c[i][j] + a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        *this = c;
    }
} a, b, tmp;

LL Hash(Mat &x) {
    LL ret = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            ret = (ret * P + x[i][j]) ^ Q;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(p);
    m = int(sqrt(p)) + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(a[i][j]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) read(b[i][j]);
    tmp = b;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) tmp *= a, vis[Hash(tmp)] = i;
    tmp = a;
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) tmp *= a;
    a = tmp;
    for (int i = 1; ; i++) {
        int x = vis[Hash(tmp)];
        if (x) {
            printf("%d\n", i * m - x);
            return 0;
        }
        tmp *= a;
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

#define N 105
#define M 16
#define T 65536
#define INF LL(1e18)
int n, m, t;
int d[N], c[N][M];
LL dp[T], f[T];

void work(int x) {
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) f[i] = dp[i];
    for (int i = m - 1; i > -1; i--) {
        int k = 1 << i;
        for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) f[j | k] = min(f[j | k], f[j] + c[x][i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = min(dp[i], f[i] + d[x]);
}

int main() {

    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(d[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) read(c[i][j]);
    }
    t = 1 << m;
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < t; i++) dp[i] = INF;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) work(i);
    printf("%lld\n", dp[t - 1]);
    return 0;
}
