int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;

LL n, m, k;
int P;

#define lowbit(x) (x & -x)

inline int LOG(LL x) {
    int ret = 0;
    if (x >> 32) x >>= 32, ret |= 32;
    if (x >> 16) x >>= 16, ret |= 16;
    if (x >> 8) x >>= 8, ret |= 8;
    if (x >> 4) x >>= 4, ret |= 4;
    if (x >> 2) x >>= 2, ret |= 2;
    return ret + int(x >> 1);
}

LL fuck(LL base, int i, int j) {
    base = (base >> max(i, j)) << max(i, j);
    LL st = base, ed = st + (1ll << max(i, j)) - 1;
    if (ed <= k) return 0;
    else {
        st = max(st, k + 1);
        st -= k, ed -= k;
        if ((st ^ ed) & 1) {
            return (((((st + ed) % P) * (((ed - st + 1) / 2) % P)) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
        } else return (((((st + ed) / 2) % P) * ((ed - st + 1) % P) % P) * ((1ll << min(i, j)) % P)) % P;
    }
}

void work() {
    LL ans = 0;
    for (LL i = n; i;) {
        int bi = LOG(lowbit(i));
        i ^= lowbit(i);
        for (LL j = m; j; ) {
            int bj = LOG(lowbit(j));
            j ^= lowbit(j);
            ans = (ans + fuck(i ^ j, bi, bj)) % P;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    int T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        read(k);
        read(P);
        work();
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4514.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define MAXN 205
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f
typedef long long ll;

struct edge {
    int next,to,flow;
    ll w;
} e[MAXN*MAXN];

int n,src=0,sink,ecnt=1;
int a[MAXN],b[MAXN],c[MAXN],num[MAXN],head[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int f,long long w) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    e[ecnt].w=w;
    e[ecnt].flow=f;
    head[u]=ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to=u;
    e[ecnt].next=head[v];
    e[ecnt].w=-w;
    e[ecnt].flow=0;
    head[v]=ecnt;
}

inline int solve(int x) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int i=2,t=(int)sqrt(x); i<=t; i++) {
        if (!(x%i)) {
            while (!(x%i)) {
                ans++;
                x/=i;
            }
            t=(int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    if (x!=1) ans++;
    return ans;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        num[i]=solve(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",b+i);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) scanf("%d",c+i);
}

inline void build() {
    sink=n+1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (num[i]&1) {
            add(i,sink,b[i],0);
        } else {
            add(src,i,b[i],0);
        }
    }
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        bool odd=num[i]&1;
        for (int j=i+1; j<=n; j++) {
            if (num[i]-num[j]==1 && a[i]%a[j]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            } else if (num[j]-num[i]==1 && a[j]%a[i]==0) {
                if (odd) {
                    add(j,i,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                } else {
                    add(i,j,INF,(ll)-c[i]*c[j]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool inq[MAXN];
long long dis[MAXN];
int pre[MAXN],pos[MAXN];
queue <int> q;

inline bool spfa() {
    q.push(src);
    memset(dis,31,sizeof(dis));
    memset(pre,-1,sizeof(pre));
    dis[src]=0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[x]=0;
        for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].flow && dis[e[now].to]>dis[x]+e[now].w) {
                pre[e[now].to]=x;
                pos[e[now].to]=now;
                dis[e[now].to]=dis[x]+e[now].w;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to]=1;
                    q.push(e[now].to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (pre[sink]==-1) return 0;
    else return 1;
}

inline void work() {
    long long val=0;
    int ans=0,flow;
    while (spfa()) {
        flow=INF;
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            flow=min(flow,e[pos[now]].flow);
        }
        if (dis[sink]>0) {
            if (-val/dis[sink]<flow)
                flow=int(-val/dis[sink]);
        }
        if (flow==0) break;
        if (flow<0) {
            while (1) puts("FUCK");
        }
        for (int now=sink; now!=0; now=pre[now]) {
            e[pos[now]].flow-=flow;
            e[pos[now]^1].flow+=flow;
        }
        val+=flow*dis[sink];
        ans+=flow;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    build();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 10000000
typedef long long LL;

int T,n,m;
int fac[MAXN+5],invfac[MAXN+5],dp[MAXN+5];

int quickpower(long long a,int x) {
    long long ret=1;
    while (x) {
        if (x&1) ret=(ret*a)%MOD;
        a=(a*a)%MOD;
        x>>=1;
    }
    return int(ret);
}

int inv(int x) {
    return quickpower(LL(x),MOD-2);
}

void init() {
    fac[0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MAXN; i++) fac[i]=int((LL(fac[i-1])*i)%MOD);
    invfac[MAXN]=inv(fac[MAXN]);
    for (int i=MAXN-1; i>-1; i--) invfac[i]=int((LL(invfac[i+1])*(i+1))%MOD);
    dp[0]=1,dp[1]=0;
    for (int i=2; i<=MAXN; i++) {
        dp[i]=int((1-((i&1)<<1)+dp[i-1]*LL(i)+MOD)%MOD);
    }
}

    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(m);
        printf("%d\n",int((((((LL(fac[n])*invfac[n-m])%MOD)*invfac[m])%MOD)*dp[n-m])%MOD));
    }

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;
#define MAXN 3005

int n, m;
LL L, d[MAXN], f[2][MAXN];

LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}
LD slope(int i, int j, int k) {
    return LD(f[i][j] + 2 * L * d[j] + m * power(d[j]) - f[i][k] - 2 * L * d[k] - m * power(d[k])) / (d[j] - d[k]);
}

struct monoQueue {
    int v[MAXN], l, r;
    void clear() {
        v[0] = l = r = 0;
    }
    void maintain(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[l], v[l + 1]) <= 2 * m * d[i]) l++;
    }
    void insert(int k, int i) {
        while (l < r && slope(k, v[r], i) <= slope(k, v[r - 1], v[r])) r--;
        v[++r] = i;
    }
    int front() {
        return v[l];
    }
} q[2];

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, ai; i <= n; i++) read(ai), d[i] = d[i - 1] + ai;
    L = d[n];
    for (int k = 1; k <= m; k++) {
        int now = k & 1, pre = now ^ 1;
        q[now].clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            q[pre].maintain(pre, i);
            int j = q[pre].front();
            f[now][i] = f[pre][j] + m * power(d[i] - d[j]) - 2 * L * (d[i] - d[j]);
            q[now].insert(now, i);
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", f[m & 1][n] + power(L));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4519.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f
#define MAXN 900
#define MAXM 9000

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXM * 2 * 2];

int n, m, S, T;
int head[MAXN], cur[MAXN], tag[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 1
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int q[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    tag[S] = 1;
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

inline int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            int ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f));
            if (ret) {
                left -= ret;
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int G[MAXN][MAXN];
int a[MAXN], tmp[MAXN], W[MAXM];
set <int> s;
void solve(int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) return;
    S = a[l], T = a[r];
    for (int i = 2; i <= ecnt; i++) e[i].f = W[i >> 1];
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    s.insert(ret);
    int i = l, j = r;
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++)
        if (tag[a[k]]) tmp[i++] = a[k];
        else tmp[j--] = a[k];
    for (int k = l; k <= r; k++) a[k] = tmp[k];
    solve(l, i - 1);
    solve(j + 1, r);
}

int main() {
    read(n);

//BZOJ4520.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

#define read(x) x = 0; while (ch < '0') ch = getchar(); while (ch >= '0') x = x * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar()
#define power(x) (LL(x) * LL(x))
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define rint register int
#define rll register LL
typedef long long LL;

#define Max(a, b) (a < b && (a = b))
#define Min(a, b) (a > b && (a = b))

#define MAXN 100319

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int x[2], ma[2], mi[2], l, r;
} t[MAXN];

int D;
bool operator < (const Node a, const Node b) {
    return a.x[D] < b.x[D] || (a.x[D] == b.x[D] && a.x[!D] < b.x[!D]);
}

inline void upd(rint x) {
    rint l = t[x].l, r = t[x].r;
    if (l) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[l].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[l].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[l].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[l].mi[1]);
    }
    if (r) {
        Max(t[x].ma[0], t[r].ma[0]);
        Max(t[x].ma[1], t[r].ma[1]);
        Min(t[x].mi[0], t[r].mi[0]);
        Min(t[x].mi[1], t[r].mi[1]);
    }
}

int build(int l, int r, int d) {
    int x = (l + r) >> 1;
    D = d;
    nth_element(t + l, t + x, t + r + 1);
    t[x].ma[0] = t[x].mi[0] = t[x].x[0];
    t[x].ma[1] = t[x].mi[1] = t[x].x[1];
    if (l < x) t[x].l = build(l, x - 1, !d);
    if (r > x) t[x].r = build(x + 1, r, !d);
    upd(x);
    return x;
}

int Q[2];

int n, K, rt;

LL g(int x) {
    return x ? max(power(t[x].ma[0] - Q[0]), power(t[x].mi[0] - Q[0])) + max(power(t[x].ma[1] - Q[1]), power(t[x].mi[1] - Q[1])) : 0;
}

LL h[543];
int top;

void poppush(rll v) {
    rint x, p;
    h[1] = h[top];
    h[top] = INF;
    x = 1;
    while (x < top) {
        p = x, x <<= 1;
        x ^= (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]);
        if (h[p] > h[x]) swap(h[p], h[x]);
        else break;
    }
    h[top] = v;
    x = top;
    while (x > 1) {
        p = x ^ (h[x] > h[x ^ 1]), x >>= 1;
        if (h[x] > h[p]) swap(h[x], h[p]);
        else break;
    }
}

void query(int x) {
    if (!x) return;
    LL dis = power(t[x].x[0] - Q[0]) + power(t[x].x[1] - Q[1]);
    if (dis > h[1]) poppush(dis);
    LL D1 = g(t[x].l), D2 = g(t[x].r);
    if (D1 > D2) {
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
    } else {
        if (D2 >= h[1]) query(t[x].r);
        if (D1 >= h[1]) query(t[x].l);
    }
}

int main() {
    register int ch = 0, i;
    read(n);
    read(K);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(t[i].x[0]);
        read(t[i].x[1]);
    }
    memset(h, 0x3f, sizeof h);
    for (i = 1; i <= 2 * K; i++) h[i] = 0;
    top = 2 * K;
    rt = build(1, n, 0);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        Q[0] = t[i].x[0], Q[1] = t[i].x[1];
        query(rt);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", h[1]);
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

LL f[11][2][2][10][3];

int tmp[12];

LL dfs(int x, bool _4, bool _8, int last, int dep, bool lim) {
    if (_4 && _8) return 0;
    if (!~x) return dep == 3;
    if (!lim && ~f[x][_4][_8][last][dep]) return f[x][_4][_8][last][dep];
    LL ret = 0;
    int top = lim ? tmp[x] : 9;
    for (int i = x == 10; i <= top; i++) {
        if (~dep) {
            if (dep == 3) ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, 3, lim && i == top);
            else ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, i == last ? dep + 1 : 1, lim && i == top);
        } else ret += dfs(x - 1, _4 || i == 4, _8 || i == 8, i, 1, lim && i == top);
    }
    if (!lim) f[x][_4][_8][last][dep] = ret;
    return ret;
}

LL solve(LL x) {
    if (x < 10000000000ll) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        tmp[i] = int(x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
    return dfs(10, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1);
}

int main() {
    memset(f, -1, sizeof f);
    LL L, R;
    read(L);
    read(R);
    printf("%lld\n", solve(R) - solve(L - 1));
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4524.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

typedef long long LL;

bool vis[128];
int p[33], mp[33], pcnt = 0;
LL power[33][66];
LL n;
int K;

void init() {
    for (int i = 2; i < 128; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            p[++pcnt] = i;
            power[pcnt][0] = 1;
            for (LL j = 1, k = n / i; power[pcnt][j - 1] <= k; power[pcnt][j] = power[pcnt][j - 1] * i, mp[pcnt]++, j++);
            for (int j = i * i; j < 128; j += i) vis[j] = 1;
        }
    }
}

LL mid;
int tot;

void dfs(LL val, int dep, int num) {
    if (tot >= K) return;
    if (!dep) {
        if (val >= mid) tot++;
        return;
    }
    if (val * power[num][dep] < mid) return;
    for (int i = num; i; i--) dfs(val * p[i], dep - 1, i);
    if (val >= mid) tot++;
}

bool check() {
    tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
        if (mp[i]) dfs(p[i], mp[i] - 1, i);
        if (tot >= K) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    init();
    LL l = 2, r = n;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check()) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", l);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4540.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    bool _f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0', _c = getchar();
    if (_f) _a = -_a;
}
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 17
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

int blo[MAXN], sqn, Log[MAXN];

struct Query {
    int l, r, x;
    bool operator < (const Query &a) const {
        if (blo[l] != blo[a.l]) return l < a.l;
        else return r < a.r;
    }
} q[MAXN];

int n, Q, a[MAXN], st[MAXN][LOG];
LL pre[MAXN], suf[MAXN], ans[MAXN], tot = 0;

inline int cmp(int x, int y) {
    return a[x] != a[y] ? (a[x] < a[y] ? x : y) : (x > y ? x : y);
}
inline int rmq(int l, int r) {
    return cmp(st[l][Log[r - l + 1]], st[r - (1 << Log[r - l + 1]) + 1][Log[r - l + 1]]);
}

int sta[MAXN], top;

void build() {
    sqn = (int)sqrt(n) + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) blo[i] = i / sqn;
    Log[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i][0] = i;
    for (int k = 1; k < LOG; k++) {
        int x = 1 << (k - 1);
        for (int i = 1, j = n - (1 << k) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[i][k] = cmp(st[i][k - 1], st[i + x][k - 1]);
        }
    }
    a[0] = a[n + 1] = -INF;
    pre[sta[0] = 0] = 0, top = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (a[i] < a[sta[top]]) top--;
        pre[i] = pre[sta[top]] + a[i] * LL(i - sta[top]);
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
    suf[sta[0] = n + 1] = 0, top = 0;
    for (int i = n; i; i--) {
        while (a[i] < a[sta[top]]) top--;
        suf[i] = suf[sta[top]] + a[i] * LL(sta[top] - i);
        sta[++top] = i;
    }
}

LL getl(int l, int r) {
    int p = rmq(l, r);
    return suf[l] - suf[p] + LL(r - p + 1) * a[p];
}

LL getr(int l, int r) {
    int p = rmq(l, r);
    return pre[r] - pre[p] + LL(p - l + 1) * a[p];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) read(q[i].l), read(q[i].r), q[i].x = i;
    build();
    sort(q + 1, q + Q + 1);
    for (int i = 1, l = 1, r = 0; i <= Q; i++) {
        while (l > q[i].l) tot += getl(--l, r);
        while (r < q[i].r) tot += getr(l, ++r);
        while (l < q[i].l) tot -= getl(l++, r);
        while (r > q[i].r) tot -= getr(l, r--);
        ans[q[i].x] = tot;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= Q; i++) printf("%lld\n", ans[i]);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4546.cpp
/* Never Say Die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double LD;

#define MAXN 500319
#define LOG 18

struct Node {
    int c[2], v;
} t[MAXN * (LOG + 2)];

int Q, n, tcnt = 0;
int rt[MAXN];

int insert(int pre, int dep, int v) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    t[x] = t[pre];
    t[x].v++;
    if (~dep) {
        t[x].c[(v >> dep) & 1] = insert(t[x].c[(v >> dep) & 1], dep - 1, v);
    }
    return x;
}

int Query_xor(int lx, int rx, int v) {
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = LOG; ~i; i--) {
        int to = (~v >> i) & 1;
        if (t[t[rx].c[to]].v - t[t[lx].c[to]].v) {
            ans |= 1 << i;
            lx = t[lx].c[to], rx = t[rx].c[to];
        } else {
            lx = t[lx].c[!to], rx = t[rx].c[!to];
        }
    }
    return ans ^ v;
}

int Query_les(int lx, int rx, int v) {
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = LOG; ~i; i--) {
        int p = (v >> i) & 1;
        if (p) ans += t[t[rx].c[0]].v - t[t[lx].c[0]].v;
        lx = t[lx].c[p], rx = t[rx].c[p];
    }
    ans += t[rx].v - t[lx].v;
    return ans;
}

int Query_kth(int lx, int rx, int k) {
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = LOG; ~i; i--) {
        int ls = t[t[rx].c[0]].v - t[t[lx].c[0]].v;
        if (ls < k) {
            k -= ls;
            lx = t[lx].c[1], rx = t[rx].c[1];
            ans |= 1 << i;
        } else lx = t[lx].c[0], rx = t[rx].c[0];
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    scanf("%d", &Q);
    for (int i = 1, op, l, r, x; i <= Q; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &op);
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            scanf("%d", &x);
            n++;
            rt[n] = insert(rt[n - 1], LOG, x);
            break;
        case 2 :
            scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &r, &x);
            printf("%d\n", Query_xor(rt[l - 1], rt[r], x));
            break;
        case 3 :
            scanf("%d", &x);
            n -= x;
            break;
        case 4 :
            scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &r, &x);
            printf("%d\n", Query_les(rt[l - 1], rt[r], x));
            break;
        case 5 :
            scanf("%d%d%d", &l, &r, &x);
            printf("%d\n", Query_kth(rt[l - 1], rt[r], x));
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4551.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
int ch=0;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline bool readop() {
    while (ch!='Q' && ch!='C') ch=getchar();
    return ch=='Q';
}

#define MAXN 100005
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];
int n,q,ecnt=0,dfn=0,head[MAXN],fa[MAXN][19],dep[MAXN],tid[MAXN],st[MAXN],ed[MAXN];
inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    tid[x]=++dfn;
    st[x]=dfn;
    for (int k=1; k<=18; k++) {
        fa[x][k]=fa[fa[x][k-1]][k-1];
    }
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to!=fa[x][0]) {
            fa[e[now].to][0]=x;
            dep[e[now].to]=dep[x]+1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
    ed[x]=dfn;
}

#define s 131072
struct node {
    int v,lch,rch,lazy;
} t[s<<1];
int tcnt=0;
int build(int l,int r) {
    int now=++tcnt;
    t[now].v=1,t[now].lazy=0;
    if (l!=r) {
        int mid=(l+r)>>1;
        t[now].lch=build(l,mid);
        t[now].rch=build(mid+1,r);
    }
    return now;
}

void pushdown(int x) {
    int cc=t[x].lch;
    if (t[cc].v<t[x].lazy) {
        t[cc].v=t[x].lazy;
        t[cc].lazy=t[x].lazy;
    }
    cc=t[x].rch;
    if (t[cc].v<t[x].lazy) {
        t[cc].v=t[x].lazy;
        t[cc].lazy=t[x].lazy;
    }
    t[x].lazy=0;
}
void update(int x,int l,int r,int ql,int qr,int v) {
    if (t[x].v>=v) return;
    if (l==ql && r==qr) {
        t[x].v=v;
        t[x].lazy=v;
        return;
    }
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) update(t[x].lch,l,mid,ql,min(mid,qr),v);
    if (qr>mid) update(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,max(mid+1,ql),qr,v);
    t[x].v=min(t[t[x].lch].v,t[t[x].rch].v);
}

int query(int x,int l,int r,int p) {
    if (l==r) return t[x].v;
    if (t[x].lazy) pushdown(x);
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) return query(t[x].lch,l,mid,p);
    else return query(t[x].rch,mid+1,r,p);
}

void init() {
    dep[1]=1;
    fa[1][0]=1;
    dfs(1);
    build(1,n);
}

int jumpto(int x,int de) {
    for (int k=18; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((de>>k)&1) x=fa[x][k];
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i=1,u,v; i<n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u,v);
    }
    init();
    for (int i=1,x; i<=q; i++) {
        if (readop()) {
            read(x);
            int dd=query(1,1,n,tid[x]);
            printf("%d\n",jumpto(x,dep[x]-dd));
        } else {
            read(x);
            update(1,1,n,st[x],ed[x],dep[x]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4551.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

inline void readop(int &a) {
    while (_c < 'C' || _c > 'Q') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *top, *c[2], *ma;
    int val;
    bool rev, isrt;
    Node () : ma(this), val(0) {}
    void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    void revIt() {
        swap(c[0], c[1]);
        rev ^= 1;
    }
    void relax() {
        if (rev) {
            c[0]->revIt();
            c[1]->revIt();
            rev = 0;
        }
    }
    void upd() {
        ma = this;
        if (c[0]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[0]->ma;
        if (c[1]->ma->val > ma->val) ma = c[1]->ma;
    }
    void setrt(Node *f);
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr = mem + 1;

void Node::setrt(Node *f) {
    top = f;
    fa = null;
    isrt = 1;
}

Node *newNode(int v = 0) {
    ptr->val = v;
    ptr->rev = 0;
    ptr->isrt = 1;
    ptr->fa = ptr->top = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    ptr->ma = ptr;
    return ptr++;
}

void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa->isrt) {
        fa->isrt = 0;
        x->isrt = 1;
        x->top = fa->top;
    }
}

void pushto(Node *x) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN];
    int top = 0;
    while (x != null) sta[top++] = x, x = x->fa;
    while (top--) sta[top]->relax();
}

void splay(Node *x) {
    pushto(x);
    while (x->fa != null) {
        if (x->fa->fa == null) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

void expose(Node *x) {
    static Node *y;
    for (y = null; x != null; y = x, x = x->top) {
        splay(x);
        x->c[1]->setrt(x);
        x->setc(y, 1);
    }
}

void mkrt(Node *x) {
    expose(x);
    splay(x);
    x->revIt();
}

int query(/*Node *u, */Node *v) {
    /*	mkrt(u); */expose(v);
    splay(v);
    return int(v->ma - mem);
}

void modify(Node *x, int v) {
    splay(x);
    x->val = v;
    x->upd();
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int dep[MAXN], fa[MAXN], head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != fa[x]) {
            (mem + e[now].to)->top = (mem + x);
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

int n, Q;

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(Q);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) newNode(i == 1);
    dep[1] = 1;
    dfs(1);
    mkrt(mem + 1);
    for (int i = 1, op, x; i <= Q; i++) {
        readop(op);
        read(x);
        if (op == 'C') {
            modify(mem + x, dep[x]);
        } else printf("%d\n", query(mem + x));
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>

#include <queue>

#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Node {
    Node *fa, *c[2];
    int sum, val, siz, lazy;
    Node () : sum(0), val(0), siz(0) {}
    inline bool d() {
        return fa->c[1] == this;
    }
    inline void setc(Node *ch, int p) {
        c[p] = ch;
        ch->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        sum = c[0]->sum + c[1]->sum + val;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + 1;
    }
    inline void fil() {
        sum = siz;
        val = 1;
        lazy = 1;
    }
    inline void clr() {
        sum = val = 0;
        lazy = -1;
    }
    inline void relax() {
        if (lazy) {
            if (lazy > 0) c[0]->fil(), c[1]->fil();
            else c[0]->clr(), c[1]->clr();
            lazy = 0;
        }
    }
} Tnull, *null = &Tnull, mem[MAXN], *ptr, *rt;

inline Node *newNode(int v) {
    ptr->sum = ptr->val = v;
    ptr->siz = 1;
    ptr->siz = ptr->lazy = 0;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    int d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

inline void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    static Node *sta[MAXN], *y;
    int top = 0;
    for (y = x; y != null; sta[top++] = y, y = y->fa);
    for ( ; top--; sta[top]->relax());
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline Node *select(int k) {
    for (Node *x = rt; ; ) {
        x->relax();
        int si = x->c[0]->siz;
        if (k < si) x = x->c[0];
        else if (k > si) k -= si + 1, x = x->c[1];
        else return x;
    }
}

inline Node *get(int l, int r) {
    Node *L = select(l - 1), *R = select(r + 1);
    splay(L);
    splay(R, L);
    return R->c[0];
}

int n, m, K;
int a[MAXN];

Node *build(int l, int r, int val) {
    if (l > r) return null;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    Node *x = newNode(a[mid] >= val);
    x->setc(build(l, mid - 1, val), 0);
    x->setc(build(mid + 1, r, val), 1);
    x->upd();
    return x;
}

int op[MAXN], ll[MAXN], rr[MAXN];

inline bool check(int val) {
    ptr = mem;
    rt = build(0, n + 1, val);
    Node *R;
    int sum, siz;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        R = get(ll[i], rr[i]);
        sum = R->sum;
        siz = rr[i] - ll[i] + 1;
        if (sum == 0 || siz == sum) continue;
        if (op[i]) {
            R = get(ll[i], ll[i] + sum - 1);
            R->fil();
            R = get(ll[i] + sum, rr[i]);
            R->clr();
        } else {
            R = get(ll[i], ll[i] + (siz - sum) - 1);
            R->clr();
            R = get(ll[i] + (siz - sum), rr[i]);
            R->fil();
        }
    }
    return get(K, K)->val;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(op[i]), read(ll[i]), read(rr[i]);
    read(K);
    int l = 1, r = n, mid;
    while (l < r) {
        mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
        if (check(mid)) l = mid;
        else r = mid - 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n", l);
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319

int n, m, ans = 0;

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[10700000];

int tcnt = 0;

int a[MAXN], ll[MAXN], rr[MAXN];

struct NODE {
    int l, r, rt;
} T[MAXN * 2];

int Tcnt = 0;

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].v;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)));
    if (qr > mid) ret = max(ret, query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr));
    return ret;
}

int Query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr, int w) {
    if (!x) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return query(T[x].rt, 1, MAX, 1, w);
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret = max(ret, Query(T[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr), w));
    if (qr > mid) ret = max(ret, Query(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr, w));
    return ret;
}

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int w, int D) {
    if (!x) x = ++tcnt;
    t[x].v = max(t[x].v, D);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (w <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, w, D);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, w, D);
    }
}

void Update(int &x, int l, int r, int v, int w, int D) {
    if (!x) x = ++Tcnt;
    update(T[x].rt, 1, MAX, w, D);
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) Update(T[x].l, l, mid, v, w, D);
        else Update(T[x].r, mid + 1, r, v, w, D);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]), ll[i] = rr[i] = a[i];
    for (int i = 1, x, p; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(p);
        ll[x] = min(ll[x], p);
        rr[x] = max(rr[x], p);
    }
    int rt = 0;
    for (int i = 1, dp; i <= n; i++) {
        dp = Query(rt, 1, MAX, 1, a[i], ll[i]) + 1;
        ans = max(ans, dp);
        Update(rt, 1, MAX, rr[i], a[i], dp);
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

inline void readMap(int &a) {
    while (_c != '*' && _c != 'x' && _c != '#') _c = getchar();
    a = _c;
    _c = getchar();
}

#define MAXN 9999

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 17];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, 1
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, m;
int G[55][55], row[55][55], col[55][55], node = 1, S = 0, T = 1;

void build() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int now = ++node;
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                row[i][j] = now;
                flag = 1;
            } else if (G[i][j] == '#') {
                if (flag) add(S, now), now = ++node, flag = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flag) add(S, now);
        else node--;
    }
    for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
        int now = ++node;
        bool flag = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                col[i][j] = now;
                flag = 1;
            } else if (G[i][j] == '#') {
                if (flag) add(now, T), now = ++node, flag = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flag) add(now, T);
        else node--;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (G[i][j] == '*') {
                add(row[i][j], col[i][j]);
            }
        }
}

int q[MAXN];
int tag[MAXN], cur[MAXN];

bool bfs() {
    memset(tag + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * (node));
    int he = 0, ta = 1;
    q[he] = S;
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (he < ta) {
        int x = q[he++];
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q[ta++] = e[now].to;
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x) {
    if (x == T) return 1;
    for (int &now = cur[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[x] < tag[e[now].to]) {
            if (dfs(e[now].to)) {
                e[now].f = 0, e[now^1].f = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = node + 1; i--;) cur[i] = head[i];
        while (dfs(S)) ret++;
    }
    return ret;
}

//	freopen("game.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("game.out", "w", stdout);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) readMap(G[i][j]);
    build();
    printf("%d\n", dinic());
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 18

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int n, int m) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] - 'a' + 1, y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), k = x[sa[1]] = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]]) && (y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
}

int n, m;
char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int a[LOG][MAXN], LOG2[MAXN];

inline int Min(int l, int r) {
    static int L;
    if (l > r) return n - sa[r] + 1;
    L = LOG2[r - l + 1];
    return min(a[L][l], a[L][r - (1 << L) + 1]);
}

void pre_st() {
    LOG2[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) LOG2[i] = LOG2[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) a[0][i] = h[i];
    for (int k = 1, x, xx; k < LOG; k++) {
        x = 1 << (k - 1);
        xx = n - (1 << k) + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= xx; i++) {
            a[k][i] = min(a[k - 1][i], a[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 32];

int tcnt = 0;
int rt[MAXN];

inline void update(int x, int v) {
    static int *pre, l, r, mid;
    pre = NULL;
    l = 1, r = n;
    while (l < r) {
        t[++tcnt] = t[x];
        t[tcnt].v++;
        if (pre) *pre = tcnt;
        mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (v <= mid) pre = &t[tcnt].l, x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else pre = &t[tcnt].r, x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
    *pre = ++tcnt;
    t[tcnt] = t[x];
    t[tcnt].v++;
}

int findLo(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        int mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[rx].l].v - t[t[lx].l].v) lx = t[lx].l, rx = t[rx].l, r = mid;
            else lx = t[lx].r, rx = t[rx].r, l = mid + 1;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) if ((ret = findLo(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)))) return ret;
    if (qr > mid) if ((ret = findLo(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr))) return ret;
    return 0;
}

int findHi(int lx, int rx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (!(t[rx].v - t[lx].v)) return 0;
    if (l == ql && r == qr) {
        int mid;
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r) >> 1;
            if (t[t[rx].r].v - t[t[lx].r].v) lx = t[lx].r, rx = t[rx].r, l = mid + 1;
            else lx = t[lx].l, rx = t[rx].l, r = mid;
        }
        return l;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (qr > mid) if ((ret = findHi(t[lx].r, t[rx].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr))) return ret;
    if (ql <= mid) if ((ret = findHi(t[lx].l, t[rx].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr)))) return ret;;
    return 0;
}

inline bool check(int st, int ed, int len, int x) {
    static int ret;
    ret = findLo(rt[st - 1], rt[ed], 1, n, x, n);
    if (ret) if (Min(x + 1, ret) >= len) return 1;
    ret = findHi(rt[st - 1], rt[ed], 1, n, 1, x);
    if (ret) if (Min(ret + 1, x) >= len) return 1;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
//	freopen("str.in", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("str.out", "w", stdout);
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    getsa(s, sa, n, 26);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        if (k) k--;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }

    pre_st();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        rt[i] = tcnt + 1;
        update(rt[i - 1], rk[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, q, w, c, d, l, r, mid; i <= m; i++) {
        read(q);
        read(w);
        read(c);
        read(d);
        l = 0, r = min(w - q + 1, d - c + 1);
        while (l < r) {
            mid = (l + r + 1) >> 1;
            if (check(q, w - mid + 1, mid, rk[c])) l = mid;
            else r = mid - 1;
        }
        printf("%d\n", l);
    }
    return 0;
}

    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 200319
typedef long long LL;
inline LL power(LL x) {
    return x * x;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

struct Cir {
    int x, y, r;
    void re() {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(r);
    }
} a[MAXN];

struct Point {
    int x, f;
    Point (int q = 0, int w = 0) : x(q), f(w) {}
};

int nowpos;

bool operator < (Point q, Point w) {
    if (q.x == w.x) return q.f < w.f;
    double p1 = a[q.x].y + q.f * sqrt(power(a[q.x].r) - power(nowpos - a[q.x].x));
    double p2 = a[w.x].y + w.f * sqrt(power(a[w.x].r) - power(nowpos - a[w.x].x));
    return p1 < p2;
}

set<Point> s;
set<Point>::iterator it;

int n, pcnt = 0;
pair<int, int> pp[MAXN * 2];
int si[MAXN];

#define dis(i, j) (power(a[i].x - a[j].x) + power(a[i].y - a[j].y))
bool inner(int i, int j) {
    return dis(i, j) <= power(a[i].r);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i].re();
        pp[++pcnt] = make_pair(a[i].x - a[i].r, i);
        pp[++pcnt] = make_pair(a[i].x + a[i].r, i);
    }
    sort(pp + 1, pp + pcnt + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= pcnt; i++) {
        nowpos = pp[i].first;
        int x = pp[i].second;
        Point up(x, 1), down(x, -1);
        if (nowpos < a[x].x) {
            it = s.upper_bound(up);
            if (it == s.end() || !inner(it->x, x)) si[x] = 1;
            else si[x] = -si[it->x];
            s.insert(up);
            s.insert(down);
        } else {
            s.erase(up);
            s.erase(down);
        }
    }
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += si[i] * power(a[i].r);
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4562.cpp
/* Never say die. */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
int _c = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &_a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (_c < '0' || _c>'9') {
        if (_c == '-') f = 1;
        _c=getchar();
    }
    _a = 0;
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') {
        _a = _a * 10 + _c - '0';
        _c = getchar();
    }
    if (f) _a = -_a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
int id[MAXN], od[MAXN];
void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    id[v]++, od[u]++;
}

int n, m;
int ans[MAXN];

int dp(int x) {
    if (ans[x]) return ans[x];
    if (!od[x]) return ans[x] = 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) ans[x] += dp(e[now].to);
    return ans[x];
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) read(u), read(v), add(u, v);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) dp(i);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!id[i] && od[i]) tot += ans[i];
    printf("%d\n", tot);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4566.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 400010

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) P[i] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (int i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

char s[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int n, l1;
void getsa() {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    int m = 127;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i], y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (int j = 1, i, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (i = n - j + 1, k = 0; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), i = 2, x[sa[1]] = k = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i - 1]] == y[sa[i]] && y[sa[i - 1] + j] == y[sa[i] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (int i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (int j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

int sta[MAXN], p[MAXN], L[MAXN], R[MAXN], s1[MAXN], s2[MAXN];

void work() {
    int top = 0;
    sta[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        while (sta[top] >= h[i]) {
            R[p[top]] = i - 1;
            top--;
        }
        L[i] = p[top] + 1;
        sta[++top] = h[i], p[top] = i;
    }
    while (top) R[p[top--]] = n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s1[i] = s1[i - 1] + (sa[i] < l1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) s2[i] = s2[i - 1] + (sa[i] > l1);
    LL ans = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += (LL)h[i] * ((s2[i - 1] - s2[L[i] - 2]) * (s1[R[i]] - s1[i - 1]) + (s1[i - 1] - s1[L[i] - 2]) * (s2[R[i]] - s2[i - 1]));
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%s", s + 1);
    n = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    s[l1 = ++n] = '|';
    scanf("%s", s + n + 1);
    n += (int)strlen(s + n + 1);
    getsa();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4567.cpp
#include<iostream>
#include<cstdlib>
#include<cstdio>

#define MAXN 100010
#define MAXM 510010
#define ll long long
#define INF 1000000000
#define MOD 1000000007
#define eps 1e-8
int son[MAXM][26];
char s[MAXM];
bool v[MAXM];
int tms[MAXM];
int tim;
int rt,tot;
int n;
ll ans;
vector<int>mp[MAXN];
int siz[MAXN];
bool cmp(int x,int y) {
    return siz[x]<siz[y];
}
void ins() {
    int l=strlen(s+1);
    int p=rt;
    int i;
    for(i=l; i; i--) {
        if(!son[p][s[i]-'a']) {
            son[p][s[i]-'a']=++tot;
        }
        p=son[p][s[i]-'a'];
    }
    v[p]=1;
}
void dfs(int x) {
    int i;
    if(v[x]) {
        mp[tms[x]].push_back(++tim);
        tms[x]=tim;
    }
    for(i=0; i<26; i++) {
        if(son[x][i]) {
            tms[son[x][i]]=tms[x];
            dfs(son[x][i]);
        }
    }
}
void dp(int x) {
    int i,y;
    siz[x]=1;
    for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
        y=mp[x][i];
        dp(y);
        siz[x]+=siz[y];
    }
}
void cal(int x) {
    int i;
    tms[x]=++tim;
    sort(mp[x].begin(),mp[x].end(),cmp);
    for(i=0; i<mp[x].size(); i++) {
        ans+=tim+1-tms[x];
        cal(mp[x][i]);
    }
}
int main() {
    int i;
    rt=tot=1;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for(i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",s+1);
        ins();
    }
    tms[rt]=tim=1;
    dfs(rt);
    dp(1);
    tim=0;
    cal(1);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4567.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#define MAXL 510005
#define MAXN 100005
using namespace std;
struct edge {
    int next,to;
} e[MAXN];

struct statu {
    int x,fa;
    statu() {}
    statu(int _x,int _f):x(_x),fa(_f) {}
} q[MAXL];

int n,ecnt=0,nod=0,label=0;
int trie[MAXL][26],head[MAXN],isword[MAXL],f[MAXN],s[MAXN],temp[MAXN];
char re[MAXL];
long long ans=0;
inline bool cmp(int a,int b) {
    return s[a]>s[b];
}

inline void add(int u,int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void insert(int x) {
    int len=(int)strlen(re),now=0;
    for (int i=len-1,to; i>-1; i--) {
        to=re[i]-'a';
        if (!trie[now][to]) {
            trie[now][to]=++nod;
        }
        now=trie[now][to];
    }
    isword[now]=x;
}

inline void bfs() {
    int h=1,t=2;
    q[1]=statu(0,0);
    while (h<t) {
        int now=q[h].x,fa=q[h].fa;
        h++;
        if (isword[now]) {
            f[isword[now]]=fa;
            add(fa,isword[now]);
            fa=isword[now];
        }
        for (int to=0; to<26; to++) {
            if (trie[now][to]) {
                q[t++]=statu(trie[now][to],fa);
            }
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int x) {
    s[x]=1;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        dfs(e[now].to);
        s[x]+=s[e[now].to];
    }
    int tot=0;
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        temp[++tot]=e[now].to;
    }
    sort(temp+1,temp+tot+1,cmp);
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        e[now].to=temp[tot--];
    }
}

void findans(int x) {
    for (int now=head[x]; now; now=e[now].next) {
        temp[e[now].to]=++label;
        ans+=temp[e[now].to]-temp[x];
        findans(e[now].to);
    }
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%s",re);
        insert(i);
    }
    bfs();
    dfs(0);
    temp[0]=0;
    findans(0);
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4568.cpp
/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
#define MAXN 20005
#define MAXQ 200005
#define TOP 60
#define LOGN 15

int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &x) {
    bool s = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') s = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    x = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (s) x = -x;
}

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

struct Basis {
    LL v[TOP + 1];
    LL &operator [] (int a) {
        return v[a];
    }
    void clear() {
        memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
    }
    void merge(LL x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if ((x>>i)&1ll) {
                if (!v[i]) {
                    v[i] = x;
                    break;
                } else x ^= v[i];
            }
        }
    }
    void Merge(Basis x) {
        for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (x[i]) merge(x[i]);
        }
    }
} b[MAXN][LOGN + 1], ans;

int n, q, head[MAXN], f[MAXN][LOGN + 1], dep[MAXN], ecnt = 0;
LL a[MAXN];

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt].to = v;
    e[ecnt].next = head[u];
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt].to = u;
    e[ecnt].next = head[v];
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

void dfs(int x) {
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].to != f[x][0]) {
            f[e[now].to][0] = x;
            dep[e[now].to] = dep[x] + 1;
            dfs(e[now].to);
        }
    }
}

void init() {
    for (int k = 1; k <= LOGN; k++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i][k] = f[f[i][k - 1]][k - 1];
            b[i][k] = b[i][k - 1];
            b[i][k].Merge(b[f[i][k - 1]][k - 1]);
        }
    }
}

void work(int u, int v) {
    ans.clear();
    if (dep[u] > dep[v]) swap(u, v);
    int x = dep[v] - dep[u];
    for (int i = LOGN; i >= 0; i--)
        if ((x>>i)&1)
            ans.Merge(b[v][i]), v = f[v][i];
    if (u != v) {
        for (int i = LOGN; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (f[u][i] != f[v][i]) {
                ans.Merge(b[u][i]);
                ans.Merge(b[v][i]);
                u = f[u][i], v= f[v][i];
            }
        }
        ans.Merge(b[u][0]);
        ans.Merge(b[v][0]);
        u = f[u][0];
    }
    ans.Merge(b[u][0]);
    LL ret = 0;
    for (int i = TOP; i >= 0; i--) ret = max(ret, ret ^ ans[i]);
    printf("%lld\n", ret);
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(q);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(a[i]);
        b[i][0].merge(a[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i < n; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    f[1][0] = 0;
    dep[1] = 0;
    dfs(1);
    init();
    for (int i = 1, x, y; i <= q; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        work(x, y);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4569.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
#define MAXN 100005

int n,m;
int f[20][MAXN];
inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        f[0][i]=i;
    }
    for (int k=1; k<=18; k++) {
        int delta=1<<k;
        for (int i=1,ta=n-delta+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            f[k][i]=i;
        }
    }
}

int getf(int k,int x) {
    if (f[k][x]==x) return x;
    return f[k][x]=getf(k,f[k][x]);
}

inline void merge(int k,int a,int b) {
    int fa=getf(k,a),fb=getf(k,b);
    if (fa!=fb) {
        f[k][fa]=fb;
    }
}

inline void deal(int a,int b,int x) {
    for (int k=18; k!=-1; k--) {
        if ((x>>k)&1) {
            merge(k,a,b);
            a+=1<<k,b+=1<<k;
        }
    }
}

inline void pushdown() {
    for (int k=18; k; k--) {
        int delta=1<<(k-1);
        for (int i=1,ta=n-(1<<k)+1; i<=ta; i++) {
            if (getf(k,i)!=i) {
                merge(k-1,i,getf(k,i));
                merge(k-1,i+delta,getf(k,i)+delta);
            }
        }
    }
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1,l1,r1,l2,r2; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&l1,&r1,&l2,&r2);
        deal(l1,l2,r1-l1+1);
    }
    pushdown();
    int tot=0;
    long long ans=9;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        if (getf(0,i)==i) tot++;
    }
    for (int i=1; i<tot; i++) {
        ans=(ans*10)%1000000007;
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4570.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

#define eps 1e-8
#define MAXN 1000005
#define MAX_BUF_SIZE 30000000

// fastio

#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
char buf[MAX_BUF_SIZE],*ptr;
void init_buf() {
    fread(buf,sizeof(char),MAX_BUF_SIZE,stdin);
    ptr=buf;
}
#define getchar() (*(ptr++))
#endif

typedef long long ll;

char ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}

inline ll power(int x) {
    return (ll)x*x;
}

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
} p[MAXN],sta[MAXN];

#define c p[1]

#define dis(a,b) ((power(a.x-b.x)+power(a.y-b.y)))
bool operator < (const point &a,const point &b) {
    ll cross=(ll)(a.x-c.x)*(b.y-c.y)-(ll)(b.x-c.x)*(a.y-c.y);
    if (cross==0) return dis(a,c)<dis(b,c);
    return cross<0;
}

int n;
double ans=1e15;

inline void updateans(double k,point a) {
    if (-k<eps) return;
    double wtf=a.x+a.y-k*a.x-a.y/k;
    if (wtf<ans) ans=wtf;
}

int main() {
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    init_buf();
#endif
    read(n);
    int tl=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        if (p[i].y>p[tl].y) tl=i;
        else if (p[i].y==p[tl].y && p[tl].x>p[i].x) tl=i;
    }
    if (n==1) {
        printf("%.4lf\n",p[1].x+p[1].y+2.0*sqrt((ll)p[1].x*p[1].y));
        return 0;
    }
    swap(p[tl],p[1]);
    sort(p+2,p+n+1);
    int top=2;
    sta[1]=p[1],sta[2]=p[2];
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        while (top>1 && (ll)(p[i].x-sta[top-1].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top].y)>=(ll)(p[i].x-sta[top].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top-1].y))
            top--;
        sta[++top]=p[i];
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=top; i++) {
        if (sta[i].x<=sta[i-1].x) top=i-1;
    }
    double lastk,nowk,nextk;
    // 1
    nextk=(double)(sta[2].y-sta[1].y)/(sta[2].x-sta[1].x);
    updateans(nextk,sta[1]);
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[1].y/sta[1].x);
    if (nowk>nextk) updateans(nowk,sta[1]);
    // 2~top-1
    for (int i=2; i<top; i++) {
        lastk=nextk;
        nextk=(double)(sta[i+1].y-sta[i].y)/(sta[i+1].x-sta[i].x);
        updateans(nextk,sta[i]);
        nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[i].y/sta[i].x);
        if (nowk>nextk && nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[i]);
    }
    // top
    lastk=nextk;
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[top].y/sta[top].x);
    if (nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[top]);
    printf("%.4lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

namespace IO {

    fread(rb, sizeof(char), RMAX, stdin);
}
template <class _T> inline void read(_T &_a) {
    _a = 0;
    register bool _f = 0;
    register int _c = getchar();
    while (_c < '0' || _c > '9') _f |= _c == '-', _c = getchar();
    while (_c >= '0' && _c <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + (_c ^ '0'), _c = getchar();
    _a = _f ? -_a : _a;
}
template <class _T> inline void write(_T _a) {
    static char buf[20], *top = buf;
    if (_a) {
        while (_a) {
            register _T tm = _a / 10;
            *(++top) = char(_a - tm * 10) | '0';
            _a = tm;
        }
        while (top != buf) putchar(*(top--));
    } else putchar('0');
}
void output() {
    fwrite(wb, sizeof(char), wp - wb, stdout);
}

using namespace IO;

inline LL power(int x) {
    return (LL)x*x;
}

struct point {
    int x,y;
    point() {}
    point(int a,int b):x(a),y(b) {}
} p[MAXN],sta[MAXN];

#define c p[1]

#define dis(a,b) ((power(a.x-b.x)+power(a.y-b.y)))
bool operator < (const point &a,const point &b) {
    LL cross=(LL)(a.x-c.x)*(b.y-c.y)-(LL)(b.x-c.x)*(a.y-c.y);
    if (cross==0) return dis(a,c)<dis(b,c);
    return cross<0;
}

int n;
double ans=1e15;

inline void updateans(double k,point a) {
    if (-k<eps) return;
    double wtf=a.x+a.y-k*a.x-a.y/k;
    if (wtf<ans) ans=wtf;
}

int main() {
    init();
    read(n);
    int tl=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        read(p[i].x);
        read(p[i].y);
        if (p[i].y>p[tl].y) tl=i;
        else if (p[i].y==p[tl].y && p[tl].x>p[i].x) tl=i;
    }
    if (n==1) {
        printf("%.4lf\n",p[1].x+p[1].y+2.0*sqrt((LL)p[1].x*p[1].y));
        return 0;
    }
    swap(p[tl],p[1]);
    sort(p+2,p+n+1);
    int top=2;
    sta[1]=p[1],sta[2]=p[2];
    for (int i=3; i<=n; i++) {
        while (top>1 && (LL)(p[i].x-sta[top-1].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top].y)>=(LL)(p[i].x-sta[top].x)*(p[i].y-sta[top-1].y))
            top--;
        sta[++top]=p[i];
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=top; i++) {
        if (sta[i].x<=sta[i-1].x) top=i-1;
    }
    double lastk,nowk,nextk;
    // 1
    nextk=(double)(sta[2].y-sta[1].y)/(sta[2].x-sta[1].x);
    updateans(nextk,sta[1]);
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[1].y/sta[1].x);
    if (nowk>nextk) updateans(nowk,sta[1]);
    // 2~top-1
    for (int i=2; i<top; i++) {
        lastk=nextk;
        nextk=(double)(sta[i+1].y-sta[i].y)/(sta[i+1].x-sta[i].x);
        updateans(nextk,sta[i]);
        nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[i].y/sta[i].x);
        if (nowk>nextk && nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[i]);
    }
    // top
    lastk=nextk;
    nowk=-sqrt((double)sta[top].y/sta[top].x);
    if (nowk<lastk) updateans(nowk,sta[top]);
    printf("%.4lf\n",ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4571.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 262145

struct node {
    int l,r,v;
} t[MAXN*24];

int n,m,cnt=0;
int a[MAXN],root[MAXN];

void build(int &x,int l,int r) {
    x=++cnt;
    t[x].v=0;
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    build(t[x].l,l,mid);
    build(t[x].r,mid+1,r);
}

void update(int x,int &now,int l,int r,int p) {
    now=++cnt;
    t[now].v=t[x].v+1;
    t[now].l=t[x].l;
    t[now].r=t[x].r;
    if (l==r) return;
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (p<=mid) update(t[x].l,t[now].l,l,mid,p);
    else update(t[x].r,t[now].r,mid+1,r,p);
}

bool query(int ta,int tb,int ql,int qr,int l,int r) {
    if (ql<=l && qr>=r) {
        return t[ta].v>t[tb].v;
    }
    int mid=(l+r)>>1;
    if (ql<=mid) if (query(t[ta].l,t[tb].l,ql,qr,l,mid)) return 1;
    if (qr>mid) if (query(t[ta].r,t[tb].r,ql,qr,mid+1,r)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
    }
    build(root[0],0,MAXN);
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        update(root[i-1],root[i],0,MAXN,a[i]);
    }
}

int ymax(int b,int x,int l,int r) {
    int ans=0;
    for (int k=17; k>-1; k--) {
        if ((b>>k)&1) { // b get 1 then a+x better get 0
            int nowl=max(ans-x,0),nowr=(ans|((1<<k)-1))-x;
            if (nowr<0 || !query(root[r],root[l-1],nowl,nowr,0,MAXN)) {
                ans^=(1<<k);
            }
        } else { // b get 0 then a+x better get 1
            ans^=1<<k;
            int nowl=max(ans-x,0),nowr=(ans|((1<<k)-1))-x;
            if (nowr<0 || !query(root[r],root[l-1],nowl,nowr,0,MAXN)) {
                ans^=(1<<k);
            }
        }
    }
    return b^ans;
}

inline void work() {
    for (int i=1,b,x,l,r; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&b,&x,&l,&r);
        printf("%d\n",ymax(b,x,l,r));
    }
}

int main() {
    init();
    work();
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int a[255];
int dp[255][255];
int top=-1,n;
int main() {
    scanf("%d",&n);
    memset(dp,-1,sizeof(dp));
    for (int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        scanf("%d",a+i);
        top=max(top,a[i]);
        dp[i][i]=a[i];
    }
    for (int len=1; len<n; len++) {
        for (int i=1,t=n-len; i<=t; i++) {
            int j=i+len;
            for (int k=i; k<j; k++) {
                if (dp[i][k]!=-1 && dp[k+1][j]!=-1 && dp[i][k]==dp[k+1][j]) {
                    dp[i][j]=dp[i][k]+1;
                    top=max(top,dp[i][j]);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d",top);
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 503
#define MOD 1000000007

int power(LL a, int b) {
    int ret = 1;
    for ( ; b; b >>= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ret = int((ret * a) % MOD);
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return ret;
}

int n;
int dp[N * 2][N], sum[N * 2];
int A[N], B[N];
int tem[N * 2], tot = 0;
int L[N * 2], R[N * 2], len[N * 2], inv[N];

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        read(A[i]), read(B[i]);
        tem[++tot] = A[i];
        tem[++tot] = B[i] + 1;
    }
    sort(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1);
    tot = int(unique(tem + 1, tem + tot + 1) - tem - 1) - 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) L[i] = tem[i], R[i] = tem[i + 1] - 1, len[i] = tem[i + 1] - tem[i];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) inv[i] = power(i, MOD - 2);
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) sum[i] = 1;
    for (register int i = 1, j, k, st, ed; i <= n; i++) {
        st = int(lower_bound(L + 1, L + tot + 1, A[i]) - L), ed = int(lower_bound(R + 1, R + tot + 1, B[i]) - R);
        for (j = st; j <= ed; j++) {
            for (k = i; k > 1; k--) {
                dp[j][k] = int((dp[j][k] + dp[j][k - 1] * LL(len[j] - k + 1) % MOD * inv[k]) % MOD);
            }
            dp[j][1] = int((dp[j][1] + LL(sum[j - 1]) * len[j]) % MOD);
        }
        for (j = st; j <= tot; j++) {
            sum[j] = sum[j - 1];
            for (k = i; k; k--) {
                if ((sum[j] += dp[j][k]) >= MOD) sum[j] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

/*	Never stop fighting for what you believe in.	*/
#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
int ch;
inline void read(int &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
inline void read(LL &a) {
    while (ch<'0' || ch>'9') ch=getchar();
    a=0;
    while (ch>='0' && ch<='9') {
        a=a*10+ch-'0';
        ch=getchar();
    }
}
#define MOD 2333
int C[2345][2345],sum[2345][2345];

void init() {
    C[0][0]=sum[0][0]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MOD; i++) sum[0][i]=1;
    for (int i=1; i<=MOD; i++) {
        sum[i][0]=C[i][0]=1;
        for (int j=1; j<=i; j++) {
            C[i][j]=C[i-1][j-1]+C[i-1][j];
            if (C[i][j]>=MOD) C[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
        for (int j=1; j<=MOD; j++) {
            sum[i][j]=sum[i][j-1]+C[i][j];
            if (sum[i][j]>=MOD) sum[i][j]-=MOD;
        }
    }
}

int Lucas(LL n,LL k) {
    if (n<k || k<0) return 0;
    if (n<=MOD) return C[n][k];
    return (Lucas(n/MOD,k/MOD)*C[n%MOD][k%MOD])%MOD;
}

int ans(LL n,LL k) {
    if (k<0) return 0;
    return (ans(n/MOD,k/MOD-1)*sum[n%MOD][MOD-1]+Lucas(n/MOD,k/MOD)*sum[n%MOD][k%MOD])%MOD;
}
int main() {
    init();
    int T;
    LL n,k;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(n);
        read(k);
        printf("%d\n",ans(n,k));
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4602.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
/* Configuration */

#define MAXN 1005
#define MAXM 10005
#define MOD 19260817

struct edge {
    int next,to,x,y;
} e[MAXM<<1];

int T,n,m,ecnt,head[MAXN];

typedef long long ll;
ll rot[MAXN];

inline void add(int u,int v,int x,int y) {
    e[++ecnt].to=v;
    e[ecnt].x=x;
    e[ecnt].y=y;
    e[ecnt].next=head[u];
    head[u]=ecnt;
}

inline void init() {
    scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
    memset(head,0,sizeof(head));
    memset(rot,0,sizeof(rot));
    ecnt=0;
    for (int i=1,u,v,x,y; i<=m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d%d%d",&u,&v,&x,&y);
        if (y<0) y+=MOD;
        add(u,v,x,y);
        add(v,u,y,x);
    }
}

inline ll rev(ll x) {
    ll ret=1;
    int temp=MOD-2;
    while (temp) {
        if (temp&1) ret=(ret*x)%MOD;
        x=(x*x)%MOD;
        temp>>=1;
    }
    return ret;
}

inline bool work() {
    queue<int> q;
    for (int qqq=1; qqq<=n; qqq++) {
        if (rot[qqq]) continue;
        rot[qqq]=1;
        q.push(qqq);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u=q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int now=head[u]; now; now=e[now].next) {
                int v=e[now].to,x=e[now].x,y=e[now].y;
                ll go=(((rot[u]*rev((ll)y))%MOD)*x)%MOD;
                if (!rot[v]) {
                    rot[v]=go;
                    q.push(v);
                } else {
                    if (rot[v]!=go) return 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d",&T);
    for (int ca=1; ca<=T; ca++) {
        init();
        printf("Case #%d: ",ca);
        if (work()) puts("Yes");
        else puts("No");
    }
    return 0;
}

#define MAXN 50319
#define INF 0x1f1f1f1f

const int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1}, dy[] = {-1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0};

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point (int _x = 0, int _y = 0) : x(_x), y(_y) {}
    bool operator < (Point a) const {
        return x < a.x || (x == a.x && y < a.y);
    }
    bool operator == (Point a) const {
        return x == a.x && y == a.y;
    }
} p[MAXN];

int n, tot = 0;
int lab[MAXN];
map <Point, int> G;

struct edge {
    int next, to, f;
} e[MAXN * 6 * 4 * 2];

int head[MAXN * 2], cur[MAXN * 2], S = 0, T = 1, node = 1, ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v, int f) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int tag[MAXN * 2];
queue <int> q;
bool bfs() {
    memset(tag, 0, sizeof(int) * (node + 1));
    q.push(S);
    tag[S] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && !tag[e[now].to]) {
                tag[e[now].to] = tag[x] + 1;
                q.push(e[now].to);
            }
        }
    }
    return !!tag[T];
}

int dfs(int x, int flow) {
    if (x == T) return flow;
    int left = flow;
    for (int &now = cur[x], ret; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (e[now].f && tag[e[now].to] > tag[x]) {
            if ((ret = dfs(e[now].to, min(left, e[now].f)))) {
                e[now].f -= ret;
                e[now ^ 1].f += ret;
                left -= ret;
                if (!left) return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return flow - left;
}

int dinic() {
    int ret = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        memcpy(cur, head, sizeof(int) * (node + 1));
        ret += dfs(S, INF);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1, x, y, z, c; i <= n; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(y);
        read(z);
        read(c);
        p[i] = Point(x - z, y - z);
        if (G.find(p[i]) == G.end()) G[p[i]] = c * (10 + ((x + y + z) % 3 == 0));
        else G[p[i]] += c * (10 + ((x + y + z) % 3 == 0));
    }
    sort(p + 1, p + n + 1);
    n = int(unique(p + 1, p + n + 1) - p - 1);
    for (int i = 1, val; i <= n; i++) {
        val = G[p[i]], G[p[i]] = i;
        lab[i] = ++node;
        tot += val;
        switch (((p[i].x + p[i].y) % 3 + 3) % 3) {
        case 0 :
            add(lab[i], ++node, val);
            break;
        case 1 :
            add(S, lab[i], val);
            break;
        case 2 :
            add(lab[i], T, val);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if ((p[i].x + p[i].y) % 3 == 0) {
            for (int d1 = 0, d2 = 1; d1 < 6; d1++, d2++) {
                int p1 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d1], p[i].y + dy[d1])];
                int p2 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d2], p[i].y + dy[d2])];
                if (p1 && p2) {
                    if (((p[p1].x + p[p1].y) % 3 + 3) % 3 == 2) swap(p1, p2);
                    add(lab[p1], lab[i], INF), add(lab[i] + 1, lab[p2], INF);
                }
            }
            for (int d1 = 0, d2 = 3; d2 < 6; d1++, d2++) {
                int p1 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d1], p[i].y + dy[d1])];
                int p2 = G[Point(p[i].x + dx[d2], p[i].y + dy[d2])];
                if (p1 && p2) {
                    if (((p[p1].x + p[p1].y) % 3 + 3) % 3 == 2)  swap(p1, p2);
                    add(lab[p1], lab[i], INF), add(lab[i] + 1, lab[p2], INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = tot - dinic();
    printf("%d.%d\n", ans / 10, ans % 10);
    return 0;
}
