#define sec second
inline LL min(LL a, LL b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline LL max(LL a, LL b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319
#define MAX 1000319
#define Inf 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
int T;
int n, a[MAXN];
LL t1[2][MAX], t2[2][MAX], (*pre)[MAX], (*now)[MAX];

LL solve(LL (opt)(LL, LL)) {
    pre = t1, now = t2;
    LL INF = -opt(Inf, -Inf);
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[1]; i++) pre[0][i] = INF, pre[1][i] = INF;
    pre[0][a[1]] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= a[i]; j++) now[0][j] = now[1][j] = INF;
        for (int j = min(a[i], a[i - 1]); ~j; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF || pre[1][j] != INF) now[0][a[i] - j] = opt(pre[0][j], pre[1][j]) + j;
        }
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; j >= a[i]; j--) {
            if (pre[0][j] != INF) now[1][0] = opt(now[1][0], pre[0][j] + a[i]);
        }
        LL tmp = INF;
        for (int j = a[i - 1]; ~j; j--) {
            tmp = opt(tmp, pre[0][j]);
            if (j <= a[i] && tmp != INF) {
                now[1][a[i] - j] = opt(now[1][a[i] - j], tmp + j);
            }
        }
        swap(now, pre);
    }
    LL ans = pre[1][0];
    for (int i = 0; i <= a[n]; i++) ans = opt(ans, pre[0][i]);
    return ans;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    printf("%lld %lld\n", solve(min), solve(max));
}

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef long double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

bool vis[55][10][10][10];
D f[55][10][10][10];

D dp(int k, int a, int b, int c) {
    if (!k) return 0;
    if (vis[k][a][b][c]) return f[k][a][b][c];
    vis[k][a][b][c] = 1;
    int tot = a + b + c + 1;
    D &ret = f[k][a][b][c];
    ret = 0;
    if (a) {
        ret += dp(k - 1, a - 1, b, c) * (a / D(tot));
    }
    if (b) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c + 1) * (b / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a + 1, b - 1, c) * (b / D(tot));
    }
    if (c) {
        if (tot <= 7) ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c) * (c / D(tot));
        else ret += dp(k - 1, a, b + 1, c - 1) * (c / D(tot));
    }
    ret += (dp(k - 1, a, b, c) + 1) / D(tot);
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    int K, A, B, C, T;
    read(T);
    while (T--) {
        read(K);
        read(A);
        read(B);
        read(C);
        printf("%.2lf\n", (double)dp(K, A, B, C) + 1e-10);
    }
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4842.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 1015
#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct edge {
    int next, to, f, w;
} e[MAXN * 16];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

inline void add(int u, int v, int f, int w) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v, f, w
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u, 0, -w
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int n, K, S, T, t1, t2;
int a[MAXN], pre[MAXN];
LL ans, dis[MAXN];

#define TOP 2047

int q[TOP + 1];
bool inq[MAXN];

void SPFA() {
    memset(dis, 0x3f, sizeof(LL) * (n + 2));
    dis[S] = 0;
    pre[T] = -1;
    int he = 1, ta = 1;
    q[1] = S;
    while (he <= ta) {
        int x = q[(he++) & TOP];
        inq[x] = 0;
        for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
            if (e[now].f && dis[e[now].to] > dis[x] + e[now].w) {
                dis[e[now].to] = dis[x] + e[now].w;
                pre[e[now].to] = now;
                if (!inq[e[now].to]) {
                    inq[e[now].to] = 1;
                    q[(++ta) & TOP] = e[now].to;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    while (t1) {
        SPFA();
        int flow = INF;
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) flow = min(e[pre[x]].f, flow);
        t1 -= (flow = min(flow, t1));
        ans -= flow * dis[T];
        for (int x = T; x != S; x = e[pre[x] ^ 1].to) e[pre[x]].f -= flow, e[pre[x] ^ 1].f += flow;
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(K);
    read(t1);
    read(t2);
    t1 = K - t1;
    S = 0, T = n + 1;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] -= x, ans += x;
    for (int i = 1, x; i <= n; i++) read(x), a[i] += x;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, i + 1, t1 - t2, 0);
    int st = ecnt;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) add(i, min(i + K, T), 1, -a[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) add(S, i, INF, 0);
    solve();
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        st += 2;
        if (e[st].f) putchar('E');
        else putchar('S');
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>

#define sec second
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        ch=getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }

#define MAXN 100319

LL A, B, C;
LL n, m;
LL t[MAXN], b[MAXN];
LL st[MAXN], sb[MAXN];

int main() {
    read(A);
    read(B);
    read(C);
    read(n);
    read(m);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(t[i]);
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) read(b[i]);
    sort(t + 1, t + n + 1);
    sort(b + 1, b + m + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[i] = st[i - 1] + t[i];
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sb[i] = sb[i - 1] + b[i];
    A = min(A, B);
    LL ans = 0x7fffffffffffffff;
    for (LL T = b[m], i = n, j = m; T >= min(b[1], t[1]); T--) {
        while (i && t[i] >= T) i--;
        while (j && b[j] >= T) j--;
        LL can = T * j - sb[j], mov = sb[m] - sb[j] - T * (m - j);
        if (min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + D(T * i - st[i]) * C < ans) {
            ans = min(mov, can) * A + max(0ll, mov - can) * B + (T * i - st[i]) * C;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

//BZOJ4869.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;

#define MAXN 50319

int n, m, c, tot;

int a[MAXN], stp[MAXN];

int P[55], po[55][32769], pO[55][32000];

struct Node {
    int l, r, sum;
    bool lp;
} t[MAXN * 2];

int tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
        t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
    } else {
        t[x].sum = a[l] % P[0];
        t[x].lp = 0;
    }
    return x;
}

inline int phi(int x) {
    int ret = x;
    for (int i = 2, j = (int)sqrt(x); i <= j; i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) {
            ret = ret / i * (i - 1);
            while (!(x % i)) x /= i;
            j = (int)sqrt(x);
        }
    }
    return x > 1 ? ret / x * (x - 1) : ret;
}

int calc(int x, int p) {
    if (x >= P[p]) x = x % P[p] + P[p];
    while (p--) {
        x = int(LL(po[p][x & 32767]) * pO[p][x >> 15] % P[p]);
        if (p && !x) x += P[p];
    }
    return x % P[0];
}

int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (l == ql && r == qr) return t[x].sum;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1, ret = 0;
    if (ql <= mid) ret += query(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) ret += query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    return ret % P[0];
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (t[x].lp) return;
    if (l == r) {
        stp[l]++;
        t[x].lp = stp[l] >= tot;
        t[x].sum = calc(a[l], stp[l]);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (ql <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, ql, min(mid, qr));
    if (qr >  mid) update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, max(mid + 1, ql), qr);
    t[x].sum = (t[t[x].l].sum + t[t[x].r].sum) % P[0];
    t[x].lp = t[t[x].l].lp & t[t[x].r].lp;
}

int main() {
    int p;
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(p);
    read(c);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    P[0] = p;
    while (p != 1) {
        p = phi(p);
        P[++tot] = p;
    }
    P[++tot] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
        po[i][0] = pO[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= 32768; j++) po[i][j] = int(LL(po[i][j - 1]) * c % P[i]);
        for (int j = 1; j < 32000; j++) pO[i][j] = int(LL(pO[i][j - 1]) * po[i][32768] % P[i]);
    }
    build(1, n);
    for (int i = 1, x, l, r; i <= m; i++) {
        read(x);
        read(l);
        read(r);
        if (x) printf("%d\n", query(1, 1, n, l, r));
        else update(1, 1, n, l, r);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <queue>
#include <string>

#include <bitset>

#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch>'9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch=getchar();
    }
    a = 0;
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define N 51

struct Mat {
    LL a[N][N];
    LL *operator[] (const int x) const {
        return (LL*)a[x];
    }
};

LL n, P;
int K, R;

void mul(Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    static Mat c;
    memset(c.a, 0, sizeof c.a);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++)
                (c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j]) %= P;
    a = c;
}

Mat tr, a;

void work() {
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) tr[i][i] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) a[i][i]++, a[i][i + 1 == K ? 0 : i + 1]++;
    for (n *= K; n; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) mul(tr, a);
        mul(a, a);
    }
}

int main() {
    read(n);
    read(P);
    read(K);
    read(R);
    work();
    printf("%d\n", int(tr[0][R] % P));
    return 0;
}

#define sec second

    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {

#define MAXN 100319

struct edge {
    int next, to;
} e[MAXN * 2];

int head[MAXN], ecnt = 1;

void add(int u, int v) {
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[u], v
    };
    head[u] = ecnt;
    e[++ecnt] = (edge) {
        head[v], u
    };
    head[v] = ecnt;
}

int rt[MAXN], col[MAXN];

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * 64];

int tcnt = 0;

void update(int &x, int l, int r, int p) {
    if (!x) t[x = ++tcnt].v = 0, t[x].l = t[x].r = 0;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) update(t[x].l, l, mid, p);
        else update(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, p);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v + t[t[x].r].v;
    } else t[x].v = 1;
}

int query(int x, int l, int r) {
    if (!x) return l;
    int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
    if (t[x].l && t[t[x].l].v == mid - l + 1) return query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r);
    else return query(t[x].l, l, mid);
}

int T, n, m, K;

bool dfs(int x) {
    col[x] = query(rt[x], 1, K + 1);
    if (col[x] > K) return 1;
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        update(rt[e[now].to], 1, K + 1, col[x]);
    }
    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
        if (!col[e[now].to]) if (dfs(e[now].to)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void work() {
    read(n);
    read(m);
    read(K);
    tcnt = 0;
    ecnt = 1;
    memset(head + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    memset(rt + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    memset(col + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * n);
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        read(u);
        read(v);
        add(u, v);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!col[i]) {
            if (dfs(i)) {
                int x;
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) if (col[j] == K + 1) {
                        x = j;
                        break;
                    }
                printf("path %d", x);
                for (int cnt = K; cnt; cnt--) {
                    for (int now = head[x]; now; now = e[now].next) {
                        if (col[e[now].to] == cnt) {
                            x = e[now].to;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    printf(" %d", x);
                }
                printf("\n");
                return;
            }
        }
    printf("color");
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf(" %d", col[i]);
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    read(T);
    while (T--) work();
    return 0;
}

#define MOD 2017

struct Mat {
    int a[N][N];
    inline int *operator [] (const int x) const {
        return (int*)a[x];
    }
} tmp;

int n, m, T;

inline void mul(Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    memset(tmp.a, 0, sizeof tmp.a);
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++)
        for (k = 0; k <= n; k++)
            for (j = 0; j <= n; j++)
                tmp[i][j] = (tmp[i][j] + a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % MOD;
    a = tmp;
}

Mat a, b, c;

    scanf("%d%d", &n, &m);
    b[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        b[i][i]++;
        b[i][0]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
        b[u][v]++, b[v][u]++;
    }
    scanf("%d", &T);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
    for ( ; T; T >>= 1) {
        if (T & 1) mul(a, b);
        mul(b, b);
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        ans += a[1][i];
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans % MOD);
}

//BZOJ4888.cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstdio>
#include <bitset>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>
#include <map>
#include <set>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second

#define MAXN 100319
#define LOG 20

struct Node {
    int l, r, v;
} t[MAXN * (LOG * 2 + 5)];

int rt[LOG], rb[LOG], tcnt = 0;

int build(int l, int r) {
    int x = ++tcnt;
    if (l < r) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        t[x].l = build(l, mid);
        t[x].r = build(mid + 1, r);
        t[x].v = t[t[x].l].v ^ t[t[x].r].v;
    } else t[x].v = l == 0;
    return x;
}
int query(int x, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    int ret2 = 0;
    while (l != ql || r != qr) {
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (qr <= mid) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else if (ql > mid) x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
        else {
            ret2 ^= query(t[x].r, mid + 1, r, mid + 1, qr);
            r = qr = mid;
            x = t[x].l;
        }
    }
    return t[x].v ^ ret2;
}

void update(int x, int l, int r, int p) {
    while (1) {
        t[x].v ^= 1;
        if (l == r) break;
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) x = t[x].l, r = mid;
        else x = t[x].r, l = mid + 1;
    }
}

int n, ans = 0;
int a[MAXN];

int main() {
//	freopen("read.in", "r", stdin);
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) scanf("%d", a + i), a[i] += a[i - 1];
    for (int j = 0; j < LOG; j++) {
        rb[j] = 1 << (j + 1);
        rt[j] = build(0, rb[j]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < LOG; j++) {
            int x = (a[i] + 1) % rb[j];
            if (x <= (1 << j)) ans ^= query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], x, x + (1 << j) - 1) << j;
            else ans ^= (query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], x, rb[j]) ^ query(rt[j], 0, rb[j], 0, x - (1 << j) - 1)) << j;
            update(rt[j], 0, rb[j], a[i] % rb[j]);
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

//BZOJ4892.cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second

inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

#define MAXN 200319
#define LOG 18

void Sort(int in[], int out[], int p[], int n, int m) {
    static int P[MAXN];
    memset(P + 1, 0, sizeof(int) * m);
    register int i;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) P[in[i]]++;
    for (i = 2; i <= m; i++) P[i] += P[i - 1];
    for (i = n; i; i--) out[P[in[p[i]]]--] = p[i];
}

void getsa(char s[], int sa[], int rk[], int h[], int n, int m = 5) {
    static int t1[MAXN], t2[MAXN], *x = t1, *y = t2;
    t1[n + 1] = t2[n + 1] = 0;
    register int i, j, k;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) x[i] = s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : (s[i] == 'T' ? 2 : (s[i] == 'G' ? 3 : (s[i] == 'C' ? 4 : 5))), y[i] = i;
    Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
    for (j = 1, k = 0; k < n; m = k, j <<= 1) {
        for (k = 0, i = n - j + 1; i <= n; i++) y[++k] = i;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (sa[i] > j) y[++k] = sa[i] - j;
        Sort(x, sa, y, n, m);
        for (swap(x, y), x[sa[1]] = k = 1, i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            x[sa[i]] = (y[sa[i]] == y[sa[i - 1]] && y[sa[i] + j] == y[sa[i - 1] + j]) ? k : ++k;
        }
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) rk[sa[i]] = i;
    for (i = 1, k = 0; i <= n; h[rk[i++]] = k) {
        k -= !!k;
        for (j = sa[rk[i] - 1]; s[i + k] == s[j + k]; k++);
    }
}

char a[MAXN];
int sa[MAXN], rk[MAXN], h[MAXN];

int st[LOG][MAXN], Log[MAXN];

#define rmq(l, r) min(st[Log[r - l]][l + 1], st[Log[r - l]][r - (1 << Log[r - l]) + 1])

inline int lcp(int x, int y) {
    if (x > y) return rmq(y, x);
    else return rmq(x, y);
}

void getst(int n) {
    Log[0] = -1;
    register int i, j, k, x;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) st[0][i] = h[i];
    for (k = 1; k <= Log[n]; k++) {
        for (i = 1, x = 1 << (k - 1), j = n - (x << 1) + 1; i <= j; i++) {
            st[k][i] = min(st[k - 1][i], st[k - 1][i + x]);
        }
    }
}

void work() {
    scanf("%s", a + 1);
    int n = (int)strlen(a + 1);
    a[n + 1] = '$';
    scanf("%s", a + n + 2);
    int m = (int)strlen(a + n + 2);
    getsa(a, sa, rk, h, n + m + 1);
    getst(n + m + 1);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1, j, k, rep, LCP; i <= n - m + 1; i++) {
        for (j = n + 2, k = i, rep = 0; rep <= 3 && j <= n + m + 1; ) {
            LCP = lcp(rk[j], rk[k]);
            j += LCP, k += LCP;
            if (j <= n + m + 1) j++, k++, rep++;
        }
        if (rep <= 3) ans++;
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}

int T;
int main() {
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) work();
}

void ins(int d) {
    int x = 0;
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'a';
        if (!t[x][to]) t[x][to] = ++tcnt;
        x = t[x][to];
        if ((cnt[x] += d) > (int)a[x].size()) a[x].push_back(Tim);
    }
}

int query(int lim) {
    int x = 0;
    int len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        int to = s[i] - 'a';
        x = t[x][to];
        if (lim >= (int)a[x].size()) return -1;
    }
    return a[x][lim];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    int ans = 0, op, A, B, C;
    for (Tim = 1; Tim <= n; Tim++) {
        scanf("%d%s", &op, s + 1);
        switch (op) {
        case 1 :
            ins(1);
            break;
        case 2 :
            ins(-1);
            break;
        case 3 :
            scanf("%d%d%d", &A, &B, &C);
            printf("%d\n", ans = query(int(((long long) A * abs(ans) + B) % C)));
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    o = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') oo |= ch == '-', ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') o = o * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();
    if (oo) o = -o;

#define MAXN 20000319
#define getrand() (seed = ((seed * 12321) ^ 9999) & 32767)
bool p[MAXN];
int seed, n, K, S;
int f[MAXN], ans2, ans3;
void input() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &K, &seed, &S);
    int t = 0;
    n = K * 2 + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = (getrand() / 128) & 1;
        t += p[i];
    }
    int i = 1;
    while (t > K) {
        while (p[i] == 0) i++;
        p[i] = 0;
        t--;
    }
    while (t < K) {
        while (p[i] == 1) i++;
        p[i] = 1;
        t++;
    }
}

inline int solve1(register int x) {
    register int ret = 0, i, cnt, Max = x;
    f[x] = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, cnt = 0; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1) {
        if (p[i]) {
            ret += (++cnt > 0);
            if (cnt >= f[Max]) Max = i;
        } else --cnt;
        f[i] = cnt;
    }
    if (ret == 0) return x;
    while (p[Max]) Max = Max == n ? 1 : Max + 1;
    return Max;
}

struct myPii {
    int fir, sec;
    inline bool operator < (const myPii &a) const {
        return fir < a.fir || (fir == a.fir && sec < a.sec);
    }
} tt[MAXN];

inline int solve2(register int x) {
    register int i, j, cc = 0;
    tt[0].fir = f[x];
    tt[0].sec = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, j = 1; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1, j++) if (!p[i]) {
            tt[++cc].fir = f[i];
            tt[cc].sec = j;
        }
//	sort(tt, tt + cc + 1);
    nth_element(tt, tt + K - S, tt + K + 1);
    int P = x + tt[K - S].sec;
    return P > n ? P - n : P;
}

inline int solve3(register int x) {
    register int i, j, cc = 0;
    tt[0].fir = f[x];
    tt[0].sec = 0;
    for (i = x == n ? 1 : x + 1, j = 1; i != x; i = i == n ? 1 : i + 1, j++) if (!p[i]) {
            tt[++cc].fir = f[i];
            tt[cc].sec = j;
        }
    nth_element(tt, tt + S, tt + K + 1);
    int P = x + tt[S].sec;
    return P > n ? P - n : P;
}

int main() {
    input();
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!p[i]) {
            printf("%d\n", solve1(i));
            printf("%d\n", solve2(i));
            printf("%d\n", solve3(i));
            break;
        }
    return 0;
}

    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') _f |= ch == '-', ch = getchar();
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') _a = _a * 10 + (ch ^ '0'), ch = getchar();

#define MOD 1000000007
#define MAXN 233333 + 2

    register int i, j, k, ans = 0, tmp;
    read(n);
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) read(a[i]);
    for (i = n; i; i--) {
        tmp = 0;
        k = a[i];
        for (j = (k - 1) & k; j; j = (j - 1) & k) {
            if ((tmp += dp[j]) >= MOD) tmp -= MOD;
        }
        if ((ans += tmp) >= MOD) ans -= MOD;

        while (dp[a[i]] >= MOD) dp[a[i]] -= MOD;
    }

//BZOJ4906.cpp
/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define MAXN 100319

struct Mat {
    LL dp[4][4];
    Mat () {}
    Mat (int a, int b, int c) {
        memset(dp, 0, sizeof dp);
        dp[0][0] = a;
        dp[1][1] = b;
        dp[2][2] = c;
        dp[3][3] = a;
        register int i, j, k, l;
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            for (j = i; j < 4; j++) {
                for (k = i; k <= j; k++) {
                    for (l = k; l <= j; l++) {
                        dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[k][l]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    LL *operator [] (const unsigned x) const {
        return (LL*)dp[x];
    }
    Mat operator + (const Mat &a) const {
        Mat ret;
        memset(ret.dp, 0, sizeof(ret.dp));
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = i; j < 4; j++)
                for (int k = j; k < 4; k++)
                    ret[i][k] = max(ret[i][k], dp[i][j] + a[j][k]);
        return ret;
    }
    Mat operator * (const int a) const {
        Mat ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = dp[i][j] * a;
            }
        return ret;
    }
};

struct Node {
    Node *c[2], *fa;
    Mat v, s;
    LL siz;
    int val;
    inline bool d() {
        return this == fa->c[1];
    }
    inline void setc(Node *cc, int p) {
        c[p] = cc;
        cc->fa = this;
    }
    inline void upd() {
        s = c[0]->s + (v * val) + c[1]->s;
        siz = c[0]->siz + c[1]->siz + val;

        //	printf("%lld\n", s[0][3]);
    }
} mem[MAXN * 4], *ptr = mem, Tnull, *null = &Tnull, *rt;

inline Node *newNode(Mat v = Mat(0, 0, 0), int x = 0) {
    ptr->v = v;
    ptr->s = ptr->v * x;
    ptr->siz = ptr->val = x;
    ptr->fa = ptr->c[0] = ptr->c[1] = null;
    return ptr++;
}

inline void rot(Node *x) {
    Node *fa = x->fa;
    bool d = x->d();
    fa->fa->setc(x, fa->d());
    fa->setc(x->c[!d], d);
    x->setc(fa, !d);
    fa->upd();
    if (fa == rt) rt = x;
}

inline void splay(Node *x, Node *fa = null) {
    while (x->fa != fa) {
        if (x->fa->fa == fa) rot(x);
        else x->d() == x->fa->d() ? (rot(x->fa), rot(x)) : (rot(x), rot(x));
    }
    x->upd();
}

inline void get(LL k) {
    Node *x = rt;
    for ( ; ; ) {
        if (x->c[0]->siz > k) x = x->c[0];
        else if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val < k) {
            k -= x->c[0]->siz + x->val;
            x = x->c[1];
        } else {
            if (x->c[0]->siz + x->val == k) {
                splay(x);
                Node *y = x->c[1];
                while (y->c[0] != null) y = y->c[0];
                splay(y, x);
            } else {
                k -= x->c[0]->siz;
                splay(x);
                Node *y = newNode(x->v, x->val - int(k));
                y->setc(x->c[1], 1);
                x->setc(y, 1);
                x->val = int(k);
                y->upd();
                x->upd();
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

int n;

int main() {
    read(n);
    rt = newNode();
    rt->setc(newNode(Mat(0, 0, 0), 1), 1);
    LL nowans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        LL p;
        int a, b, c, x;
        read(p);
        read(a);
        read(b);
        read(c);
        read(x);
        get(p);
        rt->c[1]->setc(newNode(Mat(a, b, c), x), 0);
        rt->c[1]->upd();
        rt->upd();
        printf("%lld\n", rt->s.dp[0][3] - nowans);
        nowans = rt->s.dp[0][3];
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Never Say Die */
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
typedef double D;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp(a, b) make_pair(a, b)
#define fir first
#define sec second
inline int min(int a, int b) {
    return a < b ? a : b;
}
inline int max(int a, int b) {
    return a > b ? a : b;
}
int ch = 0;
template <class T> inline void read(T &a) {
    bool f = 0;
    a = 0;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = 1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        a = a * 10 + ch - '0';
        ch = getchar();
    }
    if (f) a = -a;
}

#define INF 0x3f3f3f3f

struct Ha {
    int len, pre, nxt;
    bool operator < (const Ha &a) const {
        if (nxt - pre >= 0 && a.nxt - a.pre < 0) return 1;
        if (nxt - pre < 0 && a.nxt - a.pre >= 0) return 0;
        if (nxt - pre >= 0) return pre < a.pre;
        else return nxt > a.nxt;
    }
} a[305];

int n, dp[90005];
char s[305];

int main() {
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof dp);
    dp[0] = 0;
    read(n);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf("%s", s + 1);
        a[i].len = (int)strlen(s + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= a[i].len; j++) {
            if (s[j] == ')') {
                if (a[i].nxt) a[i].nxt--;
                else a[i].pre++;
            } else a[i].nxt++;
        }
    }
    sort(a + 1, a + n + 1);
    int tot = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        int delta = a[i].nxt - a[i].pre;
        if (delta <= 0) {
            for (int j = a[i].pre; j <= tot; j++) if (~dp[j]) dp[j + delta] = max(dp[j + delta], dp[j] + a[i].len);
        } else {
            for (int j = tot; j >= a[i].pre; j--) if (~dp[j]) dp[j + delta] = max(dp[j + delta], dp[j] + a[i].len);
            tot += delta;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", dp[0]);
    return 0;
}
